-- ONE FILE: Studio > Play with R6 > select Client > paste into Command Bar.
-- No server script, RemoteEvent, executor APIs, or `script` object required.
-- Paste again to replace this controller. Stop Play to reset local world edits.
-- Java-derived movement and HumanoidModel pose equations; Roblox collision,
-- camera, and Motor6D evaluation still have engine-specific differences.
-- Startup fix: no module imports; original R6 body joints stay connected.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
-- Launch lock: a second copy started while the first is still loading (queue_on_teleport plus auto-execute after a
-- server hop) stops here, before anything waits on the web.
do
    local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
    local launch = rawget(env, "SteveLaunch")
    if type(launch) == "table" and not launch.done and os.clock() - (launch.t or 0) < 20 then
        warn("Steve: the script is already starting; this second copy stops.")
        return
    end
    rawset(env, "SteveLaunch", {t = os.clock(), done = false})
end
local DEVELOPER_TAGS = {
    Error101_s = {"Script Developer", Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)},
    Snapshot_Rush = {"Script Developer", Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)},
    Error_Code1034 = {"Texture/Audio Creator", Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 255)},
}
-- Online features (Game Menu: Servers, Report Players, Reports).
local STEVE_ONLINE = {
    -- Ban list: a raw text file you host and edit (GitHub raw / Pastebin raw link). One ban per line:
    --   Username 2026-12-31 reason       (banned until the end of that day)
    --   Username forever reason
    BanListUrl = "",
    -- ntfy.sh channels for the Servers list and player reports (anyone who knows these names can read them).
    PresenceTopic = "steve-mc-presence-7q2x9k4f",
    ReportsTopic = "steve-mc-reports-7q2x9k4f",
    -- Script files (in the executor's workspace folder) run again after joining someone's server.
    AutoExecuteFiles = {"Minecraft Steve.luau", "Minecraft Steve.obfuscated.luau", "SteveDev/steve.luau"},
    -- This build's ID: after a teleport the copy with the same ID is run (an older saved copy would load an old version).
    Build = "20261106-162722",
    -- Automatic bans: a textdb.online entry the script reads and writes (Reports > Ban / Bans > Unban).
    BanStore = "steve_mc_bans_7q2x9k4f",
}
-- Tester access gate: run before input handlers and world initialization.
do
    local testers = {
        [string.lower("RobloxStudioPIayer")] = true,
        [string.lower("Error101_s")] = true,
        [string.lower("Error_Code1034")] = true,
        [string.lower("Snapshot_Rush")] = true,
        [string.lower("bljidk83")] = true,
        [string.lower("Playmobilstantion10")] = true,
        [string.lower("odigunamevop4169")] = true,
        [string.lower("JonSenseiPro")] = true,
        [string.lower("NoahTheEpicDude2155")] = true,
        [string.lower("Hjhjhjhhhhhhhd")] = true,
        [string.lower("Hitmeforgamepass")] = true,
        [string.lower("FlintHealer8075")] = true,
    }
    -- the moderation commands read it (testers may /kick)
    STEVE_ONLINE.Testers = testers
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    while not player do
        Players:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalPlayer"):Wait()
        player = Players.LocalPlayer
    end
    local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local previous = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SteveTesterAccess")
    if previous then previous:Destroy() end
    -- Check the account username, not its display name.
    if not testers[string.lower(player.Name)] then
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name = "SteveTesterAccess"
        gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        gui.DisplayOrder = 10000
        local backdrop = Instance.new("Frame")
        backdrop.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        backdrop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22)
        backdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
        backdrop.BorderSizePixel = 0
        backdrop.Active = true
        backdrop.Parent = gui
        local message = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        message.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        message.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        message.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.85, 0.25)
        message.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        message.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        message.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        message.Text = "sorry bud but your not a Tester"
        message.TextScaled = true
        message.TextWrapped = true
        message.Parent = backdrop
        local textSize = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
        textSize.MinTextSize = 12
        textSize.MaxTextSize = 32
        textSize.Parent = message
        gui.Parent = playerGui
        return
    end
end
-- Bans (STEVE_ONLINE.BanListUrl): a banned player gets this screen instead of the script.
do
    local url = STEVE_ONLINE.BanListUrl
    local req = request or http_request
    local banned
    if url ~= "" and req then
        local ok, res = pcall(req, {Url = url .. (url:find("?", 1, true) and "&" or "?") .. "t=" .. os.time(), Method = "GET"})
        if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.StatusCode == 200 and type(res.Body) == "string" then
            local me = string.lower(Players.LocalPlayer.Name)
            for line in res.Body:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
                local name, untilText, reason = line:match("^%s*([%w_]+)%s+(%S+)%s*(.*)$")
                if name and name:lower() == me then
                    local u = untilText:lower()
                    if u == "forever" or u == "permanent" then banned = {untilText = "forever", reason = reason}
                    else
                        local y, mo, d = untilText:match("^(%d+)%-(%d+)%-(%d+)$")
                        if y and os.time() <= os.time({year = tonumber(y), month = tonumber(mo), day = tonumber(d), hour = 23, min = 59, sec = 59}) then
                            banned = {untilText = untilText, reason = reason}
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if banned then
        local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SteveBanned"); if old then old:Destroy() end
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.IgnoreGuiInset, gui.DisplayOrder = "SteveBanned", false, true, 10000
        local backdrop = Instance.new("Frame")
        backdrop.Size, backdrop.BackgroundColor3, backdrop.BackgroundTransparency, backdrop.BorderSizePixel, backdrop.Active = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22), 0.1, 0, true
        backdrop.Parent = gui
        local message = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        message.AnchorPoint, message.Position, message.Size, message.BackgroundTransparency = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.85, 0.35), 1
        message.Font, message.TextColor3, message.TextScaled, message.TextWrapped = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 85), true, true
        message.Text = "You are banned from the Minecraft script\n" .. (banned.untilText == "forever" and "Permanently" or ("Until " .. banned.untilText))
            .. ((banned.reason or "") ~= "" and ("\nReason: " .. banned.reason) or "")
        message.Parent = backdrop
        local limit = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint"); limit.MinTextSize, limit.MaxTextSize = 12, 30; limit.Parent = message
        gui.Parent = playerGui
        return
    end
end
-- Automatic bans (STEVE_ONLINE.BanStore): {"v":1,"bans":[{n=name,u=userId,e=expiry (0 = forever),r=reason,by=dev,t=time}]}.
local SteveBans = {}
do
    local HS = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local function req() return request or http_request end
    local function url() return "https://textdb.online/" .. STEVE_ONLINE.BanStore end
    function SteveBans.fetch()
        local r = req()
        if not r then return nil end
        local ok, res = pcall(r, {Url = url() .. "?t=" .. os.time() .. math.random(1000, 9999), Method = "GET"})
        if not (ok and type(res) == "table" and res.StatusCode == 200) then return nil end
        local body = tostring(res.Body or "")
        if body == "" then return {v = 1, bans = {}} end
        local ok2, data = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, body)
        if ok2 and type(data) == "table" and type(data.bans) == "table" then return data end
        return {v = 1, bans = {}}
    end
    function SteveBans.active(list)
        local out = {}
        for _, b in ipairs(list and list.bans or {}) do
            if type(b) == "table" and not b.k and (tonumber(b.e) == 0 or (tonumber(b.e) or 0) > os.time()) then out[#out + 1] = b end
        end
        return out
    end
    function SteveBans.find(list, player)
        for _, b in ipairs(SteveBans.active(list)) do
            if tonumber(b.u) == player.UserId or string.lower(tostring(b.n)) == string.lower(player.Name) then return b end
        end
    end
    function SteveBans.save(list)
        local r = req()
        if not r then return false end
        -- expired bans and kicks are dropped
        local kept = SteveBans.active(list)
        for _, b in ipairs(list.bans or {}) do
            if type(b) == "table" and b.k and (tonumber(b.e) or 0) > os.time() then kept[#kept + 1] = b end
        end
        list.bans = kept
        local ok, res = pcall(r, {Url = "https://textdb.online/update/?key=" .. STEVE_ONLINE.BanStore .. "&value=" .. HS:UrlEncode(HS:JSONEncode(list)), Method = "GET"})
        return ok and type(res) == "table" and res.StatusCode == 200
    end
    function SteveBans.ban(name, userId, days, reason, by)
        local list = SteveBans.fetch()
        if not list then return false end
        local kept = {}
        for _, b in ipairs(list.bans) do if string.lower(tostring(b.n)) ~= string.lower(name) then kept[#kept + 1] = b end end
        kept[#kept + 1] = {n = name, u = userId, e = days == "forever" and 0 or (os.time() + days * 86400), r = reason or "", by = by, t = os.time()}
        list.bans = kept
        return SteveBans.save(list)
    end
    function SteveBans.unban(name)
        local list = SteveBans.fetch()
        if not list then return false end
        local kept = {}
        for _, b in ipairs(list.bans) do if string.lower(tostring(b.n)) ~= string.lower(name) then kept[#kept + 1] = b end end
        list.bans = kept
        return SteveBans.save(list)
    end
    -- only accounts with a developer tag may ban, unban or kick
    function SteveBans.isDev(name) return DEVELOPER_TAGS[tostring(name)] ~= nil end
    -- testers (the tester list) and developers may kick; nobody else may ban or kick
    function SteveBans.isTester(name)
        return SteveBans.isDev(name) or (STEVE_ONLINE.Testers ~= nil and STEVE_ONLINE.Testers[string.lower(tostring(name))] == true)
    end
    -- a kick: the player is disconnected the next time their script checks (within 15 s); it lasts 3 minutes so a player
    -- who rejoins after it is not kicked again
    function SteveBans.kick(name, userId, reason, by)
        local list = SteveBans.fetch()
        if not list then return false end
        local kept = {}
        for _, b in ipairs(list.bans) do
            if not (b.k and string.lower(tostring(b.n)) == string.lower(name)) then kept[#kept + 1] = b end
        end
        kept[#kept + 1] = {n = name, u = userId, k = true, e = os.time() + 180, t = os.time(), r = reason or "", by = by}
        list.bans = kept
        return SteveBans.save(list)
    end
    function SteveBans.findKick(list, player, since)
        for _, b in ipairs(list and list.bans or {}) do
            if type(b) == "table" and b.k and (tonumber(b.e) or 0) > os.time() and (tonumber(b.t) or 0) >= since
                and (tonumber(b.u) == player.UserId or string.lower(tostring(b.n)) == string.lower(player.Name)) then return b end
        end
    end
    function SteveBans.disconnect(text)
        pcall(function() Players.LocalPlayer:Kick(text) end)
    end
    function SteveBans.banText(b)
        return "You are banned from the Minecraft script\n" .. SteveBans.untilText(b) .. ((tostring(b.r or "") ~= "") and ("\nReason: " .. tostring(b.r)) or "")
    end
    function SteveBans.untilText(b)
        if tonumber(b.e) == 0 then return "Permanently" end
        return "Until " .. os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tonumber(b.e) or 0)
    end
    function SteveBans.screen(b)
        local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SteveBanned"); if old then old:Destroy() end
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.IgnoreGuiInset, gui.DisplayOrder = "SteveBanned", false, true, 10000
        local backdrop = Instance.new("Frame")
        backdrop.Size, backdrop.BackgroundColor3, backdrop.BackgroundTransparency, backdrop.BorderSizePixel, backdrop.Active = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22), 0.1, 0, true
        backdrop.Parent = gui
        local message = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        message.AnchorPoint, message.Position, message.Size, message.BackgroundTransparency = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.85, 0.35), 1
        message.Font, message.TextColor3, message.TextScaled, message.TextWrapped = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 85), true, true
        message.Text = "You are banned from the Minecraft script\n" .. SteveBans.untilText(b) .. ((tostring(b.r or "") ~= "") and ("\nReason: " .. tostring(b.r)) or "")
        message.Parent = backdrop
        local limit = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint"); limit.MinTextSize, limit.MaxTextSize = 12, 30; limit.Parent = message
        -- Click anywhere to close the screen (the script stays off).
        local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
        close.Size, close.BackgroundTransparency, close.Text = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 1, ""
        close.Parent = backdrop
        close.Activated:Connect(function() gui:Destroy() end)
        gui.Parent = playerGui
    end
    local ban = SteveBans.find(SteveBans.fetch(), Players.LocalPlayer)
    if ban then SteveBans.screen(ban); task.delay(3, function() SteveBans.disconnect(SteveBans.banText(ban)) end); return end
    local started = os.time()
    local token = {}
    rawset(_G, "SteveModerationToken", token)
    task.spawn(function()
        while rawget(_G, "SteveModerationToken") == token do
            task.wait(15)
            local okF, list = pcall(SteveBans.fetch)
            if okF and list then
                local b = SteveBans.find(list, Players.LocalPlayer)
                if b then
                    pcall(SteveBans.screen, b)
                    task.wait(2)
                    SteveBans.disconnect(SteveBans.banText(b))
                    break
                end
                local k = SteveBans.findKick(list, Players.LocalPlayer, started)
                if k then
                    SteveBans.disconnect("You were kicked from the Minecraft script by " .. tostring(k.by or "a developer")
                        .. ((tostring(k.r or "") ~= "") and (": " .. tostring(k.r)) or ""))
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end
-- Java's LoadingOverlay (the Mojang Studios screen) while the script decodes its built-in assets: the
-- logo (gui/title/mojangstudios.png, top half drawn left, bottom half right), the progress bar 0.8325 down
-- the screen, and the 1 s fade-out once the game runs smoothly again.
local SteveBoot = {}
do
    local MOJANG_LOGO = ""
    local gui, logos, bar, target, shown, finishing, started, fadeStart = nil, {}, {}, 0, 0, false, os.clock(), nil
    local lastYield, smooth = 0, 0
    local function logoContent()
        local ok, content = pcall(function()
            local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
            local map = {}
            for i = 1, 64 do map[alphabet:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
            local n = #MOJANG_LOGO
            local raw = buffer.create(math.floor(n * 3 / 4))
            local o = 0
            for i = 1, n, 4 do
                local a, b, c, d = MOJANG_LOGO:byte(i, i + 3)
                local v = map[a] * 262144 + map[b] * 4096 + (map[c] or 0) * 64 + (map[d] or 0)
                buffer.writeu8(raw, o, math.floor(v / 65536) % 256); o = o + 1
                if c ~= 61 then buffer.writeu8(raw, o, math.floor(v / 256) % 256); o = o + 1 end
                if d ~= 61 then buffer.writeu8(raw, o, v % 256); o = o + 1 end
            end
            -- White pixels; the RLE carries the alpha (16 levels) in runs of up to 255 pixels.
            local pixels = buffer.create(512 * 512 * 4)
            buffer.fill(pixels, 0, 255)
            local p = 0
            for i = 0, o - 2, 2 do
                local alpha, run = buffer.readu8(raw, i) * 17, buffer.readu8(raw, i + 1)
                if alpha ~= 255 then for k = 0, run - 1 do buffer.writeu8(pixels, (p + k) * 4 + 3, alpha) end end
                p = p + run
            end
            local image = game:GetService("AssetService"):CreateEditableImage({Size = Vector2.new(512, 512)})
            image:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Vector2.new(512, 512), pixels)
            return Content.fromObject(image)
        end)
        return ok and content or nil
    end
    local function frame(parent, color)
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.BorderSizePixel, f.BackgroundColor3 = 0, color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        f.Parent = parent
        return f
    end
    local function layout()
        if not gui then return end
        local size = gui.AbsoluteSize
        local W, H = math.max(size.X, 1), math.max(size.Y, 1)
        -- Java's automatic GUI scale.
        local sc = 1
        while W >= 320 * (sc + 1) and H >= 240 * (sc + 1) do sc = sc + 1 end
        local gw, gh = W / sc, H / sc
        local d = math.min(gw * 0.75, gh) * 0.25
        local o, e = math.floor(d * 0.5), d * 4
        local p = math.floor(e * 0.5)
        local cx, cy = math.floor(gw * 0.5), math.floor(gh * 0.5)
        for i, logo in ipairs(logos) do
            logo.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((cx - (i == 1 and p or 0)) * sc, (cy - o) * sc)
            logo.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(p * sc, math.floor(d) * sc)
        end
        local q = math.floor(gh * 0.8325)
        local x0, x1, y0, y1 = math.floor(gw / 2) - p, math.floor(gw / 2) + p, q - 5, q + 5
        local function put(f, a, b, c, dd) f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(a * sc, b * sc); f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(0, c - a) * sc, math.max(0, dd - b) * sc) end
        put(bar[1], x0 + 1, y0, x1 - 1, y0 + 1)
        put(bar[2], x0 + 1, y1 - 1, x1 - 1, y1)
        put(bar[3], x0, y0, x0 + 1, y1)
        put(bar[4], x1 - 1, y0, x1, y1)
        put(bar[5], x0 + 2, y0 + 2, x0 + math.ceil((x1 - x0 - 2) * shown), y1 - 2)
    end
    local function alpha(a)
        gui.Background.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - a
        for _, logo in ipairs(logos) do
            if logo:IsA("ImageLabel") then logo.ImageTransparency = 1 - a else logo.TextTransparency = 1 - a end
        end
        for _, f in ipairs(bar) do f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - a end
    end
    function SteveBoot.show()
        local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        local playerGui = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if not playerGui or gui then return end
        local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SteveLoading")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.IgnoreGuiInset, gui.DisplayOrder = "SteveLoading", false, true, 1000000
        local background = frame(gui, Color3.fromRGB(239, 50, 61))
        background.Name, background.Size, background.Active = "Background", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), true
        local content = logoContent()
        for i = 1, 2 do
            local logo
            if content then
                logo = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                logo.BackgroundTransparency, logo.ImageContent = 1, content
                logo.ImageRectOffset, logo.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(0, (i - 1) * 256), Vector2.new(512, 256)
            else
                logo = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                logo.BackgroundTransparency, logo.Text, logo.TextScaled = 1, i == 1 and "MOJANG" or "STUDIOS", true
                logo.Font, logo.TextColor3 = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            end
            logo.Parent = background
            logos[i] = logo
        end
        for i = 1, 5 do bar[i] = frame(background) end
        gui.Parent = playerGui
        layout()
        local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
        local connection
        connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if not gui or not gui.Parent then connection:Disconnect(); return end
            -- LoadingOverlay: currentProgress = currentProgress * 0.95 + actual * 0.05 (per frame at 60 fps).
            shown = math.clamp(shown + (target - shown) * math.min(1, dt * 3), 0, 1)
            if finishing then
                -- The game is running again once a few frames in a row come quickly.
                smooth = dt < 0.05 and smooth + 1 or 0
                if not fadeStart and smooth >= 3 then fadeStart = os.clock(); shown = 1 end
            end
            if os.clock() - started > 60 and not fadeStart then fadeStart = os.clock() end
            layout()
            if fadeStart then
                local a = 1 - (os.clock() - fadeStart)
                if a <= 0 then connection:Disconnect(); gui:Destroy(); gui = nil; return end
                alpha(a)
            end
        end)
    end
    -- Progress 0..1; yields a frame now and then so the screen can draw (only where yielding is allowed).
    function SteveBoot.progress(fraction)
        if target < fraction then target = fraction end
        if gui and os.clock() - lastYield > 0.05 and coroutine.isyieldable() then
            lastYield = os.clock()
            task.wait()
            lastYield = os.clock()
        end
    end
    function SteveBoot.finish()
        target, finishing = 1, true
    end
end
pcall(SteveBoot.show)
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
-- Input: UserInputService, plus virtual input from the touch controls (the same handlers see both).
local MinecraftSounds -- real Minecraft sounds (set up below, before the controller)
local VirtualInput = {keys = {}, mouse = {}, delta = Vector2.zero, location = nil,
    handlers = {InputBegan = {}, InputEnded = {}, InputChanged = {}}, actions = {}}
local Input, Actions
do
    local real = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local realActions = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
    local function signal(name)
        return {Connect = function(_, fn)
            local connection = real[name]:Connect(fn)
            local list = VirtualInput.handlers[name]
            list[#list + 1] = fn
            return {Connected = true, Disconnect = function(self)
                self.Connected = false
                connection:Disconnect()
                for i, f in ipairs(list) do if f == fn then table.remove(list, i); break end end
            end}
        end}
    end
    -- Methods are set before the metatable (its __newindex writes through to UserInputService).
    Input = {InputBegan = signal("InputBegan"), InputEnded = signal("InputEnded"), InputChanged = signal("InputChanged")}
    function Input:IsKeyDown(key) return VirtualInput.keys[key] == true or real:IsKeyDown(key) end
    -- With touch controls on, Roblox's touch-as-mouse emulation is ignored (any finger, even on the
    -- joystick, would otherwise turn the camera or count as a mouse press).
    function Input:IsMouseButtonPressed(button)
        if VirtualInput.mouse[button] == true then return true end
        if VirtualInput.touchOnly then return false end
        return real:IsMouseButtonPressed(button)
    end
    function Input:GetMouseDelta()
        local d = VirtualInput.delta
        VirtualInput.delta = Vector2.zero
        if VirtualInput.touchOnly then return d end
        return real:GetMouseDelta() + d
    end
    function Input:GetMouseLocation() return VirtualInput.location or real:GetMouseLocation() end
    setmetatable(Input, {
        __index = function(_, k)
            local v = real[k]
            if type(v) == "function" then return function(_, ...) return v(real, ...) end end
            return v
        end,
        __newindex = function(_, k, v) real[k] = v end})
    Actions = setmetatable({}, {__index = function(_, k)
        local v = realActions[k]
        if type(v) == "function" then return function(_, ...) return v(realActions, ...) end end
        return v
    end})
    function Actions:BindActionAtPriority(name, fn, touchButton, priority, ...)
        VirtualInput.actions[name] = {fn = fn, priority = priority or 0, inputs = {...}}
        return realActions:BindActionAtPriority(name, fn, touchButton, priority, ...)
    end
    function Actions:BindAction(name, fn, touchButton, ...)
        VirtualInput.actions[name] = {fn = fn, priority = 0, inputs = {...}}
        return realActions:BindAction(name, fn, touchButton, ...)
    end
    function Actions:UnbindAction(name)
        VirtualInput.actions[name] = nil
        return realActions:UnbindAction(name)
    end
    -- A virtual key or mouse button: bound actions first (highest priority; Sink stops it), then
    -- every InputBegan / InputEnded listener with gameProcessed = sunk, as Roblox does.
    function VirtualInput.press(keyCode, inputType, down)
        local state = down and Enum.UserInputState.Begin or Enum.UserInputState.End
        local location = VirtualInput.location or real:GetMouseLocation()
        local input = {KeyCode = keyCode or Enum.KeyCode.Unknown, UserInputType = inputType or Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard, UserInputState = state,
            Position = Vector3.new(location.X, location.Y, 0), Delta = Vector3.zero}
        local list = {}
        for name, a in pairs(VirtualInput.actions) do
            for _, i in ipairs(a.inputs) do
                if i == input.KeyCode or i == input.UserInputType then list[#list + 1] = {name, a}; break end
            end
        end
        table.sort(list, function(x, y) return x[2].priority > y[2].priority end)
        local sunk = false
        for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
            local ok, result = pcall(entry[2].fn, entry[1], state, input)
            if ok and result ~= Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass then sunk = true; break end
        end
        for _, fn in ipairs(table.clone(VirtualInput.handlers[down and "InputBegan" or "InputEnded"])) do
            local ok, e = pcall(fn, input, sunk)
            if not ok then warn("Steve touch input: " .. tostring(e)) end
        end
    end
    function VirtualInput.key(keyCode, down)
        if (VirtualInput.keys[keyCode] == true) == down then return end
        VirtualInput.keys[keyCode] = down or nil
        VirtualInput.press(keyCode, Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard, down)
    end
    function VirtualInput.button(inputType, down)
        if (VirtualInput.mouse[inputType] == true) == down then return end
        VirtualInput.mouse[inputType] = down or nil
        VirtualInput.press(nil, inputType, down)
    end
    function VirtualInput.releaseAll()
        for k in pairs(VirtualInput.keys) do VirtualInput.key(k, false) end
        for b in pairs(VirtualInput.mouse) do VirtualInput.button(b, false) end
        VirtualInput.location = nil
    end
end
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
-- Events for other scripts (The Verity Script): _G.SteveEventListeners[name] = function(kind, data).
local function steveEmit(kind, data)
    local listeners = rawget(_G, "SteveEventListeners")
    if type(listeners) ~= "table" then return end
    for _, fn in pairs(listeners) do
        if type(fn) == "function" then
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok, e = pcall(fn, kind, data)
                if not ok then warn("Steve event listener: " .. tostring(e)) end
            end)
        end
    end
end

-- Live player attributes and status-effect modifiers (written by /attribute, /effect, potions;
-- read by the movement, jump, gravity and mining equations below).
local PlayerStats = {movementSpeed = 0.1, sneakingSpeed = 0.3, jumpStrength = 0.41999998688697815, jumpBoost = 0,
    gravity = 0.08, levitation = nil, slowFalling = false, digMultiplier = 1, attackBonus = 0, attackMultiplier = 1,
    noclip = false, adventure = false, spectator = false, xpLevel = 0, xpProgress = 0, xpTotal = 0}
-- BEGIN PURE MATH (also exercised by tests/controller.spec.lua)
local function wrapAngle(angle)
    return (angle + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
end
local function approachAngle(current, target, alpha)
    return wrapAngle(current + wrapAngle(target - current) * alpha)
end
local function clamp(value, low, high)
    return math.max(low, math.min(high, value))
end
local function lerp(a, b, t)
    return a + (b - a) * t
end
local function rotLerpRad(t, current, target)
    return current + wrapAngle(target - current) * t
end
local function easeOutQuart(value)
    local inverse = 1 - value
    return 1 - inverse * inverse * inverse * inverse
end
local function horizontalTick(vx, vz, ix, iz, grounded, sprint, crouch, slipperiness)
    local length = math.sqrt(ix * ix + iz * iz)
    -- Normalize before sneaking, so diagonal sneak is not faster.
    if length > 1 then ix, iz = ix / length, iz / length end
    local friction = grounded and slipperiness * 0.91 or 0.91
    -- Modern 1.21 LivingEntity.travel: ground acceleration is speed *
    -- 0.21600002 / friction^3; air acceleration is speed * 0.1.
    local movementSpeed, sprintMultiplier, sneakMultiplier = PlayerStats.movementSpeed, 1.3, PlayerStats.sneakingSpeed
    -- LivingEntity.getFrictionInfluencedSpeed(): blocks with slipperiness
    -- above 0.6 use the 0.21600002 scaling; ordinary/slower blocks keep the
    -- base movement speed.
    local acceleration = grounded
        and (slipperiness > 0.6
            and movementSpeed * 0.21600002 / (slipperiness * slipperiness * slipperiness)
            or movementSpeed)
        or movementSpeed * 0.1
    if sprint then acceleration = acceleration * sprintMultiplier end
    if crouch then acceleration = acceleration * sneakMultiplier end
    -- Player.tick() damps xxa/zza by 0.98 before LivingEntity.travel.
    ix, iz = ix * 0.98, iz * 0.98
    -- Java applies friction after moveRelative, with no frame-rate-dependent term.
    return vx * friction + ix * acceleration, vz * friction + iz * acceleration
end
local function verticalTick(vy)
    -- LivingEntity.travel(): Levitation replaces gravity; Slow Falling caps it at 0.01 while falling.
    if PlayerStats.levitation then return (vy + (0.05 * PlayerStats.levitation - vy) * 0.2) * 0.98 end
    local gravity = PlayerStats.gravity
    if PlayerStats.slowFalling and vy <= 0 then gravity = math.min(gravity, 0.01) end
    return (vy - gravity) * 0.98
end
local function javaDestroyProgress(speed, hardness, harvestable, inWater, grounded)
    if hardness<0 then return 0 end
    if hardness==0 then return 1 end
    speed = speed * PlayerStats.digMultiplier -- Haste, Mining Fatigue, block_break_speed
    if inWater then speed = speed * 0.2 end
    if not grounded then speed = speed * 0.2 end
    return speed / math.max(0.05, hardness) / (harvestable and 30 or 100)
end
local function snapGrid(value, origin, size)
    return origin + math.floor((value - origin) / size + 0.5) * size
end
local function placementCenter(tx, ty, tz, sx, sy, sz, nx, ny, nz, size, ox, oy, oz, existingBlock, hx, hy, hz)
    local cx, cy, cz
    if existingBlock then
        -- Preserve the clicked block's lattice, even if its first block was
        -- placed flush to a wall/floor with a non-grid-aligned surface.
        return tx + nx * (sx + size) / 2, ty + ny * (sy + size) / 2, tz + nz * (sz + size) / 2
    else
        -- Start at the actual hit point, then add half a voxel. Keep the
        -- face-normal coordinate flush with arbitrary Roblox
        -- geometry; snap only the two lateral coordinates. Snapping the face
        -- coordinate too can put a first block inside a half-stud baseplate.
        local faceX, faceY, faceZ = hx or tx, hy or ty, hz or tz
        cx = faceX + nx * size * 0.5
        cy = faceY + ny * size * 0.5
        cz = faceZ + nz * size * 0.5
        if math.abs(nx) < 0.5 then cx = snapGrid(cx, ox, size) end
        if math.abs(ny) < 0.5 then cy = snapGrid(cy, oy, size) end
        if math.abs(nz) < 0.5 then cz = snapGrid(cz, oz, size) end
        return cx, cy, cz
    end
    return snapGrid(cx, ox, size), snapGrid(cy, oy, size), snapGrid(cz, oz, size)
end
-- BEGIN VOXEL MATH
local function dominantFace(x, y, z)
    local ax, ay, az = math.abs(x), math.abs(y), math.abs(z)
    if ax >= ay and ax >= az then return x >= 0 and 1 or -1, 0, 0 end
    if ay >= az then return 0, y >= 0 and 1 or -1, 0 end
    return 0, 0, z >= 0 and 1 or -1
end
-- Six plane cuts: retain the outside slab, pass the inside to the next plane.
-- Boxes are {minX,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ}. No overlapping fragments.
local function sixSlabs(bounds, cube)
    local inside, outside = {}, {}
    for i = 1, 6 do inside[i] = bounds[i] end
    for axis = 1, 3 do
        if bounds[axis + 3] <= cube[axis] or bounds[axis] >= cube[axis + 3] then
            return {bounds}, nil
        end
    end
    for axis = 1, 3 do
        for side = 1, 2 do
            local split = side == 1 and cube[axis] or cube[axis + 3]
            local edge = side == 1 and axis or axis + 3
            if (side == 1 and inside[edge] < split) or (side == 2 and inside[edge] > split) then
                local slab = {}
                for i = 1, 6 do slab[i] = inside[i] end
                slab[side == 1 and axis + 3 or axis] = split
                inside[edge] = split
                outside[#outside + 1] = slab
            end
        end
    end
    return outside, inside
end
-- END VOXEL MATH
-- Java's HumanoidModel space is Roblox model space with X and Y flipped
-- (Java renders entity models with scale(-1, -1, 1)). Converting a ModelPart
-- therefore negates its x/y pivot and its xRot/yRot, keeps zRot, and keeps
-- Java's Z-Y-X rotation order. Arguments are Java pixels and radians; the
-- last two are the box centre relative to the pivot, also in Java pixels.
local function javaPart(pixel, px, py, pz, xRot, yRot, zRot, cx, cy)
    return CFrame.new(-px * pixel, -py * pixel, pz * pixel)
        * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, zRot) * CFrame.Angles(0, -yRot, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-xRot, 0, 0)
        * CFrame.new(-cx * pixel, -cy * pixel, 0)
end
-- END PURE MATH

local function toolMining(item, kind, handHarvestable)
    local tool = toolStats[item]
    local effective = tool and ((tool.kind == "shovel" and (kind == "Dirt" or kind == "Grass"))
        or (tool.kind == "axe" and (kind == "Wood Planks" or kind == "Oak Log"))
        or (tool.kind == "pickaxe" and (kind == "Stone" or kind == "Diamond Ore" or kind == "Diamond Block")))
    -- Stone is tier 1: it mines diamond-bearing blocks faster, but cannot harvest them.
    local harvestable = handHarvestable or (tool and tool.kind == "pickaxe" and kind == "Stone")
    return effective and 4 or 1, harvestable == true
end

local function texture(part, ids)
    if ids.javaSkin or ids.javaBlock then return JavaContent.paint(part,ids) end
    for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") then child:Destroy() end
    end
    for i, face in ipairs(faces) do
        local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
        decal.Name = "SteveSkin" .. face.Name
        decal.Face = face
        decal.Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(ids[i] or ids[1])
        decal.Parent = part
    end
end
local function motor(name, parent, child, c0, c1)
    local joint = Instance.new("Motor6D")
    joint.Name, joint.Part0, joint.Part1 = name, parent, child
    joint.C0, joint.C1 = c0, c1
    joint.Parent = parent
    return joint
end
-- BEGIN RIG HELPERS (tested without a Roblox runtime)
local function inspectRig(character, pairsToFind)
    local found = {}
    for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("Motor6D") then
            for key, parts in pairs(pairsToFind) do
                if object.Part0 == parts[1] and object.Part1 == parts[2] then
                    if found[key] or object.Enabled == false then
                        return nil, "duplicate or disabled " .. key .. " joint"
                    end
                    found[key] = object
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for key in pairs(pairsToFind) do
        if not found[key] then return nil, "missing " .. key .. " joint" end
    end
    if found.neck.Name ~= "Neck" then return nil, "original Neck has already been replaced" end
    return found
end
local function poseExistingJoint(joint, c0, c1, saved)
    if not saved[joint] then
        saved[joint] = {C0 = joint.C0, C1 = joint.C1, Transform = joint.Transform}
    end
    -- Never change Name, Parent, Part0, Part1 or Enabled on a living body joint.
    joint.C0, joint.C1, joint.Transform = c0, c1, CFrame.identity
    return joint
end
local function restoreJointPoses(saved)
    for joint, properties in pairs(saved) do
        if joint.Parent then
            joint.C0, joint.C1, joint.Transform = properties.C0, properties.C1, properties.Transform
        end
    end
end
-- END RIG HELPERS
-- BEGIN R15 BODY
-- The local Steve body (R15 and R6 alike): six client parts on the HumanoidRootPart with
-- their own joints, the real body parts hidden locally. The real joints are never touched,
-- so a missing Neck can never kill the avatar, and the animations other players see (the
-- game's or REPLICATION's) never bend the local Steve.
local function createR15Body(character, root)
    local model = Instance.new("Model")
    model.Name = "SteveBody"
    local parts = {}
    for _, name in ipairs({"Torso", "Head", "Left Arm", "Right Arm", "Left Leg", "Right Leg"}) do
        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Name, part.Size, part.CFrame = name, Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), root.CFrame
        part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.Massless = false, false, false, true
        part.Parent = model
        parts[name] = part
    end
    local function joint(name, part0, part1)
        local motor6D = Instance.new("Motor6D")
        motor6D.Name, motor6D.Part0, motor6D.Part1 = name, part0, part1
        motor6D.Parent = model
        return motor6D
    end
    local torso = parts.Torso
    local rig = {
        root = joint("SteveRoot", root, torso), neck = joint("SteveNeck", torso, parts.Head),
        ls = joint("SteveLeftShoulder", torso, parts["Left Arm"]), rs = joint("SteveRightShoulder", torso, parts["Right Arm"]),
        lh = joint("SteveLeftHip", torso, parts["Left Leg"]), rh = joint("SteveRightHip", torso, parts["Right Leg"]),
    }
    -- Accessories are hidden by the controller itself; this hides the body
    -- meshes and face. They also stop colliding, so only the solver moves us.
    local hidden = {}
    for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if not object:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") then
            if object:IsA("BasePart") and object ~= root then
                hidden[object] = {Transparency = object.Transparency, CanCollide = object.CanCollide,
                    Massless = object.Massless, LocalTransparencyModifier = object.LocalTransparencyModifier}
                object.Transparency, object.CanCollide, object.Massless = 1, false, true
            elseif object:IsA("Decal") then
                hidden[object] = {Transparency = object.Transparency}
                object.Transparency = 1
            end
        end
    end
    model.Parent = character
    local body = {parts = parts, rig = rig}
    -- R6 feet are the leg length below the hips (HipHeight 0); R15's HipHeight already spans its legs.
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local realLeg = character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
    body.legHeight = (humanoid and humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and realLeg) and realLeg.Size.Y or 0
    -- Java never draws your own name tag; the hidden real head would float it at Steve's chin.
    local displayType = humanoid and humanoid.DisplayDistanceType
    if humanoid then humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None end
    function body.restore()
        model:Destroy()
        if humanoid and displayType then humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = displayType end
        for object, properties in pairs(hidden) do
            if object.Parent then for key, value in pairs(properties) do object[key] = value end end
        end
    end
    return body
end
-- END R15 BODY

-- Input is handled directly by ContextActionService/UserInputService below.
-- Do not import PlayerModule: some client runtimes cannot resolve it.
-- Some clients lose PlayerScripts; the runtime marker then lives in PlayerGui (Folders survive respawn).
local playerScripts = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerScripts") or player:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts", 3)
    or player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local previous = playerScripts:FindFirstChild("SteveClientRuntime")
if previous then
    local stopPrevious = previous:FindFirstChild("Stop")
    if not stopPrevious or not stopPrevious:IsA("BindableEvent") then
        warn("Steve: unexpected SteveClientRuntime object; stop Play and restart.")
        return
    end
    stopPrevious:Fire()
    local deadline = os.clock() + 3
    while previous.Parent and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait() end
    if previous.Parent then warn("Steve: previous controller could not stop; restart Play."); return end
end
local runtime = Instance.new("Folder")
runtime.Name, runtime.Parent = "SteveClientRuntime", playerScripts
local stopEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
stopEvent.Name, stopEvent.Parent = "Stop", runtime
local sessionConnections, stopped = {}, false
local localBlocks = workspace:FindFirstChild("SteveLocalBlocks")
if not localBlocks then
    localBlocks = Instance.new("Folder")
    localBlocks.Name, localBlocks.Parent = "SteveLocalBlocks", workspace
end
-- BEGIN JAVA DATA
local function loadJavaCatalog()
    -- Lossless local asset data; this decoder performs no imports or requests.
    local encoded=[==[]==]
    local alphabet='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    local values={};for i=1,#alphabet do values[alphabet:sub(i,i)]=i-1 end
    local binary={}
    for i=1,#encoded,4 do
        if i%40000==1 then SteveBoot.progress(0.45*i/#encoded) end
        local a,b,c,d=encoded:sub(i,i),encoded:sub(i+1,i+1),encoded:sub(i+2,i+2),encoded:sub(i+3,i+3)
        local value=values[a]*262144+values[b]*4096+(values[c] or 0)*64+(values[d] or 0)
        local chunk=string.char(math.floor(value/65536)%256)
        if c~='=' then chunk=chunk..string.char(math.floor(value/256)%256) end
        if d~='=' then chunk=chunk..string.char(value%256) end
        binary[#binary+1]=chunk
    end
    binary=table.concat(binary)
    local dict,nextCode,previous={},257,nil
    local output={}
    for i=0,255 do dict[i]=string.char(i) end
    for i=1,#binary,2 do
        if i%40000==1 then SteveBoot.progress(0.45+0.4*i/#binary) end
        local code=string.byte(binary,i)*256+string.byte(binary,i+1)
        if code==256 then
            dict={};for j=0,255 do dict[j]=string.char(j) end
            nextCode,previous=257,nil
        else
            local entry=dict[code] or (code==nextCode and previous and previous..previous:sub(1,1))
            assert(entry,'Corrupt embedded block catalog')
            output[#output+1]=entry
            if previous then dict[nextCode]=previous..entry:sub(1,1);nextCode=nextCode+1 end
            previous=entry
        end
    end
    SteveBoot.progress(0.85)
    return game:GetService('HttpService'):JSONDecode(table.concat(output))
end

-- END JAVA DATA
-- BEGIN SURVIVAL RULES
local SurvivalRules={}
-- Java evaluates ray strength and the initial direction in IEEE-754 float32.
local floatBuffer=buffer and buffer.create(4)
local function javaFloat(value)
    if floatBuffer then buffer.writef32(floatBuffer,0,value);return buffer.readf32(floatBuffer,0) end
    return (string.unpack('f',string.pack('f',value))) -- offline Lua regression runner
end
local blastDirections={}
for ix=0,15 do for iy=0,15 do for iz=0,15 do
    if ix==0 or ix==15 or iy==0 or iy==15 or iz==0 or iz==15 then
        local function component(i)return javaFloat(javaFloat(javaFloat(i/15)*2)-1) end
        local x,y,z=component(ix),component(iy),component(iz);local length=math.sqrt(x*x+y*y+z*z)
        blastDirections[#blastDirections+1]={x/length*javaFloat(.3),y/length*javaFloat(.3),z/length*javaFloat(.3)}
    end
end end end
function SurvivalRules.explosion(x,y,z,power,sample,random)
    local cells,seen={},{};random=random or math.random
    for _,direction in ipairs(blastDirections) do
        local strength=javaFloat(power*javaFloat(javaFloat(.7)+javaFloat(javaFloat(random())*javaFloat(.6))))
        local px,py,pz=x,y,z
        while strength>0 do
            local cx,cy,cz=math.floor(px),math.floor(py),math.floor(pz)
            local block=sample(cx,cy,cz)
            if block then strength=javaFloat(strength-javaFloat(javaFloat((block.resistance or 0)+javaFloat(.3))*javaFloat(.3))) end
            if strength>0 and block and not block.unbreakable then
                local key=cx..','..cy..','..cz
                if not seen[key] then cells[#cells+1]={x=cx,y=cy,z=cz,block=block};seen[key]=true end
            end
            px,py,pz=px+direction[1],py+direction[2],pz+direction[3]
            strength=javaFloat(strength-javaFloat(.22500001))
        end
    end
    return cells
end
function SurvivalRules.explosionDamage(distance,exposure,power)
    local impact=math.max(0,1-distance/(power*2))*exposure
    return math.floor((impact*impact+impact)/2*7*(power*2)+1),impact
end
-- PortalShape: empty interior 2..21 wide, 3..21 high; corners are optional.
function SurvivalRules.portal(get,axis)
    local function block(x,y) return axis=='x' and get(x,y,0) or get(0,y,x) end
    local function empty(id)return not id or id=='air' or id=='fire' or id=='nether_portal' end
    if not empty(block(0,0)) then return end
    local bottom=0
    while bottom>-21 and empty(block(0,bottom-1)) do bottom=bottom-1 end
    if block(0,bottom-1)~='obsidian' then return end
    local left=0
    while left>-21 and empty(block(left-1,bottom)) and block(left-1,bottom-1)=='obsidian' do left=left-1 end
    if block(left-1,bottom)~='obsidian' then return end
    local width=0
    while width<=21 and empty(block(left+width,bottom)) and block(left+width,bottom-1)=='obsidian' do width=width+1 end
    if width<2 or width>21 or block(left+width,bottom)~='obsidian' then return end
    for height=0,21 do
        local top=true
        for x=left,left+width-1 do if block(x,bottom+height)~='obsidian' then top=false;break end end
        if top then if height>=3 then return {axis=axis,left=left,bottom=bottom,width=width,height=height} end;return end
        if height==21 or block(left-1,bottom+height)~='obsidian' or block(left+width,bottom+height)~='obsidian' then return end
        for x=left,left+width-1 do if not empty(block(x,bottom+height)) then return end end
    end
end
function SurvivalRules.lid(previous,open) return math.max(0,math.min(1,previous+(open and .1 or -.1))) end
-- END SURVIVAL RULES

-- BEGIN CREATIVE RULES
-- Pure local inventory / block rules. No Roblox state is accessed here.
local CreativeRules = {}
function CreativeRules.copy(t) local r={}; for k,v in pairs(t or {}) do r[k]=v end; return r end
-- Item stacks are {id,count,damage} plus optional data components (enchantments, potion, name,
-- patterns, pages...). Stacks merge only when everything except the count matches (ItemStack.isSameItemSameComponents).
local stackBase={id=true,count=true,damage=true}
local function deepCopy(v) if type(v)~='table' then return v end local r={}; for k,x in pairs(v) do r[k]=deepCopy(x) end; return r end
local function componentKey(v)
    if type(v)~='table' then return tostring(v) end
    local keys={}; for k in pairs(v) do keys[#keys+1]=k end
    table.sort(keys,function(a,b) return tostring(a)<tostring(b) end)
    local out={}; for _,k in ipairs(keys) do out[#out+1]=tostring(k)..'='..componentKey(v[k]) end
    return '{'..table.concat(out,',')..'}'
end
function CreativeRules.hasComponents(s) for k in pairs(s) do if not stackBase[k] then return true end end return false end
function CreativeRules.componentKey(s)
    local c; for k,v in pairs(s) do if not stackBase[k] then c=c or {}; c[k]=v end end
    return c and componentKey(c) or ''
end
function CreativeRules.sameItem(a,b)
    if not (a and b and a.id==b.id and (a.damage or 0)==(b.damage or 0)) then return false end
    if not CreativeRules.hasComponents(a) and not CreativeRules.hasComponents(b) then return true end
    return CreativeRules.componentKey(a)==CreativeRules.componentKey(b)
end
-- A copy of a stack (with all its components) holding n items.
function CreativeRules.withCount(s,n) local r=deepCopy(s); r.count=n; return r end
function CreativeRules.inventory()
    local inv={slots={},cursor=nil}
    local function maxStack(id) return itemStackLimits[id] or ((itemStackLimits[id] or (toolStats[id] and 1 or 64))) end
    function inv.add(id,count,range,damage,template)
        local original=count
        range=range or {1,36}
        local probe=template or {id=id,damage=damage}
        for i=range[1],range[2] do
            local s=inv.slots[i]
            if s and s.id==id and (template and CreativeRules.sameItem(s,template) or not template and not CreativeRules.hasComponents(s)) then
                local n=math.max(0,math.min(count,maxStack(id)-s.count)); s.count=s.count+n; count=count-n
            end
        end
        for i=range[1],range[2] do
            if count<=0 then break end
            if not inv.slots[i] then local n=math.min(count,maxStack(id)); inv.slots[i]=template and CreativeRules.withCount(template,n) or {id=id,count=n,damage=damage}; count=count-n end
        end
        return original-count
    end
    function inv.catalog(id,shift,middle,right,template)
        -- CreativeModeInventoryScreen.slotClicked: ordinary catalog pickup is
        -- one item; Shift or middle-click copies a full stack onto the cursor.
        local c=inv.cursor
        local function make(n) return template and CreativeRules.withCount(template,n) or {id=id,count=n} end
        if middle then if not c then inv.cursor=make(maxStack(id)) end; return end
        if c then
            if (template and CreativeRules.sameItem(c,template)) or (not template and c.id==id and not CreativeRules.hasComponents(c)) then c.count=right and c.count-1 or shift and maxStack(id) or math.min(maxStack(id),c.count+1)
            elseif right then c.count=c.count-1
            else inv.cursor=nil; return end
            if c.count<=0 then inv.cursor=nil end
        else inv.cursor=make(shift and maxStack(id) or 1) end
    end
    function inv.gather()
        local c=inv.cursor; if not c then return end
        for i=1,36 do
            local s=inv.slots[i]
            if s and CreativeRules.sameItem(s,c) then
                local n=math.min(s.count,maxStack(c.id)-c.count)
                c.count=c.count+n; s.count=s.count-n
                if s.count==0 then inv.slots[i]=nil end
            end
        end
    end
    function inv.click(index,right,shift)
        local s,c=inv.slots[index],inv.cursor
        if shift and s then
            local n=inv.add(s.id,s.count,index<=9 and {10,36} or {1,9},s.damage,s)
            s.count=s.count-n; if s.count==0 then inv.slots[index]=nil end
        elseif not c then
            if s then
                local n=right and math.ceil(s.count/2) or s.count
                inv.cursor=CreativeRules.withCount(s,n); s.count=s.count-n
                if s.count==0 then inv.slots[index]=nil end
            end
        elseif not s or CreativeRules.sameItem(s,c) then
            local n=math.min(right and 1 or c.count,maxStack(c.id)-(s and s.count or 0))
            if n>0 then inv.slots[index]=CreativeRules.withCount(c,(s and s.count or 0)+n); c.count=c.count-n end
            if c.count==0 then inv.cursor=nil end
        else inv.slots[index],inv.cursor=c,s end
    end
    function inv.spread(indices,right)
        local c=inv.cursor; if not c then return end
        local valid,seen={},{}
        for _,i in ipairs(indices) do
            local s=inv.slots[i]
            if not seen[i] and (not s or (CreativeRules.sameItem(s,c) and s.count<maxStack(c.id))) then valid[#valid+1]=i; seen[i]=true end
        end
        if #valid==0 then return end
        local each=right and 1 or math.floor(c.count/#valid)
        for _,i in ipairs(valid) do
            local s=inv.slots[i]; local n=math.min(each,c.count,maxStack(c.id)-(s and s.count or 0))
            if n>0 then inv.slots[i]=CreativeRules.withCount(c,(s and s.count or 0)+n); c.count=c.count-n end
        end
        if c.count==0 then inv.cursor=nil end
    end
    function inv.take(index,all)
        local s=inv.slots[index]; if not s then return end
        local n=all and s.count or 1; local result=CreativeRules.withCount(s,n)
        s.count=s.count-n; if s.count==0 then inv.slots[index]=nil end
        return result
    end
    function inv.swap(a,b) inv.slots[a],inv.slots[b]=inv.slots[b],inv.slots[a] end
    return inv
end
local materialBlocks={grass='grass_block',leafygrass='grass_block',ground='dirt',mud='mud',sand='sand',
    sandstone='sandstone',snow='snow_block',ice='ice',glacier='packed_ice',wood='oak_log',woodplanks='oak_planks',
    rock='stone',slate='deepslate',basalt='basalt',limestone='calcite',concrete='stone',brick='bricks',
    cobblestone='cobblestone',pavement='stone_bricks',asphalt='black_concrete',salt='diorite',glass='glass',
    metal='iron_block',corrodedmetal='copper_block',diamondplate='iron_block',foil='iron_block',
    fabric='white_wool',neon='glowstone',water='water'}
function CreativeRules.classify(names,material,known,explicit)
    local function normalize(s) return tostring(s or ''):gsub('(%l)(%u)','%1_%2'):lower():gsub('minecraft:',''):gsub('[^a-z0-9]+','_'):gsub('^_',''):gsub('_$','') end
    local aliases={grass='grass_block',wood='oak_planks',wood_planks='oak_planks',log='oak_log',leaves='oak_leaves',
        rock='stone',soil='dirt',ground='dirt',snow='snow_block',brick='bricks',stone_shovel='stone_shovel'}
    for _,value in ipairs(explicit or {}) do
        local id=normalize(value); id=aliases[id] or id
        if known[id] then return id end
    end
    for _,name in ipairs(names) do
        local n=normalize(name):gsub('_?%d+$',''); local id=aliases[n] or n
        if known[id] then return id end
        local best
        for candidate in pairs(known) do
            if ('_'..n..'_'):find('_'..candidate..'_',1,true) and (not best or #candidate>#best) then best=candidate end
        end
        if best then return best end
        for alias,target in pairs(aliases) do
            if known[target] and ('_'..n..'_'):find('_'..alias..'_',1,true) then return target end
        end
        for _,wood in ipairs({'dark_oak','pale_oak','oak','spruce','birch','jungle','acacia','cherry','mangrove'}) do
            if n:find(wood,1,true) and (n:find('tree',1,true) or n:find('trunk',1,true)) and known[wood..'_log'] then return wood..'_log' end
        end
        if n:find('terrain',1,true) or n:find('part',1,true) or n:find('mesh',1,true) or n=='model' then
            -- Generic exporter names carry no material information.
        elseif n:find('soil',1,true) or n:find('ground',1,true) then return 'dirt' end
    end
    local id=materialBlocks[normalize(material):gsub('_','')] or 'stone'
    return known[id] and id or 'stone'
end
CreativeRules.directions={north={0,0,-1},east={1,0,0},south={0,0,1},west={-1,0,0},up={0,1,0},down={0,-1,0}}
CreativeRules.opposite={north='south',south='north',east='west',west='east',up='down',down='up'}
CreativeRules.left={north='west',west='south',south='east',east='north'}
function CreativeRules.stairShape(state,neighbor)
    local facing=state.facing; local opposite=CreativeRules.opposite
    local function same(n) return n and n.id:match('_stairs$') and n.state.half==state.half end
    local function differentSide(direction)
        local n=neighbor(direction)
        return not same(n) or n.state.facing~=facing
    end
    local front=neighbor(facing)
    if same(front) and front.state.facing~=facing and front.state.facing~=opposite[facing] and differentSide(opposite[front.state.facing]) then
        return front.state.facing==CreativeRules.left[facing] and 'outer_left' or 'outer_right'
    end
    local rear=neighbor(opposite[facing])
    if same(rear) and rear.state.facing~=facing and rear.state.facing~=opposite[facing] and differentSide(rear.state.facing) then
        return rear.state.facing==CreativeRules.left[facing] and 'inner_left' or 'inner_right'
    end
    return 'straight'
end
function CreativeRules.matches(condition,state)
    if condition.OR then for _,c in ipairs(condition.OR) do if CreativeRules.matches(c,state) then return true end end; return false end
    if condition.AND then for _,c in ipairs(condition.AND) do if not CreativeRules.matches(c,state) then return false end end; return true end
    for k,v in pairs(condition) do
        local valid=false
        for value in tostring(v):gmatch('[^|]+') do if tostring(state[k])==value then valid=true end end
        if not valid then return false end
    end
    return true
end
function CreativeRules.modelSpecs(entry,state)
    local result={}; local data=entry.models
    for _,v in ipairs(data.variants or data.multipart or {}) do
        if CreativeRules.matches(v[1],state) then result[#result+1]=v[2]; if data.variants then break end end
    end
    if #result==0 and data.variants then result[1]=data.variants[1][2] end
    return result
end
-- Blocks that react to power (they look through map blocks for it).
function CreativeRules.redstoneConsumer(id)
    return id=='redstone_wire' or id=='redstone_torch' or id=='redstone_wall_torch' or id=='repeater' or id=='comparator'
        or id=='redstone_lamp' or id=='tnt' or id=='piston' or id=='sticky_piston' or id=='note_block' or id=='dispenser'
        or id=='dropper' or id=='hopper' or id=='observer' or id=='powered_rail' or id=='activator_rail' or id=='bell'
        or id:match('_door$') or id:match('_trapdoor$') or id:match('_fence_gate$') or id:match('copper_bulb$') or id=='crafter'
        or id=='wave_maker' or id=='clutch' or id=='gearshift' or id=='adjustable_chain_gearshift'
end
-- Signals are rebuilt from sources every tick, so a dust loop cannot power
-- itself after its source is removed. Devices schedule transitions in game ticks.
function CreativeRules.redstone(nodes,neighbor,tick,mapCell)
    local opposite=CreativeRules.opposite
    local mapPower
    local function output(n,dir)
        if not n then return 0 end
        if n.id=='redstone_block' then return 15 end
        if n.id=='trapped_chest' then return n.output or 0 end
        if n.id=='daylight_detector' then return tonumber(n.state.power) or 0 end
        if n.signalDir then return n.signalDir[dir] or n.signal or 0 end
        if n.signal then return n.signal end
        if n.id=='sculk_sensor' or n.id=='calibrated_sculk_sensor' then return n.sensorPower or 0 end
        if n.id=='detector_rail' then return n.output or 0 end
        if n.id=='lever' or n.id:match('_button$') or n.id:match('pressure_plate$') then return n.state.powered=='true' and 15 or tonumber(n.state.power) or 0 end
        if n.id=='redstone_torch' or n.id=='redstone_wall_torch' then
            local attached=n.id=='redstone_wall_torch' and opposite[n.state.facing] or 'down'
            return (n.state.lit=='false' or dir==attached) and 0 or 15
        end
        if n.id=='repeater' or n.id=='comparator' or n.id=='observer' then return dir==opposite[n.state.facing] and (n.output or 0) or 0 end
        return 0
    end
    local function input(n,dir,includeDust)
        local other=neighbor(n,dir); if not other then return 0 end
        if includeDust and other.id=='redstone_wire' then
            local out=opposite[dir]
            return (out=='down' or (out~='up' and other.state[out] and other.state[out]~='none')) and (other.power or 0) or 0
        end
        return output(other,opposite[dir])
    end
    local function strong(other,dir,includeDust)
        if not other then return 0 end
        if other.strongDir and other.strongDir[dir] then return other.strongDir[dir] end
        local id,state=other.id,other.state
        if id=='redstone_wire' then
            return includeDust and (dir=='down' or (dir~='up' and state[dir] and state[dir]~='none')) and (other.power or 0) or 0
        end
        if id=='redstone_torch' or id=='redstone_wall_torch' then return dir=='up' and output(other,dir) or 0 end
        if id=='lever' or id:match('_button$') then
            local attached=state.face=='wall' and opposite[state.facing] or state.face=='ceiling' and 'up' or 'down'
            return dir==attached and output(other,dir) or 0
        end
        if id:match('pressure_plate$') or id=='sculk_sensor' or id=='calibrated_sculk_sensor' or id=='detector_rail' or id=='lectern' then return dir=='down' and output(other,dir) or 0 end
        if id=='repeater' or id=='comparator' or id=='observer' then return output(other,dir) end
        return 0
    end
    -- Power held by a solid map cell next to n (in direction dir): the strongest source around it.
    mapPower=function(n,dir,includeDust)
        local around=mapCell and mapCell(n,dir)
        if not around then return 0 end
        local p=0
        for _,a in ipairs(around) do p=math.max(p,strong(a[1],a[2],includeDust)) end
        return p
    end
    for _,n in ipairs(nodes) do
        n.oldPower=n.power or 0; n.power=0
        if n.release and tick>=n.release then n.state.powered='false'; n.release=nil end
    end
    -- Direct sources strongly power adjacent solid blocks. Dust reads that
    -- block once; arbitrary chains of ordinary blocks do not conduct.
    for _,n in ipairs(nodes) do
        n.strong=0
        if n.solid then for dir in pairs(CreativeRules.directions) do n.strong=math.max(n.strong,strong(neighbor(n,dir),opposite[dir],false)) end end
    end
    for _,n in ipairs(nodes) do if n.id=='redstone_wire' then
        for dir in pairs(CreativeRules.directions) do
            local other=neighbor(n,dir)
            n.power=math.max(n.power,input(n,dir,false),other and other.strong or (not other and dir~='up' and mapPower(n,dir,false)) or 0)
        end
    end end
    local queue,head={},1
    for _,n in ipairs(nodes) do if n.id=='redstone_wire' and n.power>0 then queue[#queue+1]=n end end
    while head<=#queue do
        local n=queue[head];head=head+1
        for _,other in ipairs(n.wireNeighbors or {}) do
            local power=n.power-1
            if power>(other.power or 0) then other.power=power;queue[#queue+1]=other end
        end
    end
    for _,n in ipairs(nodes) do
        if n.solid then for dir in pairs(CreativeRules.directions) do n.strong=math.max(n.strong,strong(neighbor(n,dir),opposite[dir],true)) end end
    end
    for _,n in ipairs(nodes) do
        local id,state=n.id,n.state
        n.input=0;n.received={}
        local consumer=CreativeRules.redstoneConsumer(id)
        for dir in pairs(CreativeRules.directions) do
            local other=neighbor(n,dir)
            n.received[dir]=math.max(input(n,dir,true),other and other.strong or (not other and consumer and mapPower(n,dir,true)) or 0)
            n.input=math.max(n.input,n.received[dir])
        end
        if id=='redstone_wire' then state.power=tostring(n.power)
        elseif id=='repeater' or id=='comparator' then
            local facing=state.facing or 'north'; local left=CreativeRules.left[facing]
            local rear=input(n,facing,true)
            local back=neighbor(n,facing)
            rear=math.max(rear,back and back.strong or (not back and mapPower(n,facing,true)) or 0)
            if id=='comparator' and back and back.comparatorStrength then rear=back.comparatorStrength end
            local side=math.max(input(n,left,true),input(n,opposite[left],true))
            local locked=false
            if id=='repeater' then
                for _,dir in ipairs({left,opposite[left]}) do
                    local other=neighbor(n,dir)
                    if other and (other.id=='repeater' or other.id=='comparator') and input(n,dir,false)>0 then locked=true end
                end
                state.locked=tostring(locked)
            end
            local wanted=id=='repeater' and (rear>0 and 15 or 0) or (state.mode=='subtract' and math.max(0,rear-side) or (rear>=side and rear or 0))
            if locked then n.pending=nil
            elseif wanted~=(n.output or 0) then
                if not n.pending or n.pending.value~=wanted then n.pending={value=wanted,due=tick+(id=='repeater' and 2*(tonumber(state.delay) or 1) or 2)} end
            else n.pending=nil end
            if n.pending and tick>=n.pending.due then n.output=n.pending.value; n.pending=nil end
            state.powered=tostring((n.output or 0)>0)
        elseif id=='redstone_torch' or id=='redstone_wall_torch' then
            local attach=id=='redstone_wall_torch' and opposite[state.facing] or 'down'
            local support=neighbor(n,attach)
            local powered=support and math.max(support.strong or 0,output(support,opposite[attach])) or mapPower(n,attach,true)
            local wanted=powered==0 and (not n.burnoutUntil or tick>=n.burnoutUntil)
            if wanted~=(state.lit~='false') then
                if not n.pending or n.pending.value~=wanted then n.pending={value=wanted,due=tick+2} end
            else n.pending=nil end
            if n.pending and tick>=n.pending.due then
                state.lit=tostring(n.pending.value);n.pending=nil
                if state.lit=='false' then
                    n.toggles=n.toggles or {};n.toggles[#n.toggles+1]=tick
                    while n.toggles[1] and tick-n.toggles[1]>60 do table.remove(n.toggles,1) end
                    if #n.toggles>=8 then n.burnoutUntil=tick+160 end
                end
            end
        elseif id=='redstone_lamp' then
            if n.input>0 then state.lit='true'; n.offAt=nil
            elseif state.lit=='true' then n.offAt=n.offAt or tick+4; if tick>=n.offAt then state.lit='false' end end
        elseif id:match('_door$') or id:match('_trapdoor$') or id:match('_fence_gate$') then
            if n.input>0 then state.powered,state.open='true','true'
            elseif state.powered=='true' then state.powered,state.open='false','false' end
        end
    end
end

-- END CREATIVE RULES
-- BEGIN JAVA CONTENT
-- Loaded once per controller run; generated assets are read only when R6 setup succeeds.
JavaContent = {itemFrames={},itemById={},byId={},byIndex={},byName={},known={},textureCache={},animated=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})}
function JavaContent.initialize()
    if JavaContent.data then return end
    if JavaContent.loadingData then while not JavaContent.data do task.wait() end return end
    JavaContent.loadingData=true
    JavaContent.data=loadJavaCatalog()
    SteveBoot.progress(0.9)
    for _,sprite in ipairs(JavaContent.data.textures) do
        for i=1,#sprite.d,2 do if sprite.d:sub(i,i+1)=='00' then sprite.transparent=true;break end end
    end
    for _,sprite in ipairs(JavaContent.data.textures) do
        for _,alpha in ipairs(sprite.alpha or {}) do if alpha<1 then sprite.transparent=true;break end end
    end
    local aliases={dirt=1,grass_block=2,stone=3,diamond_ore=4,diamond_block=5,oak_planks=6,oak_log=7,stone_shovel=8,stone_axe=9,stone_pickaxe=10}
    for _,entry in ipairs(JavaContent.data.blocks) do
        local index=aliases[entry.id] or (#blockNames+1)
        local previousName=blockNames[index]
        blockNames[index]=entry.name
        entry.index=index
        JavaContent.byId[entry.id],JavaContent.byIndex[index],JavaContent.known[entry.id]=entry,entry,true
        JavaContent.byName[entry.name]=entry
        itemStackLimits[index]=entry.maxStack or (entry.stats and 1 or 64)
        if entry.obtainable~=false then JavaContent.itemById[entry.itemId or entry.id]=entry end
        if entry.itemOnly then toolStats[index]=entry.stats else blockTextures[index]={javaBlock=index} end
        local name=entry.id
        local wood=name:find('planks',1,true) or name:find('log',1,true) or name:find('wood',1,true) or name:find('bamboo',1,true)
        local earth=name:find('dirt',1,true) or name:find('grass',1,true) or name:find('sand',1,true) or name:find('snow',1,true) or name:find('mud',1,true)
        blockStats[entry.name]=blockStats[entry.name] or blockStats[previousName] or {hardness=wood and 2 or earth and 0.5 or 1.5,harvestable=not not (wood or earth)}
        blockStats[entry.name].harvestable=entry.tool~='pickaxe'
        local hardness={redstone_wire=0,repeater=0,comparator=0,torch=0,redstone_torch=0,redstone_wall_torch=0,lever=.5,glass=.3,obsidian=50,crying_obsidian=50}
        if hardness[name] then blockStats[entry.name].hardness=hardness[name] end
        if name:find('button',1,true) or name:find('pressure_plate',1,true) then blockStats[entry.name].hardness=.5 end
        if name=='bedrock' or name=='barrier' or name:find('command_block',1,true) then blockStats[entry.name].hardness=-1 end
        if entry.hardness~=nil then blockStats[entry.name].hardness=entry.hardness end
    end
    for name,sprite in pairs(JavaContent.iconSprites or {}) do
        local entry=JavaContent.byId[name]
        if entry then entry.icon=sprite end
    end
    -- Apply after the catalog exists, for inventory, hotbar and offhand alike.
    local shieldIcon=JavaContent.iconSprites.shield
    if JavaContent.itemById.shield then JavaContent.itemById.shield.icon=shieldIcon end
    if JavaContent.data.javaGui then JavaContent.data.javaGui["item/shield"]=shieldIcon end
    for name in pairs(skin) do skin[name]={javaSkin=name} end
    JavaContent.addExtraAssets()
    pcall(JavaContent.addVisualFixes)
    SteveBoot.progress(0.95)
end
-- A catalog entry added later (mods): the same registration as the loop above.
function JavaContent.registerEntry(entry)
    if JavaContent.byId[entry.id] then return JavaContent.byId[entry.id] end
    -- Keep source identity for physical properties, including mods registered later.
    entry.physicsNamespace = entry.physicsNamespace or entry.namespace or entry.id:match("^([^:]+):") or entry.mod
    JavaContent.physicsMassRevision = (JavaContent.physicsMassRevision or 0) + 1
    local data=JavaContent.data
    data.blocks[#data.blocks+1]=entry
    local index=#blockNames+1
    blockNames[index]=entry.name
    entry.index=index
    JavaContent.byId[entry.id],JavaContent.byIndex[index],JavaContent.known[entry.id]=entry,entry,true
    JavaContent.byName[entry.name]=entry
    itemStackLimits[index]=entry.maxStack or (entry.stats and 1 or 64)
    if entry.obtainable~=false then JavaContent.itemById[entry.itemId or entry.id]=entry end
    if entry.itemOnly then toolStats[index]=entry.stats else blockTextures[index]={javaBlock=index} end
    blockStats[entry.name]=blockStats[entry.name] or {hardness=entry.hardness or 0,harvestable=true}
    return entry
end
-- Mods (Tab > Mods): every mod starts OFF each time the script loads.
JavaContent.mods = {list = {}, byId = {}}
-- Catalog indices stay stable; availability follows the exact owning mod.
function JavaContent.mods.available(entry)
    if not entry then return false end
    if not entry.mod then return true end
    local mod = JavaContent.mods.byId[entry.mod]
    return mod ~= nil and mod.enabled == true
end
-- A mod may need another one (an addon): it can only be turned on while every mod in mod.requires is on.
function JavaContent.mods.requiresMet(mod)
    for _, id in ipairs(mod and mod.requires or {}) do
        local other = JavaContent.mods.byId[id]
        if not (other and other.enabled) then return false, other and other.name or id end
    end
    return true
end
function JavaContent.mods.changed(id)
    local mods = JavaContent.mods
    local ctx = mods.ctx
    local inv = ctx and ctx.inventory
    local mod = mods.byId[id]
    if inv and mod then
        inv.modStash = inv.modStash or {}
        local stash = inv.modStash[id] or {}
        inv.modStash[id] = stash
        if not mod.enabled then
            local function take(owner, key)
                local stack = owner[key]
                local entry = stack and JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
                if entry and entry.mod == id then
                    stash[#stash+1] = {owner=owner,key=key,stack=stack};owner[key]=nil
                end
            end
            for key in pairs(inv.slots) do take(inv.slots,key) end
            for key in pairs(inv.equipment or {}) do take(inv.equipment,key) end
            take(inv,'cursor')
            if ctx.ui and ctx.ui.kit then
                for key in pairs(ctx.ui.kit.craft.slots) do take(ctx.ui.kit.craft.slots,key) end
            end
        else
            for i=#stash,1,-1 do
                local item=stash[i]
                if item.owner[item.key]==nil then item.owner[item.key]=item.stack;table.remove(stash,i)
                else
                    local count=inv.add(item.stack.id,item.stack.count,nil,item.stack.damage,item.stack)
                    item.stack.count-=count
                    if item.stack.count<=0 then table.remove(stash,i) end
                end
            end
        end
        if ctx.ui then ctx.ui.modsChanged() end
    end
    if ctx and ctx.world and mod and not mod.enabled then
        local world=ctx.world
        for cell,saved in pairs(world.modOriginals or {}) do
            if saved.mod==id then
                world.setBlockAt(saved.center,saved.index,saved.state)
                world.modOriginals[cell]=nil;world.modCells[cell]=nil
            end
        end
    end
    if mods.netChanged then mods.netChanged(id) end
end
-- A mod's own creative tab (Fabric ItemGroup): {key, title, icon = item id, items = {item ids}, mod = mod id}.
function JavaContent.addCreativeTab(tab)
    local tabs = JavaContent.data.creativeTabs
    for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do if t.key == tab.key then return t end end
    tab.mod = tab.mod or true
    -- a tab sorted after another (NeoForge tab ordering: Create Simulated comes right after Create)
    if tab.after then
        for i, t in ipairs(tabs) do
            if t.key == tab.after then table.insert(tabs, i + 1, tab); return tab end
        end
    end
    tabs[#tabs + 1] = tab
    return tab
end
function JavaContent.removeCreativeTab(key)
    local tabs = JavaContent.data.creativeTabs
    for i = #tabs, 1, -1 do if tabs[i].key == key then table.remove(tabs, i) end end
end
function JavaContent.mods.useItem(stack, name, sneaking)
    for _, mod in ipairs(JavaContent.mods.list) do
        if mod.enabled and mod.useItem and mod.useItem(stack, name, sneaking) then return true end
    end
    return false
end
function JavaContent.mods.disableAll()
    for _, mod in ipairs(JavaContent.mods.list) do if mod.enabled or mod.enabling then pcall(mod.disable) end end
end
function JavaContent.mods.onSkill(peer, ...)
    local mod = JavaContent.mods.byId.shooting_star_demo
    if mod and mod.enabled and mod.onNet then mod.onNet(peer, ...) end
end

    -- face rects: the sides run backwards in both directions, up is the (u+d+w, v) square with v reversed.
    local function box(a, b, u, v, w, h, d, tex, lid, skip)
        local faces = {west = {u + d, v + d + h, u, v + d}, north = {u + d + w, v + d + h, u + d, v + d},
            east = {u + 2 * d + w, v + d + h, u + d + w, v + d}, south = {u + 2 * d + 2 * w, v + d + h, u + 2 * d + w, v + d},
            up = {u + d + w, v + d, u + d + 2 * w, v}, down = {u + d, v, u + d + w, v + d}}
        local f = {}
        for name, r in pairs(faces) do
            if name ~= skip then f[name] = {tex, {r[1] / 4, r[2] / 4, r[3] / 4, r[4] / 4}, 0, -1} end
        end
        return {a = a, b = b, lid = lid, f = f}
    end

    local function javaCube(model)
        if not model or model.javaCube then return end

            local f = e.f
            if f.up and f.down then
                local u, d = f.up, f.down
                f.up = {d[1], {d[2][1], d[2][4], d[2][3], d[2][2]}, d[3], d[4]}
                f.down = {u[1], {u[2][1], u[2][2], u[2][3], u[2][4]}, u[3], u[4]}
            end
            for _, side in ipairs({"north", "south", "east", "west"}) do
                local face = f[side]
                if face then f[side] = {face[1], {face[2][3], face[2][4], face[2][1], face[2][2]}, face[3], face[4]} end
            end
        end
    end
