    local HEAD_KIND = {skeleton_skull = "skeleton", skeleton_wall_skull = "skeleton", wither_skeleton_skull = "wither_skeleton",
        wither_skeleton_wall_skull = "wither_skeleton", zombie_head = "zombie", zombie_wall_head = "zombie", creeper_head = "creeper",
        creeper_wall_head = "creeper", player_head = "player", player_wall_head = "player", piglin_head = "piglin",
        piglin_wall_head = "piglin", dragon_head = "dragon", dragon_wall_head = "dragon"}
    -- {x, y, z, w, h, d, u, v, inflate, pivot, {axis, radians}} in the head model's space (y down).
    local MOB_HEAD = {{-4, -8, -4, 8, 8, 8, 0, 0}}
    local HUMANOID_HEAD = {{-4, -8, -4, 8, 8, 8, 0, 0}, {-4, -8, -4, 8, 8, 8, 32, 0, 0.25}}
    local PIGLIN_HEAD = {{-5, -8, -4, 10, 8, 8, 0, 0}, {-2, -4, -5, 4, 4, 1, 31, 1}, {2, -2, -5, 1, 2, 1, 2, 4}, {-3, -2, -5, 1, 2, 1, 2, 0},
        {0, 0, -2, 1, 5, 4, 51, 6, 0, {4.5, -6, 0}, {"z", -math.pi / 6}}, {-1, 0, -2, 1, 5, 4, 39, 6, 0, {-4.5, -6, 0}, {"z", math.pi / 6}}}
    -- DragonHeadModel: head at (0, -7.986666, 0), the jaw a child at (0, 4, -8) opened 0.2 rad; the mesh is scaled 0.75.
    local DRAGON_HEAD = {{-6, -1, -24, 12, 5, 16, 176, 44}, {-8, -8, -10, 16, 16, 16, 112, 30}, {-5, -12, -4, 2, 4, 6, 0, 0},
        {-5, -3, -22, 2, 2, 4, 112, 0}, {3, -12, -4, 2, 4, 6, 0, 0}, {3, -3, -22, 2, 2, 4, 112, 0},
        {-6, 0, -16, 12, 4, 16, 176, 65, 0, {0, 4, -8}, {"x", 0.2}}}
    local function headModel(kind, wall, turn, tex, display)
        local sprite = HEAD_TEXTURES[kind]
        local boxes = (kind == "zombie" or kind == "player") and HUMANOID_HEAD or kind == "piglin" and PIGLIN_HEAD
            or kind == "dragon" and DRAGON_HEAD or MOB_HEAD
        local sc = kind == "dragon" and 0.75 or 1
        local by = kind == "dragon" and -7.986666 or 0
        local yOff, zc = wall and 4 or 0, wall and 12 or 8
        local fu, fv = 16 / sprite.w, 16 / sprite.h
        local elements = {}
        for _, b in ipairs(boxes) do
            local x, y, z, w, h, d, u, v, g, pivot, rot = b[1], b[2], b[3], b[4], b[5], b[6], b[7], b[8], b[9] or 0, b[10], b[11]
            local ox, oy, oz = 0, by, 0
            if pivot then ox, oy, oz = pivot[1], by + pivot[2], pivot[3] end
            local x0, y0, z0 = (ox + x - g) * sc, (oy + y - g) * sc, (oz + z - g) * sc
            local x1, y1, z1 = (ox + x + w + g) * sc, (oy + y + h + g) * sc, (oz + z + d + g) * sc
            local function r(a, bb, c, dd) return {a * fu, bb * fv, c * fu, dd * fv} end
            -- Block-model face rects for a ModelPart.Cube seen through scale(-1, -1, 1): the model's west face is
            -- the world's east face, the model's down face (the (u+d, v) square) the world's top.
            local e = {a = {8 - x1, yOff - y1, zc + z0}, b = {8 - x0, yOff - y0, zc + z1}, f = {
                north = {tex, r(u + d, v + d, u + d + w, v + d + h), 0, -1},
                south = {tex, r(u + 2 * d + w, v + d, u + 2 * d + 2 * w, v + d + h), 0, -1},
                east = {tex, r(u, v + d, u + d, v + d + h), 0, -1},
                west = {tex, r(u + d + w, v + d, u + 2 * d + w, v + d + h), 0, -1},
                up = {tex, r(u + d + w, v + d, u + d, v), 0, -1},
                down = {tex, r(u + d + 2 * w, v, u + d + w, v + d), 0, -1}}}
            if turn ~= 0 then
                e.r = {origin = {8, 0, 8}, axis = "y", angle = -22.5 * turn}
            elseif rot then
                -- A rotation about X changes sign through the flip; about Z it does not.
                e.r = {origin = {8 - ox * sc, yOff - oy * sc, zc + oz * sc}, axis = rot[1], angle = math.deg(rot[1] == "x" and -rot[2] or rot[2])}
            end
            elements[#elements + 1] = e
        end
        return {e = elements, display = display}
    end
    local function addModel(model) JavaContent.data.models[#JavaContent.data.models + 1] = model; return #JavaContent.data.models end
    function JavaContent.addHeadModels()
        local data = JavaContent.data
        local headTex, floorModels = {}, {}
        for _, entry in ipairs(data.blocks) do
            local kind = HEAD_KIND[entry.id]
            local variants = entry.models and entry.models.variants
            if kind and variants and not entry.headModel then
                entry.headModel = true
                if not headTex[kind] then
                    local sprite = HEAD_TEXTURES[kind]
                    sprite.transparent = true
                    data.textures[#data.textures + 1] = sprite
                    headTex[kind] = #data.textures
                end
                -- models/item/template_skull.json
                local display = {gui = {rotation = {30, 45, 0}, translation = {0, 3, 0}, scale = {1, 1, 1}},
                    fixed = {rotation = {0, 180, 0}, translation = {0, 4, 0}, scale = {1, 1, 1}},
                    ground = {rotation = {0, 0, 0}, translation = {0, 3, 0}, scale = {0.5, 0.5, 0.5}},
                    thirdperson_righthand = {rotation = {45, 45, 0}, translation = {0, 3, 0}, scale = {0.5, 0.5, 0.5}},
                    thirdperson_lefthand = {rotation = {45, 45, 0}, translation = {0, 3, 0}, scale = {0.5, 0.5, 0.5}}}
                local wall = entry.id:find("_wall_", 1, true) ~= nil
                local list = {}
                if wall then
                    local m = addModel(headModel(kind, true, 0, headTex[kind], display))
                    for _, f in ipairs({{"north", 0}, {"east", 90}, {"south", 180}, {"west", 270}}) do
                        list[#list + 1] = {{facing = f[1]}, {m = m, x = 0, y = f[2], uv = false}}
                    end
                else
                    floorModels[kind] = floorModels[kind] or {}
                    for turn = 0, 3 do floorModels[kind][turn] = addModel(headModel(kind, false, turn, headTex[kind], display)) end
                    for rot = 0, 15 do
                        list[#list + 1] = {{rotation = tostring(rot)}, {m = floorModels[kind][rot % 4], x = 0, y = 90 * math.floor(rot / 4), uv = false}}
                    end
                    entry.itemModel, entry.iconModel = floorModels[kind][0], floorModels[kind][0]
                end
                entry.models.variants = list
            end
        end
        -- Wall heads drop / show as their floor head.
        for _, entry in ipairs(data.blocks) do
            local kind = HEAD_KIND[entry.id]
            if kind and entry.id:find("_wall_", 1, true) and floorModels[kind] then entry.itemModel = floorModels[kind][0] end
        end
    end
    -- Standing / hanging signs: the catalog's 16 rotation variants were generated one step off (rotation 0 at
    -- -22.5 degrees, rotation 3 back at 0). Rotation r is now r x 22.5 degrees: models by r % 4, y = 90 * floor(r / 4).
    local function fixRotationVariants(entry, data)
        local variants = entry.models and entry.models.variants
        if not variants or #variants ~= 16 or entry.rotationFixed then return end
        local byRot = {}
        for _, pair in ipairs(variants) do if pair[1].rotation then byRot[tonumber(pair[1].rotation)] = pair[2] end end
        if not (byRot[0] and byRot[1] and byRot[2] and byRot[3]) then return end
        local function angleOf(spec)
            local m = data.models[spec.m]
            local e = m and m.e and m.e[1]
            return e and e.r and e.r.axis == "y" and e.r.angle or 0
        end
        if angleOf(byRot[0]) ~= -22.5 or angleOf(byRot[3]) ~= 0 then return end
        entry.rotationFixed = true
        local base = {[0] = byRot[3].m, byRot[0].m, byRot[1].m, byRot[2].m}
        for _, pair in ipairs(variants) do
            local rot = tonumber(pair[1].rotation)
            if rot then pair[2] = {m = base[rot % 4], x = 0, y = 90 * math.floor(rot / 4), uv = false} end
        end
    end

    local function animatedSprite(t)
        local sprite = {}
        for k, v in pairs(t.frames[1]) do sprite[k] = v end
        sprite.frames, sprite.frametime, sprite.sequence = t.frames, t.frametime, t.sequence
        return sprite
    end
    function JavaContent.addFluidTextures()
        local data = JavaContent.data
        for id, t in pairs({water = WATER_STILL, lava = LAVA_STILL}) do
            local entry = JavaContent.byId[id]
            local variants = entry and entry.models and entry.models.variants
            if variants and not entry.animatedFluid then
                entry.animatedFluid = true
                data.textures[#data.textures + 1] = animatedSprite(t)
                local tex = #data.textures
                local copies = {}
                for _, v in ipairs(variants) do
                    local m = v[2].m
                    if not copies[m] and data.models[m] then
                        local copy = {e = {}, display = data.models[m].display}
                        for _, e in ipairs(data.models[m].e) do
                            local ce = {}
                            for k, val in pairs(e) do ce[k] = val end
                            ce.f = {}
                            for name, f in pairs(e.f) do ce.f[name] = {tex, {0, 0, 16, 16}, f[3], f[4], f[5]} end
                            copy.e[#copy.e + 1] = ce
                        end
                        data.models[#data.models + 1] = copy
                        copies[m] = #data.models
                    end
                    if copies[m] then v[2] = {m = copies[m], x = v[2].x, y = v[2].y, uv = v[2].uv} end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function JavaContent.addVisualFixes()
        local data = JavaContent.data
        pcall(JavaContent.addFluidTextures)
        JavaContent.addHeadModels()
        for _, entry in ipairs(data.blocks) do
            if entry.props and entry.props.rotation then fixRotationVariants(entry, data) end
            -- Ender chest: the same ModelPart.Cube UVs as the other chests.
            if entry.id == "ender_chest" and entry.models and entry.models.variants then javaCube(data.models[entry.models.variants[1][2].m]) end
            -- Bed item = the head model plus the foot one block behind it (items/*_bed.json composite).
            if entry.id:match("_bed$") and entry.models and entry.models.variants and not entry.iconModel then
                local head, foot
                for _, v in ipairs(entry.models.variants) do
                    if v[1].facing == "south" or v[1].facing == nil then
                        if v[1].part == "head" then head = v[2].m elseif v[1].part == "foot" then foot = v[2].m end
                    end
                end
                head, foot = head or entry.itemModel, foot
                local hm, fm = data.models[head], foot and data.models[foot]
                if hm and fm then
                    local elements = {}
                    for _, e in ipairs(hm.e) do elements[#elements + 1] = e end
                    for _, e in ipairs(fm.e) do
                        local copy = {}
                        for k, val in pairs(e) do copy[k] = val end
                        copy.a, copy.b = {e.a[1], e.a[2], e.a[3] + 16}, {e.b[1], e.b[2], e.b[3] + 16}
                        if e.r then copy.r = {origin = {e.r.origin[1], e.r.origin[2], e.r.origin[3] + 16}, axis = e.r.axis, angle = e.r.angle, rescale = e.r.rescale} end
                        elements[#elements + 1] = copy
                    end
                    entry.iconModel = addModel({e = elements, display = hm.display})
                end
            end
            -- Beds: the 26.3 block models (the old entity-model path sank them into the ground).
            if entry.id:match("_bed$") then entry.entityModel, entry.entityParts = nil, nil end
            -- The plain bundle's catalog icon was the open bag; Java shows item/bundle outside the selection view.
            if entry.id == "bundle" and data.javaGui["item/bundle"] then entry.icon = data.javaGui["item/bundle"] end
        end
        -- The shield icon: its model rendered at GUI resolution (models/item/shield.json display).
        local shield = JavaContent.byId.shield
        if shield and shield.itemModel and data.models[shield.itemModel] and #data.models[shield.itemModel].e > 0 then shield.iconModel = shield.itemModel end
    end

    -- net.minecraft.util.SpecialDates (local date, like ZonedDateTime.now()).
    JavaContent.SpecialDates = {}
    function JavaContent.SpecialDates.dayNow()
        local forced
        pcall(function() forced = getgenv and getgenv().SteveForceDate end)
        if type(forced) == "string" then
            local mo, d = forced:match("^(%d+)%-(%d+)$")
            if mo then return tonumber(mo), tonumber(d) end
        end
        local now = os.date("*t")
        return now.month, now.day
    end
    function JavaContent.SpecialDates.isHalloween() local mo, d = JavaContent.SpecialDates.dayNow(); return mo == 10 and d == 31 end
    function JavaContent.SpecialDates.isExtendedChristmas() local mo, d = JavaContent.SpecialDates.dayNow(); return mo == 12 and d >= 24 and d <= 26 end
    function JavaContent.addExtraAssets()
        local data = JavaContent.data
        do
            local dust = JavaContent.byId and JavaContent.byId.redstone_wire
            if dust then dust.name = (data.lang and data.lang["item.minecraft.redstone"]) or "Redstone Dust" end
        end
        -- Christmas: chests and trapped chests become presents (ChestRenderer.xmasTextures, items/chest.json local_time).
        if JavaContent.SpecialDates.isExtendedChristmas() and not JavaContent.xmasApplied then
            JavaContent.xmasApplied = true
            CHEST_HALVES.normal = {left = XMAS_CHEST.left, right = XMAS_CHEST.right}
            CHEST_HALVES.trapped = CHEST_HALVES.normal
            for _, id in ipairs({"chest", "trapped_chest"}) do
                local entry = JavaContent.byId and JavaContent.byId[id] or JavaContent.itemById[id]
                if entry then
                    local models = {entry.itemModel}
                    local variants = entry.models and entry.models.variants
                    if variants then for _, v in ipairs(variants) do models[#models + 1] = v[2] and v[2].m end end
                    for _, mi in ipairs(models) do
                        local model = mi and data.models[mi]
                        for _, el in ipairs(model and model.e or {}) do
                            for _, f in pairs(el.f or {}) do
                                local old = data.textures[f[1]]
                                if old and not old.xmas and old.w == 64 and old.h == 64 then
                                    local gift = {w = XMAS_CHEST.single.w, h = XMAS_CHEST.single.h, p = XMAS_CHEST.single.p, d = XMAS_CHEST.single.d, xmas = true}
                                    gift.transparent = old.transparent
                                    data.textures[f[1]] = gift
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    -- the inventory icon is drawn from the (gift) model instead of the pre-rendered chest picture
                    entry.iconModel = entry.itemModel
                    local item = JavaContent.itemById and JavaContent.itemById[id]
                    if item and item ~= entry then item.iconModel = item.itemModel end
                end
            end
        end
        for level, sprite in pairs(LIGHT_SPRITES) do data.javaGui[string.format("item/light_%02d", level)] = sprite end
        for _, entry in ipairs(data.blocks) do
            local base = CHEST_TEXTURE[entry.id] or CHEST_TEXTURE[(entry.id:gsub("^waxed_", ""))]
            local halves = base and CHEST_HALVES[base]
            local variants = entry.models and entry.models.variants
            if base and variants and variants[1] then javaCube(data.models[variants[1][2].m]) end
            if halves and variants and entry.props and entry.props.type and not entry.doubleChest then
                entry.doubleChest = true
                local single = data.models[variants[1][2].m]
                local added = {}
                for _, side in ipairs({"left", "right"}) do
                    local sprite = halves[side]
                    sprite.transparent = true
                    data.textures[#data.textures + 1] = sprite
                    local tex = #data.textures
                    -- LEFT: partner clockwise of facing (west in this south-facing frame): body from x 0, no west face.
                    local xa = side == "left" and -0.05 or 1
                    local xb = side == "left" and 15 or 16.05
                    local la = side == "left" and -0.05 or 15
                    local lb = side == "left" and 1 or 16.05
                    local skip = side == "left" and "west" or "east"
                    data.models[#data.models + 1] = {
                        e = {box({xa, 0, 1}, {xb, 10, 15}, 0, 19, 15, 10, 14, tex, false, skip),
                            box({xa, 9, 1}, {xb, 14, 15}, 0, 0, 15, 5, 14, tex, true, skip),
                            box({la, 7, 15}, {lb, 11, 16}, 0, 0, 1, 4, 1, tex, true, skip)},
                        display = single and single.display}
                    local m = #data.models
                    for _, v in ipairs(variants) do
                        local spec = v[2]
                        added[#added + 1] = {{facing = v[1].facing, type = side}, {m = m, x = spec.x, y = spec.y, uv = spec.uv}}
                    end
                end
                for i, v in ipairs(added) do table.insert(variants, i, v) end
            end
        end
    end
end
-- One EditableImage per (texture, uv, rotation): the same sampling as the pixel path below.
JavaContent.imageCache={}
function JavaContent.spriteImage(sprite,uv,rotation)
    local key=tostring(sprite)..'|'..(uv and table.concat(uv,',') or '')..'|'..tostring(rotation or 0)
    local cached=JavaContent.imageCache[key]
    if cached~=nil then return cached or nil end
    local ok,content=pcall(function()
        local w,h=sprite.w,sprite.h
        local area=uv or {0,0,16,16}
        local turns=math.floor((rotation or 0)/90+.5)
        local image=game:GetService('AssetService'):CreateEditableImage({Size=Vector2.new(w,h)})
        local pixels=buffer.create(w*h*4)
        for y=0,h-1 do for x=0,w-1 do
            local u,v=(x+.5)/w,(y+.5)/h
            for _=1,turns do u,v=v,1-u end
            local tx=math.floor((area[1]+(area[3]-area[1])*u)*w/16)%w
            local ty=math.floor((area[2]+(area[4]-area[2])*v)*h/16)%h
            local at=(ty*w+tx)*2+1
            local c=tonumber(sprite.d:sub(at,at+1),16)
            if c and c>0 then
                local rgb=sprite.p[c];local i=(y*w+x)*4
                buffer.writeu8(pixels,i,math.floor(rgb/65536)%256)
                buffer.writeu8(pixels,i+1,math.floor(rgb/256)%256)
                buffer.writeu8(pixels,i+2,rgb%256)
                buffer.writeu8(pixels,i+3,math.floor((sprite.alpha and sprite.alpha[c] or 1)*255+.5))
            end
        end end
        image:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero,Vector2.new(w,h),pixels)
        return Content.fromObject(image)
    end)
    JavaContent.imageCache[key]=ok and content or false
    return ok and content or nil
end
function JavaContent.sprite(parent,sprite,tint,uv,rotation,pixelsOnly)
    if not pixelsOnly and (parent:IsA('SurfaceGui') or parent:IsA('BillboardGui')) then
        local content=JavaContent.spriteImage(sprite,uv,rotation)
        if content then
            for _,child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA('Frame') then child.Visible=false end end
            local image=parent:FindFirstChild('StevePixelImage')
            if not image then
                image=Instance.new('ImageLabel');image.Name='StevePixelImage'
                image.BackgroundTransparency,image.BorderSizePixel,image.Size=1,0,UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                image.ResampleMode=Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated;image.Parent=parent
            end
            image.ImageContent=content
            image.ImageColor3=tint and Color3.new(math.clamp(tint[1],0,1),math.clamp(tint[2],0,1),math.clamp(tint[3],0,1)) or Color3.new(1,1,1)
            image.ImageTransparency=tint and tint[4] or 0
            return
        end
    end
    local w,h=sprite.w,sprite.h
    uv=uv or {0,0,16,16}; rotation=rotation or 0
    local colors={}
    for i,rgb in ipairs(sprite.p) do
        local r,g,b=math.floor(rgb/65536)%256,math.floor(rgb/256)%256,rgb%256
        colors[i]=Color3.fromRGB(r*(tint and tint[1] or 1),g*(tint and tint[2] or 1),b*(tint and tint[3] or 1))
    end
    local function sample(x,y)
        local u,v=(x+.5)/w,(y+.5)/h
        for _=1,rotation/90 do u,v=v,1-u end
        local tx=math.floor((uv[1]+(uv[3]-uv[1])*u)*w/16)%w
        local ty=math.floor((uv[2]+(uv[4]-uv[2])*v)*h/16)%h
        local at=(ty*w+tx)*2+1
        return tonumber(sprite.d:sub(at,at+1),16)
    end
    local pool=parent:GetChildren();local used=0
    local previous={}
    for y=0,h-1 do
        local current={}
        local x=0
        while x<w do
            local color=sample(x,y); local finish=x+1
            while finish<w and sample(finish,y)==color do finish=finish+1 end
            if color and color>0 then
                local run=x..':'..finish..':'..color
                local merged=previous[run]
                if merged then
                    merged.rows=merged.rows+1;merged.pixel.Size=UDim2.fromScale((finish-x)/w,merged.rows/h);current[run]=merged
                else
                used=used+1
                local pixel=pool[used] or Instance.new('Frame');pixel.Visible=true
                pixel.BorderSizePixel,pixel.BackgroundColor3=0,colors[color]
                pixel.BackgroundTransparency=1-(sprite.alpha and sprite.alpha[color] or 1)*(1-(tint and tint[4] or 0))
                pixel.ZIndex=parent:IsA('GuiObject') and parent.ZIndex or 1
                pixel.Active=false
                pixel.Size,pixel.Position=UDim2.fromScale((finish-x)/w,1/h),UDim2.fromScale(x/w,y/h)
                pixel.Parent=parent
                current[run]={pixel=pixel,rows=1}
                end
            end
            x=finish
        end
        previous=current
    end
    for i=used+1,#pool do pool[i].Visible=false end
end
-- Average visible color, used to paint opaque carrier parts behind their pixel surfaces.
function JavaContent.averageColor(sprite)
    if sprite.average then return sprite.average end
    local r,g,b,n=0,0,0,0
    for i=1,#sprite.d,2 do
        local c=tonumber(sprite.d:sub(i,i+1),16)
        if c and c>0 then local rgb=sprite.p[c];r,g,b,n=r+math.floor(rgb/65536)%256,g+math.floor(rgb/256)%256,b+rgb%256,n+1 end
    end
    n=math.max(n,1);sprite.average=Color3.fromRGB(r/n,g/n,b/n)
    return sprite.average
end
-- Roblox depth-sorts transparent parts per part, not per pixel, so faces drawn on
-- invisible carriers show through each other. Fully opaque textures get a solid
-- carrier, which writes depth and hides everything behind it like Java does.
function JavaContent.rectOpaque(sprite,uv)
    if not sprite.transparent then return true end
    if not uv or not sprite.d then return false end
    sprite.opaqueRects=sprite.opaqueRects or {}
    local k=uv[1]..','..uv[2]..','..uv[3]..','..uv[4]
    local hit=sprite.opaqueRects[k]
    if hit~=nil then return hit end
    local w,h=sprite.w,sprite.h
    local x0,x1=math.min(uv[1],uv[3])*w/16,math.max(uv[1],uv[3])*w/16
    local y0,y1=math.min(uv[2],uv[4])*h/16,math.max(uv[2],uv[4])*h/16
    local ok=x1-x0>1e-3 and y1-y0>1e-3
    if ok then
        for py=math.floor(y0+1e-3),math.ceil(y1-1e-3)-1 do
            for px=math.floor(x0+1e-3),math.ceil(x1-1e-3)-1 do
                local at=(py*w+px)*2+1
                local idx=tonumber(sprite.d:sub(at,at+1),16) or 0
                if idx==0 or (sprite.alpha and (sprite.alpha[idx] or 1)<0.99) then ok=false;break end
            end
            if not ok then break end
        end
    end
    sprite.opaqueRects[k]=ok
    return ok
end
function JavaContent.solidCarrier(part,sprite)
    if sprite.transparent then return false end
    part.Transparency=0;part.Color=JavaContent.averageColor(sprite);part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    return true
end
function JavaContent.surface(part,face,sprite,tint,uv,rotation,pixelsOnly)
    local gui=Instance.new('SurfaceGui')
    gui.Name,gui.Face,gui.CanvasSize='StevePixelSurface',face,Vector2.new(sprite.w*4,sprite.h*4)
    gui.AlwaysOnTop,gui.LightInfluence,gui.MaxDistance=false,0.5,160
    gui.SizingMode=Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize
    gui.ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    gui.ClipsDescendants=true
    if sprite.frames then JavaContent.animated[gui]={sprite=sprite,tint=tint,uv=uv,rotation=rotation,frame=0} end
    JavaContent.sprite(gui,sprite,tint,uv,rotation,pixelsOnly)
    gui.Parent=part
    return gui
end
function JavaContent.paint(part,ids)
    for _,child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA('Decal') or child:IsA('Texture') or child.Name=='StevePixelSurface' then child:Destroy() end
    end
    if ids.javaSkin then
        local data=JavaContent.data.skin[ids.javaSkin]
        for i,face in ipairs(faces) do JavaContent.surface(part,face,data[i]) end
    elseif ids.javaBlock then
        local entry=JavaContent.byIndex[ids.javaBlock]
        local specs=CreativeRules.modelSpecs(entry,entry.state)
        local model=JavaContent.data.models[specs[1] and specs[1].m or entry.itemModel]
        local element=model.e[1]
        if not element then return end
        local map={north=Enum.NormalId.Front,south=Enum.NormalId.Back,up=Enum.NormalId.Top,down=Enum.NormalId.Bottom,west=Enum.NormalId.Left,east=Enum.NormalId.Right}
        for name,f in pairs(element.f) do JavaContent.surface(part,map[name],JavaContent.data.textures[f[1]],f[4]>=0 and JavaContent.tint(entry) or nil,f[2],f[3]) end
    end
end
function JavaContent.classify(hit)
    local names,explicit={},{}; local p=hit.Instance
    while p and p~=workspace do
        names[#names+1]=p.Name
        local value=p:GetAttribute('MinecraftBlockType') or p:GetAttribute('MinecraftBlockId')
        if value then explicit[#explicit+1]=value end
        p=p.Parent
    end
    local id=CreativeRules.classify(names,hit.Material.Name,JavaContent.known,explicit)
    return JavaContent.byId[id].name
end

-- Render angled block models at GUI resolution instead of enlarging 24px thumbnails.
JavaContent.blockIconCache={}
function JavaContent.blockIcon(entry)
    if not entry or not entry.iconModel and (entry.itemOnly or not entry.icon or entry.icon.w~=24) then return end
    local cached=JavaContent.blockIconCache[entry.index]
    if cached~=nil then return cached or nil end
    local ok,content=pcall(function()
        local model=JavaContent.data.models[entry.iconModel or entry.itemModel]
        if model and #model.e==0 then
            local specs=CreativeRules.modelSpecs(entry,entry.state)
            model=specs[1] and JavaContent.data.models[specs[1].m] or model
        end
        if not model or #model.e==0 then return nil end
        local N=96
        local hasGui=model.display and model.display.gui
        local display=hasGui or {}
        local r=display.rotation or (hasGui and {0,0,0}) or {30,225,0}
        local sc=display.scale or (hasGui and {1,1,1}) or {.625,.625,.625}
        local tr=display.translation or {0,0,0}
        local rotation=CFrame.Angles(math.rad(r[1]),math.rad(r[2]),math.rad(r[3]))
        local pixels=buffer.create(N*N*4)
        local depth={}
        local function project(v)
            v=v-Vector3.new(8,8,8)
            v=rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(v*Vector3.new(sc[1],sc[2],sc[3]))+Vector3.new(tr[1],tr[2],tr[3])
            return Vector3.new((.5+v.X/16)*N,(.5-v.Y/16)*N,v.Z)
        end
        local function face(a,b,c,tex,uv,turn,tint,shade,transform)
            a,b,c=project(transform:PointToWorldSpace(a)),project(transform:PointToWorldSpace(b)),project(transform:PointToWorldSpace(c))
            local u,v=b-a,c-a
            local det=u.X*v.Y-u.Y*v.X
            if math.abs(det)<1e-6 then return end
            local d=b+c-a
            local x0,x1=math.max(0,math.floor(math.min(a.X,b.X,c.X,d.X))),math.min(N-1,math.ceil(math.max(a.X,b.X,c.X,d.X)))
            local y0,y1=math.max(0,math.floor(math.min(a.Y,b.Y,c.Y,d.Y))),math.min(N-1,math.ceil(math.max(a.Y,b.Y,c.Y,d.Y)))
            for y=y0,y1 do for x=x0,x1 do
                local dx,dy=x+.5-a.X,y+.5-a.Y
                local fu,fv=(dx*v.Y-dy*v.X)/det,(u.X*dy-u.Y*dx)/det
                if fu>=0 and fu<1 and fv>=0 and fv<1 then
                    local z=a.Z+fu*u.Z+fv*v.Z
                    local at=y*N+x
                    if not depth[at] or z>=depth[at] then
                        for _=1,math.floor((turn or 0)/90)%4 do fu,fv=fv,1-fu end
                        local tx=math.floor((uv[1]+(uv[3]-uv[1])*fu)*tex.w/16)%tex.w
                        local ty=math.floor((uv[2]+(uv[4]-uv[2])*fv)*tex.h/16)%tex.h
                        local off=(ty*tex.w+tx)*2+1
                        local ci=tonumber(tex.d:sub(off,off+1),16) or 0
                        local alpha=ci>0 and (tex.alpha and tex.alpha[ci] or 1) or 0
                        if alpha>0 then
                            local rgb=tex.p[ci]
                            local rr,gg,bb=math.floor(rgb/65536)%256,math.floor(rgb/256)%256,rgb%256
                            buffer.writeu8(pixels,at*4,math.floor(rr*shade*(tint and tint[1] or 1)))
                            buffer.writeu8(pixels,at*4+1,math.floor(gg*shade*(tint and tint[2] or 1)))
                            buffer.writeu8(pixels,at*4+2,math.floor(bb*shade*(tint and tint[3] or 1)))
                            buffer.writeu8(pixels,at*4+3,math.floor(alpha*255+.5))
                            depth[at]=z
                        end
                    end
                end
            end end
        end
        for _,e in ipairs(model.e) do
            local x,y,z=e.a[1],e.a[2],e.a[3]
            local X,Y,Z=e.b[1],e.b[2],e.b[3]
            local V=Vector3.new
            local corners={north={V(X,Y,z),V(x,Y,z),V(X,y,z)},south={V(x,Y,Z),V(X,Y,Z),V(x,y,Z)},
                west={V(x,Y,z),V(x,Y,Z),V(x,y,z)},east={V(X,Y,Z),V(X,Y,z),V(X,y,Z)},
                up={V(x,Y,z),V(X,Y,z),V(x,Y,Z)},down={V(x,y,Z),V(X,y,Z),V(x,y,z)}}
            local transform=CFrame.identity
            if e.r then
                local o=V(table.unpack(e.r.origin));local angle=math.rad(e.r.angle)
                transform=CFrame.new(o)*CFrame.Angles(e.r.axis=='x' and angle or 0,e.r.axis=='y' and angle or 0,e.r.axis=='z' and angle or 0)*CFrame.new(-o)
                if e.r.rescale then
                    local factor=1/math.cos(angle)
                    local scale=V(e.r.axis=='x' and 1 or factor,e.r.axis=='y' and 1 or factor,e.r.axis=='z' and 1 or factor)
                    for _,vertices in pairs(corners) do for i,vertex in ipairs(vertices) do vertices[i]=o+(vertex-o)*scale end end
                end
            end
            for name,f in pairs(e.f) do
                local tex=JavaContent.data.textures[f[1]]
                if tex then
                    local points=corners[name]
                    local tint=f[4] and f[4]>=0 and JavaContent.tint(entry) or nil
                    local shade=e.shade==false and 1 or (name=='up' and 1 or name=='down' and .55 or (name=='east' or name=='west') and .7 or .85)
                    face(points[1],points[2],points[3],tex,f[2] or {0,0,16,16},f[3],tint,shade,transform)
                end
            end
        end
        local image=game:GetService('AssetService'):CreateEditableImage({Size=Vector2.new(N,N)})
        image:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero,Vector2.new(N,N),pixels)
        return Content.fromObject(image)
    end)
    JavaContent.blockIconCache[entry.index]=ok and content or false
    return ok and content or nil
end
function JavaContent.icon(parent,index)
    local old=parent:FindFirstChild('ItemIcon'); if old then old:Destroy() end
    local native=JavaContent.nativeTools and JavaContent.nativeTools[index]
    if native then
        local label=Instance.new(native.TextureId~='' and 'ImageLabel' or 'TextLabel')
        label.Name,label.BackgroundTransparency,label.Size,label.ZIndex='ItemIcon',1,UDim2.fromScale(1,1),parent.ZIndex+1
        if native.TextureId~='' then label.Image=native.TextureId
        else label.Text=native.Name;label.TextScaled=true;label.TextWrapped=true;label.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1) end
        label.Parent=parent
        return
    end
    local entry=JavaContent.byIndex[index]
    local sprite=entry and entry.icon
    if not sprite and toolSprites[index] then
        JavaContent.toolIcons=JavaContent.toolIcons or {}
        sprite=JavaContent.toolIcons[index]
        if not sprite then
            local t=toolSprites[index]; local palette={}; local bytes={}
            for _,c in ipairs(t.palette) do palette[#palette+1]=c[1]*65536+c[2]*256+c[3] end
            for _,row in ipairs(t.rows) do for x=1,16 do local s=row:sub(x,x); bytes[#bytes+1]=string.format('%02x',s=='.' and 0 or s:byte()-64) end end
            sprite={w=16,h=16,p=palette,d=table.concat(bytes)};JavaContent.toolIcons[index]=sprite
        end
    end
    if not sprite then return end
    local blockContent=JavaContent.blockIcon(entry)
    local content=blockContent or JavaGui.content(sprite)
    local icon=Instance.new(content and 'ImageLabel' or 'Frame')
    icon.Name,icon.BackgroundTransparency,icon.Size='ItemIcon',1,UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
    icon.ZIndex=parent.ZIndex+1; icon.Active=false
    if content then icon.ImageContent,icon.ResampleMode=content,(blockContent or (sprite.w>32 and not entry.flatIcon)) and Enum.ResamplerMode.Default or Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated end
    icon.Parent=parent
    if not content then JavaContent.sprite(icon,sprite) end
end
-- BlockState.canBeReplaced() for placement (the Replaceable material and its block tags).
JavaContent.replaceable={short_grass=true,tall_grass=true,fern=true,large_fern=true,dead_bush=true,vine=true,glow_lichen=true,
    fire=true,soul_fire=true,water=true,lava=true,seagrass=true,tall_seagrass=true,snow=true,light=true,structure_void=true,
    bubble_column=true,crimson_roots=true,warped_roots=true,nether_sprouts=true,hanging_roots=true,short_dry_grass=true,
    tall_dry_grass=true,bush=true,leaf_litter=true,resin_clump=true,sculk_vein=true}
function JavaContent.nonSolid(id)
    return id=='air' or id=='cave_air' or id=='void_air' or id=='water' or id=='lava' or id=='redstone_wire' or id=='nether_portal' or id=='fire' or id=='soul_fire' or id=='bubble_column'
        or id:find('torch',1,true) or id:find('button',1,true) or id=='lever' or id:find('flower',1,true)
        or id:find('sapling',1,true) or id:find('rail',1,true) or id:find('grass',1,true) and id~='grass_block'
        or id:find('fern',1,true) or id:find('vine',1,true) or id:find('seagrass',1,true)
end
-- Java block shapes (catalog.blockShapes from ShapeRef: BlockState.getCollisionShape, getShape
-- without the random offset, getLightEmission). Boxes are in 1/16 block units inside the cell.
JavaContent.shapeBoxes={}
function JavaContent.boxes(index)
    local cached=JavaContent.shapeBoxes[index]
    if cached then return cached end
    local list={}
    for box in tostring(JavaContent.data.blockShapes.shapes[index+1] or ''):gmatch('[^;]+') do
        local n={}
        for v in box:gmatch('[^,]+') do n[#n+1]=tonumber(v) end
        if #n==6 then list[#list+1]=n end
    end
    JavaContent.shapeBoxes[index]=list
    return list
end
-- {collision, outline, light, full, same} for a block state, nil for a full cube without light.
function JavaContent.shape(id,state)
    local data=JavaContent.data and JavaContent.data.blockShapes
    local b=data and data.blocks[id]
    if not b then return nil end
    local t=b.all
    if not t then
        local entry=JavaContent.byId[id]
        local default=entry and entry.state or {}
        local key={}
        for i,p in ipairs(b.p) do local v=state and state[p]; if v==nil then v=default[p] end; key[i]=tostring(v) end
        t=b.s[table.concat(key,',')]
        if not t then
            for i,p in ipairs(b.p) do key[i]=tostring(default[p]) end
            t=b.s[table.concat(key,',')]
        end
        if not t then return nil end
    end
    return {collision=JavaContent.boxes(t[1]),outline=JavaContent.boxes(t[2]),light=t[3] or 0,
        full=t[1]==data.full and t[2]==data.full,same=t[1]==t[2]}
end
-- BedBlock shapes (the catalog has none): a 9-pixel base and the two legs on the end away from the other half.
do
    local catalogShape = JavaContent.shape
    local BASE = {0, 3, 0, 16, 9, 16}
    local LEGS = {north = {{0, 0, 0, 3, 3, 3}, {13, 0, 0, 16, 3, 3}}, south = {{0, 0, 13, 3, 3, 16}, {13, 0, 13, 16, 3, 16}},
        west = {{0, 0, 0, 3, 3, 3}, {0, 0, 13, 3, 3, 16}}, east = {{13, 0, 0, 16, 3, 3}, {13, 0, 13, 16, 3, 16}}}
    local OPPOSITE = {north = "south", south = "north", east = "west", west = "east"}
    function JavaContent.shape(id, state)
        if id:match("_bed$") then
            local facing = state and state.facing or "north"
            local away = (state and state.part == "head") and facing or OPPOSITE[facing] or "south"
            local list = {BASE, LEGS[away][1], LEGS[away][2]}
            return {collision = list, outline = list, light = 0, full = false, same = true}
        end
        return catalogShape(id, state)
    end
end
-- Block effects on the player and fall damage (Block.getFriction / getSpeedFactor / getJumpFactor / stepOn /
-- fallOn / updateEntityMovementAfterFallOn / makeStuckInBlock, HoneyBlock.slideDown, LivingEntity.causeFallDamage).
function JavaContent.createBlockPhysics(ctx)
    local world, humanoid, root = ctx.world, ctx.humanoid, ctx.root
    local B = CONFIG.Block
    local phys = {fallDistance = 0}
    local FRICTION = {slime_block = 0.8, ice = 0.98, packed_ice = 0.98, frosted_ice = 0.98, blue_ice = 0.989}
    local SPEED = {soul_sand = 0.4, honey_block = 0.4}
    local JUMP = {honey_block = 0.5}
    local STUCK = {cobweb = {0.25, 0.05, 0.25}, sweet_berry_bush = {0.8, 0.75, 0.8}, powder_snow = {0.9, 1.5, 0.9}}
    local function nodeAt(p) return world.sample(world.cell(p)) end
    local function idAt(p) local n = nodeAt(p); return n and n.id or nil end
    local function feet() return root.Position - Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2, 0) end
    -- Entity.getBlockPosBelowThatAffectsMyMovement: half a block under the feet.
    local function below() return idAt(feet() - Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * B, 0)) end
    local function under() return idAt(feet() - Vector3.new(0, 0.2 * B, 0)) end
    local function effect(id) local fx = world.statusEffects; return fx and fx.level and fx.level(id) or 0 end
    function phys.friction() local id = below(); return id and FRICTION[id] or nil end
    function phys.speedFactor()
        local f = SPEED[idAt(feet() + Vector3.new(0, 0.1 * B, 0)) or ""]
        return f or SPEED[below() or ""] or 1
    end
    function phys.jumpFactor()
        local f = JUMP[idAt(feet() + Vector3.new(0, 0.1 * B, 0)) or ""]
        return f or JUMP[below() or ""] or 1
    end
    function phys.stuck()
        for _, p in ipairs({feet() + Vector3.new(0, 0.1 * B, 0), root.Position, root.Position + Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y * 0.4, 0)}) do
            local id = idAt(p)
            if id and STUCK[id] then return STUCK[id], id end
        end
    end
    local function protection()
        local equipment = ctx.equipment and ctx.equipment() or {}
        local epf = 0
        for _, slot in ipairs({"helmet", "chestplate", "leggings", "boots"}) do
            local e = equipment[slot] and equipment[slot].enchantments
            if e then epf = epf + (e.protection or 0) + (slot == "boots" and 3 * (e.feather_falling or 0) or 0) end
        end
        return math.min(20, epf)
    end
    function phys.hurt(amount, cause)
        if not CONFIG.Survival or PlayerStats.spectator or amount <= 0 or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
        world.lastDamage, world.lastDamageTime = cause, os.clock()
        humanoid:TakeDamage(amount * humanoid.MaxHealth / 20)
    end
    -- Landing: Block.fallOn with its damage multiplier; returns the block landed on.
    function phys.land(fall, sneaking)
        local cell = world.cell(feet() - Vector3.new(0, 0.2 * B, 0))
        local n = world.sample(cell)
        local id = n and n.id
        local multiplier, extra = 1, 0
        if id == "hay_block" or id == "honey_block" then multiplier = 0.2
        elseif id and id:match("_bed$") then multiplier = 0.5
        elseif id == "slime_block" and not sneaking then multiplier = 0
        elseif id == "pointed_dripstone" and n.state and n.state.vertical_direction == "up" and n.state.thickness == "tip" then extra, multiplier = 2.5, 2 end
        -- FarmBlock.fallOn: trampled to dirt when random < fallDistance - 0.5.
        if id == "farmland" and math.random() < fall - 0.5 and JavaContent.byId.dirt then world.setBlockAt(cell, JavaContent.byId.dirt.index, {}) end
        local damage = math.ceil((fall + extra - 3 - effect("jump_boost")) * multiplier)
        if damage > 0 then
            if MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.play(damage > 4 and "entity.player.big_fall" or "entity.player.small_fall", nil, 1, 1) end
            phys.hurt(damage * (1 - protection() / 25), "fall")
        end
        return id
    end
    -- Block.updateEntityMovementAfterFallOn: slime and beds bounce (not while sneaking).
    function phys.bounce(id, vy, sneaking)
        if vy >= 0 or sneaking then return nil end
        if id == "slime_block" then return -vy end
        if id and id:match("_bed$") then return -vy * 0.66 end
        return nil
    end
    -- stepOn while standing: slime slows walking; magma and lit campfires burn.
    function phys.stepOn(vx, vy, vz, sneaking)
        local n = nodeAt(feet() - Vector3.new(0, 0.2 * B, 0))
        local id = n and n.id
        if id == "slime_block" and math.abs(vy) < 0.1 and not sneaking then
            local d = 0.4 + math.abs(vy) * 0.2
            vx, vz = vx * d, vz * d
        end
        local burning = (id == "magma_block" and not sneaking) or ((id == "campfire" or id == "soul_campfire") and n.state and n.state.lit == "true")
        if burning and effect("fire_resistance") == 0 and os.clock() - (phys.lastBurn or 0) > 0.5 then
            phys.lastBurn = os.clock()
            phys.hurt(id == "soul_campfire" and 2 or 1, id == "magma_block" and "hotFloor" or "inFire")
        end
        return vx, vz
    end
    -- HoneyBlock.slideDown: falling against a honey block's side slows to 0.05 a tick.
    function phys.honeySlide(vy)
        if vy >= -0.08 then return nil end
        local f = feet()
        local reach = root.Size.X / 2 + 0.07 * B
        for _, o in ipairs({Vector3.new(reach, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-reach, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, reach), Vector3.new(0, 0, -reach)}) do
            if idAt(f + o + Vector3.new(0, 0.1 * B, 0)) == "honey_block" or idAt(f + o + Vector3.new(0, 0.9 * B, 0)) == "honey_block" then return -0.05 end
        end
        return nil
    end
    return phys
end
-- Climbable (BlockTags.CLIMBABLE): their shape parts carry the ladder tag.
JavaContent.climbable={ladder=true,vine=true,scaffolding=true,weeping_vines=true,weeping_vines_plant=true,
    twisting_vines=true,twisting_vines_plant=true,cave_vines=true,cave_vines_plant=true}
function JavaContent.fluidHeight(state)
    if state.fluidAbove=='true' then return 1 end
    local level=tonumber(state.level) or 0
    return ((level==0 or level>=8) and 8 or 8-level)/9
end
function JavaContent.display(index,context,unit,blocking)
    local e=JavaContent.byIndex[index]
    local m=e and JavaContent.data.models[e.itemModel]
    local left=context:find('lefthand',1,true)~=nil
    local displays=(blocking and e and e.blockingDisplay) or (e and e.handDisplay) or (m and m.display)
    local d=displays and (displays[context] or left and displays[(context:gsub('lefthand','righthand'))]) or {}
    local r,t,s=d.rotation or {0,0,0},d.translation or {0,0,0},d.scale or {1,1,1}
    -- ItemTransform.apply(leftHand): mirror translation X and rotation Y/Z.
    if left then r,t={r[1],-r[2],-r[3]},{-t[1],t[2],t[3]} end
    return CFrame.new(t[1]*unit/16,t[2]*unit/16,t[3]*unit/16)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(r[1]),math.rad(r[2]),math.rad(r[3])),unit*s[1]
end
function JavaContent.entityModel(id,variant,scale,parent,center,origin,seeThrough)
    local definition=JavaContent.data.entities[id]
    if not definition then return end
    local rootData=(type(variant)=='table' and variant or definition.variants[variant or 1] or definition.variants[1]).root
    local model=Instance.new('Model');model.Name=id;model.Parent=parent
    local bones,parts={},{}
    local function vector(v)return Vector3.new(v[1],-v[2],-v[3])*scale/16 end
    local function build(data,parentBone,name)
        local pose=data.pose
        local bone={name=name,parent=parentBone,pose=CFrame.new(vector(pose))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,-pose[6])*CFrame.Angles(0,-pose[5],0)*CFrame.Angles(pose[4],0,0),faces={},rawPose=pose}
        bones[#bones+1]=bone
        for _,face in ipairs(data.faces)do
            local a,b,c=vector(face.v[1]),vector(face.v[2]),vector(face.v[3]);local width,height=(b-a).Magnitude,(c-a).Magnitude
            if width>.00001 and height>.00001 then
                local right,up=(b-a).Unit,-(c-a).Unit
                local frame=CFrame.fromMatrix((b+c)/2,right,up,right:Cross(up))
                local p=Instance.new('Part');p.Name=name;p.Size=Vector3.new(width,height,.001);p.Anchored=true;p.CanCollide=false;p.CanTouch=false;p.CanQuery=false;p.Transparency=1;p.CastShadow=false;p.Parent=model
                local sprite=JavaContent.data.textures[face.t]
                if not seeThrough then JavaContent.solidCarrier(p,sprite) end
                JavaContent.surface(p,Enum.NormalId.Front,sprite,nil,{16,0,0,16})
                bone.faces[#bone.faces+1]={part=p,frame=frame};parts[#parts+1]={p,frame,p.Size}
            end
        end
        for childName,child in pairs(data.children)do build(child,bone,childName)end
    end
    build(rootData,nil,'root')
    -- overrides[name]={x=,y=} replaces a bone's Java xRot/yRot (keeping its zRot), as setupAnim does.
    local function pivot(frame,_,openness,phase,walking,look,overrides)
        local base=frame*CFrame.new(0,(origin or 24)*scale/16,0)
        for _,bone in ipairs(bones)do
            local posed=bone.pose
            local override=overrides and overrides[bone.name]
            if override then
                local p=bone.rawPose
                posed=CFrame.new(vector({p[1]+(override.px or 0),p[2]+(override.py or 0),p[3]+(override.pz or 0)}))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,-(override.z or p[6]))*CFrame.Angles(0,-(override.y or p[5]),0)*CFrame.Angles(override.x or p[4],0,0)
                -- Hidden bones (IllagerModel crossed arms) leave the model until shown again.
                local hide=override.hidden==true
                if hide~=(bone.hidden==true) then bone.hidden=hide;for _,face in ipairs(bone.faces) do face.part.Parent=not hide and model or nil end end
            end
            local anim=CFrame.identity;local name=bone.name
            if phase then
                if name:find('leg') or name:find('arm') then local sign=name:find('left') and 1 or -1;if name:find('hind') then sign=-sign end;anim=CFrame.Angles(math.cos(phase)*sign*(walking or 0)*.7,0,0)
                elseif name:find('wing') then local angle=id=='worn_elytra' and ((walking or 0)>.5 and .8 or .1) or math.sin(phase*2)*.6;anim=CFrame.Angles(0,0,angle*(name:find('left')and 1 or -1))
                elseif name=='head' then anim=CFrame.Angles(0,look or math.sin(phase*.2)*.12,0)
                elseif name:find('tail') then anim=CFrame.Angles(0,math.sin(phase)*.12,0)
                elseif name:find('paddle') then anim=CFrame.Angles(math.sin(phase)*(walking or 0)*.6,0,math.cos(phase)*(walking or 0)*.3) end
            end
            if openness and name=='lid' then anim=CFrame.new(0,openness*scale*.5,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,openness*math.pi/2,0) end
            bone.frame=(bone.parent and bone.parent.frame or base)*posed*anim
            for _,face in ipairs(bone.faces)do face.part.CFrame=bone.frame*face.frame end
        end
    end
    pivot(CFrame.new(center or Vector3.zero))
    return {model=model,parts=parts,bones=bones,pivot=pivot}
end

function JavaContent.model(index,state,scale,parent,center,visual)
    local entry=JavaContent.byIndex[index]
    if visual and entry and entry.heldMesh and JavaContent.meshTemplate then
        local okM,c,unit=pcall(JavaContent.meshTemplate,entry.heldMesh)
        if okM and type(c)=='table' and unit then
            local k=scale/unit
            local model=c.template:Clone();model.Name=entry.id
            local parts={}
            for _,pair in ipairs(c.parts) do
                local p=model:FindFirstChild(pair[1].Name)
                if p then
                    p.CanCollide,p.CanQuery,p.CanTouch,p.CastShadow=false,false,false,false
                    parts[#parts+1]={p,CFrame.new(pair[2].Position*k),pair[1].Size*k}
                end
            end
            model.Parent=parent
            local function pivot(frame,factor)
                factor=factor or 1
                for _,q in ipairs(parts) do q[1].Size=q[3]*factor;q[1].CFrame=frame*CFrame.new(q[2].Position*factor) end
            end
            pivot(CFrame.new(center or Vector3.zero))
            return {model=model,parts=parts,pivot=pivot,culls={}}
        end
    end
    if visual and entry and entry.handModel then
        local result=JavaContent.entityModel(entry.handModel,1,scale,parent,center,0,false)
        local rawPivot,shift=result.pivot,CFrame.new(-scale/2,-scale/2,-scale/2)
        result.pivot=function(frame) rawPivot(frame*shift) end
        result.pivot(CFrame.new(center or Vector3.zero))
        return result
    end
    if entry and entry.entityModel then
        local result=JavaContent.entityModel(entry.entityParts and entry.entityParts[state.part or 'foot'] or entry.entityModel,1,scale,parent,center,entry.entityOrigin or 0)
        local rawPivot=result.pivot
        local yaw=state.rotation and -tonumber(state.rotation)*math.pi/8 or ({north=0,east=-math.pi/2,south=math.pi,west=math.pi/2})[state.facing] or 0
        local wall=entry.id:find('_wall_',1,true)
        local orientation=CFrame.Angles(0,yaw,0)
        if entry.id:match('_bed$') then orientation=orientation*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi) end
        local offset=CFrame.new(0,-scale/2+(wall and scale*.25 or 0),0)*orientation*CFrame.new(0,0,wall and -scale*.25 or 0)
        local box
        if not visual then
            box=Instance.new('Part');box.Name='BlockCollider';box.Anchored=true;box.Transparency=1;box.CanCollide=not entry.noCollision;box.Size=Vector3.new(1,entry.entityHeight or (entry.entityOrigin and 1 or .5),1)*scale;box.CanTouch=false;box.Parent=result.model
            box:SetAttribute('SteveVoxelCenter',center);box:SetAttribute('MinecraftBlockId',entry.id);box:SetAttribute('MinecraftBlockType',entry.name)
            result.parts[#result.parts+1]={box,CFrame.identity,box.Size}
        end
        if not visual then for _,pair in ipairs(result.parts)do
            pair[1]:SetAttribute('SteveVoxelCenter',center);pair[1]:SetAttribute('MinecraftBlockId',entry.id);pair[1]:SetAttribute('MinecraftBlockType',entry.name)
        end end
        result.pivot=function(frame,factor,openness,overrides)rawPivot(frame*offset,factor,openness,nil,nil,nil,overrides);if box then box.CFrame=frame end end
        result.pivot(CFrame.new(center or Vector3.zero));return result
    end
    local model=Instance.new('Model'); model.Name=entry and entry.id or blockNames[index] or 'Item'
    local parts,culls={},{}
    local function part(size,frame,color)
        local p=Instance.new('Part'); p.Size,p.CFrame,p.Anchored=size,frame,true
        p.CanCollide,p.CanQuery,p.CanTouch=not visual,not visual,false
        p.Color,p.Material=color or Color3.new(1,1,1),Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        p.CastShadow=not visual
        p.Parent=model; parts[#parts+1]={p,frame,size}
        return p
    end
    if visual and entry and entry.itemTexture then
        local sprite=JavaContent.data.textures[JavaContent.itemFrames[index] or entry.itemTexture]
        for y=0,sprite.h-1 do for x=0,sprite.w-1 do
            local at=(y*sprite.w+x)*2+1;local color=tonumber(sprite.d:sub(at,at+1),16)
            if color>0 then
                local rgb=sprite.p[color]
                part(Vector3.new(scale/sprite.w,scale/sprite.h,scale/16),CFrame.new(((x+.5)/sprite.w-.5)*scale,(.5-(y+.5)/sprite.h)*scale,0),
                    Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(rgb/65536)%256,math.floor(rgb/256)%256,rgb%256))
            end
        end end
    elseif toolSprites[index] then
        local sprite=toolSprites[index]
        for y,row in ipairs(sprite.rows) do for x=1,16 do
            local s=row:sub(x,x)
            if s~='.' then local c=sprite.palette[s:byte()-64]; part(Vector3.new(1,1,1)*scale/16,CFrame.new((x-8.5)*scale/16,(8.5-y)*scale/16,0),Color3.fromRGB(c[1],c[2],c[3])) end
        end end
    elseif entry and not (entry.id=='air' or entry.id=='cave_air' or entry.id=='void_air') then
        local fluidTop=not visual and (entry.id=='water' or entry.id=='lava') and state and JavaContent.fluidHeight(state)*16 or nil
        local specs=visual and {{m=entry.itemModel,x=0,y=0}} or CreativeRules.modelSpecs(entry,state,JavaContent.cellPos(center,scale))
        if visual and #JavaContent.data.models[entry.itemModel].e==0 then specs=CreativeRules.modelSpecs(entry,entry.state) end
        local faceMap={north=Enum.NormalId.Front,south=Enum.NormalId.Back,up=Enum.NormalId.Top,down=Enum.NormalId.Bottom,west=Enum.NormalId.Left,east=Enum.NormalId.Right}
        for specNumber,spec in ipairs(specs) do
            local base=CFrame.Angles(0,-math.rad(spec.y or 0),0)*CFrame.Angles(-math.rad(spec.x or 0),0,0)
            for elementNumber,e in ipairs(JavaContent.data.models[spec.m].e) do
                local a,b=Vector3.new(table.unpack(e.a)),Vector3.new(table.unpack(e.b))
                if fluidTop then b=Vector3.new(b.X,math.min(b.Y,fluidTop),b.Z) end
                local delta=b-a
                local extent=Vector3.new(math.abs(delta.X),math.abs(delta.Y),math.abs(delta.Z))*scale/16
                local elementCenter=((a+b)/2-Vector3.new(8,8,8))*scale/16
                local frame=base
                if e.r then
                    local origin=(Vector3.new(table.unpack(e.r.origin))-Vector3.new(8,8,8))*scale/16
                    local angle=math.rad(e.r.angle)
                    if e.r.rescale then
                        local factor=1/math.cos(angle)
                        local sx,sy,sz=e.r.axis=='x' and 1 or factor,e.r.axis=='y' and 1 or factor,e.r.axis=='z' and 1 or factor
                        extent=Vector3.new(extent.X*sx,extent.Y*sy,extent.Z*sz)
                        local offset=elementCenter-origin
                        elementCenter=origin+Vector3.new(offset.X*sx,offset.Y*sy,offset.Z*sz)
                    end
                    frame=frame*CFrame.new(origin)*CFrame.Angles(e.r.axis=='x' and angle or 0,e.r.axis=='y' and angle or 0,e.r.axis=='z' and angle or 0)*CFrame.new(-origin)
                end
                if entry.id=='redstone_wire' then
                    local lift=(specNumber*2+elementNumber)*scale*.00012
                    elementCenter=elementCenter+Vector3.new(0,delta.Y==0 and lift or 0,delta.Z==0 and lift or 0)
                end
                frame=frame*CFrame.new(elementCenter)
                local p=part(Vector3.new(math.max(.005,extent.X),math.max(.005,extent.Y),math.max(.005,extent.Z)),frame)
                if e.lid then parts[#parts].hinge=base*CFrame.new(Vector3.new(-8,1,-7)*scale/16) end
                p.CanCollide=not visual and not JavaContent.nonSolid(entry.id)
                if not visual then
                    p:SetAttribute('SteveVoxel',true); p:SetAttribute('SteveVoxelCenter',center)
                    p:SetAttribute('MinecraftBlockType',entry.name); p:SetAttribute('MinecraftBlockId',entry.id)
                    if entry.id=='water' then CollectionService:AddTag(p,'MinecraftWater') end
                    if entry.id=='lava' then CollectionService:AddTag(p,'MinecraftLava') end
                    if entry.id=='water' or entry.id=='lava' then p:SetAttribute('SteveFluid',true) end
                    if entry.id=='ladder' then CollectionService:AddTag(p,'MinecraftLadder') end
                end
                p.Transparency=1 -- Invisible geometry carrier: no white behind alpha pixels.
                local count,opaque=0,true
                for name,f in pairs(e.f) do
                    count=count+1
                    if JavaContent.data.textures[f[1]].transparent and not JavaContent.rectOpaque(JavaContent.data.textures[f[1]],f[2]) then p.Transparency=1;opaque=false end
                    local tint=f[4]>=0 and (entry.id=='redstone_wire' and JavaContent.dustTint(tonumber(state.power) or 0) or JavaContent.tint(entry)) or nil
                    if entry.id=='water' or entry.id=='bubble_column' then tint={.25,.45,1,.3};p.Transparency=1 end
                    local rotation=f[3] or 0
                    if spec.uv and (name=='up' or name=='down') then rotation=(rotation+(name=='up' and 1 or -1)*(spec.y or 0))%360 end
                    -- Roblox Top/Bottom SurfaceGuis are turned against Java's up/down UVs (see FIXES 4).
                    if name=='up' then rotation=(rotation+90)%360 elseif name=='down' then rotation=(rotation+270)%360 end
                    local surface=JavaContent.surface(p,faceMap[name],JavaContent.data.textures[f[1]],tint,f[2],rotation,entry.id=='redstone_wire')
                    surface.ZOffset=0
                    -- Light sources render at full brightness (block light 15 in Java).
                    if (entry.light or 0)>=10 or (state and state.lit=='true' and (entry.light or 0)==0 and not entry.id:find('candle',1,true)) then surface.LightInfluence=0 end
                    -- Cullface (rotated with the variant): hidden against a full occluding neighbour.
                    local cullName=f[5] or ((entry.id=='water' or entry.id=='lava') and name)
                    if cullName and not visual then
                        local d=CreativeRules.directions[cullName]
                        local v=base:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(d[1],d[2],d[3]))
                        local ax,ay,az=math.abs(v.X),math.abs(v.Y),math.abs(v.Z)
                        culls[#culls+1]={surface,(ay>=ax and ay>=az) and (v.Y>0 and 'up' or 'down') or (ax>=az and (v.X>0 and 'east' or 'west')) or (v.Z>0 and 'south' or 'north')}
                    end
                    if entry.id=='redstone_wire' and f[4]>=0 then
                        for _,pixel in ipairs(surface:GetChildren()) do
                            local color=pixel.BackgroundColor3
                            pixel:SetAttribute('DustBase',Color3.new(color.R/math.max(tint[1],.001),tint[2]>0 and color.G/tint[2] or color.R/math.max(tint[1],.001),tint[3]>0 and color.B/tint[3] or color.R/math.max(tint[1],.001)))
                        end
                    end
                end
                -- a box missing only its bottom (torch sticks, repeater torches) still closes from every visible side
                if (count<6 and not (count==5 and not e.f.down)) or entry.id:find('glass',1,true) or entry.id:find('leaves',1,true) or entry.id=='water' or entry.id=='bubble_column' then opaque=false end
                if opaque then
                    -- Closed element with opaque textures on every face: solid carrier so it occludes depth.
                    local _,f=next(e.f)
                    local sprite=JavaContent.data.textures[f[1]]
                    if not JavaContent.solidCarrier(p,sprite) then p.Transparency=0;p.Color=JavaContent.averageColor(sprite);p.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic end
                else p.Transparency=1 end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Barrier / light / structure void render nothing (their models are only particles in Java).
    if not visual and entry and (entry.id=='barrier' or entry.id=='light' or entry.id=='structure_void') then
        for _,pair in ipairs(parts) do
            pair[1].Transparency=1
            for _,g in ipairs(pair[1]:GetChildren()) do if g:IsA('SurfaceGui') then g:Destroy() end end
        end
        table.clear(culls)
        if entry.id~='structure_void' then
            local holder=Instance.new('Part');holder.Name='SteveMarker'
            holder.Anchored,holder.Transparency,holder.CanCollide,holder.CanQuery,holder.CanTouch,holder.CastShadow=true,1,false,false,false,false
            holder.Size=Vector3.new(.05,.05,.05);holder.Parent=model;parts[#parts+1]={holder,CFrame.identity,holder.Size}
            local gui=Instance.new('BillboardGui');gui.Name='SteveMarker';gui.Size=UDim2.fromScale(scale*.5,scale*.5);gui.LightInfluence=0;gui.Enabled=false
            gui.Parent=holder
            local sprite=JavaContent.data.textures[entry.itemTexture]
            if sprite then JavaContent.sprite(gui,sprite) end
        end
    end
    -- Java's real shapes: collision boxes the body stops on, outline boxes the crosshair targets and
    -- mines (a torch is its stick, a flower has no collision); the model elements only draw.
    local shape=not visual and entry and JavaContent.shape(entry.id,state)
    if shape and not shape.full and not (entry.id=='water' or entry.id=='lava' or entry.id=='bubble_column') then
        for _,pair in ipairs(parts) do pair[1].CanCollide=false;pair[1].CanQuery=false end
        local climb=JavaContent.climbable[entry.id]
        local function box(n,collide,collider)
            local a,b=Vector3.new(n[1],n[2],n[3]),Vector3.new(n[4],n[5],n[6])
            local extent=(b-a)*scale/16
            local p=Instance.new('Part');p.Name=collider and 'BlockCollider' or 'BlockOutline'
            p.Anchored,p.Transparency,p.CastShadow,p.CanTouch=true,1,false,false
            p.Size=Vector3.new(math.max(.01,extent.X),math.max(.01,extent.Y),math.max(.01,extent.Z))
            p.CanCollide,p.CanQuery=collide,true
            if collider then p:SetAttribute('SteveCollider',true) end
            p:SetAttribute('SteveVoxel',true);p:SetAttribute('SteveVoxelCenter',center)
            p:SetAttribute('MinecraftBlockType',entry.name);p:SetAttribute('MinecraftBlockId',entry.id)
            if climb then CollectionService:AddTag(p,'MinecraftLadder') end
            local frame=CFrame.new(((a+b)/2-Vector3.new(8,8,8))*scale/16)
            p.CFrame=frame;p.Parent=model;parts[#parts+1]={p,frame,p.Size}
        end
        for _,n in ipairs(shape.outline) do box(n,shape.same,false) end
        if not shape.same then for _,n in ipairs(shape.collision) do box(n,true,true) end end
    end
    -- LightEngine stand-in: light-emitting states (torch 14, lantern 15, lit furnace 13...) light the area.
    if shape and shape.light>0 and center then
        local glow=Instance.new('Part');glow.Name='BlockLight'
        glow.Anchored,glow.Transparency,glow.CastShadow,glow.CanTouch,glow.CanCollide,glow.CanQuery=true,1,false,false,false,false
        glow.Size=Vector3.new(.05,.05,.05);glow.Parent=model;parts[#parts+1]={glow,CFrame.identity,glow.Size}
        local light=Instance.new('PointLight')
        -- Shadows on (light stops at walls); the block's own parts never shadow its light.
        light.Range=math.min(60,shape.light*scale*.9);light.Brightness=.4+shape.light/15*1.1;light.Shadows=true
        for _,pair in ipairs(parts) do pair[1].CastShadow=false end
        local id=entry.id
        light.Color=(id:find('soul',1,true) and Color3.fromRGB(120,220,255)) or ((id:find('redstone',1,true) or id=='crying_obsidian' or id=='respawn_anchor') and Color3.fromRGB(255,120,90))
            or ((id:find('amethyst',1,true) or id=='end_rod' or id:find('sea_lantern',1,true) or id=='beacon' or id=='conduit') and Color3.fromRGB(225,235,255)) or Color3.fromRGB(255,214,160)
        light.Parent=glow
    end
    -- BlockBehaviour offsets (flowers, grass, bamboo, dripstone...): Mth.getSeed(x, 0, z).
    if not visual and center and entry and entry.offset then
        local bx,_,bz=CreativeRules.blockPos(center,scale)
        local dx,dy,dz=CreativeRules.blockOffset(entry,bx,bz)
        if dx then
            local shift=CFrame.new(dx*scale,dy*scale,dz*scale)
            for _,pair in ipairs(parts) do pair[2]=shift*pair[2]; if pair.hinge then pair.hinge=shift*pair.hinge end end
        end
    end
    model.Parent=parent
    local function pivot(frame,factor,openness)
        factor=factor or 1
        for _,pair in ipairs(parts) do
            local localFrame=pair[2]
            if pair.hinge and openness then localFrame=pair.hinge*CFrame.Angles(-(1-(1-openness)^3)*math.pi/2,0,0)*pair.hinge:Inverse()*localFrame end
            pair[1].Size=pair[3]*factor
            pair[1].CFrame=frame*CFrame.new(localFrame.Position*factor)*localFrame.Rotation
        end
    end
    pivot(CFrame.new(center or Vector3.zero))
    return {model=model,parts=parts,pivot=pivot,culls=culls}
end

-- BlockColors for a tinted face: the catalog's per-block colour (26.3 item tints and the
-- plains grass/foliage colormaps), grass green when a block has none.
function JavaContent.tint(entry)
    return entry and entry.tint or {0.486,0.741,0.42}
end
-- Item identity is separate from a placed block's state/model.
function JavaContent.dustTint(power)
    local f=power/15
    return {f*.6+(f>0 and .4 or .3),math.max(0,f*f*.7-.5),math.max(0,f*f*.6-.7)}
end
function JavaContent.itemIndex(index)
    local e=JavaContent.byIndex[index]
    if not e then return toolStats[index] and index or nil end
    local id=e.id
    local aliases={wall_torch='torch',redstone_wall_torch='redstone_torch',soul_wall_torch='soul_torch',tripwire='tripwire',kelp_plant='kelp',cave_vines_plant='cave_vines',weeping_vines_plant='weeping_vines',twisting_vines_plant='twisting_vines',bamboo_sapling='bamboo',big_dripleaf_stem='big_dripleaf',attached_melon_stem='melon_seeds',attached_pumpkin_stem='pumpkin_seeds'}
    id=aliases[id] or id:gsub('_wall_sign$','_sign'):gsub('_wall_hanging_sign$','_hanging_sign'):gsub('_wall_banner$','_banner'):gsub('_wall_head$','_head'):gsub('_wall_skull$','_skull'):gsub('_coral_wall_fan$','_coral_fan')
    local item=JavaContent.byId[id]
    return item and item.obtainable~=false and JavaContent.mods.available(item) and item.index or nil
end
-- ArrowModel (26.3): cross_1 / cross_2 = 16x4 quads from x -12 to 4 turned 45 and 135 degrees about X (texture
-- 0,0..16,5; the far side uses the mirrored copy 16..32), back = a 5x5 cross scaled 0.8 at x -11 turned 45 degrees
-- (texture 0,5..5,10); whole mesh scaled 0.9 (units of 0.9/16 block). +X points along the flight.
do
    local ARROW_TEXTURES = {
        arrow = {w=32,h=32,p={14869218,16777215,12698049,10454093,7560761,11833434,12359778,10395294},d=""},
        arrow_spectral = {w=32,h=32,p={14334256,16777079,8077061,13601831,16777215},d=""},
        arrow_tipped = {w=32,h=32,p={14869218,16777215,12698049,10454093,7560761,11833434,12359778,10395294},d=""},
    }
    function JavaContent.arrowModel(id, parent, position)
        local tex = ARROW_TEXTURES[(id == "spectral_arrow" and "arrow_spectral") or (id == "tipped_arrow" and "arrow_tipped") or "arrow"] or ARROW_TEXTURES.arrow
        local u = 0.9 / 16 * CONFIG.Block
        local model = Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name = "SteveArrow"
        local pieces = {}
        local function plane(size, offset, faces)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name, p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = "ArrowQuad", true, false, false, false, false
            p.Transparency, p.Size = 1, size
            for face, uv in pairs(faces) do
                local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
                gui.Name, gui.Face, gui.LightInfluence = "StevePixelSurface", face, 1
                gui.SizingMode, gui.CanvasSize = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize, Vector2.new(64, 64)
                gui.Parent = p
                JavaContent.sprite(gui, tex, nil, uv)
            end
            p.Parent = model
            pieces[#pieces + 1] = {part = p, offset = offset}
        end
        -- Texture rects are in sixteenths of the 32px texture: head on the right of 0..16 (front face canvas runs
        -- toward -X, so it takes the mirrored copy 16..32), feathers at the back.
        local faces = {[Enum.NormalId.Front] = {8, 0, 16, 2.5}, [Enum.NormalId.Back] = {0, 0, 8, 2.5}}
        for _, a in ipairs({math.pi / 4, math.pi * 3 / 4}) do
            plane(Vector3.new(16 * u, 4 * u, 0.01), CFrame.Angles(a, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(-4 * u, 0, 0), faces)
        end
        local back = {0, 2.5, 2.5, 5}
        plane(Vector3.new(0.01, 4 * u, 4 * u), CFrame.new(-11 * u, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi / 4, 0, 0),
            {[Enum.NormalId.Right] = back, [Enum.NormalId.Left] = back})
        local visual = {model = model}
        -- pivot(CFrame.lookAt(p, p + velocity)): local +X along the look direction.
        function visual.pivot(frame)
            local base = frame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0)
            for _, piece in ipairs(pieces) do piece.part.CFrame = base * piece.offset end
        end
        visual.pivot(CFrame.new(position or Vector3.zero))
        model.Parent = parent
        return visual
    end
    -- A GUI item texture (item/crossbow_arrow...) as a model texture index, for the held item frames.
    local guiIndices = {}
    function JavaContent.guiTextureIndex(name)
        if guiIndices[name] then return guiIndices[name] end
        local sprite = JavaContent.data.javaGui[name]
        if not sprite then return nil end
        local list = JavaContent.data.textures
        list[#list + 1] = sprite
        guiIndices[name] = #list
        return #list
    end
end
function JavaContent.animateTextures()
    local tick=math.floor(os.clock()*20)
    if JavaContent.textureTick==tick then return end
    JavaContent.textureTick=tick
    for gui,a in pairs(JavaContent.animated) do
        if not gui.Parent then JavaContent.animated[gui]=nil
        elseif not workspace.CurrentCamera or (gui.Parent.Position-workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude<=gui.MaxDistance then
            local total=0
            for _,f in ipairs(a.sprite.sequence) do total=total+(type(f)=='table' and f.time or a.sprite.frametime) end
            local at=tick%math.max(1,total);local frame=0
            for _,f in ipairs(a.sprite.sequence) do
                local duration=type(f)=='table' and f.time or a.sprite.frametime
                frame=type(f)=='table' and f.index or f
                if at<duration then break end;at=at-duration
            end
            if frame~=a.frame then
                a.frame=frame
                JavaContent.sprite(gui,a.sprite.frames[frame+1],a.tint,a.uv,a.rotation)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- END JAVA CONTENT
-- BEGIN JAVA GUI
-- Java GUI drawing: 26.3 textures shown 1:1 in GUI pixels inside UIScale canvases at Java's
-- auto GUI scale. EditableImage gives one pixel-exact image per texture; without it the
-- textures fall back to pixel frames.
JavaGui = {contents = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})}
-- Options "GUI Scale: Auto": the largest scale that still leaves 320x240 GUI pixels.
function JavaGui.scale(viewport)
    local s = 1
    while viewport.X >= 320 * (s + 1) and viewport.Y >= 240 * (s + 1) do s = s + 1 end
    local chosen = JavaGui.guiScaleOption
    if type(chosen) == "number" and chosen > 0 then s = math.min(s, chosen) end
    return s
end
function JavaGui.content(sprite)
    local cached = JavaGui.contents[sprite]
    if cached ~= nil then return cached or nil end
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        local w, h = sprite.w, sprite.h
        local image = game:GetService("AssetService"):CreateEditableImage({Size = Vector2.new(w, h)})
        local pixels = buffer.create(w * h * 4)
        local d, palette, alpha = sprite.d, sprite.p, sprite.alpha
        for i = 0, w * h - 1 do
            local c = tonumber(string.sub(d, i * 2 + 1, i * 2 + 2), 16)
            if c and c > 0 then
                local rgb = palette[c]
                buffer.writeu8(pixels, i * 4, math.floor(rgb / 65536) % 256)
                buffer.writeu8(pixels, i * 4 + 1, math.floor(rgb / 256) % 256)
                buffer.writeu8(pixels, i * 4 + 2, rgb % 256)
                buffer.writeu8(pixels, i * 4 + 3, math.floor((alpha and alpha[c] or 1) * 255 + 0.5))
            end
        end
        image:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Vector2.new(w, h), pixels)
        return Content.fromObject(image)
    end)
    JavaGui.contents[sprite] = ok and result or false
    if not ok and not JavaGui.warned then
        JavaGui.warned = true
        warn("Steve: EditableImage unavailable, GUI textures use pixel frames: " .. tostring(result))
    end
    return ok and result or nil
end
-- A sprite (or a rectangle of it) at GUI-pixel coordinates.
function JavaGui.image(parent, sprite, x, y, w, h, rect, z)
    rect = rect or {0, 0, sprite.w, sprite.h}
    local content = JavaGui.content(sprite)
    local node = Instance.new(content and "ImageLabel" or "Frame")
    node.Name, node.BackgroundTransparency, node.BorderSizePixel = "JavaImage", 1, 0
    node.Position, node.Size, node.ZIndex = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), UDim2.fromOffset(w or rect[3], h or rect[4]), z or 1
    if content then
        node.ImageContent, node.ResampleMode = content, Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated
        node.ImageRectOffset, node.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(rect[1], rect[2]), Vector2.new(rect[3], rect[4])
    else
        node.ClipsDescendants = true
        JavaContent.sprite(node, sprite, nil, {rect[1] * 16 / sprite.w, rect[2] * 16 / sprite.h, (rect[1] + rect[3]) * 16 / sprite.w, (rect[2] + rect[4]) * 16 / sprite.h})
    end
    node.Parent = parent
    return node
end
-- Change which rectangle of an existing image is shown (progress arrows, flames).
function JavaGui.crop(node, sprite, x, y, rect)
    node.Position, node.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), UDim2.fromOffset(rect[3], rect[4])
    node.Visible = rect[3] > 0 and rect[4] > 0
    if node:IsA("ImageLabel") then
        node.ImageRectOffset, node.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(rect[1], rect[2]), Vector2.new(math.max(rect[3], 1), math.max(rect[4], 1))
    end
end
-- GuiGraphics.blitSprite() with nine_slice scaling.
function JavaGui.slice(parent, sprite, border, x, y, w, h, z)
    local node = JavaGui.image(parent, sprite, x, y, w, h, nil, z)
    if node:IsA("ImageLabel") then
        node.ScaleType, node.SliceCenter = Enum.ScaleType.Slice, Rect.new(border, border, sprite.w - border, sprite.h - border)
    end
    return node
end
-- Codepoints of a UTF-8 string (bytes when it is not valid UTF-8).
function JavaGui.codepoints(text)
    local out = {}
    if not pcall(function() for _, c in utf8.codes(text) do out[#out + 1] = c end end) then
        out = {}
        for i = 1, #text do out[i] = string.byte(text, i) end
    end
    return out
end
-- Glyph for a codepoint: ascii.png below 128, font/nonlatin_european.png (™, accents, Cyrillic,
-- Greek...) or font/accented.png (é, ñ, ü: 9x12 cells, ascent 10) above, "?" when no page has it.
-- Returns sprite, rect x, rect y, advance, cell width, cell height, y offset from the ASCII top.
function JavaGui.glyph(code)
    local data = JavaContent.data.javaGui
    if code >= 128 then
        local extra = data.fontExtra
        local index = extra and extra.map[tostring(code)]
        if index then
            return extra.sprite, index % extra.cols * extra.cell, math.floor(index / extra.cols) * extra.cell, extra.widths[index + 1] or 6, 8, 8, 0
        end
        local accent = data.fontAccent
        index = accent and accent.map[tostring(code)]
        if index then
            return accent.sprite, index % accent.cols * accent.cw, math.floor(index / accent.cols) * accent.ch, accent.widths[index + 1] or 6,
                accent.cw, accent.ch, 7 - accent.ascent
        end
        -- the last row of ascii.png (default.json): ≡ ± ≥ ≤ ⌠ ⌡ ÷ ≈ ° ∙ · √ ⁿ ² ■
        local CP = {[0x2261] = 240, [0xB1] = 241, [0x2265] = 242, [0x2264] = 243, [0x2320] = 244, [0x2321] = 245, [0xF7] = 246,
            [0x2248] = 247, [0xB0] = 248, [0x2219] = 249, [0xB7] = 250, [0x221A] = 251, [0x207F] = 252, [0xB2] = 253, [0x25A0] = 254}
        code = CP[code] or 63
    end
    return data.font, code % 16 * 8, math.floor(code / 16) * 8, data.fontWidths[code + 1] or 6, 8, 8, 0
end
function JavaGui.width(text)
    local w = 0
    for _, code in ipairs(JavaGui.codepoints(text)) do local _, _, _, advance = JavaGui.glyph(code); w = w + advance end
    return w
end
-- Font: 8x8 glyphs from font/ascii.png; the drop shadow sits at +1,+1 in a quarter of the colour.
function JavaGui.text(parent, text, x, y, color, shadow, z)
    local data = JavaContent.data.javaGui
    local content = JavaGui.content(data.font)
    color = color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Name, holder.BackgroundTransparency, holder.ZIndex = "JavaText", 1, z or 1
    holder.Position, holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), UDim2.fromOffset(JavaGui.width(text), 9)
    if not content then
        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.BackgroundTransparency, label.Size, label.Font, label.TextSize = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Enum.Font.Arcade, 8
        label.Text, label.TextColor3, label.TextXAlignment, label.ZIndex = text, color, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, holder.ZIndex
        label.Parent = holder
    else
        local shadowColor = Color3.new(math.floor(color.R * 255 / 4) / 255, math.floor(color.G * 255 / 4) / 255, math.floor(color.B * 255 / 4) / 255)
        local pen = 0
        for _, code in ipairs(JavaGui.codepoints(text)) do
            local sprite, gx, gy, advance, gw, gh, gyOffset = JavaGui.glyph(code)
            local page = content
            if sprite ~= data.font then
                page = JavaGui.content(sprite)
                if not page then page, gx, gy, gw, gh, gyOffset = content, 63 % 16 * 8, math.floor(63 / 16) * 8, 8, 8, 0 end
            end
            if code ~= 32 then
                for pass = shadow and 1 or 2, 2 do
                    local glyph = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                    glyph.BackgroundTransparency, glyph.ImageContent, glyph.ResampleMode = 1, page, Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated
                    glyph.ImageRectOffset, glyph.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(gx, gy), Vector2.new(gw, gh)
                    glyph.Size, glyph.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(gw, gh), UDim2.fromOffset(pen + (pass == 1 and 1 or 0), gyOffset + (pass == 1 and 1 or 0))
                    glyph.ImageColor3, glyph.ZIndex = pass == 1 and shadowColor or color, holder.ZIndex + (pass == 1 and 0 or 1)
                    glyph.Parent = holder
                end
            end
            pen = pen + advance
        end
    end
    holder.Parent = parent
    return holder
end
function JavaGui.maxDamage(id)
    local stat, entry = toolStats[id], JavaContent.byIndex[id]
    local armor = entry and JavaContent.data.armor and JavaContent.data.armor[entry.id]
    return stat and stat.durability or armor and armor.durability
end
-- GuiGraphics.renderItem() + renderItemDecorations(): 16x16 item, count at (17 - width, 9)
-- with shadow, and a 13x2 durability bar at (2, 13) coloured hsv(remaining / 3, 1, 1).
-- Item model layers the plain icon cannot show (ItemModel tints and range_dispatch properties):
