-- potion / tipped arrow / leather / firework star / map colours, compass and clock frames, crossbow
-- and bow pull states, the enchantment glint and the cooldown sweep.
JavaGui.dynamic = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local glintNodes = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function itemName(stack) local e = stack and JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]; return e and (e.itemId or e.id) end
local foil = {enchanted_book = true, enchanted_golden_apple = true, experience_bottle = true, nether_star = true, end_crystal = true, debug_stick = true}
-- Returns the layers ({sprite name, tint}) and whether the item animates.
function JavaGui.layers(stack)
    local name = itemName(stack)
    if not name then return nil end
    local dyn = JavaContent.dynamicFrame and JavaContent.dynamicFrame(stack, name)
    if dyn then return {{dyn}}, true end
    local potion = stack.potion and JavaContent.potionColor
    if name == "potion" or name == "splash_potion" or name == "lingering_potion" then
        return {{"item/potion_overlay", JavaContent.potionColor and JavaContent.potionColor(stack) or 0x385DC6}, {"item/" .. name}}
    end
    if name == "tipped_arrow" then return {{"item/tipped_arrow_head", potion and JavaContent.potionColor(stack) or 0x385DC6}, {"item/tipped_arrow_base"}} end
    -- items/light.json: select on block_state level -> item/light_00..15.
    if name == "light" then
        local level = tonumber(stack.blockState and stack.blockState.level) or 15
        return {{string.format("item/light_%02d", math.clamp(level, 0, 15))}}
    end
    local leather = name:match("^leather_(%a+)$")
    if leather and (leather == "helmet" or leather == "chestplate" or leather == "leggings" or leather == "boots" or leather == "horse_armor") then
        return {{"item/" .. name, stack.dyed or 0xA06540}, {"item/" .. name .. "_overlay"}}
    end
    if name == "firework_star" then
        local colors = stack.explosion and stack.explosion.colors or {}
        local r, g, b = 0, 0, 0
        for _, c in ipairs(colors) do r = r + math.floor(c / 65536) % 256; g = g + math.floor(c / 256) % 256; b = b + c % 256 end
        local tint = #colors > 0 and (math.floor(r / #colors) * 65536 + math.floor(g / #colors) * 256 + math.floor(b / #colors)) or 0x8A8A8A
        return {{"item/firework_star"}, {"item/firework_star_overlay", tint}}
    end
    if name == "filled_map" then return {{"item/filled_map"}, {"filled_map_markings", 0x46402E}} end
    if name == "crossbow" and stack.charged then return {{stack.charged.name == "firework_rocket" and "item/crossbow_firework" or "item/crossbow_arrow"}} end
    return nil
end
-- Decals filter smoothly: a small EditableImage is enlarged (nearest) first so its pixels stay sharp.
JavaGui.sharpCache = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
function JavaGui.sharpContent(content)
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        local image = content.Object
        if not image then return content end
        local cached = JavaGui.sharpCache[image]
        if cached then return cached end
        local size = image.Size
        local f = math.max(1, math.floor(256 / math.max(size.X, size.Y)))
        if f <= 1 then return content end
        local src = image:ReadPixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, size)
        local W, H = size.X * f, size.Y * f
        local dst = buffer.create(W * H * 4)
        for y = 0, H - 1 do
            local row = math.floor(y / f) * size.X
            for x = 0, W - 1 do buffer.writeu32(dst, (y * W + x) * 4, buffer.readu32(src, (row + math.floor(x / f)) * 4)) end
        end
        local out = game:GetService("AssetService"):CreateEditableImage({Size = Vector2.new(W, H)})
        out:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Vector2.new(W, H), dst)
        local c = Content.fromObject(out)
        JavaGui.sharpCache[image] = c
        return c
    end)
    return ok and result or content
end
-- InventoryScreen.renderEntityInInventoryFollowsMouse: the player in the box (x0, y0)-(x1, y1) at `scale` GUI
-- pixels a block, its body turned f*20 degrees and head f*40 / g*20 toward the mouse (f, g = atan(offset / 40)).
-- A ViewportFrame copy of Steve's body (skin faces as Decals, which ViewportFrames draw; SurfaceGuis they do not).
function JavaGui.playerPreview(parent, x0, y0, x1, y1, scale)
    local Players, RunService = game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("RunService")
    local UIS, GuiService = game:GetService("UserInputService"), game:GetService("GuiService")
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    local B = CONFIG.Block
    local vf = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
    vf.Name, vf.BackgroundTransparency, vf.ZIndex = "PlayerPreview", 1, 4
    vf.Position, vf.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(x0, y0), UDim2.fromOffset(x1 - x0, y1 - y0)
    vf.Ambient, vf.LightColor, vf.LightDirection = Color3.fromRGB(165, 165, 165), Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120), Vector3.new(-0.3, -0.5, 0.8)
    vf.Parent = parent
    local world = Instance.new("WorldModel")
    world.Parent = vf
    local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
    camera.FieldOfView = 4
    camera.Parent = vf
    vf.CurrentCamera = camera
    local studsTall = (y1 - y0) / scale * B
    local distance = studsTall / (2 * math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView) / 2))
    camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, 0, -distance), Vector3.zero)
    local sources, copies, kinds, nextCheck = {}, {}, {}, 0
    -- Everything drawn on the player: the body, worn armour and held items (catalog models, Roblox tools).
    local function gather(character, body)
        local list = {}
        for _, part in ipairs(body:GetDescendants()) do if part:IsA("BasePart") then list[#list + 1] = {part, "body"} end end
        local W = rawget(_G, "SteveWorld")
        local ok, extra = pcall(function() return W and W.previewModels and W.previewModels() or {} end)
        for _, e in ipairs(ok and extra or {}) do
            if e.model then
                for _, part in ipairs(e.model:GetDescendants()) do if part:IsA("BasePart") then list[#list + 1] = {part, e.head and "head" or "extra"} end end
            end
        end
        local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if tool then for _, part in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do if part:IsA("BasePart") then list[#list + 1] = {part, "tool"} end end end
        return list
    end
    local function rebuild(list)
        world:ClearAllChildren()
        sources, copies, kinds = {}, {}, {}
        for _, item in ipairs(list) do
            local part, kind = item[1], item[2]
            if kind == "tool" then
                -- Roblox tool parts are copied as they are (meshes, textures), without scripts, sounds or joints.
                local c = part:Clone()
                for _, d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("Sound") or d:IsA("JointInstance") or d:IsA("Constraint") or d:IsA("BasePart") then d:Destroy() end
                end
                c.Anchored, c.CanCollide, c.CanQuery, c.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
                c.Parent = world
                sources[#sources + 1], copies[#copies + 1], kinds[#kinds + 1] = part, c, kind
            else
                local c = Instance.new("Part")
                c.Anchored, c.CanCollide, c.CanQuery, c.CanTouch, c.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
                c.Size, c.Transparency = part.Size, 1
                local surfaced = false
                for _, s in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                    if s:IsA("SurfaceGui") or s:IsA("Decal") then surfaced = true end
                end
                -- Armour and held-item pixel parts carry their colour on the part itself.
                if kind ~= "body" and not surfaced then c.Color, c.Material, c.Transparency = part.Color, part.Material, part.Transparency end
                for _, s in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                    if s:IsA("SurfaceGui") and s.Name == "StevePixelSurface" then
                        local img = s:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ImageLabel")
                        if img then
                            local d = Instance.new("Decal")
                            d.Face, d.Color3 = s.Face, img.ImageColor3
                            pcall(function() d.TextureContent = JavaGui.sharpContent(img.ImageContent) end)
                            d.Parent = c
                        end
                    elseif s:IsA("Decal") then s:Clone().Parent = c end
                end
                c.Parent = world
                sources[#sources + 1], copies[#copies + 1], kinds[#kinds + 1] = part, c, kind
            end
        end
    end
    local connection
    connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not vf.Parent then connection:Disconnect(); world:Destroy(); return end
        local character = player.Character
        local body = character and character:FindFirstChild("SteveBody")
        local torso = body and body:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        local head = body and body:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not (torso and head and hrp) or vf.AbsoluteSize.Y < 1 then return end
        if os.clock() >= nextCheck then
            nextCheck = os.clock() + 0.5
            local list = gather(character, body)
            local same = #list == #sources
            if same then for i, item in ipairs(list) do if sources[i] ~= item[1] then same = false; break end end end
            if not same then rebuild(list) end
        end
        -- The mouse relative to the box centre, in GUI pixels.
        local m = UIS:GetMouseLocation() - GuiService:GetGuiInset()
        local a, size = vf.AbsolutePosition, vf.AbsoluteSize
        local unit = size.Y / (y1 - y0)
        local f = math.atan(-(m.X - (a.X + size.X / 2)) / unit / 40)
        local g = math.atan(-(m.Y - (a.Y + size.Y / 2)) / unit / 40)
        local bodyYaw, headYaw, headPitch = math.rad(-f * 20), math.rad(-f * 20), math.rad(g * 20)
        -- The live pose (limb swing, sneaking...) relative to the torso; the body faces the camera.
        local look = torso.CFrame.LookVector
        local feetY = hrp.Position.Y - hrp.Size.Y / 2
        local flat = CFrame.new(torso.Position.X, feetY, torso.Position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z), 0)
        local torsoFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, bodyYaw, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -(0.9 + 0.0625) * B, 0) * flat:ToObjectSpace(torso.CFrame)
        -- The head turns about the neck: take out its live turn, put in the mouse's.
        local pivot = CFrame.new(0, torso.Size.Y / 2, 0)
        local live = torso.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(head.CFrame)
        local headFix = pivot * CFrame.Angles(0, headYaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(headPitch, 0, 0) * live.Rotation:Inverse() * pivot:Inverse()
        for i, part in ipairs(sources) do
            local c = copies[i]
            if part.Parent and c then
                local rel = torso.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
                if kinds[i] == "head" or part == head or part:IsDescendantOf(head) then rel = headFix * rel end
                c.CFrame = torsoFrame * rel
                if kinds[i] == "extra" and c.Transparency < 1 then c.Color = part.Color end
            end
        end
    end)
    return vf
end
-- Minecraft Java Game Menu (PauseScreen), Options and Mods screens. Esc still opens Roblox's menu underneath
-- (cursor free, game input paused); its visuals are hidden while this one shows.
do
    local MENU_SPRITES = {
        ["widget/slider"] = {w=200,h=20,p={0,2829099,2697513,2894892,2960685,3026478,3092271,2763306,2500134,2434341,2631720,3355443,3223857,3158064,2565927,3289650,3421236,2368548},d=""},
        ["widget/slider_highlighted"] = {w=200,h=20,p={16777215,2829099,2697513,2894892,2960685,3026478,3092271,2763306,2500134,2434341,2631720,3355443,3223857,3158064,2565927,3289650,3421236,2368548},d=""},
        ["widget/slider_handle"] = {w=8,h=20,p={0,11184810,7303023,7105644,6842472,5395026,7237230,7039851,5592405,11053224,7368816,7171437,6908265,5526612,5855577,10921638,5658198,11250603,5197647,7631988,5789784,7434609,7566195,7697781,5723991},d=""},
        ["widget/slider_handle_highlighted"] = {w=8,h=20,p={16777215,11513775,7697781,7500402,7237230,5723991,7631988,7434609,5987163,11447982,7763574,7566195,7303023,5855577,6250335,11316396,6052956,11579568,5526612,8026746,6184542,7829367,7960953,8092539,6118749},d=""},
        ["inworld_menu_background"] = {w=16,h=16,p={0},d="",alpha={0.251}},
        ["inworld_menu_list_background"] = {w=16,h=16,p={0},d="",alpha={0.439}},
        ["inworld_header_separator"] = {w=32,h=2,p={16777215,0},d="01010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010202020202020202020202020202020202020202020202020202020202020202",alpha={0.200,0.749}},
        ["inworld_footer_separator"] = {w=32,h=2,p={0,16777215},d="01010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010202020202020202020202020202020202020202020202020202020202020202",alpha={0.749,0.200}},
    }
    local OPTIONS_FILE = "SteveOptions.json"
    local defaults = {fov = 70, sensitivity = 100, invertMouse = false, viewBobbing = true, renderDistance = 12,
        maxFramerate = 120, guiScale = 0, brightness = 50, fovEffects = 100, blur = 5, masterVolume = 100}
    JavaGui.options = JavaGui.options or {}
    for k, v in pairs(defaults) do if JavaGui.options[k] == nil then JavaGui.options[k] = v end end
    pcall(function()
        if isfile and isfile(OPTIONS_FILE) then
            local saved = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile(OPTIONS_FILE))
            for k, v in pairs(saved) do if defaults[k] ~= nil and type(v) == type(defaults[k]) then JavaGui.options[k] = v end end
        end
    end)
    local function saveOptions()
        pcall(function() if writefile then writefile(OPTIONS_FILE, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(JavaGui.options)) end end)
    end
    -- Apply the options to the game (called after every change and once at start).
    function JavaGui.applyOptions()
        local o = JavaGui.options
        CONFIG.FOV = o.fov
        -- FOV Effects scales the sprint widening (and the bow zoom, which multiplies the FOV).
        CONFIG.SprintFOV = o.fov + (o.fov * 78 / 70 - o.fov) * (o.fovEffects / 100)
        CONFIG.MouseSensitivity = 0.006 * o.sensitivity / 100
        CONFIG.InvertMouse = o.invertMouse
        CONFIG.ViewBobbing = o.viewBobbing
        JavaGui.guiScaleOption = o.guiScale
        if MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.volume = o.masterVolume / 100 end
        pcall(function() if setfpscap then setfpscap(o.maxFramerate >= 260 and 0 or o.maxFramerate) end end)
        local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
        local cc = lighting:FindFirstChild("SteveBrightness")
        if not cc then cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect"); cc.Name = "SteveBrightness"; cc.Parent = lighting end
        cc.Brightness = (o.brightness - 50) / 50 * 0.2
    end
    JavaGui.applyOptions()

    function JavaGui.pauseMenu(ctx)
        for name, sprite in pairs(MENU_SPRITES) do if not JavaContent.data.javaGui[name] then JavaContent.data.javaGui[name] = sprite end end
        local G = JavaContent.data.javaGui
        local Players, RunService, UIS, GuiService = game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("RunService"), game:GetService("UserInputService"), game:GetService("GuiService")
        local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
        local player = Players.LocalPlayer
        local lang = JavaContent.data.lang or {}
        local function L(key, fallback) return lang[key] or fallback end
        local WHITE, GRAY = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 160)
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.IgnoreGuiInset, gui.DisplayOrder, gui.Enabled = "SteveJavaMenu", false, true, 1500, false
        gui.Parent = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        local backdrop = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        backdrop.Name, backdrop.BackgroundTransparency, backdrop.Size, backdrop.ZIndex = "Backdrop", 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 1
        backdrop.ScaleType, backdrop.ResampleMode = Enum.ScaleType.Tile, Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated
        pcall(function() backdrop.ImageContent = JavaGui.content(G["inworld_menu_background"]) end)
        backdrop.Parent = gui
        local canvas = Instance.new("Frame")
        canvas.Name, canvas.BackgroundTransparency, canvas.ZIndex = "Canvas", 1, 2
        canvas.Parent = gui
        local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale"); uiScale.Parent = canvas
        local blur
        local state = {screen = nil, open = false, robloxShown = false, built = nil}
        local hover = {}
        local function click() if MinecraftSounds then pcall(MinecraftSounds.play, "ui.button.click", nil, 0.25, 1) end end

        -- Widgets ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local function button(parent, x, y, w, label, onClick, enabled)
            enabled = enabled ~= false
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
            b.Text, b.BackgroundTransparency, b.AutoButtonColor, b.ZIndex = "", 1, false, 3
            b.Position, b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), UDim2.fromOffset(w, 20)
            b.Parent = parent
            local normal = JavaGui.slice(b, G["widget/button"], 3, 0, 0, w, 20, 3)
            local lit = JavaGui.slice(b, G["widget/button_highlighted"], 3, 0, 0, w, 20, 3)
            local off = JavaGui.slice(b, G["widget/button_disabled"], 3, 0, 0, w, 20, 3)
            local text
            local function setLabel(t)
                if text then text:Destroy() end
                text = JavaGui.text(b, t, math.floor((w - JavaGui.width(t)) / 2), 6, enabled and WHITE or GRAY, true, 4)
            end
            setLabel(label)
            local function draw() normal.Visible = enabled and not hover[b]; lit.Visible = enabled and hover[b] == true; off.Visible = not enabled end
            b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() hover[b] = true; draw() end)
            b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hover[b] = nil; draw() end)
            b.Activated:Connect(function() if enabled and onClick then click(); onClick() end end)
            draw()
            return {b = b, setLabel = setLabel}
        end
        -- AbstractSliderButton: 8x20 handle over the 1px-bordered track; dragging sets the value.
        local function slider(parent, x, y, w, value, steps, label, onChange)
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
            b.Text, b.BackgroundTransparency, b.AutoButtonColor, b.ZIndex = "", 1, false, 3
            b.Position, b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), UDim2.fromOffset(w, 20)
            b.Parent = parent
            local track = JavaGui.slice(b, G["widget/slider"], 1, 0, 0, w, 20, 3)
            local trackLit = JavaGui.slice(b, G["widget/slider_highlighted"], 1, 0, 0, w, 20, 3)
            local handle = JavaGui.image(b, G["widget/slider_handle"], 0, 0, 8, 20, nil, 4)
            local handleLit = JavaGui.image(b, G["widget/slider_handle_highlighted"], 0, 0, 8, 20, nil, 4)
            local text
            local v = value
            local function draw()
                local hot = hover[b] == true or state.dragging == b
                track.Visible, trackLit.Visible = not hot, hot
                handle.Visible, handleLit.Visible = not hot, hot
                local hx = math.floor(v * (w - 8) + 0.5)
                handle.Position, handleLit.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(hx, 0), UDim2.fromOffset(hx, 0)
                if text then text:Destroy() end
                local t = label(v)
                text = JavaGui.text(b, t, math.floor((w - JavaGui.width(t)) / 2), 6, WHITE, true, 5)
            end
            local function setFromMouse()
                local m = UIS:GetMouseLocation() - GuiService:GetGuiInset()
                local s = uiScale.Scale
                local nv = math.clamp((m.X - b.AbsolutePosition.X - 4 * s) / math.max(1, b.AbsoluteSize.X - 8 * s), 0, 1)
                if steps and steps > 0 then nv = math.floor(nv * steps + 0.5) / steps end
                if nv ~= v then v = nv; onChange(v); draw() end
            end
            b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() hover[b] = true; draw() end)
            b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hover[b] = nil; draw() end)
            b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    state.dragging = b; state.dragMove = setFromMouse; setFromMouse(); draw()
                end
            end)
            draw()
            return b
        end
        local function title(parent, W, y, t) return JavaGui.text(parent, t, math.floor((W - JavaGui.width(t)) / 2), y, WHITE, true, 4) end
        -- In-world list area: the list background between the header and footer separators.
        local function listArea(parent, W, top, bottom)
            local bg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            bg.BackgroundTransparency, bg.ZIndex = 1, 2
            bg.Position, bg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, top), UDim2.fromOffset(W, bottom - top)
            bg.ScaleType, bg.TileSize, bg.ResampleMode = Enum.ScaleType.Tile, UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated
            pcall(function() bg.ImageContent = JavaGui.content(G["inworld_menu_list_background"]) end)
            bg.Parent = parent
            for _, sep in ipairs({{"inworld_header_separator", top - 2}, {"inworld_footer_separator", bottom}}) do
                local line = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                line.BackgroundTransparency, line.ZIndex = 1, 3
                line.Position, line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, sep[2]), UDim2.fromOffset(W, 2)
                line.ScaleType, line.TileSize, line.ResampleMode = Enum.ScaleType.Tile, UDim2.fromOffset(32, 2), Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated
                pcall(function() line.ImageContent = JavaGui.content(G[sep[1]]) end)
                line.Parent = parent
            end
        end
        local function onOff(v) return v and L("options.on", "ON") or L("options.off", "OFF") end
        local function value(label, v) return label .. ": " .. v end
        local function changed() JavaGui.applyOptions(); saveOptions() end

        -- Screens ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local screens = {}
        local function show(name) state.screen = name; state.built = nil end
        -- While the menu shows, the controller frees the cursor and ignores game input (cursor request).
        local function cursorRequest(on)
            local requests = rawget(_G, "SteveCursorRequests")
            if on and type(requests) ~= "table" then requests = {}; rawset(_G, "SteveCursorRequests", requests) end
            if type(requests) == "table" then requests.SteveJavaMenu = on or nil end
        end
        local function closeMenu()
            state.open = false
            gui.Enabled = false
            if blur then blur.Enabled = false end
            cursorRequest(false)
        end
        function screens.pause(root, W, H)
            if DEVELOPER_TAGS[player.Name] == nil then title(root, W, math.max(math.floor((H - 116) * 0.25), 36) - 16, L("menu.game", "Game Menu"))
            else title(root, W, math.max(math.floor((H - 140) * 0.25), 36) - 16, L("menu.game", "Game Menu")) end
            local dev = DEVELOPER_TAGS[player.Name] ~= nil
            local top = math.max(math.floor((H - (dev and 140 or 116)) * 0.25), 36)
            local x = math.floor(W / 2 - 102)
            button(root, x, top, 204, L("menu.returnToGame", "Back to Game"), closeMenu)
            button(root, x, top + 24, 98, L("gui.advancements", "Advancements"), nil, false)
            button(root, x + 106, top + 24, 98, L("gui.stats", "Statistics"), nil, false)
            button(root, x, top + 48, 98, "Mods", function() show("mods") end)
            button(root, x + 106, top + 48, 98, "Report Players", function() state.report = {}; show("report_player") end)
            button(root, x, top + 72, 98, L("menu.options", "Options..."), function() show("options") end)
            button(root, x + 106, top + 72, 98, "Servers", function() show("servers"); state.refreshServers() end)
            if dev then button(root, x, top + 96, 204, "Reports", function() show("reports"); state.refreshReports() end) end
            button(root, x, top + (dev and 120 or 96), 204, "Quit Script", function()
                closeMenu()
                -- Stop everything: the script cleans up and Roblox is back to normal until it is executed again.
                task.defer(function() stopEvent:Fire() end)
            end)
        end
        function screens.options(root, W, H)
            local o = JavaGui.options
            title(root, W, 12, L("options.title", "Options"))
            local cx = math.floor(W / 2)
            slider(root, cx - 155, 29, 150, (o.fov - 30) / 80, 80, function(v)
                local fov = math.floor(30 + v * 80 + 0.5)
                local shown = fov == 70 and L("options.fov.min", "Normal") or fov == 110 and L("options.fov.max", "Quake Pro") or tostring(fov)
                return value(L("options.fov", "FOV"), shown)
            end, function(v) o.fov = math.floor(30 + v * 80 + 0.5); changed() end)
            button(root, cx + 5, 29, 150, L("options.online", "Online..."), nil, false)
            local rows = {
                {{L("options.skinCustomisation", "Skin Customization..."), nil}, {L("options.sounds", "Music & Sounds..."), "sounds"}},
                {{L("options.video", "Video Settings..."), "video"}, {L("options.controls", "Controls..."), "controls"}},
                {{L("options.language", "Language..."), nil}, {L("options.chat", "Chat Settings..."), nil}},
                {{L("options.resourcepack", "Resource Packs..."), nil}, {L("options.accessibility", "Accessibility Settings..."), nil}},
                {{L("options.telemetry", "Telemetry Data..."), nil}, {L("options.credits_and_attribution", "Credits & Attribution..."), nil}},
            }
            local top = 61 + math.max(0, math.floor((H - 33 - 61 - 116) / 2))
            for i, row in ipairs(rows) do
                for j, cell in ipairs(row) do
                    local target = cell[2]
                    button(root, j == 1 and cx - 155 or cx + 5, top + (i - 1) * 24, 150, cell[1], target and function() show(target) end or nil, target ~= nil)
                end
            end
            button(root, cx - 100, H - 27, 200, L("gui.done", "Done"), function() show("pause") end)
        end
        function screens.video(root, W, H)
            local o = JavaGui.options
            title(root, W, 12, L("options.videoTitle", "Video Settings"))
            listArea(root, W, 33, H - 33)
            local cx = math.floor(W / 2)
            local entries = {
                {"slider", (o.renderDistance - 2) / 30, 30, function(v) return value(L("options.renderDistance", "Render Distance"), (L("options.chunks", "%s chunks"):gsub("%%s", tostring(math.floor(2 + v * 30 + 0.5))))) end,
                    function(v) o.renderDistance = math.floor(2 + v * 30 + 0.5) end},
                {"slider", (math.min(o.maxFramerate, 260) - 10) / 250, 25, function(v)
                    local f = math.floor(10 + v * 250 + 0.5)
                    return value(L("options.framerateLimit", "Max Framerate"), f >= 260 and L("options.framerateLimit.max", "Unlimited") or (L("options.framerate", "%s fps"):gsub("%%s", tostring(f))))
                end, function(v) o.maxFramerate = math.floor(10 + v * 250 + 0.5) end},
                {"toggle", L("options.viewBobbing", "View Bobbing"), "viewBobbing"},
                {"cycle", L("options.guiScale", "GUI Scale"), "guiScale", {0, 1, 2, 3, 4}, function(x) return x == 0 and L("options.guiScale.auto", "Auto") or tostring(x) end},
                {"slider", o.brightness / 100, 100, function(v)
                    local p = math.floor(v * 100 + 0.5)
                    return value(L("options.gamma", "Brightness"), p == 0 and L("options.gamma.min", "Moody") or p == 100 and L("options.gamma.max", "Bright") or p == 50 and L("options.gamma.default", "Default") or ("+" .. p .. "%"))
                end, function(v) o.brightness = math.floor(v * 100 + 0.5) end},
                {"slider", o.fovEffects / 100, 100, function(v) return value(L("options.fovEffectScale", "FOV Effects"), math.floor(v * 100 + 0.5) .. "%") end,
                    function(v) o.fovEffects = math.floor(v * 100 + 0.5) end},
                {"slider", o.blur / 10, 10, function(v) return value(L("options.accessibility.menu_background_blurriness", "Menu Background Blur"), tostring(math.floor(v * 10 + 0.5))) end,

                        o[key] = list[idx % #list + 1]; changed(); btn.setLabel(value(e[2], fmt(o[key])))
                    end)

            end
            button(root, cx - 100, H - 27, 200, L("gui.done", "Done"), function() show("options") end)
        end

        function screens.mods(root, W, H)
            title(root, W, 12, "Mods")
            listArea(root, W, 33, H - 33)
            local function clip(text, width)
                text = tostring(text or "")
                if JavaGui.width(text) <= width then return text end
                while #text > 1 and JavaGui.width(text .. "...") > width do text = text:sub(1, -2) end
                return text .. "..."
            end
            local cx = math.floor(W / 2)
            if #JavaContent.mods.list == 0 then
                local t = "No mods loaded"
                JavaGui.text(root, t, math.floor((W - JavaGui.width(t)) / 2), math.floor((33 + H - 33) / 2) - 4, GRAY, true, 4)
            end
            local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
            scroll.BackgroundTransparency, scroll.BorderSizePixel, scroll.ZIndex = 1, 0, 3
            scroll.Position, scroll.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 35), UDim2.fromOffset(W, H - 33 - 35 - 2 - 18)
            scroll.ScrollBarThickness, scroll.CanvasSize = 6, UDim2.fromOffset(0, #JavaContent.mods.list * 50 + 8)
            scroll.Parent = root
            for i, mod in ipairs(JavaContent.mods.list) do
                local y = 4 + (i - 1) * 50
                if mod.icon then JavaGui.image(scroll, mod.icon, cx - 155, y, 40, 40, nil, 4) end
                JavaGui.text(scroll, clip(mod.name, 190), cx - 110, y + 1, WHITE, true, 4)
                JavaGui.text(scroll, clip("by " .. tostring(mod.author) .. " - " .. tostring(mod.version), 190), cx - 110, y + 12, GRAY, true, 4)
                local desc = tostring(mod.description or "")
                local cut = #desc
                while cut > 1 and JavaGui.width(desc:sub(1, cut)) > 190 do cut = cut - 1 end
                JavaGui.text(scroll, desc:sub(1, cut), cx - 110, y + 23, GRAY, true, 4)
                if cut < #desc then JavaGui.text(scroll, clip(desc:sub(cut + 1):gsub("^ ", ""), 190), cx - 110, y + 33, GRAY, true, 4) end
                local met, needs = JavaContent.mods.requiresMet(mod)
                local label = mod.enabling and "Loading..." or ((not mod.enabled and not met) and ("Needs " .. tostring(needs)) or ("Enabled: " .. onOff(mod.enabled)))
                button(scroll, cx + 86, y, 74, label, function()
                    if mod.enabled then
                        -- addons that need this mod go off with it
                        for _, other in ipairs(JavaContent.mods.list) do
                            for _, req in ipairs(other.requires or {}) do
                                if req == mod.id and (other.enabled or other.enabling) then pcall(other.disable) end
                            end
                        end
                        pcall(mod.disable)
                    elseif JavaContent.mods.requiresMet(mod) then mod.enable(function() state.built = nil end) end

        end

        local connections = {}
        -- Online: ntfy.sh channels ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local HS = game:GetService("HttpService")
        local req = request or http_request
        local function publish(topic, data)
            if not req then return false end
            local ok, res = pcall(req, {Url = "https://ntfy.sh/" .. topic, Method = "POST", Body = HS:JSONEncode(data)})
            return ok and type(res) == "table" and res.StatusCode == 200
        end
        -- a request that does not answer within `limit` seconds is left behind (its result ignored)
        local function timed(limit, fn)
            local done, a, b = false, nil, nil
            task.spawn(function() a, b = fn(); done = true end)
            local t0 = os.clock()
            while not done and os.clock() - t0 < limit do task.wait(0.2) end
            return done, a, b
        end
        local function pollTopic(topic, since)
            local out = {}
            if not req then return out end
            local _, ok, res = timed(12, function()
                return pcall(req, {Url = "https://ntfy.sh/" .. topic .. "/json?poll=1&since=" .. since, Method = "GET"})
            end)
            if not (ok and type(res) == "table" and res.StatusCode == 200 and type(res.Body) == "string") then return out end
            for line in res.Body:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
                local ok2, msg = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, line)
                if ok2 and type(msg) == "table" and msg.event == "message" and type(msg.message) == "string" then
                    local ok3, data = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, msg.message)
                    if ok3 and type(data) == "table" and data.v == "steve1" then data._time = msg.time; out[#out + 1] = data end
                end
            end
            return out
        end
        local function tagOf(name)
            local t = DEVELOPER_TAGS[name]
            if t then return t[1], t[2] end
            return "Tester", Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 85)
        end
        local function fit(text, width)
            if JavaGui.width(text) <= width then return text end
            while #text > 1 and JavaGui.width(text .. "...") > width do text = text:sub(1, -2) end
            return text .. "..."
        end
        local function ago(t)
            local d = math.max(0, os.time() - (tonumber(t) or os.time()))
            if d < 60 then return d .. "s ago" elseif d < 3600 then return math.floor(d / 60) .. "m ago" end
            return math.floor(d / 3600) .. "h ago"
        end
        local function message(root, W, y, text, color)
            JavaGui.text(root, text, math.floor((W - JavaGui.width(text)) / 2), y, color or GRAY, true, 4)
        end
        local function scrollList(root, W, top, bottom, height)
            local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
            list.BackgroundTransparency, list.BorderSizePixel, list.ZIndex = 1, 0, 3
            list.Position, list.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, top), UDim2.fromOffset(W, bottom - top)
            list.ScrollBarThickness, list.CanvasSize = 6, UDim2.fromOffset(0, height)
            list.Parent = root
            return list
        end

        -- Presence: once a minute, this server's details go to the Servers channel.
        -- this server's details to the Servers channel (not more than once a minute; 30 minutes' pause after "quota reached")
        local lastAnnounce, pauseUntil = 0, 0
        function state.announce()
            if game.JobId == "" or os.clock() - lastAnnounce < 60 or os.time() < pauseUntil or not req then return end
            lastAnnounce = os.clock()
            timed(10, function()
                local ok, res = pcall(req, {Url = "https://ntfy.sh/" .. STEVE_ONLINE.PresenceTopic, Method = "POST", Body = HS:JSONEncode({v = "steve1",
                    u = player.UserId, n = player.Name, d = player.DisplayName, p = game.PlaceId, g = game.GameId, j = game.JobId,
                    c = #Players:GetPlayers(), m = Players.MaxPlayers, t = os.time()})})
                if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.StatusCode == 429 then pauseUntil = os.time() + 1800 end
            end)
        end
        state.presence = true
        local presenceToken = {}
        _G.StevePresenceToken = presenceToken   -- the newest menu owns the loop (one per client)
        task.spawn(function()
            while state.presence and _G.StevePresenceToken == presenceToken do
                if game.JobId ~= "" then state.announce() end
                task.spawn(function()
                    local okB, ban = pcall(function() return SteveBans.find(SteveBans.fetch(), player) end)
                    if okB and ban and state.presence then
                        state.presence = false
                        SteveBans.screen(ban)
                        task.defer(function() stopEvent:Fire() end)
                    end
                end)
                -- every 5 minutes: ntfy.sh allows about 250 messages a day per connection (once a minute ran out in hours)
                for _ = 1, 300 do if not state.presence or _G.StevePresenceToken ~= presenceToken then break end task.wait(1) end
            end
        end)

        -- Servers -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local servers = {list = nil, loading = false, status = nil}
        function state.refreshServers()
            if servers.loading then return end
            servers.loading, servers.list, servers.status = true, nil, nil
            state.built = nil
            task.spawn(function()
                local latest = {}
                if state.announce then pcall(state.announce) end
                -- servers announce every 5 minutes: one seen in the last 7 is online
                for _, m in ipairs(pollTopic(STEVE_ONLINE.PresenceTopic, "7m")) do
                    if type(m.u) == "number" and type(m.j) == "string" and m.j ~= "" and os.time() - (tonumber(m.t) or 0) < 420 then
                        local prev = latest[m.u]
                        if not prev or (tonumber(m.t) or 0) > (tonumber(prev.t) or 0) then latest[m.u] = m end
                    end
                end
                local byJob = {}
                for _, m in pairs(latest) do
                    if true then
                        local srv = byJob[m.j]
                        if not srv then srv = {job = m.j, place = tonumber(m.p), universe = tonumber(m.g), count = tonumber(m.c) or 0, max = tonumber(m.m) or 0, users = {}}; byJob[m.j] = srv end
                        srv.users[#srv.users + 1] = m
                        srv.count = math.max(srv.count, tonumber(m.c) or 0)
                    end
                end
                local list = {}
                for _, srv in pairs(byJob) do list[#list + 1] = srv end
                for _, srv in ipairs(list) do srv.own = srv.job == game.JobId end
                table.sort(list, function(a, b)
                    if a.own ~= b.own then return a.own end
                    return #a.users > #b.users
                end)
                for _, srv in ipairs(list) do
                    local ok, info = pcall(function() return game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(srv.place) end)
                    srv.name = ok and type(info) == "table" and info.Name or ("Place " .. tostring(srv.place))
                end
                servers.list, servers.loading = list, false
                state.built = nil
            end)
        end
        local function join(srv)
            -- the saved copy of the build that is running now; another saved build only if none matches (and it says so)
            local code, other
            for _, f in ipairs(STEVE_ONLINE.AutoExecuteFiles) do
                local ok, src = pcall(function() return isfile and isfile(f) and readfile(f) end)
                if ok and type(src) == "string" and #src > 0 then
                    local run = "loadstring(readfile(" .. string.format("%q", f) .. "))()"
                    local b = src:sub(1, 6000):match('Build = "([^"]+)"')
                    if b and b == STEVE_ONLINE.Build then code = run; break end
                    other = other or {run, f}
                end
            end
            local note = ""
            if not code and other then
                code = other[1]
                note = " (the saved " .. other[2] .. " is a different version: save this script as Minecraft Steve.luau in the workspace folder)"
            end
            if code and queue_on_teleport then pcall(queue_on_teleport, code) end
            servers.status = code and ("Joining " .. srv.name .. "..." .. note) or "Joining... (no script file found to run after the teleport)"
            state.built = nil
            local ok, err = pcall(function() game:GetService("TeleportService"):TeleportToPlaceInstance(srv.place, srv.job, player) end)
            if not ok then servers.status = "Could not join: " .. tostring(err); state.built = nil end
        end
        connections[#connections + 1] = game:GetService("TeleportService").TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(who, result, err)
            if who == player then servers.status = "Could not join: " .. tostring(err ~= "" and err or result); state.built = nil end
        end)
        function screens.servers(root, W, H)
            title(root, W, 12, "Servers")
            listArea(root, W, 33, H - 64)
            local cx = math.floor(W / 2)
            if servers.loading then message(root, W, math.floor(H / 2) - 20, "Scanning for servers...")
            elseif servers.list and #servers.list == 0 then message(root, W, math.floor(H / 2) - 20, "No servers are running the Minecraft script right now")
            elseif servers.list then
                local list = scrollList(root, W, 35, H - 66, #servers.list * 40 + 4)
                for i, srv in ipairs(servers.list) do
                    local x0, y = cx - 152, 2 + (i - 1) * 40
                    local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                    icon.BackgroundColor3, icon.BorderSizePixel, icon.ZIndex = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0, 4
                    icon.Position, icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(x0 + 2, y + 2), UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32)
                    icon.Image = "rbxthumb://type=GameIcon&id=" .. tostring(srv.universe) .. "&w=150&h=150"
                    icon.Parent = list
                    JavaGui.text(list, fit(srv.name, 200), x0 + 37, y + 2, WHITE, true, 4)
                    local players = srv.count .. "/" .. srv.max
                    JavaGui.text(list, players, x0 + 305 - JavaGui.width(players) - 2, y + 2, GRAY, true, 4)
                    -- Script users there, with their tags.
                    local px = x0 + 37
                    for k, u in ipairs(srv.users) do
                        if k > 2 then JavaGui.text(list, "+" .. (#srv.users - 2), px, y + 13, GRAY, true, 4); break end
                        local tag, color = tagOf(u.n)
                        local nameText = fit(u.n, 70)
                        JavaGui.text(list, nameText, px, y + 13, WHITE, true, 4)
                        px = px + JavaGui.width(nameText) + 3
                        local tagText = "[" .. tag .. "]"
                        JavaGui.text(list, tagText, px, y + 13, color, true, 4)
                        px = px + JavaGui.width(tagText) + 6
                    end
                    JavaGui.text(list, "Server " .. srv.job:sub(1, 8) .. (srv.own and " (your server)" or ""), x0 + 37, y + 24, srv.own and Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 85) or GRAY, true, 4)
                    button(list, x0 + 305 - 44, y + 14, 42, "Join", function() join(srv) end, not srv.own)
                end
            end
            if servers.status then message(root, W, H - 60 + 4, fit(servers.status, W - 20), WHITE) end
            button(root, cx - 154, H - 27, 150, "Refresh", function() state.refreshServers() end)
            button(root, cx + 4, H - 27, 150, L("gui.back", "Back"), function() show("pause") end)
        end

        end

        -- Blocks around the crosshair (or the reported player), with who placed each one.
        local function buildSnapshot(target)
            local world = ctx.world
            local B = CONFIG.Block
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local params = RaycastParams.new()
            params.FilterType, params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, {player.Character}
            local hit = cam and workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.LookVector * 30 * B, params)
            local centre = hit and hit.Position or (target.Character and target.Character:GetPivot().Position) or Vector3.zero
            local origin = workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin")
            if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" then origin = Vector3.new(0, B / 2, 0) end
            local c = origin + Vector3.new(math.floor((centre.X - origin.X) / B + 0.5), math.floor((centre.Y - origin.Y) / B + 0.5), math.floor((centre.Z - origin.Z) / B + 0.5)) * B
            local found = {}
            for _, n in pairs(world.nodes or {}) do
                local d = (n.center - c).Magnitude
                if d <= 8 * B then found[#found + 1] = {n = n, d = d} end
            end
            table.sort(found, function(a, b) return a.d < b.d end)
            local ids, idIndex, placers, placerIndex, parts = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
            for i = 1, math.min(#found, 600) do
                local n = found[i].n
                local rel = (n.center - c) / B
                if not idIndex[n.id] then ids[#ids + 1] = n.id; idIndex[n.id] = #ids end
                local who = n.placer or "?"
                if not placerIndex[who] then placers[#placers + 1] = who; placerIndex[who] = #placers end
                parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%d,%d,%d,%d,%d", math.floor(rel.X + 0.5), math.floor(rel.Y + 0.5), math.floor(rel.Z + 0.5), idIndex[n.id], placerIndex[who])
            end
            -- Players near the snapshot (name, position in blocks, facing), so reviewers see who stood where.
            local people = {}
            for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local char = other.Character
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp then
                    local rel = (hrp.Position - c) / B
                    if rel.Magnitude <= 24 then
                        local look = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
                        people[#people + 1] = string.format("%s,%d,%d,%d,%d", other.Name, math.floor(rel.X + 0.5), math.floor(rel.Y - 0.5), math.floor(rel.Z + 0.5),
                            math.floor(math.deg(math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)) + 0.5))
                    end
                end
            end
            return {ids = ids, placers = placers, blocks = table.concat(parts, ";"), players = table.concat(people, ";")}
        end
        -- The snapshot drawn in a ViewportFrame: blocks in their colours, players as figures (the target in red).
        local function snapshotView(parent, snap, x, y, w, h, targetName, byPlayer)
            local vf = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
            vf.BackgroundColor3, vf.BackgroundTransparency, vf.BorderSizePixel, vf.ZIndex = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24), 0.2, 0, 4
            vf.Position, vf.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
            vf.Ambient, vf.LightColor, vf.LightDirection = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.3)
            vf.Parent = parent
            local wm = Instance.new("WorldModel"); wm.Parent = vf
            local cam = Instance.new("Camera"); cam.FieldOfView = 50; cam.Parent = vf; vf.CurrentCamera = cam
            local lo, hi = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge), Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
            local ids, placers = snap.ids or {}, snap.placers or {}
            for entry in tostring(snap.blocks or ""):gmatch("[^;]+") do
                local bx, by, bz, b, p = entry:match("^(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+),(%d+),(%d+)$")
                if bx then
                    local pos = Vector3.new(tonumber(bx), tonumber(by), tonumber(bz))
                    lo, hi = lo:Min(pos), hi:Max(pos)
                    local id, who = ids[tonumber(b)] or "stone", placers[tonumber(p)] or "?"
                    local part = Instance.new("Part")
                    part.Anchored, part.Size, part.CFrame, part.Material = true, Vector3.new(0.98, 0.98, 0.98), CFrame.new(pos), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                    local colour = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
                    if byPlayer then
                        colour = who == "?" and Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110) or byPlayer[(tonumber(p) - 1) % #byPlayer + 1]
                    else
                        local e = JavaContent.byId[id]
                        local sprite = e and e.particle and JavaContent.data.textures[e.particle]
                        if sprite then colour = JavaContent.averageColor(sprite) end
                    end
                    part.Color = colour
                    part:SetAttribute("Who", who); part:SetAttribute("Block", id)
                    part.Parent = wm
                end
            end
            for entry in tostring(snap.players or ""):gmatch("[^;]+") do
                local name, px, py, pz, yaw = entry:match("^([^,]+),(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+)$")
                if name then
                    local pos = Vector3.new(tonumber(px), tonumber(py), tonumber(pz))
                    lo, hi = lo:Min(pos), hi:Max(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.8, 0))
                    local colour = name == targetName and Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70) or Color3.fromRGB(80, 160, 255)
                    local base = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(tonumber(yaw)), 0)
                    for _, piece in ipairs({{Vector3.new(0.5, 0.75, 0.25), 0.375}, {Vector3.new(0.5, 0.75, 0.25), 1.125}, {Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5), 1.75}}) do
                        local part = Instance.new("Part")
                        part.Anchored, part.Size, part.CFrame, part.Color, part.Material = true, piece[1], base * CFrame.new(0, piece[2] - 0.5, 0), colour, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                        part:SetAttribute("Who", name); part:SetAttribute("Block", "player")
                        part.Parent = wm
                    end
                end
            end
            if lo.X == math.huge then lo, hi = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero end
            local centre, radius = (lo + hi) / 2, math.max(4, (hi - lo).Magnitude / 2 + 2)
            state.previewYaw, state.previewPitch = state.previewYaw or 0.7, state.previewPitch or 0.5
            local function place()
                cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(centre) * CFrame.Angles(0, state.previewYaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-state.previewPitch, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 0, radius * 2.2)
            end
            place()
            local dragging, last
            vf.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging, last = true, input.Position end
            end)
            vf.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
            end)
            vf.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if dragging and last and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                    local d = input.Position - last
                    last = input.Position
                    state.previewYaw = state.previewYaw - d.X * 0.01
                    state.previewPitch = math.clamp(state.previewPitch + d.Y * 0.01, -1.4, 1.4)
                    place()
                end
            end)
            return vf, wm, cam
        end
        local function sendReport()
            local r = state.report
            local target = r.target
            local report = {id = HS:GenerateGUID(false):gsub("-", ""):sub(1, 12), by = player.Name, target = target.Name, targetId = target.UserId,
                kind = r.kind, reason = r.reason, comment = (state.reportComment or ""):sub(1, 300), place = game.PlaceId, job = game.JobId, t = os.time()}
            local chat = ctx.world and ctx.world.chat
            if r.kind == "chat" and chat and chat.log then
                local lines = {}
                for i = math.max(1, #chat.log - 39), #chat.log do lines[#lines + 1] = chat.log[i] end
                report.chat = lines
            elseif r.kind == "build" then
                report.build = r.snapshot or buildSnapshot(target)
            elseif r.kind == "skin" then
                local net = ctx.world and ctx.world.net
                local peer = net and net.peers and net.peers[target]
                report.skin = peer and (peer.skinKey or peer.skin) and tostring(peer.skinKey or peer.skin) or "unknown"
            end
            -- ntfy messages are at most 4 KB: the report goes in numbered parts.
            local json = HS:JSONEncode(report)
            local size = 1500
            local total = math.ceil(#json / size)
            local ok = true
            for i = 1, total do
                ok = publish(STEVE_ONLINE.ReportsTopic, {v = "steve1", r = report.id, i = i, n = total, d = json:sub((i - 1) * size + 1, i * size)}) and ok
                if total > 1 then task.wait(0.3) end
            end
            state.reportStatus = ok and "Report sent. Thank you for keeping the game safe." or "The report could not be sent (no connection)."
            state.reportComment = nil
            show("report_sent")
        end
        function screens.report_reason(root, W, H)
            local r = state.report
            title(root, W, 12, (r.target and r.target.Name or "?") .. ": " .. (r.kind or "?"):gsub("^%l", string.upper))
            listArea(root, W, 33, H - 33)
            local cx = math.floor(W / 2)
            local reasons = REASONS[r.kind] or {}
            for i, reason in ipairs(reasons) do
                local chosen = r.reason == reason
                button(root, cx - 155, 37 + (i - 1) * 22, 150, (chosen and "> " or "") .. fit(reason, 130) .. (chosen and " <" or ""), function() r.reason = reason; state.built = nil end)
            end
            JavaGui.text(root, "Comment (optional):", cx + 5, 37, GRAY, true, 4)
            JavaGui.slice(root, G["widget/text_field"], 1, cx + 5, 48, 150, 80, 3)
            local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
            box.BackgroundTransparency, box.ZIndex = 1, 5
            box.Position, box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + 9, 51), UDim2.fromOffset(142, 74)
            box.Font, box.TextSize, box.TextColor3 = Enum.Font.Code, 8, WHITE
            box.PlaceholderText, box.PlaceholderColor3 = "What happened?", GRAY
            box.TextXAlignment, box.TextYAlignment, box.TextWrapped, box.ClearTextOnFocus, box.MultiLine = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, true, false, true
            box.Text = state.reportComment or ""
            box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function() state.reportComment = box.Text:sub(1, 300) end)
            box.Parent = root
            local note = r.kind == "build" and "The blocks around your crosshair are sent" or r.kind == "chat" and "The recent chat is sent" or nil
            if note then JavaGui.text(root, fit(note, 150), cx + 5, 132, GRAY, true, 4) end
            if r.kind == "build" then
                -- Roblox scripts cannot open photos or files (on PC or mobile), so this 3D snapshot is the picture.
                r.snapshot = r.snapshot or buildSnapshot(r.target)
                local top = 143
                local vh = H - 33 - 4 - top - 22
                if vh >= 30 then snapshotView(root, r.snapshot, cx + 5, top, 150, vh, r.target and r.target.Name) end
                JavaGui.text(root, fit("Roblox can't add photos;", 150), cx + 5, H - 33 - 22, GRAY, true, 4)
                JavaGui.text(root, fit("this 3D view is sent", 150), cx + 5, H - 33 - 12, GRAY, true, 4)
            end
            button(root, cx - 154, H - 27, 150, "Send Report", function() task.spawn(sendReport) end, r.reason ~= nil)
            button(root, cx + 4, H - 27, 150, L("gui.back", "Back"), function() show("report_kind") end)
        end
        function screens.report_sent(root, W, H)
            title(root, W, 12, "Report Player")
            message(root, W, math.floor(H / 2) - 10, state.reportStatus or "", WHITE)
            button(root, math.floor(W / 2) - 100, H - 27, 200, L("gui.done", "Done"), function() show("pause") end)
        end

        -- Reports (developers) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local reports = {list = nil, loading = false, status = {}}
        function state.refreshReports()
            if reports.loading then return end
            reports.loading, reports.list = true, nil
            state.built = nil
            task.spawn(function()
                local parts, statuses = {}, {}
                for _, m in ipairs(pollTopic(STEVE_ONLINE.ReportsTopic, "12h")) do
                    if type(m.r) == "string" then
                        if m.status then statuses[m.r] = m.status .. " (" .. tostring(m.by) .. ")"
                        elseif tonumber(m.i) and tonumber(m.n) and type(m.d) == "string" then
                            parts[m.r] = parts[m.r] or {n = tonumber(m.n), got = {}}
                            parts[m.r].got[tonumber(m.i)] = m.d
                        end
                    end
                end
                local list = {}
                for id, p in pairs(parts) do
                    local whole = {}
                    for i = 1, p.n do whole[i] = p.got[i] end
                    if #whole == p.n then
                        local ok, report = pcall(HS.JSONDecode, HS, table.concat(whole))
                        if ok and type(report) == "table" then report.status = statuses[id]; list[#list + 1] = report end
                    end
                end
                table.sort(list, function(a, b) return (tonumber(a.t) or 0) > (tonumber(b.t) or 0) end)
                reports.list, reports.loading = list, false
                state.built = nil
            end)
        end
        function screens.reports(root, W, H)
            title(root, W, 12, "Reports")
            listArea(root, W, 33, H - 33)
            local cx = math.floor(W / 2)
            if reports.loading then message(root, W, math.floor(H / 2) - 4, "Loading reports...")
            elseif reports.list and #reports.list == 0 then message(root, W, math.floor(H / 2) - 4, "No reports in the last 12 hours")
            elseif reports.list then
                local scroll = scrollList(root, W, 35, H - 35, #reports.list * 30 + 4)
                for i, r in ipairs(reports.list) do
                    local y = 2 + (i - 1) * 30
                    local head = tostring(r.target) .. "  -  " .. tostring(r.kind) .. ": " .. tostring(r.reason)
                    JavaGui.text(scroll, fit(head, 230), cx - 160, y + 2, r.status and GRAY or WHITE, true, 4)
                    JavaGui.text(scroll, fit("by " .. tostring(r.by) .. ", " .. ago(r.t) .. "  " .. (r.status or "Open"), 230), cx - 160, y + 13, GRAY, true, 4)
                    button(scroll, cx + 80, y + 2, 80, "View", function() state.viewing = r; state.preview = nil; show("report_view") end)
                end
            end
            button(root, cx - 154, H - 27, 100, "Refresh", function() state.refreshReports() end)
            button(root, cx - 50, H - 27, 100, "Bans", function() show("bans"); state.refreshBans() end)
            button(root, cx + 54, H - 27, 100, L("gui.back", "Back"), function() show("pause") end)
        end
        -- Bans (developers): every active ban, with Unban.
        local bans = {list = nil, loading = false, status = nil}
        function state.refreshBans()
            if bans.loading then return end
            bans.loading, bans.list = true, nil
            state.built = nil
            task.spawn(function()
                local data = SteveBans.fetch()
                bans.list = data and SteveBans.active(data) or {}
                bans.status = data == nil and "Could not reach the ban list" or nil
                bans.loading = false
                state.built = nil
            end)
        end
        function screens.bans(root, W, H)
            title(root, W, 12, "Bans")
            listArea(root, W, 33, H - 33)
            local cx = math.floor(W / 2)
            if bans.loading then message(root, W, math.floor(H / 2) - 4, "Loading bans...")
            elseif bans.list and #bans.list == 0 then message(root, W, math.floor(H / 2) - 4, bans.status or "Nobody is banned")
            elseif bans.list then
                local scroll = scrollList(root, W, 35, H - 35, #bans.list * 30 + 4)
                for i, b in ipairs(bans.list) do
                    local y = 2 + (i - 1) * 30
                    JavaGui.text(scroll, fit(tostring(b.n) .. "  -  " .. SteveBans.untilText(b), 230), cx - 160, y + 2, WHITE, true, 4)
                    JavaGui.text(scroll, fit((tostring(b.r or "") ~= "" and (tostring(b.r) .. ", ") or "") .. "by " .. tostring(b.by or "?"), 230), cx - 160, y + 13, GRAY, true, 4)
                    button(scroll, cx + 80, y + 2, 80, "Unban", function()
                        bans.status = "Unbanning " .. tostring(b.n) .. "..."
                        state.built = nil
                        task.spawn(function()
                            local ok = SteveBans.unban(tostring(b.n))
                            state.refreshBans()
                            bans.status = ok and (tostring(b.n) .. " was unbanned") or "Could not reach the ban list"
                        end)
                    end)
                end
            end
            if bans.status and bans.list and #bans.list > 0 then message(root, W, H - 60 + 4, fit(bans.status, W - 20), WHITE) end
            button(root, cx - 154, H - 27, 150, "Refresh", function() state.refreshBans() end)
            button(root, cx + 4, H - 27, 150, L("gui.back", "Back"), function() show("reports"); state.refreshReports() end)
        end
        local PLAYER_COLOURS = {Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 85), Color3.fromRGB(85, 170, 255), Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 85), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 85),
            Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 255), Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0), Color3.fromRGB(170, 85, 255)}
        local function decide(r, label, days)
            state.toast = days and "Banning..." or "Dismissing..."
            state.built = nil
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok = true
                if days then ok = SteveBans.ban(tostring(r.target), tonumber(r.targetId), days, tostring(r.reason), player.Name) end
                if ok then
                    publish(STEVE_ONLINE.ReportsTopic, {v = "steve1", r = r.id, status = label, by = player.Name})
                    r.status = label .. " (" .. player.Name .. ")"
                    state.toast = days and (tostring(r.target) .. " is " .. label:lower() .. " - their script stops within a minute") or "Report dismissed"
                else
                    state.toast = "Could not reach the ban list - try again"
                end
                state.built = nil
            end)
        end
        function screens.report_view(root, W, H)
            local r = state.viewing
            if not r then show("reports"); return end
            title(root, W, 12, "Report: " .. tostring(r.target))
            listArea(root, W, 33, H - 60)
            local left = 8
            local colW = r.build and math.floor(W / 2) - 16 or W - 16
            local y = 37
            local function line(text, color) JavaGui.text(root, fit(text, colW), left, y, color or WHITE, true, 4); y = y + 11 end
            line("Reported: " .. tostring(r.target) .. "   by " .. tostring(r.by))
            line("Type: " .. tostring(r.kind) .. "   Reason: " .. tostring(r.reason))
            line("When: " .. os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tonumber(r.t) or 0) .. " (" .. ago(r.t) .. ")", GRAY)
            line("Status: " .. (r.status or "Open"), GRAY)
            if (r.comment or "") ~= "" then
                local comment = tostring(r.comment)
                while #comment > 0 and y < H - 70 do
                    local cut = #comment
                    while cut > 1 and JavaGui.width(comment:sub(1, cut)) > colW do cut = cut - 1 end
                    line((y == 37 + 44 and "\"" or "") .. comment:sub(1, cut), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 170))
                    comment = comment:sub(cut + 1)
                end
            end
            if r.skin then line("Skin: " .. tostring(r.skin), GRAY) end
            if type(r.chat) == "table" then
                y = y + 4
                for _, entry in ipairs(r.chat) do
                    if y > H - 72 then break end
                    local text = os.date("%H:%M", tonumber(entry.t) or 0) .. " " .. tostring(entry.text)
                    local fromTarget = tostring(entry.text):find("<" .. tostring(r.target) .. ">", 1, true) ~= nil
                    line(text, fromTarget and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 85) or GRAY)
                end
            end
            if type(r.build) == "table" then
                -- The reported build, rebuilt in a 3D view: block colours, or one colour per player who placed it.
                local vx, vy, vw, vh = math.floor(W / 2), 37, math.floor(W / 2) - 8, H - 60 - 37 - 30
                local vf = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
                vf.BackgroundColor3, vf.BackgroundTransparency, vf.BorderSizePixel, vf.ZIndex = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24), 0.2, 0, 4
                vf.Position, vf.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(vx, vy), UDim2.fromOffset(vw, vh)
                vf.Ambient, vf.LightColor, vf.LightDirection = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.3)
                vf.Parent = root
                local wm = Instance.new("WorldModel"); wm.Parent = vf
                local cam = Instance.new("Camera"); cam.FieldOfView = 50; cam.Parent = vf; vf.CurrentCamera = cam
                local byPlayer = state.previewByPlayer == true
                local lo, hi = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge), Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
                local ids, placers = r.build.ids or {}, r.build.placers or {}
                for entry in tostring(r.build.blocks or ""):gmatch("[^;]+") do
                    local x, yy, z, b, p = entry:match("^(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+),(%d+),(%d+)$")
                    if x then
                        local pos = Vector3.new(tonumber(x), tonumber(yy), tonumber(z))
                        lo, hi = lo:Min(pos), hi:Max(pos)
                        local id, who = ids[tonumber(b)] or "stone", placers[tonumber(p)] or "?"
                        local part = Instance.new("Part")
                        part.Anchored, part.Size, part.CFrame = true, Vector3.new(0.98, 0.98, 0.98), CFrame.new(pos)
                        local colour = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
                        if byPlayer then
                            colour = who == "?" and Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110) or PLAYER_COLOURS[(tonumber(p) - 1) % #PLAYER_COLOURS + 1]
                        else
                            local entryData = JavaContent.byId[id]
                            local sprite = entryData and entryData.particle and JavaContent.data.textures[entryData.particle]
                            if sprite then colour = JavaContent.averageColor(sprite) end
                        end
                        part.Color, part.Material = colour, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                        part:SetAttribute("Who", who); part:SetAttribute("Block", id)
                        part.Parent = wm
                    end
                end
                for entry in tostring(r.build.players or ""):gmatch("[^;]+") do
                    local name, px, py, pz, yaw = entry:match("^([^,]+),(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+)$")
                    if name then
                        local pos = Vector3.new(tonumber(px), tonumber(py), tonumber(pz))
                        lo, hi = lo:Min(pos), hi:Max(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.8, 0))
                        local colour = name == tostring(r.target) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70) or Color3.fromRGB(80, 160, 255)
                        local base = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(tonumber(yaw)), 0)
                        for _, piece in ipairs({{Vector3.new(0.5, 0.75, 0.25), 0.375}, {Vector3.new(0.5, 0.75, 0.25), 1.125}, {Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5), 1.75}}) do
                            local part = Instance.new("Part")
                            part.Anchored, part.Size, part.CFrame, part.Color, part.Material = true, piece[1], base * CFrame.new(0, piece[2] - 0.5, 0), colour, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                            part:SetAttribute("Who", name); part:SetAttribute("Block", "player")
                            part.Parent = wm
                        end
                    end
                end
                if lo.X == math.huge then lo, hi = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero end
                local centre, radius = (lo + hi) / 2, math.max(4, (hi - lo).Magnitude / 2 + 2)
                state.previewYaw, state.previewPitch = state.previewYaw or 0.7, state.previewPitch or 0.5
                local function place()
                    cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(centre) * CFrame.Angles(0, state.previewYaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-state.previewPitch, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 0, radius * 2.2)
                end
                place()
                local info = JavaGui.text(root, "Drag to turn, hover a block", vx, vy + vh + 2, GRAY, true, 4)
                local dragging, last
                vf.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging, last = true, input.Position end
                end)
                vf.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
                end)
                vf.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
                    if dragging and last then
                        local d = input.Position - last
                        last = input.Position
                        state.previewYaw = state.previewYaw - d.X * 0.01
                        state.previewPitch = math.clamp(state.previewPitch + d.Y * 0.01, -1.4, 1.4)
                        place()
                    end
                    -- Hover: which block is under the mouse, and who placed it.
                    local a, size = vf.AbsolutePosition, vf.AbsoluteSize
                    local mx, my = (input.Position.X - a.X) / size.X * 2 - 1, 1 - (input.Position.Y - a.Y) / size.Y * 2
                    local t = math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) / 2)
                    local dir = cam.CFrame.LookVector + cam.CFrame.RightVector * mx * t * (size.X / math.max(1, size.Y)) + cam.CFrame.UpVector * my * t
                    local hit = wm:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, dir.Unit * 500)
                    local text = hit and (tostring(hit.Instance:GetAttribute("Block")) .. " - placed by " .. tostring(hit.Instance:GetAttribute("Who") == "?" and "the map / unknown" or hit.Instance:GetAttribute("Who"))) or "Drag to turn, hover a block"
                    if info then info:Destroy() end
                    info = JavaGui.text(root, fit(text, vw), vx, vy + vh + 2, hit and WHITE or GRAY, true, 4)
                end)
                button(root, vx, vy + vh + 12, 110, byPlayer and "Colour: Players" or "Colour: Blocks", function() state.previewByPlayer = not byPlayer; state.built = nil end)
                -- Legend: who placed blocks, in their colours.
                local ly = y + 6
                if byPlayer then
                    for i, who in ipairs(placers) do
                        if ly > H - 72 then break end
                        JavaGui.text(root, fit((who == "?" and "map / unknown" or who), colW), left, ly, who == "?" and Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110) or PLAYER_COLOURS[(i - 1) % #PLAYER_COLOURS + 1], true, 4)
                        ly = ly + 10
                    end
                end
            end
            if state.toast then message(root, W, H - 56, fit(state.toast, W - 10), Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 85)) end
            local cx = math.floor(W / 2)
            local bw = 72
            local x0 = cx - math.floor((bw * 5 + 16) / 2)
            button(root, x0, H - 27, bw, "Ban 1 Day", function() decide(r, "Banned 1 day", 1) end)
            button(root, x0 + (bw + 4), H - 27, bw, "Ban 7 Days", function() decide(r, "Banned 7 days", 7) end)
            button(root, x0 + (bw + 4) * 2, H - 27, bw, "Ban Forever", function() decide(r, "Banned forever", "forever") end)
            button(root, x0 + (bw + 4) * 3, H - 27, bw, "Dismiss", function() decide(r, "Dismissed", nil) end)
            button(root, x0 + (bw + 4) * 4, H - 27, bw, L("gui.back", "Back"), function() state.toast = nil; show("reports") end)
        end
        -- Opening / closing: Tab toggles the menu (Esc stays Roblox's own menu) ----------------------
        local function openMenu()
            state.open = true
            show("pause")
            gui.Enabled = true
            cursorRequest(true)
            if not blur or not blur.Parent then blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect"); blur.Name = "SteveMenuBlur"; blur.Parent = Lighting end
            blur.Size, blur.Enabled = JavaGui.options.blur * 2, true
        end
        connections[#connections + 1] = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Tab or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() or GuiService.MenuIsOpen then return end
            if state.open then click(); closeMenu() else openMenu() end
        end)
        -- Roblox's menu (Esc) takes over: close ours so they never overlap.
        connections[#connections + 1] = GuiService.MenuOpened:Connect(function() if state.open then closeMenu() end end)
        connections[#connections + 1] = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if state.dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and state.dragMove then state.dragMove() end
        end)
        connections[#connections + 1] = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then state.dragging, state.dragMove = nil, nil end
        end)
        local root
        local lastKey
        connections[#connections + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            -- The HUD (hotbar, chat) is hidden behind the menu (Java blurs it away).
            local hud = gui.Parent and gui.Parent:FindFirstChild("SteveHotbar")
            if hud then
                if gui.Enabled and hud.Enabled then hud.Enabled = false; state.hudHidden = hud
                elseif not gui.Enabled and state.hudHidden then state.hudHidden.Enabled = true; state.hudHidden = nil end
            end
            if not gui.Enabled then return end
            local view = gui.AbsoluteSize
            local sc = JavaGui.scale(view)
            local W, H = math.floor(view.X / sc), math.floor(view.Y / sc)
            uiScale.Scale = sc
            canvas.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)
            backdrop.TileSize = UDim2.fromOffset(16 * sc, 16 * sc)
            local key = state.screen .. W .. "x" .. H
            if key ~= lastKey or not state.built then
                lastKey, state.built = key, true
                if root then root:Destroy() end
                hover = {}
                root = Instance.new("Frame")
                root.BackgroundTransparency, root.Size, root.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 2
                root.Parent = canvas
                local ok, err = pcall(screens[state.screen], root, W, H)
                if not ok then warn("[Steve] menu: " .. tostring(err)) end
            end
        end)
        -- Render Distance: placed blocks further than that many chunks (16 blocks) from the camera are not drawn.
        local blocksFolder = localBlocks and localBlocks:FindFirstChild("JavaBlocks")
        local farFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
        farFolder.Name = "SteveFarBlocks"
        farFolder.Parent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local nextCull = 0
        connections[#connections + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if os.clock() < nextCull or not blocksFolder then return end
            nextCull = os.clock() + 1
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then return end
            local limit = JavaGui.options.renderDistance * 16 * CONFIG.Block
            local eye = cam.CFrame.Position
            for _, m in ipairs(blocksFolder:GetChildren()) do
                local c = m:GetAttribute("SteveRenderCenter") or m:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter")
                if typeof(c) == "Vector3" and (c - eye).Magnitude > limit then m.Parent = farFolder end
            end
            for _, m in ipairs(farFolder:GetChildren()) do
                local c = m:GetAttribute("SteveRenderCenter") or m:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter")
                if typeof(c) ~= "Vector3" or (c - eye).Magnitude <= limit then m.Parent = blocksFolder end
            end
        end)
        -- Render Distance for the game map: anchored map parts are bucketed by chunk (16 blocks) and chunks further
        -- than the setting are not drawn (LocalTransparencyModifier). Huge parts (floors) always stay.
        local CHUNK = 16 * CONFIG.Block
        local buckets, partBucket, hiddenBuckets = {}, setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), {}
        local function ours(p)
            local a = p.Parent
            while a and a ~= workspace do
                if a:IsA("Model") and a:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return true end
                local name = a.Name
                if name ~= "SteveExcavation" and (name:sub(1, 5) == "Steve" or name:sub(1, 9) == "Minecraft" or name:sub(1, 4) == "Java") then return true end
                a = a.Parent
            end
            return false
        end
        local function indexPart(p)
            if not p:IsA("BasePart") or p:IsA("Terrain") or not p.Anchored or partBucket[p] then return end
            if p.Size.X > CHUNK * 2 or p.Size.Z > CHUNK * 2 or ours(p) then return end
            local key = math.floor(p.Position.X / CHUNK) .. "," .. math.floor(p.Position.Z / CHUNK)
            local b = buckets[key]
            if not b then b = {x = math.floor(p.Position.X / CHUNK), z = math.floor(p.Position.Z / CHUNK), parts = {}}; buckets[key] = b end
            b.parts[#b.parts + 1] = p
            partBucket[p] = b
            if hiddenBuckets[b] then p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            local list = workspace:GetDescendants()
            for i, p in ipairs(list) do
                indexPart(p)
                if i % 3000 == 0 then task.wait() end
            end
        end)
