        connections[#connections + 1] = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(p) if p:IsA("BasePart") then task.defer(indexPart, p) end end)
        local nextMap = 0
        connections[#connections + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if os.clock() < nextMap then return end
            nextMap = os.clock() + 0.5
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then return end
            local cx, cz = math.floor(cam.CFrame.Position.X / CHUNK), math.floor(cam.CFrame.Position.Z / CHUNK)
            local rd = JavaGui.options.renderDistance
            for _, b in pairs(buckets) do
                local far = math.max(math.abs(b.x - cx), math.abs(b.z - cz)) > rd
                if far ~= (hiddenBuckets[b] == true) then
                    hiddenBuckets[b] = far or nil
                    for _, p in ipairs(b.parts) do if p.Parent then p.LocalTransparencyModifier = far and 1 or 0 end end
                end
            end
        end)
        -- Roblox's player list (Tab) stays hidden while the script runs.
        local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
        pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, false) end)
        JavaGui.applyOptions()
        local api = {}
        function api.open() openMenu() end
        function api.close() closeMenu() end
        function api.toggle() if state.open then closeMenu() else openMenu() end end
        function api.destroy()
            for _, c in ipairs(connections) do c:Disconnect() end
            cursorRequest(false)
            state.presence = false
            for b in pairs(hiddenBuckets) do for _, p in ipairs(b.parts) do if p.Parent then p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0 end end end
            pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, true) end)
            if blur then blur:Destroy() end
            if state.hudHidden then pcall(function() state.hudHidden.Enabled = true end) end
            if blocksFolder then for _, m in ipairs(farFolder:GetChildren()) do m.Parent = blocksFolder end end
            farFolder:Destroy()
            gui:Destroy()
        end
        JavaGui.menu = api
        return api
    end
end
-- Focus a text box opened by a key (T, /, E...): Java ignores the opening key's character, so a one-character
-- insertion made right away by a key that is still held is taken back.
function JavaGui.focus(box)
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local before, start = box.Text, os.clock()
    local connection
    connection = box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
        if os.clock() - start > 0.3 then connection:Disconnect(); return end
        local t = box.Text
        if #t == #before + 1 and t:sub(1, #before) == before then
            local c = t:sub(-1)
            local code = (c:match("%a") and Enum.KeyCode[c:upper()]) or (c == "/" and Enum.KeyCode.Slash) or nil
            if code and UIS:IsKeyDown(code) then
                connection:Disconnect()
                box.Text = before
                box.CursorPosition = #before + 1
            end
        end
    end)
    task.delay(0.3, function() if connection.Connected then connection:Disconnect() end end)
    box:CaptureFocus()
    box.CursorPosition = #box.Text + 1
end
-- The death message key from the last damage cause (within 5 s), like DamageSource.getLocalizedDeathMessage.
function JavaContent.deathKey(world)
    local cause = world and world.lastDamage
    if cause and os.clock() - (world.lastDamageTime or 0) < 5 then
        local key = "death.attack." .. cause
        local lang = JavaContent.data and JavaContent.data.lang
        if lang and lang[key] then return key end
    end
    return "death.attack.generic"
end
function JavaContent.deathMessage(world, name)
    local lang = JavaContent.data and JavaContent.data.lang or {}
    local text = lang[JavaContent.deathKey(world)] or "%1$s died"
    return (text:gsub("%%1%$s", function() return name end))
end
-- DeathScreen: the gradient, "You Died!" at twice the size, the death message, "Score: n", and Respawn / Title
-- Screen (here: Exit Script) buttons that enable after 20 ticks. It lives outside the character, so it stays up
-- through the Roblox respawn until Respawn is pressed.
do
    local current, pendingRespawn
    function JavaGui.deathOpen() return current ~= nil and current.Parent ~= nil end
    function JavaGui.closeDeath()
        if pendingRespawn then pendingRespawn:Disconnect(); pendingRespawn = nil end
        if current then current:Destroy(); current = nil end
    end
    function JavaGui.showDeath(message, score)
        JavaGui.closeDeath()
        local Players, RunService = game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("RunService")
        local player = Players.LocalPlayer
        local G = JavaContent.data.javaGui
        local deadCharacter = player.Character
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.IgnoreGuiInset, gui.DisplayOrder = "SteveDeathScreen", false, true, 950
        local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
        bg.Size, bg.BorderSizePixel, bg.BackgroundColor3, bg.Active = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 0, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), true
        local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        gradient.Rotation = 90
        gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(80, 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(128, 48, 48))
        gradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1 - 0x60 / 255, 1 - 0xA0 / 255)
        gradient.Parent = bg
        bg.Parent = gui
        local canvas = Instance.new("Frame")
        canvas.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        canvas.Parent = gui
        local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
        scale.Parent = canvas
        local function line(text, colour, size)
            local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
            holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            holder.Parent = canvas
            if size then local u = Instance.new("UIScale"); u.Scale = size; u.Parent = holder end
            JavaGui.text(holder, text, 0, 0, colour or Color3.new(1, 1, 1), true, 3)
            return {frame = holder, width = JavaGui.width(text) * (size or 1)}
        end
        local title = line("You Died!", nil, 2)
        local cause = line(message or "")
        local scoreText = "Score: "
        local scoreLine = line(scoreText)
        local scoreValue = line(tostring(score or 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 85))
        local buttons = {}
        local function button(label, onClick)
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
            b.Text, b.BackgroundTransparency, b.AutoButtonColor, b.Size = "", 1, false, UDim2.fromOffset(200, 20)
            b.Name = label:gsub(" ", "")
            b.Parent = canvas
            local normal = JavaGui.slice(b, G["widget/button"], 3, 0, 0, 200, 20, 2)
            local lit = JavaGui.slice(b, G["widget/button_highlighted"], 3, 0, 0, 200, 20, 2)
            local off = G["widget/button_disabled"] and JavaGui.slice(b, G["widget/button_disabled"], 3, 0, 0, 200, 20, 2)
            local caption = Instance.new("Frame")
            caption.BackgroundTransparency, caption.Size, caption.Parent = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), b
            local entry = {b = b, enabled = false, hover = false}
            function entry.setLabel(text)
                caption:ClearAllChildren()
                JavaGui.text(caption, text, math.floor((200 - JavaGui.width(text)) / 2), 6, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), true, 4)
            end
            entry.setLabel(label)
            function entry.draw()
                normal.Visible = entry.enabled and not entry.hover
                lit.Visible = entry.enabled and entry.hover
                if off then off.Visible = not entry.enabled else normal.Visible = normal.Visible or not entry.enabled end
            end
            b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() entry.hover = true; entry.draw() end)
            b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() entry.hover = false; entry.draw() end)
            b.Activated:Connect(function() if entry.enabled then onClick(entry) end end)
            entry.draw()
            buttons[#buttons + 1] = entry
            return entry
        end
        local respawn = button("Respawn", function(entry)
            entry.enabled = false
            entry.setLabel("Respawning...")
            entry.draw()
            if pendingRespawn then pendingRespawn:Disconnect(); pendingRespawn = nil end
            local started = os.clock()
            -- Poll readiness as well as identity: CharacterAdded can fire before its
            -- Humanoid/root arrive, and may already have fired before this click.
            local function ready()
                local character = player.Character
                local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                return character and character ~= deadCharacter and hum and hum.Health > 0
                    and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            end
            if ready() then JavaGui.closeDeath(); return end
            pendingRespawn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if current ~= gui or not gui.Parent then
                    if pendingRespawn then pendingRespawn:Disconnect(); pendingRespawn = nil end
                    return
                end
                if ready() then JavaGui.closeDeath(); return end
                if os.clock() - started >= math.max(10, Players.RespawnTime + 5) then
                    pendingRespawn:Disconnect(); pendingRespawn = nil
                    entry.enabled = true
                    entry.setLabel("Retry Respawn")
                    entry.draw()
                end
            end)
            -- This controller disables humanoid evaluation for its custom movement.
            -- Restore Roblox's death handling so the server can replace the avatar.
            local hum = deadCharacter and deadCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if player.Character == deadCharacter and hum and hum.Health <= 0 then
                hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
                hum.EvaluateStateMachine = true
                hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
                deadCharacter:BreakJoints()
            end
        end)
        local exit = button("Exit Script", function() JavaGui.closeDeath(); stopEvent:Fire() end)
        task.delay(1, function() for _, b in ipairs(buttons) do b.enabled = true; b.draw() end end)
        local layout
        layout = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not gui.Parent then layout:Disconnect(); return end
            local view = gui.AbsoluteSize
            local s = JavaGui.scale(view)
            scale.Scale = s
            local W, H = view.X / s, view.Y / s
            canvas.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)
            title.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(W / 2 - title.width / 2), 60)
            cause.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(W / 2 - cause.width / 2), 85)
            local total = scoreLine.width + scoreValue.width
            scoreLine.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(W / 2 - total / 2), 100)
            scoreValue.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(W / 2 - total / 2) + scoreLine.width, 100)
            respawn.b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(W / 2 - 100), math.floor(H / 4 + 72))
            exit.b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(W / 2 - 100), math.floor(H / 4 + 96))
        end)
        gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
            if current == gui then
                current = nil
                if pendingRespawn then pendingRespawn:Disconnect(); pendingRespawn = nil end
            end
        end)
        gui.Parent = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        current = gui
    end
end
local function addLayer(frame, spriteName, tint, z)
    local sprite = JavaContent.data.javaGui[spriteName]
    if not sprite then return end
    local node = JavaGui.image(frame, sprite, 0, 0, 16, 16, nil, z)
    node.Name = "ItemDeco"
    if tint then
        local color = Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(tint / 65536) % 256, math.floor(tint / 256) % 256, tint % 256)
        if node:IsA("ImageLabel") then node.ImageColor3 = color
        else JavaContent.sprite(node, sprite, {color.R, color.G, color.B}) end
    end
end
function JavaGui.decoKey(stack)
    if not stack then return "" end
    local key = ""
    local layers, dynamic = JavaGui.layers(stack)
    if layers then for _, l in ipairs(layers) do key = key .. l[1] .. tostring(l[2]) end end
    if stack.enchantments and next(stack.enchantments) or foil[itemName(stack) or ""] then key = key .. "*" end
    local cd = JavaContent.cooldown and JavaContent.cooldown(stack) or 0
    if cd > 0 then key = key .. "cd" .. math.floor(cd * 16) end
    return key, dynamic or cd > 0
end
-- Sample the same alpha silhouette as the item renderer. Pixel frames work even when
-- EditableImage is unavailable or its memory budget has been exhausted.
function JavaGui.addGlint(frame, stack, layers, z)
    local texture = JavaContent.data.javaGui.glint
    if not texture then return end
    local sprites = {}
    if layers then
        for _, layer in ipairs(layers) do
            local sprite = JavaContent.data.javaGui[layer[1]]
            if sprite then sprites[#sprites + 1] = sprite end
        end
    else
        local entry = JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
        local sprite = entry and entry.icon or JavaContent.toolIcons and JavaContent.toolIcons[stack.id]
        if sprite then sprites[1] = sprite end
    end
    if #sprites == 0 then return end
    local node = Instance.new("Frame")
    node.Name, node.BackgroundTransparency, node.BorderSizePixel = "ItemGlint", 1, 0
    node.Size, node.ZIndex = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), z
    node.Parent = frame
    local pixels = {}
    local w, h = 16, 16
    for _, sprite in ipairs(sprites) do w, h = math.max(w, sprite.w), math.max(h, sprite.h) end
    -- Each glint pixel is drawn opaque as the item's own colour plus the glint (Java blends dst + glint^2).
    local tints = {}
    for i, layer in ipairs(layers or {}) do tints[i] = layer[2] end
    for y = 0, h - 1 do for x = 0, w - 1 do
        local alpha, base = 0, nil
        for i, sprite in ipairs(sprites) do
            local sx, sy = math.floor((x + 0.5) * sprite.w / w), math.floor((y + 0.5) * sprite.h / h)
            local at = (sy * sprite.w + sx) * 2 + 1
            local c = tonumber(sprite.d:sub(at, at + 1), 16) or 0
            local a = c > 0 and (sprite.alpha and sprite.alpha[c] or 1) or 0
            if a > 0 then
                local rgb = sprite.p[c]
                local r, g, b = math.floor(rgb / 65536) % 256 / 255, math.floor(rgb / 256) % 256 / 255, rgb % 256 / 255
                local t = tints[i]
                if t then r, g, b = r * (math.floor(t / 65536) % 256 / 255), g * (math.floor(t / 256) % 256 / 255), b * (t % 256 / 255) end
                if base then base = {base[1] * (1 - a) + r * a, base[2] * (1 - a) + g * a, base[3] * (1 - a) + b * a} else base = {r, g, b} end
            end
            alpha = a + alpha * (1 - a)
        end
        if alpha > 0 then
            local pixel = Instance.new("Frame")
            pixel.BorderSizePixel, pixel.BackgroundColor3, pixel.BackgroundTransparency = 0, Color3.new(base[1], base[2], base[3]), 1
            pixel.Position, pixel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(x / w, y / h), UDim2.fromScale(1 / w, 1 / h)
            pixel.ZIndex, pixel.Parent = z, node
            pixels[#pixels + 1] = {node = pixel, x = x * 32 / w, y = y * 32 / h, alpha = alpha, base = base}
        end
    end end
    glintNodes[node] = pixels
end
function JavaGui.animateGlint(t)
    local texture = JavaContent.data.javaGui.glint
    if not texture then return end
    local function sample(x, y)
        local at = (math.floor(y) % texture.h * texture.w + math.floor(x) % texture.w) * 2 + 1
        local c = tonumber(texture.d:sub(at, at + 1), 16) or 0
        if c == 0 then return 0, 0, 0 end
        local rgb = texture.p[c]
        return math.floor(rgb / 65536) % 256 / 255, math.floor(rgb / 256) % 256 / 255, rgb % 256 / 255
    end
    for node, pixels in pairs(glintNodes) do
        if not node.Parent then glintNodes[node] = nil
        else
            for _, pixel in ipairs(pixels) do
                -- One glint layer (setupGlintTexturing), squared (SRC_COLOR, ONE) and added to the item.
                local gr, gg, gb = JavaContent.glintAt(pixel.x / 32, pixel.y / 32, t)
                local base = pixel.base or {0, 0, 0}
                pixel.node.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(math.min(1, base[1] + gr), math.min(1, base[2] + gg), math.min(1, base[3] + gb))
                pixel.node.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - pixel.alpha
            end
        end
    end
end
-- ItemRenderer foil (RenderSystem.setupGlintTexturing(8)): one layer of the glint texture, scrolled
-- (110 s and 30 s periods at glint speed 0.5 x 8), turned 10 degrees, sampled smoothly, squared and added
-- (blend SRC_COLOR, ONE). u, v are 0..1 across the item.
do
    local K, C10, S10 = 0.25, math.cos(math.pi / 18), math.sin(math.pi / 18)
    local floats
    function JavaContent.isFoil(stack)
        if type(stack) ~= "table" then return false end
        if stack.glint ~= nil then return stack.glint end
        if stack.enchantments and next(stack.enchantments) then return true end
        return foil[itemName(stack) or ""] and true or false
    end
    function JavaContent.glintAt(u, v, t)
        local tex = JavaContent.data.javaGui.glint
        if not tex then return 0, 0, 0 end
        if not floats or floats.tex ~= tex then
            floats = {tex = tex}
            for i = 0, tex.w * tex.h - 1 do
                local c = tonumber(tex.d:sub(i * 2 + 1, i * 2 + 2), 16) or 0
                local rgb = c > 0 and tex.p[c] or 0
                floats[i * 3 + 1], floats[i * 3 + 2], floats[i * 3 + 3] = math.floor(rgb / 65536) % 256 / 255, math.floor(rgb / 256) % 256 / 255, rgb % 256 / 255
            end
        end
        local ms = t * 1000 * 0.5 * 8
        local f, g = (ms % 110000) / 110000, (ms % 30000) / 30000
        local su, sv = u * K, v * K
        local x = (su * C10 - sv * S10 - f) * tex.w - 0.5
        local y = (su * S10 + sv * C10 + g) * tex.h - 0.5
        local x0, y0 = math.floor(x), math.floor(y)
        local fx, fy = x - x0, y - y0
        local w, h = tex.w, tex.h
        local function at(xx, yy) return ((yy % h) * w + (xx % w)) * 3 end
        local a, b, c, d = at(x0, y0), at(x0 + 1, y0), at(x0, y0 + 1), at(x0 + 1, y0 + 1)
        local out = {}
        for k = 1, 3 do
            local top = floats[a + k] + (floats[b + k] - floats[a + k]) * fx
            local bottom = floats[c + k] + (floats[d + k] - floats[c + k]) * fx
            local value = top + (bottom - top) * fy
            out[k] = value * value
        end
        return out[1], out[2], out[3]
    end
    -- 3D items are pixel parts: each part gets its spot on the item and is recoloured with the glint.
    local glintParts = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    function JavaContent.glintModel(model, on)
        if not model then return end
        local parts = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency < 1 and not p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceGui") then parts[#parts + 1] = p end
        end
        if not on then
            for _, p in ipairs(parts) do local g = glintParts[p]; if g then p.Color = g.base; glintParts[p] = nil end end
            return
        end
        local pivot = model:GetPivot()
        local lo, hi = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge), Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
        local locs = {}
        for i, p in ipairs(parts) do local l = pivot:PointToObjectSpace(p.Position); locs[i] = l; lo, hi = lo:Min(l), hi:Max(l) end
        local ext = hi - lo
        -- The item lies in the plane of its two longest extents.
        local axes = {{"X", ext.X}, {"Y", ext.Y}, {"Z", ext.Z}}
        table.sort(axes, function(a, b) return a[2] > b[2] end)
        local ua, va = axes[1][1], axes[2][1]
        if (ua == "Y") then ua, va = va, ua end
        for i, p in ipairs(parts) do
            if not glintParts[p] then
                local l = locs[i]
                glintParts[p] = {base = p.Color, u = (l[ua] - lo[ua]) / math.max(1e-6, ext[ua]), v = 1 - (l[va] - lo[va]) / math.max(1e-6, ext[va])}
            end
        end
    end
    function JavaContent.animateModelGlint(t)
        for p, g in pairs(glintParts) do
            if not p.Parent then glintParts[p] = nil
            else
                local r, gg, b = JavaContent.glintAt(g.u, g.v, t)
                p.Color = Color3.new(math.min(1, g.base.R + r), math.min(1, g.base.G + gg), math.min(1, g.base.B + b))
            end
        end
    end
end
function JavaGui.decorate(frame, stack, z)
    for _, c in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do if c.Name == "ItemDeco" or c.Name == "ItemGlint" or c.Name == "ItemCooldown" then c:Destroy() end end
    if not stack then return end
    local layers = JavaGui.layers(stack)
    if layers then
        local icon = frame:FindFirstChild("ItemIcon")
        if icon then icon.Visible = false end
        for i, l in ipairs(layers) do addLayer(frame, l[1], l[2], z + i) end
    else
        local icon = frame:FindFirstChild("ItemIcon")
        if icon then icon.Visible = true end
    end
    -- Mask the scrolling glint by the visible item layers, never by the slot rectangle.
    if JavaContent.isFoil(stack) then
        JavaGui.addGlint(frame, stack, layers, z + 3)
    end
    -- BundleItem bar: width min(1 + 12 * weight, 13), blue (0x7087FF), red (0xFF5555) once full.
    if stack.bundle and #stack.bundle > 0 then
        local weight = 0
        for _, st in ipairs(stack.bundle) do
            local inner = JavaContent.byIndex[st.id]
            local isBundle = inner and (inner.itemId or inner.id):match("bundle$")
            weight = weight + st.count / (isBundle and 16 or (itemStackLimits[st.id] or (inner and inner.maxStack) or 64))
        end
        local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
        bg.Name, bg.BorderSizePixel, bg.BackgroundColor3, bg.ZIndex = "ItemDeco", 0, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), z + 5
        bg.Position, bg.Size, bg.Parent = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 13), UDim2.fromOffset(13, 2), frame
        local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
        bar.Name, bar.BorderSizePixel, bar.ZIndex = "ItemDeco", 0, z + 6
        bar.BackgroundColor3 = weight >= 1 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 85) or Color3.fromRGB(112, 135, 255)
        bar.Position, bar.Size, bar.Parent = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 13), UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(1 + math.floor(12 * weight), 13), 1), frame
    end
    -- Cooldown: a white sweep over the lower part, shrinking (renderItemDecorations).
    local cd = JavaContent.cooldown and JavaContent.cooldown(stack) or 0
    if cd > 0 then
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.Name, f.BorderSizePixel, f.BackgroundColor3, f.BackgroundTransparency, f.ZIndex = "ItemCooldown", 0, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.5, z + 4
        local top = math.floor(16 * (1 - cd))
        f.Position, f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, top), UDim2.fromOffset(16, math.ceil(16 * cd))
        f.Parent = frame
    end
end
-- Every frame: animated icons re-check their key; glints scroll.
function JavaGui.tickDynamic()
    for view in pairs(JavaGui.dynamic) do if view.stack then view.set(view.stack, true) end end
    local t = os.clock()
    -- Twenty updates per second match the other pixel animations without per-frame rebuilds.
    local tick = math.floor(t * 20)
    if JavaGui.glintTick ~= tick then
        JavaGui.glintTick = tick
        JavaGui.animateGlint(t)
        pcall(JavaContent.animateModelGlint, t)
    end
end
function JavaGui.itemView(parent, x, y, z)
    local view = {}
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name, frame.BackgroundTransparency, frame.ZIndex = "JavaItem", 1, z
    frame.Size, frame.Position, frame.Parent = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), parent
    view.frame = frame
    function view.set(stack)
        if stack and not JavaContent.mods.available(JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]) then stack=nil end
        local id = stack and stack.id or nil
        local count, damage = stack and stack.count or 0, stack and stack.damage or 0
        local deco, dynamic = JavaGui.decoKey(stack)
        local key = tostring(id) .. ":" .. count .. ":" .. damage .. ":" .. deco
        view.stack = stack
        JavaGui.dynamic[view] = dynamic and true or nil
        if view.key == key then return end
        view.key = key
        if view.deco ~= deco or view.id ~= id then
            if view.id ~= id then
                view.id = id
                local old = frame:FindFirstChild("ItemIcon")
                if old then old:Destroy() end
                if id then JavaContent.icon(frame, id) end
            end
            view.deco = deco
            JavaGui.decorate(frame, stack, z)
        end
        if false then
            view.id = id
            local old = frame:FindFirstChild("ItemIcon")
            if old then old:Destroy() end
            if id then JavaContent.icon(frame, id) end
        end
        if view.count then view.count:Destroy(); view.count = nil end
        if view.bar then view.bar:Destroy(); view.bar = nil end
        if id and count > 1 then
            local text = tostring(count)
            view.count = JavaGui.text(frame, text, 17 - JavaGui.width(text), 9, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), true, z + 3)
        end
        local max = id and JavaGui.maxDamage(id)
        if max and damage > 0 then
            local remaining = math.max(0, 1 - damage / max)
            local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
            bar.BorderSizePixel, bar.BackgroundColor3, bar.ZIndex = 0, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), z + 2
            bar.Position, bar.Size, bar.Parent = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 13), UDim2.fromOffset(13, 2), frame
            local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
            fill.BorderSizePixel, fill.BackgroundColor3, fill.ZIndex = 0, Color3.fromHSV(remaining / 3, 1, 1), z + 3
            fill.Size, fill.Parent = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(13 * remaining + 0.5), 1), bar
            view.bar = bar
        end
    end
    return view
end
-- END JAVA GUI
-- BEGIN RECIPES
-- Java 26.3 recipe and menu rules over the jar's data (catalog.recipes / enchantments / potions):
-- crafting (shaped, shapeless, transmute, dye, imbue and every crafting_special), stonecutting,
-- smithing, brewing, enchanting (EnchantmentHelper), anvil (AnvilMenu) and grindstone.
local Recipes = {}
-- Experience (Player.giveExperiencePoints / giveExperienceLevels) for anvils, grindstones, enchanting.
local function xpNeeded(level) if level >= 30 then return 112 + (level - 30) * 9 elseif level >= 15 then return 37 + (level - 15) * 5 end return 7 + level * 2 end
function PlayerStats.addXp(points)
    PlayerStats.xpTotal = math.max(0, PlayerStats.xpTotal + points)
    local p = PlayerStats.xpProgress * xpNeeded(PlayerStats.xpLevel) + points
    while p >= xpNeeded(PlayerStats.xpLevel) do p = p - xpNeeded(PlayerStats.xpLevel); PlayerStats.xpLevel = PlayerStats.xpLevel + 1 end
    PlayerStats.xpProgress = math.max(0, p) / xpNeeded(PlayerStats.xpLevel)
end
function PlayerStats.addLevels(levels)
    PlayerStats.xpLevel = math.max(0, PlayerStats.xpLevel + levels)
    if PlayerStats.xpLevel == 0 then PlayerStats.xpProgress = 0 end
end
do
    local tagSets = {}
    local function data() return JavaContent.data end
    -- Item id of a stack ("oak_planks"), as recipes and tags name it.
    function Recipes.name(stack)
        local e = stack and JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
        return e and (e.itemId or e.id) or nil
    end
    function Recipes.index(name)
        local e = JavaContent.itemById[name] or JavaContent.byId[name]
        return e and e.index or nil
    end
    function Recipes.stack(name, count)
        local index = Recipes.index(name)
        return index and {id = index, count = count or 1} or nil
    end
    function Recipes.tagged(tag, name)
        tag = tag:gsub("^minecraft:", "")
        local set = tagSets[tag]
        if not set then
            set = {}
            for _, id in ipairs((data().itemTags or {})[tag] or {}) do set[id] = true end
            tagSets[tag] = set
        end
        return set[name] == true
    end
    -- Ingredient: "id", "#tag" or a list of either.
    function Recipes.matches(ingredient, name)
        if not name then return false end
        if type(ingredient) == "table" then
            for _, i in ipairs(ingredient) do if Recipes.matches(i, name) then return true end end
            return false
        end
        if string.sub(ingredient, 1, 1) == "#" then return Recipes.tagged(string.sub(ingredient, 2), name) end
        return ingredient == name
    end
    local dyeNames = {"white", "orange", "magenta", "light_blue", "yellow", "lime", "pink", "gray", "light_gray", "cyan", "purple", "blue", "brown", "green", "red", "black"}
    function Recipes.dyeColor(name) return name and name:match("^(.+)_dye$") end
    function Recipes.maxDamage(stack) return stack and JavaGui.maxDamage(stack.id) end
    -- Item.getCraftingRemainder()
    local remainders = {milk_bucket = "bucket", water_bucket = "bucket", lava_bucket = "bucket", powder_snow_bucket = "bucket",
        honey_bottle = "glass_bottle", dragon_breath = "glass_bottle"}
    function Recipes.remainder(name) return remainders[name] end

    -- Crafting ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- grid: list of stacks (row-major, width w). Returns result stack, recipe, extra remainders per cell.
    local function bounds(grid, w, h)
        local x0, y0, x1, y1
        for y = 0, h - 1 do for x = 0, w - 1 do
            if grid[y * w + x + 1] then
                x0 = math.min(x0 or x, x); y0 = math.min(y0 or y, y); x1 = math.max(x1 or x, x); y1 = math.max(y1 or y, y)
            end
        end end
        return x0, y0, x1, y1
    end
    local function items(grid, n)
        local list = {}
        for i = 1, n do if grid[i] then list[#list + 1] = {stack = grid[i], name = Recipes.name(grid[i]), cell = i} end end
        return list
    end
    local function shapedMatch(r, grid, w, x0, y0, mirror)
        for y = 0, r.h - 1 do for x = 0, r.w - 1 do
            local ingredient = r.k[y * r.w + (mirror and r.w - 1 - x or x) + 1]
            local stack = grid[(y0 + y) * w + x0 + x + 1]
            if ingredient == "" then if stack then return false end
            elseif not stack or not Recipes.matches(ingredient, Recipes.name(stack)) then return false end
        end end
        return true
    end
    -- Shapeless: every ingredient used by exactly one item (small backtracking matcher, like Java's).
    local function shapelessMatch(ingredients, list)
        if #ingredients ~= #list then return false end
        local used = {}
        local function try(i)
            if i > #ingredients then return true end
            for j, item in ipairs(list) do
                if not used[j] and Recipes.matches(ingredients[i], item.name) then
                    used[j] = true
                    if try(i + 1) then return true end
                    used[j] = nil
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        return try(1)
    end
    -- DyedItemColor.applyDyes
    function Recipes.applyDyes(stack, dyes)
        local r, g, b, maxSum, count = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
        local function add(rgb)
            local R, G, B = math.floor(rgb / 65536) % 256, math.floor(rgb / 256) % 256, rgb % 256
            maxSum = maxSum + math.max(R, G, B); r = r + R; g = g + G; b = b + B; count = count + 1
        end
        if stack.dyed then add(stack.dyed) end
        for _, d in ipairs(dyes) do add(data().dyeColors[d] or 0xFFFFFF) end
        local R, G, B = math.floor(r / count), math.floor(g / count), math.floor(b / count)
        local f, top = maxSum / count, math.max(R, G, B)
        if top > 0 then R, G, B = math.floor(R * f / top), math.floor(G * f / top), math.floor(B * f / top) end
        return R * 65536 + G * 256 + B
    end
    local shapes = {fire_charge = "large_ball", gold_nugget = "star", feather = "burst"}
    local special = {}
    -- RepairItemRecipe: two of the same damageable item -> summed durability + 5%, curses kept.
    function special.repairitem(list)
        if #list ~= 2 or list[1].name ~= list[2].name then return end
        local a, b = list[1].stack, list[2].stack
        local max = Recipes.maxDamage(a)
        if not max or a.count ~= 1 or b.count ~= 1 then return end
        local remaining = (max - (a.damage or 0)) + (max - (b.damage or 0)) + math.floor(max * 5 / 100)
        local result = {id = a.id, count = 1, damage = math.max(0, max - remaining)}
        for _, s in ipairs({a, b}) do
            for e, level in pairs(s.enchantments or {}) do
                local info = data().enchantments[e]
                if info and info.curse then result.enchantments = result.enchantments or {}; result.enchantments[e] = math.max(level, result.enchantments[e] or 0) end
            end
        end
        return result
    end
    function special.bannerduplicate(list, r)
        if #list ~= 2 then return end
        local source, blank
        for _, item in ipairs(list) do
            if item.name ~= r.r then return end
            if item.stack.patterns and #item.stack.patterns > 0 then if source then return end source = item else if blank then return end blank = item end
        end
        if not source or not blank then return end
        return CreativeRules.withCount(source.stack, 1), {[source.cell] = CreativeRules.withCount(source.stack, 1)}
    end
    function special.bookcloning(list)
        local original, copies = nil, 0
        for _, item in ipairs(list) do
            if item.name == "written_book" then if original then return end original = item
            elseif item.name == "writable_book" then copies = copies + 1 else return end
        end
        if not original or copies < 1 then return end
        local book = original.stack.book or {}
        if (book.generation or 0) >= 2 then return end
        local result = CreativeRules.withCount(original.stack, copies)
        result.book = CreativeRules.copy(book); result.book.generation = (book.generation or 0) + 1
        return result, {[original.cell] = CreativeRules.withCount(original.stack, 1)}
    end
    function special.firework_rocket(list)
        local paper, gunpowder, stars = 0, 0, {}
        for _, item in ipairs(list) do
            if item.name == "paper" then paper = paper + 1
            elseif item.name == "gunpowder" then gunpowder = gunpowder + 1
            elseif item.name == "firework_star" then stars[#stars + 1] = item.stack.explosion
            else return end
        end
        if paper ~= 1 or gunpowder < 1 or gunpowder > 3 then return end
        local result = Recipes.stack("firework_rocket", 3)
        result.fireworks = {flight = gunpowder, explosions = stars}
        return result
    end
    function special.firework_star(list)
        local gunpowder, colors, shape, trail, twinkle = 0, {}, nil, false, false
        for _, item in ipairs(list) do
            local n = item.name
            if n == "gunpowder" then gunpowder = gunpowder + 1
            elseif Recipes.dyeColor(n) then colors[#colors + 1] = data().dyeColors[Recipes.dyeColor(n)]
            elseif shapes[n] or Recipes.tagged("skulls", n) then if shape then return end shape = shapes[n] or "creeper"
            elseif n == "diamond" then if trail then return end trail = true
            elseif n == "glowstone_dust" then if twinkle then return end twinkle = true
            else return end
        end
        if gunpowder ~= 1 or #colors == 0 then return end
        local result = Recipes.stack("firework_star", 1)
        result.explosion = {shape = shape or "small_ball", colors = colors, fade = {}, trail = trail, twinkle = twinkle}
        return result
    end
    function special.firework_star_fade(list)
        local star, fade = nil, {}
        for _, item in ipairs(list) do
            if item.name == "firework_star" then if star then return end star = item.stack
            elseif Recipes.dyeColor(item.name) then fade[#fade + 1] = data().dyeColors[Recipes.dyeColor(item.name)]
            else return end
        end
        if not star or #fade == 0 or not star.explosion then return end
        local result = CreativeRules.withCount(star, 1)
        result.explosion.fade = fade
        return result
    end
    function special.mapextending(list, _, grid, w)
        if w ~= 3 or #list ~= 9 then return end
        local map = grid[5]
        if Recipes.name(map) ~= "filled_map" then return end
        for i = 1, 9 do if i ~= 5 and Recipes.name(grid[i]) ~= "paper" then return end end
        local info = map.map or {}
        if info.locked or (info.scale or 0) >= 4 then return end
        local result = CreativeRules.withCount(map, 1)
        result.map = CreativeRules.copy(info); result.map.scale = (info.scale or 0) + 1
        return result
    end
    function special.shielddecoration(list)
        if #list ~= 2 then return end
        local shield, banner
        for _, item in ipairs(list) do
            if item.name == "shield" then shield = item.stack elseif item.name:match("_banner$") then banner = item end
        end
        if not shield or not banner or shield.patterns then return end
        local result = CreativeRules.withCount(shield, 1)
        result.patterns = CreativeRules.copy(banner.stack.patterns or {})
        result.baseColor = banner.name:match("^(.+)_banner$")
        return result
    end
    function special.decorated_pot(list, _, grid, w)
        if w ~= 3 or #list ~= 4 then return end
        local sides = {}
        for n, cell in ipairs({2, 4, 6, 8}) do
            local name = Recipes.name(grid[cell])
            if not name or not Recipes.tagged("decorated_pot_ingredients", name) then return end
            sides[n] = name
        end
        local result = Recipes.stack("decorated_pot", 1)
        result.sherds = {back = sides[1], left = sides[2], right = sides[3], front = sides[4]}
        return result
    end
    function Recipes.craft(grid, w, h)
        local x0, y0, x1, y1 = bounds(grid, w, h)
        if not x0 then return nil end
        local bw, bh = x1 - x0 + 1, y1 - y0 + 1
        local list = items(grid, w * h)
        for _, r in ipairs(data().recipes.crafting) do
            local t = r.t
            local result, keep
            if t == "s" then
                if r.w == bw and r.h == bh and (shapedMatch(r, grid, w, x0, y0, false) or shapedMatch(r, grid, w, x0, y0, true)) then
                    result = Recipes.stack(r.r, r.c)
                end
            elseif t == "l" then
                if shapelessMatch(r.i, list) then result = Recipes.stack(r.r, r.c) end
            elseif t == "m" then
                -- TransmuteRecipe: the input's components carry over to the new item.
                if #list == 2 then
                    for k = 1, 2 do
                        local input, material = list[k], list[3 - k]
                        if Recipes.matches(r.i, input.name) and Recipes.matches(r.m, material.name) and input.name ~= r.r then
                            result = CreativeRules.withCount(input.stack, r.c or 1); result.id = Recipes.index(r.r)
                        end
                    end
                end
            elseif t == "d" then
                local target, dyes = nil, {}
                for _, item in ipairs(list) do
                    if Recipes.matches(r.i, item.name) and not target then target = item.stack
                    elseif Recipes.matches(r.m, item.name) and Recipes.dyeColor(item.name) then dyes[#dyes + 1] = Recipes.dyeColor(item.name)
                    else target = nil; dyes = {}; break end
                end
                if target and #dyes > 0 then result = CreativeRules.withCount(target, 1); result.dyed = Recipes.applyDyes(target, dyes) end
            elseif t == "i" then
                if w == 3 and h == 3 and #list == 9 and Recipes.matches(r.i, Recipes.name(grid[5])) then
                    local ok = true
                    for i = 1, 9 do if i ~= 5 and not Recipes.matches(r.m, Recipes.name(grid[i])) then ok = false end end
                    if ok then result = Recipes.stack(r.r, r.c); result.potion = grid[5].potion end
                end
            elseif special[t] then
                result, keep = special[t](list, r, grid, w)
            end
            if result and result.id then return result, r, keep end
        end
        return nil
    end
    -- Consume one of every grid item (CraftingResultSlot.onTake): remainders refill empty cells or go to the player.
    function Recipes.consume(grid, n, keep, giveBack)
        for i = 1, n do
            local s = grid[i]
            if s then
                local name = Recipes.name(s)
                s.count = s.count - 1
                if s.count <= 0 then grid[i] = nil end
                local rest = keep and keep[i] or (Recipes.remainder(name) and Recipes.stack(Recipes.remainder(name), 1))
                if rest then
                    if not grid[i] then grid[i] = rest
                    elseif CreativeRules.sameItem(grid[i], rest) and grid[i].count < 64 then grid[i].count = grid[i].count + rest.count
                    else giveBack(rest) end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Stonecutter / smithing / brewing --------------------------------------------------------------
    function Recipes.stonecutting(stack)
        local name, out = Recipes.name(stack), {}
        if not name then return out end
        for _, r in ipairs(data().recipes.stonecutting) do
            if Recipes.matches(r.i, name) and Recipes.index(r.r) then out[#out + 1] = r end
        end
        return out
    end
    local trimMaterials = {iron_ingot = "iron", copper_ingot = "copper", gold_ingot = "gold", lapis_lazuli = "lapis", emerald = "emerald",
        diamond = "diamond", netherite_ingot = "netherite", redstone = "redstone", amethyst_shard = "amethyst", quartz = "quartz", resin_brick = "resin"}
    function Recipes.smithing(template, base, addition)
        local tn, bn, an = Recipes.name(template), Recipes.name(base), Recipes.name(addition)
        if not (tn and bn and an) then return nil end
        for _, r in ipairs(data().recipes.smithing) do
            if Recipes.matches(r.tp, tn) and Recipes.matches(r.b, bn) and Recipes.matches(r.a, an) then
                if r.t == "transform" then
                    local result = CreativeRules.withCount(base, r.c or 1); result.id = Recipes.index(r.r)
                    return result, r
                else
                    local material = trimMaterials[an]
                    if material and not (base.trim and base.trim.pattern == r.p and base.trim.material == material) then
                        local result = CreativeRules.withCount(base, 1); result.trim = {pattern = r.p, material = material}
                        return result, r
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Is this item an input of any smithing recipe slot? (SmithingMenu.mayPlace per slot)
    function Recipes.smithingAccepts(field, stack)
        local name = Recipes.name(stack)
        for _, r in ipairs(data().recipes.smithing) do if Recipes.matches(r[field], name) then return true end end
        return false
    end
    function Recipes.potionName(stack)
        local name = Recipes.name(stack)
        return name, stack.potion or (name == "potion" or name == "splash_potion" or name == "lingering_potion") and "water" or nil
    end
    function Recipes.brew(bottle, reagent)
        local item, potion = Recipes.potionName(bottle)
        local rn = Recipes.name(reagent)
        if not item or not rn then return nil end
        for _, r in ipairs(data().recipes.brewing) do
            if r.i == item and (r.ip == nil or r.ip == potion) and Recipes.matches(r.r, rn) then
                local out = Recipes.stack(r.o, 1)
                out.potion = r.op or potion
                return out
            end
        end
    end
    function Recipes.isReagent(stack)
        local rn = Recipes.name(stack)
        for _, r in ipairs(data().recipes.brewing) do if Recipes.matches(r.r, rn) then return true end end
        return false
    end
    function Recipes.isBottle(stack)
        local n = Recipes.name(stack)
        return n == "potion" or n == "splash_potion" or n == "lingering_potion" or n == "glass_bottle"
    end

    -- java.util.Random (48-bit LCG), exact, so enchanting rolls behave like Java's.
    function Recipes.random(seed)
        local r = {}
        local two24, two48 = 16777216, 281474976710656
        local hi, lo
        function r.setSeed(s)
            s = (s or 0) % two48
            local x = (s - s % 1)
            -- seed = (s ^ 0x5DEECE66D) & ((1 << 48) - 1), done on 24-bit halves.
            local sh, sl = math.floor(x / two24) % two24, x % two24
            hi, lo = bit32.bxor(sh, 0x5DE), bit32.bxor(sl, 0xECE66D)
        end
        local function step()
            -- seed = seed * 0x5DEECE66D + 0xB mod 2^48
            local mh, ml = 0x5DE, 0xECE66D
            local p0 = lo * ml + 0xB
            local carry = math.floor(p0 / two24)
            local newLo = p0 % two24
            local p1 = (lo * mh + hi * ml + carry) % two24
            hi, lo = p1, newLo
        end
        function r.next(bits)
            step()
            local v = math.floor((hi * two24 + lo) / 2 ^ (48 - bits))
            -- (int) cast: only a full 32-bit result can come out negative.
            if bits == 32 and v >= 2147483648 then v = v - 4294967296 end
            return v
        end
        function r.nextInt(bound)
            if not bound then return r.next(32) end
            if bound <= 0 then return 0 end
            if bit32.band(bound, bound - 1) == 0 then
                local v = r.next(31)
                return math.floor(bound * v / 2147483648)
            end
            local bits, val
            repeat bits = r.next(31); val = bits % bound until bits - val + (bound - 1) < 2147483648
            return val
        end
        function r.nextFloat() return r.next(24) / 16777216 end
        r.setSeed(seed)
        return r
    end

    -- Enchanting ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    function Recipes.enchantable(stack)
        local name = Recipes.name(stack)
        return name and (data().enchantable or {})[name] or 0
    end
    local function supports(info, name, tableOnly)
        local list = tableOnly and info.primary or info.supported
        return list and Recipes.matches(list, name)
    end
    function Recipes.canEnchant(id, stack)
        local info = data().enchantments[id]
        local name = Recipes.name(stack)
        return info ~= nil and (name == "enchanted_book" or supports(info, name, false))
    end
    function Recipes.compatible(a, b)
        if a == b then return false end
        local ia, ib = data().enchantments[a], data().enchantments[b]
        for _, x in ipairs(ia and ia.exclusive or {}) do if x == b then return false end end
        for _, x in ipairs(ib and ib.exclusive or {}) do if x == a then return false end end
        return true
    end
    local function minCost(info, level) return info.min[1] + info.min[2] * (level - 1) end
    local function maxCost(info, level) return info.maxCost[1] + info.maxCost[2] * (level - 1) end
    -- EnchantmentHelper.getEnchantmentCost
    function Recipes.enchantCost(random, slot, shelves, stack)
        if Recipes.enchantable(stack) <= 0 then return 0 end
        shelves = math.min(shelves, 15)
        local i = random.nextInt(8) + 1 + math.floor(shelves / 2) + random.nextInt(shelves + 1)
        if slot == 0 then return math.max(math.floor(i / 3), 1) end
        if slot == 1 then return math.floor(i * 2 / 3) + 1 end
        return math.max(i, shelves * 2)
    end
    local order
    local function sortedEnchantments()
        if not order then
            order = {}
            for id, info in pairs(data().enchantments) do if info.table then order[#order + 1] = id end end
            table.sort(order)
        end
        return order
    end
    -- EnchantmentHelper.selectEnchantment
    function Recipes.selectEnchantments(random, stack, level)
        local value = Recipes.enchantable(stack)
        if value <= 0 then return {} end
        local name = Recipes.name(stack)
        level = level + 1 + random.nextInt(math.floor(value / 4) + 1) + random.nextInt(math.floor(value / 4) + 1)
        local f = (random.nextFloat() + random.nextFloat() - 1) * 0.15
        level = math.clamp(math.floor(level + level * f + 0.5), 1, 2147483647)
        local available = {}
        for _, id in ipairs(sortedEnchantments()) do
            local info = data().enchantments[id]
            if name == "book" or supports(info, name, true) then
                for l = info.max, 1, -1 do
                    if level >= minCost(info, l) and level <= maxCost(info, l) then available[#available + 1] = {id = id, level = l, weight = info.weight}; break end
                end
            end
        end
        local chosen = {}
        local function pick(list)
            local total = 0
            for _, e in ipairs(list) do total = total + e.weight end
            if total <= 0 then return nil end
            local n = random.nextInt(total)
            for _, e in ipairs(list) do n = n - e.weight; if n < 0 then return e end end
        end
        if #available == 0 then return chosen end
        chosen[1] = pick(available)
        while random.nextInt(50) <= level do
            local filtered = {}
            for _, e in ipairs(available) do
                local ok = true
                for _, c in ipairs(chosen) do if not Recipes.compatible(e.id, c.id) then ok = false end end
                if ok then filtered[#filtered + 1] = e end
            end
            available = filtered
            if #available == 0 then break end
            chosen[#chosen + 1] = pick(available)
            level = math.floor(level / 2)
        end
        return chosen
    end

    -- Anvil (AnvilMenu.createResult). Returns result, cost, materials used from slot 2.
    local function increased(cost) return math.min(cost * 2 + 1, 2147483647) end
    function Recipes.repairMaterial(stack, material)
        local name, m = Recipes.name(stack), Recipes.name(material)
        if not name or not m then return false end
        local tool = name:match("^(%a+)_") or ""
        local prefix = ({wooden = "wooden", stone = "stone", copper = "copper", iron = "iron", golden = "gold", diamond = "diamond", netherite = "netherite"})[tool]
        if prefix and (name:match("_sword$") or name:match("_pickaxe$") or name:match("_axe$") or name:match("_shovel$") or name:match("_hoe$") or name:match("_spear$")) then
            return Recipes.tagged(prefix .. "_tool_materials", m)
        end
        local armor = ({leather = "leather", chainmail = "chain", iron = "iron", golden = "gold", diamond = "diamond", netherite = "netherite", copper = "copper"})[tool]
        if armor and (name:match("_helmet$") or name:match("_chestplate$") or name:match("_leggings$") or name:match("_boots$")) then
            return Recipes.tagged("repairs_" .. armor .. "_armor", m)
        end
        local others = {turtle_helmet = "repairs_turtle_helmet", wolf_armor = "repairs_wolf_armor", elytra = nil, shield = "wooden_tool_materials", mace = nil}
        if name == "elytra" then return m == "phantom_membrane" end
        if name == "mace" then return m == "breeze_rod" end
        return others[name] ~= nil and Recipes.tagged(others[name], m)
    end
    function Recipes.anvil(first, second, rename, creative)
        if not first then return nil, 0, 0 end
        local result = CreativeRules.withCount(first, first.count)
        local enchants = CreativeRules.copy(first.enchantments or {})
        local i, j, k, used = 0, (first.repairCost or 0) + (second and second.repairCost or 0), 0, 0
        local max = Recipes.maxDamage(first)
        if second then
            local isBook = Recipes.name(second) == "enchanted_book" and next(second.enchantments or {}) ~= nil
            if max and Recipes.repairMaterial(first, second) then
                local l = math.min(result.damage or 0, math.floor(max / 4))
                if l <= 0 then return nil, 0, 0 end
                local m = 0
                while l > 0 and m < second.count do
                    result.damage = (result.damage or 0) - l; i = i + 1
                    l = math.min(result.damage, math.floor(max / 4)); m = m + 1
                end
                used = m
            else
                if not isBook and (Recipes.name(first) ~= Recipes.name(second) or not max) then return nil, 0, 0 end
                if max and not isBook then
                    local l = max - (first.damage or 0)
                    local m = max - (second.damage or 0)
                    local p = math.max(0, max - (l + m + math.floor(max * 12 / 100)))
                    if p < (result.damage or 0) then result.damage = p; i = i + 2 end
                end
                local compatibleAny, incompatibleAny = false, false
                local keys = {}
                for id in pairs(second.enchantments or {}) do keys[#keys + 1] = id end
                table.sort(keys)
                for _, id in ipairs(keys) do
                    local q = second.enchantments[id]
                    local info = data().enchantments[id]
                    local r = enchants[id] or 0
                    local s = r == q and q + 1 or math.max(q, r)
                    local ok = creative or Recipes.canEnchant(id, first)
                    for other in pairs(enchants) do
                        if other ~= id and not Recipes.compatible(id, other) then ok = false; i = i + 1 end
                    end
                    if not ok then incompatibleAny = true
                    else
                        compatibleAny = true
                        if info and s > info.max then s = info.max end
                        enchants[id] = s
                        local t = info and info.anvil or 1
                        if isBook then t = math.max(1, math.floor(t / 2)) end
                        i = i + t * s
                        if first.count > 1 then i = 40 end
                    end
                end
                if incompatibleAny and not compatibleAny then return nil, 0, 0 end
            end
        end
        if rename ~= nil then
            if rename:match("^%s*$") then
                if first.name then k = 1; i = i + k; result.name = nil end
            elseif rename ~= (first.name or blockNames[first.id] or "") then
                k = 1; i = i + k; result.name = rename
            end
        end
        local cost = j + i
        if i <= 0 then return nil, cost, used end
        if k == i and k > 0 and cost >= 40 then cost = 39 end
        if cost >= 40 and not creative then return nil, cost, used end
        local t = result.repairCost or 0
        if second and t < (second.repairCost or 0) then t = second.repairCost end
        if k ~= i or k == 0 then t = increased(t) end
        result.repairCost = t
        result.enchantments = next(enchants) and enchants or nil
        return result, cost, used
    end

    -- Grindstone (GrindstoneMenu): strip non-curse enchantments, merge two of the same item.
    local function withoutNonCurses(stack)
        local result = CreativeRules.withCount(stack, stack.count)
        local kept, curses = {}, 0
        for id, level in pairs(stack.enchantments or {}) do
            local info = data().enchantments[id]
            if info and info.curse then kept[id] = level; curses = curses + 1 end
        end
        result.enchantments = next(kept) and kept or nil
        if Recipes.name(result) == "enchanted_book" and not result.enchantments then result.id = Recipes.index("book") end
        local cost = 0
        for _ = 1, curses do cost = increased(cost) end
        result.repairCost = cost > 0 and cost or nil
        return result
    end
    function Recipes.grindstone(a, b)
        if not a and not b then return nil end
        local function enchanted(s) for id in pairs(s.enchantments or {}) do local info = data().enchantments[id]; if not (info and info.curse) then return true end end return false end
        if a and b then
            if Recipes.name(a) ~= Recipes.name(b) or a.count > 1 or b.count > 1 then return nil end
            local max = Recipes.maxDamage(a)
            if not max then return nil end
            local result = CreativeRules.withCount(a, 1)
            local merged = CreativeRules.copy(a.enchantments or {})
            for id, level in pairs(b.enchantments or {}) do merged[id] = math.max(level, merged[id] or 0) end
            result.enchantments = next(merged) and merged or nil
            result.damage = math.max(0, max - ((max - (a.damage or 0)) + (max - (b.damage or 0)) + math.floor(max * 5 / 100)))
            return withoutNonCurses(result)
        end
        local only = a or b
        if not enchanted(only) then return nil end
        return withoutNonCurses(CreativeRules.withCount(only, 1))
    end
    -- XP from the removed enchantments (GrindstoneMenu.getExperienceAmount).
    function Recipes.grindstoneXp(stacks)
        local sum = 0
        for _, s in ipairs(stacks) do
            for id, level in pairs(s and s.enchantments or {}) do
                local info = data().enchantments[id]
                if info and not info.curse then sum = sum + minCost(info, level) end
            end
        end
        if sum <= 0 then return 0 end
        local half = math.ceil(sum / 2)
        return half + math.random(0, half - 1)
    end

    -- Loom: patterns a banner can take (LoomMenu.getSelectablePatterns).
    function Recipes.loomPatterns(patternItem)
        local bp = data().bannerPatterns
        if patternItem then
            local list = (data().bannerPatternItems or {})[Recipes.name(patternItem)]
            if list then return list end
            return {}
        end
        return bp.order
    end
end
