-- BEGIN CREATIVE UI
-- Java screens: HUD hotbar (Gui.renderItemHotbar), survival InventoryScreen, creative
-- CreativeModeInventoryScreen with the 26.3 tabs, and the chest / hopper / dispenser /
-- furnace / shulker box container screens, all using AbstractContainerMenu click rules.
local function createCreativeUI(gui, inventory, connections, onChange, onOpen)
    local G = JavaContent.data.javaGui
    local ui = {open = false, selected = 1, tab = "BUILDING_BLOCKS", scroll = 0}
    local textColor, white = Color3.fromRGB(64, 64, 64), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    local function connect(signal, fn) connections[#connections + 1] = signal:Connect(fn) end
    local function maxStack(id) return itemStackLimits[id] or (toolStats[id] and 1 or 64) end
    local function held(key) return Input:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode["Left" .. key]) or Input:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode["Right" .. key]) end
    local function same(a, b) return CreativeRules.sameItem(a, b) end
    local withCount = CreativeRules.withCount
    inventory.equipment = inventory.equipment or {}
    local equipment = {slots = inventory.equipment}
    local craft = {slots = {}}
    local view = {s = 0, w = 0, h = 0}
    local function canvas(name, z)
        local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        frame.Name, frame.BackgroundTransparency, frame.ZIndex, frame.Parent = name, 1, z, gui
        local scale = Instance.new("UIScale"); scale.Parent = frame
        return frame, scale
    end
    local hud, hudScale = canvas("JavaHud", 1)
    local screenRoot, screenScale = canvas("JavaScreen", 20)
    screenRoot.Visible = false

    -- HUD -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local H = {items = {}, hearts = {}, food = {}, armor = {}}
    H.hotbar = JavaGui.image(hud, G["hud/hotbar"], 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 2)
    H.selection = JavaGui.image(hud, G["hud/hotbar_selection"], 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 4)
    H.offhand = JavaGui.image(hud, G["hud/hotbar_offhand_left"], 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 2)
    for i = 1, 9 do H.items[i] = JavaGui.itemView(hud, 0, 0, 5) end
    H.offItem = JavaGui.itemView(hud, 0, 0, 5)
    local function icons(list, empty, full, half)
        for i = 1, 10 do
            list[i] = {empty = JavaGui.image(hud, G[empty], 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 2),
                full = JavaGui.image(hud, G[full], 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3), half = JavaGui.image(hud, G[half], 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3)}
        end
    end
    icons(H.hearts, "hud/heart/container", "hud/heart/full", "hud/heart/half")
    icons(H.food, "hud/food_empty", "hud/food_full", "hud/food_half")
    icons(H.armor, "hud/armor_empty", "hud/armor_full", "hud/armor_half")
    H.xp = JavaGui.image(hud, G["hud/experience_bar_background"], 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 2)
    H.xpFill = G["hud/experience_bar_progress"] and JavaGui.image(hud, G["hud/experience_bar_progress"], 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3)
    H.jump = G["hud/jump_bar_background"] and JavaGui.image(hud, G["hud/jump_bar_background"], 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 2)
    H.jumpFill = G["hud/jump_bar_progress"] and JavaGui.image(hud, G["hud/jump_bar_progress"], 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3)
    local nameTicks, nameText, nameLabel = 0, nil, nil
    local function placeHud()
        local W, Hh = view.w, view.h
        local x0 = math.floor(W / 2) - 91
        H.hotbar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0, Hh - 22)
        H.selection.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0 - 1 + (ui.selected - 1) * 20, Hh - 23)
        H.offhand.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0 - 29, Hh - 23)
        for i = 1, 9 do H.items[i].frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0 + 3 + (i - 1) * 20, Hh - 19) end
        H.offItem.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0 - 26, Hh - 19)
        for i = 1, 10 do
            for _, node in pairs(H.hearts[i]) do node.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0 + (i - 1) * 8, Hh - 39) end
            for _, node in pairs(H.food[i]) do node.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0 + 173 - (i - 1) * 8, Hh - 39) end
            for _, node in pairs(H.armor[i]) do node.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0 + (i - 1) * 8, Hh - 49) end
        end
        H.xp.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0, Hh - 29)
        H.xpLevel = nil
    end
    -- Gui.renderPlayerHealth(): hearts, food from the right, armour above the hearts.
    local function setIcons(list, value, shown)
        for i = 1, 10 do
            local icon = list[i]
            icon.empty.Visible = shown
            icon.full.Visible = shown and (i - 1) * 2 + 1 < value
            icon.half.Visible = shown and (i - 1) * 2 + 1 == value
        end
    end
    local function updateHud()
        local survival = CONFIG.Survival
        -- Spectator: no hotbar (Gui.renderHotbar is skipped for spectators).
        local spectating = PlayerStats.spectator
        H.hotbar.Visible, H.selection.Visible = not spectating, not spectating
        for i = 1, 9 do H.items[i].frame.Visible = not spectating end
        if spectating then H.offhand.Visible = false; H.offItem.frame.Visible = false end
        local health, maxHealth, hunger = 20, 20, 20
        if ui.status then health, maxHealth, hunger = ui.status() end
        setIcons(H.hearts, math.ceil(math.clamp(health / math.max(maxHealth, 1) * 20, 0, 20)), survival)
        setIcons(H.food, hunger or 20, survival)
        local points = 0
        for _, stack in pairs(inventory.equipment) do
            local e = JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
            local armor = e and JavaContent.data.armor and JavaContent.data.armor[e.id]
            points = points + (armor and armor.points or 0)
        end
        setIcons(H.armor, points, survival and points > 0)
        H.xp.Visible = survival
        -- Gui.renderExperienceBar(): fill = progress * 183; level in 0x80FF20 with a 1px black outline.
        if H.xpFill then
            local fill = math.floor(PlayerStats.xpProgress * 183)
            JavaGui.crop(H.xpFill, G["hud/experience_bar_progress"], math.floor(view.w / 2) - 91, view.h - 29, {0, 0, fill, 5})
            H.xpFill.Visible = survival and fill > 0
        end
        -- Gui.renderJumpMeter(): shown instead of the experience bar while a throw charges (_G.SteveHudPower 0..1).
        local power = rawget(_G, "SteveHudPower")
        if H.jump and H.jumpFill then
            local charging = type(power) == "number"
            H.jump.Visible = charging
            H.jump.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(view.w / 2) - 91, view.h - 29)
            if charging then
                H.xp.Visible = false
                if H.xpFill then H.xpFill.Visible = false end
                JavaGui.crop(H.jumpFill, G["hud/jump_bar_progress"], math.floor(view.w / 2) - 91, view.h - 29, {0, 0, math.floor(math.clamp(power, 0, 1) * 183), 5})
            else
                H.jumpFill.Visible = false
            end
        end
        local level = survival and PlayerStats.xpLevel > 0 and type(power) ~= "number" and tostring(PlayerStats.xpLevel) or nil
        if H.xpLevelText ~= level or H.xpLevelW ~= view.w then
            if H.xpLevel then H.xpLevel:Destroy(); H.xpLevel = nil end
            H.xpLevelText, H.xpLevelW = level, view.w
            if level then
                local x, y = math.floor((view.w - JavaGui.width(level)) / 2), view.h - 31 - 4
                H.xpLevel = Instance.new("Frame"); H.xpLevel.BackgroundTransparency, H.xpLevel.ZIndex, H.xpLevel.Parent = 1, 6, hud
                for _, o in ipairs({{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}}) do JavaGui.text(H.xpLevel, level, x + o[1], y + o[2], Color3.new(0, 0, 0), false, 6) end
                JavaGui.text(H.xpLevel, level, x, y, Color3.fromRGB(128, 255, 32), false, 7)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Screens -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local screen = nil
    local highlightBack, highlightFront, cursorView, tooltip
    local function clearScreen()
        for _, child in ipairs(screenRoot:GetChildren()) do if not child:IsA("UIScale") then child:Destroy() end end
        screen = nil
    end
    -- A slot: owner.slots[index] at GUI (x, y) inside the window. kind: normal, result,
    -- armor, catalog, destroy. accepts(stack) limits what can be placed.
    local function addSlot(def)
        def.view = JavaGui.itemView(screen.window, def.x, def.y, 6)
        screen.slots[#screen.slots + 1] = def
        return def
    end
    local function playerSlots(x, mainY, hotbarY)
        for row = 0, 2 do for col = 0, 8 do
            addSlot({owner = inventory, index = 10 + row * 9 + col, x = x + col * 18, y = mainY + row * 18, group = "main"})
        end end
        for col = 0, 8 do addSlot({owner = inventory, index = 1 + col, x = x + col * 18, y = hotbarY, group = "hotbar"}) end
    end
    local armorNames = {"helmet", "chestplate", "leggings", "boots"}
    local function armorSlot(name, x, y)
        local placeholder = JavaGui.image(screen.window, G["container/slot/" .. name], x, y, nil, nil, nil, 5)
        return addSlot({owner = equipment, index = name, x = x, y = y, kind = "armor", max = 1, placeholder = placeholder,
            accepts = function(stack)
                local e = JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
                local armor = e and JavaContent.data.armor and JavaContent.data.armor[e.id]
                return (armor ~= nil and armor.slot == name) or (name == "helmet" and e ~= nil and (e.id == "carved_pumpkin" or e.id:match("_head$") ~= nil or e.id:match("_skull$") ~= nil))
            end})
    end
    local function offhandSlot(x, y)
        -- Empty-slot outline is distinct from the equipped shield's item sprite.
        local placeholder = JavaGui.image(screen.window, G["container/slot/shield"], x, y, 16, 16, nil, 5)
        placeholder.Name = "ShieldPlaceholder"
        return addSlot({owner = inventory, index = 41, x = x, y = y, placeholder = placeholder})
    end
    local function newScreen(kind, width, height)
        clearScreen()
        screen = {kind = kind, width = width, height = height, slots = {}, labels = {}}
        -- renderTransparentBackground(): 0xC0101010 to 0xD0101010 vertical gradient.
        local dim = Instance.new("Frame")
        dim.BackgroundColor3, dim.BorderSizePixel, dim.Size, dim.ZIndex = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 16), 0, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 1
        local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        gradient.Rotation, gradient.Transparency = 90, NumberSequence.new(1 - 0xC0 / 255, 1 - 0xD0 / 255)
        gradient.Parent, dim.Parent = dim, screenRoot
        local window = Instance.new("Frame")
        window.Name, window.BackgroundTransparency, window.ZIndex = "Window", 1, 3
        window.Size, window.Parent = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height), screenRoot
        screen.window = window
        highlightBack = JavaGui.image(window, G["container/slot_highlight_back"], 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 5)
        highlightFront = JavaGui.image(window, G["container/slot_highlight_front"], 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 9)
        highlightBack.Visible, highlightFront.Visible = false, false
        return screen
    end
    local function label(text, x, y, centered)
        if centered then x = math.floor((screen.width - JavaGui.width(text)) / 2) end
        screen.labels[#screen.labels + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, text, x, y, textColor, false, 4)
    end
    local function placeScreen()
        if not screen then return end
        screen.left = math.floor((view.w - screen.width) / 2)
        screen.top = math.floor((view.h - screen.height) / 2)
        screen.window.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(screen.left, screen.top)
    end

    -- Survival InventoryScreen (inventory.png, 176x166).
    local function openInventory()
        newScreen("inventory", 176, 166)
        JavaGui.image(screen.window, G.inventory, 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3)
        JavaGui.playerPreview(screen.window, 26, 8, 75, 78, 30)
        label("Crafting", 97, 8)
        for i, name in ipairs(armorNames) do armorSlot(name, 8, 8 + (i - 1) * 18) end
        offhandSlot(77, 62)
        for i = 1, 4 do addSlot({owner = craft, index = i, x = 98 + (i - 1) % 2 * 18, y = 18 + math.floor((i - 1) / 2) * 18, group = "craft"}) end
        addSlot({owner = craft, index = 5, x = 154, y = 28, kind = "result"})
        playerSlots(8, 84, 142)
        if ui.decorate then ui.decorate("inventory", screen) end
    end

    -- CreativeModeInventoryScreen (195x136) ---------------------------------------------
    local tabs = JavaContent.data.creativeTabs or {}
    local function tabRect(tab)
        local x = tab.column * 27
        if tab.column == 6 then x = 195 - 27 * (7 - tab.column) + 1 end
        return x, tab.row == "top" and -32 or 136
    end
    -- Fabric item-group paging: vanilla tabs on page 0, mod tabs ten to a page after it; the common tabs on every page.
    local paging = {common = {HOTBAR = true, SEARCH = true, INVENTORY = true}}
    ui.page = 0
    function paging.count()
        local extra = 0
        for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do
            if t.mod then
                local slot = extra % 10
                t.page, t.row, t.column = math.floor(extra / 10) + 1, slot < 5 and "top" or "bottom", slot % 5
                extra = extra + 1
            else t.page = 0 end
        end
        return 1 + math.ceil(extra / 10)
    end
    function paging.visible()
        local list = {}
        for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do if paging.common[t.key] or (t.page or 0) == ui.page then list[#list + 1] = t end end
        return list
    end
    function paging.at(mx, my)
        if not screen or not screen.pages then return nil end
        local x, y = mx - screen.left, my - screen.top
        for _, b in ipairs(screen.pages) do if x >= b.x and x < b.x + (b.w or 10) and y >= b.y and y < b.y + (b.h or 12) then return b end end
    end
    local function savedHotbars()
        local ok, saved = pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("SteveSavedHotbars") or "{}") end)
        local items = {}
        for row = 1, 9 do
            local stacks = ok and type(saved) == "table" and saved[tostring(row)]
            for col = 1, 9 do
                local s = stacks and stacks[col]
                local entry = s and JavaContent.byIndex[s[1]]
                items[#items + 1] = entry and JavaContent.mods.available(entry) and s[1] or false
            end
        end
        return items
    end
    -- Java's variant lists (CreativeModeTabs.generate*): stacks with components for one item id.
    local function variantStacks(id, allLevels)
        local e = JavaContent.itemById[id]
        if not e then return nil end
        local data = JavaContent.data
        local out = {}
        if id == "enchanted_book" then
            local names = {}
            for name in pairs(data.enchantments or {}) do names[#names + 1] = name end
            table.sort(names)
            for _, name in ipairs(names) do
                local max = data.enchantments[name].max or 1
                for level = allLevels and 1 or max, max do out[#out + 1] = {id = e.index, count = 1, enchantments = {[name] = level}} end
            end
        elseif id == "potion" or id == "splash_potion" or id == "lingering_potion" or id == "tipped_arrow" then
            local order = {"water", "mundane", "thick", "awkward", "night_vision", "long_night_vision", "invisibility", "long_invisibility",
                "leaping", "long_leaping", "strong_leaping", "fire_resistance", "long_fire_resistance", "swiftness", "long_swiftness", "strong_swiftness",
                "slowness", "long_slowness", "strong_slowness", "turtle_master", "long_turtle_master", "strong_turtle_master", "water_breathing",
                "long_water_breathing", "healing", "strong_healing", "harming", "strong_harming", "poison", "long_poison", "strong_poison",
                "regeneration", "long_regeneration", "strong_regeneration", "strength", "long_strength", "strong_strength", "weakness",
                "long_weakness", "luck", "slow_falling", "long_slow_falling", "wind_charged", "weaving", "oozing", "infested"}
            local known = data.potions and data.potions.potions or {}
            for _, name in ipairs(order) do if known[name] then out[#out + 1] = {id = e.index, count = 1, potion = name} end end
        elseif id == "suspicious_stew" then
            -- SuspiciousEffectHolder flowers, one stew per distinct effect (durations in ticks).
            for _, effect in ipairs({{"saturation", 7}, {"night_vision", 100}, {"fire_resistance", 60}, {"blindness", 220}, {"weakness", 140},
                {"regeneration", 140}, {"jump_boost", 100}, {"poison", 220}, {"wither", 140}, {"nausea", 140}}) do
                out[#out + 1] = {id = e.index, count = 1, stewEffects = {{effect[1], effect[2]}}}
            end
        elseif id == "goat_horn" then
            for _, name in ipairs({"ponder_goat_horn", "sing_goat_horn", "seek_goat_horn", "feel_goat_horn", "admire_goat_horn", "call_goat_horn", "yearn_goat_horn", "dream_goat_horn"}) do
                out[#out + 1] = {id = e.index, count = 1, instrument = name}
            end
        elseif id == "ominous_bottle" then
            for amplifier = 0, 4 do out[#out + 1] = {id = e.index, count = 1, amplifier = amplifier} end
        elseif id == "light" then
            for level = 15, 0, -1 do out[#out + 1] = {id = e.index, count = 1, blockState = {level = tostring(level)}} end
        elseif id == "test_block" then
            for _, mode in ipairs({"start", "log", "fail", "accept"}) do out[#out + 1] = {id = e.index, count = 1, blockState = {mode = mode}} end
        elseif id == "firework_rocket" then
            for flight = 1, 3 do out[#out + 1] = {id = e.index, count = 1, fireworks = {flight = flight, explosions = {}}} end
        else
            return nil
        end
        return out
    end
    local function tabItems(tab)
        if tab.key == "HOTBAR" then return savedHotbars() end
        local items, query = {}, ui.query and ui.query:lower() or ""
        if tab.key == "SEARCH" then
            local seen = {}
            for _, other in ipairs(tabs) do
                local all = other.items
                if other.searchOnly then
                    all = table.clone(other.items)
                    for _, id in ipairs(other.searchOnly) do all[#all + 1] = id end
                end
                for _, id in ipairs(all) do
                    local e = JavaContent.itemById[id]
                    if e and JavaContent.mods.available(e) and not seen[e.index] and (query == "" or e.name:lower():find(query, 1, true) or e.id:find(query, 1, true)) then
                        seen[e.index] = true
                        local variants = variantStacks(id, true)
                        if variants then for _, v in ipairs(variants) do items[#items + 1] = v end else items[#items + 1] = e.index end
                    end
                end
            end
            return items
        end
        if tab.sections then
            tab.bannerRows = {}
            for _, sec in ipairs(tab.sections) do
                tab.bannerRows[#tab.bannerRows + 1] = {row = math.floor(#items / 9), section = sec}
                for _ = 1, 9 do items[#items + 1] = false end
                local n = 0
                for _, id in ipairs(sec.items) do
                    local e = JavaContent.itemById[id]
                    if e and JavaContent.mods.available(e) then items[#items + 1] = e.index; n = n + 1 end
                end
                for _ = 1, (9 - n % 9) % 9 do items[#items + 1] = false end
            end
            return items
        end
        for _, id in ipairs(tab.items) do
            local e = JavaContent.itemById[id]
            if e and JavaContent.mods.available(e) then
                local variants = variantStacks(id, false)
                if variants then for _, v in ipairs(variants) do items[#items + 1] = v end else items[#items + 1] = e.index end
            end
        end
        return items
    end
    local fillCatalog -- defined below; the search box refills the grid while typing
    local function currentTab()
        for _, tab in ipairs(tabs) do if tab.key == ui.tab then return tab end end
        return tabs[1]
    end
    local function openCreative()
        local tab = currentTab()
        local pages = paging.count()
        if not paging.common[tab.key] then ui.page = tab.page or 0 end
        ui.page = math.clamp(ui.page, 0, pages - 1)
        newScreen("creative", 195, 136)
        local background = tab.key == "INVENTORY" and "tab_inventory" or tab.key == "SEARCH" and "tab_item_search" or "tab_items"
        JavaGui.image(screen.window, G[background], 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3)
        screen.tabs = {}
        for _, t in ipairs(paging.visible()) do
            local x, y = tabRect(t)
            local selected = t == tab
            local sprite = G[string.format("container/creative_inventory/tab_%s_%s_%d", t.row, selected and "selected" or "unselected", t.column + 1)]
            -- Unselected tabs sit behind the background, the selected tab in front of it.
            JavaGui.image(screen.window, sprite, x, y, nil, nil, nil, selected and 4 or 1)
            local icon = JavaContent.itemById[t.icon]
            if icon then JavaGui.itemView(screen.window, x + 5, y + (t.row == "top" and 9 or 7), selected and 5 or 2).set({id = icon.index, count = 1}) end
            screen.tabs[#screen.tabs + 1] = {tab = t, x = x, y = y}
        end
        -- NeoForge CreativeModeInventoryScreen paging: a 20x20 "<" at the left and ">" at the right, 50 above the screen,
        -- and "page / pages" centred between them (only when there is more than one page)
        screen.pages = nil
        if pages > 1 then
            screen.pages = {}
            for k, dir in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
                local bx, by = k == 1 and 0 or 195 - 20, -50
                local enabled = (dir < 0 and ui.page > 0) or (dir > 0 and ui.page < pages - 1)
                local b = {x = bx, y = by, w = 20, h = 20, dir = dir, enabled = enabled}
                JavaGui.slice(screen.window, G[enabled and "widget/button" or "widget/button_disabled"], 3, bx, by, 20, 20, 6)
                if enabled then b.lit = JavaGui.slice(screen.window, G["widget/button_highlighted"], 3, bx, by, 20, 20, 6); b.lit.Visible = false end
                local arrow = dir < 0 and "<" or ">"
                JavaGui.text(screen.window, arrow, bx + math.floor((20 - JavaGui.width(arrow)) / 2), by + 6, enabled and white or Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 160), true, 7)
                screen.pages[k] = b
            end
            local pageText = (ui.page + 1) .. " / " .. pages
            JavaGui.text(screen.window, pageText, math.floor(195 / 2 - JavaGui.width(pageText) / 2), -44, white, true, 7)
        end
        if tab.key ~= "INVENTORY" then
            if tab.key ~= "SEARCH" then label(tab.title, 8, 6) end
            screen.items = tabItems(tab)
            screen.rows = math.max(1, math.ceil(#screen.items / 9))
            ui.scroll = math.clamp(ui.scroll, 0, 1)
            for row = 0, 4 do for col = 0, 8 do
                addSlot({owner = {slots = {}}, index = row * 9 + col + 1, x = 9 + col * 18, y = 18 + row * 18, kind = "catalog"})
            end end
            for col = 0, 8 do addSlot({owner = inventory, index = 1 + col, x = 9 + col * 18, y = 112, group = "hotbar"}) end
            local canScroll = screen.rows > 5
            screen.scroller = JavaGui.image(screen.window, G[canScroll and "container/creative_inventory/scroller" or "container/creative_inventory/scroller_disabled"], 175, 18, nil, nil, nil, 5)
            if tab.key == "SEARCH" then
                -- EditBox at (82, 6), 80 wide: a Roblox TextBox takes the typing, the Java font draws it.
                local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
                box.BackgroundTransparency, box.TextTransparency, box.Text, box.ClearTextOnFocus = 1, 1, ui.query or "", false
                box.Position, box.Size, box.ZIndex, box.Parent = UDim2.fromOffset(82, 6), UDim2.fromOffset(80, 9), 8, screen.window
                screen.search = box
                connect(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
                    if not (screen and screen.search == box) then return end
                    ui.query, ui.scroll = box.Text, 0
                    screen.items = tabItems(tab)
                    screen.rows = math.max(1, math.ceil(#screen.items / 9))
                    fillCatalog(); ui.refresh()
                end)
                screen.searchText = JavaGui.text(screen.window, (ui.query or "") .. "_", 82, 6, white, true, 7)
                task.defer(function() if box.Parent then JavaGui.focus(box) end end)
            end
        else
            for i, name in ipairs(armorNames) do armorSlot(name, 54 + math.floor((i - 1) / 2) * 54, 6 + (i - 1) % 2 * 27) end
            JavaGui.playerPreview(screen.window, 73, 6, 105, 49, 20)
            offhandSlot(35, 20)
            for row = 0, 2 do for col = 0, 8 do
                addSlot({owner = inventory, index = 10 + row * 9 + col, x = 9 + col * 18, y = 54 + row * 18, group = "main"})
            end end
            for col = 0, 8 do addSlot({owner = inventory, index = 1 + col, x = 9 + col * 18, y = 112, group = "hotbar"}) end
            addSlot({owner = {slots = {}}, index = 1, x = 173, y = 112, kind = "destroy"})
        end
    end
    local function scrollRows() return screen and screen.rows and math.max(0, screen.rows - 5) or 0 end
    fillCatalog = function()
        if not screen or not screen.items then return end
        local first = math.floor(ui.scroll * scrollRows() + 0.5) * 9
        for _, slot in ipairs(screen.slots) do
            if slot.kind == "catalog" then
                local item = screen.items[first + slot.index]
                if type(item) == "table" then slot.item, slot.template = item.id, item else slot.item, slot.template = item or nil, nil end
            end
        end
        if screen.scroller then screen.scroller.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(175, 18 + math.floor((112 - 17) * ui.scroll)) end
        if screen.bannerLayer then screen.bannerLayer:Destroy(); screen.bannerLayer = nil end
        local tab = currentTab()
        if tab and tab.bannerRows and screen.items then
            local layer = Instance.new("Frame")
            layer.Name, layer.BackgroundTransparency, layer.Size, layer.ZIndex = "Banners", 1, UDim2.fromOffset(195, 136), 4
            layer.Parent = screen.window
            screen.bannerLayer = layer
            local topRow = first / 9
            for _, br in ipairs(tab.bannerRows) do
                local r = br.row - topRow
                if r >= 0 and r <= 4 then
                    local sec = br.section
                    local x, y = 8, 17 + r * 18
                    if sec.image then
                        local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                        img.BackgroundTransparency, img.Image, img.ResampleMode, img.ZIndex = 1, sec.image, Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated, 4
                        img.Position, img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), UDim2.fromOffset(162, 18)
                        img.Parent = layer
                    end
                    -- the title on its translucent backing (#AARRGGBB)
                    local function argb(h, default)
                        h = tostring(h or default):gsub("#", "")
                        local a, rr, gg, bb = tonumber(h:sub(1, 2), 16) or 255, tonumber(h:sub(3, 4), 16) or 255, tonumber(h:sub(5, 6), 16) or 255, tonumber(h:sub(7, 8), 16) or 255
                        return Color3.fromRGB(rr, gg, bb), 1 - a / 255
                    end
                    local title = tostring(sec.title or "")
                    local bgc, bgt = argb(sec.background, "#aa000000")
                    local back = Instance.new("Frame")
                    back.BackgroundColor3, back.BackgroundTransparency, back.BorderSizePixel, back.ZIndex = bgc, bgt, 0, 5
                    back.Position, back.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(x + 2, y + 2), UDim2.fromOffset(JavaGui.width(title) + 6, 14)
                    back.Parent = layer
                    -- drawAuraText: the whole title in the secondary colour with a shadow, then its top 5 pixels in the
                    -- main colour (no shadow)
                    local light = argb(sec.color, "#ffffffff")
                    local dark = sec.color2 and argb(sec.color2) or Color3.new(light.R * 0.8, light.G * 0.8, light.B * 0.8)
                    JavaGui.text(layer, title, x + 5, y + 5, dark, true, 6)
                    local clip = Instance.new("Frame")
                    clip.BackgroundTransparency, clip.ClipsDescendants, clip.ZIndex = 1, true, 7
                    clip.Position, clip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(x + 5, y + 5), UDim2.fromOffset(JavaGui.width(title) + 2, 5)
                    clip.Parent = layer
                    JavaGui.text(clip, title, 0, 0, light, false, 7)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Container screens -----------------------------------------------------------------
    local containerTitles = {trapped_chest = "Chest", chest = "Chest", barrel = "Barrel", ender_chest = "Ender Chest", hopper = "Hopper",
        dispenser = "Dispenser", dropper = "Dropper", furnace = "Furnace", smoker = "Smoker", blast_furnace = "Blast Furnace"}
    local fuelTicks = {coal = true, charcoal = true, coal_block = true, blaze_rod = true, lava_bucket = true, stick = true, dried_kelp_block = true}
    local function isFuel(stack)
        local e = JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
        local id = e and e.id or ""
        return fuelTicks[id] or id:find("_planks", 1, true) ~= nil or id:find("_log", 1, true) ~= nil or id:find("_wood", 1, true) ~= nil
    end

    -- Click rules (AbstractContainerMenu.doClick) ---------------------------------------
    local function stackIn(slot)
        if slot.kind == "catalog" then return slot.item and (slot.template and withCount(slot.template, 1) or {id = slot.item, count = 1}) or nil end
        if slot.kind == "destroy" then return nil end
        return slot.owner.slots[slot.index]
    end
    local function setStack(slot, stack) slot.owner.slots[slot.index] = stack end
    local function accepts(slot, stack)
        if slot.kind == "result" or slot.kind == "catalog" or slot.kind == "destroy" then return false end
        return not slot.accepts or slot.accepts(stack)
    end
    local function slotMax(slot, stack) return math.min(maxStack(stack.id), slot.max or 64) end
    local function isBundle(st) local e = st and JavaContent.byIndex[st.id]; return e ~= nil and (e.itemId or e.id):match("bundle$") ~= nil end
    -- BundleContents weight: each stack counts count / maxStackSize; a bundle holds 1.
    local function bundleWeight(b)
        local w = 0
        for _, st in ipairs(b.bundle or {}) do w = w + st.count / (isBundle(st) and 16 or maxStack(st.id)) end
        return w
    end
    local function bundleInsert(b, st)
        if isBundle(st) and #(st.bundle or {}) > 0 then return 0 end
        local room = math.floor((1 - bundleWeight(b)) * maxStack(st.id) + 1e-6)
        local n = math.min(st.count, room)
        if n <= 0 then return 0 end
        b.bundle = b.bundle or {}
        local last = b.bundle[#b.bundle]
        local merged = false
        for _, x in ipairs(b.bundle) do if same(x, st) and x.count < maxStack(x.id) then local m = math.min(n, maxStack(x.id) - x.count); x.count = x.count + m; merged = m == n; if merged then break end end end
        if not merged then table.insert(b.bundle, withCount(st, n)) end
        st.count = st.count - n
        return n
    end
    ui.bundleWeight = bundleWeight
    local function bundleClick(slot, s, c)
        if isBundle(c) then
            if not s then
                local out = c.bundle and table.remove(c.bundle)
                if out and accepts(slot, out) then setStack(slot, out) elseif out then table.insert(c.bundle, out) end
                if c.bundle and #c.bundle == 0 then c.bundle = nil end
            elseif bundleInsert(c, s) > 0 and s.count <= 0 then setStack(slot, nil) end
            return true
        elseif isBundle(s) and slot.kind ~= "result" then
            if not c then
                local out = s.bundle and table.remove(s.bundle)
                if out then inventory.cursor = out end
                if s.bundle and #s.bundle == 0 then s.bundle = nil end
            elseif bundleInsert(s, c) > 0 and c.count <= 0 then inventory.cursor = nil end
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    local function pickup(slot, right)
        local s, c = stackIn(slot), inventory.cursor
        if right and slot.kind ~= "catalog" and slot.kind ~= "destroy" and (isBundle(c) or isBundle(s)) and bundleClick(slot, s, c) then return end
        if slot.kind == "result" then
            if slot.canTake and s and not slot.canTake(s) then return end
            if s and (not c or (same(c, s) and c.count + s.count <= maxStack(s.id))) then
                if c then c.count = c.count + s.count else inventory.cursor = withCount(s, s.count) end
                setStack(slot, nil)
                if slot.onTake then slot.onTake(s, 1) end
            end
            return
        end
        if not c then
            if s then
                local n = right and math.ceil(s.count / 2) or s.count
                inventory.cursor = withCount(s, n)
                s.count = s.count - n
                if s.count <= 0 then setStack(slot, nil) end
            end
        elseif not s then
            if accepts(slot, c) then
                local n = math.min(right and 1 or c.count, slotMax(slot, c))
                setStack(slot, withCount(c, n))
                c.count = c.count - n
                if c.count <= 0 then inventory.cursor = nil end
            end
        elseif same(s, c) then
            local n = math.min(right and 1 or c.count, slotMax(slot, c) - s.count)
            if n > 0 then s.count = s.count + n; c.count = c.count - n; if c.count <= 0 then inventory.cursor = nil end end
        elseif accepts(slot, c) and c.count <= slotMax(slot, c) then
            setStack(slot, c); inventory.cursor = s
        end
    end
    -- moveItemStackTo(): merge into matching stacks first, then the first empty slot.
    local function moveTo(stack, targets)
        for _, t in ipairs(targets) do
            local s = stackIn(t)
            if stack.count <= 0 then break end
            if s and same(s, stack) and accepts(t, stack) then
                local n = math.min(stack.count, slotMax(t, stack) - s.count)
                if n > 0 then s.count = s.count + n; stack.count = stack.count - n end
            end
        end
        for _, t in ipairs(targets) do
            if stack.count <= 0 then break end
            if not stackIn(t) and accepts(t, stack) then
                local n = math.min(stack.count, slotMax(t, stack))
                setStack(t, withCount(stack, n)); stack.count = stack.count - n
            end
        end
    end
    local function group(name, reverse)
        local list = {}
        for _, slot in ipairs(screen.slots) do if slot.group == name then list[#list + 1] = slot end end
        if reverse then for i = 1, math.floor(#list / 2) do list[i], list[#list + 1 - i] = list[#list + 1 - i], list[i] end end
        return list
    end
    local function concat(a, b) local out = {}; for _, v in ipairs(a) do out[#out + 1] = v end; for _, v in ipairs(b) do out[#out + 1] = v end; return out end
    -- quickMoveStack() for each menu: container <-> player (reverse from the hotbar end),
    -- furnace input/fuel routing, armour into its slot, main <-> hotbar otherwise.
    local function quickMove(slot, repeated)
        local s = stackIn(slot)
        if not s or slot.kind == "catalog" then return end
        if slot.kind == "result" and slot.canTake and not slot.canTake(s) then return end
        local moving = withCount(s, s.count)
        local player = concat(group("main"), group("hotbar"))
        local hasContainer = #group("container") > 0
        local targets
        if screen.quickTargets then targets = screen.quickTargets(slot, s, group, concat) end
        if targets then
        elseif slot.group == "container" or slot.group == "craft" or slot.kind == "result" or slot.kind == "armor" or slot.index == 41 then
            targets = hasContainer and concat(group("hotbar", true), group("main", true)) or player
            if slot.group == "craft" then targets = player end
        elseif hasContainer then
            if screen.progress then
                local e = JavaContent.byIndex[s.id]
                local smeltable = e and JavaContent.data.smelting and JavaContent.data.smelting[e.id]
                if smeltable then targets = {screen.slots[1]}
                elseif isFuel(s) then targets = {screen.slots[2]}
                elseif slot.group == "main" then targets = group("hotbar") else targets = group("main") end
            else targets = group("container") end
        else
            local e = JavaContent.byIndex[s.id]
            local armor = e and JavaContent.data.armor and JavaContent.data.armor[e.id]
            if armor then
                for _, other in ipairs(screen.slots) do
                    if other.kind == "armor" and other.index == armor.slot and not stackIn(other) then targets = {other} end
                end
            end
            targets = targets or (slot.group == "main" and group("hotbar") or group("main"))
        end
        if slot.kind == "result" then
            -- Shift-clicking a result crafts as many times as the ingredients allow (whole results only).
            local room = withCount(s, s.count)
            local copies = {}
            for i, t in ipairs(targets) do local o = stackIn(t); copies[i] = o and withCount(o, o.count) or false end
            moveTo(room, targets)
            if room.count > 0 then
                for i, t in ipairs(targets) do setStack(t, copies[i] or nil) end
                return
            end
            setStack(slot, nil)
            if slot.onTake then slot.onTake(s, 1) end
            if screen.changed then screen.changed() end
            local again = stackIn(slot)
            if again and same(again, s) and (repeated or 0) < 64 then quickMove(slot, (repeated or 0) + 1) end
            return
        end
        moveTo(moving, targets)
        if moving.count <= 0 then setStack(slot, nil) else s.count = moving.count end
    end
    -- PICKUP_ALL (double click): non-full stacks first, then full ones, up to a full cursor.
    local function collect()
        local c = inventory.cursor
        if not c then return end
        for pass = 0, 1 do
            for _, slot in ipairs(screen.slots) do
                local s = slot.kind ~= "result" and slot.kind ~= "catalog" and stackIn(slot)
                if s and same(s, c) and (pass == 1 or s.count < maxStack(s.id)) and c.count < maxStack(c.id) then
                    local n = math.min(s.count, maxStack(c.id) - c.count)
                    c.count = c.count + n; s.count = s.count - n
                    if s.count <= 0 then setStack(slot, nil) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function catalogClick(slot, right)
        if not slot.item then
            if inventory.cursor and not right then inventory.cursor = nil elseif inventory.cursor then
                inventory.cursor.count = inventory.cursor.count - 1
                if inventory.cursor.count <= 0 then inventory.cursor = nil end
            end
            return
        end
        inventory.catalog(slot.item, held("Shift"), false, right, slot.template)
    end
    local function returnCrafting()
        for i = 1, 5 do
            local s = craft.slots[i]
            if s then
                local added = inventory.add(s.id, s.count, nil, s.damage, s)
                if added < s.count and ui.drop then ui.drop(withCount(s, s.count - added)) end
                craft.slots[i] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    -- Opening and closing ---------------------------------------------------------------
    local function layout()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
        local s = JavaGui.scale(viewport)
        local w, h = math.floor(viewport.X / s), math.floor(viewport.Y / s)
        if s == view.s and w == view.w and h == view.h then return end
        view.s, view.w, view.h = s, w, h
        hudScale.Scale, screenScale.Scale = s, s
        hud.Size, screenRoot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
        placeHud(); placeScreen()
    end
    local function show(build)
        build()
        layout(); placeScreen()
        cursorView = JavaGui.itemView(screenRoot, 0, 0, 30)
        screenRoot.Visible, ui.open = true, true
        onOpen(true)
        fillCatalog(); ui.refresh()
    end
    local function rebuildCreative()
        show(openCreative)
    end
    function ui.toggle()
        if ui.open then
            if ui.storageClose then local close = ui.storageClose; ui.storageClose = nil; close() end
            if screen and screen.search then screen.search:ReleaseFocus() end
            returnCrafting()
            local c = inventory.cursor
            if c then
                -- placeItemBackInInventory(): what does not fit is dropped.
                local added = inventory.add(c.id, c.count, nil, c.damage, c)
                if added < c.count and ui.drop then ui.drop(withCount(c, c.count - added)) end
                inventory.cursor = nil
            end
            clearScreen()
            if tooltip then tooltip:Destroy(); tooltip = nil end
            screenRoot.Visible, ui.open, ui.hover = false, false, nil
            onOpen(false)
            ui.refresh()
            return
        end
        if not CONFIG.Survival and CONFIG.AllowCatalog then rebuildCreative() else show(openInventory) end
    end
    -- Building blocks for other menus (createBlockScreens): same slots, click rules and drawing.
    ui.kit = {G = G, textColor = textColor, craft = craft, equipment = equipment, inventory = inventory,
        screen = function() return screen end,
        newScreen = newScreen, slot = addSlot, playerSlots = playerSlots, label = label, stackIn = stackIn, setStack = setStack,
        same = same, maxStack = maxStack, held = held,
        image = function(sprite, x, y, w, h, rect, z) return JavaGui.image(screen.window, sprite, x, y, w, h, rect, z or 4) end,
        text = function(text, x, y, color, shadow, z) return JavaGui.text(screen.window, text, x, y, color or textColor, shadow, z or 4) end,
        -- Opens a menu: build(screen) fills it; onClose runs when it is closed (items go back to the player).
        open = function(build, onClose)
            if ui.open then ui.toggle() end
            ui.storageClose = onClose
            show(build)
        end,
        -- Put a stack back into the inventory, dropping what does not fit (placeItemBackInInventory).
        giveBack = function(stack)
            if not stack or stack.count <= 0 then return end
            local added = inventory.add(stack.id, stack.count, nil, stack.damage, stack)
            if added < stack.count and ui.drop then ui.drop(withCount(stack, stack.count - added)) end
        end}
    function ui.openStorage(storage, name, onClose, slots, kind, progress)
        if ui.open then ui.toggle() end
        ui.storageClose = onClose
        show(function() openContainer(storage, containerTitles[kind or ""] or name, slots or 27, kind, progress) end)
    end

    -- Input -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function mouseGui()
        local p = Input:GetMouseLocation()
        return p.X / math.max(view.s, 1), p.Y / math.max(view.s, 1)
    end
    ui.kit.mouse = mouseGui
    local function slotAt(mx, my)
        if not screen then return nil end
        local x, y = mx - screen.left, my - screen.top
        for _, slot in ipairs(screen.slots) do
            if x >= slot.x - 1 and x < slot.x + 17 and y >= slot.y - 1 and y < slot.y + 17 then return slot end
        end
    end
    local function tabAt(mx, my)
        if not screen or not screen.tabs then return nil end
        local x, y = mx - screen.left, my - screen.top
        for _, t in ipairs(screen.tabs) do
            if x >= t.x and x < t.x + 26 and y >= t.y and y < t.y + 32 then return t.tab end
        end
    end
    local drag, lastClick = nil, {slot = nil, time = 0, button = nil}
    local function inside(mx, my)
        local x, y = mx - screen.left, my - screen.top
        return x >= 0 and y >= 0 and x < screen.width and y < screen.height
    end
    local function press(button, mx, my)
        if not screen then return end
        local pageButton = paging.at(mx, my)
        if pageButton then
            if button == 1 and pageButton.enabled then
                ui.page = ui.page + pageButton.dir
                paging.count()
                for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do if not paging.common[t.key] and (t.page or 0) == ui.page then ui.tab = t.key; break end end
                ui.scroll, ui.query = 0, nil
                if MinecraftSounds then pcall(MinecraftSounds.play, "ui.button.click", nil, 0.25, 1) end
                rebuildCreative()
            end
            return
        end
        local tab = tabAt(mx, my)
        if tab then
            if button == 1 and tab.key ~= ui.tab then ui.tab, ui.scroll, ui.query = tab.key, 0, nil; rebuildCreative() end
            return
        end
        local x, y = mx - screen.left, my - screen.top
        if screen.scroller and button == 1 and x >= 175 and x < 187 and y >= 18 and y < 130 and scrollRows() > 0 then
            ui.scrolling = true; return
        end
        local slot = slotAt(mx, my)
        local right = button == 2
        if not slot and screen.click and screen.click(button, x, y) then ui.refresh(); return end
        if button == 3 then
            -- CLONE: a full stack of the hovered item onto an empty cursor (creative only).
            local s = slot and stackIn(slot)
            if not CONFIG.Survival and s and not inventory.cursor then inventory.cursor = withCount(s, maxStack(s.id)) end
            ui.refresh(); return
        end
        if not slot then
            -- Clicking outside the window throws the carried stack (right: one item).
            if not inside(mx, my) and inventory.cursor and ui.drop then
                local c = inventory.cursor
                local stack = withCount(c, right and 1 or c.count)
                if ui.drop(stack) then c.count = c.count - stack.count; if c.count <= 0 then inventory.cursor = nil end end
            end
            ui.refresh(); return
        end
        if slot.kind == "destroy" then
            if held("Shift") then for i in pairs(inventory.slots) do inventory.slots[i] = nil end; for k in pairs(inventory.equipment) do inventory.equipment[k] = nil end
            else inventory.cursor = nil end
            ui.refresh(); return
        end
        if slot.kind == "catalog" then catalogClick(slot, right); ui.refresh(); return end
        if slot.toggle and not stackIn(slot) and not inventory.cursor then slot.toggle(); ui.refresh(); return end
        local now = os.clock()
        local double = not right and lastClick.slot == slot and lastClick.button == button and now - lastClick.time < 0.25
        lastClick = {slot = slot, time = now, button = button}
        if held("Shift") then
            if double then
                -- Shift double-click moves every matching stack, as Java's QUICK_MOVE_ALL.
                local s = stackIn(slot) or screen.lastMoved
                if s then for _, other in ipairs(screen.slots) do local o = stackIn(other); if o and same(o, s) and other.group == slot.group then quickMove(other) end end end
            else
                screen.lastMoved = stackIn(slot) and {id = stackIn(slot).id, damage = stackIn(slot).damage}
                quickMove(slot)
            end
        elseif double and inventory.cursor then collect()
        elseif inventory.cursor and slot.kind ~= "result" then
            -- QUICK_CRAFT starts on press; a release over the same single slot is a plain click.
            drag = {button = button, slots = {slot}}
        else pickup(slot, right) end
        if screen and screen.changed then screen.changed() end
        ui.refresh()
    end
    local function release(button)
        if button == 1 then ui.scrolling = false end
        if not drag or drag.button ~= button then return end
        local d = drag
        drag = nil
        local c = inventory.cursor
        if not c then return end
        if #d.slots == 1 then pickup(d.slots[1], button == 2); if screen and screen.changed then screen.changed() end; ui.refresh(); return end
        -- getQuickCraftPlaceCount(): left splits evenly, right places one per slot.
        local each = button == 2 and 1 or math.floor(c.count / #d.slots)
        for _, slot in ipairs(d.slots) do
            local s = stackIn(slot)
            local n = math.min(each, c.count, slotMax(slot, c) - (s and s.count or 0))
            if n > 0 then
                if s then s.count = s.count + n else setStack(slot, withCount(c, n)) end
                c.count = c.count - n
            end
        end
        if c.count <= 0 then inventory.cursor = nil end
        if screen and screen.changed then screen.changed() end
        ui.refresh()
    end
    connect(Input.InputBegan, function(input)
        if not ui.open then return end
        local t = input.UserInputType
        local button = t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and 1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and 2 or t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 and 3
        if button then press(button, mouseGui()) end
    end)
    connect(Input.InputEnded, function(input)
        local t = input.UserInputType
        if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then release(1) elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then release(2) end
    end)
    connect(Input.InputChanged, function(input)
        if ui.open and screen and screen.wheel and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
            local mx, my = mouseGui()
            screen.wheel(input.Position.Z, mx - screen.left, my - screen.top); ui.refresh(); return
        end
        if not ui.open or not screen or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel or scrollRows() == 0 then return end
        ui.scroll = math.clamp(ui.scroll - input.Position.Z / scrollRows(), 0, 1)
        fillCatalog(); ui.refresh()
    end)

    -- Tooltip (TooltipRenderUtil) and per-frame drawing ---------------------------------
    local function tooltipLines(stack)
        local e = JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
        local L, itemId = JavaContent.data.lang or {}, e and (e.itemId or e.id)
        local title = blockNames[stack.id] or (e and e.name) or "?"
        local potionInfo = stack.potion and JavaContent.data.potions and JavaContent.data.potions.potions[stack.potion]
        if potionInfo and itemId then title = L["item.minecraft." .. itemId .. ".effect." .. potionInfo.base] or title end
        local lines = {{stack.name or title, stack.enchantments and Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 255) or white}}
        local gray = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)
        if type(stack.song) == "table" then lines[#lines + 1] = {"Verity - " .. tostring(stack.song.title), gray} end
        if potionInfo then
            -- PotionContents.addPotionTooltip: "Speed II (3:00)" in blue (beneficial) or red (harmful).
            local scale = itemId == "lingering_potion" and 0.25 or itemId == "tipped_arrow" and 0.125 or 1
            if #potionInfo.effects == 0 then lines[#lines + 1] = {L["effect.none"] or "No Effects", gray} end
            for _, eff in ipairs(potionInfo.effects) do
                local info = JavaContent.data.potions.effects[eff[1]] or {}
                local text = L["effect.minecraft." .. eff[1]] or eff[1]
                if eff[3] > 0 then text = text .. " " .. (L["potion.potency." .. eff[3]] or tostring(eff[3] + 1)) end
                local ticks = math.floor(eff[2] * scale)
                if ticks > 20 then local sec = math.floor(ticks / 20); text = text .. string.format(" (%d:%02d)", math.floor(sec / 60), sec % 60) end
                lines[#lines + 1] = {text, info.kind == "harmful" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 85) or Color3.fromRGB(85, 85, 255)}
            end
        end
        for _, layer in ipairs(stack.patterns or {}) do
            lines[#lines + 1] = {L["block.minecraft.banner." .. layer.pattern .. "." .. layer.color] or layer.pattern, gray}
        end
        -- ItemLore: dark purple italic lines under the name.
        for _, line in ipairs(stack.lore or {}) do lines[#lines + 1] = {line, Color3.fromRGB(170, 0, 170)} end
        if stack.book then
            if stack.book.author then lines[#lines + 1] = {(L["book.byAuthor"] or "by %1$s"):gsub("%%1%$s", stack.book.author), gray} end
            lines[#lines + 1] = {L["book.generation." .. (stack.book.generation or 0)] or "Original", gray}
        end
        if stack.fireworks then lines[#lines + 1] = {(L["item.minecraft.firework_rocket.flight"] or "Flight Duration:") .. " " .. stack.fireworks.flight, gray} end
        if stack.bundle or (itemId and itemId:match("bundle$")) then
            -- BundleTooltip: contents, then the fill level.
            for _, st in ipairs(stack.bundle or {}) do lines[#lines + 1] = {(blockNames[st.id] or "?") .. " x" .. st.count, gray} end
            if not stack.bundle then lines[#lines + 1] = {L["item.minecraft.bundle.empty"] or "Empty", gray}
            else lines[#lines + 1] = {math.floor(ui.bundleWeight(stack) * 64 + 0.5) .. "/64", gray} end
        end
        if stack.map then
            lines[#lines + 1] = {"#" .. stack.map.id, gray}
            if stack.map.locked then lines[#lines + 1] = {L["filled_map.locked"] and L["filled_map.locked"]:gsub("%%s", stack.map.id) or "Locked", gray} end
            lines[#lines + 1] = {(L["filled_map.scale"] or "Scaling at 1:%s"):gsub("%%s", tostring(2 ^ (stack.map.scale or 0))), gray}
        end
        if stack.charged then lines[#lines + 1] = {(L["item.minecraft.crossbow.projectile"] or "Projectile:") .. " " .. (blockNames[stack.charged.stack and stack.charged.stack.id or 0] or stack.charged.name), gray} end
        if stack.lodestone then lines[#lines + 1] = {L["item.minecraft.lodestone_compass"] or "Lodestone Compass", gray} end
        if stack.trim then
            lines[#lines + 1] = {L["item.minecraft.smithing_template.upgrade"] or "Upgrade:", gray}
            lines[#lines + 1] = {" " .. (L["trim_pattern.minecraft." .. stack.trim.pattern] or stack.trim.pattern), gray}
            lines[#lines + 1] = {" " .. (L["trim_material.minecraft." .. stack.trim.material] or stack.trim.material), gray}
        end
        -- Enchantments in gray: "Sharpness V" (single-level enchantments without a numeral).
        for id, level in pairs(stack.enchantments or {}) do
            local info = JavaContent.data.enchantments and JavaContent.data.enchantments[id]
            local numeral = ({"I", "II", "III", "IV", "V", "VI", "VII", "VIII", "IX", "X"})[level] or tostring(level)
            local name = (JavaContent.data.lang or {})["enchantment.minecraft." .. id] or id
            lines[#lines + 1] = {name .. ((info and info.max > 1 or level > 1) and " " .. numeral or ""), Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)}
        end
        if ui.advancedTooltips then
            local max = JavaGui.maxDamage(stack.id)
            if max then lines[#lines + 1] = {string.format("Durability: %d / %d", max - (stack.damage or 0), max), white} end
            lines[#lines + 1] = {"minecraft:" .. (e and (e.itemId or e.id) or "?"), Color3.fromRGB(85, 85, 85)}
        end
        return lines
    end
    local function drawTooltip(lines, mx, my)
        local key = ""
        for _, line in ipairs(lines) do key = key .. line[1] .. "\n" end
        if not tooltip or tooltip:GetAttribute("Key") ~= key then
            if tooltip then tooltip:Destroy() end
            local width, height = 0, #lines == 1 and 8 or #lines * 10
            for _, line in ipairs(lines) do width = math.max(width, JavaGui.width(line[1])) end
            tooltip = Instance.new("Frame")
            tooltip.BackgroundTransparency, tooltip.ZIndex, tooltip.Size = 1, 40, UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
            tooltip:SetAttribute("Key", key)
            JavaGui.slice(tooltip, G["tooltip/background"], 9, -12, -12, width + 24, height + 24, 40)
            JavaGui.slice(tooltip, G["tooltip/frame"], 10, -12, -12, width + 24, height + 24, 41)
            local y = 0
            for i, line in ipairs(lines) do
                JavaGui.text(tooltip, line[1], 0, y, line[2], true, 42)
                y = y + (i == 1 and 12 or 10)
            end
            tooltip.Parent = screenRoot
        end
        -- DefaultTooltipPositioner: +12/-12 from the mouse, flipped or clamped at the screen edges.
        local w, h = tooltip.Size.X.Offset, tooltip.Size.Y.Offset
        local x, y = math.floor(mx) + 12, math.floor(my) - 12
        if x + w > view.w then x = math.max(math.floor(mx) - 24 - w, 4) end
        if y + h + 3 > view.h then y = view.h - h - 3 end
        tooltip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, math.max(y, 4))
    end
    ui.kit.itemTooltip = function(stack) return tooltipLines(stack) end
    function ui.render()
        JavaGui.tickDynamic()
        layout()
        updateHud()
        -- Held item name above the hotbar for 2 seconds, fading over the last half second.
        if nameLabel then
            nameTicks = nameTicks - 1
            if nameTicks <= 0 then nameLabel:Destroy(); nameLabel = nil end
        end
        if not ui.open or not screen then return end
        local mx, my = mouseGui()
        if ui.scrolling and screen.scroller then
            ui.scroll = math.clamp((my - screen.top - 18 - 7.5) / (112 - 15), 0, 1); fillCatalog(); ui.refresh()
        end
        local slot = slotAt(mx, my)
        ui.hover = slot
        if drag and slot and inventory.cursor then
            local known = false
            for _, s in ipairs(drag.slots) do if s == slot then known = true end end
            local s = stackIn(slot)
            if not known and accepts(slot, inventory.cursor) and (not s or (same(s, inventory.cursor) and s.count < slotMax(slot, s)))
                and (drag.button == 2 or inventory.cursor.count > #drag.slots) then drag.slots[#drag.slots + 1] = slot end
        end
        highlightBack.Visible, highlightFront.Visible = slot ~= nil, slot ~= nil
        if slot then
            highlightBack.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(slot.x - 4, slot.y - 4)
            highlightFront.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(slot.x - 4, slot.y - 4)
        end
        cursorView.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(mx) - 8, math.floor(my) - 8)
        local tab = tabAt(mx, my)
        local s = slot and stackIn(slot)
        local pageButton = paging.at(mx, my)
        for _, b in ipairs(screen.pages or {}) do if b.lit then b.lit.Visible = b == pageButton end end
        if pageButton and not inventory.cursor then drawTooltip({{string.format("Page %d/%d", ui.page + 1, paging.count()), white}}, mx, my)
        elseif tab and not inventory.cursor then drawTooltip({{tab.title, white}}, mx, my)
        elseif s and not inventory.cursor then drawTooltip(tooltipLines(s), mx, my)
        else
            -- Menu widgets (recipe buttons, beacon powers, enchantment clues) supply their own tooltip lines.
            local lines = not inventory.cursor and screen.hoverTooltip and screen.hoverTooltip(mx - screen.left, my - screen.top)
            if lines then drawTooltip(lines, mx, my) elseif tooltip then tooltip:Destroy(); tooltip = nil end
        end
        if screen.progress then
            -- AbstractFurnaceScreen: flame grows from the bottom (ceil(lit*13)+1), arrow from the left (ceil(cook*24)).
            local lit, cook = screen.progress()
            if lit > 0 then
                local h = math.ceil(lit * 13) + 1
                JavaGui.crop(screen.lit, G["container/" .. screen.kind .. "/lit_progress"], 56, 36 + 14 - h, {0, 14 - h, 14, h})
            else screen.lit.Visible = false end
            JavaGui.crop(screen.burn, G["container/" .. screen.kind .. "/burn_progress"], 79, 34, {0, 0, math.ceil(cook * 24), 16})
        end
        if screen.update then screen.update(mx - screen.left, my - screen.top) end
        if screen.searchText and screen.search then
            local focused = screen.search:IsFocused() and os.clock() % 0.6 < 0.3
            local text = (ui.query or "") .. (focused and "_" or "")
            if screen.searchText:GetAttribute("Text") ~= text then
                screen.searchText:Destroy()
                screen.searchText = JavaGui.text(screen.window, text, 82, 6, white, true, 7)
                screen.searchText:SetAttribute("Text", text)
            end
        end
    end
    function ui.modsChanged()
        if screen and screen.kind == "creative" then rebuildCreative() end
        ui.refresh()
    end
    function ui.refresh()
        for i = 1, 9 do H.items[i].set(inventory.slots[i]) end
        H.offItem.set(inventory.slots[41])
        H.offhand.Visible = inventory.slots[41] ~= nil
        H.selection.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(view.w / 2) - 92 + (ui.selected - 1) * 20, view.h - 23)
        if screen then
            for _, slot in ipairs(screen.slots) do
                local s = stackIn(slot)
                if slot.kind == "catalog" and s then s = withCount(s, 1) end
                slot.view.set(s)
                if slot.placeholder then slot.placeholder.Visible = s == nil end
            end
            if cursorView then cursorView.set(inventory.cursor) end
        end
        onChange(ui.selected)
    end
    function ui.select(index)
        local before = inventory.slots[ui.selected] and inventory.slots[ui.selected].id
        ui.selected = index
        local now = inventory.slots[index]
        -- Gui.toolHighlightTimer: the newly selected item's name shows for 40 ticks.
        if now and now.id ~= before then
            if nameLabel then nameLabel:Destroy() end
            local text = blockNames[now.id] or "?"
            local y = view.h - (CONFIG.Survival and 59 or 45)
            nameLabel = JavaGui.text(hud, text, math.floor((view.w - JavaGui.width(text)) / 2), y, white, true, 8)
            nameTicks = 120
        end
        ui.refresh()
    end
    function ui.keySlot(index)
        local slot = ui.open and ui.hover
        if slot then
            -- SWAP: hovered slot <-> hotbar slot (catalog items give a full stack).
            if slot.kind == "catalog" then
                if slot.item then inventory.slots[index] = slot.template and withCount(slot.template, maxStack(slot.item)) or {id = slot.item, count = maxStack(slot.item)} end
            elseif slot.kind ~= "destroy" and slot.kind ~= "result" then
                local s, h = stackIn(slot), inventory.slots[index]
                if (not h or accepts(slot, h)) and not (slot.owner == inventory and slot.index == index) then
                    setStack(slot, h); inventory.slots[index] = s
                end
            end
            ui.refresh()
        elseif not ui.open then ui.select(index) end
    end
    function ui.swapOffhand()
        local slot = ui.open and ui.hover
        if ui.open then
            if not slot or slot.kind == "catalog" or slot.kind == "destroy" or slot.kind == "result" or (slot.owner == inventory and slot.index == 41) then return end
            local s, o = stackIn(slot), inventory.slots[41]
            if o and not accepts(slot, o) then return end
            setStack(slot, o); inventory.slots[41] = s
        else
            inventory.swap(ui.selected, 41)
        end
        ui.refresh()
    end
    -- Middle click is read directly by this screen's own mouse handler above.
    function ui.middle() end
    -- THROW: Q drops one (Ctrl: the stack) from the hovered slot, only with an empty cursor.
    function ui.dropKey(all)
        if not ui.drop then return end
        if ui.open then
            local slot = ui.hover
            if not slot or inventory.cursor then return end
            if slot.kind == "catalog" then
                if slot.item then ui.drop(slot.template and withCount(slot.template, all and maxStack(slot.item) or 1) or {id = slot.item, count = all and maxStack(slot.item) or 1}) end
            elseif slot.kind ~= "destroy" then
                local s = stackIn(slot)
                if s then
                    local n = all and s.count or 1
                    if ui.drop(withCount(s, n)) then s.count = s.count - n; if s.count <= 0 then setStack(slot, nil) end end
                end
            end
        else
            local s = inventory.slots[ui.selected]
            if s and ui.drop(withCount(s, all and s.count or 1)) then inventory.take(ui.selected, all) end
        end
        ui.refresh()
    end
    -- Java's crosshair sprite replaces the text crosshair when the HUD textures are available.
    local crosshair = gui:FindFirstChild("SteveCrosshair")
    if crosshair and JavaGui.content(G["hud/crosshair"]) then
        crosshair.Text = ""
        local image = JavaGui.image(crosshair, G["hud/crosshair"], 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, crosshair.ZIndex)
        local scale = Instance.new("UIScale"); scale.Parent = crosshair
        crosshair.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 15)
        image.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
        -- Gui.renderCrosshair attack indicator (CROSSHAIR mode): 9 px below the centre.
        local indicator = G["hud/crosshair_attack_indicator_background"] and {
            bg = JavaGui.image(crosshair, G["hud/crosshair_attack_indicator_background"], 0, 16, nil, nil, nil, crosshair.ZIndex),
            progress = JavaGui.image(crosshair, G["hud/crosshair_attack_indicator_progress"], 0, 16, nil, nil, nil, crosshair.ZIndex + 1),
            full = JavaGui.image(crosshair, G["hud/crosshair_attack_indicator_full"], 0, 16, nil, nil, nil, crosshair.ZIndex)}
        connect(RunService.RenderStepped, function()
            scale.Scale = math.max(view.s, 1)
            if indicator then
                local strength, ready = 1, false
                if ui.attackIndicator then
                    local ok, a, b = pcall(ui.attackIndicator)
                    if ok then strength, ready = a, b end
                end
                indicator.full.Visible = ready
                local charging = not ready and strength < 1
                indicator.bg.Visible = charging
                JavaGui.crop(indicator.progress, G["hud/crosshair_attack_indicator_progress"], 0, 16, {0, 0, math.floor(strength * 17), 4})
                indicator.progress.Visible = charging and math.floor(strength * 17) > 0
            end
        end)
    end
    layout()
    ui.refresh()
    return ui
end

-- END CREATIVE UI
-- BEGIN JAVA EFFECTS
local function createJavaEffects(character)
    local fx={particles={},emitters={},tickCount=0}
    local folder=Instance.new('Folder');folder.Name='SteveJavaParticles';folder.Parent=workspace
    local cast=RaycastParams.new();cast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;cast.FilterDescendantsInstances={character,folder};cast.RespectCanCollide=true
    function fx.emit(kind,position,velocity,options)
        options=options or {}
        local sprites=options.sprites or (JavaContent.data.particles and JavaContent.data.particles[kind])
        if not sprites or #sprites==0 then return end
        if kind=='portal' then sprites={sprites[math.random(#sprites)]} end
        if #fx.particles>=CONFIG.MaxParticles then local old=table.remove(fx.particles,1);old.part:Destroy() end
        local part=Instance.new('Part');part.Name='JavaParticle_'..kind;part.Size=Vector3.new(.01,.01,.01);part.Transparency=1
        part.Anchored,part.CanCollide,part.CanQuery,part.CanTouch=true,false,false,false;part.Position=position;part.Parent=folder
        local gui=Instance.new('BillboardGui');gui.Name='JavaParticleSprite';gui.AlwaysOnTop=false;gui.LightInfluence=options.fullbright and 0 or 1
        gui.Size=UDim2.fromScale((options.size or .2)*CONFIG.Block,(options.size or .2)*CONFIG.Block);gui.Parent=part
        local p={part=part,gui=gui,position=position,previous=position,velocity=velocity or Vector3.zero,age=0,life=options.life or 20,
            gravity=options.gravity or 0,friction=options.friction or .98,sprites=sprites,tint=options.tint,uv=options.uv,frame=0,collision=options.collision,
            kind=kind,origin=position,initialVelocity=velocity or Vector3.zero,size=options.size or .2,target=options.target}
        fx.particles[#fx.particles+1]=p
        JavaContent.sprite(gui,sprites[1],p.tint,p.uv)
    end
    -- Block shape in block units (0..1) per box, from the placed model's elements
    -- turned by the blockstate x/y rotation; Java uses VoxelShape.forAllBoxes().
    local function shapeBoxes(entry,state)
        local boxes={}
        if entry.entityModel then return {{0,0,0,1,entry.entityHeight or .5,1}} end
        for _,spec in ipairs(CreativeRules.modelSpecs(entry,state or entry.state)) do
            for _,e in ipairs(JavaContent.data.models[spec.m].e or {}) do
                local a,b={e.a[1],e.a[2],e.a[3]},{e.b[1],e.b[2],e.b[3]}
                for _=1,((spec.x or 0)/90)%4 do a,b={a[1],a[3],16-a[2]},{b[1],b[3],16-b[2]} end
                for _=1,((spec.y or 0)/90)%4 do a,b={16-a[3],a[2],a[1]},{16-b[3],b[2],b[1]} end
                boxes[#boxes+1]={math.min(a[1],b[1])/16,math.min(a[2],b[2])/16,math.min(a[3],b[3])/16,math.max(a[1],b[1])/16,math.max(a[2],b[2])/16,math.max(a[3],b[3])/16}
            end
        end
        if #boxes==0 or #boxes>8 then
            local u={1,1,1,0,0,0}
            for _,box in ipairs(boxes) do for i=1,3 do u[i]=math.min(u[i],box[i]);u[i+3]=math.max(u[i+3],box[i+3]) end end
            if #boxes==0 then u={0,0,0,1,1,1} end
            boxes={u}
        end
        return boxes
    end
    local function particleSprite(entry)
        local sprite=entry.particle and JavaContent.data.textures[entry.particle]
        if sprite then return sprite end
        local model=JavaContent.data.models[entry.itemModel]
        for _,e in ipairs(model and model.e or {}) do for _,face in pairs(e.f) do return JavaContent.data.textures[face[1]] end end
    end
    -- TerrainParticle tint: 0.6 gray times the block color (grass block exempt).
    local function particleTint(entry)
        if entry.id~='grass_block' then
            local model=JavaContent.data.models[entry.itemModel]
            for _,e in ipairs(model and model.e or {}) do for _,face in pairs(e.f) do
                if face[4]>=0 then local t=JavaContent.tint(entry);return {.6*t[1],.6*t[2],.6*t[3]} end
            end end
        end
        return {.6,.6,.6}
    end
    -- new TerrainParticle(level,x,y,z,xa,ya,za,state,pos); position in studs, speeds in blocks/tick.
    local function terrainParticle(sprite,tint,position,xa,ya,za,power,scale)
        -- Particle(level,x,y,z,xa,ya,za): random jitter, then a random speed along it.
        local xd,yd,zd=xa+(math.random()*2-1)*.4,ya+(math.random()*2-1)*.4,za+(math.random()*2-1)*.4
        local speed=(math.random()+math.random()+1)*.15
        local length=math.sqrt(xd*xd+yd*yd+zd*zd);if length<1e-7 then length=1 end
        xd,yd,zd=xd/length*speed*.4,yd/length*speed*.4+.1,zd/length*speed*.4
        if power then xd,yd,zd=xd*power,(yd-.1)*power+.1,zd*power end
        -- quadSize 0.1*(r*.5+.5)*2 halved by TerrainParticle; the billboard spans 2*quadSize.
        local quad=.1*(math.random()*.5+.5)*(scale or 1)
        -- A random quarter of the sprite: uo,vo = random*3 in quarter-texture steps.
        local u,v=math.random()*12,math.random()*12
        fx.emit('block',position,Vector3.new(xd,yd,zd)*CONFIG.Block,
            {sprites={sprite},uv={u,v,u+4,v+4},tint=tint,life=math.floor(4/(math.random()*.9+.1)),size=quad*2,gravity=.04,collision=true})
    end
    -- Blocks Java never spawns break / crack particles for: fire (Level.destroyBlock skips the destroy
    -- event for BaseFireBlock), liquids (a bucket picks them up), and noTerrainParticles() blocks.
    fx.noTerrain={fire=true,soul_fire=true,water=true,lava=true,bubble_column=true,barrier=true,light=true}
    -- ParticleEngine.crack(): one particle per tick just outside the struck face.
    function fx.crack(index,center,normal,state)
        if typeof(center) == 'Vector3' and JavaContent.mods.renderPos then center = JavaContent.mods.renderPos(center) or center end
        local entry=JavaContent.byIndex[index];if not entry or fx.noTerrain[entry.id] then return end
        local sprite=particleSprite(entry);if not sprite then return end
        local box={1,1,1,0,0,0}
        for _,b in ipairs(shapeBoxes(entry,state)) do for i=1,3 do box[i]=math.min(box[i],b[i]);box[i+3]=math.max(box[i+3],b[i+3]) end end
        local p={}
        for i=1,3 do p[i]=math.random()*math.max(0,box[i+3]-box[i]-.2)+.1+box[i] end
        local n=normal or Vector3.new(0,1,0)
        if math.abs(n.X)>.5 then p[1]=n.X<0 and box[1]-.1 or box[4]+.1
        elseif math.abs(n.Y)>.5 then p[2]=n.Y<0 and box[2]-.1 or box[5]+.1
        else p[3]=n.Z<0 and box[3]-.1 or box[6]+.1 end
        local corner=center-Vector3.new(.5,.5,.5)*CONFIG.Block
        terrainParticle(sprite,particleTint(entry),corner+Vector3.new(p[1],p[2],p[3])*CONFIG.Block,0,0,0,.2,.6)
    end
    -- ParticleEngine.destroy(): a 2..4 per-axis grid over every shape box, flying outward from the box center.
    function fx.destroyBlock(index,center,state)
        local entry=JavaContent.byIndex[index];if not entry or fx.noTerrain[entry.id] then return end
        local sprite=particleSprite(entry);if not sprite then return end
        local tint=particleTint(entry);local corner=center-Vector3.new(.5,.5,.5)*CONFIG.Block
        for _,b in ipairs(shapeBoxes(entry,state)) do
            local dx,dy,dz=math.min(1,b[4]-b[1]),math.min(1,b[5]-b[2]),math.min(1,b[6]-b[3])
            local nx,ny,nz=math.max(2,math.ceil(dx/.25)),math.max(2,math.ceil(dy/.25)),math.max(2,math.ceil(dz/.25))
            for x=0,nx-1 do for y=0,ny-1 do for z=0,nz-1 do
                local fx_,fy_,fz_=(x+.5)/nx,(y+.5)/ny,(z+.5)/nz
                terrainParticle(sprite,tint,corner+Vector3.new(fx_*dx+b[1],fy_*dy+b[2],fz_*dz+b[3])*CONFIG.Block,fx_-.5,fy_-.5,fz_-.5)
            end end end
        end
    end
    -- Kept for existing callers: breaking=true is a full destroy, otherwise a single crack particle.
    function fx.block(index,center,breaking,normal,state)
        if typeof(center) == 'Vector3' and JavaContent.mods.renderPos then center = JavaContent.mods.renderPos(center) or center end
        local entry=JavaContent.byIndex[index]
        if entry and fx.noTerrain[entry.id] then
            -- BaseFireBlock.playerWillDestroy: levelEvent 1009, the extinguish fizz (0.5, 2.6 +- 0.8).
            if breaking and MinecraftSounds and (entry.id=="fire" or entry.id=="soul_fire") then
                MinecraftSounds.play("block.fire.extinguish",center,0.5,2.6+(math.random()-math.random())*0.8)
            end
            return
        end
        if breaking and MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.block(index,"break",center) end
        if breaking then fx.destroyBlock(index,center,state) else fx.crack(index,center,normal,state) end
    end
    -- Java's destroy_stage_0..9 overlay drawn over every face of the block being mined.
    local crack={}
    local canvas={[Enum.NormalId.Front]={Vector3.new(-1,0,0),Vector3.new(0,-1,0)},[Enum.NormalId.Back]={Vector3.new(1,0,0),Vector3.new(0,-1,0)},
        [Enum.NormalId.Left]={Vector3.new(0,0,1),Vector3.new(0,-1,0)},[Enum.NormalId.Right]={Vector3.new(0,0,-1),Vector3.new(0,-1,0)},
        [Enum.NormalId.Top]={Vector3.new(1,0,0),Vector3.new(0,0,1)},[Enum.NormalId.Bottom]={Vector3.new(1,0,0),Vector3.new(0,0,-1)}}
    -- Texture coordinate (0..16) of a world point along a world direction, measured inside the block cell like Java's sheeted decal.
    local function cellCoord(point,direction,cellMin)
        local world=direction.X~=0 and Vector3.new(1,0,0) or direction.Y~=0 and Vector3.new(0,1,0) or Vector3.new(0,0,1)
        local axis=(point-cellMin):Dot(world)/CONFIG.Block*16
        return (direction:Dot(world)>0) and axis or 16-axis
    end
    function fx.hideCrack()
        if crack.folder then crack.folder:Destroy() end
        crack={}
    end
    function fx.showCrack(target,center,stage,parts)
        local sprites=JavaContent.data.destroy;if not sprites or stage<0 then fx.hideCrack();return end
        local sprite=sprites[math.clamp(stage,0,9)+1]
        if crack.target~=target or crack.center~=center then
            fx.hideCrack()
            crack.target,crack.center,crack.surfaces=target,center,{}
            crack.folder=Instance.new('Folder');crack.folder.Name='SteveBlockCrack';crack.folder.Parent=folder
            local cellMin=center-Vector3.new(.5,.5,.5)*CONFIG.Block
            for _,source in ipairs(parts) do
                local frame,size=source.CFrame,source.Size
                for normal,dirs in pairs(canvas) do
                    local n=Vector3.FromNormalId(normal);local half=size/2
                    local depth=math.abs(n:Dot(half))
                    local right,down=frame:VectorToWorldSpace(dirs[1]),frame:VectorToWorldSpace(dirs[2])
                    local w,h=math.abs(dirs[1]:Dot(size)),math.abs(dirs[2]:Dot(size))
                    if w>.01 and h>.01 then
                        local face=Instance.new('Part');face.Name='Crack';face.Anchored,face.CanCollide,face.CanQuery,face.CanTouch,face.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,false
                        face.Transparency=1;face.Size=Vector3.new(n.X~=0 and .002 or size.X,n.Y~=0 and .002 or size.Y,n.Z~=0 and .002 or size.Z)
                        -- Sit just outside the face so Roblox sorts the decal in front of the block surface.
                        face.CFrame=frame*CFrame.new(n*(depth+.006));face.Parent=crack.folder
                        local topLeft=face.Position-right*w/2-down*h/2
                        local u0,v0=cellCoord(topLeft,right,cellMin),cellCoord(topLeft,down,cellMin)
                        local uv={u0,v0,u0+w/CONFIG.Block*16,v0+h/CONFIG.Block*16}
                        local gui=JavaContent.surface(face,normal,sprite,nil,uv,0)
                        gui.LightInfluence=0
                        crack.surfaces[#crack.surfaces+1]={gui=gui,uv=uv}
                    end
                end
            end
            crack.stage=stage
        elseif crack.stage~=stage then
            crack.stage=stage
            for _,s in ipairs(crack.surfaces) do JavaContent.sprite(s.gui,sprite,nil,s.uv,0) end
        end
    end
    function fx.explosion(position)fx.emitters[#fx.emitters+1]={position=position,age=0} end
    function fx.hit(position,critical)
        for _=1,critical and 16 or 7 do fx.emit(critical and 'crit' or 'damage_indicator',position,
            Vector3.new((math.random()-.5)*.25,math.random()*.2,(math.random()-.5)*.25)*CONFIG.Block,
            {size=.15,life=12,gravity=.02,collision=true}) end
    end
    function fx.tick()
        fx.tickCount=fx.tickCount+1;fx.lastTick=os.clock()
        for i=#fx.emitters,1,-1 do
            local e=fx.emitters[i]
            for _=1,6 do
                local offset=Vector3.new(math.random()-math.random(),math.random()-math.random(),math.random()-math.random())*CONFIG.Block*4
                local gray=math.random()*.6+.4
