                fx.emit('explosion',e.position+offset,Vector3.zero,{size=4*(1-e.age/16),life=math.random(6,9),tint={gray,gray,gray},fullbright=true})
            end
            e.age=e.age+1;if e.age>=8 then table.remove(fx.emitters,i) end
        end
        for i=#fx.particles,1,-1 do
            local p=fx.particles[i];p.age=p.age+1;p.previous=p.position
            if p.age>=p.life then p.part:Destroy();table.remove(fx.particles,i)
            else
                if p.target then
                    -- VibrationParticle: flies from the source to its listener over the travel time.
                    p.position=p.origin:Lerp(p.target,p.age/p.life)
                elseif p.kind=='portal' then
                    local a=p.age/p.life;local travel=1+a-2*a*a
                    p.position=p.origin+p.initialVelocity*travel+Vector3.new(0,(1-a)*CONFIG.Block,0)
                else
                    p.velocity=p.velocity+Vector3.new(0,-p.gravity*CONFIG.Block,0)
                    local hit=p.collision and p.velocity.Magnitude>.00001 and workspace:Raycast(p.position,p.velocity,cast)
                    if hit then p.position=hit.Position+hit.Normal*.005;p.velocity=(p.velocity-hit.Normal*p.velocity:Dot(hit.Normal))*.7
                    else p.position=p.position+p.velocity end
                    p.velocity=p.velocity*p.friction
                end
                local frame=p.target and p.age%#p.sprites or math.min(#p.sprites-1,math.floor(p.age*#p.sprites/p.life))
                if frame~=p.frame then p.frame=frame;JavaContent.sprite(p.gui,p.sprites[frame+1],p.tint,p.uv) end
            end
        end
    end
    function fx.render()
        local alpha=math.min(1,(os.clock()-(fx.lastTick or os.clock()))/CONFIG.Tick)
        for _,p in ipairs(fx.particles) do
            p.part.Position=p.previous:Lerp(p.position,alpha)
            local age=(p.age+alpha)/p.life;local scale=1
            if p.kind=='portal' then scale=1-(1-age)^2
            elseif p.kind=='flame' or p.kind=='soul_fire_flame' then scale=1-age*age*.5 end
            p.gui.Size=UDim2.fromScale(p.size*CONFIG.Block*scale,p.size*CONFIG.Block*scale)
        end
    end
    local connections={};local watched=setmetatable({}, {__mode='k'})
    local function watch(hum)
        if not hum:IsA('Humanoid') or watched[hum] then return end
        watched[hum]=true;local health=hum.Health
        connections[#connections+1]=hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(value)
            local model=hum.Parent;local body=model and (model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') or model.PrimaryPart)
            if body and value<health then fx.hit(body.Position,false) end
            health=value
        end)
    end
    for _,object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do watch(object) end
    connections[#connections+1]=workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(watch)
    function fx.destroy()for _,c in ipairs(connections) do c:Disconnect() end;folder:Destroy() end
    return fx
end
-- END JAVA EFFECTS

-- BEGIN LOOT RULES
local LootRules={}
function LootRules.roll(tableData,context,random)
    local result={};random=random or math.random;context=context or {}
    local function name(v)return type(v)=='string' and v:gsub('minecraft:','') or v end
    local condition
    condition=function(c)
        local kind=name(c.condition)
        if kind=='survives_explosion' then return not context.radius or random()<1/context.radius end
        if kind=='match_tool' then
            local p=c.predicate or {};local items=p.items
            if items then
                local found=false
                if type(items)=='string' then found=name(items)==context.tool
                else for _,id in ipairs(items) do if name(id)==context.tool then found=true end end end
                if not found then return false end
            end
            for _,e in ipairs((p.predicates or {})['minecraft:enchantments'] or {}) do
                if (context.enchantments and context.enchantments[name(e.enchantments)] or 0)<((e.levels or {}).min or 1) then return false end
            end
            return true
        end
        if kind=='inverted' then return not condition(c.term) end
        if kind=='any_of' then for _,term in ipairs(c.terms) do if condition(term) then return true end end;return false end
        if kind=='all_of' then for _,term in ipairs(c.terms) do if not condition(term) then return false end end;return true end
        if kind=='block_state_property' then
            for k,v in pairs(c.properties or {}) do if tostring((context.state or {})[k])~=tostring(v) then return false end end;return true
        end
        if kind=='random_chance' then return random()<(tonumber(c.chance) or 0) end
        if kind=='table_bonus' then return random()<(c.chances[1] or 0) end
        if kind=='killed_by_player' then return context.player==true end
        if kind=='random_chance_with_enchanted_bonus' then return random()<(c.unenchanted_chance or 0) end
        if kind=='entity_properties' then
            local predicate=c.predicate or {}
            if predicate.flags and predicate.flags.is_on_fire~=nil then return predicate.flags.is_on_fire==not not context.onFire end
            if next(predicate)==nil then return context.player==true end
            return false
        end
        return false -- Unsupported predicates cannot silently grant the wrong loot.
    end
    local function allowed(conditions)for _,c in ipairs(conditions or {})do if not condition(c)then return false end end;return true end
    local function number(n)
        if type(n)=='number' then return n end
        if type(n)~='table' then return 0 end
        if name(n.type)=='uniform' then return math.floor((n.min or 0)+random()*((n.max or 0)-(n.min or 0)+1)) end
        if name(n.type)=='binomial' then local total=0;for _=1,n.n do if random()<n.p then total=total+1 end end;return total end
        return n.value or 0
    end
    local function apply(stack,functions)
        for _,f in ipairs(functions or {})do if allowed(f.conditions)then
            local kind=name(f['function'])
            if kind=='set_count' then stack.count=(f.add and stack.count or 0)+number(f.count)
            elseif kind=='apply_bonus' then
                local level=context.enchantments and context.enchantments[name(f.enchantment)] or 0
                local parameters=f.parameters or {};local formula=name(f.formula)
                if formula=='binomial_with_bonus_count' then for _=1,level+(parameters.extra or 0)do if random()<(parameters.probability or 0)then stack.count=stack.count+1 end end
                elseif formula=='ore_drops' and level>0 then stack.count=stack.count*(math.max(0,math.floor(random()*(level+2))-1)+1)
                elseif formula=='uniform_bonus_count' then stack.count=stack.count+math.floor(random()*((parameters.bonusMultiplier or 1)*level+1))end
            elseif kind=='limit_count' then local limit=f.limit;stack.count=type(limit)=='number' and math.min(stack.count,limit) or math.max(limit.min or 0,math.min(stack.count,limit.max or math.huge))
            elseif kind=='explosion_decay' and context.radius then local count=0;for _=1,stack.count do if random()<1/context.radius then count=count+1 end end;stack.count=count
            -- Item components (kept on the dropped stack).
            elseif kind=='set_potion' then stack.components=stack.components or {};stack.components.potion=name(f.id)
            elseif kind=='set_enchantments' then
                stack.components=stack.components or {};local e=stack.components.enchantments or {}
                for id,level in pairs(f.enchantments or {}) do e[name(id)]=math.max(1,math.floor(number(level))) end
                stack.components.enchantments=e
            elseif kind=='enchant_randomly' then
                local options={}
                local list=f.options
                if type(list)=='string' then list={list} end
                for _,o in ipairs(list or {}) do
                    o=name(o)
                    if o:sub(1,1)=='#' then for id,info in pairs(JavaContent.data.enchantments or {}) do if info.table or info.treasure then options[#options+1]=id end end
                    else options[#options+1]=o end
                end
                if #options==0 then for id in pairs(JavaContent.data.enchantments or {}) do options[#options+1]=id end end
                table.sort(options)
                local pick=options[math.floor(random()*#options)+1]
                local info=pick and JavaContent.data.enchantments[pick]
                if info then
                    stack.components=stack.components or {};stack.components.enchantments={[pick]=math.floor(random()*info.max)+1}
                    if stack.name=='book' then stack.name='enchanted_book' end
                end
            elseif kind=='enchant_with_levels' and Recipes then
                local item=JavaContent.itemById[stack.name]
                local r=Recipes.random(math.floor(random()*2147483647))
                local chosen=item and Recipes.selectEnchantments(r,{id=item.index,count=1},math.max(1,math.floor(number(f.levels))))
                if chosen and #chosen>0 then
                    stack.components=stack.components or {};stack.components.enchantments={}
                    for _,c in ipairs(chosen) do stack.components.enchantments[c.id]=c.level end
                    if stack.name=='book' then stack.name='enchanted_book' end
                end
            end
        end end
    end
    local expand
    expand=function(entry,functions)
        if not allowed(entry.conditions) then return false end
        local kind=name(entry.type)
        if kind=='alternatives' then for _,child in ipairs(entry.children)do if expand(child,functions) then return true end end;return false
        elseif kind=='group' or kind=='sequence' then for _,child in ipairs(entry.children)do local ok=expand(child,functions);if not ok and kind=='sequence' then return false end end;return true
        elseif kind=='item' then
            local stack={name=name(entry.name),count=1};apply(stack,entry.functions);apply(stack,functions);apply(stack,tableData and tableData.functions)
            if stack.count>0 then result[#result+1]=stack end
            return true
        elseif kind=='empty' then return true
        elseif kind=='loot_table' then
            -- NestedLootTable: roll the referenced table into this result.
            local sub=type(entry.value)=='string' and JavaContent.data.loot and JavaContent.data.loot[name(entry.value)] or (type(entry.value)=='table' and entry.value)
            for _,stack in ipairs(sub and LootRules.roll(sub,context,random) or {}) do result[#result+1]=stack end
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    for _,pool in ipairs(tableData and tableData.pools or {})do if allowed(pool.conditions)then
        for _=1,number(pool.rolls or 1)do
            local entries=pool.entries or {};local total=0
            for _,entry in ipairs(entries)do total=total+(entry.weight or 1)end
            local choice=random()*total
            for _,entry in ipairs(entries)do choice=choice-(entry.weight or 1);if choice<0 then expand(entry,pool.functions);break end end
        end
    end end
    return result
end
-- END LOOT RULES

-- BEGIN VEHICLES
-- Boats (Boat.floatBoat / controlBoat) and minecarts (OldMinecartBehavior: moveAlongTrack,
-- powered/detector/activator rails, chest/furnace/hopper/TNT carts). Physics run in Java
-- block space (blocks, blocks per tick) and are converted to studs for collision/rendering.
local RAIL_EXITS = {
    north_south = {{0, 0, -1}, {0, 0, 1}}, east_west = {{-1, 0, 0}, {1, 0, 0}},
    ascending_east = {{-1, -1, 0}, {1, 0, 0}}, ascending_west = {{-1, 0, 0}, {1, -1, 0}},
    ascending_north = {{0, 0, -1}, {0, -1, 1}}, ascending_south = {{0, -1, -1}, {0, 0, 1}},
    south_east = {{0, 0, 1}, {1, 0, 0}}, south_west = {{0, 0, 1}, {-1, 0, 0}},
    north_west = {{0, 0, -1}, {-1, 0, 0}}, north_east = {{0, 0, -1}, {1, 0, 0}},
}
local RAILS = {rail = true, powered_rail = true, detector_rail = true, activator_rail = true}
local function createVehicles(ctx)
    local api, world, root, character, folder = ctx.api, ctx.world, ctx.root, ctx.character, ctx.folder
    local B = CONFIG.Block
    local vehicles = {list = {}}
    world.funRails = game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("SteveFunRails") == true
    local function origin()
        local o = workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin")
        return typeof(o) == "Vector3" and o or Vector3.new(0, B / 2, 0)
    end
    -- Block space: block (i,j,k) spans i..i+1; studs: the grid's cell centres.
    local function toStuds(p) return origin() + (p - Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)) * B end
    local function toBlocks(p) return (p - origin()) / B + Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) end
    local function cellCentre(i, j, k) return origin() + Vector3.new(i, j, k) * B end
    local function nodeAtCell(i, j, k) return world.nodes and ctx.nodeAt(cellCentre(i, j, k)) end
    local function railAt(i, j, k)
        local n = nodeAtCell(i, j, k)
        return n and RAILS[n.id] and n or nil
    end
    local sizes = JavaContent.data.entitySizes or {}
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType, params.RespectCanCollide, params.IgnoreWater = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true, true
    local function ignoreList(v)
        local list = {character, folder}
        for _, name in ipairs({"SteveDroppedItems", "SteveJavaParticles", "SteveCatalogHands"}) do
            local f = workspace:FindFirstChild(name); if f then list[#list + 1] = f end
        end
        if v and v.hull then list[#list + 1] = v.hull end
        for _, p in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
            if p.Character and p.Character ~= character then list[#list + 1] = p.Character end
        end
        if v and v.passenger then list[#list + 1] = v.passenger.visual.model end
        return list
    end

    -- Entity.move(): sweep the hull Y, then X, then Z; returns which axes hit something.
    local function move(v, delta)
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList(v)
        local half = Vector3.new(v.width, v.height, v.width) * B * 0.98
        local hits = {}
        for _, axis in ipairs({"Y", "X", "Z"}) do
            local d = delta[axis] * B
            if math.abs(d) > 1e-7 then
                local dir = Vector3.new(axis == "X" and 1 or 0, axis == "Y" and 1 or 0, axis == "Z" and 1 or 0) * (d > 0 and 1 or -1)
                local centre = toStuds(v.pos) + Vector3.new(0, v.height * B / 2, 0)
                local size = half
                -- Sideways: floor seams are not walls (skip the bottom 0.1 block of the hull).
                if axis ~= "Y" then centre, size = centre + Vector3.new(0, 0.05 * B, 0), half - Vector3.new(0, 0.1 * B, 0) end
                local ok, cast = pcall(function() return workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(centre), size, dir * math.abs(d), params) end)
                if ok and cast then
                    d = math.max(0, cast.Distance - 0.01) * (d > 0 and 1 or -1)
                    hits[axis] = true
                end
                v.pos = v.pos + Vector3.new(axis == "X" and d or 0, axis == "Y" and d or 0, axis == "Z" and d or 0) / B
            end
        end
        return hits
    end
    -- Water surface (block space y) under the hull, from Terrain water or placed water blocks.
    local waterParams = RaycastParams.new()
    waterParams.FilterType, waterParams.IgnoreWater = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, false
    local function waterSurface(v)
        waterParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList(v)
        local from = toStuds(v.pos + Vector3.new(0, v.height + 1, 0))
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(from, Vector3.new(0, -3 * B, 0), waterParams)
        if not hit then return nil end
        local id = hit.Instance:GetAttribute("MinecraftBlockId")
        if (hit.Instance:IsA("Terrain") and hit.Material == Enum.Material.Water) or id == "water" or id == "bubble_column" then
            return toBlocks(hit.Position).Y
        end
    end
    local function groundFriction(v)
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList(v)
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(toStuds(v.pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0)), Vector3.new(0, -0.1 * B, 0), params)
        if not hit then return nil end
        local id = hit.Instance:GetAttribute("MinecraftBlockId") or ""
        local custom = tonumber(hit.Instance:GetAttribute("MinecraftSlipperiness"))
        if custom then return custom end
        if id == "blue_ice" then return 0.989 end
        if id == "ice" or id == "packed_ice" or id == "frosted_ice" or hit.Material == Enum.Material.Ice or hit.Material == Enum.Material.Glacier then return 0.98 end
        if id == "slime_block" then return 0.8 end
        return 0.6
    end

    -- Creation -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function hullPart(v)
        local hull = Instance.new("Part")
        hull.Name, hull.Anchored, hull.CanCollide, hull.CanTouch, hull.Transparency = "VehicleHull", true, true, false, 1
        hull.Size = Vector3.new(v.width, v.height, v.width) * B
        hull:SetAttribute("MinecraftMineable", false)
        hull.Parent = v.visual.model
        v.hull = hull
    end
    local function add(v)
        v.dm, v.old, v.damage, v.hurt, v.hurtDir, v.age = Vector3.zero, v.pos, 0, 0, 1, 0
        hullPart(v)
        vehicles.list[#vehicles.list + 1] = v
        return v
    end
    function vehicles.spawnBoat(id, position, yaw)
        if #vehicles.list >= 32 then return false end
        local definition = JavaContent.data.boats[id]; if not definition then return false end
        local dims = sizes[id] or sizes.oak_boat or {width = 1.375, height = 0.5625}
        local visual = JavaContent.entityModel(definition.model, 1, B, folder, position, 6)
        visual.model:SetAttribute("MinecraftMineable", false)
        add({kind = "boat", id = id, pos = toBlocks(position), yaw = yaw or 0, deltaRotation = 0, status = "air",
            width = dims.width, height = dims.height, visual = visual, paddles = {0, 0}, paddleOn = {false, false},
            storage = definition.chest and CreativeRules.inventory() or nil})
        return true
    end
    local cartBlocks = {chest_minecart = "chest", furnace_minecart = "furnace", tnt_minecart = "tnt", hopper_minecart = "hopper", command_block_minecart = "command_block"}
    function vehicles.spawnCart(id, rail)
        if #vehicles.list >= 32 then return false end
        local b = toBlocks(rail.center)
        local i, j, k = math.floor(b.X), math.floor(b.Y), math.floor(b.Z)
        local shape = rail.state.shape or "north_south"
        local pos = Vector3.new(i + 0.5, j + 0.0625 + (shape:find("ascending") and 0.5 or 0), k + 0.5)
        local dims = sizes.minecart or {width = 0.98, height = 0.7}
        local visual = JavaContent.entityModel("minecart", 1, B, folder, toStuds(pos), 6)
        if not visual then return false end
        visual.model:SetAttribute("MinecraftMineable", false)
        local v = add({kind = "cart", id = id, pos = pos, yaw = 0, pitch = 0, width = dims.width, height = dims.height, visual = visual})
        local blockId = cartBlocks[id]
        local entry = blockId and JavaContent.byId[blockId]
        if entry then
            v.block = JavaContent.model(entry.index, CreativeRules.copy(entry.state), B * 0.75, visual.model, toStuds(pos), true)
        end
        if id == "chest_minecart" then v.storage, v.storageSize = CreativeRules.inventory(), 27 end
        if id == "hopper_minecart" then v.storage, v.storageSize = CreativeRules.inventory(), 5 end
        if id == "furnace_minecart" then v.fuel, v.push = 0, Vector3.zero end
        return true
    end
    -- /summon: a minecart at any position (it rolls onto rails if it lands on one).
    function vehicles.spawnCartAt(id, pos)
        if #vehicles.list >= 32 then return false end
        local dims = sizes.minecart or {width = 0.98, height = 0.7}
        local visual = JavaContent.entityModel("minecart", 1, B, folder, toStuds(pos), 6)
        if not visual then return false end
        visual.model:SetAttribute("MinecraftMineable", false)
        local v = add({kind = "cart", id = id, pos = pos, yaw = 0, pitch = 0, width = dims.width, height = dims.height, visual = visual})
        local entry = cartBlocks[id] and JavaContent.byId[cartBlocks[id]]
        if entry then v.block = JavaContent.model(entry.index, CreativeRules.copy(entry.state), B * 0.75, visual.model, toStuds(pos), true) end
        if id == "chest_minecart" then v.storage, v.storageSize = CreativeRules.inventory(), 27 end
        if id == "hopper_minecart" then v.storage, v.storageSize = CreativeRules.inventory(), 5 end
        if id == "furnace_minecart" then v.fuel, v.push = 0, Vector3.zero end
        return true
    end
    local function remove(v, drop)
        if api.riding == v then vehicles.dismount() end
        vehicles.releaseMob(v)
        for i, other in ipairs(vehicles.list) do if other == v then table.remove(vehicles.list, i) break end end
        if drop then
            local at = toStuds(v.pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
            local function dropItem(id) local e = JavaContent.itemById[id]; if e then world.drop({id = e.index, count = 1}, at, nil, true) end end
            -- Java drops the vehicle item (carts with a block drop the cart and the block).
            if v.kind == "boat" then dropItem(v.id)
            else dropItem(cartBlocks[v.id] and "minecart" or v.id); if cartBlocks[v.id] then dropItem(cartBlocks[v.id]) end end
            for _, stack in pairs(v.storage and v.storage.slots or {}) do world.drop(stack, at, nil, true) end
        end
        v.visual.model:Destroy()
    end
    local function primeCart(v, fuse)
        if v.fuse then return end
        v.fuse = fuse or 80
    end

    -- Riding -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Passenger attachment: boats seat the rider 0.4125 below their origin (height/3 - 0.6),
    -- minecarts 0.35 below; the rider's legs go forward in the riding pose.
    function vehicles.seat(v)
        local drop = v.kind == "boat" and -0.4125 or -0.35
        return toStuds(v.pos + Vector3.new(0, drop, 0))
    end
    function vehicles.releaseMob(v)
        local m = v.passenger
        if not m then return end
        v.passenger, m.vehicle = nil, nil
        m.vehicleCooldown = (world.tickCount or 0) + 20
        m.position = toStuds(v.pos) + Vector3.new((v.width / 2 + 0.6) * B, B, 0)
        m.previous, m.delta = m.position, Vector3.zero
    end
    function vehicles.mount(v)
        if api.riding and api.riding ~= v then vehicles.dismount() end
        if v.passenger and v.kind ~= "boat" then return false end
        api.riding, api.gliding = v, false
        v.seat = function() return vehicles.seat(v) end
        -- The rendered (interpolated) position, so the rider moves with the drawn vehicle.
        v.seatAt = function(partial)
            local drop = v.kind == "boat" and -0.4125 or -0.35
            return toStuds((v.old or v.pos):Lerp(v.pos, partial) + Vector3.new(0, drop, 0))
        end
    end
    -- Dismount: the first free spot beside the vehicle (left, right, then front/back), else on top.
    function vehicles.dismount()
        local v = api.riding
        if not v then return end
        if v.kind == "mob" then api.riding = nil; if v.dismount then v.dismount() end; return end
        api.riding = nil
        local forward = Vector3.new(-math.sin(v.yaw), 0, -math.cos(v.yaw))
        local side = forward:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList(v)
        local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
        overlap.FilterType, overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances, overlap.RespectCanCollide = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, ignoreList(nil), true
        for _, offset in ipairs({side, -side, forward, -forward}) do
            local feet = toStuds(v.pos) + offset * (v.width / 2 + 0.5) * B
            local ground = workspace:Raycast(feet + Vector3.new(0, B, 0), Vector3.new(0, -2 * B, 0), params)
            if ground then
                local centre = ground.Position + Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2 + 0.05, 0)
                if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(centre), root.Size * 0.95, overlap) == 0 then
                    if world.teleport then world.teleport(centre - Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2 + 0.02, 0))
                    else root.CFrame = CFrame.new(centre) end
                    return
                end
            end
        end
        local feet = toStuds(v.pos + Vector3.new(0, v.height, 0))
        if world.teleport then world.teleport(feet) else root.CFrame = CFrame.new(feet + Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2, 0)) end
    end

    -- Boat physics ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function boatTick(v, controls)
        local ridden = api.riding == v
        local surface = waterSurface(v)
        local old = v.status
        local friction
        if surface and surface > v.pos.Y + v.height + 0.001 then v.status = "underwater"
        elseif surface and surface >= v.pos.Y then v.status = "water"
        else
            friction = groundFriction(v)
            v.status = friction and "land" or "air"
        end
        -- controlBoat(): A/D turn one degree per tick, W adds 0.04, S takes 0.005, turning alone 0.005.
        v.paddleOn = {false, false}
        if ridden then
            local f = 0
            local left, right, fwd, back = controls.left, controls.right, controls.forward, controls.back
            if left then v.deltaRotation = v.deltaRotation + 1 end
            if right then v.deltaRotation = v.deltaRotation - 1 end
            if left ~= right and not fwd and not back then f = f + 0.005 end
            v.yaw = v.yaw + math.rad(v.deltaRotation)
            if fwd then f = f + 0.04 end
            if back then f = f - 0.005 end
            v.dm = v.dm + Vector3.new(-math.sin(v.yaw), 0, -math.cos(v.yaw)) * f
            v.paddleOn = {(right and not left) or fwd, (left and not right) or fwd}
        end
        -- floatBoat()
        local gravity, buoy, inv = -0.04, 0, 0.05
        if old == "air" and (v.status == "water" or v.status == "underwater") then
            v.pos = Vector3.new(v.pos.X, (surface or v.pos.Y) - v.height + 0.101, v.pos.Z)
            v.dm = Vector3.new(v.dm.X, 0, v.dm.Z)
            v.status = "water"
        else
            if v.status == "water" then buoy, inv = (surface - v.pos.Y) / v.height, 0.9
            elseif v.status == "underwater" then buoy, inv = 0.01, 0.45
            elseif v.status == "air" then inv = 0.9
            elseif v.status == "land" then inv = friction; if ridden then inv = inv / 2 end end
            v.dm = Vector3.new(v.dm.X * inv, v.dm.Y + gravity, v.dm.Z * inv)
            v.deltaRotation = v.deltaRotation * inv
            if buoy > 0 then v.dm = Vector3.new(v.dm.X, (v.dm.Y + buoy * 0.06153846) * 0.75, v.dm.Z) end
        end
        local hits = move(v, v.dm)
        if hits.X then v.dm = Vector3.new(0, v.dm.Y, v.dm.Z) end
        if hits.Z then v.dm = Vector3.new(v.dm.X, v.dm.Y, 0) end
        if hits.Y then v.dm = Vector3.new(v.dm.X, 0, v.dm.Z) end
        -- Paddle phase advances pi/8 per tick while that paddle rows.
        for i = 1, 2 do if v.paddleOn[i] then v.paddles[i] = v.paddles[i] + math.pi / 8 end end
    end

    -- Minecart physics --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- AbstractMinecart.getPos(): the point on the track nearest (x, z), with slope height.
    local function railPoint(x, y, z)
        local i, j, k = math.floor(x), math.floor(y), math.floor(z)
        if railAt(i, j - 1, k) then j = j - 1 end
        local rail = railAt(i, j, k)
        if not rail then return nil end
        local e = RAIL_EXITS[rail.state.shape or "north_south"] or RAIL_EXITS.north_south
        local a, b = e[1], e[2]
        local d0, d1, d2 = i + 0.5 + a[1] * 0.5, j + 0.0625 + a[2] * 0.5, k + 0.5 + a[3] * 0.5
        local d3, d4, d5 = i + 0.5 + b[1] * 0.5, j + 0.0625 + b[2] * 0.5, k + 0.5 + b[3] * 0.5
        local dx, dy, dz = d3 - d0, (d4 - d1) * 2, d5 - d2
        local t = dx == 0 and z - k or dz == 0 and x - i or ((x - d0) * dx + (z - d2) * dz) * 2
        x, y, z = d0 + dx * t, d1 + dy * t, d2 + dz * t
        if dy < 0 then y = y + 1 elseif dy > 0 then y = y + 0.5 end
        return Vector3.new(x, y, z)
    end
    local function solidAt(i, j, k)
        local n = nodeAtCell(i, j, k)
        if n then return n.solid end
        local s = world.sample(cellCentre(i, j, k))
        return s ~= nil and s.id ~= "air"
    end
    local function cartPassenger(v) return api.riding == v or v.passenger ~= nil end
    local function moveAlongTrack(v, i, j, k, rail, controls, look, fraction)
        fraction = fraction or 1
        local p0 = railPoint(v.pos.X, v.pos.Y, v.pos.Z)
        local y = j
        local shape = rail.state.shape or "north_south"
        local powered = rail.state.powered == "true"
        local brake = rail.id == "powered_rail" and not powered
        local boost = rail.id == "powered_rail" and powered
        local dm = v.dm
        if shape == "ascending_east" then dm = dm + Vector3.new(-0.0078125, 0, 0) * fraction; y = y + 1
        elseif shape == "ascending_west" then dm = dm + Vector3.new(0.0078125, 0, 0) * fraction; y = y + 1
        elseif shape == "ascending_north" then dm = dm + Vector3.new(0, 0, 0.0078125) * fraction; y = y + 1
        elseif shape == "ascending_south" then dm = dm + Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.0078125) * fraction; y = y + 1 end
        local e = RAIL_EXITS[shape] or RAIL_EXITS.north_south
        local a, b = e[1], e[2]
        local dx, dz = b[1] - a[1], b[3] - a[3]
        local len = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
        if dm.X * dx + dm.Z * dz < 0 then dx, dz = -dx, -dz end
        local speed = math.sqrt(dm.X ^ 2 + dm.Z ^ 2)
        if not world.funRails then speed = math.min(2, speed) end
        dm = Vector3.new(speed * dx / len, dm.Y, speed * dz / len)
        -- A rider pressing forward starts a stopped cart (0.1 of the player's own input motion).
        if api.riding == v and controls.forward and dm.X ^ 2 + dm.Z ^ 2 < 0.01 then
            local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
            if flat.Magnitude > 0 then flat = flat.Unit * 0.098; dm = dm + Vector3.new(flat.X * 0.1, 0, flat.Z * 0.1); brake = false end
        end
        if brake then
            local h = math.sqrt(dm.X ^ 2 + dm.Z ^ 2)
            if h < 0.03 then dm = Vector3.zero else dm = Vector3.new(dm.X * 0.5 ^ fraction, 0, dm.Z * 0.5 ^ fraction) end
        end
        local ax, az = i + 0.5 + a[1] * 0.5, k + 0.5 + a[3] * 0.5
        local bx, bz = i + 0.5 + b[1] * 0.5, k + 0.5 + b[3] * 0.5
        local ex, ez = bx - ax, bz - az
        local t
        if ex == 0 then t = v.pos.Z - k elseif ez == 0 then t = v.pos.X - i else t = ((v.pos.X - ax) * ex + (v.pos.Z - az) * ez) * 2 end
        v.pos = Vector3.new(ax + ex * t, y, az + ez * t)
        local factor = cartPassenger(v) and 0.75 or 1
        local max = world.funRails and math.huge or (v.inWater and 0.2 or 0.4)
        v.dm = dm
        local hits = move(v, Vector3.new(math.clamp(factor * dm.X, -max, max), 0, math.clamp(factor * dm.Z, -max, max)) * fraction)
        if hits.X or hits.Z then v.dm = Vector3.new(0, v.dm.Y, 0) end
        local fx, fz = math.floor(v.pos.X) - i, math.floor(v.pos.Z) - k
        if a[2] ~= 0 and fx == a[1] and fz == a[3] then v.pos = Vector3.new(v.pos.X, y + a[2], v.pos.Z)
        elseif b[2] ~= 0 and fx == b[1] and fz == b[3] then v.pos = Vector3.new(v.pos.X, y + b[2], v.pos.Z) end
        -- applyNaturalSlowdown(): 0.997 with a rider, 0.96 empty (furnace carts use their push).
        local slow = (world.funRails and boost) and 1 or (cartPassenger(v) and 0.997 or 0.96)
        slow = slow ^ fraction
        if v.id == "furnace_minecart" then
            local p = v.push
            if p.Magnitude > 1e-4 and v.fuel > 0 then
                local h = math.sqrt(v.dm.X ^ 2 + v.dm.Z ^ 2)
                local pd = p.Unit
                v.push = pd * h
                v.dm = Vector3.new(v.dm.X * 0.8 + pd.X * 0.04, v.dm.Y, v.dm.Z * 0.8 + pd.Z * 0.04)
                slow = 0.98
            else slow = 0.98 end
        end
        v.dm = Vector3.new(v.dm.X * slow, v.dm.Y, v.dm.Z * slow)
        local p1 = railPoint(v.pos.X, v.pos.Y, v.pos.Z)
        if p0 and p1 then
            local d17 = (p0.Y - p1.Y) * 0.05
            local h = math.sqrt(v.dm.X ^ 2 + v.dm.Z ^ 2)
            if h > 0 then v.dm = Vector3.new(v.dm.X * (h + d17) / h, v.dm.Y, v.dm.Z * (h + d17) / h) end
            v.pos = Vector3.new(v.pos.X, p1.Y, v.pos.Z)
        end
        local l, i1 = math.floor(v.pos.X), math.floor(v.pos.Z)
        if l ~= i or i1 ~= k then
            local h = math.sqrt(v.dm.X ^ 2 + v.dm.Z ^ 2)
            local direction = Vector3.new(l - i, 0, i1 - k).Unit
            v.dm = direction * h + Vector3.new(0, v.dm.Y, 0)
        end
        if boost then
            local h = math.sqrt(v.dm.X ^ 2 + v.dm.Z ^ 2)
            if h > 0.01 then v.dm = v.dm + Vector3.new(v.dm.X / h * 0.06, 0, v.dm.Z / h * 0.06) * fraction
            elseif shape == "east_west" then
                if solidAt(i - 1, j, k) then v.dm = Vector3.new(0.02, v.dm.Y, v.dm.Z) elseif solidAt(i + 1, j, k) then v.dm = Vector3.new(-0.02, v.dm.Y, v.dm.Z) end
            elseif shape == "north_south" then
                if solidAt(i, j, k - 1) then v.dm = Vector3.new(v.dm.X, v.dm.Y, 0.02) elseif solidAt(i, j, k + 1) then v.dm = Vector3.new(v.dm.X, v.dm.Y, -0.02) end
            end
        end
        -- Climbing a slope: keep the climb in the vertical speed, so a cart leaving the top end flies off.
        if shape:find("^ascending") then
            local up = (shape == "ascending_east" and v.dm.X > 0) or (shape == "ascending_west" and v.dm.X < 0)
                or (shape == "ascending_north" and v.dm.Z < 0) or (shape == "ascending_south" and v.dm.Z > 0)
            local h = math.sqrt(v.dm.X ^ 2 + v.dm.Z ^ 2)
            v.dm = Vector3.new(v.dm.X, up and (world.funRails and h or math.min(h, 0.4)) or 0, v.dm.Z)
        end
        -- Activator rail: powered it ejects riders and lights TNT carts; hopper carts lock.
        if rail.id == "activator_rail" then
            if powered then
                if api.riding == v then vehicles.dismount() end
                vehicles.releaseMob(v)
                if v.id == "tnt_minecart" then primeCart(v, 80) end
            end
            v.locked = powered
        end
        if rail.id == "detector_rail" then rail.cartTick = world.tickCount end
    end
    local function comeOffTrack(v)
        -- Fun rails keep every bit of speed off the track; otherwise getMaxSpeed() clamps it.
        local max = world.funRails and math.huge or (v.inWater and 0.2 or 0.4)
        v.dm = Vector3.new(math.clamp(v.dm.X, -max, max), v.dm.Y, math.clamp(v.dm.Z, -max, max))
        if v.onGround then v.dm = Vector3.new(v.dm.X * 0.5, v.dm.Y, v.dm.Z * 0.5) end
        local hits = move(v, v.dm)
        v.onGround = hits.Y and v.dm.Y < 0
        if hits.Y then v.dm = Vector3.new(v.dm.X, 0, v.dm.Z) end
        if hits.X then v.dm = Vector3.new(0, v.dm.Y, v.dm.Z) end
        if hits.Z then v.dm = Vector3.new(v.dm.X, v.dm.Y, 0) end
        if not v.onGround and not world.funRails then v.dm = v.dm * 0.95 end
    end
    local function cartTick(v, controls, look)
        v.old = v.pos
        v.dm = v.dm - Vector3.new(0, 0.04, 0)
        local i, j, k = math.floor(v.pos.X), math.floor(v.pos.Y), math.floor(v.pos.Z)
        if railAt(i, j - 1, k) then j = j - 1 end
        local rail = railAt(i, j, k)
        if rail then
            v.dm = Vector3.new(v.dm.X, 0, v.dm.Z)
            local steps = world.funRails and math.max(1, math.ceil(Vector3.new(v.dm.X, 0, v.dm.Z).Magnitude / 0.25)) or 1
            for step = 1, steps do
                local x, y, z = math.floor(v.pos.X), math.floor(v.pos.Y), math.floor(v.pos.Z)
                if railAt(x, y - 1, z) then y = y - 1 end
                local current = railAt(x, y, z)
                if not current then break end
                moveAlongTrack(v, x, y, z, current, controls, look, 1 / steps)
            end
        else comeOffTrack(v) end
        -- yaw follows travel; pitch follows the slope
        local d = v.pos - v.old
        if d.X ^ 2 + d.Z ^ 2 > 0.001 * 0.001 then
            v.travel = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z).Unit
            v.pitch = math.atan2(d.Y, math.sqrt(d.X ^ 2 + d.Z ^ 2))
        else v.pitch = 0 end
        if v.fuel and v.fuel > 0 then
            v.fuel = v.fuel - 1
            if v.fuel % 4 == 0 then world.effects.emit("smoke", toStuds(v.pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.8, 0)), Vector3.zero, {life = 20, size = .2}) end
        end
        -- Hopper minecart: pulls items from the container above and item entities on it, unless on a powered activator rail.
        if v.id == "hopper_minecart" and not v.locked and v.age % 4 == 0 then
            local storage = v.storage
            local function insert(stack)
                for slot = 1, 5 do
                    local s = storage.slots[slot]
                    if not s then storage.slots[slot] = CreativeRules.withCount(stack, 1); return true end
                    if CreativeRules.sameItem(s, stack) and s.count < (itemStackLimits[s.id] or 64) then s.count = s.count + 1; return true end
                end
            end
            local above = nodeAtCell(i, math.floor(v.pos.Y) + 1, k)
            if above and above.storage then
                for slot, s in pairs(above.storage.slots) do
                    if insert(s) then s.count = s.count - 1; if s.count <= 0 then above.storage.slots[slot] = nil end; break end
                end
            end
            local centre = toStuds(v.pos)
            for _, d in ipairs(world.drops) do
                if d.count > 0 and (d.position - centre).Magnitude < B and insert(d.template or {id = d.id, damage = d.damage}) then d.count = d.count - 1 end
            end
        end
        if v.fuse then
            v.fuse = v.fuse - 1
            world.effects.emit("smoke", toStuds(v.pos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)), Vector3.zero, {life = 10, size = .15})
            if v.fuse <= 0 then
                local at = toStuds(v.pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
                remove(v, false)
                -- MinecartTNT.explode(): power 4 plus up to 1.5 from speed.
                world.explode(at)
                return
            end
        end
    end

    -- Rails: RailState connections and powered-rail power ----------------------------------------------
    function vehicles.railShape(n)
        local b = toBlocks(n.center)
        local i, j, k = math.floor(b.X), math.floor(b.Y), math.floor(b.Z)
        local conn = {}
        for dir, d in pairs({north = {0, -1}, south = {0, 1}, east = {1, 0}, west = {-1, 0}}) do
            for _, dy in ipairs({0, 1, -1}) do
                if railAt(i + d[1], j + dy, k + d[2]) then conn[dir] = dy; break end
            end
        end
        -- Removing the upper endpoint does not erase an existing slope. Only
        -- a new connection on another axis/opposite ascent should redirect it;
        -- placement.shape separately checks both physical supports.
        local uphill = (n.state.shape or ""):match("^ascending_(.+)$")
        if uphill then
            local ns = uphill == "north" or uphill == "south"
            local reverse = ({north = "south", south = "north", east = "west", west = "east"})[uphill]
            local crossing = ns and (conn.east ~= nil or conn.west ~= nil)
                or not ns and (conn.north ~= nil or conn.south ~= nil)
            if not crossing and conn[reverse] ~= 1 then return n.state.shape end
        end
        local curve = n.id == "rail"
        local count = 0
        for _ in pairs(conn) do count = count + 1 end
        if curve and count >= 3 then
            local powered = (n.input or 0) > 0
            local shape
            local choices = powered and {{"north","west"},{"north","east"},{"south","west"},{"south","east"}}
                or {{"south","east"},{"south","west"},{"north","east"},{"north","west"}}
            for _, pair in ipairs(choices) do
                if conn[pair[1]] ~= nil and conn[pair[2]] ~= nil then shape = pair[1] .. "_" .. pair[2] end
            end
            if shape then return shape end
        end
        local ns, ew = conn.north ~= nil or conn.south ~= nil, conn.east ~= nil or conn.west ~= nil
        if curve and ns and ew and not (conn.north and conn.south) and not (conn.east and conn.west) then
            return (conn.south and "south" or "north") .. "_" .. (conn.east and "east" or "west")
        elseif ns and (not ew or conn.north and conn.south) then
            -- RailState: only a connected rail one block higher makes this one ascend (the lower rail
            -- of a slope is the ascending one; the top rail stays flat).
            if conn.north == 1 then return "ascending_north"
            elseif conn.south == 1 then return "ascending_south" end
            return "north_south"
        elseif ew then
            if conn.east == 1 then return "ascending_east"
            elseif conn.west == 1 then return "ascending_west" end
            return "east_west"
        end
        -- Unconnected: the straight shape it was placed with (player's direction).
        return n.state.shape == "east_west" and "east_west" or "north_south"
    end
    -- PoweredRailBlock.findPoweredRailSignal(): power runs up to 8 rails along a line of the same rail.
    local function railPower(nodes)
        local queue, dist = {}, {}
        for _, n in ipairs(nodes) do
            if (n.id == "powered_rail" or n.id == "activator_rail") then
                if (n.input or 0) > 0 then queue[#queue + 1] = n; dist[n] = 0 end
            end
        end
        local head = 1
        while head <= #queue do
            local n = queue[head]; head = head + 1
            if dist[n] < 8 then
                local b = toBlocks(n.center)
                local i, j, k = math.floor(b.X), math.floor(b.Y), math.floor(b.Z)
                for _, ex in ipairs(RAIL_EXITS[n.state.shape or "north_south"] or {}) do
                    for _, dy in ipairs({0, 1, -1}) do
                        local m = railAt(i + ex[1], j + dy, k + ex[3])
                        if m and m.id == n.id and dist[m] == nil then dist[m] = dist[n] + 1; queue[#queue + 1] = m; break end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for _, n in ipairs(nodes) do
            if n.id == "powered_rail" or n.id == "activator_rail" then n.state.powered = tostring(dist[n] ~= nil) end
            -- Detector rail: on while a cart sits on it (checked again 20 ticks after it leaves).
            if n.id == "detector_rail" then
                local on = n.cartTick and world.tickCount - n.cartTick < 20
                n.state.powered = tostring(on and true or false)
                n.output = on and 15 or 0
            end
        end
    end

    -- Interaction -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function vehicleOf(instance)
        for _, v in ipairs(vehicles.list) do if instance and instance:IsDescendantOf(v.visual.model) then return v end end
    end
    -- Use (right click) on a vehicle, or a boat/minecart item on water, ground or a rail.
    function vehicles.use(hit, sneaking, index, e)
        local v = hit and vehicleOf(hit.Instance)
        if v then
            if v.kind == "boat" then
                if sneaking and v.storage then ctx.ui.openStorage(v.storage, "Chest Boat", function() end, 27, "chest")
                elseif not sneaking and api.riding ~= v then vehicles.mount(v) end
            elseif v.id == "chest_minecart" or v.id == "hopper_minecart" then
                ctx.ui.openStorage(v.storage, v.id == "chest_minecart" and "Minecart with Chest" or "Minecart with Hopper", function() end, v.storageSize, v.id == "chest_minecart" and "chest" or "hopper")
            elseif v.id == "furnace_minecart" then
                if e and (e.id == "coal" or e.id == "charcoal") then
                    -- MinecartFurnace.interact(): coal adds 3600 ticks and pushes away from the player.
                    if world.consume(index, 1) then v.fuel = math.min(32000, v.fuel + 3600) end
                end
                local away = toStuds(v.pos) - root.Position
                v.push = Vector3.new(away.X, 0, away.Z)
            elseif v.id == "minecart" and not sneaking and api.riding ~= v then vehicles.mount(v) end
            return true
        end
        if not e then return false end
        if JavaContent.data.boats[e.id] then
            local look = api.controls and api.controls.look or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
            local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
            if vehicles.spawnBoat(e.id, hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.05, 0), yaw) then world.consume(index, 1) end
            return true
        end
        if e.id:match("minecart$") then
            local n = world.resolve(hit.Instance)
            if n and RAILS[n.id] and vehicles.spawnCart(e.id, n) then world.consume(index, 1) end
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    -- Attack: creative players break vehicles at once; otherwise damage += 10 per hit, broken past 40.
    function vehicles.attack(instance, damage)
        local v = vehicleOf(instance)
        if not v then return false end
        v.hurt, v.hurtDir = 10, -v.hurtDir
        v.damage = v.damage + (damage or 1) * 10
        if not CONFIG.Survival then remove(v, false)
        elseif v.damage > 40 then remove(v, true) end
        return true
    end

    vehicles.railPower = railPower
    function vehicles.tick(controls, look)
        if api.riding and controls.sneak then vehicles.dismount() end
        for idx = #vehicles.list, 1, -1 do
            local v = vehicles.list[idx]
            if v then
                v.age = v.age + 1
                local centre = toStuds(v.pos)
                if v.kind == "cart" and api.riding ~= v then
                    local d = centre - root.Position
                    local flat = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z)
                    if math.abs(d.Y) < B * 1.5 and flat.Magnitude > 0.01 and flat.Magnitude < B * (v.width / 2 + 0.45) then
                        v.dm = v.dm + flat.Unit * 0.05
                    end
                end
                if v.passenger and (v.passenger.removed or v.passenger.humanoid.Health <= 0) then vehicles.releaseMob(v) end
                if not v.passenger and (v.kind == "boat" or v.id == "minecart" and api.riding ~= v) then
                    for _, m in ipairs(api.mobs or {}) do
                        if not m.removed and not m.rider and not m.vehicle and (m.vehicleCooldown or 0) <= (world.tickCount or 0) and m.humanoid.Health > 0 and m.width < v.width
                            and (m.position - centre).Magnitude < B * (v.width / 2 + 0.5) then
                            v.passenger, m.vehicle = m, v; break
                        end
                    end
                end
                v.old, v.oldYaw, v.oldPitch, v.oldTravel = v.pos, v.yaw, v.pitch or 0, v.travel
                if v.hurt > 0 then v.hurt = v.hurt - 1 end
                if v.damage > 0 then v.damage = v.damage - 1 end
                if v.kind == "boat" then boatTick(v, controls) else cartTick(v, controls, look) end
                if v.visual.model.Parent then
                    v.hull.CFrame = CFrame.new(toStuds(v.pos) + Vector3.new(0, v.height * B / 2, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, v.yaw, 0)
                end
                if v.pos.Y < -64 then remove(v, false) end
            end
        end
    end
    function vehicles.render(partial)
        for _, v in ipairs(vehicles.list) do
            local p = toStuds((v.old or v.pos):Lerp(v.pos, partial))
            local yaw = (v.oldYaw or v.yaw) + math.atan2(math.sin(v.yaw - (v.oldYaw or v.yaw)), math.cos(v.yaw - (v.oldYaw or v.yaw))) * partial
            -- hurt wobble: rotate about the long axis by sin(hurtTime) * hurtTime * damage / 10
            local wobble = v.hurt > 0 and math.rad(math.sin(v.hurt - partial) * (v.hurt - partial) * v.damage / 10 * v.hurtDir) or 0
            if v.kind == "boat" then
                -- Model +X is the bow: turn it onto the boat's -Z forward.
                local frame = CFrame.new(p) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw + math.pi / 2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(wobble, 0, 0)
                -- BoatModel.animatePaddle(): x = lerp(-pi/3, -pi/12, (sin(-t)+1)/2), y = lerp(-pi/4, pi/4, (sin(-t+1)+1)/2)
                local overrides = {}
                for i, name in ipairs({"left_paddle", "right_paddle"}) do
                    local t = v.paddles[i]
                    local x = -math.pi / 3 + (-math.pi / 12 + math.pi / 3) * (math.sin(-t) + 1) / 2
                    local y = -math.pi / 4 + (math.pi / 2) * (math.sin(-t + 1) + 1) / 2
                    if i == 2 then y = math.pi - y end
                    overrides[name] = {x = x, y = y}
                end
                v.visual.pivot(frame, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, overrides)
            else
                local dir = v.travel or Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
                local previous = v.oldTravel or dir
                local from, target = math.atan2(-previous.Z, previous.X), math.atan2(-dir.Z, dir.X)
                local turn = math.atan2(math.sin(target - from), math.cos(target - from))
                local pitch = (v.oldPitch or v.pitch or 0) + ((v.pitch or 0) - (v.oldPitch or v.pitch or 0)) * partial
                local frame = CFrame.new(p) * CFrame.Angles(0, from + turn * partial, 0) * CFrame.Angles(wobble, 0, pitch)
                v.visual.pivot(frame)
                if v.block then
                    -- MinecartRenderer: display block scaled 0.75, centred 0.375 + 0.28125 above the cart.
                    v.block.pivot(frame * CFrame.new(0, (0.375 + 0.28125) * B, 0))
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function vehicles.destroy() for i = #vehicles.list, 1, -1 do vehicles.releaseMob(vehicles.list[i]); vehicles.list[i].visual.model:Destroy(); vehicles.list[i] = nil end end
    vehicles.toStuds, vehicles.toBlocks = toStuds, toBlocks
    return vehicles
end
-- END VEHICLES
-- BEGIN MOBS
-- Java 26.3 mobs: attributes from DefaultAttributes, LivingEntity physics (gravity 0.08, drag 0.98,
-- ground friction 0.546, step height 0.6), WalkNodeEvaluator-style A* pathfinding over block cells,
-- MoveControl / LookControl / BodyRotationControl, the GoalSelector with priorities and flags,
-- per-mob registerGoals, setupAnim and keyframe animations, riding and villager trading.
local function createMobs(world, h)
    local B = CONFIG.Block
    local root, character, folder, api = h.root, h.character, h.folder, h.api
    local effects = world.effects
    local mobs = {list = {}, limit = 48}
    local data = JavaContent.data
    local attrs = data.mobAttributes or {}
    local tick = 0
    function mobs.now() return tick end
    local function rand() return math.random() end
    local function wrap(a) a = (a + math.pi) % (math.pi * 2) - math.pi; return a end
    local function approachAngle(from, to, maxStep) local d = wrap(to - from); return from + math.clamp(d, -maxStep, maxStep) end
    local function forwardOf(yaw) return Vector3.new(-math.sin(yaw), 0, -math.cos(yaw)) end
    local function yawTo(d) return math.atan2(-d.X, -d.Z) end
    local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z) end
    local function particle(kind, p, v, o) if effects then effects.emit(kind, p, v or Vector3.zero, o) end end
    local function creative() return not CONFIG.Survival end
    mobs.hostile = {zombie = true, husk = true, drowned = true, skeleton = true, stray = true, bogged = true, parched = true, wither_skeleton = true, creeper = true,
        spider = true, cave_spider = true, endermite = true, silverfish = true, witch = true, pillager = true, vindicator = true, evoker = true, illusioner = true,
        ravager = true, blaze = true, ghast = true, phantom = true, slime = true, magma_cube = true, piglin_brute = true, zoglin = true, warden = true, wither = true,
        ender_dragon = true, breeze = true, guardian = true, elder_guardian = true, vex = true, shulker = true, zombie_villager = true, hoglin = true, creaking = true,
        zombie_nautilus = true, camel_husk = false}
    local flyers = {allay = true, bat = true, bee = true, blaze = true, ghast = true, happy_ghast = true, phantom = true, vex = true, wither = true, ender_dragon = true, parrot = true, breeze = false}
    local swimmers = {cod = true, salmon = true, pufferfish = true, tropical_fish = true, squid = true, glow_squid = true, dolphin = true, guardian = true, elder_guardian = true,
        tadpole = true, axolotl = true, nautilus = true, zombie_nautilus = true}
    mobs.flyers, mobs.swimmers = flyers, swimmers
    -- Experience on death (Mob.getBaseExperienceReward and overrides).
    local xpReward = {blaze = 10, guardian = 10, elder_guardian = 10, ender_dragon = 12000, wither = 50, evoker = 10, ravager = 20, warden = 5, breeze = 10, piglin_brute = 20, vindicator = 5,
        pillager = 5, witch = 5, silverfish = 5, endermite = 3, ghast = 5, phantom = 5, creaking = 0}

    -- The player as an entity -------------------------------------------------------------------
    local player = {isPlayer = true, id = "player"}
    local function playerHum() return character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") end
    function player.pos() return root.Position - Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2, 0) end
    function player.eye() return world.eye and world.eye() or root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6 * B, 0) end
    function player.alive() local hum = playerHum(); return hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0 and not PlayerStats.spectator end
    mobs.player = player
    local function posOf(e) return e.isPlayer and e.pos() or e.position end
    local function eyeOf(e) return e.isPlayer and e.eye() or e.position + Vector3.new(0, e.eye * e.scale, 0) end
    local function aliveOf(e) if e.isPlayer then return e.alive() end return e.humanoid.Health > 0 and not e.removed end
    mobs.posOf, mobs.eyeOf, mobs.aliveOf = posOf, eyeOf, aliveOf

    -- World queries -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local castParams = RaycastParams.new()
    castParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    castParams.RespectCanCollide = true
    local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
    overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    overlap.RespectCanCollide = true
    local ignore = {}
    local function refreshIgnore()
        ignore = {character, folder}
        for _, name in ipairs({"SteveDroppedItems", "SteveJavaParticles", "SteveItemEntities", "SteveBlockEntities", "SteveVehicles"}) do
            local f = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
            if f then ignore[#ignore + 1] = f end
        end
        for _, p in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do if p.Character then ignore[#ignore + 1] = p.Character end end
        castParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
        overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
    end
    refreshIgnore()
    mobs.castParams = castParams
    -- Cells: centre of the block cell containing p.
    local function cellOf(p) return world.cell and world.cell(p) or Vector3.new(math.floor(p.X / B + 0.5), math.floor(p.Y / B + 0.5), math.floor(p.Z / B + 0.5)) * B end
    local cellCache, cacheTick = {}, 0
    local function cellKey(c) return string.format("%d,%d,%d", math.floor(c.X / B * 2 + 0.5), math.floor(c.Y / B * 2 + 0.5), math.floor(c.Z / B * 2 + 0.5)) end
    -- 0 = open, 1 = solid, 2 = water, 3 = lava, 4 = fence/wall (1.5 high), 5 = danger (fire, cactus, berry bush, powder snow)
    local function cellType(c)
        local k = cellKey(c)
        local v = cellCache[k]
        if v then return v end
        v = 0
        local n = world.nodeAt and world.nodeAt(c)
        if n then
            local id = n.id
            if id == "water" or n.state.waterlogged == "true" then v = 2
            elseif id == "lava" then v = 3
            elseif id:match("_fence$") or id:match("_wall$") or (id:match("_fence_gate$") and n.state.open ~= "true") then v = 4
            elseif id == "fire" or id == "soul_fire" or id == "cactus" or id == "sweet_berry_bush" or id == "powder_snow" or id == "magma_block" or id:match("campfire$") then v = 5
            elseif (id:match("_door$") or id:match("_trapdoor$") or id:match("_fence_gate$")) and n.state.open == "true" then v = 0
            elseif n.solid then v = 1
            else v = 0 end
        else
            local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(c), Vector3.new(B, B, B) * 0.8, overlap)
            for _, p in ipairs(parts) do if p.CanCollide and p.Transparency < 1 or p.CanCollide and p:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter") then v = 1; break end end
            if v == 0 and #parts > 0 then for _, p in ipairs(parts) do if p.CanCollide then v = 1; break end end end
            if v == 0 then
                local ok, mats, occ = pcall(function() return workspace.Terrain:ReadVoxels(Region3.new(c - Vector3.new(0.01, 0.01, 0.01), c + Vector3.new(0.01, 0.01, 0.01)):ExpandToGrid(4), 4) end)
                if ok and occ and occ[1] and occ[1][1] and occ[1][1][1] and occ[1][1][1] > 0.5 then
                    local m = mats[1][1][1]
                    v = m == Enum.Material.Water and 2 or m == Enum.Material.CrackedLava and 3 or 1
                end
            end
        end
        cellCache[k] = v
        return v
    end
    mobs.cellType = cellType
    function mobs.invalidate() cellCache = {} end
    local function inWater(p) return cellType(cellOf(p)) == 2 end
    local function inLava(p) return cellType(cellOf(p)) == 3 end

    -- Spawning ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function attribute(id, name, default)
        local a = attrs[id]
        local v = a and a[name]
        if v ~= nil then return v end
        return default
    end
    local defaults = {max_health = 20, movement_speed = 0.7, attack_damage = 2, follow_range = 16, armor = 0, flying_speed = 0.4, knockback_resistance = 0, step_height = 0.6, scale = 1, gravity = 0.08, jump_strength = 0.42, tempt_range = 10}
    function mobs.attr(m, name) return attribute(m.id, name, defaults[name]) end
    local function pickVariant(def, baby, wanted)
        local list = baby and def.babies and #def.babies > 0 and def.babies or def.variants
        if wanted then for i, v in ipairs(list) do if v.name == wanted then return v, i end end end
        local i = math.random(#list)
        return list[i], i
    end
    local function buildVisual(m)
        local def = data.entities[m.id]
        local variant = pickVariant(def, m.baby, m.variantName)
        m.variantName = variant.name
        if m.visual then
            if m.hitbox then m.hitbox.Parent = nil end
            if m.humanoid then m.humanoid.Parent = nil end
            pcall(function() if m.visual.destroy then m.visual.destroy() else m.visual.model:Destroy() end end)
            m.visual = nil
        end
        if mobs.customVisual then
            local okV, custom = pcall(mobs.customVisual, m)
            if okV and custom then
                m.visual = custom
                m.modelScale = B * (def.scale or 1) * (m.baby and 0.5 or 1)
                m.visual.model:SetAttribute("MinecraftMob", m.id)
                m.bones = {}
                m.hitbox.Parent = m.visual.model
                m.humanoid.Parent = m.visual.model
                m.visual.model.PrimaryPart = m.hitbox
                return
            end
        end
        local scale = B * (def.scale or 1) * (m.sizeScale or 1) * ((m.baby and not (def.babies and #def.babies > 0)) and 0.5 or 1)
        m.modelScale = scale
        m.visual = JavaContent.entityModel(m.id, variant, scale, folder, m.position, 24)
        m.visual.model:SetAttribute("MinecraftMob", m.id)
        m.visual.model:SetAttribute("MinecraftVariant", variant.name)
        m.bones = {}
        for _, bone in ipairs(m.visual.bones) do m.bones[bone.name] = bone end
        m.hitbox.Parent = m.visual.model
        m.humanoid.Parent = m.visual.model
        m.visual.model.PrimaryPart = m.hitbox
    end
    mobs.buildVisual = buildVisual
    function mobs.spawn(id, position, baby, options)
        if #mobs.list >= mobs.limit then return false end
        local def = data.entities[id]
        if not def then return false end
        options = options or {}
        local dims = data.entitySizes and data.entitySizes[id] or {width = 0.6, height = 1.8}
        local m = {id = id, position = position, previous = position, velocity = Vector3.zero, yaw = rand() * math.pi * 2, headYaw = 0, headPitch = 0,
            age = 0, baby = baby or false, width = dims.width, height = dims.height, eye = dims.eye or dims.height * 0.85, onGround = false,
            walkPos = 0, walkSpeed = 0, walkSpeedOld = 0, hurtTime = 0, deathTime = 0, attackAnim = 0, attackAnimOld = 0, fallDistance = 0,
            goals = {}, targetGoals = {}, anim = {}, flags = {}, variantName = options.variant, sizeScale = options.size, noAi = options.noAi}
        m.headYaw = m.yaw
        m.babyAge = baby and -24000 or 0
        -- Baby sizes: EntityType dimensions scaled 0.5 (LivingEntity.getAgeScale) unless the baby has its own model size.
        m.scale = B * (baby and 0.5 or 1) * (options.size or 1) * (def.scale or 1)
        if id == "slime" or id == "magma_cube" or id == "sulfur_cube" then
            m.size = options.size or ({1, 2, 4})[math.random(3)]
            m.scale = B * m.size * 0.5 * 2
            m.sizeScale = m.size * 0.5 * 2 / (def.scale or 1)
        end
        local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
        hitbox.Name, hitbox.Anchored, hitbox.Transparency, hitbox.CanCollide, hitbox.CanTouch, hitbox.CanQuery = "HumanoidRootPart", true, 1, false, false, true
        hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(m.width, m.height, m.width) * m.scale
        m.hitbox = hitbox
        local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
        humanoid.MaxHealth = attribute(id, "max_health", 20)
        humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
        humanoid.DisplayName, humanoid.RequiresNeck, humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = "", false, false
        humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
        m.humanoid = humanoid
        m.lastHealth = humanoid.MaxHealth
        buildVisual(m)
        hitbox.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, hitbox.Size.Y / 2, 0))
        mobs.list[#mobs.list + 1] = m
        if mobs.setup then mobs.setup(m) end
        local headMobs = {zombie = true, husk = true, drowned = true, zombie_villager = true, zombified_piglin = true,
            skeleton = true, stray = true, wither_skeleton = true, bogged = true, parched = true}
        if headMobs[id] and not m.headItem and JavaContent.SpecialDates and JavaContent.SpecialDates.isHalloween() and rand() < 0.25 then
            m.headItem = rand() < 0.1 and "jack_o_lantern" or "carved_pumpkin"   -- setDropChance(HEAD, 0): never dropped
        end
        return m
    end

    -- Physics (LivingEntity.travel / Entity.move) -----------------------------------------------------
    -- One filter list a tick: the player, effects and every mob model.
    local castList, castListTick = nil, -1
    local castBoxParams = RaycastParams.new()
    castBoxParams.FilterType, castBoxParams.RespectCanCollide = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true
    local function castBox(m, from, delta)
        if castListTick ~= tick then
            castList = {}
            for _, x in ipairs(ignore) do castList[#castList + 1] = x end
            for _, other in ipairs(mobs.list) do castList[#castList + 1] = other.visual.model end
            castBoxParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = castList
            castListTick = tick
        end
        local size = Vector3.new(m.width * m.scale * 0.98, m.height * m.scale * 0.98, m.width * m.scale * 0.98)
        local ok, hit = pcall(function() return workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(from + Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2 + 0.01 * B, 0)), size, delta, castBoxParams) end)
        return ok and hit or nil
    end
    local function moveAxis(m, delta)
        if delta.Magnitude < 1e-5 then return delta, false end
        local hit = castBox(m, m.position, delta)
        if delta.Y < 0 and delta.X == 0 and delta.Z == 0 then
            -- A shape cast ignores parts it starts inside: a ray from inside the body still finds the floor's top.
            local h = m.height * m.scale
            local ray = workspace:Raycast(m.position + Vector3.new(0, h * 0.9, 0), Vector3.new(0, delta.Y - h * 0.9 - 0.01 * B, 0), castBoxParams)
            if ray and ray.Normal.Y > 0.5 and ray.Position.Y >= m.position.Y + delta.Y - 0.001 and ray.Position.Y <= m.position.Y + h * 0.9 then
                local move = Vector3.new(0, ray.Position.Y + 0.002 * B - m.position.Y, 0)
                m.position = m.position + move
                return move, true
            end
        end
        if not hit then m.position = m.position + delta; return delta, false end
        local move = delta.Unit * math.max(0, hit.Distance - 0.002 * B)
        m.position = m.position + move
        return move, true
    end
    -- Entity.move with step-up (maxUpStep 0.6) for horizontal collisions on the ground.
    -- Entity.move: X then Z then Y, each clipped separately (so mobs slide along walls), with
    -- step-up (maxUpStep 0.6) when a horizontal move is blocked on the ground.
    local function moveHorizontal(m, dx, dz)
        local _, bx = moveAxis(m, Vector3.new(dx, 0, 0))
        local _, bz = moveAxis(m, Vector3.new(0, 0, dz))
        return bx, bz
    end
    local function moveEntity(m, motion)
        local start = m.position
        local bx, bz = moveHorizontal(m, motion.X, motion.Z)
        if (bx or bz) and (m.onGround or m.flags.climbing) and not m.flying then
            local step = (mobs.attr(m, "step_height") or 0.6) * B
            local after = m.position
            m.position = start
            local upHit = castBox(m, m.position, Vector3.new(0, step, 0))
            if not upHit then
                m.position = m.position + Vector3.new(0, step, 0)
                local sx, sz = moveHorizontal(m, motion.X, motion.Z)
                local gained = flat(m.position - start).Magnitude - flat(after - start).Magnitude
                if gained > 0.001 * B then
                    local down = castBox(m, m.position, Vector3.new(0, -step, 0))
                    if down then m.position = m.position - Vector3.new(0, math.max(0, down.Distance - 0.002 * B), 0) end
                    bx, bz = sx, sz
                else m.position = after end
            else m.position = after end
        end
        m.horizontalCollision = bx or bz
        local _, blockedY = moveAxis(m, Vector3.new(0, motion.Y, 0))
        m.verticalCollision = blockedY
        m.onGround = blockedY and motion.Y < 0
        return m.horizontalCollision, blockedY
    end
    mobs.moveEntity = moveEntity
    local function travel(m)
        local water = inWater(m.position + Vector3.new(0, 0.2 * B, 0))
        local lava = not water and inLava(m.position + Vector3.new(0, 0.2 * B, 0))
        if JavaContent.fluidQuery and not water and not lava then
            local okF, f = pcall(JavaContent.fluidQuery, m.position + Vector3.new(0, 0.2 * B, 0))
            if okF and (f == "water" or f == "slime") then water = true elseif okF and f == "lava" then lava = true end
        end
        m.inWater, m.inLava = water, lava
        local v = m.velocity
        local speed = m.moveSpeed or 0
        local forward, strafe = m.zza or 0, m.xxa or 0
        if m.flying or (flyers[m.id] and not m.onGround and not water) then
            -- FlyingMoveControl / AbstractFlyingMob: no gravity, drag 0.91.
            local wish = m.flyDir or Vector3.zero
            v = v + wish * (m.flySpeed or 0.02) * B
            moveEntity(m, v)
            v = v * 0.91
            m.velocity = v
            return
        end
        if water and (swimmers[m.id] or m.id == "drowned" or m.id == "axolotl" or m.id == "turtle") then
            -- Swimming mobs: no gravity in water, drag 0.9.
            local wish = m.swimDir or Vector3.zero
            v = v + wish * (m.swimSpeed or 0.02) * B
            moveEntity(m, v)
            m.velocity = v * 0.9
            return
        end
        if water or lava then
            -- LivingEntity.travel in fluids: 0.02 acceleration, drag 0.8 (lava 0.5), gravity /4.
            local dir = forwardOf(m.yaw) * forward + forwardOf(m.yaw - math.pi / 2) * strafe
            v = v + dir * 0.02 * B
            if m.jumping then v = v + Vector3.new(0, 0.04 * B, 0) end
            moveEntity(m, v)
            local drag = water and 0.8 or 0.5
            v = Vector3.new(v.X * drag, v.Y * 0.8 - 0.02 * B, v.Z * drag)
            if m.horizontalCollision and m.jumping then v = Vector3.new(v.X, 0.3 * B, v.Z) end
            m.velocity = v
            return
        end
        -- Resting on the ground with no input: no casts (the ground is re-checked every 10 ticks).
        if m.onGround and (m.zza or 0) == 0 and (m.xxa or 0) == 0 and not m.jumping and flat(v).Magnitude < 0.002 * B and (m.age % 10) ~= 0 then
            -- Keep the settled downward motion so the next real move still finds the ground.
            m.velocity = Vector3.new(0, -(mobs.attr(m, "gravity") or 0.08) * 0.98 * B, 0)
            return
        end
        -- Ground: block friction 0.6 (drag 0.6 * 0.91), acceleration speed * 0.21600002 / 0.6^3 = speed;
        -- air: 0.02. The input is zza/xxa * 0.98 (AI sets zza to its speed, riders to 1).
        local f = m.onGround and 0.546 or 0.91
        local accel = m.onGround and speed or 0.02 * (m.airSpeedScale or 1)
        local input = (forwardOf(m.yaw) * forward + forwardOf(m.yaw - math.pi / 2) * strafe) * 0.98
        if input.Magnitude > 1 then input = input.Unit end
        v = v + input * accel * B
        if m.jumping and m.onGround and (m.jumpDelay or 0) <= 0 then
            local jump = (mobs.attr(m, "jump_strength") or 0.42)
            v = Vector3.new(v.X, jump * B, v.Z)
            m.jumpDelay = 10
        end
        if m.flags.climbing and m.horizontalCollision then v = Vector3.new(v.X, 0.2 * B, v.Z) end
        moveEntity(m, v)
        if m.verticalCollision then v = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z) end
        local gravity = (mobs.attr(m, "gravity") or 0.08) * B
        if m.slowFalling then gravity = 0.01 * B end
        v = Vector3.new(v.X * f, (v.Y - gravity) * 0.98, v.Z * f)
        m.velocity = v
        if m.jumpDelay then m.jumpDelay = m.jumpDelay - 1 end
    end
    mobs.travel = travel

    -- Pathfinding (PathFinder + WalkNodeEvaluator, simplified to block cells) ------------------------
    local function free(c, height)
        for i = 0, math.max(0, math.ceil(height - 0.01) - 1) do
            local t = cellType(c + Vector3.new(0, i * B, 0))
            if t == 1 or t == 4 or t == 3 then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function standable(c, height, canSwim)
        local t = cellType(c)
        if t == 2 then return canSwim end
        if not free(c, height) then return false end
        local below = cellType(c - Vector3.new(0, B, 0))
        return below == 1 or below == 4 or (below == 2 and canSwim)
    end
    -- Finds a path of cell centres from start to goal (or the closest reachable cell).
    function mobs.findPath(m, goal, maxNodes)
        local start = cellOf(m.position + Vector3.new(0, 0.3 * B, 0))
        local target = cellOf(goal + Vector3.new(0, 0.3 * B, 0))
        local height = m.height * (m.baby and 0.5 or 1)
        local canSwim = true
        maxNodes = maxNodes or math.min(400, math.floor(mobs.attr(m, "follow_range") * 16))
        local open, cameFrom, g = {}, {}, {}
        local function key(c) return cellKey(c) end
        local function hdist(a, b) return (a - b).Magnitude / B end
        local sk = key(start)
        g[sk] = 0
        open[1] = {c = start, k = sk, f = hdist(start, target)}
        local best, bestH = start, hdist(start, target)
        local closed = {}
        local visited = 0
        local dirs = {Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)}
        while #open > 0 and visited < maxNodes do
            -- pop lowest f
            local bi = 1
            for i = 2, #open do if open[i].f < open[bi].f then bi = i end end
            local node = table.remove(open, bi)
            if not closed[node.k] then
                closed[node.k] = true
                visited = visited + 1
                local hh = hdist(node.c, target)
                if hh < bestH then best, bestH = node.c, hh end
                if hh < 0.5 then best = node.c; break end
                for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
                    local candidates = {}
                    local side = node.c + d * B
                    if standable(side, height, canSwim) then candidates[1] = {side, 1}
                    elseif free(node.c + Vector3.new(0, B, 0), height) and standable(side + Vector3.new(0, B, 0), height, canSwim) and cellType(side) ~= 4 then
                        candidates[1] = {side + Vector3.new(0, B, 0), 2}
                    elseif free(side, height) then
                        for drop = 1, 3 do
                            local down = side - Vector3.new(0, drop * B, 0)
                            if standable(down, height, canSwim) then candidates[1] = {down, 1 + drop * 0.5}; break end
                            if not free(down, 1) then break end
                        end
                    end
                    for _, cand in ipairs(candidates) do
                        local c, cost = cand[1], cand[2]
                        local t = cellType(c)
                        if t == 2 then cost = cost + 8 elseif t == 5 or cellType(c - Vector3.new(0, B, 0)) == 5 then cost = cost + 16 end
                        local ck = key(c)
                        local ng = g[node.k] + cost
                        if not closed[ck] and (not g[ck] or ng < g[ck]) then
                            g[ck] = ng; cameFrom[ck] = node
                            open[#open + 1] = {c = c, k = ck, f = ng + hdist(c, target)}
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        -- Rebuild
        local path = {}
        local k = key(best)
        local cur = best
        while cur do
            table.insert(path, 1, cur - Vector3.new(0, B / 2, 0))
            local prev = cameFrom[k]
            if not prev then break end
            cur, k = prev.c, prev.k
        end
        return path, bestH < 0.6
    end

    -- Navigation and controls ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local pathBudget = 0
    function mobs.moveTo(m, goal, speedModifier)
        m.navGoal, m.navSpeed = goal, speedModifier or 1
        if m.flying or flyers[m.id] or (m.inWater and swimmers[m.id]) then m.path = {goal}; m.pathIndex = 1; return true end
        if pathBudget <= 0 then m.pathPending = true; return true end
        pathBudget = pathBudget - 1
        m.pathPending = false
        m.path, m.pathReaches = mobs.findPath(m, goal)
        m.pathIndex = math.min(2, #m.path)
        m.pathTick = tick
        return #m.path > 0
    end
    function mobs.stop(m) m.path, m.navGoal, m.pathPending = nil, nil, false; m.zza = 0; m.moveSpeed = 0 end
    function mobs.isDone(m) return not m.path or not m.pathIndex or m.pathIndex > #m.path end
    local function followPath(m)
        if m.pathPending and m.navGoal then mobs.moveTo(m, m.navGoal, m.navSpeed) end
        if mobs.isDone(m) then m.zza = 0; m.moveSpeed = 0; m.flyDir = nil; m.swimDir = nil; return end
        local node = m.path[m.pathIndex]
        local d = node - m.position
        -- PathNavigation.maxDistanceToWaypoint: width/2 for wide mobs, else 0.75 - width/2.
        local reach = (m.width > 0.75 and m.width / 2 or 0.75 - m.width / 2) * B
        if flat(d).Magnitude < reach and math.abs(d.Y) < 1.2 * B then
            m.pathIndex = m.pathIndex + 1
            if mobs.isDone(m) then m.zza = 0; m.moveSpeed = 0; return end
            node = m.path[m.pathIndex]; d = node - m.position
        end
        local speed = mobs.attr(m, "movement_speed") * (m.navSpeed or 1)
        if m.flying or flyers[m.id] then
            m.flyDir = d.Magnitude > 0.01 and d.Unit or Vector3.zero
            -- FlyingMoveControl: input = flying_speed, air acceleration 0.02.
            m.flySpeed = (mobs.attr(m, "flying_speed") or 0.4) * (m.navSpeed or 1) * 0.02
            m.targetYaw = yawTo(d)
            return
        end
        if m.inWater and swimmers[m.id] then
            m.swimDir = d.Magnitude > 0.01 and d.Unit or Vector3.zero
            m.swimSpeed = speed * 0.01 -- AbstractFish.travel: moveRelative(0.01, speed)
            m.targetYaw = yawTo(d)
            return
        end
        -- MoveControl.tick: turn at most 90 degrees a tick, walk forward, jump at higher nodes.
        m.targetYaw = yawTo(d)
        m.yaw = approachAngle(m.yaw, m.targetYaw, math.rad(90))
        m.moveSpeed = speed
        m.zza = speed
        m.jumping = (d.Y > 0.5 * B and flat(d).Magnitude < 1.5 * B) or (m.horizontalCollision and m.onGround)
        -- Stuck: recompute after 3 seconds without progress.
        if tick - (m.pathTick or 0) > 60 and m.navGoal and (m.lastProgress or 0) < tick - 60 then mobs.moveTo(m, m.navGoal, m.navSpeed) end
    end
    -- LookControl: 10 degrees of yaw (head) and 40 of pitch a tick towards the look target.
    local function lookTick(m)
        if m.lookAt then
            local d = m.lookAt - (m.position + Vector3.new(0, m.eye * m.scale, 0))
            local wantYaw = yawTo(d)
            local wantPitch = math.atan2(d.Y, flat(d).Magnitude)
            m.headYaw = approachAngle(m.headYaw, wantYaw, math.rad(m.lookSpeed or 10))
            m.headPitch = m.headPitch + math.clamp(-wantPitch - m.headPitch, -math.rad(40), math.rad(40))
            m.lookTicks = (m.lookTicks or 0) - 1
            if m.lookTicks <= 0 then m.lookAt = nil end
        else
            m.headYaw = approachAngle(m.headYaw, m.yaw, math.rad(10))
            m.headPitch = m.headPitch * 0.8
        end
        -- BodyRotationControl: the body follows movement; idle bodies turn toward the head past 75 degrees.
        if (m.zza or 0) ~= 0 or flat(m.velocity).Magnitude > 0.003 * B then
            m.bodyYaw = approachAngle(m.bodyYaw or m.yaw, m.yaw, math.rad(15))
            m.headYaw = m.bodyYaw + math.clamp(wrap(m.headYaw - m.bodyYaw), -math.rad(75), math.rad(75))
        else
            local diff = wrap(m.headYaw - (m.bodyYaw or m.yaw))
            if math.abs(diff) > math.rad(75) then m.bodyYaw = (m.bodyYaw or m.yaw) + diff - math.rad(75) * (diff > 0 and 1 or -1) end
        end
        m.bodyYaw = m.bodyYaw or m.yaw
    end
    function mobs.lookAt(m, point, ticks, speed) m.lookAt, m.lookTicks, m.lookSpeed = point, ticks or 2, speed or 10 end

    -- Damage ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function knockback(m, from, strength)
        local resist = mobs.attr(m, "knockback_resistance") or 0
