        strength = strength * (1 - resist)
        if strength <= 0 then return end
        local d = flat(m.position - from)
        if d.Magnitude < 1e-4 then d = Vector3.new(rand() - 0.5, 0, rand() - 0.5) end
        d = d.Unit
        -- LivingEntity.knockback: halve the old motion, push `strength` blocks/tick away from the
        -- attacker and, on the ground, up by min(0.4, y / 2 + strength).
        local v = m.velocity / 2 + d * strength * B
        m.velocity = Vector3.new(v.X, m.onGround and math.min(0.4 * B, m.velocity.Y / 2 + strength * B) or m.velocity.Y, v.Z)
    end
    mobs.knockback = knockback
    -- EntityType.fireImmune.
    mobs.fireImmune = {blaze = true, ghast = true, happy_ghast = true, magma_cube = true, strider = true, wither = true, wither_skeleton = true,
        zombified_piglin = true, zoglin = true, ender_dragon = true, warden = false}
    -- The fire block in any cell the mob's box covers.
    function mobs.fireAt(m)
        if not (world.cell and world.nodeAt) then return nil end
        local cells = math.max(1, math.ceil(m.height * m.scale / B - 0.01))
        for y = 0, cells - 1 do
            local n = world.nodeAt(world.cell(m.position + Vector3.new(0, y * B + 0.05, 0)))
            if n and (n.id == "fire" or n.id == "soul_fire") then return n end
        end
    end
    function mobs.hurt(m, amount, source)
        -- A copy of another player's mob: the hit goes to its owner, who applies it.
        if m.puppet then
            if m.humanoid.Health <= 0 or (m.invulnerableTime or 0) > 10 then return false end
            m.invulnerableTime, m.hurtTime = 20, 10
            if mobs.puppetHit then pcall(mobs.puppetHit, m, amount) end
            if MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.play("entity." .. m.id .. ".hurt", m.position, MinecraftSounds.mobVolume(m), 1) end
            return true
        end
        if m.humanoid.Health <= 0 or (m.invulnerable or 0) > 0 or (m.invulnerableTicks or 0) > 0 then return false end
        if mobs.onHurt and mobs.onHurt(m, amount, source) == false then return false end
        -- LivingEntity.hurtServer: within 10 ticks of the last hit only a bigger hit counts (the difference).
        if (m.invulnerableTime or 0) > 10 then
            if amount <= (m.lastHurtAmount or 0) then return false end
            local extra = amount - (m.lastHurtAmount or 0)
            m.lastHurtAmount = amount
            amount = extra
        else
            m.lastHurtAmount, m.invulnerableTime = amount, 20
        end
        local armor = mobs.attr(m, "armor") or 0
        -- Breach (mace): armour counts 15% less per level.
        if source and source.breach then armor = armor * math.max(0, 1 - 0.15 * source.breach) end
        -- CombatRules.getDamageAfterAbsorb (toughness 0).
        amount = amount * (1 - math.clamp(armor - amount / 2, armor * 0.2, 20) / 25)
        m.ownHurt = true
        m.humanoid:TakeDamage(amount)
        if MinecraftSounds then
            MinecraftSounds.play("entity." .. m.id .. (m.humanoid.Health <= 0 and ".death" or ".hurt"), m.position, MinecraftSounds.mobVolume(m), (math.random() - math.random()) * 0.2 + (m.baby and 1.5 or 1))
        end
        return true
    end
    function mobs.hurtPlayer(amount, source)
        local hum = playerHum()
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or creative() then return false end
        local a = api
        if a.blocking and source and source.position then
            local toward = flat(source.position - player.pos())
            local look = flat(world.look and world.look() or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
            if toward.Magnitude > 0 and look.Magnitude > 0 and toward.Unit:Dot(look.Unit) > 0 then return false end
        end
        local dmg = a.armorDamage and a.armorDamage(amount) or amount
        hum:TakeDamage(dmg * hum.MaxHealth / 20)
        if source and source.position and world.knockback then
            local d = flat(player.pos() - source.position)
            if d.Magnitude > 0 then world.knockback(d.Unit * 0.4 + Vector3.new(0, 0.36, 0)) end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function onHealthChanged(m)
        local now = m.humanoid.Health
        if now < m.lastHealth then
            -- Taken damage: red flash, knockback from whoever hit (the player unless a mob did it).
            m.hurtTime, m.hurtDuration = 10, 10
            if not m.ownHurt then
                m.lastHurtBy, m.lastHurtTick = player, tick
                -- LivingEntity.hurt: 0.4 away from the attacker; Player.attack: +0.5 when sprinting.
                knockback(m, player.pos(), 0.4)
                if api.sprinting then knockback(m, player.pos(), 0.5) end
                if mobs.onPlayerHit then mobs.onPlayerHit(m) end
            end
            m.ownHurt = false
            if world.vibrate then world.vibrate(m.position, 7, {mob = m}) end
        end
        m.lastHealth = now
    end
    local function die(m)
        if m.deathTime == 0 then
            if mobs.onDeath then mobs.onDeath(m) end
            -- Loot and experience (killed by a player when the player hit it last within 100 ticks).
            local byPlayer = m.lastHurtBy == player and tick - (m.lastHurtTick or -1000) < 100
            steveEmit("mob_died", {id = m.id, name = m.customName, byPlayer = byPlayer, position = m.position})
            local tableData = data.entityLoot and data.entityLoot[m.id]
            if not m.baby then
                for _, stack in ipairs(tableData and LootRules.roll(tableData, {player = byPlayer}) or {}) do
                    local e = JavaContent.itemById[stack.name]
                    if e then world.drop({id = e.index, count = stack.count}, m.position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * B, 0), Vector3.new(rand() - 0.5, 1, rand() - 0.5) * B * 2, true) end
                end
                if m.item and (m.guaranteed or rand() < 0.085) then local e = JavaContent.itemById[m.item]; if e then world.drop({id = e.index, count = 1}, m.position, nil, true) end end
                if byPlayer and world.spawnXp then
                    local xp = xpReward[m.id] or (mobs.hostile[m.id] and 5 or (1 + math.random(0, 2)))
                    world.spawnXp(m.position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * B, 0), xp)
                end
            end
            if world.vibrate then world.vibrate(m.position, 15, {mob = m}) end
        end
        m.deathTime = m.deathTime + 1
        if m.deathTime >= 20 then
            for _ = 1, 20 do particle("poof", m.position + Vector3.new(rand() - 0.5, rand() * m.height, rand() - 0.5) * m.scale, Vector3.new(rand() - 0.5, rand() * 0.2, rand() - 0.5) * B * 0.1, {life = 15, size = 0.25}) end
            mobs.remove(m)
        end
    end
    function mobs.remove(m)
        if m.removed then return end
        m.removed = true
        if mobs.onRemove then mobs.onRemove(m) end
        if m.equipment then for _, v in pairs(m.equipment) do if v.visual then v.visual.model:Destroy() end end end
        if m.nameGui then m.nameGui:Destroy() end
        if m.leashLine then m.leashLine:Destroy() end
        if m.visual.destroy then m.visual.destroy() else m.visual.model:Destroy() end
        for i, x in ipairs(mobs.list) do if x == m then table.remove(mobs.list, i); break end end
    end

    -- GoalSelector: goals by priority; a running goal blocks lower-priority goals sharing a flag
    -- (MOVE, LOOK, JUMP, TARGET). canUse is checked every other tick (Java's tickCount % 2).
    local Goal = {}
    local function goal(priority, flags, def) def.priority, def.flags = priority, flags; return def end
    mobs.goal = goal
    local function addGoal(m, priority, flags, def) m.goals[#m.goals + 1] = goal(priority, flags, def) end
    local function addTarget(m, priority, def) m.targetGoals[#m.targetGoals + 1] = goal(priority, {target = true}, def) end
    mobs.addGoal, mobs.addTarget = addGoal, addTarget
    local function runSelector(m, list)
        table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.priority < b.priority end)
        local busy = {}
        for _, g in ipairs(list) do
            if g.running then
                if not g.canContinue or not g.canContinue(m, g) then g.running = false; if g.stop then g.stop(m, g) end
                else for f in pairs(g.flags) do busy[f] = g.priority end end
            end
        end
        if tick % 2 == 0 then
            for _, g in ipairs(list) do
                if not g.running then
                    local blocked = false
                    for f in pairs(g.flags) do if busy[f] and busy[f] <= g.priority then blocked = true end end
                    if not blocked and g.canUse(m, g) then
                        -- Preempt lower-priority goals using the same flags.
                        for _, other in ipairs(list) do
                            if other.running and other.priority > g.priority then
                                for f in pairs(g.flags) do if other.flags[f] then other.running = false; if other.stop then other.stop(m, other) end; break end end
                            end
                        end
                        g.running = true
                        if g.start then g.start(m, g) end
                        for f in pairs(g.flags) do busy[f] = g.priority end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for _, g in ipairs(list) do if g.running and g.tick then g.tick(m, g) end end
    end
    local MOVE, LOOK, JUMP, MOVE_LOOK = {move = true}, {look = true}, {jump = true}, {move = true, look = true}
    mobs.MOVE, mobs.LOOK, mobs.MOVE_LOOK = MOVE, LOOK, MOVE_LOOK

    local function dist(a, b) return (posOf(a) - posOf(b)).Magnitude / B end
    local function distM(m, p) return (m.position - p).Magnitude / B end
    local function canSee(m, e)
        local from = m.position + Vector3.new(0, m.eye * m.scale, 0)
        local to = eyeOf(e)
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(from, to - from, castParams)
        if not hit then return true end
        if e.isPlayer then return hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character) end
        return hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(e.visual.model)
    end
    mobs.canSee = canSee
    -- DefaultRandomPos.getPos / LandRandomPos: a walkable spot within h blocks horizontally, v vertically.
    local function randomPos(m, h, v, awayFrom, toward)
        for _ = 1, 10 do
            local off = Vector3.new(math.random(-h, h), math.random(-v, v), math.random(-h, h))
            if awayFrom then
                local away = flat(m.position - awayFrom)
                if away.Magnitude > 0 and off:Dot(away) < 0 then off = Vector3.new(-off.X, off.Y, -off.Z) end
            elseif toward then
                local dir = flat(toward - m.position)
                if dir.Magnitude > 0 and off:Dot(dir) < 0 then off = Vector3.new(-off.X, off.Y, -off.Z) end
            end
            local c = cellOf(m.position + off * B + Vector3.new(0, 0.3 * B, 0))
            for dy = 0, v do
                local cc = c - Vector3.new(0, dy * B, 0)
                local t = cellType(cc)
                local below = cellType(cc - Vector3.new(0, B, 0))
                if t == 0 and (below == 1 or below == 4) then return cc - Vector3.new(0, B / 2, 0) end
                if t ~= 0 then break end
            end
        end
    end
    mobs.randomPos = randomPos
    local function holding(e, test)
        if not e.isPlayer then return false end
        local a, b = h.inventory.slots[h.ui.selected], h.inventory.slots[41]
        return (a ~= nil and test(Recipes.name(a)) == true) or (b ~= nil and test(Recipes.name(b)) == true)
    end

    -- Common goals ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    function Goal.float(m)
        -- FloatGoal: swim up in water / lava.
        return {canUse = function() return m.inWater or m.inLava end, canContinue = function() return m.inWater or m.inLava end,
            tick = function() if math.random() < 0.8 then m.jumping = true end end}
    end
    function Goal.panic(speed)
        -- PanicGoal: after being hurt (or on fire), run to a random spot within 5 blocks.
        return {canUse = function(m) if not (m.lastHurtTick and tick - m.lastHurtTick < 2 or m.onFire) then return false end
                local p = randomPos(m, 5, 4); if not p then return false end; m.panicTarget = p; return true end,
            start = function(m) mobs.moveTo(m, m.panicTarget, speed); m.panicking = true end,
            canContinue = function(m) return not mobs.isDone(m) end, stop = function(m) m.panicking = false end}
    end
    function Goal.stroll(speed, interval, swim)
        -- RandomStrollGoal / WaterAvoidingRandomStrollGoal: 1/120 chance a tick to wander up to 10 blocks.
        interval = interval or 120
        return {canUse = function(m)
                if m.noWander or m.sitting then return false end
                if math.random(interval) ~= 1 then return false end
                local p = randomPos(m, 10, 7); if not p then return false end; m.strollTarget = p; return true end,
            start = function(m) mobs.moveTo(m, m.strollTarget, speed) end,
            canContinue = function(m) return not mobs.isDone(m) and not m.sitting end, stop = function(m) mobs.stop(m) end}
    end
    function Goal.fly(speed)
        -- WaterAvoidingRandomFlyingGoal / random hovering for flyers.
        return {canUse = function(m) if math.random(60) ~= 1 then return false end
                m.strollTarget = m.position + Vector3.new(math.random(-8, 8), math.random(-3, 4), math.random(-8, 8)) * B; return true end,
            start = function(m) m.flying = true; mobs.moveTo(m, m.strollTarget, speed) end,
            canContinue = function(m) return not mobs.isDone(m) and distM(m, m.strollTarget) > 1 end, stop = function(m) mobs.stop(m) end}
    end
    function Goal.swim(speed)
        -- RandomSwimmingGoal
        return {canUse = function(m) if not m.inWater or math.random(40) ~= 1 then return false end
                m.strollTarget = m.position + Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10), math.random(-3, 3), math.random(-10, 10)) * B; return true end,
            start = function(m) mobs.moveTo(m, m.strollTarget, speed) end,
            canContinue = function(m) return m.inWater and not mobs.isDone(m) and distM(m, m.strollTarget) > 1 end, stop = function(m) mobs.stop(m) end}
    end
    function Goal.lookAtPlayer(range, chance)
        -- LookAtPlayerGoal: 2% a tick to look at a player within range for 40-80 ticks.
        range, chance = range or 8, chance or 0.02
        return {canUse = function(m) return player.alive() and math.random() < chance and dist(m, player) < range end,
            start = function(m, g) g.left = 40 + math.random(0, 39) end,
            canContinue = function(m, g) return player.alive() and dist(m, player) < range and g.left > 0 end,
            tick = function(m, g) g.left = g.left - 1; mobs.lookAt(m, eyeOf(player), 2) end}
    end
    function Goal.lookAround()
        -- RandomLookAroundGoal
        return {canUse = function() return math.random() < 0.02 end,
            start = function(m, g) local a = math.random() * math.pi * 2; g.dir = Vector3.new(math.cos(a), 0, math.sin(a)); g.left = 20 + math.random(0, 19) end,
            canContinue = function(m, g) return g.left > 0 end,
            tick = function(m, g) g.left = g.left - 1; mobs.lookAt(m, m.position + Vector3.new(0, m.eye * m.scale, 0) + g.dir * B * 4, 2) end}
    end
    function Goal.tempt(speed, test)
        -- TemptGoal: follow a player holding food within tempt range (10), stop at 2.5 blocks.
        return {canUse = function(m) if (m.temptCooldown or 0) > 0 then m.temptCooldown = m.temptCooldown - 1; return false end
                return player.alive() and dist(m, player) < (mobs.attr(m, "tempt_range") or 10) and holding(player, test) end,
            canContinue = function(m) return player.alive() and holding(player, test) and dist(m, player) < 12 end,
            tick = function(m) mobs.lookAt(m, eyeOf(player), 2, 30)
                if dist(m, player) < 2.5 then mobs.stop(m) elseif tick % 10 == 0 then mobs.moveTo(m, player.pos(), speed) end end,
            stop = function(m) m.temptCooldown = 100; mobs.stop(m) end}
    end
    function Goal.followParent(speed)
        -- FollowParentGoal: babies follow the nearest adult of their kind 3-8 blocks away.
        return {canUse = function(m) if not m.baby then return false end
                local best, bd
                for _, o in ipairs(mobs.list) do if o ~= m and o.id == m.id and not o.baby and aliveOf(o) then local d = dist(m, o); if d < 8 and (not bd or d < bd) then best, bd = o, d end end end
                if not best or bd < 3 then return false end; m.parent = best; return true end,
            canContinue = function(m) return m.parent and aliveOf(m.parent) and dist(m, m.parent) >= 3 and dist(m, m.parent) <= 16 end,
            tick = function(m) if tick % 10 == 0 then mobs.moveTo(m, posOf(m.parent), speed) end end, stop = function(m) mobs.stop(m) end}
    end
    function Goal.breed(speed)
        -- BreedGoal: in-love animals walk to a partner (the items module spawns the baby when close).
        return {canUse = function(m) if (m.love or 0) <= 0 then return false end
                for _, o in ipairs(mobs.list) do if o ~= m and o.id == m.id and (o.love or 0) > 0 and dist(m, o) < 8 then m.partner = o; return true end end
                return false end,
            canContinue = function(m) return m.partner and (m.love or 0) > 0 and aliveOf(m.partner) end,
            tick = function(m) mobs.lookAt(m, eyeOf(m.partner), 2); if tick % 10 == 0 then mobs.moveTo(m, posOf(m.partner), speed) end end, stop = function(m) mobs.stop(m) end}
    end
    function Goal.avoid(test, range, walk, sprint)
        -- AvoidEntityGoal: flee from matching entities within range.
        return {canUse = function(m)
                local threat
                if test(player) and player.alive() and dist(m, player) < range then threat = player end
                if not threat then for _, o in ipairs(mobs.list) do if o ~= m and aliveOf(o) and test(o) and dist(m, o) < range then threat = o; break end end end
                if not threat then return false end
                local p = randomPos(m, 16, 7, posOf(threat)); if not p then return false end
                m.fleeFrom, m.fleeTo = threat, p; return true end,
            start = function(m) mobs.moveTo(m, m.fleeTo, walk) end,
            canContinue = function(m) return not mobs.isDone(m) end,
            tick = function(m) m.navSpeed = dist(m, m.fleeFrom) < 7 and sprint or walk end, stop = function(m) mobs.stop(m) end}
    end
    function Goal.melee(speed, followUnseen)
        -- MeleeAttackGoal: path to the target, hit within reach every 20 ticks.
        return {canUse = function(m) return m.target and aliveOf(m.target) end,
            canContinue = function(m) return m.target and aliveOf(m.target) and (followUnseen or canSee(m, m.target) or tick % 20 ~= 0) end,
            start = function(m, g) g.ticksUntilPath, g.cooldown = 0, 0; m.aggressive = true end,
            stop = function(m) m.aggressive = false; mobs.stop(m) end,
            tick = function(m, g)
                local t = m.target
                mobs.lookAt(m, eyeOf(t), 2, 30)
                g.ticksUntilPath = g.ticksUntilPath - 1
                if g.ticksUntilPath <= 0 then
                    g.ticksUntilPath = 4 + math.random(0, 6)
                    local d = dist(m, t)
                    if d > 32 then g.ticksUntilPath = g.ticksUntilPath + 10 elseif d > 16 then g.ticksUntilPath = g.ticksUntilPath + 5 end
                    mobs.moveTo(m, posOf(t), speed)
                end
                g.cooldown = math.max(0, g.cooldown - 1)
                -- Reach: (width*2)^2 + target width.
                local reach = (m.width * 2) * (m.width * 2) + (t.isPlayer and 0.6 or t.width)
                local d = posOf(t) - m.position
                if d.Magnitude / B * d.Magnitude / B <= reach + 1 and g.cooldown <= 0 and math.abs(d.Y) < 2 * B then
                    g.cooldown = 20
                    m.attackAnim, m.swingStart = 1, tick
                    mobs.doHurtTarget(m, t)
                end
            end}
    end
    function Goal.leap(yd)
        -- LeapAtTargetGoal: 2-4 blocks away on the ground, 1 in 5 per check.
        return {canUse = function(m) if not (m.target and m.onGround) then return false end
                local d = dist(m, m.target); return d >= 2 and d <= 4 and math.random(5) == 1 end,
            start = function(m) local d = flat(posOf(m.target) - m.position); if d.Magnitude > 0 then d = d.Unit end
                m.velocity = Vector3.new(d.X * 0.4 * B + m.velocity.X * 0.2, yd * B, d.Z * 0.4 * B + m.velocity.Z * 0.2) end,
            canContinue = function(m) return not m.onGround end}
    end
    function Goal.moveTowardsRestriction() return {canUse = function() return false end} end
    -- Target goals -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    function Goal.nearestPlayer(mustSee, condition)
        -- NearestAttackableTargetGoal<Player>: every 10 ticks on average, within follow range.
        return {canUse = function(m)
                if math.random(10) ~= 1 then return false end
                if creative() or not player.alive() then return false end
                if condition and not condition(m) then return false end
                if dist(m, player) > mobs.attr(m, "follow_range") then return false end
                if mustSee and not canSee(m, player) then return false end
                return true end,
            start = function(m) m.target = player end,
            canContinue = function(m) return m.target == player and player.alive() and not creative() and dist(m, player) < mobs.attr(m, "follow_range") * 1.2 end,
            stop = function(m) if m.target == player then m.target = nil end end}
    end
    function Goal.nearestMob(test, mustSee)
        return {canUse = function(m)
                if math.random(10) ~= 1 then return false end
                local best, bd
                for _, o in ipairs(mobs.list) do
                    if o ~= m and aliveOf(o) and test(o) then
                        local d = dist(m, o)
                        if d < mobs.attr(m, "follow_range") and (not bd or d < bd) and (not mustSee or canSee(m, o)) then best, bd = o, d end
                    end
                end
                if best then m.pendingTarget = best end
                return best ~= nil end,
            start = function(m) m.target = m.pendingTarget end,
            canContinue = function(m) return m.target and aliveOf(m.target) and dist(m, m.target) < mobs.attr(m, "follow_range") * 1.2 end,
            stop = function(m) m.target = nil end}
    end
    function Goal.hurtBy(alertOthers)
        -- HurtByTargetGoal: retaliate (and call others of the same kind).
        return {canUse = function(m) return m.lastHurtBy and m.lastHurtTick and tick - m.lastHurtTick < 4 and aliveOf(m.lastHurtBy) and not (m.lastHurtBy.isPlayer and creative()) end,
            start = function(m)
                m.target = m.lastHurtBy
                if alertOthers then for _, o in ipairs(mobs.list) do if o ~= m and o.id == m.id and dist(m, o) < 10 then o.target = m.lastHurtBy; o.angryUntil = tick + 400 end end end
            end,
            canContinue = function(m) return m.target and aliveOf(m.target) and not (m.target.isPlayer and creative()) and dist(m, m.target) < mobs.attr(m, "follow_range") * 1.2 end,
            stop = function(m) m.target = nil end}
    end
    mobs.Goal = Goal

    function mobs.doHurtTarget(m, t)
        -- Mob.doHurtTarget: attack damage (difficulty Normal), knockback away from the mob.
        local damage = mobs.attr(m, "attack_damage") or 2
        if m.id == "iron_golem" then damage = damage / 2 + math.random(0, math.floor(damage) - 1) end
        if mobs.onAttack and mobs.onAttack(m, t, damage) == false then return end
        if t.isPlayer then mobs.hurtPlayer(damage, m)
        else
            t.lastHurtBy, t.lastHurtTick = m, tick
            mobs.hurt(t, damage, m)
            knockback(t, m.position, 0.4)
        end
    end

    -- Mob projectiles (fireballs, snowballs, wind charges, shulker bullets, spit, skulls, potions, tridents)
    local shots = {}
    local function itemSprite(name) local e = JavaContent.itemById[name]; return e and e.icon end
    local function shotPart(sprite, size)
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name, p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.Transparency, p.Size = "MobShot", true, false, false, false, 1, Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
        local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        gui.Size, gui.LightInfluence = UDim2.fromScale(size * B, size * B), 0
        gui.Parent = p
        local content = sprite and JavaGui.content(sprite)
        if content then local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel"); img.BackgroundTransparency, img.Size, img.ImageContent, img.ResampleMode = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), content, Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated; img.Parent = gui end
        p.Parent = folder
        return p
    end
    local function shoot(m, kind, from, velocity, opts)
        opts = opts or {}
        local sprite = itemSprite(({large_fireball = "fire_charge", small_fireball = "fire_charge", snowball = "snowball", wind_charge = "wind_charge", llama_spit = "white_dye",
            wither_skull = "wither_skeleton_skull", potion = "splash_potion", trident = "trident", shulker_bullet = "end_rod", dragon_fireball = "dragon_breath"})[kind] or "snowball")
        shots[#shots + 1] = {kind = kind, position = from, previous = from, velocity = velocity, owner = m, age = 0, gravity = opts.gravity or 0,
            accel = opts.accel, target = opts.target, potion = opts.potion, part = shotPart(sprite, kind == "large_fireball" and 1 or 0.4)}
    end
    mobs.shoot = shoot
    local function explodeAt(p, power) if world.explode then world.explode(p, power) end end
    local function shotHit(s, hit)
        local m = hit and mobs.mobFrom(hit.Instance)
        local onPlayer = hit and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)
        local kind = s.kind
        local function damage(amount, extra)
            if onPlayer then mobs.hurtPlayer(amount, s.owner) elseif m and m ~= s.owner then m.lastHurtBy, m.lastHurtTick = s.owner, tick; mobs.hurt(m, amount, s.owner) end
            if extra then extra() end
        end
        if kind == "large_fireball" then damage(6); explodeAt(s.position, 1)
        elseif kind == "small_fireball" then
            damage(5)
            if not onPlayer and not m and hit and world.ignite then pcall(world.ignite, hit, nil) end
        elseif kind == "snowball" then if m and m.id == "blaze" then damage(3) elseif onPlayer then mobs.hurtPlayer(0, s.owner) end
        elseif kind == "wind_charge" then
            particle("gust", s.position, Vector3.zero, {life = 12, size = 1})
            local d = player.pos() - s.position
            if d.Magnitude < 2.5 * B and world.knockback then world.knockback((d.Magnitude > 0.01 and d.Unit or Vector3.yAxis) * 1.1 * (1 - d.Magnitude / (2.5 * B)) + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)) end
        elseif kind == "shulker_bullet" then damage(4, function() if onPlayer and world.statusEffects then world.statusEffects.give("levitation", 10, 0) end end)
        elseif kind == "llama_spit" then damage(1)
        elseif kind == "wither_skull" then
            damage(8, function() if onPlayer and world.statusEffects then world.statusEffects.give("wither", 10, 1) end end)
            -- WitherSkull.onHit: an explosion of power 1 (no fire).
            explodeAt(s.position, 1)
        elseif kind == "trident" then damage(8)
        elseif kind == "potion" then
            local d = (player.pos() - s.position).Magnitude / B
            if d < 4 and world.items then
                local stack = Recipes.stack("splash_potion", 1); stack.potion = s.potion
                world.items.drinkPotion(stack, 1 - d / 4)
            end
            for _ = 1, 20 do particle("effect", s.position, Vector3.new(rand() - 0.5, rand() * 0.5, rand() - 0.5) * B * 0.3, {life = 15, size = 0.12}) end
        elseif kind == "dragon_fireball" then
            if world.items then world.items.clouds[#world.items.clouds + 1] = {position = s.position, radius = 3, age = 0, duration = 600, stack = {potion = "harming"}, color = 0x9933CC, waitTime = 0, applied = {}} end
        end
    end
    local function stepShots()
        for i = #shots, 1, -1 do
            local s = shots[i]
            s.age = s.age + 1
            s.previous = s.position
            if s.accel then s.velocity = s.velocity * 0.95 + s.accel end
            if s.kind == "shulker_bullet" and s.target and aliveOf(s.target) then
                local d = eyeOf(s.target) - s.position
                s.velocity = s.velocity * 0.85 + d.Unit * 0.15 * 0.6 * B
            end
            local list = {s.part, folder}
            for _, x in ipairs(ignore) do if x ~= character then list[#list + 1] = x end end
            if s.owner and s.owner.visual then list[#list + 1] = s.owner.visual.model end
            castParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = list
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(s.position, s.velocity, castParams)
            castParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
            if hit then s.position = hit.Position; shotHit(s, hit); s.part:Destroy(); table.remove(shots, i)
            else
                s.position = s.position + s.velocity
                s.velocity = s.velocity * (s.gravity > 0 and 0.99 or 1) - Vector3.new(0, s.gravity * B, 0)
                if s.kind == "large_fireball" or s.kind == "small_fireball" then particle("smoke", s.position, Vector3.zero, {life = 10, size = 0.2}) end
                if s.age > 300 then s.part:Destroy(); table.remove(shots, i) end
            end
        end
    end
    local function aimAt(m, t, speed, inaccuracy, from)
        from = from or (m.position + Vector3.new(0, m.eye * m.scale, 0))
        local to = eyeOf(t) - Vector3.new(0, 0.3 * B, 0)
        local d = to - from
        local v = d.Unit * speed * B
        if inaccuracy and inaccuracy > 0 then v = v + Vector3.new(rand() - 0.5, rand() - 0.5, rand() - 0.5) * inaccuracy * 0.0075 * speed * B end
        return from, v
    end

    -- Specific behaviour goals ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    local Goal = mobs.Goal
    local function bowAttack(interval, range)
        -- RangedBowAttackGoal: strafe at 0.5..range*0.75, draw for 20 ticks, shoot (velocity 1.6).
        return {canUse = function(m) return m.target and aliveOf(m.target) end,
            canContinue = function(m) return m.target and aliveOf(m.target) end,
            start = function(m, g) g.seeTime, g.attackTime, g.strafeTime, g.strafeLeft = 0, -1, -1, false; m.aggressive = true end,
            stop = function(m) m.aggressive, m.usingItem = false, nil; mobs.stop(m) end,
            tick = function(m, g)
                local t = m.target
                local d = dist(m, t)
                local see = canSee(m, t)
                if see then g.seeTime = g.seeTime + 1 else g.seeTime = g.seeTime - 1 end
                if d <= range and g.seeTime >= 20 then mobs.stop(m); g.strafeTime = g.strafeTime + 1 elseif tick % 10 == 0 then mobs.moveTo(m, posOf(t), 1.0); g.strafeTime = -1 end
                if g.strafeTime >= 20 then
                    if rand() < 0.3 then g.strafeLeft = not g.strafeLeft end
                    g.strafeTime = 0
                end
                if g.strafeTime > -1 then
                    -- MoveControl.strafe: forward/sideways 0.5 each, scaled by the speed.
                    m.moveSpeed = mobs.attr(m, "movement_speed")
                    m.xxa = (g.strafeLeft and 0.5 or -0.5) * m.moveSpeed
                    m.zza = (d > range * 0.75 and 0.5 or d < range * 0.25 and -0.5 or 0) * m.moveSpeed
                    m.yaw = yawTo(posOf(t) - m.position)
                end
                mobs.lookAt(m, eyeOf(t), 2, 30)
                if m.usingItem then
                    if not see and g.seeTime < -60 then m.usingItem = nil
                    elseif see and tick - m.usingItem >= 20 then
                        m.usingItem = nil
                        local from, v = aimAt(m, t, 1.6, 14 - 2 * 4)
                        if api.shoot then api.shoot(from, v.Unit, 1.6 / 3 * 1.6, m, "arrow") end
                        g.attackTime = interval
                    end
                else
                    g.attackTime = g.attackTime - 1
                    if g.attackTime <= 0 and g.seeTime >= -60 then m.usingItem = tick end
                end
            end}
    end
    local function crossbowAttack()
        -- RangedCrossbowAttackGoal: charge 25 ticks, wait 20-40, fire (velocity 1.6).
        return {canUse = function(m) return m.target and aliveOf(m.target) end, canContinue = function(m) return m.target and aliveOf(m.target) end,
            start = function(m, g) g.state, g.delay = "unloaded", 0; m.aggressive = true end,
            stop = function(m) m.aggressive, m.chargingCrossbow = false, false; mobs.stop(m) end,
            tick = function(m, g)
                local t = m.target
                mobs.lookAt(m, eyeOf(t), 2, 30)
                local see = canSee(m, t)
                if dist(m, t) > 8 or not see then if tick % 10 == 0 then mobs.moveTo(m, posOf(t), 1.0) end else mobs.stop(m) end
                if g.state == "unloaded" then g.state, g.delay = "charging", 25; m.chargingCrossbow = true
                elseif g.state == "charging" then g.delay = g.delay - 1; if g.delay <= 0 then g.state, g.delay = "charged", 20 + math.random(0, 19); m.chargingCrossbow = false end
                elseif g.state == "charged" then g.delay = g.delay - 1; if g.delay <= 0 and see then g.state = "ready" end
                elseif g.state == "ready" then
                    local from, v = aimAt(m, t, 1.6, 14 - 2 * 4)
                    if api.shoot then api.shoot(from, v.Unit, 1.6 / 3 * 1.6, m, "arrow") end
                    g.state = "unloaded"
                end
            end}
    end
    local function rangedShots(kind, interval, range, speed, onFire)
        -- Generic RangedAttackGoal (snow golem snowballs, witch potions, llama spit, breeze charges, wither skulls).
        return {canUse = function(m) return m.target and aliveOf(m.target) end, canContinue = function(m) return m.target and aliveOf(m.target) end,
            start = function(m, g) g.cool = interval; m.aggressive = true end, stop = function(m) m.aggressive = false; mobs.stop(m) end,
            tick = function(m, g)
                local t = m.target
                mobs.lookAt(m, eyeOf(t), 2, 30)
                local see = canSee(m, t)
                if dist(m, t) > range * 0.6 or not see then if tick % 10 == 0 then mobs.moveTo(m, posOf(t), 1.0) end else mobs.stop(m) end
                g.cool = g.cool - 1
                if g.cool <= 0 and see and dist(m, t) <= range then
                    g.cool = interval
                    if onFire then onFire(m, t) else
                        local from, v = aimAt(m, t, speed, 2)
                        shoot(m, kind, from, v + Vector3.new(0, (kind == "snowball" or kind == "potion") and dist(m, t) * 0.02 * B or 0, 0), {gravity = (kind == "snowball" or kind == "potion" or kind == "llama_spit") and 0.03 or 0})
                    end
                    m.attackAnim, m.swingStart = 1, tick
                end
            end}
    end
    local function swell()
        -- SwellGoal + Creeper.tick: fuse 30 ticks within 3 blocks (cancels past 7), explosion power 3.
        return {canUse = function(m) return (m.target and aliveOf(m.target) and dist(m, m.target) < 3) or (m.ignited or 0) > 0 end,
            canContinue = function(m) return (m.target and aliveOf(m.target) and dist(m, m.target) < 7 and canSee(m, m.target)) or (m.ignited or 0) > 0 end,
            start = function(m) mobs.stop(m); m.swellDir = 1 end, stop = function(m) m.swellDir = -1 end,
            tick = function(m) mobs.stop(m) end}
    end
    local function enderLook()
        -- EnderMan.isLookingAtMe: the player's view within ~atan(0.025/dist) of the head, with line of sight.
        return {canUse = function(m)
                if creative() or not player.alive() or dist(m, player) > 64 then return false end
                local helmet = api.equipped and api.equipped("helmet")
                if helmet == "carved_pumpkin" then return false end
                local look = world.look and world.look() or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
                local to = (m.position + Vector3.new(0, m.eye * m.scale, 0)) - player.eye()
                local d = to.Magnitude
                return look:Dot(to.Unit) > 1 - 0.025 / (d / B) and canSee(m, player) end,
            start = function(m) m.target = player; m.creepy = true; m.angryUntil = tick + 400 end,
            canContinue = function() return false end}
    end
    local function teleportRandom(m, around, range)
        -- EnderMan.teleport: up to 64 tries within 32 blocks onto solid ground, not into water.
        around, range = around or m.position, range or 32
        for _ = 1, 64 do
            local p = around + Vector3.new((rand() - 0.5) * 2 * range, math.random(-range / 2, range / 2), (rand() - 0.5) * 2 * range) * B
            local c = cellOf(p)
            for dy = 0, 16 do
                local cc = c - Vector3.new(0, dy * B, 0)
                if cellType(cc) == 0 and cellType(cc + Vector3.new(0, B, 0)) == 0 and cellType(cc + Vector3.new(0, 2 * B, 0)) == 0 and cellType(cc - Vector3.new(0, B, 0)) == 1 then
                    for _ = 1, 32 do particle("portal", m.position + Vector3.new(rand() - 0.5, rand() * 2.9, rand() - 0.5) * B, Vector3.new(rand() - 0.5, rand() - 0.5, rand() - 0.5) * B * 0.2, {life = 30, size = 0.1}) end
                    m.position = cc - Vector3.new(0, B / 2, 0); m.previous = m.position
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    mobs.teleportRandom = teleportRandom
    local function slimeMove()
        -- SlimeMoveControl: hop every 10-30 ticks (towards the target when it has one).
        return {canUse = function() return true end, canContinue = function() return true end,
            tick = function(m, g)
                g.delay = (g.delay or 0) - 1
                local t = m.target
                if t then m.yaw = approachAngle(m.yaw, yawTo(posOf(t) - m.position), math.rad(10)) elseif tick % 60 == 0 then m.yaw = rand() * math.pi * 2 end
                if m.onGround and g.delay <= 0 then
                    g.delay = math.random(10, 30) / (t and 3 or 1)
                    m.jumping = true
                    m.moveSpeed = mobs.attr(m, "movement_speed") * (m.size or 1) * 0.6
                    m.zza = m.moveSpeed
                    m.squish = 1
                elseif m.onGround then m.zza = 0; m.jumping = false end
                -- Damage on contact (Slime.dealDamage): size-based, not for the smallest slime.
                if t and t.isPlayer and (m.size or 1) > 1 and dist(m, t) < 0.6 * (m.size or 1) + 0.5 and tick % 10 == 0 and canSee(m, t) then
                    mobs.hurtPlayer((m.id == "magma_cube" and 2 or 1) * (m.size or 1), m)
                end
            end}
    end
    local function hover(range, minHeight)
        -- Flying idle: drift to random spots (ghast / blaze / bat / vex style).
        return {canUse = function(m) return math.random(20) == 1 end,
            start = function(m) m.flying = true; local p = m.position + Vector3.new((rand() - 0.5) * 2 * range, (rand() - 0.5) * range, (rand() - 0.5) * 2 * range) * B
                local ground = workspace:Raycast(p, Vector3.new(0, -64 * B, 0), castParams)
                if ground and p.Y - ground.Position.Y < (minHeight or 2) * B then p = Vector3.new(p.X, ground.Position.Y + (minHeight or 2) * B, p.Z) end
                mobs.moveTo(m, p, 1) end,
            canContinue = function(m) return not mobs.isDone(m) end, stop = function(m) mobs.stop(m) end}
    end
    local function followOwner(speed, minD, maxD)
        -- FollowOwnerGoal: tamed pets follow beyond 10 blocks, teleport beyond 12.
        return {canUse = function(m) return m.tamed and not m.sitting and player.alive() and dist(m, player) > (minD or 10) end,
            canContinue = function(m) return m.tamed and not m.sitting and dist(m, player) > (maxD or 2) end,
            tick = function(m)
                mobs.lookAt(m, player.eye(), 2, 30)
                if dist(m, player) >= 12 then
                    local p = player.pos() - flat(world.look and world.look() or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)) * B * 2
                    local c = cellOf(p + Vector3.new(0, 0.3 * B, 0))
                    if cellType(c) == 0 and cellType(c - Vector3.new(0, B, 0)) == 1 then m.position = c - Vector3.new(0, B / 2, 0); m.previous = m.position; mobs.stop(m) end
                elseif tick % 10 == 0 then mobs.moveTo(m, player.pos(), speed) end
            end, stop = function(m) mobs.stop(m) end}
    end
    local function sit()
        return {canUse = function(m) return m.sitting end, canContinue = function(m) return m.sitting end, start = function(m) mobs.stop(m) end, tick = function(m) m.zza = 0 end}
    end
    local function ownerDefense()
        -- OwnerHurtByTargetGoal + OwnerHurtTargetGoal: attack what hurt the owner or what the owner hit.
        return {canUse = function(m) return m.tamed and not m.sitting and mobs.ownerTarget and aliveOf(mobs.ownerTarget) and mobs.ownerTarget ~= m end,
            start = function(m) m.target = mobs.ownerTarget end,
            canContinue = function(m) return m.target and aliveOf(m.target) and not m.sitting end, stop = function(m) m.target = nil end}
    end
    local function eatGrass()
        -- EatBlockGoal: sheep eat grass (1/1000, babies 1/50) for 40 ticks and regrow wool.
        return {canUse = function(m) if math.random(m.baby and 50 or 1000) ~= 1 then return false end
                local below = world.nodeAt and world.nodeAt(cellOf(m.position - Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * B, 0))); return below ~= nil and below.id == "grass_block" end,
            start = function(m, g) g.left = 40; mobs.stop(m); m.eating = tick end,
            canContinue = function(m, g) return g.left > 0 end,
            tick = function(m, g) g.left = g.left - 1
                if g.left == 4 then
                    local c = cellOf(m.position - Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * B, 0)); local below = world.nodeAt(c)
                    if below and below.id == "grass_block" then
                        local dirt = JavaContent.byId.dirt; world.setBlockAt(c, dirt.index, CreativeRules.copy(dirt.state)); world.updateNeighbors()
                        if m.sheared then m.sheared = false; m.variantName = m.color or "white"; mobs.buildVisual(m) end
                    end
                end end,
            stop = function(m) m.eating = nil end}
    end

    -- Per-mob goal sets (each Mob.registerGoals) --------------------------------------------------------
    local function isUndead(id) return id:match("zombie") or id:match("skeleton") or id == "stray" or id == "bogged" or id == "husk" or id == "drowned" or id == "wither" or id == "phantom" or id == "zoglin" or id == "parched" end
    local function animal(m, speed, food, extra)
        local G = Goal
        mobs.addGoal(m, 0, JUMP, G.float(m))
        mobs.addGoal(m, 1, MOVE, G.panic(1.25 * (speed or 1)))
        mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE, G.breed(1.0))
        if food then mobs.addGoal(m, 3, MOVE_LOOK, G.tempt(1.2, food)) end
        mobs.addGoal(m, 4, MOVE, G.followParent(1.1))
        if extra then extra() end
        mobs.addGoal(m, 6, MOVE, G.stroll(1.0))
        mobs.addGoal(m, 7, LOOK, G.lookAtPlayer(6))
        mobs.addGoal(m, 8, LOOK, G.lookAround())
    end
    local function tagFood(tag) return function(n) return n and Recipes.tagged(tag, n) end end
    local function monster(m, attack, speed)
        local G = Goal
        mobs.addGoal(m, 0, JUMP, G.float(m))
        mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE_LOOK, attack or G.melee(speed or 1.0, false))
        mobs.addGoal(m, 7, MOVE, G.stroll(0.8))
        mobs.addGoal(m, 8, LOOK, G.lookAtPlayer(8))
        mobs.addGoal(m, 8, LOOK, G.lookAround())
        mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.hurtBy(false))
        mobs.addTarget(m, 2, G.nearestPlayer(true))
    end
    local villagerLike = function(o) return o.id == "villager" or o.id == "wandering_trader" end
    function mobs.setup(m)
        local id, G = m.id, Goal
        if id == "zombie" or id == "husk" or id == "drowned" or id == "zombie_villager" then
            monster(m, G.melee(1.0, false))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 3, G.nearestMob(function(o) return villagerLike(o) and not o.baby end, false))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 4, G.nearestMob(function(o) return o.id == "iron_golem" end, true))
            m.burnsInSun = id ~= "husk" and id ~= "drowned"
            m.armPose = "zombie"
        elseif id == "skeleton" or id == "stray" or id == "bogged" or id == "parched" then
            monster(m, bowAttack(m.id == "bogged" and 50 or 40, 15))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 3, MOVE, G.avoid(function(o) return o.id == "wolf" end, 6, 1.0, 1.2))
            m.burnsInSun = id ~= "parched"
            m.armPose = "bow"; m.item = "bow"
        elseif id == "wither_skeleton" then
            monster(m, G.melee(1.0, false)); m.item = "stone_sword"; m.armPose = "melee"
        elseif id == "creeper" then
            mobs.addGoal(m, 1, JUMP, G.float(m))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE, swell())
            mobs.addGoal(m, 3, MOVE, G.avoid(function(o) return o.id == "ocelot" or o.id == "cat" end, 6, 1.0, 1.2))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 4, MOVE_LOOK, G.melee(1.0, false))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 5, MOVE, G.stroll(0.8))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 6, LOOK, G.lookAtPlayer(8))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 6, LOOK, G.lookAround())
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.nearestPlayer(true))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 2, G.hurtBy(false))
        elseif id == "spider" or id == "cave_spider" then
            mobs.addGoal(m, 1, JUMP, G.float(m))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 3, JUMP, G.leap(0.4))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 4, MOVE_LOOK, G.melee(1.0, true))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 5, MOVE, G.stroll(0.8))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 6, LOOK, G.lookAtPlayer(8))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 6, LOOK, G.lookAround())
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.hurtBy(false))
            -- SpiderTargetGoal: only hunts in the dark.
            mobs.addTarget(m, 2, G.nearestPlayer(true, function() return mobs.brightness and mobs.brightness() < 0.5 end))
            m.climber = true
        elseif id == "enderman" then
            mobs.addGoal(m, 0, JUMP, G.float(m))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE_LOOK, G.melee(1.0, false))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 7, MOVE, G.stroll(1.0, 120))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 8, LOOK, G.lookAtPlayer(8))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 8, LOOK, G.lookAround())
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, enderLook())
            mobs.addTarget(m, 2, G.hurtBy(false))
        elseif id == "silverfish" or id == "endermite" then
            monster(m, G.melee(1.0, false))
        elseif id == "slime" or id == "magma_cube" then
            mobs.addGoal(m, 1, MOVE, slimeMove())
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.nearestPlayer(true))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 2, G.nearestMob(function(o) return o.id == "iron_golem" end, true))
        elseif id == "witch" then
            monster(m, rangedShots("potion", 60, 10, 0.75, function(mm, t)
                local potion = dist(mm, t) <= 3 and "weakness" or ((t.isPlayer and world.statusEffects and not world.statusEffects.has("slowness")) and dist(mm, t) >= 8 and "slowness" or (rand() < 0.25 and "poison" or "harming"))
                local from, v = aimAt(mm, t, 0.75, 8)
                shoot(mm, "potion", from, v + Vector3.new(0, dist(mm, t) * 0.02 * B, 0), {gravity = 0.05, potion = potion})
            end))
        elseif id == "pillager" then
            monster(m, crossbowAttack()); m.item = "crossbow"; m.armPose = "crossbow"
            mobs.addTarget(m, 3, G.nearestMob(villagerLike, true))
        elseif id == "vindicator" then
            monster(m, G.melee(1.0, false)); m.item = "iron_axe"; m.armPose = "attacking"
            mobs.addTarget(m, 3, G.nearestMob(villagerLike, true))
            -- Vindicator.VindicatorJohnnyAttackGoal: "Johnny" attacks every living thing.
            mobs.addTarget(m, 4, G.nearestMob(function(o) return m.customName == "Johnny" and o ~= m end, false))
        elseif id == "evoker" or id == "illusioner" then
            mobs.addGoal(m, 0, JUMP, G.float(m))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE, G.avoid(function(o) return o.isPlayer end, 8, 0.6, 1.0))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 4, MOVE, {canUse = function(mm) return mm.target and aliveOf(mm.target) and (mm.spellCooldown or 0) <= tick end,
                start = function(mm) mm.spellCooldown = tick + 100; mm.casting = tick
                    -- Evoker: fangs along the line to the target, or vexes every 340 ticks.
                    if (mm.vexCooldown or 0) <= tick and rand() < 0.5 then
                        mm.vexCooldown = tick + 340
                        for _ = 1, 3 do mobs.spawn("vex", mm.position + Vector3.new(rand() * 2 - 1, 1, rand() * 2 - 1) * B) end
                    else
                        local from, to = mm.position, posOf(mm.target)
                        local d = flat(to - from)
                        for i = 1, 16 do
                            local p = from + d.Unit * (1.25 * i) * B
                            mobs.later(i, function()
                                for _ = 1, 6 do particle("crit", p + Vector3.new(rand() - 0.5, rand(), rand() - 0.5) * B, Vector3.new(0, 0.1 * B, 0), {life = 10, size = 0.15}) end
                                if (player.pos() - p).Magnitude < 0.8 * B then mobs.hurtPlayer(6, mm) end
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end, canContinue = function(mm) return tick - (mm.casting or 0) < 20 end, stop = function(mm) mm.casting = nil end})
            mobs.addGoal(m, 8, MOVE, G.stroll(0.6))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 9, LOOK, G.lookAtPlayer(3))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.hurtBy(true))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 2, G.nearestPlayer(true))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 3, G.nearestMob(villagerLike, true))
        elseif id == "ravager" then
            monster(m, G.melee(1.0, true))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 3, G.nearestMob(villagerLike, true))
        elseif id == "vex" then
            m.flying = true
            mobs.addGoal(m, 4, MOVE, {canUse = function(mm) return mm.target and aliveOf(mm.target) and rand() < 0.15 end,
                start = function(mm) mm.charging = true; mm.variantName = "charging"; mobs.buildVisual(mm) end,
                canContinue = function(mm) return mm.charging and mm.target and aliveOf(mm.target) end,
                tick = function(mm) mobs.moveTo(mm, eyeOf(mm.target), 1.0)
                    if dist(mm, mm.target) < 1.2 then mobs.doHurtTarget(mm, mm.target); mm.charging = false end end,
                stop = function(mm) mm.charging = false; mm.variantName = "default"; mobs.buildVisual(mm) end})
            mobs.addGoal(m, 8, MOVE, hover(6, 1))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.hurtBy(true))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 2, G.nearestPlayer(true))
            m.item = "iron_sword"
        elseif id == "blaze" then
            m.flying = true
            mobs.addGoal(m, 4, MOVE_LOOK, rangedShots("small_fireball", 100, 48, 1.0, function(mm, t)
                -- Blaze: three fireballs 6 ticks apart.
                for i = 0, 2 do mobs.later(i * 6, function() if aliveOf(mm) and mm.target then local from, v = aimAt(mm, mm.target, 1.0, 17); shoot(mm, "small_fireball", from, v, {accel = v.Unit * 0.1 * B}) end end) end
                mm.charged = tick
            end))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 7, MOVE, hover(4, 2))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 8, LOOK, G.lookAtPlayer(8))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.hurtBy(true))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 2, G.nearestPlayer(true))
        elseif id == "wither" then
            -- WitherBoss: 220 invulnerable ticks (it grows its health), then a power-7 explosion.
            m.flying = true
            m.invulnerableTicks = m.invulnerableTicks or 220
            mobs.addGoal(m, 0, MOVE_LOOK, {canUse = function(mm) return (mm.invulnerableTicks or 0) > 0 end,
                canContinue = function(mm) return (mm.invulnerableTicks or 0) > 0 end,
                tick = function(mm)
                    -- The explosion goes off on the last invulnerable tick, so it cannot hurt the wither itself.
                    if mm.invulnerableTicks == 1 then explodeAt(mm.position + Vector3.new(0, mm.height * mm.scale / 2, 0), 7) end
                    mm.invulnerableTicks = mm.invulnerableTicks - 1
                    mm.velocity = Vector3.zero
                    mm.humanoid.Health = math.min(mm.humanoid.MaxHealth, mm.humanoid.MaxHealth * (1 - mm.invulnerableTicks / 220))
                end})
            -- Hover 5 blocks over the target, closing in when farther than 9 blocks (WitherBoss.aiStep).
            mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE, {canUse = function(mm) return mm.target and aliveOf(mm.target) and (mm.invulnerableTicks or 0) <= 0 end,
                canContinue = function(mm) return mm.target and aliveOf(mm.target) and (mm.invulnerableTicks or 0) <= 0 end,
                tick = function(mm)
                    local t = posOf(mm.target)
                    local v = mm.velocity
                    local vy = v.Y
                    if mm.position.Y < t.Y + 5 * B then vy = math.max(vy, 0) + (0.3 * B - math.max(vy, 0)) * 0.6
                    else vy = vy * 0.6 end
                    local flatD = Vector3.new(t.X - mm.position.X, 0, t.Z - mm.position.Z)
                    local vx, vz = v.X * 0.6, v.Z * 0.6
                    if flatD.Magnitude > 9 * B then local u = flatD.Unit; vx, vz = vx + u.X * 0.3 * B, vz + u.Z * 0.3 * B end
                    mm.velocity = Vector3.new(vx, vy, vz)
                    mm.yaw = yawTo(t - mm.position)
                end})
            -- Skulls: the main head every 40 ticks at its target, the side heads at nearby living targets.
            mobs.addGoal(m, 3, LOOK, {canUse = function(mm) return mm.target and aliveOf(mm.target) and (mm.invulnerableTicks or 0) <= 0 end,
                canContinue = function(mm) return mm.target and aliveOf(mm.target) and (mm.invulnerableTicks or 0) <= 0 end,
                start = function(mm, g) g.main, g.side = 20, 10 end,
                tick = function(mm, g)
                    g.main, g.side = g.main - 1, g.side - 1
                    local function fire(target, offset)
                        local from = mm.position + Vector3.new(0, 3 * mm.scale, 0) + offset
                        local d = (eyeOf(target) - from)
                        if d.Magnitude > 20 * B then return end
                        shoot(mm, "wither_skull", from, d.Unit * 0.6 * B, {accel = d.Unit * 0.1 * B})
                        if MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.play("entity.wither.shoot", mm.position, 1, 1) end
                    end
                    if g.main <= 0 and canSee(mm, mm.target) then g.main = 40; fire(mm.target, Vector3.zero) end
                    if g.side <= 0 then
                        g.side = 10 + math.random(0, 10)
                        local side = Vector3.new(math.cos(mm.yaw), 0, -math.sin(mm.yaw)) * 1.3 * mm.scale
                        fire(mm.target, math.random() < 0.5 and side or -side)
                    end
                end})
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.hurtBy(false))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 2, G.nearestPlayer(false))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 3, G.nearestMob(function(o) return not isUndead(o.id) and o.id ~= "wither" and o.id ~= "ender_dragon" end, false))
        elseif id == "ghast" then
            m.flying = true
            mobs.addGoal(m, 5, MOVE, hover(16, 4))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 7, LOOK, {canUse = function(mm) return mm.target and aliveOf(mm.target) and dist(mm, mm.target) < 64 end,
                canContinue = function(mm) return mm.target and aliveOf(mm.target) and dist(mm, mm.target) < 64 end,
                start = function(mm, g) g.charge = 0 end,
                tick = function(mm, g)
                    -- Ghast.GhastShootFireballGoal: charge 10 ticks (shooting face) then fire, cooldown 40.
                    mobs.lookAt(mm, eyeOf(mm.target), 2, 30)
                    mm.yaw = yawTo(posOf(mm.target) - mm.position)
                    if canSee(mm, mm.target) then g.charge = g.charge + 1 elseif g.charge > 0 then g.charge = g.charge - 1 end
                    local shooting = g.charge > 10
                    if shooting ~= mm.shootingFace then mm.shootingFace = shooting; mm.variantName = shooting and "shooting" or "default"; mobs.buildVisual(mm) end
                    if g.charge == 20 then
                        local look = forwardOf(mm.yaw)
                        local from = mm.position + Vector3.new(0, mm.height * mm.scale / 2, 0) + look * 4 * B
                        local d = (eyeOf(mm.target) - from).Unit
                        shoot(mm, "large_fireball", from, d * 0.5 * B, {accel = d * 0.1 * B})
                        g.charge = -40
                    end
                end,
                stop = function(mm) if mm.shootingFace then mm.shootingFace = false; mm.variantName = "default"; mobs.buildVisual(mm) end end})
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.nearestPlayer(true))
        elseif id == "phantom" then
            m.flying = true
            mobs.addGoal(m, 1, MOVE, {canUse = function(mm) return mm.target and aliveOf(mm.target) end, canContinue = function(mm) return mm.target and aliveOf(mm.target) end,
                start = function(mm, g) g.phase, g.left, g.angle = "circle", 100, rand() * math.pi * 2 end,
                tick = function(mm, g)
                    -- Phantom: circle 20 blocks up, then swoop at the target.
                    local t = mm.target
                    g.left = g.left - 1
                    if g.phase == "circle" then
                        g.angle = g.angle + 0.05
                        mobs.moveTo(mm, posOf(t) + Vector3.new(math.cos(g.angle) * 12, 16, math.sin(g.angle) * 12) * B, 1.5)
                        if g.left <= 0 then g.phase, g.left = "swoop", 100 end
                    else
                        mobs.moveTo(mm, eyeOf(t), 2)
                        if dist(mm, t) < 1.5 then mobs.doHurtTarget(mm, t); g.phase, g.left = "circle", 100 + math.random(0, 100) end
                        if g.left <= 0 then g.phase, g.left = "circle", 100 end
                    end
                end})
            mobs.addGoal(m, 5, MOVE, hover(10, 12))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.nearestPlayer(true))
            m.burnsInSun = true
        elseif id == "guardian" or id == "elder_guardian" then
            mobs.addGoal(m, 4, MOVE_LOOK, {canUse = function(mm) return mm.target and aliveOf(mm.target) and dist(mm, mm.target) < 15 and canSee(mm, mm.target) end,
                canContinue = function(mm) return mm.target and aliveOf(mm.target) and dist(mm, mm.target) < 15 end,
                start = function(mm, g) g.time = -10; mobs.stop(mm); mm.beamTarget = mm.target end,
                tick = function(mm, g)
                    -- Guardian.GuardianAttackGoal: laser for 80 ticks, then 6 (+1 magic) damage.
                    g.time = g.time + 1
                    mobs.lookAt(mm, eyeOf(mm.target), 2, 90)
                    if g.time >= 80 then
                        mobs.hurtPlayer(mm.id == "elder_guardian" and 8 or 6, mm)
                        mobs.hurtPlayer(1, nil)
                        mm.target = nil
                    end
                    mm.beamProgress = math.max(0, g.time) / 80
                end,
                stop = function(mm) mm.beamTarget, mm.beamProgress = nil, nil end})
            mobs.addGoal(m, 7, MOVE, G.swim(1.0))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 8, LOOK, G.lookAtPlayer(8))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.nearestPlayer(true))
        elseif id == "shulker" then
            mobs.addGoal(m, 4, LOOK, rangedShots("shulker_bullet", 60, 16, 0.6, function(mm, t)
                local from = mm.position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * B, 0)
                shoot(mm, "shulker_bullet", from, (eyeOf(t) - from).Unit * 0.3 * B, {target = t})
                mm.peekUntil = tick + 40
            end))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.hurtBy(true))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 2, G.nearestPlayer(true))
            m.noWander = true
        elseif id == "breeze" then
            mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE_LOOK, rangedShots("wind_charge", 40, 16, 1.0, function(mm, t)
                mm.anim.SHOOT = tick
                mobs.later(10, function() if aliveOf(mm) and mm.target then local from, v = aimAt(mm, mm.target, 0.7, 5); shoot(mm, "wind_charge", from, v) end end)
            end))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 3, MOVE, {canUse = function(mm) return mm.target and mm.onGround and math.random(40) == 1 end,
                start = function(mm) mm.anim.JUMP = tick
                    local d = flat(posOf(mm.target) - mm.position); d = d.Magnitude > 0 and d.Unit or Vector3.zero
                    mm.velocity = d * 0.6 * B + Vector3.new(0, 0.9 * B, 0) end,
                canContinue = function(mm) return not mm.onGround end})
            mobs.addGoal(m, 6, MOVE, G.stroll(0.6))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.hurtBy(false))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 2, G.nearestPlayer(true))
        elseif id == "hoglin" or id == "zoglin" or id == "piglin_brute" then
            monster(m, G.melee(1.0, true))
            if id == "piglin_brute" then m.item = "golden_axe"; m.armPose = "melee" end
        elseif id == "piglin" then
            monster(m, G.melee(1.0, true))
            m.item = rand() < 0.5 and "crossbow" or "golden_sword"; m.armPose = m.item == "crossbow" and "crossbow" or "melee"
            m.goldNeutral = true
        elseif id == "zombified_piglin" then
            mobs.addGoal(m, 0, JUMP, G.float(m))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE_LOOK, G.melee(1.0, false))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 7, MOVE, G.stroll(1.0))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.hurtBy(true))
            m.item = "golden_sword"; m.armPose = "zombie"
        elseif id == "creaking" then
            mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE_LOOK, G.melee(1.0, true))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 7, MOVE, G.stroll(0.6))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.nearestPlayer(true))
        elseif id == "warden" then
            -- Warden: anger rises with vibrations and nearby players; at 80 it hunts (melee 30, sonic boom).
            m.anger = 0
            mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE_LOOK, G.melee(1.2, true))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 3, MOVE, {canUse = function(mm) return mm.target and aliveOf(mm.target) and (mm.boomCooldown or 0) <= tick and dist(mm, mm.target) > 3 and dist(mm, mm.target) < 15 end,
                start = function(mm) mm.boomCooldown = tick + 40; mm.anim.SONIC_BOOM = tick
                    mobs.later(34, function()
                        if not (aliveOf(mm) and mm.target) then return end
                        local from = mm.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.6 * mm.scale, 0)
                        local to = eyeOf(mm.target)
                        for i = 1, math.floor((to - from).Magnitude / B) do particle("sonic_boom", from + (to - from).Unit * i * B, Vector3.zero, {life = 10, size = 1, fullbright = true}) end
                        if mm.target.isPlayer then local hum = playerHum(); if hum and not creative() then hum:TakeDamage(10 * hum.MaxHealth / 20); if world.knockback then world.knockback((to - from).Unit * 2.5 + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)) end end
                        else mobs.hurt(mm.target, 10, mm) end
                    end) end,
                canContinue = function(mm) return tick - (mm.anim.SONIC_BOOM or 0) < 60 end, tick = function(mm) mobs.stop(mm) end})
            mobs.addGoal(m, 7, MOVE, G.stroll(0.5))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, {canUse = function(mm) return (mm.anger or 0) >= 80 and player.alive() and not creative() end, start = function(mm) mm.target = player end,
                canContinue = function(mm) return (mm.anger or 0) >= 40 and player.alive() and not creative() end, stop = function(mm) mm.target = nil end})
        elseif id == "iron_golem" then
            mobs.addGoal(m, 1, MOVE_LOOK, G.melee(1.0, true))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 7, MOVE, G.stroll(0.6, 240))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 8, LOOK, G.lookAtPlayer(6))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 8, LOOK, G.lookAround())
            mobs.addTarget(m, 2, G.hurtBy(false))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 3, G.nearestMob(function(o) return mobs.hostile[o.id] and o.id ~= "creeper" end, false))
        elseif id == "snow_golem" then
            mobs.addGoal(m, 1, MOVE_LOOK, rangedShots("snowball", 20, 10, 1.6))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE, G.stroll(1.0))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 3, LOOK, G.lookAtPlayer(6))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.nearestMob(function(o) return mobs.hostile[o.id] end, false))
        elseif id == "villager" or id == "wandering_trader" then
            mobs.addGoal(m, 0, JUMP, G.float(m))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 1, MOVE, G.avoid(function(o) return o.id == "zombie" or o.id == "husk" or o.id == "drowned" or o.id == "zombie_villager" or o.id == "pillager" or o.id == "vindicator" or o.id == "evoker" or o.id == "ravager" or o.id == "vex" or o.id == "zoglin" end, 8, 0.5, 0.6))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE, G.panic(0.6))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 3, LOOK, {canUse = function(mm) return mm.trading end, canContinue = function(mm) return mm.trading end, tick = function(mm) mobs.stop(mm); mobs.lookAt(mm, player.eye(), 2) end})
            mobs.addGoal(m, 5, MOVE, G.stroll(0.5, 80))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 6, LOOK, G.lookAtPlayer(8, 0.05))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 7, LOOK, G.lookAround())
            m.profession = (m.variantName or ""):match("^plains_(.+)$") or (id == "wandering_trader" and "wandering_trader" or "none")
        elseif id == "wolf" then
            mobs.addGoal(m, 1, JUMP, G.float(m))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE, sit())
            mobs.addGoal(m, 4, JUMP, G.leap(0.4))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 5, MOVE_LOOK, G.melee(1.0, true))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 6, MOVE, followOwner(1.0, 10, 2))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 7, MOVE, G.breed(1.0))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 8, MOVE, G.stroll(1.0))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 10, LOOK, G.lookAtPlayer(8))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 10, LOOK, G.lookAround())
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, ownerDefense())
            mobs.addTarget(m, 3, G.hurtBy(true))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 5, G.nearestMob(function(o) return not o.tamed and (o.id == "sheep" or o.id == "rabbit" or o.id == "fox") end, false))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 6, G.nearestMob(function(o) return o.id == "skeleton" or o.id == "stray" or o.id == "wither_skeleton" or o.id == "bogged" end, false))
        elseif id == "cat" or id == "ocelot" then
            animal(m, 1.0, tagFood(id .. "_food"), function()
                mobs.addGoal(m, 1, MOVE, sit())
                mobs.addGoal(m, 5, MOVE, followOwner(1.0, 10, 5))
                mobs.addGoal(m, 3, JUMP, G.leap(0.3))
                mobs.addGoal(m, 4, MOVE_LOOK, G.melee(0.8, true))
            end)
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.nearestMob(function(o) return o.id == "chicken" or o.id == "rabbit" end, false))
        elseif id == "parrot" then
            m.flying = false
            mobs.addGoal(m, 0, JUMP, G.float(m))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 1, MOVE, G.panic(1.25))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE, sit())
            mobs.addGoal(m, 3, MOVE, followOwner(1.0, 5, 1))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 4, MOVE, G.fly(1.0))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 5, LOOK, G.lookAtPlayer(8))
        elseif id == "fox" then
            animal(m, 1.0, tagFood("fox_food"), function() mobs.addGoal(m, 3, MOVE_LOOK, G.melee(1.2, true)); mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE, G.avoid(function(o) return o.isPlayer or o.id == "wolf" or o.id == "polar_bear" end, 8, 1.6, 1.4)) end)
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.nearestMob(function(o) return o.id == "chicken" or o.id == "rabbit" or o.id == "cod" or o.id == "salmon" end, false))
        elseif id == "polar_bear" or id == "panda" or id == "llama" or id == "trader_llama" or id == "goat" then
            animal(m, 1.0, tagFood(id:gsub("^trader_", "") .. "_food"), function() mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE_LOOK, G.melee(1.25, true)) end)
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.hurtBy(true))
            if id == "llama" or id == "trader_llama" then
                for i, g in ipairs(m.goals) do if g.priority == 2 and g.flags.move and g.tick and not g.isSpit then m.goals[i] = mobs.goal(2, MOVE_LOOK, rangedShots("llama_spit", 40, 20, 1.5)) end end
            end
        elseif id == "bee" then
            mobs.addGoal(m, 0, MOVE_LOOK, G.melee(1.4, true))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE, G.breed(1.0))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 3, MOVE_LOOK, G.tempt(1.25, tagFood("bee_food")))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 8, MOVE, G.fly(1.0))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.hurtBy(true))
            m.flying = true
        elseif id == "bat" or id == "allay" or id == "happy_ghast" then
            m.flying = true
            mobs.addGoal(m, 5, MOVE, hover(id == "happy_ghast" and 12 or 6, 2))
            if id == "allay" then mobs.addGoal(m, 3, MOVE, followOwner(1.0, 6, 3)); m.tamed = true end
            if id == "happy_ghast" then mobs.addGoal(m, 6, LOOK, G.lookAtPlayer(8)) end
        elseif swimmers[id] then
            mobs.addGoal(m, 1, MOVE, G.panic(1.25))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 4, MOVE, G.swim(1.0))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 6, LOOK, G.lookAtPlayer(6))
            if id == "axolotl" then mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.nearestMob(function(o) return o.id == "cod" or o.id == "salmon" or o.id == "tropical_fish" or o.id == "squid" or o.id == "glow_squid" or o.id == "drowned" or o.id == "guardian" end, true)); mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE_LOOK, G.melee(1.0, true)) end
            if id == "dolphin" then mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.hurtBy(true)); mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE_LOOK, G.melee(1.2, true)) end
        elseif id == "strider" then
            animal(m, 1.0, tagFood("strider_food"))
        elseif id == "frog" then
            animal(m, 1.0, tagFood("frog_food"))
            mobs.addTarget(m, 1, G.nearestMob(function(o) return (o.id == "slime" or o.id == "magma_cube") and (o.size or 1) == 1 end, true))
            mobs.addGoal(m, 2, MOVE_LOOK, {canUse = function(mm) return mm.target and aliveOf(mm.target) and dist(mm, mm.target) < 4 end,
                start = function(mm) mm.anim.FROG_TONGUE = tick
                    mobs.later(6, function() if mm.target and aliveOf(mm.target) then local t = mm.target; mobs.remove(t)
                        if t.id == "magma_cube" then local e = JavaContent.itemById[({temperate = "ochre_froglight", warm = "pearlescent_froglight", cold = "verdant_froglight"})[mm.variantName] or "ochre_froglight"]; if e then world.drop({id = e.index, count = 1}, t.position, nil, true) end
                        else local e = JavaContent.itemById.slime_ball; if e then world.drop({id = e.index, count = 1}, t.position, nil, true) end end end end) end,
                canContinue = function(mm) return tick - (mm.anim.FROG_TONGUE or 0) < 10 end})
        elseif id == "armadillo" or id == "sniffer" or id == "camel" or id == "camel_husk" or id == "turtle" or id == "copper_golem" or id == "sulfur_cube" then
            animal(m, 1.0, tagFood((id == "camel_husk" and "camel" or id) .. "_food"))
        else
            -- Farm animals and the rest: AnimalPanic, Breed, Tempt, FollowParent, Stroll, Look.
            local foodTag = ({cow = "cow_food", mooshroom = "cow_food", sheep = "sheep_food", pig = "pig_food", chicken = "chicken_food", rabbit = "rabbit_food",
                horse = "horse_food", donkey = "horse_food", mule = "horse_food", skeleton_horse = nil, zombie_horse = nil, hoglin = "hoglin_food", nautilus = "nautilus_food"})[id]
            animal(m, 1.0, foodTag and tagFood(foodTag) or nil, function() if id == "sheep" then mobs.addGoal(m, 5, MOVE, eatGrass()) end end)
            if id == "rabbit" then mobs.addGoal(m, 4, MOVE, G.avoid(function(o) return o.isPlayer or o.id == "wolf" or o.id == "fox" end, 8, 2.2, 2.2)) end
        end
        if id == "sheep" then m.color = m.variantName ~= "sheared" and m.variantName or "white" end
        if m.item and api.equipMob then api.equipMob(m, m.item) end
    end

    -- Delayed actions (fangs, fireball volleys, sonic boom wind-up) ----------------------------------
    local delayed = {}
    function mobs.later(ticks, fn) delayed[#delayed + 1] = {at = tick + ticks, fn = fn} end
    function mobs.mobFrom(instance)
        if not instance then return nil end
        for _, m in ipairs(mobs.list) do if instance:IsDescendantOf(m.visual.model) then return m end end
    end
    -- Sky brightness for spiders / sunlight burning (Level.getSkyDarken).
    function mobs.brightness()
        local b = world.blocks
        if b and b.skyDarken then return (15 - b.skyDarken()) / 15 end
        return 1
    end
    local function skyVisible(p)
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(p + Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * B, 0), Vector3.new(0, 200 * B, 0), castParams)
        return hit == nil
    end
    -- Mob.isSunBurnTick: daytime, sky visible, not in water / rain, no helmet.
    local function sunBurn(m)
        if not m.burnsInSun or m.inWater then return end
        if m.age % 20 ~= 0 then return end
        local c = world.chat
        if c and c.weather and c.weather ~= "clear" then return end
        if mobs.brightness() > 0.5 and skyVisible(m.position + Vector3.new(0, m.height * m.scale, 0)) then
            m.onFire = 160
        end
    end

    -- Interactions (Mob.mobInteract): trading, riding, sitting, harnesses ---------------------------
    local rideable = {pig = "carrot_on_a_stick", strider = "warped_fungus_on_a_stick", horse = true, donkey = true, mule = true, skeleton_horse = true, zombie_horse = true,
        camel = true, camel_husk = true, llama = true, trader_llama = true, happy_ghast = true, nautilus = true, zombie_nautilus = true}
    local riding
    local function seatHeight(m)
        local h2 = ({pig = 0.75, strider = 1.7, horse = 1.35, donkey = 1.15, mule = 1.2, camel = 2.0, camel_husk = 2.0, llama = 1.3, trader_llama = 1.3, happy_ghast = 4.0, nautilus = 0.9, skeleton_horse = 1.35, zombie_horse = 1.35})[m.id] or m.height * 0.85
        return h2 * (m.baby and 0.5 or 1)
    end
    local function mount(m)
        if not api.vehicles then return false end
        if api.riding then api.vehicles.dismount() end
        riding = {kind = "mob", mob = m, id = m.id, yaw = m.yaw}
        riding.seat = function() return m.position + Vector3.new(0, seatHeight(m) * B, 0) end
        riding.seatAt = function(partial) return (m.previous or m.position):Lerp(m.position, partial) + Vector3.new(0, seatHeight(m) * B, 0) end
        riding.dismount = function()
            local side = forwardOf(m.yaw):Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
            local feet = m.position + side * (m.width / 2 + 0.6) * B + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
            if world.teleport then world.teleport(feet) else root.CFrame = CFrame.new(feet + Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2, 0)) end
            m.rider = nil; riding = nil
        end
        api.riding, api.gliding = riding, false
        m.rider = true
        return true
    end
    mobs.mount = mount
    local function heldStack() return h.inventory.slots[h.ui.selected] end
    function mobs.interact(m, s, name)
        if not aliveOf(m) then return false end
        if mobs.preInteract then
            local okI, taken = pcall(mobs.preInteract, m, s, name)
            if okI and taken ~= nil then return taken end
        end
        -- Villager / wandering trader: open trades (babies and nitwits only shake heads).
        if (m.id == "villager" or m.id == "wandering_trader") and not m.baby then
            if name == "villager_spawn_egg" then return false end
            if m.profession == "none" or m.profession == "nitwit" then m.shakeHead = tick; return true end
            mobs.openTrades(m)
            return true
        end
        -- Tamed pets: the owner toggles sitting with an empty hand.
        if m.tamed and m.owner == "player" and (m.id == "wolf" or m.id == "cat" or m.id == "parrot") and not s then
            m.sitting = not m.sitting; mobs.stop(m); m.target = nil; return true
        end
        if m.id == "happy_ghast" and name and name:match("_harness$") and not m.harness then
            m.harness = name:gsub("_harness$", ""); if world.items then end
            local st = heldStack(); if st and CONFIG.Survival then st.count = st.count - 1; if st.count <= 0 then h.inventory.slots[h.ui.selected] = nil end; h.ui.refresh() end
            return true
        end
        local r = rideable[m.id]
        if r and not m.baby and not (world.sneaking and world.sneaking()) then
            local equine = m.id == "horse" or m.id == "donkey" or m.id == "mule" or m.id == "skeleton_horse" or m.id == "zombie_horse" or m.id == "camel" or m.id == "camel_husk" or m.id == "llama" or m.id == "trader_llama"
            if (m.saddled or (m.id == "happy_ghast" and m.harness) or (equine and not s)) and (not s or name == r or name == "carrot_on_a_stick" or name == "warped_fungus_on_a_stick") then
                return mount(m)
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    -- Riding control (Pig / Strider with their sticks, AbstractHorse, Camel, HappyGhast).
    function mobs.rideTick(controls)
        if not riding or api.riding ~= riding then riding = nil; return end
        local m = riding.mob
        if not aliveOf(m) then api.vehicles.dismount(); return end
        local look = controls.look or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
        local yaw = yawTo(flat(look).Magnitude > 0 and flat(look) or forwardOf(m.yaw))
        riding.yaw = m.yaw
        mobs.stop(m)
        if m.id == "pig" or m.id == "strider" then
            local stick = m.id == "pig" and "carrot_on_a_stick" or "warped_fungus_on_a_stick"
            local s = heldStack()
            if s and Recipes.name(s) == stick then
                m.yaw = approachAngle(m.yaw, yaw, math.rad(10))
                m.zza, m.moveSpeed = 1, mobs.attr(m, "movement_speed") * 0.225 / 0.25 * (1 + (m.boost or 0) / 140)
            else m.zza = 0 end
            if m.boost and m.boost > 0 then m.boost = m.boost - 1 end
            return
        end
        if m.id == "happy_ghast" then
            local wish = Vector3.zero
            if controls.forward then wish = wish + look elseif controls.back then wish = wish - look end
            if controls.jump then wish = wish + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
            m.flyDir = wish.Magnitude > 0 and wish.Unit or Vector3.zero
            m.flySpeed = 0.018; m.flying = true
            m.yaw = approachAngle(m.yaw, yaw, math.rad(8))
            return
        end
        if m.tamedHorse == false or ((m.id == "horse" or m.id == "donkey" or m.id == "mule" or m.id == "camel" or m.id == "llama") and not m.tamed) then
            -- AbstractHorse.tameWithName: a few seconds of bucking, then tame when random(100) < temper.
            m.buckTicks = (m.buckTicks or 0) + 1
            if m.buckTicks > 40 + math.random(0, 40) then
                m.temper = (m.temper or 0) + 5
                if math.random(0, 99) < m.temper then
