                    m.tamed, m.owner = true, "player"
                    for _ = 1, 7 do particle("heart", m.position + Vector3.new(rand() - 0.5, m.height * m.scale / B, rand() - 0.5) * B, Vector3.zero, {life = 20, size = 0.25}) end
                else
                    for _ = 1, 7 do particle("smoke", m.position + Vector3.new(rand() - 0.5, m.height * m.scale / B, rand() - 0.5) * B, Vector3.zero, {life = 20, size = 0.25}) end
                    m.standing = tick
                    api.vehicles.dismount()
                end
                m.buckTicks = 0
            end
            return
        end
        if m.id == "llama" or m.id == "trader_llama" then return end
        if not (m.saddled or m.id == "camel" and m.tamed) then return end
        -- AbstractHorse.getRiddenInput: strafe at half speed, backwards at a quarter; camels dash.
        m.yaw = yaw
        local f = controls.forward and 1 or controls.back and -0.25 or 0
        local sx = controls.left and 0.5 or controls.right and -0.5 or 0
        m.zza, m.xxa, m.moveSpeed = f, sx, mobs.attr(m, "movement_speed")
        if controls.jump and m.onGround then
            if m.id == "camel" or m.id == "camel_husk" then
                if (m.dashCooldown or 0) <= tick then m.dashCooldown = tick + 55; m.anim.CAMEL_DASH = tick; m.velocity = m.velocity + forwardOf(m.yaw) * 1.5 * B + Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * B, 0) end
            else m.velocity = Vector3.new(m.velocity.X, (mobs.attr(m, "jump_strength") or 0.7) * B, m.velocity.Z) end
        end
    end

    -- Villager trading (MerchantMenu / MerchantScreen) ----------------------------------------------
    local levelNames = {"novice", "apprentice", "journeyman", "expert", "master"}
    local xpLevels = {0, 10, 70, 150, 250}
    local function addOffers(m, level)
        local sets = data.villagerTrades and data.villagerTrades[m.profession]
        if not sets then return end
        local function pick(set)
            if not set then return end
            local pool = {}
            for _, t in ipairs(set.trades) do pool[#pool + 1] = t end
            for _ = 1, math.min(set.amount, #pool) do
                local t = table.remove(pool, math.random(#pool))
                local gives = Recipes.stack(t.gives[1], t.gives[2])
                if gives then
                    if t.enchantLevels then
                        local chosen = Recipes.selectEnchantments(Recipes.random(math.random(0, 2147483646)), gives, math.random(t.enchantLevels[1], t.enchantLevels[2]))
                        if #chosen > 0 then gives.enchantments = {}; for _, c in ipairs(chosen) do gives.enchantments[c.id] = c.level end end
                        if Recipes.name(gives) == "book" then gives.id = Recipes.index("enchanted_book") or gives.id end
                    end
                    if t.potion then gives.potion = t.potion end
                    m.offers[#m.offers + 1] = {wants = Recipes.stack(t.wants[1], t.wants[2]), wants2 = t.wants2 and Recipes.stack(t.wants2[1], t.wants2[2]),
                        gives = gives, uses = 0, maxUses = t.maxUses, xp = t.xp}
                end
            end
        end
        if m.profession == "wandering_trader" then pick(sets.buying); pick(sets.common); pick(sets.uncommon)
        else pick(sets["level_" .. level]) end
    end
    function mobs.openTrades(m)
        if not m.profession then m.profession = (m.variantName or ""):match("^[a-z]+_(.+)$") or (m.id == "wandering_trader" and "wandering_trader" or "none") end
        local kit = h.ui.kit
        if not kit then return end
        if not m.offers then m.offers = {}; m.tradeLevel, m.tradeXp = 1, 0; addOffers(m, 1) end
        m.trading = true
        local G = kit.G
        local L = data.lang or {}
        local payments = {slots = {}}
        local selected
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("merchant", 276, 166)
            kit.image(G.villager, 0, 0, 276, 166, nil, 3)
            local name = m.customName or L["entity.minecraft." .. (m.id == "villager" and "villager." .. m.profession or m.id)] or m.id
            local title = m.id == "villager" and (name .. " - " .. (L["merchant.level." .. m.tradeLevel] or levelNames[m.tradeLevel])) or name
            screen.labels[#screen.labels + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, title, 49 + 107 - math.floor(JavaGui.width(title) / 2), 6, kit.textColor, false, 4)
            screen.labels[#screen.labels + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, L["merchant.trades"] or "Trades", 5 + 49 - math.floor(JavaGui.width(L["merchant.trades"] or "Trades") / 2), 6, kit.textColor, false, 4)
            kit.label(L["container.inventory"] or "Inventory", 107, 72)
            kit.slot({owner = payments, index = 1, x = 136, y = 37, group = "container"})
            kit.slot({owner = payments, index = 2, x = 162, y = 37, group = "container"})
            local result = kit.slot({owner = payments, index = 3, x = 220, y = 37, kind = "result", group = "result"})
            kit.playerSlots(108, 84, 142)
            local function enough(stack, want) return want == nil or (stack and Recipes.name(stack) == Recipes.name(want) and stack.count >= want.count) end
            local function refreshResult()
                local o = selected and m.offers[selected]
                payments.slots[3] = (o and o.uses < o.maxUses and enough(payments.slots[1], o.wants) and enough(payments.slots[2], o.wants2)) and CreativeRules.withCount(o.gives, o.gives.count) or nil
            end
            screen.changed = refreshResult
            result.onTake = function()
                local o = m.offers[selected]
                if not o then return end
                for i, want in ipairs({o.wants, o.wants2}) do
                    local p = payments.slots[i]
                    if want and p then p.count = p.count - want.count; if p.count <= 0 then payments.slots[i] = nil end end
                end
                o.uses = o.uses + 1
                -- Villager xp and levelling (VillagerData.NEXT_LEVEL_XP_THRESHOLDS).
                m.tradeXp = (m.tradeXp or 0) + o.xp
                if world.spawnXp then world.spawnXp(m.position + Vector3.new(0, B, 0), 3 + math.random(0, 3)) end
                if m.id == "villager" and m.tradeLevel < 5 and m.tradeXp >= xpLevels[m.tradeLevel + 1] then
                    m.tradeLevel = m.tradeLevel + 1; addOffers(m, m.tradeLevel)
                    for _ = 1, 10 do particle("happy_villager", m.position + Vector3.new(rand() - 0.5, rand() * 2, rand() - 0.5) * B, Vector3.zero, {life = 20, size = 0.15}) end
                end
                refreshResult()
            end
            screen.quickTargets = function(slot, stack, group, concat)
                if slot.kind == "result" or slot.group == "container" then return concat(group("hotbar", true), group("main", true)) end
                return {screen.slots[1], screen.slots[2]}
            end
            -- Offer buttons (MerchantScreen.TradeOfferButton): 88x20 at (5, 16 + 20i), 7 visible.
            local rows = {}
            local offset = 0
            for i = 1, 7 do
                local y = 16 + (i - 1) * 20
                local row = {x = 5, y = y, w = 88, h = 20}
                row.bg = JavaGui.slice(screen.window, G["widget/button"], 3, 5, y, 88, 20, 4)
                row.a = JavaGui.itemView(screen.window, 5 + 5, y + 2, 6)
                row.b = JavaGui.itemView(screen.window, 5 + 35, y + 2, 6)
                row.arrow = JavaGui.image(screen.window, G["container/villager/trade_arrow"], 5 + 53, y + 5, 10, 9, nil, 6)
                row.out = JavaGui.itemView(screen.window, 5 + 68, y + 2, 6)
                rows[i] = row
            end
            local function placeFrom(slotIndex, want)
                if not want then return end
                local need = want.count
                for i = 1, 36 do
                    local st = h.inventory.slots[i]
                    if st and Recipes.name(st) == Recipes.name(want) and need > 0 then
                        local p = payments.slots[slotIndex]
                        if not p then payments.slots[slotIndex] = CreativeRules.withCount(st, 0); p = payments.slots[slotIndex] end
                        if CreativeRules.sameItem(p, st) or p.count == 0 then
                            local take = math.min(need, st.count, (itemStackLimits[st.id] or 64) - p.count)
                            p.count = p.count + take; st.count = st.count - take; need = need - take
                            if st.count <= 0 then h.inventory.slots[i] = nil end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if payments.slots[slotIndex] and payments.slots[slotIndex].count <= 0 then payments.slots[slotIndex] = nil end
            end
            screen.onClick = function(button, x, y)
                for i, row in ipairs(rows) do
                    local index = offset + i
                    if m.offers[index] and x >= row.x and x < row.x + row.w and y >= row.y and y < row.y + row.h then
                        -- MerchantMenu.tryMoveItems: return old payments, fill from the inventory.
                        for k = 1, 2 do if payments.slots[k] then kit.giveBack(payments.slots[k]); payments.slots[k] = nil end end
                        selected = index
                        placeFrom(1, m.offers[index].wants)
                        placeFrom(2, m.offers[index].wants2)
                        refreshResult(); h.ui.refresh()
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            screen.wheel = function(delta) offset = math.clamp(offset - (delta > 0 and 1 or -1), 0, math.max(0, #m.offers - 7)) end
            screen.update = nil
            local function draw(x, y)
                for i, row in ipairs(rows) do
                    local o = m.offers[offset + i]
                    row.bg.Visible = o ~= nil
                    row.arrow.Visible = o ~= nil
                    row.a.set(o and o.wants); row.b.set(o and o.wants2); row.out.set(o and o.gives)
                    if o then
                        local hover = x >= row.x and x < row.x + row.w and y >= row.y and y < row.y + row.h
                        local sprite = (offset + i == selected or hover) and G["widget/button_highlighted"] or G["widget/button"]
                        local content = JavaGui.content(sprite)
                        if content and row.bg:IsA("ImageLabel") then row.bg.ImageContent = content end
                        local arrowSprite = o.uses >= o.maxUses and G["container/villager/trade_arrow_out_of_stock"] or G["container/villager/trade_arrow"]
                        local ac = JavaGui.content(arrowSprite)
                        if ac and row.arrow:IsA("ImageLabel") then row.arrow.ImageContent = ac end
                    end
                end
            end
            screen.update = function(x, y) draw(x, y) end
            screen.click = function(button, x, y) return screen.onClick(button, x, y) end
            screen.hoverTooltip = function(x, y)
                for i, row in ipairs(rows) do
                    local o = m.offers[offset + i]
                    if o and y >= row.y and y < row.y + row.h then
                        if x >= row.x + 5 and x < row.x + 21 then return kit.itemTooltip(o.wants) end
                        if o.wants2 and x >= row.x + 35 and x < row.x + 51 then return kit.itemTooltip(o.wants2) end
                        if x >= row.x + 68 and x < row.x + 84 then return kit.itemTooltip(o.gives) end
                    end
                end
            end
            refreshResult()
        end, function()
            m.trading = false
            for k = 1, 2 do if payments.slots[k] then kit.giveBack(payments.slots[k]); payments.slots[k] = nil end end
            payments.slots[3] = nil
        end)
    end

    -- Tick ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local equipVisuals = {}
    local headVisuals = {}
    function mobs.tick(controls)
        tick = tick + 1
        pathBudget = 3
        if tick % 40 == 0 then cellCache = {}; refreshIgnore() end
        for i = #delayed, 1, -1 do local d = delayed[i]; if tick >= d.at then table.remove(delayed, i); pcall(d.fn) end end
        if controls then mobs.rideTick(controls) end
        stepShots()
        for i = #mobs.list, 1, -1 do
            local m = mobs.list[i]
            if m and not m.removed then
                m.age = m.age + 1
                if (m.invulnerableTime or 0) > 0 then m.invulnerableTime = m.invulnerableTime - 1 end
                m.ambientTime = (m.ambientTime or -80) + 1
                if MinecraftSounds and math.random(0, 999) < m.ambientTime and (m.position - root.Position).Magnitude < 32 * B then
                    m.ambientTime = -80
                    MinecraftSounds.play("entity." .. m.id .. ".ambient", m.position, MinecraftSounds.mobVolume(m), (math.random() - math.random()) * 0.2 + (m.baby and 1.5 or 1))
                end
                m.previous = m.position
                m.previousYaw, m.previousHeadYaw, m.previousHeadPitch = m.bodyYaw or m.yaw, m.headYaw, m.headPitch
                onHealthChanged(m)
                if m.vehicle and m.humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    m.position = api.vehicles.seat(m.vehicle) + Vector3.new(0, 0.4 * B, 0)
                    m.walkSpeed, m.walkSpeedOld = 0, 0
                    continue
                end
                if m.puppet and m.humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    -- Another player's mob: glide to where its owner says it is.
                    local p = m.puppet
                    local d = (p.target or m.position) - m.position
                    if d.Magnitude > 8 * B then m.position = p.target else m.position = m.position + d * 0.35 end
                    m.walkSpeedOld = m.walkSpeed
                    m.walkSpeed = math.clamp(Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z).Magnitude / B * 2, 0, 1)
                    m.walkPos = m.walkPos + m.walkSpeed
                    m.yaw = m.yaw + (((p.yaw or m.yaw) - m.yaw + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi) * 0.4
                    m.bodyYaw, m.headYaw = m.yaw, m.yaw
                    if m.hurtTime > 0 then m.hurtTime = m.hurtTime - 1 end
                    if (m.invulnerableTime or 0) > 0 then m.invulnerableTime = m.invulnerableTime - 1 end
                    m.hitbox.CFrame = CFrame.new(m.position + Vector3.new(0, m.hitbox.Size.Y / 2, 0))
                    continue
                end
                if m.humanoid.Health <= 0 then die(m)
                elseif (m.position - root.Position).Magnitude < 128 * B then
                    if m.hurtTime > 0 then m.hurtTime = m.hurtTime - 1 end
                    if m.attackAnim > 0 then m.attackAnimOld = m.attackAnim; m.attackAnim = math.max(0, 1 - (tick - (m.swingStart or tick)) / 6); if m.attackAnim <= 0 then m.attackAnimOld = 0 end end
                    m.jumping, m.xxa = false, 0
                    if m.emerge then
                        m.emerge = m.emerge - 1
                        if m.emerge == 133 then m.anim.WARDEN_EMERGE = tick end
                        if m.emerge <= 0 then m.emerge = nil end
                    elseif not m.noAi and not m.rider then
                        runSelector(m, m.targetGoals)
                        runSelector(m, m.goals)
                        followPath(m)
                    end
                    lookTick(m)
                    -- Climbing (spiders) and creeper fuse.
                    m.flags.climbing = m.climber and m.horizontalCollision
                    if m.id == "creeper" then
                        m.swellOld = m.swell or 0
                        local dir = (m.ignited and m.ignited > 0) and 1 or (m.swellDir or -1)
                        m.swell = math.clamp((m.swell or 0) + dir, 0, 30)
                        if m.swell >= 30 then
                            local p = m.position
                            mobs.remove(m)
                            if world.explode then world.explode(p, 3) end
                        end
                    end
                    if not m.removed then
                        travel(m)
                        -- WalkAnimationState: speed follows 4 * horizontal distance moved.
                        local moved = flat(m.position - m.previous).Magnitude / B
                        local f = math.min(1, moved * 4 / ((m.baby and 2) or 1))
                        if m.flying or swimmers[m.id] then f = math.min(1, moved * 4) end
                        m.walkSpeedOld = m.walkSpeed
                        m.walkSpeed = m.walkSpeed + (f - m.walkSpeed) * 0.4
                        m.walkPos = m.walkPos + m.walkSpeed
                        if moved > 0.01 then m.lastProgress = tick end
                        -- Fall damage (LivingEntity.causeFallDamage: distance - 3).
                        if m.velocity.Y < 0 and not m.onGround and not m.flying and not flyers[m.id] then m.fallDistance = m.fallDistance - m.velocity.Y / B
                        elseif m.onGround then
                            if m.fallDistance > 3 and not m.inWater and m.id ~= "chicken" and m.id ~= "cat" and m.id ~= "ocelot" and m.id ~= "iron_golem" then mobs.hurt(m, math.ceil(m.fallDistance - 3), nil) end
                            m.fallDistance = 0
                        end
                        -- Fire (sunlight, lava): 1 damage a second.
                        sunBurn(m)
                        -- Entity.lavaHurt / BaseFireBlock.entityInside / Entity.baseTick burning.
                        local immune = mobs.fireImmune[m.id]
                        if m.inLava and not immune then
                            m.onFire = math.max(m.onFire or 0, 300)
                            if tick - (m.lavaHurtAt or -100) >= 10 then m.lavaHurtAt = tick; mobs.hurt(m, 4, nil) end
                        end
                        local fireNode = mobs.fireAt(m)
                        if fireNode and not immune then
                            m.onFire = math.max(m.onFire or 0, 160)
                            if tick - (m.fireHurtAt or -100) >= 10 then m.fireHurtAt = tick; mobs.hurt(m, fireNode.id == "soul_fire" and 2 or 1, nil) end
                        end
                        if m.inWater then m.onFire = nil end
                        if m.onFire then
                            if immune then m.onFire = m.onFire - 4
                            else
                                if m.onFire % 20 == 0 and not m.inLava then mobs.hurt(m, 1, nil) end
                                m.onFire = m.onFire - 1
                            end
                            if m.onFire <= 0 then m.onFire = nil end
                        end
                        -- Babies grow up after 24000 ticks (AgeableMob).
                        if m.baby then
                            m.babyAge = m.babyAge + 1 + math.floor((m.growth or 0) * 24000); m.growth = 0
                            if m.babyAge >= 0 then m.baby = false; m.scale = B; m.hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(m.width, m.height, m.width) * m.scale; buildVisual(m) end
                        end
                        -- Warden anger: players within 16 blocks and every nearby vibration.
                        if m.id == "warden" then
                            if player.alive() and not creative() and dist(m, player) < 16 and tick % 20 == 0 then m.anger = math.min(150, (m.anger or 0) + (dist(m, player) < 4 and 35 or 10)); if (m.anger or 0) < 80 then m.anim.WARDEN_SNIFF = tick end end
                            if tick % 20 == 0 then m.anger = math.max(0, (m.anger or 0) - 1) end
                            if (m.anger or 0) >= 80 and not m.roared then m.roared = true; m.anim.WARDEN_ROAR = tick end
                            if world.statusEffects and player.alive() and dist(m, player) < 20 and tick % 120 == 0 and not creative() then world.statusEffects.give("darkness", 13, 0) end
                        end
                        -- Piglins barter gold ingots lying near them (PiglinAi.admireGoldItem): 6 seconds, then loot.
                        if m.id == "piglin" and not m.baby and world.drops then
                            if m.admiring then
                                if tick >= m.admiring then
                                    m.admiring = nil
                                    local loot = data.loot["gameplay/piglin_bartering"]
                                    for _, st in ipairs(loot and LootRules.roll(loot, {}) or {}) do
                                        local e = JavaContent.itemById[st.name]
                                        if e then world.drop({id = e.index, count = st.count}, m.position + Vector3.new(0, B, 0), forwardOf(m.yaw) * B, true) end
                                    end
                                end
                            else
                                for _, d in ipairs(world.drops) do
                                    local e = JavaContent.byIndex[d.id]
                                    if e and (e.itemId or e.id) == "gold_ingot" and d.count > 0 and (d.position - m.position).Magnitude < 1.5 * B then
                                        d.count = d.count - 1; m.admiring = tick + 120; m.target = nil; mobs.stop(m); break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        -- Pufferfish puff up near players.
                        if m.id == "pufferfish" and tick % 10 == 0 then
                            local near = player.alive() and dist(m, player) < 2.5
                            local want = near and "big" or "small"
                            if m.variantName ~= want then m.variantName = want; buildVisual(m) end
                            if near and not creative() and world.statusEffects then world.statusEffects.give("poison", 3, 0); mobs.hurtPlayer(1, m) end
                        end
                        -- Enderman: teleport when hurt or in water.
                        if m.id == "enderman" and ((m.inWater and tick % 20 == 0) or (m.lastHurtTick == tick - 1)) then teleportRandom(m) end
                        -- Panic sets the panicking flag; flee movement handled by the goal.
                        m.hitbox.CFrame = CFrame.new(m.position + Vector3.new(0, m.hitbox.Size.Y / 2, 0))
                        if (m.position.Y < -400) then mobs.remove(m) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Vibrations anger the warden (WardenAi: +35 per vibration it can hear).
    function mobs.hearVibration(position)
        for _, m in ipairs(mobs.list) do
            if m.id == "warden" and (m.position - position).Magnitude < 16 * B then
                m.anger = math.min(150, (m.anger or 0) + 35)
                m.lastVibration = tick
                if (m.anger or 0) < 80 then mobs.lookAt(m, position, 20) end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Animation --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local rad = math.pi / 180
    local cos, sin, abs, pi = math.cos, math.sin, math.abs, math.pi
    local animDefs = data.animations or {}
    local function triangle(x, period) return (abs(x % period - period * 0.5) - period * 0.25) / (period * 0.25) end
    -- Mth.catmullrom
    local function catmull(t, a, b, c, d) return 0.5 * (2 * b + (c - a) * t + (2 * a - 5 * b + 4 * c - d) * t * t + (3 * b - a - 3 * c + d) * t * t * t) end
    local function sample(keys, t)
        local n = #keys
        if n == 0 then return 0, 0, 0 end
        if t <= keys[1][1] then local v = keys[1][2]; return v[1], v[2], v[3] end
        local i = 1
        while i < n and keys[i + 1][1] <= t do i = i + 1 end
        if i >= n then local v = keys[n][2]; return v[1], v[2], v[3] end
        local k0, k1 = keys[i], keys[i + 1]
        local span = k1[1] - k0[1]
        local a = span > 0 and (t - k0[1]) / span or 0
        local v0, v1 = k0[2], k1[2]
        if k1[3] == 1 then
            local vp, vn = keys[math.max(1, i - 1)][2], keys[math.min(n, i + 2)][2]
            return catmull(a, vp[1], v0[1], v1[1], vn[1]), catmull(a, vp[2], v0[2], v1[2], vn[2]), catmull(a, vp[3], v0[3], v1[3], vn[3])
        end
        return v0[1] + (v1[1] - v0[1]) * a, v0[2] + (v1[2] - v0[2]) * a, v0[3] + (v1[3] - v0[3]) * a
    end
    -- KeyframeAnimations.animate: rotation / position / scale channels added to the bones.
    local function keyframes(st, defName, elapsedMs, scale)
        local def = animDefs[defName]
        if not def then return end
        local t = elapsedMs / 1000
        if def.loop and def.length > 0 then t = t % def.length end
        scale = scale or 1
        for bone, chans in pairs(def.bones) do
            local b = st[bone]
            if b then
                for _, ch in ipairs(chans) do
                    local x, y, z = sample(ch.keys, t)
                    if ch.target == "ROTATION" then b.x, b.y, b.z = b.x + x * scale, b.y + y * scale, b.z + z * scale
                    elseif ch.target == "POSITION" then b.px, b.py, b.pz = b.px + x * scale, b.py + y * scale, b.pz + z * scale end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function walkKeys(st, name, s, maxSpeed, scaleFactor)
        keyframes(st, name, s.walkPos * 50 * maxSpeed, math.min(s.walkSpeed * scaleFactor, 1))
    end
    local function playing(m, name, partial, length)
        local start = m.anim[name]
        if not start then return nil end
        local ms = (tick - start + partial) * 50
        local def = animDefs[length or name]
        if def and not def.loop and ms > def.length * 1000 + 100 then m.anim[name] = nil; return nil end
        return ms
    end
    local function play(st, m, defName, key, partial)
        local ms = playing(m, key, partial, defName)
        if ms then keyframes(st, defName, ms, 1) end
    end
    local A = {}
    local function head(st, s, name) local b = st[name or "head"]; if b then b.y = b.y + s.yRot * rad; b.x = b.x + s.xRot * rad end end
    local function quad(st, s, mult)
        local c, w = s.walkPos * 0.6662, s.walkSpeed * (mult or 1)
        if st.right_hind_leg then st.right_hind_leg.x = st.right_hind_leg.x + cos(c) * 1.4 * w end
        if st.left_hind_leg then st.left_hind_leg.x = st.left_hind_leg.x + cos(c + pi) * 1.4 * w end
        if st.right_front_leg then st.right_front_leg.x = st.right_front_leg.x + cos(c + pi) * 1.4 * w end
        if st.left_front_leg then st.left_front_leg.x = st.left_front_leg.x + cos(c) * 1.4 * w end
    end
    local function bobArms(st, age)
        if st.right_arm then st.right_arm.z = st.right_arm.z + cos(age * 0.09) * 0.05 + 0.05; st.right_arm.x = st.right_arm.x + sin(age * 0.067) * 0.05 end
        if st.left_arm then st.left_arm.z = st.left_arm.z - (cos(age * 0.09) * 0.05 + 0.05); st.left_arm.x = st.left_arm.x - sin(age * 0.067) * 0.05 end
    end
    -- HumanoidModel.setupAnim (+ arm poses, riding, swing).
    local function humanoid(st, s, m)
        head(st, s)
        local c, w = s.walkPos * 0.6662, s.walkSpeed
        local ra, la, rl, ll = st.right_arm, st.left_arm, st.right_leg, st.left_leg
        if ra then ra.x = cos(c + pi) * 2 * w * 0.5; ra.y, ra.z = 0, 0 end
        if la then la.x = cos(c) * 2 * w * 0.5; la.y, la.z = 0, 0 end
        if rl then rl.x = cos(c) * 1.4 * w; rl.y, rl.z = 0, 0 end
        if ll then ll.x = cos(c + pi) * 1.4 * w; ll.y, ll.z = 0, 0 end
        local pose = m.armPose
        local hd = st.head
        if ra and la and hd then
            if pose == "bow" and m.aggressive then
                ra.y = -0.1 + hd.y; la.y = 0.1 + hd.y + 0.4; ra.x = -pi / 2 + hd.x; la.x = -pi / 2 + hd.x
            elseif pose == "crossbow" and m.aggressive then
                -- AnimationUtils.animateCrossbowHold / Charge
                if m.chargingCrossbow then ra.y = -0.8; ra.x = -0.97079635; la.x = ra.x; la.y = 0.4
                else ra.y = -0.3 + hd.y; la.y = 0.6 + hd.y; ra.x = -pi / 2 + hd.x + 0.1; la.x = -1.5 + hd.x end
            elseif pose == "zombie" then
                -- AnimationUtils.animateZombieArms
                local f = sin(s.attack * pi); local g = sin((1 - (1 - s.attack) * (1 - s.attack)) * pi)
                ra.z, la.z = 0, 0
                ra.y = -(0.1 - f * 0.6); la.y = 0.1 - f * 0.6
                local base = -pi / (m.aggressive and 1.5 or 2.25)
                ra.x = base + f * 1.2 - g * 0.4; la.x = base + f * 1.2 - g * 0.4
                bobArms(st, s.age)
                return
            elseif m.item then ra.x = ra.x * 0.5 - pi / 10 end
            -- setupAttackAnimation (right arm swing).
            if s.attack > 0 and st.body then
                local f = s.attack
                local by = sin(math.sqrt(f) * pi * 2) * 0.2
                st.body.y = st.body.y + by
                ra.pz = sin(by) * 5; ra.px = -cos(by) * 5 - (-5)
                ra.y = ra.y + by; la.y = la.y + by; la.x = la.x + by
                local ff = 1 - s.attack; ff = ff * ff; ff = ff * ff; ff = 1 - ff
                local g = sin(ff * pi); local hh = sin(s.attack * pi) * -(hd.x - 0.7) * 0.75
                ra.x = ra.x - (g * 1.2 + hh); ra.y = ra.y + by * 2; ra.z = ra.z + sin(s.attack * pi) * -0.4
            end
            bobArms(st, s.age)
        end
    end
    for _, id in ipairs({"zombie", "husk", "drowned", "zombie_villager", "skeleton", "stray", "bogged", "parched", "wither_skeleton", "piglin", "piglin_brute", "zombified_piglin", "giant"}) do A[id] = humanoid end
    A.enderman = function(st, s, m)
        humanoid(st, s, m)
        -- EndermanModel: long legs swing less; mouth open (head lowered) when angry.
        if st.right_leg then st.right_leg.x = st.right_leg.x * 0.5 end
        if st.left_leg then st.left_leg.x = st.left_leg.x * 0.5 end
        if st.right_arm then st.right_arm.x = st.right_arm.x * 0.5 end
        if st.left_arm then st.left_arm.x = st.left_arm.x * 0.5 end
        if m.target and st.head then st.head.py = st.head.py - 5 end
    end
    for _, id in ipairs({"cow", "mooshroom", "pig", "sheep", "polar_bear", "panda", "goat", "hoglin", "zoglin", "llama", "trader_llama", "turtle", "creeper"}) do
        A[id] = function(st, s, m)
            head(st, s); quad(st, s)
            if m.id == "sheep" and m.eating and st.head then
                -- SheepModel: the head dips to eat.
                local t = tick - m.eating + s.partial
                local f = t >= 4 and t <= 36 and 1 or (t < 4 and t / 4 or math.max(0, (40 - t) / 4))
                st.head.py = st.head.py + 9 * f; st.head.x = 0.62831855 + 0.21991149 * sin(t * 4.7) * (t > 4 and t < 36 and 1 or 0) * f + st.head.x * (1 - f)
            end
            if m.id == "creeper" and m.swell then end
        end
    end
    A.chicken = function(st, s, m)
        head(st, s)
        if st.right_leg then st.right_leg.x = st.right_leg.x + cos(s.walkPos * 0.6662) * 1.4 * s.walkSpeed end
        if st.left_leg then st.left_leg.x = st.left_leg.x + cos(s.walkPos * 0.6662 + pi) * 1.4 * s.walkSpeed end
        -- ChickenModel: wings flap while falling.
        local flap = m.onGround and 0 or (sin(s.age * 1.2) + 1)
        if st.right_wing then st.right_wing.z = st.right_wing.z + flap end
        if st.left_wing then st.left_wing.z = st.left_wing.z - flap end
    end
    local legNames = {"right_hind_leg", "left_hind_leg", "right_middle_hind_leg", "left_middle_hind_leg", "right_middle_front_leg", "left_middle_front_leg", "right_front_leg", "left_front_leg"}
    local spider = function(st, s)
        head(st, s)
        -- SpiderModel.setupAnim: legs paddle in four phases and lift alternately.
        local w, l = s.walkSpeed, s.walkPos * 0.6662 * 2
        local m1 = -(cos(l) * 0.4) * w; local n1 = -(cos(l + pi) * 0.4) * w; local o1 = -(cos(l + pi / 2) * 0.4) * w; local p1 = -(cos(l + pi * 1.5) * 0.4) * w
        local q = abs(sin(s.walkPos * 0.6662) * 0.4) * w; local r = abs(sin(s.walkPos * 0.6662 + pi) * 0.4) * w
        local s2 = abs(sin(s.walkPos * 0.6662 + pi / 2) * 0.4) * w; local t2 = abs(sin(s.walkPos * 0.6662 + pi * 1.5) * 0.4) * w
        local ys = {m1, -m1, n1, -n1, o1, -o1, p1, -p1}
        local zs = {q, -q, r, -r, s2, -s2, t2, -t2}
        for i, n in ipairs(legNames) do local b = st[n]; if b then b.y = b.y + ys[i]; b.z = b.z + zs[i] end end
    end
    A.spider, A.cave_spider = spider, spider
    local wolfLike = function(st, s, m)
        head(st, s, st.real_head and "head" or "head")
        if m.sitting then
            -- WolfModel sitting pose.
            if st.upper_body then st.upper_body.x = st.upper_body.x end
            for _, n in ipairs({"right_hind_leg", "left_hind_leg"}) do if st[n] then st[n].x = 4.712389; st[n].py = st[n].py + 4 end end
            for _, n in ipairs({"right_front_leg", "left_front_leg"}) do if st[n] then st[n].x = 5.811947 end end
            if st.body then st.body.x = pi / 4; st.body.py = st.body.py + 2 end
        else quad(st, s) end
        if st.tail then st.tail.x = st.tail.x + (m.tamed and (m.humanoid.Health / m.humanoid.MaxHealth) * 0.5 or 0) + (m.target and 0.3 or 0); st.tail.y = cos(s.walkPos * 0.6662) * 1.4 * s.walkSpeed end
    end
    A.wolf = wolfLike
    local feline = function(st, s, m)
        head(st, s)
        local c, w = s.walkPos * 0.6662, s.walkSpeed
        -- FelineModel walk: hind legs in phase, fronts opposite, 0.3pi offset.
        if st.left_hind_leg then st.left_hind_leg.x = st.left_hind_leg.x + cos(c) * w end
        if st.right_hind_leg then st.right_hind_leg.x = st.right_hind_leg.x + cos(c + pi * 0.3) * w end
        if st.left_front_leg then st.left_front_leg.x = st.left_front_leg.x + cos(c + pi + pi * 0.3) * w end
        if st.right_front_leg then st.right_front_leg.x = st.right_front_leg.x + cos(c + pi) * w end
        if st.tail2 then st.tail2.x = st.tail2.x + 0.47123894 * w * cos(c) end
        if m.sitting and st.body then st.body.x = pi / 4; st.body.py = st.body.py + 4 end
    end
    A.cat, A.ocelot = feline, feline
    local equine = function(st, s, m)
        head(st, s, st.head_parts and "head_parts" or "head")
        local c, w = s.walkPos * 0.6662, s.walkSpeed
        -- AbstractEquineModel: diagonal legs, tail lifts with speed.
        for _, pair in ipairs({{"left_hind_leg", 0}, {"right_hind_leg", pi}, {"left_front_leg", pi}, {"right_front_leg", 0}}) do
            local b = st[pair[1]]; if b then b.x = b.x + cos(c * 0.6 + pair[2]) * 0.5 * w * 2.4 end
        end
        if st.tail then st.tail.x = st.tail.x + 0.5235988 + w * 0.75 end
        if m.standing and tick - m.standing < 20 and st.body then st.body.x = -pi / 4 end
    end
    for _, id in ipairs({"horse", "donkey", "mule", "skeleton_horse", "zombie_horse"}) do A[id] = equine end
    A.iron_golem = function(st, s, m)
        head(st, s)
        local w = s.walkSpeed
        if st.right_leg then st.right_leg.x = -1.5 * triangle(s.walkPos, 13) * w end
        if st.left_leg then st.left_leg.x = 1.5 * triangle(s.walkPos, 13) * w end
        local attack = m.swingStart and tick - m.swingStart < 10 and (tick - m.swingStart + s.partial)
        if attack and st.right_arm then st.right_arm.x = -2 + 1.5 * triangle(attack, 10); st.left_arm.x = -2 + 1.5 * triangle(attack, 10)
        elseif st.right_arm then st.right_arm.x = (-0.2 + 1.5 * triangle(s.walkPos, 13)) * w; st.left_arm.x = (-0.2 - 1.5 * triangle(s.walkPos, 13)) * w end
    end
    A.snow_golem = function(st, s)
        head(st, s)
        if st.upper_body then st.upper_body.y = s.yRot * rad * 0.25 end
    end
    local villagerAnim = function(st, s, m)
        head(st, s)
        if m.shakeHead and tick - m.shakeHead < 40 and st.head then st.head.z = 0.3 * sin(0.45 * s.age); st.head.x = 0.4 end
        if st.right_leg then st.right_leg.x = cos(s.walkPos * 0.6662) * 1.4 * s.walkSpeed * 0.5 end
        if st.left_leg then st.left_leg.x = cos(s.walkPos * 0.6662 + pi) * 1.4 * s.walkSpeed * 0.5 end
        if st.nose and m.id == "witch" then st.nose.px = st.nose.px + sin(s.age * 0.1) * 0.5 end
    end
    A.villager, A.wandering_trader, A.witch = villagerAnim, villagerAnim, villagerAnim
    -- IllagerModel: arms crossed unless attacking / casting / holding a weapon.
    local illager = function(st, s, m)
        head(st, s)
        if st.right_leg then st.right_leg.x = cos(s.walkPos * 0.6662) * 1.4 * s.walkSpeed * 0.5 end
        if st.left_leg then st.left_leg.x = cos(s.walkPos * 0.6662 + pi) * 1.4 * s.walkSpeed * 0.5 end
        local crossed = not (m.aggressive or m.casting)
        if st.arms then st.arms.hidden = not crossed end
        if st.right_arm then st.right_arm.hidden = crossed end
        if st.left_arm then st.left_arm.hidden = crossed end
        if m.casting and st.right_arm then
            st.right_arm.pz, st.right_arm.px = 0, -5 - st.right_arm.px * 0
            st.right_arm.x = cos(s.age * 0.6662) * 0.25; st.left_arm.x = cos(s.age * 0.6662) * 0.25
            st.right_arm.z = 2.3561945; st.left_arm.z = -2.3561945
        elseif m.aggressive and st.right_arm then
            if m.armPose == "crossbow" then humanoid(st, s, m)
            else
                local f = sin(s.attack * pi); local g = sin((1 - (1 - s.attack) * (1 - s.attack)) * pi)
                st.right_arm.z, st.left_arm.z = 0, 0
                st.right_arm.y = 0.15707964; st.left_arm.y = -0.15707964
                st.right_arm.x = -1.8849558 + cos(s.age * 0.09) * 0.15 - f * 2.2 + g * 0.4
                st.left_arm.x = -0.0 + cos(s.age * 0.19) * 0.5
            end
        end
    end
    for _, id in ipairs({"evoker", "vindicator", "pillager", "illusioner"}) do A[id] = illager end
    A.ravager = function(st, s, m) head(st, s); quad(st, s, 0.4) end
    A.blaze = function(st, s)
        head(st, s)
        -- BlazeModel: three rings of rods circling at different speeds.
        local f = s.age * pi * -0.1
        for i = 0, 11 do
            local b = st["part" .. i]
            if b then
                local ring = i < 4 and 0 or i < 8 and 1 or 2
                if i == 4 then f = pi / 4 + s.age * pi * 0.03 elseif i == 8 then f = 0.47123894 + s.age * pi * -0.05 end
                local r = ring == 0 and 9 or ring == 1 and 7 or 5
                local y = ring == 0 and (-2 + cos((i * 2 + s.age) * 0.25)) or ring == 1 and (2 + cos((i * 2 + s.age) * 0.25)) or (11 + cos((i * 1.5 + s.age) * 0.5))
                b.px, b.py, b.pz = cos(f) * r - b.rx, y - b.ry, sin(f) * r - b.rz
                f = f + pi / 2
            end
        end
    end
    local ghastAnim = function(st, s)
        for i = 0, 8 do local b = st["tentacle" .. i]; if b then b.x = 0.2 * sin(s.age * 0.3 + i) + 0.4 end end

    local squidAnim = function(st, s, m)

        if st.left_wing then st.left_wing.z = flying and -cos(s.age * 2.1) * pi * 0.15 or 0 end
        if flying then
            for _, n in ipairs({"front_legs", "middle_legs", "back_legs"}) do if st[n] then st[n].x = pi / 4 end end
            if st.bone then st.bone.x = 0; st.bone.py = st.bone.py + cos(s.age * 0.18) * 0.9 end
        end
    end
    A.parrot = function(st, s, m)

        if st.left_wing then st.left_wing.z = st.left_wing.z - flap end
    end
    A.phantom = function(st, s, m)
        local f = (m.age % 64 + s.partial) * 7.448451 * rad * 16
        local a = cos(f) * 16 * rad
        if st.left_wing_base then st.left_wing_base.z = a end
        if st.left_wing_tip then st.left_wing_tip.z = a end
        if st.right_wing_base then st.right_wing_base.z = -a end
        if st.right_wing_tip then st.right_wing_tip.z = -a end
        if st.tail_base then st.tail_base.x = -(5 + cos(f * 2) * 5) * rad end
        if st.tail_tip then st.tail_tip.x = -(5 + cos(f * 2) * 5) * rad end
    end
    A.vex = function(st, s, m)

        if not m.onGround then keyframes(st, prefix .. "HOP", (m.age + s.partial) * 50, 1) end
        if math.random(400) == 1 and not m.anim.TILT then m.anim.TILT = tick end
        play(st, m, prefix .. "IDLE_HEAD_TILT", "TILT", s.partial)
    end
    A.warden = function(st, s, m)
        head(st, s)
        -- WardenModel.animateWalk + tendril wiggle, then the brain's keyframes.
        local f = math.min(0.5, 3 * s.walkSpeed)
        local g = s.walkPos * 0.8662
        local hcos, hsin = cos(g), sin(g)
        if st.head then st.head.z = st.head.z + 0.06 * hcos * f; st.head.x = st.head.x + 1.2 * cos(g + pi / 2) * f end
        if st.body then st.body.z = 0.1 * hsin * f; st.body.x = 1 * hcos * f * 0.5 end
        if st.left_leg then st.left_leg.x = 1 * hcos * f end
        if st.right_leg then st.right_leg.x = 1 * cos(g + pi) * f end
        if st.left_arm then st.left_arm.x = -(0.8 * hcos * f); st.left_arm.z = 0 end
        if st.right_arm then st.right_arm.x = -(0.8 * hsin * f); st.right_arm.z = 0 end
        local tendril = (m.lastVibration and tick - m.lastVibration < 10) and sin(s.age * 2.25) * 0.7 or 0
        if st.left_tendril then st.left_tendril.x = tendril end
        if st.right_tendril then st.right_tendril.x = -tendril end
        if m.swingStart and tick - m.swingStart < 7 then keyframes(st, "WardenAnimation.WARDEN_ATTACK", (tick - m.swingStart + s.partial) * 50, 1) end
        for _, n in ipairs({"EMERGE", "ROAR", "SNIFF", "SONIC_BOOM", "DIG"}) do play(st, m, "WardenAnimation.WARDEN_" .. n, "WARDEN_" .. n, s.partial) end
        if m.anim.SONIC_BOOM then play(st, m, "WardenAnimation.WARDEN_SONIC_BOOM", "SONIC_BOOM", s.partial) end
    end

    -- Render -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function boneState(m)
        local st = {}
        for _, bone in ipairs(m.visual.bones) do
            local p = bone.rawPose
            st[bone.name] = {x = p[4], y = p[5], z = p[6], px = 0, py = 0, pz = 0, rx = p[1], ry = p[2], rz = p[3]}
        end
        return st
    end
    local function overridesFrom(st)
        local out = {}
        for name, b in pairs(st) do
            if type(b) == "table" then out[name] = {x = b.x, y = b.y, z = b.z, px = b.px ~= 0 and b.px or nil, py = b.py ~= 0 and b.py or nil, pz = b.pz ~= 0 and b.pz or nil, hidden = b.hidden} end
        end
        return out
    end
    local function lerpAngle(a, b, t) return a + wrap(b - a) * t end
    local renderMob
    function mobs.render(partial)
        for _, m in ipairs(mobs.list) do
            -- One mob's error must not stop the frame (the player's own animations render after the mobs).
            local ok, err = pcall(renderMob, m, partial)
            if not ok and not m.renderError then m.renderError = true; warn("[Steve] mob render failed (" .. tostring(m.id) .. "): " .. tostring(err)) end
        end
    end
    renderMob = function(m, partial)
        do
            if not m.removed and m.visual.model.Parent then
                local pos = m.previous:Lerp(m.position, partial)
                if m.vehicle then
                    local v = m.vehicle
                    pos = api.vehicles.toStuds((v.old or v.pos):Lerp(v.pos, partial)) + Vector3.new(0, 0.05 * B, 0)
                    if v.kind == "boat" and api.riding == v then pos = pos + Vector3.new(math.sin(v.yaw), 0, math.cos(v.yaw)) * 0.6 * B end
                end
                local bodyYaw = lerpAngle(m.previousYaw or m.bodyYaw or m.yaw, m.bodyYaw or m.yaw, partial)
                local headYaw = lerpAngle(m.previousHeadYaw or m.headYaw, m.headYaw, partial)
                local s = {partial = partial, age = m.age + partial, walkPos = m.walkPos - m.walkSpeed * (1 - partial), walkSpeed = m.walkSpeedOld + (m.walkSpeed - m.walkSpeedOld) * partial,
                    yRot = math.clamp(wrap(headYaw - bodyYaw) / rad, -75, 75) * -1, xRot = (m.headPitch or 0) / rad, attack = m.attackAnim > 0 and (1 - m.attackAnim) or 0}
                if m.emerge then pos = pos - Vector3.new(0, m.emerge / 134 * m.scale * m.height, 0) end
                local st = boneState(m)
                local fn = A[m.id]
                if fn then local ok = pcall(fn, st, s, m); if not ok then st = boneState(m) end end
                local frame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, bodyYaw, 0)
                -- LivingEntityRenderer.isEntityUpsideDown: named "Dinnerbone" or "Grumm".
                if m.customName == "Dinnerbone" or m.customName == "Grumm" then
                    frame = frame * CFrame.new(0, m.height * m.scale + 0.1 * B, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi)
                end
                -- SheepRenderer: "jeb_" cycles the wool through the 16 dye colours, 25 ticks each.
                if m.id == "sheep" and not m.sheared then
                    if m.customName == "jeb_" then
                        local colours = {"white", "orange", "magenta", "light_blue", "yellow", "lime", "pink", "gray", "light_gray", "cyan", "purple", "blue", "brown", "green", "red", "black"}
                        local c = colours[math.floor(m.age / 25) % 16 + 1]
                        if m.variantName ~= c then m.variantName = c; m.jeb = true; mobs.buildVisual(m) end
                    elseif m.jeb then
                        m.jeb = nil; m.variantName = m.color or "white"; mobs.buildVisual(m)
                    end
                end
                -- LivingEntityRenderer.setupRotations: dying mobs tip over 90 degrees.
                if m.deathTime > 0 then frame = frame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.min(1, math.sqrt((m.deathTime - 1 + partial) / 20 * 1.6)) * math.pi / 2) end
                -- Creepers swell (CreeperRenderer.scale) - shown as a slight jitter here.
                m.visual.pivot(frame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0), nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, overridesFrom(st))
                -- Hurt / burning tint (LivingEntityRenderer overlay).
                local red = m.hurtTime > 0 or m.deathTime > 0
                if red and not m.flash then
                    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight"); hl.FillColor, hl.FillTransparency, hl.OutlineTransparency, hl.DepthMode = Color3.new(1, 0, 0), 0.55, 1, Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
                    hl.Parent = m.visual.model; m.flash = hl
                elseif not red and m.flash then m.flash:Destroy(); m.flash = nil end
                if m.id == "creeper" and (m.swell or 0) > 0 then
                    local f = ((m.swellOld or 0) + ((m.swell or 0) - (m.swellOld or 0)) * partial) / 28
                    local white = math.floor(f * 10) % 2 == 1
                    if white and not m.flash then local hl = Instance.new("Highlight"); hl.FillColor, hl.FillTransparency, hl.OutlineTransparency = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.4, 1; hl.Parent = m.visual.model; m.flash = hl
                    elseif not white and m.flash and m.hurtTime == 0 then m.flash:Destroy(); m.flash = nil end
                end
                -- Held item in the right hand (ItemInHandLayer).
                if m.item then
                    local v = equipVisuals[m]
                    if not v then
                        local e = JavaContent.itemById[m.item]
                        if e then
                            local offset, scale = CFrame.new(), m.scale * 0.5
                            if JavaContent.display then offset, scale = JavaContent.display(e.index, "thirdperson_righthand", m.scale) end
                            v = JavaContent.model(e.index, {}, scale, m.visual.model, pos, true); v.offset = offset; equipVisuals[m] = v
                        end
                    end
                    local arm = m.bones and m.bones.right_arm
                    if v and arm and arm.frame then v.pivot(arm.frame * CFrame.new(-1 / 16 * m.scale, -10 / 16 * m.scale, -2 / 16 * m.scale) * CFrame.Angles(-math.pi / 2, 0, 0) * v.offset) end
                end
                -- Worn head block (CustomHeadLayer.translateToHead): 0.625 of a block, centred 4 px above the neck.
                local headItem = m.headItem or (m.id == "snow_golem" and not m.noPumpkin and "carved_pumpkin") or nil
                if headVisuals[m] and headVisuals[m].itemId ~= headItem then headVisuals[m].model:Destroy(); headVisuals[m] = nil end
                if headItem then
                    local hv = headVisuals[m]
                    if not hv then
                        local e = JavaContent.itemById[headItem]
                        if e then
                            hv = JavaContent.model(e.index, {}, m.scale * 0.625, m.visual.model, pos, true)
                            -- an item on an entity is lit like the entity (not the block's own light level)
                            for _, d in ipairs(hv.model:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("SurfaceGui") then d.LightInfluence = 0.5 end end
                            hv.itemId = headItem
                            headVisuals[m] = hv
                        end
                    end
                    local head = m.bones and m.bones.head
                    local lift = m.id == "snow_golem" and 5.5 or 4
                    if hv and head and head.frame then hv.pivot(head.frame * CFrame.new(0, lift / 16 * m.scale, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0)) end
                end
                -- Guardian beam.
                if m.beamTarget and m.beamProgress then
                    if not m.beam then
                        local b = Instance.new("Part"); b.Anchored, b.CanCollide, b.CanQuery, b.CanTouch, b.Material = true, false, false, false, Enum.Material.Neon
                        b.Parent = folder; m.beam = b
                    end
                    local from = pos + Vector3.new(0, m.height * m.scale * 0.5, 0)
                    local to = eyeOf(m.beamTarget)
                    local d = to - from
                    m.beam.Size = Vector3.new(0.1 * B, 0.1 * B, d.Magnitude)
                    m.beam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(from + d / 2, to)
                    local p = m.beamProgress
                    m.beam.Color = Color3.new(0.25 + p * 0.75, 0.3 + p * 0.7, 1 - p * 0.5)
                elseif m.beam then m.beam:Destroy(); m.beam = nil end
            elseif m.removed and equipVisuals[m] then equipVisuals[m].model:Destroy(); equipVisuals[m] = nil end
        end
        for m, v in pairs(equipVisuals) do if m.removed then v.model:Destroy(); equipVisuals[m] = nil end end
        for m, v in pairs(headVisuals) do if m.removed then v.model:Destroy(); headVisuals[m] = nil end end
    end
    function mobs.destroy()
        for _, s in ipairs(shots) do s.part:Destroy() end
        for _, m in ipairs(mobs.list) do
            if m.beam then m.beam:Destroy() end
            if m.visual then
                if m.visual.destroy then m.visual.destroy() else m.visual.model:Destroy() end
            end
        end
        table.clear(mobs.list)
    end
    -- Hooks other modules use.
    function mobs.onDeath(m)
        -- Slimes split (Slime.remove): 2-4 smaller ones.
        if (m.id == "slime" or m.id == "magma_cube") and (m.size or 1) > 1 then
            for _ = 1, math.random(2, 4) do mobs.later(19, function() mobs.spawn(m.id, m.position + Vector3.new(rand() - 0.5, 0.5, rand() - 0.5) * B, false, {size = (m.size or 2) / 2}) end) end
        end
        if m.id == "chicken" then end
    end
    function mobs.onPlayerHit(m)
        -- Neutral mobs remember who hit them; owners' pets join in.
        mobs.ownerTarget = m
        if m.id == "zombified_piglin" or m.id == "wolf" or m.id == "bee" or m.id == "iron_golem" or m.id == "polar_bear" or m.id == "llama" or m.id == "panda" or m.id == "enderman" or m.id == "piglin" or m.id == "goat" or m.id == "dolphin" or m.id == "trader_llama" then
            m.target = player
        end
        if m.id == "armadillo" then m.rolled = true; m.anim.ROLL = tick end
        if m.id == "squid" or m.id == "glow_squid" then for _ = 1, 30 do particle(m.id == "glow_squid" and "glow_squid_ink" or "squid_ink", m.position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * B, 0), Vector3.new(rand() - 0.5, rand() - 0.5, rand() - 0.5) * B * 0.2, {life = 30, size = 0.2}) end end
    end
    function mobs.onAttack(m, t)
        if m.id == "iron_golem" and t then
            -- IronGolem.doHurtTarget: throws the target up.
            if t.isPlayer then if world.knockback then world.knockback(Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0)) end else t.velocity = t.velocity + Vector3.new(0, 0.4 * B, 0) end
        elseif m.id == "cave_spider" and t.isPlayer and world.statusEffects then world.statusEffects.give("poison", 7, 0)
        elseif m.id == "wither_skeleton" and t.isPlayer and world.statusEffects then world.statusEffects.give("wither", 10, 0)
        elseif m.id == "husk" and t.isPlayer and world.statusEffects then world.statusEffects.give("hunger", 7, 0)
        elseif m.id == "bee" and t.isPlayer then if world.statusEffects then world.statusEffects.give("poison", 10, 0) end; mobs.later(20, function() m.humanoid.Health = 0 end)
        elseif (m.id == "hoglin" or m.id == "zoglin") and t.isPlayer and world.knockback then world.knockback(Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)) end
    end
    return mobs
end
-- END MOBS
local function createJavaGameplay(world,character,root,inventory,ui,register,nodeAt,worldMining)
    local api={mobs={},arrows={},charge=0};local size=CONFIG.Block
    local folder=Instance.new('Folder');folder.Name='SteveMobsAndProjectiles';folder.Parent=workspace
    local ray=RaycastParams.new();ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;ray.FilterDescendantsInstances={character,folder};ray.RespectCanCollide=true
    local function selected()local s=inventory.slots[ui.selected];return s and JavaContent.byIndex[s.id] end
    local function give(id,count,position)
        local e=JavaContent.itemById[id];if not e then return end
        local added=inventory.add(e.index,count);if added<count then world.drop({id=e.index,count=count-added},position)end;ui.refresh()
    end
    local function exchange(index,id)
        local replacement=JavaContent.itemById[id];if not replacement then return false end
        local stack=inventory.slots[ui.selected]
        if CONFIG.Survival and stack and stack.id==index and stack.count==1 then
            inventory.slots[ui.selected]={id=replacement.index,count=1};ui.refresh();return true
        end
        if not world.consume(index,1)then return false end
        give(id,1,root.Position);return true
    end
    local function equipment(m,id,guaranteed)
        local entry=JavaContent.itemById[id];if not entry then return end
        if m.equipment then m.equipment.model:Destroy()end
        m.item=id;m.guaranteed=guaranteed
        m.equipment=JavaContent.model(entry.index,{},size*.55,m.visual.model,m.position,true)
    end
    local hostile={zombie=true,husk=true,drowned=true,skeleton=true,stray=true,bogged=true,wither_skeleton=true,creeper=true,spider=true,cave_spider=true,endermite=true,silverfish=true,witch=true,pillager=true,vindicator=true,evoker=true,ravager=true,blaze=true,ghast=true,phantom=true,slime=true,magma_cube=true,piglin_brute=true,zoglin=true,warden=true,wither=true,ender_dragon=true,breeze=true}
    local flying={allay=true,bat=true,bee=true,blaze=true,ghast=true,phantom=true,vex=true,wither=true,ender_dragon=true}
    function api.isHostile(id) return hostile[id]==true end
    local health={cow=10,pig=10,chicken=4,sheep=8,creeper=20,spider=16,enderman=40,iron_golem=100,warden=500,wither=300,ender_dragon=200,rabbit=3,wolf=8}
    function api.spawn(id,position,baby)
        if #api.mobs>=16 then return false end
        local def=JavaContent.data.entities[id];if not def then return false end
        local variant=math.random(#def.variants);local scale=size*(baby and .5 or 1)
        local visual=JavaContent.entityModel(id,variant,scale,folder,position,24)
        local hitbox=Instance.new('Part');hitbox.Name='HumanoidRootPart';hitbox.Anchored=true;hitbox.Transparency=1
        -- EntityType.Builder.sized(width, height) from 26.3 (babies are half size).
        local dims=JavaContent.data.entitySizes and JavaContent.data.entitySizes[id] or {width=.6,height=1.8}
        hitbox.Size=Vector3.new(dims.width,dims.height,dims.width)*scale;hitbox.CanCollide=true;hitbox.CanTouch=false;hitbox.Parent=visual.model
        local humanoid=Instance.new('Humanoid');humanoid.MaxHealth=health[id] or 20;humanoid.Health=humanoid.MaxHealth;humanoid.DisplayName=id:gsub('_',' ');humanoid.RequiresNeck=false;humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath=false;humanoid.Parent=visual.model
        local m={id=id,position=position,previous=position,visual=visual,hitbox=hitbox,humanoid=humanoid,yaw=math.random()*math.pi*2,age=0,variant=variant,scale=scale,velocity=0,walking=0,width=dims.width,height=dims.height,eye=dims.eye or dims.height*.85}
        visual.model:SetAttribute('MinecraftMob',id);visual.model:SetAttribute('MinecraftVariant',def.variants[variant].name);visual.model.PrimaryPart=hitbox
        api.mobs[#api.mobs+1]=m
        if id=='skeleton' or id=='stray' or id=='bogged' then equipment(m,'bow')
        elseif id=='wither_skeleton' then equipment(m,'stone_sword')
        elseif id=='pillager' then equipment(m,'crossbow')
        elseif id=='piglin' or id=='zombified_piglin' then equipment(m,'golden_sword')
        elseif id=='piglin_brute' then equipment(m,'golden_axe')
        elseif id=='vindicator' then equipment(m,'iron_axe')
        elseif (id=='zombie' or id=='husk') and math.random()<.05 then equipment(m,math.random()<.5 and 'iron_sword' or 'iron_shovel') end
        hitbox.CFrame=CFrame.new(position+Vector3.new(0,hitbox.Size.Y/2,0))
        return true
    end
    function api.shoot(position,direction,power,owner,arrowId)
        if #api.arrows>=64 then return false end
        local e=JavaContent.itemById[arrowId or 'arrow'];if not e then return false end
        local visual=JavaContent.arrowModel(arrowId or 'arrow',folder,position)
        api.arrows[#api.arrows+1]={position=position,previous=position,velocity=direction.Unit*size*3*power,age=0,power=power,owner=owner,visual=visual,id=arrowId or 'arrow'}
        return true
    end
    inventory.equipment=inventory.equipment or {}
    api.hunger=20;api.saturation=5;api.useTicks=0;api.boats={};api.armorVisuals={}
    local armorSlots={'helmet','chestplate','leggings','boots'}
    function api.equip(index)
        local entry=JavaContent.byIndex[index];local definition=entry and JavaContent.data.armor[entry.id]
        local stack=inventory.slots[ui.selected]
        if not definition or not stack or stack.id~=index then return false end
        local previous=inventory.equipment[definition.slot]
        inventory.equipment[definition.slot]=stack;inventory.slots[ui.selected]=previous
        ui.refresh();return true
    end
    function api.armorDamage(damage)
        local points,toughness=0,0
        for _,slot in ipairs(armorSlots)do
            local stack=inventory.equipment[slot];local entry=stack and JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id];local armor=entry and JavaContent.data.armor[entry.id]
            if armor and entry.id~='elytra' then
                points=points+armor.points;toughness=toughness+armor.toughness
                if CONFIG.Survival then stack.damage=(stack.damage or 0)+math.max(1,math.floor(damage/4));if stack.damage>=armor.durability then inventory.equipment[slot]=nil end end
            end
        end
        local reduction=math.min(20,math.max(points/5,points-damage/(2+toughness/4)))
        return damage*(1-reduction/25)
    end
    function api.flightTick(velocity,look,grounded,inWater,jump)
        local stack=inventory.equipment.chestplate;local e=stack and JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
        local canFly=e and e.id=='elytra' and (stack.damage or 0)<431
        local pressed=jump and not api.lastJump;api.lastJump=jump
        if grounded or inWater or not canFly or api.riding then api.gliding=false;api.boost=0
        elseif pressed and velocity.Y<0 then api.gliding=true end
        if not api.gliding then api.glideTicks=0;return end
        api.glideTicks=(api.glideTicks or 0)+1
        local horizontal=math.sqrt(look.X*look.X+look.Z*look.Z)
        local speed=math.sqrt(velocity.X*velocity.X+velocity.Z*velocity.Z)
        local x,y,z=velocity.X,velocity.Y-.08+horizontal*horizontal*.06,velocity.Z
        if y<0 and horizontal>0 then local lift=y*-.1*horizontal*horizontal;y=y+lift;x=x+look.X/horizontal*lift;z=z+look.Z/horizontal*lift end
        if look.Y>0 and horizontal>0 then local lift=speed*look.Y*.04;y=y+lift*3.2;x=x-look.X/horizontal*lift;z=z-look.Z/horizontal*lift end
        if horizontal>0 then x=x+(look.X/horizontal*speed-x)*.1;z=z+(look.Z/horizontal*speed-z)*.1 end
        local result=Vector3.new(x*.99,y*.98,z*.99)
        if (api.boost or 0)>0 then api.boost=api.boost-1;result=result+look*.1+(look*1.5-result)*.5;world.effects.emit('end_rod',root.Position,Vector3.zero)end
        api.flightAge=(api.flightAge or 0)+1
        if CONFIG.Survival and api.flightAge%20==0 then stack.damage=(stack.damage or 0)+1 end
        return result
    end
    api.vehicles=createVehicles({api=api,world=world,root=root,character=character,folder=folder,nodeAt=nodeAt,ui=ui})
    -- Batch 7e: Java mobs (AI, pathfinding, animations, riding, trading) replace the simple mob loop.
    api.mobsModule=createMobs(world,{root=root,character=character,folder=folder,api=api,inventory=inventory,ui=ui})
    api.mobs=api.mobsModule.list
    function api.spawn(id,position,baby,options) local m=api.mobsModule.spawn(id,position,baby,options);return m or false end
    function api.isHostile(id) return api.mobsModule.hostile[id]==true end
    api.boats=api.vehicles.list
    function api.spawnBoat(id,position) return api.vehicles.spawnBoat(id,position) end
    function api.extraTick()
        local controls=api.controls or {}
        api.vehicles.tick(controls,controls.look or Vector3.new(0,0,-1))
        api.foodAge=(api.foodAge or 0)+1
        if api.foodAge%80==0 and api.hunger>=18 and not api.noRegen then local h=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid');if h and h.Health>0 and h.Health<h.MaxHealth then h.Health=math.min(h.MaxHealth,h.Health+1);api.hunger=math.max(0,api.hunger-1)end end
        if api.foodAge%800==0 and CONFIG.Survival then api.hunger=math.max(0,api.hunger-1)end
    end
    function api.extraRender(partial)
        api.vehicles.render(partial)
        if not api.body then return end
        for _,slot in ipairs(armorSlots)do
            local stack=inventory.equipment[slot];local entry=stack and JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id];local definition=entry and JavaContent.data.armor[entry.id]
            local visual=api.armorVisuals[slot]
            if visual and visual.item~=(entry and entry.id) then visual.model:Destroy();api.armorVisuals[slot]=nil;visual=nil end
            -- Worn armor stays on see-through carriers: solid ones would block the first-person camera.
            if definition and not visual then visual=JavaContent.entityModel(definition.model,1,size,folder,Vector3.zero,0,entry.id~='elytra');visual.item=entry.id;api.armorVisuals[slot]=visual end
            if visual then visual.model.Parent=not world.renderFirstPerson and folder or nil end
            if visual then
                if entry.id=='elytra' then
                    -- Entity models are converted with Java's back (+Z) mapped to Roblox's front, so turn
                    -- the wings half a turn; ElytraLayer then pushes them 2px (0.125) behind the body.
                    local torso=api.body.body;visual.pivot(torso.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,size*.375,size*.125)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi,0),nil,nil,os.clock(),api.gliding and 1 or 0)
                else
                    for _,bone in ipairs(visual.bones)do
                        local target=api.body[bone.name=='hat' and 'head' or bone.name]
                        if target then
                            local offset=(bone.name=='head' or bone.name=='hat') and -4 or 6
                            if bone.name=='head' then offset=-4 elseif bone.name:find('arm')then offset=4 end
                            local side=bone.name=='right_arm' and -1 or bone.name=='left_arm' and 1 or 0
                            local joint=target.CFrame*CFrame.new(side*(world.skinSlim and .5 or 1)*size/16,offset*size/16,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi,0)
                            for _,face in ipairs(bone.faces)do face.part.CFrame=joint*face.frame end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function api.extraUse(held,index,direction,eye,pressed)
        local e=JavaContent.byIndex[index];if not e then api.scoping=false;api.blocking=false;api.useTicks=0;return false end
        api.scoping=e.id=='spyglass' and held;api.blocking=e.id=='shield' and held
        if e.id=='spyglass' or e.id=='shield' then return held end
        if JavaContent.data.armor[e.id] then if pressed and api.equip(index) and world.swing then world.swing() end;return held end
        if e.id=='firework_rocket' and api.gliding then if pressed and world.consume(index,1)then api.boost=30;if world.swing then world.swing() end end;return true end
        local food=JavaContent.data.food[e.id]
        if food or e.id=='milk_bucket' then
            if not held then api.useTicks=0;return false end
            if food and api.hunger>=20 and not food.always then return true end
            api.useTicks=api.useTicks+1
            if api.useTicks>=(food and food.duration or 32)then
                if e.id=='milk_bucket' then exchange(index,'bucket')
                elseif world.consume(index,1)then api.hunger=math.min(20,api.hunger+food.nutrition);api.saturation=math.min(api.hunger,api.saturation+food.saturation);if e.id:find('stew')or e.id:find('soup')then give('bowl',1,root.Position)elseif e.id=='honey_bottle'then give('glass_bottle',1,root.Position)end end
                api.useTicks=0
            end
            return true
        end
        api.useTicks=0
        return false
    end

    function api.updateUse(held,index,direction,eye)
        local pressed=held and not api.useHeld;api.useHeld=held
        if api.usingIndex~=index then api.useTicks=0;api.charge=0;api.usingIndex=index end
        if api.extraUse(held,index,direction,eye,pressed)then api.charge=0;return true end
        local e=JavaContent.byIndex[index]
        if not e or e.id~='bow' then api.charge=0;api.charging=nil;return false end
        if api.charging and api.charging~=index then api.charge=0 end
        api.charging=index
        if held then api.charge=math.min(30,api.charge+1);return true end
        if api.charge>0 then
            local duration=api.charge/20;local power=math.min(1,(duration*duration+duration*2)/3);api.charge=0
            if power<.1 then return true end
            local slot,ammo
            for i,stack in pairs(inventory.slots)do local item=JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id];if item and (item.id=='arrow' or item.id=='spectral_arrow' or item.id=='tipped_arrow')then slot,ammo=i,item;break end end
            if not CONFIG.Survival and not ammo then ammo=JavaContent.itemById.arrow end
            if ammo and api.shoot(eye+direction*size*.3,direction,power,nil,ammo.id) then
                if CONFIG.Survival then local stack=inventory.slots[slot];stack.count=stack.count-1;if stack.count==0 then inventory.slots[slot]=nil end end
                world.damageTool(index,1);ui.refresh()
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    function api.use(hit,sneaking,index)
        local e=JavaContent.byIndex[index]
        if hit and api.vehicles.use(hit,sneaking,index,e) then return true end
        if not e or not hit then return false end
        for _,m in ipairs(api.mobs)do if hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(m.visual.model)then
            if e.id=='bucket' and (m.id=='cow' or m.id=='mooshroom' or m.id=='goat')then exchange(index,'milk_bucket');return true end
            if toolStats[index] and (m.id:find('zombie') or m.id:find('skeleton') or m.id:find('piglin') or m.id=='pillager' or m.id=='vindicator')then
                if world.consume(index,1)then equipment(m,e.id,true)end;return true
            end
        end end
        if e.spawnEgg then
            local pos=hit.Position+hit.Normal*size*.4
            if api.spawn(e.spawnEgg,pos,sneaking and not hostile[e.spawnEgg])then world.consume(index,1)else worldMining.message='Mob limit reached (16 active mobs)' end
            return true
        end
        if e.id=='bucket' then
            local n=world.resolve(hit.Instance)
            if n and (n.id=='water' or n.id=='lava') and (tonumber(n.state.level) or 0)==0 then
                local filled=n.id..'_bucket';if exchange(index,filled)then world.breakBlock(hit,false)end
            end
            return true
        end
        if e.id=='water_bucket' or e.id=='lava_bucket' or e.id=='powder_snow_bucket' then
            local n=world.resolve(hit.Instance);local center=n and n.center or worldMining.cell(hit)
            local x,y,z=dominantFace(hit.Normal.X,hit.Normal.Y,hit.Normal.Z);center=center+Vector3.new(x,y,z)*size
            if not world.sample(center)then
                local block=JavaContent.byId[e.id:gsub('_bucket','')]
                if block and exchange(index,'bucket')then register(block.index,center,CreativeRules.copy(block.state));world.updateNeighbors();world.vibrate(center,13,{player=true})
                    -- A placed fluid starts flowing (it was registered without waking the fluid ticks).
                    if world.fluids then world.fluids.changed(center) end end
            end
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    local function mobLoot(m)
        local tableData=JavaContent.data.entityLoot and JavaContent.data.entityLoot[m.id]
        for _,stack in ipairs(tableData and LootRules.roll(tableData,{player=true})or {})do
            local e=JavaContent.itemById[stack.name];if e then world.drop({id=e.index,count=stack.count},m.position)end
        end
        if m.item and (m.guaranteed or math.random()<.085)then local e=JavaContent.itemById[m.item];world.drop({id=e.index,count=1},m.position)end
    end
    function api.containerTick(n)
        if not n.storage or (n.id~='furnace' and n.id~='smoker' and n.id~='blast_furnace') then return end
        local slots=n.storage.slots;local input=slots[1];local entry=input and JavaContent.byIndex[input.id]
        local recipe=entry and JavaContent.data.smelting[entry.id]
        if recipe and n.id=='smoker' then
            local foods={beef=true,porkchop=true,chicken=true,mutton=true,rabbit=true,cod=true,salmon=true,potato=true,kelp=true}
            if not foods[entry.id] then recipe=nil end
        elseif recipe and n.id=='blast_furnace' then
            if not (entry.id:find('ore') or entry.id:find('raw_') or recipe.item=='iron_nugget' or recipe.item=='gold_nugget') then recipe=nil end
        end
        local result=recipe and JavaContent.itemById[recipe.item];local output=slots[3]
        local canCook=result and (not output or (output.id==result.index and output.count<(itemStackLimits[result.index] or 64)))
        n.burn=math.max(0,(n.burn or 0)-1)
        if canCook and n.burn==0 and slots[2] then
            local fuel=JavaContent.byIndex[slots[2].id];local id=fuel and fuel.id or ''
            local duration=({coal=1600,charcoal=1600,coal_block=16000,blaze_rod=2400,lava_bucket=20000,stick=100,dried_kelp_block=4000})[id] or ((id:find('_planks') or id:find('_log') or id:find('_wood')) and 300 or 0)
            if duration>0 then
                n.burn,n.burnTotal=duration,duration;slots[2].count=slots[2].count-1
                if slots[2].count==0 then slots[2]=id=='lava_bucket' and {id=JavaContent.itemById.bucket.index,count=1} or nil end
            end
        end
        n.state.lit=tostring(n.burn>0)
        if n.burn>0 and canCook then
            n.cook=(n.cook or 0)+1
            n.cookTotal=(recipe.time or 200)/(n.id=='furnace' and 1 or 2)
            if n.cook>=n.cookTotal then
                n.cook=0;input.count=input.count-1;if input.count==0 then slots[1]=nil end
                slots[3]={id=result.index,count=(output and output.count or 0)+1}
                if n.containerOpen then ui.refresh()end
            end
        else n.cook=0 end
    end
    function api.tick()
        api.extraTick()
        api.mobsModule.tick(api.controls)
        for i=#api.arrows,1,-1 do
            local a=api.arrows[i];a.age=a.age+1;a.previous=a.position
            if a.stuck then
                if a.age>10 and (not a.owner or a.owner.dispenser) and (root.Position-a.position).Magnitude<size*1.5 then give(a.id,1,a.position);a.visual.model:Destroy();table.remove(api.arrows,i)
                elseif a.age>1200 then a.visual.model:Destroy();table.remove(api.arrows,i)end
            else
                local cast=RaycastParams.new();cast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;cast.FilterDescendantsInstances={a.visual.model,a.owner and a.owner.visual.model or character}
                local hit=workspace:Raycast(a.position,a.velocity,cast)
                if hit then
                    a.position=hit.Position;local model=hit.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model');local victim=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                    if victim then local damage=math.ceil(a.velocity.Magnitude/size*2);if victim.Parent==character then damage=api.blocking and 0 or api.armorDamage(damage)end;victim:TakeDamage(damage);world.effects.emit('crit',hit.Position,Vector3.zero);a.visual.model:Destroy();table.remove(api.arrows,i)
                    else a.stuck=true;world.vibrate(a.position,2,{player=not a.owner}) end -- PROJECTILE_LAND
                else a.position=a.position+a.velocity;a.velocity=a.velocity*.99-Vector3.new(0,size*.05,0)end
                if a.age>1200 and a.visual.model.Parent then a.visual.model:Destroy();table.remove(api.arrows,i)end
            end
        end
    end
    function api.render(partial)
        api.extraRender(partial)
        api.mobsModule.render(partial)
        for _,a in ipairs(api.arrows)do if a.visual.model.Parent then local p=a.previous:Lerp(a.position,partial);a.visual.pivot(CFrame.lookAt(p,p+a.velocity))end end
    end
    function api.destroy()api.mobsModule.destroy();folder:Destroy()end
    return api
end

-- BEGIN BLOCK PLACEMENT
-- Java 26.3 block placement and shapes on top of the creative world:
--  * Mth.getSeed / LegacyRandomSource (64-bit maths in 16-bit limbs, exact in doubles) for the
--    random model variants (WeightedVariants, MultiPartModel) and the XZ / XYZ model offsets;
--  * getStateForPlacement of the attached / directional families (nearest looking directions and
--    canSurvive), stacking (slabs, candles, sea pickles, snow, petals, turtle eggs);
--  * updateShape connections (fences, walls, panes, fence gates, mushroom blocks, snowy grass,
--    pointed dripstone) and face culling (Block.shouldRenderFace for full occluders and glass);
--  * fire: BaseFireBlock state, survival, ageing, burning out and spreading (FireBlock.tick), fire
--    and lava setting entities alight, and the burning flames (FlameFeatureRenderer) and the
--    first-person fire overlay (ScreenEffectRenderer.renderFire).
do
    local L16 = 65536
    local function limbs(n)
        local neg = n < 0
        if neg then n = -n end
        local r = {}
        for i = 1, 4 do r[i] = n % L16; n = math.floor(n / L16) end
        if neg then
            local carry = 1
            for i = 1, 4 do local v = (L16 - 1 - r[i]) + carry; r[i] = v % L16; carry = math.floor(v / L16) end
        end
        return r
    end
    local function mul64(a, b)
        local r, carry = {}, 0
        for k = 1, 4 do
            local s = carry
            for i = 1, k do s = s + a[i] * b[k - i + 1] end
            r[k] = s % L16; carry = math.floor(s / L16)
        end
        return r
    end
    local function add64(a, b)
        local r, c = {}, 0
        for i = 1, 4 do local s = a[i] + b[i] + c; r[i] = s % L16; c = math.floor(s / L16) end
        return r
    end
    local function xor64(a, b) return {bit32.bxor(a[1], b[1]), bit32.bxor(a[2], b[2]), bit32.bxor(a[3], b[3]), bit32.bxor(a[4], b[4])} end
    CreativeRules.limbs = limbs
    -- Mth.getSeed(x, y, z) as 64-bit limbs of l (the seed is l >> 16).
    function CreativeRules.javaSeed(x, y, z)
        local xi = (x * 3129871) % 4294967296
        if xi >= 2147483648 then xi = xi - 4294967296 end
        local l = xor64(xor64(limbs(xi), limbs(z * 116129781)), limbs(y))
        return add64(mul64(mul64(l, l), limbs(42317861)), mul64(l, limbs(11)))
    end
    -- The seed (l >> 16) as limbs, for setSeed.
    function CreativeRules.seedOf(l) return {l[2], l[3], l[4], l[4] >= 32768 and L16 - 1 or 0} end
    -- LegacyRandomSource: the 48-bit LCG (0x5DEECE66D, 0xB).
    function CreativeRules.javaRandom()
        local self, s0, s1, s2 = {}, 0, 0, 0
        function self.setSeed(l) s0, s1, s2 = bit32.bxor(l[1], 0xE66D), bit32.bxor(l[2], 0xDEEC), bit32.bxor(l[3], 0x5) end
        local function nextBits(bits)
            local r0 = s0 * 0xE66D + 0xB
            local r1 = s0 * 0xDEEC + s1 * 0xE66D + math.floor(r0 / L16)
            local r2 = s0 * 0x5 + s1 * 0xDEEC + s2 * 0xE66D + math.floor(r1 / L16)
            s0, s1, s2 = r0 % L16, r1 % L16, r2 % L16
            return math.floor((s2 * 4294967296 + s1 * L16 + s0) / 2 ^ (48 - bits))
        end
        self.next = nextBits
        function self.nextInt(bound)
            local r = nextBits(31)
            if bit32.band(bound, bound - 1) == 0 then return math.floor(bound * r / 2147483648) end
            local v = r % bound
            while r - v + bound - 1 >= 2147483648 do r = nextBits(31); v = r % bound end
            return v
        end
        function self.nextLong()
            local hi = nextBits(32); if hi >= 2147483648 then hi = hi - 4294967296 end
            local lo = nextBits(32); if lo >= 2147483648 then lo = lo - 4294967296 end
            local h = limbs(hi)
            return add64({0, 0, h[1], h[2]}, limbs(lo))
        end
        return self
    end
    -- BlockBehaviour offsets: seed = Mth.getSeed(x, 0, z); XZ within +-max, XYZ also -max vertical..0.
    function CreativeRules.blockOffset(entry, x, z)
        local o = entry and entry.offset
        if not o then return nil end
        local s = CreativeRules.javaSeed(x, 0, z)[2]
        local h = o[1]
        local dx = math.min(h, math.max(-h, ((s % 16) / 15 - 0.5) * 0.5))
        local dz = math.min(h, math.max(-h, ((math.floor(s / 256) % 16) / 15 - 0.5) * 0.5))
        local dy = (o[2] or 0) > 0 and ((math.floor(s / 16) % 16) / 15 - 1) * o[2] or 0
        return dx, dy, dz
    end
    -- Integer block position of a cell centre.
    function CreativeRules.blockPos(center, size)
        local origin = workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin")
        if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" then origin = Vector3.new(0, size / 2, 0) end
        local v = (center - origin) / size
        return math.floor(v.X + 0.5), math.floor(v.Y + 0.5), math.floor(v.Z + 0.5)
    end
    -- Model parts for a placed block: the blockstate selection, then the weighted choice
    -- (ModelBlockRenderer seeds with state.getSeed(pos); multipart shares one nextLong).
    local selectSpecs = CreativeRules.modelSpecs
    function CreativeRules.modelSpecs(entry, state, x, y, z)
        local result = selectSpecs(entry, state)
        if not x then return result end
        local weighted = false
        for _, s in ipairs(result) do if s.alt then weighted = true; break end end
        if not weighted then return result end
        if entry.seedLower and state.half == "upper" then y = y - 1 end
        local random = CreativeRules.javaRandom()
        random.setSeed(CreativeRules.seedOf(CreativeRules.javaSeed(x, y, z)))
