                if not canReach(cx, cz, x, z, cur, distance, thickness) then return end
                carveEllipsoid(cx, cz, x, y, z, hr, vr, mask, skip)
            end
        end
    end

    -- NoiseBasedChunkGenerator.generateCarvers + applyCarvingMask.
    local World = WG.World
    function World:carve(chunk)
        local carverData = self.data.carver or {}
        local mask = newMask()
        local random = WG.WorldgenRandom.new(WG.LegacyRandom.new(I64.from(0)))
        local cx, cz = chunk.cx, chunk.cz
        for dx = -8, 8 do
            for dz = -8, 8 do
                local sx, sz = cx + dx, cz + dz
                local biomeName = self.biomeSource.noiseBiome(floor(sx * 16 / 4), 0, floor(sz * 16 / 4))
                local biome = self.biomes[biomeName]
                for index, name in ipairs(biome and biome.carvers or {}) do
                    local cfg = carverData[name]
                    if cfg then
                        random:setLargeFeatureSeed(I64.add(self.seed, I64.from(index - 1)), sx, sz)
                        if random:nextFloat() <= f32(cfg.probability) then
                            local t = cfg.type:gsub("^minecraft:", "")
                            if t == "cave" then caveCarve(cfg, random, cx, cz, sx, sz, mask)
                            elseif t == "canyon" then canyonCarve(cfg, random, cx, cz, sx, sz, mask) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if WG.tick then WG.tick() end
        end
        if not mask.any then return end
        -- Visit in BitSet order: columns by x then z, each contiguous run from the top down.
        local aq = chunk.aquifer
        local GRASS, MYCELIUM, DIRT = WG.Blocks.id("grass_block[snowy=false]"), WG.Blocks.id("mycelium[snowy=false]"), WG.Blocks.id("dirt")
        local BEDROCK = WG.Blocks.id("bedrock")
        local bits = mask.bits
        for column = 0, 255 do
            local x, z = floor(column / 16), column % 16
            local base = column * MASK_H
            local i = 0
            while i < MASK_H do
                if bits[base + i] then
                    local j = i
                    while j + 1 < MASK_H and bits[base + j + 1] do j = j + 1 end
                    local hasGrass = false
                    local wx, wz = chunk.x0 + x, chunk.z0 + z
                    for wy = j + MASK_MIN, i + MASK_MIN, -1 do
                        local s = chunk:get(x, wy, z)
                        if s ~= BEDROCK then
                            local name = WG.Blocks.names[s]
                            if s == GRASS or s == MYCELIUM or name:match("^grass_block") or name:match("^mycelium") then hasGrass = true end
                            local state = aq.compute(wx, wy, wz, 0)
                            if state then
                                chunk:set(x, wy, z, state)
                                if hasGrass and chunk:get(x, wy - 1, z) == DIRT then
                                    local top = self:topMaterial(chunk, x, wy - 1, z, state ~= AIR)
                                    if top then chunk:set(x, wy - 1, z, top) end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    i = j + 1
                else
                    i = i + 1
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

do
    -- FEATURES: ChunkGenerator.applyBiomeDecoration over a 3x3 WorldGenRegion: placed features
    -- (placement modifiers) per decoration step in Java's FeatureSorter order, each with its own
    -- WorldgenRandom feature seed; block predicates, rule tests, state providers, canSurvive.
    local floor, abs, min, max, sqrt = math.floor, math.abs, math.min, math.max, math.sqrt
    local f32 = WG.f32
    local Blocks = WG.Blocks
    local AIR, WATER, LAVA = WG.AIR, WG.WATER, WG.LAVA
    local MIN_Y, HEIGHT = WG.MIN_Y, WG.HEIGHT
    local MAX_Y = MIN_Y + HEIGHT - 1
    local Providers = WG.Providers
    local msin, mcos = WG.msin, WG.mcos
    local F = {}
    WG.Feature = F
    local function trunc(v) return v >= 0 and floor(v) or -floor(-v) end
    local function mceil(v) return -floor(-v) end
    local PI = math.pi
    local FPI = f32(math.pi)

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- block states
    local data, flags, defaults, tagSets
    local baseOf, propsOf, infoOf = {}, {}, {}
    local function strip(n) return (n:gsub("^minecraft:", "")) end
    -- Canonical state name: base[k=v,...] with sorted non-default properties.
    local function canon(name, props)
        name = strip(name)
        local d = defaults and defaults[name]
        local keys = {}
        if props then for k, v in pairs(props) do if not d or d[k] ~= tostring(v) then keys[#keys + 1] = k end end end
        if #keys == 0 then return name end
        table.sort(keys)
        local parts = {}
        for i, k in ipairs(keys) do parts[i] = k .. "=" .. tostring(props[k]) end
        return name .. "[" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "]"
    end
    F.canon = canon
    local function base(id)
        local b = baseOf[id]
        if not b then
            local n = Blocks.names[id] or "air"
            b = n:match("^([^%[]+)") or n
            baseOf[id] = b
        end
        return b
    end
    F.base = base
    local function props(id)
        local p = propsOf[id]
        if not p then
            p = {}
            local n = Blocks.names[id] or "air"
            local inner = n:match("%[(.*)%]")
            if inner then for k, v in inner:gmatch("([^=,]+)=([^,]+)") do p[k] = v end end
            propsOf[id] = p
        end
        return p
    end
    local function prop(id, k)
        local v = props(id)[k]
        if v ~= nil then return v end
        local d = defaults[base(id)]
        return d and d[k]
    end
    F.prop = prop
    local function hasProp(id, k) local d = defaults[base(id)]; return d ~= nil and d[k] ~= nil end
    -- trySetValue: unchanged when the block has no such property.
    local function with(id, k, v)
        if not hasProp(id, k) then return id end
        local p = {}
        for kk, vv in pairs(props(id)) do p[kk] = vv end
        p[k] = tostring(v)
        return Blocks.id(canon(base(id), p))
    end
    F.with = with
    local function stateId(spec)
        if spec == nil then return nil end
        if type(spec) == "string" then return Blocks.id(canon(spec)) end
        local name = spec.id or spec.Name
        return Blocks.id(canon(name, spec.properties or spec.Properties))
    end
    F.stateId = stateId
    -- Physics flags of the default state (FeatureRef): air, replaceable, sturdy faces, solid, fluid.
    local function info(id)
        local i = infoOf[id]
        if not i then
            local b = base(id)
            local f = flags[b] or {"", "Block", ""}
            local s = f[1]
            i = {air = s:find("a", 1, true) ~= nil, repl = s:find("r", 1, true) ~= nil, up = s:find("u", 1, true) ~= nil,
                down = s:find("d", 1, true) ~= nil, side = s:find("s", 1, true) ~= nil, full = s:find("f", 1, true) ~= nil,
                solid = s:find("S", 1, true) ~= nil, solidRender = s:find("R", 1, true) ~= nil, cls = f[2], fluid = f[3] ~= "" and f[3] or nil}
            if prop(id, "waterlogged") == "true" then i.fluid = "water" end
            -- Snow layers / slabs: sturdy only when full.
            if b == "snow" then local l = tonumber(prop(id, "layers")) or 1; i.up = l == 8; i.full = l == 8 end
            if b:find("_slab$") then local t = prop(id, "type"); i.up = t ~= "bottom"; i.down = t ~= "top"; i.full = t == "double" end
            -- Source fluid: level 0 (or waterlogged).
            i.source = i.fluid ~= nil and (prop(id, "level") == nil or prop(id, "level") == "0" or i.cls ~= "LiquidBlock")
            i.liquid = i.cls == "LiquidBlock"
            infoOf[id] = i
        end
        return i
    end
    F.info = info
    local function isTag(id, tag) local s = tagSets[strip(tag)]; return s ~= nil and s[base(id)] == true end
    F.isTag = isTag
    local function isAir(id) return info(id).air end
    F.isAir = isAir
    -- HolderSet<Block>: "name", ["a", "b"] or "#tag".
    local setCache = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local function blockSet(spec)
        if type(spec) == "string" and spec:sub(1, 1) == "#" then return tagSets[strip(spec:sub(2))] or {} end
        local c = setCache[spec]
        if c then return c end
        c = {}
        if type(spec) == "string" then c[strip(spec)] = true
        else for _, n in ipairs(spec) do if n:sub(1, 1) == "#" then for k in pairs(tagSets[strip(n:sub(2))] or {}) do c[k] = true end else c[strip(n)] = true end end end
        if type(spec) == "table" then setCache[spec] = c end
        return c
    end
    F.blockSet = blockSet
    local function inSet(id, spec) return blockSet(spec)[base(id)] == true end

    function F.init(d)
        data = d
        flags, defaults = d.blockFlags or {}, d.blockDefaults or {}
        tagSets = {}
        for tag, list in pairs(d.blockTags or {}) do local s = {}; for _, n in ipairs(list) do s[n] = true end; tagSets[tag] = s end
        WG.blockDefaults = defaults
        -- Feature index per step, and each biome's feature set (BiomeFilter).
        F.stepIndex = {}
        for s, list in ipairs(d.steps or {}) do
            local m = {}
            for i, n in ipairs(list) do m[n] = i - 1 end
            F.stepIndex[s] = m
        end
        F.biomeHas = {}
        for name, b in pairs(d.biome) do
            local set = {}
            for _, step in ipairs(b.features or {}) do for _, f in ipairs(step) do set[f] = true end end
            F.biomeHas[name] = set
        end
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- directions
    local DIRS = {
        down = {0, -1, 0}, up = {0, 1, 0}, north = {0, 0, -1}, south = {0, 0, 1}, west = {-1, 0, 0}, east = {1, 0, 0},
    }
    local DIR_ORDER = {"down", "up", "north", "south", "west", "east"}
    local HORIZONTAL = {"north", "east", "south", "west"}
    local OPP = {down = "up", up = "down", north = "south", south = "north", west = "east", east = "west"}
    local CW = {north = "east", east = "south", south = "west", west = "north"}
    local AXIS = {down = "y", up = "y", north = "z", south = "z", west = "x", east = "x"}
    F.DIRS, F.DIR_ORDER, F.HORIZONTAL, F.OPP = DIRS, DIR_ORDER, HORIZONTAL, OPP
    local function randomHorizontal(r) return HORIZONTAL[r:nextInt(4) + 1] end
    local function shuffle(list, r)
        for i = #list, 2, -1 do
            local j = r:nextInt(i) + 1
            list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
        end
        return list
    end
    F.shuffle = shuffle

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- Java HashSet<BlockPos> order
    -- Vec3i.hashCode, HashMap.hash spreading, power-of-two buckets (insertion order within a bucket).
    local function int32(v) v = v % 4294967296; return v end
    local function posHash(x, y, z)
        local h = int32(int32(int32(y + z * 31) * 31) + x)
        return bit32.bxor(h, bit32.rshift(h, 16))
    end
    local PosSet = {}
    PosSet.__index = PosSet
    function PosSet.new(cap) return setmetatable({list = {}, has = {}, cap0 = cap or 16}, PosSet) end
    local function pkey(x, y, z) return x .. "," .. y .. "," .. z end
    function PosSet:add(x, y, z)
        local k = pkey(x, y, z)
        if self.has[k] then return false end
        self.has[k] = true
        self.list[#self.list + 1] = {x, y, z}
        return true
    end
    function PosSet:contains(x, y, z) return self.has[pkey(x, y, z)] == true end
    function PosSet:size() return #self.list end
    -- Iteration order of the equivalent java.util.HashSet.
    function PosSet:ordered()
        local n = #self.list
        local cap = self.cap0
        while n > cap * 0.75 do cap = cap * 2 end
        local arr = {}
        for i, p in ipairs(self.list) do arr[i] = {p = p, b = bit32.band(posHash(p[1], p[2], p[3]), cap - 1), i = i} end
        table.sort(arr, function(a, b) if a.b ~= b.b then return a.b < b.b end return a.i < b.i end)
        local out = {}
        for i, e in ipairs(arr) do out[i] = e.p end
        return out
    end
    F.PosSet = PosSet

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- final heightmaps
    -- WORLD_SURFACE, OCEAN_FLOOR, MOTION_BLOCKING, MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES (first available y).
    local HM = {"WORLD_SURFACE", "OCEAN_FLOOR", "MOTION_BLOCKING", "MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES"}
    local hmPred = {
        WORLD_SURFACE = function(id) return not info(id).air end,
        OCEAN_FLOOR = function(id) return isTag(id, "blocks_motion_in_heightmap") end,
        MOTION_BLOCKING = function(id) return isTag(id, "blocks_motion_in_heightmap") or info(id).fluid ~= nil end,
        MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES = function(id) return (isTag(id, "blocks_motion_in_heightmap") or info(id).fluid ~= nil) and not isTag(id, "leaves") end,
    }
    local predCache = {}
    for _, t in ipairs(HM) do
        local cache, p = {}, hmPred[t]
        predCache[t] = function(id) local v = cache[id]; if v == nil then v = p(id); cache[id] = v end return v end
    end
    function F.prime(chunk)
        if chunk.hm then return end
        local hm = {}
        for _, t in ipairs(HM) do
            local map, pred = {}, predCache[t]
            for i = 0, 255 do
                local x, z = i % 16, floor(i / 16)
                local top = MIN_Y
                for y = MAX_Y, MIN_Y, -1 do
                    if pred(chunk:get(x, y, z)) then top = y + 1; break end
                end
                map[i] = top
            end
            hm[t] = map
        end
        chunk.hm = hm
    end
    -- Heightmap.update for every final map (called by Chunk:set once primed).
    function F.updateHeights(chunk, x, y, z, id)
        local i = x + z * 16
        for _, t in ipairs(HM) do
            local map, pred = chunk.hm[t], predCache[t]
            local first = map[i]
            if y > first - 2 then
                if pred(id) then
                    if y >= first then map[i] = y + 1 end
                elseif first - 1 == y then
                    local found = MIN_Y
                    for yy = y - 1, MIN_Y, -1 do if pred(chunk:get(x, yy, z)) then found = yy + 1; break end end
                    map[i] = found
                end
            end
        end
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- region (WorldGenRegion)
    local Region = {}
    Region.__index = Region
    F.Region = Region
    -- world: {chunk(cx, cz) -> chunk (terrain at least), biome(x, y, z) -> name, seaLevel, temperature(biome, x, y, z)}
    function Region.new(world, cx, cz)
        return setmetatable({world = world, cx = cx, cz = cz, cache = {}}, Region)
    end
    function Region:chunkAt(x, z)
        local cx, cz = floor(x / 16), floor(z / 16)
        local key = cx * 65536 + cz
        local c = self.cache[key]
        if not c then c = self.world.chunk(cx, cz); F.prime(c); self.cache[key] = c end
        return c
    end
    function Region:get(x, y, z)
        if y < MIN_Y or y > MAX_Y then return AIR end
        return self:chunkAt(x, z):get(x % 16, y, z % 16)
    end
    function Region:canWrite(x, y, z)
        if y < MIN_Y or y > MAX_Y then return false end
        return abs(floor(x / 16) - self.cx) <= 1 and abs(floor(z / 16) - self.cz) <= 1
    end
    function Region:set(x, y, z, id)
        if not self:canWrite(x, y, z) then return false end
        self:chunkAt(x, z):set(x % 16, y, z % 16, id)
        return true
    end
    -- level.getHeight(type, x, z): the first free y.
    function Region:height(t, x, z)
        local c = self:chunkAt(x, z)
        if t == "WORLD_SURFACE_WG" then return c.surfaceWG[x % 16 + (z % 16) * 16] end
        if t == "OCEAN_FLOOR_WG" then return c.oceanFloorWG[x % 16 + (z % 16) * 16] end
        return c.hm[t][x % 16 + (z % 16) * 16]
    end
    function Region:biome(x, y, z) return self.world.biome(x, y, z) end
    function Region:isEmpty(x, y, z) return info(self:get(x, y, z)).air end
    function Region:fluidAt(x, y, z) return info(self:get(x, y, z)).fluid end
    function Region:isWater(x, y, z) return self:fluidAt(x, y, z) == "water" end
    function Region:sturdy(x, y, z, face)
        local i = info(self:get(x, y, z))
        if face == "up" then return i.up elseif face == "down" then return i.down end
        return i.side
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- canSurvive
    local survive = {}
    local function vegetation(tag) return function(R, id, x, y, z) return isTag(R:get(x, y - 1, z), tag) end end
    survive.VegetationBlock = vegetation("supports_vegetation")
    for _, c in ipairs({"BushBlock", "SaplingBlock", "FlowerBlock", "TallGrassBlock", "SweetBerryBushBlock", "FlowerBedBlock", "FireflyBushBlock", "EyeblossomBlock", "TallFlowerBlock"}) do survive[c] = survive.VegetationBlock end
    survive.DryVegetationBlock = vegetation("supports_dry_vegetation")
    survive.ShortDryGrassBlock, survive.TallDryGrassBlock = survive.DryVegetationBlock, survive.DryVegetationBlock
    survive.AzaleaBlock = vegetation("supports_azalea")
    survive.MangrovePropaguleBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z)
        if prop(id, "hanging") == "true" then return isTag(R:get(x, y + 1, z), "supports_hanging_mangrove_propagule") end
        return isTag(R:get(x, y - 1, z), "supports_mangrove_propagule")
    end
    survive.DoublePlantBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z)
        if prop(id, "half") == "upper" then local b = R:get(x, y - 1, z); return base(b) == base(id) and prop(b, "half") == "lower" end
        return isTag(R:get(x, y - 1, z), "supports_vegetation")
    end
    survive.CactusBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z)
        for _, d in ipairs(HORIZONTAL) do
            local v = DIRS[d]
            local n = R:get(x + v[1], y, z + v[3])
            if info(n).solid or info(n).fluid == "lava" then return false end
        end
        local b = R:get(x, y - 1, z)
        return (base(b) == "cactus" or isTag(b, "supports_cactus")) and not info(R:get(x, y + 1, z)).liquid
    end
    survive.CactusFlowerBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z) local b = R:get(x, y - 1, z); return isTag(b, "support_override_cactus_flower") or info(b).up end
    survive.SugarCaneBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z)
        local b = R:get(x, y - 1, z)
        if base(b) == "sugar_cane" then return true end
        if not isTag(b, "supports_sugar_cane") then return false end
        for _, d in ipairs(HORIZONTAL) do
            local v = DIRS[d]
            local n = R:get(x + v[1], y - 1, z + v[3])
            if info(n).fluid == "water" or base(n) == "frosted_ice" then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    survive.MushroomBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z)
        local b = R:get(x, y - 1, z)
        if isTag(b, "overrides_mushroom_light_requirement") then return true end
        return info(b).solidRender -- light is 0 before the light step
    end
    survive.LilyPadBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z)
        local b = R:get(x, y - 1, z)
        return (info(b).fluid == "water" and info(b).source or isTag(b, "supports_lily_pad")) and info(R:get(x, y, z)).fluid == nil
    end
    survive.SeagrassBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z) local b = R:get(x, y - 1, z); return info(b).up and not isTag(b, "cannot_support_seagrass") end
    survive.TallSeagrassBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z)
        if prop(id, "half") == "upper" then local b = R:get(x, y - 1, z); return base(b) == base(id) and prop(b, "half") == "lower" end
        local b = R:get(x, y - 1, z)
        local here = info(R:get(x, y, z))
        return info(b).up and not isTag(b, "cannot_support_seagrass") and here.fluid == "water" and here.source
    end
    survive.SeaPickleBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z) return info(R:get(x, y - 1, z)).up end
    survive.LeafLitterBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z) return info(R:get(x, y - 1, z)).up end
    survive.SmallDripleafBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z)
        if prop(id, "half") == "upper" then local b = R:get(x, y - 1, z); return base(b) == base(id) and prop(b, "half") == "lower" end
        local b = R:get(x, y - 1, z)
        local above = info(R:get(x, y, z))
        return isTag(b, "supports_small_dripleaf") or (above.fluid == "water" and above.source and isTag(b, "supports_vegetation"))
    end
    survive.BigDripleafBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z) local b = R:get(x, y - 1, z); return base(b) == "big_dripleaf" or base(b) == "big_dripleaf_stem" or isTag(b, "supports_big_dripleaf") end
    survive.HangingRootsBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z) return info(R:get(x, y + 1, z)).down end
    survive.SporeBlossomBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z) return info(R:get(x, y + 1, z)).down and not R:isWater(x, y, z) end
    survive.BambooStalkBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z) return isTag(R:get(x, y - 1, z), "supports_bamboo") end
    survive.CarpetBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z) return not R:isEmpty(x, y - 1, z) end
    survive.MossyCarpetBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z)
        local b = R:get(x, y - 1, z)
        if prop(id, "bottom") ~= "false" then return not info(b).air end
        return base(b) == base(id) and prop(b, "bottom") ~= "false"
    end
    survive.SnowLayerBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z)
        local b = R:get(x, y - 1, z)
        if isTag(b, "cannot_support_snow_layer") then return false end
        if isTag(b, "support_override_snow_layer") then return true end
        return info(b).full or (base(b) == "snow" and prop(b, "layers") == "8")
    end
    survive.CocoaBlock = function(R, id, x, y, z)
        local v = DIRS[prop(id, "facing") or "north"]
        return isTag(R:get(x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3]), "supports_cocoa")
    end
    local function growingPlant(dir, head, body)
        return function(R, id, x, y, z)
            local v = DIRS[OPP[dir]]
            local a = R:get(x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3])
            local b = base(a)
            if b == "magma_block" then return false end
            return b == head or b == body or R:sturdy(x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3], dir)
        end
    end
    survive.KelpBlock = growingPlant("up", "kelp", "kelp_plant")
    survive.KelpPlantBlock = survive.KelpBlock
    function F.canSurvive(R, id, x, y, z)
        local fn = survive[info(id).cls]
        if not fn then return true end
        return fn(R, id, x, y, z)
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- block predicates / rule tests
    local function offsetOf(p) local o = p.offset; if o then return o[1], o[2], o[3] end return 0, 0, 0 end
    local predicate
    predicate = function(R, p, x, y, z)
        if p == nil then return true end
        local t = strip(p.type or "true")
        if t == "true" or t == "always_true" then return true end
        if t == "all_of" then for _, q in ipairs(p.predicates) do if not predicate(R, q, x, y, z) then return false end end return true end
        if t == "any_of" then for _, q in ipairs(p.predicates) do if predicate(R, q, x, y, z) then return true end end return false end
        if t == "not" then return not predicate(R, p.predicate, x, y, z) end
        local ox, oy, oz = offsetOf(p)
        local px, py, pz = x + ox, y + oy, z + oz
        if t == "matching_blocks" then return inSet(R:get(px, py, pz), p.blocks) end
        if t == "matching_block_tag" then return isTag(R:get(px, py, pz), p.tag) end
        if t == "matching_fluids" then
            local fl = info(R:get(px, py, pz)).fluid
            if not fl then return false end
            local fluids = p.fluids
            if type(fluids) == "string" then fluids = {fluids} end
            local src = info(R:get(px, py, pz)).source
            for _, f in ipairs(fluids) do
                f = strip(f)
                if f == fl and src then return true end
                if f == "flowing_" .. fl and not src then return true end
            end
            return false
        end
        if t == "replaceable" then return info(R:get(px, py, pz)).repl end
        if t == "solid" then return info(R:get(px, py, pz)).solid end
        if t == "would_survive" then return F.canSurvive(R, stateId(p.state), px, py, pz) end
        if t == "has_sturdy_face" then return R:sturdy(px, py, pz, p.direction) end
        if t == "inside_world_bounds" then return py >= MIN_Y and py <= MAX_Y end
        if t == "unobstructed" then return true end
        if t == "height_range" then return y >= WG.anchorY(p.min_inclusive) and y <= WG.anchorY(p.max_inclusive) end
        if t == "volume_match" then
            for dx = p.min[1], p.max[1] do for dz = p.min[3], p.max[3] do for dy = p.min[2], p.max[2] do
                if not predicate(R, p.match, x + dx, y + dy, z + dz) then return false end
            end end end
            return true
        end
        if t == "matching_biomes" then
            local b = R:biome(x, y, z)
            local list = p.biomes
            if type(list) == "string" then list = {list} end
            for _, n in ipairs(list) do if strip(n) == b then return true end end
            return false
        end
        error("unsupported block predicate " .. tostring(p.type))
    end
    F.predicate = predicate
    -- RuleTest (ore targets): consumes randomness only for the random_* tests.
    local ruleTest
    ruleTest = function(rule, id, y, r)
        local t = strip(rule.predicate_type)
        if t == "always_true" then return true end
        if t == "tag_match" then return isTag(id, rule.tag) end
        if t == "block_match" then return base(id) == strip(rule.block) end
        if t == "blockstate_match" then return id == stateId(rule.block_state) end
        if t == "random_block_match" then return base(id) == strip(rule.block) and r:nextFloat() < rule.probability end
        if t == "random_blockstate_match" then return id == stateId(rule.block_state) and r:nextFloat() < rule.probability end
        if t == "height_match" then return y >= rule.min_inclusive and y <= rule.max_inclusive end
        if t == "all_of" then for _, q in ipairs(rule.rules) do if not ruleTest(q, id, y, r) then return false end end return true end
        if t == "any_of" then for _, q in ipairs(rule.rules) do if ruleTest(q, id, y, r) then return true end end return false end
        if t == "not" then return not ruleTest(rule.rule, id, y, r) end
        error("unsupported rule test " .. tostring(rule.predicate_type))
    end
    F.ruleTest = ruleTest

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- state providers
    local noiseCache = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local function providerNoise(p, key, params, seed)
        local c = noiseCache[p]
        if not c then c = {}; noiseCache[p] = c end
        if not c[key] then
            local r = WG.WorldgenRandom.new(WG.LegacyRandom.new(WG.I64.from(seed)))
            c[key] = WG.normalNoise(params, r)
        end
        return c[key]
    end
    local function weightedPick(r, entries)
        local total = 0
        for _, e in ipairs(entries) do total = total + (e.weight or 1) end
        local pick = r:nextInt(total)
        for _, e in ipairs(entries) do pick = pick - (e.weight or 1); if pick < 0 then return e.data end end
    end
    F.weightedPick = weightedPick
    local optState
    local function resolveProvider(p)
        if type(p) == "string" and data.stateProvider[p] then return data.stateProvider[p] end
        return p
    end
    -- getState: never nil (rule_based / random_block fall back to the block already there).
    local function getState(R, p, r, x, y, z)
        p = resolveProvider(p)
        local t = type(p) == "table" and p.type and strip(p.type)
        if t == "rule_based" then
            local s = optState(R, p, r, x, y, z)
            return s or R:get(x, y, z)
        end
        if t == "random_block" then
            local s = optState(R, p, r, x, y, z)
            return s or R:get(x, y, z)
        end
        return optState(R, p, r, x, y, z)
    end
    F.getState = getState
    optState = function(R, p, r, x, y, z)
        p = resolveProvider(p)
        if type(p) == "string" or (type(p) == "table" and (p.id or p.Name)) then return stateId(p) end
        local t = strip(p.type or "simple_state_provider")
        if t == "simple_state_provider" or t == "simple" then return stateId(p.state) end
        if t == "weighted" or t == "weighted_state_provider" then return stateId(weightedPick(r, p.entries)) end
        if t == "rule_based" then
            for _, rule in ipairs(p.rules) do
                if predicate(R, rule.if_true, x, y, z) then
                    local s = optState(R, rule["then"], r, x, y, z)
                    if s then return s end
                end
            end
            if p.fallback == nil then return nil end
            return optState(R, p.fallback, r, x, y, z)
        end
        if t == "randomized_int_state_provider" or t == "randomized_int" then
            local s = getState(R, p.source, r, x, y, z)
            if not hasProp(s, p.property) then return s end
            return with(s, p.property, Providers.int(p.values, r))
        end
        if t == "rotated_block_provider" or t == "rotated" then
            local dir = p.direction or DIR_ORDER[r:nextInt(6) + 1]
            local s = getState(R, p.state, r, x, y, z)
            s = with(s, "axis", AXIS[dir])
            s = with(s, "facing", dir)
            if AXIS[dir] ~= "y" then s = with(s, "facing", dir) end
            return s
        end
        if t == "random_block" then
            local list = {}
            local set = blockSet(p.blocks)
            for n in pairs(set) do list[#list + 1] = n end
            table.sort(list)
            if #list == 0 then return nil end
            return Blocks.id(list[r:nextInt(#list) + 1])
        end
        if t == "noise_provider" or t == "noise" then
            local n = providerNoise(p, "n", p.noise, p.seed)
            local v = f32(n:get(x * p.scale, y * p.scale, z * p.scale))
            local place = math.clamp(f32((1 + v) / 2), 0, f32(0.9999))
            return stateId(p.states[floor(f32(place * #p.states)) + 1])
        end
        if t == "noise_threshold_provider" or t == "noise_threshold" then
            local n = providerNoise(p, "n", p.noise, p.seed)
            local v = f32(n:get(x * p.scale, y * p.scale, z * p.scale))
            if v < p.threshold then return stateId(p.low_states[r:nextInt(#p.low_states) + 1]) end
            if r:nextFloat() < p.high_chance then return stateId(p.high_states[r:nextInt(#p.high_states) + 1]) end
            return stateId(p.default_state)
        end
        if t == "dual_noise_provider" or t == "dual_noise" then
            local slow = providerNoise(p, "slow", p.slow_noise, p.seed)
            local n = providerNoise(p, "n", p.noise, p.seed)
            local s = f32(p.slow_scale)
            local function slowAt(ax, ay, az) return f32(slow:get(f32(ax * s), f32(ay * s), f32(az * s))) end
            local function pick(states, v)
                local place = math.clamp(f32((1 + v) / 2), 0, f32(0.9999))
                return states[floor(f32(place * #states)) + 1]
            end
            local lo, hi = p.variety[1], p.variety[2] + 1
            local vv = slowAt(x, y, z)
            local variety = trunc(lo + (math.clamp((vv + 1) / 2, 0, 1)) * (hi - lo))
            local possible = {}
            for i = 0, variety - 1 do possible[#possible + 1] = pick(p.states, slowAt(x + i * 54545, y, z + i * 34234)) end
            local v = f32(n:get(x * p.scale, y * p.scale, z * p.scale))
            return stateId(pick(possible, v))
        end
        error("unsupported state provider " .. tostring(p.type))
    end
    F.optState = optState

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- placement
    local placeFeature, placePlaced
    local function resolvePlaced(p) if type(p) == "string" then return data.placed[p], p end return p, nil end
    local function resolveFeature(f) if type(f) == "string" then return data.feature[f] end return f end
    local function countOf(p, r) return Providers.int(p, r) end
    local modifiers = {}
    modifiers.count = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out) for _ = 1, countOf(m.count, r) do out(x, y, z) end end
    modifiers.in_square = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out) local a = r:nextInt(16) + x; local b = r:nextInt(16) + z; out(a, y, b) end
    modifiers.heightmap = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out) local h = R:height(m.heightmap, x, z); if h > MIN_Y then out(x, h, z) end end
    modifiers.biome = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out, top)
        local b = R:biome(x, y, z)
        if top and F.biomeHas[b] and F.biomeHas[b][top] then out(x, y, z) end
    end
    modifiers.rarity_filter = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out) if r:nextFloat() < f32(1 / m.chance) then out(x, y, z) end end
    modifiers.height_range = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out) out(x, Providers.height(m.height, r), z) end
    modifiers.block_predicate_filter = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out) if predicate(R, m.predicate, x, y, z) then out(x, y, z) end end
    modifiers.surface_water_depth_filter = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out)
        if R:height("WORLD_SURFACE", x, z) - R:height("OCEAN_FLOOR", x, z) <= m.max_water_depth then out(x, y, z) end
    end
    modifiers.offset = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out)
        local dx = Providers.int(m.x or 0, r)
        local dy = Providers.int(m.y or 0, r)
        local dz = Providers.int(m.z or 0, r)
        out(x + dx, y + dy, z + dz)
    end
    modifiers.random_offset = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out)
        local dx = Providers.int(m.xz_spread, r)
        local dy = Providers.int(m.y_spread, r)
        local dz = Providers.int(m.xz_spread, r)
        out(x + dx, y + dy, z + dz)
    end
    modifiers.environment_scan = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out)
        local v = DIRS[m.direction_of_search]
        local allowed = m.allowed_search_condition
        if not predicate(R, allowed, x, y, z) then return end
        for _ = 1, m.max_steps do
            if predicate(R, m.target_condition, x, y, z) then out(x, y, z); return end
            x, y, z = x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3]
            if y < MIN_Y or y > MAX_Y then return end
            if not predicate(R, allowed, x, y, z) then break end
        end
        if predicate(R, m.target_condition, x, y, z) then out(x, y, z) end
    end
    modifiers.noise_threshold_count = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out)
        local n = WG.biomeInfoNoise:get2(x / 200, z / 200)
        local c = n < m.noise_level and m.below_noise or m.above_noise
        for _ = 1, c do out(x, y, z) end
    end
    modifiers.noise_based_count = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out)
        local n = WG.biomeInfoNoise:get2(x / m.noise_factor, z / m.noise_factor)
        local c = mceil((n + (m.noise_offset or 0)) * m.noise_to_count_ratio)
        for _ = 1, c do out(x, y, z) end
    end
    modifiers.surface_relative_threshold_filter = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out)
        local s = R:height(m.heightmap, x, z)
        local lo = s + (m.min_inclusive or -1e18)
        local hi = s + (m.max_inclusive or 1e18)
        if lo <= y and y <= hi then out(x, y, z) end
    end
    modifiers.count_on_every_layer = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out)
        -- CountOnEveryLayerPlacement.
        local layer = 0
        repeat
            local found = false
            for _ = 1, countOf(m.count, r) do
                local px = r:nextInt(16) + x
                local pz = r:nextInt(16) + z
                local h = R:height("MOTION_BLOCKING", px, pz)
                local ly = F.findOnGroundYPosition(R, px, h, pz, layer)
                if ly ~= math.huge then out(px, ly, pz); found = true end
            end
            layer = layer + 1
        until not found
    end
    function F.findOnGroundYPosition(R, x, y, z, layer)
        local current = 0
        local wasAir = info(R:get(x, y, z)).air
        for yy = y, MIN_Y + 1, -1 do
            local belowAir = info(R:get(x, yy - 1, z)).air
            local below = R:get(x, yy - 1, z)
            if not belowAir and wasAir and base(below) ~= "bedrock" then
                if current == layer then return yy end
                current = current + 1
            end
            wasAir = belowAir
        end
        return math.huge
    end
    modifiers.random_chance = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out) if r:nextFloat() < m.chance then out(x, y, z) end end
    modifiers.fixed_placement = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out)
        for _, p in ipairs(m.positions) do
            if floor(p[1] / 16) == floor(x / 16) and floor(p[3] / 16) == floor(z / 16) then out(p[1], p[2], p[3]) end
        end
    end
    modifiers.randomly_selected = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out, top)
        local mm = m.placements[r:nextInt(#m.placements) + 1]
        modifiers[strip(mm.type)](R, mm, r, x, y, z, out, top)
    end
    modifiers.cuboid = function(R, m, r, x, y, z, out)
        local h = Providers.int(m.y_size, r)
        local w = Providers.int(m.xz_size, r)
        local l = Providers.int(m.xz_size, r)
        local edges, interior = m.include_edges, m.include_interior
        for dx = 0, w do for dy = 0, h do for dz = 0, l do
            if (edges or dx ~= 0 and dx ~= w or dy ~= 0 and dy ~= h)
                and (edges or dz ~= 0 and dz ~= l or dy ~= 0 and dy ~= h)
                and (edges or dx ~= 0 and dx ~= w or dz ~= 0 and dz ~= l)
                and (interior or dx == 0 or dx == w or dy == 0 or dy == h or dz == 0 or dz == l) then
                out(x + dx, y + dy, z + dz)
            end
        end end end
    end
    F.modifiers = modifiers
    -- FeaturePlacer.place: depth-first over the modifier list, features placed in output order.
    placePlaced = function(R, placed, r, x, y, z, top)
        placed = resolvePlaced(placed)
        local feature = placed.feature
        local list = placed.placement or {}
        if #list == 0 then return placeFeature(R, feature, r, x, y, z) end
        local any = false
        local function run(i, px, py, pz)
            local m = list[i]
            local outs = {}
            local fn = modifiers[strip(m.type)]
            if not fn then error("unsupported placement " .. tostring(m.type)) end
            fn(R, m, r, px, py, pz, function(a, b, c) outs[#outs + 1] = {a, b, c} end, top)
            if i < #list then
                for _, o in ipairs(outs) do run(i + 1, o[1], o[2], o[3]) end
            else
                for _, o in ipairs(outs) do if placeFeature(R, feature, r, o[1], o[2], o[3]) then any = true end end
            end
        end
        run(1, x, y, z)
        return any
    end
    F.placePlaced = placePlaced

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- features
    local features = {}
    F.features = features
    placeFeature = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        f = resolveFeature(f)
        local fn = features[strip(f.type)]
        if not fn then
            F.missing = F.missing or {}
            F.missing[strip(f.type)] = (F.missing[strip(f.type)] or 0) + 1
            return false
        end
        WG.tick()
        return fn(R, f, r, x, y, z) and true or false
    end
    F.placeFeature = placeFeature
    local function markAbove() end -- post-processing marks (shape updates) are not replicated

    -- Ores.
    local function adjacentToAir(R, x, y, z)
        for _, d in ipairs(DIR_ORDER) do local v = DIRS[d]; if info(R:get(x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3])).air then return true end end
        return false
    end
    local function canPlaceOre(R, f, id, target, r, x, y, z)
        if not ruleTest(target.target, id, y, r) then return false end
        local discard = f32(f.discard_chance_on_air_exposure or 0)
        local skip
        if discard <= 0 then skip = true elseif discard >= 1 then skip = false else skip = r:nextFloat() >= discard end
        if skip then return true end
        return not adjacentToAir(R, x, y, z)
    end
    features.ore = function(R, f, r, ox, oy, oz)
        local size = f.size
        local dir = f32(r:nextFloat() * FPI)
        local spreadXY = f32(size / 8)
        local maxRadius = mceil(f32(f32(f32(size / 16) * 2 + 1) / 2))
        local x0 = ox + math.sin(dir) * spreadXY
        local x1 = ox - math.sin(dir) * spreadXY
        local z0 = oz + math.cos(dir) * spreadXY
        local z1 = oz - math.cos(dir) * spreadXY
        local y0 = oy + r:nextInt(3) - 2
        local y1 = oy + r:nextInt(3) - 2
        local xStart = ox - mceil(spreadXY) - maxRadius
        local yStart = oy - 2 - maxRadius
        local zStart = oz - mceil(spreadXY) - maxRadius
        local sizeXZ = 2 * (mceil(spreadXY) + maxRadius)
        local sizeY = 2 * (2 + maxRadius)
        local ok = false
        for xp = xStart, xStart + sizeXZ do
            for zp = zStart, zStart + sizeXZ do
                if yStart <= R:height("OCEAN_FLOOR_WG", xp, zp) then ok = true; break end
            end
            if ok then break end
        end
        if not ok then return false end
        local d = {}
        for i = 0, size - 1 do
            local step = f32(i / size)
            local xx = x0 + step * (x1 - x0)
            local yy = y0 + step * (y1 - y0)
            local zz = z0 + step * (z1 - z0)
            local ss = r:nextDouble() * size / 16
            local rr = (f32(msin(f32(FPI * step)) + 1) * ss + 1) / 2
            d[i * 4 + 1], d[i * 4 + 2], d[i * 4 + 3], d[i * 4 + 4] = xx, yy, zz, rr
        end
        for i1 = 0, size - 2 do
            if not (d[i1 * 4 + 4] <= 0) then
                for i2 = i1 + 1, size - 1 do
                    if not (d[i2 * 4 + 4] <= 0) then
                        local dx = d[i1 * 4 + 1] - d[i2 * 4 + 1]
                        local dy = d[i1 * 4 + 2] - d[i2 * 4 + 2]
                        local dz = d[i1 * 4 + 3] - d[i2 * 4 + 3]
                        local dr = d[i1 * 4 + 4] - d[i2 * 4 + 4]
                        if dr * dr > dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz then
                            if dr > 0 then d[i2 * 4 + 4] = -1 else d[i1 * 4 + 4] = -1 end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local tested = {}
        local placed = 0
        for i = 0, size - 1 do
            local rr = d[i * 4 + 4]
            if not (rr < 0) then
                local xx, yy, zz = d[i * 4 + 1], d[i * 4 + 2], d[i * 4 + 3]
                local xMin = max(floor(xx - rr), xStart)
                local yMin = max(floor(yy - rr), yStart)
                local zMin = max(floor(zz - rr), zStart)
                local xMax = max(floor(xx + rr), xMin)
                local yMax = max(floor(yy + rr), yMin)
                local zMax = max(floor(zz + rr), zMin)
                for x = xMin, xMax do
                    local xd = (x + 0.5 - xx) / rr
                    if xd * xd < 1 then
                        for y = yMin, yMax do
                            local yd = (y + 0.5 - yy) / rr
                            if xd * xd + yd * yd < 1 then
                                for z = zMin, zMax do
                                    local zd = (z + 0.5 - zz) / rr
                                    if xd * xd + yd * yd + zd * zd < 1 and y >= MIN_Y and y <= MAX_Y then
                                        local bi = x - xStart + (y - yStart) * sizeXZ + (z - zStart) * sizeXZ * sizeY
                                        if not tested[bi] then
                                            tested[bi] = true
                                            if R:canWrite(x, y, z) then
                                                local id = R:get(x, y, z)
                                                for _, target in ipairs(f.targets) do
                                                    if canPlaceOre(R, f, id, target, r, x, y, z) then
                                                        R:set(x, y, z, stateId(target.state))
                                                        placed = placed + 1
                                                        break
                                                    end
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return placed > 0
    end
    features.scattered_ore = function(R, f, r, ox, oy, oz)
        local tries = r:nextInt(f.size + 1)
        local function axis(m) return floor(f32(f32(r:nextFloat() - r:nextFloat()) * m) + 0.5) end
        for i = 0, tries - 1 do
            local m = min(i, 7)
            local x = ox + axis(m)
            local y = oy + axis(m)
            local z = oz + axis(m)
            local id = R:get(x, y, z)
            for _, target in ipairs(f.targets) do
                if canPlaceOre(R, f, id, target, r, x, y, z) then R:set(x, y, z, stateId(target.state)); break end
            end
        end
        return true
    end

    -- Selectors.
    features.random_selector = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        for _, e in ipairs(f.features) do
            if r:nextFloat() < f32(e.chance) then return placePlaced(R, e.feature, r, x, y, z) end
        end
        return placePlaced(R, f.default, r, x, y, z)
    end
    features.simple_random_selector = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        local list = f.features
        if type(list) == "string" then list = {list} end
        return placePlaced(R, list[r:nextInt(#list) + 1], r, x, y, z)
    end
    features.weighted_random_selector = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        local p = weightedPick(r, f.features)
        if not p then return false end
        return placePlaced(R, p, r, x, y, z)
    end
    features.random_boolean_selector = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        if r:nextBoolean() then return placePlaced(R, f.feature_true, r, x, y, z) end
        return placePlaced(R, f.feature_false, r, x, y, z)
    end
    features.sequence = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        for _, p in ipairs(f.features) do if not placePlaced(R, p, r, x, y, z) then return false end end
        return true
    end
    features.overlay = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        local any = false
        for _, p in ipairs(f.features) do if placePlaced(R, p, r, x, y, z) then any = true end end
        return any
    end

    -- Plants and blocks.
    -- DoublePlantBlock.placeAt (copyWaterloggedFrom each half).
    local function placeDoublePlant(R, id, x, y, z)
        local lower = with(id, "half", "lower")
        if hasProp(lower, "waterlogged") then lower = with(lower, "waterlogged", R:isWater(x, y, z) and "true" or "false") end
        R:set(x, y, z, lower)
        local upper = with(id, "half", "upper")
        if hasProp(upper, "waterlogged") then upper = with(upper, "waterlogged", R:isWater(x, y + 1, z) and "true" or "false") end
        R:set(x, y + 1, z, upper)
    end
    -- StructurePiece.reorient for a chest at a position.
    function F.reorientChest(R, x, y, z, facing)
        local solid = nil
        for _, d in ipairs(HORIZONTAL) do
            local v = DIRS[d]
            local s = R:get(x + v[1], y, z + v[3])
            if base(s) == "chest" then return facing end
            if info(s).solidRender then
                if solid then solid = nil; break end
                solid = d
            end
        end
        if solid then return OPP[solid] end
        local function sr(d) local v = DIRS[d]; return info(R:get(x + v[1], y, z + v[3])).solidRender end
        local dir = facing
        if sr(dir) then dir = OPP[dir] end
        if sr(dir) then dir = CW[dir] end
        if sr(dir) then dir = OPP[dir] end
        return dir
    end
    F.placeDoublePlant = placeDoublePlant
    features.simple_block = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        local s = optState(R, f.to_place, r, x, y, z)
        if not s then return false end
        if not F.canSurvive(R, s, x, y, z) then return false end
        local cls = info(s).cls
        if cls == "DoublePlantBlock" or cls == "TallFlowerBlock" or cls == "TallSeagrassBlock" or cls == "SmallDripleafBlock" or cls == "TallDryGrassBlock" and false then
            local above = R:get(x, y + 1, z)
            local ai = info(above)
            if not ai.air and (info(s).fluid ~= ai.fluid or not ai.repl) then return false end
            placeDoublePlant(R, s, x, y, z)
        elseif cls == "MossyCarpetBlock" then
            R:set(x, y, z, s)
        else
            R:set(x, y, z, s)
        end
        return true
    end
    features.block_column = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        local layers = f.layers
        local heights, total = {}, 0
        for i, l in ipairs(layers) do heights[i] = Providers.int(l.height, r); total = total + heights[i] end
        if total == 0 then return false end
        local v = DIRS[f.direction or "up"]
        local nx, ny, nz = x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3]
        for k = 0, total - 1 do
            if not predicate(R, f.allowed_placement, nx, ny, nz) then
                local remove = total - k
                local tip = f.prioritize_tip
                local s, e, st = tip and 1 or #heights, tip and #heights + 1 or 0, tip and 1 or -1
                local i = s
                while i ~= e and remove > 0 do
                    local take = min(heights[i], remove)
                    remove = remove - take
                    heights[i] = heights[i] - take
                    i = i + st
                end
                break
            end
            nx, ny, nz = nx + v[1], ny + v[2], nz + v[3]
        end
        local px, py, pz = x, y, z
        for i, l in ipairs(layers) do
            for _ = 1, heights[i] do
                R:set(px, py, pz, getState(R, l.provider or l.state, r, px, py, pz))
                px, py, pz = px + v[1], py + v[2], pz + v[3]
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    features.disk = function(R, f, r, ox, oy, oz)
        local any = false
        local top, bottom = oy + f.half_height, oy - f.half_height - 1
        local rad = Providers.int(f.radius, r)
        for cz = oz - rad, oz + rad do
            for cx = ox - rad, ox + rad do
                local xd, zd = cx - ox, cz - oz
                if xd * xd + zd * zd <= rad * rad then
                    for y = top, bottom + 1, -1 do
                        if predicate(R, f.target, cx, y, cz) then
                            local s = optState(R, f.state_provider, r, cx, y, cz)
                            if s then R:set(cx, y, cz, s); any = true end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return any
    end
    features.block_blob = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        while y > MIN_Y + 3 and not predicate(R, f.can_place_on, x, y - 1, z) do y = y - 1 end
        if y <= MIN_Y + 3 then return false end
        local s = stateId(f.state)
        for _ = 1, 3 do
            local xr, yr, zr = r:nextInt(2), r:nextInt(2), r:nextInt(2)
            local tr = f32(f32((xr + yr + zr) * f32(0.333)) + 0.5)
            for bz = z - zr, z + zr do for by = y - yr, y + yr do for bx = x - xr, x + xr do
                local dx, dy, dz = bx - x, by - y, bz - z
                if dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= tr * tr then R:set(bx, by, bz, s) end
            end end end
            x = x + (-1 + r:nextInt(2))
            y = y - r:nextInt(2)
            z = z + (-1 + r:nextInt(2))
        end
        return true
    end
    features.spring_feature = function(R, f, x, y, z) end
    features.spring_feature = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        local valid = f.valid_blocks
        local function ok(ax, ay, az) return inSet(R:get(ax, ay, az), valid) end
        if not ok(x, y + 1, z) then return false end
        if f.requires_block_below ~= false and not ok(x, y - 1, z) then return false end
        local here = R:get(x, y, z)
        if not info(here).air and not inSet(here, valid) then return false end
        local rock, hole = 0, 0
        for _, d in ipairs({"west", "east", "north", "south", "down"}) do
            local v = DIRS[d]
            if ok(x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3]) then rock = rock + 1 end
            if R:isEmpty(x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3]) then hole = hole + 1 end
        end
        if rock == (f.rock_count or 4) and hole == (f.hole_count or 1) then
            local fluid = strip(f.state.Name or f.state.id or "water")
            R:set(x, y, z, Blocks.id(fluid == "lava" and "lava" or "water"))
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    local function shouldFreeze(R, biome, x, y, z)
        if R.world.temperature(biome, x, y, z) >= 0.15 then return false end
        if y < MIN_Y or y > MAX_Y then return false end
        local id = R:get(x, y, z)
        return info(id).fluid == "water" and info(id).liquid and info(id).source
    end
    local function shouldSnow(R, biome, x, y, z)
        local b = data.biome[biome]
        if not b or not b.has_precipitation then return false end
        if R.world.temperature(biome, x, y, z) >= 0.15 then return false end
        if y < MIN_Y or y > MAX_Y then return false end
        local id = R:get(x, y, z)
        return (info(id).air or base(id) == "snow") and survive.SnowLayerBlock(R, Blocks.id("snow"), x, y, z)
    end
    F.shouldFreeze, F.shouldSnow = shouldFreeze, shouldSnow
    features.freeze_top_layer = function(R, f, r, ox, oy, oz)
        local ice, snow = Blocks.id("ice"), Blocks.id("snow")
        for dx = 0, 15 do
            for dz = 0, 15 do
                local x, z = ox + dx, oz + dz
                local y = R:height("MOTION_BLOCKING", x, z)
                local biome = R:biome(x, y, z)
                if shouldFreeze(R, biome, x, y - 1, z) then R:set(x, y - 1, z, ice) end
                if shouldSnow(R, biome, x, y, z) then
                    R:set(x, y, z, snow)
                    local below = R:get(x, y - 1, z)
                    if hasProp(below, "snowy") then R:set(x, y - 1, z, with(below, "snowy", "true")) end
                end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    features.lake = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        if y <= MIN_Y + 4 then return false end
        x, y, z = x - 8, y - 4, z - 8
        local grid = {}
        local spots = r:nextInt(4) + 4
        for _ = 1, spots do
            local xr = r:nextDouble() * 6 + 3
            local yr = r:nextDouble() * 4 + 2
            local zr = r:nextDouble() * 6 + 3
            local xp = r:nextDouble() * (16 - xr - 2) + 1 + xr / 2
            local yp = r:nextDouble() * (8 - yr - 4) + 2 + yr / 2
            local zp = r:nextDouble() * (16 - zr - 2) + 1 + zr / 2
            for xx = 1, 14 do for zz = 1, 14 do for yy = 1, 6 do
                local xd, yd, zd = (xx - xp) / (xr / 2), (yy - yp) / (yr / 2), (zz - zp) / (zr / 2)
                if xd * xd + yd * yd + zd * zd < 1 then grid[(xx * 16 + zz) * 8 + yy] = true end
            end end end
        end
        local fluid = getState(R, f.fluid, r, x, y, z)
        local function edge(xx, zz, yy)
            return not grid[(xx * 16 + zz) * 8 + yy] and (
                xx < 15 and grid[((xx + 1) * 16 + zz) * 8 + yy] or xx > 0 and grid[((xx - 1) * 16 + zz) * 8 + yy]
                or zz < 15 and grid[(xx * 16 + zz + 1) * 8 + yy] or zz > 0 and grid[(xx * 16 + zz - 1) * 8 + yy]
                or yy < 7 and grid[(xx * 16 + zz) * 8 + yy + 1] or yy > 0 and grid[(xx * 16 + zz) * 8 + yy - 1])
        end
        for xx = 0, 15 do for zz = 0, 15 do for yy = 0, 7 do
            if edge(xx, zz, yy) then
                local s = R:get(x + xx, y + yy, z + zz)
                if yy >= 4 and info(s).liquid then return false end
                if yy < 4 and not info(s).solid and s ~= fluid then return false end
                if not predicate(R, f.can_place_feature, x + xx, y + yy, z + zz) then return false end
            end
        end end end
        local caveAir = Blocks.id("cave_air")
        for xx = 0, 15 do for zz = 0, 15 do for yy = 0, 7 do
            if grid[(xx * 16 + zz) * 8 + yy] and predicate(R, f.can_replace_with_air_or_fluid, x + xx, y + yy, z + zz) then
                R:set(x + xx, y + yy, z + zz, yy >= 4 and caveAir or fluid)
            end
        end end end
        local barrier = getState(R, f.barrier, r, x, y, z)
        if not info(barrier).air then
            for xx = 0, 15 do for zz = 0, 15 do for yy = 0, 7 do
                if edge(xx, zz, yy) and (yy < 4 or r:nextInt(2) ~= 0) then
                    local s = R:get(x + xx, y + yy, z + zz)
                    if info(s).solid and predicate(R, f.can_replace_with_barrier, x + xx, y + yy, z + zz) then R:set(x + xx, y + yy, z + zz, barrier) end
                end
            end end end
        end
        if info(fluid).fluid == "water" then
            local ice = Blocks.id("ice")
            for xx = 0, 15 do for zz = 0, 15 do
                local px, py, pz = x + xx, y + 4, z + zz
                if shouldFreeze(R, R:biome(px, py, pz), px, py, pz) and predicate(R, f.can_replace_with_air_or_fluid, px, py, pz) then R:set(px, py, pz, ice) end
            end end
        end
        return true
    end
    features.vegetation_patch = function(R, f, r, x, y, z, waterlogged)
        local xR = Providers.int(f.xz_radius, r) + 1
        local zR = Providers.int(f.xz_radius, r) + 1
        local inward = f.surface == "ceiling" and "up" or "down"
        local outward = OPP[inward]
        local vi, vo = DIRS[inward], DIRS[outward]
        local replaceable = f.replaceable
        local surface = PosSet.new()
        local extraEdge = f32(f.extra_edge_column_chance or 0)
        local extraBottom = f32(f.extra_bottom_block_chance or 0)
        local range = f.vertical_range
        for dx = -xR, xR do
            local xEdge = dx == -xR or dx == xR
            for dz = -zR, zR do
                local zEdge = dz == -zR or dz == zR
                local edgeC = xEdge or zEdge
                local corner = xEdge and zEdge
                local edgeNotCorner = edgeC and not corner
                if not corner and (not edgeNotCorner or extraEdge ~= 0 and not (r:nextFloat() > extraEdge)) then
                    local px, py, pz = x + dx, y, z + dz
                    local off = 0
                    while info(R:get(px, py, pz)).air and off < range do py = py + vi[2]; off = off + 1 end
                    off = 0
                    while not info(R:get(px, py, pz)).air and off < range do py = py + vo[2]; off = off + 1 end
                    local bx, by, bz = px, py + vi[2], pz
                    if info(R:get(px, py, pz)).air and R:sturdy(bx, by, bz, outward) then
                        local depth = Providers.int(f.depth, r) + ((extraBottom > 0 and r:nextFloat() < extraBottom) and 1 or 0)
                        local gy = by
                        local placedGround = true
                        for i = 0, depth - 1 do
                            local s = getState(R, f.ground_state, r, bx, gy, bz)
                            local below = R:get(bx, gy, bz)
                            if base(s) ~= base(below) then
                                if not inSet(below, replaceable) then placedGround = i ~= 0; break end
                                R:set(bx, gy, bz, s)
                                gy = gy + vi[2]
                            end
                        end
                        if placedGround then surface:add(bx, by, bz) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local list = surface:ordered()
        if waterlogged then
            local water = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(list) do
                local exposed = false
                for _, d in ipairs({"north", "east", "south", "west", "down"}) do
                    local v = DIRS[d]
                    if not R:sturdy(p[1] + v[1], p[2] + v[2], p[3] + v[3], OPP[d]) then exposed = true; break end
                end
                if not exposed then water[#water + 1] = p end
            end
            local ws = PosSet.new()
            for _, p in ipairs(water) do ws:add(p[1], p[2], p[3]) end
            list = ws:ordered()
            for _, p in ipairs(list) do R:set(p[1], p[2], p[3], WATER) end
        end
        local chance = f32(f.vegetation_chance or 0)
        for _, p in ipairs(list) do
            if chance > 0 and r:nextFloat() < chance then
                if waterlogged then
                    if placePlaced(R, f.vegetation_feature, r, p[1] + vo[1], p[2] + vo[2] - 1, p[3] + vo[3]) then
                        local s = R:get(p[1], p[2], p[3])
                        if hasProp(s, "waterlogged") and prop(s, "waterlogged") ~= "true" then R:set(p[1], p[2], p[3], with(s, "waterlogged", "true")) end
                    end
                else
                    placePlaced(R, f.vegetation_feature, r, p[1] + vo[1], p[2] + vo[2], p[3] + vo[3])
                end
            end
        end
        return #list > 0
    end
    features.waterlogged_vegetation_patch = function(R, f, r, x, y, z) return features.vegetation_patch(R, f, r, x, y, z, true) end
    features.bamboo = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        local bamboo = Blocks.id("bamboo")
        if R:isEmpty(x, y, z) and survive.BambooStalkBlock(R, bamboo, x, y, z) then
            local height = r:nextInt(12) + 5
            if r:nextFloat() < f32(f.probability) then
                local rad = r:nextInt(4) + 1
                local podzol = Blocks.id("podzol")
                for xx = x - rad, x + rad do for zz = z - rad, z + rad do
                    local xd, zd = xx - x, zz - z
                    if xd * xd + zd * zd <= rad * rad then
                        local py = R:height("WORLD_SURFACE", xx, zz) - 1
                        if isTag(R:get(xx, py, zz), "beneath_bamboo_podzol_replaceable") then R:set(xx, py, zz, podzol) end
                    end
                end end
            end
            local trunk = Blocks.id(canon("bamboo", {age = "1", leaves = "none", stage = "0"}))
            local by = y
            for _ = 1, height do
                if not R:isEmpty(x, by, z) then break end
                R:set(x, by, z, trunk)
                by = by + 1
            end
            if by - y >= 3 then
                R:set(x, by, z, Blocks.id(canon("bamboo", {age = "1", leaves = "large", stage = "1"})))
                R:set(x, by - 1, z, Blocks.id(canon("bamboo", {age = "1", leaves = "large", stage = "0"})))
                R:set(x, by - 2, z, Blocks.id(canon("bamboo", {age = "1", leaves = "small", stage = "0"})))
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function mushroomBlock(R, x, y, z, s)
        local c = R:get(x, y, z)
        if info(c).air or isTag(c, "replaceable_by_mushrooms") then R:set(x, y, z, s) end
    end
    local function hugeMushroom(radiusAt, cap)
        return function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
            local h = r:nextInt(3) + 4
            if r:nextInt(12) == 0 then h = h * 2 end
            if not (y >= MIN_Y + 1 and y + h + 1 <= MAX_Y + 1) then return false end
            if not predicate(R, f.can_place_on, x, y - 1, z) then return false end
            for dy = 0, h do
                local rad = radiusAt(-1, -1, (f.foliage_radius or 2), dy)
                for dx = -rad, rad do for dz = -rad, rad do
                    local s = R:get(x + dx, y + dy, z + dz)
                    if not info(s).air and not isTag(s, "leaves") then return false end
                end end
            end
            cap(R, f, r, x, y, z, h)
            for dy = 0, h - 1 do mushroomBlock(R, x, y + dy, z, getState(R, f.stem_provider, r, x, y, z)) end
            return true
        end
    end
    local function mushroomSides(s, t)
        for k, v in pairs(t) do if hasProp(s, k) then s = with(s, k, v and "true" or "false") end end
        return s
    end
    features.huge_brown_mushroom = hugeMushroom(function(_, _, lr, yo) return yo <= 3 and 0 or lr end, function(R, f, r, x, y, z, h)
        local fr = (f.foliage_radius or 2)
        for dx = -fr, fr do for dz = -fr, fr do
            local minX, maxX, minZ, maxZ = dx == -fr, dx == fr, dz == -fr, dz == fr
            local xE, zE = minX or maxX, minZ or maxZ
            if not xE or not zE then
                local s = getState(R, f.cap_provider, r, x, y, z)
                if hasProp(s, "west") and hasProp(s, "north") then
                    s = mushroomSides(s, {west = minX or zE and dx == 1 - fr, east = maxX or zE and dx == fr - 1,
                        north = minZ or xE and dz == 1 - fr, south = maxZ or xE and dz == fr - 1})
                end
                mushroomBlock(R, x + dx, y + h, z + dz, s)
            end
        end end
    end)
    features.huge_red_mushroom = hugeMushroom(function(_, th, lr, yo)
        if yo < th and yo >= th - 3 then return lr elseif yo == th then return lr end
        return 0
    end, function(R, f, r, x, y, z, h)
        for dy = h - 3, h do
            local rad = dy < h and (f.foliage_radius or 2) or (f.foliage_radius or 2) - 1
            local center = (f.foliage_radius or 2) - 2
            for dx = -rad, rad do for dz = -rad, rad do
                local xE, zE = dx == -rad or dx == rad, dz == -rad or dz == rad
                if dy >= h or xE ~= zE then
                    local s = getState(R, f.cap_provider, r, x, y, z)
                    if hasProp(s, "up") then
                        s = mushroomSides(s, {up = dy >= h - 1, west = dx < -center, east = dx > center, north = dz < -center, south = dz > center})
                    end
                    mushroomBlock(R, x + dx, y + dy, z + dz, s)
                end
            end end
        end
    end)
    -- The red cap's radius test uses the tree height, not -1 (Java passes treeHeight via isValidPosition? no: -1, -1).
    features.blue_ice = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        if y > R.world.seaLevel - 1 then return false end
        if base(R:get(x, y, z)) ~= "water" and base(R:get(x, y - 1, z)) ~= "water" then return false end
        local found = false
        for _, d in ipairs(DIR_ORDER) do
            if d ~= "down" then local v = DIRS[d]; if base(R:get(x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3])) == "packed_ice" then found = true; break end end
        end
        if not found then return false end
        local blue = Blocks.id("blue_ice")
        R:set(x, y, z, blue)
        for _ = 1, 200 do
            local yOff = r:nextInt(5) - r:nextInt(6)
            local xz = 3
            if yOff < 2 then xz = xz + trunc(yOff / 2) end
            if xz >= 1 then
                local px = x + r:nextInt(xz) - r:nextInt(xz)
                local py = y + yOff
                local pz = z + r:nextInt(xz) - r:nextInt(xz)
                local b = base(R:get(px, py, pz))
                if b == "air" or b == "cave_air" or b == "void_air" or b == "water" or b == "packed_ice" or b == "ice" then
                    for _, d in ipairs(DIR_ORDER) do
                        local v = DIRS[d]
                        if base(R:get(px + v[1], py + v[2], pz + v[3])) == "blue_ice" then R:set(px, py, pz, blue); break end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    features.monster_room = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        local function canReplace(s) return not isTag(s, "features_cannot_replace") end
        local function safeSet(ax, ay, az, s) if canReplace(R:get(ax, ay, az)) then R:set(ax, ay, az, s) end end
        local xr = r:nextInt(2) + 2
        local zr = r:nextInt(2) + 2
        local minX, maxX, minZ, maxZ = -xr - 1, xr + 1, -zr - 1, zr + 1
        local holes = 0
        for dx = minX, maxX do for dy = -1, 4 do for dz = minZ, maxZ do
            local solid = info(R:get(x + dx, y + dy, z + dz)).solid
            if dy == -1 and not solid then return false end
            if dy == 4 and not solid then return false end
            if (dx == minX or dx == maxX or dz == minZ or dz == maxZ) and dy == 0 and R:isEmpty(x + dx, y, z + dz) and R:isEmpty(x + dx, y + 1, z + dz) then holes = holes + 1 end
        end end end
        if holes < 1 or holes > 5 then return false end
        local caveAir, mossy, cobble = Blocks.id("cave_air"), Blocks.id("mossy_cobblestone"), Blocks.id("cobblestone")
        for dx = minX, maxX do for dy = 3, -1, -1 do for dz = minZ, maxZ do
            local wx, wy, wz = x + dx, y + dy, z + dz
            local s = R:get(wx, wy, wz)
            if dx == minX or dy == -1 or dz == minZ or dx == maxX or dy == 4 or dz == maxZ then
                if wy >= MIN_Y and not info(R:get(wx, wy - 1, wz)).solid then
                    R:set(wx, wy, wz, caveAir)
                elseif info(s).solid and base(s) ~= "chest" then
                    if dy == -1 and r:nextInt(4) ~= 0 then safeSet(wx, wy, wz, mossy) else safeSet(wx, wy, wz, cobble) end
                end
            elseif base(s) ~= "chest" and base(s) ~= "spawner" then
                safeSet(wx, wy, wz, caveAir)
            end
        end end end
        for _ = 1, 2 do
            for _ = 1, 3 do
                local cx = x + r:nextInt(xr * 2 + 1) - xr
                local cz = z + r:nextInt(zr * 2 + 1) - zr
                if R:isEmpty(cx, y, cz) then
                    local walls = 0
                    for _, d in ipairs(HORIZONTAL) do
                        local v = DIRS[d]
                        if info(R:get(cx + v[1], y, cz + v[3])).solid then walls = walls + 1 end
                    end
                    if walls == 1 then
                        safeSet(cx, y, cz, Blocks.id(canon("chest", {facing = F.reorientChest(R, cx, y, cz, "north")})))
                        -- RandomizableContainer.setBlockEntityLootTable: a loot seed when the chest is there.
                        if base(R:get(cx, y, cz)) == "chest" then r:nextLong() end
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        safeSet(x, y, z, Blocks.id("spawner"))
        r:nextInt(4) -- the spawner's mob
        return true
    end
    features.vines = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        if not R:isEmpty(x, y, z) then return false end
        for _, d in ipairs(DIR_ORDER) do
            if d ~= "down" then
                local v = DIRS[d]
                local n = R:get(x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3])
                -- VineBlock.isAcceptableNeighbour: a full face toward the vine.
                if R:sturdy(x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3], OPP[d]) and info(n).full then
                    R:set(x, y, z, Blocks.id(canon("vine", {[d] = "true"})))
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    features.spike = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        while R:isEmpty(x, y, z) and y > MIN_Y + 2 do y = y - 1 end
        if not predicate(R, f.can_place_on, x, y, z) then return false end
        local s = stateId(f.state)
        y = y + r:nextInt(4)
        local height = r:nextInt(4) + 7
        local width = trunc(height / 4) + r:nextInt(2)
        if width > 1 and r:nextInt(60) == 0 then y = y + 10 + r:nextInt(30) end
        local function canRep(ax, ay, az) local st = R:get(ax, ay, az); return info(st).air or predicate(R, f.can_replace, ax, ay, az) end
        for yOff = 0, height - 1 do
            local scale = f32(f32(1 - f32(yOff / height)) * width)
            local nw = mceil(scale)
            for xo = -nw, nw do
                local dx = f32(abs(xo) - f32(0.25))
                for zo = -nw, nw do
                    local dz = f32(abs(zo) - f32(0.25))
                    if (xo == 0 and zo == 0 or not (f32(dx * dx + dz * dz) > f32(scale * scale)))
                        and (xo ~= -nw and xo ~= nw and zo ~= -nw and zo ~= nw or not (r:nextFloat() > 0.75)) then
                        if canRep(x + xo, y + yOff, z + zo) then R:set(x + xo, y + yOff, z + zo, s) end
                        if yOff ~= 0 and nw > 1 and canRep(x + xo, y - yOff, z + zo) then R:set(x + xo, y - yOff, z + zo, s) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local pw = math.clamp(width - 1, 0, 1)
        for xo = -pw, pw do for zo = -pw, pw do
            local cy = y - 1
            local run = 50
            if abs(xo) == 1 and abs(zo) == 1 then run = r:nextInt(5) end
            while cy > 50 do
                local st = R:get(x + xo, cy, z + zo)
                if not info(st).air and not predicate(R, f.can_replace, x + xo, cy, z + zo) and st ~= s then break end
                R:set(x + xo, cy, z + zo, s)
                cy = cy - 1
                run = run - 1
                if run <= 0 then cy = cy - (r:nextInt(5) + 1); run = r:nextInt(5) end
            end
        end end
        return true
    end
    features.fallen_tree = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        local function log(px, py, pz, axis)
            local s = getState(R, f.trunk_provider, r, px, py, pz)
            if axis then s = with(s, "axis", axis) end
            R:set(px, py, pz, s)
        end
        local function validTreePos(px, py, pz) local s = R:get(px, py, pz); return info(s).air or isTag(s, "replaceable_by_trees") end
        local function overSolid(px, py, pz) return R:sturdy(px, py - 1, pz, "up") end
        log(x, y, z)
        F.decorate(R, r, f.stump_decorators or {}, {{x, y, z}}, {}, {})
        local dir = randomHorizontal(r)
        local v = DIRS[dir]
        local len = Providers.int(f.log_length, r) - 2
        local k = 2 + r:nextInt(2)
        local lx, ly, lz = x + v[1] * k, y + 1, z + v[3] * k
        for _ = 1, 6 do
            if validTreePos(lx, ly, lz) and overSolid(lx, ly, lz) then break end
            ly = ly - 1
        end
        local gap = 0
        local ok = true
        for i = 0, len - 1 do
            local px, pz = lx + v[1] * i, lz + v[3] * i
            if not validTreePos(px, ly, pz) then ok = false; break end
            if not overSolid(px, ly, pz) then gap = gap + 1; if gap > 2 then ok = false; break end else gap = 0 end
        end
        if ok then
            local logs = PosSet.new()
            for i = 0, len - 1 do
                local px, pz = lx + v[1] * i, lz + v[3] * i
                log(px, ly, pz, AXIS[dir])
                logs:add(px, ly, pz)
            end
            F.decorate(R, r, f.log_decorators or {}, logs:ordered(), {}, {})
        end
        return true
    end
end
do
    -- applyBiomeDecoration for one chunk: the biomes of its 3x3 neighbourhood choose the features of
    -- each step, run in FeatureSorter index order with setFeatureSeed(decorationSeed, index, step).
    -- onlyInto = {cx, cz}: re-run a neighbour's decoration writing only into that (regenerated) chunk.
    local F = WG.Feature
    local floor = math.floor
    local MIN_Y, HEIGHT = WG.MIN_Y, WG.HEIGHT
    local function noiseBiomes(world, cx, cz, chunk)
        if chunk.noiseBiomes then return chunk.noiseBiomes end
        local set = {}
        local nb = world.noiseBiome
        for qy = MIN_Y / 4, (MIN_Y + HEIGHT) / 4 - 1 do
            for qz = cz * 4, cz * 4 + 3 do
                for qx = cx * 4, cx * 4 + 3 do set[nb(qx, qy, qz)] = true end
            end
            WG.tick()
        end
        chunk.noiseBiomes = set
        return set
    end
    function F.decorateChunk(world, cx, cz, seed, onlyInto)
        local R = F.Region.new(world, cx, cz)
        if onlyInto then
            local set = R.set
            R.canWrite = function(self, x, y, z)
                return y >= MIN_Y and y < MIN_Y + HEIGHT and floor(x / 16) == onlyInto[1] and floor(z / 16) == onlyInto[2]
            end
        end
        local possible = {}
        local tb = F.profile and os.clock()
        for dx = -1, 1 do for dz = -1, 1 do
            for b in pairs(noiseBiomes(world, cx + dx, cz + dz, R:chunkAt((cx + dx) * 16, (cz + dz) * 16))) do possible[b] = true end
        end end
        if tb then F.profile["(biomes)"] = (F.profile["(biomes)"] or 0) + os.clock() - tb end
        local rand = WG.WorldgenRandom.new(WG.Xoroshiro.fromSeed(WG.I64.from(0)))
        local minX, minZ = cx * 16, cz * 16
        local decorationSeed = rand:setDecorationSeed(seed, minX, minZ)
        local biomes = world.data.biome
        local structSteps = world.struct and WG.Struct and WG.Struct.stepStructures(world.struct)
        local nearStarts = structSteps and WG.Struct.startsNear(world.struct, cx, cz) or {}
        for s, names in ipairs(world.data.steps) do
            -- Structures of this step first (each structure's index in the step seeds its random).
            if structSteps and structSteps[s - 1] and #nearStarts > 0 then
                for si, sname in ipairs(structSteps[s - 1]) do
                    for _, start in ipairs(nearStarts) do
                        if start.structure == sname then
                            rand:setFeatureSeed(decorationSeed, si - 1, s - 1)
                            local ok, err = pcall(WG.Struct.placeInChunk, R, world.struct, start, rand, cx, cz)
                            if not ok then F.errors = F.errors or {}; F.errors[sname] = tostring(err) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local idx = F.stepIndex[s]
            local chosen, list = {}, {}
            for b in pairs(possible) do
                local bd = biomes[b]
                local step = bd and bd.features and bd.features[s]
                if step then
                    for _, n in ipairs(step) do
                        local i = idx[n]
                        if i and not chosen[i] then chosen[i] = true; list[#list + 1] = i end
                    end
                end
            end
            table.sort(list)
            for _, i in ipairs(list) do
                local name = names[i + 1]
                rand:setFeatureSeed(decorationSeed, i, s - 1)
                local t0 = F.profile and os.clock()
                local ok, err = xpcall(F.placePlaced, function(e) return debug and debug.traceback and debug.traceback(e) or e end, R, name, rand, minX, MIN_Y, minZ, name)
                if t0 then F.profile[name] = (F.profile[name] or 0) + os.clock() - t0 end
                if not ok then
                    F.errors = F.errors or {}
                    F.errors[name] = tostring(err)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
do
    -- MultifaceGrowthFeature (glow lichen) with MultifaceSpreader, UnderwaterMagmaFeature.
    local F = WG.Feature
    local DIRS, OPP, HORIZONTAL, DIR_ORDER = F.DIRS, F.OPP, F.HORIZONTAL, F.DIR_ORDER
    local info, base, prop, with = F.info, F.base, F.prop, F.with
    local AXIS = {down = "y", up = "y", north = "z", south = "z", west = "x", east = "x"}
    local function hasFace(id, d) return prop(id, d) == "true" end
    local function canAttach(R, x, y, z, d)
        local v = DIRS[d]
        local nx, ny, nz = x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3]
        local n = R:get(nx, ny, nz)
        return R:sturdy(nx, ny, nz, OPP[d]) and info(n).full
    end
    local function validFor(R, block, old, x, y, z, d)
        if base(old) == block and hasFace(old, d) then return false end
        return canAttach(R, x, y, z, d)
    end
    local function stateFor(R, block, old, x, y, z, d)
        if not validFor(R, block, old, x, y, z, d) then return nil end
        local s
        if base(old) == block then s = old
        elseif info(old).fluid == "water" and info(old).source then s = with(WG.Blocks.id(block), "waterlogged", "true")
        else s = WG.Blocks.id(block) end
        return with(s, d, "true")
