    end
    local function canSpreadInto(R, block, x, y, z, d)
        local e = R:get(x, y, z)
        local ok = info(e).air or base(e) == block or (base(e) == "water" and info(e).source)
        return ok and validFor(R, block, e, x, y, z, d)
    end
    local function spreadFrom(R, block, state, x, y, z, from, r)
        local all = F.shuffle({"down", "up", "north", "south", "west", "east"}, r)
        for _, sd in ipairs(all) do
            if AXIS[sd] ~= AXIS[from] and hasFace(state, from) and not hasFace(state, sd) then
                local v, w = DIRS[sd], DIRS[from]
                local cands = {
                    {x, y, z, sd},
                    {x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3], from},
                    {x + v[1] + w[1], y + v[2] + w[2], z + v[3] + w[3], OPP[sd]},
                }
                for _, c in ipairs(cands) do
                    if canSpreadInto(R, block, c[1], c[2], c[3], c[4]) then
                        local s = stateFor(R, block, R:get(c[1], c[2], c[3]), c[1], c[2], c[3], c[4])
                        if s and R:set(c[1], c[2], c[3], s) then return true end
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    F.features.multiface_growth = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        local block = (f.block or "minecraft:glow_lichen"):gsub("^minecraft:", "")
        local function airOrWater(s) return info(s).air or base(s) == "water" end
        if not airOrWater(R:get(x, y, z)) then return false end
        local valid = {}
        if f.can_place_on_ceiling then valid[#valid + 1] = "up" end
        if f.can_place_on_floor then valid[#valid + 1] = "down" end
        if f.can_place_on_wall then for _, d in ipairs(HORIZONTAL) do valid[#valid + 1] = d end end
        local onSet = F.blockSet(f.can_be_placed_on)
        local chance = WG.f32(f.chance_of_spreading or 0.5)
        local function place(px, py, pz, old, dirs)
            for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
                local v = DIRS[d]
                if onSet[base(R:get(px + v[1], py + v[2], pz + v[3]))] then
                    local s = stateFor(R, block, old, px, py, pz, d)
                    if not s then return false end
                    R:set(px, py, pz, s)
                    if r:nextFloat() < chance then spreadFrom(R, block, s, px, py, pz, d, r) end
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local dirs = {}
        for i, d in ipairs(valid) do dirs[i] = d end
        F.shuffle(dirs, r)
        if place(x, y, z, R:get(x, y, z), dirs) then return true end
        for _, sd in ipairs(dirs) do
            local pl = {}
            for _, d in ipairs(valid) do if d ~= OPP[sd] then pl[#pl + 1] = d end end
            F.shuffle(pl, r)
            local v = DIRS[sd]
            for _ = 1, f.search_range or 10 do
                -- Java re-offsets from the origin each step (always one block away).
                local px, py, pz = x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3]
                local s = R:get(px, py, pz)
                if not airOrWater(s) and base(s) ~= block then break end
                if place(px, py, pz, s, pl) then return true end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    F.features.underwater_magma = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        local function water(s) return base(s) == "water" end
        if not water(R:get(x, y, z)) then return false end
        local py = y
        for _ = 1, f.floor_search_range - 1 do
            if not water(R:get(x, py, z)) then break end
            py = py - 1
        end
        if water(R:get(x, py, z)) then return false end
        local rad = f.placement_radius_around_floor
        local prob = WG.f32(f.placement_probability_per_valid_position)
        local magma = WG.Blocks.id("magma_block")
        local any = false
        local function visible(ax, ay, az) return not info(R:get(ax, ay, az)).solidRender end
        for bz = z - rad, z + rad do for by = py - rad, py + rad do for bx = x - rad, x + rad do
            if r:nextFloat() < prob then
                local s = R:get(bx, by, bz)
                if not (water(s) or info(s).air) and not visible(bx, by - 1, bz) then
                    local ok = true
                    for _, d in ipairs(HORIZONTAL) do
                        local v = DIRS[d]
                        if visible(bx + v[1], by, bz + v[3]) then ok = false; break end
                    end
                    if ok then R:set(bx, by, bz, magma); any = true end
                end
            end
        end end end
        return any
    end
end
do
    -- GeodeFeature (amethyst geodes).
    local F = WG.Feature
    local DIRS, DIR_ORDER = F.DIRS, F.DIR_ORDER
    local info, base, with, getState, Providers = F.info, F.base, F.with, F.getState, WG.Providers
    local sqrt, floor = math.sqrt, math.floor
    local noiseFor = {}
    F.features.geode = function(R, f, r, ox, oy, oz)
        local B, Ly, C = f.blocks, f.layers or {}, f.crack or {}
        local outerWall = f.outer_wall_distance or {type = "uniform", min_inclusive = 4, max_inclusive = 5}
        local dist = f.distribution_points or {type = "uniform", min_inclusive = 3, max_inclusive = 4}
        local pointOffset = f.point_offset or {type = "uniform", min_inclusive = 1, max_inclusive = 2}
        local numPoints = Providers.int(dist, r)
        local seedKey = R.world.seedKey or "seed"
        local noise = noiseFor[seedKey]
        if not noise then
            noise = WG.normalNoise({base_octave = -4, octave_count = 1, base_amplitude = 1, normalize = "legacy"},
                WG.WorldgenRandom.new(WG.LegacyRandom.new(R.world.levelSeed)))
            noiseFor[seedKey] = noise
        end
        local adj = numPoints / (outerWall.max_inclusive or outerWall.value)
        local innerAir = 1 / sqrt(Ly.filling or 1.7)
        local innermost = 1 / sqrt((Ly.inner_layer or 2.2) + adj)
        local innerCrust = 1 / sqrt((Ly.middle_layer or 3.2) + adj)
        local outerCrust = 1 / sqrt((Ly.outer_layer or 4.2) + adj)
        local crackSize = 1 / sqrt((C.base_crack_size or 2.0) + r:nextDouble() / 2 + (numPoints > 3 and adj or 0))
        local crack = r:nextFloat() < (C.generate_crack_chance or 1.0)
        local invalid = 0
        local points = {}
        local invalidSet = F.blockSet(B.invalid_blocks)
        for _ = 1, numPoints do
            local x = Providers.int(outerWall, r)
            local y = Providers.int(outerWall, r)
            local z = Providers.int(outerWall, r)
            local s = R:get(ox + x, oy + y, oz + z)
            if info(s).air or invalidSet[base(s)] then
                invalid = invalid + 1
                if invalid > f.invalid_blocks_threshold then return false end
            end
            points[#points + 1] = {ox + x, oy + y, oz + z, Providers.int(pointOffset, r)}
        end
        local cracks = {}
        if crack then
            local idx = r:nextInt(4)
            local co = numPoints * 2 + 1
            local cx, cz = 0, 0
            if idx == 0 then cx = co elseif idx == 1 then cz = co elseif idx == 2 then cx, cz = co, co end
            cracks = {{ox + cx, oy + 7, oz + cz}, {ox + cx, oy + 5, oz + cz}, {ox + cx, oy + 1, oz + cz}}
        end
        local cant = F.blockSet(B.cannot_replace)
        local function safeSet(x, y, z, s) if not cant[base(R:get(x, y, z))] then R:set(x, y, z, s) end end
        local potential = {}
        local mult = f.noise_multiplier or 0.05
        local cpo = C.crack_point_offset or 2
        local altChance = f.use_alternate_layer0_chance or 0
        local potChance = f.use_potential_placements_chance or 0.35
        local requireAlt = f.placements_require_layer0_alternate ~= false
        local lo, hi = f.min_gen_offset or -16, f.max_gen_offset or 16
        for z = oz + lo, oz + hi do
            for y = oy + lo, oy + hi do
                for x = ox + lo, ox + hi do
                    local nOff = noise:get(x, y, z) * mult
                    local shell = 0
                    for _, p in ipairs(points) do
                        local dx, dy, dz = x - p[1], y - p[2], z - p[3]
                        shell = shell + 1 / sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + p[4]) + nOff
                    end
                    if not (shell < outerCrust) then
                        if shell >= innerAir then
                            safeSet(x, y, z, getState(R, B.filling_provider, r, x, y, z))
                        else
                            local cs = 0
                            for _, p in ipairs(cracks) do
                                local dx, dy, dz = x - p[1], y - p[2], z - p[3]
                                cs = cs + 1 / sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + cpo) + nOff
                            end
                            if crack and cs >= crackSize then
                                safeSet(x, y, z, WG.AIR)
                            elseif shell >= innermost then
                                local alt = r:nextFloat() < altChance
                                if alt then safeSet(x, y, z, getState(R, B.alternate_inner_layer_provider, r, x, y, z))
                                else safeSet(x, y, z, getState(R, B.inner_layer_provider, r, x, y, z)) end
                                if (not requireAlt or alt) and r:nextFloat() < potChance then potential[#potential + 1] = {x, y, z} end
                            elseif shell >= innerCrust then
                                safeSet(x, y, z, getState(R, B.middle_layer_provider, r, x, y, z))
                            elseif shell >= outerCrust then
                                safeSet(x, y, z, getState(R, B.outer_layer_provider, r, x, y, z))
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            WG.tick()
        end
        local inner = B.inner_placements
        for _, c in ipairs(potential) do
            local s = F.stateId(inner[r:nextInt(#inner) + 1])
            for _, d in ipairs(DIR_ORDER) do
                s = with(s, "facing", d)
                local v = DIRS[d]
                local px, py, pz = c[1] + v[1], c[2] + v[2], c[3] + v[3]
                local here = R:get(px, py, pz)
                s = with(s, "waterlogged", (info(here).fluid and info(here).source) and "true" or "false")
                if info(here).air or (base(here) == "water" and info(here).source) then safeSet(px, py, pz, s); break end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
end

do
    -- More feature types: BlockPileFeature (village hay / pumpkin / ice piles).
    local F = WG.Feature
    local f32 = WG.f32
    F.features.block_pile = function(R, f, r, x, y, z)
        if y < WG.MIN_Y + 5 then return false end
        local xr = 2 + r:nextInt(2)
        local zr = 2 + r:nextInt(2)
        local function mayPlaceOn(px, py, pz)
            local below = R:get(px, py - 1, pz)
            if F.base(below) == "dirt_path" then return r:nextBoolean() end
            return R:sturdy(px, py - 1, pz, "up")
        end
        local function try(px, py, pz)
            if R:isEmpty(px, py, pz) and mayPlaceOn(px, py, pz) then
                R:set(px, py, pz, F.getState(R, f.state_provider, r, px, py, pz))
            end
        end
        -- BlockPos.betweenClosed: x fastest, then y, then z.
        for bz = z - zr, z + zr do
            for by = y, y + 1 do
                for bx = x - xr, x + xr do
                    local xd, zd = x - bx, z - bz
                    if f32(xd * xd + zd * zd) <= f32(f32(r:nextFloat() * 10) - f32(r:nextFloat() * 6)) then
                        try(bx, by, bz)
                    elseif r:nextFloat() < 0.031 then
                        try(bx, by, bz)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
end

do
    -- TreeFeature: root placer, trunk placers, foliage placers, minimum size, tree decorators,
    -- leaf distances (updateLeaves). Positions go through Java HashSet order where Java iterates sets.
    local F = WG.Feature
    local floor, abs, min, max, sqrt = math.floor, math.abs, math.min, math.max, math.sqrt
    local f32 = WG.f32
    local Blocks = WG.Blocks
    local Providers = WG.Providers
    local MIN_Y, HEIGHT = WG.MIN_Y, WG.HEIGHT
    local MAX_Y = MIN_Y + HEIGHT - 1
    local DIRS, HORIZONTAL, OPP, DIR_ORDER = F.DIRS, F.HORIZONTAL, F.OPP, F.DIR_ORDER
    local CW = {north = "east", east = "south", south = "west", west = "north"}
    local AXIS = {down = "y", up = "y", north = "z", south = "z", west = "x", east = "x"}
    local info, base, prop, with, isTag = F.info, F.base, F.prop, F.with, F.isTag
    local getState, optState, PosSet = F.getState, F.optState, F.PosSet
    local function strip(n) return (n:gsub("^minecraft:", "")) end
    local function trunc(v) return v >= 0 and floor(v) or -floor(-v) end
    local function randomHorizontal(r) return HORIZONTAL[r:nextInt(4) + 1] end

    local function validTreePos(R, x, y, z) local s = R:get(x, y, z); return info(s).air or isTag(s, "replaceable_by_trees") end
    F.validTreePos = validTreePos
    local function isAirOrLeaves(R, x, y, z) local s = R:get(x, y, z); return info(s).air or isTag(s, "leaves") end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- trunk placers
    -- ctx: {R, r, tree, trunks (PosSet), valid(x,y,z)}
    local function trunkValid(T, x, y, z)
        if validTreePos(T.R, x, y, z) then return true end
        local through = T.tree.trunk_placer.can_grow_through
        return through ~= nil and F.blockSet(through)[base(T.R:get(x, y, z))] == true
    end
    local function isFree(T, x, y, z) return trunkValid(T, x, y, z) or isTag(T.R:get(x, y, z), "logs") end
    local function setTrunk(T, x, y, z, s) T.trunks:add(x, y, z); T.R:set(x, y, z, s) end
    local function placeLog(T, x, y, z, modify)
        if trunkValid(T, x, y, z) then
            local s = getState(T.R, T.tree.trunk_provider, T.r, x, y, z)
            if modify then s = modify(s) end
            setTrunk(T, x, y, z, s)
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    local function placeLogIfFree(T, x, y, z) if isFree(T, x, y, z) then placeLog(T, x, y, z) end end
    local function belowTrunk(T, x, y, z)
        local s = optState(T.R, T.tree.below_trunk_provider, T.r, x, y, z)
        if s then setTrunk(T, x, y, z, s) end
    end
    local function axisMod(axis) return function(s) return with(s, "axis", axis) end end
    local function att(x, y, z, radiusOffset, double) local s = double and 2 or 1; return {x = x, y = y, z = z, ro = radiusOffset, ho = 0, sx = s, sz = s} end
    local trunks = {}
    trunks.straight_trunk_placer = function(T, h, x, y, z)
        belowTrunk(T, x, y - 1, z)
        for i = 0, h - 1 do placeLog(T, x, y + i, z) end
        return {att(x, y + h, z, 0, false)}
    end
    trunks.forking_trunk_placer = function(T, h, x, y, z)
        local r = T.r
        belowTrunk(T, x, y - 1, z)
        local out = {}
        local lean = randomHorizontal(r)
        local leanH = h - r:nextInt(4) - 1
        local leanSteps = 3 - r:nextInt(3)
        local tx, tz = x, z
        local ey
        for yo = 0, h - 1 do
            local yy = y + yo
            if yo >= leanH and leanSteps > 0 then tx = tx + DIRS[lean][1]; tz = tz + DIRS[lean][3]; leanSteps = leanSteps - 1 end
            if placeLog(T, tx, yy, tz) then ey = yy + 1 end
        end
        if ey then out[#out + 1] = att(tx, ey, tz, 1, false) end
        tx, tz = x, z
        local branch = randomHorizontal(r)
        if branch ~= lean then
            local bpos = leanH - r:nextInt(2) - 1
            local steps = 1 + r:nextInt(3)
            ey = nil
            local yo = bpos
            while yo < h and steps > 0 do
                if yo >= 1 then
                    local yy = y + yo
                    tx = tx + DIRS[branch][1]; tz = tz + DIRS[branch][3]
                    if placeLog(T, tx, yy, tz) then ey = yy + 1 end
                end
                yo = yo + 1
                steps = steps - 1
            end
            if ey then out[#out + 1] = att(tx, ey, tz, 0, false) end
        end
        return out
    end
    trunks.giant_trunk_placer = function(T, h, x, y, z)
        belowTrunk(T, x, y - 1, z); belowTrunk(T, x + 1, y - 1, z); belowTrunk(T, x, y - 1, z + 1); belowTrunk(T, x + 1, y - 1, z + 1)
        for hh = 0, h - 1 do
            placeLogIfFree(T, x, y + hh, z)
            if hh < h - 1 then
                placeLogIfFree(T, x + 1, y + hh, z)
                placeLogIfFree(T, x + 1, y + hh, z + 1)
                placeLogIfFree(T, x, y + hh, z + 1)
            end
        end
        return {att(x, y + h, z, 0, true)}
    end
    trunks.mega_jungle_trunk_placer = function(T, h, x, y, z)
        local r = T.r
        local out = trunks.giant_trunk_placer(T, h, x, y, z)
        local bh = h - 2 - r:nextInt(4)
        while bh > trunc(h / 2) do
            local angle = f32(r:nextFloat() * f32(math.pi * 2))
            local bx, bz = 0, 0
            for b = 0, 4 do
                bx = trunc(f32(1.5 + f32(WG.mcos(angle) * b)))
                bz = trunc(f32(1.5 + f32(WG.msin(angle) * b)))
                placeLog(T, x + bx, y + bh - 3 + trunc(b / 2), z + bz)
            end
            out[#out + 1] = att(x + bx, y + bh, z + bz, -2, false)
            bh = bh - (2 + r:nextInt(4))
        end
        return out
    end
    trunks.dark_oak_trunk_placer = function(T, h, x, y, z)
        local r = T.r
        local out = {}
        belowTrunk(T, x, y - 1, z); belowTrunk(T, x + 1, y - 1, z); belowTrunk(T, x, y - 1, z + 1); belowTrunk(T, x + 1, y - 1, z + 1)
        local lean = randomHorizontal(r)
        local leanH = h - r:nextInt(4)
        local leanSteps = 2 - r:nextInt(3)
        local tx, tz = x, z
        local ey = y + h - 1
        for dy = 0, h - 1 do
            if dy >= leanH and leanSteps > 0 then tx = tx + DIRS[lean][1]; tz = tz + DIRS[lean][3]; leanSteps = leanSteps - 1 end
            local yy = y + dy
            if isAirOrLeaves(T.R, tx, yy, tz) then
                placeLog(T, tx, yy, tz); placeLog(T, tx + 1, yy, tz); placeLog(T, tx, yy, tz + 1); placeLog(T, tx + 1, yy, tz + 1)
            end
        end
        out[#out + 1] = att(tx, ey, tz, 0, true)
        for ox = -1, 2 do
            for oz = -1, 2 do
                if (ox < 0 or ox > 1 or oz < 0 or oz > 1) and r:nextInt(3) <= 0 then
                    local len = r:nextInt(3) + 2
                    for by = 0, len - 1 do placeLog(T, x + ox, ey - by - 1, z + oz) end
                    out[#out + 1] = att(x + ox, ey, z + oz, 0, false)
                end
            end
        end
        return out
    end
    -- FancyTrunkPlacer.
    local function treeShape(height, y)
        if f32(y) < f32(f32(height) * f32(0.3)) then return -1 end
        local radius = f32(height / 2)
        local adjacent = f32(radius - y)
        local distance = f32(sqrt(f32(f32(radius * radius) - f32(adjacent * adjacent))))
        if adjacent == 0 then distance = radius elseif abs(adjacent) >= radius then return 0 end
        return f32(distance * 0.5)
    end
    local function logAxis(sx, sz, bx, bz)
        local xd, zd = abs(bx - sx), abs(bz - sz)
        local m = max(xd, zd)
        if m > 0 then return xd == m and "x" or "z" end
        return "y"
    end
    local function makeLimb(T, sx, sy, sz, ex, ey, ez, doPlace)
        if not doPlace and sx == ex and sy == ey and sz == ez then return true end
        local dx, dy, dz = ex - sx, ey - sy, ez - sz
        local steps = max(abs(dx), max(abs(dy), abs(dz)))
        local fx, fy, fz = f32(dx / steps), f32(dy / steps), f32(dz / steps)
        for i = 0, steps do
            local bx = sx + floor(f32(0.5 + f32(i * fx)))
            local by = sy + floor(f32(0.5 + f32(i * fy)))
            local bz = sz + floor(f32(0.5 + f32(i * fz)))
            if doPlace then
                placeLog(T, bx, by, bz, axisMod(logAxis(sx, sz, bx, bz)))
            elseif not isFree(T, bx, by, bz) then
                return false
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    trunks.fancy_trunk_placer = function(T, treeHeight, x, y, z)
        local r = T.r
        local height = treeHeight + 2
        local trunkHeight = floor(height * 0.618)
        belowTrunk(T, x, y - 1, z)
        local clusters = min(1, floor(1.382 + (1.0 * height / 13.0) ^ 2))
        local trunkTop = y + trunkHeight
        local relY = height - 5
        local coords = {{x = x, y = y + relY, z = z, base = trunkTop}}
        while relY >= 0 do
            local shape = treeShape(height, relY)
            if not (shape < 0) then
                for _ = 1, clusters do
                    local radius = 1.0 * shape * (r:nextFloat() + 0.328)
                    local angle = f32(r:nextFloat() * 2) * math.pi
                    local cx = radius * math.sin(angle) + 0.5
                    local cz = radius * math.cos(angle) + 0.5
                    local csx, csy, csz = x + floor(cx), y + relY - 1, z + floor(cz)
                    if makeLimb(T, csx, csy, csz, csx, csy + 5, csz, false) then
                        local dx, dz = x - csx, z - csz
                        local bh = csy - sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) * 0.381
                        local bt = bh > trunkTop and trunkTop or trunc(bh)
                        if makeLimb(T, x, bt, z, csx, csy, csz, false) then coords[#coords + 1] = {x = csx, y = csy, z = csz, base = bt} end
                    end
                end
            end
            relY = relY - 1
        end
        makeLimb(T, x, y, z, x, y + trunkHeight, z, true)
        for _, c in ipairs(coords) do
            if not (x == c.x and c.base == c.y and z == c.z) and (c.base - y) >= height * 0.2 then
                makeLimb(T, x, c.base, z, c.x, c.y, c.z, true)
            end
        end
        local out = {}
        for _, c in ipairs(coords) do if (c.base - y) >= height * 0.2 then out[#out + 1] = att(c.x, c.y, c.z, 0, false) end end
        return out
    end
    trunks.bending_trunk_placer = function(T, h, x, y, z)
        local r, P = T.r, T.tree.trunk_placer
        local dir = randomHorizontal(r)
        local logH = h - 1
        belowTrunk(T, x, y - 1, z)
        local out = {}
        local px, py, pz = x, y, z
        for i = 0, logH do
            if i + 1 >= logH + r:nextInt(2) then px = px + DIRS[dir][1]; pz = pz + DIRS[dir][3] end
            if validTreePos(T.R, px, py, pz) then placeLog(T, px, py, pz) end
            if i >= (P.min_height_for_leaves or 1) then out[#out + 1] = att(px, py, pz, 0, false) end
            py = py + 1
        end
        local len = Providers.int(P.bend_length, r)
        for _ = 0, len do
            if validTreePos(T.R, px, py, pz) then placeLog(T, px, py, pz) end
            out[#out + 1] = att(px, py, pz, 0, false)
            px = px + DIRS[dir][1]; pz = pz + DIRS[dir][3]
        end
        return out
    end
    trunks.upwards_branching_trunk_placer = function(T, h, x, y, z)
        local r, P = T.r, T.tree.trunk_placer
        local out = {}
        local lx, lz
        for hp = 0, h - 1 do
            local cur = y + hp
            if placeLog(T, x, cur, z) and hp < h - 1 and r:nextFloat() < f32(P.place_branch_per_log_probability) then
                local dir = randomHorizontal(r)
                local blen = Providers.int(P.extra_branch_length, r)
                local bpos = max(0, blen - Providers.int(P.extra_branch_length, r) - 1)
                local bsteps = Providers.int(P.extra_branch_steps, r)
                -- placeBranch
                local along = cur + bpos
                local bx, bz = x, z
                local idx = bpos
                while idx < h and bsteps > 0 do
                    if idx >= 1 then
                        local ph = cur + idx
                        bx = bx + DIRS[dir][1]; bz = bz + DIRS[dir][3]
                        along = ph
                        if placeLog(T, bx, ph, bz) then along = ph + 1 end
                        out[#out + 1] = att(bx, ph, bz, 0, false)
                    end
                    idx = idx + 1
                    bsteps = bsteps - 1
                end
                if along - cur > 1 then
                    out[#out + 1] = att(bx, along, bz, 0, false)
                    out[#out + 1] = att(bx, along - 2, bz, 0, false)
                end
            end
            if hp == h - 1 then out[#out + 1] = att(x, cur + 1, z, 0, false) end
        end
        return out
    end
    trunks.cherry_trunk_placer = function(T, h, x, y, z)
        local r, P = T.r, T.tree.trunk_placer
        belowTrunk(T, x, y - 1, z)
        local bs = P.branch_start_offset_from_top
        local first = max(0, h - 1 + Providers.int(bs, r))
        local second = max(0, h - 1 + Providers.int({type = "uniform", min_inclusive = bs.min_inclusive, max_inclusive = bs.max_inclusive - 1}, r))
        if second >= first then second = second + 1 end
        local count = Providers.int(P.branch_count, r)
        local middle, both = count == 3, count >= 2
        local th
        if middle then th = h elseif both then th = max(first, second) + 1 else th = first + 1 end
        for i = 0, th - 1 do placeLog(T, x, y + i, z) end
        local out = {}
        if middle then out[#out + 1] = att(x, y + th, z, 0, false) end
        local dir = randomHorizontal(r)
        local side = axisMod(AXIS[dir])
        local function branch(bdir, offset, continues)
            local lx, ly, lz = x, y + offset, z
            local endOff = h - 1 + Providers.int(P.branch_end_offset_from_top, r)
            local extend = continues or endOff < offset
            local dist = Providers.int(P.branch_horizontal_length, r) + (extend and 1 or 0)
            local ex, ey, ez = x + DIRS[bdir][1] * dist, y + endOff, z + DIRS[bdir][3] * dist
            for _ = 1, extend and 2 or 1 do
                lx, lz = lx + DIRS[bdir][1], lz + DIRS[bdir][3]
                placeLog(T, lx, ly, lz, side)
            end
            local vdir = ey > ly and 1 or -1
            while true do
                local dist2 = abs(ex - lx) + abs(ey - ly) + abs(ez - lz)
                if dist2 == 0 then return att(ex, ey + 1, ez, 0, false) end
                local chance = f32(abs(ey - ly) / dist2)
                local vert = r:nextFloat() < chance
                if vert then ly = ly + vdir else lx, lz = lx + DIRS[bdir][1], lz + DIRS[bdir][3] end
                placeLog(T, lx, ly, lz, (not vert) and side or nil)
            end
        end
        out[#out + 1] = branch(dir, first, first < th - 1)
        if both then out[#out + 1] = branch(OPP[dir], second, second < th - 1) end
        return out
    end
    trunks.poplar_trunk_placer = function(T, h, x, y, z)
        local r, P = T.r, T.tree.trunk_placer
        belowTrunk(T, x, y - 1, z)
        local upTo = h - Providers.int(P.trunk_height_above_branches, r)
        for i = 0, h - 1 do
            placeLog(T, x, y + i, z)
            local dirs = F.shuffle({"down", "up", "north", "south", "west", "east"}, r)
            local hz = {}
            for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do if d ~= "up" and d ~= "down" then hz[#hz + 1] = d end end
            if upTo - 1 == i then
                local n = Providers.int(P.branch_amount, r)
                for k = 1, n do
                    local d = hz[k]
                    placeLog(T, x + DIRS[d][1], y + i, z + DIRS[d][3], axisMod(AXIS[d]))
                end
            end
        end
        return {att(x, y + upTo, z, 0, false)}
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- foliage placers
    -- L: {R, r, tree, foliage (PosSet)}
    local function tryPlaceLeaf(L, x, y, z)
        local cur = L.R:get(x, y, z)
        if prop(cur, "persistent") == "true" then return false end
        if not validTreePos(L.R, x, y, z) then return false end
        local s = getState(L.R, L.tree.foliage_provider, L.r, x, y, z)
        if F.prop(s, "waterlogged") ~= nil then
            local i = info(cur)
            s = with(s, "waterlogged", (i.fluid == "water" and i.source) and "true" or "false")
        end
        L.foliage:add(x, y, z)
        L.R:set(x, y, z, s)
        return true
    end
    local function leavesRow(L, skip, ox, oy, oz, radius, y, double)
        local off = double and 1 or 0
        for dx = -radius, radius + off do
            for dz = -radius, radius + off do
                local mdx, mdz
                if double then mdx, mdz = min(abs(dx), abs(dx - 1)), min(abs(dz), abs(dz - 1)) else mdx, mdz = abs(dx), abs(dz) end
                if not skip(L.r, mdx, y, mdz, radius, double, dx, dz) then tryPlaceLeaf(L, ox + dx, oy + y, oz + dz) end
            end
        end
    end
    local function rowWithHanging(L, skip, ox, oy, oz, radius, y, double, hang, ext)
        leavesRow(L, skip, ox, oy, oz, radius, y, double)
        local off = double and 1 or 0
        local lx, ly, lz = ox, oy - 1, oz
        for _, along in ipairs(HORIZONTAL) do
            local toEdge = CW[along]
            local pos = (toEdge == "south" or toEdge == "east")
            local offEdge = pos and radius + off or radius
            local px = ox + DIRS[toEdge][1] * offEdge - DIRS[along][1] * radius
            local py = oy + y - 1
            local pz = oz + DIRS[toEdge][3] * offEdge - DIRS[along][3] * radius
            for _ = -radius, radius + off - 1 do
                local above = L.foliage:contains(px, py + 1, pz)
                if above then
                    local function ext1(cx, cy, cz, chance)
                        if abs(cx - lx) + abs(cy - ly) + abs(cz - lz) >= 7 then return false end
                        if L.r:nextFloat() > chance then return false end
                        return tryPlaceLeaf(L, cx, cy, cz)
                    end
                    if ext1(px, py, pz, hang) then ext1(px, py - 1, pz, ext) end
                end
                px, pz = px + DIRS[along][1], pz + DIRS[along][3]
            end
        end
    end
    local foliage = {}
    local function blobSkip(r, dx, y, dz, rad) return dx == rad and dz == rad and (r:nextInt(2) == 0 or y == 0) end
    foliage.blob_foliage_placer = {
        height = function(P, r) return P.height end,
        place = function(L, P, a, fh, lr, off)
            for yo = off, off - (fh + a.ho), -1 do
                local cr = max(lr + a.ro - 1 - trunc(yo / 2), 0)
                leavesRow(L, blobSkip, a.x, a.y, a.z, cr, yo, a.sx == 2)
            end
        end,
    }
    foliage.fancy_foliage_placer = {
        height = function(P, r) return P.height end,
        place = function(L, P, a, fh, lr, off)
            local skip = function(r, dx, y, dz, rad) return f32(f32(f32(dx + 0.5) ^ 2) + f32(f32(dz + 0.5) ^ 2)) > f32(rad * rad) end
            for yo = off, off - fh, -1 do
                local cr = lr + ((yo ~= off and yo ~= off - fh) and 1 or 0)
                leavesRow(L, skip, a.x, a.y, a.z, cr, yo, a.sx == 2)
            end
        end,
    }
    foliage.bush_foliage_placer = {
        height = function(P, r) return P.height end,
        place = function(L, P, a, fh, lr, off)
            local skip = function(r, dx, y, dz, rad) return dx == rad and dz == rad and r:nextInt(2) == 0 end
            for yo = off, off - (fh + a.ho), -1 do
                leavesRow(L, skip, a.x, a.y, a.z, lr + a.ro - 1 - yo, yo, a.sx == 2)
            end
        end,
    }
    local cornerSkip = function(r, dx, y, dz, rad) return dx == rad and dz == rad and rad > 0 end
    foliage.spruce_foliage_placer = {
        height = function(P, r, th) return max(4, th - Providers.int(P.trunk_height, r)) end,
        place = function(L, P, a, fh, lr, off)
            local cr = L.r:nextInt(2)
            local maxR, minR = 1, 0
            for yo = off, -(fh + a.ho), -1 do
                leavesRow(L, cornerSkip, a.x, a.y, a.z, cr, yo, a.sx == 2)
                if cr >= maxR then cr = minR; minR = 1; maxR = min(maxR + 1, lr + a.ro) else cr = cr + 1 end
            end
        end,
    }
    foliage.pine_foliage_placer = {
        height = function(P, r) return Providers.int(P.height, r) end,
        radius = function(P, r, trunkH) return Providers.int(P.radius, r) + r:nextInt(max(trunkH + 1, 1)) end,
        place = function(L, P, a, fh, lr, off)
            local cr = 0
            local fho = fh + a.ho
            for yo = off, off - fho, -1 do
                leavesRow(L, cornerSkip, a.x, a.y, a.z, cr, yo, a.sx == 2)
                if cr >= 1 and yo == off - fho + 1 then cr = cr - 1 elseif cr < lr + a.ro then cr = cr + 1 end
            end
        end,
    }
    local roundSkip = function(r, dx, y, dz, rad) if dx + dz >= 7 then return true end return dx * dx + dz * dz > rad * rad end
    foliage.mega_pine_foliage_placer = {
        height = function(P, r) return Providers.int(P.crown_height, r) end,
        place = function(L, P, a, fh, lr, off)
            local prev = 0
            local fho = fh + a.ho
            for yy = a.y - fho + off, a.y + off do
                local yo = a.y - yy
                local smooth = lr + a.ro + floor(f32(f32(yo / fho) * f32(3.5)))
                local jag = (yo > 0 and smooth == prev and yy % 2 == 0) and smooth + 1 or smooth
                leavesRow(L, roundSkip, a.x, yy, a.z, jag, 0, a.sx == 2)
                prev = smooth
            end
        end,
    }
    foliage.acacia_foliage_placer = {
        height = function() return 0 end,
        place = function(L, P, a, fh, lr, off)
            local skip = function(r, dx, y, dz, rad)
                if y == 0 then return (dx > 1 or dz > 1) and dx ~= 0 and dz ~= 0 end
                return dx == rad and dz == rad and rad > 0
            end
            local d = a.sx == 2
            local fho = fh + a.ho
            leavesRow(L, skip, a.x, a.y + off, a.z, lr + a.ro, -1 - fho, d)
            leavesRow(L, skip, a.x, a.y + off, a.z, lr - 1, -fho, d)
            leavesRow(L, skip, a.x, a.y + off, a.z, lr + a.ro - 1, 0, d)
        end,
    }
    foliage.dark_oak_foliage_placer = {
        height = function() return 4 end,
        place = function(L, P, a, fh, lr, off)
            local d = a.sx == 2
            local skip = function(r, mdx, y, mdz, rad, double, dx, dz)
                if y == 0 and double and (dx == -rad or dx >= rad) and (dz == -rad or dz >= rad) then return true end
                if y == -1 and not double then return mdx == rad and mdz == rad end
                if y == 1 then return mdx + mdz > rad * 2 - 2 end
                return false
            end
            local oy = a.y + off
            if d then
                leavesRow(L, skip, a.x, oy, a.z, lr + 2, -1, d)
                leavesRow(L, skip, a.x, oy, a.z, lr + 3, 0, d)
                leavesRow(L, skip, a.x, oy, a.z, lr + 2, 1, d)
                if L.r:nextBoolean() then leavesRow(L, skip, a.x, oy, a.z, lr, 2, d) end
            else
                leavesRow(L, skip, a.x, oy, a.z, lr + 2, -1, d)
                leavesRow(L, skip, a.x, oy, a.z, lr + 1, 0, d)
            end
        end,
    }
    foliage.jungle_foliage_placer = {
        height = function(P) return P.height end,
        place = function(L, P, a, fh, lr, off)
            local lh = (a.sx == 2 and fh or 1 + L.r:nextInt(2)) + a.ho
            for yo = off, off - lh, -1 do
                leavesRow(L, roundSkip, a.x, a.y, a.z, lr + a.ro + 1 - yo, yo, a.sx == 2)
            end
        end,
    }
    foliage.mega_jungle_foliage_placer = foliage.jungle_foliage_placer
    foliage.random_spread_foliage_placer = {
        height = function(P, r) return Providers.int(P.foliage_height, r) end,
        place = function(L, P, a, fh, lr, off)
            local r = L.r
            for _ = 1, P.leaf_placement_attempts do
                local dx = r:nextInt(lr) - r:nextInt(lr)
                local dy = r:nextInt(fh) - r:nextInt(fh)
                local dz = r:nextInt(lr) - r:nextInt(lr)
                tryPlaceLeaf(L, a.x + dx, a.y + dy, a.z + dz)
            end
        end,
    }
    foliage.cherry_foliage_placer = {
        height = function(P, r) return Providers.int(P.height, r) end,
        place = function(L, P, a, fh, lr, off)
            local wide, corner = f32(P.wide_bottom_layer_hole_chance), f32(P.corner_hole_chance)
            local skip = function(r, dx, y, dz, rad)
                if y == -1 and (dx == rad or dz == rad) and r:nextFloat() < wide then return true end
                local isCorner = dx == rad and dz == rad
                if rad > 2 then return isCorner or dx + dz > rad * 2 - 2 and r:nextFloat() < corner end
                return isCorner and r:nextFloat() < corner
            end
            local d = a.sx == 2
            local oy = a.y + off
            local cr = lr + a.ro - 1
            local fho = fh + a.ho
            leavesRow(L, skip, a.x, oy, a.z, cr - 2, fho - 3, d)
            leavesRow(L, skip, a.x, oy, a.z, cr - 1, fho - 4, d)
            for y = fho - 5, 0, -1 do leavesRow(L, skip, a.x, oy, a.z, cr, y, d) end
            rowWithHanging(L, skip, a.x, oy, a.z, cr, -1, d, f32(P.hanging_leaves_chance), f32(P.hanging_leaves_extension_chance))
            rowWithHanging(L, skip, a.x, oy, a.z, cr - 1, -2, d, f32(P.hanging_leaves_chance), f32(P.hanging_leaves_extension_chance))
        end,
    }
    foliage.poplar_foliage_placer = {
        height = function(P, r) return Providers.int(P.height, r) end,
        place = function(L, P, a, fh, lr, off)
            local r = L.r
            local d = a.sx == 2
            local ox, oy, oz = a.x, a.y + off, a.z
            local cr = lr + a.ro - 1
            local flip = r:nextBoolean()
            local fho = fh + a.ho
            local hole = f32(P.side_hole_chance)
            local function partial(y) return fho - 1 == y or fho - 2 == y end
            local function cut(dx, dz, rad, part)
                local small
                if flip then small = dx > 0 and dz > 0 or dz < 0 and dx < 0 else small = dx > 0 and dz < 0 or dz > 0 and dx < 0 end
                return small and rad - 1 or (part and rad + 1 or rad)
            end
            local function within(rad, adx, adz, c, extra) return adx + adz <= rad * 2 - (c + extra) end
            local function row(rad, y)
                local o = d and 1 or 0
                for dx = -rad, rad + o do
                    for dz = -rad, rad + o do
                        local part = partial(y)
                        local c = cut(dx, dz, rad, part)
                        local adx, adz = abs(dx), abs(dz)
                        local edge = adx == rad or adz == rad
                        local skip
                        if part and edge then skip = true
                        else
                            local extra = r:nextFloat() <= hole and 1 or 0
                            skip = not within(rad, adx, adz, c, extra)
                        end
                        if not skip then tryPlaceLeaf(L, ox + dx, oy + y, oz + dz) end
                    end
                end
            end
            row(cr - 2, fho - 1)
            row(cr - 1, fho - 2)
            row(cr - 1, fho - 3)
            for y = fho - 4, 1, -1 do row(cr, y) end
            -- replaceLeavesWithLog at y = fho - 4
            do
                local y = fho - 4
                local o = d and 1 or 0
                for dx = -cr, cr + o do
                    for dz = -cr, cr + o do
                        local adx, adz = abs(dx), abs(dz)
                        if within(cr, adx, adz, cut(dx, dz, cr, partial(y)), 2) and (adz == 0 and cr - adx >= 4 or adx == 0 and cr - adz >= 4) then
                            local px, py, pz = ox + dx, oy + y, oz + dz
                            local leaf = getState(L.R, L.tree.foliage_provider, r, px, py, pz)
                            if L.R:get(px, py, pz) == leaf then
                                local logS = getState(L.R, L.tree.trunk_provider, r, px, py, pz)
                                logS = with(logS, "axis", adz == 0 and "x" or "z")
                                L.foliage:add(px, py, pz)
                                L.R:set(px, py, pz, logS)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            row(cr - 1, 0)
            row(math.clamp(cr - 2, 1, 2), -1)
        end,
    }

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- decorators
    local decorators = {}
    local function sortedByY(list)
        -- ObjectArrayList.sort (stable) by y.
        local arr = {}
        for i, p in ipairs(list) do arr[i] = {p = p, i = i} end
        table.sort(arr, function(a, b) if a.p[2] ~= b.p[2] then return a.p[2] < b.p[2] end return a.i < b.i end)
        local out = {}
        for i, e in ipairs(arr) do out[i] = e.p end
        return out
    end
    local function placeVine(C, x, y, z, face) C.set(x, y, z, Blocks.id(F.canon("vine", {[face] = "true"}))) end
    local function lowestTrunkOrRoot(C)
        local out = {}
        if #C.roots == 0 then for _, p in ipairs(C.logs) do out[#out + 1] = p end
        elseif #C.logs > 0 and C.roots[1][2] == C.logs[1][2] then
            for _, p in ipairs(C.logs) do out[#out + 1] = p end
            for _, p in ipairs(C.roots) do out[#out + 1] = p end
        else for _, p in ipairs(C.roots) do out[#out + 1] = p end end
        return out
    end
    decorators.trunk_vine = function(C, D)
        local r = C.r
        for _, p in ipairs(C.logs) do
            local x, y, z = p[1], p[2], p[3]
            if r:nextInt(3) > 0 and C.isAir(x - 1, y, z) then placeVine(C, x - 1, y, z, "east") end
            if r:nextInt(3) > 0 and C.isAir(x + 1, y, z) then placeVine(C, x + 1, y, z, "west") end
            if r:nextInt(3) > 0 and C.isAir(x, y, z - 1) then placeVine(C, x, y, z - 1, "south") end
            if r:nextInt(3) > 0 and C.isAir(x, y, z + 1) then placeVine(C, x, y, z + 1, "north") end
        end
    end
    decorators.leave_vine = function(C, D)
        local r = C.r
        local p = f32(D.probability)
        local function hang(x, y, z, face)
            placeVine(C, x, y, z, face)
            local n = 4
            y = y - 1
            while C.isAir(x, y, z) and n > 0 do placeVine(C, x, y, z, face); y = y - 1; n = n - 1 end
        end
        for _, q in ipairs(C.leaves) do
            local x, y, z = q[1], q[2], q[3]
            if r:nextFloat() < p and C.isAir(x - 1, y, z) then hang(x - 1, y, z, "east") end
            if r:nextFloat() < p and C.isAir(x + 1, y, z) then hang(x + 1, y, z, "west") end
            if r:nextFloat() < p and C.isAir(x, y, z - 1) then hang(x, y, z - 1, "south") end
            if r:nextFloat() < p and C.isAir(x, y, z + 1) then hang(x, y, z + 1, "north") end
        end
    end
    decorators.cocoa = function(C, D)
        local r = C.r
        if r:nextFloat() >= f32(D.probability) then return end
        if #C.logs == 0 then return end
        local ty = C.logs[1][2]
        for _, p in ipairs(C.logs) do
            if p[2] - ty <= 2 then
                for _, dir in ipairs(HORIZONTAL) do
                    if r:nextFloat() <= 0.25 then
                        local o = DIRS[OPP[dir]]
                        local x, y, z = p[1] + o[1], p[2], p[3] + o[3]
                        if C.isAir(x, y, z) then
                            C.set(x, y, z, Blocks.id(F.canon("cocoa", {age = tostring(r:nextInt(3)), facing = dir})))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    decorators.beehive = function(C, D)
        local r = C.r
        if #C.logs == 0 then return end
        if r:nextFloat() >= f32(D.probability) then return end
        local hiveY
        if #C.leaves > 0 then hiveY = max(C.leaves[1][2] - 1, C.logs[1][2] + 1)
        else hiveY = min(C.logs[1][2] + 1 + r:nextInt(3), C.logs[#C.logs][2]) end
        local spots = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(C.logs) do
            if p[2] == hiveY then
                for _, d in ipairs({"north", "east", "south", "west"}) do
                    if d ~= "north" then spots[#spots + 1] = {p[1] + DIRS[d][1], p[2], p[3] + DIRS[d][3]} end
                end
            end
        end
        if #spots == 0 then return end
        F.shuffle(spots, r)
        for _, s in ipairs(spots) do
            if C.isAir(s[1], s[2], s[3]) and C.isAir(s[1], s[2], s[3] + 1) then
                C.set(s[1], s[2], s[3], Blocks.id(F.canon("bee_nest", {facing = "south"})))
                local bees = 2 + r:nextInt(2)
                for _ = 1, bees do r:nextInt(599) end
                return
            end
        end
    end
    decorators.alter_ground = function(C, D)
        local list = lowestTrunkOrRoot(C)
        if #list == 0 then return end
        local minY = list[1][2]
        local function placeAt(x, y, z)
            for dy = 2, -3, -1 do
                local s = optState(C.R, D.provider, C.r, x, y + dy, z)
                if s then C.set(x, y + dy, z, s); break end
                if not C.isAir(x, y + dy, z) and dy < 0 then break end
            end
        end
        local function circle(x, y, z)
            for xx = -2, 2 do for zz = -2, 2 do
                if abs(xx) ~= 2 or abs(zz) ~= 2 then placeAt(x + xx, y, z + zz) end
            end end
        end
        for _, p in ipairs(list) do
            if p[2] == minY then
                local x, y, z = p[1], p[2], p[3]
                circle(x - 1, y, z - 1); circle(x + 2, y, z - 1); circle(x - 1, y, z + 2); circle(x + 2, y, z + 2)
                for _ = 1, 5 do
                    local pl = C.r:nextInt(64)
                    local xx, zz = pl % 8, floor(pl / 8)
                    if xx == 0 or xx == 7 or zz == 0 or zz == 7 then circle(x - 3 + xx, y, z - 3 + zz) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    decorators.attached_to_leaves = function(C, D)
        local r = C.r
        local black = {}
        local copy = {}
        for i, p in ipairs(C.leaves) do copy[i] = p end
        F.shuffle(copy, r)
        local dirs = D.directions
        for _, p in ipairs(copy) do
            local dir = dirs[r:nextInt(#dirs) + 1]
            local v = DIRS[dir]
            local px, py, pz = p[1] + v[1], p[2] + v[2], p[3] + v[3]
            local key = px .. "," .. py .. "," .. pz
            if not black[key] and r:nextFloat() < f32(D.probability) then
                local ok = true
                for i = 1, D.required_empty_blocks do
                    if not C.isAir(p[1] + v[1] * i, p[2] + v[2] * i, p[3] + v[3] * i) then ok = false; break end
                end
                if ok then
                    local ex, ey = D.exclusion_radius_xz, D.exclusion_radius_y
                    for bz = pz - ex, pz + ex do for by = py - ey, py + ey do for bx = px - ex, px + ex do black[bx .. "," .. by .. "," .. bz] = true end end end
                    C.set(px, py, pz, getState(C.R, D.block_provider, r, px, py, pz))
                end
            end
        end
    end
    decorators.attached_to_logs = function(C, D)
        local r = C.r
        local copy = {}
        for i, p in ipairs(C.logs) do copy[i] = p end
        F.shuffle(copy, r)
        for _, p in ipairs(copy) do
            local dir = D.directions[r:nextInt(#D.directions) + 1]
            local v = DIRS[dir]
            local px, py, pz = p[1] + v[1], p[2] + v[2], p[3] + v[3]
            if r:nextFloat() <= f32(D.probability) and C.isAir(px, py, pz) then C.set(px, py, pz, getState(C.R, D.block_provider, r, px, py, pz)) end
        end
    end
    decorators.place_on_ground = function(C, D)
        local list = lowestTrunkOrRoot(C)
        if #list == 0 then return end
        local o = list[1]
        local minY, minX, maxX, minZ, maxZ = o[2], o[1], o[1], o[3], o[3]
        for _, p in ipairs(list) do
            if p[2] == minY then minX = min(minX, p[1]); maxX = max(maxX, p[1]); minZ = min(minZ, p[3]); maxZ = max(maxZ, p[3]) end
        end
        local r = C.r
        local rad, h = D.radius or 2, D.height or 1
        local function between(a, b) return r:nextInt(b - a + 1) + a end
        for _ = 1, D.tries or 128 do
            local x = between(minX - rad, maxX + rad)
            local y = between(minY - h, minY + h)
            local z = between(minZ - rad, maxZ + rad)
            local above = C.R:get(x, y + 1, z)
            if (info(above).air or base(above) == "vine") and info(C.R:get(x, y, z)).solidRender and C.R:height("MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES", x, z) <= y + 1 then
                C.set(x, y + 1, z, getState(C.R, D.block_state_provider or D.block_provider, r, x, y + 1, z))
            end
        end
    end
    decorators.pale_moss = function(C, D)
        local r = C.r
        local copy = {}
        for i, p in ipairs(C.logs) do copy[i] = p end
        F.shuffle(copy, r)
        if #copy == 0 then return end
        local o = copy[1]
        for _, p in ipairs(copy) do if p[2] < o[2] then o = p end end
        if r:nextFloat() < f32(D.ground_probability) then
            F.placeFeature(C.R, "minecraft:pale_moss_patch", r, o[1], o[2] + 1, o[3])
        end
        local function hanger(x, y, z)
            while C.isAir(x, y - 1, z) and not (r:nextFloat() < 0.5) do
                C.set(x, y, z, Blocks.id(F.canon("pale_hanging_moss", {tip = "false"})))
                y = y - 1
            end
            C.set(x, y, z, Blocks.id(F.canon("pale_hanging_moss", {tip = "true"})))
        end
        for _, p in ipairs(C.logs) do
            if r:nextFloat() < f32(D.trunk_probability) and C.isAir(p[1], p[2] - 1, p[3]) then hanger(p[1], p[2] - 1, p[3]) end
        end
        for _, p in ipairs(C.leaves) do
            if r:nextFloat() < f32(D.leaves_probability) and C.isAir(p[1], p[2] - 1, p[3]) then hanger(p[1], p[2] - 1, p[3]) end
        end
    end
    decorators.creaking_heart = function(C, D)
        local r = C.r
        if #C.logs == 0 then return end
        if r:nextFloat() >= f32(D.probability) then return end
        local copy = {}
        for i, p in ipairs(C.logs) do copy[i] = p end
        F.shuffle(copy, r)
        for _, p in ipairs(copy) do
            local ok = true
            for _, d in ipairs(DIR_ORDER) do
                local v = DIRS[d]
                if not isTag(C.R:get(p[1] + v[1], p[2] + v[2], p[3] + v[3]), "logs") then ok = false; break end
            end
            if ok then
                C.set(p[1], p[2], p[3], Blocks.id(F.canon("creaking_heart", {creaking_heart_state = "dormant", natural = "true"})))
                return
            end
        end
    end
    decorators.shelf_mushroom = function(C, D)
        local r = C.r
        if r:nextFloat() >= f32(D.probability) then return end
        local logs = C.logs
        if #logs == 0 then return end
        local function replaceable(x, y, z)
            if not info(C.R:get(x, y, z)).repl then return false end
            for _, d in ipairs({"up", "east", "west", "north", "south"}) do
                local v = d == "up" and {0, 0, 0} or DIRS[d]
                if base(C.R:get(x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3])) == "water" then return false end
            end
            return true
        end
        local function hasAt(x, y, z) return base(C.R:get(x, y, z)) == "shelf_mushroom" end
        local function place(x, y, z, facing) C.set(x, y, z, Blocks.id(F.canon("shelf_mushroom", {age = tostring(r:nextInt(2)), facing = facing}))) end
        if logs[1][2] == logs[#logs][2] then
            local axisX = logs[1][1] ~= logs[#logs][1]
            local dirs = axisX and {"north", "south"} or {"east", "west"}
            for _, p in ipairs(logs) do
                for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
                    if not (r:nextFloat() > 0.25) then
                        local x, y, z = p[1] + DIRS[d][1], p[2], p[3] + DIRS[d][3]
                        if replaceable(x, y, z) then
                            local adj = false
                            for _, h in ipairs(HORIZONTAL) do
                                if hasAt(x + DIRS[h][1], y, z + DIRS[h][3]) or hasAt(p[1] + DIRS[h][1], p[2], p[3] + DIRS[h][3]) then adj = true end
                            end
                            if not adj then place(x, y, z, d) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            local first = randomHorizontal(r)
            local dirs = {first, CW[first]}
            local baseY = logs[1][2]
            for _, p in ipairs(logs) do
                local dy = p[2] - baseY
                if dy >= 1 and dy <= 4 then
                    for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
                        if not (r:nextFloat() > 0.25) then
                            local x, y, z = p[1] + DIRS[d][1], p[2], p[3] + DIRS[d][3]
                            if replaceable(x, y, z) and not hasAt(x, y - 1, z) then place(x, y, z, d); break end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- decorators run with lists sorted by y (stable over the sets' HashSet order).
    function F.decorate(R, r, list, logs, leaves, roots, onSet)
        if #list == 0 then return end
        local C = {R = R, r = r, logs = sortedByY(logs), leaves = sortedByY(leaves), roots = sortedByY(roots)}
        C.set = function(x, y, z, s) if onSet then onSet(x, y, z) end R:set(x, y, z, s) end
        C.isAir = function(x, y, z) return info(R:get(x, y, z)).air end
        for _, D in ipairs(list) do
            local fn = decorators[strip(D.type)]
            if fn then fn(C, D) else F.missing = F.missing or {}; F.missing["decorator:" .. strip(D.type)] = true end
        end
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- root placer
    local function placeRoots(T, ox, oy, oz, tx, ty, tz)
        local P = T.tree.root_placer
        local M = P.mangrove_root_placement
        local R, r = T.R, T.r
        local function canPlace(x, y, z) return validTreePos(R, x, y, z) or F.blockSet(M.can_grow_through)[base(R:get(x, y, z))] == true end
        local cy = oy
        while cy < ty do
            if not canPlace(ox, cy, oz) then return false end
            cy = cy + 1
        end
        local positions = {{tx, ty - 1, tz}}
        local function potential(px, py, pz, dir)
            local below = {px, py - 1, pz}
            local nx, nz = px + DIRS[dir][1], pz + DIRS[dir][3]
            local width = abs(px - tx) + abs(py - ty) + abs(pz - tz)
            local skew = f32(M.random_skew_chance)
            if width > M.max_root_width - 3 and width <= M.max_root_width then
                if r:nextFloat() < skew then return {below, {nx, py - 1, nz}} end
                return {below}
            elseif width > M.max_root_width then return {below}
            elseif r:nextFloat() < skew then return {below} end
            if r:nextBoolean() then return {{nx, py, nz}} end
            return {below}
        end
        local function simulate(px, py, pz, dir, list, layer)
            if layer ~= M.max_root_length and #list <= M.max_root_length then
                for _, q in ipairs(potential(px, py, pz, dir)) do
                    if canPlace(q[1], q[2], q[3]) then
                        list[#list + 1] = q
                        if not simulate(q[1], q[2], q[3], dir, list, layer + 1) then return false end
                    end
                end
                return true
            end
            return false
        end
        for _, dir in ipairs(HORIZONTAL) do
            local sx, sz = tx + DIRS[dir][1], tz + DIRS[dir][3]
            local list = {}
            if not simulate(sx, ty, sz, dir, list, 0) then return false end
            for _, q in ipairs(list) do positions[#positions + 1] = q end
            positions[#positions + 1] = {sx, ty, sz}
        end
        local function waterlog(x, y, z, s)
            if F.prop(s, "waterlogged") ~= nil then s = with(s, "waterlogged", info(R:get(x, y, z)).fluid == "water" and "true" or "false") end
            return s
        end
        for _, q in ipairs(positions) do
            local x, y, z = q[1], q[2], q[3]
            if F.blockSet(M.muddy_roots_in)[base(R:get(x, y, z))] then
                local s = getState(R, M.muddy_roots_provider, r, x, y, z)
                T.roots:add(x, y, z); R:set(x, y, z, waterlog(x, y, z, s))
            elseif validTreePos(R, x, y, z) or F.blockSet(M.can_grow_through)[base(R:get(x, y, z))] then
                local s = getState(R, P.root_provider, r, x, y, z)
                T.roots:add(x, y, z); R:set(x, y, z, waterlog(x, y, z, s))
                local A = P.above_root_placement
                if A and r:nextFloat() < f32(A.above_root_placement_chance) and info(R:get(x, y + 1, z)).air then
                    local s2 = getState(R, A.above_root_provider, r, x, y + 1, z)
                    T.roots:add(x, y + 1, z); R:set(x, y + 1, z, waterlog(x, y + 1, z, s2))
                end
            end
        end
        return true
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- TreeFeature
    local function sizeAt(S, treeHeight, yo)
        local t = strip(S.type)
        if t == "three_layers_feature_size" then
            if yo < (S.limit or 1) then return S.lower_size or 0 end
            return yo >= treeHeight - (S.upper_limit or 1) and (S.upper_size or 1) or (S.middle_size or 1)
        end
        return yo < (S.limit or 1) and (S.lower_size or 0) or (S.upper_size or 1)
    end
    F.features.tree = function(R, tree, r, x, y, z)
        local T = {R = R, r = r, tree = tree, trunks = PosSet.new(), roots = PosSet.new()}
        local L = {R = R, r = r, tree = tree, foliage = PosSet.new()}
        local TP, FP = tree.trunk_placer, tree.foliage_placer
        local trunkFn = trunks[strip(TP.type)]
        local fol = foliage[strip(FP.type)]
        if not trunkFn or not fol then F.missing = F.missing or {}; F.missing["tree:" .. strip(TP.type) .. "/" .. strip(FP.type)] = true; return false end
        local treeHeight = TP.base_height + r:nextInt((TP.height_rand_a or 0) + 1) + r:nextInt((TP.height_rand_b or 0) + 1)
        local foliageHeight = fol.height(FP, r, treeHeight)
        local trunkHeight = treeHeight - foliageHeight
        local leafRadius = fol.radius and fol.radius(FP, r, trunkHeight) or Providers.int(FP.radius, r)
        local tx, ty, tz = x, y, z
        if tree.root_placer then ty = y + Providers.int(tree.root_placer.trunk_offset_y, r) end
        local minY = min(y, ty)
        local maxY = max(y, ty) + treeHeight + 1
        if not (minY >= MIN_Y + 1 and maxY <= MAX_Y + 1) then return false end
        local S = tree.minimum_size
        local clipped = treeHeight
        do
            local done = false
            for yy = 0, treeHeight + 1 do
                local rr = sizeAt(S, treeHeight, yy)
                for dx = -rr, rr do
                    for dz = -rr, rr do
                        local px, py, pz = tx + dx, ty + yy, tz + dz
                        if not isFree(T, px, py, pz) or not tree.ignore_vines and base(R:get(px, py, pz)) == "vine" then
                            clipped = yy - 2; done = true; break
                        end
                    end
                    if done then break end
                end
                if done then break end
            end
        end
        if not (clipped >= treeHeight or S.min_clipped_height and clipped >= S.min_clipped_height) then return false end
        if tree.root_placer and not placeRoots(T, x, y, z, tx, ty, tz) then return false end
        local atts = trunkFn(T, clipped, tx, ty, tz)
        for _, a in ipairs(atts) do
            local off = Providers.int(FP.offset, r)
            fol.place(L, FP, a, foliageHeight, leafRadius, off)
        end
        if T.trunks:size() == 0 and L.foliage:size() == 0 then return false end
        local decorations = PosSet.new()
        local logs, leaves, roots = T.trunks:ordered(), L.foliage:ordered(), T.roots:ordered()
        F.decorate(R, r, tree.decorators or {}, logs, leaves, roots, function(dx, dy, dz) decorations:add(dx, dy, dz) end)
        -- updateLeaves: leaf distances from logs (bounded by the tree's box).
        local bx0, by0, bz0, bx1, by1, bz1 = math.huge, math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
        local function grow(p) bx0 = min(bx0, p[1]); by0 = min(by0, p[2]); bz0 = min(bz0, p[3]); bx1 = max(bx1, p[1]); by1 = max(by1, p[2]); bz1 = max(bz1, p[3]) end
        for _, set in ipairs({T.roots, T.trunks, L.foliage, decorations}) do for _, p in ipairs(set.list) do grow(p) end end
        if bx0 == math.huge then return false end
        local function inside(px, py, pz) return px >= bx0 and px <= bx1 and py >= by0 and py <= by1 and pz >= bz0 and pz <= bz1 end
        local full = {}
        local function key(px, py, pz) return px .. "," .. py .. "," .. pz end
        for _, set in ipairs({decorations, T.roots}) do for _, p in ipairs(set.list) do if inside(p[1], p[2], p[3]) then full[key(p[1], p[2], p[3])] = true end end end
        -- Dijkstra by level: always the smallest pending distance first (Java's toCheck lists).
        local levels, heads = {}, {}
        for i = 0, 6 do levels[i] = {}; heads[i] = 1 end
        for _, p in ipairs(T.trunks.list) do levels[0][#levels[0] + 1] = p end
        local d = 0
        while d < 7 do
            local queue = levels[d]
            if heads[d] > #queue then
                d = d + 1
            else
                local p = queue[heads[d]]
                heads[d] = heads[d] + 1
                local k = key(p[1], p[2], p[3])
                if inside(p[1], p[2], p[3]) then
                    if d ~= 0 then
                        local st = R:get(p[1], p[2], p[3])
                        if F.prop(st, "distance") ~= nil then R:set(p[1], p[2], p[3], with(st, "distance", tostring(d))) end
                    end
                    full[k] = true
                    local cur = d
                    for _, dn in ipairs(DIR_ORDER) do
                        local v = DIRS[dn]
                        local nx, ny, nz = p[1] + v[1], p[2] + v[2], p[3] + v[3]
                        if inside(nx, ny, nz) and not full[key(nx, ny, nz)] then
                            local st = R:get(nx, ny, nz)
                            local have = isTag(st, "logs") and 0 or tonumber(F.prop(st, "distance") or "")
                            if have then
                                local nd = min(have, cur + 1)
                                if nd < 7 then
                                    levels[nd][#levels[nd] + 1] = {nx, ny, nz}
                                    if nd < d then d = nd end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
end

do
    -- STRUCTURES: structure set placement (random spread, frequency reducers, exclusion zones), structure
    -- selection, JigsawStructure / JigsawPlacement (pools, templates, free-space shapes, junctions),
    -- template placement with processors, and the Beardifier that shapes terrain around jigsaw pieces.
    local floor, abs, min, max, sqrt = math.floor, math.abs, math.min, math.max, math.sqrt
    local f32 = WG.f32
    local I64 = WG.I64
    local Blocks = WG.Blocks
    local MIN_Y, HEIGHT = WG.MIN_Y, WG.HEIGHT
    local MAX_Y = MIN_Y + HEIGHT - 1
    local S = {}
    WG.Struct = S
    local function strip(n) return (n:gsub("^minecraft:", "")) end
    local function full(n) if n:find(":", 1, true) then return n end return "minecraft:" .. n end
    local function floorDiv(a, b) return floor(a / b) end
    local function legacyRandom() return WG.WorldgenRandom.new(WG.LegacyRandom.new(I64.from(0))) end
    -- Generation steps (GenerationStep.Decoration ordinal).
    local STEPS = {raw_generation = 0, lakes = 1, local_modifications = 2, underground_structures = 3, surface_structures = 4, strongholds = 5,
        underground_ores = 6, underground_decoration = 7, fluid_springs = 8, vegetal_decoration = 9, top_layer_modification = 10}
    -- Implemented structure types (others are placed as starts but not built yet).
    local BUILT = {["minecraft:jigsaw"] = true}

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- placement
    local function setLargeFeatureWithSalt(r, seed, x, z, salt) r:setLargeFeatureWithSalt(seed, x, z, salt) end
    local function spreadEval(r, kind, limit)
        if kind == "triangular" then return floor((r:nextInt(limit) + r:nextInt(limit)) / 2) end
        return r:nextInt(limit)
    end
    local potentialCache = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    function S.potentialChunk(p, seed, cx, cz)
        local gx, gz = floorDiv(cx, p.spacing), floorDiv(cz, p.spacing)
        local cache = potentialCache[p]
        if not cache then cache = {}; potentialCache[p] = cache end
        local key = gx * 65536 + gz
        local hit = cache[key]
        if hit and hit[3] == seed then return hit[1], hit[2] end
        local r = legacyRandom()
        setLargeFeatureWithSalt(r, seed, gx, gz, p.salt)
        local limit = p.spacing - p.separation
        local sx = spreadEval(r, p.spread_type, limit)
        local sz = spreadEval(r, p.spread_type, limit)
        cache[key] = {gx * p.spacing + sx, gz * p.spacing + sz, seed}
        return gx * p.spacing + sx, gz * p.spacing + sz
    end
    local function frequencyOk(p, seed, cx, cz)
        local freq = f32(p.frequency or 1)
        if not (freq < 1) then return true end
        local m = p.frequency_reduction_method or "default"
        local r = legacyRandom()
        if m == "legacy_type_1" then
            local x, z = floor(cx / 16), floor(cz / 16)
            r:setSeed(I64.xor(I64.from(bit32.bxor(x % 4294967296, (z * 16) % 4294967296) >= 2147483648 and bit32.bxor(x % 4294967296, (z * 16) % 4294967296) - 4294967296 or bit32.bxor(x % 4294967296, (z * 16) % 4294967296)), seed))
            r:nextInt()
            return r:nextInt(floor(1 / freq)) == 0
        elseif m == "legacy_type_2" then
            setLargeFeatureWithSalt(r, seed, cx, cz, 10387320)
            return r:nextFloat() < freq
        elseif m == "legacy_type_3" then
            r:setLargeFeatureSeed(seed, cx, cz)
            return r:nextDouble() < freq
        end
        setLargeFeatureWithSalt(r, seed, p.salt, cx, cz)
        return r:nextFloat() < freq
    end
    -- isStructureChunk for random_spread (concentric rings: strongholds are not placed).
    function S.isStructureChunk(world, set, cx, cz)
        local p = set.placement
        if strip(p.type) ~= "random_spread" then return false end
        local px, pz = S.potentialChunk(p, world.levelSeed, cx, cz)
        if px ~= cx or pz ~= cz then return false end
        if not frequencyOk(p, world.levelSeed, cx, cz) then return false end
        local ex = p.exclusion_zone
        if ex then
            local other = world.data.structureSets[ex.other_set]
            if other then
                local op = other.placement
                for dx = -ex.chunk_count, ex.chunk_count do
                    for dz = -ex.chunk_count, ex.chunk_count do
                        local ox, oz = S.potentialChunk(op, world.levelSeed, cx + dx, cz + dz)
                        if ox == cx + dx and oz == cz + dz and frequencyOk(op, world.levelSeed, cx + dx, cz + dz) then return false end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return true
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- rotation
    local ROTATIONS = {"none", "clockwise_90", "clockwise_180", "counterclockwise_90"}
    local DIR_CW = {north = "east", east = "south", south = "west", west = "north", up = "up", down = "down"}
    local DIR_CCW = {north = "west", west = "south", south = "east", east = "north", up = "up", down = "down"}
    local DIR_OPP = {north = "south", south = "north", east = "west", west = "east", up = "down", down = "up"}
    local function rotDir(d, rot)
        if rot == "clockwise_90" then return DIR_CW[d] or d end
        if rot == "counterclockwise_90" then return DIR_CCW[d] or d end
        if rot == "clockwise_180" then
            if d == "up" or d == "down" then return d end
            return DIR_OPP[d] or d
        end
        return d
    end
    S.rotDir = rotDir
    local function rotPos(x, y, z, rot)
        if rot == "clockwise_90" then return -z, y, x end
        if rot == "counterclockwise_90" then return z, y, -x end
        if rot == "clockwise_180" then return -x, y, -z end
        return x, y, z
    end
    local RAIL_CW = {north_south = "east_west", east_west = "north_south", ascending_east = "ascending_south", ascending_south = "ascending_west",
        ascending_west = "ascending_north", ascending_north = "ascending_east", south_east = "south_west", south_west = "north_west",
        north_west = "north_east", north_east = "south_east"}
    local stateRotCache = {}
    local F
    -- BlockState.rotate for the common property shapes.
    local function rotateState(id, rot)
        if rot == "none" then return id end
        local key = id * 4 + (rot == "clockwise_90" and 1 or rot == "clockwise_180" and 2 or 3)
        local c = stateRotCache[key]
        if c then return c end
        F = F or WG.Feature
        local name = Blocks.names[id] or "air"
        local base = name:match("^([^%[]+)") or name
        local props = {}
        local inner = name:match("%[(.*)%]")
        if inner then for k, v in inner:gmatch("([^=,]+)=([^,]+)") do props[k] = v end end
        local d = WG.blockDefaults and WG.blockDefaults[base] or {}
        local function get(k) local v = props[k]; if v == nil then v = d[k] end return v end
        local steps = rot == "clockwise_90" and 1 or rot == "clockwise_180" and 2 or 3
        local out = {}
        for k, v in pairs(d) do out[k] = get(k) end
        for k, v in pairs(props) do out[k] = v end
        if get("facing") then out.facing = rotDir(get("facing"), rot) end
        if get("axis") and steps % 2 == 1 then
            local a = get("axis")
            out.axis = a == "x" and "z" or a == "z" and "x" or a
        end
        if get("rotation") and tonumber(get("rotation")) then out.rotation = tostring((tonumber(get("rotation")) + 4 * steps) % 16) end
        if get("north") ~= nil and get("east") ~= nil and get("south") ~= nil and get("west") ~= nil then
            for _, dd in ipairs({"north", "east", "south", "west"}) do out[rotDir(dd, rot)] = get(dd) end
        end
        if get("orientation") then
            local front, top = get("orientation"):match("^(%a+)_(%a+)$")
            if front then out.orientation = rotDir(front, rot) .. "_" .. rotDir(top, rot) end
        end
        if get("shape") and RAIL_CW[get("shape")] ~= nil then
            local s = get("shape")
            for _ = 1, steps do s = RAIL_CW[s] or s end
            out.shape = s
        end
        c = Blocks.id(F.canon(base, out))
        stateRotCache[key] = c
        return c
    end
    S.rotateState = rotateState

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- templates
    local templateCache = {}
    local function parseState(s)
        F = F or WG.Feature
        local base = s:match("^([^%[]+)") or s
        local props = {}
        local inner = s:match("%[(.*)%]")
        if inner then for k, v in inner:gmatch("([^=,]+)=([^,]+)") do props[k] = v end end
        return Blocks.id(F.canon(base, props))
    end
    function S.template(world, loc)
        local t = templateCache[loc]
        if t then return t end
        local raw = world.data.templates[loc]
        if not raw then return nil end
        t = {size = raw.size, palettes = {}, blocks = {}, jigsaws = {}, entities = raw.entities or {}}
        for i, p in ipairs(raw.palettes) do
            local ids = {}
            for j, s in ipairs(p) do ids[j - 1] = parseState(s) end
            t.palettes[i] = ids
        end
        local d = raw.d
        for i = 1, #d, 9 do
            t.blocks[#t.blocks + 1] = {tonumber(d:sub(i, i + 1), 16), tonumber(d:sub(i + 2, i + 3), 16), tonumber(d:sub(i + 4, i + 5), 16), tonumber(d:sub(i + 6, i + 8), 16)}
        end
        for _, b in ipairs(raw.be) do
            local info = b[5] or {}
            t.blocks[#t.blocks + 1] = {b[1], b[2], b[3], b[4], info}
            if info.jigsaw then
                local state = t.palettes[1][b[4]]
                local front = (WG.Feature.prop(state, "orientation") or "north_up"):match("^(%a+)_")
                local joint = info.joint or ((front == "up" or front == "down") and "rollable" or "aligned")
                t.jigsaws[#t.jigsaws + 1] = {x = b[1], y = b[2], z = b[3], state = state, name = full(info.name or "minecraft:empty"),
                    target = full(info.target or "minecraft:empty"), pool = full(info.pool or "minecraft:empty"), joint = joint,
                    final = info.final_state or "minecraft:air", pp = info.placement_priority or 0, sp = info.selection_priority or 0}
            end
        end
        templateCache[loc] = t
        return t
    end
    local function templateBox(t, x, y, z, rot)
        local sx, sy, sz = t.size[1] - 1, t.size[2] - 1, t.size[3] - 1
        local ax, ay, az = rotPos(0, 0, 0, rot)
        local bx, by, bz = rotPos(sx, sy, sz, rot)
        return {min(ax, bx) + x, min(ay, by) + y, min(az, bz) + z, max(ax, bx) + x, max(ay, by) + y, max(az, bz) + z}
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- pool elements
    local Element = {}
    local function elementKind(el) return strip(el.element_type) end
    function Element.box(world, el, x, y, z, rot)
        local k = elementKind(el)
        if k == "single_pool_element" or k == "legacy_single_pool_element" then
            return templateBox(S.template(world, el.location), x, y, z, rot)
        elseif k == "feature_pool_element" then
            return {x, y, z, x, y, z}
        elseif k == "list_pool_element" then
            local b
            for _, e in ipairs(el.elements) do
                if elementKind(e) ~= "empty_pool_element" then
                    local eb = Element.box(world, e, x, y, z, rot)
                    if not b then b = {eb[1], eb[2], eb[3], eb[4], eb[5], eb[6]}
                    else
                        b[1], b[2], b[3] = min(b[1], eb[1]), min(b[2], eb[2]), min(b[3], eb[3])
                        b[4], b[5], b[6] = max(b[4], eb[4]), max(b[5], eb[5]), max(b[6], eb[6])
                    end
                end
            end
            return b
        end
        return {x, y, z, x, y, z}
    end
    -- getShuffledJigsawBlocks: template jigsaws rotated, shuffled, stable-sorted by selection priority.
    function Element.jigsaws(world, el, x, y, z, rot, r)
        local k = elementKind(el)
        if k == "single_pool_element" or k == "legacy_single_pool_element" then
            local t = S.template(world, el.location)
            local list = {}
            for i, j in ipairs(t.jigsaws) do
                local rx, ry, rz = rotPos(j.x, j.y, j.z, rot)
                list[i] = {x = rx + x, y = ry + y, z = rz + z, state = rotateState(j.state, rot), name = j.name, target = j.target, pool = j.pool,
                    joint = j.joint, pp = j.pp, sp = j.sp}
            end
            S.site = "SinglePoolElement.getShuffledJigsawBlocks"
            WG.Feature.shuffle(list, r)
            local idx = {}
            for i, j in ipairs(list) do idx[j] = i end
            table.sort(list, function(a, b) if a.sp ~= b.sp then return a.sp > b.sp end return idx[a] < idx[b] end)
            return list
        elseif k == "feature_pool_element" then
            return {{x = x, y = y, z = z, state = Blocks.id(WG.Feature.canon("jigsaw", {orientation = "down_south"})), name = nil,
                target = "minecraft:empty", pool = "minecraft:empty", joint = "rollable", pp = 0, sp = 0}}
        elseif k == "list_pool_element" then
            return Element.jigsaws(world, el.elements[1], x, y, z, rot, r)
        end
        return {}
    end
    local function frontOf(j) return (WG.Feature.prop(j.state, "orientation") or "north_up"):match("^(%a+)_") end
    local function topOf(j) return (WG.Feature.prop(j.state, "orientation") or "north_up"):match("_(%a+)$") end
    local function canAttach(a, b)
        return frontOf(a) == DIR_OPP[frontOf(b)] and (a.joint == "rollable" or topOf(a) == topOf(b)) and (b.name == nil or a.target == b.name)
    end
    local STEP_Y = {up = 1, down = -1}
    local DV = {north = {0, 0, -1}, south = {0, 0, 1}, east = {1, 0, 0}, west = {-1, 0, 0}, up = {0, 1, 0}, down = {0, -1, 0}}

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- pools
    local function poolTemplates(world, name)
        local p = world.data.templatePools[name]
        if not p then return nil end
        if not p._expanded then
            local list = {}
            for _, e in ipairs(p.elements) do
                for _ = 1, e.weight or 1 do list[#list + 1] = e.element end
            end
            p._expanded = list
        end
        return p._expanded, p
    end
    local function shuffledCopy(list, r)
        local c = {}
        for i, v in ipairs(list) do c[i] = v end
        return WG.Feature.shuffle(c, r)
    end
    local function poolMaxSize(world, name)
        local list, p = poolTemplates(world, name)
        if not list then return 0 end
        if p._maxSize then return p._maxSize end
        local m = 0
        for _, el in ipairs(list) do
            if elementKind(el) ~= "empty_pool_element" then
                local b = Element.box(world, el, 0, 0, 0, "none")
                if b then m = max(m, b[5] - b[2] + 1) end
            end
        end
        p._maxSize = m
        return m
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- jigsaw placement
    local function boxInside(b, x, y, z) return x >= b[1] and x <= b[4] and y >= b[2] and y <= b[5] and z >= b[3] and z <= b[6] end
    local function boxesOverlap(a, b) return a[1] <= b[4] and a[4] >= b[1] and a[2] <= b[5] and a[5] >= b[2] and a[3] <= b[6] and a[6] >= b[3] end
    -- Free space: an outer AABB (doubles, exclusive max) minus placed integer boxes.
    local function freeFits(free, b)
        local o = free.outer
        if b[1] + 0.25 < o[1] or b[2] + 0.25 < o[2] or b[3] + 0.25 < o[3] then return false end
        if b[4] + 0.75 > o[4] or b[5] + 0.75 > o[5] or b[6] + 0.75 > o[6] then return false end
        for _, r in ipairs(free.removed) do if boxesOverlap(b, r) then return false end end
        return true
    end
    local function newPiece(el, x, y, z, ground, rot, box)
        return {element = el, x = x, y = y, z = z, ground = ground, rotation = rot, box = box, junctions = {}}
    end
    local function projection(el) return strip(el.projection or "rigid") end
    local function groundDelta(el) return 1 end
    -- JigsawStructure.findGenerationPoint + JigsawPlacement.addPieces.
    function S.jigsaw(world, st, cx, cz, r)
        local height = WG.Providers.height(st.start_height or {absolute = 0}, r)
        local px, py, pz = cx * 16, height, cz * 16
        S.site = "Rotation.getRandom"
        local rot = ROTATIONS[r:nextInt(4) + 1]
        local list = poolTemplates(world, st.start_pool)
        if not list or #list == 0 then return nil end
        S.site = "StructureTemplatePool.getRandomTemplate"
        local el = list[r:nextInt(#list) + 1]
        if elementKind(el) == "empty_pool_element" then return nil end
        local ax, ay, az = px, py, pz
