            if self.stopped then return end
            local cx, cz = pcx + o[1], pcz + o[2]
            local key = ckey(cx, cz)
            if self.status[key] ~= "meshed" then self:meshChunk(cx, cz) end
        end
    end
    function Session:updateCollision(px, py, pz)
        local pcx, pcz, psy = floor(px / 16), floor(pz / 16), floor((py - WG.MIN_Y) / 16)
        local wanted = {}
        local function want(cx, cz, sy)
            if sy >= 0 and sy < WG.HEIGHT / 16 and self:chunk(cx, cz) then wanted[ckey(cx, cz) * 32 + sy] = {cx, sy, cz} end
        end
        for dx = -2, 2 do for dz = -2, 2 do for dy = -2, 2 do want(pcx + dx, pcz + dz, psy + dy) end end end
        -- Mobs in the generated world stand on collision too.
        if self.spawned then
            for m in pairs(self.spawned) do
                if m.position then
                    local mx, my, mz = self:toBlock(m.position)
                    local mcx, mcz, msy = floor(mx / 16), floor(mz / 16), floor((my - WG.MIN_Y) / 16)
                    for dx = -1, 1 do for dz = -1, 1 do for dy = -1, 0 do want(mcx + dx, mcz + dz, msy + dy) end end end
                end
            end
        end
        -- Outline boxes (plants, torches...) only in the sections around the player.
        local near = {}
        for dx = -1, 1 do for dz = -1, 1 do for dy = -1, 1 do near[ckey(pcx + dx, pcz + dz) * 32 + psy + dy] = true end end end
        self.collisionNear = self.collisionNear or {}
        for key, at in pairs(wanted) do
            local isNear = near[key] == true
            if not self.collision[key] or self.collisionNear[key] ~= isNear then self:buildCollision(at[1], at[2], at[3], isNear); WG.tick() end
        end
        for key, parts in pairs(self.collision) do
            if not wanted[key] then for _, p in ipairs(parts) do p:Destroy() end; self.collision[key] = nil; self.collisionNear[key] = nil end
        end
    end
    function Session:unloadFar(px, pz)
        local pcx, pcz = floor(px / 16), floor(pz / 16)
        for key, m in pairs(self.meshes) do
            local cz = key % 4194304 - 2097152
            local cx = floor(key / 4194304) - 2097152
            if max(abs(cx - pcx), abs(cz - pcz)) > self.radius + 2 then
                for _, parts in pairs(m) do for _, p in pairs(parts) do p:Destroy() end end
                self.meshes[key] = nil
                self.status[key] = self.chunks[key] and "generated" or nil
            end
        end
        for key in pairs(self.chunks) do
            local cz = key % 4194304 - 2097152
            local cx = floor(key / 4194304) - 2097152
            if max(abs(cx - pcx), abs(cz - pcz)) > self.radius + 6 then
                -- Its decorated neighbours wrote into it: those writes are replayed when it comes back.
                if self.chunks[key].decorated or self.chunks[key].full then self.dropped[key] = true end
                self.chunks[key] = nil; self.status[key] = nil
            end
        end
        self.colorCount = (self.colorCount or 0) + 1
        if self.colorCount > 50 then self.colorCount = 0; self.colorCache = {} end
    end
    -- World spawn, as MinecraftServer.setInitialSpawn: NoiseSpawnFinder (climate only, the settings'
    -- spawn_target) picks the chunk, then the 11x11 chunk spiral takes the first column with a
    -- respawn position (PlayerSpawnFinder.getLevelRespawnPos).
    local function quantize(v) local q = WG.f32(WG.f32(v) * 10000); return q >= 0 and floor(q) or -floor(-q) end
    function Session:spawnChunk()
        local gen = self.gen
        local targets, cache = {}, {}
        for i, point in ipairs(gen.data.settings.spawn_target or {}) do
            local list = {}
            for name, range in pairs(point) do
                if not cache[name] then cache[name] = WG.Density.compile(gen.state, name) end
                list[#list + 1] = {name = name, min = quantize(range[1]), max = quantize(range[2])}
            end
            targets[i] = list
        end
        if #targets == 0 then return 0, 0 end
        local function fitnessAt(x, z)
            -- Quart-aligned sample at y 0; each density function sampled once per point.
            local qx, qz = floor(x / 4) * 4, floor(z / 4) * 4
            local values = {}
            for name, fn in pairs(cache) do values[name] = quantize(fn(qx, 0, qz)) end
            local best = math.huge
            for _, list in ipairs(targets) do
                local f = 0
                for _, p in ipairs(list) do
                    local v = values[p.name]
                    local d = v > p.max and v - p.max or (v < p.min and p.min - v or 0)
                    f = f + d * d
                end
                if f < best then best = f end
            end
            WG.tick()
            return best
        end
        -- fitness * 2048^2 + x^2 + z^2 compared exactly (it can pass 2^53 as one double).
        local K = 2048 * 2048
        local function better(f1, d1, f2, d2)
            local df = f1 - f2
            if df >= 2147483648 then return false elseif df <= -2147483648 then return true end
            return df * K < d2 - d1
        end
        local bx, bz, bf, bd = 0, 0, fitnessAt(0, 0), 0
        local f32 = WG.f32
        local function radial(maxRadius, step)
            local angle, radius = 0, step
            local ox, oz = bx, bz
            while radius <= maxRadius do
                local sx, sz = math.sin(angle) * radius, math.cos(angle) * radius
                local x = ox + (sx >= 0 and floor(sx) or -floor(-sx))
                local z = oz + (sz >= 0 and floor(sz) or -floor(-sz))
                local f, d = fitnessAt(x, z), x * x + z * z
                if better(f, d, bf, bd) then bx, bz, bf, bd = x, z, f, d end
                angle = f32(angle + f32(step / radius))
                if angle > math.pi * 2 then angle = 0; radius = f32(radius + step) end
            end
        end
        radial(2048, 512)
        radial(512, 32)
        self.spawnBlock = {bx, bz}
        return floor(bx / 16), floor(bz / 16)
    end
    -- Blocks whose collision is a full cube top (all terrain blocks; features add the rest).
    local PARTIAL = {"_slab", "_stairs", "snow[", "_carpet", "_pressure_plate", "_button", "_sapling", "_flower", "flower", "short_grass", "tall_grass", "fern", "bush", "dead_bush", "vine", "_torch", "torch", "rail", "lily_pad", "sugar_cane", "_mushroom", "seagrass", "kelp", "pointed_dripstone", "_wall", "_fence", "_pane", "bamboo", "cactus", "_head", "pumpkin_stem", "melon_stem"}
    local fullTopCache = {}
    local function fullTop(id)
        local c = fullTopCache[id]
        if c == nil then
            local name = WG.Blocks.names[id] or ""
            c = id ~= AIR
            for _, pat in ipairs(PARTIAL) do if name:find(pat, 1, true) then c = false break end end
            if name:find("snow[", 1, true) and name:find("layers=8", 1, true) then c = true end
            fullTopCache[id] = c
        end
        return c
    end
    local function isFluid(id)
        local info = Render.stateInfo(id)
        return info.liquid ~= nil or info.waterlogged == true
    end
    function Session:respawnPos(x, z)
        local chunk = self:generate(floor(x / 16), floor(z / 16))
        local lx, lz = x % 16, z % 16
        local i = lx + lz * 16
        local topY = chunk.hm.MOTION_BLOCKING[i] - 1
        if topY < WG.MIN_Y then return nil end
        local surface = chunk.hm.WORLD_SURFACE[i] - 1
        if surface <= topY and surface > chunk.hm.OCEAN_FLOOR[i] - 1 then return nil end
        for y = topY + 1, WG.MIN_Y, -1 do
            local id = chunk:get(lx, y, lz) or AIR
            if WG.Feature.info(id).fluid then break end
            if WG.Feature.info(id).up then return y + 1 end
        end
        return nil
    end
    function Session:findSpawn()
        local scx, scz = self:spawnChunk()
        self.loadingCentre = {scx, scz}
        local chunk = self:generate(scx, scz)
        local wx, wy, wz = scx * 16 + 8, chunk:height("surfaceWG", 8, 8) + 1, scz * 16 + 8
        local xo, zo, dx, dz = 0, 0, 0, -1
        for _ = 1, 121 do
            if xo >= -5 and xo <= 5 and zo >= -5 and zo <= 5 then
                local found
                for x = (scx + xo) * 16, (scx + xo) * 16 + 15 do
                    for z = (scz + zo) * 16, (scz + zo) * 16 + 15 do
                        local y = self:respawnPos(x, z)
                        if y then found = {x, y, z} break end
                    end
                    if found then break end
                end
                if found then wx, wy, wz = found[1], found[2], found[3] break end
            end
            if xo == zo or (xo < 0 and xo == -zo) or (xo > 0 and xo == 1 - zo) then dx, dz = -dz, dx end
            xo, zo = xo + dx, zo + dz
        end
        self.worldSpawn = {wx, wy, wz}
        return wx, wy, wz
    end
    -- Where a joining player lands: PlayerSpawnFinder over the spawnRadius (10) square, candidates
    -- in a random coprime order; the first open respawn position wins.
    function Session:playerSpawn()
        local sx, sy, sz = table.unpack(self.worldSpawn)
        local radius = 10
        local side = radius * 2 + 1
        local count = math.min(1024, side * side)
        local coprime = count <= 16 and count - 1 or 17
        local offset = Random.new():NextInteger(0, count - 1)
        for i = 0, count - 1 do
            local value = (offset + coprime * i) % count
            local x, z = sx + value % side - radius, sz + floor(value / side) - radius
            local y = self:respawnPos(x, z)
            if y then
                local chunk = self:generate(floor(x / 16), floor(z / 16))
                local a, b = chunk:get(x % 16, y, z % 16), chunk:get(x % 16, y + 1, z % 16)
                if (a == AIR or a == nil) and (b == AIR or b == nil) then return x, y, z end
            end
        end
        return sx, sy, sz
    end
    function Session:destroy()
        self.stopped = true
        if self.folder then self.folder:Destroy() end
        if self.loading then self.loading:Destroy() end
    end

    -- LevelLoadingScreen: "Loading terrain..." over the menu background, the 200x2 progress bar
    -- and the 2-pixel chunk status map.
    local COLORS = {empty = 0x545454, terrain = 0x303572, generated = 0x21C600, meshed = 0xFFFFFF}
    function Session:showLoading(gui, radius)
        local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        screen.Name, screen.IgnoreGuiInset, screen.DisplayOrder, screen.ResetOnSpawn = "SteveLoadingTerrain", true, 100, false
        local back = Instance.new("Frame")
        back.Size, back.BackgroundColor3, back.BorderSizePixel = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Color3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05), 0
        back.Parent = screen
        local canvas = Instance.new("Frame")
        canvas.BackgroundTransparency, canvas.Size = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        canvas.Parent = back
        local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
        scale.Parent = canvas
        local menu = JavaContent.data.javaGui and JavaContent.data.javaGui.menu_background
        local tiles = {}
        local text, bar, fill
        local cells = {}
        local function layout()
            local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
            local s = JavaGui.scale(vp)
            scale.Scale = s
            local w, h = math.ceil(vp.X / s), math.ceil(vp.Y / s)
            canvas.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
            for _, t in ipairs(tiles) do t:Destroy() end
            tiles = {}
            if menu then
                for ty = 0, math.ceil(h / 32) do for tx = 0, math.ceil(w / 32) do
                    tiles[#tiles + 1] = JavaGui.image(canvas, menu, tx * 32, ty * 32, 32, 32, nil, 1)
                end end
            end
            local xc, yc = floor(w / 2), floor(h / 2)
            local diameter = radius * 2 + 1
            local total = diameter * 2
            local xs, ys = xc - floor(total / 2), yc - floor(total / 2)
            for _, c in pairs(cells) do c.frame:Destroy() end
            cells = {}
            for x = 0, diameter - 1 do for z = 0, diameter - 1 do
                local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                f.BorderSizePixel, f.Size, f.Position, f.ZIndex = 0, UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2), UDim2.fromOffset(xs + x * 2, ys + z * 2), 3
                f.Parent = canvas
                cells[#cells + 1] = {frame = f, dx = x - radius, dz = z - radius}
            end end
            local top = yc - radius * 2 - 9 * 3
            if text then text:Destroy() end
            local label = (JavaContent.data.lang or {})["multiplayer.downloadingTerrain"] or "Loading terrain..."
            text = JavaGui.text(canvas, label, xc - floor(JavaGui.width(label) / 2), top, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), true, 3)
            if bar then bar:Destroy() end
            bar = Instance.new("Frame")
            bar.BorderSizePixel, bar.BackgroundColor3, bar.Size, bar.Position, bar.ZIndex = 0, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), UDim2.fromOffset(200, 2), UDim2.fromOffset(xc - 100, top + 12), 3
            bar.Parent = canvas
            fill = Instance.new("Frame")
            fill.BorderSizePixel, fill.BackgroundColor3, fill.Size, fill.ZIndex = 0, Color3.new(0, 1, 0), UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2), 4
            fill.Parent = bar
        end
        layout()
        screen.Parent = gui
        self.loading = screen
        local smoothed = 0
        local function refresh()
            -- The map centres on the spawn chunk once it is known (PREPARE_GLOBAL_SPAWN shows it empty).
            local centre = self.loadingCentre
            local done, total = 0, 0
            for _, c in ipairs(cells) do
                local st = centre and self.status[ckey(centre[1] + c.dx, centre[2] + c.dz)] or "empty"
                c.frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHex(string.format("%06x", COLORS[st] or COLORS.empty))
                total = total + 1
                if st == "meshed" then done = done + 1 elseif st ~= "empty" then done = done + 0.5 end
            end
            smoothed = smoothed + (done / math.max(total, 1) - smoothed) * 0.2
            fill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(smoothed * 200 + 0.5), 2)
        end
        return refresh
    end
end

do
    -- Mob spawning in a generated world: NaturalSpawner.spawnMobsForChunkGeneration (creatures placed
    -- when a chunk is first finished, with the chunk's decoration-seeded legacy random) and natural
    -- spawning near the player each second (mob caps, light rules, despawning far away).
    local Session = WG.Session
    local floor, max, min, abs = math.floor, math.max, math.min, math.abs
    local F = WG.Feature
    local Spawn = {}
    WG.Spawn = Spawn
    local WATER_MOBS = {cod = true, salmon = true, squid = true, glow_squid = true, dolphin = true, tropical_fish = true, pufferfish = true, axolotl = true, nautilus = true}
    local CAPS = {monster = 70, creature = 10, ambient = 15, axolotls = 5, underground_water_creature = 5, water_creature = 5, water_ambient = 20}
    local function strip(n) return (n:gsub("^minecraft:", "")) end
    local function listFor(biome, category)
        local spawns = biome and biome.spawns
        return spawns and spawns[category] or {}
    end
    local function pick(r, list)
        local total = 0
        for _, e in ipairs(list) do total = total + (e.weight or 1) end
        if total <= 0 then return nil end
        local k = r:nextInt(total)
        for _, e in ipairs(list) do k = k - (e.weight or 1); if k < 0 then return e end end
    end
    -- A land spawn position: free feet and head, a solid top below.
    local function landOk(self, x, y, z)
        local Fi = F.info
        local below, feet, head = self:block(x, y - 1, z), self:block(x, y, z), self:block(x, y + 1, z)
        if not below or not feet or not head then return false end
        if not Fi(below).up then return false end
        if self:collides(feet) or self:collides(head) then return false end
        if Fi(feet).fluid or Fi(head).fluid then return false end
        return true
    end
    local function topNonColliding(self, x, z, water)
        local c = self:chunk(floor(x / 16), floor(z / 16))
        if not c or not c.hm then return nil end
        local i = (x % 16) + (z % 16) * 16
        local y = water and c.hm.WORLD_SURFACE[i] or c.hm.MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES[i]
        return y
    end
    function Session:spawnMob(id, x, y, z)
        local gameplay = self.opts.world and self.opts.world.gameplay
        if not gameplay or not gameplay.spawn then return nil end
        local feet = self.origin + Vector3.new(x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5) * self.size
        local m = gameplay.spawn(id, feet)
        if m then self.spawned = self.spawned or {}; self.spawned[m] = true end
        return m
    end
    -- Creatures at chunk generation.
    function Session:spawnOriginalMobs(cx, cz)
        local chunk = self:chunk(cx, cz)
        if not chunk or chunk.mobsSpawned then return end
        chunk.mobsSpawned = true
        local biomeName = self.gen:biome(cx * 16, WG.MIN_Y + WG.HEIGHT - 1, cz * 16)
        local biome = self.data.biome[biomeName]
        local list = listFor(biome, "creature")
        if #list == 0 then return end
        local prob = WG.f32(biome.creature_probability or 0.1)
        local r = WG.WorldgenRandom.new(WG.LegacyRandom.new(WG.I64.from(0)))
        r:setDecorationSeed(self.seed, cx * 16, cz * 16)
        local xo, zo = cx * 16, cz * 16
        local guard = 0
        while r:nextFloat() < prob and guard < 32 do
            guard = guard + 1
            local e = pick(r, list)
            if e then
                local id = strip(e.type)
                local count = WG.Providers.int(e.count or 1, r)
                local x, z = xo + r:nextInt(16), zo + r:nextInt(16)
                local sx, sz = x, z
                for _ = 1, count do
                    local ok = false
                    local attempts = 0
                    while not ok and attempts < 4 do
                        attempts = attempts + 1
                        local y = topNonColliding(self, x, z, WATER_MOBS[id])
                        if y and (WATER_MOBS[id] and F.info(self:block(x, y - 1, z) or WG.AIR).fluid or landOk(self, x, y, z)) then
                            local below = self:block(x, y - 1, z)
                            if WATER_MOBS[id] or F.isTag(below, "animals_spawnable_on") then
                                r:nextFloat() -- the spawned mob's yaw
                                if self:spawnMob(id, x, WATER_MOBS[id] and y - 1 or y, z) then ok = true end
                            end
                        end
                        x = x + r:nextInt(5) - r:nextInt(5)
                        z = z + r:nextInt(5) - r:nextInt(5)
                        while x < xo or x >= xo + 16 or z < zo or z >= zo + 16 do
                            x = sx + r:nextInt(5) - r:nextInt(5)
                            z = sz + r:nextInt(5) - r:nextInt(5)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Structure entities whose chunk is now shown.
    function Session:spawnPending()
        local list = self.pendingEntities
        if not list then return end
        local keep = {}
        for _, e in ipairs(list) do
            local key = (floor(e.x / 16) + 2097152) * 4194304 + (floor(e.z / 16) + 2097152)
            if self.meshes[key] then
                local id = e.id
                local gameplay = self.opts.world and self.opts.world.gameplay
                if gameplay and gameplay.spawn and id ~= "armor_stand" then
                    local feet = self.origin + Vector3.new(e.x, e.y, e.z) * self.size
                    local m = gameplay.spawn(id, feet)
                    if m then self.spawned = self.spawned or {}; self.spawned[m] = true; m.persistent = true; m.customName = m.customName or nil end
                end
            else
                keep[#keep + 1] = e
            end
        end
        self.pendingEntities = keep
    end
    -- Natural spawning around the player (one cycle per call).
    function Session:naturalSpawn(px, py, pz)
        self.spawned = self.spawned or {}
        local r = self.spawnRandom or Random.new()
        self.spawnRandom = r
        local gameplay = self.opts.world and self.opts.world.gameplay
        local blocks = self.opts.world and self.opts.world.blocks
        local darken = blocks and blocks.skyDarken and blocks.skyDarken() or 0
        -- Despawning (Mob.checkDespawn): instantly past 128 blocks, sometimes past 32.
        local counts = {}
        local alive = {}
        for _, m in ipairs(gameplay and gameplay.mobs or {}) do alive[m] = true end
        for m in pairs(self.spawned) do
            if m.dead or m.removed or not alive[m] then
                self.spawned[m] = nil
            else
                local bx, by, bz = self:toBlock(m.position)
                local d2 = (bx - px) ^ 2 + (by - py) ^ 2 + (bz - pz) ^ 2
                if (d2 > 128 * 128 or (d2 > 32 * 32 and r:NextInteger(0, 799) == 0)) and not m.persistent and not m.customName and not m.tamed and not m.leash then
                    local mobs = gameplay and gameplay.mobsModule
                    if mobs and mobs.remove then pcall(mobs.remove, m) end
                    self.spawned[m] = nil
                else
                    counts[m.category or "creature"] = (counts[m.category or "creature"] or 0) + 1
                end
            end
        end
        local pcx, pcz = floor(px / 16), floor(pz / 16)
        local chunks = {}
        for dx = -self.radius, self.radius do for dz = -self.radius, self.radius do
            local c = self:chunk(pcx + dx, pcz + dz)
            if c and c.full and c.sky then chunks[#chunks + 1] = {pcx + dx, pcz + dz, c} end
        end end
        if #chunks == 0 then return end
        local scale = #chunks / 289
        for category, cap in pairs(CAPS) do
            if (counts[category] or 0) < cap * scale and (category ~= "creature" or r:NextInteger(0, 19) == 0) then
                local ch = chunks[r:NextInteger(1, #chunks)]
                local x = ch[1] * 16 + r:NextInteger(0, 15)
                local z = ch[2] * 16 + r:NextInteger(0, 15)
                local top = ch[3].hm.WORLD_SURFACE[(x % 16) + (z % 16) * 16]
                local y = r:NextInteger(WG.MIN_Y, top)
                local biome = self.data.biome[self.gen:biome(x, y, z)]
                local list = listFor(biome, category)
                local e = #list > 0 and list[r:NextInteger(1, #list)]
                if e then
                    -- weighted pick
                    local total = 0
                    for _, q in ipairs(list) do total = total + (q.weight or 1) end
                    local k = r:NextInteger(0, max(total - 1, 0))
                    for _, q in ipairs(list) do k = k - (q.weight or 1); if k < 0 then e = q; break end end
                    local id = strip(e.type)
                    local packs = WG.Providers.int(e.count or 1, WG.WorldgenRandom.new(WG.LegacyRandom.new(WG.I64.from(r:NextInteger(0, 2147483647)))))
                    for _ = 1, max(1, packs) do
                        local sx = x + r:NextInteger(0, 5) - r:NextInteger(0, 5)
                        local sz = z + r:NextInteger(0, 5) - r:NextInteger(0, 5)
                        local d2 = (sx - px) ^ 2 + (y - py) ^ 2 + (sz - pz) ^ 2
                        if d2 >= 24 * 24 and d2 <= 128 * 128 then
                            local ok = false
                            local sky = self:lightAt(sx, y, sz)
                            if WATER_MOBS[id] then
                                ok = F.info(self:block(sx, y, sz) or WG.AIR).fluid == "water" and F.info(self:block(sx, y + 1, sz) or WG.AIR).fluid == "water"
                                if id == "axolotl" or id == "glow_squid" then ok = ok and y < self.gen.seaLevel - 13 end
                            elseif landOk(self, sx, y, sz) then
                                if category == "monster" then
                                    -- Monster.isDarkEnoughToSpawn (block light is folded into the level).
                                    local c = self:chunk(floor(sx / 16), floor(sz / 16))
                                    local raw = c and WG.Light.at(c, sx % 16, y, sz % 16) or 15
                                    local skyOnly = y >= (c and c.hm.WORLD_SURFACE[(sx % 16) + (sz % 16) * 16] or 0) and 15 or raw
                                    ok = skyOnly <= r:NextInteger(0, 31) and max(0, raw - darken) <= r:NextInteger(0, 7)
                                elseif category == "ambient" then
                                    ok = y < self.gen.seaLevel and sky <= r:NextInteger(0, 3)
                                else
                                    ok = F.isTag(self:block(sx, y - 1, sz), "animals_spawnable_on") and sky > 8
                                end
                            end
                            if ok then
                                local m = self:spawnMob(id, sx, y, sz)
                                if m then m.category = category end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

do
    -- /generate_world: a new world for a seed, the loading screen while the spawn area builds,
    -- then streaming around the player; the map-mining hooks so generated blocks are mined,
    -- sampled (explosions, fire) and occupied like any other block.
    local floor = math.floor
    local Session = WG.Session
    local Render = WG.Render
    local current
    WG.LOAD_RADIUS = 3
    -- Binds the generated world into WORLD MINING (one binding, routed to the current session).
    local marker = Instance.new("Part")
    marker.Name = "SteveGenTerrainMarker"
    marker:SetAttribute("SteveGenTerrain", true)
    local function isGen(inst) return inst ~= nil and typeof(inst) == "Instance" and inst:GetAttribute("SteveGenTerrain") == true end
    function WG.bindMining(system)
        if system.genBound then return end
        system.genBound = true
        function system.genKind(hit, center)
            if not current or not isGen(hit.Instance) then return nil end
            local info = current:sampleCell(center)
            return info and info.entry and info.entry.name or nil
        end
        function system.genSample(center)
            if not current then return nil end
            local info = current:sampleCell(center)
            if not info or info.air then return nil end
            local e = info.entry
            if info.liquid then return {id = info.id, index = e and e.index, center = center, liquid = true} end
            return {id = info.id, index = e and e.index, center = center, gen = true,
                hit = {Instance = marker, Material = Enum.Material.Slate, Position = center, Normal = Vector3.yAxis},
                resistance = e and e.resistance or 6, unbreakable = e and e.hardness and e.hardness < 0}
        end
        function system.genOccupied(center)
            if not current then return false end
            local info = current:sampleCell(center)
            return info ~= nil and not info.air and not info.liquid
        end
        function system.genCut(hit, center, canHarvest, complete, lootTool)
            if not current or not isGen(hit.Instance) then return false end
            local info, x, y, z = current:sampleCell(center)
            if not info or info.air or info.liquid then if complete then complete(false) end return true end
            local kind = info.entry and info.entry.name or "Stone"
            -- A waterlogged block leaves its water behind.
            current:setBlock(x, y, z, info.waterlogged and WG.WATER or WG.AIR)
            if canHarvest ~= false then
                if system.onCollect then pcall(system.onCollect, kind, center, lootTool) end
                system.message = "+1 " .. kind
            else
                system.message = "Broken (requires a better pickaxe for drops)"
            end
            if complete then complete(true) end
            return true
        end
    end
    function WG.current() return current end
    -- opts: {world = creative world, gui = PlayerGui, seedText = string?, chat = chat module?}
    function WG.startWorld(opts)
        if current then current:destroy(); current = nil end
        local seed
        if opts.seedText and opts.seedText ~= "" then seed = WG.parseSeed(opts.seedText) end
        if not seed then
            local r = Random.new()
            seed = WG.I64.new(r:NextInteger(0, 4294967295), r:NextInteger(0, 4294967295))
        end
        local size = CONFIG.Block
        local grid = workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin")
        if typeof(grid) ~= "Vector3" then grid = Vector3.new(0, size / 2, 0) end
        -- Block (0, y, 0) centres sit on the existing cell grid, 4000 blocks above it.
        local origin = grid + Vector3.new(0, 4000 * size, 0) - Vector3.new(size, size, size) / 2
        local session = Session.new({seed = seed, seedText = WG.I64.tostring(seed), size = size, origin = origin, radius = opts.radius or 6})
        current = session
        session.opts.world = opts.world
        WG.bindMining(opts.world.mining)
        if opts.chat then opts.chat.seed = session.seedText end
        -- The loading screen is up at once; the player is held still until the spawn area is built.
        local refresh = session:showLoading(opts.gui, WG.LOAD_RADIUS)
        local refreshing = true
        task.spawn(function() while refreshing and not session.stopped do refresh(); task.wait(0.05) end end)
        local root = opts.root
        opts.world.genHold = true
        local function release()
            refreshing = false
            opts.world.genHold = false
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, err = pcall(function()
                WG.budget = 0.03
                -- The generator (noises, density router, climate tree) builds on this thread.
                session.gen = WG.World.new(session.data, session.seed, session.data.climate, session.data.biome)
                local wx, wy, wz = session:findSpawn()
                local scx, scz = floor(wx / 16), floor(wz / 16)
                -- Spawn area: generate, then mesh (Java's spawn chunks).
                for r = 0, WG.LOAD_RADIUS + 1 do
                    for dx = -r, r do for dz = -r, r do
                        if math.max(math.abs(dx), math.abs(dz)) == r then session:generate(scx + dx, scz + dz); WG.tick() end
                    end end
                end
                for r = 0, WG.LOAD_RADIUS do
                    for dx = -r, r do for dz = -r, r do
                        if math.max(math.abs(dx), math.abs(dz)) == r then session:meshChunk(scx + dx, scz + dz) end
                    end end
                end
                local sx, sy, sz = session:playerSpawn()
                session:updateCollision(sx, sy, sz)
                refresh()
                if session.stopped then release() return end
                opts.world.teleport(session:toStuds(sx, sy, sz) - Vector3.new(0, size / 2, 0))
                task.wait(0.1)
                release()
                if session.loading then session.loading:Destroy(); session.loading = nil end
                -- Streaming around the player.
                WG.budget = 0.006
                local lastSpawn = 0
                while not session.stopped do
                    local bx, by, bz = session:toBlock(root.Position)
                    session:updateCollision(bx, by, bz)
                    session:update(bx, bz, by)
                    session:unloadFar(bx, bz)
                    -- Creatures of newly finished chunks, then natural spawning once a second.
                    for key, m in pairs(session.meshes) do
                        local c = session.chunks[key]
                        if c and not c.mobsSpawned then
                            local cz = key % 4194304 - 2097152
                            local cx = floor(key / 4194304) - 2097152
                            pcall(session.spawnOriginalMobs, session, cx, cz)
                        end
                    end
                    pcall(session.spawnPending, session)
                    if os.clock() - lastSpawn > 1 then
                        lastSpawn = os.clock()
                        local ok, e = pcall(session.naturalSpawn, session, bx, by, bz)
                        if not ok then warn("Steve world spawning: " .. tostring(e)) end
                    end
                    session.atlas:animate(math.floor(os.clock() * 20))
                    task.wait(0.1)
                end
            end)
            if not ok then
                release()
                warn("Steve world generation: " .. tostring(err))
                if session.loading then session.loading:Destroy(); session.loading = nil end
            end
        end)
        return session
    end
end
-- END WORLD GENERATION

-- BEGIN CREATIVE WORLD
-- BEGIN BLOCK MACHINES
-- Java block entities ticked every game tick: hoppers (HopperBlockEntity), droppers and
-- dispensers (DispenserBlock + dispense behaviors), sculk sensors and calibrated sensors
-- (VibrationSystem), sculk shriekers (SculkShriekerBlockEntity + WardenSpawnTracker).
local function createBlockMachines(world,h)
    local size,nodeAt,neighbor,register=CONFIG.Block,h.nodeAt,h.neighbor,h.register
    local directions,opposite=CreativeRules.directions,CreativeRules.opposite
    local machines={events={},current={},delayed={},warningLevel=0,warningCooldown=0,lastWarning=0,darknessStart=-1,darknessUntil=-1}
    local function dirVector(dir) return Vector3.new(table.unpack(directions[dir])) end
    local function maxStack(id) return itemStackLimits[id] or (toolStats[id] and 1 or 64) end
    local function later(ticks,fn) machines.delayed[#machines.delayed+1]={at=world.tickCount+ticks,fn=fn} end
    local function changed(n) if n.containerOpen or world.currentContainer==n then h.ui.refresh() end end

    -- Containers ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local containerSizes={chest=27,trapped_chest=27,barrel=27,hopper=5,dispenser=9,dropper=9,furnace=3,smoker=3,blast_furnace=3,brewing_stand=5,crafter=9}
    local furnaces={furnace=true,smoker=true,blast_furnace=true}
    local function containerSize(n)
        if not n or n.id=='ender_chest' then return nil end
        if n.id:match('shulker_box$') or n.id:match('copper_chest$') then return 27 end
        return containerSizes[n.id]
    end
    -- Java creates the block entity on placement; here storage appears on first use.
    local function storageOf(n)
        local slots=containerSize(n);if not slots then return nil end
        n.storage=n.storage or CreativeRules.inventory();n.storageSize=n.storageSize or slots
        return n.storage,slots
    end
    local function entryOf(stack) return stack and JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id] end
    local fuelTicks={coal=1600,charcoal=1600,coal_block=16000,blaze_rod=2400,lava_bucket=20000,stick=100,dried_kelp_block=4000}
    local function isFuel(id) return fuelTicks[id]~=nil or id:find('_planks',1,true)~=nil or id:find('_log',1,true)~=nil or id:find('_wood',1,true)~=nil end
    -- WorldlyContainer faces: furnace top = input, sides = fuel, bottom = output then fuel.
    local function slotsForFace(n,face,slots)
        if furnaces[n.id] then
            if face=='up' then return {1} elseif face=='down' then return {3,2} else return {2} end
        end
        -- BrewingStandBlockEntity: up = ingredient, down = bottles + ingredient, sides = bottles + fuel.
        if n.id=='brewing_stand' then
            if face=='up' then return {4} elseif face=='down' then return {1,2,3,4} else return {1,2,3,5} end
        end
        local list={};for i=1,slots do list[i]=i end
        -- Crafter: hoppers fill the least-filled enabled slot first, so recipes stay balanced.
        if n.id=='crafter' then
            local s=n.storage.slots
            table.sort(list,function(a,b) local ca,cb=s[a] and s[a].count or 0,s[b] and s[b].count or 0;if ca~=cb then return ca<cb end;return a<b end)
        end
        return list
    end
    local function canInsert(n,slot,stack)
        local e=entryOf(stack);if not e then return false end
        if furnaces[n.id] then
            if slot==3 then return false end
            if slot==2 then return isFuel(e.id) or (e.id=='bucket' and not n.storage.slots[2]) end
        end
        if n.id=='brewing_stand' then
            if slot==4 then return Recipes.isReagent(stack) elseif slot==5 then return e.id=='blaze_powder' end
            return Recipes.isBottle(stack) and not n.storage.slots[slot]
        end
        if n.id=='crafter' then return not (n.disabledSlots and n.disabledSlots[slot]) end
        return not (n.id:match('shulker_box$') and e.id:match('shulker_box$'))
    end
    local function canExtract(n,slot,stack,face)
        if furnaces[n.id] and face=='down' then local e=entryOf(stack);return slot==3 or (slot==2 and e~=nil and e.id=='bucket') end
        if n.id=='brewing_stand' and slot==4 then local e=entryOf(stack);return e~=nil and e.id=='glass_bottle' end
        return true
    end
    -- HopperBlockEntity.addItem(): one item into the first slot, in order, that is empty or can merge.
    local function insertOne(target,face,stack)
        local storage,slots=storageOf(target);if not storage then return false end
        for _,slot in ipairs(slotsForFace(target,face,slots)) do
            local s=storage.slots[slot]
            if canInsert(target,slot,stack) then
                if not s then storage.slots[slot]=CreativeRules.withCount(stack,1);return true end
                if CreativeRules.sameItem(s,stack) and s.count<maxStack(s.id) then s.count=s.count+1;return true end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    -- A whole stack into a container (crafter output, droppers): true when all of it fitted.
    function machines.insert(target,stack,face)
        while stack.count>0 and insertOne(target,face,stack) do stack.count=stack.count-1 end
        changed(target)
        return stack.count<=0
    end
    local function takeOne(storage,slot)
        local s=storage.slots[slot];s.count=s.count-1;if s.count<=0 then storage.slots[slot]=nil end
    end

    -- Hopper: 8-tick transfer cooldown, push then pull, locked while powered ------------
    local function hopperTick(n)
        n.cooldown=(n.cooldown or 0)-1
        if n.cooldown>0 or (n.input or 0)>0 then return end
        n.cooldown=0
        local storage=storageOf(n);local moved=false
        local facing=n.state.facing or 'down'
        local target=neighbor(n,facing)
        local modInv=(not containerSize(target)) and target and JavaContent.mods.inventory and JavaContent.mods.inventory(target)
        if modInv then
            for i=1,5 do
                local s=storage.slots[i]
                if s and modInv.insert(CreativeRules.withCount(s,1),opposite[facing]) then takeOne(storage,i);moved=true;break end
            end
        end
        if containerSize(target) then
            for i=1,5 do
                local s=storage.slots[i]
                if s and insertOne(target,opposite[facing],s) then
                    takeOne(storage,i);moved=true;changed(target)
                    if target.id=='hopper' then target.cooldown=math.max(target.cooldown or 0,8) end
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        local full=true
        for i=1,5 do local s=storage.slots[i];if not s or s.count<maxStack(s.id) then full=false;break end end
        if not full then
            local above=neighbor(n,'up');local aboveSlots=containerSize(above)
            local aboveInv=(not aboveSlots) and above and JavaContent.mods.inventory and JavaContent.mods.inventory(above)
            if aboveInv then
                local s=aboveInv.peek('down')
                if s and insertOne(n,'up',CreativeRules.withCount(s,1)) then aboveInv.take('down');moved=true end
            elseif aboveSlots then
                local source=storageOf(above)
                for _,slot in ipairs(slotsForFace(above,'down',aboveSlots)) do
                    local s=source.slots[slot]
                    if s and canExtract(above,slot,s,'down') and insertOne(n,'up',s) then takeOne(source,slot);moved=true;changed(above);break end
                end
            elseif not (above and above.solid) then
                -- Item entities inside the hopper's top area (y 11/16 to 2 blocks).
                for _,d in ipairs(world.drops) do
                    local delta=d.position-n.center
                    if d.count>0 and math.abs(delta.X)<=size*.5 and math.abs(delta.Z)<=size*.5 and delta.Y>=size*.1875 and delta.Y<=size*1.5 then
                        local one=CreativeRules.withCount(d.template or d,1)
                        while d.count>0 and insertOne(n,'up',one) do d.count=d.count-1;moved=true end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if moved then n.cooldown=8;changed(n) end
    end

    -- Dropper / dispenser ---------------------------------------------------------------
    local function triangle(mean,spread) return mean+spread*(math.random()-math.random()) end
    -- DispenserBlock.getDispensePosition(): 0.7 blocks out, lowered for the item's centre.
    local function dispensePosition(n)
        local facing=n.state.facing or 'north';local d=dirVector(facing)
        return n.center+d*size*.7-Vector3.new(0,(facing=='up' or facing=='down') and size*.125 or size*.15625,0),d
    end
    -- DefaultDispenseItemBehavior.spawnItem(..., speed 6), velocity converted to studs/second.
    local function spawnItem(n,stack)
        local position,d=dispensePosition(n)
        local speed=math.random()*.1+.2
        local v=Vector3.new(triangle(d.X*speed,.0172275*6),triangle(.2,.0172275*6),triangle(d.Z*speed,.0172275*6))
        world.drop(CreativeRules.withCount(stack,1),position,v*size*20,true)
    end
    local function dispenseSmoke(n)
        local position,d=dispensePosition(n)
        for _=1,4 do h.effects.emit('smoke',position+Vector3.new(math.random()-.5,math.random()-.5,math.random()-.5)*size*.2,d*size*.02,{life=12,size=.15,tint={.5,.5,.5}}) end
    end
    local function dispense(n)
        local storage=storageOf(n);local choices={}
        for i=1,9 do if storage.slots[i] then choices[#choices+1]=i end end
        if #choices==0 then return end -- Java only plays the fail click here
        local slot=choices[math.random(#choices)];local stack=storage.slots[slot];local e=entryOf(stack)
        local facing=n.state.facing or 'north';local front=n.center+dirVector(facing)*size;local frontNode=nodeAt(front)
        local function consume() takeOne(storage,slot) end
        -- Bucket-style behaviors hand back a container item in the same slot when possible.
        local function replace(id)
            local r=JavaContent.itemById[id];if not r then consume();return end
            if stack.count==1 then storage.slots[slot]={id=r.index,count=1}
            else consume();if not insertOne(n,'up',{id=r.index,count=1}) then spawnItem(n,{id=r.index}) end end
        end
        if n.id=='dropper' or not e then
            if n.id=='dropper' and containerSize(frontNode) then
                if insertOne(frontNode,opposite[facing],stack) then consume();changed(frontNode) end
            else spawnItem(n,stack);consume();dispenseSmoke(n) end
        elseif e.id=='arrow' or e.id=='spectral_arrow' or e.id=='tipped_arrow' then
            -- AbstractProjectileDispenseBehavior: aim (dx, dy+0.1, dz), speed 1.1, inaccuracy 6.
            local position,d=dispensePosition(n)
            local aim=Vector3.new(d.X,d.Y+.1,d.Z).Unit+Vector3.new(triangle(0,.0172275*6),triangle(0,.0172275*6),triangle(0,.0172275*6))
            if world.gameplay.shoot(position,aim,1.1/3,{dispenser=true,visual=n.visual},e.id) then consume() end
        elseif e.id=='water_bucket' or e.id=='lava_bucket' or e.id=='powder_snow_bucket' then
            local block=JavaContent.byId[(e.id:gsub('_bucket$',''))]
            if block and not world.sample(front) then
                register(block.index,front,CreativeRules.copy(block.state));world.updateNeighbors();replace('bucket');machines.vibrate(front,13)
                if world.fluids then world.fluids.changed(front) end
            else spawnItem(n,stack);consume();dispenseSmoke(n) end
        elseif e.id=='bucket' then
            if frontNode and (frontNode.id=='water' or frontNode.id=='lava') and (tonumber(frontNode.state.level) or 0)==0 then
                world.nodes[h.key(front)]=nil;frontNode.visual.model:Destroy();world.updateNeighbors()
                if world.fluids then world.fluids.changed(front) end
                replace(frontNode.id..'_bucket');machines.vibrate(front,12)
            else spawnItem(n,stack);consume();dispenseSmoke(n) end
        elseif e.id=='tnt' then
            world.spawnPrimed(e.index,front,80);consume();machines.vibrate(front,10)
        elseif e.id=='flint_and_steel' then
            if frontNode and frontNode.id=='tnt' then world.prime(frontNode)
            elseif not world.sample(front) and JavaContent.byId.fire then
                local fire=world.placement and world.placement.ignite(front)
                if not world.placement then fire=register(JavaContent.byId.fire.index,front,CreativeRules.copy(JavaContent.byId.fire.state)) end
                if fire then fire.solid=false;fire.fireAge=0;world.updateNeighbors() end
                machines.vibrate(front,13)
            end
            local stat=toolStats[stack.id];stack.damage=(stack.damage or 0)+1
            if stat and stat.durability and stack.damage>=stat.durability then storage.slots[slot]=nil end
        elseif e.spawnEgg then
            if world.gameplay.spawn(e.spawnEgg,front-Vector3.new(0,size*.5,0)) then consume();machines.vibrate(front,14) end
        elseif JavaContent.data.boats and JavaContent.data.boats[e.id] then
            if world.gameplay.spawnBoat(e.id,front) then consume() end
        elseif e.id:match('minecart$') and frontNode and frontNode.id:match('rail$') then
            -- MinecartDispenseItemBehavior: a cart onto the rail in front (otherwise the item is dropped).
            if world.gameplay.vehicles.spawnCart(e.id,frontNode) then consume() end
        else spawnItem(n,stack);consume();dispenseSmoke(n) end
        changed(n)
    end
    -- Rising power (this block or, by quasi-connectivity, the block above) schedules a dispense 4 ticks
    -- after the power change. Inputs come from the previous tick's redstone pass, so 3 ticks remain.
    local function dispenserTick(n)
        local above=neighbor(n,'up')
        local powered=(n.input or 0)>0 or (above~=nil and (above.input or 0)>0)
        if powered and not n.triggered then n.triggered=true;n.dispenseAt=world.tickCount+3
        elseif not powered and n.triggered then n.triggered=false end
        if n.dispenseAt and world.tickCount>=n.dispenseAt then n.dispenseAt=nil;dispense(n) end
    end

    -- Vibrations ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Game event frequencies (VibrationSystem.getGameEventFrequency): 1 step, 2 hit ground /
    -- projectile land, 7 entity damage, 8 eat, 9 close/deactivate, 10 open/activate/prime,
    -- 11 block change, 12 destroy/fluid pickup, 13 place/fluid place, 14 entity place, 15 explode/die.
    function machines.vibrate(position,frequency,cause)
        machines.events[#machines.events+1]={position=position,frequency=frequency,cause=cause or {}}
    end
    -- Wool between source and listener blocks the vibration (#occludes_vibration_signals).
    local function occluded(from,to)
        local delta=to-from;local steps=math.ceil(delta.Magnitude/(size*.25))
        for i=1,steps-1 do
            local cell=nodeAt(h.cell(from+delta*(i/steps)))
            if cell and cell.id:match('_wool$') then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    -- Each idle listener takes the closest valid event of the tick; it arrives after floor(distance) ticks.
    local function listen(n,range,accept)
        local best,bestDistance
        for _,event in ipairs(machines.current) do
            local distance=(event.position-n.center).Magnitude/size
            if distance<=range and (not bestDistance or distance<bestDistance) and accept(event) and event.position~=n.center and not occluded(event.position,n.center) then
                best,bestDistance=event,distance
            end
        end
        if not best then return nil end
        local travel=math.floor(bestDistance)
        if travel>0 and JavaContent.data.particles.vibration then
            h.effects.emit('vibration',best.position,Vector3.zero,{target=n.center,life=travel,size=.6,fullbright=true})
        end
        -- The event was raised last tick, so one tick of the travel time has already passed.
        return {arrive=world.tickCount+math.max(0,travel-1),distance=bestDistance,frequency=best.frequency,cause=best.cause}
    end
    local function sensorTick(n)
        local calibrated=n.id=='calibrated_sculk_sensor'
        local range=calibrated and 16 or 8
        if not n.sensorReady then
            -- The catalog default is 'active'; a placed sensor starts inactive like Java.
            n.sensorReady=true;if not n.phaseUntil then n.state.sculk_sensor_phase='inactive' end
        end
        if n.state.sculk_sensor_phase=='inactive' and not n.vibration then
            local filter=calibrated and n.received and n.received[opposite[n.state.facing or 'north']] or 0
            local sneaking=world.gameplay.controls and world.gameplay.controls.sneak
            n.vibration=listen(n,range,function(event)
                if not event.frequency then return false end
                if event.cause.player and sneaking and (event.frequency==1 or event.frequency==2) then return false end
                return filter==0 or event.frequency==filter
            end)
        end
        if n.vibration and world.tickCount>=n.vibration.arrive then
            local v=n.vibration;n.vibration=nil
            n.state.sculk_sensor_phase='active';n.phaseUntil=world.tickCount+(calibrated and 10 or 30)
            -- getRedstoneStrengthForDistance(): max(1, 15 - floor(15 / range * distance)).
            n.sensorPower=math.max(1,15-math.floor(15/range*v.distance))
            n.comparatorStrength=v.frequency
            -- The clicking tendrils are a vibration only shriekers listen for.
            machines.events[#machines.events+1]={position=n.center,tendrils=true,cause=v.cause}
        elseif n.phaseUntil and world.tickCount>=n.phaseUntil then
            -- getAnalogOutputSignal() reports the frequency only while ACTIVE.
            if n.state.sculk_sensor_phase=='active' then n.state.sculk_sensor_phase='cooldown';n.sensorPower=0;n.comparatorStrength=0;n.phaseUntil=world.tickCount+10
            else n.state.sculk_sensor_phase='inactive';n.phaseUntil=nil end
        end
    end

    -- Shriekers, warning level and the warden -------------------------------------------
    local function wardenNear(position,blocks)
        for _,m in ipairs(world.gameplay.mobs) do
            if m.id=='warden' and not m.dead and (m.position-position).Magnitude<=blocks*size then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    -- SpawnUtil.trySpawnMob(WARDEN, 20 tries, 5 blocks out, 6 up/down, on top of solid ground).
    local function summonWarden(n)
        local params=RaycastParams.new();params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances=h.ignore;params.RespectCanCollide=true
        for _=1,20 do
            local column=n.center+Vector3.new(math.random(-5,5),6,math.random(-5,5))*size
            local hit=workspace:Raycast(column,Vector3.new(0,-12*size,0),params)
            if hit and hit.Normal.Y>.7 then
                local feet=hit.Position;local clear=true
                for y=1,3 do if nodeAt(h.cell(feet+Vector3.new(0,(y-.5)*size,0))) then clear=false end end
                if clear and world.gameplay.spawn('warden',feet) then
                    local m=world.gameplay.mobs[#world.gameplay.mobs];m.emerge=134 -- Warden emerge pose
                    machines.vibrate(feet,14)
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    -- Warden.applyDarknessAround(): Darkness for 260 ticks within 40 blocks.
    local function darkness(position)
        if (h.root.Position-position).Magnitude<=40*size then
            if world.tickCount>=machines.darknessUntil then machines.darknessStart=world.tickCount end
            machines.darknessUntil=world.tickCount+260
        end
    end
    local function shriek(n)
        if n.shriekEnd then return end
        if n.state.can_summon=='true' then
            -- WardenSpawnTracker.tryWarn(): no warning with a warden within 48 blocks or during the 200-tick cooldown.
            if wardenNear(n.center,48) or world.tickCount<machines.warningCooldown then return end
            machines.warningLevel=math.min(4,machines.warningLevel+1)
            machines.warningCooldown,machines.lastWarning=world.tickCount+200,world.tickCount
            n.warningLevel=machines.warningLevel
        else n.warningLevel=0 end
        n.shriekEnd=world.tickCount+90
        machines.vibrate(n.center,nil,{shriek=true})
        -- ShriekParticleOption: ten rising rings, five ticks apart.
        for i=0,9 do
            later(i*5,function()
                if world.nodes[h.key(n.center)]==n then
                    h.effects.emit('shriek',n.center+Vector3.new(0,size*.5,0),Vector3.new(0,size*.1,0),{life=30,size=1.7,friction=1,fullbright=true})
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    local function shriekerTick(n)
        if n.shriekEnd and world.tickCount>=n.shriekEnd then
            n.shriekEnd=nil
            -- tryToWarn(): at warning level 4 the warden is summoned; any warning brings Darkness.
            if (n.warningLevel or 0)>0 then
                if n.warningLevel>=4 then summonWarden(n) end
                darkness(n.center)
            end
        end
        -- stepOn(): a player walking (not sneaking) on the shrieker sets it off directly.
        local feet=h.root.Position-Vector3.new(0,h.root.Size.Y/2,0);local top=n.center+Vector3.new(0,size/2,0)
        local delta=feet-top
        if math.abs(delta.X)<size*.5 and math.abs(delta.Z)<size*.5 and delta.Y>-.05*size and delta.Y<.1*size
            and not (world.gameplay.controls and world.gameplay.controls.sneak) then shriek(n) end
        if not n.shriekEnd and not n.heard then
            n.heard=listen(n,8,function(event) return event.tendrils and event.cause.player end)
        end
        if n.heard and world.tickCount>=n.heard.arrive then n.heard=nil;shriek(n) end
    end

    function machines.tick(nodes)
        -- Events raised during this tick (sensor tendrils included) are heard next tick, whatever the node order.
        machines.current,machines.events=machines.events,{}
        for i=#machines.delayed,1,-1 do
            local d=machines.delayed[i]
            if world.tickCount>=d.at then table.remove(machines.delayed,i);d.fn() end
        end
        -- Warning level drops by one after 12000 ticks without a warning.
        if machines.warningLevel>0 and world.tickCount-machines.lastWarning>=12000 then
            machines.warningLevel=machines.warningLevel-1;machines.lastWarning=world.tickCount
        end
        for _,n in ipairs(nodes) do
            local id=n.id
            if id=='hopper' then hopperTick(n)
            elseif id=='dropper' or id=='dispenser' then dispenserTick(n)
            elseif id=='sculk_sensor' or id=='calibrated_sculk_sensor' then sensorTick(n)
            elseif id=='sculk_shrieker' then shriekerTick(n) end
        end
    end
    local darknessFx=Instance.new('ColorCorrectionEffect')
    darknessFx.Name,darknessFx.Enabled,darknessFx.Parent='SteveDarkness',false,game:GetService('Lighting')
    -- LightTexture darkness: fades in/out over 22 ticks and pulses with max(0, cos(t*pi*0.025)) * 0.45.
    function machines.render(partial)
        local t=world.tickCount+partial
        if t>=machines.darknessUntil then darknessFx.Enabled=false;return end
        local blend=math.clamp(math.min(t-machines.darknessStart,machines.darknessUntil-t)/22,0,1)
        local pulse=math.max(0,math.cos(t*math.pi*.025))*.45*blend
        darknessFx.Enabled=true
        darknessFx.Brightness,darknessFx.Saturation,darknessFx.Contrast=-(.3*blend+pulse),-.5*blend,.15*blend
    end
    function machines.destroy() darknessFx:Destroy() end
    return machines
end
-- END BLOCK MACHINES
-- BEGIN BLOCK SCREENS
-- Java 26.3 block menus on the creative UI kit: CraftingScreen (and the inventory's 2x2 grid),
-- StonecutterScreen, SmithingScreen, LoomScreen, CartographyTableScreen, GrindstoneScreen,
-- AnvilScreen, EnchantmentScreen, BeaconScreen, BrewingStandScreen, CrafterScreen and the
-- lectern's BookViewScreen. Layout numbers are the screens' own (GUI pixels from the window).
local function createBlockScreens(ctx)
    local ui, world = ctx.ui, ctx.world
    local kit = ui.kit
    local G = kit.G
    local screens = {}
    local white = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    local function rgb(n) return Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(n / 65536) % 256, math.floor(n / 256) % 256, n % 256) end
    local function L(key) return (JavaContent.data.lang or {})[key] or key end
    -- Language.getOrDefault + String.format for %s and %1$s.
    local function T(key, ...)
        local args, i = {...}, 0
        local s = (L(key):gsub("%%(%d)%$s", function(n) return tostring(args[tonumber(n)]) end))
        return (s:gsub("%%s", function() i = i + 1; return tostring(args[i]) end))
    end
    screens.T = T
    local function creative() return not CONFIG.Survival end
    local function name(stack) return Recipes.name(stack) end

    -- Widgets ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function setSprite(node, sprite)
        if node:IsA("ImageLabel") then
            local content = JavaGui.content(sprite)
            if content then node.ImageContent = content; node.ImageRectOffset, node.ImageRectSize = Vector2.zero, Vector2.new(sprite.w, sprite.h) end
        end
    end
    screens.setSprite = setSprite
    local function inside(w, x, y) return x >= w.x and y >= w.y and x < w.x + w.w and y < w.y + w.h end
    -- Every menu: widgets get clicks that miss the slots and are redrawn each frame.
    local function install(screen)
        screen.widgets = screen.widgets or {}
        screen.click = function(button, x, y)
            for _, w in ipairs(screen.widgets) do
                if w.click and inside(w, x, y) and (not w.active or w.active()) then
                    if button == 1 then w.click(x - w.x, y - w.y) end
                    return true
                end
            end
            return screen.onClick ~= nil and screen.onClick(button, x, y) == true
        end
        screen.update = function(x, y)
            for _, w in ipairs(screen.widgets) do if w.draw then w.draw(inside(w, x, y), x, y) end end
            if screen.onUpdate then screen.onUpdate(x, y) end
        end
        screen.hoverTooltip = function(x, y)
            for _, w in ipairs(screen.widgets) do if w.tooltip and inside(w, x, y) then local t = w.tooltip(); if t then return t end end end
            return screen.onTooltip and screen.onTooltip(x, y) or nil
        end
    end
    local function widget(screen, w)
        screen.widgets = screen.widgets or {}
        screen.widgets[#screen.widgets + 1] = w
        return w
    end
    screens.install, screens.widget = install, widget
    -- Button (widget/button nine-slice, white label, grey when inactive).
    local function button(screen, x, y, w, h, text, onClick, active)
        local b = widget(screen, {x = x, y = y, w = w, h = h, click = onClick, active = active})
        b.bg = JavaGui.slice(screen.window, G["widget/button"], 3, x, y, w, h, 4)
        function b.setText(t, color)
            if b.text == t and b.color == color then return end
            b.text, b.color = t, color
            if b.label then b.label:Destroy() end
            b.label = JavaGui.text(screen.window, t, x + math.floor((w - JavaGui.width(t)) / 2), y + math.floor((h - 8) / 2), color or white, true, 6)
        end
        b.setText(text)
        local shown
        function b.draw(hover)
            local on = not b.active or b.active()
            local sprite = not on and "widget/button_disabled" or hover and "widget/button_highlighted" or "widget/button"
            if sprite ~= shown then shown = sprite; setSprite(b.bg, G[sprite]); b.setText(b.text, on and white or rgb(0xA0A0A0)) end
        end
        return b
    end
    screens.button = button
    -- Text field: an invisible TextBox takes the keys; the text is drawn in the Java font.
    local function textField(screen, x, y, w, h, opts)
        local f = widget(screen, {x = x, y = y, w = w, h = h, text = opts.text or ""})
        local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
        box.Name, box.BackgroundTransparency, box.TextTransparency, box.TextSize = "JavaTextField", 1, 1, 8
        box.ClearTextOnFocus, box.MultiLine, box.Text = false, opts.multiline == true, f.text
        box.Position, box.Size, box.ZIndex, box.Parent = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), 9, screen.window
        f.box = box
        local drawn, drawnKey
        function f.set(text) f.text = text; box.Text = text end
        function f.focus() JavaGui.focus(box) end
        box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
            local t = box.Text
            if opts.maxLength and #t > opts.maxLength then t = t:sub(1, opts.maxLength); box.Text = t end
            if t ~= f.text then f.text = t; if opts.onChange then opts.onChange(t) end end
        end)
        box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) if enter and opts.onEnter then opts.onEnter(f.text) end end)
        function f.draw()
            local editable = not opts.editable or opts.editable()
            box.TextEditable = editable
            if not editable and box:IsFocused() then box:ReleaseFocus() end
            local caret = box:IsFocused() and os.clock() % 0.6 < 0.3
            local text = f.text
            -- EditBox scrolls to keep the end in view.
            local limit = w - (opts.inset or 4) * 2
            while JavaGui.width(text) > limit and #text > 0 do text = text:sub(2) end
            local key = text .. (caret and "_" or "") .. tostring(editable)
            if key == drawnKey then return end
            drawnKey = key
            if drawn then drawn:Destroy() end
            local color = editable and (opts.color or rgb(0xE0E0E0)) or rgb(0x707070)
            drawn = JavaGui.text(screen.window, text .. (caret and "_" or ""), x + (opts.inset or 4), y + math.floor((h - 8) / 2), color, opts.shadow ~= false, 8)
        end
        return f
    end
    screens.textField = textField
    -- A sprite that can switch between named sprites.
    local function sprite(screen, x, y, nameNow, w, h, z)
        local node = JavaGui.image(screen.window, G[nameNow], x, y, w, h, nil, z or 4)
        local s = {node = node, name = nameNow}
        function s.set(n) if n ~= s.name and G[n] then s.name = n; setSprite(node, G[n]) end end
        function s.show(v) node.Visible = v end
        return s
    end
    -- Item drawn outside a slot (stonecutter recipes, beacon payments, display slots).
    local function itemAt(screen, x, y, stack, z)
        local v = JavaGui.itemView(screen.window, x, y, z or 6)
        v.set(stack)
        return v
    end
    -- Menus whose slots only exist while open: everything goes back to the player on close.
    local function tempOwner(count)
        local owner = {slots = {}}
        return owner, function() for i = 1, count do kit.giveBack(owner.slots[i]); owner.slots[i] = nil end end
    end
    local function toPlayer(group, concat, reverse)
        if reverse then return concat(group("hotbar", true), group("main", true)) end
        return concat(group("main"), group("hotbar"))
    end
    local function across(slot, group) return slot.group == "main" and group("hotbar") or group("main") end
    local function giveXp(points) if PlayerStats.addXp then PlayerStats.addXp(points) end end
    local function spendLevels(n) if PlayerStats.addLevels then PlayerStats.addLevels(-n) end end

    -- Crafting (CraftingMenu / InventoryMenu) ------------------------------------------------------
    local function craftingMenu(screen, owner, size, result)
        local count = size * size
        local keep
        screen.changed = function()
            local grid = {}
            for i = 1, count do grid[i] = owner.slots[i] end
            local stack, _, k = Recipes.craft(grid, size, size)
            owner.slots[count + 1], keep = stack, k
        end
        result.onTake = function()
            Recipes.consume(owner.slots, count, keep, kit.giveBack)
            screen.changed()
        end
        screen.quickTargets = function(slot, _, group, concat)
            if slot.kind == "result" or slot.group == "craft" then return toPlayer(group, concat, slot.kind == "result") end
            if size == 3 and (slot.group == "main" or slot.group == "hotbar") then
                -- CraftingMenu: inventory items go into the grid first, then main <-> hotbar.
                return concat(group("craft"), across(slot, group))
            end
        end
        screen.changed()
    end
    ui.decorate = function(kind, screen)
        if kind ~= "inventory" then return end
        local result
        for _, slot in ipairs(screen.slots) do if slot.kind == "result" then result = slot end end
        if result then craftingMenu(screen, kit.craft, 2, result) end
    end
    function screens.crafting()
        local owner, close = tempOwner(9)
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("crafting_table", 176, 166)
            kit.image(G.crafting_table, 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3)
            kit.label(L("container.crafting"), 29, 6)
            kit.label(L("container.inventory"), 8, 72)
            for i = 1, 9 do kit.slot({owner = owner, index = i, x = 30 + (i - 1) % 3 * 18, y = 17 + math.floor((i - 1) / 3) * 18, group = "craft"}) end
            local result = kit.slot({owner = owner, index = 10, x = 124, y = 35, kind = "result", group = "result"})
            kit.playerSlots(8, 84, 142)
            craftingMenu(screen, owner, 3, result)
        end, function() close(); owner.slots[10] = nil end)
    end

    -- Stonecutter ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    function screens.stonecutter()
        local owner, close = tempOwner(1)
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("stonecutter", 176, 166)
            kit.image(G.stonecutter, 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3)
            kit.label(L("container.stonecutter"), 8, 5)
            kit.label(L("container.inventory"), 8, 72)
            kit.slot({owner = owner, index = 1, x = 20, y = 33, group = "container"})
            local result = kit.slot({owner = owner, index = 2, x = 143, y = 33, kind = "result", group = "result"})
            kit.playerSlots(8, 84, 142)
            local recipes, selected, offset, inputName = {}, nil, 0, nil
            local buttons = {}
            for j = 0, 11 do
                local x, y = 52 + j % 4 * 16, 14 + math.floor(j / 4) * 18 + 2
                buttons[j + 1] = {bg = sprite(screen, x, y - 1, "container/stonecutter/recipe", 16, 18, 4), item = itemAt(screen, x, y, nil, 6), x = x, y = y}
            end
            local scroller = sprite(screen, 119, 15, "container/stonecutter/scroller", 12, 15, 5)
            local function rows() return math.max(0, math.ceil(#recipes / 4) - 3) end
            local function start() return math.floor(offset * rows() + 0.5) * 4 end
            local function setResult()
                local r = selected and recipes[selected]
                owner.slots[2] = r and owner.slots[1] and Recipes.stack(r.r, r.c) or nil
            end
            screen.changed = function()
                local input = owner.slots[1]
                local n = input and name(input)
                if n ~= inputName then inputName = n; recipes = input and Recipes.stonecutting(input) or {}; selected = nil; offset = 0 end
                setResult()
            end
            result.onTake = function()
                local input = owner.slots[1]
                if input then input.count = input.count - 1; if input.count <= 0 then owner.slots[1] = nil end end
                screen.changed()
            end
            screen.quickTargets = function(slot, stack, group, concat)
                if slot.kind == "result" or slot.group == "container" then return toPlayer(group, concat, slot.kind == "result") end
                if #Recipes.stonecutting(stack) > 0 then return {screen.slots[1]} end
                return across(slot, group)
            end
            local dragging = false
            screen.onClick = function(button, x, y)
                if button ~= 1 then return false end
                for j, b in ipairs(buttons) do
                    local index = start() + j
                    if recipes[index] and x >= b.x and x < b.x + 16 and y >= b.y and y < b.y + 18 then
                        selected = index; setResult(); return true
                    end
                end
                if x >= 119 and x < 131 and y >= 15 and y < 69 and rows() > 0 then dragging = true; return true end
                return false
            end
            screen.wheel = function(delta) if rows() > 0 then offset = math.clamp(offset - delta / rows(), 0, 1) end end
            screen.onUpdate = function(x, y)
                if dragging then
                    if not Input:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then dragging = false
                    else offset = math.clamp((y - 15 - 7.5) / (54 - 15), 0, 1) end
                end
                scroller.set(rows() > 0 and "container/stonecutter/scroller" or "container/stonecutter/scroller_disabled")
                scroller.node.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(119, 15 + math.floor(41 * offset))
                for j, b in ipairs(buttons) do
                    local index = start() + j
                    local r = recipes[index]
                    b.bg.show(r ~= nil)
                    if r then
                        local hover = x >= b.x and x < b.x + 16 and y >= b.y and y < b.y + 18
                        b.bg.set(index == selected and "container/stonecutter/recipe_selected" or hover and "container/stonecutter/recipe_highlighted" or "container/stonecutter/recipe")
                    end
                    b.item.set(r and Recipes.stack(r.r, r.c) or nil)
                end
            end
            screen.onTooltip = function(x, y)
                for j, b in ipairs(buttons) do
                    local r = recipes[start() + j]
                    if r and x >= b.x and x < b.x + 16 and y >= b.y and y < b.y + 18 then return kit.itemTooltip(Recipes.stack(r.r, r.c)) end
                end
            end
            install(screen)
            screen.changed()
        end, function() close(); owner.slots[2] = nil end)
    end

    -- Smithing table ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local cycling = {
        template = {"smithing_template_armor_trim", "smithing_template_netherite_upgrade"},
        trimBase = {"helmet", "chestplate", "leggings", "boots"},
        upgradeBase = {"helmet", "sword", "chestplate", "pickaxe", "leggings", "axe", "boots", "hoe", "shovel", "spear"},
        trimAddition = {"ingot", "redstone_dust", "lapis_lazuli", "quartz", "diamond", "emerald", "amethyst_shard"},
        upgradeAddition = {"ingot"}}
    function screens.smithing()
        local owner, close = tempOwner(3)
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("smithing", 176, 166)
            kit.image(G.smithing, 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3)
            kit.label(L("container.upgrade"), 44, 15)
            kit.label(L("container.inventory"), 8, 72)
            local fields = {"tp", "b", "a"}
            local ghosts = {}
            for i, x in ipairs({8, 26, 44}) do
                local s = kit.slot({owner = owner, index = i, x = x, y = 48, group = "container", accepts = function(stack) return Recipes.smithingAccepts(fields[i], stack) end})
                ghosts[i] = sprite(screen, x, 48, "container/slot/smithing_template_armor_trim", 16, 16, 5)
                s.placeholder = ghosts[i].node
            end
            local result = kit.slot({owner = owner, index = 4, x = 98, y = 48, kind = "result", group = "result"})
            kit.playerSlots(8, 84, 142)
            local errorIcon = sprite(screen, 65, 46, "container/smithing/error", 28, 21, 5)
            screen.changed = function()
                local s = owner.slots
                owner.slots[4] = s[1] and s[2] and s[3] and Recipes.smithing(s[1], s[2], s[3]) or nil
            end
            result.onTake = function()
                for i = 1, 3 do local s = owner.slots[i]; if s then s.count = s.count - 1; if s.count <= 0 then owner.slots[i] = nil end end end
                screen.changed()
            end
            screen.quickTargets = function(slot, stack, group, concat)
                if slot.kind == "result" or slot.group == "container" then return toPlayer(group, concat, slot.kind == "result") end
                for i, f in ipairs(fields) do if Recipes.smithingAccepts(f, stack) then return {screen.slots[i]} end end
                return across(slot, group)
            end
            screen.onUpdate = function()
                local s = owner.slots
                errorIcon.show(s[1] ~= nil and s[2] ~= nil and s[3] ~= nil and owner.slots[4] == nil)
                -- CyclingSlotBackground: the empty-slot icons change every 30 ticks.
                local step = math.floor(os.clock() * 20 / 30)
                local upgrade = s[1] and name(s[1]) == "netherite_upgrade_smithing_template"
                local lists = {cycling.template, s[1] and (upgrade and cycling.upgradeBase or cycling.trimBase) or {},
                    s[1] and (upgrade and cycling.upgradeAddition or cycling.trimAddition) or {}}
                for i = 1, 3 do
                    local list = lists[i]
                    ghosts[i].show(#list > 0 and s[i] == nil)
                    if #list > 0 then ghosts[i].set("container/slot/" .. list[step % #list + 1]) end
                end
            end
            install(screen)
            screen.changed()
        end, function() close(); owner.slots[4] = nil end)
    end

    -- Banners: pattern layers composited into a sprite (BannerRenderer colours each mask by DyeColor).
    local bannerCache = {}
    function screens.bannerSprite(baseColor, layers, w, h)
        local bp = JavaContent.data.bannerPatterns
        local colors = JavaContent.data.dyeColors
        local key = baseColor .. "|"
        for _, l in ipairs(layers or {}) do key = key .. l.pattern .. ":" .. l.color .. "," end
        if bannerCache[key] then return bannerCache[key] end
        local masks = {{mask = bp.base, color = colors[baseColor] or 0xFFFFFF}}
        for _, l in ipairs(layers or {}) do
            local p = bp.patterns[l.pattern]
            if p then masks[#masks + 1] = {mask = p.mask, color = colors[l.color] or 0xFFFFFF} end
        end
        local palette, index, data = {}, {}, table.create and table.create(800) or {}
        for i = 1, 800 do
            local r, g, b, any = 0, 0, 0, false
            for _, m in ipairs(masks) do
                local a = tonumber(string.sub(m.mask, i, i), 16) / 15
                if a > 0 then
                    any = true
                    local c = m.color
                    -- Base texture shading: the mask's own grey value is baked into alpha; colour multiplies.
                    r = r + ((math.floor(c / 65536) % 256) - r) * a
                    g = g + ((math.floor(c / 256) % 256) - g) * a
                    b = b + ((c % 256) - b) * a
                end
            end
            if any then
                local rgbValue = math.floor(r) * 65536 + math.floor(g) * 256 + math.floor(b)
                local k = index[rgbValue]
                if not k then
                    if #palette < 255 then palette[#palette + 1] = rgbValue; k = #palette; index[rgbValue] = k else k = #palette end
                end
                data[i] = string.format("%02x", k)
            else data[i] = "00" end
        end
        local result = {w = 20, h = 40, p = palette, d = table.concat(data)}
        bannerCache[key] = result
        return result
    end
    local function bannerColor(stack) local n = name(stack); return n and n:match("^(.+)_banner$") end

    -- Loom -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    function screens.loom()
        local owner, close = tempOwner(3)
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("loom", 176, 166)
            kit.image(G.loom, 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3)
            kit.label(L("container.loom"), 8, 4)
            kit.label(L("container.inventory"), 8, 72)
            kit.slot({owner = owner, index = 1, x = 13, y = 26, group = "container", accepts = function(s) return bannerColor(s) ~= nil end})
            kit.slot({owner = owner, index = 2, x = 33, y = 26, group = "container", accepts = function(s) return Recipes.dyeColor(name(s)) ~= nil end})
            kit.slot({owner = owner, index = 3, x = 23, y = 45, group = "container", accepts = function(s) return (JavaContent.data.bannerPatternItems or {})[name(s)] ~= nil end})
            local result = kit.slot({owner = owner, index = 4, x = 143, y = 57, kind = "result", group = "result"})
            kit.playerSlots(8, 84, 142)
            local patterns, selected, offset = {}, nil, 0
            local buttons = {}
            for j = 0, 15 do
                local x, y = 60 + j % 4 * 14, 13 + math.floor(j / 4) * 14
                local preview = Instance.new("Frame")
                preview.BackgroundTransparency, preview.Size, preview.Position, preview.ZIndex, preview.ClipsDescendants = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(8, 12), UDim2.fromOffset(x + 3, y + 1), 6, true
                preview.Parent = screen.window
                buttons[j + 1] = {bg = sprite(screen, x, y, "container/loom/pattern", 14, 14, 4), preview = preview, x = x, y = y}
            end
            local scroller = sprite(screen, 119, 13, "container/loom/scroller", 12, 15, 5)
            local errorIcon = sprite(screen, 138, 52, "container/loom/error", 26, 26, 7)
            local bannerView = Instance.new("Frame")
            bannerView.BackgroundTransparency, bannerView.Size, bannerView.Position, bannerView.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(20, 40), UDim2.fromOffset(141, 8), 5
            bannerView.Parent = screen.window
            local function rows() return math.max(0, math.ceil(#patterns / 4) - 4) end
            local function start() return math.floor(offset * rows() + 0.5) * 4 end
            local shownKey, previewKey
            local function full() local b = owner.slots[1]; return b ~= nil and #(b.patterns or {}) >= 6 end
            local function refreshResult()
                local banner, dye = owner.slots[1], owner.slots[2]
