                local p = selected and patterns[selected]
                if banner and dye and p and not full() then
                    local out = CreativeRules.withCount(banner, 1)
                    out.patterns = CreativeRules.copy(banner.patterns or {})
                    out.patterns[#out.patterns + 1] = {pattern = p, color = Recipes.dyeColor(name(dye))}
                    owner.slots[4] = out
                else owner.slots[4] = nil end
            end
            screen.changed = function()
                local banner, dye = owner.slots[1], owner.slots[2]
                local list = banner and dye and not full() and Recipes.loomPatterns(owner.slots[3]) or {}
                local key = table.concat(list, ",")
                if key ~= shownKey then shownKey = key; patterns = list; selected = #list == 1 and 1 or nil; offset = 0 end
                refreshResult()
            end
            result.onTake = function()
                for i = 1, 2 do local s = owner.slots[i]; if s then s.count = s.count - 1; if s.count <= 0 then owner.slots[i] = nil end end end
                screen.changed()
            end
            screen.quickTargets = function(slot, stack, group, concat)
                if slot.kind == "result" or slot.group == "container" then return toPlayer(group, concat, slot.kind == "result") end
                for i = 1, 3 do if screen.slots[i].accepts(stack) then return {screen.slots[i]} end end
                return across(slot, group)
            end
            local dragging = false
            screen.onClick = function(buttonId, x, y)
                if buttonId ~= 1 then return false end
                for j, b in ipairs(buttons) do
                    local index = start() + j
                    if patterns[index] and x >= b.x and x < b.x + 14 and y >= b.y and y < b.y + 14 then selected = index; refreshResult(); return true end
                end
                if x >= 119 and x < 131 and y >= 13 and y < 69 and rows() > 0 then dragging = true; return true end
                return false
            end
            screen.wheel = function(delta) if rows() > 0 then offset = math.clamp(offset - delta / rows(), 0, 1) end end
            screen.onUpdate = function(x, y)
                if dragging then
                    if not Input:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then dragging = false
                    else offset = math.clamp((y - 13 - 7.5) / (56 - 15), 0, 1) end
                end
                scroller.set(rows() > 0 and "container/loom/scroller" or "container/loom/scroller_disabled")
                scroller.node.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(119, 13 + math.floor(41 * offset))
                errorIcon.show(full())
                local key = shownKey .. "|" .. start()
                for j, b in ipairs(buttons) do
                    local index = start() + j
                    local p = patterns[index]
                    b.bg.show(p ~= nil)
                    if p then
                        local hover = x >= b.x and x < b.x + 14 and y >= b.y and y < b.y + 14
                        b.bg.set(index == selected and "container/loom/pattern_selected" or hover and "container/loom/pattern_highlighted" or "container/loom/pattern")
                    end
                end
                if key ~= previewKey then
                    previewKey = key
                    for j, b in ipairs(buttons) do
                        b.preview:ClearAllChildren()
                        local p = patterns[start() + j]
                        -- LoomScreen.renderPattern: a grey banner with the pattern in white.
                        if p then JavaGui.image(b.preview, screens.bannerSprite("gray", {{pattern = p, color = "white"}}), 0, 0, 8, 16, nil, 6) end
                    end
                end
                local shown = owner.slots[4] or owner.slots[1]
                local bkey = shown and (bannerColor(shown) .. CreativeRules.componentKey(shown)) or ""
                if bannerView:GetAttribute("Key") ~= bkey then
                    bannerView:SetAttribute("Key", bkey)
                    bannerView:ClearAllChildren()
                    if shown then JavaGui.image(bannerView, screens.bannerSprite(bannerColor(shown), shown.patterns), 0, 0, 20, 40, nil, 5) end
                end
            end
            screen.onTooltip = function(x, y)
                for j, b in ipairs(buttons) do
                    local p = patterns[start() + j]
                    if p and x >= b.x and x < b.x + 14 and y >= b.y and y < b.y + 14 then
                        local info = JavaContent.data.bannerPatterns.patterns[p]
                        local dye = owner.slots[2] and Recipes.dyeColor(name(owner.slots[2])) or "white"
                        return {{L(info.key .. "." .. dye), white}}
                    end
                end
            end
            install(screen)
            screen.changed()
        end, function() close(); owner.slots[4] = nil end)
    end

    -- Cartography table ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    function screens.cartography()
        local owner, close = tempOwner(2)
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("cartography_table", 176, 166)
            kit.image(G.cartography_table, 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3)
            kit.label(L("container.cartography_table"), 8, 4)
            kit.label(L("container.inventory"), 8, 72)
            kit.slot({owner = owner, index = 1, x = 15, y = 15, group = "container", accepts = function(s) return name(s) == "filled_map" end})
            kit.slot({owner = owner, index = 2, x = 15, y = 52, group = "container", accepts = function(s) local n = name(s); return n == "paper" or n == "map" or n == "glass_pane" end})
            local result = kit.slot({owner = owner, index = 3, x = 145, y = 39, kind = "result", group = "result"})
            kit.playerSlots(8, 84, 142)
            local preview = sprite(screen, 67, 13, "container/cartography_table/map", 66, 66, 4)
            local second = sprite(screen, 67, 29, "container/cartography_table/duplicated_map", 50, 66, 5)
            local lock = sprite(screen, 118, 60, "container/cartography_table/locked", 10, 14, 6)
            local errorIcon = sprite(screen, 35, 31, "container/cartography_table/error", 28, 21, 5)
            local mode
            screen.changed = function()
                local map, extra = owner.slots[1], owner.slots[2]
                mode = nil
                owner.slots[3] = nil
                if not map then return end
                local info = map.map or {}
                local n = extra and name(extra)
                if n == "paper" and not info.locked and (info.scale or 0) < 4 then
                    mode = "scale"; local out = CreativeRules.withCount(map, 1); out.map = CreativeRules.copy(info); out.map.scale = (info.scale or 0) + 1; owner.slots[3] = out
                elseif n == "glass_pane" and not info.locked then
                    mode = "lock"; local out = CreativeRules.withCount(map, 1); out.map = CreativeRules.copy(info); out.map.locked = true; owner.slots[3] = out
                elseif n == "map" then mode = "copy"; owner.slots[3] = CreativeRules.withCount(map, 2)
                elseif extra then mode = "error" end
            end
            result.onTake = function()
                for i = 1, 2 do local s = owner.slots[i]; if s then s.count = s.count - 1; if s.count <= 0 then owner.slots[i] = nil end end end
                screen.changed()
            end
            screen.quickTargets = function(slot, stack, group, concat)
                if slot.kind == "result" or slot.group == "container" then return toPlayer(group, concat, slot.kind == "result") end
                if name(stack) == "filled_map" then return {screen.slots[1]} end
                if screen.slots[2].accepts(stack) then return {screen.slots[2]} end
                return across(slot, group)
            end
            screen.onUpdate = function()
                local has = owner.slots[1] ~= nil
                preview.show(has and mode ~= "error")
                preview.set(mode == "scale" and "container/cartography_table/scaled_map" or mode == "copy" and "container/cartography_table/duplicated_map" or "container/cartography_table/map")
                preview.node.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mode == "copy" and 83 or 67, 13)
                preview.node.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(mode == "copy" and 50 or 66, 66)
                second.show(mode == "copy")
                lock.show(mode == "lock" or (has and owner.slots[1].map and owner.slots[1].map.locked == true))
                errorIcon.show(mode == "error")
            end
            install(screen)
            screen.changed()
        end, function() close(); owner.slots[3] = nil end)
    end

    -- Anvil -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    function screens.anvil(node)
        local owner, close = tempOwner(2)
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("anvil", 176, 166)
            kit.image(G.anvil, 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3)
            kit.label(L("container.repair"), 60, 6)
            kit.label(L("container.inventory"), 8, 72)
            local field = sprite(screen, 59, 20, "container/anvil/text_field_disabled", 110, 16, 4)
            local rename, cost, used = nil, 0, 0
            local lastFirst
            local nameField
            nameField = textField(screen, 62, 24, 103, 12, {maxLength = 50, inset = 0, color = white,
                editable = function() return owner.slots[1] ~= nil end,
                onChange = function(t) rename = t; screen.changed(); ui.refresh() end})
            kit.slot({owner = owner, index = 1, x = 27, y = 47, group = "container"})
            kit.slot({owner = owner, index = 2, x = 76, y = 47, group = "container"})
            local result = kit.slot({owner = owner, index = 3, x = 134, y = 47, kind = "result", group = "result"})
            kit.playerSlots(8, 84, 142)
            local errorIcon = sprite(screen, 99, 45, "container/anvil/error", 28, 21, 5)
            local costLabel, costKey, costBg
            screen.changed = function()
                local first = owner.slots[1]
                if first ~= lastFirst then
                    lastFirst = first
                    local current = first and (first.name or blockNames[first.id] or "") or ""
                    rename = first and current or nil
                    nameField.set(current)
                end
                local out
                out, cost, used = Recipes.anvil(first, owner.slots[2], rename, creative())
                owner.slots[3] = out
            end
            result.canTake = function() return creative() or (PlayerStats.xpLevel >= cost and cost > 0) end
            result.onTake = function()
                if not creative() then spendLevels(cost) end
                owner.slots[1] = nil
                local second = owner.slots[2]
                if second and used > 0 then second.count = second.count - used; if second.count <= 0 then owner.slots[2] = nil end
                else owner.slots[2] = nil end
                cost = 0
                -- AnvilMenu.onTake: 12% chance (survival) to damage the anvil one stage.
                if node and not creative() and math.random() < 0.12 then
                    local next = ({anvil = "chipped_anvil", chipped_anvil = "damaged_anvil"})[node.id]
                    local entry = next and JavaContent.byId[next]
                    if entry then local state = CreativeRules.copy(node.state); world.setBlockAt(node.center, entry.index, state)
                    else world.setBlockAt(node.center, nil, nil, false); ui.toggle() end
                end
                lastFirst = nil
                screen.changed()
            end
            screen.quickTargets = function(slot, stack, group, concat)
                if slot.kind == "result" or slot.group == "container" then return toPlayer(group, concat, slot.kind == "result") end
                return {screen.slots[1], screen.slots[2]}
            end
            screen.onUpdate = function()
                field.set(owner.slots[1] and "container/anvil/text_field" or "container/anvil/text_field_disabled")
                errorIcon.show(owner.slots[1] ~= nil and owner.slots[2] ~= nil and owner.slots[3] == nil)
                -- AnvilScreen.renderLabels: "Enchantment Cost: N" (green 0x80FF20 / red 0xFF6060), "Too Expensive!".
                local text, color
                if cost > 0 then
                    color = 0x80FF20
                    if cost >= 40 and not creative() then text = L("container.repair.expensive"); color = 0xFF6060
                    elseif owner.slots[3] then
                        text = T("container.repair.cost", cost)
                        if not (creative() or PlayerStats.xpLevel >= cost) then color = 0xFF6060 end
                    end
                end
                local key = text and (text .. color) or ""
                if key ~= costKey then
                    costKey = key
                    if costLabel then costLabel:Destroy(); costLabel = nil end
                    if costBg then costBg:Destroy(); costBg = nil end
                    if text then
                        local k = 176 - 8 - JavaGui.width(text) - 2
                        costBg = Instance.new("Frame")
                        costBg.BorderSizePixel, costBg.BackgroundColor3, costBg.BackgroundTransparency = 0, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 1 - 0x4F / 255
                        costBg.Position, costBg.Size, costBg.ZIndex, costBg.Parent = UDim2.fromOffset(k - 2, 67), UDim2.fromOffset(176 - 8 - (k - 2), 12), 4, screen.window
                        costLabel = JavaGui.text(screen.window, text, k, 69, rgb(color), true, 5)
                    end
                end
            end
            install(screen)
            screen.changed()
        end, function() close(); owner.slots[3] = nil end)
    end

    -- Enchanting table ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local enchantWords = {}
    for w in ("the elder scrolls klaatu berata niktu xyzzy bless curse light darkness fire air earth water hot dry cold wet ignite snuff embiggen twist shorten stretch fiddle destroy imbue galvanize enchant free limited range of towards inside sphere cube self other ball mental physical grow shrink demon elemental spirit animal creature beast humanoid undead fresh stale phnglui mglwnafh cthulhu rlyeh wgahnagl fhtagnbaguette"):gmatch("%S+") do enchantWords[#enchantWords + 1] = w end
    -- Text in the Standard Galactic Alphabet font (EnchantmentNames).
    local function sgaText(parent, text, x, y, color, z)
        local content = JavaGui.content(G.font_sga)
        local widths = G.fontSgaWidths
        local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
        holder.BackgroundTransparency, holder.Position, holder.Size, holder.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), UDim2.fromOffset(100, 9), z
        local pen = 0
        for i = 1, #text do
            local code = string.byte(text, i)
            if code ~= 32 and content then
                local glyph = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                glyph.BackgroundTransparency, glyph.ImageContent, glyph.ResampleMode = 1, content, Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated
                glyph.ImageRectOffset, glyph.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(code % 16 * 8, math.floor(code / 16) * 8), Vector2.new(8, 8)
                glyph.Size, glyph.Position, glyph.ImageColor3, glyph.ZIndex = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), UDim2.fromOffset(pen, 0), color, z
                glyph.Parent = holder
            end
            pen = pen + (widths[code + 1] or 6)
        end
        holder.Parent = parent
        return holder
    end
    local function sgaWidth(text) local w = 0; for i = 1, #text do w = w + (G.fontSgaWidths[string.byte(text, i) + 1] or 6) end; return w end
    world.enchantSeed = world.enchantSeed or math.random(0, 2147483647)
    -- EnchantingTableBlock.BOOKSHELF_OFFSETS: bookshelves two blocks out with air between.
    local function inTag(tag, id)
        for _, x in ipairs(JavaContent.data.blockTags[tag] or {}) do if x == id then return true end end
        return false
    end
    -- EnchantingTableBlock.BOOKSHELF_OFFSETS: (-2..2, 0..1, -2..2) on the outer ring; the block at
    -- offset / 2 (integer division towards zero) must let the power through.
    local function bookshelves(node)
        if not node then return 0 end
        local B, n = CONFIG.Block, 0
        local function half(v) return v >= 0 and math.floor(v / 2) or -math.floor(-v / 2) end
        for dx = -2, 2 do for dz = -2, 2 do
            if math.abs(dx) == 2 or math.abs(dz) == 2 then
                for dy = 0, 1 do
                    local shelf = world.sample(node.center + Vector3.new(dx, dy, dz) * B)
                    local between = world.sample(node.center + Vector3.new(half(dx), half(dy), half(dz)) * B)
                    if shelf and inTag("enchantment_power_provider", shelf.id) and (not between or inTag("enchantment_power_transmitter", between.id)) then n = n + 1 end
                end
            end
        end end
        return n
    end
    function screens.enchanting(node)
        local owner, close = tempOwner(2)
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("enchanting_table", 176, 166)
            kit.image(G.enchanting_table, 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3)
            kit.label(L("container.enchant"), 8, 6)
            kit.label(L("container.inventory"), 8, 72)
            kit.slot({owner = owner, index = 1, x = 15, y = 47, group = "container", max = 1})
            kit.slot({owner = owner, index = 2, x = 35, y = 47, group = "container", accepts = function(s) return name(s) == "lapis_lazuli" end,
                placeholder = JavaGui.image(screen.window, G["container/slot/lapis_lazuli"], 35, 47, nil, nil, nil, 5)})
            kit.playerSlots(8, 84, 142)
            local costs, clues, levels = {0, 0, 0}, {}, {}
            local rows = {}
            local shelves = bookshelves(node)
            local random = Recipes.random(0)
            local function list(stack, slot, cost)
                random.setSeed(world.enchantSeed + slot)
                local out = Recipes.selectEnchantments(random, stack, cost)
                if name(stack) == "book" and #out > 1 then table.remove(out, random.nextInt(#out) + 1) end
                return out
            end
            screen.changed = function()
                local item = owner.slots[1]
                costs, clues = {0, 0, 0}, {}
                if item and Recipes.enchantable(item) > 0 and not next(item.enchantments or {}) then
                    random.setSeed(world.enchantSeed)
                    for j = 0, 2 do
                        costs[j + 1] = Recipes.enchantCost(random, j, shelves, item)
                        if costs[j + 1] < j + 1 then costs[j + 1] = 0 end
                    end
                    for j = 0, 2 do
                        if costs[j + 1] > 0 then
                            local l = list(item, j, costs[j + 1])
                            if #l > 0 then clues[j + 1] = l[random.nextInt(#l) + 1] end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local function affordable(j)
                local lapis = owner.slots[2] and owner.slots[2].count or 0
                return costs[j] > 0 and (creative() or (lapis >= j and PlayerStats.xpLevel >= costs[j] and PlayerStats.xpLevel >= j))
            end
            local function enchant(j)
                local item = owner.slots[1]
                if not item or not affordable(j) or not clues[j] then return end
                local l = list(item, j - 1, costs[j])
                if #l == 0 then return end
                if not creative() then spendLevels(j) end
                local out = CreativeRules.withCount(item, item.count)
                if name(item) == "book" then out.id = Recipes.index("enchanted_book") end
                out.enchantments = CreativeRules.copy(out.enchantments or {})
                for _, e in ipairs(l) do out.enchantments[e.id] = e.level end
                owner.slots[1] = out
                if not creative() then
                    local lapis = owner.slots[2]
                    lapis.count = lapis.count - j
                    if lapis.count <= 0 then owner.slots[2] = nil end
                end
                world.enchantSeed = math.random(0, 2147483647)
                screen.changed(); ui.refresh()
            end
            -- Names: EnchantmentNames.initSeed(seed) then getRandomName per button.
            local nameRandom = Recipes.random(0)
            local function randomName(maxWidth)
                local words = {}
                for _ = 1, nameRandom.nextInt(2) + 3 do words[#words + 1] = enchantWords[nameRandom.nextInt(#enchantWords) + 1] end
                local s = table.concat(words, " ")
                while sgaWidth(s) > maxWidth and #s > 0 do s = s:sub(1, -2) end
                return s
            end
            for j = 1, 3 do
                local y = 14 + 19 * (j - 1)
                local row = widget(screen, {x = 60, y = y, w = 108, h = 19, click = function() enchant(j) end})
                row.bg = sprite(screen, 60, y, "container/enchanting_table/enchantment_slot", 108, 19, 4)
                row.level = sprite(screen, 61, y + 1, "container/enchanting_table/level_" .. j, 16, 16, 5)
                function row.draw(hover)
                    local cost = costs[j]
                    local on = affordable(j)
                    row.bg.set(cost == 0 and "container/enchanting_table/enchantment_slot_disabled" or not on and "container/enchanting_table/enchantment_slot_disabled"
                        or hover and "container/enchanting_table/enchantment_slot_highlighted" or "container/enchanting_table/enchantment_slot")
                    row.level.show(cost > 0)
                    row.level.set("container/enchanting_table/level_" .. j .. (on and "" or "_disabled"))
                    local key = cost .. tostring(on) .. tostring(hover) .. world.enchantSeed
                    if key ~= row.key then
                        row.key = key
                        if row.words then row.words:Destroy(); row.words = nil end
                        if row.cost then row.cost:Destroy(); row.cost = nil end
                        if cost > 0 then
                            nameRandom.setSeed(world.enchantSeed)
                            local text
                            for _ = 1, j do text = randomName(86 - JavaGui.width(tostring(cost))) end
                            local color = not on and 0x342F25 or hover and 0xFFFF80 or 0x685E4A
                            row.words = sgaText(screen.window, text, 80, y + 2, rgb(color), 6)
                            local c = tostring(cost)
                            row.cost = JavaGui.text(screen.window, c, 80 + 86 - JavaGui.width(c), y + 9, rgb(on and 0x80FF20 or 0x407F10), true, 6)
                        end
                    end
                end
                function row.tooltip()
                    local clue, cost = clues[j], costs[j]
                    if not clue or cost == 0 then return nil end
                    local info = JavaContent.data.enchantments[clue.id] or {}
                    local roman = ({"I", "II", "III", "IV", "V"})[clue.level] or tostring(clue.level)
                    local lines = {{T("container.enchant.clue", L("enchantment.minecraft." .. clue.id) .. ((info.max or 1) > 1 and " " .. roman or "")), white}}
                    if not creative() then
                        lines[#lines + 1] = {"", white}
                        if PlayerStats.xpLevel < cost then
                            lines[#lines + 1] = {T("container.enchant.level.requirement", cost), rgb(0xFF5555)}
                        else
                            local lapis = owner.slots[2] and owner.slots[2].count or 0
                            lines[#lines + 1] = {j == 1 and L("container.enchant.lapis.one") or T("container.enchant.lapis.many", j), lapis >= j and rgb(0xAAAAAA) or rgb(0xFF5555)}
                            lines[#lines + 1] = {j == 1 and L("container.enchant.level.one") or T("container.enchant.level.many", j), rgb(0xAAAAAA)}
                        end
                    end
                    return lines
                end
                rows[j] = row
            end
            -- The open book on the left (EnchantmentScreen renders the BookModel).
            install(screen)
            screen.changed()
        end, function() close() end)
    end

    -- Beacon -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local beaconEffects = {{"speed", "haste"}, {"resistance", "jump_boost"}, {"strength"}, {"regeneration"}}
    screens.beaconEffects = beaconEffects
    function screens.beacon(node)
        local payment = {slots = {}}
        node.beacon = node.beacon or {}
        local data = node.beacon
        local primary, secondary = data.primary, data.secondary
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("beacon", 230, 219)
            kit.image(G.beacon, 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3)
            screen.labels[#screen.labels + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, L("block.minecraft.beacon.primary"), 62 - math.floor(JavaGui.width(L("block.minecraft.beacon.primary")) / 2), 10, rgb(0xE0E0E0), true, 4)
            screen.labels[#screen.labels + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, L("block.minecraft.beacon.secondary"), 169 - math.floor(JavaGui.width(L("block.minecraft.beacon.secondary")) / 2), 10, rgb(0xE0E0E0), true, 4)
            kit.slot({owner = payment, index = 1, x = 136, y = 110, group = "container", max = 1,
                accepts = function(s) return Recipes.tagged("beacon_payment_items", name(s)) end})
            kit.playerSlots(36, 137, 195)
            for i, id in ipairs({"netherite_ingot", "emerald", "diamond", "gold_ingot", "iron_ingot"}) do
                itemAt(screen, ({20, 41, 63, 86, 108})[i], 109, Recipes.stack(id, 1), 5)
            end
            local function levels() return data.levels or 0 end
            local function effectButton(x, y, effect, tier, upgrade)
                local b = widget(screen, {x = x, y = y, w = 22, h = 22})
                b.bg = sprite(screen, x, y, "container/beacon/button", 22, 22, 4)
                JavaGui.image(screen.window, G["effect/" .. effect], x + 2, y + 2, 18, 18, nil, 5)
                local function available()
                    if tier < 3 then return levels() > tier end
                    return levels() >= 4 and primary ~= nil and (not upgrade or primary ~= nil)
                end
                local function chosen()
                    if tier < 3 then return primary == effect end
                    return secondary == effect
                end
                b.active = available
                b.click = function()
                    if tier < 3 then primary = effect; if secondary and secondary ~= "regeneration" then secondary = nil end
                    else secondary = effect end
                end
                function b.draw(hover)
                    b.bg.set(not available() and "container/beacon/button_disabled" or chosen() and "container/beacon/button_selected"
                        or hover and "container/beacon/button_highlighted" or "container/beacon/button")
                end
                function b.tooltip() return {{L("effect.minecraft." .. effect) .. (upgrade and " II" or ""), white}} end
                return b
            end
            for tier = 0, 2 do
                local list = beaconEffects[tier + 1]
                local width = #list * 22 + (#list - 1) * 2
                for j, effect in ipairs(list) do effectButton(76 + (j - 1) * 24 - math.floor(width / 2), 22 + tier * 25, effect, tier) end
            end
            -- Secondary: Regeneration, or Primary II (the primary effect's upgrade button).
            local upgradeButton = effectButton(167 + 24 - 23, 47, primary or "speed", 3, true)
            upgradeButton.click = function() secondary = primary end
            local function upgradeChosen() return secondary ~= nil and secondary == primary end
            upgradeButton.draw = function(hover)
                upgradeButton.bg.set(not (levels() >= 4 and primary) and "container/beacon/button_disabled" or upgradeChosen() and "container/beacon/button_selected"
                    or hover and "container/beacon/button_highlighted" or "container/beacon/button")
                local icon = primary and G["effect/" .. primary]
                if icon and upgradeButton.icon ~= primary then
                    upgradeButton.icon = primary
                    if upgradeButton.iconNode then upgradeButton.iconNode:Destroy() end
                    upgradeButton.iconNode = JavaGui.image(screen.window, icon, upgradeButton.x + 2, upgradeButton.y + 2, 18, 18, nil, 5)
                end
            end
            upgradeButton.active = function() return levels() >= 4 and primary ~= nil end
            upgradeButton.tooltip = function() return primary and {{L("effect.minecraft." .. primary) .. " II", white}} or nil end
            effectButton(167 - 23, 47, "regeneration", 3)
            local confirm = widget(screen, {x = 164, y = 107, w = 22, h = 22})
            confirm.bg = sprite(screen, 164, 107, "container/beacon/button", 22, 22, 4)
            JavaGui.image(screen.window, G["container/beacon/confirm"], 166, 109, 18, 18, nil, 5)
            confirm.active = function() return payment.slots[1] ~= nil and primary ~= nil end
            confirm.click = function()
                data.primary, data.secondary = primary, secondary
                payment.slots[1] = nil
                ui.toggle()
            end
            function confirm.draw(hover) confirm.bg.set(not confirm.active() and "container/beacon/button_disabled" or hover and "container/beacon/button_highlighted" or "container/beacon/button") end
            confirm.tooltip = function() return {{L("gui.done"), white}} end
            local cancel = widget(screen, {x = 190, y = 107, w = 22, h = 22, click = function() ui.toggle() end})
            cancel.bg = sprite(screen, 190, 107, "container/beacon/button", 22, 22, 4)
            JavaGui.image(screen.window, G["container/beacon/cancel"], 192, 109, 18, 18, nil, 5)
            function cancel.draw(hover) cancel.bg.set(hover and "container/beacon/button_highlighted" or "container/beacon/button") end
            cancel.tooltip = function() return {{L("gui.cancel"), white}} end
            screen.quickTargets = function(slot, stack, group, concat)
                if slot.group == "container" then return toPlayer(group, concat, true) end
                if screen.slots[1].accepts(stack) and not payment.slots[1] then return {screen.slots[1]} end
                return across(slot, group)
            end
            install(screen)
        end, function() kit.giveBack(payment.slots[1]); payment.slots[1] = nil end)
    end

    -- Brewing stand (the block keeps its 5 slots: bottles 1-3, ingredient 4, fuel 5) -------------
    function screens.brewing(node)
        node.storage = node.storage or CreativeRules.inventory()
        node.storageSize = 5
        node.containerOpen = true
        world.currentContainer = node
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("brewing_stand", 176, 166)
            kit.image(G.brewing_stand, 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3)
            kit.label(L("container.brewing"), 0, 6, true)
            kit.label(L("container.inventory"), 8, 72)
            local storage = node.storage
            for i, p in ipairs({{56, 51}, {79, 58}, {102, 51}}) do
                kit.slot({owner = storage, index = i, x = p[1], y = p[2], group = "container", max = 1, accepts = Recipes.isBottle,
                    placeholder = JavaGui.image(screen.window, G["container/slot/potion"], p[1], p[2], nil, nil, nil, 5)})
            end
            kit.slot({owner = storage, index = 4, x = 79, y = 17, group = "container", accepts = Recipes.isReagent})
            kit.slot({owner = storage, index = 5, x = 17, y = 17, group = "container", accepts = function(s) return name(s) == "blaze_powder" end,
                placeholder = JavaGui.image(screen.window, G["container/slot/brewing_fuel"], 17, 17, nil, nil, nil, 5)})
            kit.playerSlots(8, 84, 142)
            local fuel = JavaGui.image(screen.window, G["container/brewing_stand/fuel_length"], 60, 44, 18, 4, nil, 5)
            local arrow = JavaGui.image(screen.window, G["container/brewing_stand/brew_progress"], 97, 16, 9, 28, nil, 5)
            local bubbles = JavaGui.image(screen.window, G["container/brewing_stand/bubbles"], 63, 14, 12, 29, nil, 5)
            local lengths = {29, 24, 20, 16, 11, 6, 0}
            screen.quickTargets = function(slot, stack, group, concat)
                if slot.group == "container" then return toPlayer(group, concat, true) end
                local n = name(stack)
                if n == "blaze_powder" and (not storage.slots[5] or storage.slots[5].count < 64) then return {screen.slots[5]} end
                if Recipes.isReagent(stack) then return {screen.slots[4]} end
                if Recipes.isBottle(stack) then return {screen.slots[1], screen.slots[2], screen.slots[3]} end
                return across(slot, group)
            end
            screen.onUpdate = function()
                -- BrewingStandScreen: fuel bar width, arrow fills downwards, bubbles cycle every 2 ticks.
                local f = math.clamp(math.floor((18 * (node.fuel or 0) + 20 - 1) / 20), 0, 18)
                JavaGui.crop(fuel, G["container/brewing_stand/fuel_length"], 60, 44, {0, 0, f, 4})
                local t = node.brewTime or 0
                if t > 0 then
                    local h = math.floor(28 * (1 - t / 400))
                    JavaGui.crop(arrow, G["container/brewing_stand/brew_progress"], 97, 16, {0, 0, 9, h})
                    local b = lengths[math.floor(t / 2) % 7 + 1]
                    JavaGui.crop(bubbles, G["container/brewing_stand/bubbles"], 63, 14 + 29 - b, {0, 29 - b, 12, b})
                else arrow.Visible, bubbles.Visible = false, false end
            end
            install(screen)
        end, function() node.containerOpen = false; world.currentContainer = nil; world.vibrate(node.center, 9, {player = true}) end)
    end

    -- Crafter (9 slots kept on the block; empty slots can be disabled by clicking) --------------
    function screens.crafter(node)
        node.storage = node.storage or CreativeRules.inventory()
        node.disabledSlots = node.disabledSlots or {}
        node.storageSize = 9
        node.containerOpen = true
        world.currentContainer = node
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("crafter", 176, 166)
            kit.image(G.crafter, 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3)
            kit.label(L("container.crafter"), 0, 6, true)
            kit.label(L("container.inventory"), 8, 72)
            local storage = node.storage
            local disabled = {}
            for i = 1, 9 do
                local x, y = 26 + (i - 1) % 3 * 18, 17 + math.floor((i - 1) / 3) * 18
                -- CrafterScreen: clicking an empty slot with an empty cursor disables / enables it.
                kit.slot({owner = storage, index = i, x = x, y = y, group = "container", accepts = function() return not node.disabledSlots[i] end,
                    toggle = function() node.disabledSlots[i] = not node.disabledSlots[i] or nil end})
                disabled[i] = sprite(screen, x - 1, y - 1, "container/crafter/disabled_slot", 18, 18, 7)
            end
            local preview = itemAt(screen, 134, 35, nil, 6)
            local redstone = sprite(screen, 79, 35, "container/crafter/unpowered_redstone", 16, 16, 5)
            kit.playerSlots(8, 84, 142)
            screen.onUpdate = function()
                for i = 1, 9 do disabled[i].show(node.disabledSlots[i] == true) end
                local grid, key = {}, ""
                for i = 1, 9 do
                    local st = storage.slots[i]
                    grid[i] = st
                    key = key .. (st and (st.id .. CreativeRules.componentKey(st)) or "-") .. ","
                end
                if key ~= screen.previewKey then screen.previewKey = key; preview.set((Recipes.craft(grid, 3, 3))) end
                redstone.set(node.triggered and "container/crafter/powered_redstone" or "container/crafter/unpowered_redstone")
            end
            screen.quickTargets = function(slot, _, group, concat)
                if slot.group == "container" then return toPlayer(group, concat, true) end
                return concat(group("container"), across(slot, group))
            end
            install(screen)
        end, function() node.containerOpen = false; world.currentContainer = nil end)
    end

    -- Books (BookViewScreen: book.png, 114px lines, 14 lines a page) ----------------------------
    local function wrap(text, width)
        local lines = {}
        for paragraph in (text .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
            local line = ""
            for word in paragraph:gmatch("%S+%s*") do
                if JavaGui.width(line .. word:gsub("%s+$", "")) > width and line ~= "" then lines[#lines + 1] = line:gsub("%s+$", ""); line = "" end
                while JavaGui.width(word) > width do
                    local cut = #word
                    while cut > 1 and JavaGui.width(word:sub(1, cut)) > width do cut = cut - 1 end
                    lines[#lines + 1] = word:sub(1, cut); word = word:sub(cut + 1)
                end
                line = line .. word
            end
            lines[#lines + 1] = (line:gsub("%s+$", ""))
        end
        return lines
    end
    screens.wrap = wrap
    -- view: {pages = {...}, page = n, onPage(n), takeBook()} (lecterns add Take Book).
    function screens.book(view)
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("book", 192, 220)
            kit.image(G.book, 0, 0, 192, 192, nil, 3)
            local pages = view.pages
            local page = math.clamp(view.page or 1, 1, math.max(#pages, 1))
            local lines, indicator = {}, nil
            local function show()
                for _, l in ipairs(lines) do l:Destroy() end
                lines = {}
                if indicator then indicator:Destroy() end
                local text = T("book.pageIndicator", page, math.max(#pages, 1))
                indicator = JavaGui.text(screen.window, text, 192 - 44 - JavaGui.width(text), 18, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), false, 5)
                for i, line in ipairs(wrap(pages[page] or "", 114)) do
                    if i > 14 then break end
                    lines[#lines + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, line, 36, 32 + (i - 1) * 9, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), false, 5)
                end
                if view.onPage then view.onPage(page) end
            end
            local function pageButton(x, forward)
                local b = widget(screen, {x = x, y = 159, w = 23, h = 13})
                local base = forward and "widget/page_forward" or "widget/page_backward"
                b.icon = sprite(screen, x, 159, base, 23, 13, 5)
                b.active = function() return forward and page < #pages or not forward and page > 1 end
                b.click = function() page = page + (forward and 1 or -1); show() end
                function b.draw(hover) b.icon.show(b.active()); b.icon.set(hover and base .. "_highlighted" or base) end
            end
            pageButton(116, true); pageButton(43, false)
            if view.takeBook then
                button(screen, -4, 196, 98, 20, L("gui.done"), function() ui.toggle() end)
                button(screen, 98, 196, 98, 20, L("lectern.take_book"), function() view.takeBook(); ui.toggle() end, function() return not CONFIG.Survival or true end)
            else
                button(screen, -4, 196, 200, 20, L("gui.done"), function() ui.toggle() end)
            end
            screen.wheel = function(delta)
                if delta < 0 and page < #pages then page = page + 1; show() elseif delta > 0 and page > 1 then page = page - 1; show() end
            end
            install(screen)
            show()
        end, view.onClose)
    end

    -- BookModel.setupAnim as bone overrides (yRot, and the pages' x offset).
    function screens.bookPose(time, rightFlip, leftFlip, openness)
        local f = (math.sin(time * 0.02) * 0.1 + 1.25) * openness
        local x = math.sin(f)
        return {left_lid = {y = math.pi + f}, right_lid = {y = -f}, left_pages = {y = f, px = x}, right_pages = {y = -f, px = x},
            flip_page1 = {y = f - f * 2 * rightFlip, px = x}, flip_page2 = {y = f - f * 2 * leftFlip, px = x}}
    end

    -- Sign editing (AbstractSignEditScreen): four centred lines, 90px wide (60 on hanging signs).
    local signRgb = {white = 0xFFFFFF, orange = 0xFF681F, magenta = 0xFF00FF, light_blue = 0x9AC0CD, yellow = 0xFFFF00, lime = 0xBFFF00, pink = 0xFF69B4,
        gray = 0x808080, light_gray = 0xD3D3D3, cyan = 0x00FFFF, purple = 0xA020F0, blue = 0x0000FF, brown = 0x8B4513, green = 0x00FF00, red = 0xFF0000, black = 0}
    function screens.sign(node, side, wood, hanging, onDone)
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("sign", 200, 200)
            local cx = 100
            local title = L("sign.edit")
            screen.labels[#screen.labels + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, title, cx - math.floor(JavaGui.width(title) / 2), 0, white, true, 4)
            local textY, maxWidth, lineHeight
            if hanging then
                kit.image(G["hanging_signs/" .. wood] or G["hanging_signs/oak"], cx - 36, 30, 72, 72, nil, 3)
                textY, maxWidth, lineHeight = 30 + 44 - 18, 60, 9
            else
                kit.image(G["signs/" .. wood] or G["signs/oak"], cx - 47, 20, 94, 102, nil, 3)
                textY, maxWidth, lineHeight = 20 + 23 - 20, 90, 10
            end
            local value = signRgb[side.color or "black"] or 0
            local color = side.glowing and (value == 0 and rgb(0xF0EBCC) or rgb(value))
                or Color3.fromRGB(math.floor((math.floor(value / 65536) % 256) * 0.4), math.floor((math.floor(value / 256) % 256) * 0.4), math.floor((value % 256) * 0.4))
            local fields, drawn = {}, {}
            for i = 1, 4 do
                local y = textY + (i - 1) * lineHeight
                local f = textField(screen, cx - math.floor(maxWidth / 2), y - 1, maxWidth, lineHeight, {text = side.lines[i] or "", maxLength = 384,
                    onChange = function(t)
                        while JavaGui.width(t) > maxWidth do t = t:sub(1, -2) end
                        side.lines[i] = t
                        if fields[i] and fields[i].text ~= t then fields[i].set(t) end
                    end,
                    onEnter = function() if fields[i + 1] then fields[i + 1].focus() end end})
                -- The sign's own centred text (drawn here instead of the field's left-aligned one).
                f.draw = function()
                    local caret = f.box:IsFocused() and os.clock() % 0.6 < 0.3
                    local text = (side.lines[i] or "") .. (caret and "_" or "")
                    if drawn[i] and drawn[i]:GetAttribute("Text") == text then return end
                    if drawn[i] then drawn[i]:Destroy() end
                    drawn[i] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, text, cx - math.floor(JavaGui.width(side.lines[i] or "") / 2), y, color, false, 8)
                    drawn[i]:SetAttribute("Text", text)
                end
                fields[i] = f
            end
            button(screen, cx - 100, 150, 200, 20, L("gui.done"), function() ui.toggle() end)
            install(screen)
            task.defer(function() if fields[1] then fields[1].focus() end end)
        end, function() if onDone then onDone() end end)
    end

    -- Command blocks (CommandBlockEditScreen).
    function screens.command(node)
        node.command = node.command or {text = "", output = "", track = true, auto = node.id == "chain_command_block"}
        local cb = node.command
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("command_block", 320, 230)
            local cx = 160
            local title = L("advMode.setCommand")
            screen.labels[#screen.labels + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, title, cx - math.floor(JavaGui.width(title) / 2), 0, white, true, 4)
            screen.labels[#screen.labels + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, L("advMode.command"), cx - 150, 30, rgb(0xA0A0A0), true, 4)
            JavaGui.slice(screen.window, G["widget/text_field"], 1, cx - 150, 40, 300, 20, 4)
            local text = cb.text
            textField(screen, cx - 150, 40, 300, 20, {text = text, maxLength = 32500, onChange = function(t) text = t end})
            screen.labels[#screen.labels + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, L("advMode.previousOutput"), cx - 150, 85, rgb(0xA0A0A0), true, 4)
            JavaGui.slice(screen.window, G["widget/text_field"], 1, cx - 150, 95, 276, 20, 4)
            screen.labels[#screen.labels + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, cb.track and (cb.output ~= "" and cb.output or "-") or "-", cx - 146, 101, rgb(0x707070), true, 5)
            local track = cb.track
            local trackButton
            trackButton = button(screen, cx + 130, 95, 20, 20, track and "O" or "X", function() track = not track; trackButton.setText(track and "O" or "X") end)
            local modes = {"command_block", "chain_command_block", "repeating_command_block"}
            local modeNames = {command_block = "advMode.mode.redstoneTriggered", chain_command_block = "advMode.mode.sequence", repeating_command_block = "advMode.mode.autoexec.bat"}
            local mode = node.id
            local conditional = node.state.conditional == "true"
            local auto = cb.auto
            local modeButton, condButton, autoButton
            modeButton = button(screen, cx - 154, 125, 100, 20, L(modeNames[mode]), function()
                for i, m in ipairs(modes) do if m == mode then mode = modes[i % 3 + 1]; break end end
                modeButton.setText(L(modeNames[mode]))
            end)
            condButton = button(screen, cx - 50, 125, 100, 20, L(conditional and "advMode.mode.conditional" or "advMode.mode.unconditional"), function()
                conditional = not conditional; condButton.setText(L(conditional and "advMode.mode.conditional" or "advMode.mode.unconditional"))
            end)
            autoButton = button(screen, cx + 54, 125, 100, 20, L(auto and "advMode.mode.autoexec.bat" or "advMode.mode.redstone"), function()
                auto = not auto; autoButton.setText(L(auto and "advMode.mode.autoexec.bat" or "advMode.mode.redstone"))
            end)
            button(screen, cx - 154, 200, 150, 20, L("gui.done"), function()
                cb.text, cb.track, cb.auto = text, track, auto
                if not track then cb.output = "" end
                local n = node
                if mode ~= node.id then
                    local entry = JavaContent.byId[mode]
                    if entry then
                        n = world.setBlockAt(node.center, entry.index, CreativeRules.copy(node.state)) or node
                        n.command = cb
                    end
                end
                n.state.conditional = tostring(conditional)
                world.updateNeighbors()
                ui.toggle()
            end)
            button(screen, cx + 4, 200, 150, 20, L("gui.cancel"), function() ui.toggle() end)
            install(screen)
        end)
    end

    -- Structure / jigsaw / test blocks: Java's fields, kept on the block.
    local function field(screen, labelKey, x, y, w, value, onChange)
        if labelKey then screen.labels[#screen.labels + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, L(labelKey), x, y - 10, rgb(0xA0A0A0), true, 4) end
        JavaGui.slice(screen.window, G["widget/text_field"], 1, x, y, w, 20, 4)
        return textField(screen, x, y, w, 20, {text = tostring(value or ""), onChange = onChange})
    end
    world.structures = world.structures or {}
    function screens.structure(node)
        node.structure = node.structure or {name = "", pos = {0, 1, 0}, size = {5, 5, 5}, rotation = 0}
        local d = node.structure
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("structure_block", 320, 240)
            local cx = 160
            local mode = node.state.mode or "save"
            local nameField = field(screen, "structure_block.structure_name", cx - 152, 20, 236, d.name, function(t) d.name = t end)
            -- the structure files in the executor's "Steve Structures" folder (saved from Minecraft), one per press
            local fileIndex = 0
            button(screen, cx + 88, 20, 64, 20, "Files...", function()
                local names = {}
                pcall(function()
                    for _, f in ipairs(listfiles(SteveNBT.FOLDER)) do
                        local n = tostring(f):gsub("\\", "/"):match("([^/]+)%.nbt$")
                        if n then names[#names + 1] = n end
                    end
                end)
                table.sort(names)
                if #names == 0 then
                    pcall(function() if not isfolder(SteveNBT.FOLDER) then makefolder(SteveNBT.FOLDER) end end)
                    nameField.set(""); d.name = ""
                    return
                end
                fileIndex = fileIndex % #names + 1
                nameField.set(names[fileIndex]); d.name = names[fileIndex]
            end)
            for i = 1, 3 do
                field(screen, i == 1 and "structure_block.position" or nil, cx - 152 + (i - 1) * 80, 60, 80, d.pos[i], function(t) d.pos[i] = tonumber(t) or d.pos[i] end)
                field(screen, i == 1 and "structure_block.size" or nil, cx - 152 + (i - 1) * 80, 100, 80, d.size[i], function(t) d.size[i] = math.clamp(tonumber(t) or d.size[i], 0, 48) end)
            end
            local B = CONFIG.Block
            local function origin() return node.center + Vector3.new(d.pos[1], d.pos[2], d.pos[3]) * B end
            local status
            local function message(text)
                if status then status:Destroy() end
                status = JavaGui.text(screen.window, text, cx - math.floor(JavaGui.width(text) / 2), 150, white, true, 6)
            end
            local modeButton, rotButton
            modeButton = button(screen, cx - 154, 165, 50, 20, L("structure_block.mode." .. mode), function()
                local order = {"save", "load", "corner", "data"}
                for i, m in ipairs(order) do if m == mode then mode = order[i % 4 + 1]; break end end
                modeButton.setText(L("structure_block.mode." .. mode))
            end)
            rotButton = button(screen, cx - 100, 165, 50, 20, tostring(d.rotation), function()
                d.rotation = (d.rotation + 90) % 360; rotButton.setText(tostring(d.rotation))
            end)
            -- StructureTemplate: Save copies the blocks in the box; Load places them back, rotated.
            button(screen, cx + 54, 165, 100, 20, L("structure_block.button.save") .. "/" .. L("structure_block.button.load"), function()
                if d.name == "" then message(T("structure_block.invalid_structure_name", "")); return end
                if mode == "save" then
                    local list = {}
                    for x = 0, d.size[1] - 1 do for y = 0, d.size[2] - 1 do for z = 0, d.size[3] - 1 do
                        local n = world.nodeAt(origin() + Vector3.new(x, y, z) * B)
                        if n and n ~= node then list[#list + 1] = {x = x, y = y, z = z, index = n.index, state = CreativeRules.copy(n.state)} end
                    end end end
                    world.structures[d.name] = {size = {d.size[1], d.size[2], d.size[3]}, blocks = list}
                    pcall(SteveNBT.saveTemplate, d.name, d.size, list)
                    message(T("structure_block.save_success", d.name))
                elseif mode == "load" then
                    local template = world.structures[d.name]
                    if not template then
                        -- a structure saved in Minecraft: Steve Structures/<name>.nbt
                        local loaded, err = SteveNBT.loadTemplate(d.name)
                        if not loaded then message(T("structure_block.load_not_found", d.name)); warn("[Structure] " .. tostring(err)); return end
                        d.size = {loaded.size[1], loaded.size[2], loaded.size[3]}
                        local okP, res = pcall(SteveNBT.place, world, loaded, origin(), d.rotation)
                        if not okP then warn("[Structure] " .. tostring(res)) end
                        local missing = {}
                        for id in pairs(loaded.missing) do missing[#missing + 1] = id end
                        if #missing > 0 then warn("[Structure] blocks not in Steve: " .. table.concat(missing, ", ")) end
                        world.updateNeighbors()
                        message(T("structure_block.load_success", d.name))
                        return
                    end
                    for _, b in ipairs(template.blocks) do
                        local x, z = b.x, b.z
                        for _ = 1, d.rotation / 90 do x, z = -z, x end
                        world.setBlockAt(origin() + Vector3.new(x, b.y, z) * B, b.index, CreativeRules.copy(b.state))
                    end
                    world.updateNeighbors()
                    message(T("structure_block.load_success", d.name))
                end
            end)
            button(screen, cx - 154, 205, 150, 20, L("gui.done"), function() node.state.mode = mode; world.updateNeighbors(); ui.toggle() end)
            button(screen, cx + 4, 205, 150, 20, L("gui.cancel"), function() ui.toggle() end)
            install(screen)
        end)
    end

    -- Book and quill (BookEditScreen + BookSignScreen): 100 pages of 1024 characters, 14 lines each.
    function screens.bookEdit(stack, slotIndex)
        stack.book = stack.book or {}
        local pages = stack.book.pages or {""}
        stack.book.pages = pages
        local page = 1
        local signing, title, finalized = false, "", false
        local function author() return game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Name end
        local function save(finalize)
            if finalized then return end
            stack.book.pages = pages
            if finalize then
                finalized = true
                -- WritableBookItem -> written_book: title, author, generation 0.
                stack.id = Recipes.index("written_book") or stack.id
                stack.book = {pages = pages, title = title, author = author(), generation = 0}
            end
            ui.refresh()
        end
        local function build()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("book_edit", 192, 220)
            kit.image(G.book, 0, 0, 192, 192, nil, 3)
            local drawn = {}
            local function clearDrawn() for _, d in ipairs(drawn) do d:Destroy() end; drawn = {} end
            if not signing then
                local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
                box.Name, box.BackgroundTransparency, box.TextTransparency, box.TextSize, box.MultiLine, box.ClearTextOnFocus = "BookPage", 1, 1, 8, true, false
                box.Position, box.Size, box.ZIndex, box.Text, box.Parent = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 32), UDim2.fromOffset(114, 128), 9, pages[page] or "", screen.window
                local key
                local function show()
                    local caret = box:IsFocused() and os.clock() % 0.6 < 0.3
                    local text = pages[page] or ""
                    local k = text .. tostring(caret) .. page .. #pages
                    if k == key then return end
                    key = k
                    clearDrawn()
                    local indicator = screens.T("book.pageIndicator", page, #pages)
                    drawn[#drawn + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, indicator, 192 - 44 - JavaGui.width(indicator), 18, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), false, 5)
                    local lines = screens.wrap(text, 114)
                    for i, line in ipairs(lines) do
                        if i > 14 then break end
                        if caret and i == #lines then line = line .. "_" end
                        drawn[#drawn + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, line, 36, 32 + (i - 1) * 9, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), false, 5)
                    end
                end
                box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                    local t = box.Text
                    -- Pages hold 1024 characters and 14 lines of 114px.
                    if #t > 1024 then t = t:sub(1, 1024) end
                    while #screens.wrap(t, 114) > 14 and #t > 0 do t = t:sub(1, -2) end
                    if t ~= box.Text then box.Text = t end
                    pages[page] = t
                end)
                local function turn(d)
                    if d > 0 and page == #pages then
                        if #pages >= 100 or (pages[page] or "") == "" then return end
                        pages[#pages + 1] = ""
                    end
                    page = math.clamp(page + d, 1, #pages)
                    box.Text = pages[page] or ""
                    key = nil
                end
                local function pageButton(x, forward)
                    local w = {x = x, y = 159, w = 23, h = 13}
                    local base = forward and "widget/page_forward" or "widget/page_backward"
                    local node = JavaGui.image(screen.window, G[base], x, 159, 23, 13, nil, 6)
                    w.click = function() turn(forward and 1 or -1) end
                    w.draw = function(hover)
                        node.Visible = forward and (page < #pages or ((pages[page] or "") ~= "" and #pages < 100)) or (not forward and page > 1)
                        screens.setSprite(node, G[hover and base .. "_highlighted" or base])
                    end
                    screen.widgets = screen.widgets or {}
                    screen.widgets[#screen.widgets + 1] = w
                end
                pageButton(116, true); pageButton(43, false)
                screens.button(screen, -4, 196, 98, 20, screens.T("book.signButton"), function() signing = true; kit.open(build, function() save(false) end) end)
                screens.button(screen, 98, 196, 98, 20, screens.T("gui.done"), function() ui.toggle() end)
                screen.onUpdate = show
                task.defer(function() JavaGui.focus(box) end)
            else
                -- BookSignScreen
                local titleText = screens.T("book.editTitle")
                drawn[#drawn + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, titleText, 36 + math.floor((114 - JavaGui.width(titleText)) / 2), 34, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), false, 5)
                local byText = screens.T("book.byAuthor", author())
                drawn[#drawn + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, byText, 36 + math.floor((114 - JavaGui.width(byText)) / 2), 60, rgb(0x444444), false, 5)
                for i, line in ipairs(screens.wrap(screens.T("book.finalizeWarning"), 114)) do
                    drawn[#drawn + 1] = JavaGui.text(screen.window, line, 36, 82 + (i - 1) * 9, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), false, 5)
                end
                local field = screens.textField(screen, 36, 46, 114, 10, {text = title, maxLength = 32, color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), shadow = false, inset = 0,
                    onChange = function(t) title = t end})
                screens.button(screen, -4, 196, 98, 20, screens.T("book.finalizeButton"), function()
                    if title:match("^%s*$") then return end
                    save(true); ui.toggle()
                end, function() return not title:match("^%s*$") end)
                screens.button(screen, 98, 196, 98, 20, screens.T("gui.cancel"), function() signing = false; kit.open(build, function() save(false) end) end)
                task.defer(function() field.focus() end)
            end
            install(screen)
        end
        kit.open(build, function() save(false) end)
    end
    return screens
end
-- END BLOCK SCREENS
-- BEGIN BLOCK USES
-- Block.useItemOn / useWithoutItem for every interactive 26.3 block that the older code did not
-- handle, their block-entity ticks (brewing, campfire, crafter, beacon, jukebox, composter,
-- command blocks...) and block-entity visuals (bell, enchanting / lectern book, banners, sign
-- text, campfire and shelf items, beacon beam). Java's order: unless sneaking with an item,
-- useItemOn first, then useWithoutItem; a block that passes leaves the item to its own use.
local function createBlockUses(world, h)
    local B = CONFIG.Block
    local nodeAt, neighbor, rebuild = h.nodeAt, h.neighbor, h.rebuild
    local effects, ui, inventory, screens, root = h.effects, h.ui, h.inventory, h.screens, h.root
    local blocks = {sleeping = nil}
    local directions, opposite = CreativeRules.directions, CreativeRules.opposite
    local white = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    local T = screens.T
    local function L(key) return (JavaContent.data.lang or {})[key] or key end
    local function creative() return not CONFIG.Survival end
    local function dir(d) return Vector3.new(table.unpack(directions[d])) end
    local function held() return inventory.slots[ui.selected] end
    local function inTag(kind, tag, id)
        for _, x in ipairs((JavaContent.data[kind] or {})[tag] or {}) do if x == id then return true end end
        return false
    end
    local function blockTag(tag, id) return inTag("blockTags", tag, id) end
    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name, folder.Parent = "SteveBlockEntities", workspace

    -- Shared helpers ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function give(stack)
        if not stack or stack.count <= 0 then return end
        local added = inventory.add(stack.id, stack.count, nil, stack.damage, stack)
        if added < stack.count then world.drop(CreativeRules.withCount(stack, stack.count - added)) end
        ui.refresh()
    end
    local function dropAt(stack, position, velocity)
        if stack then world.drop(stack, position, velocity or Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * B * 2, B * 4, (math.random() - 0.5) * B * 2), true) end
    end
    -- Survival: one item from the held stack. Creative keeps it (ItemStack.consume).
    local function consume(n)
        if creative() then return true end
        local s = held()
        if not s or s.count < (n or 1) then return false end
        s.count = s.count - (n or 1)
        if s.count <= 0 then inventory.slots[ui.selected] = nil end
        ui.refresh()
        return true
    end
    -- ItemUtils.createFilledResult: bucket <-> filled bucket, bottle <-> potion.
    local function exchange(result)
        if not result then return false end
        local s = held()
        if creative() then
            for _, v in pairs(inventory.slots) do if CreativeRules.sameItem(v, result) then return true end end
            give(result); return true
        end
        if s and s.count == 1 then inventory.slots[ui.selected] = result; ui.refresh() else consume(1); give(result) end
        return true
    end
    local function damageHeld(amount) local s = held(); if s then world.damageTool(s.id, amount or 1, s) end end
    local function replace(n, id, changes)
        local entry = JavaContent.byId[id]
        if not entry then return n end
        local state = CreativeRules.copy(entry.state)
        for k, v in pairs(changes or {}) do state[k] = v end
        local placed = world.setBlockAt(n.center, entry.index, state)
        world.updateNeighbors()
        return placed or n
    end
    local function setState(n, changes)
        for k, v in pairs(changes) do n.state[k] = v end
        rebuild(n); world.updateNeighbors()
    end
    local function chat() return world.chat end
    local function actionBar(text, color)
        local c = chat(); if c then c.showTitle("actionbar", {{text = text, color = color or white}}) end
    end
    local function system(text)
        local c = chat(); if c then c.add({{text = text, color = white}}) end
    end
    local function particle(kind, position, velocity, options) effects.emit(kind, position, velocity or Vector3.zero, options) end
    local function bottom(n) return n.center - Vector3.new(0, B / 2, 0) end
    -- Hit point inside the block, 0..1 on each axis.
    local function local01(n, hit) return (hit.Position - (n.center - Vector3.new(B, B, B) / 2)) / B end
    local function hitFace(hit)
        local nrm = hit.Normal
        local ax, ay, az = math.abs(nrm.X), math.abs(nrm.Y), math.abs(nrm.Z)
        if ay >= ax and ay >= az then return nrm.Y > 0 and "up" or "down" end
        if ax >= az then return nrm.X > 0 and "east" or "west" end
        return nrm.Z > 0 and "south" or "north"
    end
    -- Day time 0..24000 (0 = sunrise), from /time or the Lighting clock.
    local function dayTime()
        local c = chat()
        if c and c.time then return c.time % 24000 end
        return ((game:GetService("Lighting").ClockTime - 6) % 24) * 1000
    end
    local function thundering() local c = chat(); return c and c.weather == "thunder" end
    -- Level.getSkyDarken / getSunAngle (DimensionType.timeOfDay).
    local function timeOfDay(t)
        local d = (t / 24000 - 0.25) % 1
        local e = 0.5 - math.cos(d * math.pi) / 2
        return (d * 2 + e) / 3
    end
    local function skyDarken()
        local f = timeOfDay(dayTime())
        local g = 1 - (math.cos(f * math.pi * 2) * 2 + 0.2)
        g = 1 - math.clamp(g, 0, 1)
        local c = chat()
        if c and c.weather == "rain" then g = g * (1 - 5 / 16) elseif c and c.weather == "thunder" then g = g * (1 - 5 / 16) * (1 - 5 / 16) end
        return math.floor((1 - g) * 11)
    end
    blocks.timeOfDay, blocks.skyDarken = timeOfDay, skyDarken
    blocks.dayTime = dayTime

    -- Block-entity visuals (bells, books, banners, sign text, items on blocks) -------------------
    local extras = {}
    local function extra(n) local e = extras[n]; if not e then e = {}; extras[n] = e end; return e end
    local function clearExtra(n)
        local e = extras[n]
        if not e then return end
        for _, v in pairs(e) do
            if type(v) == "table" and v.model then v.model:Destroy() elseif typeof(v) == "Instance" then v:Destroy() end
        end
        extras[n] = nil
    end
    blocks.resetVisual=clearExtra
    local function itemModel(index, scale, position)
        local offset, modelScale = CFrame.new(), scale
        if JavaContent.display and JavaContent.byIndex[index] then offset, modelScale = JavaContent.display(index, "fixed", scale) end
        local v = JavaContent.model(index, {}, modelScale, folder, position, true)
        v.offset = offset
        return v
    end
    local yawOfFacing = {north = 0, east = -math.pi / 2, south = math.pi, west = math.pi / 2}
    local function facingYaw(n)
        if n.state.rotation then return -tonumber(n.state.rotation) * math.pi / 8 end
        return yawOfFacing[n.state.facing or "north"] or 0
    end
    -- Sign text: a SurfaceGui on a thin part in front of the board (SignRenderer.translateSignText).
    local signColors = {white = 0xFFFFFF, orange = 0xFF681F, magenta = 0xFF00FF, light_blue = 0x9AC0CD, yellow = 0xFFFF00, lime = 0xBFFF00,
        pink = 0xFF69B4, gray = 0x808080, light_gray = 0xD3D3D3, cyan = 0x00FFFF, purple = 0xA020F0, blue = 0x0000FF, brown = 0x8B4513,
        green = 0x00FF00, red = 0xFF0000, black = 0x000000}
    local function signTextColor(side)
        local c = signColors[side.color or "black"] or 0
        if side.glowing then return c == 0 and Color3.fromRGB(0xF0, 0xEB, 0xCC) or Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(c / 65536) % 256, math.floor(c / 256) % 256, c % 256) end
        -- SignRenderer.getDarkColor: the dye's text colour times 0.4.
        return Color3.fromRGB(math.floor((math.floor(c / 65536) % 256) * 0.4), math.floor((math.floor(c / 256) % 256) * 0.4), math.floor((c % 256) * 0.4))
    end
    -- Yaw that turns local +Z to the sign's front (rotation 0 = south; wall facing = the front).
    local frontOfFacing = {south = 0, west = -math.pi / 2, north = math.pi, east = math.pi / 2}
    local function frontYaw(n)
        if n.state.rotation then return -tonumber(n.state.rotation) * math.pi / 8 end
        return frontOfFacing[n.state.facing or "south"] or 0
    end
    local function signGeometry(n)
        if n.id:match("hanging_sign$") then
            -- HangingSignRenderer: text at (0, -0.32, 0.073) under the pivot at 0.625, scale 0.9/64, 9px lines.
            return {y = 0.305 - 0.5, boardZ = 0, half = 0.073, width = 14 / 16, height = 10 / 16, scale = 0.015625 * 0.9, lineHeight = 9}
        end
        if n.id:match("_wall_") then
            return {y = 0.5208 - 0.5, boardZ = -0.4375, half = 0.0467, width = 1, height = 0.5, scale = 0.015625 * 2 / 3, lineHeight = 10}
        end
        return {y = 0.8333 - 0.5, boardZ = 0, half = 0.0467, width = 1, height = 0.5, scale = 0.015625 * 2 / 3, lineHeight = 10}
    end
    local function drawSign(n)
        local e = extra(n)
        if e.signFront then e.signFront:Destroy(); e.signFront = nil end
        if e.signBack then e.signBack:Destroy(); e.signBack = nil end
        local sign = n.sign
        if not sign then return end
        local g = signGeometry(n)
        local base = CFrame.new(n.center) * CFrame.Angles(0, frontYaw(n), 0)
        for _, sideName in ipairs({"front", "back"}) do
            local side = sign[sideName]
            local any = false
            for _, l in ipairs(side.lines) do if l ~= "" then any = true end end
            if any then
                local p = Instance.new("Part")
                p.Name, p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.Transparency = "SignText", true, false, false, false, 1
                p.Size = Vector3.new(g.width, g.height, 0.001) * B
                local z = sideName == "front" and g.boardZ + g.half or g.boardZ - g.half
                p.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(0, g.y * B, z * B) * (sideName == "back" and CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0) or CFrame.identity)
                local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
                gui.Face, gui.SizingMode, gui.LightInfluence = Enum.NormalId.Back, Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize, side.glowing and 0 or 1
                local cw, ch = math.floor(g.width / g.scale), math.floor(g.height / g.scale)
                gui.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(cw, ch)
                gui.Parent = p
                local color = signTextColor(side)
                for i, line in ipairs(side.lines) do
                    if line ~= "" then
                        local w = JavaGui.width(line)
                        JavaGui.text(gui, line, math.floor((cw - w) / 2), math.floor(ch / 2 + (i - 1) * g.lineHeight - 4 * g.lineHeight / 2), color, side.glowing, 2)
                    end
                end
                p.Parent = folder
                e[sideName == "front" and "signFront" or "signBack"] = p
            end
        end
    end
    blocks.drawSign = drawSign

    -- Animated block-entity models: bell body, books, banners.
    local function ensureModel(n, field, modelId)
        local e = extra(n)
        if not e[field] and JavaContent.data.entities[modelId] then
            e[field] = JavaContent.entityModel(modelId, 1, B, folder, n.center, 0, true)
            if world.bindPhysicsVisual then world.bindPhysicsVisual(n,e[field]) end
            for _, pair in ipairs(e[field].parts) do pair[1].CanQuery = false end
        end
        return e[field]
    end
    -- Banner patterns drawn on the flag (front, and mirrored on the back).
    local function bannerOverlay(n, visual)
        local e = extra(n)
        local colorName = n.id:match("^(.-)_wall_banner$") or n.id:match("^(.-)_banner$")
        local key = colorName .. CreativeRules.componentKey({patterns = n.patterns or {}})
        if e.bannerKey == key then return end
        e.bannerKey = key
        for _, f in ipairs({"bannerFront", "bannerBack"}) do if e[f] then e[f]:Destroy(); e[f] = nil end end
        local sprite = screens.bannerSprite(colorName, n.patterns)
        for i, f in ipairs({"bannerFront", "bannerBack"}) do
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name, p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.Transparency = "BannerCloth", true, false, false, false, 1
            p.Size = Vector3.new(20, 40, 0.01) * (2 / 3) / 16 * B
            local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
            gui.Face, gui.SizingMode, gui.CanvasSize = i == 1 and Enum.NormalId.Back or Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize, Vector2.new(20, 40)
            gui.Parent = p
            JavaGui.image(gui, sprite, 0, 0, 20, 40, nil, 1)
            p.Parent = folder
            e[f] = p
        end
        e.bannerVisual = visual
    end

    -- Uses -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local use = {}
    local function kindOf(id)
        if id == "crafting_table" or id == "stonecutter" or id == "smithing_table" or id == "loom" or id == "cartography_table" or id == "grindstone"
            or id == "enchanting_table" or id == "beacon" or id == "brewing_stand" or id == "crafter" or id == "lectern" or id == "bell" or id == "cake"
            or id == "composter" or id == "daylight_detector" or id == "decorated_pot" or id == "dragon_egg" or id == "jukebox" or id == "note_block"
            or id == "pumpkin" or id == "redstone_wire" or id == "respawn_anchor" or id == "tnt" or id == "vault" or id == "light"
            or id == "structure_block" or id == "jigsaw" or id == "test_block" or id == "test_instance_block" or id == "chiseled_bookshelf"
            or id == "sweet_berry_bush" or id == "flower_pot" then return id end
        if id == "anvil" or id == "chipped_anvil" or id == "damaged_anvil" then return "anvil" end
        if id:match("_bed$") then return "bed" end
        if id:match("candle_cake$") then return "candle_cake" end
        if id:match("candle$") then return "candle" end
        if id == "campfire" or id == "soul_campfire" then return "campfire" end
        if id:match("cauldron$") then return "cauldron" end
        if id == "cave_vines" or id == "cave_vines_plant" then return "cave_vines" end
        if id:match("_shelf$") then return "shelf" end
        if id:match("copper_golem_statue$") then return "statue" end
        if id:match("^potted_") then return "potted" end
        if id == "redstone_ore" or id == "deepslate_redstone_ore" then return "redstone_ore" end
        if id == "beehive" or id == "bee_nest" then return "beehive" end
        if id == "command_block" or id == "chain_command_block" or id == "repeating_command_block" then return "command_block" end
        if id:match("_sign$") then return "sign" end
    end
    blocks.kindOf = kindOf

    -- Simple menu blocks (open the screen; crafting tables etc. have no game event).
    use.crafting_table = function() screens.crafting(); return true end
    use.stonecutter = function() screens.stonecutter(); return true end
    use.smithing_table = function() screens.smithing(); return true end
    use.loom = function() screens.loom(); return true end
    use.cartography_table = function() screens.cartography(); return true end
    use.grindstone = function(n) screens.grindstone(n); return true end
    use.anvil = function(n) screens.anvil(n); return true end
    use.enchanting_table = function(n) screens.enchanting(n); return true end
    use.beacon = function(n) screens.beacon(n); return true end
    use.brewing_stand = function(n) screens.brewing(n); world.vibrate(n.center, 10, {player = true}); return true end
    use.crafter = function(n) screens.crafter(n); world.vibrate(n.center, 10, {player = true}); return true end

    -- Beds: BedBlock.useWithoutItem -> ServerPlayer.startSleepInBed ------------------------------
    local function bedHead(n)
        if n.state.part == "head" then return n end
        return n.partner and world.nodes[n.partner] or n
    end
    local function standUp()
        local s = blocks.sleeping
        if not s then return end
        blocks.sleeping = nil
        if s.overlay then s.overlay:Destroy() end
        root.Anchored = false
        local head = s.bed
        if head and world.nodes[h.key(head.center)] == head then
            head.state.occupied = "false"
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(head.center + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.5 + root.Size.Y / 2 + 0.05, 0))
        else root.CFrame = s.oldCFrame end
    end
    blocks.standUp = standUp
    local function sleepOverlay()
        local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name, gui.IgnoreGuiInset, gui.DisplayOrder, gui.ResetOnSpawn = "SteveSleep", true, 50, false
        local dark = Instance.new("Frame")
        dark.Name, dark.BorderSizePixel, dark.Size, dark.BackgroundColor3, dark.BackgroundTransparency = "Fade", 0, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 16), 1
        dark.Parent = gui
        local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
        holder.Name, holder.BackgroundTransparency = "Gui", 1
        local scale = Instance.new("UIScale"); scale.Parent = holder
        holder.Parent = gui
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
        local s = JavaGui.scale(viewport)
        scale.Scale = s
        local w, ht = math.floor(viewport.X / s), math.floor(viewport.Y / s)
        holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, ht)
        -- InBedChatScreen: "Leave Bed" at (width/2 - 100, height - 40, 200, 20).
        local bg = JavaGui.slice(holder, JavaContent.data.javaGui["widget/button"], 3, math.floor(w / 2) - 100, ht - 40, 200, 20, 2)
        local text = L("multiplayer.stopSleeping")
        if text == "multiplayer.stopSleeping" then text = "Leave Bed" end
        JavaGui.text(holder, text, math.floor(w / 2) - math.floor(JavaGui.width(text) / 2), ht - 34, white, true, 3)
        local click = Instance.new("TextButton")
        click.BackgroundTransparency, click.Text, click.Position, click.Size, click.ZIndex = 1, "", UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(w / 2) - 100, ht - 40), UDim2.fromOffset(200, 20), 5
        click.Parent = holder
        click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(standUp)
        click.MouseEnter:Connect(function() screens.setSprite(bg, JavaContent.data.javaGui["widget/button_highlighted"]) end)
        click.MouseLeave:Connect(function() screens.setSprite(bg, JavaContent.data.javaGui["widget/button"]) end)
        gui.Parent = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        return gui, dark
    end
    use.bed = function(n)
        local head = bedHead(n)
        -- Too far: the player must be within 3 blocks of the bed (Player.bedInRange).
        local rel = (head.center - root.Position)
        if math.abs(rel.X) > 3.5 * B or math.abs(rel.Z) > 3.5 * B or math.abs(rel.Y) > 2.5 * B then actionBar(L("block.minecraft.bed.too_far_away")); return true end
        if head.state.occupied == "true" then actionBar(L("block.minecraft.bed.occupied")); return true end
        local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        local spawn = head.center - Vector3.new(0, B / 2, 0) + Vector3.new(0, B, 0)
