        local old = player:GetAttribute("SteveSpawnPoint")
        if typeof(old) ~= "Vector3" or (old - spawn).Magnitude > 0.1 then system(L("block.minecraft.set_spawn")) end
        player:SetAttribute("SteveSpawnPoint", spawn)
        local t = dayTime()
        if not (thundering() or (t >= 12542 and t <= 23459)) then actionBar(L("block.minecraft.bed.no_sleep")); return true end
        if not creative() then
            local api = world.gameplay
            for _, m in ipairs(api and api.mobs or {}) do
                local d = m.position - head.center
                if api.isHostile(m.id) and math.abs(d.X) <= 8 * B and math.abs(d.Z) <= 8 * B and math.abs(d.Y) <= 5 * B then
                    actionBar(L("block.minecraft.bed.not_safe")); return true
                end
            end
        end
        -- Lie down: head on the pillow, body along the bed (Player.startSleeping).
        head.state.occupied = "true"
        local facing = head.state.facing or "north"
        local overlay, dark = sleepOverlay()
        blocks.sleeping = {bed = head, ticks = 0, oldCFrame = root.CFrame, overlay = overlay, dark = dark}
        root.Anchored = true
        local look = dir(facing)
        root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(head.center + Vector3.new(0, -B / 2 + 9 / 16 * B + 0.15 * B, 0) - look * B * 0.1, head.center - look * B + Vector3.new(0, -B / 2 + 9 / 16 * B + 0.15 * B, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(-math.pi / 2, 0, 0)
        return true
    end
    local function sleepTick()
        local s = blocks.sleeping
        if not s then return end
        s.ticks = s.ticks + 1
        -- Gui.renderSleepOverlay: 0xDC101010 scaled by sleepTimer/100, fading out over 10 ticks after 100.
        local g = s.ticks / 100
        if g > 1 then g = 1 - (s.ticks - 100) / 10 end
        s.dark.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 220 / 255 * math.clamp(g, 0, 1)
        if s.ticks == 100 then
            -- ServerLevel: everyone asleep -> next morning, weather cleared.
            local c = chat()
            if c and c.setTime then local t = c.time or 0; c.setTime(t + 24000 - t % 24000) end
            if c and c.setWeather and c.weather ~= "clear" then c.setWeather("clear") end
        end
        if s.ticks >= 110 then standUp() end
    end

    -- Bell: BellBlock.isProperHit then ring (50 ticks of shaking) ------------------------------
    local function ring(n, direction)
        n.bellShake, n.bellDirection = 0, direction
        world.vibrate(n.center, 6, {player = true})
    end
    use.bell = function(n, _, _, hit)
        local face = hitFace(hit)
        if face == "up" or face == "down" then return false end
        local y = local01(n, hit).Y
        if y > 0.8124 then return false end
        local facing, attach = n.state.facing or "north", n.state.attachment or "floor"
        local axisFace = (face == "north" or face == "south") and "z" or "x"
        local axisFacing = (facing == "north" or facing == "south") and "z" or "x"
        if attach == "floor" and axisFace ~= axisFacing then return false end
        if (attach == "single_wall" or attach == "double_wall") and axisFace == axisFacing then return false end
        ring(n, face)
        return true
    end

    -- Cake and candle cakes ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function eatCake(n)
        local api = world.gameplay
        if not creative() and api and api.hunger >= 20 then return false end
        if api and not creative() then api.hunger = math.min(20, api.hunger + 2); api.saturation = math.min(api.hunger, (api.saturation or 0) + 0.4) end
        world.vibrate(n.center, 8, {player = true})
        local bites = tonumber(n.state.bites) or 0
        if bites < 6 then setState(n, {bites = tostring(bites + 1)})
        else world.setBlockAt(n.center, nil, nil, false); world.updateNeighbors() end
        return true
    end
    use.cake = function(n, s, item)
        if item and blockTag("candle_cakes", (item == "candle" and "candle_cake" or item .. "_cake")) and (tonumber(n.state.bites) or 0) == 0 then
            consume(1)
            replace(n, item == "candle" and "candle_cake" or item .. "_cake", {lit = "false"})
            return true
        end
        if s and not creative() and world.gameplay and world.gameplay.hunger >= 20 then return false end
        return eatCake(n)
    end
    use.candle_cake = function(n, s, item, hit)
        if item == "flint_and_steel" or item == "fire_charge" then
            if n.state.lit ~= "true" then setState(n, {lit = "true"}); if item == "flint_and_steel" then damageHeld(1) else consume(1) end end
            return true
        end
        -- CandleCakeBlock: a hit on the lit candle (above the cake top) puts it out.
        if n.state.lit == "true" and not s and local01(n, hit).Y > 0.5 then setState(n, {lit = "false"}); return true end
        if s then return false end
        local api = world.gameplay
        if not creative() and api and api.hunger >= 20 then return false end
        local candle = n.id:gsub("_cake$", "")
        dropAt(Recipes.stack(candle, 1), n.center)
        local cake = replace(n, "cake", {bites = "0"})
        return eatCake(cake)
    end

    -- Candles: add more (up to 4), light, put out ------------------------------------------------
    use.candle = function(n, s, item)
        if item == n.id and (tonumber(n.state.candles) or 1) < 4 then
            consume(1); setState(n, {candles = tostring((tonumber(n.state.candles) or 1) + 1)}); return true
        end
        if item == "flint_and_steel" or item == "fire_charge" then
            if n.state.lit ~= "true" and n.state.waterlogged ~= "true" then setState(n, {lit = "true"}); if item == "flint_and_steel" then damageHeld(1) else consume(1) end end
            return true
        end
        if not s and n.state.lit == "true" then setState(n, {lit = "false"}); return true end
        return false
    end

    -- Campfire: up to four raw foods cook on top (CampfireBlockEntity) ---------------------------
    local function campfireRecipe(stack)
        local name = Recipes.name(stack)
        for _, r in ipairs(JavaContent.data.recipes.cooking.campfire_cooking or {}) do if Recipes.matches(r.i, name) then return r end end
    end
    use.campfire = function(n, s, item)
        if item and item:match("_shovel$") and n.state.lit == "true" then
            setState(n, {lit = "false"}); damageHeld(1)
            for _ = 1, 20 do particle("campfire_cosy_smoke", n.center + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.4, 0), Vector3.new(0, B * 0.05, 0), {life = 60, size = 0.3}) end
            return true
        end
        if (item == "flint_and_steel" or item == "fire_charge") and n.state.lit ~= "true" then
            setState(n, {lit = "true"}); if item == "flint_and_steel" then damageHeld(1) else consume(1) end
            return true
        end
        local r = s and campfireRecipe(s)
        if r then
            n.campfire = n.campfire or {items = {}, time = {}, total = {}}
            for i = 1, 4 do
                if not n.campfire.items[i] then
                    n.campfire.items[i] = CreativeRules.withCount(s, 1)
                    n.campfire.time[i], n.campfire.total[i] = 0, r.t or 600
                    consume(1)
                    world.vibrate(n.center, 13, {player = true})
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        return false
    end

    -- Cauldrons (CauldronInteraction) -----------------------------------------------------------
    local function cauldronLevel(n) return tonumber(n.state.level) or (n.id == "lava_cauldron" and 3 or 0) end
    use.cauldron = function(n, s, item)
        if not item then return false end
        local id = n.id
        -- Fill with any bucket, whatever is inside (CauldronInteraction.addDefaultInteractions).
        local fills = {water_bucket = {"water_cauldron", "3"}, lava_bucket = {"lava_cauldron"}, powder_snow_bucket = {"powder_snow_cauldron", "3"}}
        local fill = fills[item]
        if fill then
            if not (id == fill[1] and cauldronLevel(n) == 3) then
                exchange(Recipes.stack("bucket", 1)); replace(n, fill[1], fill[2] and {level = fill[2]} or nil)
                world.vibrate(n.center, 13, {player = true})
            end
            return true
        end
        local level = cauldronLevel(n)
        local function lower(by)
            if level - by <= 0 then replace(n, "cauldron") else setState(n, {level = tostring(level - by)}) end
        end
        if item == "bucket" then
            local full = {water_cauldron = "water_bucket", lava_cauldron = "lava_bucket", powder_snow_cauldron = "powder_snow_bucket"}
            if full[id] and (id == "lava_cauldron" or level == 3) then exchange(Recipes.stack(full[id], 1)); replace(n, "cauldron"); world.vibrate(n.center, 12, {player = true}); return true end
            return false
        end
        if id == "cauldron" then
            if item == "potion" and (s.potion or "water") == "water" then
                exchange(Recipes.stack("glass_bottle", 1)); replace(n, "water_cauldron", {level = "1"}); return true
            end
            return false
        end
        if id ~= "water_cauldron" then return false end
        if item == "glass_bottle" then
            local water = Recipes.stack("potion", 1); water.potion = "water"
            exchange(water); lower(1); return true
        end
        if item == "potion" and (s.potion or "water") == "water" then
            if level < 3 then exchange(Recipes.stack("glass_bottle", 1)); setState(n, {level = tostring(level + 1)}) end
            return true
        end
        -- Washing: dyed leather, banner patterns, dyed shulker boxes.
        if s.dyed then
            local out = CreativeRules.withCount(s, s.count); out.dyed = nil
            inventory.slots[ui.selected] = out; ui.refresh(); lower(1); return true
        end
        if item:match("_banner$") and s.patterns and #s.patterns > 0 then
            local out = CreativeRules.withCount(s, 1)
            table.remove(out.patterns)
            if #out.patterns == 0 then out.patterns = nil end
            if creative() then give(out) else consume(1); give(out) end
            lower(1); return true
        end
        if item:match("_shulker_box$") then
            local out = CreativeRules.withCount(s, s.count); out.id = Recipes.index("shulker_box")
            inventory.slots[ui.selected] = out; ui.refresh(); lower(1); return true
        end
        return false
    end

    -- Berries -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    use.cave_vines = function(n)
        if n.state.berries ~= "true" then return false end
        dropAt(Recipes.stack("glow_berries", 1), n.center)
        setState(n, {berries = "false"})
        return true
    end
    use.sweet_berry_bush = function(n, _, item)
        local age = tonumber(n.state.age) or 0
        if age < 3 and item == "bone_meal" then return nil end
        if age <= 1 then return false end
        dropAt(Recipes.stack("sweet_berries", 1 + math.random(0, 1) + (age == 3 and 1 or 0)), n.center)
        setState(n, {age = "1"})
        return true
    end

    -- Chiseled bookshelf: six slots picked by where the front is hit ---------------------------
    local function faceCoords(n, hit, facing)
        local p = local01(n, hit)
        if facing == "north" then return 1 - p.X, p.Y elseif facing == "south" then return p.X, p.Y
        elseif facing == "west" then return p.Z, p.Y else return 1 - p.Z, p.Y end
    end
    local function section(x) if x < 0.375 then return 0 elseif x < 0.6875 then return 1 end return 2 end
    use.chiseled_bookshelf = function(n, s, item, hit)
        local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
        if hitFace(hit) ~= facing then return false end
        local x, y = faceCoords(n, hit, facing)
        local slot = section(x) + (y >= 0.5 and 0 or 3)
        n.books = n.books or {}
        local key = "slot_" .. slot .. "_occupied"
        if n.books[slot + 1] then
            give(n.books[slot + 1]); n.books[slot + 1] = nil
            n.lastBook = slot
            setState(n, {[key] = "false"})
            return true
        end
        if item and inTag("itemTags", "bookshelf_books", item) then
            n.books[slot + 1] = CreativeRules.withCount(s, 1)
            consume(1); n.lastBook = slot
            setState(n, {[key] = "true"})
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    -- Shelves: three slots across the front; powered shelves swap with the hotbar ---------------
    use.shelf = function(n, s, _, hit)
        local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
        if hitFace(hit) ~= facing then return false end
        n.shelf = n.shelf or {}
        if n.state.powered == "true" then
            -- Swap all three items with the hotbar slots around the selected one.
            local start = math.clamp(ui.selected - 1, 1, 7)
            for i = 0, 2 do
                local a = inventory.slots[start + i]
                inventory.slots[start + i] = n.shelf[i + 1]
                n.shelf[i + 1] = a
            end
            ui.refresh(); return true
        end
        local x = faceCoords(n, hit, facing)
        local slot = math.clamp(math.floor(x * 3), 0, 2) + 1
        local old = n.shelf[slot]
        if s then
            n.shelf[slot] = CreativeRules.withCount(s, s.count)
            inventory.slots[ui.selected] = old
        else
            if not old then return false end
            inventory.slots[ui.selected] = old; n.shelf[slot] = nil
        end
        ui.refresh()
        return true
    end

    -- Composter (ComposterBlock.insertItem / extractProduce) ------------------------------------
    use.composter = function(n, s, item)
        local level = tonumber(n.state.level) or 0
        if level == 8 then
            dropAt(Recipes.stack("bone_meal", 1), n.center + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.5, 0), Vector3.new(0, B * 2, 0))
            setState(n, {level = "0"})
            return true
        end
        local chance = item and (JavaContent.data.compostable or {})[item]
        if not chance or level >= 7 then return false end
        consume(1)
        if level == 0 or math.random() < chance then
            level = level + 1
            setState(n, {level = tostring(level)})
            if level == 7 then n.composterReady = world.tickCount + 20 end
        end
        for _ = 1, 10 do
            particle("composter", n.center + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8 * B, B * (0.1 + level / 16), (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8 * B), Vector3.zero, {life = 20, size = 0.1})
        end
        return true
    end

    -- Copper golem statue: right-click cycles its pose ----------------------------------------
    local poses = {"standing", "sitting", "running", "star"}
    use.statue = function(n, s)
        if s then return false end
        local current = n.state.copper_golem_pose or "standing"
        local index = 1
        for i, p in ipairs(poses) do if p == current then index = i end end
        setState(n, {copper_golem_pose = poses[index % #poses + 1]})
        return true
    end

    -- Daylight detector: toggle inverted -----------------------------------------------------
    use.daylight_detector = function(n)
        setState(n, {inverted = n.state.inverted == "true" and "false" or "true"})
        blocks.updateDaylight(n)
        return true
    end
    function blocks.updateDaylight(n)
        local i = 15 - skyDarken()
        local f = timeOfDay(dayTime()) * math.pi * 2
        if n.state.inverted == "true" then i = 15 - i
        elseif i > 0 then
            local g = f < math.pi and 0 or math.pi * 2
            f = f + (g - f) * 0.2
            i = math.floor(i * math.cos(f) + 0.5)
        end
        n.state.power = tostring(math.clamp(i, 0, 15))
    end

    -- Decorated pot: stores one stack and wobbles ----------------------------------------------
    use.decorated_pot = function(n, s)
        if s then
            local pot = n.potItem
            if not pot or (CreativeRules.sameItem(pot, s) and pot.count < (itemStackLimits[pot.id] or 64)) then
                if pot then pot.count = pot.count + 1 else n.potItem = CreativeRules.withCount(s, 1) end
                consume(1)
                n.wobble = {start = world.tickCount, positive = true}
                world.vibrate(n.center, 13, {player = true})
                return true
            end
        end
        n.wobble = {start = world.tickCount, positive = false}
        world.vibrate(n.center, 11, {player = true})
        return true
    end

    -- Dragon egg: teleports up to 15 blocks away (DragonEggBlock.teleport) --------------------
    use.dragon_egg = function(n)
        for _ = 1, 1000 do
            local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(0, 15) - math.random(0, 15), math.random(0, 7) - math.random(0, 7), math.random(0, 15) - math.random(0, 15)) * B
            local target = n.center + offset
            if offset.Magnitude > 0 and not world.sample(target) then
                local from = n.center
                local entry = JavaContent.byId.dragon_egg
                world.setBlockAt(from, nil, nil, false)
                world.setBlockAt(target, entry.index, CreativeRules.copy(entry.state))
                for i = 0, 127 do
                    local t = i / 127
                    particle("portal", from:Lerp(target, t) + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * B,
                        Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.2, {life = 30, size = 0.1})
                end
                world.updateNeighbors()
                return true
            end
        end
        return true
    end

    -- Flower pots -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local pottedNames = {azalea = "potted_azalea_bush", flowering_azalea = "potted_flowering_azalea_bush"}
    use.flower_pot = function(n, _, item)
        if not item then return true end
        local potted = pottedNames[item] or "potted_" .. item
        if not JavaContent.byId[potted] then return false end
        consume(1)
        replace(n, potted)
        return true
    end
    use.potted = function(n)
        local plant = n.id:gsub("^potted_", "")
        for k, v in pairs(pottedNames) do if v == n.id then plant = k end end
        local stack = Recipes.stack(plant, 1)
        if stack then give(stack) end
        replace(n, "flower_pot")
        return true
    end

    -- Jukebox -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function songOf(stack)
        local name = Recipes.name(stack)
        local song = name and name:match("^music_disc_(.+)$")
        return song and (JavaContent.data.jukeboxSongs or {})[song] and song or nil
    end
    -- A disc carrying its own audio (stack.song from The Verity Script): played at the jukebox.
    local function stopCustomSong(n)
        if n.customSong then pcall(function() n.customSong:Stop(); n.customSong.Parent:Destroy() end); n.customSong = nil end
    end
    local function playCustomSong(n, song)
        stopCustomSong(n)
        local emitter = Instance.new("Part")
        emitter.Name, emitter.Anchored, emitter.CanCollide, emitter.CanQuery, emitter.CanTouch, emitter.Transparency = "JukeboxSong", true, false, false, false, 1
        emitter.Size, emitter.Position = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), n.center
        emitter.Parent = workspace
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.SoundId, sound.Volume, sound.Looped = song.asset, 1, false
        -- Java: jukebox songs are heard within 64 blocks.
        sound.RollOffMode, sound.RollOffMinDistance, sound.RollOffMaxDistance = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear, 4 * B, 64 * B
        sound.Parent = emitter
        n.customSong = sound
        sound.Ended:Connect(function() if n.customSong == sound then n.customSongEnded = true end end)
        sound:Play()
    end
    _G.SteveMusicDisc = function(title, asset, position)
        local stack
        for _, name in ipairs({"music_disc_cat", "music_disc_13", "music_disc_blocks", "music_disc_chirp"}) do
            stack = Recipes.stack(name, 1)
            if stack then break end
        end
        if not stack then return false end
        stack.song = {title = tostring(title or "Verity"), asset = tostring(asset)}
        dropAt(stack, position, Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * B, B * 3, (math.random() - 0.5) * B))
        return true
    end
    local function eject(n)
        stopCustomSong(n)
        if not n.record then return end
        dropAt(n.record, n.center + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.6, 0), Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * B, B * 2, (math.random() - 0.5) * B))
        n.record, n.song, n.songStart = nil, nil, nil
        setState(n, {has_record = "false"})
    end
    use.jukebox = function(n, s)
        if n.record then eject(n); return true end
        if s and type(s.song) == "table" and s.song.asset then
            n.record = CreativeRules.withCount(s, 1)
            consume(1)
            n.song, n.songStart, n.customSongEnded = nil, nil, nil
            setState(n, {has_record = "true"})
            playCustomSong(n, s.song)
            blocks.nowPlaying = {text = T("record.nowPlaying", "Verity - " .. s.song.title), start = os.clock()}
            world.vibrate(n.center, 10, {player = true})
            return true
        end
        local song = s and songOf(s)
        if not song then return false end
        n.record = CreativeRules.withCount(s, 1)
        consume(1)
        n.song, n.songStart = song, world.tickCount
        setState(n, {has_record = "true"})
        -- Gui.setNowPlaying: "Now Playing: C418 - cat" in cycling rainbow colours.
        local info = JavaContent.data.jukeboxSongs[song]
        blocks.nowPlaying = {text = T("record.nowPlaying", L(info.key or ("jukebox_song.minecraft." .. song))), start = os.clock()}
        world.vibrate(n.center, 10, {player = true})
        return true
    end

    -- Note block ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local instruments = {
        {"basedrum", function(id) return id:match("stone") or id:match("ore$") or id:match("brick") or id:match("netherrack") or id:match("obsidian") or id:match("concrete$") or id:match("terracotta") or id:match("deepslate") or id:match("andesite") or id:match("diorite") or id:match("granite") or id:match("blackstone") or id:match("basalt") or id:match("quartz") or id:match("prismarine") or id:match("purpur") or id:match("nylium") or id == "bedrock" or id:match("coral_block$") end},
        {"snare", function(id) return id:match("sand$") or id == "gravel" or id:match("concrete_powder$") or id == "suspicious_sand" or id == "suspicious_gravel" end},
        {"hat", function(id) return id:match("glass") or id == "sea_lantern" or id == "beacon" or id == "conduit" end},
        {"bass", function(id) return id:match("planks$") or id:match("_log$") or id:match("_wood$") or id:match("_stem$") or id:match("hyphae$") or id == "bookshelf" or id == "chest" or id == "crafting_table" or id == "note_block" or id == "jukebox" or id:match("_fence$") or id:match("_door$") end},
        {"bell", function(id) return id == "gold_block" end}, {"flute", function(id) return id == "clay" or id == "infested_stone" end},
        {"chime", function(id) return id == "packed_ice" end}, {"guitar", function(id) return id:match("_wool$") end},
        {"xylophone", function(id) return id == "bone_block" end}, {"iron_xylophone", function(id) return id == "iron_block" end},
        {"cow_bell", function(id) return id == "soul_sand" end}, {"didgeridoo", function(id) return id == "pumpkin" or id == "carved_pumpkin" or id == "jack_o_lantern" end},
        {"bit", function(id) return id == "emerald_block" end}, {"banjo", function(id) return id == "hay_block" end},
        {"pling", function(id) return id == "glowstone" end}}
    local heads = {zombie_head = "zombie", skeleton_skull = "skeleton", creeper_head = "creeper", dragon_head = "dragon", wither_skeleton_skull = "wither_skeleton", piglin_head = "piglin", player_head = "custom_head"}
    local function instrumentFor(n)
        local above = neighbor(n, "up")
        if above and heads[above.id] then return heads[above.id] end
        local below = world.sample(n.center - Vector3.new(0, B, 0))
        if below then for _, pair in ipairs(instruments) do if pair[2](below.id) then return pair[1] end end end
        return "harp"
    end
    local function playNote(n)
        local above = neighbor(n, "up")
        if above and not heads[above.id] then return end
        n.state.instrument = instrumentFor(n)
        local note = tonumber(n.state.note) or 0
        -- NoteParticle colour from note / 24.
        local f = note / 24
        local function c(o) return math.max(0, math.sin((f + o) * math.pi * 2) * 0.65 + 0.35) end
        particle("note", n.center + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.7, 0), Vector3.new(0, B * 0.2, 0), {life = 6, size = 0.2, tint = {c(0), c(1 / 3), c(2 / 3)}})
        world.vibrate(n.center, 6, {player = true})
    end
    use.note_block = function(n, _, item)
        if item and (heads[item] or item:match("_head$") or item:match("_skull$")) then return nil end
        n.state.note = tostring(((tonumber(n.state.note) or 0) + 1) % 25)
        playNote(n)
        return true
    end

    -- Pumpkin + shears -> carved pumpkin and 4 seeds ---------------------------------------------
    use.pumpkin = function(n, _, item, hit)
        if item ~= "shears" then return false end
        local face = hitFace(hit)
        if face == "up" or face == "down" then
            local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
            if math.abs(look.X) > math.abs(look.Z) then face = look.X > 0 and "west" or "east" else face = look.Z > 0 and "north" or "south" end
        end
        local out = n.center + dir(face) * B * 0.65
        dropAt(Recipes.stack("pumpkin_seeds", 4), out, dir(face) * B * 1.5 + Vector3.new(0, B * 1.5, 0))
        damageHeld(1)
        replace(n, "carved_pumpkin", {facing = face})
        world.vibrate(n.center, 6, {player = true})
        return true
    end

    -- Redstone ore lights up when touched -------------------------------------------------------
    local function lightOre(n)
        if n.state.lit ~= "true" then n.state.lit = "true"; rebuild(n) end
        for _ = 1, 4 do
            local face = ({"north", "south", "east", "west", "up", "down"})[math.random(6)]
            particle("dust", n.center + dir(face) * B * 0.5625 + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.9 * Vector3.new(1 - math.abs(dir(face).X), 1 - math.abs(dir(face).Y), 1 - math.abs(dir(face).Z)),
                Vector3.zero, {life = 10, size = 0.1, tint = {1, 0, 0}})
        end
    end
    use.redstone_ore = function(n, s)
        lightOre(n)
        local e = s and JavaContent.byIndex[s.id]
        if e and not e.itemOnly and not toolStats[s.id] then return nil end
        return true
    end

    -- Redstone dust: a lone dot / cross toggles -------------------------------------------------
    use.redstone_wire = function(n, s)
        if s then return false end
        local isolated = true
        for _, other in ipairs(n.wireNeighbors or {}) do if other then isolated = false end end
        if not isolated then return false end
        n.dot = not n.dot
        for _, d in ipairs({"north", "east", "south", "west"}) do n.state[d] = n.dot and "none" or "side" end
        world.connectionsDirty = true
        rebuild(n)
        return true
    end

    -- Respawn anchor: charge with glowstone; outside the Nether it explodes ----------------------
    use.respawn_anchor = function(n, _, item)
        local charges = tonumber(n.state.charges) or 0
        if item == "glowstone" and charges < 4 then consume(1); setState(n, {charges = tostring(charges + 1)}); return true end
        if charges == 0 then return false end
        local center = n.center
        world.setBlockAt(center, nil, nil, false)
        world.updateNeighbors()
        if world.explode then world.explode(center) end
        return true
    end

    -- TNT with a fire charge (flint and steel is handled by the world) --------------------------
    use.tnt = function(n, _, item)
        if item == "fire_charge" then if world.prime(n) then consume(1) end; return true end
        return nil
    end

    -- Vault: a trial key unlocks it and it ejects its reward one item at a time ---------------
    use.vault = function(n, _, item)
        if n.state.vault_state ~= "active" then return false end
        local key = n.state.ominous == "true" and "ominous_trial_key" or "trial_key"
        if item ~= key then return false end
        consume(1)
        local loot = JavaContent.data.loot[n.state.ominous == "true" and "chests/trial_chambers/reward_ominous" or "chests/trial_chambers/reward"]
        n.vaultItems = {}
        for _, stack in ipairs(loot and LootRules.roll(loot, {player = true}) or {}) do
            local e = JavaContent.itemById[stack.name]
            if e then local out = {id = e.index, count = stack.count}; for k, v in pairs(stack.components or {}) do out[k] = v end; n.vaultItems[#n.vaultItems + 1] = out end
        end
        n.vaultNext = world.tickCount + 20
        setState(n, {vault_state = "unlocking"})
        return true
    end

    -- Beehive / bee nest harvest -----------------------------------------------------------------
    use.beehive = function(n, _, item)
        if (tonumber(n.state.honey_level) or 0) < 5 then return false end
        if item == "shears" then
            dropAt(Recipes.stack("honeycomb", 3), n.center + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.6, 0)); damageHeld(1)
        elseif item == "glass_bottle" then exchange(Recipes.stack("honey_bottle", 1))
        else return false end
        setState(n, {honey_level = "0"})
        return true
    end

    -- Light block: holding light cycles its level (creative) ------------------------------------
    use.light = function(n, _, item)
        if item ~= "light" or not creative() then return false end
        setState(n, {level = tostring(((tonumber(n.state.level) or 15) + 1) % 16)})
        return true
    end

    -- Lectern -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function lecternSignal(n)
        if not n.book then return 0 end
        local pages = #((n.book.book or {}).pages or {})
        local f = pages > 1 and ((n.page or 1) - 1) / (pages - 1) or 1
        return math.floor(f * 14) + 1
    end
    use.lectern = function(n, s, item)
        if not n.book then
            if item == "written_book" or item == "writable_book" then
                n.book = CreativeRules.withCount(s, 1); n.page = 1
                consume(1)
                setState(n, {has_book = "true"})
                return true
            end
            return false
        end
        screens.book({pages = (n.book.book or {}).pages or {""}, page = n.page,
            onPage = function(page)
                if page ~= n.page then n.page = page; n.pulse = world.tickCount end
            end,
            takeBook = function()
                give(n.book); n.book = nil; n.page = nil
                setState(n, {has_book = "false"})
            end})
        return true
    end

    -- Signs: edit screen, dyes, glow ink, honeycomb wax --------------------------------------
    local function signSide(n)
        -- SignBlockEntity.isFacingFrontText: compare the player's position with the sign's facing.
        local front = CFrame.Angles(0, frontYaw(n), 0):VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
        local toPlayer = root.Position - (world.renderPosition and world.renderPosition(n.center) or n.center)
        return front:Dot(toPlayer) >= 0 and "front" or "back"
    end
    local function newSign() return {front = {lines = {"", "", "", ""}, color = "black", glowing = false}, back = {lines = {"", "", "", ""}, color = "black", glowing = false}} end
    function blocks.editSign(n, sideName)
        n.sign = n.sign or newSign()
        local side = n.sign[sideName]
        local wood = n.id:gsub("_wall_hanging_sign$", ""):gsub("_hanging_sign$", ""):gsub("_wall_sign$", ""):gsub("_sign$", "")
        screens.sign(n, side, wood, n.id:match("hanging_sign$") ~= nil, function() drawSign(n) end)
    end
    use.sign = function(n, s, item)
        n.sign = n.sign or newSign()
        local sideName = signSide(n)
        local side = n.sign[sideName]
        local any = false
        for _, l in ipairs(side.lines) do if l ~= "" then any = true end end
        if n.sign.waxed then return true end
        local dye = item and item:match("^(.+)_dye$")
        if dye and any then if side.color ~= dye then side.color = dye; consume(1); drawSign(n) end; return true end
        if item == "glow_ink_sac" and any then if not side.glowing then side.glowing = true; consume(1); drawSign(n) end; return true end
        if item == "ink_sac" and any then if side.glowing then side.glowing = false; consume(1); drawSign(n) end; return true end
        if item == "honeycomb" then n.sign.waxed = true; consume(1); return true end
        blocks.editSign(n, sideName)
        return true
    end

    -- Operator blocks: command, structure, jigsaw, test ------------------------------------------
    use.command_block = function(n) if not creative() then return false end; screens.command(n); return true end
    use.structure_block = function(n) if not creative() then return false end; screens.structure(n); return true end
    use.jigsaw = function(n) if not creative() then return false end; screens.jigsaw(n); return true end
    use.test_block = function(n) if not creative() then return false end; screens.testBlock(n); return true end
    use.test_instance_block = function(n) if not creative() then return false end; screens.testInstance(n); return true end

    function blocks.use(hit, sneaking)
        if blocks.sleeping then return true end
        -- sneaking with a block in hand places it instead of using the block (MultiPlayerGameMode.performUseItemOn:
        -- isSecondaryUseActive with an item skips the block); tools (wrench, glue, staff) still act while sneaking
        local placing = false
        if sneaking then
            local hs = held()
            local ie = hs and JavaContent.byIndex[JavaContent.itemIndex(hs.id)]
            placing = ie and not ie.itemOnly and true or false
        end
        if not placing and JavaContent.mods.useBlock then
            local okU, used = pcall(JavaContent.mods.useBlock, hit, sneaking)
            if okU and used ~= nil then return used end
        end
        if not placing then
            for _, m in ipairs(JavaContent.mods.list) do
                if m.enabled and m.useBlock then
                    local okU, used = pcall(m.useBlock, hit, sneaking)
                    if okU and used ~= nil then return used end
                end
            end
        end
        local n = world.resolve(hit.Instance)
        if not n then return nil end
        local kind = kindOf(n.id)
        local handler = kind and use[kind]
        if not handler then return nil end
        local s = held()
        local item = s and Recipes.name(s)
        -- Sneaking with something in hand skips the block (MultiPlayerGameMode.performUseItemOn).
        if sneaking and s then return nil end
        local result = handler(n, s, item, hit)
        if result == false then return nil end
        return result
    end

    -- Placing and breaking ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    function blocks.placed(n, stack)
        if not n then return end
        local id = n.id
        if id:match("_banner$") or id:match("_wall_banner$") then
            n.patterns = stack and stack.patterns and CreativeRules.copy(stack.patterns) or nil
            if not id:match("_wall_") then
                -- RotationSegment.convertToSegment(player yaw + 180)
                local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
                local yaw = math.deg(math.atan2(-look.X, look.Z))
                n.state.rotation = tostring(math.floor((yaw + 180) * 16 / 360 + 0.5) % 16)
                rebuild(n)
            end
        elseif id:match("_sign$") then
            n.sign = newSign()
            blocks.editSign(n, "front")
        elseif id == "decorated_pot" and stack and stack.sherds then n.sherds = CreativeRules.copy(stack.sherds)
        elseif id == "beacon" then n.beacon = {} end
    end
    -- Contents that drop when the block breaks; returns true when the item drop was handled here.
    function blocks.broken(n, harvest)
        local center = n.center
        if n.books then for _, b in pairs(n.books) do dropAt(b, center) end end
        if n.shelf then for _, b in pairs(n.shelf) do dropAt(b, center) end end
        if n.campfire then for _, b in pairs(n.campfire.items) do dropAt(b, center) end end
        if n.record then dropAt(n.record, center) end
        stopCustomSong(n)
        if n.book then dropAt(n.book, center) end
        if n.potItem then dropAt(n.potItem, center) end
        if blocks.sleeping and (blocks.sleeping.bed == n or (n.partner and world.nodes[n.partner] == blocks.sleeping.bed)) then standUp() end
        clearExtra(n)
        -- Banners and decorated pots keep their patterns / sherds (copy_components).
        if harvest and (n.patterns or n.sherds) then
            local item = n.id:gsub("_wall_banner$", "_banner")
            local stack = Recipes.stack(item, 1)
            if stack then stack.patterns = n.patterns; stack.sherds = n.sherds; dropAt(stack, center) end
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    -- Ticks -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function tryCraft(n)
        -- CrafterBlock.dispenseFrom: craft once, eject the result out of the front.
        local storage = n.storage
        if not storage then return end
        local grid = {}
        for i = 1, 9 do grid[i] = storage.slots[i] end
        local result, _, keep = Recipes.craft(grid, 3, 3)
        if not result then
            particle("smoke", n.center, Vector3.zero, {life = 10, size = 0.15})
            return
        end
        local front = (n.state.orientation or "north_up"):match("^(%a+)_") or "north"
        local target = neighbor(n, front)
        local remainders = {}
        Recipes.consume(storage.slots, 9, keep, function(r) remainders[#remainders + 1] = r end)
        local function eject(stack)
            if target and target.storage and world.machines and world.machines.insert then
                if world.machines.insert(target, stack, opposite[front]) then return end
            end
            dropAt(stack, n.center + dir(front) * B * 0.7, dir(front) * B * 2)
        end
        eject(result)
        for _, r in ipairs(remainders) do eject(r) end
        n.state.crafting = "true"; n.craftingUntil = world.tickCount + 6
        world.vibrate(n.center, 11, {})
    end
    local function brewTick(n)
        -- BrewingStandBlockEntity.serverTick
        local slots = n.storage and n.storage.slots
        if not slots then return end
        n.fuel = n.fuel or 0
        n.brewTime = n.brewTime or 0
        local fuelItem = slots[5]
        if n.fuel <= 0 and fuelItem and Recipes.name(fuelItem) == "blaze_powder" then
            n.fuel = 20; fuelItem.count = fuelItem.count - 1
            if fuelItem.count <= 0 then slots[5] = nil end
        end
        local ingredient = slots[4]
        local brewable = false
        if ingredient then for i = 1, 3 do if slots[i] and Recipes.brew(slots[i], ingredient) then brewable = true end end end
        if n.brewTime > 0 then
            n.brewTime = n.brewTime - 1
            if n.brewTime == 0 and brewable then
                for i = 1, 3 do local out = slots[i] and Recipes.brew(slots[i], ingredient); if out then slots[i] = out end end
                local rest = Recipes.remainder(Recipes.name(ingredient))
                ingredient.count = ingredient.count - 1
                if ingredient.count <= 0 then slots[4] = rest and Recipes.stack(rest, 1) or nil
                elseif rest then dropAt(Recipes.stack(rest, 1), n.center + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.6, 0)) end
                world.vibrate(n.center, 11, {})
            elseif not brewable or not ingredient or Recipes.name(ingredient) ~= n.brewIngredient then n.brewTime = 0 end
        elseif brewable and n.fuel > 0 then
            n.fuel = n.fuel - 1; n.brewTime = 400; n.brewIngredient = Recipes.name(ingredient)
        end
        for i = 1, 3 do n.state["has_bottle_" .. (i - 1)] = tostring(slots[i] ~= nil) end
    end
    local beaconBases
    local function beaconLevels(n)
        beaconBases = beaconBases or {}
        if not next(beaconBases) then for _, id in ipairs(JavaContent.data.blockTags.beacon_base_blocks or {}) do beaconBases[id] = true end end
        local levels = 0
        for l = 1, 4 do
            for dx = -l, l do for dz = -l, l do
                local b = world.sample(n.center + Vector3.new(dx, -l, dz) * B)
                if not b or not beaconBases[b.id] then return levels end
            end end
            levels = l
        end
        return levels
    end
    local function beaconBeam(n, on)
        local e = extra(n)
        if on and not e.beam then
            local beam = Instance.new("Part")
            beam.Name, beam.Anchored, beam.CanCollide, beam.CanQuery, beam.CanTouch, beam.CastShadow = "BeaconBeam", true, false, false, false, false
            beam.Material, beam.Color, beam.Transparency = Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.15
            beam.Size = Vector3.new(0.4 * B, 320 * B, 0.4 * B)
            beam.CFrame = CFrame.new(n.center + Vector3.new(0, 160 * B + B / 2, 0))
            local glow = beam:Clone()
            glow.Name, glow.Transparency, glow.Size = "BeaconGlow", 0.8, Vector3.new(0.5 * B, 320 * B, 0.5 * B)
            glow.Parent = folder
            beam.Parent = folder
            e.beam, e.glow = beam, glow
        elseif not on and e.beam then e.beam:Destroy(); e.glow:Destroy(); e.beam, e.glow = nil, nil end
    end
    local function beaconTick(n)
        if world.tickCount % 80 ~= (n.beaconPhase or 0) then return end
        n.beaconPhase = n.beaconPhase or world.tickCount % 80
        n.beacon = n.beacon or {}
        local data = n.beacon
        data.levels = beaconLevels(n)
        beaconBeam(n, data.levels > 0)
        -- BeaconBlockEntity.applyEffects: (levels*10+10) block radius, (9+levels*2)*20 ticks.
        local fx = world.statusEffects
        if data.levels > 0 and data.primary and fx then
            local range = data.levels * 10 + 10
            local d = root.Position - (world.renderPosition and world.renderPosition(n.center) or n.center)
            if math.abs(d.X) <= range * B and math.abs(d.Z) <= range * B then
                local seconds = (9 + data.levels * 2)
                local amp = (data.levels >= 4 and data.primary == data.secondary) and 1 or 0
                fx.give(data.primary, seconds, amp, true)
                if data.levels >= 4 and data.secondary and data.secondary ~= data.primary then fx.give(data.secondary, seconds, 0, true) end
            end
        end
    end
    local function commandTick(n)
        local cb = n.command
        if not cb then return end
        local powered = (n.input or 0) > 0
        local active = powered or cb.auto
        if n.id == "repeating_command_block" then
            if active then blocks.runCommand(n) end
        elseif n.id == "command_block" then
            if active and not cb.wasActive then blocks.runCommand(n) end
        end
        cb.wasActive = active
    end
    function blocks.runCommand(n, depth)
        local cb = n.command
        if not cb or cb.text == "" then return false end
        depth = depth or 0
        if depth > 64 then return false end
        -- Conditional blocks only run when the block behind them succeeded last time.
        local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
        if n.state.conditional == "true" then
            local behind = neighbor(n, opposite[facing])
            if not (behind and behind.command and (behind.command.success or 0) > 0) then cb.success = 0; return false end
        end
        local c = chat()
        local ok = 0
        if c and c.run then
            local text = cb.text:gsub("^/", "")
            local result = c.run(text, c.blockSource and c.blockSource(n.center) or (c.selfSource and c.selfSource()) or nil)
            ok = type(result) == "number" and result or 0
        end
        cb.success = ok
        cb.output = os.date("[%H:%M:%S] ") .. (ok > 0 and "Command run" or "Command failed")
        -- Chain command blocks in front run next.
        local front = neighbor(n, facing)
        if front and front.id == "chain_command_block" and front.command and ((front.input or 0) > 0 or front.command.auto) then blocks.runCommand(front, depth + 1) end
        return ok > 0
    end
    local function vaultTick(n)
        if n.state.vault_state == "unlocking" and world.tickCount >= (n.vaultNext or 0) then
            setState(n, {vault_state = "ejecting"}); n.vaultNext = world.tickCount + 20
        elseif n.state.vault_state == "ejecting" and world.tickCount >= (n.vaultNext or 0) then
            local item = table.remove(n.vaultItems or {}, 1)
            if item then
                local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
                dropAt(item, n.center + dir(facing) * B * 0.6 + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.2, 0), dir(facing) * B * 2 + Vector3.new(0, B * 1.5, 0))
                n.vaultNext = world.tickCount + 20
            else setState(n, {vault_state = "inactive"}) end
        end
    end
    -- Which tick / render branch a block needs, worked out once per placed block.
    local tickIds = {brewing_stand = true, crafter = true, beacon = true, composter = true, jukebox = true, note_block = true, bell = true,
        daylight_detector = true, lectern = true, chiseled_bookshelf = true, cake = true, respawn_anchor = true, decorated_pot = true,
        vault = true, enchanting_table = true}
    local function tickKind(id)
        if tickIds[id] then return id end
        if id == "campfire" or id == "soul_campfire" then return "campfire" end
        if id:match("cauldron$") then return "cauldron" end
        if id:match("candle_cake$") then return "candle_cake" end
        if id == "redstone_ore" or id == "deepslate_redstone_ore" then return "redstone_ore" end
        if id == "command_block" or id == "repeating_command_block" then return "command" end
        return false
    end
    local function renderKind(id)
        if id == "bell" or id == "enchanting_table" or id == "lectern" then return id end
        if id:match("_banner$") then return "banner" end
        if id:match("_sign$") then return "sign" end
        if id == "campfire" or id == "soul_campfire" then return "campfire" end
        if id:match("_shelf$") then return "shelf" end
        return false
    end
    function blocks.tick(nodes)
        sleepTick()
        for _, n in ipairs(nodes) do
            local id = n.tickKind
            if id == nil then id = tickKind(n.id); n.tickKind = id end
            if not id then
            elseif id == "brewing_stand" then brewTick(n)
            elseif id == "crafter" then
                local powered = (n.input or 0) > 0
                if powered and not n.triggered then n.triggered = true; n.state.triggered = "true"; n.craftAt = world.tickCount + 4
                elseif not powered and n.triggered then n.triggered = false; n.state.triggered = "false" end
                if n.craftAt and world.tickCount >= n.craftAt then n.craftAt = nil; tryCraft(n) end
                if n.craftingUntil and world.tickCount >= n.craftingUntil then n.craftingUntil = nil; n.state.crafting = "false" end
                -- Comparator: filled or disabled slots.
                local count = 0
                for i = 1, 9 do if (n.storage and n.storage.slots[i]) or (n.disabledSlots and n.disabledSlots[i]) then count = count + 1 end end
                n.comparatorStrength = count
            elseif id == "beacon" then beaconTick(n)
            elseif id == "campfire" then
                local c = n.campfire
                if c then
                    for i = 1, 4 do
                        if c.items[i] then
                            if n.state.lit == "true" then
                                c.time[i] = c.time[i] + 1
                                if c.time[i] >= c.total[i] then
                                    local r = campfireRecipe(c.items[i])
                                    if r then dropAt(Recipes.stack(r.r, r.c or 1), n.center + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.5, 0), Vector3.new(0, B, 0)) end
                                    c.items[i] = nil
                                end
                            else c.time[i] = math.max(0, c.time[i] - 2) end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if n.state.lit == "true" and math.random() < 0.11 then
                    particle("campfire_cosy_smoke", n.center + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.66, B * 0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.66), Vector3.new(0, B * 0.07, 0), {life = 120, size = 0.4})
                end
            elseif id == "composter" then
                if n.composterReady and world.tickCount >= n.composterReady then n.composterReady = nil; n.state.level = "8" end
                n.comparatorStrength = tonumber(n.state.level) or 0
            elseif id == "cauldron" then n.comparatorStrength = cauldronLevel(n)
            elseif id == "jukebox" then
                if n.song then
                    local info = JavaContent.data.jukeboxSongs[n.song]
                    local playing = world.tickCount - n.songStart < info.length * 20
                    n.signal = playing and 15 or 0
                    n.comparatorStrength = info.output
                    if playing and (world.tickCount - n.songStart) % 20 == 0 then
                        particle("note", n.center + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.7, 0), Vector3.new(0, B * 0.2, 0), {life = 6, size = 0.2, tint = {math.random(), math.random(), math.random()}})
                    end
                elseif n.customSong then
                    local playing = n.customSong.IsPlaying and not n.customSongEnded
                    n.signal = playing and 15 or 0
                    n.comparatorStrength = playing and 15 or 0
                    if playing and world.tickCount % 20 == 0 then
                        particle("note", n.center + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.7, 0), Vector3.new(0, B * 0.2, 0), {life = 6, size = 0.2, tint = {math.random(), math.random(), math.random()}})
                    end
                else n.signal = 0; n.comparatorStrength = 0 end
            elseif id == "note_block" then
                local powered = (n.input or 0) > 0
                if powered and not n.notePowered then playNote(n) end
                n.notePowered = powered
            elseif id == "bell" then
                local powered = (n.input or 0) > 0
                if powered and not n.bellPowered then ring(n, n.state.facing or "north") end
                n.bellPowered = powered
                if n.bellShake then n.bellShake = n.bellShake + 1; if n.bellShake >= 50 then n.bellShake = nil end end
            elseif id == "daylight_detector" then
                if world.tickCount % 20 == 0 then blocks.updateDaylight(n) end
            elseif id == "lectern" then
                n.comparatorStrength = lecternSignal(n)
                n.signal = n.pulse and world.tickCount - n.pulse < 2 and 15 or 0
                n.state.powered = tostring(n.signal > 0)
            elseif id == "chiseled_bookshelf" then n.comparatorStrength = n.lastBook and n.lastBook + 1 or 0
            elseif id == "cake" then n.comparatorStrength = (7 - (tonumber(n.state.bites) or 0)) * 2
            elseif id == "candle_cake" then n.comparatorStrength = 14
            elseif id == "respawn_anchor" then n.comparatorStrength = math.floor((tonumber(n.state.charges) or 0) / 4 * 15)
            elseif id == "decorated_pot" then n.comparatorStrength = n.potItem and math.floor(1 + n.potItem.count / (itemStackLimits[n.potItem.id] or 64) * 14) or 0
            elseif id == "redstone_ore" then
                local d = root.Position - (world.renderPosition and world.renderPosition(n.center) or n.center)
                if math.abs(d.X) < B * 0.5 and math.abs(d.Z) < B * 0.5 and d.Y > 0 and d.Y < B * 1.6 then lightOre(n) end
                if n.state.lit == "true" and math.random() < 3 / 4096 then n.state.lit = "false" end
            elseif id == "vault" then vaultTick(n)
            elseif id == "command" then commandTick(n)
            elseif id == "enchanting_table" then
                -- EnchantingTableBlockEntity.bookAnimationTick
                local d = root.Position - (world.renderPosition and world.renderPosition(n.center) or n.center)
                n.book3d = n.book3d or {open = 0, oOpen = 0, flip = 0, oFlip = 0, flipT = 0, flipA = 0, rot = 0, oRot = 0, tRot = 0, time = 0}
                local b = n.book3d
                b.oOpen, b.oRot, b.oFlip = b.open, b.rot, b.flip
                b.time = b.time + 1
                if d.Magnitude < 3 * B then
                    b.tRot = math.atan2(d.Z, d.X)
                    b.open = b.open + 0.1
                    if b.open < 0.5 or math.random(40) == 1 then
                        local f = b.flipT
                        repeat b.flipT = b.flipT + math.random(-4, 4) until f ~= b.flipT
                    end
                else
                    b.tRot = b.tRot + 0.02
                    b.open = b.open - 0.1
                end
                while b.rot >= math.pi do b.rot = b.rot - math.pi * 2 end
                while b.rot < -math.pi do b.rot = b.rot + math.pi * 2 end
                while b.tRot >= math.pi do b.tRot = b.tRot - math.pi * 2 end
                while b.tRot < -math.pi do b.tRot = b.tRot + math.pi * 2 end
                local g = b.tRot - b.rot
                while g >= math.pi do g = g - math.pi * 2 end
                while g < -math.pi do g = g + math.pi * 2 end
                b.rot = b.rot + g * 0.4
                b.open = math.clamp(b.open, 0, 1)
                local i = math.clamp((b.flipT - b.flip) * 0.4, -0.2, 0.2)
                b.flipA = b.flipA + (i - b.flipA) * 0.9
                b.flip = b.flip + b.flipA
            end
        end
    end

    -- Frame rendering: bell swing, books, banners, signs, items on blocks, now-playing ----------
    local function renderItems(n, list, count, place)
        local e = extra(n)
        e.items = e.items or {}
        for i = 1, count do
            local stack = list[i]
            local view = e.items[i]
            if stack and (not view or view.id ~= stack.id) then
                if view then view.model:Destroy() end
                view = itemModel(stack.id, B * 0.375, n.center)
                view.id = stack.id
                if world.bindPhysicsVisual then world.bindPhysicsVisual(n,view) end
                e.items[i] = view
            elseif not stack and view then view.model:Destroy(); e.items[i] = nil; view = nil end
            if view then view.pivot(place(i) * view.offset) end
        end
    end
    function blocks.physicsExtras()
        for n,e in pairs(extras) do
            local t=n.physicsOwner and n.physicsOwner.T
            if t then
                e.physicsParts=e.physicsParts or {}
                for _,v in pairs(e) do
                    if typeof(v)=="Instance" and v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Parent then
                        local saved=e.physicsParts[v]
                        if not saved or v.CFrame~=saved.drawn then
                            local cf=v.CFrame
                            if (cf.Position-n.center).Magnitude>64*B then cf=t:Inverse()*cf end
                            saved={localFrame=cf};e.physicsParts[v]=saved
                        end
                        v.CFrame=t*saved.localFrame;saved.drawn=v.CFrame
                    elseif type(v)=="table" and v.model and v.physicsRefresh then v.physicsRefresh() end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function blocks.render(partial)
        local now = world.tickCount + partial
        for n in pairs(extras) do
            if world.nodes[h.key(n.center)] ~= n then clearExtra(n) end
        end
        for _, n in pairs(world.nodes) do
            local id = n.renderKind
            if id == nil then id = renderKind(n.id); n.renderKind = id end
            if not id then
            elseif id == "bell" then
                local v = ensureModel(n, "bell", "block_bell")
                if v then
                    -- BellModel.setupAnim: sin(t / pi) / (4 + t / 3) towards the struck side.
                    local x, z = 0, 0
                    if n.bellShake then
                        local t = n.bellShake + partial
                        local i = math.sin(t / math.pi) / (4 + t / 3)
                        local d = n.bellDirection
                        if d == "north" then x = -i elseif d == "south" then x = i elseif d == "east" then z = -i elseif d == "west" then z = i end
                    end
                    v.pivot(CFrame.new(bottom(n)), nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, {bell_body = {x = x, z = z}})
                end
            elseif id == "enchanting_table" and n.book3d then
                local v = ensureModel(n, "book", "block_book")
                if v then
                    -- EnchantTableRenderer
                    local b = n.book3d
                    local t = b.time + partial
                    local rot = b.oRot + (b.rot - b.oRot) * partial
                    local open = b.oOpen + (b.open - b.oOpen) * partial
                    local flip = b.oFlip + (b.flip - b.oFlip) * partial
                    local j = math.clamp(((flip + 0.25) % 1) * 1.6 - 0.3, 0, 1)
                    local k = math.clamp(((flip + 0.75) % 1) * 1.6 - 0.3, 0, 1)
                    local frame = CFrame.new(bottom(n) + Vector3.new(0, (0.75 + 0.1 + math.sin(t * 0.1) * 0.01) * B, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, -rot, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(80))
                    v.pivot(frame, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, screens.bookPose(t, j, k, open))
                end
            elseif id == "lectern" then
                local v = n.book and ensureModel(n, "book", "block_book")
                local e = extras[n]
                if v then
                    -- LecternRenderer: (0.5, 1.0625, 0.5), facing, 67.5 degrees, open book.
                    local yaw = ({north = 0, east = -math.pi / 2, south = math.pi, west = math.pi / 2})[n.state.facing or "north"] + math.pi / 2
                    local frame = CFrame.new(bottom(n) + Vector3.new(0, 1.0625 * B, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(67.5)) * CFrame.new(0, -0.125 * B, 0)
                    v.pivot(frame, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, screens.bookPose(0, 0.1, 0.9, 1.2))
                elseif e and e.book then e.book.model:Destroy(); e.book = nil end
            elseif id == "banner" and n.visual and n.visual.bones then
                -- BannerRenderer: the flag sways, (-0.0125 + 0.01 * cos(2pi * t / 100)) * pi.
                local angle = (-0.0125 + 0.01 * math.cos(math.pi * 2 * ((now + (n.center.X * 7 + n.center.Z * 13)) % 100) / 100)) * math.pi
                n.visual.pivot(CFrame.new(n.center), nil, nil, {flag = {x = angle}})
                bannerOverlay(n, n.visual)
                local e = extras[n]
                for _, bone in ipairs(n.visual.bones) do
                    if bone.name == "flag" and bone.frame and e then
                        local s = (2 / 3) / 16 * B
                        e.bannerFront.CFrame = bone.frame * CFrame.new(0, -20 * s, 2.02 * s)
                        e.bannerBack.CFrame = bone.frame * CFrame.new(0, -20 * s, 0.98 * s)
                    end
                end
            elseif id == "sign" and n.sign then
                local e = extra(n)
                if not e.signFront and not e.signBack and not e.signDrawn then e.signDrawn = true; drawSign(n) end
            elseif id == "campfire" and n.campfire then
                -- CampfireRenderer: items lie flat at y 0.449, 0.3125 out from the centre, by facing.
                local facingIndex = ({south = 0, west = 1, north = 2, east = 3})[n.state.facing or "north"] or 0
                renderItems(n, n.campfire.items, 4, function(i)
                    local yaw = -((i - 1 + facingIndex) % 4) * math.pi / 2
                    return CFrame.new(bottom(n) + Vector3.new(0, 0.44921875 * B, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi / 2, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(-0.3125 * B, -0.3125 * B, 0)
                end)
            elseif id == "shelf" and n.shelf then
                local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
                local yaw = ({north = math.pi, east = math.pi / 2, south = 0, west = -math.pi / 2})[facing]
                renderItems(n, n.shelf, 3, function(i)
                    return CFrame.new(n.center) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.new(((i - 2) * 0.3125) * B, 0, 0.25 * B)
                end)
            end
        end
        -- Gui.renderNowPlaying-style overlay message, rainbow coloured for 3 seconds.
        if blocks.nowPlaying then
            local np = blocks.nowPlaying
            local age = os.clock() - np.start
            if age < 3 then actionBar(np.text, Color3.fromHSV((age * 50 / 20 / 50) % 1, 0.7, 0.6 + 0.4)) else blocks.nowPlaying = nil end
        end
    end
    function blocks.destroy()
        standUp()
        for n in pairs(extras) do clearExtra(n) end
        folder:Destroy()
    end
    return blocks
end
-- END BLOCK USES
-- BEGIN ITEM USES
-- Item.use / useOn / releaseUsing / interactLivingEntity for every interactive 26.3 item that the
-- older code did not cover: throwables (snowball, eggs, ender pearl, potions, experience bottle,
-- wind charge, trident), consumables with their effects, crossbow, fishing rod, goat horn, brush,
-- bundle, maps, books, bone meal, waxing / scraping, item frames, armor stands, paintings, end
-- crystals, leads, name tags, saddles, shears, dyes, buckets of mobs, fireworks, XP orbs, cooldowns
-- and the totem of undying. Java's order: entity interaction, block use, Item.useOn, Item.use.
local function createItemUses(world, h)
    local B = CONFIG.Block
    local root, character, ui, inventory, effects, screens = h.root, h.character, h.ui, h.inventory, h.effects, h.screens
    local items = {projectiles = {}, orbs = {}, entities = {}, clouds = {}, rockets = {}, cooldowns = {}, using = nil, maps = {}, nextMap = 0}
    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name, folder.Parent = "SteveItemEntities", workspace
    local white = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    local function L(key) return (JavaContent.data.lang or {})[key] or key end
    local function creative() return not CONFIG.Survival end
    local function api() return world.gameplay end
    local function fx() return world.statusEffects end
    local function held() return inventory.slots[ui.selected] end
    local function nameOf(stack) return Recipes.name(stack) end
    local function stackOf(name, count) return Recipes.stack(name, count) end
    local function give(stack)
        if not stack or stack.count <= 0 then return end
        local added = inventory.add(stack.id, stack.count, nil, stack.damage, stack)
        if added < stack.count then world.drop(CreativeRules.withCount(stack, stack.count - added)) end
        ui.refresh()
    end
    local function consume(n)
        if creative() then return true end
        local s = held()
        if not s or s.count < (n or 1) then return false end
        s.count = s.count - (n or 1)
        if s.count <= 0 then inventory.slots[ui.selected] = nil end
        ui.refresh()
        return true
    end
    -- ItemUtils.createFilledResult
    local function exchange(result)
        local s = held()
        if creative() then
            for _, v in pairs(inventory.slots) do if CreativeRules.sameItem(v, result) then return end end
            give(result); return
        end
        if s and s.count == 1 then inventory.slots[ui.selected] = result; ui.refresh() else consume(1); give(result) end
    end
    local function damageHeld(amount) local s = held(); if s then world.damageTool(s.id, amount or 1, s) end end
    local function swing() if world.swing then world.swing() end end
    local function particle(kind, position, velocity, options) effects.emit(kind, position, velocity or Vector3.zero, options) end
    local function eye() return world.eye and world.eye() or root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.62 * B, 0) end
    local function look() return world.look and world.look() or root.CFrame.LookVector end
    -- Adds to the player's motion in blocks per tick (Entity.push).
    local function impulse(v) if world.knockback then world.knockback(v) end end
    local function actionBar(text) if world.chat then world.chat.showTitle("actionbar", {{text = text, color = white}}) end end
    local function iconSprite(index) local e = JavaContent.byIndex[index]; return e and e.icon end

    -- Cooldowns (ItemCooldowns) ------------------------------------------------------------------
    function items.onCooldown(stack)
        local n = stack and nameOf(stack)
        local c = n and items.cooldowns[n]
        if not c then return 0 end
        local f = (c.finish - (world.tickCount + (world.partial or 0))) / (c.finish - c.start)
        return math.clamp(f, 0, 1)
    end
    local function cooldown(name, ticks) items.cooldowns[name] = {start = world.tickCount, finish = world.tickCount + ticks} end
    JavaContent.cooldown = items.onCooldown
    -- Item model properties for icons: compass / recovery compass needles, clock face, pull states.
    local function player() return game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer end
    function JavaContent.dynamicFrame(stack, name)
        if name == "compass" or name == "recovery_compass" then
            local target
            if name == "compass" then
                local spawn = player():GetAttribute("SteveSpawnPoint")
                target = stack.lodestone or (typeof(spawn) == "Vector3" and spawn) or Vector3.zero
            else
                local death = player():GetAttribute("SteveDeathPosition")
                target = typeof(death) == "Vector3" and death or nil
            end
            local frame
            if target then
                -- CompassAngleState: 0.5 - (yaw/360 - 0.25 - atan2(dz, dx)/2pi), in 32 frames.
                local d = target - root.Position
                local angle = math.atan2(d.Z, d.X) / (2 * math.pi)
                local lk = look()
                local yaw = math.deg(math.atan2(-lk.X, lk.Z)) / 360
                frame = math.floor(((0.5 - (yaw - 0.25 - angle)) % 1) * 32 + 0.5) % 32
            else frame = math.floor(os.clock() * 20) % 32 end
            return string.format("item/%s_%02d", name, frame)
        elseif name == "clock" then
            local b = world.blocks
            local t = b and b.timeOfDay and b.dayTime and b.timeOfDay(b.dayTime()) or 0
            return string.format("item/clock_%02d", math.floor(t * 64) % 64)
        elseif name == "crossbow" and not stack.charged and items.using and items.using.name == "crossbow" and stack == held() then
            local pull = items.using.ticks / items.using.duration
            return "item/crossbow_pulling_" .. (pull < 0.58 and 0 or pull < 1 and 1 or 2)
        elseif name == "bow" and stack == held() and world.gameplay and (world.gameplay.charge or 0) > 0 then
            local pull = world.gameplay.charge / 20
            return "item/bow_pulling_" .. (pull < 0.65 and 0 or pull < 0.9 and 1 or 2)
        end
    end

    -- Potions (PotionContents) ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    local potionData = JavaContent.data.potions or {potions = {}, effects = {}}
    local function potionEffects(stack)
        local p = stack and stack.potion and potionData.potions[stack.potion]
        return p and p.effects or {}
    end
    -- PotionContents.getColor: effect colours averaged, weighted by amplifier + 1; water is 0x385DC6.
    function items.potionColor(stack)
        local list = potionEffects(stack)
        if #list == 0 then return 0x385DC6 end
        local r, g, b, n = 0, 0, 0, 0
        for _, e in ipairs(list) do
            local c = (potionData.effects[e[1]] or {}).color or 0
            local w = e[3] + 1
            r = r + math.floor(c / 65536) % 256 * w; g = g + math.floor(c / 256) % 256 * w; b = b + c % 256 * w; n = n + w
        end
        return math.floor(r / n) * 65536 + math.floor(g / n) * 256 + math.floor(b / n)
    end
    local function rgb3(c) return {math.floor(c / 65536) % 256 / 255, math.floor(c / 256) % 256 / 255, c % 256 / 255} end
    local function applyEffect(id, ticks, amplifier, scale)
        local f = fx()
        if not f then return end
        if id == "instant_health" or id == "instant_damage" then
            if (scale or 1) > 0 then f.give(id, 1, amplifier) end
            return
        end
        local t = math.floor(ticks * (scale or 1) + 0.5)
        if t > 20 then f.give(id, t / 20, amplifier) end
    end
    local function drinkPotion(stack, scale)
        for _, e in ipairs(potionEffects(stack)) do applyEffect(e[1], e[2], e[3], scale) end
    end
    items.drinkPotion = drinkPotion
    JavaContent.potionColor = function(stack) return items.potionColor(stack) end

    -- Consumables (Consumable / ConsumeEffect per item) ----------------------------------------
    local consumeEffects = {
        golden_apple = {{"regeneration", 100, 1}, {"absorption", 2400, 0}},
        enchanted_golden_apple = {{"regeneration", 400, 1}, {"resistance", 6000, 0}, {"fire_resistance", 6000, 0}, {"absorption", 2400, 3}},
        pufferfish = {{"poison", 1200, 1}, {"hunger", 300, 2}, {"nausea", 300, 0}},
        rotten_flesh = {{"hunger", 600, 0, 0.8}}, spider_eye = {{"poison", 100, 0}}, poisonous_potato = {{"poison", 100, 0, 0.6}},
        chicken = {{"hunger", 600, 0, 0.3}}}
    local drinks = {potion = 32, milk_bucket = 32, honey_bottle = 40, ominous_bottle = 32}
    local function chorusTeleport()
        -- ChorusFruitItem / TeleportRandomlyConsumeEffect: up to 16 tries within 8 blocks.
        for _ = 1, 16 do
            local target = root.Position + Vector3.new(math.random() * 16 - 8, math.random(-8, 7), math.random() * 16 - 8) * B
            local down = workspace:Raycast(target + Vector3.new(0, B, 0), Vector3.new(0, -B * 10, 0), h.cast)
            if down then
                local feet = down.Position
                if not workspace:Raycast(feet + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0), Vector3.new(0, B * 1.8, 0), h.cast) then
                    if world.teleport then world.teleport(feet) end
                    for _ = 1, 32 do particle("portal", feet + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() * 2, math.random() - 0.5) * B, Vector3.zero, {life = 30, size = 0.1}) end
                    cooldown("chorus_fruit", 20)
                    return
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function finishConsume(stack, name)
        local a = api()
        local food = stack.food or JavaContent.data.food[name]
        if food and a and name ~= "honey_bottle" and name ~= "ominous_bottle" then
            a.hunger = math.min(20, a.hunger + food.nutrition)
            a.saturation = math.min(a.hunger, a.saturation + food.saturation)
        end
        for _, e in ipairs(consumeEffects[name] or {}) do
            if not e[4] or math.random() < e[4] then applyEffect(e[1], e[2], e[3]) end
        end
        if name == "potion" then drinkPotion(stack, 1)
        elseif name == "milk_bucket" then if fx() then fx().clear() end
        elseif name == "honey_bottle" then if fx() then fx().clear("poison") end; if a then a.hunger = math.min(20, a.hunger + 6); a.saturation = math.min(a.hunger, a.saturation + 1.2) end
        elseif name == "ominous_bottle" then applyEffect("bad_omen", 120000, stack.amplifier or 0)
        elseif name == "suspicious_stew" then for _, e in ipairs(stack.stewEffects or {}) do applyEffect(e[1], e[2], 0) end
        elseif name == "chorus_fruit" then chorusTeleport() end
        world.vibrate(root.Position, name:match("potion") and 8 or 8, {player = true})
        -- Remainders: bottles and bowls.
        local rest = ({potion = "glass_bottle", honey_bottle = nil, ominous_bottle = nil, milk_bucket = "bucket", mushroom_stew = "bowl", rabbit_stew = "bowl",
            beetroot_soup = "bowl", suspicious_stew = "bowl"})[name]
        if name == "honey_bottle" then rest = "glass_bottle" end
        if creative() then return end
        if rest then exchange(stackOf(rest, 1)) else consume(1) end
    end

    -- Projectiles (ThrowableProjectile / AbstractArrow-style) -----------------------------------
    local cast = RaycastParams.new()
    cast.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    h.cast = cast
    local function filter(extra)
        local list = {character, folder}
        if world.effects and world.effects.folder then list[#list + 1] = world.effects.folder end
        for _, x in ipairs(extra or {}) do list[#list + 1] = x end
        cast.FilterDescendantsInstances = list
        return cast
    end
    local function billboard(sprite, size, parent)
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name, p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.Transparency, p.Size = "ItemSprite", true, false, false, false, 1, Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
        local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        gui.Size, gui.LightInfluence = UDim2.fromScale(size * B, size * B), 1
        gui.Parent = p
        if sprite then
            local content = JavaGui.content(sprite)
            local image = Instance.new(content and "ImageLabel" or "Frame")
            image.BackgroundTransparency, image.Size = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            if content then image.ImageContent, image.ResampleMode = content, Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated else JavaContent.sprite(image, sprite) end
            image.Parent = gui
            p:SetAttribute("Image", true)
        end
        p.Parent = parent or folder
        return p, gui
    end
    -- Projectile.shootFromRotation: direction from view (+pitch offset), Gaussian inaccuracy, plus the shooter's motion.
    local function launch(kind, speed, pitchOffset, gravity, sprite, onHit, extra)
        local dir = look()
        if pitchOffset ~= 0 then
            local flat = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
            local pitch = math.asin(math.clamp(dir.Y, -1, 1)) + math.rad(pitchOffset)
            local f = flat.Magnitude > 1e-4 and flat.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
            dir = f * math.cos(pitch) + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(pitch), 0)
        end
        local function gauss() local u, v = math.random(), math.random(); return math.sqrt(-2 * math.log(math.max(u, 1e-9))) * math.cos(2 * math.pi * v) end
        dir = (dir + Vector3.new(gauss(), gauss(), gauss()) * 0.0075).Unit
        local velocity = dir * speed * B + (world.motion and world.motion() or Vector3.zero) * B * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
        local p = {kind = kind, position = eye() - Vector3.new(0, 0.1 * B, 0), velocity = velocity, gravity = gravity * B, age = 0, onHit = onHit}
        for k, v in pairs(extra or {}) do p[k] = v end
        if p.model then p.part = p.model.model
        else p.part = billboard(sprite, 0.5) end
        p.previous = p.position
        items.projectiles[#items.projectiles + 1] = p
        return p
    end
    items.launch = launch
    local function mobFrom(instance)
        local a = api()
        if not a or not instance then return nil end
        for _, m in ipairs(a.mobs) do if instance:IsDescendantOf(m.visual.model) then return m end end
    end
    items.mobFrom = mobFrom
    local function nearbyMobs(position, radius)
        local out = {}
        local a = api()
        for _, m in ipairs(a and a.mobs or {}) do
            if m.humanoid.Health > 0 and (m.position - position).Magnitude <= radius * B then out[#out + 1] = m end
        end
        return out
    end
    local function hurtPlayer(amount)
        local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum and amount > 0 and not creative() then hum:TakeDamage(amount * hum.MaxHealth / 20) end
    end
    local function splashParticles(position, color, instant)
        local c = rgb3(color)
        for _ = 1, 40 do
            local v = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() * 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.6
            particle(instant and "instant_effect" or "effect", position + Vector3.new(0, 0.2 * B, 0), v, {life = 20, size = 0.15, tint = c, gravity = 0})
        end
    end
    -- XP orbs (ExperienceOrb) ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local orbSizes = {2477, 1237, 617, 307, 149, 73, 37, 17, 7, 3}
    local function orbIcon(value) for i, v in ipairs(orbSizes) do if value >= v then return 11 - i end end return 0 end
    function items.spawnXp(position, total)
        -- ExperienceOrb.award splits the amount into Java's orb sizes.
        while total > 0 do
            local value = 1
            for _, v in ipairs(orbSizes) do if total >= v then value = v; break end end
            total = total - value
            local frames = (JavaContent.data.itemEntities or {}).xp_orb
            local part, gui = billboard(frames and frames[orbIcon(value) + 1], 0.3)
            items.orbs[#items.orbs + 1] = {position = position, velocity = Vector3.new((math.random() * 0.2 - 0.1) * 2, math.random() * 0.2 * 2, (math.random() * 0.2 - 0.1) * 2) * B,
                value = value, age = 0, part = part, gui = gui}
        end
    end
    world.spawnXp = items.spawnXp

    -- Throwable hits ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function hitMobOrBlock(result)
        local m = result and mobFrom(result.Instance)
        return m, result
    end
    local onHit = {}
    function onHit.snowball(p, result)
        local m = hitMobOrBlock(result)
        if m and m.id == "blaze" then m.humanoid:TakeDamage(3) end
        if m then m.knock = p.velocity.Unit * 0.4 * B end
        for _ = 1, 8 do particle("item_snowball", p.position, Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() * 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.3, {life = 10, size = 0.1}) end
    end
    function onHit.egg(p, result)
        -- ThrownEgg.onHit: 1/8 a chick, of which 1/32 make four.
        if math.random(8) == 1 then
            local n = math.random(32) == 1 and 4 or 1
            for _ = 1, n do if api() then api().spawn("chicken", p.position, true) end end
        end
        local m = hitMobOrBlock(result)
        if m then m.knock = p.velocity.Unit * 0.4 * B end
        for _ = 1, 8 do particle("item_snowball", p.position, Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() * 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.3, {life = 10, size = 0.1, tint = {1, 0.95, 0.8}}) end
    end
    onHit.blue_egg, onHit.brown_egg = onHit.egg, onHit.egg
    function onHit.ender_pearl(p)
        -- ThrownEnderpearl: teleport the thrower, 5 damage, 5% endermite.
