        for _ = 1, 32 do particle("portal", p.position + Vector3.new(0, math.random() * 2 * B, 0), Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0, math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.2, {life = 30, size = 0.1}) end
        if world.teleport then world.teleport(p.position) end
        hurtPlayer(5)
        if math.random() < 0.05 and api() then api().spawn("endermite", p.position) end
    end
    local function splashPotion(p, lingering)
        local color = items.potionColor(p.stack)
        local instant = false
        for _, e in ipairs(potionEffects(p.stack)) do if e[1]:match("^instant_") then instant = true end end
        splashParticles(p.position, color, instant)
        if lingering then
            -- AreaEffectCloud: radius 3, shrinking to nothing over 600 ticks, effects at 1/4 duration.
            items.clouds[#items.clouds + 1] = {position = p.position, radius = 3, age = 0, duration = 600, stack = p.stack, color = color, waitTime = 10, applied = {}}
            return
        end
        -- ThrownSplashPotion.applySplash: within 4 blocks, 1 - distance/4 of the duration.
        local d = (root.Position - p.position).Magnitude / B
        if d < 4 then
            local scale = 1 - d / 4
            if p.direct == "player" then scale = 1 end
            drinkPotion(p.stack, scale)
        end
        for _, m in ipairs(nearbyMobs(p.position, 4)) do
            for _, e in ipairs(potionEffects(p.stack)) do
                local undead = m.id:match("zombie") or m.id:match("skeleton") or m.id == "wither" or m.id == "phantom" or m.id == "drowned" or m.id == "husk" or m.id == "stray" or m.id == "zoglin"
                if (e[1] == "instant_damage" and not undead) or (e[1] == "instant_health" and undead) then m.humanoid:TakeDamage(6 * 2 ^ e[3])
                elseif (e[1] == "instant_health" and not undead) or (e[1] == "instant_damage" and undead) then m.humanoid.Health = math.min(m.humanoid.MaxHealth, m.humanoid.Health + 4 * 2 ^ e[3])
                else m.effects = m.effects or {}; m.effects[e[1]] = {amplifier = e[3], ticks = e[2]} end
            end
        end
        world.vibrate(p.position, 7, {})
    end
    function onHit.splash_potion(p) splashPotion(p, false) end
    function onHit.lingering_potion(p) splashPotion(p, true) end
    function onHit.experience_bottle(p)
        splashParticles(p.position, 0x385DC6, true)
        items.spawnXp(p.position, 3 + math.random(0, 4) + math.random(0, 4))
    end
    function onHit.wind_charge(p)
        -- AbstractWindCharge.explode: a 1.2-radius burst that knocks entities back and flips doors/levers/bells.
        particle("gust", p.position, Vector3.zero, {life = 12, size = 1})
        local d = root.Position - p.position
        if d.Magnitude < 2.5 * B then impulse((d.Magnitude > 0.01 and d.Unit or Vector3.yAxis) * 1.1 * (1 - d.Magnitude / (2.5 * B)) + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)) end
        for _, m in ipairs(nearbyMobs(p.position, 2.5)) do m.knock = ((m.position - p.position).Unit + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) * B * 0.8 end
        local center = p.position
        for dx = -1, 1 do for dy = -1, 1 do for dz = -1, 1 do
            local n = world.nodeAt and world.nodeAt(world.cell and world.cell(center + Vector3.new(dx, dy, dz) * B) or center)
            if n and ((n.id:match("_door$") or n.id:match("_trapdoor$") or n.id:match("_fence_gate$")) and not n.id:find("iron", 1, true) or n.id == "lever" or n.id:match("_button$")) then
                if n.id == "lever" then n.state.powered = n.state.powered == "true" and "false" or "true"
                elseif n.id:match("_button$") then n.state.powered = "true"; n.release = world.tickCount + 20
                else n.state.open = n.state.open == "true" and "false" or "true" end
            end
        end end end
        world.updateNeighbors()
    end
    function onHit.trident(p, result)
        local m = hitMobOrBlock(result)
        if m then
            m.humanoid:TakeDamage(8 + 2.5 * ((p.stack.enchantments or {}).impaling or 0) * ((m.id:match("fish") or m.id == "squid" or m.id == "dolphin" or m.id == "guardian" or m.id == "turtle") and 1 or 0))
            p.velocity = p.velocity * -0.01
            p.returning = true
        end
        p.stuck = not m
        return true -- stays in the world
    end
    -- Fireworks (FireworkRocketEntity.explode): coloured spark balls per explosion.
    local function fireworkBurst(position, explosions)
        for _, e in ipairs(explosions or {}) do
            local colors = e.colors and #e.colors > 0 and e.colors or {0xFFFFFF}
            local count = e.shape == "large_ball" and 70 or e.shape == "burst" and 50 or 40
            local speed = e.shape == "large_ball" and 1.0 or 0.5
            for i = 1, count do
                local v
                if e.shape == "star" then
                    local a = i / count * math.pi * 2
                    local r = (i % 2 == 0) and 0.6 or 0.25
                    v = Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, math.sin(a) * r, (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1)
                elseif e.shape == "creeper" then
                    v = Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6, (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6, 0)
                elseif e.shape == "burst" then v = Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2, math.random() * 0.6, (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2)
                else
                    local u, w = math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * math.pi * 2
                    local s = math.sqrt(1 - u * u)
                    v = Vector3.new(s * math.cos(w), u, s * math.sin(w)) * speed * 0.5
                end
                local c = colors[(i % #colors) + 1]
                particle("firework", position, v * B, {life = 30 + math.random(0, 10), size = 0.15, tint = rgb3(c), fullbright = true, gravity = 0.004 * B, friction = 0.91})
            end
        end
        if explosions and #explosions > 0 then
            local d = (root.Position - position).Magnitude / B
            if d <= 5 then hurtPlayer((5 + #explosions * 2) * math.sqrt((5 - d) / 5)) end
            for _, m in ipairs(nearbyMobs(position, 5)) do m.humanoid:TakeDamage(5 + #explosions * 2) end
        end
    end
    function items.launchFirework(position, stack, velocity)
        local flight = stack.fireworks and stack.fireworks.flight or 1
        local part = billboard(iconSprite(stack.id), 0.5)
        items.rockets[#items.rockets + 1] = {position = position, velocity = velocity or Vector3.new(math.random() * 0.002 - 0.001, 0.05, math.random() * 0.002 - 0.001) * B,
            age = 0, lifetime = 10 * (flight + 1) + math.random(0, 5) + math.random(0, 6), explosions = stack.fireworks and stack.fireworks.explosions or {}, part = part}
    end

    -- Item frames, armor stands, paintings, end crystals (entities placed by items) -----------------
    local entityData = JavaContent.data.itemEntities or {}
    local function entityPart(entity, size, cf, sprite, face)
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name, p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch, p.Transparency, p.Size, p.CFrame = "ItemEntity", true, false, false, 1, size, cf
        p:SetAttribute("SteveItemEntity", entity.id)
        if sprite then JavaContent.surface(p, face or Enum.NormalId.Back, sprite) end
        p.Parent = entity.model
        return p
    end
    local nextEntity = 0
    local function newEntity(kind, position)
        nextEntity = nextEntity + 1
        local model = Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name, model.Parent = kind, folder
        local e = {id = nextEntity, kind = kind, position = position, model = model, age = 0}
        items.entities[#items.entities + 1] = e
        return e
    end
    local function removeEntity(e)
        for i, x in ipairs(items.entities) do if x == e then table.remove(items.entities, i); break end end
        if e.visual then e.visual.model:Destroy() end
        if e.itemVisual then e.itemVisual.model:Destroy() end
        e.model:Destroy()
    end
    function items.entityFrom(instance)
        local id = instance and instance:GetAttribute("SteveItemEntity")
        if not id then return nil end
        for _, e in ipairs(items.entities) do if e.id == id then return e end end
    end
    local faceVectors = {up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), down = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), north = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), south = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), east = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), west = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0)}
    local function faceOf(normal)
        local ax, ay, az = math.abs(normal.X), math.abs(normal.Y), math.abs(normal.Z)
        if ay >= ax and ay >= az then return normal.Y > 0 and "up" or "down" end
        if ax >= az then return normal.X > 0 and "east" or "west" end
        return normal.Z > 0 and "south" or "north"
    end
    local function blockCenter(hit)
        local n = world.resolve(hit.Instance)
        if n then return n.center, n end
        return world.cell and world.cell(hit.Position - hit.Normal * 0.01) or hit.Position, nil
    end
    -- Item frame: 12x12 face, 1px thick, flush with the block face; the item floats in front.
    local function placeFrame(hit, kind)
        local center = blockCenter(hit)
        local face = faceOf(hit.Normal)
        local n = faceVectors[face]
        local e = newEntity(kind, center + n * B * (0.5 + 1 / 32))
        e.face, e.rotation = face, 0
        local up = math.abs(n.Y) > 0.5 and Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        e.frame = CFrame.lookAt(e.position, e.position + n, up)
        local plate = entityPart(e, Vector3.new(12 / 16 * B, 12 / 16 * B, 1 / 16 * B), e.frame, entityData[kind], Enum.NormalId.Front)
        if kind == "glow_item_frame" then for _, g in ipairs(plate:GetChildren()) do if g:IsA("SurfaceGui") then g.LightInfluence = 0 end end end
        return e
    end
    local function frameItem(e)
        if e.itemVisual then e.itemVisual.model:Destroy(); e.itemVisual = nil end
        if e.mapGui then e.mapGui:Destroy(); e.mapGui = nil end
        if not e.item then return end
        if nameOf(e.item) == "filled_map" and items.mapContent then
            -- ItemFrameRenderer: a map fills the frame.
            local p = entityPart(e, Vector3.new(B, B, 0.002), e.frame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -1 / 32 * B - 0.003) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -e.rotation * math.pi / 4))
            items.mapContent(p, e.item)
            e.mapGui = p
            return
        end
        local offset, scale = CFrame.new(), B * 0.5
        if JavaContent.display then offset, scale = JavaContent.display(e.item.id, "fixed", B * 0.5) end
        e.itemVisual = JavaContent.model(e.item.id, {}, scale, folder, e.position, true)
        e.itemVisual.pivot(e.frame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -1 / 32 * B) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -e.rotation * math.pi / 4) * offset)
    end
    -- Painting: Java picks among the variants with the largest area that fit the wall.
    local function placePainting(hit)
        local center = blockCenter(hit)
        local face = faceOf(hit.Normal)
        if face == "up" or face == "down" then return false end
        local n = faceVectors[face]
        local right = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0):Cross(n)
        local function fits(w, ht)
            -- PaintingVariant.width x height: blocks behind solid, the front empty.
            local ox, oy = -math.floor((w - 1) / 2), -math.floor((ht - 1) / 2)
            for x = 0, w - 1 do for y = 0, ht - 1 do
                local wall = center + right * (ox + x) * B + Vector3.new(0, (oy + y) * B, 0)
                if not world.sample(wall) then return false end
                if world.sample(wall + n * B) then return false end
            end end
            for _, e in ipairs(items.entities) do
                if e.kind == "painting" and (e.position - (center + n * B * 0.53)).Magnitude < math.max(w, ht) * B * 0.6 then return false end
            end
            return true
        end
        local best, area = {}, 0
        for _, id in ipairs(entityData.paintingOrder or {}) do
            local v = entityData.paintings[id]
            if fits(v.w, v.h) then
                local a = v.w * v.h
                if a > area then best, area = {id}, a elseif a == area then best[#best + 1] = id end
            end
        end
        if #best == 0 then return false end
        local id = best[math.random(#best)]
        local v = entityData.paintings[id]
        local ox, oy = -math.floor((v.w - 1) / 2), -math.floor((v.h - 1) / 2)
        local mid = center + right * (ox + (v.w - 1) / 2) * B + Vector3.new(0, (oy + (v.h - 1) / 2) * B, 0) + n * B * (0.5 + 1 / 32)
        local e = newEntity("painting", mid)
        e.variant, e.face = id, face
        e.frame = CFrame.lookAt(mid, mid + n)
        entityPart(e, Vector3.new(v.w * B, v.h * B, 1 / 16 * B), e.frame, v.sprite, Enum.NormalId.Front)
        if v.title then actionBar(L(v.title) .. "  " .. L(v.author or "")) end
        return true
    end
    -- Armor stand: stands on the block, facing the player in 45 degree steps.
    local function placeStand(hit)
        local center = blockCenter(hit)
        local face = faceOf(hit.Normal)
        local feet = center + faceVectors[face] * B - Vector3.new(0, B / 2, 0)
        local dir = (root.Position - feet) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
        local yaw = math.floor(math.atan2(dir.X, dir.Z) / (math.pi / 4) + 0.5) * math.pi / 4
        local e = newEntity("armor_stand", feet)
        e.yaw, e.equipment = yaw, {}
        e.visual = JavaContent.entityModel("armor_stand", 1, B, e.model, feet, 24)
        local box = entityPart(e, Vector3.new(0.5 * B, 1.975 * B, 0.5 * B), CFrame.new(feet + Vector3.new(0, 0.9875 * B, 0)))
        box.CanQuery = true
        e.box = box
        return e
    end
    function items.spawnStand(feet, yaw)
        local e = newEntity("armor_stand", feet)
        e.yaw, e.equipment = yaw or 0, {}
        e.visual = JavaContent.entityModel("armor_stand", 1, B, e.model, feet, 24)
        local box = entityPart(e, Vector3.new(0.5 * B, 1.975 * B, 0.5 * B), CFrame.new(feet + Vector3.new(0, 0.9875 * B, 0)))
        box.CanQuery = true
        e.box = box
        return e
    end
    function items.removeEntity(e) removeEntity(e) end
    local function placeCrystal(hit)
        local n = world.resolve(hit.Instance)
        if not n or (n.id ~= "obsidian" and n.id ~= "bedrock") or faceOf(hit.Normal) ~= "up" then return false end
        local above = n.center + Vector3.new(0, B, 0)
        if world.sample(above) or world.sample(above + Vector3.new(0, B, 0)) then return false end
        local e = newEntity("end_crystal", above - Vector3.new(0, B / 2, 0))
        e.visual = JavaContent.entityModel("end_crystal", 1, B, e.model, e.position, 0)
        e.box = entityPart(e, Vector3.new(2, 2, 2) * B, CFrame.new(e.position + Vector3.new(0, B, 0)))
        e.box.CanQuery = true
        return true
    end
    -- Hitting entities (left click).
    function items.attackEntity(instance)
        local e = items.entityFrom(instance)
        if not e then return false end
        if e.kind == "item_frame" or e.kind == "glow_item_frame" then
            if e.item then
                if not creative() then world.drop(e.item, e.position) end
                e.item = nil; frameItem(e)
            else
                if not creative() then world.drop(stackOf(e.kind, 1), e.position) end
                removeEntity(e)
            end
        elseif e.kind == "painting" then
            if not creative() then world.drop(stackOf("painting", 1), e.position) end
            removeEntity(e)
        elseif e.kind == "armor_stand" then
            -- Two hits within 5 ticks break it (creative: one).
            if creative() or (e.lastHit and world.tickCount - e.lastHit <= 5) then
                if not creative() then world.drop(stackOf("armor_stand", 1), e.position) end
                for _, s in pairs(e.equipment) do world.drop(s, e.position) end
                removeEntity(e)
            else e.lastHit, e.wobble = world.tickCount, world.tickCount end
        elseif e.kind == "end_crystal" then
            local p = e.position + Vector3.new(0, B, 0)
            removeEntity(e)
            if world.explode then world.explode(p) end
        end
        swing()
        return true
    end
    -- Right-clicking entities.
    local armorSlotOf = {helmet = "head", chestplate = "chest", leggings = "legs", boots = "feet"}
    local function useEntity(e, s, hit)
        local name = s and nameOf(s)
        if e.kind == "item_frame" or e.kind == "glow_item_frame" then
            if not e.item and s then e.item = CreativeRules.withCount(s, 1); consume(1)
            elseif e.item then e.rotation = (e.rotation + 1) % 8 end
            frameItem(e)
            return true
        elseif e.kind == "armor_stand" then
            local armor = s and JavaContent.data.armor and JavaContent.data.armor[name]
            local slot = armor and armorSlotOf[armor.slot]
            if not slot and name and (name == "carved_pumpkin" or name:match("_head$") or name:match("_skull$")) then slot = "head" end
            if slot then
                local old = e.equipment[slot]
                e.equipment[slot] = CreativeRules.withCount(s, 1)
                consume(1)
                if old then give(old) end
            else
                -- ArmorStand.getClickedSlot: by the height of the hit.
                local y = (hit.Position.Y - e.position.Y) / B
                local pick = y >= 1.6 and "head" or y >= 0.9 and "chest" or y >= 0.4 and "legs" or "feet"
                if s or not e.equipment[pick] then return true end
                give(e.equipment[pick]); e.equipment[pick] = nil
            end
            items.dressStand(e)
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    function items.dressStand(e)
        e.dress = e.dress or {}
        for slot, v in pairs(e.dress) do v.model:Destroy(); e.dress[slot] = nil end
        local slotNames = {head = "helmet", chest = "chestplate", legs = "leggings", feet = "boots"}
        for slot, s in pairs(e.equipment) do
            local name = nameOf(s)
            local material = name and name:match("^(%a+)_" .. slotNames[slot] .. "$")
            local id = material and "armor_" .. material .. "_" .. slotNames[slot]
            if id and JavaContent.data.entities[id] then e.dress[slot] = JavaContent.entityModel(id, 1, B, e.model, e.position, 24)
            elseif slot == "head" then e.dress[slot] = JavaContent.model(s.id, {}, B * 0.625, e.model, e.position, true) end
        end
    end

    -- Mob interactions (Mob.interact / interactLivingEntity) ---------------------------------
    local breedTags = {cow = "cow_food", mooshroom = "cow_food", sheep = "sheep_food", pig = "pig_food", chicken = "chicken_food", goat = "goat_food",
        horse = "horse_food", donkey = "horse_food", mule = "horse_food", llama = "llama_food", trader_llama = "llama_food", rabbit = "rabbit_food",
        wolf = "wolf_food", cat = "cat_food", ocelot = "ocelot_food", fox = "fox_food", panda = "panda_food", turtle = "turtle_food", bee = "bee_food",
        hoglin = "hoglin_food", strider = "strider_food", frog = "frog_food", axolotl = "axolotl_food", camel = "camel_food", armadillo = "armadillo_food",
        sniffer = "sniffer_food", parrot = "parrot_food", goat_food = nil}
    local saddleable = {pig = true, horse = true, donkey = true, mule = true, strider = true, camel = true, skeleton_horse = true, zombie_horse = true}
    local leashable = {cow = true, mooshroom = true, sheep = true, pig = true, chicken = true, goat = true, horse = true, donkey = true, mule = true, llama = true,
        trader_llama = true, rabbit = true, wolf = true, cat = true, fox = true, panda = true, polar_bear = true, bee = true, hoglin = true, zoglin = true,
        strider = true, frog = true, axolotl = true, camel = true, armadillo = true, sniffer = true, parrot = true, iron_golem = true, snow_golem = true,
        dolphin = true, ocelot = true, turtle = true, skeleton_horse = true, zombie_horse = true, allay = true, happy_ghast = true}
    local bucketable = {cod = "cod_bucket", salmon = "salmon_bucket", pufferfish = "pufferfish_bucket", tropical_fish = "tropical_fish_bucket", axolotl = "axolotl_bucket", tadpole = "tadpole_bucket"}
    local function hearts(m, kind)
        for _ = 1, kind == "smoke" and 7 or 3 do
            particle(kind == "smoke" and "smoke" or "heart", m.position + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, m.height * m.scale / B + math.random() * 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * B, Vector3.new(0, 0.02 * B, 0), {life = 20, size = 0.25})
        end
    end
    local function nameTag(m)
        if m.nameGui then m.nameGui:Destroy(); m.nameGui = nil end
        if not m.customName then return end
        local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        gui.Size, gui.StudsOffset, gui.AlwaysOnTop, gui.LightInfluence = UDim2.fromOffset(JavaGui.width(m.customName) * 2 + 4, 20), Vector3.new(0, m.height * m.scale + 0.3 * B, 0), false, 0
        local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
        bg.BackgroundColor3, bg.BackgroundTransparency, bg.BorderSizePixel, bg.Size = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.75, 0, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        bg.Parent = gui
        local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
        holder.BackgroundTransparency, holder.Size, holder.Position = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)
        local scale = Instance.new("UIScale"); scale.Scale = 2; scale.Parent = holder
        holder.Parent = gui
        JavaGui.text(holder, m.customName, 0, 0, white, false, 2)
        gui.Adornee, gui.Parent = m.hitbox, m.visual.model
        m.nameGui = gui
    end
    items.nameTag = nameTag
    local function useOnMob(m, s, name)
        if m.humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
        local baby = m.scale < B * 0.75
        if name == "name_tag" and s.name then m.customName = s.name; nameTag(m); consume(1); return true end
        if name == "lead" and leashable[m.id] and not m.leash then m.leash = "player"; consume(1); return true end
        if m.leash == "player" then m.leash = nil; if not creative() then give(stackOf("lead", 1)) end; return true end
        if name == "saddle" and saddleable[m.id] and not m.saddled and not baby then m.saddled = true; consume(1); return true end
        if name == "shears" then
            if m.id == "sheep" and not m.sheared and not baby then
                m.sheared = true
                local mm = world.gameplay and world.gameplay.mobsModule
                if mm then m.jeb = nil; m.variantName = "sheared"; pcall(mm.buildVisual, m) end
                world.drop(stackOf((m.color or "white") .. "_wool", math.random(1, 3)), m.position + Vector3.new(0, B, 0))
                damageHeld(1); return true
            elseif m.id == "mooshroom" and not baby then
                for _ = 1, 5 do world.drop(stackOf((m.variantName == "brown") and "brown_mushroom" or "red_mushroom", 1), m.position + Vector3.new(0, B, 0)) end
                local pos = m.position; m.humanoid.Health = 0; m.visual.model:Destroy()
                for i, x in ipairs(api().mobs) do if x == m then table.remove(api().mobs, i) end end
                api().spawn("cow", pos); damageHeld(1); return true
            elseif m.id == "snow_golem" and not m.noPumpkin then m.noPumpkin = true; world.drop(stackOf("carved_pumpkin", 1), m.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5 * B, 0)); damageHeld(1); return true end
        end
        local dye = name and name:match("^(.+)_dye$")
        if dye and m.id == "sheep" and m.color ~= dye then
                m.color = dye
                local mm = world.gameplay and world.gameplay.mobsModule
                if mm and not m.sheared and not m.jeb then m.variantName = dye; pcall(mm.buildVisual, m) end
                consume(1); return true end
        if dye and m.id == "wolf" and m.tamed then m.collar = dye; consume(1); return true end
        if name == "bowl" and m.id == "mooshroom" and not baby then exchange(stackOf("mushroom_stew", 1)); return true end
        if name == "bucket" and (m.id == "cow" or m.id == "goat" or m.id == "mooshroom") and not baby then exchange(stackOf("milk_bucket", 1)); return true end
        if name == "water_bucket" and bucketable[m.id] then
            local out = stackOf(bucketable[m.id], 1)
            m.humanoid.Health = 0; m.visual.model:Destroy()
            for i, x in ipairs(api().mobs) do if x == m then table.remove(api().mobs, i) end end
            exchange(out); return true
        end
        if (name == "flint_and_steel" or name == "fire_charge") and m.id == "creeper" then
            m.ignited = 30; if name == "flint_and_steel" then damageHeld(1) else consume(1) end; return true
        end
        -- Taming: bones for wolves, raw fish for cats, seeds for parrots.
        if not m.tamed and ((m.id == "wolf" and name == "bone") or (m.id == "cat" and (name == "cod" or name == "salmon")) or (m.id == "parrot" and name and name:match("_seeds$"))) then
            consume(1)
            if math.random(m.id == "parrot" and 10 or 3) == 1 then m.tamed, m.owner = true, "player"; hearts(m) else hearts(m, "smoke") end
            return true
        end
        -- Animal.mobInteract: breeding food puts adults in love; babies grow 10% faster.
        local tag = breedTags[m.id]
        if tag and name and Recipes.tagged(tag, name) then
            if baby then consume(1); m.growth = (m.growth or 0) + 0.1; hearts(m, "happy"); return true end
            if (m.breedCooldown or 0) > world.tickCount or (m.love or 0) > 0 then return false end
            consume(1)
            m.love = 600
            hearts(m)
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    items.useOnMob = useOnMob

    -- Item.useOn: items used on a block ------------------------------------------------------
    local function setBlock(center, id, state)
        local entry = JavaContent.byId[id]
        if not entry then return nil end
        local s = CreativeRules.copy(entry.state)
        for k, v in pairs(state or {}) do s[k] = v end
        return world.setBlockAt(center, entry.index, s)
    end
    local function free(center)
        local b = world.sample(center)
        return not b or b.id == "air" or b.id == "short_grass" or b.id:match("leaves$") or b.id:match("sapling$") or b.id == "fern" or b.id == "vine"
    end
    local function happy(center)
        for _ = 1, 15 do particle("happy_villager", center + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.3, math.random() - 0.5) * B, Vector3.zero, {life = 20, size = 0.12}) end
    end
    -- Simple 26.3-shaped trees (TreeFeature configurations reduced to their trunk / foliage shapes).
    local function growTree(n, wood)
        local base = n.center
        local log, leaves = wood .. "_log", wood .. "_leaves"
        if wood == "azalea" then log, leaves = "oak_log", math.random() < 0.25 and "flowering_azalea_leaves" or "azalea_leaves" end
        if wood == "crimson" or wood == "warped" then log, leaves = wood .. "_stem", wood == "crimson" and "nether_wart_block" or "warped_wart_block" end
        if not JavaContent.byId[log] or not JavaContent.byId[leaves] then return false end
        local height = ({oak = 4, birch = 5, spruce = 6, jungle = 4, acacia = 5, cherry = 5, dark_oak = 6, pale_oak = 6, mangrove = 4, azalea = 4, crimson = 5, warped = 5})[wood] or 4
        height = height + math.random(0, 2)
        for y = 1, height + 1 do if y > 0 and not free(base + Vector3.new(0, y, 0) * B) then return false end end
        local function leaf(p) if free(p) and not world.sample(p) then setBlock(p, leaves, {persistent = "false", distance = "1"}) end end
        setBlock(base, log, {axis = "y"})
        for y = 1, height - 1 do setBlock(base + Vector3.new(0, y, 0) * B, log, {axis = "y"}) end
        if wood == "spruce" then
            -- SpruceFoliagePlacer: a cone, widest at the bottom.
            for y = 2, height + 1 do
                local r = math.max(0, math.min(2, math.floor((height + 1 - y) / 2)))
                for dx = -r, r do for dz = -r, r do
                    if not (dx == 0 and dz == 0 and y < height) and (math.abs(dx) + math.abs(dz) <= r + 1) then leaf(base + Vector3.new(dx, y, dz) * B) end
                end end
            end
        else
            -- BlobFoliagePlacer (oak-like): radius 2 for two layers, then 1, with random corners.
            for y = height - 3, height do
                local r = y >= height - 1 and 1 or 2
                for dx = -r, r do for dz = -r, r do
                    local corner = math.abs(dx) == r and math.abs(dz) == r
                    if not (corner and (y == height or math.random() < 0.5)) and not (dx == 0 and dz == 0 and y < height) then leaf(base + Vector3.new(dx, y, dz) * B) end
                end end
            end
        end
        world.updateNeighbors()
        return true
    end
    local crops = {wheat = 7, carrots = 7, potatoes = 7, beetroots = 3, melon_stem = 7, pumpkin_stem = 7, torchflower_crop = 1, pitcher_crop = 4, cocoa = 2, sweet_berry_bush = 3, nether_wart = nil}
    local function boneMeal(n, hit)
        local id = n.id
        local max = crops[id]
        if max then
            local age = tonumber(n.state.age) or 0
            if age >= max then return false end
            -- CropBlock.getBonemealAgeIncrease: 2-5 (beetroots and small crops: 1).
            local add = (id == "wheat" or id == "carrots" or id == "potatoes" or id:match("_stem$")) and math.random(2, 5) or 1
            if id == "torchflower_crop" and age + add > max then setBlock(n.center, "torchflower") else n.state.age = tostring(math.min(max, age + add)) end
            world.blocks_rebuild(n)
            happy(n.center); return true
        end
        if id == "cave_vines" or id == "cave_vines_plant" then
            if n.state.berries == "true" then return false end
            n.state.berries = "true"; world.blocks_rebuild(n); happy(n.center); return true
        end
        if id:match("_sapling$") or id == "azalea" or id == "flowering_azalea" or id == "mangrove_propagule" or id == "crimson_fungus" or id == "warped_fungus" then
            -- SaplingBlock: 45% per use, stage 0 -> 1, then the tree.
            if math.random() >= 0.45 then happy(n.center); return true end
            if (tonumber(n.state.stage) or 0) == 0 and id:match("_sapling$") then n.state.stage = "1"; happy(n.center); return true end
            local wood = id:gsub("_sapling$", ""):gsub("^flowering_", ""):gsub("_propagule$", ""):gsub("_fungus$", "")
            if (wood == "dark_oak" or wood == "pale_oak") then
                -- Needs a 2x2 of saplings.
                local count = 0
                for _, d in ipairs({{1, 0}, {0, 1}, {1, 1}}) do local o = world.sample(n.center + Vector3.new(d[1], 0, d[2]) * B); if o and o.id == id then count = count + 1 end end
                if count < 3 then happy(n.center); return true end
            end
            growTree(n, wood)
            happy(n.center); return true
        end
        if id == "grass_block" or id == "moss_block" or id:match("_nylium$") then
            -- GrassBlock.performBonemeal: short grass and the biome's flowers around.
            local above = id == "grass_block" and "short_grass" or id == "moss_block" and "moss_carpet" or (id == "crimson_nylium" and "crimson_roots" or "warped_roots")
            for _ = 1, 32 do
                local p = n.center + Vector3.new(math.random(-3, 3), 1, math.random(-3, 3)) * B
                local under = world.sample(p - Vector3.new(0, B, 0))
                if not world.sample(p) and under and under.id == id then
                    local pick = above
                    if id == "grass_block" and math.random() < 0.125 then pick = math.random() < 0.5 and "dandelion" or "poppy" end
                    setBlock(p, pick)
                end
            end
            world.updateNeighbors(); happy(n.center + Vector3.new(0, B, 0)); return true
        end
        if id == "short_grass" or id == "fern" then
            local tall = id == "short_grass" and "tall_grass" or "large_fern"
            if world.sample(n.center + Vector3.new(0, B, 0)) then return false end
            setBlock(n.center, tall, {half = "lower"}); setBlock(n.center + Vector3.new(0, B, 0), tall, {half = "upper"})
            world.updateNeighbors(); happy(n.center); return true
        end
        if id == "sunflower" or id == "lilac" or id == "rose_bush" or id == "peony" then world.drop(stackOf(id, 1), n.center); happy(n.center); return true end
        if id == "kelp" or id == "kelp_plant" or id == "twisting_vines" or id == "weeping_vines" or id == "bamboo" or id == "bamboo_sapling" then
            local step = id == "weeping_vines" and -1 or 1
            local p = n.center
            while world.sample(p + Vector3.new(0, step, 0) * B) and world.sample(p + Vector3.new(0, step, 0) * B).id:match(id:gsub("_plant$", ""):gsub("_sapling$", "")) do p = p + Vector3.new(0, step, 0) * B end
            local target = p + Vector3.new(0, step, 0) * B
            if world.sample(target) then return false end
            setBlock(target, id == "bamboo_sapling" and "bamboo" or id:gsub("_plant$", ""))
            world.updateNeighbors(); happy(n.center); return true
        end
        if id == "sea_pickle" and (tonumber(n.state.pickles) or 1) < 4 then n.state.pickles = tostring((tonumber(n.state.pickles) or 1) + 1); world.blocks_rebuild(n); happy(n.center); return true end
        if id == "red_mushroom" or id == "brown_mushroom" then
            if math.random() >= 0.4 then happy(n.center); return true end
            -- HugeMushroomFeature: a stem and a cap.
            local cap = id .. "_block"
            for y = 0, 4 do setBlock(n.center + Vector3.new(0, y, 0) * B, "mushroom_stem") end
            for dx = -2, 2 do for dz = -2, 2 do
                if not (math.abs(dx) == 2 and math.abs(dz) == 2) then
                    local p = n.center + Vector3.new(dx, id == "brown_mushroom" and 4 or 5, dz) * B
                    if free(p) then setBlock(p, cap) end
                end
            end end
            world.updateNeighbors(); return true
        end
        return false
    end
    -- HoneycombItem.WAXABLES / WeatheringCopper.PREVIOUS
    local function waxed(id) return JavaContent.byId["waxed_" .. id] and "waxed_" .. id or (id == "copper_block" and JavaContent.byId.waxed_copper_block and "waxed_copper_block") end
    local function previousStage(id)
        local rest = id:match("^exposed_(.+)$")
        if rest then return rest == "copper" and "copper_block" or rest end
        rest = id:match("^weathered_(.+)$"); if rest then return "exposed_" .. rest end
        rest = id:match("^oxidized_(.+)$"); if rest then return "weathered_" .. rest end
    end
    local function swapKeepState(n, id, kind)
        local entry = JavaContent.byId[id]
        if not entry then return false end
        local state = CreativeRules.copy(n.state)
        local placed = world.setBlockAt(n.center, entry.index, state)
        if placed and n.partner then
            local other = world.nodes and world.nodes[n.partner]
            if other then local e2 = JavaContent.byId[id]; if e2 then world.setBlockAt(other.center, e2.index, CreativeRules.copy(other.state)) end end
        end
        for _ = 1, 12 do particle(kind, n.center + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * B * 1.1, Vector3.zero, {life = 20, size = 0.12}) end
        world.updateNeighbors()
        return true
    end
    -- EndPortalFrameBlock.getOrCreatePortalShape: 12 frames with eyes, all facing in.
    local function checkPortal(n)
        for cx = -2, 2 do for cz = -2, 2 do
            local center = n.center + Vector3.new(cx, 0, cz) * B
            local ok = true
            for dx = -2, 2 do for dz = -2, 2 do
                local ring = math.max(math.abs(dx), math.abs(dz)) == 2 and not (math.abs(dx) == 2 and math.abs(dz) == 2)
                if ring and ok then
                    local f = world.nodeAt(center + Vector3.new(dx, 0, dz) * B)
                    local want = dz == -2 and "south" or dz == 2 and "north" or dx == -2 and "east" or "west"
                    if not (f and f.id == "end_portal_frame" and f.state.eye == "true" and f.state.facing == want) then ok = false end
                end
            end end
            if ok then
                for dx = -1, 1 do for dz = -1, 1 do setBlock(center + Vector3.new(dx, 0, dz) * B, "end_portal") end end
                world.updateNeighbors()
                return true
            end
        end end
        return false
    end
    local fenceKnots = {}
    local function useOnBlock(hit, s, name)
        if world.physicsHit then hit=world.physicsHit(hit) end
        local n = world.resolve(hit.Instance)
        local face = faceOf(hit.Normal)
        if name == "bone_meal" and n then
            if boneMeal(n, hit) then consume(1); world.vibrate(n.center, 11, {player = true}); return true end
            return false
        end
        if name == "honeycomb" and n then
            local to = waxed(n.id)
            if to and not n.id:match("^waxed_") then consume(1); return swapKeepState(n, to, "wax_on") end
            return false
        end
        if name and name:match("_axe$") and n then
            if n.id:match("^waxed_") then damageHeld(1); return swapKeepState(n, n.id:gsub("^waxed_", ""), "wax_off") end
            local prev = previousStage(n.id)
            if prev and JavaContent.byId[prev] then damageHeld(1); return swapKeepState(n, prev, "scrape") end
            return false
        end
        if name and name:match("_hoe$") and n and n.id == "rooted_dirt" then
            setBlock(n.center, "dirt"); world.drop(stackOf("hanging_roots", 1), n.center + hit.Normal * B * 0.6); damageHeld(1); world.updateNeighbors(); return true
        end
        if name == "glass_bottle" and (hit.Material == Enum.Material.Water or (n and (n.id == "water" or n.state.waterlogged == "true"))) then
            local water = stackOf("potion", 1); water.potion = "water"; exchange(water); return true
        end
        if name == "potion" and (s.potion or "water") == "water" and n and (n.id == "dirt" or n.id == "coarse_dirt" or n.id == "rooted_dirt") and face ~= "down" then
            setBlock(n.center, "mud"); exchange(stackOf("glass_bottle", 1))
            for _ = 1, 5 do particle("splash", n.center + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * B, Vector3.zero, {life = 10, size = 0.1}) end
            world.updateNeighbors(); return true
        end
        if name == "fire_charge" then if world.ignite and world.ignite(hit, nil) then consume(1) end; return true end
        if name == "ender_eye" and n and n.id == "end_portal_frame" then
            if n.state.eye == "true" then return false end
            n.state.eye = "true"; world.blocks_rebuild(n); consume(1)
            for _ = 1, 16 do particle("smoke", n.center + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0.8, math.random() - 0.5) * B, Vector3.zero, {life = 15, size = 0.1}) end
            checkPortal(n)
            return true
        end
        if name == "end_crystal" then if placeCrystal(hit) then consume(1); return true end; return false end
        if name == "item_frame" or name == "glow_item_frame" then placeFrame(hit, name); consume(1); return true end
        if name == "painting" then if placePainting(hit) then consume(1); return true end; return false end
        if name == "armor_stand" then if face ~= "down" then placeStand(hit); consume(1); return true end; return false end
        if name == "firework_rocket" then items.launchFirework(hit.Position + hit.Normal * 0.1, s); consume(1); return true end
        if name == "lead" or (n and n.id:match("_fence$")) then
            -- LeadItem.bindPlayerMobs: every mob leashed to the player is tied to this fence.
            if n and n.id:match("_fence$") then
                local bound = false
                for _, m in ipairs(api() and api().mobs or {}) do if m.leash == "player" then m.leash = {knot = n.center}; bound = true end end
                if bound then fenceKnots[n] = true; return true end
                if name ~= "lead" then
                    -- Right-clicking a knot takes the mobs back.
                    local taken = false
                    for _, m in ipairs(api() and api().mobs or {}) do if type(m.leash) == "table" and m.leash.knot == n.center then m.leash = "player"; taken = true end end
                    if taken then return true end
                end
            end
            if name == "lead" then return false end
        end
        if (name == "compass") and n and n.id == "lodestone" then
            local out = CreativeRules.withCount(s, 1); out.lodestone = n.center
            if s.count == 1 or creative() then inventory.slots[ui.selected] = out; ui.refresh() else consume(1); give(out) end
            return true
        end
        if name == "debug_stick" and n and creative() then
            -- DebugStickItem: right click cycles the chosen property (sneak: backwards).
            local entry = JavaContent.byIndex[n.index]
            local props = entry and entry.props or {}
            local keys = {}
            for k in pairs(props) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
            table.sort(keys)
            if #keys == 0 then return true end
            s.debug = s.debug or {}
            local key = s.debug[n.id] or keys[1]
            local values = props[key]
            local current = tostring(n.state[key])
            local index = 1
            for i, v in ipairs(values) do if v == current then index = i end end
            index = (index + (world.sneaking and world.sneaking() and -2 or 0)) % #values + 1
            n.state[key] = values[index]
            world.blocks_rebuild(n); world.updateNeighbors()
            actionBar(string.format("\"%s\" to %s", key, values[index]))
            return true
        end
        local mobBucket = name and ({cod_bucket = "cod", salmon_bucket = "salmon", pufferfish_bucket = "pufferfish", tropical_fish_bucket = "tropical_fish", axolotl_bucket = "axolotl", tadpole_bucket = "tadpole"})[name]
        if mobBucket then
            -- MobBucketItem: water placed, then the mob in it.
            local center = (n and n.center or blockCenter(hit)) + faceVectors[face] * B
            if not world.sample(center) then
                setBlock(center, "water")
                if api() then api().spawn(mobBucket, center - Vector3.new(0, B / 2, 0)) end
                exchange(stackOf("bucket", 1))
                world.updateNeighbors()
            end
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    items.useOnBlock = useOnBlock
    local function placeKnotsTick()
        for n in pairs(fenceKnots) do if not world.nodeAt(n.center) then fenceKnots[n] = nil
            for _, m in ipairs(api() and api().mobs or {}) do if type(m.leash) == "table" and m.leash.knot == n.center then m.leash = nil; world.drop(stackOf("lead", 1), n.center) end end
        end end
    end

    -- Maps (MapItem / MapItemSavedData): 128x128 colours rendered top-down around the centre --------
    local function mapCenter(x, scale)
        local size = 128 * 2 ^ scale
        return math.floor((x + 64) / size) * size + size / 2 - 64
    end
    local function makeMap(scale)
        items.nextMap = items.nextMap + 1
        local id = items.nextMap
        local px, pz = root.Position.X / B, root.Position.Z / B
        local data = {id = id, scale = scale or 0, cx = mapCenter(px, scale or 0), cz = mapCenter(pz, scale or 0), pixels = {}, done = 0, image = nil}
        items.maps[id] = data
        return data
    end
    items.makeMap = makeMap
    -- MapColor brightness: higher than the pixel to the north = HIGH, equal = NORMAL, lower = LOW.
    local shades = {180 / 255, 220 / 255, 1}
    local function renderMapRows(data, rows)
        local step = 2 ^ data.scale
        local params = filter()
        for _ = 1, rows do
            local row = data.done
            if row >= 128 then return true end
            local lastHeight
            for col = 0, 127 do
                local x = (data.cx - 64 + (col + 0.5) * step) * B
                local z = (data.cz - 64 + (row + 0.5) * step) * B
                local hit = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, 400 * B, z), Vector3.new(0, -800 * B, 0), params)
                local color, height = nil, nil
                if hit then
                    height = hit.Position.Y
                    local n = world.resolve(hit.Instance)
                    local entry = n and JavaContent.byIndex[n.index]
                    if entry and entry.particle and JavaContent.data.textures[entry.particle] then
                        local avg = JavaContent.averageColor(JavaContent.data.textures[entry.particle])
                        color = avg
                    elseif hit.Material == Enum.Material.Water then color = Color3.fromRGB(64, 64, 255)
                    else color = hit.Instance:IsA("Terrain") and workspace.Terrain:GetMaterialColor(hit.Material) or hit.Instance.Color end
                end
                local north = data.northHeights and data.northHeights[col]
                local shade = 2
                if height and north then shade = height > north + 0.1 and 3 or height < north - 0.1 and 1 or 2 end
                data.pixels[row * 128 + col + 1] = color and Color3.new(color.R * shades[shade], color.G * shades[shade], color.B * shades[shade]) or false
                data.newNorth = data.newNorth or {}
                data.newNorth[col] = height
                lastHeight = height
            end
            data.northHeights, data.newNorth = data.newNorth, nil
            data.done = row + 1
        end
        return data.done >= 128
    end
    -- Writes the map into an EditableImage (map_background colour where nothing was seen).
    local function mapImage(data)
        if data.image and data.imageDone == data.done then return data.content end
        local ok = pcall(function()
            local image = data.image or game:GetService("AssetService"):CreateEditableImage({Size = Vector2.new(128, 128)})
            data.image = image
            local b = buffer.create(128 * 128 * 4)
            for i = 0, 128 * 128 - 1 do
                local c = data.pixels[i + 1]
                if c then
                    buffer.writeu8(b, i * 4, math.floor(c.R * 255)); buffer.writeu8(b, i * 4 + 1, math.floor(c.G * 255)); buffer.writeu8(b, i * 4 + 2, math.floor(c.B * 255)); buffer.writeu8(b, i * 4 + 3, 255)
                end
            end
            image:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Vector2.new(128, 128), b)
            data.content = Content.fromObject(image)
        end)
        data.imageDone = data.done
        return ok and data.content or nil
    end
    function items.mapContent(part, stack)
        local data = stack.map and items.maps[stack.map.id]
        if not data then return end
        local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
        gui.Face, gui.SizingMode, gui.CanvasSize = Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize, Vector2.new(128, 128)
        local label = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        label.BackgroundTransparency, label.Size, label.ResampleMode = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated
        label.ImageContent = mapImage(data) or label.ImageContent
        label.Parent = gui
        gui.Parent = part
    end

    -- Overlays: held map, spyglass scope, carved pumpkin, totem animation --------------------
    local overlayGui
    local function overlays()
        if overlayGui and overlayGui.Parent then return overlayGui end
        local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        overlayGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        overlayGui.Name, overlayGui.IgnoreGuiInset, overlayGui.ResetOnSpawn, overlayGui.DisplayOrder = "SteveItemOverlays", true, false, -1
        overlayGui.Parent = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        return overlayGui
    end
    local function fullImage(name, sprite)
        local g = overlays()
        local node = g:FindFirstChild(name)
        if not node then
            local content = JavaGui.content(sprite)
            node = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            node.Name, node.BackgroundTransparency, node.Size, node.ZIndex = name, 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 1
            if content then node.ImageContent = content end
            node.Parent = g
        end
        return node
    end
    local function heldMapOverlay(stack)
        local g = overlays()
        local frame = g:FindFirstChild("HeldMap")
        local data = stack and stack.map and items.maps[stack.map.id]
        if not data then if frame then frame.Visible = false end; return end
        if not frame then
            frame = Instance.new("Frame")
            frame.Name, frame.BackgroundTransparency, frame.AnchorPoint = "HeldMap", 1, Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
            frame.Position, frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1.02), UDim2.fromScale(0.42, 0.42)
            local ratio = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint"); ratio.Parent = frame
            local bg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            bg.Name, bg.BackgroundTransparency, bg.Size, bg.ResampleMode = "Background", 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated
            local content = JavaGui.content(JavaContent.data.javaGui.map_background)
            if content then bg.ImageContent = content end
            bg.Parent = frame
            local pixels = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            pixels.Name, pixels.BackgroundTransparency, pixels.ResampleMode = "Pixels", 1, Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated
            pixels.Position, pixels.Size = UDim2.fromScale(7 / 142, 7 / 142), UDim2.fromScale(128 / 142, 128 / 142)
            pixels.Parent = frame
            local marker = Instance.new("Frame")
            marker.Name, marker.BackgroundColor3, marker.BorderSizePixel, marker.AnchorPoint, marker.Size = "Player", Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0, Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.03, 0.04)
            marker.Parent = pixels
            frame.Parent = g
        end
        frame.Visible = true
        local content = mapImage(data)
        if content then frame.Pixels.ImageContent = content end
        local step = 2 ^ data.scale
        local mx = (root.Position.X / B - (data.cx - 64)) / step / 128
        local mz = (root.Position.Z / B - (data.cz - 64)) / step / 128
        frame.Pixels.Player.Visible = mx >= 0 and mx <= 1 and mz >= 0 and mz <= 1
        frame.Pixels.Player.Position = UDim2.fromScale(mx, mz)
    end
    local totemAnim
    local function totemOverlay()
        if not totemAnim then return end
        local t = (os.clock() - totemAnim.start) * 20
        local node = fullImage("Totem", JavaContent.data.javaGui["item/totem_of_undying"])
        if t > 40 then node.Visible = false; totemAnim = nil; return end
        -- GameRenderer.renderItemActivationAnimation: rises, grows and spins over 40 ticks.
        local f = t / 40
        local g, h2 = f * f, f * f * f
        local scale = 50 + 175 * math.sin(math.sqrt(f) * math.pi)
        node.Visible = true
        node.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        node.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(scale * 2, scale * 2)
        node.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + 0.0, 0.5 + (1 - h2 * 0 - g) * 0.25 - 0.1)
        node.Rotation = 900 * math.abs(math.sin(f * math.pi)) * 0.05
        node.ImageTransparency = 0
    end
    function items.tryTotem()
        local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local slot
        if inventory.slots[ui.selected] and nameOf(inventory.slots[ui.selected]) == "totem_of_undying" then slot = ui.selected
        elseif inventory.slots[41] and nameOf(inventory.slots[41]) == "totem_of_undying" then slot = 41 end
        if not slot or not hum then return false end
        local s = inventory.slots[slot]
        s.count = s.count - 1
        if s.count <= 0 then inventory.slots[slot] = nil end
        ui.refresh()
        -- LivingEntity.checkTotemDeathProtection
        hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth / 20
        if fx() then fx().clear(); fx().give("regeneration", 45, 1); fx().give("absorption", 5, 1); fx().give("fire_resistance", 40, 0) end
        totemAnim = {start = os.clock()}
        items.totemParticles = 30
        return true
    end
    function items.hasTotem()
        local a, b = inventory.slots[ui.selected], inventory.slots[41]
        return (a and nameOf(a) == "totem_of_undying") or (b and nameOf(b) == "totem_of_undying") or false
    end

    -- Item.use and held uses ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    local throwables = {snowball = {1.5, 0, 0.03}, egg = {1.5, 0, 0.03}, blue_egg = {1.5, 0, 0.03}, brown_egg = {1.5, 0, 0.03},
        ender_pearl = {1.5, 0, 0.03, 20}, splash_potion = {0.5, -20, 0.05}, lingering_potion = {0.5, -20, 0.05},
        experience_bottle = {0.7, -20, 0.07}, wind_charge = {1.5, 0, 0, 10}}
    local function findAmmo(crossbow)
        local function ok(s) local n = s and nameOf(s); return n == "arrow" or n == "spectral_arrow" or n == "tipped_arrow" or (crossbow and n == "firework_rocket") end
        if ok(inventory.slots[41]) then return 41 end
        for i = 1, 36 do if ok(inventory.slots[i]) and nameOf(inventory.slots[i]) ~= "firework_rocket" then return i end end
        if creative() then return "creative" end
    end
    local function crossbowCharge(s) return 25 - 5 * ((s.enchantments or {}).quick_charge or 0) end
    local function shootCrossbow(s)
        local ammo = s.charged
        s.charged = nil
        local dir = look()
        local count = ((s.enchantments or {}).multishot or 0) > 0 and 3 or 1
        for i = 1, count do
            local angle = count == 1 and 0 or ({0, -10, 10})[i]
            local d = (CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.yAxis, math.rad(angle)) * CFrame.new()):VectorToWorldSpace(dir)
            if ammo.name == "firework_rocket" then
                items.launchFirework(eye() + d * B * 0.3, ammo.stack, d * 1.6 * B)
                items.rockets[#items.rockets].straight = true
            elseif world.gameplay then
                world.gameplay.shoot(eye() + d * B * 0.3, d, 3.15 / 3, nil, ammo.name)
            end
        end
        damageHeld(count == 3 and 3 or 1)
        ui.refresh()
    end
    local bobber
    local function removeBobber() if bobber then bobber.part:Destroy(); if bobber.line then bobber.line:Destroy() end; bobber = nil end end
    local function reel(s)
        if not bobber then return end
        local damage = 0
        if bobber.mob then bobber.mob.knock = (root.Position - bobber.mob.position).Unit * 0.1 * B * 10; damage = 5
        elseif bobber.biting and bobber.biting > 0 then
            -- FishingHook.retrieve: fishing loot (luck of the sea), 1-6 XP.
            local loot = JavaContent.data.loot["gameplay/fishing"]
            for _, st in ipairs(loot and LootRules.roll(loot, {player = true, luck = (s.enchantments or {}).luck_of_the_sea or 0}) or {}) do
                local e = JavaContent.itemById[st.name]
                if e then local out = {id = e.index, count = st.count}; for k, v in pairs(st.components or {}) do out[k] = v end; world.drop(out, bobber.position, (root.Position - bobber.position) * 0.1 + Vector3.new(0, B * 3, 0)) end
            end
            items.spawnXp(root.Position, math.random(1, 6))
            damage = 1
        elseif bobber.stuck then damage = 2 end
        if damage > 0 then damageHeld(damage) end
        removeBobber()
    end
    local function cast(s)
        local dir = look()
        local part = billboard((JavaContent.data.itemEntities or {}).fishing_hook, 0.3)
        local line = Instance.new("Part")
        line.Name, line.Anchored, line.CanCollide, line.CanQuery, line.CanTouch, line.Color, line.Material = "FishingLine", true, false, false, false, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        line.Size, line.Parent = Vector3.new(0.02, 0.02, 0.02), folder
        local lure = (s.enchantments or {}).lure or 0
        bobber = {position = eye() + dir * B * 0.3, velocity = dir * B * 1.0, part = part, line = line, age = 0, lure = lure}
    end
    local consumable = function(name) return JavaContent.data.food[name] or drinks[name] end
    local function startUse(s, name, hit, sneaking)
        local a = api()
        local spearStats = toolStats[s.id]
        if spearStats and spearStats.kind == "spear" and spearStats.kinetic then
            items.using = {name = name, slot = ui.selected, ticks = 0, kind = "spear", duration = spearStats.kinetic.delay + spearStats.kinetic.damage[1]}
            if MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.play(name == "wooden_spear" and "item.spear_wood.use" or "item.spear.use", root.Position, 1, 1) end
            return true
        end
        local throw = throwables[name]
        if throw then
            if items.onCooldown(s) > 0 then return true end
            local stack = CreativeRules.withCount(s, 1)
            launch(name, throw[1], throw[2], throw[3], iconSprite(s.id), onHit[name], {stack = stack})
            if throw[4] then cooldown(name, throw[4]) end
            consume(1); swing()
            world.vibrate(root.Position, 14, {player = true})
            return true
        end
        -- Consumable component (1.21.2+): the stack's own consumable/food first, then the item's defaults.
        if (consumable(name) and not s.noConsume) or s.consumable then
            local food = s.food or JavaContent.data.food[name]
            if food and not food.always and not creative() and a and a.hunger >= 20 and name ~= "honey_bottle" and name ~= "ominous_bottle" then return true end
            if items.onCooldown(s) > 0 then return true end
            local seconds = s.consumable and tonumber(s.consumable.consume_seconds)
            items.using = {name = name, slot = ui.selected, ticks = 0, duration = seconds and math.max(1, math.floor(seconds * 20 + 0.5)) or drinks[name] or (food and food.duration) or 32, kind = "consume"}
            return true
        end
        if name == "crossbow" then
            if s.charged then shootCrossbow(s); return true end
            if not findAmmo(true) then return true end
            items.using = {name = name, slot = ui.selected, ticks = 0, duration = crossbowCharge(s), kind = "crossbow"}
            return true
        end
        if name == "trident" then
            local max = JavaGui.maxDamage(s.id)
            if max and (s.damage or 0) >= max - 1 then return true end
            local riptide = (s.enchantments or {}).riptide or 0
            local raining = world.chat and world.chat.weather and world.chat.weather ~= "clear"
            if riptide > 0 and not ((world.inWater and world.inWater()) or raining) then return true end
            items.using = {name = name, slot = ui.selected, ticks = 0, kind = "trident"}
            return true
        end
        if name == "fishing_rod" then
            if bobber then reel(s) else cast(s) end
            swing()
            return true
        end
        if name == "goat_horn" then
            if items.onCooldown(s) > 0 then return true end
            local seconds = (JavaContent.data.instruments or {})[s.instrument or "ponder_goat_horn"] or 7
            cooldown("goat_horn", math.floor(seconds * 20))
            items.using = {name = name, slot = ui.selected, ticks = 0, duration = math.floor(seconds * 20), kind = "horn"}
            world.vibrate(root.Position, 11, {player = true})
            return true
        end
        if name == "brush" then items.using = {name = name, slot = ui.selected, ticks = 0, kind = "brush"}; return true end
        if name and name:match("bundle$") then
            if s.bundle and #s.bundle > 0 then items.using = {name = name, slot = ui.selected, ticks = 0, kind = "bundle"} end
            return true
        end
        if name == "map" then
            local data = makeMap(0)
            local out = stackOf("filled_map", 1)
            out.map = {id = data.id, scale = 0}
            exchange(out)
            return true
        end
        if name == "writable_book" then if screens.bookEdit then screens.bookEdit(s, ui.selected) end; return true end
        if name == "written_book" then screens.book({pages = (s.book or {}).pages or {""}}); return true end
        if name == "knowledge_book" then consume(1); return true end
        return false
    end
    local function release(u, s)
        if u.kind == "crossbow" and s and u.ticks >= u.duration and not s.charged then
            -- CrossbowItem.releaseUsing: load (multishot loads three from one item).
            local slot = findAmmo(true)
            if slot then
                local ammo = slot == "creative" and stackOf("arrow", 1) or inventory.slots[slot]
                s.charged = {name = nameOf(ammo), stack = CreativeRules.withCount(ammo, 1)}
                if slot ~= "creative" and not creative() then ammo.count = ammo.count - 1; if ammo.count <= 0 then inventory.slots[slot] = nil end end
                ui.refresh()
            end
        elseif u.kind == "trident" and s and u.ticks >= 10 then
            local riptide = (s.enchantments or {}).riptide or 0
            if riptide > 0 then
                -- TridentItem.releaseUsing: riptide launches the player.
                local f = 3 * (1 + riptide) / 4
                impulse(look() * f)
                damageHeld(1)
                items.riptide = 20
            else
                local stack = CreativeRules.withCount(s, 1)
                local model = JavaContent.entityModel("trident", 1, B, folder, eye(), 0)
                launch("trident", 2.5, 0, 0.05, nil, onHit.trident, {stack = stack, model = model, loyalty = (s.enchantments or {}).loyalty or 0, creativeThrow = creative()})
                damageHeld(1)
                if not creative() then inventory.slots[ui.selected] = nil; ui.refresh() end
            end
            swing()
        end
    end
    local suspicious = {suspicious_sand = {"sand", "archaeology/desert_pyramid"}, suspicious_gravel = {"gravel", "archaeology/trail_ruins_common"}}
    local function usingTick(u, s, aim)
        u.ticks = u.ticks + 1
        if u.kind == "crossbow" then
            -- Fully charged: the projectile is loaded and the use ends by itself, button held or not.
            if u.ticks >= u.duration then
                items.using = nil
                if s and not s.charged then release(u, s) end
                if MinecraftSounds then pcall(MinecraftSounds.play, "item.crossbow.loading_end", nil, 1, 1) end
            end
            return
        end
        if u.kind == "consume" then
            -- Eating particles: every 4 ticks once 25 ticks or fewer remain.
            local left = u.duration - u.ticks
            if left <= 25 and u.ticks % 4 == 0 and MinecraftSounds then
                if drinks[u.name] then MinecraftSounds.play("entity.generic.drink", nil, 0.5, math.random() * 0.1 + 0.9)
                else MinecraftSounds.play("entity.generic.eat", nil, 0.5 + 0.5 * math.random(0, 1), (math.random() - math.random()) * 0.2 + 1) end
            end
            if left <= 25 and u.ticks % 4 == 0 and iconSprite(s.id) then
                for _ = 1, 5 do particle("item", eye() + look() * B * 0.4 - Vector3.new(0, 0.2 * B, 0), Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() * 0.3, math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.15, {sprites = {iconSprite(s.id)}, uv = {math.random(0, 12), math.random(0, 12), 0, 0}, size = 0.08, life = 15, gravity = 0.04 * B}) end
            end
            if u.ticks >= u.duration then
                items.using = nil
                if MinecraftSounds and not drinks[u.name] then MinecraftSounds.play("entity.player.burp", nil, 0.5, math.random() * 0.1 + 0.9) end
                finishConsume(s, u.name)
            end
        elseif u.kind == "spear" then
            items.spearCharge(u, s, items.motion and items.motion() or Vector3.zero)
            if u.ticks >= u.duration then items.using = nil end
        elseif u.kind == "brush" then
            local hit = aim()
            local n = hit and world.resolve(hit.Instance)
            if u.ticks >= 200 then items.using = nil; return end
            if n and suspicious[n.id] and u.ticks % 10 == 5 then
                -- BrushableBlockEntity.brush: dusted 0..3, done after 10 brushes.
                n.brushed = (n.brushed or 0) + 1
                n.state.dusted = tostring(math.min(3, math.floor(n.brushed / 3)))
                world.blocks_rebuild(n)
                for _ = 1, 4 do particle("block", hit.Position, hit.Normal * B * 0.05, {sprites = {JavaContent.data.textures[JavaContent.byIndex[n.index].particle]}, life = 10, size = 0.1}) end
                if n.brushed >= 10 then
                    local loot = JavaContent.data.loot[suspicious[n.id][2]]
                    for _, st in ipairs(loot and LootRules.roll(loot, {player = true}) or {}) do
                        local e = JavaContent.itemById[st.name]
                        if e then world.drop({id = e.index, count = st.count}, n.center + hit.Normal * B * 0.6, hit.Normal * B) end
                    end
                    setBlock(n.center, suspicious[n.id][1])
                    world.updateNeighbors()
                    damageHeld(1)
                end
            end
        elseif u.kind == "bundle" then
            if u.ticks % 4 == 0 then
                local list = s.bundle or {}
                local last = table.remove(list)
                if last then world.drop(last) else items.using = nil end
                if #list == 0 then s.bundle = nil; items.using = nil end
                ui.refresh()
            end
        elseif u.kind == "horn" then
            if u.ticks >= u.duration then items.using = nil end
        end
    end
    -- Called every tick from the controller: entity, block, useOn and use, in Java's order.
    function items.interact(down, pressed, sneaking, index, aim, place)
        local s = held()
        local name = s and nameOf(s)
        local u = items.using
        if u then
            if not s or u.slot ~= ui.selected or nameOf(s) ~= u.name then items.using = nil; return false end
            if not down then items.using = nil; release(u, s); return true end
            usingTick(u, s, aim)
            return true
        end
        if not pressed then return false end
        if s and JavaContent.mods.useItem(s, name, sneaking) then swing(); return true end
        local hit = aim()
        if hit then
            local e = items.entityFrom(hit.Instance)
            if e then if useEntity(e, s, hit) then swing() end; return true end
            local m = mobFrom(hit.Instance)
            if m then
                -- Mob.interact (trading, riding, sitting) before the item's interactLivingEntity.
                local mm = world.gameplay and world.gameplay.mobsModule
                if mm and mm.interact(m, s, name) then swing(); return true end
                if s and useOnMob(m, s, name) then swing(); return true end
            else
                if world.use(hit, sneaking, index) then swing(); return true end
                if s and not (sneaking and false) and useOnBlock(hit, s, name) then swing(); return true end
                local entry = s and JavaContent.byIndex[s.id]
                if s and consumable(name) and entry and not entry.itemOnly and place and place(hit) then swing(); return true end
            end
        end
        if s and name == "firework_rocket" and world.gameplay and world.gameplay.gliding then return false end
        if s then return startUse(s, name, hit, sneaking) end
        return false
    end
    function items.useProgress()
        local u = items.using
        if not u then return nil end
        return u.name, u.ticks, u.duration
    end

    -- Left clicks: entities, debug stick, mace smash ------------------------------------------
    -- Creative debug stick: no mining; a left click picks the property to change.
    function items.blocksMining(hit, pressed)
        if JavaContent.mods.mine then
            local okM, taken = pcall(JavaContent.mods.mine, pressed)
            if okM and taken then return true end
        end
        for _, m in ipairs(JavaContent.mods.list) do
            if m.enabled and m.mine then
                local okM, taken = pcall(m.mine, pressed)
                if okM and taken then return true end
            end
        end
        local s = held()
        if not (s and nameOf(s) == "debug_stick" and creative()) then return false end
        if pressed then items.attackBlock(hit) end
        return true
    end
    function items.attackBlock(hit)
        local s = held()
        if s and nameOf(s) == "debug_stick" and creative() then
            local n = world.resolve(hit.Instance)
            local entry = n and JavaContent.byIndex[n.index]
            if entry and entry.props then
                local keys = {}
                for k in pairs(entry.props) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
                table.sort(keys)
                if #keys > 0 then
                    s.debug = s.debug or {}
                    local current, index = s.debug[n.id], 0
                    for i, k in ipairs(keys) do if k == current then index = i end end
                    s.debug[n.id] = keys[index % #keys + 1]
                    actionBar(string.format("selected \"%s\" (%s)", s.debug[n.id], tostring(n.state[s.debug[n.id]])))
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    local fallStart, lastY
    function items.attackBonus(victimPosition)
        local s = held()
        if not (s and nameOf(s) == "mace") then return 0 end
        local fall = items.fallDistance or 0
        if fall <= 1.5 then return 0 end
        -- MaceItem.getAttackDamageBonus: 4/block for 3 blocks, 2/block to 8, then 1/block (+ density).
        local bonus = fall <= 3 and 4 * fall or fall <= 8 and 12 + 2 * (fall - 3) or 22 + fall - 8
        bonus = bonus + 0.5 * ((s.enchantments or {}).density or 0) * fall
        items.fallDistance = 0
        for _ = 1, 20 do particle("block", victimPosition, Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random(), math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.3, {life = 15, size = 0.1}) end
        for _, m in ipairs(nearbyMobs(victimPosition, 3.5)) do m.knock = ((m.position - victimPosition) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Unit * B * 0.7 + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.4, 0) end
        return bonus
    end

    -- Player.attack (Java) -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function tagged(tag, id)
        for _, t in ipairs((JavaContent.data.entityTags or {})[tag] or {}) do if t == id then return true end end
        return false
    end
    local function level(s, name) return s and (s.enchantments or {})[name] or 0 end
    -- EnchantmentHelper.modifyDamage.
    function items.enchantDamage(s, targetId)
        local bonus = 0
        local sharp = level(s, "sharpness")
        if sharp > 0 then bonus = bonus + 1 + 0.5 * (sharp - 1) end
        if targetId then
            if tagged("sensitive_to_smite", targetId) then bonus = bonus + 2.5 * level(s, "smite") end
            if tagged("sensitive_to_bane_of_arthropods", targetId) then bonus = bonus + 2.5 * level(s, "bane_of_arthropods") end
            if tagged("sensitive_to_impaling", targetId) then bonus = bonus + 2.5 * level(s, "impaling") end
        end
        return bonus
    end
    local function sound(event, position) if MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.play(event, position, 1, 1) end end
    -- info: {strength, baseDamage (attribute), sprinting, grounded, falling, inWater, climbing, riding,
    --        horizontalSpeed (blocks/tick), position (player), yaw, onKnockback(), noFall(), launch(v)}
    function items.playerAttack(m, info)
        local a = api()
        local mm = a and a.mobsModule
        if not mm then return false end
        local s = held()
        local stats = s and toolStats[s.id]
        local strength = info.strength
        local magic = strength * items.enchantDamage(s, m.id)
        local base = info.baseDamage * (0.2 + strength * strength * 0.8)
        local full = strength > 0.9
        local knockbackHit = info.sprinting and full
        if knockbackHit then sound("entity.player.attack.knockback", info.position) end
        -- Item.getAttackDamageBonus (the mace smash).
        local smashing = s and nameOf(s) == "mace" and (items.fallDistance or 0) > 1.5
        local fall = items.fallDistance or 0
        base = base + items.attackBonus(m.position)
        local crit = full and info.falling and not info.grounded and not info.climbing and not info.inWater and not info.riding and not info.sprinting
        if crit then base = base * 1.5 end
        local total = base + magic
        -- Swords sweep, and so does anything carrying Sweeping Edge.
        local sweeps = s and ((stats and stats.kind == "sword") or nameOf(s):match("_sword$") or level(s, "sweeping_edge") > 0)
        local sweep = full and not crit and not knockbackHit and info.grounded and info.horizontalSpeed < 0.1 * 2.5 and sweeps
        if total <= 0 then return false end
        local before = m.humanoid.Health
        local source = {player = true, position = info.position, breach = smashing and level(s, "breach") or nil}
        local hurt = mm.hurt(m, total, source)
        if not hurt then sound("entity.player.attack.nodamage", info.position); return false end
        -- LivingEntity.hurt knockback, then Player.causeExtraKnockback.
        mm.knockback(m, info.position, 0.4)
        local extra = level(s, "knockback") + (knockbackHit and 0.5 or 0)
        if extra > 0 then mm.knockback(m, info.position, extra); info.onKnockback() end
        local fire = level(s, "fire_aspect")
        if fire > 0 then m.onFire = math.max(m.onFire or 0, 80 * fire) end
        if sweep then
            sound("entity.player.attack.sweep", info.position)
            local ratio = level(s, "sweeping_edge")
            ratio = ratio > 0 and ratio / (ratio + 1) or 0
            -- Item.getSweepHitBox: the target's box inflated 1 x 0.25 x 1; distanceToSqr(player) < 9.
            -- Mob boxes: width x height x width (x scale, studs) standing on `position`.
            local half = m.width * m.scale / 2
            for _, other in ipairs(nearbyMobs(m.position, half / B + 3)) do
                local d = other.position - m.position
                local oh = other.width * other.scale / 2
                local inBox = math.abs(d.X) < half + B + oh and math.abs(d.Z) < half + B + oh
                    and d.Y < m.height * m.scale + 0.25 * B and -d.Y < other.height * other.scale + 0.25 * B
                if other ~= m and inBox and (other.position - info.position).Magnitude < 3 * B then
                    local d = (1 + ratio * base + items.enchantDamage(s, other.id)) * strength
                    if mm.hurt(other, d, source) then mm.knockback(other, info.position, 0.4) end
                end
            end
            local look = Vector3.new(-math.sin(info.yaw), 0, -math.cos(info.yaw))
            particle("sweep_attack", info.position + look * B, Vector3.zero, {life = 4, size = 1})
        end
        if crit then sound("entity.player.attack.crit", info.position); for _ = 1, 12 do particle("crit", m.position + Vector3.new(0, B, 0), Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random(), math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.3, {life = 10, size = 0.1}) end end
        if not crit and not sweep then sound(full and "entity.player.attack.strong" or "entity.player.attack.weak", info.position) end
        if magic > 0 then for _ = 1, 12 do particle("enchanted_hit", m.position + Vector3.new(0, B, 0), Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random(), math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.3, {life = 10, size = 0.1}) end end
        -- MaceItem.hurtEnemy: the smash stops your fall (no fall damage); wind burst launches you back up.
        if smashing then
            info.noFall()
            sound(fall > 5 and "item.mace.smash_ground_heavy" or "item.mace.smash_ground", m.position)
            local wind = level(s, "wind_burst")
            if wind > 0 then info.launch(0.35 + 0.35 * wind) end
        end
        local dealt = before - m.humanoid.Health
        if dealt > 2 then for _ = 1, math.floor(dealt * 0.5) do particle("damage_indicator", m.position + Vector3.new(0, B, 0), Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.2, {life = 12, size = 0.12}) end end
        return true
    end
    -- PiercingWeapon (spear jab): every mob 2-4.5 blocks along the aim (hitbox margin 0.125).
    function items.spearTargets(eyePosition, look, minReach, maxReach)
        local out = {}
        for _, m in ipairs(nearbyMobs(eyePosition, maxReach + 2)) do
            local centre = m.position + Vector3.new(0, (m.height or 1) * 0.5 * B, 0)
            local along = (centre - eyePosition):Dot(look)
            local off = ((centre - eyePosition) - look * along).Magnitude
            local half = (m.width or 0.6) * 0.5 * B + 0.125 * B + math.max(0, ((m.height or 1) * 0.5 - 0.3)) * B * 0.5
            if along >= minReach * B and along <= maxReach * B and off <= half then out[#out + 1] = m end
        end
        return out
    end
    function items.spearJab(info)
        local s = held()
        local stats = s and toolStats[s.id]
        if not (stats and stats.kind == "spear") then return false end
        -- MINIMUM_ATTACK_CHARGE 1: only a fully charged jab attacks.
        if info.strength < 1 then return false end
        local hitAny = false
        for _, m in ipairs(items.spearTargets(eye(), look(), 2, 4.5)) do
            if items.playerAttack(m, info) then hitAny = true end
        end
        if MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.play(s.id and nameOf(s) == "wooden_spear" and "item.spear_wood.attack" or "item.spear.attack", info.position, 1, 1) end
        return hitAny
    end
    -- KineticWeapon.damageEntities: holding use with a spear, each tick, every mob in reach (once per 10 ticks).
    function items.spearCharge(u, s, motion)
        local stats = toolStats[s.id]
        local k = stats and stats.kinetic
        if not k then return end
        local used = u.ticks - k.delay
        if used < 0 then return end
        local lookV = look()
        local speed = lookV:Dot(motion * 20)
        u.stabbed = u.stabbed or {}
        local a = api()
        local mm = a and a.mobsModule
        if not mm then return end
        for _, m in ipairs(items.spearTargets(eye(), lookV, 2, 4.5)) do
            if not u.stabbed[m] or u.ticks - u.stabbed[m] >= 10 then
                local targetSpeed = lookV:Dot((m.velocity or Vector3.zero) / B * 20)
                local relative = math.max(0, speed - targetSpeed)
                local damageOk = used <= k.damage[1] and relative >= k.damage[2]
                local knockOk = used <= k.knockback[1] and speed >= k.knockback[2]
                if damageOk or knockOk then
                    u.stabbed[m] = u.ticks
                    local amount = 1 + math.floor(relative * k.multiplier) + items.enchantDamage(s, m.id)
                    local hit = damageOk and mm.hurt(m, amount, {player = true, position = root.Position})
                    if knockOk then mm.knockback(m, root.Position, 0.4 + level(s, "knockback")) end
                    if hit or knockOk then
                        if MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.play(nameOf(s) == "wooden_spear" and "item.spear_wood.hit" or "item.spear.hit", m.position, 1, 1) end
                        world.damageTool(s.id, 1, s)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Ticks --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
