    local function stepProjectiles()
        for i = #items.projectiles, 1, -1 do
            local p = items.projectiles[i]
            p.age = p.age + 1
            p.previous = p.position
            local remove = false
            if p.kind == "trident" and (p.stuck or p.returning) then
                -- ThrownTrident: loyalty brings it back; otherwise it waits to be picked up.
                if (p.loyalty or 0) > 0 then p.returning = true end
                if p.returning and (p.loyalty or 0) > 0 then
                    local to = eye() - p.position
                    p.velocity = to.Unit * math.min(to.Magnitude, B * 0.05 * p.loyalty * 10)
                    p.position = p.position + p.velocity
                    p.stuck = false
                end
                local near = (root.Position - p.position).Magnitude < 1.5 * B
                if near and p.age > 5 then
                    if not p.creativeThrow then give(p.stack) end
                    remove = true
                elseif p.age > 1200 and not p.loyalty then remove = true end
            else
                local hit = workspace:Raycast(p.position, p.velocity, filter({p.part}))
                if hit then
                    p.position = hit.Position
                    local keep = p.onHit and p.onHit(p, hit)
                    if not keep then remove = true end
                    world.vibrate(p.position, 2, {player = true})
                else
                    p.position = p.position + p.velocity
                    -- ThrowableProjectile: drag 0.99 (0.8 in water), then gravity.
                    p.velocity = p.velocity * 0.99 - Vector3.new(0, p.gravity, 0)
                end
                if p.age > 1200 then remove = true end
            end
            if remove then
                if p.model then p.model.model:Destroy() else p.part:Destroy() end
                table.remove(items.projectiles, i)
            end
        end
    end
    local function stepOrbs()
        for i = #items.orbs, 1, -1 do
            local o = items.orbs[i]
            o.age = o.age + 1
            local target = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6 * B, 0)
            local d = target - o.position
            local dist = d.Magnitude / B
            -- ExperienceOrb.tick: within 8 blocks it accelerates towards the player.
            if dist < 8 then o.velocity = o.velocity + d.Unit * B * (1 - dist / 8) ^ 2 * 0.1 end
            o.velocity = o.velocity - Vector3.new(0, 0.03 * B, 0)
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(o.position, o.velocity, filter({o.part}))
            if hit and hit.Normal.Y > 0.5 and dist >= 8 then o.position = hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0); o.velocity = o.velocity * Vector3.new(0.98, 0, 0.98)
            else o.position = o.position + o.velocity; o.velocity = o.velocity * 0.98 end
            if dist < 1.2 or o.age > 6000 then
                if dist < 1.2 then
                    -- Mending repairs a worn item first, 2 durability per point.
                    local points = o.value
                    for _, slot in ipairs({ui.selected, 41}) do
                        local st = inventory.slots[slot]
                        if st and (st.enchantments or {}).mending and (st.damage or 0) > 0 and points > 0 then
                            local fix = math.min(st.damage, points * 2)
                            st.damage = st.damage - fix; points = points - math.ceil(fix / 2)
                        end
                    end
                    if points > 0 and PlayerStats.addXp then PlayerStats.addXp(points) end
                    ui.refresh()
                end
                o.part:Destroy()
                table.remove(items.orbs, i)
            end
        end
    end
    local function stepClouds()
        for i = #items.clouds, 1, -1 do
            local c = items.clouds[i]
            c.age = c.age + 1
            c.radius = c.radius - 3 / c.duration
            for _ = 1, math.ceil(c.radius * c.radius * math.pi * 0.2) do
                local a, r = math.random() * math.pi * 2, math.sqrt(math.random()) * c.radius
                particle("entity_effect", c.position + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, 0.1, math.sin(a) * r) * B, Vector3.new(0, 0.01 * B, 0), {life = 20, size = 0.12, tint = rgb3(c.color)})
            end
            if c.age > c.waitTime and c.age % 5 == 0 then
                local d = (root.Position - c.position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                if d.Magnitude <= c.radius * B and math.abs(root.Position.Y - c.position.Y) < 2 * B and (c.applied.player or 0) <= world.tickCount then
                    drinkPotion(c.stack, 0.25)
                    c.applied.player = world.tickCount + 20
                    c.radius = c.radius - 0.5
                end
            end
            if c.age >= c.duration or c.radius <= 0.5 then table.remove(items.clouds, i) end
        end
    end
    local function stepRockets()
        for i = #items.rockets, 1, -1 do
            local r = items.rockets[i]
            r.age = r.age + 1
            if not r.straight then r.velocity = Vector3.new(r.velocity.X * 1.15, r.velocity.Y + 0.04 * B, r.velocity.Z * 1.15) end
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(r.position, r.velocity, filter({r.part}))
            if hit and r.straight then r.position = hit.Position; r.age = r.lifetime else r.position = r.position + r.velocity end
            if r.age % 2 == 0 then particle("firework", r.position, -r.velocity * 0.05, {life = 10, size = 0.08, fullbright = true}) end
            if r.age >= r.lifetime then
                fireworkBurst(r.position, r.explosions)
                r.part:Destroy()
                table.remove(items.rockets, i)
            end
        end
    end
    local function waterAt(position)
        local n = world.nodeAt and world.cell and world.nodeAt(world.cell(position))
        if n and (n.id == "water" or n.state.waterlogged == "true") then return true end
        local ok, region = pcall(function()
            local cell = Vector3.new(math.floor(position.X / 4) * 4, math.floor(position.Y / 4) * 4, math.floor(position.Z / 4) * 4)
            return workspace.Terrain:ReadVoxels(Region3.new(cell, cell + Vector3.new(4, 4, 4)), 4)
        end)
        return ok and region and region[1] and region[1][1] and region[1][1][1] == Enum.Material.Water
    end
    local function stepBobber()
        if not bobber then return end
        local b = bobber
        b.age = b.age + 1
        local s = held()
        if not s or nameOf(s) ~= "fishing_rod" or (b.position - root.Position).Magnitude > 32 * B then removeBobber(); return end
        if b.mob then
            if b.mob.humanoid.Health <= 0 then b.mob = nil else b.position = b.mob.position + Vector3.new(0, b.mob.height * b.mob.scale * 0.8, 0) end
            return
        end
        local inWater = waterAt(b.position)
        if inWater then
            -- FishingHook.catchingFish: wait, nibble (fish approaching), then a 20-40 tick bite.
            b.velocity = Vector3.new(b.velocity.X * 0.9, (b.velocity.Y + 0.02 * B) * 0.9, b.velocity.Z * 0.9)
            if not b.wait then b.wait = math.max(20, math.random(100, 600) - b.lure * 100) end
            if b.biting and b.biting > 0 then
                b.biting = b.biting - 1
                if b.biting == 0 then b.wait = math.max(20, math.random(100, 600) - b.lure * 100) end
            elseif b.nibble and b.nibble > 0 then
                b.nibble = b.nibble - 1
                if b.nibble % 3 == 0 then particle("fishing", b.position + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0, math.random() - 0.5) * B * b.nibble / 20, Vector3.zero, {life = 8, size = 0.08}) end
                if b.nibble == 0 then
                    b.biting = math.random(20, 40)
                    b.velocity = b.velocity - Vector3.new(0, 0.2 * B, 0)
                    for _ = 1, 10 do particle("splash", b.position, Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random(), math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.1, {life = 10, size = 0.08}) end
                end
            else
                b.wait = b.wait - 1
                if b.wait <= 0 then b.nibble = math.random(20, 80) end
            end
            b.position = b.position + b.velocity
        elseif not b.stuck then
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(b.position, b.velocity, filter({b.part}))
            if hit then
                local m = mobFrom(hit.Instance)
                if m then b.mob = m else b.position = hit.Position; b.stuck = true end
            else
                b.position = b.position + b.velocity
                b.velocity = b.velocity * 0.92 - Vector3.new(0, 0.03 * B, 0)
            end
        end
    end
    local function stepMobs()
        local a = api()
        if not a then return end
        for _, m in ipairs(a.mobs) do
            if m.humanoid.Health > 0 then
                -- Leads: pulled along beyond 6 blocks, snap beyond 10 (Leashable).
                local holder = m.leash == "player" and root.Position or (type(m.leash) == "table" and m.leash.knot)
                if holder then
                    local d = holder - m.position
                    if d.Magnitude > 10 * B then m.leash = nil; world.drop(stackOf("lead", 1), m.position)
                    elseif d.Magnitude > 6 * B then m.position = m.position + d.Unit * math.min(d.Magnitude - 6 * B, 0.3 * B) end
                end
                if m.knock then m.velocity = (m.velocity or Vector3.zero) + m.knock; m.knock = nil end
                if m.ignited then
                    m.ignited = m.ignited - 1
                    if m.ignited <= 0 then
                        m.ignited = nil
                        local p = m.position
                        m.humanoid.Health = 0
                        if world.explode then world.explode(p) end
                    end
                end
                -- Status effects on mobs (poison / wither / regeneration ticks).
                for id, e in pairs(m.effects or {}) do
                    e.ticks = e.ticks - 1
                    local every = math.max(1, math.floor(25 / 2 ^ e.amplifier))
                    if id == "poison" and world.tickCount % every == 0 and m.humanoid.Health > 1 then m.humanoid:TakeDamage(1)
                    elseif id == "wither" and world.tickCount % math.max(1, math.floor(40 / 2 ^ e.amplifier)) == 0 then m.humanoid:TakeDamage(1)
                    elseif id == "regeneration" and world.tickCount % math.max(1, math.floor(50 / 2 ^ e.amplifier)) == 0 then m.humanoid.Health = math.min(m.humanoid.MaxHealth, m.humanoid.Health + 1) end
                    if e.ticks <= 0 then m.effects[id] = nil end
                end
                -- Breeding: two adults in love within 8 blocks make a baby (+1-7 XP).
                if (m.love or 0) > 0 then
                    m.love = m.love - 1
                    if m.love % 10 == 0 then particle("heart", m.position + Vector3.new(0, m.height * m.scale, 0), Vector3.zero, {life = 20, size = 0.2}) end
                    for _, other in ipairs(a.mobs) do
                        if other ~= m and other.id == m.id and (other.love or 0) > 0 and (other.position - m.position).Magnitude < 8 * B then
                            m.love, other.love = 0, 0
                            m.breedCooldown, other.breedCooldown = world.tickCount + 6000, world.tickCount + 6000
                            a.spawn(m.id, (m.position + other.position) / 2, true)
                            items.spawnXp(m.position, math.random(1, 7))
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function items.tick()
        stepProjectiles(); stepOrbs(); stepClouds(); stepRockets(); stepBobber(); stepMobs(); placeKnotsTick()
        for name, c in pairs(items.cooldowns) do if world.tickCount >= c.finish then items.cooldowns[name] = nil end end
        -- Fall distance for the mace.
        local y = root.Position.Y
        if lastY and y < lastY - 0.01 then items.fallDistance = (items.fallDistance or 0) + (lastY - y) / B
        elseif lastY and y >= lastY - 0.001 then items.fallDistance = 0 end
        lastY = y
        if items.riptide then
            items.riptide = items.riptide - 1
            for _, m in ipairs(nearbyMobs(root.Position, 1.5)) do m.humanoid:TakeDamage(8) end
            if items.riptide <= 0 then items.riptide = nil end
        end
        if items.totemParticles then
            items.totemParticles = items.totemParticles - 1
            for _ = 1, 8 do particle("totem_of_undying", root.Position + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() * 2 - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * B, Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random(), math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.3, {life = 30, size = 0.12, gravity = 0.01 * B}) end
            if items.totemParticles <= 0 then items.totemParticles = nil end
        end
        -- Maps fill in a few rows per tick.
        for _, data in pairs(items.maps) do if data.done < 128 then renderMapRows(data, 4) end end
        -- Totem in hand: Roblox's Dead state is switched off so the totem can save the player.
        local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, hum.Health <= 0 or not items.hasTotem()) end) end
        -- Recovery compasses point at the last death.
        if hum and hum.Health <= 0 and not items.deathSaved then items.deathSaved = true; player():SetAttribute("SteveDeathPosition", root.Position) end
    end
    function items.render(partial)
        world.partial = partial
        for _, p in ipairs(items.projectiles) do
            local pos = p.previous:Lerp(p.position, partial)
            if p.model then
                local v = p.velocity.Magnitude > 0.001 and p.velocity or Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
                p.model.pivot(CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + v) * CFrame.Angles(-math.pi / 2, 0, 0))
            else p.part.Position = pos end
        end
        for _, o in ipairs(items.orbs) do
            o.part.Position = o.position
            -- ExperienceOrbRenderer colour: r = (sin(t)+1)/2, g = 1, b = (sin(t+4.19)+1)/10.
            local t = (o.age + partial) / 2
            local img = o.gui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ImageLabel")
            if img then img.ImageColor3 = Color3.new((math.sin(t) + 1) * 0.5, 1, (math.sin(t + 4.1887903) + 1) * 0.1) end
        end
        for _, r in ipairs(items.rockets) do r.part.Position = r.position end
        if bobber then
            local b = bobber
            b.part.Position = b.position
            local tip = eye() + look() * B * 0.5 + root.CFrame.RightVector * B * 0.35 - Vector3.new(0, 0.1 * B, 0)
            local d = b.position - tip
            b.line.Size = Vector3.new(0.015 * B, 0.015 * B, math.max(0.01, d.Magnitude))
            b.line.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(tip + d / 2, b.position)
        end
        for _, e in ipairs(items.entities) do
            if e.kind == "armor_stand" and e.visual then
                local wobble = e.wobble and math.max(0, 5 - (world.tickCount - e.wobble)) or 0
                local frame = CFrame.new(e.position) * CFrame.Angles(0, e.yaw + math.sin(wobble * 1.5) * wobble * 0.05, 0)
                e.visual.pivot(frame)
                for _, v in pairs(e.dress or {}) do v.pivot(frame * (v.offset or CFrame.new(0, 0, 0))) end
            elseif e.kind == "end_crystal" and e.visual then
                -- EndCrystalRenderer: the glass spins and bobs.
                local t = (world.tickCount + partial) * 3
                local bob = math.sin(t * 0.2 / 3) / 2 + 0.5
                e.visual.pivot(CFrame.new(e.position), nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, {
                    outer_glass = {y = math.rad(t), x = math.rad(60)}, inner_glass = {y = math.rad(t), x = math.rad(60)}, cube = {y = math.rad(t), z = math.rad(60)}})
                e.bob = bob
            end
        end
        -- Leash lines.
        local a = api()
        for _, m in ipairs(a and a.mobs or {}) do
            local holder = m.leash == "player" and (root.Position + root.CFrame.RightVector * 0.3 * B) or (type(m.leash) == "table" and m.leash.knot)
            if holder and m.humanoid.Health > 0 then
                if not m.leashLine then
                    local line = Instance.new("Part")
                    line.Name, line.Anchored, line.CanCollide, line.CanQuery, line.CanTouch, line.Color, line.Material = "Lead", true, false, false, false, Color3.fromRGB(110, 80, 50), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                    line.Parent = folder
                    m.leashLine = line
                end
                local from = m.position + Vector3.new(0, m.height * m.scale * 0.6, 0)
                local d = holder - from
                m.leashLine.Size = Vector3.new(0.04 * B, 0.04 * B, d.Magnitude)
                m.leashLine.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(from + d / 2, holder)
            elseif m.leashLine then m.leashLine:Destroy(); m.leashLine = nil end
        end
        -- Overlays: held map, spyglass, carved pumpkin, totem.
        local s = held()
        heldMapOverlay(s and nameOf(s) == "filled_map" and s or (inventory.slots[41] and nameOf(inventory.slots[41]) == "filled_map" and inventory.slots[41]) or nil)
        local G = JavaContent.data.javaGui
        local helmet = inventory.equipment and inventory.equipment.helmet
        local pumpkin = helmet and nameOf(helmet) == "carved_pumpkin"
        local blur = fullImage("Pumpkin", G.pumpkinblur)
        blur.Visible = pumpkin and not (world.firstPerson and not world.firstPerson()) or false
        totemOverlay()
        -- Spyglass: the scope texture centred and square, black around it (Gui.renderSpyglassOverlay).
        local scope = fullImage("Scope", G.spyglass_scope)
        local scoping = world.gameplay and world.gameplay.scoping
        scope.Visible = scoping or false
        if scoping then
            scope.AnchorPoint, scope.Position, scope.Size = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            if not scope:FindFirstChild("Ratio") then local r = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint"); r.Name = "Ratio"; r.Parent = scope end
            local bars = overlays():FindFirstChild("ScopeBars")
            if not bars then
                bars = Instance.new("Frame"); bars.Name, bars.BackgroundTransparency, bars.Size, bars.ZIndex = "ScopeBars", 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 0
                for i = 1, 2 do local f = Instance.new("Frame"); f.BorderSizePixel, f.BackgroundColor3, f.Size = 0, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1); f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(i == 1 and -0.25 or 0.75, 0); f.Parent = bars end
                bars.Parent = overlays()
            end
            bars.Visible = true
            local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(16, 9)
            local side = math.max(0, (1 - vp.Y / vp.X) / 2)
            local kids = bars:GetChildren()
            kids[1].Size, kids[1].Position = UDim2.fromScale(side + 0.002, 1), UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
            kids[2].Size, kids[2].Position = UDim2.fromScale(side + 0.002, 1), UDim2.fromScale(1 - side - 0.002, 0)
        elseif overlays():FindFirstChild("ScopeBars") then overlays().ScopeBars.Visible = false end
    end
    function items.destroy()
        removeBobber()
        if overlayGui then overlayGui:Destroy() end
        folder:Destroy()
    end
    return items
end
-- END ITEM USES
local function createCreativeWorld(character,root,inventory,ui,worldMining)
    local world={nodes={},tickCount=0,drops={},primed={},lastHeld=nil,lastShown=nil}
    world.vibrate=function() end -- replaced by the block machines below
    world.mining=worldMining
    local size=CONFIG.Block
    local effects=createJavaEffects(character);world.effects=effects
    local folder=localBlocks:FindFirstChild('JavaBlocks') or Instance.new('Folder')
    folder.Name,folder.Parent='JavaBlocks',localBlocks
    local dropsFolder=Instance.new('Folder'); dropsFolder.Name,dropsFolder.Parent='SteveDroppedItems',workspace
    local key=function(p) return string.format('%.3f,%.3f,%.3f',p.X,p.Y,p.Z) end
    local function nodeAt(p) return world.nodes[key(p)] end
    local function neighbor(n,dir)
        local d=CreativeRules.directions[dir]
        if not d then return end
        if n.neighborTick~=world.tickCount then n.neighborTick=world.tickCount;n.neighborCache={} end
        local value=n.neighborCache[dir]
        if value==nil then value=nodeAt(n.center+Vector3.new(table.unpack(d))*size) or false;n.neighborCache[dir]=value end
        return value or nil
    end
    local function signature(state)
        local keys={}; for k in pairs(state) do keys[#keys+1]=k end; table.sort(keys)
        local values={}; for _,k in ipairs(keys) do values[#values+1]=k..'='..tostring(state[k]) end
        return table.concat(values,',')
    end
        -- Motion lasts two game ticks, with a frame-interpolated head and pushed blocks.
    local motions={}
    local function animateNode(n,from,to,removeAfter)
        motions[#motions+1]={node=n,visual=n.visual,from=from,to=to,start=os.clock(),duration=2*CONFIG.Tick,removeAfter=removeAfter}
        n.visual.pivot(CFrame.new(from))
        n.movingUntil=world.tickCount+2
    end

    local function rebuild(n)
        if n.id=='redstone_wire' and n.visual then
            local topology=table.concat({n.state.north or 'none',n.state.east or 'none',n.state.south or 'none',n.state.west or 'none'},',')
            if n.topology==topology then
                local tint=JavaContent.dustTint(tonumber(n.state.power) or 0)
                for _,pair in ipairs(n.visual.parts) do for _,gui in ipairs(pair[1]:GetChildren()) do
                    if gui:IsA('SurfaceGui') then for _,pixel in ipairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
                        local base=pixel:GetAttribute('DustBase')
                        if base then pixel.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(base.R*tint[1],base.G*tint[2],base.B*tint[3]) end
                    end end
                end end
                n.signature=signature(n.state);return
            end
            n.topology=topology
        elseif n.id=='redstone_wire' then n.topology=table.concat({n.state.north or 'none',n.state.east or 'none',n.state.south or 'none',n.state.west or 'none'},',') end
        local old=n.visual
        n.visual=JavaContent.model(n.index,n.state,size,folder,n.center+(n.shift or Vector3.zero),false)
        n.visual.model:SetAttribute('MinecraftBlockId',n.id)
        n.visual.model:SetAttribute('SteveVoxelCenter',n.center)
        if n.shift then
            n.visual.model:SetAttribute('SteveShift',n.shift)
            -- relabel shifted parts: they belong to the block's grid cell, not to where they are drawn
            for _,d in ipairs(n.visual.model:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:GetAttribute('SteveVoxelCenter')~=nil then d:SetAttribute('SteveVoxelCenter',n.center) end
            end
        end
        n.visual.model:SetAttribute('MinecraftState',game:GetService('HttpService'):JSONEncode(n.state))
        n.signature=signature(n.state)
        if old then old.model:Destroy() end
        if world.attachPhysics and n.physicsOwner then world.attachPhysics(n,n.physicsOwner) end
        if world.placement then world.placement.cull(n) end
    end
    -- Flush placement against map geometry: the model/collision offset of a placed block (its cell is unchanged).
    function world.setShift(n,shift)
        if not n then return end
        if shift and shift.Magnitude<0.01 then shift=nil end
        if n.shift==shift then return end
        n.shift=shift
        rebuild(n)
    end
    function world.resolve(part)
        local center=part and part:GetAttribute('SteveVoxelCenter')
        if typeof(center)~='Vector3' and part then
            local p=part.Parent
            for _=1,4 do
                if not p or p==workspace then break end
                center=p:GetAttribute('SteveVoxelCenter')
                if typeof(center)=='Vector3' then break end
                p=p.Parent
            end
        end
        return typeof(center)=='Vector3' and nodeAt(center) or nil
    end
    function world.nodeAt(center) return nodeAt(center) end
    local function register(index,center,state)
        local entry=JavaContent.byIndex[index]
        local n={id=entry.id,index=index,center=center,state=state or CreativeRules.copy(entry.state)}
        n.solid=not JavaContent.nonSolid(n.id) and not n.id:match('_stairs$') and not n.id:match('_slab$')
            and not n.id:find('glass',1,true) and not n.id:find('door',1,true) and not n.id:find('fence',1,true)
        if entry.conductor~=nil then n.solid=entry.conductor end
        world.nodes[key(center)]=n
        if world.physicsOwnerAt then n.physicsOwner=world.physicsOwnerAt(center) end
        rebuild(n)
        return n
    end
    -- Moving blocks keep normal nodes in a private grid; only presentation/input cross frames.
    world.physicsOwners = {}
    function world.physicsOwnerAt(p)
        local n = nodeAt(p)
        if n and n.physicsOwner then return n.physicsOwner end
        for owner in pairs(world.physicsOwners) do
            if owner.contains and owner.contains(p) then return owner end
        end
    end
    function world.physicsTransform(p)
        local o = world.physicsOwnerAt(p)
        return o and o.T
    end
    function world.renderPosition(p)
        local t = world.physicsTransform(p)
        return t and t * p or p
    end
    function world.physicsOutline(part)
        local n = world.resolve(part)
        if not (n and n.physicsOwner and n.visual) then return nil end
        local boxes = {}
        -- These parts already follow the body's rotation and animated visual.
        for _, p in ipairs(n.visual.model:GetChildren()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name == "BlockOutline" then
                boxes[#boxes+1] = {p.CFrame,p.Size}
            end
        end
        if #boxes > 0 then return boxes end
        local transform = n.physicsOwner.T or CFrame.identity
        local frame = transform * CFrame.new(n.center + (n.shift or Vector3.zero))
        local shape = JavaContent.shape(n.id,n.state)
        if shape and not shape.full then
            for _, box in ipairs(shape.outline or {}) do
                local low = Vector3.new(box[1],box[2],box[3])
                local high = Vector3.new(box[4],box[5],box[6])
                boxes[#boxes+1] = {frame*CFrame.new(((low+high)/2-Vector3.one*8)*(size/16)),(high-low)*(size/16)}
            end
        else
            boxes[1] = {frame,Vector3.one*size}
        end
        return boxes
    end
    function world.physicsHit(hit)
        if not hit then return nil end
        -- RaycastResult is userdata: reading custom fields throws instead of returning nil.
        if typeof(hit)=="RaycastResult" then
            hit={Instance=hit.Instance,Position=hit.Position,Normal=hit.Normal,Material=hit.Material,Distance=hit.Distance}
        end
        if hit.physicsLocal then return hit end
        local n = world.resolve(hit.Instance)
        local t = n and n.physicsOwner and n.physicsOwner.T
        if not t then return hit end
        return {Instance=hit.Instance, Position=t:PointToObjectSpace(hit.Position),
            Normal=t:VectorToObjectSpace(hit.Normal), Material=hit.Material,
            Distance=hit.Distance, physicsLocal=true, physicsTransform=t, physicsOwner=n.physicsOwner}
    end
    function world.bindPhysicsVisual(n, v)
        if not (v and v.pivot) or v.physicsBound then return end
        v.physicsBound = true
        local pivot = v.pivot
        local pose = table.pack(CFrame.new(n.center))
        v.pivot = function(frame, ...)
            pose = table.pack(frame, ...)
            local t = n.physicsOwner and n.physicsOwner.T
            return pivot(t and t * frame or frame, ...)
        end
        v.physicsRefresh = function()
            local t = n.physicsOwner and n.physicsOwner.T
            pivot(t and t * pose[1] or pose[1], table.unpack(pose,2,pose.n))
            if v.physicsSpin then
                local at=(t or CFrame.identity)*CFrame.new(n.center)*v.physicsSpin
                for _,pair in ipairs(v.parts or {}) do
                    local p=pair[1]
                    if p.Parent and p.Name~="BlockOutline" and p.Name~="BlockCollider" and p.Name~="SteveMarker" and p.Name~="BlockLight" then p.CFrame=at*pair[2] end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function world.attachPhysics(n, owner)
        n.physicsOwner = owner
        if owner then
            n.modOwner = owner.modId
            world.modCells=world.modCells or {}
            local grid=workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin") or Vector3.new(0,size/2,0)
            local q=(n.center-grid)/size
            world.modCells[math.floor(q.X+.5)..","..math.floor(q.Y+.5)..","..math.floor(q.Z+.5)]=owner.modId
            world.physicsOwners[owner] = true
            world.bindPhysicsVisual(n,n.visual)
            if owner.decorate then owner.decorate(n) end
            if n.visual and n.visual.physicsRefresh then n.visual.physicsRefresh() end
        end
    end
    function world.drawPhysicsOwner(owner)
        for _,n in pairs(world.nodes) do
            if n.physicsOwner==owner and n.visual and n.visual.model.Parent then
                world.bindPhysicsVisual(n,n.visual)
                n.visual.physicsRefresh()
                n.visual.model:SetAttribute('SteveRenderCenter',world.renderPosition(n.center))
            end
        end
    end
    -- Preserve the node itself: inventories, furnace progress, sign text, custom data and GUI references.
    function world.chestPartner(n)
        local st=n.state
        if not n.id:match('chest$') or (st.type~='left' and st.type~='right') then return nil end
        local d=CreativeRules.clockwise[st.facing]
        if st.type=='right' then d=CreativeRules.opposite[d] end
        local p=d and nodeAt(n.center+Vector3.new(table.unpack(CreativeRules.directions[d]))*size)
        if p and p.id==n.id and p.physicsOwner==n.physicsOwner and p.state.facing==st.facing
            and p.state.type==(st.type=='left' and 'right' or 'left') then return p end
    end
    function world.reconcileChests()
        local broken={}
        for _,n in pairs(world.nodes) do
            if n.id:match('chest$') and (n.state.type=='left' or n.state.type=='right') and not world.chestPartner(n) then
                broken[#broken+1]=n
            end
        end
        for _,n in ipairs(broken) do n.state.type='single';n.openPartner=nil;n.openSize=nil;n.openView=n.storage;rebuild(n) end
    end
    function world.relocateNodes(moves, owner)
        local moving, remap = {}, {}
        for _,m in ipairs(moves) do moving[m.node]=true; remap[key(m.node.center)]=key(m.at) end
        for _,m in ipairs(moves) do
            local occupied=nodeAt(m.at)
            assert(not occupied or moving[occupied], 'Physics plot destination occupied')
        end
        for _,m in ipairs(moves) do world.nodes[key(m.node.center)]=nil end
        for _,m in ipairs(moves) do
            local n=m.node
            if world.blocks and world.blocks.resetVisual then world.blocks.resetVisual(n) end
            n.center=m.at;n.neighborTick=nil;n.physicsOwner=owner
            if m.state then n.state=m.state end
            world.nodes[key(n.center)]=n
        end
        for _,n in pairs(world.nodes) do
            if n.partner and remap[n.partner] then n.partner=remap[n.partner] end
            if n.piston and remap[n.piston] then n.piston=remap[n.piston] end
        end
        for _,m in ipairs(moves) do rebuild(m.node);world.attachPhysics(m.node,owner) end
        world.chestsDirty=true
        world.connectionsDirty=true
    end
    function world.removePhysicsOwner(owner)
        world.physicsOwners[owner]=nil
        local removed={}
        for k,n in pairs(world.nodes) do if n.physicsOwner==owner then removed[#removed+1]=k end end
        for _,k in ipairs(removed) do
            local n=world.nodes[k]
            if world.currentContainer==n then ui.toggle() end
            if n.visual then n.visual.model:Destroy() end
            world.nodes[k]=nil
        end
        world.connectionsDirty=true
    end
    JavaContent.mods.renderPos = world.renderPosition

    -- Re-pasting/respawn resumes placed block states instead of leaving an inert world.
    for _,model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
        local id,center=model:GetAttribute('MinecraftBlockId'),model:GetAttribute('SteveVoxelCenter')
        local entry=JavaContent.byId[id]
        if entry and typeof(center)=='Vector3' then
            local ok,state=pcall(function() return game:GetService('HttpService'):JSONDecode(model:GetAttribute('MinecraftState')) end)
            local saved=model:GetAttribute('MinecraftStorage')
            local savedCommand=model:GetAttribute('MinecraftCommand')
            local savedShift=model:GetAttribute('SteveShift')
            model:Destroy();local n=register(entry.index,center,ok and state or nil)
            if typeof(savedShift)=='Vector3' then n.shift=savedShift;rebuild(n) end
            if savedCommand then
                local decoded,cmd=pcall(function()return game:GetService('HttpService'):JSONDecode(savedCommand)end)
                if decoded and type(cmd)=='table' then n.command={text=tostring(cmd.text or ''),output='',auto=cmd.auto==true,track=cmd.track~=false} end
            end
            if saved then
                local decoded,stacks=pcall(function()return game:GetService('HttpService'):JSONDecode(saved)end)
                if decoded and type(stacks)=='table' then
                    n.storage=CreativeRules.inventory()
                    for slot,stack in pairs(stacks) do
                        local i=tonumber(slot)
                        if i and i>=1 and i<=27 and type(stack)=='table' and JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id] and type(stack.count)=='number' then
                            n.storage.slots[i]={id=stack.id,count=math.clamp(math.floor(stack.count),1,(itemStackLimits[stack.id] or (toolStats[stack.id] and 1 or 64))),damage=tonumber(stack.damage) or 0}
                        end
                    end
                    if n.id=='ender_chest' then world.enderStorage=world.enderStorage or n.storage;n.storage=world.enderStorage end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _,n in pairs(world.nodes) do
        if n.id:match('_door$') or n.state.half=='upper' or n.state.half=='lower' then
            local p=n.center+Vector3.new(0,n.state.half=='upper' and -size or size,0)
            local other=nodeAt(p)
            if other and other.id==n.id then n.partner=key(p) end
        elseif n.id:match('_bed$') then
            local d=CreativeRules.directions[n.state.facing or 'north'];local p=n.center+Vector3.new(table.unpack(d))*size*(n.state.part=='foot' and 1 or -1)
            local other=nodeAt(p);if other and other.id==n.id then n.partner=key(p) end
        elseif n.id=='piston_head' then
            local d=CreativeRules.directions[n.state.facing or 'north']
            n.piston=key(n.center-Vector3.new(table.unpack(d))*size)
        end
    end
    function world.updateNeighbors()
        if (world.neighborBatch or 0)>0 then world.neighborPending=true;return end
        world.connectionsDirty=true
        for _,n in pairs(world.nodes) do n.neighborTick=nil end
        for _,n in pairs(world.nodes) do
            local id,state=n.id,n.state
            if id:match('_slab$') then n.solid=state.type=='double' end
            if id:match('_stairs$') then state.shape=CreativeRules.stairShape(state,function(dir) return neighbor(n,dir) end)
            elseif (id=='rail' or id=='powered_rail' or id=='detector_rail' or id=='activator_rail') and world.gameplay and world.gameplay.vehicles then
                state.shape=world.gameplay.vehicles.railShape(n)
            elseif id:match('_fence$') or id:match('_wall$') or id:match('_pane$') or id=='iron_bars' then
                for _,dir in ipairs({'north','east','south','west'}) do
                    local other=neighbor(n,dir)
                    local joined=other and (other.solid or other.id:match('_fence$') or other.id:match('_wall$') or other.id:match('_pane$') or other.id=='iron_bars')
                    state[dir]=id:match('_wall$') and (joined and 'low' or 'none') or tostring(not not joined)
                end
            end
            if world.placement and world.placement.shape(n)=='remove' then
                world.nodes[key(n.center)]=nil;n.visual.model:Destroy()
                if RAILS[id] then world.loot(n.index,n.center,state) end
            elseif signature(state)~=n.signature then rebuild(n) end
        end
    end
    local function overlapsPlayer(center)
        local extent=(root.Size+Vector3.new(size,size,size))/2-Vector3.new(.02,.02,.02)
        local delta=(world.renderPosition and world.renderPosition(center) or center)-root.Position
        return math.abs(delta.X)<extent.X and math.abs(delta.Y)<extent.Y and math.abs(delta.Z)<extent.Z
    end
    function world.place(index,center,hit,look)
        hit=world.physicsHit(hit)
        index=JavaContent.itemIndex(index)
        local sourceIndex=index
        if CONFIG.Survival then local stack=inventory.slots[ui.selected];if not stack or stack.id~=index or stack.count<1 then return false end end
        local entry=index and JavaContent.byIndex[index]; if not entry or entry.itemOnly then return false end
        if entry.id=='air' or entry.id=='cave_air' or entry.id=='void_air' then return false end
        if world.placement and not (world.sneaking and world.sneaking()) then
            local target=world.placement.stackTarget(entry,center,hit)
            if target then world.placement.stack(target,entry);world.consume(sourceIndex,1);world.updateNeighbors();world.vibrate(target.center,13,{player=true});return true end
        end
        if nodeAt(center) or (worldMining.occupied and worldMining.occupied(center)) or (not JavaContent.nonSolid(entry.id) and overlapsPlayer(center)) then return false end
        local state=CreativeRules.copy(entry.state)
        local heldStack=inventory.slots[ui.selected]
        if heldStack and JavaContent.itemIndex(heldStack.id)==sourceIndex and type(heldStack.blockState)=='table' then
            for k,v in pairs(heldStack.blockState) do state[k]=tostring(v) end
        end
        if math.abs(hit.Normal.Y)<.5 then
            local wallId=entry.id:gsub('_hanging_sign$','_wall_hanging_sign'):gsub('_sign$','_wall_sign')
            if entry.id:match('_hanging_sign$') then wallId=entry.id:gsub('_hanging_sign$','_wall_hanging_sign') end
            if entry.id:match('_banner$') then wallId=entry.id:gsub('_banner$','_wall_banner') end
            if entry.id:match('_head$') then wallId=entry.id:gsub('_head$','_wall_head') end
            if entry.id:match('_skull$') then wallId=entry.id:gsub('_skull$','_wall_skull') end
            if wallId~=entry.id and JavaContent.byId[wallId] then entry=JavaContent.byId[wallId];index=entry.index;state=CreativeRules.copy(entry.state) end
        end
        if (entry.id:find('torch',1,true) and hit.Normal.Y<-.5) or (entry.id=='ladder' and math.abs(hit.Normal.Y)>.5) then return false end
        if math.abs(hit.Normal.Y)<.5 and (entry.id=='torch' or entry.id=='redstone_torch' or entry.id=='soul_torch') then
            entry=JavaContent.byId[entry.id=='torch' and 'wall_torch' or entry.id=='soul_torch' and 'soul_wall_torch' or 'redstone_wall_torch']
            index,state=entry.index,CreativeRules.copy(entry.state)
        end
        local facing=math.abs(look.X)>math.abs(look.Z) and (look.X>0 and 'east' or 'west') or (look.Z>0 and 'south' or 'north')
        if state.facing then state.facing=facing end
        if entry.id=='repeater' or entry.id=='comparator' or entry.id=='piston' or entry.id=='sticky_piston' or entry.id=='dispenser' or entry.id=='dropper' or entry.id:find('chest',1,true) or entry.id:find('furnace',1,true) or entry.id=='barrel' then state.facing=CreativeRules.opposite[facing] end
        if (entry.id=='piston' or entry.id=='sticky_piston' or entry.id=='observer' or entry.id=='dispenser' or entry.id=='dropper') and math.abs(look.Y)>.65 then state.facing=look.Y>0 and 'down' or 'up' end
        if entry.id=='observer' then state.facing=math.abs(look.Y)>.65 and (look.Y>0 and 'up' or 'down') or facing end
        if entry.id=='wave_maker' and math.abs(look.Y)>.65 then state.facing=look.Y>0 and 'down' or 'up' end
        if JavaContent.mods.placeState and entry.mod then pcall(JavaContent.mods.placeState, entry, state, hit, look, center) end
        local normalFacing=math.abs(hit.Normal.X)>.5 and (hit.Normal.X>0 and 'east' or 'west') or (hit.Normal.Z>0 and 'south' or 'north')
        if entry.id:match('_trapdoor$') then state.facing=math.abs(hit.Normal.Y)<.5 and normalFacing or CreativeRules.opposite[facing] end
        if state.rotation then state.rotation=tostring((math.floor((math.atan2(-look.X,look.Z)/(2*math.pi)*16)+.5)+8)%16) end
        if entry.id=='hopper' then state.facing=hit.Normal.Y==0 and CreativeRules.opposite[normalFacing] or 'down' end
        if entry.id=='sculk_shrieker' then state.can_summon=tostring(CONFIG.ShriekersCanSummon) end
        if state.attachment then state.attachment=hit.Normal.Y>.5 and 'floor' or hit.Normal.Y<-.5 and 'ceiling' or 'single_wall';state.facing=normalFacing end
        if entry.id:find('wall_',1,true) then state.facing=normalFacing end
        if state.axis then state.axis=math.abs(hit.Normal.Y)>.5 and 'y' or math.abs(hit.Normal.X)>.5 and 'x' or 'z' end
        if entry.id:match('_stairs$') or entry.id:match('_slab$') or entry.id:match('_trapdoor$') then
            local target=world.resolve(hit.Instance)
            local localY=hit.Position.Y-(target and target.center.Y or center.Y)
            local half=hit.Normal.Y<-.5 and 'top' or (math.abs(hit.Normal.Y)<.5 and localY>0 and 'top' or 'bottom')
            if state.half then state.half=half end; if state.type then state.type=half end
        end
        if state.face then
            state.face=hit.Normal.Y>.5 and 'floor' or hit.Normal.Y<-.5 and 'ceiling' or 'wall'
            if state.face=='wall' then state.facing=math.abs(hit.Normal.X)>.5 and (hit.Normal.X>0 and 'east' or 'west') or (hit.Normal.Z>0 and 'south' or 'north') end
        end
        if entry.id=='redstone_wall_torch' or entry.id=='wall_torch' or entry.id=='soul_wall_torch' or entry.id=='ladder' then
            state.facing=math.abs(hit.Normal.X)>.5 and (hit.Normal.X>0 and 'east' or 'west') or (hit.Normal.Z>0 and 'south' or 'north')
        end
        if world.placement then
            local placedEntry,placedState=world.placement.refine(JavaContent.byIndex[sourceIndex] or entry,entry,state,center,hit,look,facing)
            if not placedEntry then return false end
            entry,state,index=placedEntry,placedState,placedEntry.index
        end
        -- Only states declared by the block are selected; horizontal-only axes reject vertical guesses.
        for property,values in pairs(entry.props or {}) do
            local valid=false;for _,value in ipairs(values) do if tostring(value)==tostring(state[property]) then valid=true;break end end
            if not valid then state[property]=entry.state[property] or values[1] end
        end
        if entry.id:match('_bed$') then
            local d=CreativeRules.directions[facing];local other=center+Vector3.new(table.unpack(d))*size
            if nodeAt(other) or worldMining.occupied(other) or overlapsPlayer(other) then return false end
            state.part='foot';local foot=register(index,center,state)
            local headState=CreativeRules.copy(state);headState.part='head';local head=register(index,other,headState)
            foot.partner=key(other);head.partner=key(center)
        elseif state.half=='lower' and not entry.id:match('_door$') then
            local above=center+Vector3.new(0,size,0)
            if nodeAt(above) or worldMining.occupied(above) then return false end
            local lower=register(index,center,state);local upperState=CreativeRules.copy(state);upperState.half='upper'
            local upper=register(index,above,upperState);lower.partner=key(above);upper.partner=key(center)
        elseif entry.id:match('_door$') then
            local side=CreativeRules.directions[CreativeRules.left[facing]]
            local left=center+Vector3.new(table.unpack(side))*size;local right=center-Vector3.new(table.unpack(side))*size
            local leftBlock,rightBlock=nodeAt(left),nodeAt(right)
            local hitSide=(hit.Position-center):Dot(Vector3.new(table.unpack(side)))
            state.hinge=(leftBlock and leftBlock.solid and not (rightBlock and rightBlock.solid)) and 'right' or (hitSide<0 and 'left' or 'right')
            local above=center+Vector3.new(0,size,0)
            if nodeAt(above) or worldMining.occupied(above) or overlapsPlayer(above) then return false end
            state.half='lower'
            local lower=register(index,center,state)
            local upper=CreativeRules.copy(state); upper.half='upper'
            register(index,above,upper)
            lower.partner=key(above); world.nodes[key(above)].partner=key(center)
        else register(index,center,state) end
        if world.blocks then world.blocks.placed(nodeAt(center),inventory.slots[ui.selected]) end
        world.consume(sourceIndex,1)
        world.updateNeighbors()
        world.vibrate(center,13,{player=true}) -- BLOCK_PLACE
        if world.placement and world.placement.patterns then pcall(world.placement.patterns,center) end
        return true
    end
    function world.use(hit,sneaking,selected)
        hit=world.physicsHit(hit)
        if world.blocks then local handled=world.blocks.use(hit,sneaking,selected); if handled~=nil then return handled end end
        if world.gameplay and world.gameplay.use(hit,sneaking,selected) then return true end
        local n=world.resolve(hit.Instance)
        local item=JavaContent.byIndex[selected]
        if item and item.id=='flint_and_steel' then
            if n and n.id=='tnt' then local ok=world.prime(n);if ok then world.damageTool(selected,1) end;return ok end
            return world.ignite(hit,selected)
        end
        if not n then return false end
        if item and item.stats then
            local kind=item.stats.kind;local replacement
            if kind=='hoe' and (n.id=='dirt' or n.id=='grass_block' or n.id=='dirt_path') and not neighbor(n,'up') then replacement='farmland'
            elseif kind=='hoe' and n.id=='coarse_dirt' then replacement='dirt'
            elseif kind=='shovel' and (n.id=='dirt' or n.id=='grass_block' or n.id=='coarse_dirt' or n.id=='rooted_dirt' or n.id=='podzol' or n.id=='mycelium') and not neighbor(n,'up') then replacement='dirt_path'
            elseif kind=='axe' and not n.id:match('^stripped_') and (n.id:match('_log$') or n.id:match('_wood$') or n.id:match('_stem$') or n.id:match('_hyphae$')) then replacement='stripped_'..n.id end
            local entry=replacement and JavaContent.byId[replacement]
            if entry then
                local state=CreativeRules.copy(entry.state);if state.axis then state.axis=n.state.axis end
                n.visual.model:Destroy();register(entry.index,n.center,state);world.damageTool(selected,1);world.updateNeighbors();return true
            end
        end
        if sneaking then return false end
        local id,state=n.id,n.state
        if id=='chest' or id=='trapped_chest' or id=='ender_chest' or id:match('copper_chest$') or id=='barrel' or id:match('shulker_box$') or id=='hopper' or id=='dispenser' or id=='dropper' or id=='furnace' or id=='smoker' or id=='blast_furnace' then
            local above=world.sample(n.center+Vector3.new(0,size,0))
            if (id=='chest' or id=='trapped_chest' or id=='ender_chest' or id:match('copper_chest$')) and above and not JavaContent.nonSolid(above.id) then return true end
            if id=='ender_chest' then world.enderStorage=world.enderStorage or CreativeRules.inventory();n.storage=world.enderStorage
            else n.storage=n.storage or CreativeRules.inventory() end
            -- Large chest (ChestBlock.getContainer): a CompoundContainer, the RIGHT half's 27 slots first.
            n.openView,n.openSize,n.openPartner=n.storage,nil,nil
            if n.state.type=='left' or n.state.type=='right' then
                local d=n.state.type=='left' and CreativeRules.clockwise[n.state.facing] or CreativeRules.opposite[CreativeRules.clockwise[n.state.facing]]
                local partner=d and nodeAt(n.center+Vector3.new(table.unpack(CreativeRules.directions[d]))*size)
                if partner and partner.id==id and partner.state.facing==n.state.facing and partner.state.type==(n.state.type=='left' and 'right' or 'left') then
                    local over=world.sample(partner.center+Vector3.new(0,size,0))
                    if over and not JavaContent.nonSolid(over.id) then return true end
                    partner.storage=partner.storage or CreativeRules.inventory()
                    local first=(n.state.type=='right' and n or partner).storage
                    local second=(n.state.type=='right' and partner or n).storage
                    n.openView={slots=setmetatable({},{__index=function(_,i) if i<=27 then return first.slots[i] end;return second.slots[i-27] end,
                        __newindex=function(_,i,v) if i<=27 then first.slots[i]=v else second.slots[i-27]=v end end,__len=function() return 54 end})}
                    n.openSize,n.openPartner=54,partner;partner.containerOpen=true
                end
            end
            n.containerOpen=true;world.currentContainer=n
            n.storageSize=id=='hopper' and 5 or (id=='dispenser' or id=='dropper') and 9 or (id=='furnace' or id=='smoker' or id=='blast_furnace') and 3 or 27
            -- Furnace screens draw the flame (burn left / burn total) and arrow (cook / cook total).
            local progress=n.storageSize==3 and function() return (n.burn or 0)/math.max(n.burnTotal or 1,1),(n.cook or 0)/math.max(n.cookTotal or 200,1) end or nil
            if MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.container(id,n.center,true) end
            ui.openStorage(n.openView or n.storage,n.openSize and 'Large Chest' or blockNames[n.index],function()n.containerOpen=false;world.currentContainer=nil;world.vibrate(n.center,9,{player=true})
                if n.openPartner then n.openPartner.containerOpen=false;n.openPartner=nil end
                if MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.container(id,n.center,false) end end,n.openSize or n.storageSize,n.openSize and 'large_chest' or id,progress)
            world.vibrate(n.center,10,{player=true}) -- CONTAINER_OPEN (CONTAINER_CLOSE on close)
            return true
        elseif id=='lever' then state.powered=state.powered=='true' and 'false' or 'true'
        elseif id:match('_button$') then state.powered='true'; n.release=world.tickCount+((id=='stone_button' or id=='polished_blackstone_button') and 20 or 30)
        elseif id=='repeater' then state.delay=tostring((tonumber(state.delay) or 1)%4+1)
        elseif id=='comparator' then state.mode=state.mode=='subtract' and 'compare' or 'subtract'
        elseif (id:match('_door$') or id:match('_trapdoor$') or id:match('_fence_gate$')) and not id:find('iron',1,true) then
            state.open=state.open=='true' and 'false' or 'true'
            local partner=n.partner and world.nodes[n.partner]
            if partner then partner.state.open=state.open; rebuild(partner) end
        elseif id:match('_slab$') and n.index==selected and state.type~='double' then if not world.consume(selected,1) then return false end;state.type='double'
        else return false end
        local opened=state.open=='true' or state.powered=='true'
        if MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.interact(id,n.center,state) end
        world.vibrate(n.center,(id=='repeater' or id=='comparator') and 11 or id:match('_slab$') and 13 or opened and 10 or 9,{player=true})
        rebuild(n); world.updateNeighbors(); return true
    end
    function world.breakBlock(hit,harvest,lootContext)
        local n=world.resolve(hit.Instance); if not n then return false end
        effects.block(n.index,n.center,true,nil,n.state)
        if not (lootContext and lootContext.explosion) then world.vibrate(n.center,12,{player=true}) end -- BLOCK_DESTROY
        if world.currentContainer==n then ui.toggle() end
        if n.storage and n.id~='ender_chest' then for _,stack in pairs(n.storage.slots) do world.drop(stack,n.center) end;n.storage.slots={} end
        local lootDone=world.blocks and world.blocks.broken(n,harvest)
        world.nodes[key(n.center)]=nil
        n.visual.model:Destroy()
        local partner=n.partner and world.nodes[n.partner]
        if partner then world.nodes[n.partner]=nil; partner.visual.model:Destroy() end
        if n.id=='piston' or n.id=='sticky_piston' then
            local head=neighbor(n,n.state.facing or 'north')
            if head and head.id=='piston_head' then world.nodes[key(head.center)]=nil;head.visual.model:Destroy() end
        elseif n.id=='piston_head' and n.piston then
            local base=world.nodes[n.piston]
            if base then world.nodes[n.piston]=nil;base.visual.model:Destroy() end
        end
        if harvest and not lootDone then
            local state=CreativeRules.copy(n.state)
            if n.partner then if n.id:match('_bed$') then state.part='head' elseif state.half then state.half='lower' end end
            world.loot(n.index,n.center,state,lootContext)
        end
        world.updateNeighbors(); return true
    end
    local dropCast=RaycastParams.new()
    dropCast.FilterType,dropCast.FilterDescendantsInstances,dropCast.RespectCanCollide=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude,{character,dropsFolder},true
    local dropTemplates={}
    local function dropVisual(id,scale,position)
        local entry=JavaContent.byIndex[id]
        local cacheKey=id..':'..scale
        local t=dropTemplates[cacheKey]
        if t==nil then
            t=false
            if not (entry and entry.entityModel) then
                local v=JavaContent.model(id,{},scale,nil,Vector3.zero,true)
                local animated=false
                for gui in pairs(JavaContent.animated) do if gui:IsDescendantOf(v.model) then animated=true;break end end
                if not animated and v.parts and #v.parts>0 then
                    for i,pair in ipairs(v.parts) do pair[1]:SetAttribute('SteveDropPart',i) end
                    t={model=v.model,parts=v.parts}
                else v.model:Destroy() end
            end
            dropTemplates[cacheKey]=t
        end
        if not t then return JavaContent.model(id,{},scale,dropsFolder,position,true) end
        local model=t.model:Clone()
        local parts={}
        for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            local i=d:GetAttribute('SteveDropPart')
            if i then local src=t.parts[i];parts[i]={d,src[2],src[3]} end
        end
        local function pivot(frame,factor)
            factor=factor or 1
            for _,pair in ipairs(parts) do local lf=pair[2];pair[1].Size=pair[3]*factor;pair[1].CFrame=frame*CFrame.new(lf.Position*factor)*lf.Rotation end
        end
        pivot(CFrame.new(position))
        model.Parent=dropsFolder
        return {model=model,parts=parts,pivot=pivot}
    end
    function world.drop(stack,position,velocity,quiet)
        if typeof(position) == 'Vector3' and JavaContent.mods.renderPos then position = JavaContent.mods.renderPos(position) or position end
        local native=JavaContent.nativeTools and JavaContent.nativeTools[stack.id]
        if native then
            if not native.CanBeDropped then return false end
            native.Parent=workspace
            local handle=native:FindFirstChild('Handle');if handle then handle.CFrame=CFrame.new(position or (root.Position+root.CFrame.LookVector*3)) end
            return true
        end
        if #world.drops>=256 then worldMining.message='Too many dropped items nearby'; return false end
        local canonical=JavaContent.itemIndex(stack.id); if not canonical then return false end
        stack=CreativeRules.withCount(stack,stack.count);stack.id=canonical
        local thrown=position==nil
        local look=world.look and world.look() or root.CFrame.LookVector
        position=position or ((world.eye and world.eye() or root.Position)+look*size*.4)
        local origin=world.eye and world.eye() or root.Position
        local offset=position-origin
        local obstruction=thrown and offset.Magnitude>.0001 and workspace:Spherecast(origin,size*.12,offset,dropCast)
        if obstruction then position=origin+offset.Unit*math.max(0,obstruction.Distance-.02) end
        local offset,modelScale=CFrame.new(),size*(toolStats[stack.id] and .5 or .25)
        if JavaContent.display and JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id] then offset,modelScale=JavaContent.display(stack.id,'ground',size) end
        if not thrown then
            -- ItemEntity.mergeWithNeighbours: one stack instead of another model next to an equal one.
            local limit=itemStackLimits[stack.id] or (toolStats[stack.id] and 1 or 64)
            for _,d in ipairs(world.drops) do
                if d.id==stack.id and d.count+stack.count<=limit and (d.position-position).Magnitude<=size*1.25 and (not d.net or d.net.mine)
                    and CreativeRules.sameItem(d.template or {id=d.id,damage=d.damage},stack) then
                    d.count=d.count+stack.count
                    if world.netDropCount then pcall(world.netDropCount,d) end
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        local visual=dropVisual(stack.id,modelScale,position)
        if JavaContent.isFoil(stack) then pcall(JavaContent.glintModel,visual.model,true) end
        local entity={id=stack.id,count=stack.count,damage=stack.damage,template=stack,position=position,velocity=velocity or (look*size*6+Vector3.new(0,size*4,0)),age=0,visual=visual,offset=offset}
        world.drops[#world.drops+1]=entity
        if world.netDrop then pcall(world.netDrop,entity) end
        if world.swing and not quiet then world.swing() end
        return true
    end
    function world.collect(index,position)
        if not index then return end
        world.drop({id=index,count=1},position,Vector3.new((math.random()-.5)*size*2,size*4,(math.random()-.5)*size*2))
        ui.refresh()
    end
    function world.loot(index,position,state,context)
        local entry=JavaContent.byIndex[index];if not entry or entry.id=='piston_head' then return end
        local tableData=JavaContent.data and JavaContent.data.loot and JavaContent.data.loot[entry.id]
        if not tableData then
            -- No loot table: the block itself, but an explosion only lets it survive 1 in radius times.
            if context and context.radius and math.random()>=1/context.radius then return end
            local item=JavaContent.itemIndex(index);if item then world.collect(item,position)end;return
        end
        context=context or {};context.state=state or entry.state;context.player=true
        if not context.explosion then
            local stack=inventory.slots[ui.selected];local tool=JavaContent.byIndex[context.toolIndex or (stack and stack.id)]
            context.tool=tool and tool.id
        end
        for _,stack in ipairs(LootRules.roll(tableData,context))do
            local item=JavaContent.itemById[stack.name]
            if item then local out={id=item.index,count=stack.count};for k,v in pairs(stack.components or {}) do out[k]=v end;world.drop(out,position)end
        end
    end
    function world.collectKind(kind,position,toolIndex)
        for index,e in pairs(JavaContent.byIndex) do if e.name==kind then world.loot(index,position,e.state,{toolIndex=toolIndex}); return end end
    end
    ui.drop=function(stack) return world.drop(stack) end
    function world.spawnPrimed(index,center,fuse,reuse)
        if MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.play("entity.tnt.primed",center,1,1) end
        local v=reuse or JavaContent.model(index,{},size,dropsFolder,center,false)
        if reuse then
            reuse.model.Parent=dropsFolder
            for _,g in ipairs(reuse.model:GetDescendants()) do if g:IsA('SurfaceGui') then g.Enabled=true end end
        end
        for _,pair in ipairs(v.parts) do pair[1].CanCollide,pair[1].CanQuery=false,false end
        local angle=math.random()*math.pi*2
        world.primed[#world.primed+1]={position=center,previous=center,velocity=Vector3.new(-math.sin(angle)*size*.4,size*4,-math.cos(angle)*size*.4),fuse=fuse or 80,visual=v}
    end
    function world.prime(n,fuse)
        if not n or n.id~='tnt' or world.nodes[key(n.center)]~=n then return false end
        local position=world.renderPosition(n.center)
        world.nodes[key(n.center)]=nil
        n.physicsOwner=nil
        world.spawnPrimed(n.index,position,fuse,n.visual)
        world.vibrate(n.center,10,{player=fuse==nil}) -- PRIME_FUSE (chain reactions have no player)
        world.updateNeighbors();return true
    end
    -- Unified access to placed blocks and existing map geometry.
    local mapCuts,portalFrames={},{}
    local gridOrigin=workspace:GetAttribute('MinecraftGridOrigin')
    if typeof(gridOrigin)~='Vector3' then gridOrigin=Vector3.new(0,size/2,0) end
    function world.sample(center)
        local n=nodeAt(center)
        if n then
            local e=JavaContent.byIndex[n.index]
            return {id=n.id,index=n.index,center=n.center,node=n,resistance=e.resistance or 0,unbreakable=e.hardness and e.hardness<0}
        end
        return worldMining.sample and worldMining.sample(center)
    end
    function world.consume(index,amount)
        if not CONFIG.Survival then return true end
        local stack=inventory.slots[ui.selected]
        if not stack or stack.id~=index or stack.count<amount then return false end
        stack.count=stack.count-amount;if stack.count==0 then inventory.slots[ui.selected]=nil end
        ui.refresh();return true
    end
    function world.damageTool(index,amount,usedStack)
        if not CONFIG.Survival then return end
        local stats=toolStats[index];local stack=usedStack or inventory.slots[ui.selected]
        if not stats or not stats.durability or not stack or stack.id~=index then return end
        stack.damage=(stack.damage or 0)+amount
        if stack.damage>=stats.durability then
            for slot,value in pairs(inventory.slots) do if value==stack then inventory.slots[slot]=nil end end
            if inventory.cursor==stack then inventory.cursor=nil end
        end
        ui.refresh()
    end
    local function queueMap(block,callback)
        if not block or not block.hit or block.unbreakable then return false end
        mapCuts[#mapCuts+1]={center=block.center,callback=callback};return true
    end
    function world.ignite(hit,selected)
        local center=worldMining.cell(hit)
        local usedStack=inventory.slots[ui.selected]
        local target=world.sample(center)
        if target and target.id=='tnt' and target.hit then
            return queueMap(target,function(ok,latest)if ok then world.spawnPrimed(latest.index,latest.center);world.damageTool(selected,1,usedStack) end end)
        end
        local normal=hit.Normal
        local nx,ny,nz=dominantFace(normal.X,normal.Y,normal.Z)
        local start=center+Vector3.new(nx,ny,nz)*size
        local cache={}
        local function get(x,y,z)
            local p=start+Vector3.new(x,y,z)*size;local k=key(p)
            if cache[k]==nil then cache[k]=world.sample(p) or false end
            return cache[k] and cache[k].id or nil
        end
        local shape=SurvivalRules.portal(get,'x') or SurvivalRules.portal(get,'z')
        if shape then
            local entry=JavaContent.byId.nether_portal;if not entry then return false end
            local frame={start=start,shape=shape,cells={}}
            for x=shape.left,shape.left+shape.width-1 do for y=shape.bottom,shape.bottom+shape.height-1 do
                local p=start+Vector3.new(shape.axis=='x' and x or 0,y,shape.axis=='z' and x or 0)*size
                local old=nodeAt(p);if old then old.visual.model:Destroy();world.nodes[key(p)]=nil end
                local n=register(entry.index,p,{axis=shape.axis});n.solid=false;frame.cells[#frame.cells+1]=n
            end end
            portalFrames[#portalFrames+1]=frame;world.damageTool(selected,1);return true
        end
        if not world.sample(start) then
            local entry=JavaContent.byId.fire
            if entry then
                local n=world.placement and world.placement.ignite(start)
                if not world.placement then n=register(entry.index,start,CreativeRules.copy(entry.state)) end
                if not n then return false end
                n.solid=false;n.fireAge=0;world.updateNeighbors();world.damageTool(selected,1);return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function validatePortals()
        for i=#portalFrames,1,-1 do
            local f=portalFrames[i]
            local shape=SurvivalRules.portal(function(x,y,z)local b=world.sample(f.start+Vector3.new(x,y,z)*size);return b and b.id end,f.shape.axis)
            local valid=shape and shape.width==f.shape.width and shape.height==f.shape.height and shape.left==f.shape.left and shape.bottom==f.shape.bottom
            if not valid then
                for _,n in ipairs(f.cells) do if world.nodes[key(n.center)]==n then world.nodes[key(n.center)]=nil;n.visual.model:Destroy() end end
                table.remove(portalFrames,i)
            end
        end
    end
    -- Reconstruct portal groups after controller replacement or character respawn.
    local recovered={}
    for _,n in pairs(world.nodes) do
        if n.id=='nether_portal' and not recovered[key(n.center)] then
            local start=n.center
            local shape=SurvivalRules.portal(function(x,y,z)local b=world.sample(start+Vector3.new(x,y,z)*size);return b and b.id end,n.state.axis or 'x')
            if shape then
                local frame={start=start,shape=shape,cells={}}
                for x=shape.left,shape.left+shape.width-1 do for y=shape.bottom,shape.bottom+shape.height-1 do
                    local cell=nodeAt(start+Vector3.new(shape.axis=='x' and x or 0,y,shape.axis=='z' and x or 0)*size)
                    if cell and cell.id=='nether_portal' then frame.cells[#frame.cells+1]=cell;recovered[key(cell.center)]=true end
                end end
                portalFrames[#portalFrames+1]=frame
            else world.nodes[key(n.center)]=nil;n.visual.model:Destroy() end
        end
    end
    local function ambient(n)
        local id,p=n.id,n.center
        if (p-root.Position).Magnitude>size*32 then return end
        if id:find('torch',1,true) then
            if n.state.lit~='false' and world.tickCount%4==0 then
                local pos=p+Vector3.new(0,size*.2,0)
                if id:find('redstone',1,true) then effects.emit('smoke',pos,Vector3.zero,{life=10,size=.08,tint={1,.1,.1},fullbright=true})
                else effects.emit(id:find('soul',1,true) and 'soul_fire_flame' or 'flame',pos,Vector3.zero,{life=12,size=.16,fullbright=true});effects.emit('smoke',pos,Vector3.new(0,.01*size,0),{life=24,size=.18,tint={.4,.4,.4}}) end
            end
        elseif id=='fire' or id=='soul_fire' or (id:find('campfire',1,true) and n.state.lit~='false') then
            if world.tickCount%3==0 then effects.emit(id:find('campfire',1,true) and 'campfire_cosy_smoke' or 'smoke',p+Vector3.new((math.random()-.5)*size,size*.45,(math.random()-.5)*size),Vector3.new(0,size*.035,0),{life=60,size=.5,gravity=-.001}) end
        elseif id=='nether_portal' or id=='ender_chest' then
            if math.random()<.15 then effects.emit('portal',p+Vector3.new(math.random()-.5,math.random()-.5,math.random()-.5)*size,Vector3.new((math.random()-.5)*size,0,(math.random()-.5)*size),{life=math.random(40,49),size=.1+math.random()*.04,tint={.65,.22,.72},fullbright=true}) end
        elseif id=='furnace' or id=='blast_furnace' or id=='smoker' then
            if n.state.lit=='true' and world.tickCount%3==0 then local dir=Vector3.new(table.unpack(CreativeRules.directions[n.state.facing or 'north']));effects.emit('smoke',p+dir*size*.52,Vector3.new(0,size*.015,0),{life=20,size=.2}) end
        elseif id=='enchanting_table' and world.tickCount%4==0 then
            local sprites=JavaContent.data.particles.enchant
            effects.emit('enchant',p+Vector3.new(0,size,0),Vector3.new((math.random()-.5)*.03,size*.01,(math.random()-.5)*.03),{sprites={sprites[math.random(#sprites)]},life=40,size=.15,fullbright=true})
        elseif id=='bubble_column' and world.tickCount%4==0 then effects.emit('bubble',p,Vector3.new(0,size*.05,0),{life=30,size=.15})
        elseif id=='lava' and math.random()<.01 then effects.emit('lava',p+Vector3.new(0,size*.5,0),Vector3.new(0,size*.15,0),{life=30,size=.15,gravity=.02,fullbright=true,collision=true}) end
    end

    local pendingBlast
    function world.queueBlast(position,cells,complete)
        local batch=pendingBlast
        if batch and (batch.origin-position).Magnitude>size*12 then
            -- Too far from the gathering batch: cut this one on its own.
            worldMining.blast(cells,complete);return
        end
        if not batch then
            batch={origin=position,cells={},seen={},completes={},started=os.clock(),last=os.clock()}
            pendingBlast=batch
            -- Waits while more explosions keep coming (0.25 s quiet, at most 0.6 s), then one cut.
            task.spawn(function()
                repeat task.wait(.05) until os.clock()-batch.last>.25 or os.clock()-batch.started>.6
                if pendingBlast==batch then pendingBlast=nil end
                worldMining.blast(batch.cells,function() for _,f in ipairs(batch.completes) do f() end end)
            end)
        end
        batch.last=os.clock()
        for _,c in ipairs(cells) do local k=key(c);if not batch.seen[k] then batch.seen[k]=true;batch.cells[#batch.cells+1]=c end end
        batch.completes[#batch.completes+1]=complete
    end
    function world.explode(position,power)
        if MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.play("entity.generic.explode",position,4,(1+(math.random()-math.random())*0.2)*0.7) end
        effects.explosion(position)
        world.vibrate(position,15,{}) -- EXPLODE
        local cache={}
        local function sample(x,y,z)
            local k=x..','..y..','..z
            if cache[k]==nil then cache[k]=world.sample(gridOrigin+Vector3.new(x,y,z)*size) or false end
            return cache[k] or nil
        end
        local v=(position-gridOrigin)/size+Vector3.new(.5,.5,.5)
        local affected=SurvivalRules.explosion(v.X,v.Y,v.Z,power or 4,sample)
        -- Entity damage uses a sampled visible fraction of the body before blocks are removed.
        local params=OverlapParams.new();params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;params.FilterDescendantsInstances={dropsFolder}
        local seen={}
        for _,part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position,size*8,params)) do
            local model=part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model');local hum=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            local body=model and (model:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') or model.PrimaryPart)
            if hum and body and not seen[hum] then
                seen[hum]=true
                local distance=(body.Position-position).Magnitude/size
                if distance<=8 then
                    local clear,total=0,0;local exposureCast=RaycastParams.new()
                    exposureCast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;exposureCast.FilterDescendantsInstances={model,dropsFolder};exposureCast.RespectCanCollide=true
                    local ext=Vector3.new(.6,1.8,.6)*size
                    local stepX,stepY,stepZ=1/(.6*2+1),1/(1.8*2+1),1/(.6*2+1)
                    for x=0,1,stepX do for y=0,1,stepY do for z=0,1,stepZ do
                        local point=body.Position+Vector3.new((x-.5)*ext.X,(y-.5)*ext.Y,(z-.5)*ext.Z)
                        total=total+1;if not workspace:Raycast(point,position-point,exposureCast) then clear=clear+1 end
                    end end end
                    local damage,impact=SurvivalRules.explosionDamage(distance,clear/math.max(1,total),4)
                    if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) or model==character then
                        if model==character and world.gameplay.armorDamage then damage=world.gameplay.armorDamage(damage)end
                        hum:TakeDamage(damage)
                        local delta=body.Position-position
                        if delta.Magnitude>.001 then
                            local impulse=delta.Unit*impact*size
                            if model==character and world.knockback then world.knockback(impulse) else body.AssemblyLinearVelocity=body.AssemblyLinearVelocity+impulse/CONFIG.Tick end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for i=#affected,2,-1 do local j=math.random(i);affected[i],affected[j]=affected[j],affected[i] end
        world.neighborBatch=(world.neighborBatch or 0)+1
        local blastCells,blastBlocks={},{}
        for _,cell in ipairs(affected) do
            local b=cell.block;local n=b.node or nodeAt(b.center)
            if n and world.nodes[key(n.center)]==n then
                if n.id=='tnt' then world.prime(n,math.random(10,29))
                elseif n.visual.parts[1] then world.breakBlock({Instance=n.visual.parts[1][1]},true,{explosion=true,radius=power or 4}) end
            elseif b.hit and not b.unbreakable then
                blastCells[#blastCells+1]=b.center;blastBlocks[#blastBlocks+1]=b
            end
        end
        world.neighborBatch=world.neighborBatch-1
        if world.neighborBatch==0 and world.neighborPending then world.neighborPending=false;world.updateNeighbors() end
        -- Map geometry goes in one blast pass (not cell-by-cell mining); drops and chained TNT follow.
        if #blastCells>0 then
            world.queueBlast(position,blastCells,function()
                local budget=os.clock()
                for _,b in ipairs(blastBlocks) do
                    if os.clock()-budget>.008 then task.wait();budget=os.clock() end
                    if b.id=='tnt' then world.spawnPrimed(b.index,b.center,math.random(10,29))
                    elseif b.index then world.loot(b.index,b.center,nil,{explosion=true,radius=power or 4}) end
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local function piston(n,powered)
        if n.movingUntil and world.tickCount<n.movingUntil then return end
        local d=Vector3.new(table.unpack(CreativeRules.directions[n.state.facing or 'north']))*size
        local function movable(other)
            return not other.partner and not (other.movingUntil and world.tickCount<other.movingUntil) and other.id~='bedrock' and other.id~='obsidian' and not other.id:find('chest',1,true) and not other.id:find('piston',1,true)
        end
        local function shift(other,center)
            local from=other.center
            world.nodes[key(other.center)]=nil; other.center=center; world.nodes[key(center)]=other; rebuild(other)
            animateNode(other,from,center)
        end
        if powered and n.state.extended~='true' then
            local chain={}; local pos=n.center+d
            for _=1,13 do local other=nodeAt(pos); if not other then break end; if not movable(other) then return end; chain[#chain+1]=other; pos=pos+d end
            if #chain>12 or overlapsPlayer(pos) then return end
            if not nodeAt(pos) and worldMining.occupied(pos) then return end
            for i=#chain,1,-1 do shift(chain[i],chain[i].center+d) end
            n.state.extended='true'
            local e=JavaContent.byId.piston_head
            local head=register(e.index,n.center+d,{facing=n.state.facing,type=n.id=='sticky_piston' and 'sticky' or 'normal',short='false'})
            head.piston=key(n.center)
            animateNode(head,n.center,n.center+d);n.movingUntil=world.tickCount+2
        elseif not powered and n.state.extended=='true' then
            local head=nodeAt(n.center+d)
            if head and head.id=='piston_head' then
                world.nodes[key(head.center)]=nil
                for _,pair in ipairs(head.visual.parts) do pair[1].CanCollide,pair[1].CanQuery=false,false end
                animateNode(head,head.center,n.center,true)
            end
            n.movingUntil=world.tickCount+2
            n.state.extended='false'
            if n.id=='sticky_piston' then
                local other=nodeAt(n.center+d*2)
                if other and movable(other) and not overlapsPlayer(n.center+d) then shift(other,n.center+d) end
            end
        end
    end
    function world.tick()
        if world.frozen then world.lastTick=os.clock();return end
        world.tickCount=world.tickCount+1;world.lastTick=os.clock();effects.tick();world.gameplay.tick()
        if world.tickCount%10==0 then
            local held=inventory.slots[ui.selected];local heldEntry=held and JavaContent.byIndex[held.id]
            local heldId=not CONFIG.Survival and heldEntry and heldEntry.id or nil
            if heldId~=world.markerHeld or world.tickCount%40==0 then
                world.markerHeld=heldId
                for _,n in pairs(world.nodes) do
                    if (n.id=='barrier' or n.id=='light') and n.visual then
                        local show=heldId==n.id and (world.renderPosition(n.center)-root.Position).Magnitude<32*size
                        for _,pair in ipairs(n.visual.parts) do
                            local p=pair[1]
                            if p.Name=='SteveMarker' then local g=p:FindFirstChild('SteveMarker');if g then g.Enabled=show end
                            elseif n.id=='light' and p.Name~='BlockLight' then p.CanQuery=heldId=='light' end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if #mapCuts>0 and not worldMining.busy and os.clock()>=(worldMining.retryAt or 0) then
            local job=table.remove(mapCuts,1);local latest=world.sample(job.center)
            if latest and latest.hit and not latest.node and not latest.unbreakable then
                worldMining.cut(latest.hit,job.center,false,function(ok)
                    if ok and latest.index then effects.block(latest.index,job.center,true) end
                    if job.callback then job.callback(ok,latest) end
                end)
            end
        end
        if world.chestsDirty then world.chestsDirty=nil;world.reconcileChests() end
        if world.tickCount%5==0 then validatePortals() end
        local nodes={} 
        for _,n in pairs(world.nodes) do nodes[#nodes+1]=n end
        for _,n in ipairs(nodes) do
            ambient(n)
            if n.storage then
                world.gameplay.containerTick(n)
                local fullness,count=0,0
                for _,stack in pairs(n.storage.slots) do fullness=fullness+stack.count/((itemStackLimits[stack.id] or (toolStats[stack.id] and 1 or 64)));count=count+1 end
                n.comparatorStrength=count>0 and math.floor(14*fullness/(n.storageSize or 27))+1 or 0
            end
            if n.id=='chest' or n.id=='trapped_chest' or n.id=='ender_chest' or n.id:match('copper_chest$') or n.id:match('shulker_box$') then
