                n.oldLid=n.lid or 0;n.lid=SurvivalRules.lid(n.oldLid,n.containerOpen)
                if n.id=='trapped_chest' then n.output=n.containerOpen and 1 or 0 end
            elseif n.id=='barrel' then n.state.open=tostring(not not n.containerOpen) end
            if n.id=='redstone_wire' and (world.connectionsDirty or not n.wireNeighbors) then
                n.wireNeighbors={}
                for _,dir in ipairs({'north','east','south','west'}) do
                    local d=Vector3.new(table.unpack(CreativeRules.directions[dir]))*size
                    local other=nodeAt(n.center+d); local connection='none'
                    if other and other.id=='redstone_wire' then n.wireNeighbors[#n.wireNeighbors+1]=other; connection='side'
                    elseif other and other.solid and not nodeAt(n.center+Vector3.new(0,size,0)) then
                        local above=nodeAt(other.center+Vector3.new(0,size,0))
                        if above and above.id=='redstone_wire' then n.wireNeighbors[#n.wireNeighbors+1]=above; connection='up' end
                    elseif not other then
                        local below=nodeAt(n.center+d-Vector3.new(0,size,0))
                        if below and below.id=='redstone_wire' then n.wireNeighbors[#n.wireNeighbors+1]=below; connection='side' end
                    end
                    if other then
                        local directional=other.id=='repeater' or other.id=='comparator'
                        if directional and (other.state.facing==dir or other.state.facing==CreativeRules.opposite[dir]) then connection='side'
                        elseif other.id=='observer' and other.state.facing==dir then connection='side'
                        elseif not directional and (other.id=='redstone_torch' or other.id=='redstone_wall_torch' or other.id=='lever' or other.id:match('_button$') or other.id:match('pressure_plate$') or other.id:match('sculk_sensor$') or other.id=='detector_rail') then connection='side' end
                    end
                    n.state[dir]=connection
                end
                local ns=n.state.north~='none' or n.state.south~='none'
                local ew=n.state.east~='none' or n.state.west~='none'
                if ns or ew then n.dot=nil end
                if not n.dot then
                    if not ns then if n.state.east=='none' then n.state.east='side' end; if n.state.west=='none' then n.state.west='side' end end
                    if not ew then if n.state.north=='none' then n.state.north='side' end; if n.state.south=='none' then n.state.south='side' end end
                end
            elseif n.id:match('pressure_plate$') then
                local delta=root.Position-(world.renderPosition(n.center)+Vector3.new(0,root.Size.Y/2-size/2,0))
                n.state.powered=tostring(math.abs(delta.X)<size*.55 and math.abs(delta.Z)<size*.55 and math.abs(delta.Y)<size*.3)
            elseif n.id=='observer' then
                local watched=neighbor(n,n.state.facing or 'north')
                local value=watched and watched.id..signature(watched.state) or 'air'
                if n.observed and n.observed~=value then n.pulseStart=world.tickCount+2 end
                n.observed=value
                n.output=n.pulseStart and world.tickCount>=n.pulseStart and world.tickCount<n.pulseStart+2 and 15 or 0
                n.state.powered=tostring(n.output>0)
            end
        end
        if world.connectionsDirty and world.placement then world.placement.cullAll() end
        world.connectionsDirty=false
        world.machines.tick(nodes)
        world.blocks.tick(nodes)
        if world.placement then
            world.placement.tick(nodes)
            world.placement.entityTick(root.Position-Vector3.new(0,root.Size.Y/2,0),root.Size.Y,world.inWater and world.inWater())
        end
        world.items.tick()
        world.gameplay.vehicles.railPower(nodes)
        for _, n in ipairs(nodes) do
            if n.id == "rail" then
                local shape = world.gameplay.vehicles.railShape(n)
                if shape ~= n.state.shape then n.state.shape = shape; rebuild(n) end
            end
        end
        -- Whether a map cell is solid is remembered for 2 seconds (the map rarely changes).
        world.mapSolid=world.mapSolid or {}
        local mapCache={}
        local function mapCell(n,dir)
            local d=CreativeRules.directions[dir]
            local cell=n.center+Vector3.new(d[1],d[2],d[3])*size
            local k=key(cell)
            local cached=mapCache[k]
            if cached==nil then
                cached=false
                if not nodeAt(cell) then
                    local known=world.mapSolid[k]
                    if not known or world.tickCount-known.tick>40 then
                        local sample=world.sample(cell)
                        known={tick=world.tickCount,solid=sample~=nil and not sample.liquid and not sample.node}
                        world.mapSolid[k]=known
                    end
                    if known.solid then
                        local around={}
                        for name,v in pairs(CreativeRules.directions) do
                            local m=nodeAt(cell+Vector3.new(v[1],v[2],v[3])*size)
                            if m then around[#around+1]={m,CreativeRules.opposite[name]} end
                        end
                        cached=around
                    end
                end
                mapCache[k]=cached
            end
            return cached or nil
        end
        CreativeRules.redstone(nodes,neighbor,world.tickCount,mapCell)
        if world.fluids then world.fluids.tick() end
        for _,n in ipairs(nodes) do
            if n.id=='tnt' and n.input>0 then world.prime(n) end
            if n.id=='piston' or n.id=='sticky_piston' then
                local power=0;for dir,value in pairs(n.received or {}) do if dir~=n.state.facing then power=math.max(power,value) end end
                piston(n,power>0)
            end
            if n.id:match('_door$') and n.partner and world.nodes[n.partner] then
                local partner=world.nodes[n.partner]
                local powered=(n.input or 0)>0 or (partner.input or 0)>0
                if powered then n.state.open,partner.state.open='true','true' end
                n.state.powered,partner.state.powered=tostring(powered),tostring(powered)
            end
            if world.nodes[key(n.center)]==n and signature(n.state)~=n.signature then rebuild(n) end
        end
        for i=#world.primed,1,-1 do
            local t=world.primed[i];t.previous=t.position;t.fuse=t.fuse-1
            t.velocity=t.velocity+Vector3.new(0,-size*.8,0)
            local move=t.velocity*CONFIG.Tick
            local hit=move.Magnitude>.0001 and workspace:Spherecast(t.position,size*.48,move,dropCast)
            if hit then
                t.position=t.position+move.Unit*math.max(0,hit.Distance-.01)
                if hit.Normal.Y>.5 then t.velocity=Vector3.new(t.velocity.X*.7,-t.velocity.Y*.5,t.velocity.Z*.7)*.98
                else t.velocity=(t.velocity-hit.Normal*t.velocity:Dot(hit.Normal))*.98 end
            else t.position=t.position+move;t.velocity=t.velocity*.98 end
            effects.emit('smoke',t.position+Vector3.new(0,size*.01,0),Vector3.zero,{size=.2,life=20,tint={.4,.4,.4}})
            if t.fuse<=0 then t.visual.model:Destroy();table.remove(world.primed,i);world.explode(t.position-Vector3.new(0,size*.42875,0)) end
        end
        for i=#world.drops,1,-1 do
            local d=world.drops[i]
            if not JavaContent.mods.available(JavaContent.byIndex[d.id]) then d.visual.model.Parent=nil;continue end
            if not d.visual.model.Parent then d.visual.model.Parent=dropsFolder end
            d.age=d.age+1
            d.velocity=d.velocity+Vector3.new(0,-size*.8,0)
            local movement=d.velocity*CONFIG.Tick
            local hit=movement.Magnitude>.0001 and workspace:Spherecast(d.position,size*.12,movement,dropCast)
            if hit then
                d.position=d.position+movement.Unit*math.max(0,hit.Distance-.01)
                d.velocity=(d.velocity-hit.Normal*d.velocity:Dot(hit.Normal))*.588
            else d.position=d.position+movement; d.velocity=d.velocity*.98 end
            if d.age>10 and (d.position-root.Position).Magnitude<size*1.25 then
                local amount=inventory.add(d.id,d.count,nil,d.damage,d.template); d.count=d.count-amount
                if amount>0 and MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.play("entity.item.pickup",nil,0.2,((math.random()-math.random())*0.7+1)*2) end
                if amount>0 then ui.refresh(); if world.netDropCount then pcall(world.netDropCount,d) end end
            end
            if d.count<=0 or d.age>=6000 then
                d.visual.model:Destroy(); table.remove(world.drops,i)
                if world.netDropGone then pcall(world.netDropGone,d) end
            end
        end
        if world.tickCount%20==0 then
            for i=#world.drops,2,-1 do
                local a=world.drops[i]
                if not toolStats[a.id] then
                    for j=1,i-1 do
                        local b=world.drops[j]
                        if a.id==b.id and CreativeRules.sameItem(a.template or a,b.template or b) and a.count+b.count<=64 and (a.position-b.position).Magnitude<size*.5
                            and (not a.net or a.net.mine) and (not b.net or b.net.mine) then
                            b.count=b.count+a.count;b.age=math.min(a.age,b.age)
                            a.visual.model:Destroy();table.remove(world.drops,i)
                            if world.netDropCount then a.count=0;pcall(world.netDropCount,a);pcall(world.netDropCount,b) end
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local heldParent=Instance.new('Folder'); heldParent.Name,heldParent.Parent='SteveCatalogHands',workspace
    function world.render(firstPerson,selected,shown,firstFrame,thirdFrame,offhand,offFirstFrame,offThirdFrame)
        for owner in pairs(world.physicsOwners) do world.drawPhysicsOwner(owner) end
        world.renderFirstPerson=firstPerson
        if world.newShadow then
            if not world.playerShadow then
                -- A shadow left by an earlier copy of the script on this character goes first.
                for _,old in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do if old.Name=='SteveShadow' then old:Destroy() end end
                world.playerShadow=world.newShadow(character)
            end
            world.playerShadow.update(root.Position-Vector3.new(0,root.Size.Y/2,0),not firstPerson and not PlayerStats.spectator)
        end
        ui.render();effects.render()
        JavaContent.animateTextures()
        local partial=world.renderPartial or math.min(1,(os.clock()-(world.lastTick or os.clock()))/CONFIG.Tick)
        world.gameplay.render(partial)
        world.machines.render(partial)
        for _,n in pairs(world.nodes) do if n.lid then n.visual.pivot(CFrame.new(n.center),1,lerp(n.oldLid or 0,n.lid,partial)) end end
        world.blocks.render(partial)
        if world.blocks.physicsExtras then world.blocks.physicsExtras() end
        if world.placement then world.placement.render(firstPerson) end
        world.items.render(partial)
        for i=#motions,1,-1 do
            local m=motions[i];local alpha=math.min(1,(os.clock()-m.start)/m.duration)
            if m.visual.model.Parent then m.visual.pivot(CFrame.new(m.from:Lerp(m.to,alpha))) end
            if alpha>=1 or not m.visual.model.Parent or m.node.visual~=m.visual then
                if m.removeAfter then m.visual.model:Destroy() end
                table.remove(motions,i)
            end
        end
        for _,t in ipairs(world.primed) do
            local swelling=math.max(0,1-(t.fuse-partial+1)/10)^4
            local at=(t.previous or t.position):Lerp(t.position,partial)
            t.visual.pivot(CFrame.new(at),1+swelling*.3)
            -- TntRenderer: every other 5 ticks the block is drawn with the white overlay (75% toward white).
            local flash=math.floor(t.fuse/5)%2==0
            if not t.flashFrames then
                t.flashFrames={}
                for _,g in ipairs(t.visual.model:GetDescendants()) do
                    if g:IsA('SurfaceGui') then
                        local f=Instance.new('Frame')
                        f.Name,f.Size,f.BorderSizePixel,f.BackgroundColor3,f.BackgroundTransparency,f.ZIndex='TntFlash',UDim2.fromScale(1,1),0,Color3.new(1,1,1),0.25,100
                        f.Visible=false
                        f.Parent=g
                        t.flashFrames[#t.flashFrames+1]=f
                    end
                end
            end
            if t.flashOn~=flash then
                t.flashOn=flash
                for _,f in ipairs(t.flashFrames) do f.Visible=flash end
            end
        end
        for _,d in ipairs(world.drops) do
            d.visual.pivot(CFrame.new(d.position+Vector3.new(0,math.sin(d.age*.1)*size*.04,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,d.age*.05,0)*d.offset)
        end
        local use=world.gameplay
        local item=JavaContent.byIndex[selected]
        -- Item model states: bow pulling (0.65 / 0.9 of 20 ticks), crossbow pulling (pull 0.58 / 1.0) and loaded
        -- (crossbow_arrow / crossbow_firework).
        for _,hand in ipairs({{selected,world.mainStack,not world.offhandUsing,false},{offhand,world.offStack,world.offhandUsing,true}}) do
            local index,stack,usingHere,isOff=hand[1],hand[2],hand[3],hand[4]
            local entry=index and JavaContent.byIndex[index]
            if entry then
                local id=entry.itemId or entry.id
                local frames=JavaContent.data.useFrames[id]
                local frame=nil
                if id=='bow' and frames and usingHere and use.charge>0 then
                    frame=frames[use.charge>=18 and 3 or use.charge>=13 and 2 or 1]
                elseif id=='crossbow' then
                    local u=world.items and world.items.using
                    if type(stack)=='table' and stack.id==index and stack.charged then
                        frame=JavaContent.guiTextureIndex(stack.charged.name=='firework_rocket' and 'item/crossbow_firework' or 'item/crossbow_arrow')
                    elseif frames and usingHere and u and u.kind=='crossbow' then
                        local pull=u.ticks/math.max(1,u.duration or 25)
                        frame=frames[pull>=1 and 3 or pull>=0.58 and 2 or 1]
                    end
                end
                if JavaContent.itemFrames[index]~=frame then
                    JavaContent.itemFrames[index]=frame
                    if isOff then world.lastOff=nil else world.lastHeld=nil;world.lastShown=nil end
                end
            end
        end
        if world.offhandUsing and offFirstFrame then
            if use.scoping then offFirstFrame=offFirstFrame*CFrame.new(size*.2,size*.2,size*.1)
            elseif use.useTicks>0 then offFirstFrame=offFirstFrame*CFrame.new(0,math.abs(math.sin(use.useTicks*.8))*size*.06,size*.15)*CFrame.Angles(-.5,0,0)
            end
        elseif firstFrame then
            if use.scoping then firstFrame=firstFrame*CFrame.new(-size*.2,size*.2,size*.1)
            elseif use.blocking and not (item and item.blockingDisplay) then firstFrame=firstFrame*CFrame.Angles(0,-math.pi/3,0)
            elseif use.useTicks>0 then firstFrame=firstFrame*CFrame.new(0,math.abs(math.sin(use.useTicks*.8))*size*.06,size*.15)*CFrame.Angles(-.5,0,0)
            end
        end
        if selected~=world.lastHeld then
            if world.held then world.held.model:Destroy(); world.held=nil end
            if JavaContent.byIndex[selected] then
                local offset,modelScale=JavaContent.display(selected,'thirdperson_righthand',size)
                world.held=JavaContent.model(selected,JavaContent.byIndex[selected].state,modelScale,heldParent,Vector3.zero,true)
                world.held.offset=offset
            end
            world.lastHeld=selected
        end
        if shown~=world.lastShown then
            if world.shown then world.shown.model:Destroy(); world.shown=nil end
            if JavaContent.byIndex[shown] then
                local offset,modelScale=JavaContent.display(shown,'firstperson_righthand',CONFIG.ViewScale)
                world.shown=JavaContent.model(shown,JavaContent.byIndex[shown].state,modelScale,heldParent,Vector3.zero,true)
                world.shown.offset=offset
            end
            world.lastShown=shown
        end
        local function blockingOffsets(model,index,context,unit)
            local e=model and JavaContent.byIndex[index]
            if e and e.blockingDisplay then model.offset=JavaContent.display(index,context,unit,use.blocking) end
        end
        blockingOffsets(world.held,selected,'thirdperson_righthand',size)
        blockingOffsets(world.shown,shown,'firstperson_righthand',CONFIG.ViewScale)
        blockingOffsets(world.offThird,offhand,'thirdperson_lefthand',size)
        blockingOffsets(world.offFirst,offhand,'firstperson_lefthand',CONFIG.ViewScale)
        if world.held then world.held.model.Parent=not firstPerson and thirdFrame and heldParent or nil; if thirdFrame then world.held.pivot(thirdFrame*world.held.offset) end end
        if world.shown then world.shown.model.Parent=firstPerson and firstFrame and heldParent or nil; if firstFrame then world.shown.pivot(firstFrame*world.shown.offset) end end
        -- Offhand item: the same models with the mirrored *_lefthand display transforms.
        local off=offhand and JavaContent.byIndex[offhand] and offhand or nil
        if off~=world.lastOff then
            if world.offThird then world.offThird.model:Destroy();world.offThird=nil end
            if world.offFirst then world.offFirst.model:Destroy();world.offFirst=nil end
            if off then
                local entry=JavaContent.byIndex[off]
                local offset,modelScale=JavaContent.display(off,'thirdperson_lefthand',size)
                world.offThird=JavaContent.model(off,entry.state,modelScale,heldParent,Vector3.zero,true);world.offThird.offset=offset
                offset,modelScale=JavaContent.display(off,'firstperson_lefthand',CONFIG.ViewScale)
                world.offFirst=JavaContent.model(off,entry.state,modelScale,heldParent,Vector3.zero,true);world.offFirst.offset=offset
            end
            world.lastOff=off
        end
        if world.offThird then world.offThird.model.Parent=not firstPerson and offThirdFrame and heldParent or nil; if offThirdFrame then world.offThird.pivot(offThirdFrame*world.offThird.offset) end end
        if world.offFirst then world.offFirst.model.Parent=firstPerson and offFirstFrame and heldParent or nil; if offFirstFrame then world.offFirst.pivot(offFirstFrame*world.offFirst.offset) end end
        -- Enchantment glint on the held item models (the stacks come from the controller).
        for _,pair in ipairs({{world.held,world.mainStack,selected},{world.shown,world.mainStack,shown},{world.offThird,world.offStack,off},{world.offFirst,world.offStack,off}}) do
            local visual,stack,index=pair[1],pair[2],pair[3]
            if visual then
                local foil=(JavaContent.isFoil(stack) and stack.id==index) or false
                if visual.foil~=foil then visual.foil=foil;pcall(JavaContent.glintModel,visual.model,foil) end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Models worn or held by the player, for the inventory preview (armour, catalog items in hand).
    function world.previewModels()
        local list={}
        if world.held then list[#list+1]={model=world.held.model} end
        if world.offThird then list[#list+1]={model=world.offThird.model} end
        for slot,visual in pairs(world.gameplay and world.gameplay.armorVisuals or {}) do list[#list+1]={model=visual.model,head=slot=='helmet'} end
        return list
    end
    function world.destroy()
        if world.blocks then world.blocks.destroy() end
        if world.placement then world.placement.destroy() end
        if world.items then world.items.destroy() end
        for _,n in pairs(world.nodes) do
            if n.command then
                n.visual.model:SetAttribute('MinecraftCommand',game:GetService('HttpService'):JSONEncode({text=n.command.text,auto=n.command.auto,track=n.command.track}))
            end
            if n.storage then
                local stacks={}
                for slot,stack in pairs(n.storage.slots) do stacks[tostring(slot)]=stack end
                n.visual.model:SetAttribute('MinecraftStorage',game:GetService('HttpService'):JSONEncode(stacks))
            end
        end
        if world.held then world.held.model:Destroy() end
        if world.shown then world.shown.model:Destroy() end
        if world.offThird then world.offThird.model:Destroy() end
        if world.offFirst then world.offFirst.model:Destroy() end
        for _,m in ipairs(motions) do if m.removeAfter then m.visual.model:Destroy() end end
        world.gameplay.destroy()
        world.machines.destroy()
        effects.destroy()
        dropsFolder:Destroy(); heldParent:Destroy()
    end
    -- /setblock, /fill, /clone: replace one placed-block cell (index nil = air; destroy drops it).
    function world.setBlockAt(center,index,state,destroy,modId)
        local old=nodeAt(center)
        if modId then
            world.modCells=world.modCells or {}
            local grid=workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin") or Vector3.new(0,CONFIG.Block/2,0)
            local v=(center-grid)/CONFIG.Block
            local cell=math.floor(v.X+.5)..","..math.floor(v.Y+.5)..","..math.floor(v.Z+.5)
            world.modCells[cell]=modId
            world.modOriginals=world.modOriginals or {}
            if world.modOriginals[cell]==nil then world.modOriginals[cell]={center=center,mod=modId,index=old and old.index,state=old and CreativeRules.copy(old.state)} end
        end
        if old then
            if destroy then effects.block(old.index,old.center,true,nil,old.state);world.loot(old.index,old.center,old.state) end
            if old.storage and old.id~='ender_chest' then for _,stack in pairs(old.storage.slots) do world.drop(stack,old.center,nil,true) end end
            world.nodes[key(center)]=nil;old.visual.model:Destroy()
        end
        if index then local n=register(index,center,state); if n then n.modOwner=modId end;return n end
    end
    -- Map shapes and terrain that turn into blocks when mined (WORLD MINING).
    worldMining.placeBlock=function(center,kind)
        if nodeAt(center) then return end
        local entry=JavaContent.byName[kind] or JavaContent.byId[(kind or ''):lower():gsub(' ','_')] or JavaContent.byId.stone
        if entry and not entry.itemOnly then local n=register(entry.index,center,CreativeRules.copy(entry.state));if n then n.fromMap=true end;world.connectionsDirty=true end
    end
    world.gameplay=createJavaGameplay(world,character,root,inventory,ui,register,nodeAt,worldMining)
    world.machines=createBlockMachines(world,{nodeAt=nodeAt,neighbor=neighbor,register=register,key=key,root=root,effects=effects,ui=ui,
        ignore={character,dropsFolder},
        cell=function(p) local v=(p-gridOrigin)/size;return gridOrigin+Vector3.new(math.floor(v.X+.5),math.floor(v.Y+.5),math.floor(v.Z+.5))*size end})
    world.vibrate=world.machines.vibrate
    do local baseVibrate=world.vibrate
        world.vibrate=function(position,frequency,cause) baseVibrate(position,frequency,cause); local mm=world.gameplay and world.gameplay.mobsModule; if mm and not (cause and cause.mob) then mm.hearVibration(position) end end
    end
    -- Batch 7c: block menus (crafting, enchanting, anvil, beacon...) and every other interactive block.
    world.screens=createBlockScreens({ui=ui,world=world})
    world.blocks=createBlockUses(world,{nodeAt=nodeAt,neighbor=neighbor,rebuild=rebuild,key=key,root=root,effects=effects,ui=ui,inventory=inventory,screens=world.screens})
    world.blocks_rebuild=rebuild
    world.placement=createBlockPlacement(world,{size=size,nodeAt=nodeAt,register=register,key=key,rebuild=rebuild,root=root,character=character})
    world.connectionsDirty=true -- restored blocks take their culling on the first tick
    world.cell=function(p) local v=(p-gridOrigin)/size;return gridOrigin+Vector3.new(math.floor(v.X+.5),math.floor(v.Y+.5),math.floor(v.Z+.5))*size end
    -- Events for other scripts: placing, breaking, TNT and explosions.
    do
        local basePlace,baseBreak,basePrime,baseExplode=world.place,world.breakBlock,world.prime,world.explode
        world.place=function(index,center,...)
            local r=table.pack(basePlace(index,center,...))
            if r[1] then local n=nodeAt(center);if n then steveEmit('place',{id=n.id,name=JavaContent.byIndex[n.index] and JavaContent.byIndex[n.index].name or n.id,position=center}) end end
            return table.unpack(r,1,r.n)
        end
        world.breakBlock=function(hit,harvest,lootContext,...)
            local n=hit and hit.Instance and world.resolve(hit.Instance)
            local r=table.pack(baseBreak(hit,harvest,lootContext,...))
            if r[1] and n and not (lootContext and lootContext.explosion) then steveEmit('break',{id=n.id,name=JavaContent.byIndex[n.index] and JavaContent.byIndex[n.index].name or n.id,position=n.center}) end
            return table.unpack(r,1,r.n)
        end
        world.prime=function(n,...)
            steveEmit('tnt_primed',{position=type(n)=='table' and n.center or n})
            return basePrime(n,...)
        end
        world.explode=function(position,power,...)
            steveEmit('explosion',{position=position,power=power})
            local r=table.pack(baseExplode(position,power,...))
            -- Verity (The Verity Script) is a mob: thrown and hurt by the blast like one, never mined.
            local bridge=rawget(_G,'VerityBridge')
            if type(bridge)=='table' and type(bridge.blast)=='function' then
                local okB,e=pcall(bridge.blast,position,(power or 4)*2*size)
                if not okB then warn('Verity blast: '..tostring(e)) end
            end
            return table.unpack(r,1,r.n)
        end
    end
    -- FLUIDS (FlowingFluid / WaterFluid / LavaFluid / LiquidBlock): placed water and lava flow like
    -- Java. Levels are the blockstate "level": 0 source, 1-7 flowing (amount 8-level), 8+ falling.
    -- Water: drop-off 1, slope distance 4, tick delay 5, two sources make a new one. Lava (Overworld):
    -- drop-off 2, slope distance 2, tick delay 30. Solid map cells count as walls and floors.
    do
        local fluids = {pending = {}, dirtyCells = {}}
        world.fluids = fluids
        local DIRS = {north = Vector3.new(0, 0, -size), south = Vector3.new(0, 0, size), west = Vector3.new(-size, 0, 0), east = Vector3.new(size, 0, 0)}
        local HORIZONTAL = {"north", "east", "south", "west"}
        local OPPOSITE = {north = "south", south = "north", east = "west", west = "east"}
        local UP, DOWN = Vector3.new(0, size, 0), Vector3.new(0, -size, 0)
        local PROPS = {water = {dropOff = 1, slope = 4, delay = 5}, lava = {dropOff = 2, slope = 2, delay = 30}}
        -- Blocks a flowing fluid cannot wash away (FlowingFluid.canHoldFluid exceptions).
        local KEEP = {ladder = true, sugar_cane = true, bubble_column = true, nether_portal = true, end_portal = true, end_gateway = true, structure_void = true}
        local mapSolid = {}
        local function blocksMotion(n)
            local shape = JavaContent.shape(n.id, n.state)
            return not shape or shape.full or #shape.collision > 0
        end
        local function fluidOf(n)
            if not n then return nil end
            if n.id == "water" or n.id == "lava" then return n.id end
            if n.state and n.state.waterlogged == "true" then return "water" end
            return nil
        end
        -- What a cell holds: node, fluid, amount, source, falling, solid (wall/floor), open (fluid may enter).
        local function cell(pos)
            local n = nodeAt(pos)
            if n then
                local fluid = fluidOf(n)
                if fluid then
                    local level = tonumber(n.state.level) or 0
                    local logged = n.id ~= "water" and n.id ~= "lava"
                    return {node = n, fluid = fluid, source = logged or level == 0, falling = not logged and level >= 8,
                        amount = (logged or level == 0 or level >= 8) and 8 or 8 - level, logged = logged, solid = logged and blocksMotion(n)}
                end
                local solid = blocksMotion(n) or KEEP[n.id] or n.id:match("_door$") or n.id:match("_sign$") or ((JavaContent.byId[n.id] or {}).mod ~= nil)
                return {node = n, solid = solid and true or false, open = not solid, washAway = not solid}
            end
            local k = key(pos)
            local known = mapSolid[k]
            if not known or world.tickCount - known.tick > 40 then
                local sample = world.sample(pos)
                known = {tick = world.tickCount, solid = sample ~= nil and not sample.liquid, liquid = sample and sample.liquid and sample.id}
                mapSolid[k] = known
            end
            if known.liquid then return {fluid = known.liquid, source = true, amount = 8, static = true} end
            return {solid = known.solid, open = not known.solid}
        end
        function fluids.schedule(pos, delay)
            local k = key(pos)
            local due = world.tickCount + (delay or 1)
            local old = fluids.pending[k]
            if not old or old.due > due then fluids.pending[k] = {pos = pos, due = due} end
        end
        -- Something at pos changed: every fluid next to it (and in it) re-checks after its delay.
        function fluids.changed(pos)
            mapSolid[key(pos)] = nil
            for _, offset in ipairs({Vector3.zero, UP, DOWN, DIRS.north, DIRS.south, DIRS.east, DIRS.west}) do
                local c = cell(pos + offset)
                if c.fluid and not c.static then fluids.schedule(pos + offset, PROPS[c.fluid].delay) end
            end
        end
        -- FlowingFluid.getNewLiquid(): what fluid the cell at pos should hold, from its neighbours.
        local function newLiquid(pos, fluid)
            local props = PROPS[fluid]
            local maxAmount, sources = 0, 0
            for _, dir in ipairs(HORIZONTAL) do
                local c = cell(pos + DIRS[dir])
                if c.fluid == fluid then
                    if c.source then sources = sources + 1 end
                    maxAmount = math.max(maxAmount, c.amount)
                end
            end
            if fluid == "water" and sources >= 2 then
                local below = cell(pos + DOWN)
                if below.solid or (below.fluid == fluid and below.source) then return 0 end
            end
            local above = cell(pos + UP)
            if above.fluid == fluid then return 8 end
            local amount = maxAmount - props.dropOff
            if amount <= 0 then return nil end
            return 8 - amount
        end
        local function height(level) return (level == 0 or level >= 8) and 8 or 8 - level end
        -- Sets the fluid at pos (level nil removes it); washes away plants, torches, dust...
        local function setFluid(pos, fluid, level)
            local n = nodeAt(pos)
            if level == nil then
                if n and (n.id == "water" or n.id == "lava") then
                    world.nodes[key(pos)] = nil
                    if n.visual then n.visual.model:Destroy() end
                    fluids.changed(pos)
                end
                return
            end
            if n and n.id == fluid then
                if n.state.level ~= tostring(level) then n.state.level = tostring(level); rebuild(n); fluids.changed(pos) end
                return
            end
            if n and fluidOf(n) == fluid then return end -- waterlogged block: already holds it
            if n and n.visual and n.visual.parts[1] then
                -- Washed away like Java (the block drops as an item).
                world.breakBlock({Instance = n.visual.parts[1][1]}, true)
            end
            local entry = JavaContent.byId[fluid]
            if entry then register(entry.index, pos, {level = tostring(level)}) end
            fluids.changed(pos)
        end
        -- LiquidBlock.shouldSpreadLiquid(): lava touching water hardens.
        local function harden(pos)
            local here = cell(pos)
            if here.fluid ~= "lava" or here.static then return false end
            for _, offset in ipairs({UP, DIRS.north, DIRS.south, DIRS.east, DIRS.west}) do
                local other = cell(pos + offset)
                if other.fluid == "water" then
                    world.nodes[key(pos)] = nil
                    if here.node and here.node.visual then here.node.visual.model:Destroy() end
                    local entry = JavaContent.byId[here.source and "obsidian" or "cobblestone"]
                    if entry then register(entry.index, pos) end
                    if effects.emit then for _ = 1, 8 do effects.emit("large_smoke", pos + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * size, Vector3.new(0, size * 0.05, 0), {life = 20, size = 0.3}) end end
                    fluids.changed(pos)
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        -- Can the fluid move from pos into next (FlowingFluid.canPassThrough)?
        local function canPass(fluid, next)
            local c = cell(next)
            if c.solid then return false end
            if c.fluid == fluid and c.source then return false end
            if c.fluid and c.fluid ~= fluid then return true end
            return c.open or c.fluid == fluid
        end
        local function isHole(fluid, pos)
            local below = cell(pos + DOWN)
            if below.solid then return false end
            if below.fluid == fluid then return true end
            return below.open == true or (below.fluid ~= nil)
        end
        local function slopeDistance(fluid, pos, depth, from)
            local best = 1000
            for _, dir in ipairs(HORIZONTAL) do
                if dir ~= from then
                    local next = pos + DIRS[dir]
                    if canPass(fluid, next) then
                        if isHole(fluid, next) then return depth end
                        if depth < PROPS[fluid].slope then
                            best = math.min(best, slopeDistance(fluid, next, depth + 1, OPPOSITE[dir]))
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return best
        end
        local function spreadTo(pos, fluid, level, downward)
            local c = cell(pos)
            if c.static then return end
            if fluid == "lava" and downward and c.fluid == "water" then
                -- LavaFluid.spreadTo(): lava flowing down into water makes stone.
                world.nodes[key(pos)] = nil
                if c.node and c.node.visual then c.node.visual.model:Destroy() end
                local stone = JavaContent.byId.stone
                if stone then register(stone.index, pos) end
                fluids.changed(pos)
                return
            end
            if c.fluid and c.fluid ~= fluid then return end
            if c.fluid == fluid and c.source then return end
            setFluid(pos, fluid, level)
        end
        local function spreadToSides(pos, fluid, here)
            local amount = here.amount - PROPS[fluid].dropOff
            if here.falling then amount = 7 end
            if amount <= 0 then return end
            -- FlowingFluid.getSpread(): only toward the nearest drop within the slope distance.
            local best, chosen = 1000, {}
            for _, dir in ipairs(HORIZONTAL) do
                local next = pos + DIRS[dir]
                if canPass(fluid, next) then
                    local distance = isHole(fluid, next) and 0 or slopeDistance(fluid, next, 1, OPPOSITE[dir])
                    if distance < best then best, chosen = distance, {dir} elseif distance == best then chosen[#chosen + 1] = dir end
                end
            end
            for _, dir in ipairs(chosen) do
                local next = pos + DIRS[dir]
                local level = newLiquid(next, fluid)
                if level then spreadTo(next, fluid, level, false) end
            end
        end
        -- FlowingFluid.tick() then spread().
        local function tickFluid(pos)
            local here = cell(pos)
            if not here.fluid or here.static then return end
            local fluid = here.fluid
            if harden(pos) then return end
            if not here.source then
                local level = newLiquid(pos, fluid)
                if level == nil then setFluid(pos, nil); return end
                local current = tonumber(here.node.state.level) or 0
                if level ~= current then
                    setFluid(pos, fluid, level)
                    local delay = PROPS[fluid].delay
                    if fluid == "lava" and current < 8 and level < 8 and height(level) > height(current) and math.random(4) ~= 1 then delay = delay * 4 end
                    fluids.schedule(pos, delay)
                    here = cell(pos)
                end
            end
            -- The fluid above makes this one render to the top of the block.
            if here.node and (here.node.id == "water" or here.node.id == "lava") then
                local above = cell(pos + UP).fluid == fluid and "true" or "false"
                if here.node.state.fluidAbove ~= above then here.node.state.fluidAbove = above; rebuild(here.node) end
            end
            -- spread(): down first, sideways when this is a source or there is no hole below.
            if canPass(fluid, pos + DOWN) then
                local below = cell(pos + DOWN)
                if not (below.fluid == fluid) then
                    spreadTo(pos + DOWN, fluid, 8, true)
                    local sources = 0
                    for _, dir in ipairs(HORIZONTAL) do local c = cell(pos + DIRS[dir]); if c.fluid == fluid and c.source then sources = sources + 1 end end
                    if sources >= 3 then spreadToSides(pos, fluid, here) end
                    return
                end
            end
            if here.source or not isHole(fluid, pos) then spreadToSides(pos, fluid, here) end
        end
        function fluids.tick()
            local due = {}
            for k, p in pairs(fluids.pending) do if p.due <= world.tickCount then due[#due + 1] = p; fluids.pending[k] = nil end end
            -- At most 400 fluid updates a tick; the rest wait for the next one.
            table.sort(due, function(a, b) return a.due < b.due end)
            for i, p in ipairs(due) do
                if i > 400 then fluids.pending[key(p.pos)] = p else tickFluid(p.pos) end
            end
        end
        -- Placing, breaking and mining next to a fluid wakes it up (neighborChanged).
        local basePlace, baseBreak = world.place, world.breakBlock
        world.place = function(index, center, ...)
            local r = table.pack(basePlace(index, center, ...))
            if r[1] and center then fluids.changed(center) end
            return table.unpack(r, 1, r.n)
        end
        world.breakBlock = function(hit, ...)
            local n = hit and hit.Instance and world.resolve(hit.Instance)
            local center = n and n.center
            local r = table.pack(baseBreak(hit, ...))
            if r[1] and center then fluids.changed(center) end
            return table.unpack(r, 1, r.n)
        end
        local baseCut = worldMining.cut
        if baseCut then
            worldMining.cut = function(hit, center, ...)
                local r = table.pack(baseCut(hit, center, ...))
                if center then task.delay(0.1, function() fluids.changed(center) end) end
                return table.unpack(r, 1, r.n)
            end
        end
        local baseSet = world.setBlockAt
        world.setBlockAt = function(center, ...)
            local r = table.pack(baseSet(center, ...))
            if center then fluids.changed(center) end
            return table.unpack(r, 1, r.n)
        end
        -- Fluids already in the world (restored saves) wake up once.
        for _, n in pairs(world.nodes) do if n.id == "water" or n.id == "lava" then fluids.schedule(n.center, 1) end end
    end
    -- Batch 7d: every interactive item.
    world.items=createItemUses(world,{root=root,character=character,ui=ui,inventory=inventory,effects=effects,screens=world.screens})
    return world
end

-- END CREATIVE WORLD
-- BEGIN CARVE MATH
-- A vertex is {x, y, z, u?, v?, nx?, ny?, nz?}; a triangle is {a, b, c}
-- wound counter-clockwise when seen from outside the solid.
local CARVE_EPS = 1e-6
local NEXT_AXIS = {x = "y", y = "z", z = "x"}
local function carveLerp(a, b, t)
    local out = {x = a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t, y = a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t, z = a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t}
    if a.u and b.u then out.u, out.v = a.u + (b.u - a.u) * t, a.v + (b.v - a.v) * t end
    if a.nx and b.nx then
        out.nx, out.ny, out.nz = a.nx + (b.nx - a.nx) * t, a.ny + (b.ny - a.ny) * t, a.nz + (b.nz - a.nz) * t
    end
    return out
end
-- One knife: keep the side of a convex polygon where (coord - value) * side
-- is positive (strict) or non-negative. Sutherland-Hodgman keeps winding.
local function clipPolygon(polygon, axis, value, side, strict)
    local out, count = {}, #polygon
    for i = 1, count do
        local a, b = polygon[i], polygon[i % count + 1]
        local da, db = (a[axis] - value) * side, (b[axis] - value) * side
        local keepA, keepB
        if strict then keepA, keepB = da > CARVE_EPS, db > CARVE_EPS
        else keepA, keepB = da >= -CARVE_EPS, db >= -CARVE_EPS end
        if keepA then out[#out + 1] = a end
        if keepA ~= keepB then
            local t = da / (da - db)
            out[#out + 1] = carveLerp(a, b, math.max(0, math.min(1, t)))
        end
    end
    return out
end
local function triangleArea(a, b, c)
    local ux, uy, uz = b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y, b.z - a.z
    local vx, vy, vz = c.x - a.x, c.y - a.y, c.z - a.z
    local cx, cy, cz = uy * vz - uz * vy, uz * vx - ux * vz, ux * vy - uy * vx
    return math.sqrt(cx * cx + cy * cy + cz * cz) / 2
end
local function fanInto(polygon, out)
    for i = 2, #polygon - 1 do
        local a, b, c = polygon[1], polygon[i], polygon[i + 1]
        if triangleArea(a, b, c) > 1e-7 then out[#out + 1] = {a, b, c} end
    end
end
-- The six knives of a cell, as (axis, plane, outward side).
local function cellKnives(box)
    return {
        {"x", box.min.x, -1}, {"x", box.max.x, 1},
        {"y", box.min.y, -1}, {"y", box.max.y, 1},
        {"z", box.min.z, -1}, {"z", box.max.z, 1},
    }
end
-- Cut one triangle at a time with the six knives: the piece outside each
-- knife is kept, the piece inside moves on to the next knife, and whatever
-- is left inside the cell after all six is discarded. Surfaces lying on a
-- cell face count as inside, so the cell's own top surface is removed.
local function carveTriangles(triangles, box)
    local kept, knives = {}, cellKnives(box)
    for _, tri in ipairs(triangles) do
        local a, b, c = tri[1], tri[2], tri[3]
        local overlaps = true
        for _, axis in ipairs({"x", "y", "z"}) do
            local low = math.min(a[axis], b[axis], c[axis])
            local high = math.max(a[axis], b[axis], c[axis])
            if high < box.min[axis] - CARVE_EPS or low > box.max[axis] + CARVE_EPS then overlaps = false; break end
        end
        if not overlaps then
            kept[#kept + 1] = tri
        else
            local polygon = {a, b, c}
            for _, knife in ipairs(knives) do
                local outside = clipPolygon(polygon, knife[1], knife[2], knife[3], true)
                if #outside >= 3 then fanInto(outside, kept) end
                polygon = clipPolygon(polygon, knife[1], knife[2], -knife[3], false)
                if #polygon < 3 then break end
            end
        end
    end
    return kept
end
-- Keep only what lies inside a box (used to cut huge meshes into chunks).
local function clipTrianglesToBox(triangles, box)
    local kept, knives = {}, cellKnives(box)
    for _, tri in ipairs(triangles) do
        local polygon = {tri[1], tri[2], tri[3]}
        for _, knife in ipairs(knives) do
            polygon = clipPolygon(polygon, knife[1], knife[2], -knife[3], false)
            if #polygon < 3 then break end
        end
        if #polygon >= 3 then fanInto(polygon, kept) end
    end
    return kept
end
-- The same six knives on an axis-aligned box part: up to six box pieces
-- outside the cell are kept; the inside piece is discarded.
local function boxSubtract(boxMin, boxMax, cellMin, cellMax, minThickness)
    local pieces = {}
    local low = {x = boxMin.x, y = boxMin.y, z = boxMin.z}
    local high = {x = boxMax.x, y = boxMax.y, z = boxMax.z}
    for _, axis in ipairs({"x", "y", "z"}) do
        if low[axis] < cellMin[axis] then
            local pieceHigh = {x = high.x, y = high.y, z = high.z}
            pieceHigh[axis] = math.min(high[axis], cellMin[axis])
            if pieceHigh[axis] - low[axis] > minThickness then
                pieces[#pieces + 1] = {min = {x = low.x, y = low.y, z = low.z}, max = pieceHigh}
            end
            low[axis] = cellMin[axis]
        end
        if high[axis] > cellMax[axis] then
            local pieceLow = {x = low.x, y = low.y, z = low.z}
            pieceLow[axis] = math.max(low[axis], cellMax[axis])
            if high[axis] - pieceLow[axis] > minThickness then
                pieces[#pieces + 1] = {min = pieceLow, max = {x = high.x, y = high.y, z = high.z}}
            end
            high[axis] = cellMax[axis]
        end
        if low[axis] >= high[axis] then break end
    end
    return pieces
end
-- Triangles that a vertical ray through the box column can hit.
local function columnTriangles(triangles, box, margin)
    local out = {}
    for _, tri in ipairs(triangles) do
        local a, b, c = tri[1], tri[2], tri[3]
        if math.max(a.x, b.x, c.x) >= box.min.x - margin and math.min(a.x, b.x, c.x) <= box.max.x + margin
            and math.max(a.z, b.z, c.z) >= box.min.z - margin and math.min(a.z, b.z, c.z) <= box.max.z + margin then
            out[#out + 1] = tri
        end
    end
    return out
end
-- Solid test by upward-ray parity: a point is inside when an odd number of
-- surfaces lie above it. This is ordinary parity for closed meshes, and for
-- an open ground sheet it treats everything under the sheet as ground. The
-- tiny jitter keeps the ray off shared triangle edges.
local function insideSolid(triangles, px, py, pz)
    px, pz = px + 1.37e-4, pz + 2.91e-4
    local count = 0
    for _, tri in ipairs(triangles) do
        local a, b, c = tri[1], tri[2], tri[3]
        local d = (b.z - c.z) * (a.x - c.x) + (c.x - b.x) * (a.z - c.z)
        if math.abs(d) > 1e-12 then
            local l1 = ((b.z - c.z) * (px - c.x) + (c.x - b.x) * (pz - c.z)) / d
            local l2 = ((c.z - a.z) * (px - c.x) + (a.x - c.x) * (pz - c.z)) / d
            local l3 = 1 - l1 - l2
            if l1 >= 0 and l2 >= 0 and l3 >= 0 and l1 * a.y + l2 * b.y + l3 * c.y > py then
                count = count + 1
            end
        end
    end
    return count % 2 == 1
end
-- Hole walls on one cell face: the face square trimmed to where the solid
-- continues just beyond it. The square is split into trapezoids by the
-- solid's surface lines on that plane, and each trapezoid is kept when a
-- point inside it is solid. Returns triangles wound to face into the hole
-- and their total area. With outward = true it instead caps a chunk: it
-- samples just inside the box and faces the triangles out of it.
local function faceWall(triangles, box, axis, side, outward)
    local planeValue = (side > 0 and box.max[axis] or box.min[axis])
    local probe = planeValue + (outward and -side or side) * 1e-3
    local uAxis = NEXT_AXIS[axis]
    local vAxis = NEXT_AXIS[uAxis]
    local u0, u1 = box.min[uAxis], box.max[uAxis]
    local v0, v1 = box.min[vAxis], box.max[vAxis]
    local segments = {}
    for _, tri in ipairs(triangles) do
        local points = {}
        for i = 1, 3 do
            local p, q = tri[i], tri[i % 3 + 1]
            local dp, dq = p[axis] - probe, q[axis] - probe
            if (dp > 0) ~= (dq > 0) then
                local t = dp / (dp - dq)
                points[#points + 1] = {p[uAxis] + (q[uAxis] - p[uAxis]) * t, p[vAxis] + (q[vAxis] - p[vAxis]) * t}
            end
        end
        if #points == 2 then
            local a, b = points[1], points[2]
            if a[1] > b[1] then a, b = b, a end
            if b[1] - a[1] > 1e-9 and b[1] > u0 and a[1] < u1 then
                segments[#segments + 1] = {a[1], a[2], b[1], b[2]}
            elseif b[1] - a[1] <= 1e-9 then
                -- A surface line running straight along v still splits the
                -- face: remember where, so a strip boundary lands on it.
                segments[#segments + 1] = {a[1], math.min(a[2], b[2]), a[1], math.max(a[2], b[2]), vertical = true}
            end
        end
    end
    local cuts = {u0, u1}
    local function addCut(u) if u > u0 and u < u1 then cuts[#cuts + 1] = u end end
    local sloped = {}
    for _, s in ipairs(segments) do
        if s.vertical then addCut(s[1]) else sloped[#sloped + 1] = s end
    end
    segments = sloped
    for _, s in ipairs(segments) do
        addCut(s[1]); addCut(s[3])
        for _, edge in ipairs({v0, v1}) do
            if (s[2] - edge) * (s[4] - edge) < 0 then addCut(s[1] + (s[3] - s[1]) * (edge - s[2]) / (s[4] - s[2])) end
        end
    end
    table.sort(cuts)
    local walls, area = {}, 0
    local function point(u, v)
        local p = {}
        p[axis], p[uAxis], p[vAxis] = planeValue, u, math.max(v0, math.min(v1, v))
        return p
    end
    for i = 1, #cuts - 1 do
        local ua, ub = cuts[i], cuts[i + 1]
        if ub - ua > 1e-6 then
            local um = (ua + ub) / 2
            local lines = {}
            for _, s in ipairs(segments) do
                if s[1] <= ua + 1e-7 and s[3] >= ub - 1e-7 then
                    local slope = (s[4] - s[2]) / (s[3] - s[1])
                    local at = function(u) return s[2] + slope * (u - s[1]) end
                    local vm = at(um)
                    if vm > v0 and vm < v1 then lines[#lines + 1] = {at = at, mid = vm} end
                end
            end
            table.sort(lines, function(p, q) return p.mid < q.mid end)
            table.insert(lines, 1, {at = function() return v0 end, mid = v0})
            lines[#lines + 1] = {at = function() return v1 end, mid = v1}
            for j = 1, #lines - 1 do
                local lo, hi = lines[j], lines[j + 1]
                if hi.mid - lo.mid > 1e-7 then
                    local sample = {}
                    sample[axis], sample[uAxis], sample[vAxis] = probe, um, (lo.mid + hi.mid) / 2
                    if insideSolid(triangles, sample.x, sample.y, sample.z) then
                        -- Counter-clockwise in (u, v) faces +axis; a hole wall
                        -- faces into the cell (-side), a chunk cap out of it.
                        local quad = {point(ua, lo.at(ua)), point(ub, lo.at(ub)), point(ub, hi.at(ub)), point(ua, hi.at(ua))}
                        local facing = outward and side or -side
                        if facing < 0 then quad = {quad[4], quad[3], quad[2], quad[1]} end
                        local before = #walls
                        fanInto(quad, walls)
                        for k = before + 1, #walls do area = area + triangleArea(walls[k][1], walls[k][2], walls[k][3]) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return walls, area
end
-- Convex polygon face wound outward from a convex shape's centre.
local function outwardFace(polygon, center, out)
    local a, b, c = polygon[1], polygon[2], polygon[3]
    local nx = (b.y - a.y) * (c.z - a.z) - (b.z - a.z) * (c.y - a.y)
    local ny = (b.z - a.z) * (c.x - a.x) - (b.x - a.x) * (c.z - a.z)
    local nz = (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - a.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (c.x - a.x)
    local mx, my, mz = 0, 0, 0
    for _, p in ipairs(polygon) do mx, my, mz = mx + p.x, my + p.y, mz + p.z end
    mx, my, mz = mx / #polygon - center.x, my / #polygon - center.y, mz / #polygon - center.z
    if nx * mx + ny * my + nz * mz < 0 then
        local reversed = {}
        for i = #polygon, 1, -1 do reversed[#reversed + 1] = polygon[i] end
        polygon = reversed
    end
    fanInto(polygon, out)
end
-- Signed volume (divergence theorem): positive for a closed mesh wound
-- counter-clockwise outward, negative when its winding is reversed.
local function signedVolume(triangles)
    local volume = 0
    for _, tri in ipairs(triangles) do
        local a, b, c = tri[1], tri[2], tri[3]
        volume = volume + (a.x * (b.y * c.z - b.z * c.y) - a.y * (b.x * c.z - b.z * c.x) + a.z * (b.x * c.y - b.y * c.x)) / 6
    end
    return volume
end
local function v3(x, y, z) return {x = x, y = y, z = z} end
-- Roblox part shapes as closed triangle meshes in part space (size sx, sy, sz).
local function shapeTriangles(shape, sx, sy, sz)
    local hx, hy, hz = sx / 2, sy / 2, sz / 2
    local out, center = {}, v3(0, 0, 0)
    if shape == "Block" then
        local c = {}
        for i = 0, 7 do c[i] = v3(i % 2 == 0 and -hx or hx, math.floor(i / 2) % 2 == 0 and -hy or hy, i < 4 and -hz or hz) end
        for _, f in ipairs({{0, 2, 3, 1}, {4, 5, 7, 6}, {0, 1, 5, 4}, {2, 6, 7, 3}, {0, 4, 6, 2}, {1, 3, 7, 5}}) do
            outwardFace({c[f[1]], c[f[2]], c[f[3]], c[f[4]]}, center, out)
        end
    elseif shape == "Wedge" then
        -- Roblox wedges rise from the front-bottom edge (-Z) to the back-top edge (+Z).
        local b1, b2, b3, b4 = v3(-hx, -hy, -hz), v3(hx, -hy, -hz), v3(hx, -hy, hz), v3(-hx, -hy, hz)
        local t1, t2 = v3(-hx, hy, hz), v3(hx, hy, hz)
        local mid = v3(0, -hy / 3, hz / 3)
        for _, f in ipairs({{b1, b2, b3, b4}, {b4, b3, t2, t1}, {b1, t1, t2, b2}, {b1, b4, t1}, {b2, t2, b3}}) do
            outwardFace(f, mid, out)
        end
    elseif shape == "Cylinder" then
        -- Roblox cylinders run along X with radius min(Y, Z) / 2.
        local r, segments = math.min(sy, sz) / 2, 24
        local left, right = {}, {}
        for i = 1, segments do
            local angle = (i - 1) / segments * math.pi * 2
            left[i] = v3(-hx, math.cos(angle) * r, math.sin(angle) * r)
            right[i] = v3(hx, math.cos(angle) * r, math.sin(angle) * r)
        end
        outwardFace(left, center, out); outwardFace(right, center, out)
        for i = 1, segments do
            local j = i % segments + 1
            outwardFace({left[i], left[j], right[j], right[i]}, center, out)
        end
    elseif shape == "Ball" then
        local r, rings, segments = math.min(sx, sy, sz) / 2, 10, 20
        local function at(ring, seg)
            local theta, phi = ring / rings * math.pi, seg / segments * math.pi * 2
            return v3(math.sin(theta) * math.cos(phi) * r, math.cos(theta) * r, math.sin(theta) * math.sin(phi) * r)
        end
        for ring = 0, rings - 1 do
            for seg = 0, segments - 1 do
                local a, b, c, d = at(ring, seg), at(ring, seg + 1), at(ring + 1, seg + 1), at(ring + 1, seg)
                if ring == 0 then outwardFace({a, c, d}, center, out)
                elseif ring == rings - 1 then outwardFace({a, b, c}, center, out)
                else outwardFace({a, b, c, d}, center, out) end
            end
        end
    end
    return out
end

-- END CARVE MATH
-- BEGIN WORLD MINING
-- Embedded in SteveCommandBar.lua; this source fragment is not run separately.
-- World-space triangles of meshes this session carved or built, so a later cut
-- never has to read an EditableMesh-backed part back from the engine.
local carvedTriangles = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local sourceKeys = 0
local function createWorldMining(character, cancelled)
    local size, half = CONFIG.Block, CONFIG.Block / 2
    local geometry = game:GetService("GeometryService")
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("SteveExcavation")
    if not folder then
        folder = Instance.new("Folder")
        folder.Name, folder.Parent = "SteveExcavation", workspace
    end
    local mined = folder:FindFirstChild("MinedCells")
    if not mined then
        mined = Instance.new("Folder")
        mined.Name, mined.Parent = "MinedCells", folder
    end
    local system = {busy = false, message = "", retryAt = 0}
    local function box(center, extent)
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Anchored, p.Size, p.CFrame = true, extent, CFrame.new(center)
        return p
    end
    local function aabb(p)
        local c, s, cf = p.Position, p.Size / 2, p.CFrame
        local r, u, l = cf.RightVector, cf.UpVector, cf.LookVector
        local e = Vector3.new(math.abs(r.X)*s.X + math.abs(u.X)*s.Y + math.abs(l.X)*s.Z,
            math.abs(r.Y)*s.X + math.abs(u.Y)*s.Y + math.abs(l.Y)*s.Z,
            math.abs(r.Z)*s.X + math.abs(u.Z)*s.Y + math.abs(l.Z)*s.Z)
        return {c.X-e.X, c.Y-e.Y, c.Z-e.Z, c.X+e.X, c.Y+e.Y, c.Z+e.Z}
    end
    local function fromBounds(b)
        return box(Vector3.new((b[1]+b[4])/2, (b[2]+b[5])/2, (b[3]+b[6])/2),
            Vector3.new(b[4]-b[1], b[5]-b[2], b[6]-b[3]))
    end
    local function axisBox(p)
        return p:IsA("Part") and p.Shape == Enum.PartType.Block and not p:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
            and math.abs(p.CFrame.RightVector.X) > 0.999999
            and math.abs(p.CFrame.UpVector.Y) > 0.999999
    end
    function system.mineable(p)
        if p == workspace.Terrain then return workspace:GetAttribute('MinecraftTerrainMineable')~=false end
        if not p or not p:IsA('BasePart') or not p.CanQuery or p:IsDescendantOf(character) or p:GetAttribute('SteveCutFace') then return false end
        -- The Verity Script's Verity (and anything marked SteveEntity) is a mob, not a block.
        local verityBridge = rawget(_G, "VerityBridge")
        if type(verityBridge) == "table" and type(verityBridge.model) == "function" then
            local okV, verityModel = pcall(verityBridge.model)
            if okV and typeof(verityModel) == "Instance" and p:IsDescendantOf(verityModel) then return false end
        end
        local allowed=p:GetAttribute('MinecraftBlockId')~=nil or p:GetAttribute('SteveVoxel') or CollectionService:HasTag(p,'MinecraftBlock')
        local insideModel=false;local ancestor=p
        while ancestor and ancestor~=workspace do
            if ancestor:GetAttribute('MinecraftUnbreakable') or ancestor:GetAttribute('MinecraftMineable')==false or ancestor:GetAttribute('SteveEntity') then return false end
            if ancestor:IsA('Tool') or ancestor:IsA('Accessory') then return false end
            if ancestor:IsA('Model') then
                insideModel=true
                if ancestor:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') then return false end
            end
            if ancestor:GetAttribute('MinecraftMineable')==true or ancestor:GetAttribute('MinecraftBlockId')~=nil or CollectionService:HasTag(ancestor,'MinecraftBlock') then allowed=true end
            ancestor=ancestor.Parent
        end
        -- (any anchored map part can be mined, also inside Models: trees, houses, round shapes)
        if not p.Anchored and not allowed then return false end
        return not not (allowed or p.Transparency<1)
    end
    local function cellKey(p)
        return string.format("%.3f,%.3f,%.3f", p.X, p.Y, p.Z)
    end
    function system.cell(hit)
        local p = hit.Instance
        local cell=p:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter")
        if typeof(cell)=="Vector3" then return cell end
        do
            local a=p.Parent
            for _=1,4 do
                if not a or a==workspace then break end
                local c=a:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter")
                if typeof(c)=="Vector3" then return c end
                a=a.Parent
            end
        end
        if p:GetAttribute("SteveVoxel") or (CollectionService:HasTag(p, "MinecraftBlock")
            and (p.Size - Vector3.new(size,size,size)).Magnitude < 0.001) then
            return p.Position
        end
        local origin = workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin")
        if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" then origin = Vector3.new(0, half, 0) end
        local v = hit.Position - hit.Normal * 0.006
        return Vector3.new(snapGrid(v.X, origin.X, size), snapGrid(v.Y, origin.Y, size), snapGrid(v.Z, origin.Z, size))
    end
    function system.kind(hit, center)
        if JavaContent and JavaContent.data then return JavaContent.classify(hit) end
        local explicit=hit.Instance:GetAttribute("MinecraftBlockType")
        return blockStats[explicit] and explicit or "Stone"
    end
    local function applyKind(p, kind)
        p:SetAttribute("MinecraftBlockType", kind)
        local stats = blockStats[kind] or blockStats.Stone
        p:SetAttribute("MinecraftHardness", stats.hardness)
        p:SetAttribute("MinecraftHarvestable", stats.harvestable)
        p.Material = kind == "Stone" and Enum.Material.Slate or kind == "Wood Planks" and Enum.Material.WoodPlanks or Enum.Material.Ground
        p.Color = kind == "Stone" and Color3.fromRGB(120,120,120) or kind == "Wood Planks" and Color3.fromRGB(162,130,79) or Color3.fromRGB(120,85,55)
        for i, name in ipairs(blockNames) do if name == kind then texture(p, blockTextures[i]); break end end
    end
    local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
    overlap.FilterType, overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, {character}
    -- Terrain is smooth geometry, not its 4-stud voxel grid. Rays between the
    -- cube centre and points 90% of the way to its faces and corners only hit
    -- Terrain that really intrudes, so a cube resting on, or dug into, the
    -- ground is not rejected because a neighbouring voxel is partly filled.
    local terrainRays, terrainProbes
    local function terrainIntrudes(center)
        if not terrainRays then
            terrainRays = RaycastParams.new()
            terrainRays.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
            terrainRays.FilterDescendantsInstances, terrainRays.IgnoreWater = {workspace.Terrain}, true
            terrainProbes = {Vector3.new(1,0,0), Vector3.new(-1,0,0), Vector3.new(0,1,0),
                Vector3.new(0,-1,0), Vector3.new(0,0,1), Vector3.new(0,0,-1)}
            for x = -1, 1, 2 do for y = -1, 1, 2 do for z = -1, 1, 2 do
                terrainProbes[#terrainProbes+1] = Vector3.new(x, y, z)
            end end end
        end
        for _, direction in ipairs(terrainProbes) do
            local point = center + direction * (half * 0.9)
            if workspace:Raycast(center, point - center, terrainRays) or workspace:Raycast(point, center - point, terrainRays) then
                return true
            end
        end
        -- A cube buried in solid Terrain has no surface between those points.
        local e = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
        local materials, occupancy = workspace.Terrain:ReadVoxels(Region3.new(center-e, center+e):ExpandToGrid(4), 4)
        local material = materials[1] and materials[1][1] and materials[1][1][1]
        local value = occupancy[1] and occupancy[1][1] and occupancy[1][1][1]
        return value ~= nil and value >= 0.99 and material ~= Enum.Material.Water and material ~= Enum.Material.Air
    end
    -- Exact geometry overlap avoids bounding-box rejection around cutouts and
    -- slopes. The 0.06-stud inset per side tolerates CSG collision hulls that
    -- bulge slightly into a dug cell, and blocks touching the cell's faces.
    local occupiedProbe
    function system.occupied(center, skipTerrain)
        if not occupiedProbe or not occupiedProbe.Parent then
            occupiedProbe = box(center, Vector3.new(size-0.12,size-0.12,size-0.12))
            occupiedProbe.Name = "SteveOccupiedProbe"
            occupiedProbe.CanCollide, occupiedProbe.CanQuery, occupiedProbe.CanTouch, occupiedProbe.Transparency = false, false, false, 1
            occupiedProbe.Parent = folder
        end
        local probe = occupiedProbe
        probe.CFrame = CFrame.new(center)
        local solid = OverlapParams.new()
        solid.FilterType, solid.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, {character, probe}
        solid.RespectCanCollide = true
        local success, parts = pcall(function() return workspace:GetPartsInPart(probe, solid) end)
        if not success then return true end
        if #parts > 0 then return true end
        -- The placement sweep has already measured Terrain at its final position.
        if skipTerrain then return false end
        return terrainIntrudes(center)
    end
    local function inherit(source, p)
        p.Name = source.Name
        p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch, p.CanQuery = source.Anchored, source.CanCollide, source.CanTouch, source.CanQuery
        p.Material, p.MaterialVariant, p.Color, p.Transparency = source.Material, source.MaterialVariant, source.Color, source.Transparency
        p.CollisionGroup, p.CustomPhysicalProperties = source.CollisionGroup, source.CustomPhysicalProperties
        for k,v in pairs(source:GetAttributes()) do p:SetAttribute(k,v) end
        p:SetAttribute("SteveVoxel", nil)
        p:SetAttribute("MinecraftBreakProgress", nil)
        for _, tag in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTags(source)) do
            if tag ~= "MinecraftBlock" then CollectionService:AddTag(p, tag) end
        end
        for _, child in ipairs(source:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") or child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then child:Clone().Parent = p end
        end
    end
    -- Triangle fallback for geometry Roblox CSG rejects, typically open
    -- (non-manifold) meshes such as single-sided ground sheets: read the
    -- triangles, run the six knives over them (CARVE MATH), rebuild the
    -- kept surface plus trimmed hole walls as an EditableMesh MeshPart.
    local function editableAssets()
        local assets = game:GetService("AssetService")
        if not assets or not Content or not assets.CreateEditableMesh or not assets.CreateMeshPartAsync then
            error("EditableMesh is not available in this session")
        end
        return assets
    end
    local function worldTriangles(source)
        local cached = carvedTriangles[source]
        if cached then return cached end
        local frame, tris = source.CFrame, {}
        if source:IsA("MeshPart") then
            local assets = editableAssets()
            local ok, mesh = pcall(function() return assets:CreateEditableMeshAsync(source.MeshContent) end)
            if not ok or not mesh then
                ok, mesh = pcall(function() return assets:CreateEditableMeshAsync(Content.fromUri(source.MeshId)) end)
            end
            if not ok or not mesh then error("cannot read this mesh's triangles: " .. tostring(mesh)) end
            local low, high
            for _, v in ipairs(mesh:GetVertices()) do
                local p = mesh:GetPosition(v)
                low, high = low and low:Min(p) or p, high and high:Max(p) or p
            end
            if not low then mesh:Destroy(); error("mesh has no vertices") end
            -- Roblox centres a mesh's bounds on the part and stretches them to Size.
            local middle, extent = (low + high) / 2, high - low
            local scale = Vector3.new(extent.X > 1e-6 and source.Size.X / extent.X or 1,
                extent.Y > 1e-6 and source.Size.Y / extent.Y or 1, extent.Z > 1e-6 and source.Size.Z / extent.Z or 1)
            for _, face in ipairs(mesh:GetFaces()) do
                local ids = mesh:GetFaceVertices(face)
                local okUV, uvs = pcall(mesh.GetFaceUVs, mesh, face)
                local okNormal, normals = pcall(mesh.GetFaceNormals, mesh, face)
                local tri = {}
                for i = 1, 3 do
                    local w = frame:PointToWorldSpace((mesh:GetPosition(ids[i]) - middle) * scale)
                    local vertex = {x = w.X, y = w.Y, z = w.Z}
                    if okUV and uvs and uvs[i] then local uv = mesh:GetUV(uvs[i]); vertex.u, vertex.v = uv.X, uv.Y end
                    if okNormal and normals and normals[i] then
                        local n = frame:VectorToWorldSpace(mesh:GetNormal(normals[i]) / scale)
                        if n.Magnitude > 1e-6 then n = n.Unit; vertex.nx, vertex.ny, vertex.nz = n.X, n.Y, n.Z end
                    end
                    tri[i] = vertex
                end
                tris[#tris+1] = tri
            end
            mesh:Destroy()
        elseif source:IsA("BasePart") and (source:IsA("WedgePart") or source:IsA("Part")) then
            local shape = source:IsA("WedgePart") and "Wedge" or source.Shape.Name
            tris = shapeTriangles(shape, source.Size.X, source.Size.Y, source.Size.Z)
            if #tris == 0 then error(shape .. " parts can only be cut by Roblox CSG") end
            for i, tri in ipairs(tris) do
                local out = {}
                for j = 1, 3 do
                    local w = frame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(tri[j].x, tri[j].y, tri[j].z))
                    out[j] = {x = w.X, y = w.Y, z = w.Z}
                end
                tris[i] = out
            end
        else
            error(source.ClassName .. " geometry can only be cut by Roblox CSG")
        end
        return tris
    end
    local function buildMesh(tris, fidelity)
        local assets = editableAssets()
        local mesh = assets:CreateEditableMesh()
        local lx, ly, lz, hx, hy, hz = math.huge, math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
        local textured = false
        for _, tri in ipairs(tris) do for i = 1, 3 do
            local p = tri[i]
            lx, ly, lz = math.min(lx, p.x), math.min(ly, p.y), math.min(lz, p.z)
            hx, hy, hz = math.max(hx, p.x), math.max(hy, p.y), math.max(hz, p.z)
            textured = textured or p.u ~= nil
        end end
        local cx, cy, cz = (lx + hx) / 2, (ly + hy) / 2, (lz + hz) / 2
        local ids = {}
        local function vertex(p)
            local key = string.format("%.4f,%.4f,%.4f", p.x, p.y, p.z)
            if not ids[key] then ids[key] = mesh:AddVertex(Vector3.new(p.x - cx, p.y - cy, p.z - cz)) end
            return ids[key]
        end
        for _, tri in ipairs(tris) do
            local a, b, c = vertex(tri[1]), vertex(tri[2]), vertex(tri[3])
            if a ~= b and b ~= c and a ~= c then
                local face = mesh:AddTriangle(a, b, c)
                if textured then
                    mesh:SetFaceUVs(face, {mesh:AddUV(Vector2.new(tri[1].u or 0, tri[1].v or 0)),
                        mesh:AddUV(Vector2.new(tri[2].u or 0, tri[2].v or 0)), mesh:AddUV(Vector2.new(tri[3].u or 0, tri[3].v or 0))})
                end
                local p, q, r = tri[1], tri[2], tri[3]
                local flat = Vector3.new(q.x-p.x, q.y-p.y, q.z-p.z):Cross(Vector3.new(r.x-p.x, r.y-p.y, r.z-p.z))
                flat = flat.Magnitude > 1e-9 and flat.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
                local normals = {}
                for i = 1, 3 do
                    local t = tri[i]
                    local n = t.nx and Vector3.new(t.nx, t.ny, t.nz) or flat
                    normals[i] = mesh:AddNormal(n.Magnitude > 1e-6 and n.Unit or flat)
                end
                mesh:SetFaceNormals(face, normals)
            end
        end
        local ok, part = pcall(function()
            return assets:CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromObject(mesh), {CollisionFidelity = fidelity})
        end)
        if not ok then mesh:Destroy(); error("could not build the carved mesh: " .. tostring(part)) end
        part.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(hx - lx, 0.001), math.max(hy - ly, 0.001), math.max(hz - lz, 0.001))
        part.CFrame, part.Anchored = CFrame.new(cx, cy, cz), true
        -- The MeshPart renders the live EditableMesh; release it with the part.
        part.Destroying:Connect(function() mesh:Destroy() end)
        return part
    end
    local function triangleCut(source, cube, kind, keep)
        local tris = worldTriangles(source)
        -- An old wall face sits just inside its own hole, i.e. just outside
        -- this cell when the neighbour opens; grow the knives to reach it.
        -- Grow only across the face, so faces on the other walls keep their edges.
        local isFace = source:GetAttribute("SteveCutFace")
        local faceAxis = isFace and source:GetAttribute("SteveCutAxis")
        local cell = {min = {x = cube[1], y = cube[2], z = cube[3]}, max = {x = cube[4], y = cube[5], z = cube[6]}}
        if faceAxis then cell.min[faceAxis], cell.max[faceAxis] = cell.min[faceAxis] - 0.02, cell.max[faceAxis] + 0.02 end
        local kept = carveTriangles(tris, cell)
        local walls = {}
        if not isFace then
            local column = columnTriangles(tris, cell, 0.01)
            for _, axis in ipairs({"x", "y", "z"}) do for _, side in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
                local wall, area = faceWall(column, cell, axis, side)
                for _, tri in ipairs(wall) do kept[#kept+1] = tri end
                if area > 1e-4 then walls[#walls+1] = {axis = axis, side = side, tris = wall} end
            end end
        end
        if #kept > 0 then
            local fragment = buildMesh(kept, Enum.CollisionFidelity.PreciseConvexDecomposition)
            inherit(source, fragment)
            if source:IsA("MeshPart") then pcall(function() fragment.TextureID = source.TextureID end) end
            carvedTriangles[fragment] = kept
            keep(fragment)
        end
        -- Each hole wall gets a block-textured, double-sided face just inside
        -- the hole, trimmed to the same outline as the carved surface.
        for _, wall in ipairs(walls) do
            local inward = -wall.side
            local faceTris = {}
            for _, tri in ipairs(wall.tris) do
                for _, depth in ipairs({0.010, 0.008}) do
                    local moved = {}
                    for i = 1, 3 do
                        local p = {x = tri[i].x, y = tri[i].y, z = tri[i].z}
                        p[wall.axis] = p[wall.axis] + inward * depth
                        moved[i] = p
                    end
                    if depth < 0.01 then moved = {moved[3], moved[2], moved[1]} end
                    faceTris[#faceTris+1] = moved
                end
            end
            local face = buildMesh(faceTris, Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box)
            carvedTriangles[face] = faceTris
            applyKind(face, kind)
            face.Name, face.CanCollide, face.CanTouch, face.CanQuery = "SteveCutFace", false, false, false
            face:SetAttribute("SteveCutFace", true)
            face:SetAttribute("SteveCutAxis", wall.axis)
            keep(face)
        end
    end
    -- Samples a map cell's actual collision geometry; no whole-part deletion fallback.
    local blastProbe
    local sampleQuick=OverlapParams.new()
    sampleQuick.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local sampleCache,sampleCacheAt={},0
    function system.clearSampleCache() table.clear(sampleCache) end
    local sampleRaw
    function system.sample(center)
        if cancelled() then return end
        local now=os.clock()
        if now-sampleCacheAt>2 then table.clear(sampleCache);sampleCacheAt=now end
        local k=math.floor(center.X*4+.5)..','..math.floor(center.Y*4+.5)..','..math.floor(center.Z*4+.5)
        local hit=sampleCache[k]
        if hit~=nil then return hit or nil end
        local res=sampleRaw(center)
        sampleCache[k]=res or false
        return res
    end
    sampleRaw=function(center)
        sampleQuick.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}
        local candidate=false
        -- A part fills a cell only if it reaches the middle half of it: a floor poking 0.02 studs into the
        -- cell above (the Roblox baseplate does) is not a stone block that soaks up explosions.
        for _,p in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(center),Vector3.new(size,size,size)*.5,sampleQuick)) do
            if p:GetAttribute('MinecraftUnbreakable') or system.mineable(p) then candidate=true;break end
        end
        if candidate then
        if not blastProbe then
            blastProbe=box(center,Vector3.new(size,size,size)*.5)
            blastProbe.Name='SteveCellProbe';blastProbe.Transparency=1
            blastProbe.CanCollide,blastProbe.CanTouch,blastProbe.CanQuery=false,false,false
        end
        blastProbe.CFrame=CFrame.new(center)
        if blastProbe.Parent~=folder then blastProbe.Parent=folder end
        local params=OverlapParams.new();params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;params.FilterDescendantsInstances={character,blastProbe}
        local ok,parts=pcall(function()return workspace:GetPartsInPart(blastProbe,params)end)
        if not ok then return {id='unknown',resistance=3600000,unbreakable=true,center=center} end
        for _,p in ipairs(parts) do
            if p:GetAttribute('MinecraftUnbreakable') or system.mineable(p) then
                local hit={Instance=p,Material=p.Material,Position=center,Normal=Vector3.new(0,1,0)}
                local name=system.kind(hit,center);local e=JavaContent.byName[name]
                return {id=e and e.id or 'stone',index=e and e.index,center=center,hit=hit,
                    resistance=tonumber(p:GetAttribute('MinecraftBlastResistance')) or (e and e.resistance) or 6,
                    unbreakable=p:GetAttribute('MinecraftUnbreakable') or (e and e.hardness and e.hardness<0)}
            end
        end
        end
        local mats,occ=workspace.Terrain:ReadVoxels(Region3.new(center-Vector3.new(.01,.01,.01),center+Vector3.new(.01,.01,.01)):ExpandToGrid(4),4)
        if occ[1] and occ[1][1] and occ[1][1][1]>.5 then
            local material=mats[1][1][1];local hit={Instance=workspace.Terrain,Material=material,Position=center,Normal=Vector3.new(0,1,0)}
            local name=system.kind(hit,center);local e=JavaContent.byName[name]
            return {id=e and e.id or 'stone',index=e and e.index,center=center,hit=hit,resistance=e and e.resistance or 6}
        end
    end

    -- Map mining (cells of the game's own geometry), done in the same frame:
    --  * block-shaped parts aligned to the grid (any 90-degree turn) are rebuilt as the up-to-six
    --    boxes around the mined cell (sixSlabs), keeping their look, attributes and textures;
    --  * other small shapes (wedges, balls, cylinders, meshes, unions) become Minecraft blocks of
    --    their kind in every cell they fill, minus the mined one;
    --  * Terrain voxels around the cell are emptied and their solid cells become blocks too;
    --  * only very large non-box meshes still use the CSG cut (legacyCut).
    local function gridAligned(p)
        if not (p:IsA("Part") and p.Shape == Enum.PartType.Block) or p:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") then return false end
        local cf = p.CFrame
        for _, v in ipairs({cf.RightVector, cf.UpVector}) do
            local m = math.max(math.abs(v.X), math.abs(v.Y), math.abs(v.Z))
            if m < 0.99999 then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
