    local function localSize(cf, ext)
        local r, u, l = cf.RightVector, cf.UpVector, cf.LookVector
        return Vector3.new(math.abs(r.X) * ext.X + math.abs(r.Y) * ext.Y + math.abs(r.Z) * ext.Z,
            math.abs(u.X) * ext.X + math.abs(u.Y) * ext.Y + math.abs(u.Z) * ext.Z,
            math.abs(l.X) * ext.X + math.abs(l.Y) * ext.Y + math.abs(l.Z) * ext.Z)
    end
    local function piece(source, bounds)
        local p = source:Clone()
        for _, child in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
            if not (child:IsA("Texture") or child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")) then child:Destroy() end
        end
        local c = Vector3.new((bounds[1] + bounds[4]) / 2, (bounds[2] + bounds[5]) / 2, (bounds[3] + bounds[6]) / 2)
        local ext = Vector3.new(bounds[4] - bounds[1], bounds[5] - bounds[2], bounds[6] - bounds[3])
        p.Size = localSize(source.CFrame, ext)
        p.CFrame = CFrame.new(c) * source.CFrame.Rotation
        p:SetAttribute("MinecraftBreakProgress", nil)
        return p
    end
    local function gridOrigin()
        local origin = workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin")
        return typeof(origin) == "Vector3" and origin or Vector3.new(0, half, 0)
    end
    -- Every grid cell centre inside the bounds (low..high), at most limit of them.
    local function cellsIn(b, limit)
        local o = gridOrigin()
        local function first(lo, oo) return oo + math.ceil((lo - oo - half + 1e-4) / size) * size end
        local out = {}
        local x0, y0, z0 = first(b[1], o.X), first(b[2], o.Y), first(b[3], o.Z)
        local count = math.max(0, math.floor((b[4] - x0 + half) / size) + 1) * math.max(0, math.floor((b[5] - y0 + half) / size) + 1) * math.max(0, math.floor((b[6] - z0 + half) / size) + 1)
        if count > limit then return nil end
        local x = x0
        while x - half < b[4] - 1e-4 do
            local y = y0
            while y - half < b[5] - 1e-4 do
                local z = z0
                while z - half < b[6] - 1e-4 do out[#out + 1] = Vector3.new(x, y, z); z = z + size end
                y = y + size
            end
            x = x + size
        end
        return out
    end
    local function placeAt(c, kind)
        if system.placeBlock then pcall(system.placeBlock, c, kind) end
    end
    local function fills(source, c)
        local probe = box(c, Vector3.new(size, size, size) * 0.55)
        probe.CanCollide, probe.CanQuery, probe.Transparency, probe.Parent = false, false, 1, folder
        local params = OverlapParams.new()
        params.FilterType, params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include, {source}
        local ok, parts = pcall(function() return workspace:GetPartsInPart(probe, params) end)
        probe:Destroy()
        return ok and #parts > 0
    end
    local function same(a, b) return (a - b).Magnitude < 0.01 end
    local holeFaces = {}
    local HOLE_DIRS = {Vector3.xAxis, -Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.yAxis, -Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.zAxis, -Vector3.zAxis}
    local function holeKey(c) return string.format("%d,%d,%d", math.floor(c.X / size * 2 + 0.5), math.floor(c.Y / size * 2 + 0.5), math.floor(c.Z / size * 2 + 0.5)) end
    local function mapPartAt(c)
        local params = OverlapParams.new()
        params.FilterType, params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, {character}
        local ok, parts = pcall(function() return workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(c), Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3), params) end)
        if not ok then return nil end
        for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency < 0.9 and p.CanCollide and not p:GetAttribute("SteveVoxel") and not p:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter")
                and not p:GetAttribute("SteveCutFace") and not p:GetAttribute("SteveHoleFace") and system.mineable(p) then
                return p
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    -- the faces of the solid map cells around a mined cell
    function system.holeFaces(center)
        local own = holeFaces[holeKey(center)]
        if own then for _, f in ipairs(own) do f:Destroy() end; holeFaces[holeKey(center)] = nil end
        if not (JavaContent and JavaContent.data and JavaContent.paint) then return end
        for _, d in ipairs(HOLE_DIRS) do
            local n = center + d * size
            local part = mapPartAt(center + d * (half + 0.2))
            if part then
                local name = system.kind({Instance = part, Material = part.Material, Position = n, Normal = -d}, n)
                local e = JavaContent.byName[name]
                if not e or e.itemOnly or not e.index then
                    -- a name that matched an item (a part called "...Map"): the part's material decides
                    local okC, id = pcall(CreativeRules.classify, {}, part.Material.Name, JavaContent.known, {})
                    e = okC and JavaContent.byId[id] or JavaContent.byId.stone
                end
                if e and (e.id == "grass_block" or e.id == "mycelium" or e.id == "podzol") and (mapPartAt(n + Vector3.yAxis * size) or mined:FindFirstChild(cellKey(n + Vector3.yAxis * size))) then e = JavaContent.byId.dirt end
                if e and e.index then
                    -- the face only covers where the map is solid behind it (a floor whose top is off the grid is not a
                    -- whole block): clipped to the map parts on the other side, its texture cropped to match
                    local plane = center + d * half
                    local ax = {d.X ~= 0, d.Y ~= 0, d.Z ~= 0}
                    local lo = {center.X - half, center.Y - half, center.Z - half}
                    local hi = {center.X + half, center.Y + half, center.Z + half}
                    local params = OverlapParams.new()
                    params.FilterType, params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, {character}
                    local probeSize = Vector3.new(ax[1] and 0.1 or size - 0.02, ax[2] and 0.1 or size - 0.02, ax[3] and 0.1 or size - 0.02)
                    local okP, near = pcall(function() return workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(plane + d * 0.06), probeSize, params) end)
                    local u0, u1 = {math.huge, math.huge, math.huge}, {-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge}
                    for _, q in ipairs(okP and near or {}) do
                        if q:IsA("BasePart") and q.Transparency < 0.9 and q.CanCollide and not q:GetAttribute("SteveVoxel") and not q:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter")
                            and not q:GetAttribute("SteveCutFace") and not q:GetAttribute("SteveHoleFace") and system.mineable(q) then
                            local cf, sz = q.CFrame, q.Size
                            pcall(function() cf, sz = q.ExtentsCFrame, q.ExtentsSize end)
                            local r, hs = cf.Rotation, sz / 2
                            local ext = {
                                math.abs(r.XVector.X) * hs.X + math.abs(r.YVector.X) * hs.Y + math.abs(r.ZVector.X) * hs.Z,
                                math.abs(r.XVector.Y) * hs.X + math.abs(r.YVector.Y) * hs.Y + math.abs(r.ZVector.Y) * hs.Z,
                                math.abs(r.XVector.Z) * hs.X + math.abs(r.YVector.Z) * hs.Y + math.abs(r.ZVector.Z) * hs.Z}
                            local pc = {cf.Position.X, cf.Position.Y, cf.Position.Z}
                            for i = 1, 3 do
                                u0[i] = math.min(u0[i], pc[i] - ext[i]); u1[i] = math.max(u1[i], pc[i] + ext[i])
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    local c0, c1 = {}, {}
                    local empty = u0[1] == math.huge
                    for i = 1, 3 do
                        c0[i], c1[i] = math.max(lo[i], u0[i]), math.min(hi[i], u1[i])
                        if not ax[i] and c1[i] - c0[i] < 0.02 then empty = true end
                    end
                    if not empty then
                        local pv = {plane.X, plane.Y, plane.Z}
                        local mid, sz = {}, {}
                        for i = 1, 3 do
                            if ax[i] then mid[i], sz[i] = pv[i] - (d.X + d.Y + d.Z) * 0.011, 0.02
                            else mid[i], sz[i] = (c0[i] + c1[i]) / 2, c1[i] - c0[i] end
                        end
                        local face = Instance.new("Part")
                        face.Name = "SteveHoleFace"
                        face.Anchored, face.CanCollide, face.CanTouch, face.CanQuery, face.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
                        face.Size = Vector3.new(sz[1], sz[2], sz[3])
                        face.CFrame = CFrame.new(mid[1], mid[2], mid[3])
                        face.Color, face.Material = part.Color, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                        face:SetAttribute("SteveHoleFace", true)
                        -- the side of the neighbouring block that looks into the hole
                        local NAME = {[1] = {"east", "west"}, [2] = {"up", "down"}, [3] = {"south", "north"}}
                        local NID = {east = Enum.NormalId.Right, west = Enum.NormalId.Left, up = Enum.NormalId.Top, down = Enum.NormalId.Bottom, south = Enum.NormalId.Back, north = Enum.NormalId.Front}
                        local axis = ax[1] and 1 or ax[2] and 2 or 3
                        local sign = d.X + d.Y + d.Z
                        local faceName = NAME[axis][sign > 0 and 2 or 1]
                        local okM = pcall(function()
                            local specs = CreativeRules.modelSpecs(e, e.state)
                            local model = JavaContent.data.models[specs[1] and specs[1].m or e.itemModel]
                            local el = model and model.e[1]
                            local f = el and (el.f[faceName] or el.f.north)
                            if not f then error("no face") end
                            local uv = f[2] or {0, 0, 16, 16}
                            -- fractions of the cell that the face covers, along the texture's u (gui right) and v (down)
                            local function frac(i, a, flip) local t = (a - lo[i]) / size; return flip and 1 - t or t end
                            local fu0, fu1, fv0, fv1
                            if axis == 2 then
                                fu0, fu1, fv0, fv1 = frac(1, c0[1]), frac(1, c1[1]), frac(3, c0[3]), frac(3, c1[3])
                            else
                                local h = axis == 1 and 3 or 1
                                -- SurfaceGui right: Right -Z, Left +Z, Front -X, Back +X
                                local flip = (faceName == "east") or (faceName == "north")
                                fu0, fu1 = frac(h, c0[h], flip), frac(h, c1[h], flip)
                                fv0, fv1 = frac(2, c1[2], true), frac(2, c0[2], true)
                            end
                            if fu0 > fu1 then fu0, fu1 = fu1, fu0 end
                            if fv0 > fv1 then fv0, fv1 = fv1, fv0 end
                            local crop = {uv[1] + (uv[3] - uv[1]) * fu0, uv[2] + (uv[4] - uv[2]) * fv0, uv[1] + (uv[3] - uv[1]) * fu1, uv[2] + (uv[4] - uv[2]) * fv1}
                            JavaContent.surface(face, NID[faceName], JavaContent.data.textures[f[1]], f[4] >= 0 and JavaContent.tint(e) or nil, crop, f[3])
                        end)
                        if not okM then pcall(JavaContent.paint, face, {javaBlock = e.index}) end
                        face.Parent = folder
                        local k = holeKey(n)
                        holeFaces[k] = holeFaces[k] or {}
                        table.insert(holeFaces[k], face)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function system.cut(hit, center, canHarvest, complete, lootTool)
        if system.clearSampleCache then system.clearSampleCache() end
        if system.busy or os.clock() < system.retryAt then return end
        local kind = system.kind(hit, center)
        local cube = {center.X - half, center.Y - half, center.Z - half, center.X + half, center.Y + half, center.Z + half}
        local sources = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(center), Vector3.new(size, size, size) * 0.98, overlap)
        local probe = box(center, Vector3.new(size - 0.04, size - 0.04, size - 0.04))
        probe.CanCollide, probe.CanQuery, probe.Transparency, probe.Parent = false, false, 1, folder
        local exactParams = OverlapParams.new()
        exactParams.FilterType, exactParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, {character, probe}
        local exactOk, exact = pcall(function() return workspace:GetPartsInPart(probe, exactParams) end)
        probe:Destroy()
        local touching = {}
        if exactOk then for _, p in ipairs(exact) do touching[p] = true end end
        local plan, legacy = {}, false
        for _, p in ipairs(sources) do
            if system.mineable(p) and not p:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter") and (touching[p] or gridAligned(p) or not exactOk) then
                if p:GetAttribute("SteveCutFace") then plan[#plan + 1] = {p, "drop"}
                elseif p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Size.X <= size * 1.05 and p.Size.Y <= size * 1.05 and p.Size.Z <= size * 1.05 then plan[#plan + 1] = {p, "drop"}
                elseif gridAligned(p) then plan[#plan + 1] = {p, "split"}
                else
                    local b = aabb(p)
                    local cells = cellsIn(b, 1500)
                    if cells then plan[#plan + 1] = {p, "voxels", cells} else legacy = true end
                end
            end
        end
        if legacy then return system.legacyCut(hit, center, canHarvest, complete, lootTool) end
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            local made = 0
            for _, step in ipairs(plan) do
                local source, how = step[1], step[2]
                if how == "split" then
                    local slabs = sixSlabs(aabb(source), cube)
                    for _, b in ipairs(slabs) do
                        if b[4] - b[1] > 0.01 and b[5] - b[2] > 0.01 and b[6] - b[3] > 0.01 then piece(source, b).Parent = source.Parent; made = made + 1 end
                    end
                    source.Parent = nil
                elseif how == "voxels" then
                    -- The shape becomes blocks of its own kind wherever it fills a cell.
                    local sourceKind = system.kind({Instance = source, Material = source.Material, Position = center, Normal = Vector3.yAxis}, center)
                    for _, c in ipairs(step[3]) do
                        if not same(c, center) and fills(source, c) then placeAt(c, sourceKind); made = made + 1 end
                    end
                    source.Parent = nil
                else source.Parent = nil end
            end
            -- Terrain: empty the touched 4-stud voxels; their other solid cells become blocks.
            local region = Region3.new(center - Vector3.new(half, half, half), center + Vector3.new(half, half, half)):ExpandToGrid(4)
            local mats, occ = workspace.Terrain:ReadVoxels(region, 4)
            local low = region.CFrame.Position - region.Size / 2
            local newMats, newOcc, changed = {}, {}, false
            for x, ys in ipairs(occ) do
                newMats[x], newOcc[x] = {}, {}
                for y, zs in ipairs(ys) do
                    newMats[x][y], newOcc[x][y] = {}, {}
                    for z, v in ipairs(zs) do
                        local material = mats[x][y][z]
                        newMats[x][y][z], newOcc[x][y][z] = material, v
                        if v > 0.01 and material ~= Enum.Material.Water and material ~= Enum.Material.Air then
                            newMats[x][y][z], newOcc[x][y][z], changed = Enum.Material.Air, 0, true
                            local vlow = low + Vector3.new((x - 1) * 4, (y - 1) * 4, (z - 1) * 4)
                            local fillTop = vlow.Y + 4 * math.min(1, v + 0.25)
                            local terrainKind = system.kind({Instance = workspace.Terrain, Material = material, Position = vlow, Normal = Vector3.yAxis}, center)
                            for _, c in ipairs(cellsIn({vlow.X, vlow.Y, vlow.Z, vlow.X + 4, vlow.Y + 4, vlow.Z + 4}, 64) or {}) do
                                if not same(c, center) and c.Y < fillTop then placeAt(c, terrainKind); made = made + 1 end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if changed then workspace.Terrain:WriteVoxels(region, 4, newMats, newOcc) end
            if #plan == 0 and not changed then error("No solid found in the targeted cube") end
            local marker = Instance.new("Folder")
            marker.Name, marker.Parent = cellKey(center), mined
            if canHarvest ~= false then
                local countKey = "Collected_" .. kind:gsub(" ", "_")
                localBlocks:SetAttribute(countKey, (localBlocks:GetAttribute(countKey) or 0) + 1)
                system.message = "+1 " .. kind
                if system.onCollect then pcall(system.onCollect, kind, center, lootTool) end
            else
                system.message = "Broken (requires a better pickaxe for drops)"
            end
        end)
        if not ok then
            system.message = "Could not break this part of the map"
            warn("Steve mining: " .. tostring(err))
        else
            local okF, errF = pcall(system.holeFaces, center)
            if not okF then warn("Steve mining faces: " .. tostring(errF)) end
            if SteveGround then pcall(SteveGround.dug, center) end
        end
        if complete then complete(ok) end
    end
    function system.legacyCut(hit, center, canHarvest,complete,lootTool)
        if system.clearSampleCache then system.clearSampleCache() end
        if system.busy or os.clock() < system.retryAt then return end
        system.busy, system.message = true, "Cutting..."
        task.spawn(function()
            local pending, temporary, originals, terrainBackup = {}, {}, {}, nil
            local terrainWritten = false
            local function keep(p) pending[#pending+1] = p; return p end
            local function temp(p) temporary[#temporary+1] = p; return p end
            local function intersect(source, bounds)
                if axisBox(source) then
                    local a = aabb(source)
                    for i=1,3 do a[i],a[i+3] = math.max(a[i],bounds[i]),math.min(a[i+3],bounds[i+3]) end
                    for i=1,3 do if a[i+3]-a[i] < 0.00001 then return {} end end
                    return {temp(fromBounds(a))}
                end
                local mask = temp(fromBounds(bounds))
                local results = geometry:IntersectAsync(source, {mask}, {
                    CollisionFidelity=Enum.CollisionFidelity.PreciseConvexDecomposition, SplitApart=true})
                if type(results) ~= "table" then error("Geometry service returned no result") end
                for _,p in ipairs(results) do temp(p) end
                return results
            end
            local ok, err = pcall(function()
                local cube = {center.X-half,center.Y-half,center.Z-half,center.X+half,center.Y+half,center.Z+half}
                local sources = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(center), Vector3.new(size,size,size), overlap)
                -- Bounding boxes overlap far more than geometry does (large
                -- rotated parts, meshes, many earlier fragments). Keep only
                -- parts whose collision geometry really enters the cube.
                local probe = temp(box(center, Vector3.new(size-0.002,size-0.002,size-0.002)))
                probe.CanCollide, probe.CanQuery, probe.Transparency, probe.Parent = false, false, 1, folder
                local exactParams = OverlapParams.new()
                exactParams.FilterType, exactParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, {character, probe}
                local touching = {}
                local exactOk, exact = pcall(function() return workspace:GetPartsInPart(probe, exactParams) end)
                if exactOk then for _,p in ipairs(exact) do touching[p] = true end end
                probe.Parent = nil
                local candidates = {}
                for _,p in ipairs(sources) do
                    if system.mineable(p) and not p:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter")
                        and (not exactOk or touching[p] or axisBox(p)) then
                        candidates[#candidates+1] = p
                    end
                end
                -- Caps are deliberately non-queryable, so the spatial query
                -- cannot find them. Trim old caps too when the next cell opens.
                local grown = {cube[1]-0.02,cube[2]-0.02,cube[3]-0.02,cube[4]+0.02,cube[5]+0.02,cube[6]+0.02}
                for _,p in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") and p:GetAttribute("SteveCutFace") then
                        -- Triangle-built faces sit inside their hole (see triangleCut).
                        local _, inside = sixSlabs(aabb(p),carvedTriangles[p] and grown or cube)
                        if inside then candidates[#candidates+1] = p end
                    end
                end
                if #candidates > 160 then
                    error(#candidates .. " separate objects overlap this one cell; no cut was applied")
                end
                for _,p in ipairs(candidates) do
                    originals[#originals+1] = {p,p.Parent,p.CFrame,p.Size}
                    -- Fragments inherit this key, so placement can recognise
                    -- every piece of one dug object as the same support.
                    if not p:GetAttribute("SteveCutFace") and not p:GetAttribute("SteveSourceKey") then
                        sourceKeys = sourceKeys + 1
                        p:SetAttribute("SteveSourceKey", string.format("%d-%d", math.random(1, 2^30), sourceKeys))
                    end
                end
                -- Terrain cannot use CSG. Convert only the touched native
                -- voxels to local solids before the same six-plane operation.
                -- Fractional occupancy becomes a height-filled box: native
                -- smooth terrain edges therefore become terraced locally.
                local region = Region3.new(center-Vector3.new(half,half,half), center+Vector3.new(half,half,half)):ExpandToGrid(4)
                local mats, occ = workspace.Terrain:ReadVoxels(region,4)
                local low = region.CFrame.Position-region.Size/2
                local newMats, newOcc, changed = {}, {}, false
                for x,ys in ipairs(occ) do
                    newMats[x],newOcc[x] = {},{}
                    for y,zs in ipairs(ys) do
                        newMats[x][y],newOcc[x][y] = {},{}
                        for z,v in ipairs(zs) do
                            local material = mats[x][y][z]
                            newMats[x][y][z],newOcc[x][y][z] = material,v
                            if v > 0 and material ~= Enum.Material.Water then
                                local p = temp(box(low+Vector3.new(x*4-2,(y-1)*4+v*2,z*4-2), Vector3.new(4,math.max(v*4,0.001),4)))
                                p.Material, p.Color, p.Name = material, workspace.Terrain:GetMaterialColor(material), "ExcavatedTerrain"
                                candidates[#candidates+1] = p
                                newMats[x][y][z],newOcc[x][y][z],changed = Enum.Material.Air,0,true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if changed then terrainBackup = {region,mats,occ,newMats,newOcc} end
                local kind = system.kind(hit,center)
                local point,normal,footprint,footprintSize
                local function csgCut(source)
                    local slabs, inside = sixSlabs(aabb(source),cube)
                    -- Work on client-created geometry, never modify a live
                    -- source while an asynchronous boolean operation is pending.
                    local work = source
                    if not axisBox(source) then work = temp(assert(source:Clone(), "Cannot clone this mesh for cutting")) end
                    for _,slab in ipairs(slabs) do
                        for _,fragment in ipairs(intersect(work,slab)) do
                            inherit(source,fragment)
                            -- Preserve classification after fragments leave their original model.
                            if not source:GetAttribute("SteveCutFace") then
                                local sourceHit={Instance=source,Material=source.Material}
                                local sourceKind=JavaContent and JavaContent.data and JavaContent.classify(sourceHit) or kind
                                fragment:SetAttribute("MinecraftBlockType",sourceKind)
                            end
                            if point and not source:GetAttribute("SteveCutFace") then
                                fragment:SetAttribute("SteveSurfacePoint",point)
                                fragment:SetAttribute("SteveSurfaceNormal",normal)
                                fragment:SetAttribute("SteveGroundBounds",footprint)
                                fragment:SetAttribute("SteveGroundSize",footprintSize)
                            end
                            keep(fragment)
                        end
                    end
                    if not source:GetAttribute("SteveCutFace") then
                        -- Six thin caps are clipped against the actual original
                        -- solid, so their edges follow a wedge/mesh slope.
                        for axis=1,3 do for side=1,2 do
                            local cap = {cube[1],cube[2],cube[3],cube[4],cube[5],cube[6]}
                            local plane = cube[side == 1 and axis or axis+3]
                            -- Entirely outside the excavated cube. A fully
                            -- removed voxel must not leave a floating shell.
                            cap[axis],cap[axis+3] = side == 1 and plane-0.016 or plane,side == 1 and plane or plane+0.016
                            for _,face in ipairs(intersect(work,cap)) do
                                applyKind(face,kind)
                                face.Name,face.Anchored,face.CanCollide,face.CanTouch,face.CanQuery = "SteveCutFace",true,false,false,false
                                face:SetAttribute("SteveCutFace",true)
                                keep(face)
                            end
                        end end
                    end
                end
                for _,source in ipairs(candidates) do
                    if source:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") then error("SpecialMesh must be converted to a closed MeshPart before cutting") end
                    if carvedTriangles[source] then
                        -- Built by the triangle path: its triangles are already known.
                        triangleCut(source, cube, kind, keep)
                    else
                        local staged = #pending
                        local csgOk, csgError = pcall(csgCut, source)
                        if not csgOk then
                            -- e.g. "Non-manifold mesh part": discard this source's
                            -- partial CSG output and cut its triangles instead.
                            for i = #pending, staged + 1, -1 do pending[i] = nil end
                            local meshOk, meshError = pcall(triangleCut, source, cube, kind, keep)
                            if not meshOk then
                                error(tostring(csgError) .. "; triangle fallback also failed: " .. tostring(meshError), 0)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    task.wait()
                end
                -- No synthetic depth layers: retain and classify the actual map geometry.
                if cancelled() then error("Cut cancelled") end
                for _,entry in ipairs(originals) do
                    if entry[1].Parent ~= entry[2] or entry[1].CFrame ~= entry[3] or entry[1].Size ~= entry[4] then error("Source moved during cutting; try again") end
                end
                if #candidates == 0 then error("No solid found in the targeted cube") end
                -- Commit after every required cut succeeded. Failure leaves the
                -- originals and Terrain intact; no whole-mesh deletion fallback.
                for _,p in ipairs(pending) do p.Parent = folder end
                if terrainBackup then
                    terrainWritten = true
                    workspace.Terrain:WriteVoxels(region,4,newMats,newOcc)
                end
                for _,entry in ipairs(originals) do entry[1].Parent = nil end
                local marker = Instance.new("Folder")
                marker.Name,marker.Parent = cellKey(center),mined
                if canHarvest ~= false then
                    local countKey = "Collected_"..kind:gsub(" ","_")
                    localBlocks:SetAttribute(countKey,(localBlocks:GetAttribute(countKey) or 0)+1)
                    system.message = "+1 "..kind
                    if system.onCollect then pcall(system.onCollect,kind,center,lootTool) end
                else
                    system.message = "Broken (requires a better pickaxe for drops)"
                end
            end)
            if not ok then
                for _,p in ipairs(pending) do p:Destroy() end
                for _,entry in ipairs(originals) do if entry[1].Parent == nil then entry[1].Parent = entry[2] end end
                if terrainWritten then pcall(function() workspace.Terrain:WriteVoxels(terrainBackup[1],4,terrainBackup[2],terrainBackup[3]) end) end
                system.message = "Cut failed; original kept (see Output)"
                system.retryAt = os.clock()+2
                warn("Steve mining: "..tostring(err))
            end
            for _,p in ipairs(temporary) do if not p.Parent then p:Destroy() end end
            system.busy = false
            if complete then complete(ok) end
        end)
    end
    -- Explosion (ServerExplosion.finalizeExplosion): all blasted map cells go in one pass and
    -- never take the single-cell mining lock. Axis-aligned boxes are rebuilt from six slabs
    -- outside the blast bounds plus the surviving cells inside it (merged into rows); any
    -- other part gets one CSG subtraction of its blasted cells; Terrain cells are emptied.
    local function mergeBoxes(list)
        local merged = true
        while merged do
            merged = false
            for i = 1, #list do
                local a = list[i]
                if a then
                    for j = i + 1, #list do
                        local c = list[j]
                        if c then
                            for axis = 1, 3 do
                                local o1, o2 = axis % 3 + 1, (axis + 1) % 3 + 1
                                if math.abs(a[o1] - c[o1]) < 1e-4 and math.abs(a[o1 + 3] - c[o1 + 3]) < 1e-4
                                    and math.abs(a[o2] - c[o2]) < 1e-4 and math.abs(a[o2 + 3] - c[o2 + 3]) < 1e-4
                                    and (math.abs(a[axis + 3] - c[axis]) < 1e-4 or math.abs(c[axis + 3] - a[axis]) < 1e-4) then
                                    a[axis], a[axis + 3] = math.min(a[axis], c[axis]), math.max(a[axis + 3], c[axis + 3])
                                    list[j] = false
                                    merged = true
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local packed = {}
            for _, x in ipairs(list) do if x then packed[#packed + 1] = x end end
            list = packed
        end
        return list
    end
    function system.blast(cells, complete)
        if system.clearSampleCache then system.clearSampleCache() end
        task.spawn(function()
            if #cells == 0 then if complete then complete() end return end
            local lo, hi = cells[1], cells[1]
            for _, c in ipairs(cells) do lo, hi = lo:Min(c), hi:Max(c) end
            local budget = os.clock()
            local function breathe() if os.clock() - budget > 0.006 then task.wait(); budget = os.clock() end end
            local blasted = {}
            local function cellIndex(c)
                local v = (c - lo) / size
                return math.floor(v.X + 0.5), math.floor(v.Y + 0.5), math.floor(v.Z + 0.5)
            end
            for _, c in ipairs(cells) do local i, j, k = cellIndex(c); blasted[i .. "," .. j .. "," .. k] = true end
            local blast = {lo.X - half, lo.Y - half, lo.Z - half, hi.X + half, hi.Y + half, hi.Z + half}
            local sources = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new((lo + hi) / 2), hi - lo + Vector3.new(size, size, size), overlap)) do
                if system.mineable(p) and not p:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter") then sources[#sources + 1] = p end
            end
            local function classify(source, p)
                inherit(source, p)
                if not source:GetAttribute("SteveCutFace") and JavaContent and JavaContent.data then
                    p:SetAttribute("MinecraftBlockType", JavaContent.classify({Instance = source, Material = source.Material}))
                end
            end
            for _, source in ipairs(sources) do
                if cancelled() then break end
                local b = aabb(source)
                local hits = {}
                for _, c in ipairs(cells) do
                    if c.X + half > b[1] and c.X - half < b[4] and c.Y + half > b[2] and c.Y - half < b[5] and c.Z + half > b[3] and c.Z - half < b[6] then hits[#hits + 1] = c end
                end
                if #hits > 0 and source.Parent then
                    local made = {}
                    local ok, err = pcall(function()
                        if source:GetAttribute("SteveCutFace") then return end -- caps of a blasted hole just go
                        if axisBox(source) then
                            local slabs, inside = sixSlabs(b, blast)
                            local boxes = {}
                            for _, s in ipairs(slabs) do boxes[#boxes + 1] = s end
                            if inside then
                                -- Cells containing the inside box's edges (part edges need not sit on the grid).
                                local i0, j0, k0 = cellIndex(Vector3.new(inside[1] + 1e-4, inside[2] + 1e-4, inside[3] + 1e-4))
                                local i1, j1, k1 = cellIndex(Vector3.new(inside[4] - 1e-4, inside[5] - 1e-4, inside[6] - 1e-4))
                                for j = j0, j1 do for k = k0, k1 do
                                    breathe()
                                    local run
                                    for i = i0, i1 + 1 do
                                        local keep = i <= i1 and not blasted[i .. "," .. j .. "," .. k]
                                        if keep and not run then run = i
                                        elseif not keep and run then
                                            local box = {lo.X + (run - 0.5) * size, lo.Y + (j - 0.5) * size, lo.Z + (k - 0.5) * size,
                                                lo.X + (i - 0.5) * size, lo.Y + (j + 0.5) * size, lo.Z + (k + 0.5) * size}
                                            for a = 1, 3 do box[a], box[a + 3] = math.max(box[a], inside[a]), math.min(box[a + 3], inside[a + 3]) end
                                            if box[4] - box[1] > 1e-4 and box[5] - box[2] > 1e-4 and box[6] - box[3] > 1e-4 then boxes[#boxes + 1] = box end
                                            run = nil
                                        end
                                    end
                                end end
                            end
                            for _, merged in ipairs(mergeBoxes(boxes)) do made[#made + 1] = fromBounds(merged) end
                        else
                            local negatives = {}
                            for _, c in ipairs(hits) do negatives[#negatives + 1] = box(c, Vector3.new(size, size, size)) end
                            local results = geometry:SubtractAsync(source, negatives, {CollisionFidelity = Enum.CollisionFidelity.Default, SplitApart = true})
                            for _, n in ipairs(negatives) do n:Destroy() end
                            if type(results) ~= "table" then error("Geometry service returned no result") end
                            for _, p in ipairs(results) do made[#made + 1] = p end
                        end
                    end)
                    if ok then
                        for _, p in ipairs(made) do classify(source, p); p.Parent = folder end
                        source.Parent = nil
                    else
                        for _, p in ipairs(made) do p:Destroy() end
                        warn("Steve explosion: " .. tostring(err))
                    end
                    breathe()
                end
            end
            -- Cut-face caps are not queryable; drop the ones lining cells this blast emptied.
            for _, p in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") and p:GetAttribute("SteveCutFace") then
                    local i, j, k = cellIndex(p.Position)
                    if blasted[i .. "," .. j .. "," .. k] then p:Destroy() end
                end
            end
            if workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftTerrainMineable") ~= false then
                for _, c in ipairs(cells) do
                    pcall(function() workspace.Terrain:FillBlock(CFrame.new(c), Vector3.new(size, size, size), Enum.Material.Air) end)
                end
            end
            for _, c in ipairs(cells) do
                if not mined:FindFirstChild(cellKey(c)) then local marker = Instance.new("Folder"); marker.Name, marker.Parent = cellKey(c), mined end
            end
            if complete then complete() end
        end)
    end
    return system
end

-- END WORLD MINING
local steveEnabled=true
local savedInventory
local nativeTools={}
local nativeIds=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local nextNativeId=0
JavaContent.nativeTools=nativeTools
local cleanupCharacter
local generation = 0
-- BEGIN SURFACE PLACEMENT
local function fitPlacement(candidate, normal, size, exactCell, occupied, blockcast, supportTarget)
    -- Start clear, then move a complete cube onto the supporting collision
    -- surface. Snapping only the hit point puts the uphill corner inside ramps.
    local inset = 0.01
    local clearance, start
    -- Prefer a nearby clear start so a low ceiling does not prevent placing
    -- a block on the floor. Advance farther only for an embedded slope corner.
    for step=1,16 do
        local distance = size*step/8 + inset*4
        local point = candidate + normal*distance
        if not occupied(point) then clearance,start=distance,point; break end
    end
    if not start then return nil end
    local function sameSupport(instance)
        if not supportTarget or instance == supportTarget then return true end
        -- Every fragment of one dug object carries its source's key.
        local key = typeof and typeof(instance) == "Instance" and instance:GetAttribute("SteveSourceKey")
        return key ~= nil and key ~= false and supportTarget:GetAttribute("SteveSourceKey") == key
    end
    local function grazes(hit)
        -- A wall beside the cube's path is touched edge-on; a support faces it.
        local n = hit.Normal
        return n ~= nil and math.abs(n.X*normal.X + n.Y*normal.Y + n.Z*normal.Z) < 0.15
    end
    local travel = normal * -(clearance + size)
    local hit = blockcast(CFrame.new(start), Vector3.new(size,size,size), travel)
    if hit and (grazes(hit) or not sameSupport(hit.Instance)) then
        -- In a one-block hole, or between other blocks, the full cube scrapes
        -- the side walls first. Narrow it only across the face and retry.
        local across = Vector3.new(1,1,1) - Vector3.new(math.abs(normal.X), math.abs(normal.Y), math.abs(normal.Z))
        hit = blockcast(CFrame.new(start), Vector3.new(size,size,size) - across * 0.1, travel)
    end
    if not hit or grazes(hit) or not sameSupport(hit.Instance) then return nil end
    local fitted = start - normal * math.max(0,hit.Distance-inset)
    if exactCell then
        -- Existing cubes always use their actual face-adjacent cell. Never
        -- push a stack onto the far side of another object that blocks it.
        if (fitted-candidate).Magnitude > 0.04 then return nil end
        fitted = candidate
    end
    if occupied(fitted, true) then return nil end
    return fitted
end
-- END SURFACE PLACEMENT
-- BEGIN BODY COLLISION
local function createBodyCollision(root, character, cast)
    local skin = CONFIG.CollisionSkin
    local probe = Instance.new("Part")
    probe.Name, probe.Anchored, probe.Transparency = "SteveCollisionProbe", true, 1
    probe.CanCollide, probe.CanTouch, probe.CanQuery = false, false, false
    probe.Parent = character
    local overlaps = OverlapParams.new()
    overlaps.FilterType, overlaps.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, {character}
    overlaps.RespectCanCollide, overlaps.MaxParts = true, 1
    overlaps.CollisionGroup = root.CollisionGroup
    local lastSafe, pushClock
    local solver = {}
    -- Players do not collide with each other in Java (only Entity.push): other characters are left out of every
    -- body query and of the movement casts, refreshed once a second.
    local others, nextOthers, insideParams = {}, 0, nil
    local function refreshOthers()
        if os.clock() < nextOthers then return end
        nextOthers = os.clock() + 1
        others = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
            if p.Character and p.Character ~= character then others[#others + 1] = p.Character end
        end
        local list = {character}
        for _, c in ipairs(others) do list[#list + 1] = c end
        overlaps.FilterDescendantsInstances = list
        if insideParams then insideParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = list end
        cast.FilterDescendantsInstances = list
    end
    function solver.blocked(position)
        refreshOthers()
        probe.Size = root.Size - Vector3.new(skin,skin,skin)*2
        probe.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
        return #workspace:GetPartsInPart(probe,overlaps) > 0
    end
    insideParams = OverlapParams.new()
    insideParams.FilterType, insideParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, {character}
    nextOthers = 0
    insideParams.RespectCanCollide, insideParams.CollisionGroup = true, root.CollisionGroup
    local newParams = OverlapParams.new()
    newParams.FilterType, newParams.RespectCanCollide, newParams.MaxParts, newParams.CollisionGroup = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true, 1, root.CollisionGroup
    -- Parts the hull is inside now, and whether a position touches anything else.
    function solver.inside(position)
        probe.Size = root.Size - Vector3.new(skin,skin,skin)*2
        probe.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
        return workspace:GetPartsInPart(probe,insideParams)
    end
    function solver.blockedIgnoring(position, ignore)
        refreshOthers()
        local list = {character}
        for _, c in ipairs(others) do list[#list + 1] = c end
        for _, p in ipairs(ignore) do list[#list+1] = p end
        newParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = list
        probe.Size = root.Size - Vector3.new(skin,skin,skin)*2
        probe.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
        return #workspace:GetPartsInPart(probe,newParams) > 0
    end
    -- Player.updatePlayerPose(): a body that no longer fits (a trapdoor shut on it) takes the
    -- crouching pose, else the swimming pose (crawling), feet staying where they are.
    function solver.fitPose(position)
        local size = root.Size
        local feet = position.Y - size.Y / 2
        for _, blocks in ipairs({CONFIG.CrouchHeight, CONFIG.SwimHeight}) do
            local height = blocks * CONFIG.Block
            if height < size.Y - 0.001 then
                root.Size = Vector3.new(size.X, height, size.Z)
                local candidate = Vector3.new(position.X, feet + height / 2, position.Z)
                if not solver.blocked(candidate) then return candidate end
            end
        end
        root.Size = size
        return nil
    end
    function solver.sweep(position, offset)
        if offset.Magnitude < 1e-6 then return offset,false end
        local hit = workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(position),root.Size-Vector3.new(skin,skin,skin)*2,offset,cast)
        local moved = hit and offset.Unit * math.max(0,hit.Distance-skin) or offset
        -- Blockcast ignores initial intersections. An endpoint overlap query
        -- catches engine drift/moving geometry and shrinks this move to safety.
        local ignore = offset.Y >= -1e-6 and solver.blocked(position) and solver.inside(position) or nil
        local function stuck(p) if ignore then return solver.blockedIgnoring(p, ignore) end return solver.blocked(p) end
        if stuck(position+moved) then
            local low, high = 0, 1
            for _=1,12 do
                local mid = (low+high)/2
                if stuck(position+moved*mid) then high=mid else low=mid end
            end
            return moved*low,true
        end
        return moved,hit ~= nil
    end
    function solver.recover(position)
        if not solver.blocked(position) then lastSafe, pushClock = position, nil; return position,true end
        local fitted = solver.fitPose(position)
        if fitted then lastSafe, pushClock = fitted, nil; return fitted,true end
        -- Sunk into the floor (up to 0.6 block): back on top of it at once.
        for step = 1, 24 do
            local candidate = position + Vector3.new(0, step * CONFIG.Block / 40, 0)
            if not solver.blocked(candidate) then lastSafe, pushClock = candidate, nil; return candidate,true end
        end
        -- LocalPlayer.moveTowardsClosestSpace(): stuck inside blocks, the body is pushed sideways
        -- toward the nearest open side at 0.1 blocks a tick. Nothing snaps it back.
        local now = os.clock()
        local dt = math.min(0.1, now - (pushClock or now)); pushClock = now
        local best, bestDistance
        for _, direction in ipairs({Vector3.new(1,0,0),Vector3.new(-1,0,0),Vector3.new(0,0,1),Vector3.new(0,0,-1)}) do
            for step = 1, 10 do
                local distance = step * CONFIG.Block / 10
                if not solver.blocked(position + direction * distance) then
                    if not bestDistance or distance < bestDistance then best, bestDistance = direction, distance end
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if best then return position + best * math.min(bestDistance, CONFIG.Block * 2 * dt),true end
        return position,true
    end
    function solver.remember(position)
        if not solver.blocked(position) then lastSafe=position end
    end
    function solver.destroy() probe:Destroy() end
    return solver
end
-- END BODY COLLISION
-- BEGIN HEROBRINE
-- Rare encounters with a white-eyed copy of your Steve: walking between walls, peeking
-- from cover, or hiding in a crowd. Once noticed he hides; he vanishes the moment he is
-- fully out of view (or if you get too close). Chances are set in CONFIG at the top.
local function createHerobrine(ctx)
    local hb = {}
    local B = CONFIG.Block
    local px = B / 16 * 0.9375 -- PlayerRenderer scales the 32px humanoid model by 15/16
    local root, character = ctx.root, ctx.character
    local rng = Random.new()
    local function log(...) if CONFIG.HerobrineDebug then print("[Herobrine]", ...) end end

    -- Model ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Steve's head with the eyes (row 4: sclera x=1,6 and pupils x=2,5) turned white.
    local function whiteEyes(sprite)
        local copy = {w = sprite.w, h = sprite.h, p = table.clone(sprite.p), alpha = sprite.alpha and table.clone(sprite.alpha)}
        local white
        for i, c in ipairs(copy.p) do if c == 0xFFFFFF then white = i end end
        if not white then copy.p[#copy.p + 1] = 0xFFFFFF; white = #copy.p; if copy.alpha then copy.alpha[white] = 1 end end
        local d = {}
        for i = 1, #sprite.d, 2 do d[#d + 1] = sprite.d:sub(i, i + 1) end
        for _, x in ipairs({1, 2, 5, 6}) do d[4 * sprite.w + x + 1] = string.format("%02x", white) end
        copy.d = table.concat(d)
        return copy
    end
    -- Roblox-space layout of Java's HumanoidModel (feet at y=0, facing -Z, right arm at +X):
    -- size, pivot, and the box centre relative to its pivot, all in model pixels.
    local layout = {
        Head = {size = Vector3.new(8, 8, 8), pivot = Vector3.new(0, 24, 0), offset = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)},
        Torso = {size = Vector3.new(8, 12, 4), pivot = Vector3.new(0, 24, 0), offset = Vector3.new(0, -6, 0)},
        ["Right Arm"] = {size = Vector3.new(4, 12, 4), pivot = Vector3.new(5, 22, 0), offset = Vector3.new(1, -4, 0)},
        ["Left Arm"] = {size = Vector3.new(4, 12, 4), pivot = Vector3.new(-5, 22, 0), offset = Vector3.new(-1, -4, 0)},
        ["Right Leg"] = {size = Vector3.new(4, 12, 4), pivot = Vector3.new(1.9, 12, 0), offset = Vector3.new(0, -6, 0)},
        ["Left Leg"] = {size = Vector3.new(4, 12, 4), pivot = Vector3.new(-1.9, 12, 0), offset = Vector3.new(0, -6, 0)},
    }
    local model, parts, eyes
    local function build()
        model = Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name = "Herobrine"
        parts = {}
        local skin = JavaContent.data.skin
        for name, def in pairs(layout) do
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name, p.Size, p.Anchored = name, def.size * px, true
            p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = false, false, false, true
            for i, face in ipairs(faces) do
                local sprite = skin[name][i]
                if name == "Head" and i == 1 then sprite = whiteEyes(sprite) end
                if i == 1 then JavaContent.solidCarrier(p, sprite) end
                JavaContent.surface(p, face, sprite)
            end
            p.Parent = model
            parts[name] = p
        end
        -- The white eyes glow: neon squares just in front of the eye pixels.
        eyes = {}
        for _, x in ipairs({1, 2, 5, 6}) do
            local eye = Instance.new("Part")
            eye.Name, eye.Material, eye.Color, eye.Anchored = "Eye", Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), true
            eye.CanCollide, eye.CanQuery, eye.CanTouch, eye.CastShadow = false, false, false, false
            eye.Size = Vector3.new(px, px, px * 0.05)
            eye.Parent = model
            -- Front face canvas runs right-to-left along +X; pixel x sits at 3.5 - x, row 4 at -0.5.
            eyes[#eyes + 1] = {part = eye, offset = Vector3.new(3.5 - x, -0.5, -4.03) * px}
        end
        model.Parent = workspace
    end

    -- Visibility -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function exclusions()
        local list = {character}
        if model then list[#list + 1] = model end
        for _, name in ipairs({"SteveJavaParticles", "SteveDroppedItems", "SteveCatalogHands", "SteveDebugRenderer"}) do
            local f = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
            if f then list[#list + 1] = f end
        end
        return list
    end
    local params = RaycastParams.new() -- line of sight: anything opaque hides him, solid or not
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local moveParams = RaycastParams.new() -- walking: only what a body collides with
    moveParams.FilterType, moveParams.RespectCanCollide = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true
    local function characterOf(instance)
        local m = instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        while m do
            if m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return m end
            m = m.Parent and m.Parent:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        end
    end
    -- Line of sight from the camera to a point. wallsOnly: only solid world geometry blocks it
    -- (people are looked through) and being off-screen does not count. Returns visible, blocking hit.
    local function sight(point, wallsOnly)
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return false end
        if not wallsOnly then
            local screen, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(point)
            if not onScreen or screen.Z <= 0 then return false end
        end
        local from = camera.CFrame.Position
        local ignore = exclusions()
        for _ = 1, 6 do
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(from, point - from, params)
            if not hit or (hit.Position - point).Magnitude < 0.05 then return true end
            local inst = hit.Instance
            local opaque = (inst:IsA("Terrain") and hit.Material ~= Enum.Material.Water) or (not inst:IsA("Terrain") and inst.Transparency < 0.6)
            if opaque and not (wallsOnly and characterOf(inst)) then return false, hit end
            ignore[#ignore + 1] = inst
            from = hit.Position
        end
        return true
    end
    -- What you can see right now (people and walls block it, off-screen is unseen).
    local function seen(point) return (sight(point, false)) end
    -- Real cover: solid geometry (never a person) blocks the camera within 4 blocks in front of the point.
    local function covered(point)
        local visible, hit = sight(point, true)
        return not visible and hit ~= nil and (hit.Position - point).Magnitude <= 4 * B
    end
    -- Sample points over the body standing at `position` facing `yaw`.
    local function samples(position, yaw)
        local frame = CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
        local list = {}
        for _, p in ipairs({Vector3.new(0, 28, 0), Vector3.new(3, 28, 0), Vector3.new(-3, 28, 0), Vector3.new(0, 18, 0),
            Vector3.new(6, 17, 0), Vector3.new(-6, 17, 0), Vector3.new(2, 4, 0), Vector3.new(-2, 4, 0)}) do
            list[#list + 1] = frame:PointToWorldSpace(p * px)
        end
        return list
    end
    local function visibleCount(position, yaw)
        local n, head = 0, false
        for i, p in ipairs(samples(position, yaw)) do
            if seen(p) then n = n + 1; if i <= 3 then head = true end end
        end
        return n, head
    end
    -- How many of the body's sample points are behind real cover.
    local function coveredCount(position, yaw)
        local n = 0
        for _, p in ipairs(samples(position, yaw)) do if covered(p) then n = n + 1 end end
        return n
    end

    -- How much of him your camera could see from where it is now if it turned to look: walls block,
    -- turning away does not hide him. Hiding spots and paths are judged by this, from your current POV.
    local function exposure(position, yaw)
        local n, head = 0, false
        for i, p in ipairs(samples(position, yaw)) do
            if sight(p, true) then n = n + 1; if i <= 3 then head = true end end
        end
        return n, head
    end

    -- Places to stand ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function groundNear(point)
        moveParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = exclusions()
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(point + Vector3.new(0, 4 * B, 0), Vector3.new(0, -10 * B, 0), moveParams)
        if not hit or hit.Normal.Y < 0.7 then return nil end
        local feet = hit.Position
        -- room for a 2-block-tall body
        if workspace:Raycast(feet + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0), Vector3.new(0, 1.9 * B, 0), moveParams) then return nil end
        return feet
    end
    local function pathClear(a, b)
        moveParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = exclusions()
        for _, h in ipairs({0.6, 1.5}) do
            local from, to = a + Vector3.new(0, h * B, 0), b + Vector3.new(0, h * B, 0)
            if workspace:Raycast(from, to - from, moveParams) then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function facingPlayer(position)
        local d = root.Position - position
        return math.atan2(-d.X, -d.Z)
    end
    local function frontPoint(minDist, maxDist, spread)
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local look = camera and camera.CFrame.LookVector or root.CFrame.LookVector
        local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z) + rng:NextNumber(-spread, spread)
        local dist = rng:NextNumber(minDist, maxDist) * B
        return groundNear(root.Position + Vector3.new(-math.sin(yaw), 0, -math.cos(yaw)) * dist)
    end
    -- A spot just behind real cover in front of you: cast across the view, find a solid wall
    -- (not a person, not see-through) between minDist and maxDist, then step 0.8-2 blocks past it.
    local function coverPoint(minDist, maxDist, spread)
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return nil end
        local from = camera.CFrame.Position
        local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z) + rng:NextNumber(-spread, spread)
        local pitch = rng:NextNumber(-0.12, 0.04)
        local dir = Vector3.new(-math.sin(yaw) * math.cos(pitch), math.sin(pitch), -math.cos(yaw) * math.cos(pitch))
        local ignore = exclusions()
        local origin = from
        for _ = 1, 6 do
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, dir * (maxDist * B - (origin - from).Magnitude), params)
            if not hit then return nil end
            local inst = hit.Instance
            local opaque = (inst:IsA("Terrain") and hit.Material ~= Enum.Material.Water) or (not inst:IsA("Terrain") and inst.Transparency < 0.6)
            if opaque and not characterOf(inst) then
                if (hit.Position - from).Magnitude < minDist * B then return nil end
                local flat = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z).Unit
                return groundNear(hit.Position + flat * rng:NextNumber(0.8, 2) * B)
            end
            ignore[#ignore + 1] = inst
            origin = hit.Position
        end
    end
    -- A real crowd: at least 3 humanoids (not you, Herobrine or the script's mobs) all within
    -- 4 blocks of one of them - people standing together, not a spread-out server.
    local function crowd()
        local people = {}
        for _, h in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if h:IsA("Humanoid") and h.Health > 0 and h.Parent ~= character and h.Parent ~= model and not h.Parent:GetAttribute("MinecraftMob") then
                local r = h.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if r and (r.Position - root.Position).Magnitude < CONFIG.HerobrineMaxDistance * B then people[#people + 1] = r end
            end
        end
        local best, bestCentre
        for _, a in ipairs(people) do
            local group = {}
            for _, b in ipairs(people) do if (a.Position - b.Position).Magnitude <= 4 * B then group[#group + 1] = b end end
            if #group >= 3 and (not best or #group > #best) then
                local c = Vector3.zero
                for _, r in ipairs(group) do c = c + r.Position end
                best, bestCentre = group, c / #group
            end
        end
        return best, bestCentre
    end

    -- Encounter state ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local state = nil -- {mode, position, previous, yaw, target, ...}
    local lastEncounter = -math.huge
    local function vanish(reason)
        log("vanished:", reason)
        if model then model:Destroy() end
        model, parts, eyes, state = nil, nil, nil, nil
        lastEncounter = os.clock()
    end
    local function begin(mode, position, extra)
        build()
        state = {mode = mode, position = position, previous = position, yaw = facingPlayer(position), vy = 0,
            limb = 0, limbAmount = 0, limbOld = 0, age = 0, phase = "idle", seenTime = 0, wasSeen = false, started = os.clock()}
        for k, v in pairs(extra or {}) do state[k] = v end
        log("encounter:", mode)
    end
    local function tryWallWalk()
        for _ = 1, 60 do
            local s = coverPoint(CONFIG.HerobrineMinDistance, CONFIG.HerobrineMaxDistance, math.rad(45))
            if s and coveredCount(s, facingPlayer(s)) == 8 then
                -- Across your view to the nearest other cover, in either direction.
                local away = (s - root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                local side = away.Unit:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
                local first = rng:NextNumber() < 0.5 and 1 or -1
                for _, sign in ipairs({first, -first}) do
                    for d = 4, 14 do
                        local e = groundNear(s + side * sign * d * B)
                        if e and math.abs(e.Y - s.Y) < 1.5 * B and coveredCount(e, facingPlayer(e)) == 8 then
                            local mid = (s + e) / 2
                            if visibleCount(mid, facingPlayer(mid)) >= 3 and pathClear(s, e) then
                                begin("wall", s, {target = e, phase = "walk"})
                                return true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function tryPeek()
        for _ = 1, 40 do
            local s = coverPoint(CONFIG.HerobrineMinDistance, CONFIG.HerobrineMaxDistance * 0.8, math.rad(40))
            if s and coveredCount(s, facingPlayer(s)) == 8 then
                local away = (s - root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
                local side = away.Unit:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
                -- Slide along the cover in both directions to its edge, where only a sliver shows.
                for _, sign in ipairs({1, -1}) do
                    for step = 1, 14 do
                        local p = s + side * sign * step * 0.25 * B
                        if not pathClear(s, p) then break end
                        local yaw = facingPlayer(p)
                        local count, head = visibleCount(p, yaw)
                        -- Only a sliver shows (head included); everything else is behind the wall itself.
                        if head and count >= 1 and count <= 3 and coveredCount(p, yaw) >= 8 - count then
                            -- Appear fully behind the cover, then lean out to the peeking spot.
                            begin("peek", s, {hide = s, peekAt = p, phase = "stepOut", crouch = rng:NextNumber() < 0.4})
                            return true
                        end
                        if count > 3 then break end -- past the edge: he would be in plain view
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function tryCrowd()
        local group, centre = crowd()
        if not group then return false end
        -- Tuck in behind the crowd (from your point of view) where the bodies hide him: the best of
        -- many spots just past the group's centre, with his head unseen and at most one body point showing.
        local away = (centre - root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
        if away.Magnitude < CONFIG.HerobrineMinDistance * 0.6 * B then return false end
        local side = away.Unit:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
        local best, bestCount
        for _ = 1, 40 do
            local p = groundNear(centre + away.Unit * rng:NextNumber(0.6, 2.5) * B + side * rng:NextNumber(-1.5, 1.5) * B)
            if p and (p - centre).Magnitude <= 4 * B then
                local count, head = visibleCount(p, facingPlayer(p))
                if not head and count <= 1 and (not bestCount or count < bestCount) then best, bestCount = p, count end
                if bestCount == 0 then break end
            end
        end
        if not best then return false end
        begin("crowd", best, {crowdCentre = centre, group = group})
        return true
    end
    -- Behind you: 3-5 blocks straight back from where you look, on the ground, fully out of view.
    local function tryBehind()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return false end
        local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        local baseYaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z) + math.pi
        for _ = 1, 8 do
            local yaw = baseYaw + rng:NextNumber(-math.rad(25), math.rad(25))
            local dist = rng:NextNumber(3, 5) * B
            local p = groundNear(root.Position + Vector3.new(-math.sin(yaw), 0, -math.cos(yaw)) * dist)
            if p and math.abs(p.Y - (root.Position.Y - root.Size.Y / 2)) < 1.5 * B and pathClear(root.Position, p + Vector3.new(0, B, 0))
                and visibleCount(p, facingPlayer(p)) == 0 then
                begin("behind", p, {phase = "idle"})
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function tryStart()
        local options = {{CONFIG.HerobrineWallWalkWeight, tryWallWalk}, {CONFIG.HerobrinePeekWeight, tryPeek},
            {CONFIG.HerobrineBehindWeight or 0, tryBehind}}
        if crowd() then options[#options + 1] = {CONFIG.HerobrineCrowdWeight, tryCrowd} end
        local total = 0
        for _, o in ipairs(options) do total = total + o[1] end
        local pick = rng:NextNumber() * total
        for i, o in ipairs(options) do
            pick = pick - o[1]
            if pick <= 0 or i == #options then
                if o[2]() then return true end
                break
            end
        end
        -- the chosen kind found no spot here: try the others once
        for _, o in ipairs(options) do if o[1] > 0 and o[2]() then return true end end
        return false
    end

    -- Player motion (so he can mirror sprinting and bunny hopping) ----------------------------
    local player = {speed = 0, airborne = false, hops = 0, last = root.Position, lastJump = -math.huge}
    local function trackPlayer()
        local delta = root.Position - player.last
        player.last = root.Position
        player.speed = (delta * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude / B -- blocks per tick
        local rising = delta.Y / B > 0.2
        if rising and not player.airborne then player.lastJump = os.clock() end
        player.airborne = math.abs(delta.Y / B) > 0.02
    end
    -- An escape point: hidden, away from you, reachable in a straight line.
    local function hidingSpot(from)
        local away = ((from - root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Unit
        local best
        for _ = 1, 24 do
            local angle = rng:NextNumber(-1.3, 1.3)
            local dir = CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0):VectorToWorldSpace(away)
            local p = groundNear(from + dir * rng:NextNumber(3, 10) * B)
            if p and pathClear(from, p) then
                if visibleCount(p, facingPlayer(p)) == 0 then return p end
                best = best or p
            end
        end
        return best or from + away * 8 * B
    end

    -- Re-planning as your view moves --------------------------------------------------------------
    -- A spot near `from` hidden from your current position (every body point behind walls), reachable
    -- in a straight line and not too close to you; the nearest one wins.
    local function coveredSpotNear(from, radius)
        local best, bestDist
        for _ = 1, 28 do
            local angle = rng:NextNumber(-math.pi, math.pi)
            local p = groundNear(from + Vector3.new(math.sin(angle), 0, math.cos(angle)) * rng:NextNumber(0.5, radius) * B)
            if p and (p - root.Position).Magnitude > CONFIG.HerobrineVanishDistance * 1.5 * B and pathClear(from, p) then
                if exposure(p, facingPlayer(p)) == 0 then
                    local d = (p - from).Magnitude
                    if not bestDist or d < bestDist then best, bestDist = p, d end
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    -- From full cover, slide sideways (relative to where you stand now) to the edge where only a sliver shows.
    local function edgeFrom(from)
        local away = (from - root.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
        if away.Magnitude < 0.5 then return nil end
        local side = away.Unit:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
        local order = rng:NextNumber() < 0.5 and {1, -1} or {-1, 1}
        for _, sign in ipairs(order) do
            for k = 1, 24 do
                local p = from + side * sign * k * 0.25 * B
                if not pathClear(from, p) then break end
                local count, head = exposure(p, facingPlayer(p))
                if head and count >= 1 and count <= 3 then return p end
                if count > 3 then break end -- past the edge: he would be in plain view
            end
        end
    end
    -- Your camera moved: check his plan against the new point of view and re-route if it fails.
    local function viewChanged(s)
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return false end
        local cf = camera.CFrame
        local last = s.planView
        if not last then s.planView = cf; return true end
        local moved = (cf.Position - last.Position).Magnitude > 0.3 * B
            or math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(cf.LookVector:Dot(last.LookVector), -1, 1))) > 6
        if moved then s.planView = cf end
        return moved
    end
    local function replan(s)
        if s.mode == "crowd" then return end
        if s.mode == "peek" and not s.noticed and (s.phase == "idle" or s.phase == "stepOut" or s.phase == "hidden") then
            local spot = s.phase == "stepOut" and s.peekAt or s.position
            local count, head = exposure(spot, facingPlayer(spot))
            if s.phase == "hidden" or count > 3 or (s.phase == "idle" and not head) then
                -- The peek no longer works from where you are: back into full cover, then lean out at the
                -- edge that matches your new position (or wait hidden until one does).
                local hide = s.hide
                if not hide or exposure(hide, facingPlayer(hide)) > 0 then hide = coveredSpotNear(s.position, 5) end
                if hide then
                    s.hide = hide
                    s.peekAt = edgeFrom(hide)
                    s.target = hide
                    s.phase = "reposition"
                end
            end
        elseif s.phase == "walk" then
            if exposure(s.target, facingPlayer(s.target)) > 0 then
                -- The far wall stopped covering him from your new position: go to the nearest covered spot.
                local alt = coveredSpotNear(s.target, 6) or coveredSpotNear(s.position, 6)
                if alt then s.target = alt end
            end
        elseif s.phase == "flee" or s.phase == "hide" or s.phase == "reposition" then
            if s.target and exposure(s.target, facingPlayer(s.target)) > 0 then
                local alt = coveredSpotNear(s.position, 10)
                if alt then
                    s.target = alt
                    if s.phase == "reposition" then s.hide = alt; s.peekAt = edgeFrom(alt) end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Movement (Java player speeds in blocks/tick: walk 0.216, sprint 0.281, sprint-jump ~0.33) --
    local function step(goal, run, hop, crouch)
        local s = state
        s.previous = s.position
        local flat = (goal - s.position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
        local speed = (crouch and 0.065 or run and (hop and 0.33 or 0.281) or 0.216) * B
        local move = Vector3.zero
        if flat.Magnitude > speed then move = flat.Unit * speed elseif flat.Magnitude > 0 then move = flat end
        if move.Magnitude > 0 then s.yaw = math.atan2(-move.X, -move.Z) end
        moveParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = exclusions()
        local params = moveParams
        local grounded = workspace:Raycast(s.position + Vector3.new(0, 0.3 * B, 0), Vector3.new(0, -0.35 * B, 0), params) ~= nil
        -- step up / jump a 1-block ledge like the player, hop when mirroring a bunny hop
        local knee = move.Magnitude > 0 and workspace:Raycast(s.position + Vector3.new(0, 0.3 * B, 0), move.Unit * 0.5 * B, params)
        if grounded and ((hop and move.Magnitude > 0) or knee) then s.vy = 0.42 end
        s.vy = (s.vy - 0.08) * 0.98
        if grounded and s.vy < 0 then s.vy = 0 end
        local wall = move.Magnitude > 0 and workspace:Raycast(s.position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2 * B, 0), move.Unit * 0.4 * B, params)
        if wall then move = Vector3.zero end
        local nextPos = s.position + move + Vector3.new(0, s.vy * B, 0)
        local floor = workspace:Raycast(nextPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.6 * B, 0), Vector3.new(0, -0.6 * B + math.min(0, s.vy * B), 0), params)
        if floor and s.vy <= 0 then nextPos = Vector3.new(nextPos.X, floor.Position.Y, nextPos.Z); s.vy = 0 end
        s.position = nextPos
        s.crouch = crouch
        -- WalkAnimationState: speed = min(distance * 4, 1), smoothed by 0.4, position advances by speed.
        local distance = (move / B).Magnitude
        s.limbOld = s.limbAmount
        s.limbAmount = s.limbAmount + (math.min(distance * 4, 1) - s.limbAmount) * 0.4
        s.limb = s.limb + s.limbAmount
        s.airborne = not grounded
        return flat.Magnitude <= speed + 0.01
    end

    -- Behaviour per game tick ------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function noticed(dt)
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return false end
        local count, head = visibleCount(state.position, state.yaw)
        if count > 0 then state.wasSeen = true end
        local headPoint = state.position + Vector3.new(0, 28 * px, 0)
        local dir = (headPoint - camera.CFrame.Position).Unit
        local looking = head and math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(dir:Dot(camera.CFrame.LookVector), -1, 1))) < CONFIG.HerobrineNoticeAngle
        local close = count > 0 and (state.position - root.Position).Magnitude < 12 * B
        state.seenTime = (looking or close) and state.seenTime + dt or 0
        return state.seenTime > 0.3, count
    end
    local function tick(dt)
        trackPlayer()
        local s = state
        s.age = s.age + 1
        local distance = (s.position - root.Position).Magnitude / B
        if distance < (s.mode == "behind" and 1.5 or CONFIG.HerobrineVanishDistance) then vanish("too close"); return end
        if distance > CONFIG.HerobrineMaxDistance * 2 then vanish("left behind"); return end
        local wasNoticed = s.noticed
        local isNoticed, visible = noticed(dt)
        -- Behind you: gone the instant any part of him is on your screen; otherwise he waits ~30 s.
        if s.mode == "behind" then
            if visible > 0 then vanish("seen behind you"); return end
            if os.clock() - s.started > 30 then vanish("never noticed"); return end
            s.yaw = facingPlayer(s.position)
            step(s.position, false, false, false)
            return
        end
        if isNoticed and not wasNoticed then
            s.noticed = true
            log("noticed")
            if s.mode == "crowd" then s.phase = "intoCrowd"
            elseif s.mode == "peek" then s.phase = "hide"; s.target = s.hide
            else s.phase = "flee"; s.target = hidingSpot(s.position) end
        end
        -- Once noticed he vanishes the moment no part of him can be seen.
        if s.noticed and visible == 0 then vanish("hidden after being noticed"); return end
        -- Follow your point of view: re-check the hiding plan when the camera moves (and twice a second).
        if (viewChanged(s) or s.age % 10 == 0) and os.clock() - (s.lastPlan or 0) > 0.15 then
            s.lastPlan = os.clock()
            replan(s)
        end
        -- Mirror the player: run if you run at him, hop if you bunny hop.
        local chasing = s.noticed and player.speed > 0.23
        local hopping = chasing and os.clock() - player.lastJump < 0.6
        if s.phase == "walk" then
            local arrived = step(s.target, false, false, false)
            if arrived and visible == 0 then vanish("reached the other wall"); return end
            if arrived then s.phase = "flee"; s.target = hidingSpot(s.position) end
        elseif s.phase == "idle" then
            step(s.position, false, false, s.crouch)
            s.yaw = facingPlayer(s.position)
            if s.mode == "crowd" and s.group then
                -- blend in: drift with the nearest member of the crowd
                local nearest, best = nil, math.huge
                for _, r in ipairs(s.group) do
                    if r.Parent then local d = (r.Position - s.position).Magnitude; if d < best then nearest, best = r, d end end
                end
                if nearest and best > 3 * B then step(nearest.Position - (nearest.Position - s.position).Unit * 2 * B, false, false, false) end
            end
            if os.clock() - s.started > 45 and visible == 0 then vanish("waited unseen"); return end
        elseif s.phase == "stepOut" then
            -- Lean out from behind the cover slowly (sneak speed), then hold still and watch.
            local arrived = step(s.peekAt, false, false, true)
            if arrived then
                -- Land exactly on the checked spot: a few centimetres decide whether his head shows.
                s.position = Vector3.new(s.peekAt.X, s.position.Y, s.peekAt.Z)
                s.phase = "idle"
            end
            s.yaw = facingPlayer(s.position)
        elseif s.phase == "reposition" then
            -- Back behind cover (sneaking), then lean out at the new edge or wait there hidden.
            local arrived = step(s.target, false, false, true)
            if arrived then
                if s.peekAt then s.phase = "stepOut" else s.phase = "hidden" end
            end
        elseif s.phase == "hidden" then
            step(s.position, false, false, s.crouch)
            s.yaw = facingPlayer(s.position)
            if os.clock() - s.started > 45 then vanish("waited unseen"); return end
        elseif s.phase == "hide" then
            local arrived = step(s.target, chasing, hopping, false)
            if arrived then s.phase = "flee"; s.target = hidingSpot(s.position) end
        elseif s.phase == "intoCrowd" then
            local arrived = step(s.crowdCentre, chasing, hopping, false)
            if arrived then s.phase = "flee"; s.target = hidingSpot(s.position) end
        elseif s.phase == "flee" then
            local arrived = step(s.target, chasing or s.noticed, hopping, false)
            if arrived then s.target = hidingSpot(s.position) end
        end
        if os.clock() - s.started > 120 then vanish("timed out") end
    end

    -- Rendering: Java HumanoidModel.setupAnim ---------------------------------------------------
    local lastTick = os.clock()
    local function render()
        local s = state
        if not s or not model then return end
        local alpha = math.clamp((os.clock() - lastTick) / CONFIG.Tick, 0, 1)
        local position = s.previous:Lerp(s.position, alpha)
        local limb = s.limb - s.limbAmount * (1 - alpha)
