        local amount = s.limbOld + (s.limbAmount - s.limbOld) * alpha
        local age = s.age + alpha
        local base = CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, s.yaw, 0)
        -- Java angles become negative X/Y rotations in this Roblox frame (Y flipped, X mirrored).
        local rightArm = math.cos(limb * 0.6662 + math.pi) * 2 * amount * 0.5
        local leftArm = math.cos(limb * 0.6662) * 2 * amount * 0.5
        local rightLeg = math.cos(limb * 0.6662) * 1.4 * amount
        local leftLeg = math.cos(limb * 0.6662 + math.pi) * 1.4 * amount
        local armZ = math.cos(age * 0.09) * 0.05 + 0.05
        local armX = math.sin(age * 0.067) * 0.05
        -- HumanoidModel crouching: body leans 0.5 rad and drops 3.2px, head 4.2px, arms 3.2px,
        -- legs only 0.2px but move 4px back.
        local body, legZ = 0, 0
        local drop = {Head = 0, Torso = 0, ["Right Arm"] = 0, ["Left Arm"] = 0, ["Right Leg"] = 0, ["Left Leg"] = 0}
        if s.crouch then
            body, legZ = 0.5, 4; rightArm, leftArm = rightArm + 0.4, leftArm + 0.4
            drop = {Head = -4.2, Torso = -3.2, ["Right Arm"] = -3.2, ["Left Arm"] = -3.2, ["Right Leg"] = -0.2, ["Left Leg"] = -0.2}
        end
        if s.airborne then rightLeg, leftLeg = rightLeg * 0.6, leftLeg * 0.6 end
        -- head looks at you, within the 50 degree head turn
        local toPlayer = root.Position - (position + Vector3.new(0, 26 * px, 0))
        local localDir = base:VectorToObjectSpace(toPlayer)
        local headYaw = math.clamp(math.atan2(-localDir.X, -localDir.Z), -math.rad(50), math.rad(50))
        local headPitch = math.atan2(localDir.Y, math.sqrt(localDir.X ^ 2 + localDir.Z ^ 2))
        local poses = {
            Head = CFrame.Angles(0, headYaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(headPitch, 0, 0),
            Torso = CFrame.Angles(-body, 0, 0),
            ["Right Arm"] = CFrame.Angles(-(rightArm + armX), 0, armZ),
            ["Left Arm"] = CFrame.Angles(-(leftArm - armX), 0, -armZ),
            ["Right Leg"] = CFrame.Angles(-rightLeg, 0, 0),
            ["Left Leg"] = CFrame.Angles(-leftLeg, 0, 0),
        }
        for name, def in pairs(layout) do
            local pivot = def.pivot + Vector3.new(0, drop[name], 0)
            if s.crouch and name:find("Leg") then pivot = pivot + Vector3.new(0, 0, legZ) end
            if s.crouch and name:find("Arm") then pivot = pivot + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
            parts[name].CFrame = base * CFrame.new(pivot * px) * poses[name] * CFrame.new(def.offset * px)
        end
        local head = parts.Head.CFrame * CFrame.new(-layout.Head.offset * px)
        for _, eye in ipairs(eyes) do eye.part.CFrame = head * CFrame.new(layout.Head.offset * px + eye.offset) end
    end

    -- Scheduling --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local accumulator, nextRoll = 0, os.clock() + 60
    ctx.connections[#ctx.connections + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not CONFIG.HerobrineEnabled or not root.Parent then if state then vanish("disabled") end return end
        if state then
            accumulator = accumulator + dt
            while state and accumulator >= CONFIG.Tick do
                accumulator = accumulator - CONFIG.Tick
                lastTick = os.clock()
                tick(CONFIG.Tick)
            end
        elseif os.clock() >= nextRoll then
            nextRoll = os.clock() + 60
            if os.clock() - lastEncounter >= CONFIG.HerobrineCooldown and rng:NextNumber() * 100 < CONFIG.HerobrineChancePerMinute then
                if not tryStart() then log("no hiding place found this time") end
            end
        end
    end)
    ctx.connections[#ctx.connections + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(render)
    -- For testing from the Command Bar: _G.SteveHerobrine("wall" | "peek" | "crowd" | "behind").
    function hb.force(mode)
        if state then vanish("forced restart") end
        local ok = (mode == "peek" and tryPeek()) or (mode == "crowd" and tryCrowd()) or (mode == "wall" and tryWallWalk()) or (mode == "behind" and tryBehind()) or (mode == nil and tryStart())
        return ok and true or false
    end
    function hb.position() return state and state.position end
    function hb.destroy() if state then vanish("controller stopped") end end
    return hb
end
-- END HEROBRINE
-- BEGIN STATUS EFFECTS
-- MobEffect instances on the player: durations tick at 20 Hz, modifiers feed PlayerStats,
-- periodic effects (regeneration, poison, wither, hunger...) act on the Humanoid, and the
-- HUD shows Java's effect icons in the top-right corner (Gui.renderEffects).
local HARMFUL_EFFECTS = {slowness = true, mining_fatigue = true, instant_damage = true, nausea = true, blindness = true,
    hunger = true, weakness = true, poison = true, wither = true, levitation = true, unluck = true, darkness = true,
    infested = true, oozing = true, weaving = true, wind_charged = true}
local NEUTRAL_EFFECTS = {glowing = true, bad_omen = true, trial_omen = true, raid_omen = true}
local function createStatusEffects(ctx)
    local fx = {active = {}}
    local humanoid, gui, character = ctx.humanoid, ctx.gui, ctx.character
    local G = JavaContent.data.javaGui
    -- 1 Java health point in Humanoid health.
    local function hp(amount) return amount * humanoid.MaxHealth / 20 end
    function fx.has(id) return fx.active[id] ~= nil end
    function fx.level(id) local e = fx.active[id]; return e and e.amplifier + 1 or 0 end
    -- MobEffectInstance.update(): a stronger or longer instance replaces the old one.
    function fx.give(id, seconds, amplifier, hideParticles, infinite)
        amplifier = amplifier or 0
        local ticks = infinite and math.huge or math.floor((seconds or 30) * 20)
        local old = fx.active[id]
        if old and (old.amplifier > amplifier or (old.amplifier == amplifier and old.duration >= ticks)) then return false end
        fx.active[id] = {amplifier = amplifier, duration = ticks, total = ticks, ambient = false, particles = not hideParticles, age = 0}
        -- Instant effects apply once.
        if id == "instant_health" then humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.MaxHealth, humanoid.Health + hp(4 * 2 ^ amplifier)); fx.active[id] = nil
        elseif id == "instant_damage" then humanoid:TakeDamage(hp(6 * 2 ^ amplifier)); fx.active[id] = nil
        elseif id == "saturation" and ctx.gameplay() then ctx.gameplay().hunger = math.min(20, ctx.gameplay().hunger + amplifier + 1) end
        fx.changed = true
        return true
    end
    function fx.clear(id)
        if id then local had = fx.active[id] ~= nil; fx.active[id] = nil; fx.changed = true; return had end
        local n = 0
        for _ in pairs(fx.active) do n = n + 1 end
        fx.active, fx.changed = {}, true
        return n > 0
    end
    -- Night vision / blindness / invisibility visuals and the PlayerStats modifiers.
    local colour = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
    colour.Name, colour.Enabled, colour.Parent = "SteveEffects", false, game:GetService("Lighting")
    local glow
    local function apply()
        local speed = 1 + 0.2 * fx.level("speed") - 0.15 * fx.level("slowness")
        PlayerStats.movementSpeed = (PlayerStats.baseMovementSpeed or 0.1) * math.max(0, speed)
        PlayerStats.jumpBoost = 0.1 * fx.level("jump_boost")
        PlayerStats.levitation = fx.has("levitation") and fx.level("levitation") or nil
        PlayerStats.slowFalling = fx.has("slow_falling")
        local dig = 1 + 0.2 * fx.level("haste") + (fx.has("conduit_power") and 0.2 * fx.level("conduit_power") or 0)
        if fx.has("mining_fatigue") then dig = dig * ({0.3, 0.09, 0.0027, 0.00081})[math.min(fx.level("mining_fatigue"), 4)] end
        PlayerStats.digMultiplier = dig * (PlayerStats.blockBreakSpeed or 1)
        PlayerStats.attackBonus = 3 * fx.level("strength") - 4 * fx.level("weakness") + (PlayerStats.attackAttributeBonus or 0)
        local night, blind = fx.has("night_vision"), fx.has("blindness")
        colour.Enabled = night or blind
        colour.Brightness = blind and -0.6 or night and 0.25 or 0
        colour.Contrast = blind and 0.3 or night and 0.1 or 0
        for _, p in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then p.LocalTransparencyModifier = fx.has("invisibility") and 1 or 0 end
        end
        if fx.has("glowing") and not glow then
            glow = Instance.new("Highlight"); glow.FillTransparency, glow.OutlineColor = 1, Color3.new(1, 1, 1); glow.Parent = character
        elseif not fx.has("glowing") and glow then glow:Destroy(); glow = nil end
    end
    -- HUD icons --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local hud = Instance.new("Frame")
    hud.Name, hud.BackgroundTransparency, hud.ZIndex, hud.Parent = "JavaEffects", 1, 2, gui
    local scale = Instance.new("UIScale"); scale.Parent = hud
    local icons = {}
    local function drawHud(tick)
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
        local s = JavaGui.scale(viewport)
        scale.Scale = s
        hud.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(viewport.X / s), math.floor(viewport.Y / s))
        local W = math.floor(viewport.X / s)
        for _, node in ipairs(icons) do node:Destroy() end
        icons = {}
        local good, bad = 0, 0
        local ids = {}
        for id in pairs(fx.active) do ids[#ids + 1] = id end
        table.sort(ids)
        for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
            local e = fx.active[id]
            if G["effect/" .. id] then
                local harmful = HARMFUL_EFFECTS[id]
                local x, y
                if harmful then bad = bad + 1; x, y = W - 25 * bad, 26 else good = good + 1; x, y = W - 25 * good, 1 end
                local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
                frame.BackgroundTransparency, frame.Position, frame.Size, frame.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), 3
                JavaGui.image(frame, G[e.ambient and "hud/effect_background_ambient" or "hud/effect_background"], 0, 0, nil, nil, nil, 3)
                local icon = JavaGui.image(frame, G["effect/" .. id], 3, 3, nil, nil, nil, 4)
                -- In the last 10 seconds the icon pulses (Java's flashing alpha).
                if e.duration <= 200 and icon:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                    local d = e.duration
                    local alpha = math.clamp(d / 10 / 5 * 0.5, 0, 0.5) + math.cos(d * math.pi / 5) * math.clamp((10 - math.floor(d / 20)) / 10 * 0.25, 0, 0.25)
                    icon.ImageTransparency = 1 - alpha
                end
                frame.Parent = hud
                icons[#icons + 1] = frame
            end
        end
    end
    -- Ticking ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local acc, tickCount = 0, 0
    ctx.connections[#ctx.connections + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        acc = acc + dt
        while acc >= 0.05 do
            acc = acc - 0.05
            tickCount = tickCount + 1
            for id, e in pairs(fx.active) do
                e.age = e.age + 1
                local a = e.amplifier
                -- MobEffect.shouldApplyEffectTickThisTick(): interval 50/25/40/80 >> amplifier.
                local function every(base) local interval = math.floor(base / 2 ^ a); return interval <= 0 or e.age % interval == 0 end
                if id == "regeneration" and every(50) and humanoid.Health < humanoid.MaxHealth then humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.MaxHealth, humanoid.Health + hp(1))
                elseif id == "poison" and every(25) and humanoid.Health > hp(1) then humanoid.Health = math.max(hp(1), humanoid.Health - hp(1))
                elseif id == "wither" and every(40) then humanoid:TakeDamage(hp(1))
                elseif id == "hunger" and ctx.gameplay() then
                    local g = ctx.gameplay(); g.exhaustion = (g.exhaustion or 0) + 0.005 * (a + 1)
                    if g.exhaustion >= 4 then g.exhaustion = g.exhaustion - 4; g.hunger = math.max(0, g.hunger - 1) end
                elseif id == "saturation" and ctx.gameplay() then local g = ctx.gameplay(); g.hunger = math.min(20, g.hunger + a + 1)
                elseif id == "darkness" and ctx.darkness then ctx.darkness() end
                e.duration = e.duration - 1
                if e.duration <= 0 then fx.active[id] = nil; fx.changed = true end
            end
            if fx.changed or tickCount % 10 == 0 then fx.changed = false; apply(); drawHud(tickCount) end
        end
    end)
    function fx.destroy() colour:Destroy(); hud:Destroy(); if glow then glow:Destroy() end end
    return fx
end
-- END STATUS EFFECTS
-- BEGIN CHAT
-- Java chat (ChatScreen / ChatComponent / CommandSuggestions) and the 26.3 single-player
-- command set, parsed Brigadier-style with Java's own messages from lang/en_us.json.
local function createChat(ctx)
    local chat = {open = false, lines = {}, history = {}, scores = {}, objectives = {}, display = {}, teams = {},
        bossbars = {}, stopwatches = {}, gamerules = {}, randomSeeds = {}, time = 6000, gameTime = 0, weather = "clear",
        difficulty = "normal", border = {centre = Vector2.new(0, 0), size = 59999968, damage = 0.2, buffer = 5, warning = 5, warningTime = 15}}
    local LANG = JavaContent.data.lang or {}
    local B = CONFIG.Block
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local player, root, humanoid = ctx.player, ctx.root, ctx.humanoid
    for name, rule in pairs(JavaContent.data.gamerules or {}) do chat.gamerules[name] = rule.default end
    chat.seed = tostring(Random.new():NextInteger(-2 ^ 31, 2 ^ 31 - 1)) .. tostring(Random.new():NextInteger(0, 99999))

    -- Text ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local COLORS = {black = 0x000000, dark_blue = 0x0000AA, dark_green = 0x00AA00, dark_aqua = 0x00AAAA, dark_red = 0xAA0000,
        dark_purple = 0xAA00AA, gold = 0xFFAA00, gray = 0xAAAAAA, dark_gray = 0x555555, blue = 0x5555FF, green = 0x55FF55,
        aqua = 0x55FFFF, red = 0xFF5555, light_purple = 0xFF55FF, yellow = 0xFFFF55, white = 0xFFFFFF}
    local CODES = {["0"] = "black", ["1"] = "dark_blue", ["2"] = "dark_green", ["3"] = "dark_aqua", ["4"] = "dark_red", ["5"] = "dark_purple",
        ["6"] = "gold", ["7"] = "gray", ["8"] = "dark_gray", ["9"] = "blue", a = "green", b = "aqua", c = "red", d = "light_purple", e = "yellow", f = "white"}
    local function rgb(c) return Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(c / 65536) % 256, math.floor(c / 256) % 256, c % 256) end
    local function colorOf(name)
        if type(name) == "number" then return rgb(name) end
        if type(name) == "string" and name:sub(1, 1) == "#" then return rgb(tonumber(name:sub(2), 16) or 0xFFFFFF) end
        return rgb(COLORS[name or "white"] or 0xFFFFFF)
    end
    -- Language: %s and %n$s placeholders, like Java's TranslatableContents.
    local function T(key, ...)
        local fmt = LANG[key] or key
        local args = table.pack(...)
        local i = 0
        fmt = fmt:gsub("%%(%d+)%$s", function(n) return tostring(args[tonumber(n)]) end)
        fmt = fmt:gsub("%%[sd]", function() i = i + 1; return tostring(args[i]) end)
        return (fmt:gsub("%%%%", "%%"))
    end
    chat.T = T
    -- Segments: {text, color, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough}.
    local function seg(text, color, style) style = style or {}; return {text = tostring(text), color = colorOf(color), bold = style.bold, italic = style.italic, underline = style.underline} end
    -- Legacy section-sign codes inside plain text.
    local function parseLegacy(text, color)
        local out, current, bold = {}, color or "white", false
        local buffer = ""
        local i = 1
        while i <= #text do
            local c = text:sub(i, i)
            if (c == "\194" and text:sub(i + 1, i + 1) == "\167") or c == "\167" then
                local skip = c == "\194" and 2 or 1
                local code = text:sub(i + skip, i + skip):lower()
                if buffer ~= "" then out[#out + 1] = seg(buffer, current, {bold = bold}); buffer = "" end
                if CODES[code] then current, bold = CODES[code], false elseif code == "l" then bold = true elseif code == "r" then current, bold = color or "white", false end
                i = i + skip + 1
            else buffer = buffer .. c; i = i + 1 end
        end
        if buffer ~= "" then out[#out + 1] = seg(buffer, current, {bold = bold}) end
        return out
    end
    -- JSON / SNBT text components (tellraw, title, bossbar names, team prefixes).
    local function component(value, inherit, source)
        inherit = inherit or {}
        local out = {}
        local function add(v, style)
            if type(v) == "string" then for _, s in ipairs(parseLegacy(v, style.color)) do s.bold = s.bold or style.bold; s.italic = style.italic; out[#out + 1] = s end
            elseif type(v) == "number" or type(v) == "boolean" then out[#out + 1] = seg(tostring(v), style.color, style)
            elseif type(v) == "table" then
                if #v > 0 then
                    local first = v[1]
                    local base = style
                    if type(first) == "table" then base = {color = first.color or style.color, bold = first.bold or style.bold, italic = first.italic or style.italic} end
                    add(first, style)
                    for i = 2, #v do add(v[i], base) end
                    return
                end
                local st = {color = v.color or style.color, bold = v.bold == nil and style.bold or v.bold, italic = v.italic == nil and style.italic or v.italic, underline = v.underlined}
                if v.text ~= nil then add(tostring(v.text), st)
                elseif v.translate then
                    local args = {}
                    for _, w in ipairs(v.with or v.args or {}) do
                        local parts = component(w, st, source); local t = ""
                        for _, p in ipairs(parts) do t = t .. p.text end
                        args[#args + 1] = t
                    end
                    add(LANG[v.translate] and T(v.translate, table.unpack(args)) or (v.fallback or v.translate), st)
                elseif v.score then
                    local s = chat.scores[v.score.name == "*" and player.Name or v.score.name]
                    add(tostring(s and s[v.score.objective] or ""), st)
                elseif v.selector and source then
                    local ok, list = pcall(chat.select, v.selector, source)
                    local names = {}
                    for _, e in ipairs(ok and list or {}) do names[#names + 1] = e.name end
                    add(table.concat(names, ", "), st)
                elseif v.keybind then add(v.keybind:gsub("^key%.", ""), st)
                elseif v.nbt then add("", st) end
                if v.extra then for _, x in ipairs(v.extra) do add(x, st) end end
            end
        end
        add(value, {color = inherit.color, bold = inherit.bold, italic = inherit.italic})
        return out
    end
    chat.component = component
    -- Relaxed SNBT -> JSON for text components ({text:"hi",color:red} or 'hi').
    local function decodeComponent(raw)
        local ok, value = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, raw)
        if ok then return value end
        local s = raw
        if s:sub(1, 1) == "'" and s:sub(-1) == "'" then return s:sub(2, -2) end
        s = s:gsub("([{,]%s*)([%w_]+)%s*:", '%1"%2":'):gsub("'", '"')
        s = s:gsub(":%s*([%a_][%w_]*)%s*([,}])", function(word, tail)
            if word == "true" or word == "false" or word == "null" then return ":" .. word .. tail end
            return ':"' .. word .. '"' .. tail
        end)
        ok, value = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, s)
        if ok then return value end
        return nil
    end

    -- Reader and errors (Brigadier StringReader / CommandSyntaxException) -------------------------
    local function newReader(s, i) return {s = s, i = i or 1} end
    local function canRead(r, n) return r.i + (n or 1) - 1 <= #r.s end
    local function peek(r, o) local k = r.i + (o or 0); return r.s:sub(k, k) end
    local function readWhile(r, pattern)
        local start = r.i
        while canRead(r) and peek(r):match(pattern) do r.i = r.i + 1 end
        return r.s:sub(start, r.i - 1)
    end
    local function fail(r, key, ...) error({pos = r and r.i or 0, msg = T(key, ...)}, 0) end
    local function failAt(pos, key, ...) error({pos = pos, msg = T(key, ...)}, 0) end
    local function readToken(r) return readWhile(r, "[^ ]") end
    local function readUnquoted(r) return readWhile(r, "[%w_%-%.%+]") end
    local function readQuoted(r)
        local q = peek(r)
        if q ~= '"' and q ~= "'" then fail(r, "parsing.quote.expected.start") end
        r.i = r.i + 1
        local out, escaped = "", false
        while canRead(r) do
            local c = peek(r); r.i = r.i + 1
            if escaped then
                if c ~= q and c ~= "\\" then r.i = r.i - 1; fail(r, "parsing.quote.escape", c) end
                out, escaped = out .. c, false
            elseif c == "\\" then escaped = true
            elseif c == q then return out
            else out = out .. c end
        end
        fail(r, "parsing.quote.expected.end")
    end
    local function readString(r)
        if not canRead(r) then return "" end
        if peek(r) == '"' or peek(r) == "'" then return readQuoted(r) end
        return readUnquoted(r)
    end
    local function readNumber(r, integer)
        local start = r.i
        local text = readWhile(r, "[%d%.%-]")
        if text == "" then r.i = start; fail(r, integer and "parsing.int.expected" or "parsing.double.expected") end
        local n = tonumber(text)
        if not n or (integer and math.floor(n) ~= n) then r.i = start; fail(r, integer and "parsing.int.invalid" or "parsing.double.invalid", text) end
        return n
    end
    -- Balanced {...} / [...] (NBT, components) or the rest of the line.
    local function readBalanced(r)
        local open = peek(r)
        local close = open == "{" and "}" or open == "[" and "]" or nil
        if not close then return readToken(r) end
        local depth, start, quote = 0, r.i, nil
        while canRead(r) do
            local c = peek(r)
            if quote then
                if c == "\\" then r.i = r.i + 1 elseif c == quote then quote = nil end
            elseif c == '"' or c == "'" then quote = c
            elseif c == "{" or c == "[" then depth = depth + 1
            elseif c == "}" or c == "]" then depth = depth - 1; if depth == 0 then r.i = r.i + 1; return r.s:sub(start, r.i - 1) end end
            r.i = r.i + 1
        end
        fail(r, "parsing.expected", close)
    end
    local function stripNs(id) return (id:gsub("^minecraft:", "")) end

    -- Coordinates: Java block space <-> studs ------------------------------------------------------
    local function gridOrigin()
        local o = workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin")
        return typeof(o) == "Vector3" and o or Vector3.new(0, B / 2, 0)
    end
    local function toJava(studs) return (studs - gridOrigin()) / B + Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) end
    local function toStuds(java) return gridOrigin() + (java - Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)) * B end
    local function cellCentre(x, y, z) return gridOrigin() + Vector3.new(x, y, z) * B end
    chat.toJava, chat.toStuds, chat.cellCentre = toJava, toStuds, cellCentre
    -- Java yaw: 0 = south, 90 = west; pitch positive looking down. Ours: yaw radians, -Z forward.
    local function javaYaw(ourYaw) return (180 - math.deg(ourYaw) + 180) % 360 - 180 end
    local function ourYaw(jy) return math.rad(180 - jy) end
    local function fmt(n) n = math.floor(n * 1000000 + 0.5) / 1000000; return (string.format("%.6f", n):gsub("0+$", ""):gsub("%.$", "")) end

    -- Entities ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function wrapPlayer()
        local e = {type = "player", name = player.Name, isPlayer = true, uuid = tostring(player.UserId), obj = chat}
        chat.playerTags = chat.playerTags or {}
        e.tags = chat.playerTags
        function e.pos() return toJava(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2, 0)) end
        function e.rot() local y, p = ctx.getView(); return javaYaw(y), -math.deg(p) end
        function e.eye() return e.pos() + Vector3.new(0, 1.62, 0) end
        function e.teleport(p, yaw, pitch)
            ctx.teleport(toStuds(p))
            if yaw then ctx.setView(ourYaw(yaw), -math.rad(pitch or 0)) end
        end
        function e.kill() PlayerStats.killUntil = os.clock() + 1; humanoid.Health = 0 end
        function e.hurt(amount) humanoid:TakeDamage(amount * humanoid.MaxHealth / 20) end
        function e.alive() return humanoid.Health > 0 end
        return e
    end
    local function wrapMob(m)
        local e = {type = m.id, name = m.customName or T("entity.minecraft." .. m.id), uuid = m.uuid or "", obj = m}
        m.uuid = m.uuid or HttpService:GenerateGUID(false):lower(); e.uuid = m.uuid
        m.tags = m.tags or {}; e.tags = m.tags
        function e.pos() return toJava(m.position) end
        function e.rot() return javaYaw(m.yaw), 0 end
        function e.eye() return e.pos() + Vector3.new(0, m.eye or 1.6, 0) end
        function e.teleport(p, yaw) m.position = toStuds(p); m.previous = m.position; if yaw then m.yaw = ourYaw(yaw) end end
        function e.kill() m.humanoid.Health = 0 end
        function e.hurt(amount) m.humanoid:TakeDamage(amount) end
        function e.alive() return m.humanoid.Health > 0 and not m.dead end
        return e
    end
    local function wrapSimple(kind, obj, getPos, setPos, kill)
        obj.uuid = obj.uuid or HttpService:GenerateGUID(false):lower()
        obj.tags = obj.tags or {}
        local e = {type = kind, name = T("entity.minecraft." .. kind), uuid = obj.uuid, tags = obj.tags, obj = obj}
        e.pos, e.teleport, e.kill = getPos, setPos, kill
        function e.rot() return 0, 0 end
        function e.eye() return e.pos() end
        function e.hurt() kill() end
        function e.alive() return true end
        return e
    end
    function chat.entities()
        local world, gameplay = ctx.world, ctx.world.gameplay
        local list = {wrapPlayer()}
        for _, m in ipairs(gameplay.mobs) do if not m.dead then list[#list + 1] = wrapMob(m) end end
        for i, d in ipairs(world.drops) do
            local e = wrapSimple("item", d, function() return toJava(d.position) end, function(p) d.position = toStuds(p) end,
                function() d.count = 0 end)
            local entry = JavaContent.byIndex[d.id]
            e.name = entry and entry.name or e.name
            list[#list + 1] = e
        end
        for _, v in ipairs(gameplay.vehicles.list) do
            local kind = v.id == "minecart" and "minecart" or v.id
            local e = wrapSimple(kind, v, function() return v.pos end, function(p) v.pos = p; v.old = p end, function() gameplay.vehicles.attack(v.hull, 1000) end)
            list[#list + 1] = e
        end
        for _, st in ipairs((world.items and world.items.entities) or {}) do
            if st.kind == "armor_stand" then
                list[#list + 1] = wrapSimple("armor_stand", st, function() return toJava(st.position) end, function(p)
                    st.position = toStuds(p)
                    if st.box then st.box.CFrame = CFrame.new(st.position + Vector3.new(0, 0.9875 * B, 0)) end
                end, function() world.items.removeEntity(st) end)
            end
        end
        for _, t in ipairs(world.primed) do
            list[#list + 1] = wrapSimple("tnt", t, function() return toJava(t.position) end, function(p) t.position = toStuds(p) end, function() t.fuse = 1 end)
        end
        for i, a in ipairs(gameplay.arrows) do
            list[#list + 1] = wrapSimple(a.id or "arrow", a, function() return toJava(a.position) end, function(p) a.position = toStuds(p) end,
                function() a.age = 100000 end)
        end
        return list
    end
    local function teamOf(name) for id, t in pairs(chat.teams) do if t.members[name] then return id, t end end end
    chat.teamOf = teamOf
    -- Range "5", "..5", "5..", "1..3".
    local function parseRange(text, integer)
        local lo, hi = text:match("^(.-)%.%.(.*)$")
        local function num(s) if s == "" then return nil end local n = tonumber(s); if not n or (integer and math.floor(n) ~= n) then error({pos = 0, msg = T("argument.range.ints")}, 0) end return n end
        if lo then return {min = num(lo), max = num(hi)} end
        local n = num(text)
        if not n then error({pos = 0, msg = T("argument.range.empty")}, 0) end
        return {min = n, max = n}
    end
    local function inRange(range, v) return (not range.min or v >= range.min) and (not range.max or v <= range.max) end
    -- EntitySelectorParser: @p @a @r @s @e @n with [x,y,z,dx,dy,dz,distance,type,name,tag,team,limit,sort,
    -- level,gamemode,x_rotation,y_rotation,scores,nbt,predicate,advancements].
    local function parseSelector(r, singleOnly, playersOnly)
        local start = r.i
        if peek(r) ~= "@" then
            local name = readWhile(r, "[%w_%-]")
            if name == "" then fail(r, "argument.entity.invalid") end
            if #name == 36 and name:find("-") then return {uuid = name, single = true} end
            return {name = name, single = true, playersOnly = true}
        end
        r.i = r.i + 1
        local kind = peek(r); r.i = r.i + 1
        local sel = {kind = kind, filters = {}, single = kind == "p" or kind == "r" or kind == "s" or kind == "n"}
        if not ({p = 1, a = 1, r = 1, s = 1, e = 1, n = 1})[kind] then r.i = start; fail(r, "argument.entity.selector.unknown", "@" .. kind) end
        sel.playersOnly = kind == "p" or kind == "a" or kind == "r"
        if peek(r) == "[" then
            r.i = r.i + 1
            while canRead(r) and peek(r) ~= "]" do
                readWhile(r, " ")
                local key = readUnquoted(r)
                readWhile(r, " ")
                if peek(r) ~= "=" then fail(r, "argument.entity.options.valueless", key) end
                r.i = r.i + 1
                readWhile(r, " ")
                local negate = false
                if peek(r) == "!" then negate = true; r.i = r.i + 1 end
                local value
                if peek(r) == "{" or peek(r) == "[" then value = readBalanced(r)
                else
                    -- Identifier.read in selector options: namespaced ids and tags (minecraft:armor_stand, #minecraft:skeletons).
                    local prefix = ""
                    if peek(r) == "#" then prefix = "#"; r.i = r.i + 1 end
                    value = prefix .. readString(r)
                    while canRead(r) and (peek(r) == ":" or peek(r) == "/") do
                        local sep = peek(r)
                        r.i = r.i + 1
                        value = value .. sep .. readWhile(r, "[%w_%-%.%+]")
                    end
                end
                sel.filters[#sel.filters + 1] = {key = key, value = value, negate = negate}
                if key == "limit" then sel.single = tonumber(value) == 1 end
                if key == "type" and not negate and value:gsub("minecraft:", "") == "player" then sel.playersOnly = true end
                if key == "type" and not negate and kind == "r" and value:gsub("minecraft:", "") ~= "player" then sel.playersOnly = false end
                readWhile(r, " ")
                if peek(r) == "," then r.i = r.i + 1 end
            end
            if peek(r) ~= "]" then fail(r, "argument.entity.options.unterminated") end
            r.i = r.i + 1
        end
        if singleOnly and not sel.single then r.i = start; fail(r, "argument.entity.toomany") end
        -- EntityArgument.players(): @s passes the parse (isSelfSelector) and is checked when it runs.
        if playersOnly and not sel.playersOnly and kind ~= "s" then r.i = start; fail(r, "argument.player.entities") end
        return sel
    end
    -- EntitySelector.findEntities() against a command source.
    function chat.resolveSelector(sel, source)
        local all = chat.entities()
        if sel.uuid then for _, e in ipairs(all) do if e.uuid == sel.uuid then return {e} end end return {} end
        if sel.name then
            local out = {}
            for _, e in ipairs(all) do if e.isPlayer and e.name:lower() == sel.name:lower() then out[1] = e end end
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if #out == 0 and p.Name:lower() == sel.name:lower() then
                    out[1] = {type = "player", name = p.Name, isPlayer = true, remote = p, tags = {}, uuid = tostring(p.UserId),
                        pos = function() local c = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); return c and toJava(c.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)) or Vector3.zero end,
                        rot = function() return 0, 0 end, eye = function() return Vector3.zero end, teleport = function() end, kill = function() end, hurt = function() end, alive = function() return true end}
                end
            end
            return out
        end
        local origin = source.pos
        local list = {}
        if sel.kind == "s" then
            if source.entity then list = {source.entity} end
        else
            for _, e in ipairs(all) do if not sel.playersOnly or e.isPlayer then list[#list + 1] = e end end
        end
        local sort = sel.kind == "p" and "nearest" or sel.kind == "n" and "nearest" or sel.kind == "r" and "random" or "arbitrary"
        local limit = (sel.kind == "p" or sel.kind == "r" or sel.kind == "n") and 1 or math.huge
        local box, dist
        for _, f in ipairs(sel.filters) do
            local k, v, neg = f.key, f.value, f.negate
            local function keep(fn) local out = {}; for _, e in ipairs(list) do if fn(e) ~= neg then out[#out + 1] = e end end; list = out end
            if k == "x" then origin = Vector3.new(tonumber(v), origin.Y, origin.Z)
            elseif k == "y" then origin = Vector3.new(origin.X, tonumber(v), origin.Z)
            elseif k == "z" then origin = Vector3.new(origin.X, origin.Y, tonumber(v))
            elseif k == "dx" or k == "dy" or k == "dz" then box = box or {0, 0, 0}; box[k == "dx" and 1 or k == "dy" and 2 or 3] = tonumber(v)
            elseif k == "distance" then dist = parseRange(v, false)
            elseif k == "limit" then limit = tonumber(v)
            elseif k == "sort" then sort = v
            elseif k == "type" then
                local id = stripNs(v)
                if id:sub(1, 1) == "#" then
                    local tag = (JavaContent.data.entityTags or {})[stripNs(id:sub(2))] or {}
                    local set = {}; for _, t in ipairs(tag) do set[t] = true end
                    keep(function(e) return set[e.type] == true end)
                elseif id == "boat" then keep(function(e) return (e.type:match("_boat$") or e.type:match("_raft$")) ~= nil and not e.type:find("chest", 1, true) end)
                else keep(function(e) return e.type == id end) end
            elseif k == "name" then keep(function(e) return e.name == v end)
            elseif k == "tag" then keep(function(e) if v == "" then return next(e.tags) ~= nil end return e.tags[v] == true end)
            elseif k == "team" then keep(function(e) local t = teamOf(e.isPlayer and e.name or e.uuid); if v == "" then return t ~= nil end return t == v end)
            elseif k == "gamemode" then keep(function(e) return e.isPlayer and chat.gameMode() == v end)
            elseif k == "level" then local range = parseRange(v, true); keep(function(e) return e.isPlayer and inRange(range, PlayerStats.xpLevel) end)
            elseif k == "x_rotation" then local range = parseRange(v); keep(function(e) local _, p = e.rot(); return inRange(range, p) end)
            elseif k == "y_rotation" then local range = parseRange(v); keep(function(e) local y = e.rot(); return inRange(range, y) end)
            elseif k == "scores" then
                for obj, range in v:gmatch("([%w_%.%-]+)%s*=%s*([%d%.%-]+)") do
                    local rg = parseRange(range, true)
                    keep(function(e) local s = chat.scores[e.isPlayer and e.name or e.uuid]; return s ~= nil and s[obj] ~= nil and inRange(rg, s[obj]) end)
                end
            end
        end
        if box then
            local lo = origin
            local hi = origin + Vector3.new(box[1], box[2], box[3])
            local min, max = lo:Min(hi), lo:Max(hi) + Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
            local out = {}
            for _, e in ipairs(list) do
                local p = e.pos()
                if p.X >= min.X - 0.3 and p.X <= max.X + 0.3 and p.Y >= min.Y - 1.8 and p.Y <= max.Y and p.Z >= min.Z - 0.3 and p.Z <= max.Z + 0.3 then out[#out + 1] = e end
            end
            list = out
        end
        if dist then local out = {}; for _, e in ipairs(list) do if inRange(dist, (e.pos() - origin).Magnitude) then out[#out + 1] = e end end; list = out end
        if sort == "nearest" then table.sort(list, function(a, b) return (a.pos() - origin).Magnitude < (b.pos() - origin).Magnitude end)
        elseif sort == "furthest" then table.sort(list, function(a, b) return (a.pos() - origin).Magnitude > (b.pos() - origin).Magnitude end)
        elseif sort == "random" then for i = #list, 2, -1 do local j = math.random(i); list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i] end end
        local out = {}
        for i = 1, math.min(limit, #list) do out[i] = list[i] end
        return out
    end
    function chat.select(text, source)
        local r = newReader(text)
        return chat.resolveSelector(parseSelector(r, false, false), source)
    end

    -- Argument types: parse(r, ctx) -> value; suggest(remaining, ctx) -> completions -----------------
    local function list(items) local out = {}; for _, v in ipairs(items) do out[#out + 1] = v end; return out end
    local function keysOf(t) local out = {}; for k in pairs(t) do out[#out + 1] = k end; table.sort(out); return out end
    local registries = {}
    local function registry(name)
        if registries[name] then return registries[name] end
        local d = JavaContent.data
        local out = {}
        if name == "item" then for id, e in pairs(JavaContent.itemById) do out[#out + 1] = id end
        elseif name == "block" then for id, e in pairs(JavaContent.byId) do if not e.itemOnly then out[#out + 1] = id end end
        elseif name == "entity" then out = keysOf(d.entitySizes or {})
        elseif name == "summonable" then for id in pairs(d.entitySizes or {}) do if id ~= "player" and id ~= "fishing_bobber" then out[#out + 1] = id end end
        elseif name == "effect" then out = list(d.effects or {})
        elseif name == "enchantment" then out = keysOf(d.enchantments or {})
        elseif name == "particle" then out = list(d.particleTypes or {})
        elseif name == "biome" then out = list(d.biomes or {})
        elseif name == "structure" then out = list(d.structures or {})
        elseif name == "attribute" then out = keysOf(d.attributes or {})
        elseif name == "gamerule" then out = keysOf(d.gamerules or {})
        elseif name == "blocktag" then for k in pairs(d.blockTags or {}) do out[#out + 1] = "#" .. k end
        elseif name == "itemtag" then for k in pairs(d.itemTags or {}) do out[#out + 1] = "#" .. k end
        elseif name == "loot" then for k in pairs(d.loot or {}) do out[#out + 1] = "blocks/" .. k end; for k in pairs(d.entityLoot or {}) do out[#out + 1] = "entities/" .. k end
        elseif name == "dimension" then out = {"overworld", "the_nether", "the_end"} end
        table.sort(out)
        registries[name] = out
        return out
    end
    local function startsWith(s, prefix) return s:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix end
    local function filter(options, prefix)
        local out = {}
        local bare = stripNs(prefix)
        for _, o in ipairs(options) do
            if startsWith(o, prefix) or startsWith(o, bare) or startsWith("minecraft:" .. o, prefix) then out[#out + 1] = o end
        end
        return out
    end
    local ARG = {}
    local function choice(options) return {parse = function(r)
        local start = r.i
        local word = readUnquoted(r)
        for _, o in ipairs(options) do if o == word then return word end end
        r.i = start; fail(r, "argument.enum.invalid", word)
    end, suggest = function(rest) return filter(options, rest) end} end
    ARG.choice = choice
    ARG.word = {parse = function(r) local w = readUnquoted(r); if w == "" then fail(r, "argument.id.invalid") end return w end, suggest = function() return {} end}
    ARG.string = {parse = function(r) return readString(r) end, suggest = function() return {} end}
    ARG.greedy = {parse = function(r) local rest = r.s:sub(r.i); r.i = #r.s + 1; return rest end, suggest = function() return {} end, greedy = true}
    function ARG.integer(min, max) return {parse = function(r)
        local start = r.i
        local n = readNumber(r, true)
        if min and n < min then r.i = start; fail(r, "argument.integer.low", min, n) end
        if max and n > max then r.i = start; fail(r, "argument.integer.big", max, n) end
        return n
    end, suggest = function() return {} end} end
    function ARG.float(min, max) return {parse = function(r)
        local start = r.i
        local n = readNumber(r, false)
        if min and n < min then r.i = start; fail(r, "argument.float.low", min, n) end
        if max and n > max then r.i = start; fail(r, "argument.float.big", max, n) end
        return n
    end, suggest = function() return {} end} end
    ARG.bool = {parse = function(r)
        local start = r.i
        local w = readUnquoted(r)
        if w == "true" then return true elseif w == "false" then return false end
        r.i = start; fail(r, "parsing.bool.invalid", w)
    end, suggest = function(rest) return filter({"true", "false"}, rest) end}
    -- TimeArgument: ticks with optional d / s / t unit.
    function ARG.time(min) return {parse = function(r)
        local start = r.i
        local n = readNumber(r, false)
        local unit = peek(r)
        local mult = 1
        if unit == "d" then mult = 24000; r.i = r.i + 1 elseif unit == "s" then mult = 20; r.i = r.i + 1 elseif unit == "t" then r.i = r.i + 1 end
        local ticks = math.floor(n * mult + 0.5)
        if ticks < (min or 0) then r.i = start; fail(r, "argument.time.tick_count_too_low", min or 0, ticks) end
        return ticks
    end, suggest = function(rest) if rest:match("^[%d%.]+$") then return {rest .. "d", rest .. "s", rest .. "t"} end return {} end} end
    -- Coordinates: absolute, ~relative or ^local (no mixing ^ with the others).
    local function readCoord(r, integer)
        local start = r.i
        local c = peek(r)
        if c == "~" or c == "^" then
            r.i = r.i + 1
            local n = 0
            if canRead(r) and peek(r):match("[%d%.%-]") then n = readNumber(r, false) end
            return {kind = c, value = n}
        end
        if not canRead(r) or not peek(r):match("[%d%.%-]") then fail(r, "argument.pos.missing.double") end
        local n = readNumber(r, false)
        if integer and math.floor(n) ~= n then r.i = start; fail(r, "argument.pos.missing.int") end
        return {kind = "", value = n}
    end
    local function resolveCoords(coords, source, centre)
        local local_ = coords[1].kind == "^"
        if local_ then
            local yaw, pitch = math.rad(source.yaw), math.rad(source.pitch)
            -- LocalCoordinates.getPosition(): forwards (yaw+90, -pitch), up (yaw+90, 90-pitch), left = -(forwards x up).
            local f, f1 = math.cos(yaw + math.pi / 2), math.sin(yaw + math.pi / 2)
            local forward = Vector3.new(f * math.cos(-pitch), math.sin(-pitch), f1 * math.cos(-pitch))
            local up = Vector3.new(f * math.cos(-pitch + math.pi / 2), math.sin(-pitch + math.pi / 2), f1 * math.cos(-pitch + math.pi / 2))
            local left = -forward:Cross(up)
            local base = source.anchor == "eyes" and source.eye or source.pos
            return base + left * coords[1].value + up * coords[2].value + forward * coords[3].value
        end
        local p = source.pos
        local out = {}
        for i, axis in ipairs({"X", "Y", "Z"}) do
            local c = coords[i]
            if c.kind == "~" then out[i] = p[axis] + c.value
            else out[i] = c.value + ((centre and i ~= 2 and math.floor(c.value) == c.value) and 0.5 or 0) end
        end
        return Vector3.new(out[1], out[2], out[3])
    end
    local function coordArg(count, integer, centre)
        return {multi = true, parse = function(r)
            local coords = {}
            for i = 1, count do
                if i > 1 then
                    local c = peek(r)
                    if c == " " then r.i = r.i + 1
                    elseif not (c == "~" or c == "^") then fail(r, count == 3 and "argument.pos3d.incomplete" or "argument.pos2d.incomplete") end
                end
                coords[i] = readCoord(r, integer)
            end
            local carets = 0
            for _, c in ipairs(coords) do if c.kind == "^" then carets = carets + 1 end end
            if carets > 0 and carets < count then fail(r, "argument.pos.mixed") end
            if count == 2 then table.insert(coords, 2, {kind = "~", value = 0}) end
            return function(source)
                local v = resolveCoords(coords, source, centre)
                if integer then v = Vector3.new(math.floor(v.X), math.floor(v.Y), math.floor(v.Z)) end
                return v
            end
        end, suggest = function(rest)
            local parts = {}
            for w in rest:gmatch("%S+") do parts[#parts + 1] = w end
            if rest:sub(-1) == " " or rest == "" then
                local have = #parts
                local fill = {}
                for i = have + 1, count do fill[#fill + 1] = "~" end
                return {(rest .. table.concat(fill, " "))}
            end
            return {}
        end}
    end
    ARG.vec3 = coordArg(3, false, true)
    ARG.blockpos = coordArg(3, true, false)
    ARG.columnpos = coordArg(2, true, false)
    ARG.vec2 = {multi = true, parse = function(r)
        local a = readCoord(r)
        if peek(r) ~= " " then fail(r, "argument.rotation.incomplete") end
        r.i = r.i + 1
        local b = readCoord(r)
        return function(source)
            return (a.kind == "~" and source.yaw or 0) + a.value, (b.kind == "~" and source.pitch or 0) + b.value
        end
    end, suggest = function(rest) if rest == "" then return {"~ ~"} elseif rest:sub(-1) == " " then return {rest .. "~"} end return {} end}
    function ARG.entities(single, playersOnly) return {parse = function(r)
        local sel = parseSelector(r, single, playersOnly)
        return function(source)
            local found = chat.resolveSelector(sel, source)
            if #found == 0 then failAt(0, playersOnly and "argument.player.unknown" or "argument.entity.notfound.entity") end
            return found
        end
    end, suggest = function(rest)
        local options = {"@a", "@e", "@n", "@p", "@r", "@s"}
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do options[#options + 1] = p.Name end
        if rest:match("^@%a%[") then
            local keys = {"x=", "y=", "z=", "dx=", "dy=", "dz=", "distance=", "type=", "name=", "tag=", "team=", "limit=", "sort=", "level=", "gamemode=", "x_rotation=", "y_rotation=", "scores=", "nbt=", "predicate=", "advancements="}
            local head, last = rest:match("^(.*[%[,])(.-)$")
            local out = {}
            if last and not last:find("=") then for _, k in ipairs(keys) do if startsWith(k, last) then out[#out + 1] = head .. k end end end
            if last and last:match("^type=!?") then
                local pre = last:match("^type=!?")
                for _, id in ipairs(filter(registry("entity"), last:sub(#pre + 1))) do out[#out + 1] = head .. pre .. id end
            end
            if last and last:match("^sort=") then for _, s in ipairs({"nearest", "furthest", "random", "arbitrary"}) do out[#out + 1] = head .. "sort=" .. s end end
            if last and last:match("^gamemode=") then for _, s in ipairs({"survival", "creative", "adventure", "spectator"}) do out[#out + 1] = head .. "gamemode=" .. s end end
            return out
        end
        return filter(options, rest)
    end} end
    -- ResourceLocation from a registry (namespace optional).
    function ARG.resource(name, allowTag) return {parse = function(r)
        local start = r.i
        local tag = false
        if allowTag and peek(r) == "#" then tag = true; r.i = r.i + 1 end
        local id = readWhile(r, "[%w_%-%.:/]")
        if id == "" then fail(r, "argument.id.invalid") end
        id = stripNs(id)
        local options = registry(tag and (name == "item" and "itemtag" or "blocktag") or name)
        local want = tag and ("#" .. id) or id
        for _, o in ipairs(options) do if o == want then return want end end
        r.i = start
        if tag then fail(r, name == "item" and "arguments.item.tag.unknown" or "arguments.block.tag.unknown", id) end
        if name == "item" then fail(r, "argument.item.id.invalid", id) elseif name == "block" then fail(r, "argument.block.id.invalid", id)
        elseif name == "particle" then fail(r, "particle.notFound", id) end
        -- ResourceArgument: "Can't find element '<id>' of type '<registry>'".
        local registryIds = {entity = "minecraft:entity_type", summonable = "minecraft:entity_type", effect = "minecraft:mob_effect",
            enchantment = "minecraft:enchantment", attribute = "minecraft:attribute", biome = "minecraft:worldgen/biome",
            structure = "minecraft:worldgen/structure", loot = "minecraft:loot_table", dimension = "minecraft:dimension"}
        fail(r, "argument.resource.not_found", "minecraft:" .. id, registryIds[name] or ("minecraft:" .. name))
    end, suggest = function(rest)
        local options = registry(name)
        if allowTag and rest:sub(1, 1) == "#" then return filter(registry(name == "item" and "itemtag" or "blocktag"), rest) end
        return filter(options, rest)
    end} end
    -- BlockStateParser: id[props]{nbt}.
    function ARG.blockState(allowTag) return {parse = function(r)
        local start = r.i
        local result = {props = {}}
        if allowTag and peek(r) == "#" then
            r.i = r.i + 1
            local id = stripNs(readWhile(r, "[%w_%-%.:/]"))
            if not (JavaContent.data.blockTags or {})[id] then r.i = start; fail(r, "arguments.block.tag.unknown", id) end
            result.tag = id
        else
            local id = stripNs(readWhile(r, "[%w_%-%.:/]"))
            local entry = JavaContent.byId[id]
            if id == "" or not entry or entry.itemOnly then r.i = start; fail(r, "argument.block.id.invalid", id) end
            result.id, result.entry = id, entry
        end
        if peek(r) == "[" then
            r.i = r.i + 1
            while canRead(r) and peek(r) ~= "]" do
                readWhile(r, " ")
                local key = readUnquoted(r)
                readWhile(r, " ")
                if peek(r) ~= "=" then fail(r, "argument.block.property.novalue", key, result.id or "") end
                r.i = r.i + 1; readWhile(r, " ")
                local value = readString(r)
                if result.entry then
                    local values = result.entry.props and result.entry.props[key]
                    if not values then fail(r, "argument.block.property.unknown", result.id, key) end
                    local okv = false
                    for _, v in ipairs(values) do if tostring(v) == value then okv = true end end
                    if not okv then fail(r, "argument.block.property.invalid", result.id, value, key) end
                end
                result.props[key] = value
                readWhile(r, " ")
                if peek(r) == "," then r.i = r.i + 1 end
            end
            if peek(r) ~= "]" then fail(r, "argument.block.property.unclosed") end
            r.i = r.i + 1
        end
        if peek(r) == "{" then result.nbt = readBalanced(r) end
        return result
    end, suggest = function(rest)
        if allowTag and rest:sub(1, 1) == "#" then return filter(registry("blocktag"), rest) end
        local id, props = rest:match("^([%w_:]+)%[(.*)$")
        if id then
            local entry = JavaContent.byId[stripNs(id)]
            local head, last = rest:match("^(.*[%[,])(.-)$")
            local out = {}
            if entry and last and not last:find("=") then
                for k in pairs(entry.props or {}) do if startsWith(k, last) then out[#out + 1] = head .. k .. "=" end end
            elseif entry and last then
                local k, v = last:match("^(.-)=(.*)$")
                for _, value in ipairs(entry.props and entry.props[k] or {}) do if startsWith(tostring(value), v) then out[#out + 1] = head .. k .. "=" .. tostring(value) end end
            end
            table.sort(out)
            return out
        end
        return filter(registry("block"), rest)
    end} end
    local function blockMatches(pred, node, sample)
        local id = node and node.id or (sample and sample.id) or "air"
        if pred.tag then
            for _, t in ipairs((JavaContent.data.blockTags or {})[pred.tag] or {}) do if t == id then return true end end
            return false
        end
        if pred.id ~= id then return false end
        for k, v in pairs(pred.props) do if not node or tostring(node.state[k]) ~= v then return false end end
        return true
    end
    chat.blockMatches = blockMatches
    -- ItemParser: id[components]{nbt} (components are accepted and ignored).
    function ARG.item(allowTag) return {parse = function(r)
        local start = r.i
        local result = {}
        if allowTag and peek(r) == "*" then r.i = r.i + 1; result.any = true; return result end
        if allowTag and peek(r) == "#" then
            r.i = r.i + 1
            local id = stripNs(readWhile(r, "[%w_%-%.:/]"))
            if not (JavaContent.data.itemTags or {})[id] then r.i = start; fail(r, "arguments.item.tag.unknown", id) end
            result.tag = id
        else
            local id = stripNs(readWhile(r, "[%w_%-%.:/]"))
            local entry = JavaContent.itemById[id]
            if id == "" or not entry then r.i = start; fail(r, "argument.item.id.invalid", id) end
            result.id, result.entry = id, entry
        end
        if peek(r) == "[" then result.components = readBalanced(r) end
        if peek(r) == "{" then result.nbt = readBalanced(r) end
        return result
    end, suggest = function(rest)
        if allowTag and rest:sub(1, 1) == "#" then return filter(registry("itemtag"), rest) end
        return filter(registry("item"), rest)
    end} end
    local function itemMatches(pred, stack)
        if not stack then return false end
        local e = JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
        local id = e and (e.itemId or e.id) or ""
        if pred.any then return true end
        if pred.tag then for _, t in ipairs((JavaContent.data.itemTags or {})[pred.tag] or {}) do if t == id then return true end end return false end
        return pred.id == id
    end
    chat.itemMatches = itemMatches
    ARG.nbt = {parse = function(r) if peek(r) ~= "{" then fail(r, "argument.nbt.expected.compound") end return readBalanced(r) end, suggest = function() return {} end}
    ARG.component = {parse = function(r)
        local rest = r.s:sub(r.i); r.i = #r.s + 1
        local value = decodeComponent(rest)
        if value == nil then failAt(r.i - #rest, "argument.component.invalid", rest) end
        return value
    end, suggest = function() return {} end, greedy = true}
    ARG.message = ARG.greedy

    ARG.objective = {parse = function(r) local w = readUnquoted(r); if w == "" then fail(r, "argument.id.invalid") end return w end,

    ARG.team = {parse = function(r) local w = readUnquoted(r); if w == "" then fail(r, "argument.id.invalid") end return w end,
        suggest = function(rest) return filter(keysOf(chat.teams), rest) end}
    ARG.scoreHolder = {parse = function(r)

        if peek(r) == "@" then
