    ARG.operation = choice({"=", "+=", "-=", "*=", "/=", "%=", "<", ">", "><"})
    ARG.swizzle = {parse = function(r) local w = readWhile(r, "[xyz]"); if w == "" then fail(r, "arguments.swizzle.invalid") end return w end, suggest = function(rest) return filter({"x", "xy", "xyz", "xz", "y", "yz", "z"}, rest) end}
    ARG.anchor = choice({"feet", "eyes"})
    ARG.slot = {parse = function(r) local w = readWhile(r, "[%w_%.%*]"); if w == "" then fail(r, "slot.unknown", w) end return w end,
        suggest = function(rest)
            local out = {"weapon.mainhand", "weapon.offhand", "armor.head", "armor.chest", "armor.legs", "armor.feet"}
            for i = 0, 8 do out[#out + 1] = "hotbar." .. i end
            for i = 0, 26 do out[#out + 1] = "inventory." .. i end
            for i = 0, 26 do out[#out + 1] = "container." .. i end
            return filter(out, rest)
        end}
    chat.ARG, chat.registry, chat.filter = ARG, registry, filter
    chat.newReader, chat.peek, chat.canRead, chat.fail, chat.failAt, chat.readWhile = newReader, peek, canRead, fail, failAt, readWhile
    chat.seg, chat.colorOf, chat.parseLegacy, chat.fmt, chat.javaYaw, chat.ourYaw, chat.stripNs = seg, colorOf, parseLegacy, fmt, javaYaw, ourYaw, stripNs
    -- Command tree (Brigadier) -------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function lit(name, ...) return {kind = "lit", name = name, children = {...}} end
    local function arg(name, ty, ...) return {kind = "arg", name = name, ty = ty, children = {...}} end
    local function run(fn) return {kind = "run", fn = fn} end
    local commands = {}
    local function command(node, ...) commands[node.name] = node; for _, alias in ipairs({...}) do commands[alias] = node end end
    -- Feedback (CommandSourceStack.sendSuccess / sendFailure).
    local function say(text, color) chat.add(type(text) == "table" and text or {seg(text, color or "white")}) end
    local function ok(key, ...) if chat.gamerules.send_command_feedback ~= false and not chat.silent then say(T(key, ...)) end end
    local function err(key, ...) error({pos = 0, msg = T(key, ...), execution = true}, 0) end
    local function nameList(entities) local n = {}; for _, e in ipairs(entities) do n[#n + 1] = e.name end; return n end
    -- Java uses ".single" with the name and ".multiple" with a count.
    local function result(base, entities, ...)
        local extra = table.pack(...)
        if #entities == 1 then ok(base .. ".success.single", table.unpack(extra, 1, extra.n)); return 1 end
        ok(base .. ".success.multiple", table.unpack(extra, 1, extra.n)); return #entities
    end
    local function itemName(entry) return "[" .. (entry and entry.name or "?") .. "]" end
    local function blockAt(pos)
        local centre = cellCentre(pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z)
        local n = ctx.world.resolve and ctx.world.nodes and nil
        for _, node in pairs(ctx.world.nodes) do if (node.center - centre).Magnitude < 0.01 then n = node; break end end
        return n, centre
    end
    local function nodeAtBlock(pos)
        local centre = cellCentre(pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z)
        return ctx.world.nodeAt(centre), centre
    end
    local function sampleAt(pos)
        local centre = cellCentre(pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z)
        if ctx.world.nodeAt(centre) then return ctx.world.sample(centre) end
        local tick = ctx.world.tickCount or 0
        if not chat.mapSamples or tick - chat.mapSamplesTick >= 20 then chat.mapSamples, chat.mapSamplesTick = {}, tick end
        local key = pos.X .. "," .. pos.Y .. "," .. pos.Z
        local cached = chat.mapSamples[key]
        if cached == nil then cached = ctx.world.sample(centre) or false; chat.mapSamples[key] = cached end
        return cached or nil
    end
    local function gameModeName(m) return T("gameMode." .. m) end
    function chat.gameMode()
        if PlayerStats.spectator then return "spectator" elseif PlayerStats.adventure then return "adventure" end
        return CONFIG.Survival and "survival" or "creative"
    end
    function chat.setGameMode(mode)
        CONFIG.Survival = mode == "survival" or mode == "adventure"
        PlayerStats.adventure, PlayerStats.spectator, PlayerStats.noclip = mode == "adventure", mode == "spectator", mode == "spectator"
        if ctx.keybinds then ctx.keybinds.flying = mode == "spectator" or (mode == "creative" and ctx.keybinds.flying) end
        ctx.ui.refresh()
    end
    local function selfSource()
        local e = chat.entities()[1]
        local yaw, pitch = e.rot()
        return {entity = e, pos = e.pos(), eye = e.eye(), yaw = yaw, pitch = pitch, anchor = "feet", name = e.name}
    end
    chat.selfSource = selfSource
    function chat.blockSource(center)
        local source = selfSource()
        local p = toJava(center)
        source.pos, source.eye, source.yaw, source.pitch, source.name, source.anchor = p, p, 0, 0, "@", "feet"
        source.commandBlock = true
        return source
    end
    local function sourceFor(entity, base)
        local yaw, pitch = entity.rot()
        return {entity = entity, pos = base and base.pos or entity.pos(), eye = entity.eye(), yaw = base and base.yaw or yaw, pitch = base and base.pitch or pitch, anchor = base and base.anchor or "feet", name = entity.name}
    end

    -- Parsing ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function descend(node, r, args)
        if not canRead(r) then
            for _, c in ipairs(node.children) do if c.kind == "run" then return c.fn, args end end
            error({pos = r.i, msg = T("command.unknown.command"), incomplete = true}, 0)
        end
        if peek(r) ~= " " then error({pos = r.i, msg = T("command.expected.separator")}, 0) end
        r.i = r.i + 1
        local start, best = r.i, nil
        for _, c in ipairs(node.children) do
            if c.kind ~= "run" then
                r.i = start
                local childArgs = setmetatable({}, {__index = args})
                local okParse, a, b = pcall(function()
                    if c.kind == "lit" then
                        local word = readWhile(r, "[^ ]")
                        if word ~= c.name then error({pos = start, msg = T("command.unknown.argument"), literal = true}, 0) end
                    else
                        childArgs[c.name] = c.ty.parse(r, childArgs)
                        if canRead(r) and peek(r) ~= " " then error({pos = r.i, msg = T("command.expected.separator")}, 0) end
                    end
                    return descend(c, r, childArgs)
                end)
                if okParse then return a, b end
                if type(a) ~= "table" then a = {pos = r.i, msg = tostring(a)} end
                if not best or (best.literal and not a.literal) or (a.literal == best.literal and (a.pos or 0) > (best.pos or 0)) then best = a end
            end
        end
        error(best or {pos = start, msg = T("command.unknown.argument")}, 0)
    end
    function chat.parse(text)
        local r = newReader(text)
        local name = readWhile(r, "[^ ]")
        local node = commands[name]
        if not node then error({pos = 1, msg = T("command.unknown.command")}, 0) end
        return descend(node, r, {})
    end
    -- Run one command line (without the slash) from a source; returns the result count.
    function chat.run(text, source)
        -- command_block_output false: a command block's feedback and errors never reach chat.
        local quiet = source and source.commandBlock and chat.gamerules.command_block_output == false
        local okParse, fn, args = pcall(chat.parse, text)
        if not okParse and quiet then return 0 end
        if not okParse then
            local e = fn
            if type(e) ~= "table" then e = {pos = 1, msg = tostring(e)} end
            say(e.msg, "red")
            if e.pos and e.pos > 0 then
                -- "...lastTenChars<--[HERE]": up to 10 characters before the error, the rest underlined red.
                local cut = math.min(e.pos - 1, #text)
                local before = text:sub(math.max(1, cut - 9), cut)
                local parts = {}
                if cut > 10 then parts[#parts + 1] = seg("...", "gray") end
                parts[#parts + 1] = seg(before, "gray")
                if cut < #text then parts[#parts + 1] = seg(text:sub(cut + 1), "red", {underline = true}) end
                parts[#parts + 1] = seg(T("command.context.here"), "red", {italic = true})
                say(parts)
            end
            return 0
        end
        local wasSilent = chat.silent
        if quiet then chat.silent = true end
        local okRun, value = pcall(fn, args, source or selfSource())
        chat.silent = wasSilent
        if not okRun and quiet then return 0 end
        if not okRun then
            say(type(value) == "table" and value.msg or tostring(value), "red")
            if type(value) ~= "table" then warn("Steve command error: " .. tostring(value)) end
            return 0
        end
        return value or 1
    end
    -- Suggestions for the text before the cursor (CommandSuggestions.updateCommandInfo).
    local function suggestFrom(node, r, args)
        if not canRead(r) then return nil end
        if peek(r) ~= " " then return nil end
        r.i = r.i + 1
        local start = r.i
        local rest = r.s:sub(start)
        local options, usage = {}, {}
        for _, c in ipairs(node.children) do
            if c.kind == "lit" then
                local word = rest:match("^(%S+) ")
                if word == c.name then
                    r.i = start + #word
                    local deeper = suggestFrom(c, r, args)
                    if deeper then return deeper end
                elseif not rest:find(" ") and c.name:sub(1, #rest) == rest then options[#options + 1] = c.name end
            elseif c.kind == "arg" then
                r.i = start
                local childArgs = setmetatable({}, {__index = args})
                local parsed = pcall(function() childArgs[c.name] = c.ty.parse(r, childArgs) end)
                if parsed and canRead(r) and peek(r) == " " and not c.ty.greedy then
                    local deeper = suggestFrom(c, r, childArgs)
                    if deeper then return deeper end
                end
                if not parsed or not canRead(r) or c.ty.greedy then
                    if not (c.ty.multi == nil and rest:find(" ") and not c.ty.greedy and parsed) then
                        for _, o in ipairs(c.ty.suggest(rest, childArgs) or {}) do options[#options + 1] = o end
                        usage[#usage + 1] = "<" .. c.name .. ">"
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return {start = start, options = options, usage = usage}
    end
    local commandNames
    function chat.suggest(text)
        if not commandNames then
            commandNames = {}
            for name in pairs(commands) do commandNames[#commandNames + 1] = name end
            table.sort(commandNames)
        end
        local r = newReader(text)
        local name = readWhile(r, "[^ ]")
        if not canRead(r) then return {start = 1, options = filter(commandNames, name), usage = {}} end
        local node = commands[name]
        if not node then return nil end
        return suggestFrom(node, r, {})
    end
    -- Smart usage like Brigadier's CommandDispatcher.getSmartUsage().
    local function usageOf(node, depth)
        depth = depth or 0
        local parts, runnable = {}, false
        for _, c in ipairs(node.children) do
            if c.kind == "run" then runnable = true
            else parts[#parts + 1] = (c.kind == "lit" and c.name or "<" .. c.name .. ">") .. (depth < 2 and #c.children > 0 and (function() local u = usageOf(c, depth + 1); return u ~= "" and " " .. u or "" end)() or "") end
        end
        if #parts == 0 then return "" end
        local text = #parts == 1 and parts[1] or "(" .. table.concat(parts, "|") .. ")"
        if runnable then text = "[" .. text .. "]" end
        return text
    end
    chat.usageOf = usageOf
    chat.commands = commands

    -- Shared actions ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function placeBlock(pos, state, mode)
        local node, centre = nodeAtBlock(pos)
        local sample = node or sampleAt(pos)
        local isAir = not sample or sample.id == "air"
        if mode == "keep" and not isAir then return false end
        if state and node and node.id == state.id then
            local same = true
            for k, v in pairs(state.props) do if tostring(node.state[k]) ~= v then same = false end end
            if same then return false end
        end
        if not state and isAir then return false end
        if node then ctx.world.setBlockAt(centre, nil, nil, mode == "destroy")
        elseif sample and sample.hit then ctx.world.blastCells = ctx.world.blastCells or {}; table.insert(ctx.world.blastCells, centre) end
        if state then
            local entry = state.entry
            local blockState = CreativeRules.copy(entry.state)
            for k, v in pairs(state.props) do blockState[k] = v end
            ctx.world.setBlockAt(centre, entry.index, blockState)
        end
        return true
    end
    local function flushBlocks()
        local cells = ctx.world.blastCells
        ctx.world.blastCells = nil
        if cells and #cells > 0 then ctx.world.mining.blast(cells) end
        ctx.world.updateNeighbors()
    end
    local function giveItem(entry, count, item)
        local template = item and item.components and chat.stackFromItem(item, 1) or nil
        local max = (template and template.maxStack) or itemStackLimits[entry.index] or (toolStats[entry.index] and 1 or 64)
        local left = count
        while left > 0 do
            local n = math.min(left, max)
            local added = ctx.inventory.add(entry.index, n, nil, template and template.damage, template)
            if added < n and ctx.ui.drop then ctx.ui.drop(template and CreativeRules.withCount(template, n - added) or {id = entry.index, count = n - added}) end
            left = left - n
        end
        ctx.ui.refresh()
    end
    local function summon(id, pos)
        local studs = toStuds(pos)
        local gameplay = ctx.world.gameplay
        if (id == "falling_block" or id == "armor_stand") and chat.summonTree then return chat.summonTree(id, studs, nil) end
        if id == "tnt" then ctx.world.spawnPrimed(JavaContent.byId.tnt.index, studs + Vector3.new(0, B / 2, 0), 80); return true end
        if id == "lightning_bolt" then chat.lightning(studs); return true end
        if id:match("_boat$") or id:match("_raft$") then return gameplay.vehicles.spawnBoat(id, studs) end
        if id:match("minecart$") then return gameplay.vehicles.spawnCartAt and gameplay.vehicles.spawnCartAt(id, pos) end
        if id == "arrow" or id == "spectral_arrow" then return gameplay.shoot(studs, Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), 0.01, nil, id) end
        if id == "item" then return false end
        if JavaContent.data.entities[id] then
            if chat.difficulty == "peaceful" and ({zombie = 1, skeleton = 1, creeper = 1, spider = 1, witch = 1, slime = 1, phantom = 1, warden = 1})[id] then err("commands.summon.failed.peaceful") end
            return gameplay.spawn(id, studs)
        end
        return false
    end
    chat.summon = summon
    do -- (a block: the chat module is at Lua's local-variable limit)
    -- SNBT (TagParser): compounds, lists, typed arrays, quoted / unquoted strings, numbers with suffixes.
    local function parseSnbt(text)
        local i = 1
        local function ws() while i <= #text and text:sub(i, i):match("%s") do i = i + 1 end end
        local function str(isValue)
            local q = text:sub(i, i)
            if q == '"' or q == "'" then
                i = i + 1
                local out = {}
                while i <= #text do
                    local c = text:sub(i, i)
                    if c == "\\" then out[#out + 1] = text:sub(i + 1, i + 1); i = i + 2
                    elseif c == q then i = i + 1; break
                    else out[#out + 1] = c; i = i + 1 end
                end
                return table.concat(out), true
            end
            local start = i
            -- StringReader.isAllowedInUnquotedString (+ ':' inside values, for namespaced ids).
            while i <= #text and text:sub(i, i):match(isValue and "[%w_%-%.%+:]" or "[%w_%-%.%+]") do i = i + 1 end
            return text:sub(start, i - 1), false
        end
        local value
        function value()
            ws()
            local c = text:sub(i, i)
            if c == "{" then
                i = i + 1
                local t = {}
                ws()
                if text:sub(i, i) == "}" then i = i + 1; return t end
                while true do
                    ws(); local k = str(); ws()
                    if text:sub(i, i) ~= ":" then error({pos = 0, msg = T("argument.nbt.invalid", text:sub(i, i + 10))}, 0) end
                    i = i + 1
                    t[k] = value(); ws()
                    local d = text:sub(i, i); i = i + 1
                    if d == "}" then return t elseif d ~= "," then error({pos = 0, msg = T("argument.nbt.invalid", d)}, 0) end
                end
            elseif c == "[" then
                i = i + 1
                local t = {}
                ws()
                if text:sub(i + 1, i + 1) == ";" then i = i + 2 end
                ws()
                if text:sub(i, i) == "]" then i = i + 1; return t end
                while true do
                    t[#t + 1] = value(); ws()
                    local d = text:sub(i, i); i = i + 1
                    if d == "]" then return t elseif d ~= "," then error({pos = 0, msg = T("argument.nbt.invalid", d)}, 0) end
                end
            end
            local s, quoted = str(true)
            if quoted then return s end
            local number = s:match("^([%-%+]?%d*%.?%d+[eE]?[%-%+]?%d*)[bBsSlLfFdD]?$")
            if number and tonumber(number) then return tonumber(number) end
            if s == "true" then return 1 elseif s == "false" then return 0 end
            return s
        end
        return value()
    end
    chat.parseSnbt = parseSnbt
    -- ItemParser components: "[minecraft:food={nutrition:6},!minecraft:consumable,custom_name='Totem']".
    do
        local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
        local function strip(id) return (tostring(id):gsub("^minecraft:", "")) end
        -- Text components: a plain string, a JSON string, or a compound {text, extra}.
        local function plain(v)
            if type(v) == "table" then
                local out = {tostring(v.text or v.translate or "")}
                for _, x in ipairs(v.extra or (#v > 0 and v) or {}) do out[#out + 1] = plain(x) end
                return table.concat(out)
            end
            v = tostring(v)
            local first = v:sub(1, 1)
            if first == "{" or first == "[" or first == '"' then
                local ok, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(v) end)
                if ok then return plain(decoded) end
            end
            return v
        end
        local function truthy(v) return v == true or v == 1 or v == "true" end
        local function levels(v)
            local t = type(v) == "table" and (v.levels or v) or {}
            local out
            for id, lvl in pairs(t) do if type(id) == "string" then out = out or {}; out[strip(id)] = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(lvl) or 1)) end end
            return out
        end
        local apply = {
            consumable = function(st, v) st.consumable = type(v) == "table" and v or {}; st.noConsume = nil end,
            food = function(st, v)
                v = type(v) == "table" and v or {}
                st.food = {nutrition = math.floor(tonumber(v.nutrition) or 0), saturation = tonumber(v.saturation) or 0, always = truthy(v.can_always_eat)}
            end,
            custom_name = function(st, v) st.name = plain(v) end,
            item_name = function(st, v) st.name = st.name or plain(v) end,
            lore = function(st, v) st.lore = {}; for _, line in ipairs(type(v) == "table" and v or {v}) do st.lore[#st.lore + 1] = plain(line) end end,
            enchantments = function(st, v) st.enchantments = levels(v) end,
            stored_enchantments = function(st, v) st.enchantments = levels(v) end,
            enchantment_glint_override = function(st, v) st.glint = truthy(v) end,
            damage = function(st, v) st.damage = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(v) or 0)) end,
            unbreakable = function(st) st.unbreakable = true end,
            potion_contents = function(st, v)
                local id = type(v) == "table" and v.potion or v
                if id then st.potion = strip(id) end
                if type(v) == "table" and v.custom_color then st.potionColor = tonumber(v.custom_color) end
            end,
            written_book_content = function(st, v)
                v = type(v) == "table" and v or {}
                local pages = {}
                for _, p in ipairs(v.pages or {}) do pages[#pages + 1] = plain(type(p) == "table" and (p.raw or p.text and p or p) or p) end
                st.book = {title = v.title and plain(type(v.title) == "table" and (v.title.raw or v.title) or v.title), author = v.author and plain(v.author),
                    pages = pages, generation = math.floor(tonumber(v.generation) or 0)}
            end,
            fireworks = function(st, v) st.fireworks = {flight = math.floor(tonumber(type(v) == "table" and v.flight_duration) or 1), explosions = type(v) == "table" and v.explosions or nil} end,
            max_stack_size = function(st, v) st.maxStack = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(v) or 64), 1, 99) end,
            rarity = function(st, v) st.rarity = strip(v) end,
        }
        local remove = {
            consumable = function(st) st.consumable = nil; st.noConsume = true end,
            food = function(st) st.food = nil end,
            enchantments = function(st) st.enchantments = nil end,
        }
        -- Split "a=1,b={x:1,y:[2,3]},!c" at top-level commas.
        local function split(text)
            local parts, depth, quote, start = {}, 0, nil, 1
            for i = 1, #text do
                local c = text:sub(i, i)
                if quote then if c == quote and text:sub(i - 1, i - 1) ~= "\\" then quote = nil end
                elseif c == '"' or c == "'" then quote = c
                elseif c == "{" or c == "[" then depth = depth + 1
                elseif c == "}" or c == "]" then depth = depth - 1
                elseif c == "," and depth == 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = text:sub(start, i - 1); start = i + 1 end
            end
            parts[#parts + 1] = text:sub(start)
            return parts
        end
        function chat.applyComponents(st, text)
            text = tostring(text or "")
            text = text:match("^%s*%[(.*)%]%s*$") or text
            for _, part in ipairs(split(text)) do
                part = part:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
                if part ~= "" then
                    local negate, key, value = part:match("^(!?)([%w_%.:/%-]+)%s*=?%s*(.*)$")
                    if not key then error({pos = 0, msg = T("arguments.item.component.malformed", part)}, 0) end
                    key = strip(key)
                    if negate == "!" then
                        if remove[key] then remove[key](st) end
                        if st.components then st.components[key] = nil end
                    else
                        local ok, parsed = pcall(parseSnbt, value ~= "" and value or "{}")
                        if not ok then error({pos = 0, msg = T("arguments.item.component.malformed", key .. ": " .. tostring(type(parsed) == "table" and parsed.msg or parsed))}, 0) end
                        if apply[key] then apply[key](st, parsed) else st.components = st.components or {}; st.components[key] = parsed end
                    end
                end
            end
            return st
        end
        -- A stack for an item argument ({entry, components}) holding `count`.
        function chat.stackFromItem(item, count)
            local st = {id = item.entry.index, count = count or 1}
            if item.components then chat.applyComponents(st, item.components) end
            return st
        end
    end
    -- FallingBlockEntity: gravity 0.04, drag 0.98; lands on the first solid block below.
    local falling = {}
    local fallingFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    fallingFolder.Name, fallingFolder.Parent = "SteveFallingBlocks", workspace
    local function solidAt(centre)
        local sample = ctx.world.sample(centre)
        if not sample or sample.liquid then return false end
        if sample.node and JavaContent.nonSolid(sample.id) then return false end
        return true
    end
    local function land(f, centre)
        local world = ctx.world
        local there = world.nodeAt(centre)
        if not (there and not JavaContent.replaceable[there.id]) and not (not there and solidAt(centre)) then
            world.setBlockAt(centre, f.entry.index, f.state)
            local n = world.nodeAt(centre)
            local data = f.data
            if n and type(data) == "table" and n.id:find("command_block", 1, true) then
                -- CommandBlockEntity.loadAdditional: Command, auto, TrackOutput.
                n.command = {text = tostring(data.Command or ""), output = "", track = (tonumber(data.TrackOutput) or 1) ~= 0,
                    auto = (tonumber(data.auto) or 0) ~= 0}
            end
        end
    end
    local fallClock = 0
    ctx.connections[#ctx.connections + 1] = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if #falling == 0 then fallClock = 0; return end
        fallClock = math.min(fallClock + dt, 0.25)
        while fallClock >= CONFIG.Tick do
            fallClock = fallClock - CONFIG.Tick
            -- Lowest first, so a stack lands bottom to top.
            table.sort(falling, function(a, b) return a.feet.Y < b.feet.Y end)
            for i = #falling, 1, -1 do
                local f = falling[i]
                f.age = f.age + 1
                f.vy = (f.vy - 0.04 * B) * 0.98
                local nextFeet = f.feet + Vector3.new(0, f.vy, 0)
                local cell = ctx.world.cell(nextFeet + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.5, 0))
                local below = ctx.world.cell(nextFeet - Vector3.new(0, B * 0.02, 0))
                if solidAt(below) and nextFeet.Y <= below.Y + B * 0.5 + 0.001 then
                    land(f, below + Vector3.new(0, B, 0))
                    f.visual.model:Destroy(); table.remove(falling, i)
                elseif f.age > 600 then
                    f.visual.model:Destroy(); table.remove(falling, i)
                else
                    f.feet = nextFeet
                end
            end
        end
        for _, f in ipairs(falling) do f.visual.pivot(CFrame.new(f.feet + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.5, 0))) end
    end)
    -- Summon with NBT, passengers stacked on their vehicle (Entity.positionRider).
    local function summonTree(id, studs, nbt)
        id = stripNs(tostring(id))
        nbt = type(nbt) == "table" and nbt or {}
        local height = 1.8
        local dies = nbt.Health ~= nil and (tonumber(nbt.Health) or 1) <= 0
        if id == "falling_block" then
            height = 0.98
            local bs = type(nbt.BlockState) == "table" and nbt.BlockState or {Name = "sand"}
            local entry = JavaContent.byId[stripNs(tostring(bs.Name or "sand"))]
            if entry and entry.id ~= "air" then
                local state = CreativeRules.copy(entry.state)
                for k, v in pairs(type(bs.Properties) == "table" and bs.Properties or {}) do state[k] = tostring(v) end
                local visual = JavaContent.model(entry.index, state, B, fallingFolder, studs + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.5, 0), true)
                falling[#falling + 1] = {entry = entry, state = state, feet = studs, vy = 0, age = 0, visual = visual, data = nbt.TileEntityData}
            end
        elseif id == "armor_stand" then
            height = 1.975
            if not dies then
                local items = ctx.world.items
                local stand = items and items.spawnStand and items.spawnStand(studs, 0)
                if not stand then return false end
                stand.tags = {}
                for _, tag in ipairs(type(nbt.Tags) == "table" and nbt.Tags or {}) do stand.tags[tostring(tag)] = true end
            end
        elseif not dies then
            if not summon(id, toJava(studs)) then return false end
        end
        for _, passenger in ipairs(type(nbt.Passengers) == "table" and nbt.Passengers or {}) do
            if type(passenger) == "table" and passenger.id then summonTree(passenger.id, studs + Vector3.new(0, height * B, 0), passenger) end
        end
        return true
    end
    chat.summonTree = summonTree
    end

    end), arg("command", ARG.greedy, run(function(a)

    command(lit("gamemode", arg("gamemode", ARG.gamemode, run(function(a)

    end), arg("target", ARG.entities(false, true), run(function(a, src)
        local targets = a.target(src)
        for _, e in ipairs(targets) do

    command(lit("defaultgamemode", arg("gamemode", ARG.gamemode, run(function(a)

    end))))
    command(lit("difficulty", run(function() ok("commands.difficulty.query", T("options.difficulty." .. chat.difficulty)); return 1 end),
        arg("difficulty", ARG.difficulty, run(function(a)

            chat.difficulty = a.difficulty

            end

        end))))

    -- /give, /clear, /item, /loot
    command(lit("give", arg("targets", ARG.entities(false, true), arg("item", ARG.item(false), run(function(a, src)
        local targets = a.targets(src)
        giveItem(a.item.entry, 1, a.item)
        if #targets == 1 then ok("commands.give.success.single", 1, itemName(a.item.entry), targets[1].name) else ok("commands.give.success.multiple", 1, itemName(a.item.entry), #targets) end
        return #targets
    end), arg("count", ARG.integer(1), run(function(a, src)
        local targets = a.targets(src)
        local max = (itemStackLimits[a.item.entry.index] or 64) * 100
        if a.count > max then err("commands.give.failed.toomanyitems", max, itemName(a.item.entry)) end
        giveItem(a.item.entry, a.count, a.item)
        if #targets == 1 then ok("commands.give.success.single", a.count, itemName(a.item.entry), targets[1].name) else ok("commands.give.success.multiple", a.count, itemName(a.item.entry), #targets) end
        return #targets
    end))))))
    local function clearItems(pred, max)
        local removed = 0
        local inv = ctx.inventory
        local function each(t, key)
            local s = t[key]
            if s and (not pred or chat.itemMatches(pred, s)) then
                local n = max and math.min(s.count, max - removed) or s.count
                if max == 0 then removed = removed + s.count
                elseif n > 0 then s.count = s.count - n; removed = removed + n; if s.count <= 0 then t[key] = nil end end
            end
        end
        for i = 1, 41 do each(inv.slots, i) end
        for _, slot in ipairs({"helmet", "chestplate", "leggings", "boots"}) do each(inv.equipment or {}, slot) end
        if inv.cursor then local c = {inv.cursor}; each(c, 1); inv.cursor = c[1] end
        ctx.ui.refresh()
        return removed
    end
    local function clearRun(a, src)
        local targets = a.targets and a.targets(src) or {chat.entities()[1]}
        local removed = clearItems(a.item, a.maxCount)
        if removed == 0 then
            if #targets == 1 then err("clear.failed.single", targets[1].name) end
            err("clear.failed.multiple", #targets)
        end
        if a.maxCount == 0 then
            if #targets == 1 then ok("commands.clear.test.single", removed, targets[1].name) else ok("commands.clear.test.multiple", removed, #targets) end
        elseif #targets == 1 then ok("commands.clear.success.single", removed, targets[1].name) else ok("commands.clear.success.multiple", removed, #targets) end
        return removed
    end
    command(lit("clear", run(clearRun), arg("targets", ARG.entities(false, true), run(clearRun),
        arg("item", ARG.item(true), run(clearRun), arg("maxCount", ARG.integer(0), run(clearRun))))))
    local function slotRef(name)
        local inv = ctx.inventory
        local kind, n = name:match("^([%w_]+)%.?(%d*)$")
        n = tonumber(n)
        if name == "weapon.mainhand" or name == "weapon" then return inv.slots, ctx.ui.selected end
        if name == "weapon.offhand" then return inv.slots, 41 end
        if name == "armor.head" then return inv.equipment, "helmet" elseif name == "armor.chest" then return inv.equipment, "chestplate"
        elseif name == "armor.legs" then return inv.equipment, "leggings" elseif name == "armor.feet" then return inv.equipment, "boots" end
        if kind == "hotbar" and n and n <= 8 then return inv.slots, n + 1 end
        if kind == "inventory" and n and n <= 26 then return inv.slots, n + 10 end
        if kind == "container" and n then if n <= 8 then return inv.slots, n + 1 elseif n <= 35 then return inv.slots, n + 1 end end
        err("slot.unknown", name)
    end
    command(lit("item", lit("replace",
        lit("entity", arg("targets", ARG.entities(false, false), arg("slot", ARG.slot, lit("with", arg("item", ARG.item(false), run(function(a, src)
            local t, k = slotRef(a.slot); t[k] = chat.stackFromItem(a.item, 1); ctx.ui.refresh()
            ok("commands.item.entity.set.success.single", src.name, itemName(a.item.entry)); return 1
        end), arg("count", ARG.integer(1, 99), run(function(a, src)
            local t, k = slotRef(a.slot); t[k] = chat.stackFromItem(a.item, a.count); ctx.ui.refresh()
            ok("commands.item.entity.set.success.single", src.name, itemName(a.item.entry)); return 1
        end))))))),
        lit("block", arg("pos", ARG.blockpos, arg("slot", ARG.slot, lit("with", arg("item", ARG.item(false), run(function(a, src)
            local node = nodeAtBlock(a.pos(src))
            if not node or not node.storage then err("commands.item.target.not_a_container", a.pos(src).X, a.pos(src).Y, a.pos(src).Z) end
            local n = tonumber(a.slot:match("(%d+)$") or "0") + 1
            node.storage.slots[n] = chat.stackFromItem(a.item, 1)
            ok("commands.item.block.set.success", a.pos(src).X, a.pos(src).Y, a.pos(src).Z, itemName(a.item.entry)); return 1
        end))))))),
        lit("modify", arg("rest", ARG.greedy, run(function() err("commands.item.target.no_changes") end)))))
    local function lootFrom(source, a, src)
        local stacks = {}
        local entry
        if source == "loot" then
            local id = a.loot_table:gsub("^minecraft:", "")
            local kind, name = id:match("^(%w+)/(.+)$")
            local tableData = kind == "blocks" and JavaContent.data.loot[name] or kind == "entities" and JavaContent.data.entityLoot and JavaContent.data.entityLoot[name]
            if not tableData then err("argument.resource.not_found", id, "loot_table") end
            for _, s in ipairs(LootRules.roll(tableData, {player = true})) do stacks[#stacks + 1] = s end
        elseif source == "kill" then
            local e = a.target(src)[1]
            local tableData = JavaContent.data.entityLoot and JavaContent.data.entityLoot[e.type]
            for _, s in ipairs(tableData and LootRules.roll(tableData, {player = true}) or {}) do stacks[#stacks + 1] = s end
        elseif source == "mine" then
            local node = nodeAtBlock(a.pos(src))
            local id = node and node.id or (sampleAt(a.pos(src)) or {}).id
            local tableData = id and JavaContent.data.loot[id]
            for _, s in ipairs(tableData and LootRules.roll(tableData, {}) or {}) do stacks[#stacks + 1] = s end
        end
        return stacks
    end
    local function lootRun(target, source)
        return function(a, src)
            local stacks = lootFrom(source, a, src)
            local total = 0
            for _, s in ipairs(stacks) do
                local e = JavaContent.itemById[s.name]
                if e then
                    total = total + s.count
                    if target == "give" then giveItem(e, s.count)
                    else ctx.world.drop({id = e.index, count = s.count}, toStuds(a.targetPos(src) + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)), nil, true) end
                end
            end
            ok(#stacks == 1 and "commands.drop.success.single" or "commands.drop.success.multiple", #stacks == 1 and stacks[1].count or total, #stacks == 1 and itemName(JavaContent.itemById[stacks[1].name]) or "")
            return total
        end
    end
    local function lootSources(target)
        return lit("loot", arg("loot_table", ARG.resource("loot"), run(lootRun(target, "loot")))),
            lit("kill", arg("target", ARG.entities(true, false), run(lootRun(target, "kill")))),
            lit("mine", arg("pos", ARG.blockpos, run(lootRun(target, "mine")))),
            lit("fish", arg("loot_table", ARG.resource("loot"), arg("pos", ARG.blockpos, run(lootRun(target, "loot")))))
    end
    command(lit("loot", lit("give", arg("players", ARG.entities(false, true), lootSources("give"))),
        lit("spawn", arg("targetPos", ARG.vec3, lootSources("spawn"))),
        lit("insert", arg("targetPos", ARG.blockpos, lootSources("spawn"))),
        lit("replace", arg("rest", ARG.greedy, run(function() err("commands.drop.no_loot_table", "") end)))))

    -- /setblock, /fill, /clone
    local function setblockRun(mode)
        return function(a, src)
            local p = a.pos(src)
            if not placeBlock(p, a.block, mode) then err("commands.setblock.failed") end
            flushBlocks()
            ok("commands.setblock.success", p.X, p.Y, p.Z); return 1
        end
    end
    command(lit("setblock", arg("pos", ARG.blockpos, arg("block", ARG.blockState(false), run(setblockRun("replace")),
        lit("replace", run(setblockRun("replace"))), lit("destroy", run(setblockRun("destroy"))), lit("keep", run(setblockRun("keep"))), lit("strict", run(setblockRun("replace")))))))
    local function region(a, src, from, to)
        local p, q = a[from](src), a[to](src)
        local lo, hi = p:Min(q), p:Max(q)
        local volume = (hi.X - lo.X + 1) * (hi.Y - lo.Y + 1) * (hi.Z - lo.Z + 1)
        return lo, hi, volume
    end
    local function fillRun(mode)
        return function(a, src)
            local lo, hi, volume = region(a, src, "from", "to")
            local limit = chat.gamerules.max_block_modifications or 32768
            if volume > limit then err("commands.fill.toobig", limit, volume) end
            local count = 0
            for x = lo.X, hi.X do for y = lo.Y, hi.Y do for z = lo.Z, hi.Z do
                local p = Vector3.new(x, y, z)
                local edge = x == lo.X or x == hi.X or y == lo.Y or y == hi.Y or z == lo.Z or z == hi.Z
                local state = a.block
                local act = true
                if mode == "hollow" and not edge then state = nil
                elseif mode == "outline" and not edge then act = false end
                if mode == "replace" and a.filter then act = chat.blockMatches(a.filter, nodeAtBlock(p), sampleAt(p)) end
                if act then
                    if state == nil then
                        if placeBlock(p, nil, "replace") then count = count + 1 end
                    elseif state.id == "air" then
                        if placeBlock(p, nil, mode == "destroy" and "destroy" or "replace") then count = count + 1 end
                    elseif placeBlock(p, state, mode == "keep" and "keep" or mode == "destroy" and "destroy" or "replace") then count = count + 1 end
                end
            end end end
            flushBlocks()
            if count == 0 then err("commands.fill.failed") end
            ok("commands.fill.success", count); return count
        end
    end
    command(lit("fill", arg("from", ARG.blockpos, arg("to", ARG.blockpos, arg("block", ARG.blockState(false), run(fillRun("set")),
        lit("replace", run(fillRun("set")), arg("filter", ARG.blockState(true), run(fillRun("replace")))),
        lit("keep", run(fillRun("keep"))), lit("outline", run(fillRun("outline"))), lit("hollow", run(fillRun("hollow"))),
        lit("destroy", run(fillRun("destroy"))), lit("strict", run(fillRun("set"))))))))
    local function cloneRun(mask, moveMode)
        return function(a, src)
            local lo, hi, volume = region(a, src, "begin", "end")
            local limit = chat.gamerules.max_block_modifications or 32768
            if volume > limit then err("commands.clone.toobig", limit, volume) end
            local dest = a.destination(src)
            local delta = dest - lo
            local dhi = hi + delta
            if moveMode ~= "force" and not (dest.X > hi.X or dhi.X < lo.X or dest.Y > hi.Y or dhi.Y < lo.Y or dest.Z > hi.Z or dhi.Z < lo.Z) then err("commands.clone.overlap") end
            local copies = {}
            for x = lo.X, hi.X do for y = lo.Y, hi.Y do for z = lo.Z, hi.Z do
                local node = nodeAtBlock(Vector3.new(x, y, z))
                local keep = node ~= nil or mask == "replace"
                if mask == "filtered" then keep = node ~= nil and chat.blockMatches(a.filter, node) end
                if keep then copies[#copies + 1] = {pos = Vector3.new(x, y, z), node = node} end
            end end end
            local count = 0
            for _, c in ipairs(copies) do
                local target = c.pos + delta
                if c.node then
                    local entry = JavaContent.byIndex[c.node.index]
                    if placeBlock(target, {id = entry.id, entry = entry, props = c.node.state}, "replace") then count = count + 1 end
                elseif placeBlock(target, nil, "replace") then count = count + 1 end
            end
            if moveMode == "move" then for _, c in ipairs(copies) do placeBlock(c.pos, nil, "replace") end end
            flushBlocks()
            if count == 0 then err("commands.clone.failed") end
            ok("commands.clone.success", count); return count
        end
    end
    local function cloneModes(mask)
        return run(cloneRun(mask, "normal")), lit("force", run(cloneRun(mask, "force"))), lit("move", run(cloneRun(mask, "move"))), lit("normal", run(cloneRun(mask, "normal")))
    end
    command(lit("clone", arg("begin", ARG.blockpos, arg("end", ARG.blockpos, arg("destination", ARG.blockpos, run(cloneRun("replace", "normal")),
        lit("replace", cloneModes("replace")), lit("masked", cloneModes("masked")), lit("filtered", arg("filter", ARG.blockState(true), cloneModes("filtered"))),
        lit("strict", run(cloneRun("replace", "normal"))))))))

    local function tpTo(targets, pos, yaw, pitch)
        for _, e in ipairs(targets) do e.teleport(pos, yaw, pitch) end
        if #targets == 1 then ok("commands.teleport.success.location.single", targets[1].name, fmt(pos.X), fmt(pos.Y), fmt(pos.Z))
        else ok("commands.teleport.success.location.multiple", #targets, fmt(pos.X), fmt(pos.Y), fmt(pos.Z)) end
        return #targets
    end
    local function facingAngles(from, to)
        local d = to - from
        local yaw = math.deg(math.atan2(-d.X, d.Z))
        local pitch = -math.deg(math.atan2(d.Y, math.sqrt(d.X * d.X + d.Z * d.Z)))
        return yaw, pitch
    end
    command(lit("teleport",
        arg("location", ARG.vec3, run(function(a, src) return tpTo({src.entity}, a.location(src)) end)),
        arg("destination", ARG.entities(true, false), run(function(a, src)
            local d = a.destination(src)[1]
            src.entity.teleport(d.pos(), d.rot())
            ok("commands.teleport.success.entity.single", src.entity.name, d.name); return 1
        end)),
        arg("targets", ARG.entities(false, false),
            arg("location", ARG.vec3, run(function(a, src) return tpTo(a.targets(src), a.location(src)) end),
                arg("rotation", ARG.vec2, run(function(a, src) local y, p = a.rotation(src); return tpTo(a.targets(src), a.location(src), y, p) end)),
                lit("facing", arg("facingLocation", ARG.vec3, run(function(a, src)
                    local to = a.location(src); local y, p = facingAngles(to + Vector3.new(0, 1.62, 0), a.facingLocation(src)); return tpTo(a.targets(src), to, y, p)
                end)), lit("entity", arg("facingEntity", ARG.entities(true, false), run(function(a, src)
                    local to = a.location(src); local y, p = facingAngles(to + Vector3.new(0, 1.62, 0), a.facingEntity(src)[1].pos()); return tpTo(a.targets(src), to, y, p)
                end), arg("facingAnchor", ARG.anchor, run(function(a, src)
                    local f = a.facingEntity(src)[1]; local to = a.location(src)
                    local y, p = facingAngles(to + Vector3.new(0, 1.62, 0), a.facingAnchor == "eyes" and f.eye() or f.pos()); return tpTo(a.targets(src), to, y, p)
                end)))))),
            arg("destination", ARG.entities(true, false), run(function(a, src)
                local targets, d = a.targets(src), a.destination(src)[1]
                for _, e in ipairs(targets) do e.teleport(d.pos(), d.rot()) end
                if #targets == 1 then ok("commands.teleport.success.entity.single", targets[1].name, d.name) else ok("commands.teleport.success.entity.multiple", #targets, d.name) end
                return #targets
            end)))), "tp")
    command(lit("rotate", arg("target", ARG.entities(true, false), arg("rotation", ARG.vec2, run(function(a, src)
        local e = a.target(src)[1]; local y, p = a.rotation(src); e.teleport(e.pos(), y, p); ok("commands.rotate.success", e.name); return 1
    end)), lit("facing", arg("facingLocation", ARG.vec3, run(function(a, src)

    end)), lit("entity", arg("facingEntity", ARG.entities(true, false), run(function(a, src)

    end)))))))
    command(lit("ride", arg("target", ARG.entities(true, false),

    command(lit("spreadplayers", arg("center", ARG.columnpos, arg("spreadDistance", ARG.float(0), arg("maxRange", ARG.float(1), arg("respectTeams", ARG.bool, arg("targets", ARG.entities(false, false), run(function(a, src)

            return #targets
        end))))))
    local ROMAN = {"I", "II", "III", "IV", "V", "VI", "VII", "VIII", "IX", "X"}
    local function enchantRun(a, src)
        local targets = a.targets(src)
        local level = a.level or 1
        local info = JavaContent.data.enchantments[a.enchantment]
        if level > info.max then err("commands.enchant.failed.level", level, info.max) end
        local stack = ctx.inventory.slots[ctx.ui.selected]
        if not stack then err("commands.enchant.failed.itemless", src.name) end
        local tagName = type(info.supported) == "string" and info.supported:gsub("^#minecraft:", ""):gsub("^#", "") or nil
        if tagName then
            local entry = JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
            local okItem = false
            for _, id in ipairs((JavaContent.data.itemTags or {})[tagName] or {}) do if entry and (entry.itemId or entry.id) == id then okItem = true end end
            if not okItem then err("commands.enchant.failed.incompatible", itemName(entry)) end
        end
        stack.enchantments = stack.enchantments or {}
        stack.enchantments[a.enchantment] = level
        ctx.ui.refresh()
        local label = T("enchantment.minecraft." .. a.enchantment) .. (info.max > 1 and " " .. (ROMAN[level] or tostring(level)) or "")
        if #targets == 1 then ok("commands.enchant.success.single", label, targets[1].name) else ok("commands.enchant.success.multiple", label, #targets) end
        return 1
    end
    command(lit("enchant", arg("targets", ARG.entities(false, false), arg("enchantment", ARG.resource("enchantment"), run(enchantRun), arg("level", ARG.integer(0), run(enchantRun))))))
    -- Experience: Player.getXpNeededForNextLevel().
    local function xpNeeded(level) if level >= 30 then return 112 + (level - 30) * 9 elseif level >= 15 then return 37 + (level - 15) * 5 end return 7 + level * 2 end
    local function addPoints(n)
        PlayerStats.xpTotal = math.max(0, PlayerStats.xpTotal + n)
        local points = PlayerStats.xpProgress * xpNeeded(PlayerStats.xpLevel) + n
        while points < 0 and PlayerStats.xpLevel > 0 do PlayerStats.xpLevel = PlayerStats.xpLevel - 1; points = points + xpNeeded(PlayerStats.xpLevel) end
        points = math.max(0, points)
        while points >= xpNeeded(PlayerStats.xpLevel) do points = points - xpNeeded(PlayerStats.xpLevel); PlayerStats.xpLevel = PlayerStats.xpLevel + 1 end
        PlayerStats.xpProgress = points / xpNeeded(PlayerStats.xpLevel)
    end
    chat.addXp = addPoints
    local function xpRun(op, unit)
        return function(a, src)
            local targets = a.target(src)
            if op == "query" then
                if unit == "levels" then ok("commands.experience.query.levels", targets[1].name, PlayerStats.xpLevel)
                else ok("commands.experience.query.points", targets[1].name, math.floor(PlayerStats.xpProgress * xpNeeded(PlayerStats.xpLevel))) end
                return 1
            end
            local amount = a.amount
            if op == "add" then
                if unit == "levels" then PlayerStats.xpLevel = math.max(0, PlayerStats.xpLevel + amount) else addPoints(amount) end
            else
                if unit == "levels" then PlayerStats.xpLevel = amount
                else
                    if amount > xpNeeded(PlayerStats.xpLevel) then err("commands.experience.set.points.invalid") end
                    PlayerStats.xpProgress = amount / xpNeeded(PlayerStats.xpLevel)
                end
            end
            ctx.ui.refresh()
            local key = "commands.experience." .. op .. "." .. unit .. ".success." .. (#targets == 1 and "single" or "multiple")
            ok(key, amount, #targets == 1 and targets[1].name or #targets); return #targets
        end
    end
    local function xpCommand(name)
        return lit(name,
            lit("add", arg("target", ARG.entities(false, true), arg("amount", ARG.integer(), run(xpRun("add", "points")), lit("points", run(xpRun("add", "points"))), lit("levels", run(xpRun("add", "levels")))))),
            lit("set", arg("target", ARG.entities(false, true), arg("amount", ARG.integer(0), run(xpRun("set", "points")), lit("points", run(xpRun("set", "points"))), lit("levels", run(xpRun("set", "levels")))))),

    end

    -- Attributes: base values drive PlayerStats / CONFIG.
    chat.attributeBase = {}
    local function attrBase(id) local a = JavaContent.data.attributes[id]; return chat.attributeBase[id] or (a and (a.player or a.default)) or 0 end
    local function applyAttributes()
        PlayerStats.baseMovementSpeed = attrBase("movement_speed")
        PlayerStats.jumpStrength = attrBase("jump_strength")
        PlayerStats.gravity = attrBase("gravity")
        PlayerStats.sneakingSpeed = attrBase("sneaking_speed")
        PlayerStats.blockBreakSpeed = attrBase("block_break_speed")
        PlayerStats.attackAttributeBonus = attrBase("attack_damage") - 1
        CONFIG.Reach = attrBase("block_interaction_range")
        CONFIG.StepHeight = attrBase("step_height")
        humanoid.MaxHealth = attrBase("max_health") * 5
        ctx.effects.give("speed", 0.05, 0); ctx.effects.clear("speed") -- re-apply modifiers
    end
    chat.applyAttributes = applyAttributes
    local function attrName(id) return T("attribute.name." .. id) end
    command(lit("attribute", arg("target", ARG.entities(true, false), arg("attribute", ARG.resource("attribute"),
        lit("get", run(function(a, src) ok("commands.attribute.value.get.success", attrName(a.attribute), src.name, fmt(attrBase(a.attribute))); return 1 end),
            arg("scale", ARG.float(), run(function(a, src) ok("commands.attribute.value.get.success", attrName(a.attribute), src.name, fmt(attrBase(a.attribute) * a.scale)); return 1 end))),
        lit("base",
            lit("get", run(function(a, src) ok("commands.attribute.base_value.get.success", attrName(a.attribute), src.name, fmt(attrBase(a.attribute))); return 1 end),
                arg("scale", ARG.float(), run(function(a, src) ok("commands.attribute.base_value.get.success", attrName(a.attribute), src.name, fmt(attrBase(a.attribute) * a.scale)); return 1 end))),
            lit("set", arg("value", ARG.float(), run(function(a, src)
                local def = JavaContent.data.attributes[a.attribute]
                chat.attributeBase[a.attribute] = math.clamp(a.value, def.min, def.max); applyAttributes()
                ok("commands.attribute.base_value.set.success", attrName(a.attribute), src.name, fmt(chat.attributeBase[a.attribute])); return 1
            end))),
            lit("reset", run(function(a, src) chat.attributeBase[a.attribute] = nil; applyAttributes(); ok("commands.attribute.base_value.reset.success", attrName(a.attribute), src.name, fmt(attrBase(a.attribute))); return 1 end))),
        lit("modifier", arg("rest", ARG.greedy, run(function(a, src) err("commands.attribute.failed.no_modifier", attrName(a.attribute), src.name, a.rest) end)))))))

    -- /time, /weather, /gamerule, /tick, /worldborder, /setworldspawn, /spawnpoint
    local TIME_NAMES = {day = 1000, noon = 6000, night = 13000, midnight = 18000, sunrise = 23000, sunset = 12000}
    local timeValue = {parse = function(r)
        local start = r.i
        local word = readWhile(r, "[%a_]")
        if TIME_NAMES[word] then return TIME_NAMES[word] end
        r.i = start
        return ARG.time(0).parse(r)
    end, suggest = function(rest) return filter({"day", "night", "noon", "midnight", "sunrise", "sunset"}, rest) end}
    command(lit("time",
        lit("set", arg("time", timeValue, run(function(a) chat.setTime(a.time); ok("commands.time.set", a.time); return a.time end))),
        lit("add", arg("time", ARG.time(), run(function(a) chat.setTime(chat.time + a.time); ok("commands.time.set", chat.time); return chat.time end))),
        lit("query",
            lit("daytime", run(function() local t = math.floor(chat.time % 24000); ok("commands.time.query", t); return t end)),
            lit("gametime", run(function() local t = math.floor(chat.gameTime); ok("commands.time.query.gametime", t); return t end)),
            lit("day", run(function() local d = math.floor(chat.time / 24000); ok("commands.time.query", d); return d end)),
            lit("time", run(function() local t = math.floor(chat.time % 24000); ok("commands.time.query", t); return t end))),
        lit("pause", run(function() if chat.timePaused then err("commands.time.pause.already_paused") end; chat.timePaused = true; ok("commands.time.pause"); return 1 end)),
        lit("resume", run(function() if not chat.timePaused then err("commands.time.pause.already_running") end; chat.timePaused = false; ok("commands.time.resume"); return 1 end)),
        lit("rate", arg("rate", ARG.float(0), run(function(a) chat.timeRate = a.rate; ok("commands.time.rate", fmt(a.rate)); return 1 end)))))
    local function weatherRun(kind)
        return function(a)
            chat.setWeather(kind, a.duration)
            ok("commands.weather.set." .. kind); return a.duration or 1
        end
    end
    command(lit("weather", lit("clear", run(weatherRun("clear")), arg("duration", ARG.time(1), run(weatherRun("clear")))),
        lit("rain", run(weatherRun("rain")), arg("duration", ARG.time(1), run(weatherRun("rain")))),
        lit("thunder", run(weatherRun("thunder")), arg("duration", ARG.time(1), run(weatherRun("thunder"))))))
    local gameruleChildren = {}
    for name, rule in pairs(JavaContent.data.gamerules or {}) do

    command(lit("gamerule", table.unpack(gameruleChildren)))
    command(lit("tick",
        lit("query", run(function() ok("commands.tick.query.rate.running", fmt(1 / CONFIG.Tick)); return 1 end)),
        lit("rate", arg("rate", ARG.float(1, 10000), run(function(a) CONFIG.Tick = 1 / a.rate; ok("commands.tick.rate.success", fmt(a.rate)); return 1 end))),
        lit("freeze", run(function() chat.frozen = true; ok("commands.tick.status.frozen"); return 1 end)),
        lit("unfreeze", run(function() chat.frozen = false; ok("commands.tick.status.running"); return 1 end)),
        lit("step", run(function() chat.stepTicks = 1; ok("commands.tick.step.success", 1); return 1 end),
            arg("time", ARG.time(1), run(function(a) chat.stepTicks = a.time; ok("commands.tick.step.success", a.time); return 1 end)),
            lit("stop", run(function() chat.stepTicks = 0; ok("commands.tick.step.stop.success"); return 1 end))),
        lit("sprint", arg("time", ARG.time(1), run(function(a) ok("commands.tick.sprint.report", 0, 0); return 1 end)),
            lit("stop", run(function() err("commands.tick.sprint.stop.fail") end)))))
    local border = chat.border
    command(lit("worldborder",
        lit("get", run(function() ok("commands.worldborder.get", string.format("%.0f", border.size)); return math.floor(border.size) end)),
        lit("set", arg("distance", ARG.float(1, 59999968), run(function(a)
            if a.distance == border.size then err("commands.worldborder.set.failed.nochange") end
            border.size = a.distance; chat.borderChanged(); ok("commands.worldborder.set.immediate", string.format("%.1f", a.distance)); return 1
        end), arg("time", ARG.time(0), run(function(a)

            border.size = a.distance; chat.borderChanged()

        end)))),
        lit("add", arg("distance", ARG.float(-59999968, 59999968), run(function(a) border.size = math.max(1, border.size + a.distance); chat.borderChanged(); ok("commands.worldborder.set.immediate", string.format("%.1f", border.size)); return 1 end),
            arg("time", ARG.time(0), run(function(a) border.size = math.max(1, border.size + a.distance); chat.borderChanged(); ok("commands.worldborder.set.grow", string.format("%.1f", border.size), a.time / 20); return 1 end)))),
        lit("center", arg("pos", ARG.columnpos, run(function(a, src)
            local p = a.pos(src); border.centre = Vector2.new(p.X + 0.5, p.Z + 0.5); chat.borderChanged()
            ok("commands.worldborder.center.success", fmt(p.X + 0.5), fmt(p.Z + 0.5)); return 1
        end))),
        lit("damage", lit("amount", arg("damagePerBlock", ARG.float(0), run(function(a) border.damage = a.damagePerBlock; ok("commands.worldborder.damage.amount.success", fmt(a.damagePerBlock)); return 1 end))),
            lit("buffer", arg("distance", ARG.float(0), run(function(a) border.buffer = a.distance; ok("commands.worldborder.damage.buffer.success", fmt(a.distance)); return 1 end)))),
        lit("warning", lit("distance", arg("distance", ARG.integer(0), run(function(a) border.warning = a.distance; ok("commands.worldborder.warning.distance.success", a.distance); return 1 end))),
            lit("time", arg("time", ARG.time(0), run(function(a) border.warningTime = a.time / 20; ok("commands.worldborder.warning.time.success", a.time / 20); return 1 end))))))
    local function setSpawn(a, src, world)
        local p = a.pos and a.pos(src) or Vector3.new(math.floor(src.pos.X), math.floor(src.pos.Y), math.floor(src.pos.Z))
        local yaw = 0
        if a.rotation then yaw = a.rotation(src) end
        if world then chat.worldSpawn = {pos = p, yaw = yaw}; ok("commands.setworldspawn.success", p.X, p.Y, p.Z, fmt(yaw), 0)
        else
            chat.spawnPoint = {pos = p, yaw = yaw}
            player:SetAttribute("SteveSpawnPoint", toStuds(p + Vector3.new(0.5, 0, 0.5)))
            ok("commands.spawnpoint.success.single", p.X, p.Y, p.Z, fmt(yaw), 0, "minecraft:overworld", src.name)
        end
        return 1
    end
    command(lit("setworldspawn", run(function(a, src) return setSpawn(a, src, true) end), arg("pos", ARG.blockpos, run(function(a, src) return setSpawn(a, src, true) end),
        arg("rotation", ARG.vec2, run(function(a, src) return setSpawn(a, src, true) end)))))
    command(lit("spawnpoint", run(function(a, src) return setSpawn(a, src, false) end), arg("targets", ARG.entities(false, true), run(function(a, src) return setSpawn(a, src, false) end),
        arg("pos", ARG.blockpos, run(function(a, src) return setSpawn(a, src, false) end), arg("rotation", ARG.vec2, run(function(a, src) return setSpawn(a, src, false) end))))))

    -- Chat-type commands: /say /me /msg /teammsg /tellraw /title
    local function selectorText(text, src)
        return (text:gsub("@[parsen]%b[]", function(s) local okSel, l = pcall(chat.select, s, src); return okSel and table.concat(nameList(l), ", ") or s end)
            :gsub("@[parsen]", function(s) local okSel, l = pcall(chat.select, s, src); return okSel and table.concat(nameList(l), ", ") or s end))
    end
    command(lit("say", arg("message", ARG.message, run(function(a, src) say(T("chat.type.announcement", src.name, selectorText(a.message, src))); return 1 end))))
    command(lit("me", arg("action", ARG.message, run(function(a, src) say(T("chat.type.emote", src.name, selectorText(a.action, src))); return 1 end))))
    command(lit("msg", arg("targets", ARG.entities(false, true), arg("message", ARG.message, run(function(a, src)
        local targets = a.targets(src)
        for _, e in ipairs(targets) do
            say({seg(T("commands.message.display.outgoing", e.name, selectorText(a.message, src)), "gray", {italic = true})})
            if e.isPlayer and not e.remote then say({seg(T("commands.message.display.incoming", src.name, selectorText(a.message, src)), "gray", {italic = true})}) end
        end
        return #targets
    end)))), "tell", "w")
    command(lit("teammsg", arg("message", ARG.message, run(function(a, src)
        local id, team = teamOf(src.name)
        if not team then err("commands.teammsg.failed.noteam") end
        say(T("chat.type.team.sent", "[" .. (team.displayName or id) .. "]", src.name, a.message)); return 1
    end))), "tm")
    command(lit("tellraw", arg("targets", ARG.entities(false, true), arg("message", ARG.component, run(function(a, src)
        local targets = a.targets(src)
        for _, e in ipairs(targets) do if e.isPlayer and not e.remote then say(component(a.message, nil, src)) end end
        return #targets
    end)))))
    local function titleRun(kind)
        return function(a, src)
            local targets = a.targets(src)
            chat.showTitle(kind, kind ~= "clear" and kind ~= "reset" and component(a.title, nil, src) or nil)
            local key = kind == "clear" and "commands.title.cleared" or kind == "reset" and "commands.title.reset" or "commands.title.show." .. kind
            if #targets == 1 then ok(key .. ".single", targets[1].name) else ok(key .. ".multiple", #targets) end
            return #targets
        end
    end
    command(lit("title", arg("targets", ARG.entities(false, true),
        lit("clear", run(titleRun("clear"))), lit("reset", run(titleRun("reset"))),
        lit("title", arg("title", ARG.component, run(titleRun("title")))), lit("subtitle", arg("title", ARG.component, run(titleRun("subtitle")))),
        lit("actionbar", arg("title", ARG.component, run(titleRun("actionbar")))),
        lit("times", arg("fadeIn", ARG.time(0), arg("stay", ARG.time(0), arg("fadeOut", ARG.time(0), run(function(a, src)
            chat.titleTimes = {a.fadeIn, a.stay, a.fadeOut}
            local targets = a.targets(src)
            if #targets == 1 then ok("commands.title.times.single", targets[1].name) else ok("commands.title.times.multiple", #targets) end
            return #targets
        end))))))))

    -- Scoreboard, /trigger, /tag, /team, /bossbar
    local function scoreOf(holder, obj) local s = chat.scores[holder]; return s and s[obj] end
    local function setScore(holder, obj, value) chat.scores[holder] = chat.scores[holder] or {}; chat.scores[holder][obj] = value; chat.scoresChanged = true end
    chat.setScore, chat.scoreOf = setScore, scoreOf
    local function needObjective(name) local o = chat.objectives[name]; if not o then err("arguments.objective.notFound", name) end; return o end
    local function playersRun(op)
        return function(a, src)
            local holders = a.targets and a.targets(src) or (a.target and a.target(src)) or {}
            if op == "get" then
                needObjective(a.objective)
                local v = scoreOf(holders[1], a.objective)
                if v == nil then err("commands.scoreboard.players.get.null", a.objective, holders[1]) end
                ok("commands.scoreboard.players.get.success", holders[1], v, "[" .. (chat.objectives[a.objective].displayName or a.objective) .. "]"); return v
            elseif op == "list" then
                if a.target then
                    local s = chat.scores[holders[1]] or {}
                    if next(s) == nil then ok("commands.scoreboard.players.list.entity.empty", holders[1]); return 0 end
                    local n = 0; for _ in pairs(s) do n = n + 1 end
                    ok("commands.scoreboard.players.list.entity.success", holders[1], n)
                    for obj, v in pairs(s) do ok("commands.scoreboard.players.list.entity.entry", "[" .. obj .. "]", v) end
                    return n
                end
                local names = {}
                for h in pairs(chat.scores) do names[#names + 1] = h end
                if #names == 0 then ok("commands.scoreboard.players.list.empty"); return 0 end
                ok("commands.scoreboard.players.list.success", #names, table.concat(names, ", ")); return #names
            elseif op == "reset" then
                for _, h in ipairs(holders) do if a.objective then if chat.scores[h] then chat.scores[h][a.objective] = nil end else chat.scores[h] = nil end end
                chat.scoresChanged = true
                ok(a.objective and (#holders == 1 and "commands.scoreboard.players.reset.specific.single" or "commands.scoreboard.players.reset.specific.multiple") or (#holders == 1 and "commands.scoreboard.players.reset.all.single" or "commands.scoreboard.players.reset.all.multiple"),
                    a.objective or (#holders == 1 and holders[1] or #holders), #holders == 1 and holders[1] or #holders)
                return #holders
            elseif op == "enable" then
                needObjective(a.objective)
                for _, h in ipairs(holders) do chat.triggers = chat.triggers or {}; chat.triggers[h .. "/" .. a.objective] = true end
                ok(#holders == 1 and "commands.scoreboard.players.enable.success.single" or "commands.scoreboard.players.enable.success.multiple", "[" .. a.objective .. "]", #holders == 1 and holders[1] or #holders)
                return #holders
            elseif op == "operation" then
                needObjective(a.targetObjective); needObjective(a.sourceObjective)
                local sources = a.source(src)
                for _, h in ipairs(holders) do
                    for _, s in ipairs(sources) do
                        local x, y = scoreOf(h, a.targetObjective) or 0, scoreOf(s, a.sourceObjective) or 0
                        local o = a.operation
                        if o == "=" then x = y elseif o == "+=" then x = x + y elseif o == "-=" then x = x - y elseif o == "*=" then x = x * y
                        elseif o == "/=" then if y ~= 0 then x = math.floor(x / y) end elseif o == "%=" then if y ~= 0 then x = x % y end
                        elseif o == "<" then x = math.min(x, y) elseif o == ">" then x = math.max(x, y)
                        elseif o == "><" then setScore(s, a.sourceObjective, x); x = y end
                        setScore(h, a.targetObjective, x)
                    end
                end
                ok(#holders == 1 and "commands.scoreboard.players.operation.success.single" or "commands.scoreboard.players.operation.success.multiple", "[" .. a.targetObjective .. "]", #holders == 1 and holders[1] or #holders, scoreOf(holders[1], a.targetObjective))
                return #holders
            end
            needObjective(a.objective)
            for _, h in ipairs(holders) do
                local v = scoreOf(h, a.objective) or 0
                if op == "set" then v = a.score elseif op == "add" then v = v + a.score else v = v - a.score end
                setScore(h, a.objective, v)
            end
            local single = #holders == 1
            ok("commands.scoreboard.players." .. op .. ".success." .. (single and "single" or "multiple"), "[" .. a.objective .. "]", single and holders[1] or #holders, single and scoreOf(holders[1], a.objective) or a.score)
            return #holders
        end
    end
    local SLOTS = {"list", "sidebar", "below_name"}
    for _, c in ipairs({"black", "dark_blue", "dark_green", "dark_aqua", "dark_red", "dark_purple", "gold", "gray", "dark_gray", "blue", "green", "aqua", "red", "light_purple", "yellow", "white"}) do SLOTS[#SLOTS + 1] = "sidebar.team." .. c end
    command(lit("scoreboard",
        lit("objectives",
            lit("list", run(function()
                local names = keysOf(chat.objectives)
                if #names == 0 then ok("commands.scoreboard.objectives.list.empty"); return 0 end
                local shown = {}; for _, n in ipairs(names) do shown[#shown + 1] = "[" .. (chat.objectives[n].displayName or n) .. "]" end
                ok("commands.scoreboard.objectives.list.success", #names, table.concat(shown, ", ")); return #names
            end)),
            lit("add", arg("objective", ARG.objective, arg("criteria", ARG.word, run(function(a)
                if chat.objectives[a.objective] then err("commands.scoreboard.objectives.add.duplicate") end
                chat.objectives[a.objective] = {criteria = a.criteria, displayName = a.objective}; ok("commands.scoreboard.objectives.add.success", "[" .. a.objective .. "]"); return 1
            end), arg("displayName", ARG.component, run(function(a)
                if chat.objectives[a.objective] then err("commands.scoreboard.objectives.add.duplicate") end
                local parts = component(a.displayName); local t = ""; for _, p in ipairs(parts) do t = t .. p.text end
                chat.objectives[a.objective] = {criteria = a.criteria, displayName = t}; ok("commands.scoreboard.objectives.add.success", "[" .. t .. "]"); return 1
            end))))),
            lit("remove", arg("objective", ARG.objective, run(function(a)
                needObjective(a.objective); chat.objectives[a.objective] = nil
                for _, s in pairs(chat.scores) do s[a.objective] = nil end
                for slot, o in pairs(chat.display) do if o == a.objective then chat.display[slot] = nil end end
                chat.scoresChanged = true
                ok("commands.scoreboard.objectives.remove.success", "[" .. a.objective .. "]"); return 1
            end))),
            lit("setdisplay", arg("slot", choice(SLOTS), run(function(a)
                if not chat.display[a.slot] then err("commands.scoreboard.objectives.display.alreadyEmpty") end
                chat.display[a.slot] = nil; chat.scoresChanged = true; ok("commands.scoreboard.objectives.display.cleared", a.slot); return 1
            end), arg("objective", ARG.objective, run(function(a)
                needObjective(a.objective)
                if chat.display[a.slot] == a.objective then err("commands.scoreboard.objectives.display.alreadySet") end
                chat.display[a.slot] = a.objective; chat.scoresChanged = true; ok("commands.scoreboard.objectives.display.set", a.slot, "[" .. a.objective .. "]"); return 1
            end)))),
            lit("modify", arg("objective", ARG.objective, lit("displayname", arg("displayName", ARG.component, run(function(a)
                local o = needObjective(a.objective)
                local parts = component(a.displayName); local t = ""; for _, p in ipairs(parts) do t = t .. p.text end
                o.displayName = t; chat.scoresChanged = true; ok("commands.scoreboard.objectives.modify.displayname", a.objective, "[" .. t .. "]"); return 1
            end))), lit("rendertype", arg("value", choice({"integer", "hearts"}), run(function(a) needObjective(a.objective).render = a.value; ok("commands.scoreboard.objectives.modify.rendertype", "[" .. a.objective .. "]"); return 1 end)))))),
        lit("players",
            lit("list", run(playersRun("list")), arg("target", ARG.scoreHolder, run(playersRun("list")))),
            lit("get", arg("target", ARG.scoreHolder, arg("objective", ARG.objective, run(playersRun("get"))))),
            lit("set", arg("targets", ARG.scoreHolder, arg("objective", ARG.objective, arg("score", ARG.integer(), run(playersRun("set")))))),
            lit("add", arg("targets", ARG.scoreHolder, arg("objective", ARG.objective, arg("score", ARG.integer(0), run(playersRun("add")))))),
            lit("remove", arg("targets", ARG.scoreHolder, arg("objective", ARG.objective, arg("score", ARG.integer(0), run(playersRun("remove")))))),
            lit("reset", arg("targets", ARG.scoreHolder, run(playersRun("reset")), arg("objective", ARG.objective, run(playersRun("reset"))))),
            lit("enable", arg("targets", ARG.scoreHolder, arg("objective", ARG.objective, run(playersRun("enable"))))),
            lit("operation", arg("targets", ARG.scoreHolder, arg("targetObjective", ARG.objective, arg("operation", ARG.operation, arg("source", ARG.scoreHolder, arg("sourceObjective", ARG.objective, run(playersRun("operation")))))))))))
    command(lit("trigger", arg("objective", ARG.objective, run(function(a, src)
        local key = src.name .. "/" .. a.objective
        if not (chat.triggers or {})[key] then err("commands.trigger.failed.unprimed") end
        setScore(src.name, a.objective, (scoreOf(src.name, a.objective) or 0) + 1); chat.triggers[key] = nil
        ok("commands.trigger.simple.success", "[" .. a.objective .. "]"); return 1
    end), lit("add", arg("value", ARG.integer(), run(function(a, src)
        local key = src.name .. "/" .. a.objective
        if not (chat.triggers or {})[key] then err("commands.trigger.failed.unprimed") end
        setScore(src.name, a.objective, (scoreOf(src.name, a.objective) or 0) + a.value); chat.triggers[key] = nil
        ok("commands.trigger.add.success", "[" .. a.objective .. "]", a.value); return 1
    end))), lit("set", arg("value", ARG.integer(), run(function(a, src)
        local key = src.name .. "/" .. a.objective
        if not (chat.triggers or {})[key] then err("commands.trigger.failed.unprimed") end

    -- /particle, /playsound, /stopsound, /locate, /place, /fillbiome, /forceload
    local function particleRun(a, src)
        local pos = a.pos and a.pos(src) or src.pos
        local count = a.count or 0
        if a.delta and not a.deltaRaw then a.deltaRaw = a.delta(src) end
        local name = a.name
        local function emit(p, v)
            local sprites = JavaContent.data.particles and JavaContent.data.particles[name]
            ctx.world.effects.emit(sprites and name or "crit", toStuds(p), v * B, {life = 20, size = 0.2, fullbright = true})
        end
        -- ParticleCommand: count 0 sends one particle with delta*speed as its velocity; otherwise a gaussian spread.
        if count == 0 then emit(pos, (a.deltaRaw or Vector3.zero) * (a.speed or 0))
        else
            local d = a.deltaRaw or Vector3.zero
            for _ = 1, math.min(count, 256) do
                local g = function() return (math.random() + math.random() + math.random() - 1.5) * 0.66 end
                emit(pos + Vector3.new(g() * d.X, g() * d.Y, g() * d.Z), Vector3.new(g(), g(), g()) * (a.speed or 0) * 0.1)
            end
        end
        ok("commands.particle.success", name); return 1
    end
    -- Vec3Argument(false): plain numbers, no block-centre correction.
    local deltaArg = {multi = true, parse = function(r)
        local coords = {}
        for i = 1, 3 do
            if i > 1 then if peek(r) ~= " " then fail(r, "argument.pos3d.incomplete") end r.i = r.i + 1 end
            local c = peek(r)
            if c == "~" or c == "^" then r.i = r.i + 1; coords[i] = (canRead(r) and peek(r):match("[%d%.%-]")) and readNumber(r, false) or 0
            else coords[i] = readNumber(r, false) end
        end
        return function() return Vector3.new(coords[1], coords[2], coords[3]) end
    end, suggest = function(rest) return ARG.vec3.suggest(rest) end}
    command(lit("particle", arg("name", ARG.resource("particle"), run(particleRun), arg("pos", ARG.vec3, run(particleRun),
        arg("delta", deltaArg, arg("speed", ARG.float(0), arg("count", ARG.integer(0), run(function(a, src)
            a.deltaRaw = a.delta(src)
            return particleRun(a, src)
        end), lit("force", run(particleRun), arg("viewers", ARG.entities(false, true), run(particleRun))), lit("normal", run(particleRun), arg("viewers", ARG.entities(false, true), run(particleRun))))))))))
    local soundCategories = {"master", "music", "record", "weather", "block", "hostile", "neutral", "player", "ambient", "voice", "ui"}
    local function playSound(a, src)
        local targets = a.targets and a.targets(src) or {src.entity}
        local pos = a.pos and a.pos(src) or src.pos
        if MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.play(a.sound, toStuds(pos), a.volume or 1, a.pitch or 1) end
        if #targets == 1 then ok("commands.playsound.success.single", a.sound, targets[1].name) else ok("commands.playsound.success.multiple", a.sound, #targets) end
        return #targets
    end
    local soundArg = {parse = function(r) local id = readWhile(r, "[%w_%-%.:/]"); if id == "" then fail(r, "argument.id.invalid") end return id end, suggest = function() return {} end}
    command(lit("playsound", arg("sound", soundArg, run(playSound), arg("source", choice(soundCategories), run(playSound), arg("targets", ARG.entities(false, true), run(playSound),
        arg("pos", ARG.vec3, run(playSound), arg("volume", ARG.float(0), run(playSound), arg("pitch", ARG.float(0, 2), run(playSound), arg("minVolume", ARG.float(0, 1), run(playSound))))))))))

    -- Data, functions, datapacks and server-ish commands
    local function entityData(e)
        local p = e.pos()
        local yaw, pitch = e.rot()
        local data = string.format('{Pos: [%sd, %sd, %sd], Rotation: [%sf, %sf], UUID: "%s", id: "minecraft:%s"', fmt(p.X), fmt(p.Y), fmt(p.Z), fmt(yaw), fmt(pitch), e.uuid, e.type)
        if e.obj and e.obj.humanoid then data = data .. string.format(", Health: %sf", fmt(e.obj.humanoid.Health)) end
        if e.isPlayer then data = data .. string.format(", Health: %sf, XpLevel: %d, playerGameType: %d", fmt(humanoid.Health * 20 / humanoid.MaxHealth), PlayerStats.xpLevel, ({survival = 0, creative = 1, adventure = 2, spectator = 3})[chat.gameMode()]) end
        local tags = keysOf(e.tags)
        if #tags > 0 then data = data .. ', Tags: ["' .. table.concat(tags, '", "') .. '"]' end
        return data .. "}"
    end
    command(lit("data",
        lit("get",
            lit("entity", arg("target", ARG.entities(true, false), run(function(a, src) local e = a.target(src)[1]; ok("commands.data.entity.query", e.name, entityData(e)); return 1 end),
                arg("path", ARG.word, run(function(a, src) local e = a.target(src)[1]; ok("commands.data.entity.query", e.name, entityData(e)); return 1 end)))),
