                ok("commands.data.block.query", p.X, p.Y, p.Z, "{Items: [" .. table.concat(items, ", ") .. "]}"); return 1
            end))),
            lit("storage", arg("target", ARG.word, run(function(a) ok("commands.data.storage.query", a.target, "{}"); return 1 end)))),
        lit("merge", arg("rest", ARG.greedy, run(function() err("commands.data.merge.failed") end))),

    -- /skin <default> [slim|wide] | player <account> | url <slim|wide> <png url>: the player's skin.
    local function skinJob(label, fn)
        local s = ctx.world and ctx.world.skins
        if not s then err("commands.help.failed") end
        say("Setting skin: " .. label .. "...", "gray")
        task.spawn(function()
            local okSkin, e = pcall(fn, s)
            if okSkin then say("Skin set to " .. label) else say("Could not set the skin: " .. tostring(e):gsub("^.-:%d+: ", ""), "red") end
        end)
        return 1
    end
    local defaultSkins = {"steve", "alex", "ari", "efe", "kai", "makena", "noor", "sunny", "zuri"}
    command(lit("skin",
        arg("skin", ARG.choice(defaultSkins),
            run(function(a) return skinJob(a.skin, function(sk) assert(sk.useDefault(a.skin, a.skin == "alex")) end) end),
            lit("slim", run(function(a) return skinJob(a.skin .. " (slim)", function(sk) assert(sk.useDefault(a.skin, true)) end) end)),
            lit("wide", run(function(a) return skinJob(a.skin .. " (wide)", function(sk) assert(sk.useDefault(a.skin, false)) end) end))),
        lit("player", arg("account", ARG.word, run(function(a) return skinJob(a.account, function(sk) sk.fromAccount(a.account) end) end))),
        lit("url",
            lit("slim", arg("url", ARG.greedy, run(function(a) return skinJob(a.url, function(sk) sk.fromUrl(a.url, true) end) end))),
            lit("wide", arg("url", ARG.greedy, run(function(a) return skinJob(a.url, function(sk) sk.fromUrl(a.url, false) end) end))))))
    -- /generate_world [seed]: a new Java 26.3 world (random seed when none is given).
    local function generateWorld(seedText)
        local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then err("commands.help.failed") end
        say("Generating a new world" .. (seedText and (" for seed " .. seedText) or "") .. "...", "gray")
        local session = WG.startWorld({world = ctx.world, gui = Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"), root = root, seedText = seedText, chat = chat})
        say("World seed: [" .. session.seedText .. "]")
        return 1
    end

    -- moderation: only accounts with a developer tag (DEVELOPER_TAGS), on any script player by name (any server)
    local function devOnly()
        if not SteveBans.isDev(Players.LocalPlayer.Name) then
            say("You need a developer tag to use this command", "red")
            return false
        end
        return true
    end
    local function testerOnly()
        if not SteveBans.isTester(Players.LocalPlayer.Name) then
            say("You need to be a tester or a developer to use this command", "red")
            return false
        end
        return true
    end
    local function userIdOf(name)
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if string.lower(p.Name) == string.lower(name) then return p.UserId, p.Name end end
        local ok, id = pcall(function() return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(name) end)
        local real = name
        if ok and id then pcall(function() real = Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(id) end) end
        return ok and id or nil, real
    end
    local function banCmd(name, reason)
        if not devOnly() then return 0 end
        if string.lower(name) == string.lower(Players.LocalPlayer.Name) then say("You can't ban yourself", "red"); return 0 end
        task.spawn(function()
            local id, real = userIdOf(name)
            if not id then say("That player does not exist", "red"); return end
            if SteveBans.isDev(real) then say("Developers can't be banned", "red"); return end
            local okB = SteveBans.ban(real, id, "forever", reason or "Banned by an operator.", Players.LocalPlayer.Name)
            if okB then say("Banned " .. real .. ": " .. (reason or "Banned by an operator."))
            else say("Could not reach the ban list; try again", "red") end
        end)
        return 1
    end
    local function kickCmd(name, reason)
        if not testerOnly() then return 0 end
        if string.lower(name) == string.lower(Players.LocalPlayer.Name) then say("You can't kick yourself", "red"); return 0 end
        task.spawn(function()
            local id, real = userIdOf(name)
            if not id then say("That player does not exist", "red"); return end
            if SteveBans.isDev(real) then say("Developers can't be kicked", "red"); return end
            local okK = SteveBans.kick(real, id, reason or "Kicked by an operator.", Players.LocalPlayer.Name)
            if okK then say("Kicked " .. real .. ": " .. (reason or "Kicked by an operator.") .. " (they leave within 15 seconds)")
            else say("Could not reach the ban list; try again", "red") end
        end)
        return 1
    end
    command(lit("ban", arg("targets", ARG.word, run(function(a) return banCmd(a.targets, nil) end),
        arg("reason", ARG.greedy, run(function(a) return banCmd(a.targets, a.reason) end)))))
    command(lit("pardon", arg("targets", ARG.word, run(function(a)
        if not devOnly() then return 0 end
        task.spawn(function()
            local list = SteveBans.fetch()
            local found
            for _, b in ipairs(SteveBans.active(list)) do if string.lower(tostring(b.n)) == string.lower(a.targets) then found = b end end
            if not found then say("Nothing changed. The player isn't banned", "red"); return end
            if SteveBans.unban(tostring(found.n)) then say("Unbanned " .. tostring(found.n)) else say("Could not reach the ban list; try again", "red") end
        end)
        return 1
    end))))
    command(lit("banlist", run(function()
        if not devOnly() then return 0 end
        task.spawn(function()
            local bans = SteveBans.active(SteveBans.fetch())
            if #bans == 0 then say("There are no bans"); return end
            say("There are " .. #bans .. " ban(s):")
            for _, b in ipairs(bans) do
                say(tostring(b.n) .. " was banned by " .. tostring(b.by or "a developer") .. ": " .. tostring(b.r ~= "" and b.r or "Banned by an operator.") .. " (" .. SteveBans.untilText(b) .. ")", "gray")
            end
        end)
        return 1
    end)))

    -- /execute: the modifier chain is parsed by hand (Brigadier redirects back to "execute").
    local function parseEntitiesAt(r) local sel = parseSelector(r, false, false); return function(src) return chat.resolveSelector(sel, src) end end
    local function skipSpace(r) if peek(r) ~= " " then fail(r, "command.expected.separator") end r.i = r.i + 1 end
    local function executeChain(text, sources)
        local r = newReader(text)
        local count = 0
        while canRead(r) do
            local word = readWhile(r, "[%a_]")
            if word == "run" then
                skipSpace(r)
                local rest = r.s:sub(r.i)
                for _, src in ipairs(sources) do count = count + (chat.run(rest, src) > 0 and 1 or 0) end
                return count
            end
            skipSpace(r)
            local nextSources = {}
            if word == "as" then
                local f = parseEntitiesAt(r)
                for _, src in ipairs(sources) do for _, e in ipairs(f(src)) do local s = CreativeRules.copy(src); s.entity, s.name = e, e.name; nextSources[#nextSources + 1] = s end end
            elseif word == "at" then
                local f = parseEntitiesAt(r)
                for _, src in ipairs(sources) do for _, e in ipairs(f(src)) do local s = CreativeRules.copy(src); s.pos = e.pos(); s.eye = e.eye(); s.yaw, s.pitch = e.rot(); nextSources[#nextSources + 1] = s end end
            elseif word == "positioned" then
                if r.s:sub(r.i, r.i + 2) == "as " then r.i = r.i + 3; local f = parseEntitiesAt(r)
                    for _, src in ipairs(sources) do for _, e in ipairs(f(src)) do local s = CreativeRules.copy(src); s.pos = e.pos(); nextSources[#nextSources + 1] = s end end
                elseif r.s:sub(r.i, r.i + 4) == "over " then r.i = r.i + 5; readWhile(r, "[%a_]"); nextSources = sources
                else local f = ARG.vec3.parse(r); for _, src in ipairs(sources) do local s = CreativeRules.copy(src); s.pos = f(src); s.eye = s.pos; nextSources[#nextSources + 1] = s end end
            elseif word == "rotated" then
                if r.s:sub(r.i, r.i + 2) == "as " then r.i = r.i + 3; local f = parseEntitiesAt(r)
                    for _, src in ipairs(sources) do for _, e in ipairs(f(src)) do local s = CreativeRules.copy(src); s.yaw, s.pitch = e.rot(); nextSources[#nextSources + 1] = s end end
                else local f = ARG.vec2.parse(r); for _, src in ipairs(sources) do local s = CreativeRules.copy(src); s.yaw, s.pitch = f(src); nextSources[#nextSources + 1] = s end end
            elseif word == "facing" then
                if r.s:sub(r.i, r.i + 6) == "entity " then
                    r.i = r.i + 7; local f = parseEntitiesAt(r); skipSpace(r); local anchor = readWhile(r, "[%a]")
                    for _, src in ipairs(sources) do for _, e in ipairs(f(src)) do local s = CreativeRules.copy(src); s.yaw, s.pitch = facingAngles(src.eye or src.pos, anchor == "eyes" and e.eye() or e.pos()); nextSources[#nextSources + 1] = s end end
                else local f = ARG.vec3.parse(r); for _, src in ipairs(sources) do local s = CreativeRules.copy(src); s.yaw, s.pitch = facingAngles(src.eye or src.pos, f(src)); nextSources[#nextSources + 1] = s end end
            elseif word == "align" then
                local axes = readWhile(r, "[xyz]")
                for _, src in ipairs(sources) do
                    local s = CreativeRules.copy(src); local p = s.pos
                    s.pos = Vector3.new(axes:find("x") and math.floor(p.X) or p.X, axes:find("y") and math.floor(p.Y) or p.Y, axes:find("z") and math.floor(p.Z) or p.Z)
                    nextSources[#nextSources + 1] = s
                end
            elseif word == "anchored" then
                local anchor = readWhile(r, "[%a]")
                for _, src in ipairs(sources) do local s = CreativeRules.copy(src); s.anchor = anchor; nextSources[#nextSources + 1] = s end
            elseif word == "in" then
                local dim = stripNs(readWhile(r, "[%w_:]"))
                dim = ({nether = "the_nether", ["end"] = "the_end"})[dim] or dim
                local scaleOf = {overworld = 1, the_nether = 8, the_end = 1}
                if not scaleOf[dim] then fail(r, "argument.dimension.invalid", dim) end
                -- DimensionType.getTeleportationScale(from, to) = from.coordinateScale / to.coordinateScale.
                for _, src in ipairs(sources) do
                    local s = CreativeRules.copy(src)
                    local k = scaleOf[s.dimension or "overworld"] / scaleOf[dim]
                    s.pos, s.dimension = Vector3.new(s.pos.X * k, s.pos.Y, s.pos.Z * k), dim
                    nextSources[#nextSources + 1] = s
                end
            elseif word == "on" then readWhile(r, "[%a_]"); nextSources = {}
            elseif word == "summon" then
                local id = stripNs(readWhile(r, "[%w_:]"))
                for _, src in ipairs(sources) do summon(id, src.pos); local all = chat.entities(); local s = CreativeRules.copy(src); s.entity = all[#all]; nextSources[#nextSources + 1] = s end
            elseif word == "store" then
                readWhile(r, "[%a]"); skipSpace(r); local kind = readWhile(r, "[%a]"); skipSpace(r)
                if kind == "score" then readWhile(r, "[^ ]"); skipSpace(r); readWhile(r, "[^ ]")
                elseif kind == "bossbar" then readWhile(r, "[^ ]"); skipSpace(r); readWhile(r, "[%a]")
                else readWhile(r, "[^ ]"); skipSpace(r); readWhile(r, "[^ ]"); skipSpace(r); readWhile(r, "[^ ]"); skipSpace(r); readWhile(r, "[^ ]") end
                nextSources = sources
            elseif word == "if" or word == "unless" then
                local want = word == "if"
                local kind = readWhile(r, "[%a]"); skipSpace(r)
                local test
                if kind == "block" then
                    local pos = ARG.blockpos.parse(r); skipSpace(r); local pred = ARG.blockState(true).parse(r)
                    test = function(src) local p = pos(src); return chat.blockMatches(pred, nodeAtBlock(p), sampleAt(p)) end
                elseif kind == "entity" then local f = parseEntitiesAt(r); test = function(src) return #f(src) > 0 end
                elseif kind == "score" then
                    local holder = ARG.scoreHolder.parse(r); skipSpace(r); local obj = readWhile(r, "[^ ]"); skipSpace(r)
                    if r.s:sub(r.i, r.i + 7) == "matches " then
                        r.i = r.i + 8; local range = parseRange(readWhile(r, "[^ ]"), true)
                        test = function(src) local v = scoreOf(holder(src)[1], obj); return v ~= nil and inRange(range, v) end
                    else
                        local op = readWhile(r, "[<>=]"); skipSpace(r); local other = ARG.scoreHolder.parse(r); skipSpace(r); local obj2 = readWhile(r, "[^ ]")
                        test = function(src)
                            local a1, b1 = scoreOf(holder(src)[1], obj), scoreOf(other(src)[1], obj2)
                            if a1 == nil or b1 == nil then return false end
                            return (op == "<" and a1 < b1) or (op == "<=" and a1 <= b1) or (op == "=" and a1 == b1) or (op == ">" and a1 > b1) or (op == ">=" and a1 >= b1)
                        end
                    end
                elseif kind == "blocks" then
                    local a1 = ARG.blockpos.parse(r); skipSpace(r); local b1 = ARG.blockpos.parse(r); skipSpace(r); local d1 = ARG.blockpos.parse(r); skipSpace(r); local mode = readWhile(r, "[%a]")
                    test = function(src)
                        local lo, hi = a1(src):Min(b1(src)), a1(src):Max(b1(src)); local off = d1(src) - lo
                        for x = lo.X, hi.X do for y = lo.Y, hi.Y do for z = lo.Z, hi.Z do
                            local n1 = nodeAtBlock(Vector3.new(x, y, z)); local n2 = nodeAtBlock(Vector3.new(x, y, z) + off)
                            if not (mode == "masked" and not n1) and ((n1 and n1.id) ~= (n2 and n2.id)) then return false end
                        end end end
                        return true
                    end
                elseif kind == "dimension" then local d = stripNs(readWhile(r, "[%w_:]")); test = function() return d == "overworld" end
                elseif kind == "loaded" then ARG.blockpos.parse(r); test = function() return true end
                elseif kind == "biome" then ARG.blockpos.parse(r); skipSpace(r); readWhile(r, "[^ ]"); test = function() return false end
                elseif kind == "items" then readWhile(r, "[^ ]"); skipSpace(r); readWhile(r, "[^ ]"); skipSpace(r); readWhile(r, "[^ ]"); test = function() return false end
                elseif kind == "predicate" or kind == "function" then readWhile(r, "[^ ]"); test = function() return false end
                else fail(r, "command.unknown.argument") end
                for _, src in ipairs(sources) do if test(src) == want then nextSources[#nextSources + 1] = src end end
                if not canRead(r) then
                    if #nextSources > 0 then ok("commands.execute.conditional.pass") else err("commands.execute.conditional.fail") end
                    return #nextSources
                end
            else
                fail(r, "command.unknown.argument")
            end
            sources = nextSources
            if canRead(r) then skipSpace(r) end
        end
        error({pos = r.i, msg = T("command.unknown.command")}, 0)
    end
    local executeArg = {greedy = true, parse = function(r) local rest = r.s:sub(r.i); r.i = #r.s + 1; return rest end,
        suggest = function(rest)
            local words = {"align", "anchored", "as", "at", "facing", "if", "in", "on", "positioned", "rotated", "run", "store", "summon", "unless"}
            local last = rest:match("(%S*)$")
            local head = rest:sub(1, #rest - #last)
            if head:match("run $") or head:match("run .*") then
                local inner = rest:match("run (.*)$")
                local s = inner and chat.suggest(inner)
                local out = {}
                for _, o in ipairs(s and s.options or {}) do out[#out + 1] = head .. o end
                return out
            end
            local prev = head:match("(%S+)%s*$")
            if prev == "if" or prev == "unless" then return (function() local out = {}; for _, w in ipairs({"biome", "block", "blocks", "data", "dimension", "entity", "function", "items", "loaded", "predicate", "score"}) do if startsWith(w, last) then out[#out + 1] = head .. w end end; return out end)() end
            local out = {}
            for _, w in ipairs(words) do if startsWith(w, last) then out[#out + 1] = head .. w end end
            return out
        end}
    command(lit("execute", arg("chain", executeArg, run(function(a, src) return executeChain(a.chain, {src}) end))))
    local function initializeChatScreen()
        -- Chat screen (ChatComponent / ChatScreen / CommandSuggestions) -----------------------------------
        local gui = ctx.gui
        local root2d = Instance.new("Frame")
        root2d.Name, root2d.BackgroundTransparency, root2d.ZIndex, root2d.Parent = "JavaChat", 1, 15, gui
        local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale"); uiScale.Parent = root2d
        local W, H, S = 0, 0, 0
        local function layout()
            local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local v = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
            local s = JavaGui.scale(v)
            local w, h = math.floor(v.X / s), math.floor(v.Y / s)
            if s == S and w == W and h == H then return false end
            S, W, H = s, w, h
            uiScale.Scale = s
            root2d.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
            return true
        end
        -- Draw coloured segments at (x, y); bold draws a second copy 1px right (Font bold offset).
        local function drawSegments(parent, segs, x, y, z, shadow)
            local pen = x
            for _, s in ipairs(segs) do
                if s.text ~= "" then
                    JavaGui.text(parent, s.text, pen, y, s.color, shadow ~= false, z)
                    local w = JavaGui.width(s.text)
                    if s.bold then JavaGui.text(parent, s.text, pen + 1, y, s.color, false, z + 1); w = w + (utf8.len(s.text) or #s.text) end
                    if s.underline then
                        local line = Instance.new("Frame"); line.BorderSizePixel, line.BackgroundColor3, line.ZIndex = 0, s.color, z + 2
                        line.Position, line.Size, line.Parent = UDim2.fromOffset(pen, y + 8), UDim2.fromOffset(w, 1), parent
                    end
                    pen = pen + w
                end
            end
            return pen - x
        end
        local function segWidth(s) return JavaGui.width(s.text) + (s.bold and (utf8.len(s.text) or #s.text) or 0) end
        -- ComponentRenderUtils.wrapComponents(): word wrap to the 320px chat width.
        local function wrap(segs, width)
            local lines, line, used = {}, {}, 0
            for _, s in ipairs(segs) do
                for word, space in s.text:gmatch("([^ ]*)( ?)") do
                    if word == "" and space == "" then break end
                    local piece = word .. space
                    local w = segWidth({text = piece, bold = s.bold})
                    if used + w > width and used > 0 then lines[#lines + 1] = line; line, used = {}, 0 end
                    while segWidth({text = piece, bold = s.bold}) > width do
                        local cut = #piece
                        while cut > 1 and segWidth({text = piece:sub(1, cut), bold = s.bold}) > width do cut = cut - 1 end
                        while cut > 1 and (piece:byte(cut + 1) or 0) >= 128 and (piece:byte(cut + 1) or 0) < 192 do cut = cut - 1 end
                        line[#line + 1] = {text = piece:sub(1, cut), color = s.color, bold = s.bold, underline = s.underline}
                        lines[#lines + 1] = line; line, used = {}, 0
                        piece = piece:sub(cut + 1)
                    end
                    line[#line + 1] = {text = piece, color = s.color, bold = s.bold, underline = s.underline}
                    used = used + segWidth({text = piece, bold = s.bold})
                end
            end
            if #line > 0 then lines[#lines + 1] = line end
            return lines
        end
        local CHAT_WIDTH = 320
        local messages = {}
        local dirty = true
        chat.log = {}
        function chat.add(segs)
            if type(segs) == "string" then segs = parseLegacy(segs) end
            do
                local plain = {}
                for _, piece in ipairs(segs) do plain[#plain + 1] = tostring(piece.text or "") end
                chat.log[#chat.log + 1] = {t = os.time(), text = table.concat(plain)}
                while #chat.log > 200 do table.remove(chat.log, 1) end
            end
            for _, line in ipairs(wrap(segs, CHAT_WIDTH)) do messages[#messages + 1] = {segs = line, time = os.clock()} end
            while #messages > 100 do table.remove(messages, 1) end
            dirty = true
        end
        -- A message rewritten in place (Verity typing letter by letter): set() replaces its wrapped lines.
        function chat.addLive(segs)
            local group, handle = {}, {}
            -- chatLineRev: the wrapped lines are updated in place, so only lines whose text changed redraw.
            local function sameSegs(a, b)
                if #a ~= #b then return false end
                for i = 1, #a do
                    local x, y = a[i], b[i]
                    if x.text ~= y.text or x.color ~= y.color or x.bold ~= y.bold or x.underline ~= y.underline then return false end
                end
                return true
            end
            function handle.set(newSegs)
                if type(newSegs) == "string" then newSegs = parseLegacy(newSegs) end
                local old, first = {}, nil
                for i, m in ipairs(messages) do if m.group == group then old[#old + 1] = m; first = first or i end end
                local lines = wrap(newSegs, CHAT_WIDTH)
                local now = os.clock()
                local changed = #old ~= #lines
                -- New lines go right after this message's existing ones (computed once: inserting shifts #messages).
                local base = first or (#messages + 1)
                for i, line in ipairs(lines) do
                    local m = old[i]
                    if m then
                        if not sameSegs(m.segs, line) then m.segs, m.rev, changed = line, (m.rev or 0) + 1, true end
                        m.time = now
                    else
                        table.insert(messages, math.min(base + i - 1, #messages + 1), {segs = line, time = now, group = group})
                    end
                end
                for i = #old, #lines + 1, -1 do
                    for j = #messages, 1, -1 do if messages[j] == old[i] then table.remove(messages, j); break end end
                end
                while #messages > 100 do table.remove(messages, 1) end
                if changed then dirty = true end
            end
            handle.set(segs)
            return handle
        end
        -- Shared with other scripts (The Verity Script) through _G; see VERITY BRIDGE.
        chat.shared = {add = function(segs) chat.add(segs) end, addLive = function(segs) return chat.addLive(segs) end,
            open = function() if chat.openChat then chat.openChat() end end}
        _G.SteveChat = chat.shared
        local lineFrames = {}
        local function renderLines()
            -- Frames of unchanged lines are kept (only moved); old frames go after the new ones exist.
            local keep = {}
            for _, l in ipairs(lineFrames) do keep[l.message] = l end
            lineFrames = {}
            local maxLines = chat.open and 20 or 10
            local bottom = H - 40
            if not chat.open and ctx.world and ctx.world.touch then
                local visible = 0
                for i = #messages, 1, -1 do
                    if visible >= maxLines then break end
                    if (os.clock() - messages[i].time) * 20 < 200 then visible = visible + 1 end
                end
                bottom = 30 + visible * 9
            end
            local shown = 0
            for i = #messages, 1, -1 do
                local m = messages[i]
                local age = (os.clock() - m.time) * 20
                if shown >= maxLines then break end
                if chat.open or age < 200 then
                    shown = shown + 1
                    local y = bottom - shown * 9
                    local kept = keep[m]
                    if kept and kept.rev == m.rev and kept.width == W then
                        keep[m] = nil
                        kept.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y)
                        lineFrames[#lineFrames + 1] = kept
                    else
                        local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
                        frame.BackgroundColor3, frame.BorderSizePixel, frame.ZIndex = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0, 15
                        -- Start at the old line's opacity so the swap shows no flash.
                        frame.BackgroundTransparency = kept and kept.frame.BackgroundTransparency or 0.5
                        frame.Position, frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y), UDim2.fromOffset(CHAT_WIDTH + 8, 9)
                        drawSegments(frame, m.segs, 4, 1, 16)
                        frame.Parent = root2d
                        lineFrames[#lineFrames + 1] = {frame = frame, message = m, rev = m.rev, width = W}
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, l in pairs(keep) do l.frame:Destroy() end
        end
        -- Opacity: background 0.5, text fades over the last second of the 10-second life.
        local function fadeLines()
            for _, l in ipairs(lineFrames) do
                local alpha = 1
                if not chat.open then
                    local age = (os.clock() - l.message.time) * 20
                    alpha = math.clamp((1 - age / 200) * 10, 0, 1); alpha = alpha * alpha
                end
                if l.alpha ~= alpha then
                    l.alpha = alpha
                    l.frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.5 * alpha
                    for _, g in ipairs(l.frame:GetDescendants()) do
                        if g:IsA("ImageLabel") then g.ImageTransparency = 1 - alpha elseif g:IsA("TextLabel") then g.TextTransparency = 1 - alpha elseif g:IsA("Frame") and g.Size.Y.Offset == 1 then g.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - alpha end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        -- Input box: fill(2, H-14, W-2, H-2, 0x80000000); text at (4, H-12).
        local inputBg = Instance.new("Frame")
        inputBg.BackgroundColor3, inputBg.BackgroundTransparency, inputBg.BorderSizePixel, inputBg.ZIndex, inputBg.Visible = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.5, 0, 20, false
        inputBg.Parent = root2d
        local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
        box.BackgroundTransparency, box.TextTransparency, box.ClearTextOnFocus, box.Text = 1, 1, false, ""
        box.TextXAlignment, box.ZIndex, box.Size, box.Parent = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 21, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), inputBg
        local inputText, inputCursor, inputVisualKey, suggestionBox, hintBox
        local suggestions = {list = {}, selected = 1, start = 1, offset = 0}
        local ARG_COLORS = {COLORS.aqua, COLORS.yellow, COLORS.green, COLORS.light_purple, COLORS.gold}
        -- CommandSuggestions.formatText(): argument tokens cycle aqua/yellow/green/purple/gold; an error turns the rest red.
        local function highlighted(text)
            if text:sub(1, 1) ~= "/" then return {seg(text, "white")} end
            local body = text:sub(2)
            local errPos
            local okParse, e = pcall(chat.parse, body)
            if not okParse and type(e) == "table" and not e.incomplete and e.pos and e.pos > 0 then errPos = e.pos end
            local out = {seg("/", "white")}
            local index, i = 0, 1
            for token, space in body:gmatch("([^ ]*)( ?)") do
                if token == "" and space == "" then break end
                local start = i
                if errPos and start + #token > errPos then
                    local good = math.max(0, errPos - start)
                    if good > 0 then out[#out + 1] = seg(token:sub(1, good), index == 0 and COLORS.white or ARG_COLORS[(index - 1) % 5 + 1]) end
                    out[#out + 1] = seg(body:sub(start + good), "red")
                    return out
                end
                local color = (index == 0 or token:match("^[%a_]+$")) and COLORS.white or ARG_COLORS[(index - 1) % 5 + 1]
                if token:match("^[%a_]+$") and index > 0 then
                    -- literal words stay white unless they are selectors/names the parser consumed as arguments
                    color = COLORS.white
                end
                out[#out + 1] = seg(token .. space, color)
                if token:match("^[^%a_]") or (index > 0 and not token:match("^[%a_]+$")) then index = index + 1 elseif index == 0 then index = 1 end
                i = i + #token + #space
            end
            return out
        end
        local function drawInput()
            local text = box.Text
            local cursor = box.CursorPosition
            local cursorOn = math.floor(os.clock() * 20 / 6) % 2 == 0
            local visualKey = text .. "\0" .. tostring(cursor)
            if inputText and inputVisualKey == visualKey then
                if inputCursor then inputCursor.Visible = cursorOn end
                return
            end
            local oldText = inputText
            local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
            frame.BackgroundTransparency, frame.ZIndex, frame.Size, frame.Visible, frame.Parent = 1, 22, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), false, inputBg
            inputText, inputCursor, inputVisualKey = frame, nil, visualKey
            local segs = highlighted(text)
            local w = drawSegments(frame, segs, 2, 2, 23)
            -- EditBox cursor: "_" at the end, "|" inside the text, blinking every 6 ticks.
            if cursor == -1 or cursor > #text then
                inputCursor = JavaGui.text(frame, "_", 2 + w, 2, Color3.fromRGB(208, 208, 208), true, 24)
            else
                local cx = 2 + JavaGui.width(text:sub(1, cursor - 1))
                inputCursor = Instance.new("Frame")
                inputCursor.BorderSizePixel, inputCursor.BackgroundColor3, inputCursor.ZIndex = 0, Color3.fromRGB(208, 208, 208), 24
                inputCursor.Position, inputCursor.Size, inputCursor.Parent = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, 1), UDim2.fromOffset(1, 10), frame
            end
            inputCursor.Visible = cursorOn
            frame.Visible = true
            if oldText then oldText:Destroy() end
        end
        local function drawSuggestions()
            if suggestionBox then suggestionBox:Destroy(); suggestionBox = nil end
            if hintBox then hintBox:Destroy(); hintBox = nil end
            local text = box.Text
            if not chat.open or text:sub(1, 1) ~= "/" then return end
            local list = suggestions.list
            if #list > 0 then
                local shown = math.min(10, #list)
                local width = 0
                for _, o in ipairs(list) do width = math.max(width, JavaGui.width(o)) end
                local x = math.min(4 + JavaGui.width(text:sub(1, suggestions.start)), W - width - 3)
                local y = H - 12 - 3 - shown * 12
                suggestionBox = Instance.new("Frame")
                suggestionBox.BackgroundColor3, suggestionBox.BackgroundTransparency, suggestionBox.BorderSizePixel, suggestionBox.ZIndex = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 1 - 0xD0 / 255, 0, 25
                suggestionBox.Position, suggestionBox.Size, suggestionBox.Parent = UDim2.fromOffset(x - 1, y), UDim2.fromOffset(width + 2, shown * 12), root2d
                for row = 1, shown do
                    local idx = suggestions.offset + row
                    local option = list[idx]
                    if option then
                        JavaGui.text(suggestionBox, option, 1, (row - 1) * 12 + 2, idx == suggestions.selected and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170), true, 26)
                    end
                end
            elseif suggestions.hint then
                hintBox = Instance.new("Frame")
                hintBox.BackgroundColor3, hintBox.BackgroundTransparency, hintBox.BorderSizePixel, hintBox.ZIndex = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.3, 0, 25
                local w = drawSegments(hintBox, suggestions.hint, 1, 2, 26)
                hintBox.Position, hintBox.Size, hintBox.Parent = UDim2.fromOffset(4 + JavaGui.width(text:sub(1, suggestions.start)) - 1, H - 12 - 3 - 12), UDim2.fromOffset(w + 2, 12), root2d
            end
        end
        local function updateSuggestions()
            local text = box.Text
            suggestions.list, suggestions.selected, suggestions.offset, suggestions.hint = {}, 1, 0, nil
            if text:sub(1, 1) ~= "/" then drawSuggestions(); return end
            local okSuggest, s = pcall(chat.suggest, text:sub(2))
            if okSuggest and s then
                suggestions.start = s.start
                local seen = {}
                for _, o in ipairs(s.options) do if not seen[o] then seen[o] = true; suggestions.list[#suggestions.list + 1] = o end end
                if #suggestions.list == 0 then
                    local okParse, e = pcall(chat.parse, text:sub(2))
                    if not okParse and type(e) == "table" and not e.incomplete and #text > 1 and text:sub(-1) ~= " " then
                        suggestions.hint = {seg(e.msg, "red")}
                    elseif #s.usage > 0 then
                        suggestions.hint = {seg(table.concat(s.usage, " | "), "gray")}
                    end
                end
            elseif not okSuggest then
                suggestions.start = #text
            end
            drawSuggestions()
        end
        local function applySuggestion()
            local option = suggestions.list[suggestions.selected]
            if not option then return end
            local head = box.Text:sub(1, suggestions.start)
            box.Text = head .. option
            box.CursorPosition = #box.Text + 1
            suggestions.applied = true
        end
        local historyIndex
        function chat.openChat(prefix)
            if chat.open then return end
            chat.open = true
            layout()
            inputBg.Position, inputBg.Size, inputBg.Visible = UDim2.fromOffset(2, H - 14), UDim2.fromOffset(W - 4, 12), true
            box.Text = prefix or ""
            historyIndex = nil
            ctx.onOpen(true)
            dirty = true
            task.defer(function() JavaGui.focus(box) end)
            updateSuggestions()
        end
        local function closeChat()
            if not chat.open then return end
            chat.open = false
            inputBg.Visible = false
            if suggestionBox then suggestionBox:Destroy(); suggestionBox = nil end
            if hintBox then hintBox:Destroy(); hintBox = nil end
            box:ReleaseFocus()
            ctx.onOpen(false)
            dirty = true
        end
        chat.close = closeChat
        -- Roblox text chat: messages still reach other players; incoming ones show in the Java chat.
        local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
        local usesTextChat = TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService
        local restore = {}
        pcall(function()
            if usesTextChat then
                local window, bar = TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatWindowConfiguration"), TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatInputBarConfiguration")
                if window then restore[#restore + 1] = {window, "Enabled", window.Enabled}; window.Enabled = false end
                if bar then restore[#restore + 1] = {bar, "Enabled", bar.Enabled}; bar.Enabled = false end
            end
            local starter = game:GetService("StarterGui")
            restore.coreChat = starter:GetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat)
            starter:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat, false)
        end)
        local function sendChat(text)
            local channels = usesTextChat and TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
            local general = channels and channels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
            if general then
                local okSend = pcall(function() general:SendAsync(text) end)
                if okSend then return end
            end
            chat.add(T("chat.type.text", player.Name, text))
        end
        if usesTextChat then
            ctx.connections[#ctx.connections + 1] = TextChatService.MessageReceived:Connect(function(message)
                if not message.Text or message.Text == "" then return end
                local source = message.TextSource
                local name = source and source.Name or "Server"
                local id, team = teamOf(name)
                local parts = {}
                if team and team.prefix then for _, p in ipairs(team.prefix) do parts[#parts + 1] = p end end
                local nameColor = team and team.color ~= "reset" and team.color or "white"
                parts[#parts + 1] = seg("<", "white"); parts[#parts + 1] = seg(name, nameColor); parts[#parts + 1] = seg("> " .. message.Text, "white")
                chat.add(parts)
            end)
        end
        ctx.connections[#ctx.connections + 1] = box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
            if not chat.open then return end
            local text = box.Text
            if enter and text:gsub("%s", "") ~= "" then
                if chat.history[#chat.history] ~= text then chat.history[#chat.history + 1] = text end
                closeChat()
                -- Another script (Verity) may take the message or command first.
                local handled = false
                local handlers = rawget(_G, "SteveChatHandlers")
                if type(handlers) == "table" then
                    for _, h in pairs(handlers) do
                        local f = type(h) == "table" and (text:sub(1, 1) == "/" and h.command or h.message)
                        if f then
                            local okH, r = pcall(f, text)
                            if okH and r then handled = true; break end
                            if not okH then warn("Steve chat handler: " .. tostring(r)) end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not handled then
                    if text:sub(1, 1) == "/" then chat.run(text:sub(2)) else sendChat(text) end
                end
            else closeChat() end
        end)
        ctx.connections[#ctx.connections + 1] = box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
            if not chat.open then return end
            -- Roblox types the Tab key into the box too: completion must not leave a tab behind.
            if box.Text:find("\t", 1, true) then
                local cursor = box.CursorPosition
                box.Text = box.Text:gsub("\t", "")
                box.CursorPosition = math.min(math.max(1, cursor - 1), #box.Text + 1)
                return
            end
            if #box.Text > 256 then box.Text = box.Text:sub(1, 256) end
            if suggestions.applied then suggestions.applied = false; local keep = suggestions.selected; local list = suggestions.list; drawSuggestions(); suggestions.list = list; suggestions.selected = keep; return end
            updateSuggestions()
        end)
        ctx.connections[#ctx.connections + 1] = Input.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if not chat.open or not box:IsFocused() then return end
            local key = input.KeyCode
            if key == Enum.KeyCode.Tab then
                if #suggestions.list > 0 then
                    if suggestions.applied or suggestions.cycled then suggestions.selected = suggestions.selected % #suggestions.list + 1 end
                    suggestions.cycled = true
                    applySuggestion(); drawSuggestions()
                end
            elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Up or key == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
                local up = key == Enum.KeyCode.Up
                if #suggestions.list > 0 then
                    suggestions.selected = (suggestions.selected - 1 + (up and -1 or 1)) % #suggestions.list + 1
                    if suggestions.selected <= suggestions.offset then suggestions.offset = suggestions.selected - 1 end
                    if suggestions.selected > suggestions.offset + 10 then suggestions.offset = suggestions.selected - 10 end
                    drawSuggestions()
                elseif #chat.history > 0 then
                    historyIndex = math.clamp((historyIndex or #chat.history + 1) + (up and -1 or 1), 1, #chat.history + 1)
                    box.Text = chat.history[historyIndex] or ""
                    box.CursorPosition = #box.Text + 1
                end
            else suggestions.cycled = false end
        end)
        Actions:BindActionAtPriority("SteveChatOpen", function(_, state, input)
            if state ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin or chat.open or Input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
            if ctx.blocked and ctx.blocked() then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
            chat.openChat(input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Slash and "/" or "")
            return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
        end, false, Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value + 120, Enum.KeyCode.T, Enum.KeyCode.Slash)

        -- Titles (Gui.renderTitle): title at 4x, subtitle at 2x, action bar above the hotbar ---------------
        chat.titleTimes = {10, 70, 20}
        local titleState = {}
        local titleLabels, actionLabels = {}, {}
        local titleFrame
        function chat.showTitle(kind, segs)
            if kind == "clear" then titleState.title, titleState.subtitle = nil, nil
            elseif kind == "reset" then titleState.title, titleState.subtitle = nil, nil; chat.titleTimes = {10, 70, 20}
            elseif kind == "actionbar" then titleState.actionbar, titleState.actionTime = segs, os.clock()
            else titleState[kind] = segs; if kind == "title" then titleState.start = os.clock() end end
            titleState.dirty = true
        end
        local function renderTitles()
            if titleFrame then titleFrame:Destroy(); titleFrame = nil end
            titleLabels, actionLabels = {}, {}
            titleFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
            titleFrame.BackgroundTransparency, titleFrame.Size, titleFrame.ZIndex, titleFrame.Parent = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 12, root2d
            local now = os.clock()
            local fadeIn, stay, fadeOut = chat.titleTimes[1] / 20, chat.titleTimes[2] / 20, chat.titleTimes[3] / 20
            if titleState.title and titleState.start then
                local t = now - titleState.start
                local alpha = t < fadeIn and t / math.max(fadeIn, 1e-3) or t < fadeIn + stay and 1 or 1 - (t - fadeIn - stay) / math.max(fadeOut, 1e-3)
                if t <= fadeIn + stay + fadeOut then
                    local function centred(segs, scale, y)
                        local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
                        holder.BackgroundTransparency, holder.ZIndex, holder.Parent = 1, 12, titleFrame
                        local sc = Instance.new("UIScale"); sc.Scale = scale; sc.Parent = holder
                        local w = 0; for _, s in ipairs(segs) do w = w + segWidth(s) end
                        holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 10)
                        holder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(W / 2 - w * scale / 2, y)
                        drawSegments(holder, segs, 0, 0, 13)
                        for _, g in ipairs(holder:GetDescendants()) do if g:IsA("ImageLabel") then g.ImageTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1); titleLabels[#titleLabels + 1] = g end end
                    end
                    centred(titleState.title, 4, H / 2 - 10 * 4 - 4)
                    if titleState.subtitle then centred(titleState.subtitle, 2, H / 2 + 5 * 2) end
                elseif t > fadeIn + stay + fadeOut then titleState.title, titleState.subtitle = nil, nil end
            end
            if titleState.actionbar then
                local t = now - titleState.actionTime
                local alpha = math.clamp((3 - t) * 2, 0, 1)
                if alpha > 0 then
                    local segs = titleState.actionbar
                    local w = 0; for _, s in ipairs(segs) do w = w + segWidth(s) end
                    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
                    holder.BackgroundTransparency, holder.ZIndex, holder.Parent = 1, 12, titleFrame
                    holder.Position, holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(W / 2 - w / 2), H - 68 + (CONFIG.Survival and 0 or 14)), UDim2.fromOffset(w, 9)
                    drawSegments(holder, segs, 0, 0, 13)
                    for _, g in ipairs(holder:GetDescendants()) do if g:IsA("ImageLabel") then g.ImageTransparency = 1 - alpha; actionLabels[#actionLabels + 1] = g end end
                else titleState.actionbar = nil end
            end
        end
        -- Per frame: fade what is built; true when something ran out (rebuild without it).
        local function fadeTitles()
            local now = os.clock()
            local fadeIn, stay, fadeOut = chat.titleTimes[1] / 20, chat.titleTimes[2] / 20, chat.titleTimes[3] / 20
            if titleState.title and titleState.start then
                local t = now - titleState.start
                if t > fadeIn + stay + fadeOut then titleState.title, titleState.subtitle = nil, nil; return true end
                local alpha = t < fadeIn and t / math.max(fadeIn, 1e-3) or t < fadeIn + stay and 1 or 1 - (t - fadeIn - stay) / math.max(fadeOut, 1e-3)
                for _, g in ipairs(titleLabels) do g.ImageTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1) end
            end
            if titleState.actionbar then
                local alpha = math.clamp((3 - (now - titleState.actionTime)) * 2, 0, 1)
                if alpha <= 0 then titleState.actionbar = nil; return true end
                for _, g in ipairs(actionLabels) do g.ImageTransparency = 1 - alpha end
            end
            return false
        end
        -- Boss bars (BossHealthOverlay): 182x5 bar at y 12, 19 per bar, name centred above -------------
        local barFrame
        local function renderBars()
            if barFrame then barFrame:Destroy(); barFrame = nil end
            barFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
            barFrame.BackgroundTransparency, barFrame.Size, barFrame.ZIndex, barFrame.Parent = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 11, root2d
            local G = JavaContent.data.javaGui
            local y = 12
            local ids = keysOf(chat.bossbars)
            for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
                local b = chat.bossbars[id]
                local visibleToMe = false
                for _, n in ipairs(b.players) do if n == player.Name then visibleToMe = true end end
                if b.visible and visibleToMe then
                    local x = math.floor(W / 2) - 91
                    local bg, prog = G["boss_bar/" .. b.color .. "_background"], G["boss_bar/" .. b.color .. "_progress"]
                    if bg then JavaGui.image(barFrame, bg, x, y, nil, nil, nil, 11) end
                    local fill = math.floor(math.clamp(b.value / math.max(b.max, 1), 0, 1) * 182)
                    if prog and fill > 0 then JavaGui.image(barFrame, prog, x, y, fill, 5, {0, 0, fill, 5}, 12) end
                    if b.style ~= "progress" then
                        local over = G["boss_bar/" .. b.style .. "_background"]
                        local overProg = G["boss_bar/" .. b.style .. "_progress"]
                        if over then JavaGui.image(barFrame, over, x, y, nil, nil, nil, 13) end
                        if overProg and fill > 0 then JavaGui.image(barFrame, overProg, x, y, fill, 5, {0, 0, fill, 5}, 14) end
                    end
                    local w = 0; for _, s in ipairs(b.name) do w = w + segWidth(s) end
                    drawSegments(barFrame, b.name, math.floor(W / 2 - w / 2), y - 9, 15)
                    y = y + 19
                    if y >= H / 3 then break end
                end
            end
        end
        -- Scoreboard sidebar (Gui.displayScoreboardSidebar) -----------------------------------------------
        local sidebar
        local function renderSidebar()
            if sidebar then sidebar:Destroy(); sidebar = nil end
            local id, team = teamOf(player.Name)
            local objName = (team and chat.display["sidebar.team." .. (team.color or "")]) or chat.display.sidebar
            local obj = objName and chat.objectives[objName]
            if not obj then return end
            local rows = {}
            for holder, s in pairs(chat.scores) do if s[objName] ~= nil and holder:sub(1, 1) ~= "#" then rows[#rows + 1] = {holder, s[objName]} end end
            table.sort(rows, function(a, b) if a[2] ~= b[2] then return a[2] > b[2] end return a[1] < b[1] end)
            while #rows > 15 do table.remove(rows) end
            local title = obj.displayName or objName
            local width = JavaGui.width(title)
            for _, r in ipairs(rows) do width = math.max(width, JavaGui.width(r[1] .. ": ") + JavaGui.width(tostring(r[2]))) end
            local height = #rows * 9
            local bottom = math.floor(H / 2 + height / 3)
            local right = W - 3
            local left = right - width - 2
            sidebar = Instance.new("Frame")
            sidebar.BackgroundTransparency, sidebar.Size, sidebar.ZIndex, sidebar.Parent = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 10, root2d
            local function fill(x1, y1, x2, y2, alpha)
                local f = Instance.new("Frame"); f.BorderSizePixel, f.BackgroundColor3, f.BackgroundTransparency, f.ZIndex = 0, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 1 - alpha, 10
                f.Position, f.Size, f.Parent = UDim2.fromOffset(x1, y1), UDim2.fromOffset(x2 - x1, y2 - y1), sidebar
            end
            fill(left - 2, bottom - height - 10, right, bottom - height - 1, 0x66 / 255)
            fill(left - 2, bottom - height - 1, right, bottom, 0x4C / 255)
            JavaGui.text(sidebar, title, math.floor(left + width / 2 - JavaGui.width(title) / 2), bottom - height - 9, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), false, 11)
            for i, r in ipairs(rows) do
                local y = bottom - height + (i - 1) * 9
                JavaGui.text(sidebar, r[1], left, y, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), false, 11)
                local score = tostring(r[2])
                JavaGui.text(sidebar, score, right - JavaGui.width(score), y, colorOf("red"), false, 11)
            end
        end

        -- World state: time, weather, lightning, world border, post effects -------------------------------
        local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
        local originalClock = Lighting.ClockTime
        local weatherFx = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
        weatherFx.Name, weatherFx.Enabled, weatherFx.Parent = "SteveWeather", false, Lighting
        local postFx = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
        postFx.Name, postFx.Enabled, postFx.Parent = "StevePostEffect", false, Lighting
        local blurFx = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
        blurFx.Name, blurFx.Enabled, blurFx.Size, blurFx.Parent = "StevePostBlur", false, 8, Lighting
        chat.timeRate, chat.timeControlled = 1, CONFIG.JavaDayNightCycle == true
        -- Day time 0 = 06:00 (sunrise), 6000 = noon, 18000 = midnight.
        function chat.setTime(t)
            chat.time = t % (24000 * 1e6)
            chat.timeControlled = true
            Lighting.ClockTime = ((chat.time % 24000) / 1000 + 6) % 24
        end
        function chat.setWeather(kind, ticks)
            chat.weather = kind
            chat.weatherTicks = ticks or (kind == "clear" and math.random(12000, 180000) or math.random(12000, 24000))
            weatherFx.Enabled = kind ~= "clear"
            weatherFx.Brightness, weatherFx.Saturation = kind == "thunder" and -0.18 or -0.08, kind == "thunder" and -0.3 or -0.15
        end
        function chat.applyPostEffects()
            local p = chat.postEffects
            postFx.Enabled = next(p) ~= nil
            postFx.TintColor = p.creeper and Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 150) or p.spider and Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 200) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            postFx.Saturation = (p.desaturate or p.blobs) and -1 or 0
            postFx.Contrast = p.invert and -2 or 0
            blurFx.Enabled = p.blur == true
        end
        function chat.onGamerule(name, value)
            if name == "advance_time" then chat.timeControlled = chat.timeControlled or value end
            if name == "natural_health_regeneration" and ctx.world.gameplay then ctx.world.gameplay.noRegen = not value end
        end
        -- LightningBolt: a jagged white bolt from the sky, a flash, fire on the ground, 5 damage nearby.
        function chat.lightning(studs)
            local folder = Instance.new("Folder"); folder.Name = "SteveLightning"; folder.Parent = workspace
            local p = studs + Vector3.new(0, 128 * B, 0)
            for _ = 1, 12 do
                local nextP = p + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 3 * B, -(p.Y - studs.Y) / 6, (math.random() - 0.5) * 3 * B)
                if nextP.Y < studs.Y then nextP = Vector3.new(studs.X, studs.Y, studs.Z) end
                local part = Instance.new("Part")
                part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.Material = true, false, false, false, Enum.Material.Neon
                part.Color, part.Transparency = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 255), 0.2
                part.Size = Vector3.new(0.3 * B, 0.3 * B, (nextP - p).Magnitude)
                part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((p + nextP) / 2, nextP)
                part.Parent = folder
                p = nextP
                if p.Y <= studs.Y then break end
            end
            local flash = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect"); flash.Brightness = 0.6; flash.Parent = Lighting
            task.delay(0.15, function() flash:Destroy() end)
            task.delay(0.4, function() folder:Destroy() end)
            local fire = JavaContent.byId.fire
            local ground = ctx.world.sample(studs + Vector3.new(0, -B, 0))
            if fire and ground and not ctx.world.sample(studs) then ctx.world.setBlockAt(studs, fire.index, CreativeRules.copy(fire.state)) end
            for _, e in ipairs(chat.entities()) do if (toStuds(e.pos()) - studs).Magnitude < 3 * B then e.hurt(5) end end
        end
        local borderFolder
        function chat.borderChanged()
            if borderFolder then borderFolder:Destroy(); borderFolder = nil end
            local b = chat.border
            if b.size >= 59999968 then return end
            borderFolder = Instance.new("Folder"); borderFolder.Name = "SteveWorldBorder"; borderFolder.Parent = workspace
            local c, half = b.centre, b.size / 2
            local y0 = toStuds(Vector3.new(0, -64, 0)).Y
            local height = 384 * B
            for i, d in ipairs({{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}}) do
                local wall = Instance.new("Part")
                wall.Anchored, wall.CanCollide, wall.CanQuery, wall.CanTouch, wall.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
                wall.Material, wall.Color, wall.Transparency = Enum.Material.ForceField, Color3.fromRGB(32, 160, 255), 0
                local centre = toStuds(Vector3.new(c.X + d[1] * half, 0, c.Y + d[2] * half))
                wall.Size = d[1] ~= 0 and Vector3.new(0.05, height, b.size * B) or Vector3.new(b.size * B, height, 0.05)
                wall.CFrame = CFrame.new(centre.X, y0 + height / 2, centre.Z)
                wall.Parent = borderFolder
            end
        end
        local rainSprite = {w = 1, h = 6, p = {0x6E86C9}, alpha = {0.75}, d = string.rep("01", 6)}
        local acc, tickCount = 0, 0
        local function worldTick()
            tickCount = tickCount + 1
            chat.gameTime = chat.gameTime + 1
            if chat.timeControlled and not chat.timePaused and chat.gamerules.advance_time ~= false then
                chat.time = chat.time + chat.timeRate
                if tickCount % 5 == 0 then Lighting.ClockTime = ((chat.time % 24000) / 1000 + 6) % 24 end
            end
            if chat.weather ~= "clear" or (CONFIG.JavaWeatherCycle and chat.gamerules.advance_weather) then
                chat.weatherTicks = (chat.weatherTicks or 0) - 1
                if chat.weatherTicks <= 0 and chat.gamerules.advance_weather ~= false and CONFIG.JavaWeatherCycle then
                    chat.setWeather(chat.weather == "clear" and (math.random() < 0.2 and "thunder" or "rain") or "clear")
                end
            end
            if chat.weather ~= "clear" then
                -- Rain streaks falling around the player (LevelRenderer.renderSnowAndRain stand-in).
                local centre = root.Position
                for _ = 1, 6 do
                    local p = centre + Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10), math.random(6, 14), math.random(-10, 10)) * B
                    ctx.world.effects.emit("rain", p, Vector3.new(0, -1.1 * B, 0), {sprites = {rainSprite}, life = 14, size = 0.12, collision = true, gravity = 0, friction = 1})
                end
                if chat.weather == "thunder" and math.random() < 1 / 300 then
                    chat.lightning(centre + Vector3.new(math.random(-40, 40), 0, math.random(-40, 40)) * B - Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2, 0))
                end
            end
            -- WorldBorder damage: beyond the buffer, damagePerBlock per second per block outside.
            local b = chat.border
            if b.size < 59999968 and tickCount % 20 == 0 then
                local p = toJava(root.Position)
                local dx, dz = math.abs(p.X - b.centre.X) - b.size / 2, math.abs(p.Z - b.centre.Y) - b.size / 2
                local outside = math.max(dx, dz) - b.buffer
                if outside > 0 and b.damage > 0 then humanoid:TakeDamage(math.max(1, math.floor(outside * b.damage)) * humanoid.MaxHealth / 20) end
            end
            ctx.world.frozen = chat.frozen and (chat.stepTicks or 0) <= 0
            if chat.stepTicks and chat.stepTicks > 0 then chat.stepTicks = chat.stepTicks - 1 end
        end
        -- Death and join/leave messages.
        ctx.connections[#ctx.connections + 1] = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            if chat.gamerules.show_death_messages ~= false then chat.add(T(JavaContent.deathKey(ctx.world), player.Name)) end
        end)
        ctx.connections[#ctx.connections + 1] = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) chat.add({seg(T("multiplayer.player.joined", p.Name), "yellow")}) end)
        ctx.connections[#ctx.connections + 1] = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) chat.add({seg(T("multiplayer.player.left", p.Name), "yellow")}) end)
        -- Frame and tick driver.
        local lastBlink
        ctx.connections[#ctx.connections + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            local relaid = layout()
            if relaid and chat.open then inputBg.Position, inputBg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, H - 14), UDim2.fromOffset(W - 4, 12) end
            acc = acc + dt
            while acc >= 0.05 do acc = acc - 0.05; worldTick() end
            -- lines only need rebuilding on change or when one expires
            local expired = false
            if not chat.open then for _, l in ipairs(lineFrames) do if (os.clock() - l.message.time) * 20 >= 200 then expired = true end end end
            if dirty or relaid or expired then dirty = false; renderLines() end
            fadeLines()
            if chat.open then
                local blink = math.floor(os.clock() * 20 / 6) % 2 .. box.Text .. box.CursorPosition
                if blink ~= lastBlink then lastBlink = blink; drawInput() end
            elseif inputText then inputText:Destroy(); inputText, inputCursor, inputVisualKey = nil, nil, nil end
            if titleState.dirty or (relaid and (titleState.title or titleState.actionbar)) then titleState.dirty = false; renderTitles()
            elseif titleState.title or titleState.actionbar then if fadeTitles() then renderTitles() end
            elseif titleFrame then titleFrame:Destroy(); titleFrame = nil end
            if chat.barsChanged or relaid then chat.barsChanged = false; renderBars() end
            if chat.scoresChanged or relaid then chat.scoresChanged = false; renderSidebar() end
        end)
        function chat.destroy()
            if rawget(_G, "SteveChat") == chat.shared then _G.SteveChat = nil end
            Actions:UnbindAction("SteveChatOpen")
            for _, r in ipairs(restore) do pcall(function() r[1][r[2]] = r[3] end) end
            if restore.coreChat ~= nil then pcall(function() game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat, restore.coreChat) end) end
            weatherFx:Destroy(); postFx:Destroy(); blurFx:Destroy()
            if borderFolder then borderFolder:Destroy() end
            if chat.timeControlled then Lighting.ClockTime = originalClock end
            root2d:Destroy()
        end
    end
    initializeChatScreen()
    return chat
end
-- END CHAT
-- BEGIN JAVA KEYBINDS
-- Java defaults that Roblox leaves free: F swap hands, F1 hide GUI, F3 debug screen and its
-- F3+key combos, C/X+1-9 creative toolbars, double-tap jump to fly. Esc, Tab, T, /, F11
-- and F12 stay Roblox's.
local function createJavaKeybinds(ctx)
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local gui, root, player = ctx.gui, ctx.root, ctx.player
    local kb = {hudHidden = false, debugOpen = false, advancedTooltips = false,
        flying = false, jumpTriggerTime = 0, jumpWasDown = false}
    local debugCombo, showHitboxes, showChunks = false, false, false
    local messageText, messageTime = "", -math.huge
    local fpsFrames, fpsClock, fps = 0, os.clock(), 0
    local debugNextUpdate, hitboxNextUpdate, chunkKey = 0, 0, nil
    local hitboxes = {}
    local debugWorld = Instance.new("Folder")
    debugWorld.Name, debugWorld.Parent = "SteveDebugRenderer", workspace
    local function connect(signal, fn) ctx.connections[#ctx.connections + 1] = signal:Connect(fn) end
    local function busy()
        local disposed, alive = ctx.state()
        return disposed or not alive or Input:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil
    end
    -- Overlay message (Java's action bar / debug chat line), fades after a few seconds.
    local message = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    message.BackgroundTransparency, message.TextColor3, message.TextStrokeTransparency = 1, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.5
    message.Font, message.TextSize, message.Size, message.Position = Enum.Font.Code, 16, UDim2.fromOffset(800, 22), UDim2.new(0.5, -400, 1, -130)
    message.Text, message.Parent = "", gui
    local function say(text) messageText, messageTime = text, os.clock() end
    local function debugSay(text) say("[Debug]: " .. text) end
    -- F3 screen: one text line per row with Java's translucent gray backing.
    local function debugColumn(alignRight)
        local column = Instance.new("Frame")
        column.BackgroundTransparency, column.Size = 1, UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 1, 0)
        column.Position = alignRight and UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 2) or UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2)
        column.Visible, column.Parent = false, gui
        local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        layout.HorizontalAlignment = alignRight and Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right or Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left
        layout.SortOrder, layout.Parent = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, column
        return column
    end
    local debugLeft, debugRight = debugColumn(false), debugColumn(true)
    local F3 = {}
    do
        local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
        local root = Instance.new("Frame")
        root.Name, root.BackgroundTransparency, root.Visible, root.ZIndex = "SteveDebugScreen", 1, false, 40
        root.Parent = gui
        local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale"); uiScale.Parent = root
        F3.root = root
        local rows = {left = {}, right = {}}
        local BG = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
        local TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(224, 224, 224)
        local width = 320
        function F3.layout()
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
            local sc = 2
            pcall(function() sc = JavaGui.scale(vp) end)
            local inset = 0
            pcall(function() if gui.IgnoreGuiInset then inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y end end)
            uiScale.Scale = sc
            width = math.floor(vp.X / sc)
            root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, inset)
            root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, math.floor((vp.Y - inset) / sc))
        end
        local function drawRow(list, i, text, right)
            local row = list[i]
            if not row then row = {}; list[i] = row end
            if row.text == text and row.right == right and row.width == width then return end
            if row.frame then row.frame:Destroy(); row.frame = nil end
            row.text, row.right, row.width = text, right, width
            if text == nil or text == "" then return end
            local w = 0
            pcall(function() w = JavaGui.width(text) end)
            local y = 2 + 9 * (i - 1)
            local x = right and (width - 2 - w) or 2
            local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
            frame.Name, frame.BackgroundColor3, frame.BackgroundTransparency, frame.BorderSizePixel, frame.ZIndex = "F3Line", BG, 0.435, 0, 40
            frame.Position, frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(x - 1, y - 1), UDim2.fromOffset(w + 1, 9)
            frame.Parent = root
            local ok = pcall(function()
                local t = JavaGui.text(frame, text, 1, 1, TEXT, false, 41)
                t.Parent = frame
            end)
            if not ok then
                local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                l.BackgroundTransparency, l.Size, l.Font, l.TextSize, l.Text, l.TextColor3 = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Enum.Font.Code, 8, text, TEXT
                l.TextXAlignment, l.ZIndex, l.Parent = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 41, frame
            end
            row.frame = frame
        end
        function F3.draw(left, right)
            for i = 1, math.max(#left, #rows.left) do drawRow(rows.left, i, left[i], false) end
            for i = 1, math.max(#right, #rows.right) do drawRow(rows.right, i, right[i], true) end
        end
        -- block tags by block (data.blockTags is tag -> blocks)
        local tagsOf
        function F3.tags(id)
            if not tagsOf then
                tagsOf = {}
                for tag, list in pairs((JavaContent.data and JavaContent.data.blockTags) or {}) do
                    for _, x in ipairs(list) do
                        local b = tostring(x):gsub("^minecraft:", "")
                        tagsOf[b] = tagsOf[b] or {}
                        table.insert(tagsOf[b], tag)
                    end
                end
                for _, l in pairs(tagsOf) do table.sort(l) end
            end
            return tagsOf[id] or {}
        end
    end
    local function setLines(column, lines)
        local used = 0
        for _, row in ipairs(column:GetChildren()) do
            if row:IsA("TextLabel") then
                used = used + 1
                row.Visible = lines[row.LayoutOrder] ~= nil
                if row.Visible then row.Text = lines[row.LayoutOrder] end
            end
        end
        for i = used + 1, #lines do
            local row = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            row.LayoutOrder, row.AutomaticSize, row.Size = i, Enum.AutomaticSize.X, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18)
            row.BackgroundColor3, row.BackgroundTransparency, row.BorderSizePixel = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80), 0.44, 0
            row.TextColor3, row.Font, row.TextSize, row.Text = Color3.fromRGB(224, 224, 224), Enum.Font.Code, 16, lines[i]
            row.Parent = column
        end
    end
    local function gridOrigin()
        local origin = workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin")
        return typeof(origin) == "Vector3" and origin or Vector3.new(0, CONFIG.Block / 2, 0)
    end
    -- World position (studs) -> Java block-space coordinates, block (0,0,0) spanning 0..1.
    local function blockSpace(position)
        return (position - gridOrigin()) / CONFIG.Block + Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
    end
    local function feet() return blockSpace(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2, 0)) end
    -- Java yaw: 0 = south, 90 = west; Java pitch is positive looking down.
    local function javaYawPitch()
        local viewYaw, viewPitch = ctx.view()
        return (180 - math.deg(viewYaw) + 180) % 360 - 180, -math.deg(viewPitch)
    end
    local function targetInfo()
        local hit = ctx.aimHit()
        if not hit or not ctx.mineable(hit.Instance) then return nil end
        local node = ctx.world().resolve(hit.Instance)
        local entry = node and JavaContent.byIndex[node.index] or JavaContent.byName[JavaContent.classify(hit)]
        local b = blockSpace(ctx.worldMining.cell(hit))
        local lines = {string.format("Targeted Block: %d, %d, %d", math.floor(b.X), math.floor(b.Y), math.floor(b.Z)),
            "minecraft:" .. (entry and entry.id or "air")}
        local names = {}
        for k in pairs(node and node.state or {}) do names[#names + 1] = k end
        table.sort(names)
        for _, k in ipairs(names) do lines[#lines + 1] = k .. ": " .. tostring(node.state[k]) end
        return lines
    end
    local directionNames = {[0] = {"south", "Towards positive Z"}, {"west", "Towards negative X"}, {"north", "Towards negative Z"}, {"east", "Towards positive X"}}
    -- ChunkBorderRenderer: red corner posts on the neighbouring chunks, yellow 2-block grid on the
    -- current chunk's walls, blue lines on the chunk corners and every 16 blocks of height.
    local function buildChunkBorders(cx, cz, sectionY)
        debugWorld:ClearAllChildren()
        local B, base = CONFIG.Block, gridOrigin() - Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) * CONFIG.Block
        local y0, y1 = sectionY - 32, sectionY + 48
        local function line(a, b, color)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
            p.Material, p.Color = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, color
            local from, to = base + a * B, base + b * B
            p.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, (to - from).Magnitude)
            p.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((from + to) / 2, to)
            p.Parent = debugWorld
        end
        local red, yellow, blue = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0), Color3.fromRGB(64, 64, 255)
        local x0, z0 = cx * 16, cz * 16
        for dx = -16, 32, 16 do for dz = -16, 32, 16 do
            if dx == -16 or dx == 32 or dz == -16 or dz == 32 then
                line(Vector3.new(x0 + dx, y0, z0 + dz), Vector3.new(x0 + dx, y1, z0 + dz), red)
            end
        end end
        for i = 0, 16, 2 do
            local color = (i == 0 or i == 16) and blue or yellow
            line(Vector3.new(x0 + i, y0, z0), Vector3.new(x0 + i, y1, z0), color)
            line(Vector3.new(x0 + i, y0, z0 + 16), Vector3.new(x0 + i, y1, z0 + 16), color)
            line(Vector3.new(x0, y0, z0 + i), Vector3.new(x0, y1, z0 + i), color)
            line(Vector3.new(x0 + 16, y0, z0 + i), Vector3.new(x0 + 16, y1, z0 + i), color)
        end
        for y = y0, y1, 2 do
            local color = y % 16 == 0 and blue or yellow
            line(Vector3.new(x0, y, z0), Vector3.new(x0 + 16, y, z0), color)
            line(Vector3.new(x0, y, z0 + 16), Vector3.new(x0 + 16, y, z0 + 16), color)
            line(Vector3.new(x0, y, z0), Vector3.new(x0, y, z0 + 16), color)
            line(Vector3.new(x0 + 16, y, z0), Vector3.new(x0 + 16, y, z0 + 16), color)
        end
    end
    -- Entity hitboxes: a white bounding box around every mob and dropped item.
    local function refreshHitboxes()
        local wanted, world = {}, ctx.world()
        if showHitboxes and world then
            for _, m in ipairs(world.gameplay.mobs or {}) do
                local box = m.visual and (m.visual.model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.visual.model)
                if box and box.Parent then wanted[box] = true end
            end
            for _, d in ipairs(world.drops or {}) do
                if d.visual and d.visual.model.Parent then wanted[d.visual.model] = true end
            end
        end
        for target, box in pairs(hitboxes) do
            if not wanted[target] or not target.Parent then box:Destroy(); hitboxes[target] = nil end
        end
        for target in pairs(wanted) do
            if not hitboxes[target] then
                local box = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
                box.Color3, box.LineThickness, box.SurfaceTransparency, box.Adornee = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.02, 1, target
                box.Parent = gui
                hitboxes[target] = box
            end
        end
    end
    function kb.update()
        fpsFrames = fpsFrames + 1
        if os.clock() - fpsClock >= 1 then fps, fpsFrames, fpsClock = fpsFrames, 0, os.clock() end
        local age = os.clock() - messageTime
        message.Text = age < 4 and messageText or ""
        message.TextTransparency = math.clamp(age - 3, 0, 1)
        if os.clock() >= hitboxNextUpdate then hitboxNextUpdate = os.clock() + 0.25; refreshHitboxes() end
        local p = feet()
        local bx, by, bz = math.floor(p.X), math.floor(p.Y), math.floor(p.Z)
        local cx, cy, cz = math.floor(bx / 16), math.floor(by / 16), math.floor(bz / 16)
        if showChunks then
            local key = cx .. ":" .. cy .. ":" .. cz
            if key ~= chunkKey then chunkKey = key; buildChunkBorders(cx, cz, cy * 16) end
        elseif chunkKey then chunkKey = nil; debugWorld:ClearAllChildren() end
        debugLeft.Visible, debugRight.Visible = false, false
        F3.root.Visible = kb.debugOpen
        if not kb.debugOpen or os.clock() < debugNextUpdate then return end
        debugNextUpdate = os.clock() + 0.1
        F3.layout()
        local yaw, pitch = javaYawPitch()
        local facing = directionNames[math.floor(yaw / 90 + 0.5) % 4]
        local w = ctx.world()
        -- counts (once a second)
        if not F3.countAt or os.clock() - F3.countAt > 1 then
            F3.countAt = os.clock()
            local nodes = 0
            for _ in pairs((w and w.nodes) or {}) do nodes = nodes + 1 end
            F3.nodes = nodes
            F3.mobs = w and w.gameplay and w.gameplay.mobs and #w.gameplay.mobs or 0
            F3.drops = w and w.drops and #w.drops or 0
        end
        -- light, biome (a generated world knows them; the map is open sky)
        local sky, blockLight, biome = 15, 0, "minecraft:plains"
        local WGm = rawget(_G, "SteveWG")
        local session = WGm and WGm.current and WGm.current()
        if session then
            pcall(function()
                local sx, sy, sz = session:toBlock(root.Position)
                sky = session:lightAt(sx, sy, sz) or sky
                local b = session.gen and session.gen:biome(sx, sy, sz)
                if b then biome = (tostring(b):find(":") and tostring(b)) or ("minecraft:" .. tostring(b)) end
            end)
        end
        local time = math.floor(((game:GetService("Lighting").ClockTime - 6) % 24) * 1000)
        local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.zero
        local memMb = 0
        pcall(function() memMb = game:GetService("Stats"):GetTotalMemoryUsageMb() end)
        local luaMb = collectgarbage("count") / 1024
        local left = {
            "Minecraft 26.3 (26.3/Steve)",
            string.format("%d fps T: inf vsync", fps),
            "Integrated server @ 50 ms ticks",
            string.format("C: %d blocks D: %d", F3.nodes or 0, 12),
            string.format("E: %d mobs, %d items", F3.mobs or 0, F3.drops or 0),
            "minecraft:overworld FC: 0",
            "",
            string.format("XYZ: %.3f / %.5f / %.3f", p.X, p.Y, p.Z),
            string.format("Block: %d %d %d [%d %d %d]", bx, by, bz, bx % 16, by % 16, bz % 16),
            string.format("Chunk: %d %d %d in %d %d %d", bx % 16, by % 16, bz % 16, cx, cy, cz),
            string.format("Facing: %s (%s) (%.1f / %.1f)", facing[1], facing[2], yaw, pitch),
            string.format("Client Light: %d (%d sky, %d block)", math.max(sky, blockLight), sky, blockLight),
            "Biome: " .. biome,
            string.format("Local Difficulty: 2.25 // 0.00 (Day %d)", math.floor(time / 24000)),
            string.format("Time: %d", time),
            "Mode: " .. (CONFIG.Survival and "Survival" or "Creative") .. (kb.flying and " (flying)" or ""),
            "",
            "For help: press F3 + Q",
        }
        local right = {
            "Luau: Roblox client 64bit",
            string.format("Mem: %d MB (Luau %d MB)", math.floor(memMb), math.floor(luaMb)),
            string.format("Display: %dx%d (Roblox)", math.floor(vp.X), math.floor(vp.Y)),
            "",
        }
        local tl = targetInfo()
        if tl then
            for _, l in ipairs(tl) do right[#right + 1] = l end
            local id = tl[2] and tl[2]:gsub("^minecraft:", "")
            for _, tag in ipairs(F3.tags(id or "")) do right[#right + 1] = "#minecraft:" .. tag end
            right[#right + 1] = ""
        end
        -- the fluid the crosshair reaches (water / lava blocks along the view)
        do
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local fluid
            if cam and w and w.nodeAt then
                local o, d = cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.LookVector
                local B = CONFIG.Block
                local g = gridOrigin()
                for k = 1, 80 do
                    local q = o + d * (k * 0.25 * B)
                    local c = g + Vector3.new(math.floor((q.X - g.X) / B + 0.5), math.floor((q.Y - g.Y) / B + 0.5), math.floor((q.Z - g.Z) / B + 0.5)) * B
                    local n = w.nodeAt(c)
                    if n then
                        if n.id == "water" or n.id == "lava" or (n.state and n.state.waterlogged == "true") then fluid = {c, n} end
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if fluid then
                local fb = blockSpace(fluid[1])
                right[#right + 1] = string.format("Targeted Fluid: %d, %d, %d", math.floor(fb.X), math.floor(fb.Y), math.floor(fb.Z))
                local fid = fluid[2].id == "lava" and "lava" or "water"
