                local width, height, pixels = SkinCodec.png(SkinCodec.base64(JESUS_SKIN_BASE64))
                jesusSkinPixels = SkinCodec.fixSkin(width, height, pixels)
            end
            return jesusSkinPixels
        end
        local function runJesusScene(target, isVictim, sayingIndex)
            if (jesusCooldown[target] or 0) > os.clock() then return false end
            local character = target.Character
            local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then return false end
            local skinPixels = getJesusSkinPixels()
            jesusCooldown[target] = os.clock() + 30
            local start = root.Position
            local model = Instance.new("Model")
            model.Name = "SteveJesusScene"
            local pieces = {}
            local pixelScale = B / 16
            local boxes = SkinCodec.boxes(false)
            local layout = {
                Head = {pivot = Vector3.new(0, 24, 0), offset = Vector3.new(0, 28, 0)},
                Torso = {pivot = Vector3.new(0, 24, 0), offset = Vector3.new(0, 18, 0)},
                ["Right Arm"] = {pivot = Vector3.new(5, 22, 0), offset = Vector3.new(5, 18, 0)},
                ["Left Arm"] = {pivot = Vector3.new(-5, 22, 0), offset = Vector3.new(-5, 18, 0)},
                ["Right Leg"] = {pivot = Vector3.new(1.9, 12, 0), offset = Vector3.new(1.9, 6, 0)},
                ["Left Leg"] = {pivot = Vector3.new(-1.9, 12, 0), offset = Vector3.new(-1.9, 6, 0)},
            }
            for name, def in pairs(layout) do
                local box = boxes[name]
                local p = Instance.new("Part")
                p.Name, p.Size, p.Anchored, p.Transparency = name, Vector3.new(box[5], box[6], box[7]) * pixelScale, true, 1
                p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = false, false, false, false
                p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                p.Parent = model
                for i, face in ipairs(SkinCodec.faces(skinPixels, box[1], box[2], box[5], box[6], box[7])) do
                    JavaContent.surface(p, faces[i], face)
                end
                local outer = Instance.new("Part")
                outer.Name = name .. " Layer"
                outer.Size = Vector3.new(box[5] + box[8] * 2, box[6] + box[8] * 2, box[7] + box[8] * 2) * pixelScale
                outer.Anchored, outer.Transparency = true, 1
                outer.CanCollide, outer.CanQuery, outer.CanTouch, outer.CastShadow = false, false, false, false
                outer.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                outer.Parent = model
                for i, face in ipairs(SkinCodec.faces(skinPixels, box[3], box[4], box[5], box[6], box[7])) do
                    JavaContent.surface(outer, faces[i], face)
                end
                pieces[#pieces + 1] = {part = p, layer = outer, pivot = def.pivot * pixelScale, offset = def.offset * pixelScale}
            end
            local saying = JESUS_SAYINGS[math.clamp(math.floor(sayingIndex or 1), 1, #JESUS_SAYINGS)]
            if creativeWorld.chat then
                creativeWorld.chat.add("<Jesus> " .. saying)
                pcall(creativeWorld.chat.showTitle, "title", {{text = "Jesus", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0), bold = true}})
                pcall(creativeWorld.chat.showTitle, "subtitle", {{text = saying, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 170), italic = true}})
            end
            local lightPart = Instance.new("Part")
            lightPart.Name, lightPart.Anchored, lightPart.Transparency = "JesusLight", true, 1
            lightPart.CanCollide, lightPart.CanQuery, lightPart.CanTouch = false, false, false
            lightPart.Size, lightPart.Position, lightPart.Parent = Vector3.one, start + Vector3.new(0, 12 * B, 0), model
            local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
            light.Color, light.Brightness, light.Range, light.Shadows = Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 218), 2, 28, false
            light.Parent = lightPart
            model.Parent = workspace
            -- Heaven opens: a pillar of light from the sky onto the chosen one, a glowing disc on the ground,
            -- a halo, sparkles and a choir.
            local ground = start - Vector3.new(0, (root.Size.Y / 2), 0)
            local beam = Instance.new("Part")
            beam.Name, beam.Shape, beam.Anchored, beam.CanCollide, beam.CanQuery, beam.CanTouch, beam.CastShadow = "JesusBeam", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, true, false, false, false, false
            beam.Material, beam.Color, beam.Transparency = Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 190), 1
            beam.Size = Vector3.new(80 * B, 2.6 * B, 2.6 * B)
            beam.CFrame = CFrame.new(ground + Vector3.new(0, 40 * B, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
            beam.Parent = model
            local core = beam:Clone()
            core.Name, core.Size, core.Color = "JesusBeamCore", Vector3.new(80 * B, 0.9 * B, 0.9 * B), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 240)
            core.Parent = model
            local disc = beam:Clone()
            disc.Name, disc.Size, disc.CFrame = "JesusGlow", Vector3.new(0.05, 4 * B, 4 * B), CFrame.new(ground + Vector3.new(0, 0.03, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
            disc.Parent = model
            local halo = {}
            for i = 1, 14 do
                local p = Instance.new("Part")
                p.Name, p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = "JesusHalo", true, false, false, false, false
                p.Material, p.Color, p.Size = Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 90), Vector3.new(0.09, 0.09, 0.16) * B
                p.Parent = model
                halo[i] = p
            end
            -- The figure glows.
            for _, piece in ipairs(pieces) do
                for _, part in ipairs({piece.part, piece.layer}) do
                    for _, g in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do if g:IsA("SurfaceGui") then g.LightInfluence = 0 end end
                end
            end
            light.Brightness, light.Range = 4, 40
            local function sound(name, pitch) if MinecraftSounds then pcall(MinecraftSounds.play, name, start, 1, pitch or 1) end end
            sound("block.beacon.activate", 0.8)
            sound("block.end_portal.spawn", 1.4)
            local emit = creativeWorld.effects and creativeWorld.effects.emit
            local chimed = false
            local begun, ascended = os.clock(), false
            local descentEnd = start + Vector3.new(0, 2.5 * B, 0)
            task.spawn(function()
                while model.Parent and target.Parent and root.Parent do
                    local elapsed = os.clock() - begun
                    local base
                    if elapsed < 2.5 then
                        local alpha = math.clamp(elapsed / 2.5, 0, 1)
                        base = start + Vector3.new(0, (12 - 9.5 * alpha) * B, 0)
                    elseif elapsed < 3.8 then
                        local alpha = math.clamp((elapsed - 2.5) / 1.3, 0, 1)
                        local targetFacing = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
                        if targetFacing.Magnitude < 0.001 then targetFacing = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
                        local behind = root.Position - targetFacing.Unit * (1.8 * B) - Vector3.new(0, B, 0)
                        base = descentEnd:Lerp(behind, alpha)
                    else
                        if isVictim and not ascended then
                            ascended = true
                            if ctx.jesusAscend then task.spawn(ctx.jesusAscend) end
                        end
                        local targetFacing = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
                        if targetFacing.Magnitude < 0.001 then targetFacing = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
                        base = root.Position - targetFacing.Unit * (1.8 * B) - Vector3.new(0, B, 0)
                    end
                    local flatDirection = Vector3.new(root.Position.X - base.X, 0, root.Position.Z - base.Z)
                    if flatDirection.Magnitude < 0.001 then
                        flatDirection = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
                    end
                    if flatDirection.Magnitude < 0.001 then flatDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
                    local frame = CFrame.lookAt(base, base + flatDirection.Unit)
                    local walkPhase = elapsed * 20 * 0.6662
                    local walkAmount = math.clamp(elapsed / 2.5, 0, 1)
                    for _, piece in ipairs(pieces) do
                        local pose
                        if piece.part.Name == "Head" then
                            local headPosition = (frame * CFrame.new(piece.offset)).Position
                            local lookDirection = root.Position - headPosition
                            if lookDirection.Magnitude < 0.001 then lookDirection = frame.LookVector end
                            local look = frame:VectorToObjectSpace(lookDirection.Unit)
                            local pitch = math.asin(math.clamp(look.Y, -1, 1))
                            local headYaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
                            pose = frame * CFrame.new(piece.offset) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, headYaw, 0)
                        else
                            local swing = 0
                            if piece.part.Name == "Right Arm" then
                                swing = elapsed >= 3.8 and math.pi / 2 or math.cos(walkPhase + math.pi) * walkAmount
                            elseif piece.part.Name == "Left Arm" then
                                swing = elapsed >= 3.8 and math.pi / 2 or math.cos(walkPhase) * walkAmount
                            elseif piece.part.Name == "Right Leg" then
                                swing = math.cos(walkPhase) * 1.4 * walkAmount
                            elseif piece.part.Name == "Left Leg" then
                                swing = math.cos(walkPhase + math.pi) * 1.4 * walkAmount
                            end
                            pose = frame * CFrame.new(piece.pivot) * CFrame.Angles(swing, 0, 0)
                                * CFrame.new(piece.offset - piece.pivot)
                        end
                        piece.part.CFrame = pose
                        piece.layer.CFrame = pose
                    end
                    lightPart.Position = base + Vector3.new(0, 3 * B, 0)
                    -- Light: fades in, breathes, fades out at the end.
                    local fadeIn, fadeOut = math.clamp(elapsed / 1.2, 0, 1), math.clamp((8.2 - elapsed) / 1, 0, 1)
                    local glow = fadeIn * fadeOut
                    beam.Transparency = 1 - glow * (0.35 + 0.1 * math.sin(elapsed * 3))
                    core.Transparency = 1 - glow * 0.6
                    disc.Transparency = 1 - glow * 0.5
                    -- Halo over the head, turning slowly.
                    local headFrame = pieces[1] and (function() for _, piece in ipairs(pieces) do if piece.part.Name == "Head" then return piece.part.CFrame end end end)()
                    if headFrame then
                        local top = headFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.38 * B, 0)
                        for i, p in ipairs(halo) do
                            local a = i / #halo * math.pi * 2 + elapsed * 0.8
                            p.CFrame = top * CFrame.Angles(0, a, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.32 * B)
                            p.Transparency = 1 - fadeIn * fadeOut
                        end
                    end
                    -- Sparkles around the figure and drifting up the pillar.
                    if emit and math.random() < 0.6 then
                        pcall(emit, "end_rod", base + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 1.2 * B, math.random() * 2 * B, (math.random() - 0.5) * 1.2 * B),
                            Vector3.new(0, 0.03 * B, 0))
                        pcall(emit, "glow", ground + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * B, math.random() * 6 * B, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * B),
                            Vector3.new(0, 0.08 * B, 0))
                    end
                    if not chimed and elapsed >= 2.5 then
                        chimed = true
                        sound("entity.player.levelup", 0.6)
                        sound("block.amethyst_block.resonate", 1.2)
                    end
                    if elapsed >= 8.2 then break end
                    task.wait(1 / 30)
                end
                if model.Parent then model:Destroy() end
            end)
            return true
        end
        Net.scene = runJesusScene
        apply = function(peer, msgType, d, scope)
            if msgType==T_MODSTATE then
                local n=d[1]
                if not n or n<1 or n>80 or #d~=n+2 then return end
                local id=string.char(table.unpack(d,2,n+1))
                peer.mods=peer.mods or {};peer.mods[id]=d[n+2]==1
                if not peer.mods[id] then
                    local hadEffects=Net.modInbox[peer] and Net.modInbox[peer][id]~=nil

                        for tag,m in pairs(Net.puppets) do

                        end

                    if hadEffects then Net.recomposeMod(id) end
                end
                return
            elseif msgType==T_MOD then
                local n=d[1]
                if not n or n<1 or n>80 or #d<n+2 then return end

                if kind==T_MODEQUIP then key="equipment"
                elseif kind==T_SKILL and #body>=13 then key="skill:"..table.concat(body,",",10,13)
                elseif kind==T_MOB and #body>=16 then key="mob:"..table.concat(body,",",1,5)
                elseif (kind==T_SET or kind==T_BREAK) and #body>=6 then key="cell:"..table.concat(body,",",1,6)

                    item=previous and previous.signature==signature and previous or {packet=d,signature=signature}

                end

        Net.applyMessage = apply -- same decoder used by the carrier and integration checks
        local function readFrame(player)
            local character = player.Character
            local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local anim = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            if not anim then return nil end
            local slotOf = {}
            for i, id in ipairs(carriersFor(hum)) do slotOf["rbxassetid://" .. id] = i end
            local values, count = {}, 0
            for _, t in ipairs(anim:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                local slot = t.Animation and slotOf[t.Animation.AnimationId]
                if slot and not values[slot] then
                    local v = math.floor(t.Speed + 0.5) - 1
                    if v < 0 or v > 16777215 then return nil end
                    values[slot] = v; count = count + 1
                end
            end
            if count < SLOTS then return nil end
            local bytes = {}
            for slot = 1, SLOTS do
                local v = values[slot]
                bytes[#bytes + 1] = math.floor(v / 65536); bytes[#bytes + 1] = math.floor(v / 256) % 256; bytes[#bytes + 1] = v % 256
            end
            local s1, s2 = 1, 0
            for i = 1, 2 + DATA do s1 = (s1 + bytes[i]) % 255; s2 = (s2 + s1) % 255 end
            if s1 ~= bytes[3 + DATA] or s2 ~= bytes[4 + DATA] then return nil end
            return bytes
        end
        local function receiveFrom(player)
            do
                do
                    local raw = readFrame(player)
                    local frame = nil
                    if raw then
                        local sig = table.concat(raw, ",")
                        if Net.lastRaw[player] == sig then frame = raw end
                        Net.lastRaw[player] = sig
                    end
                    local peer = Net.peers[player]
                    if frame then
                        if not peer then
                            peer = {player = player, buffer = nil, lastSeq = nil, joined = os.clock()}; Net.peers[player] = peer
                            Net.discovered(player)
                        end
                        peer.seen = os.clock()
                        if frame[1] ~= peer.lastSeq then
                            if peer.lastSeq and frame[1] ~= (peer.lastSeq + 1) % 256 then peer.msg = nil end -- missed frames: resync
                            peer.lastSeq = frame[1]
                            local i = 3
                            if not peer.msg then
                                if frame[2] == 0 then i = 3 + DATA else i = 2 + frame[2] end
                            end
                            while i <= 2 + DATA do
                                local b = frame[i]
                                local m = peer.msg
                                if not m then
                                    if b ~= 0 then peer.msg = {type = b, data = {}} end
                                elseif not m.len then
                                    m.len = b
                                else
                                    m.data[#m.data + 1] = b
                                end
                                m = peer.msg
                                if m and m.len and #m.data >= m.len then peer.msg = nil; apply(peer, m.type, m.data) end
                                i = i + 1
                            end
                        end
                    elseif peer and os.clock() - (peer.seen or 0) > 10 then
                        Net.forget(player)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local function receiveTick()
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player ~= Players.LocalPlayer then
                    -- One player's bad data must not stop the reads of everyone after them.
                    local ok, e = pcall(receiveFrom, player)
                    if not ok and not Net.warnedReceive then Net.warnedReceive = true; warn("Steve net receive: " .. tostring(e)) end
                end
            end
        end

        -- Other players as Steve -------------------------------------------------------------------
        local px = B / 16 * 0.9375
        local layout = {
            Head = {size = Vector3.new(8, 8, 8), pivot = Vector3.new(0, 24, 0), offset = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)},
            Torso = {size = Vector3.new(8, 12, 4), pivot = Vector3.new(0, 24, 0), offset = Vector3.new(0, -6, 0)},
            ["Right Arm"] = {size = Vector3.new(4, 12, 4), pivot = Vector3.new(5, 22, 0), offset = Vector3.new(1, -4, 0)},
            ["Left Arm"] = {size = Vector3.new(4, 12, 4), pivot = Vector3.new(-5, 22, 0), offset = Vector3.new(-1, -4, 0)},
            ["Right Leg"] = {size = Vector3.new(4, 12, 4), pivot = Vector3.new(1.9, 12, 0), offset = Vector3.new(0, -6, 0)},
            ["Left Leg"] = {size = Vector3.new(4, 12, 4), pivot = Vector3.new(-1.9, 12, 0), offset = Vector3.new(0, -6, 0)},
        }
        local skinCache = {}
        local function skinPixels(key, slim)
            local cached = skinCache[key .. tostring(slim)]
            if cached then return cached end
            local px64
            if key:sub(1, 8) == "default:" then
                local entry = JavaContent.data.playerSkins and JavaContent.data.playerSkins[key:sub(9)]
                local sprite = entry and (entry[slim and "slim" or "wide"] or entry.wide)
                if sprite then px64 = SkinCodec.fromSprite(sprite) end
            elseif key:sub(1, 4) == "url:" then
                local req = request or http_request
                local ok, r = pcall(function() return req({Url = key:sub(5), Method = "GET"}) end)
                if ok and type(r) == "table" and r.Body then
                    local okPng, w, h, p = pcall(SkinCodec.png, r.Body)
                    if okPng then px64 = SkinCodec.fixSkin(w, h, p) end
                end
            end
            if px64 then skinCache[key .. tostring(slim)] = px64 end
            return px64
        end
        local function paintSkin(peer)
            peer.skinDirty = false
            peer.paintGen = (peer.paintGen or 0) + 1
            local gen = peer.paintGen
            local key, slim = peer.skinKey or "default:steve", peer.slim
            task.spawn(function()
                local pixels = skinPixels(key, slim)
                if gen ~= peer.paintGen or not peer.parts then return end
                if not pixels then
                    -- Download failed: try again shortly.
                    task.delay(5, function() if gen == peer.paintGen then peer.skinDirty = true end end)
                    return
                end
                local boxes = SkinCodec.boxes(slim)
                for name, part in pairs(peer.parts) do
                    local b = boxes[name]
                    for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("SurfaceGui") then child:Destroy() end end
                    part.Size = Vector3.new(b[5], b[6], b[7]) * px
                    for i, face in ipairs(SkinCodec.faces(pixels, b[1], b[2], b[5], b[6], b[7])) do JavaContent.surface(part, faces[i], face) end
                    -- The second layer (hat, jacket, sleeves, pants): a see-through box 0.5 / 0.25 px larger.
                    local outer = peer.layers[name]
                    for _, child in ipairs(outer:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("SurfaceGui") then child:Destroy() end end
                    outer.Size = Vector3.new(b[5] + b[8] * 2, b[6] + b[8] * 2, b[7] + b[8] * 2) * px
                    for i, face in ipairs(SkinCodec.faces(pixels, b[3], b[4], b[5], b[6], b[7])) do JavaContent.surface(outer, faces[i], face) end
                end
                peer.skinShown = key
            end)
        end
        local function buildSteve(peer)
            local model = Instance.new("Model")
            model.Name = "SteveNetPlayer_" .. peer.player.Name
            peer.parts, peer.layers, peer.joints = {}, {}, {}
            for name, def in pairs(layout) do
                local p = Instance.new("Part")
                p.Name, p.Size, p.Anchored, p.Transparency = name, def.size * px, true, 1
                p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = false, false, false, true
                p.Parent = model
                peer.parts[name] = p
                local outer = Instance.new("Part")
                outer.Name, outer.Size, outer.Anchored, outer.Transparency = name .. " Layer", def.size * px, true, 1
                outer.CanCollide, outer.CanQuery, outer.CanTouch, outer.CastShadow = false, false, false, false
                outer.Parent = model
                peer.layers[name] = outer
            end
            -- Hurt / death tint (LivingEntityRenderer's red overlay).
            local tint = Instance.new("Highlight")
            tint.FillColor, tint.FillTransparency, tint.OutlineTransparency, tint.Enabled = Color3.new(1, 0, 0), 0.6, 1, false
            tint.DepthMode, tint.Adornee, tint.Parent = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded, model, model
            peer.tint = tint
            peer.armorVisuals = {}
            model.Parent = workspace
            peer.model = model
            peer.limb, peer.limbAmount = 0, 0
            peer.skinDirty = true
        end
        local function hideAvatar(character, hidden)
            for _, d in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal") then d.LocalTransparencyModifier = hidden and 1 or 0 end
            end
        end
        function Net.forget(player, quiet)
            local peer = Net.peers[player]
            Net.lastRaw[player] = nil
            if not peer then return end
            if not quiet and player.Parent and creativeWorld.chat and not ctx.disposed() then
                creativeWorld.chat.add("\u{A7}e" .. player.Name .. " left the Minecraft world")
            end
            if peer.model then peer.model:Destroy() end
            if peer.heldModel then peer.heldModel.model:Destroy() end
            if peer.offModel then peer.offModel.model:Destroy() end
            if player.Character then hideAvatar(player.Character, false) end
            Net.modInbox[peer]=nil
            Net.peers[player] = nil
        end
        local function renderPeers(dt)
            for player, peer in pairs(Net.peers) do
                local character = player.Character
                local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not root or not hum then
                    if peer.model then peer.model.Parent = nil end
                else
                    repeat -- (break = done with this player this frame)
                    if not peer.model then buildSteve(peer) end
                    if peer.skinDirty then paintSkin(peer) end
                    if peer.character ~= character then
                        peer.character, peer.deadFlag, peer.deathTime, peer.deathBase = character, false, nil, nil
                    end
                    local dead = peer.deadFlag or hum.Health <= 0 or hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
                    hideAvatar(character, true)
                    if dead and peer.deathTime and peer.deathTime >= 1 then
                        if not peer.poofed then
                            peer.poofed = true
                            local at = peer.deathBase.Position + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.5, 0)
                            pcall(function()
                                for _ = 1, 20 do
                                    creativeWorld.effects.emit("poof", at + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random(), math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.8,
                                        Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() * 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.1)
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                        peer.model.Parent = nil
                        break
                    end
                    peer.poofed = nil
                    peer.model.Parent = workspace
                    for _, p in pairs(peer.parts) do p.Transparency = peer.spectator and 1 or 0 end
                    for _, p in pairs(peer.layers) do
                        for _, g in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do if g:IsA("SurfaceGui") then g.Enabled = not peer.spectator end end
                    end
                    -- Limb swing from how fast their (replicated) character moves, like Herobrine/Java.
                    local position = root.Position
                    local moved = peer.lastPosition and Vector3.new(position.X - peer.lastPosition.X, 0, position.Z - peer.lastPosition.Z).Magnitude / B or 0
                    peer.lastPosition = position
                    local perTick = moved / math.max(dt, 1 / 240) * CONFIG.Tick
                    peer.limbAmount = peer.limbAmount + (math.min(perTick * 4, 1) - peer.limbAmount) * math.min(1, 0.4 * dt / CONFIG.Tick)
                    peer.limb = peer.limb + peer.limbAmount * dt / CONFIG.Tick
                    -- Their root is posed for the plain Roblox avatar (createReplication's posed()): upright at
                    -- the avatar's hip height, leaning 0.5 rad when sneaking (R6), and lying flat (up = facing)
                    -- just above the floor when swimming or crawling. Undo that to find their feet.
                    local r15 = hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
                    local legs = r15 and hum.HipHeight or 2
                    local feet, look
                    if peer.swim and not dead then
                        feet = position - Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Z * 0.5 + 0.1, 0)
                        look = root.CFrame.UpVector
                    elseif peer.gliding and not dead then
                        feet = position - Vector3.new(0, 0.3 * B, 0)
                        look = root.CFrame.UpVector
                    else
                        local leanR6 = peer.crouch and not r15
                        feet = position - Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2 + legs - (leanR6 and (1 - math.cos(0.5)) * root.Size.Y / 2 or 0), 0)
                        look = root.CFrame.LookVector
                        local ahead = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
                        if leanR6 and ahead.Magnitude > 0.05 then feet = feet - ahead.Unit * math.sin(0.5) * root.Size.Y / 2 end
                    end
                    if Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z).Magnitude < 0.05 then look = peer.lastLook or root.CFrame.LookVector end
                    peer.lastLook = look
                    local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
                    local function wrap(a) return (a + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi end
                    local mv = peer.turnFrom and (position - peer.turnFrom) or Vector3.zero
                    peer.turnFrom = position
                    local bodyYaw = peer.bodyYaw or yaw
                    local target = bodyYaw
                    if Vector3.new(mv.X, 0, mv.Z).Magnitude / B / math.max(dt, 1 / 240) * CONFIG.Tick > 0.05 then
                        local moveYaw = math.atan2(-mv.X, -mv.Z)
                        if math.abs(wrap(yaw - moveYaw)) > math.rad(95) then moveYaw = wrap(moveYaw + math.pi) end
                        target = moveYaw
                    end
                    if peer.swinging or peer.swim or peer.gliding then target = yaw end
                    bodyYaw = bodyYaw + wrap(target - bodyYaw) * math.min(1, 0.3 * dt / CONFIG.Tick)
                    local turn = wrap(yaw - bodyYaw)
                    if math.abs(turn) > math.rad(50) then bodyYaw = bodyYaw + turn - math.sign(turn) * math.rad(50) end
                    bodyYaw = wrap(bodyYaw)
                    peer.bodyYaw = bodyYaw
                    local base = CFrame.new(feet) * CFrame.Angles(0, bodyYaw, 0)
                    peer.shadow = peer.shadow or createEntityShadow(peer.model)
                    peer.shadow.update(dead and peer.deathBase and peer.deathBase.Position or feet, not peer.spectator)
                    if dead then
                        if not peer.deathTime then peer.deathTime, peer.deathBase = 0, base end
                        peer.deathTime = peer.deathTime + dt
                        -- LivingEntityRenderer.setupRotations: zRot = min(1, sqrt(deathTime / 20 * 1.6)) * 90 degrees.
                        base = peer.deathBase * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.min(1, math.sqrt(peer.deathTime * 1.6)) * math.pi / 2)
                        peer.limbAmount = 0
                    else
                        peer.deathTime, peer.deathBase = nil, nil
                    end
                    -- Swimming pose (swimming / crawling): AvatarRenderer.setupRotations lays the body flat
                    -- (-90 about X) and moves it back 1 block, 0.3 up, head toward where they face.
                    peer.swimAmount = math.clamp((peer.swimAmount or 0) + ((peer.swim and not dead) and 1 or -1) * dt * 1.8, 0, 1)
                    if peer.swimAmount > 0 then
                        local a = peer.swimAmount
                        local tilt = peer.inWater and (-math.pi / 2 + (peer.pitch or 0)) or -math.pi / 2
                        base = base * CFrame.new(0, 0.3 * B * a, 0) * CFrame.Angles(tilt * a, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -B * a, 0)
                    end
                    peer.glideAmount = math.clamp((peer.glideAmount or 0) + ((peer.gliding and not dead) and 1 or -1) * dt * 2, 0, 1)
                    if peer.glideAmount > 0 then
                        base = base * CFrame.new(0, 0.3 * B, 0) * CFrame.Angles((-math.pi / 2 + (peer.pitch or 0)) * peer.glideAmount, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -0.3 * B, 0)
                    end
                    peer.tint.Enabled = dead or (peer.hurtUntil or 0) > os.clock()
                    -- HumanoidModel.setupAnim (Java), angles in Java's xRot / yRot / zRot.
                    local limb, amount = peer.limb, peer.limbAmount
                    local age = os.clock() * 20
                    local function lerp(a, from, to) return from + (to - from) * a end
                    local function rotLerp(a, from, to) return from + wrap(to - from) * a end
                    local hx, hy = -(peer.pitch or 0), -wrap(yaw - bodyYaw)
                    if peer.gliding then hx = -math.pi / 4 end
                    local head, body = {x = hx, y = hy, z = 0}, {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0}
                    local rA = {x = math.cos(limb * 0.6662 + math.pi) * 2 * amount * 0.5, y = 0, z = 0}
                    local lA = {x = math.cos(limb * 0.6662) * 2 * amount * 0.5, y = 0, z = 0}
                    local rL = {x = math.cos(limb * 0.6662) * 1.4 * amount, y = 0.005, z = 0.005}
                    local lL = {x = math.cos(limb * 0.6662 + math.pi) * 1.4 * amount, y = -0.005, z = -0.005}
                    if peer.riding then
                        rA.x, lA.x = rA.x - math.pi / 5, lA.x - math.pi / 5
                        rL.x, rL.y, rL.z = -1.4137167, math.pi / 10, 0.07853982
                        lL.x, lL.y, lL.z = -1.4137167, -math.pi / 10, -0.07853982
                    end
                    local function modEquipmentIndex(slot,base)
                        for id,equipment in pairs(peer.modEquipment or {}) do
                            if JavaContent.mods.available({mod=id}) and not (peer.mods and peer.mods[id]==false) then
                                local entry=JavaContent.byId[equipment[slot]]
                                if entry and entry.mod==id then return entry.index end
                            end
                        end
                        return base
                    end
                    local heldIndex=modEquipmentIndex("held",peer.held)
                    local offIndex=modEquipmentIndex("offhand",peer.offhand)
                    local rPose = peer.rightPose or ((peer.held and peer.held ~= 0) and 1 or 0)
                    local lPose = peer.leftPose or ((peer.offhand and peer.offhand ~= 0) and 1 or 0)
                    if rPose == 5 or lPose == 5 then peer.useTicks = (peer.useTicks or 0) + dt * 20 end
                    local useMax = math.max(1, peer.useMax or 25)
                    local function poseArm(right)
                        local arm, other, pose, sgn = right and rA or lA, right and lA or rA, right and rPose or lPose, right and 1 or -1
                        if pose == 0 then arm.y = 0
                        elseif pose == 1 then arm.x, arm.y = arm.x * 0.5 - math.pi / 10, 0
                        elseif pose == 2 then
                            arm.x = arm.x * 0.5 - 0.9424779 + math.clamp(hx, -math.pi * 4 / 9, 0.43633232)
                            arm.y = -sgn * math.rad(30) + math.clamp(hy, -math.pi / 6, math.pi / 6)
                        elseif pose == 3 then
                            rA.y, lA.y = -0.1 + hy - (right and 0 or 0.4), 0.1 + hy + (right and 0.4 or 0)
                            rA.x, lA.x = -math.pi / 2 + hx, -math.pi / 2 + hx
                        elseif pose == 4 then arm.x, arm.y = arm.x * 0.5 - math.pi, 0
                        elseif pose == 5 then
                            arm.y, arm.x = -sgn * 0.8, -0.97079635
                            other.x = arm.x
                            local a = math.clamp(peer.useTicks or 0, 0, useMax) / useMax
                            other.y = lerp(a, 0.4, 0.85) * sgn
                            other.x = lerp(a, other.x, -math.pi / 2)
                        elseif pose == 6 then
                            arm.y, other.y = -sgn * 0.3 + hy, sgn * 0.6 + hy
                            arm.x, other.x = -math.pi / 2 + hx + 0.1, -1.5 + hx
                        elseif pose == 7 then
                            arm.x = math.clamp(hx - 1.9198622 - (peer.crouch and math.pi / 12 or 0), -2.4, 3.3)
                            arm.y = hy - sgn * math.pi / 12
                        elseif pose == 8 then arm.x, arm.y = math.clamp(hx, -1.2, 1.2) - 1.4835298, hy - sgn * math.pi / 6
                        elseif pose == 9 then arm.x, arm.y = arm.x * 0.5 - math.pi / 5, 0 end
                    end
                    -- ArmPose.isTwoHanded / affectsOffhandPose decide which arm is posed first.
                    local twoHanded, affects = {[3] = true, [5] = true, [6] = true}, {[3] = true, [4] = true, [5] = true, [6] = true}
                    local rightFirst
                    if peer.using then rightFirst = not peer.usingOff else rightFirst = twoHanded[lPose] == true end
                    if rightFirst then poseArm(true); if not affects[rPose] then poseArm(false) end
                    else poseArm(false); if not affects[lPose] then poseArm(true) end end
                    -- setupAttackAnimation (WHACK), driven by their replicated tool-slash track.
                    local swingP
                    local anim = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                    if anim then
                        for _, t in ipairs(anim:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                            local id = t.Animation and t.Animation.AnimationId or ""
                            if (id:find("129967390", 1, true) or id:find("522635514", 1, true)) and t.Length > 0 then
                                swingP = math.clamp(t.TimePosition / t.Length, 0, 1)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    peer.swinging = swingP ~= nil
                    local armPivot
                    if swingP then
                        local p = swingP
                        body.y = math.sin(math.sqrt(p) * math.pi * 2) * 0.2 * (peer.swingOff and -1 or 1)
                        armPivot = {["Right Arm"] = {math.cos(body.y) * 5, math.sin(body.y) * 5}, ["Left Arm"] = {-math.cos(body.y) * 5, -math.sin(body.y) * 5}}
                        rA.y, lA.y, lA.x = rA.y + body.y, lA.y + body.y, lA.x + body.y
                        local aa = math.sin((1 - (1 - p) ^ 4) * math.pi)
                        local bb = math.sin(p * math.pi) * -(hx - 0.7) * 0.75
                        local arm = peer.swingOff and lA or rA
                        arm.x = arm.x - (aa * 1.2 + bb)
                        arm.y = arm.y + body.y * 2
                        arm.z = arm.z + math.sin(p * math.pi) * -0.4
                    end
                    local legZ = 0
                    local drop = {Head = 0, Torso = 0, ["Right Arm"] = 0, ["Left Arm"] = 0, ["Right Leg"] = 0, ["Left Leg"] = 0}
                    if peer.crouch then
                        body.x, legZ = 0.5, 4
                        rA.x, lA.x = rA.x + 0.4, lA.x + 0.4
                        drop = {Head = -4.2, Torso = -3.2, ["Right Arm"] = -3.2, ["Left Arm"] = -3.2, ["Right Leg"] = -0.2, ["Left Leg"] = -0.2}
                    end
                    -- AnimationUtils.bobModelPart: the idle arm sway.
                    if rPose ~= 7 then rA.z, rA.x = rA.z + math.cos(age * 0.09) * 0.05 + 0.05, rA.x + math.sin(age * 0.067) * 0.05 end
                    if lPose ~= 7 then lA.z, lA.x = lA.z - (math.cos(age * 0.09) * 0.05 + 0.05), lA.x - math.sin(age * 0.067) * 0.05 end
                    -- setupSwimAnimation: the 26-tick stroke (swimming and crawling).
                    local sa = peer.swimAmount or 0
                    if sa > 0 then
                        if not peer.gliding then head.x = rotLerp(sa, head.x, -math.pi / 4) end
                        local sp = limb % 26
                        local ra, la = swingP and 0 or sa, sa
                        if not peer.using then
                            if sp < 14 then
                                local q = (-65 * sp + sp * sp) / (-65 * 14 + 14 * 14)
                                lA.x, rA.x = rotLerp(la, lA.x, 0), lerp(ra, rA.x, 0)
                                lA.y, rA.y = rotLerp(la, lA.y, math.pi), lerp(ra, rA.y, math.pi)
                                lA.z, rA.z = rotLerp(la, lA.z, math.pi + 1.8707964 * q), lerp(ra, rA.z, math.pi - 1.8707964 * q)
                            elseif sp < 22 then
                                local t = (sp - 14) / 8
                                lA.x, rA.x = rotLerp(la, lA.x, math.pi / 2 * t), lerp(ra, rA.x, math.pi / 2 * t)
                                lA.y, rA.y = rotLerp(la, lA.y, math.pi), lerp(ra, rA.y, math.pi)
                                lA.z, rA.z = rotLerp(la, lA.z, 5.012389 - 1.8707964 * t), lerp(ra, rA.z, 1.2707963 + 1.8707964 * t)
                            else
                                local t = (sp - 22) / 4
                                lA.x, rA.x = rotLerp(la, lA.x, math.pi / 2 - math.pi / 2 * t), lerp(ra, rA.x, math.pi / 2 - math.pi / 2 * t)
                                lA.y, rA.y = rotLerp(la, lA.y, math.pi), lerp(ra, rA.y, math.pi)
                                lA.z, rA.z = rotLerp(la, lA.z, math.pi), lerp(ra, rA.z, math.pi)
                            end
                        end
                        lL.x = lerp(sa, lL.x, 0.3 * math.cos(limb * 0.33333334 + math.pi))
                        rL.x = lerp(sa, rL.x, 0.3 * math.cos(limb * 0.33333334))
                    end
                    -- Java angles -> this rig (same mapping as javaPart): Z, then -Y, then -X.
                    local function rot(t) return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, t.z) * CFrame.Angles(0, -t.y, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-t.x, 0, 0) end
                    local poses = {Head = rot(head), Torso = rot(body), ["Right Arm"] = rot(rA), ["Left Arm"] = rot(lA), ["Right Leg"] = rot(rL), ["Left Leg"] = rot(lL)}
                    for name, def in pairs(layout) do
                        local pivot = def.pivot + Vector3.new(0, drop[name], 0)
                        if armPivot and armPivot[name] then pivot = Vector3.new(armPivot[name][1], pivot.Y, armPivot[name][2]) end
                        local offset = def.offset
                        if peer.slim and name:find("Arm") then
                            -- PlayerModel slim arms: 3 px wide, pivot 0.5 px lower, box 0.5 px nearer the body.
                            pivot = pivot + Vector3.new(0, -0.5, 0)
                            offset = Vector3.new(offset.X > 0 and 0.5 or -0.5, offset.Y, offset.Z)
                        end
                        if peer.crouch and name:find("Leg") then pivot = pivot + Vector3.new(0, 0, legZ) end
                        if peer.crouch and name:find("Arm") then pivot = pivot + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
                        local joint = base * CFrame.new(pivot * px) * poses[name]
                        peer.joints[name] = joint
                        peer.parts[name].CFrame = joint * CFrame.new(offset * px)
                        peer.layers[name].CFrame = peer.parts[name].CFrame
                    end
                    -- Worn armour (HumanoidArmorLayer), same bones as your own body's armour.
                    local s16 = B * 0.9375
                    local targets = {head = "Head", hat = "Head", body = "Torso", right_arm = "Right Arm", left_arm = "Left Arm", right_leg = "Right Leg", left_leg = "Left Leg"}
                    for _, slot in ipairs({"helmet", "chestplate", "leggings", "boots"}) do
                        local index = modEquipmentIndex(slot,peer.armor and peer.armor[slot] or 0)
                        if index~=0 and not JavaContent.mods.available(JavaContent.byIndex[index]) then index=0 end
                        local entry = index ~= 0 and JavaContent.byIndex[index]
                        local definition = entry and JavaContent.data.armor and JavaContent.data.armor[entry.id]
                        local visual = peer.armorVisuals[slot]
                        if visual and visual.item ~= (definition and entry.id) then visual.model:Destroy(); peer.armorVisuals[slot] = nil; visual = nil end
                        if definition and not visual then
                            visual = JavaContent.entityModel(definition.model, 1, s16, peer.model, Vector3.zero, 0, false)
                            if visual then visual.item = entry.id; peer.armorVisuals[slot] = visual end
                        end
                        if visual then
                            visual.model.Parent = not peer.spectator and peer.model or nil
                            if entry.id == "elytra" then
                                visual.pivot(peer.parts.Torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, s16 * 0.375, s16 * 0.125) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0), nil, nil, os.clock(), peer.fly and 1 or 0)
                            else
                                for _, bone in ipairs(visual.bones) do
                                    local joint = peer.joints[targets[bone.name] or ""]
                                    if joint then
                                        joint = joint * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0)
                                        for _, face in ipairs(bone.faces) do face.part.CFrame = joint * face.frame end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    -- The held item in the right hand.
                    local function handItem(index, shown, model, context)
                        local candidate=index and JavaContent.byIndex[index]
                        if candidate and not JavaContent.mods.available(candidate) then
                            if model then model.model:Destroy() end
                            return nil
                        end
                        if shown == index and model then return model end
                        if model then model.model:Destroy(); model = nil end
                        local entry = index and index ~= 0 and JavaContent.byIndex[index]
                        if entry then
                            local offset, scale = JavaContent.display(index, context, B)
                            model = JavaContent.model(index, entry.state, scale, peer.model, Vector3.zero, true)
                            model.offset = offset
                        end
                        return model
                    end
                    peer.heldModel = handItem(heldIndex, peer.heldShown, peer.heldModel, "thirdperson_righthand"); peer.heldShown = heldIndex
                    peer.offModel = handItem(offIndex, peer.offShown, peer.offModel, "thirdperson_lefthand"); peer.offShown = offIndex
                    -- A shield in use takes its blocking transforms.
                    for _, pair in ipairs({{peer.heldModel, heldIndex, "thirdperson_righthand"}, {peer.offModel, offIndex, "thirdperson_lefthand"}}) do
                        local entry = pair[1] and JavaContent.byIndex[pair[2]]
                        if entry and entry.blockingDisplay then pair[1].offset = JavaContent.display(pair[2], pair[3], B, peer.blocking) end
                    end
                    local hand = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi) * CFrame.Angles(-math.pi / 2, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0)
                    if peer.heldModel then
                        peer.heldModel.pivot(peer.joints["Right Arm"] * hand * CFrame.new(B / 16, 0.125 * B, -0.625 * B) * peer.heldModel.offset)
                    end
                    if peer.offModel then
                        peer.offModel.pivot(peer.joints["Left Arm"] * hand * CFrame.new(-B / 16, 0.125 * B, -0.625 * B) * peer.offModel.offset)
                    end
                    until true
                end
            end
        end
        connections[#connections + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if ctx.disposed() then return end
            -- Fallback for clients that missed our tracks starting (late joiners, streamed-in characters):
            -- restart them every 45 s while someone here has not been seen running the script.
            if os.clock() >= (Net.nextRefresh or 0) then
                Net.nextRefresh = os.clock() + 45
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p ~= Players.LocalPlayer and p.Character and not Net.peers[p] then stopCarrierTracks(); break end
                end
            end
            pcall(poseTick)
            pcall(mobTick)
            pcall(frameTick)
            pcall(receiveTick)
        end)
        connections[#connections + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if ctx.disposed() then return end
            local ok, e = pcall(renderPeers, dt)
            if not ok and not Net.warned then Net.warned = true; warn("Steve net render: " .. tostring(e)) end
        end)
        connections[#connections + 1] = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) Net.forget(p, true) end)
        -- Respawn / reload: this copy's player models go with it (a frozen old Steve must not stay).
        connections[#connections + 1] = {Disconnect = function()
            for p in pairs(Net.peers) do pcall(Net.forget, p, true) end
        end}
        return Net
    end

-- Touch controls (phones / tablets): Bedrock mobile layout driving VirtualInput.
local function createTouchControls(ctx)
    local real = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local forced = rawget(_G, "SteveTouchControls") == true
    if not forced and not (real.TouchEnabled and not real.KeyboardEnabled) then return nil end
    local VI = ctx.virtual
    local K = Enum.KeyCode
    local G = JavaContent.data.javaGui
    local touch = {buttons = {}, virtual = VI, paused = false}
    VI.touchOnly = not forced
    local function icon(rows)
        local d = {}
        for _, row in ipairs(rows) do for i = 1, #row do d[#d + 1] = row:sub(i, i) == "#" and "01" or "00" end end
        return {w = #rows[1], h = #rows, p = {0xFFFFFF}, d = table.concat(d)}
    end
    local ICONS = {
        up = icon({"...##...", "..####..", ".######.", "########", "...##...", "...##...", "...##..."}),
        sprint = icon({"#...#...", "##..##..", ".##..##.", "..##..##", ".##..##.", "##..##..", "#...#..."}),
        emote = icon({".#######.", "#.......#", "#.#...#.#", "#.......#", "#.#...#.#", "#..###..#", "#.......#", ".#######."}),
        chat = icon({"#########", "#.......#", "#.#####.#", "#.......#", "#.###...#", "#.......#", "#########", ".##......", "#........"}),
        pause = icon({"##..##", "##..##", "##..##", "##..##", "##..##", "##..##"}),
        dots = icon({"##..##..##", "##..##..##"}),
        swap = icon({"...#.......", "..##.......", ".#########.", "..##.....#.", "...#.....#.", ".#.....#...", ".#.....##..", ".#########.", ".......##..", ".......#..."}),
        drop = icon({"...###...", "...###...", "...###...", "#########", ".#######.", "..#####..", "...###...", "....#....", ".........", "#########"}),
    }
    local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    screenGui.Name, screenGui.ResetOnSpawn, screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset, screenGui.DisplayOrder = "SteveTouchControls", false, true, 40
    screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    -- Inside the device's safe area (notches, rounded corners, home bar).
    pcall(function() screenGui.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.DeviceSafeInsets end)
    screenGui.Parent = ctx.gui
    local function layer(name, order)
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.Name, f.BackgroundTransparency, f.ZIndex = name, 1, order or 1
        f.Parent = screenGui
        local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
        scale.Parent = f
        return f, scale
    end
    local holder, holderScale = layer("Controls")      -- finger-sized
    local hud, hudScale = layer("HotbarControls")       -- the HUD's own GUI scale
    local hotbarGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    hotbarGui.Name, hotbarGui.ResetOnSpawn, hotbarGui.IgnoreGuiInset, hotbarGui.DisplayOrder = "SteveTouchHotbar", false, true, 40
    hotbarGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    hotbarGui.Parent = ctx.gui
    hud.Parent = hotbarGui
    local menu, menuScale = layer("GameMenu", 20)       -- Java GUI scale
    local NORMAL, LIT = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70), Color3.fromRGB(185, 185, 185)
    local function panel(parent, w, h)
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.BorderSizePixel, f.Size, f.BackgroundColor3, f.BackgroundTransparency = 0, UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), NORMAL, 0.45
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.Color, stroke.Thickness, stroke.Transparency, stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), 1, 0.35, Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        stroke.Parent = f
        f.Parent = parent
        return f
    end
    -- Bedrock mobile icons: sprite buttons swap to their _pressed texture; small icons sit on a HUD square.
    local function makeButton(spec)
        local parent = spec.hud and hud or holder
        local button = {spec = spec, on = false}
        local f
        if spec.sprite then
            f = Instance.new("Frame")
            f.BackgroundTransparency, f.Size = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(spec.w, spec.h)
            f.Parent = parent
            local images, lit, fly = {}, false, false
            for _, n in ipairs({spec.sprite, spec.sprite .. "_pressed", spec.flySprite or false, spec.flySprite and (spec.flySprite .. "_pressed") or false}) do
                if n and G["bedrock/" .. n] then
                    local img = JavaGui.image(f, G["bedrock/" .. n], 0, 0, spec.w, spec.h, nil, 2)
                    img.Visible = false
                    images[n] = img
                end
            end
            local function show()
                local base = (fly and spec.flySprite) or spec.sprite
                local want = lit and (base .. "_pressed") or base
                for n, img in pairs(images) do img.Visible = n == want end
            end
            function button.light(on) lit = on; show() end
            function button.setFlying(on)
                on = on and spec.flySprite ~= nil
                if fly ~= on then fly = on; show() end
            end
            show()
        else
            if spec.hud then
                -- Bedrock's "..." sits in a hotbar-style slot at the end of the hotbar.
                f = Instance.new("Frame")
                f.BackgroundTransparency, f.Size = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(spec.w, spec.h)
                f.Parent = parent
                JavaGui.image(f, G["hud/hotbar"], 0, 0, 22, 22, {160, 0, 22, 22}, 1)
            else
                f = panel(parent, spec.w, spec.h)
            end
            if spec.label then
                JavaGui.text(f, spec.label, math.floor((spec.w - JavaGui.width(spec.label)) / 2) + 1, math.floor((spec.h - 8) / 2) + 1, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), true, 3)
            else
                local sprite = G["bedrock/" .. spec.icon] or ICONS[spec.icon]
                local iw, ih = spec.iconW or sprite.w, spec.iconH or sprite.h
                JavaGui.image(f, sprite, math.floor((spec.w - iw) / 2), math.floor((spec.h - ih) / 2), iw, ih, nil, 3)
            end
            function button.light(lit)
                if spec.hud then return end
                f.BackgroundColor3, f.BackgroundTransparency = lit and LIT or NORMAL, lit and 0.3 or 0.45
            end
        end
        f.Name = "Touch" .. spec.name
        if spec.guiTap then
            local activate = Instance.new("TextButton")
            activate.Name, activate.BackgroundTransparency, activate.BorderSizePixel = "Activate", 1, 0
            activate.AutoButtonColor, activate.Text, activate.TextTransparency = false, "", 1
            activate.Position, activate.Size, activate.ZIndex = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 5
            activate.Parent = f
            activate.Activated:Connect(function()
                if spec.action then spec.action(); return end
                VI.key(spec.tap, true)
                VI.key(spec.tap, false)
            end)
        end
        button.frame = f
        function button.contains(p)
            local a, size = f.AbsolutePosition, f.AbsoluteSize
            return f.Visible and p.X >= a.X and p.Y >= a.Y and p.X < a.X + size.X and p.Y < a.Y + size.Y
        end
        touch.buttons[spec.name] = button
        return button
    end
    -- Positions in GUI px: right = from the right edge, top = from the top, else from the bottom.
    local specs = {
        {name = "Jump", sprite = "jump", flySprite = "flyingascend", x = 26, y = 60, w = 22, h = 22, right = true},
        {name = "Sneak", sprite = "sneak", flySprite = "flyingdescend", x = 26, y = 12, w = 22, h = 22, right = true},
        {name = "Sprint", sprite = "sprint", x = 50, y = 36, w = 22, h = 22, right = true},
        {name = "Chat", icon = "comment", tap = K.T, guiTap = true, w = 22, h = 22, top = true, centre = -34, menu = true},
        {name = "F5", label = "F5", tap = K.F5, guiTap = true, w = 22, h = 22, top = true, centre = -8},
        {name = "F3", label = "F3", tap = K.F3, guiTap = true, w = 22, h = 22, top = true, centre = 18},
        {name = "Menu", icon = "pause_icon", w = 22, h = 22, top = true, centre = 44, menu = true, guiTap = true,
            action = function() if JavaGui.menu then JavaGui.menu.toggle() end end},
        {name = "Swap", icon = "swap", tap = K.F, w = 22, h = 22, hud = true, hudX = 113},
        {name = "Drop", icon = "drop", tap = K.Q, repeatTap = true, w = 22, h = 22, hud = true, hudX = 135},
        {name = "Inventory", icon = "more-dots", iconW = 13, iconH = 3, tap = K.E, w = 22, h = 22, hud = true, menu = true},
    }
    for _, spec in ipairs(specs) do makeButton(spec) end
    local B = touch.buttons
    -- Joystick: a square pad with a square stick.
    local pad = Instance.new("Frame")
    pad.Name, pad.BackgroundTransparency, pad.Size = "MovePad", 1, UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64)
    pad.Parent = holder
    JavaGui.image(pad, G["bedrock/joystick_frame"], 0, 0, 64, 64, nil, 1)
    local stick = JavaGui.image(pad, G["bedrock/joystick_knob"], 16, 16, 32, 32, nil, 2)
    stick.Name = "Stick"
    local function stickAt(offset) stick.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16 + offset.X, 16 + offset.Y) end
    stickAt(Vector2.zero)

    -- Java-style Game Menu (Bedrock's menu button opens it).
    local dim = Instance.new("Frame")
    dim.Name, dim.BackgroundColor3, dim.BackgroundTransparency, dim.BorderSizePixel, dim.Visible = "Dim", Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.5, 0, false
    dim.Size, dim.ZIndex = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 19
    dim.Parent = screenGui
    menu.Visible = false
    local menuTitle = JavaGui.text(menu, "Game Menu", 0, 0, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), true, 21)
    local menuButtons = {}
    local function javaButton(label, action)
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
        b.Text, b.BackgroundTransparency, b.AutoButtonColor, b.Size, b.ZIndex = "", 1, false, UDim2.fromOffset(200, 20), 21
        b.Parent = menu
        local normal = JavaGui.slice(b, G["widget/button"], 3, 0, 0, 200, 20, 21)
        local lit = JavaGui.slice(b, G["widget/button_highlighted"], 3, 0, 0, 200, 20, 21)
        lit.Visible = false
        JavaGui.text(b, label, math.floor((200 - JavaGui.width(label)) / 2), 6, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), true, 22)
        b.InputBegan:Connect(function() lit.Visible, normal.Visible = true, false end)
        b.InputEnded:Connect(function() lit.Visible, normal.Visible = false, true end)
        b.Activated:Connect(action)
        menuButtons[#menuButtons + 1] = b
    end
    local function setPaused(on)
        touch.paused = on
        menu.Visible, dim.Visible = on, on
    end
    local function tapKey(key) VI.key(key, true); VI.key(key, false) end
    javaButton("Back to Game", function() setPaused(false) end)
    javaButton("Debug Screen (F3)", function() setPaused(false); tapKey(K.F3) end)
    javaButton("Change Perspective (F5)", function() setPaused(false); tapKey(K.F5) end)

    local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
    local function screenPos(input) return Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) + GuiService:GetGuiInset() end
    -- Buttons / joystick: AbsolutePosition space, which is the touch's own Position (no inset).
    local function guiPos(input) return Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) end
    local function hotbarSlot(pos)
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return nil end
        local view = camera.ViewportSize
        local s = JavaGui.scale(view)
        local gx, gy = pos.X / s, pos.Y / s
        local w, h = view.X / s, view.Y / s
        if gy < h - 22 or math.abs(gx - w / 2) > 91 then return nil end
        return math.clamp(math.floor((gx - (w / 2 - 91) - 1) / 20) + 1, 1, 9)
    end
    touch.hotbarSlot = hotbarSlot
    local numbers = {K.One, K.Two, K.Three, K.Four, K.Five, K.Six, K.Seven, K.Eight, K.Nine}
    local function blocked() return ctx.blocked() or touch.paused end
    local function cameraLookAllowed() return ctx.cameraBlocked and not ctx.cameraBlocked() end
    local fingers = {}
    local moveKeys = {}
    local function setMove(v)
        local want = {[K.W] = v.Y < -0.35, [K.S] = v.Y > 0.35, [K.A] = v.X < -0.35, [K.D] = v.X > 0.35}
        for k, on in pairs(want) do
            if on ~= (moveKeys[k] == true) then moveKeys[k] = on or nil; VI.key(k, on) end
        end
    end
    local function stopSprint()
        if B.Sprint.on then B.Sprint.on = false; B.Sprint.light(false); VI.key(K.LeftControl, false) end
    end
    local function padContains(p)
        local a, size = pad.AbsolutePosition, pad.AbsoluteSize
        local m = size.X * 0.25
        return pad.Visible and p.X >= a.X - m and p.Y >= a.Y - m and p.X < a.X + size.X + m and p.Y < a.Y + size.Y + m
    end
    local function padVector(p)
        local a, size = pad.AbsolutePosition, pad.AbsoluteSize
        local v = (p - (a + size / 2)) / (size.X / 2)
        if v.Magnitude > 1 then v = v.Unit end
        return v
    end
    local function buttonAt(p) for _, b in pairs(B) do if b.contains(p) then return b end end end
    local HOLD_TIME, TAP_MOVE = 0.3, 12
    local function begin(input)
        if touch.paused then return end
        local p = screenPos(input)
        local g = guiPos(input)
        local finger = {start = p, last = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y), time = os.clock(), moved = 0}
        fingers[input] = finger
        if blocked() then
            local b = buttonAt(g)
            if b and b.spec.menu then
                finger.kind, finger.button = "button", b; b.light(true)
                if b.spec.name == "Menu" then return end
                if b.spec.tap and not b.spec.guiTap then tapKey(b.spec.tap) end; return
            end
            if real:GetFocusedTextBox() then fingers[input] = nil; return end
            if cameraLookAllowed() then finger.kind = "look"; return end
            finger.kind = "menu"
            VI.location = p
            VI.button(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1, true)
            return
        end
        if padContains(g) then
            finger.kind = "move"
            local v = padVector(g); setMove(v); stickAt(v * 18)
            return
        end
        local b = buttonAt(g)
        if b then
            finger.kind, finger.button = "button", b
            local name = b.spec.name
            if name == "Menu" then b.light(true); return end
            if name == "Sprint" then
                b.on = not b.on; b.light(b.on); VI.key(K.LeftControl, b.on); return
            end
            if name == "Sneak" and not ctx.flying() then
                -- Sneak toggles (Bedrock's default); flying, it is held to fly down.
                b.on = not b.on; b.light(b.on); VI.key(K.LeftShift, b.on); return
            end
            b.light(true)
            if name == "Jump" then VI.key(K.Space, true) elseif name == "Sneak" then VI.key(K.LeftShift, true) end
            if b.spec.tap and not b.spec.guiTap then tapKey(b.spec.tap) end
            return
        end
        local slot = hotbarSlot(p)
        if slot then finger.kind, finger.slot = "hotbar", slot; tapKey(numbers[slot]); return end
        finger.kind = "world"
    end
    local function moved(input)
        local finger = fingers[input]
        if not finger then return end
        local now = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
        local delta = now - finger.last
        finger.last = now
        finger.moved = finger.moved + delta.Magnitude
        if finger.kind == "menu" then VI.location = screenPos(input)
        elseif finger.kind == "move" then
            local v = padVector(guiPos(input)); setMove(v); stickAt(v * 18)
        elseif finger.kind == "world" and not blocked() then
            VI.delta = VI.delta + delta * (CONFIG.TouchLookScale or 0.6)
        end
    end
    local function finish(input)
        local finger = fingers[input]
        if not finger then return end
        fingers[input] = nil
        if finger.kind == "menu" then
            VI.button(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1, false)
            task.defer(function() local any = false; for _, f in pairs(fingers) do if f.kind == "menu" then any = true end end; if not any then VI.location = nil end end)
        elseif finger.kind == "move" then
            setMove(Vector2.zero); stickAt(Vector2.zero); stopSprint()
        elseif finger.kind == "button" then
            local b, name = finger.button, finger.button.spec.name
            local wait = math.max(0, 0.1 - (os.clock() - finger.time))
            if name == "Jump" then task.delay(wait, function() VI.key(K.Space, false) end); b.light(false)
            elseif name == "Sneak" and not b.on then task.delay(wait, function() VI.key(K.LeftShift, false) end); b.light(false)
            elseif name ~= "Sprint" and name ~= "Sneak" then b.light(false) end
        elseif finger.kind == "world" then
            if finger.mining then VI.button(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1, false)
            elseif finger.moved < TAP_MOVE and os.clock() - finger.time < HOLD_TIME and not blocked() then
                -- Tap: attack what the crosshair is on if it is a mob / player, otherwise use / place.
                local button = ctx.aimingAtEntity() and Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
                VI.button(button, true)
                task.delay(0.06, function() VI.button(button, false) end)
            end
        end
    end
    touch.begin, touch.moved, touch.finish, touch.setPaused = begin, moved, finish, setPaused
    local connections = {}
    connections[#connections + 1] = real.TouchStarted:Connect(function(input)
        if ctx.disposed() then return end
        -- Roblox's top bar (its menu / chat buttons) and typing keep their touches.
        if input.Position.Y < 0 or real:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        begin(input)
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = real.TouchMoved:Connect(moved)
    connections[#connections + 1] = real.TouchEnded:Connect(finish)
    local cameraTouches = {}
    connections[#connections + 1] = real.TouchStarted:Connect(function(input)
        if touch.paused or not cameraLookAllowed() or real:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        local pos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
        if buttonAt(pos) or padContains(pos) or hotbarSlot(pos) then return end
        cameraTouches[input] = pos
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = real.TouchMoved:Connect(function(input)
        local previous = cameraTouches[input]
        if not previous then return end
        local current = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
        cameraTouches[input] = current
        if cameraLookAllowed() and not touch.paused then
            VI.delta = VI.delta + (current - previous) * (CONFIG.TouchLookScale or 0.6)
        end
    end)
    connections[#connections + 1] = real.TouchEnded:Connect(function(input)
        cameraTouches[input] = nil
    end)
    local hidden = {}
    connections[#connections + 1] = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if ctx.disposed() then return end
        local now = os.clock()
        for _, finger in pairs(fingers) do
            if finger.kind == "world" and not finger.mining and finger.moved < TAP_MOVE and now - finger.time >= HOLD_TIME and not blocked() then
                finger.mining = true
                VI.button(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1, true)
            elseif finger.kind == "button" and finger.button.spec.repeatTap and now - finger.time >= 0.5 and now >= (finger.nextRepeat or 0) then
                finger.nextRepeat = now + 0.15
                tapKey(finger.button.spec.tap)
            elseif finger.kind == "hotbar" and now - finger.time >= 0.6 and now >= (finger.nextDrop or 0) then
                finger.nextDrop = now + 0.3
                tapKey(K.Q)
            end
        end
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local view = camera and camera.ViewportSize or screenGui.AbsoluteSize
        local hs = JavaGui.scale(view)
        local safe = screenGui.AbsoluteSize
        local s = math.clamp(math.min(safe.Y, safe.X * 0.6) * 0.12 / 22, 1.5, 5)
        holderScale.Scale, hudScale.Scale, menuScale.Scale = s, hs, hs
        local w, h = safe.X / s, safe.Y / s
        holder.Size, hud.Size, menu.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), UDim2.fromOffset(view.X / hs, view.Y / hs), UDim2.fromOffset(view.X / hs, view.Y / hs)
        local rowLeft, rowRight, rowTop = (view.X / 2 - 120 * hs) / s, (view.X / 2 + 157 * hs) / s, 26 * hs / s
        local liftRight = (w - 72) < rowRight and rowTop or 0
        local liftPad = 76 > rowLeft and rowTop or 0
        local gameBlocked = blocked()
        local hideGameControls = gameBlocked and (not ctx.cameraBlocked or ctx.cameraBlocked())
        local chatting = real:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil
        local flying = ctx.flying()
        for _, b in pairs(B) do
            local spec = b.spec
            b.frame.Visible = not chatting and not touch.paused and (spec.menu or not hideGameControls)
            if spec.hud then
                b.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(view.X / hs / 2) + (spec.hudX or 91), math.floor(view.Y / hs) - 22)
            else
                local x = spec.centre and math.floor(w / 2 + spec.centre) or spec.right and (w - spec.x - spec.w) or spec.x
                local y = spec.top and 4 or (h - spec.y - spec.h - (spec.right and liftRight or 0))
                b.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
            end
        end
        -- Flying: jump / sneak become fly up / fly down (held), like Bedrock.
        B.Jump.setFlying(flying); B.Sneak.setFlying(flying)
        if flying and B.Sneak.on then B.Sneak.on = false; B.Sneak.light(false); VI.key(K.LeftShift, false) end
        pad.Visible = not chatting and not touch.paused and not hideGameControls
        pad.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, h - 12 - 64 - liftPad)
        -- Game Menu: title and buttons centred like Java's PauseScreen.
        local mw, mh = view.X / hs, view.Y / hs
        menuTitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor((mw - JavaGui.width("Game Menu")) / 2), math.floor(mh / 4) - 16)
        for i, b in ipairs(menuButtons) do b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(mw / 2 - 100), math.floor(mh / 4) + 8 + (i - 1) * 24) end
        if gameBlocked then
            for input, finger in pairs(fingers) do
                if finger.kind ~= "menu" and finger.kind ~= "button" and finger.kind ~= "look" then finish(input) end
            end
            stopSprint()
        end
        local tg = ctx.gui and ctx.gui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
        if tg and tg:IsA("ScreenGui") and tg.Enabled then hidden[tg] = true; tg.Enabled = false end
    end)
    ctx.connections[#ctx.connections + 1] = {Disconnect = function()
        for _, c in ipairs(connections) do c:Disconnect() end
        VI.releaseAll()
        VI.touchOnly = false
        for tg in pairs(hidden) do if tg.Parent then tg.Enabled = true end end
        screenGui:Destroy()
        hotbarGui:Destroy()
    end}
    return touch
end
-- Minecraft sounds: downloaded once from Mojang's launcher servers into the "Minecraft Sounds" folder
-- (writefile + game:HttpGet), played with getcustomasset. sounds.json decides variants / volume / pitch.
MinecraftSounds = (function()
    local MS = {enabled = true, volume = 1}
    local FOLDER = "Minecraft Sounds"
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local state, index, defs = "idle", nil, nil
    local assets, downloading = {}, {}
    local recent, recentAt = 0, 0
    local function usable()
        return type(writefile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function" and type(getcustomasset) == "function"
    end
    local function get(url) return game:HttpGet(url) end
    local function cdn(hash) return "https://resources.download.minecraft.net/" .. hash:sub(1, 2) .. "/" .. hash end
    local function soundFolder()
        local f = workspace:FindFirstChild(FOLDER)
        if not f then f = Instance.new("Folder"); f.Name = FOLDER; f.Parent = workspace end
        return f
    end
    -- Version manifest -> this version's asset index -> the sound files' hashes (cached as index.json).
    local function ready()
        if state == "ready" then return true end
        if state == "failed" or not usable() then return false end
        if state == "loading" then
            while state == "loading" do task.wait(0.1) end
            return state == "ready"
        end
        state = "loading"
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            if type(isfolder) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function" and not isfolder(FOLDER) then makefolder(FOLDER) end
            local indexFile = FOLDER .. "/index.json"
            if isfile(indexFile) then index = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(indexFile)) end
            if not index or not index["minecraft/sounds.json"] then
                local manifest = HttpService:JSONDecode(get("https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json"))
                local entry
                for _, want in ipairs({"26.3", manifest.latest and manifest.latest.release, JavaContent.data.version}) do
                    for _, v in ipairs(manifest.versions) do if not entry and v.id == want then entry = v end end
                end
                local version = HttpService:JSONDecode(get(entry.url))
                local objects = HttpService:JSONDecode(get(version.assetIndex.url)).objects
                index = {}
                for k, v in pairs(objects) do
                    if k:sub(1, 17) == "minecraft/sounds/" or k == "minecraft/sounds.json" then index[k] = v.hash end
                end
                writefile(indexFile, HttpService:JSONEncode(index))
            end
            local defsFile = FOLDER .. "/sounds.json"
            if not isfile(defsFile) then writefile(defsFile, get(cdn(index["minecraft/sounds.json"]))) end
            defs = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(defsFile))
        end)
        state = ok and "ready" or "failed"
        if not ok then warn("Minecraft Sounds: " .. tostring(err)) end
        return ok
    end
    -- One .ogg: downloaded once (writefile), then a getcustomasset id.
    local function asset(name)
        if assets[name] then return assets[name] end
        local hash = index["minecraft/sounds/" .. name .. ".ogg"]
        if not hash then return nil end
        local file = FOLDER .. "/" .. name:gsub("/", "_") .. ".ogg"
        if not isfile(file) then
            if downloading[file] then
                while downloading[file] do task.wait(0.05) end
            else
                downloading[file] = true
                local ok, data = pcall(get, cdn(hash))
                if ok and type(data) == "string" and #data > 0 then pcall(writefile, file, data) end
                downloading[file] = nil
            end
        end
        if not isfile(file) then return nil end
        local ok, id = pcall(getcustomasset, file)
        if ok and id then assets[name] = id end
        return assets[name]
    end
    -- sounds.json: weighted variants; "event" entries point at another event.
    local function pick(event, depth)
        local def = defs[event]
        if not def or type(def.sounds) ~= "table" then return nil end
        local total, list = 0, {}
        for _, v in ipairs(def.sounds) do
            local e = type(v) == "string" and {name = v} or v
            local w = e.weight or 1
            total = total + w
            list[#list + 1] = {e, w}
        end
        local r = math.random() * total
        for _, item in ipairs(list) do
            r = r - item[2]
            if r <= 0 then
                local e = item[1]
                if e.type == "event" then
                    if (depth or 0) > 4 then return nil end
                    local sub = pick((e.name:gsub("^minecraft:", "")), (depth or 0) + 1)
                    if sub then sub.volume, sub.pitch = sub.volume * (e.volume or 1), sub.pitch * (e.pitch or 1) end
                    return sub
                end
                return {name = (e.name:gsub("^minecraft:", "")), volume = e.volume or 1, pitch = e.pitch or 1}
            end
        end
    end
    -- Play an event (e.g. "block.stone.break"). position = studs (3D, Java's linear 16-block falloff) or nil (2D).
    function MS.play(event, position, volume, pitch)
        if typeof(position) == 'Vector3' and JavaContent.mods.renderPos then position = JavaContent.mods.renderPos(position) or position end
        if not MS.enabled or not usable() then return end
        event = tostring(event):gsub("^minecraft:", "")
        -- A burst (an explosion breaking dozens of blocks) does not start a hundred sounds at once.
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - recentAt > 0.1 then recent, recentAt = 0, now end
        recent = recent + 1
        if recent > 12 then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            if not ready() then return end
            local e = pick(event)
            if not e then return end
            local id = asset(e.name)
            if not id then return end
            volume = volume or 1
            local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
            sound.Name, sound.SoundId = event, id
            sound.Volume = math.clamp(volume * e.volume, 0, 1) * MS.volume
            sound.PlaybackSpeed = math.clamp((pitch or 1) * e.pitch, 0.5, 2)
            -- No position: an entity sound of your own player (Entity.playSound at your feet).
            if not position then
                local character = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
                local r = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if r then position = r.Position - Vector3.new(0, r.Size.Y / 2, 0) end
            end
            local holder
            if position then
                holder = Instance.new("Part")
                holder.Name, holder.Anchored, holder.CanCollide, holder.CanQuery, holder.CanTouch = event, true, false, false, false
                holder.Transparency, holder.Size, holder.Position = 1, Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05), position
                holder.Parent = soundFolder()
                -- Channel.linearAttenuation: AL_LINEAR_DISTANCE, reference distance 0, max 16 x max(volume, 1) blocks.
                sound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
                sound.RollOffMinDistance = 0.01
                sound.RollOffMaxDistance = CONFIG.Block * 16 * math.max(1, volume)
                sound.Parent = holder
            else
                sound.Parent = soundFolder()
            end
            local victim = holder or sound
            sound.Ended:Connect(function() victim:Destroy() end)
            sound:Play()
