            task.delay(30, function() if victim.Parent then victim:Destroy() end end)
        end)
    end
    -- Block sounds (SoundType): break / place (v+1)/2 at p*0.8, hit (v+1)/8 at p*0.5, step v*0.15, fall v*0.5 at p*0.75.
    local SLOT = {["break"] = 3, step = 4, place = 5, hit = 6, fall = 7}
    local MOB_VOLUME = {ghast = 5, happy_ghast = 5, ender_dragon = 5, warden = 4, bee = 0.4, cat = 0.4, ocelot = 0.4}
    function MS.mobVolume(m)
        if m.id == "slime" or m.id == "magma_cube" then return 0.4 * (m.size or 1) end
        return MOB_VOLUME[m.id] or 1
    end
    function MS.blockId(id, kind, position)
        local data = JavaContent.data
        local typeName = data.blockSounds and data.blockSounds[id]
        local st = typeName and data.soundTypes and data.soundTypes[typeName]
        if not st or not st[SLOT[kind]] then return end
        local v, p = st[1], st[2]
        if kind == "break" or kind == "place" then MS.play(st[SLOT[kind]], position, (v + 1) / 2, p * 0.8)
        elseif kind == "hit" then MS.play(st[6], position, (v + 1) / 8, p * 0.5)
        elseif kind == "step" then MS.play(st[4], position, v * 0.15, p)
        else MS.play(st[7], position, v * 0.5, p * 0.75) end
    end
    -- Roblox map parts (not Minecraft blocks): the SoundType closest to their material.
    local MATERIAL = {Grass = "GRASS", LeafyGrass = "GRASS", Sand = "SAND", Wood = "WOOD", WoodPlanks = "WOOD", Snow = "SNOW",
        Glass = "GLASS", Ice = "GLASS", Glacier = "GLASS", ForceField = "GLASS", Fabric = "WOOL", Metal = "METAL",
        CorrodedMetal = "METAL", DiamondPlate = "METAL", Foil = "METAL", Gravel = "GRAVEL", Ground = "GRAVEL", Mud = "GRAVEL"}
    function MS.material(material, kind, position)
        local typeName = MATERIAL[material and material.Name or ""] or "STONE"
        local st = JavaContent.data.soundTypes and JavaContent.data.soundTypes[typeName]
        if not st then return end
        local v, p = st[1], st[2]
        if kind == "step" then MS.play(st[4], position, v * 0.15, p)
        elseif kind == "fall" then MS.play(st[7], position, v * 0.5, p * 0.75)
        elseif kind == "hit" then MS.play(st[6], position, (v + 1) / 8, p * 0.5)
        else MS.play(st[SLOT[kind]], position, (v + 1) / 2, p * 0.8) end
    end
    function MS.block(index, kind, position)
        local entry = index and JavaContent.byIndex[index]
        if entry then MS.blockId(entry.id, kind, position) end
    end
    -- Doors / trapdoors / fence gates (BlockSetType), levers, buttons.
    local function woodFamily(id)
        if id:find("cherry", 1, true) then return "cherry_wood" end
        if id:find("bamboo", 1, true) then return "bamboo_wood" end
        if id:find("crimson", 1, true) or id:find("warped", 1, true) then return "nether_wood" end
        if id:find("copper", 1, true) then return "copper" end
        return nil
    end
    function MS.interact(id, position, state)
        local open = state.open == "true"
        local pitch = math.random() * 0.1 + 0.9
        local family = woodFamily(id)
        if id:match("_trapdoor$") then
            MS.play("block." .. (family and family .. "_trapdoor" or (id:find("iron", 1, true) and "iron_trapdoor" or "wooden_trapdoor")) .. (open and ".open" or ".close"), position, 1, pitch)
        elseif id:match("_door$") then
            MS.play("block." .. (family and family .. "_door" or (id:find("iron", 1, true) and "iron_door" or "wooden_door")) .. (open and ".open" or ".close"), position, 1, pitch)
        elseif id:match("_fence_gate$") then
            MS.play("block." .. ((family and family ~= "copper") and family .. "_fence_gate" or "fence_gate") .. (open and ".open" or ".close"), position, 1, pitch)
        elseif id == "lever" then
            MS.play("block.lever.click", position, 0.3, state.powered == "true" and 0.6 or 0.5)
        elseif id:match("_button$") then
            local stone = id == "stone_button" or id == "polished_blackstone_button"
            MS.play("block." .. (stone and "stone_button" or ((family and family ~= "copper") and family .. "_button" or "wooden_button")) .. ".click_on", position, 1, 1)
        end
    end
    function MS.container(id, position, opening)
        local event = id == "ender_chest" and "block.ender_chest" or id == "barrel" and "block.barrel" or id:match("shulker_box$") and "block.shulker_box"
            or id:match("copper_chest$") and "block.copper_chest" or (id == "chest" or id == "trapped_chest") and "block.chest" or nil
        if event then MS.play(event .. (opening and ".open" or ".close"), position, 0.5, math.random() * 0.1 + 0.9) end
    end
    function MS.preload(events)
        task.spawn(function()
            if not ready() then return end
            for _, event in ipairs(events) do
                local def = defs[event]
                if def and type(def.sounds) == "table" then
                    for _, v in ipairs(def.sounds) do
                        local e = type(v) == "string" and {name = v} or v
                        if e.type ~= "event" then asset((e.name:gsub("^minecraft:", ""))) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    -- The sounds heard in the first minute download in the background straight away.
    local first = {"entity.player.hurt", "entity.item.pickup", "entity.generic.eat", "entity.player.burp", "entity.player.attack.strong",
        "entity.player.attack.weak", "entity.generic.explode"}
    for _, t in ipairs({"stone", "wood", "grass", "gravel", "sand"}) do
        for _, k in ipairs({"break", "step", "place", "hit"}) do first[#first + 1] = "block." .. t .. "." .. k end
    end
    MS.preload(first)
    return MS
end)()
-- Name tags for the script's makers: shown over their Roblox avatar or their Minecraft player.
local function createDeveloperTags(ctx)
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local made = {}
    local B = CONFIG.Block
    -- Java's name tag: each line on a 25% black plate, Minecraft font, world-sized (0.025 blocks a pixel).
    local function build(player, head, info)
        local name = player.Name
        local width = math.max(JavaGui.width(name), JavaGui.width(info[1])) + 2
        local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        gui.Name, gui.Adornee, gui.AlwaysOnTop, gui.LightInfluence = "SteveDeveloperTag", head, true, 0
        gui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(width * 0.025 * B, 20 * 0.025 * B)
        gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 2.1, 0)
        gui.MaxDistance = 64 * B
        local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
        holder.BackgroundTransparency, holder.Size = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(width, 20)
        holder.Parent = gui
        local uiScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
        uiScale.Parent = holder
        for i, line in ipairs({{info[1], info[2]}, {name, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)}}) do
            local w = JavaGui.width(line[1]) + 2
            local plate = Instance.new("Frame")
            plate.BorderSizePixel, plate.BackgroundColor3, plate.BackgroundTransparency = 0, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.75
            plate.Size, plate.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 9), UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor((width - w) / 2), (i - 1) * 10)
            plate.Parent = holder
            JavaGui.text(plate, line[1], 1, 0, line[2], false, 2)
        end
        gui.Parent = ctx.gui
        return {gui = gui, holder = holder, scale = uiScale, width = width, head = head}
    end
    local connection = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            local info = DEVELOPER_TAGS[player.Name]
            if info and player ~= Players.LocalPlayer then
                local character = player.Character
                local head = character and (character:FindFirstChild("Head") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
                local tag = made[player]
                if tag and tag.head ~= head then tag.gui:Destroy(); tag = nil; made[player] = nil end
                if head and not tag then
                    tag = build(player, head, info)
                    made[player] = tag
                    -- One name over the player: hide Roblox's own.
                    local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum then hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None end
                end
                if tag then tag.scale.Scale = tag.gui.AbsoluteSize.X / tag.width end
            end
        end
        for player, tag in pairs(made) do
            if not player.Parent then tag.gui:Destroy(); made[player] = nil end
        end
    end)
    ctx.connections[#ctx.connections + 1] = {Disconnect = function()
        connection:Disconnect()
        for _, tag in pairs(made) do tag.gui:Destroy() end
    end}
end
local function createPlayerSkins(ctx)
    local skins = {current = nil, codec = SkinCodec}
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local faceIds = {Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.NormalId.Back, Enum.NormalId.Top, Enum.NormalId.Bottom, Enum.NormalId.Left, Enum.NormalId.Right}
    local pixel = ctx.pixel -- studs per skin pixel
    local layers = {}
    local function clear(part)
        for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name == "StevePixelSurface" or child.Name == "SteveSkinLayer" or (child:IsA("Decal") and child.Name:sub(1, 9) == "SteveSkin") then child:Destroy() end
        end
    end
    local function paint(part, faces, visible)
        for i, face in ipairs(faces) do
            local gui = JavaContent.surface(part, faceIds[i], face)
            gui.Enabled = visible
        end
    end
    -- Applies a 64x64 pixel table to Steve's six parts and their second-layer boxes.
    function skins.apply(px, slim, name)
        local boxes = SkinCodec.boxes(slim)
        for partName, part in pairs(ctx.parts) do
            local b = boxes[partName]
            local visible = true
            for _, g in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do if g.Name == "StevePixelSurface" then visible = g.Enabled; break end end
            clear(part)
            part.Size = Vector3.new(b[5], b[6], b[7]) * pixel
            paint(part, SkinCodec.faces(px, b[1], b[2], b[5], b[6], b[7]), visible)
            -- The second layer: a see-through box grown by 0.5 / 0.25 px, welded to the part.
            local outer = Instance.new("Part")
            outer.Name, outer.Transparency, outer.CanCollide, outer.CanQuery, outer.CanTouch, outer.Massless, outer.CastShadow = "SteveSkinLayer", 1, false, false, false, true, false
            outer.Size = Vector3.new(b[5] + b[8] * 2, b[6] + b[8] * 2, b[7] + b[8] * 2) * pixel
            outer.CFrame = part.CFrame
            paint(outer, SkinCodec.faces(px, b[3], b[4], b[5], b[6], b[7]), visible)
            local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
            weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.Parent = part, outer, outer
            outer.Parent = part
            layers[partName] = outer
        end
        if ctx.viewArm then
            local b = boxes["Right Arm"]
            local visible = true
            for _, g in ipairs(ctx.viewArm:GetChildren()) do if g.Name == "StevePixelSurface" then visible = g.Enabled; break end end
            clear(ctx.viewArm)
            local scale = ctx.viewArm.Size.Y / 12
            ctx.viewArm.Size = Vector3.new(b[5], 12, 4) * scale
            paint(ctx.viewArm, SkinCodec.faces(px, b[1], b[2], b[5], b[6], b[7]), visible)
        end
        if ctx.world then ctx.world.skinSlim = slim end
        skins.current = {name = name, slim = slim}
    end
    function skins.useDefault(name, slim)
        local entry = JavaContent.data.playerSkins and JavaContent.data.playerSkins[name]
        if not entry then return false, "Unknown skin: " .. tostring(name) end
        if slim == nil then slim = name == "alex" end
        local sprite = entry[slim and "slim" or "wide"] or entry.wide
        skins.apply(SkinCodec.fromSprite(sprite), slim, name)
        skins.save({kind = "default", name = name, slim = slim})
        return true
    end
    local function http(url)
        local req = request or http_request
        if not req then error("this executor has no HTTP request function") end
        local r = req({Url = url, Method = "GET"})
        if type(r) == "string" then error(r) end
        if not r.Success and (r.StatusCode or 0) ~= 200 then error("HTTP " .. tostring(r.StatusCode) .. " from " .. url) end
        return r.Body
    end
    function skins.fromPng(bytes, slim, name)
        local w, h, px = SkinCodec.png(bytes)
        px = SkinCodec.fixSkin(w, h, px)
        skins.apply(px, slim, name)
        return px
    end
    -- Minecraft account: profile id -> textures property -> skin PNG and model (slim / wide).
    function skins.fromAccount(username)
        local profile = HttpService:JSONDecode(http("https://api.mojang.com/users/profiles/minecraft/" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(username)))
        if not profile or not profile.id then error("No Minecraft account is named " .. username) end
        local session = HttpService:JSONDecode(http("https://sessionserver.mojang.com/session/minecraft/profile/" .. profile.id))
        local textures
        for _, prop in ipairs(session.properties or {}) do
            if prop.name == "textures" then textures = HttpService:JSONDecode(SkinCodec.base64(prop.value)) end
        end
        local skin = textures and textures.textures and textures.textures.SKIN
        if not skin then error(profile.name .. " uses a default skin") end
        local slim = skin.metadata and skin.metadata.model == "slim" or false
        skins.fromPng(http(skin.url), slim, profile.name)
        skins.save({kind = "url", url = skin.url, slim = slim, name = profile.name})
        return profile.name, slim
    end
    function skins.fromUrl(url, slim)
        skins.fromPng(http(url), slim, url)
        skins.save({kind = "url", url = url, slim = slim, name = url})
    end
    local saveFile = "SteveSkin_" .. tostring(game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.UserId) .. ".json"
    function skins.save(choice)
        skins.choice = choice
        pcall(function() if writefile then writefile(saveFile, HttpService:JSONEncode(choice)) end end)
    end
    -- The remembered skin, else Steve.
    function skins.restore()
        local ok, choice = pcall(function()
            if isfile and isfile(saveFile) then return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(saveFile)) end
            -- Older single save file (before per-account saves).
            if isfile and isfile("SteveSkin.json") then return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile("SteveSkin.json")) end
        end)
        if ok and type(choice) == "table" then skins.choice = choice end
        if ok and type(choice) == "table" then
            local done = pcall(function()
                if choice.kind == "default" then skins.useDefault(choice.name, choice.slim)
                elseif choice.kind == "url" and choice.url then skins.fromPng(http(choice.url), choice.slim, choice.name) end
            end)
            if done then return end
        end
        skins.useDefault("steve", false)
    end
    return skins
end
-- END PLAYER SKINS
-- Roblox tools held by Steve, on this screen only (other players keep Roblox's own tool replication):
--  * main hand: Roblox's RightGrip is re-pointed at Steve's visible right arm (Roblox's own grip offset);
--    in first person the real tool is hidden here and a scaled copy sits in Java's first-person hand;
--  * offhand: a copy on Steve's left arm, or in Java's first-person offhand position.
local function createNativeHands(ctx)
    local character, B = ctx.character, CONFIG.Block
    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name, folder.Parent = "SteveNativeHands", workspace.CurrentCamera
    local copies = {}
    local function copyOf(tool, scale)
        copies[tool] = copies[tool] or {}
        local c = copies[tool][scale]
        if c ~= nil then return c or nil end
        local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if not (handle and handle:IsA("BasePart")) then copies[tool][scale] = false; return nil end
        local model = Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name = tool.Name
        local parts = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                local ok, copy = pcall(function() return p:Clone() end)
                if ok and copy then
                    for _, d in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("JointInstance") or d:IsA("WeldConstraint")
                            or d:IsA("Constraint") or d:IsA("Sound") or d:IsA("TouchTransmitter") then d:Destroy() end
                    end
                    copy.Anchored, copy.CanCollide, copy.CanQuery, copy.CanTouch, copy.CastShadow, copy.Massless = true, false, false, false, false, true
                    copy.Size = p.Size * scale
                    for _, mesh in ipairs(copy:GetChildren()) do
                        if mesh:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                            if mesh.MeshType == Enum.MeshType.FileMesh then mesh.Scale = mesh.Scale * scale end
                            mesh.Offset = mesh.Offset * scale
                        end
                    end
                    local rel = handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)
                    copy.Parent = model
                    parts[#parts + 1] = {copy, rel.Rotation + rel.Position * scale}
                end
            end
        end
        c = {model = model, parts = parts}
        copies[tool][scale] = c
        return c
    end
    local function place(c, gripFrame, tool, scale)
        local grip = tool.Grip
        local handleFrame = gripFrame * (grip.Rotation + grip.Position * scale):Inverse()
        for _, e in ipairs(c.parts) do e[1].CFrame = handleFrame * e[2] end
        c.model.Parent = folder
    end
    local function hideReal(tool, hide)
        for _, p in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.LocalTransparencyModifier = hide and 1 or 0 end end
    end
    local hands = {}
    function hands.update(firstPerson, mainTool, offTool, firstFrame, offFirstFrame)
        local body = character:FindFirstChild("SteveBody")
        local rightArm = body and body:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
        local leftArm = body and body:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
        local k = (ctx.viewScale or B) / B
        -- First person: Java's hand frame sits low; Java items rise by their display transform, Roblox tools
        -- have none, so the grip is lifted to where a held item shows.
        local lift = CFrame.new(0, 0.3 * (ctx.viewScale or B), 0)
        local used = {}
        if mainTool and mainTool.Parent == character then
            local realArm = character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
            local weld = realArm and realArm:FindFirstChild("RightGrip")
            if weld and rightArm then
                if weld.Part0 ~= rightArm then weld.Part0 = rightArm end
                -- The grip at Steve's hand with the arm's own axes: Roblox holds tools with the arm raised and a
                -- -90 degree grip; Steve's arm hangs (Java's item pose), which is the same tool orientation.
                local c0 = CFrame.new(0, -rightArm.Size.Y / 2, 0)
                if weld.C0 ~= c0 then weld.C0 = c0 end
            end
            hideReal(mainTool, firstPerson)
            if firstPerson and firstFrame then
                local c = copyOf(mainTool, k)
                if c then place(c, firstFrame * lift, mainTool, k); used[c] = true end
            end
        end
        if offTool and offTool ~= mainTool then
            if firstPerson and offFirstFrame then
                local c = copyOf(offTool, k)
                if c then place(c, offFirstFrame * lift, offTool, k); used[c] = true end
            elseif not firstPerson and leftArm then
                local c = copyOf(offTool, 1)
                if c then place(c, leftArm.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -leftArm.Size.Y / 2, 0), offTool, 1); used[c] = true end
            end
        end
        for tool, byScale in pairs(copies) do
            for scale, c in pairs(byScale) do
                if c and not used[c] then c.model.Parent = nil end
                if c and not tool.Parent then c.model:Destroy(); byScale[scale] = nil end
            end
        end
    end
    function hands.destroy() folder:Destroy() end
    return hands
end
