    -- Files (sounds, photos) ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function b64decode(text)
        local dec = (crypt and crypt.base64decode) or (crypt and crypt.base64 and crypt.base64.decode) or base64_decode or (base64 and base64.decode)
        if dec then local ok, out = pcall(dec, text); if ok and type(out) == "string" then return out end end
        local map = {}
        local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
        for i = 1, 64 do map[alphabet:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
        local out = buffer.create(math.floor(#text * 3 / 4))
        local o = 0
        for i = 1, #text, 4 do
            local a, b, c, d = text:byte(i, i + 3)
            local v = map[a] * 262144 + map[b] * 4096 + (map[c] or 0) * 64 + (map[d] or 0)
            buffer.writeu8(out, o, math.floor(v / 65536) % 256); o = o + 1
            if c ~= 61 then buffer.writeu8(out, o, math.floor(v / 256) % 256); o = o + 1 end
            if d ~= 61 then buffer.writeu8(out, o, v % 256); o = o + 1 end
            if i % 400000 == 1 then task.wait() end
        end
        return buffer.readstring(out, 0, o)
    end
    local function ensureFiles()
        if state.assetsReady then return true end
        if not (writefile and getcustomasset) then return false end
        for _, f in ipairs({"Steve Mods", FOLDER, FOLDER .. "/sounds", FOLDER .. "/images"}) do pcall(function() if not isfolder(f) then makefolder(f) end end) end
        for name, b64 in pairs(MOD_SS_FILES) do
            local path = FOLDER .. "/" .. name
            local ok = pcall(function() if not (isfile and isfile(path)) then writefile(path, b64decode(b64)) end end)
            if ok then
                local okA, id = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
                if okA then state.assets[name] = id end
            end
            task.wait()
        end
        state.assetsReady = true
        return true
    end
    local function asset(name)
        local a = state.assets[name]
        if a == nil and (name:sub(1, 7) == "sounds/" or name:sub(1, 7) == "images/") then
            a = false
            pcall(function()
                local path = FOLDER .. "/film/" .. name:sub(1, 6) .. "/" .. name:sub(8)
                if isfile and isfile(path) then a = getcustomasset(path) end
            end)
            state.assets[name] = a
        end
        return a or nil
    end

    -- Sound (SoundInstance; 3D sounds roll off over their attenuation distance, 256 blocks) ----------------------------------
    local modFolder
    local function folder()
        if not modFolder or not modFolder.Parent then
            modFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
            modFolder.Name = "SteveModWorld"
            modFolder.Parent = workspace
        end
        return modFolder
    end
    local function play(name, pos, volume, pitch)
        local id = asset("sounds/" .. name .. ".ogg")
        if not id then return nil end
        local s = Instance.new("Sound")
        s.SoundId, s.Volume, s.PlaybackSpeed = id, (volume or 1) * (MinecraftSounds and MinecraftSounds.volume or 1), pitch or 1
        if pos then
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.Transparency, p.Size, p.Position = true, false, false, false, 1, Vector3.one, pos
            p.Parent = folder()
            s.RollOffMode, s.RollOffMinDistance, s.RollOffMaxDistance = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear, 16 * B, 256 * B
            s.Parent = p
            s.Ended:Connect(function() p:Destroy() end)
        else
            s.Parent = SoundService
            s.Ended:Connect(function() s:Destroy() end)
        end
        s:Play()
        return s
    end

    -- Geometry helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local animatedTextures = {}
    local function blockSprite(id)
        local e = JavaContent.byId[id]
        return e and e.particle and JavaContent.data.textures[e.particle] or nil
    end
    local function dressPart(p, sprite, faces, tile)
        if not sprite then return end
        local base = sprite.frames and sprite.frames[1] or sprite
        p.Color = JavaContent.averageColor(base)
        local content = JavaContent.spriteImage(base)
        if not content then return end
        for _, face in ipairs(faces or Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do
            local t = Instance.new("Texture")
            t.Face, t.StudsPerTileU, t.StudsPerTileV = face, B * (tile or 1), B * (tile or 1)
            local ok = pcall(function() t.TextureContent = content end)
            if ok then
                t.Parent = p
                if sprite.frames then animatedTextures[t] = sprite end
            else t:Destroy() end
        end
    end
    local function part(parent, size, cf, opts)
        opts = opts or {}
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Anchored, p.CastShadow = true, opts.shadow == true
        p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch = opts.collide ~= false, opts.collide ~= false, false
        p.Material = opts.material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        p.TopSurface, p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth, Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        if opts.shape then p.Shape = opts.shape end
        p.Size = Vector3.new(math.clamp(size.X, 0.05, 2048), math.clamp(size.Y, 0.05, 2048), math.clamp(size.Z, 0.05, 2048))
        p.CFrame = cf
        p.Color = opts.color or Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
        p.Transparency = opts.transparency or 0
        if opts.sprite then dressPart(p, opts.sprite, opts.faces, opts.tile) end
        p.Parent = parent
        return p
    end
    local function neon(parent, size, cf, colour, transparency, shape)
        return part(parent, size, cf, {material = Enum.Material.Neon, color = colour, transparency = transparency or 0, collide = false, shape = shape})
    end
    local function glowEmitter(parent, colour, rate, size, speed, life, opts)
        opts = opts or {}
        local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        local tex = asset("images/glow.png")
        if tex then e.Texture = tex end
        e.Color = ColorSequence.new(colour)
        e.LightEmission, e.LightInfluence = 1, 0
        e.Rate = rate or 0
        e.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, size), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, size * (opts.shrink or 0.2))})
        e.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
        e.Speed = NumberRange.new(speed * 0.5, speed)
        e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(life * 0.6, life)
        e.SpreadAngle = opts.spread or Vector2.new(180, 180)
        e.Acceleration = opts.acceleration or Vector3.zero
        e.EmissionDirection = opts.direction or Enum.NormalId.Top
        e.Drag = opts.drag or 0
        e.Parent = parent
        return e
    end
    local function anchorAt(parent, pos, size)
        local a = Instance.new("Part")
        a.Anchored, a.CanCollide, a.CanQuery, a.CanTouch, a.Transparency = true, false, false, false, 1
        a.Size, a.Position = size or Vector3.one, pos
        a.Parent = parent
        return a
    end
    -- Real Minecraft blocks for everything the skills build ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- All of it sits on the world's block grid. Small builds are placed as real blocks (world.setBlockAt), a few every
    -- frame. Big ones (craters hundreds of blocks wide, the needle) are grid-aligned runs of one block: every face carries
    -- that block's own textures one block to a tile, and mining any cell of a run turns it into that block.
    local VX = (function()
        local VX = {}
        local queue, head = {}, 1
        local FACE = {up = Enum.NormalId.Top, down = Enum.NormalId.Bottom, north = Enum.NormalId.Front, south = Enum.NormalId.Back,
            west = Enum.NormalId.Left, east = Enum.NormalId.Right}
        local function origin()
            local o = workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin")
            return typeof(o) == "Vector3" and o or Vector3.new(0, B / 2, 0)
        end
        function VX.index(p) local v = (p - origin()) / B; return math.floor(v.X + 0.5), math.floor(v.Y + 0.5), math.floor(v.Z + 0.5) end
        function VX.centre(i, j, k) return origin() + Vector3.new(i, j, k) * B end
        -- grid coordinates <-> the mods' block units (studs / B)
        function VX.toBlocks(x, z) local o = origin(); return (o.X + x * B) / B, (o.Z + z * B) / B end
        function VX.fromBlocks(x, z) local o = origin(); return (x * B - o.X) / B, (z * B - o.Z) / B end
        -- the block layer whose top face is at stud height y
        function VX.layer(y) return math.floor((y - origin().Y) / B + 1e-4) end
        function VX.topOf(j) return origin().Y + (j + 0.5) * B end

        -- How a block looks: its model's face textures, its tint, its average colour.
        local looks = {}
        function VX.look(id)
            local l = looks[id]
            if l ~= nil then return l or nil end
            local entry = JavaContent.byId[id]
            l = false
            if entry then
                l = {entry = entry, faces = {}}
                pcall(function()
                    local specs = CreativeRules.modelSpecs(entry, entry.state)
                    local model = JavaContent.data.models[specs[1] and specs[1].m or entry.itemModel]
                    local el = model and model.e and model.e[1]
                    for name, f in pairs(el and el.f or {}) do
                        if FACE[name] then l.faces[FACE[name]] = {sprite = JavaContent.data.textures[f[1]], tint = (f[4] or -1) >= 0} end
                    end
                end)
                if not next(l.faces) and entry.particle then
                    for _, n in pairs(FACE) do l.faces[n] = {sprite = JavaContent.data.textures[entry.particle]} end
                end
                local t = JavaContent.tint(entry)
                l.tint = Color3.new(t[1], t[2], t[3])
                local side = l.faces[Enum.NormalId.Front] or l.faces[Enum.NormalId.Top]
                local base = side and side.sprite and (side.sprite.frames and side.sprite.frames[1] or side.sprite)
                l.colour = base and JavaContent.averageColor(base) or Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
                l.light = entry.light or 0
                l.glow = entry.emissive == true or id == "lava"
            end
            looks[id] = l
            return l or nil
        end

        -- A block texture for a Texture: copied up nearest-neighbour to at least 128 px, so the smooth filtering Roblox
        -- gives Textures keeps every texel sharp.
        local sharp = {}
        function VX.image(sprite)
            local c = sharp[sprite]
            if c ~= nil then return c or nil end
            sharp[sprite] = false
            local ok, content = pcall(function()
                local w, h = sprite.w, sprite.h
                local k = math.max(1, math.ceil(128 / w))
                while w * k > 1024 or h * k > 1024 do k = k - 1 end
                local W, H = w * k, h * k
                local image = game:GetService("AssetService"):CreateEditableImage({Size = Vector2.new(W, H)})
                local px = buffer.create(W * H * 4)
                for y = 0, h - 1 do
                    for x = 0, w - 1 do
                        local at = (y * w + x) * 2 + 1
                        local ci = tonumber(sprite.d:sub(at, at + 1), 16) or 0
                        if ci > 0 then
                            local rgb = sprite.p[ci]
                            local r, g, b = math.floor(rgb / 65536) % 256, math.floor(rgb / 256) % 256, rgb % 256
                            local a = math.floor((sprite.alpha and sprite.alpha[ci] or 1) * 255 + 0.5)
                            for yy = y * k, y * k + k - 1 do
                                for xx = x * k, x * k + k - 1 do
                                    local i = (yy * W + xx) * 4
                                    buffer.writeu8(px, i, r); buffer.writeu8(px, i + 1, g); buffer.writeu8(px, i + 2, b); buffer.writeu8(px, i + 3, a)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                image:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Vector2.new(W, H), px)
                return Content.fromObject(image)
            end)
            if ok and content then sharp[sprite] = content; return content end
            return JavaContent.spriteImage(sprite)
        end
        -- The map's own surface where a cut gives back the old ground: a copy of the map part (not a Minecraft block).
        function VX.ground(hit, fallback)
            if not hit or not hit.Instance or not hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") then return fallback end
            local src = hit.Instance
            local id = src:GetAttribute("MinecraftBlockId")
            if id and JavaContent.byId[id] then return id end
            local tpl
            if src:IsA("Part") then
                local ok, copy = pcall(function() return src:Clone() end)
                if ok and copy then
                    tpl = copy
                    for _, d in ipairs(tpl:GetChildren()) do if not d:IsA("Texture") then d:Destroy() end end
                    tpl.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
                end
            end
            if not tpl then
                tpl = Instance.new("Part")
                if src:IsA("Terrain") then
                    tpl.Material = hit.Material
                    pcall(function() tpl.Color = src:GetMaterialColor(hit.Material) end)
                else tpl.Color, tpl.Material = src.Color, src.Material end
            end
            tpl.Anchored, tpl.CanCollide, tpl.CanQuery = true, true, true
            return {template = tpl}
        end
        -- One grid-aligned box of a block, cells i0..i1, j0..j1, k0..k1 (inclusive).
        function VX.box(parent, id, i0, j0, k0, i1, j1, k1, opts)
            if type(id) == "table" then
                local q = id.template:Clone()
                q.Size = Vector3.new(i1 - i0 + 1, j1 - j0 + 1, k1 - k0 + 1) * B
                q.CFrame = CFrame.new((VX.centre(i0, j0, k0) + VX.centre(i1, j1, k1)) / 2)
                q.Parent = parent
                return q
            end
            local l = VX.look(id)
            if not l then return nil end
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Anchored, p.CastShadow, p.CanTouch = true, false, false
            p.TopSurface, p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth, Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
            p.Material = l.glow and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            p.Color = l.colour
            p.Size = Vector3.new(i1 - i0 + 1, j1 - j0 + 1, k1 - k0 + 1) * B
            p.Position = (VX.centre(i0, j0, k0) + VX.centre(i1, j1, k1)) / 2
            p:SetAttribute("MinecraftBlockId", id)
            p:SetAttribute("MinecraftBlockType", l.entry.name)
            for n, f in pairs(l.faces) do
                if f.sprite and not (opts and opts.skip and opts.skip[n]) then
                    local base = f.sprite.frames and f.sprite.frames[1] or f.sprite
                    local content = f.sprite.frames and JavaContent.spriteImage(base) or VX.image(base)
                    if content then
                        local t = Instance.new("Texture")
                        t.Face, t.StudsPerTileU, t.StudsPerTileV = n, B, B
                        if f.tint then t.Color3 = l.tint end
                        if pcall(function() t.TextureContent = content end) then
                            t.Parent = p
                            if f.sprite.frames then animatedTextures[t] = f.sprite end
                        else t:Destroy() end
                    end
                end
            end
            p.Parent = parent
            return p
        end

        -- Real blocks, a few milliseconds of them every frame.
        function VX.set(i, j, k, id) queue[#queue + 1] = {i, j, k, id} end
        function VX.step()
            if head > #queue then return end
            local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
            local world = ctx and ctx.world
            if not (world and world.setBlockAt) then return end
            local t0 = os.clock()
            while head <= #queue and os.clock() - t0 < 0.004 do
                local q = queue[head]; queue[head] = nil; head = head + 1
                local e = JavaContent.byId[q[4]]
                if e then pcall(world.setBlockAt, VX.centre(q[1], q[2], q[3]), e.index, CreativeRules.copy(e.state), false, SS.id) end
            end
            world.connectionsDirty = true
            if head > #queue then queue, head = {}, 1 end
        end
        function VX.clear() queue, head = {}, 1 end

        -- A height field: o.i0..o.i1 x o.k0..o.k1 (grid indices); o.column(x, z) -> top layer, block id (x, z the column's
        -- middle in grid coordinates) or nil where nothing is built; o.lod(x, z) -> 1, 2 or 4 (coarser far out). Each
        -- column reaches down past its lowest neighbour; runs of one block at one height merge into one box. The cells
        -- double until the boxes fit o.budget.
        local NB = {{-1, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, -1}, {0, 1}}
        local function plan(o, s)
            local rows, n = {}, 0
            local S = s * 4
            for si = math.floor(o.i0 / S) * S, o.i1, S do
                for sk = math.floor(o.k0 / S) * S, o.k1, S do
                    local cs = math.min(S, s * (o.lod and o.lod(si + S / 2, sk + S / 2) or 1))
                    for ci = si, si + S - 1, cs do
                        for ck = sk, sk + S - 1, cs do
                            local x, z = ci + (cs - 1) / 2, ck + (cs - 1) / 2
                            local top, id = o.column(x, z)
                            if top then
                                local low = top
                                for _, nb in ipairs(NB) do
                                    local nt = o.column(x + nb[1] * cs, z + nb[2] * cs)
                                    low = math.min(low, nt or (top - (o.edge or 4)))
                                end
                                local rk = ck .. ":" .. cs
                                local row = rows[rk]
                                if not row then row = {}; rows[rk] = row end
                                row[#row + 1] = {i = ci, k = ck, s = cs, top = top, bottom = math.min(top - 2, low), id = id}
                            end
                            n = n + 1
                            if n % 3000 == 0 then task.wait() end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            -- runs along x
            local strips = {}
            for _, row in pairs(rows) do
                table.sort(row, function(a, b) return a.i < b.i end)
                local cur
                for _, c in ipairs(row) do
                    if cur and cur.id == c.id and cur.j1 == c.top and cur.i1 + 1 == c.i then
                        cur.i1 = c.i + c.s - 1
                        cur.j0 = math.min(cur.j0, c.bottom)
                    else
                        cur = {i0 = c.i, i1 = c.i + c.s - 1, k0 = c.k, k1 = c.k + c.s - 1, j0 = c.bottom, j1 = c.top, id = c.id}
                        strips[#strips + 1] = cur
                    end
                end
            end
            -- and the same run on the next row along z
            table.sort(strips, function(a, b)
                if a.i0 ~= b.i0 then return a.i0 < b.i0 end
                if a.i1 ~= b.i1 then return a.i1 < b.i1 end
                if a.j1 ~= b.j1 then return a.j1 < b.j1 end
                if a.id ~= b.id then return tostring(a.id) < tostring(b.id) end
                return a.k0 < b.k0
            end)
            local out, cur = {}, nil
            for _, st in ipairs(strips) do
                if cur and cur.i0 == st.i0 and cur.i1 == st.i1 and cur.j1 == st.j1 and cur.id == st.id and cur.k1 + 1 == st.k0 then
                    cur.k1 = st.k1
                    cur.j0 = math.min(cur.j0, st.j0)
                else
                    cur = st
                    out[#out + 1] = cur
                end
            end
            return out
        end
        function VX.plan(o)
            local budget = o.budget or 6000
            local area = math.max(1, (o.i1 - o.i0 + 1) * (o.k1 - o.k0 + 1))
            local s = 1
            while s < 16 and area / (s * s) > budget * 6 do s = s * 2 end
            local strips
            while true do
                strips = plan(o, s)
                if #strips <= budget or s >= 16 then break end
                s = s * 2
            end
            return strips, s
        end
        function VX.build(parent, strips, opts)
            for n, st in ipairs(strips) do
                if not SS.enabled or not parent.Parent then return end
                VX.box(parent, st.id, st.i0, st.j0, st.k0, st.i1, st.j1, st.k1, opts)
                if n % 100 == 0 then task.wait() end
            end
        end
        function VX.terrain(parent, o)
            local strips = VX.plan(o)
            VX.build(parent, strips, o)
            return #strips
        end

        -- Solid shapes: a set of cells {i, j, k, id} (keyed "i,j,k"); cell size s. Few enough become real blocks,
        -- otherwise one box per vertical run. Light-giving blocks stay few as real blocks (each one is a light).
        function VX.solid(parent, set, s, opts)
            s = s or 1
            local list, light = {}, 0
            for _, c in pairs(set) do
                list[#list + 1] = c
                local l = VX.look(c[4])
                if l and l.light > light then light = l.light end
            end
            if s == 1 and #list <= (light > 0 and 80 or 900) and not (opts and opts.parts) then
                for _, c in ipairs(list) do VX.set(c[1], c[2], c[3], c[4]) end
                return #list
            end
            local cols = {}
            for _, c in ipairs(list) do
                local key = c[1] .. ":" .. c[3] .. ":" .. c[4]
                local col = cols[key]
                if not col then col = {i = c[1], k = c[3], id = c[4], js = {}}; cols[key] = col end
                col.js[#col.js + 1] = c[2]
            end
            local n = 0
            for _, col in pairs(cols) do
                table.sort(col.js)
                local a, prev = col.js[1], col.js[1]
                for idx = 2, #col.js + 1 do
                    local j = col.js[idx]
                    if j ~= prev + s then
                        if not SS.enabled or not parent.Parent then return n end
                        VX.box(parent, col.id, col.i, a, col.k, col.i + s - 1, prev + s - 1, col.k + s - 1, opts)
                        n = n + 1
                        if n % 100 == 0 then task.wait() end
                        a = j
                    end
                    prev = j
                end
            end
            return n
        end
        -- A tapered spike of one block: from base (studs) along axis (unit) for length blocks, radius r0 at the base to r1.
        function VX.spike(set, base, axis, length, r0, r1, id, s)
            s = s or 1
            local bi, bj, bk = VX.index(base)
            local tip = axis * length
            local R = math.max(r0, r1) + s
            local lo = Vector3.new(math.min(0, tip.X), math.min(0, tip.Y), math.min(0, tip.Z)) - Vector3.one * R
            local hi = Vector3.new(math.max(0, tip.X), math.max(0, tip.Y), math.max(0, tip.Z)) + Vector3.one * R
            local n = 0
            for x = math.floor(lo.X / s) * s, hi.X, s do
                for y = math.floor(lo.Y / s) * s, hi.Y, s do
                    for z = math.floor(lo.Z / s) * s, hi.Z, s do
                        local p = Vector3.new(x + (s - 1) / 2, y + (s - 1) / 2, z + (s - 1) / 2)
                        local t = p:Dot(axis) / length
                        if t >= 0 and t <= 1 and (p - axis * (t * length)).Magnitude <= r0 + (r1 - r0) * t then
                            set[(bi + x) .. "," .. (bj + y) .. "," .. (bk + z)] = {bi + x, bj + y, bk + z, id}
                        end
                        n = n + 1
                        if n % 20000 == 0 then task.wait() end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        -- The cell size that keeps a spike near `cells` voxels.
        function VX.cellFor(length, radius, cells)
            local s = 1
            while s < 8 and math.pi * radius * radius * length / (s * s * s) > (cells or 1500) do s = s * 2 end
            return s
        end
        -- A thin coat on the ground, one block's top face: rays of snow, scorch marks.
        function VX.coat(parent, id, i, k, y)
            local l = VX.look(id)
            local f = l and l.faces[Enum.NormalId.Top]
            if not f or not f.sprite then return end
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Anchored, p.CastShadow, p.CanTouch, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery = true, false, false, false, false
            p.Material, p.Color, p.Transparency = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, l.colour, 1
            p.Size = Vector3.new(B, 0.05, B)
            local c = VX.centre(i, 0, k)
            p.Position = Vector3.new(c.X, y + 0.03, c.Z)
            local t = Instance.new("Texture")
            t.Face, t.StudsPerTileU, t.StudsPerTileV = Enum.NormalId.Top, B, B
            if f.tint then t.Color3 = l.tint end
            local content = VX.image(f.sprite.frames and f.sprite.frames[1] or f.sprite)
            if not content or not pcall(function() t.TextureContent = content end) then p:Destroy(); return end
            t.Parent = p
            p.Parent = parent
            return p
        end
        -- What block a map part is (its MinecraftBlockId, or what mining it would give).
        function VX.blockOf(hit)
            if not hit or not hit.Instance then return nil end
            local id = hit.Instance:GetAttribute("MinecraftBlockId")
            if id and JavaContent.byId[id] then return id end
            local ok, name = pcall(JavaContent.classify, hit)
            local e = ok and name and JavaContent.byName[name]
            return e and e.id or nil
        end
        return VX
    end)()
    local function rayParams()
        local p = RaycastParams.new()
        p.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local list = {folder()}
        for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if pl.Character then list[#list + 1] = pl.Character end end
        local fx = workspace:FindFirstChild("SteveJavaParticles"); if fx then list[#list + 1] = fx end
        local drops = workspace:FindFirstChild("SteveDroppedItems"); if drops then list[#list + 1] = drops end
        p.FilterDescendantsInstances = list
        return p
    end
    -- Map parts that belong to the game (not characters, not the script's own folders).
    local function isMap(p)
        if not p:IsA("BasePart") or p:IsA("Terrain") or not p.Anchored then return false end
        local a = p.Parent
        while a and a ~= workspace do
            if a:IsA("Model") and a:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return false end
            local name = a.Name
            if name == "SteveModWorld" or name == "SteveJavaParticles" or name == "SteveDroppedItems" or name == "SteveCatalogHands" or name:sub(1, 15) == "SteveNetPlayer_" then return false end
            a = a.Parent
        end
        return true
    end
    -- Like Java's block raycast: only the world itself (map parts, placed blocks, terrain) stops the ray - not
    -- players, other scripts' models, dropped items or invisible parts.
    local function mapRay(origin, direction)
        local params = rayParams()
        local skip = params.FilterDescendantsInstances
        for _ = 1, 12 do
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
            if not hit then return nil end
            local inst = hit.Instance
            if inst:IsA("Terrain") or (isMap(inst) and inst.Transparency < 0.95 and inst.LocalTransparencyModifier < 0.95) then return hit end
            skip[#skip + 1] = inst
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances = skip
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function groundAt(x, z, fallback)
        local hit = mapRay(Vector3.new(x, 2400, z), Vector3.new(0, -4000, 0))
        return hit and hit.Position.Y or fallback, hit ~= nil
    end
    -- The carve (star.a): everything in a vertical cylinder above a height goes. Small parts are hidden, parts that reach
    -- outside the cylinder are cut with a CSG subtraction, placed blocks are removed, Terrain is emptied.
    local geometry = game:GetService("GeometryService")
    local function hidePart(p)
        if state.hidden[p] or not SS.enabled then return end
        local saved = {p.Transparency, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, {}}
        state.hidden[p] = saved
        p.Transparency, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch = 1, false, false, false
        for _, d in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
            if d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then saved[5][d] = d.Transparency; d.Transparency = 1
            elseif d:IsA("SurfaceGui") then saved[5][d] = d.Enabled; d.Enabled = false end
        end
    end
    -- shape: nil = a vertical cylinder (centre, radius); {cf = CFrame, w = width, l = length} = a box along cf's look.
    -- One carve at a time: two carves cutting the same floor at once would each keep the other's piece.
    -- A big upright block (floors, baseplate slabs) is rebuilt from boxes around the hole instead of a CSG cut: CSG
    -- results this large keep their look but lose their collision (rays and the player fall through).
    local function splitPart(p, centre, radius, shape, frame, hw, hl, bottomY, topY)
        if not (p:IsA("Part") and p.Shape == Enum.PartType.Block and p.CFrame.UpVector.Y > 0.999) then return false end
        local cf, size = p.CFrame, p.Size
        local hx, hz = size.X / 2, size.Z / 2
        local topW, botW = cf.Position.Y + size.Y / 2, cf.Position.Y - size.Y / 2
        local cutLo, cutHi = math.max(botW, bottomY), math.min(topW, topY)
        if cutHi <= cutLo then return false end
        -- The hole in the part's own XZ plane: a circle, or the box's four corners (a convex polygon).
        local cx, cz, poly
        if shape then
            poly = {}
            for _, c in ipairs({{-1, -1}, {1, -1}, {1, 1}, {-1, 1}}) do
                local lp = cf:PointToObjectSpace(frame * Vector3.new(c[1] * hw, 0, c[2] * hl))
                poly[#poly + 1] = {lp.X, lp.Z}
            end
        else
            local lp = cf:PointToObjectSpace(centre)
            cx, cz = lp.X, lp.Z
        end
        local function interval(z)
            if not poly then
                local dz = z - cz
                if math.abs(dz) >= radius then return nil end
                local c = math.sqrt(radius * radius - dz * dz)
                return cx - c, cx + c
            end
            local lo, hi
            for i = 1, 4 do
                local a, b = poly[i], poly[i % 4 + 1]
                if (a[2] - z) * (b[2] - z) <= 0 and a[2] ~= b[2] then
                    local x = a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * (z - a[2]) / (b[2] - a[2])
                    lo, hi = math.min(lo or x, x), math.max(hi or x, x)
                end
            end
            return lo, hi
        end
        local xmin, xmax, zmin, zmax
        if poly then
            xmin, xmax, zmin, zmax = math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge
            for _, q in ipairs(poly) do xmin, xmax, zmin, zmax = math.min(xmin, q[1]), math.max(xmax, q[1]), math.min(zmin, q[2]), math.max(zmax, q[2]) end
        else
            xmin, xmax, zmin, zmax = cx - radius, cx + radius, cz - radius, cz + radius
        end
        xmin, xmax, zmin, zmax = math.max(xmin, -hx), math.min(xmax, hx), math.max(zmin, -hz), math.min(zmax, hz)
        if xmax <= xmin or zmax <= zmin then return false end
        local pieces = {}
        local function add(x0, x1, z0, z1, y0, y1)
            if x1 - x0 < 0.05 or z1 - z0 < 0.05 or y1 - y0 < 0.05 then return end
            pieces[#pieces + 1] = {x0, x1, z0, z1, y0, y1}
        end
        if cutLo > botW then add(-hx, hx, -hz, hz, botW, cutLo) end
        if cutHi < topW then add(-hx, hx, -hz, hz, cutHi, topW) end
        add(-hx, hx, -hz, zmin, cutLo, cutHi)
        add(-hx, hx, zmax, hz, cutLo, cutHi)
        add(-hx, xmin, zmin, zmax, cutLo, cutHi)
        add(xmax, hx, zmin, zmax, cutLo, cutHi)
        local rows = math.clamp(math.ceil((zmax - zmin) / 2.6), 8, 48)
        local dz = (zmax - zmin) / rows
        for i = 0, rows - 1 do
            local z0, z1 = zmin + i * dz, zmin + (i + 1) * dz
            local lo, hi
            for _, z in ipairs({z0, (z0 + z1) / 2, z1}) do
                local a, b = interval(z)
                if a then lo, hi = math.min(lo or a, a), math.max(hi or b, b) end
            end
            if not lo then add(xmin, xmax, z0, z1, cutLo, cutHi)
            else
                add(xmin, math.max(xmin, lo), z0, z1, cutLo, cutHi)
                add(math.min(xmax, hi), xmax, z0, z1, cutLo, cutHi)
            end
        end
        local template = p:Clone()
        if not template then return false end
        for _, d in ipairs(template:GetChildren()) do
            if not (d:IsA("Texture") or d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")) then d:Destroy()
            elseif d:IsA("Texture") then
                local saved = state.hidden[p] and state.hidden[p][5][p:FindFirstChild(d.Name)]
                if saved then d.Transparency = saved end
            end
        end
        local parent = p.Parent
        for i, pc in ipairs(pieces) do
            local q = template:Clone()
            local mx, mz, my = (pc[1] + pc[2]) / 2, (pc[3] + pc[4]) / 2, (pc[5] + pc[6]) / 2
            q.Size = Vector3.new(pc[2] - pc[1], pc[6] - pc[5], pc[4] - pc[3])
            q.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(mx, my - cf.Position.Y, mz)
            -- Keep the textures lined up with the original part.
            for _, tx in ipairs(q:GetChildren()) do
                if tx:IsA("Texture") then
                    local f = tx.Face
                    if f == Enum.NormalId.Top or f == Enum.NormalId.Bottom then
                        tx.OffsetStudsU = tx.OffsetStudsU + (pc[1] + hx)
                        tx.OffsetStudsV = tx.OffsetStudsV + (pc[3] + hz)
                    elseif f == Enum.NormalId.Front or f == Enum.NormalId.Back then
                        tx.OffsetStudsU = tx.OffsetStudsU + (pc[1] + hx)
                    else
                        tx.OffsetStudsU = tx.OffsetStudsU + (pc[3] + hz)
                    end
                end
            end
            q.Parent = parent
            state.built[q] = true
            if i % 60 == 0 then task.wait() end
        end
        template:Destroy()
        hidePart(p)
        return true
    end
    local function carveNow(centre, radius, bottomY, topY, shape)
        bottomY, topY = bottomY or -600, topY or 3000
        local params = OverlapParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {folder()}
        params.MaxParts = 20000
        local midY = (bottomY + topY) / 2
        local h = topY - bottomY
        local frame = shape and (shape.cf - shape.cf.Position + Vector3.new(shape.cf.Position.X, midY, shape.cf.Position.Z)) or CFrame.new(centre.X, midY, centre.Z)
        local hw, hl = shape and shape.w / 2 or radius, shape and shape.l / 2 or radius
        -- How far inside the shape a point is (in the ground plane), minus a margin: >= 0 means inside.
        local function inside(pos, margin)
            if shape then
                local lp = frame:PointToObjectSpace(pos)
                return math.min(hw - math.abs(lp.X), hl - math.abs(lp.Z)) - margin
            end
            return radius - Vector3.new(pos.X - centre.X, 0, pos.Z - centre.Z).Magnitude - margin
        end
        local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(frame, Vector3.new(hw * 2, h, hl * 2), params)
        local cutter
        for i, p in ipairs(parts) do
            if isMap(p) and not state.hidden[p] then
                local half = p.Size.Magnitude / 2
                if inside(p.Position, half) >= 0 and p.Position.Y - half >= bottomY - 0.5 then
                    hidePart(p)
                elseif inside(p.Position, -half) >= 0 and (p.Size.X > hw * 0.5 or p.Size.Z > hw * 0.5) and (p:IsA("Part") or p:IsA("MeshPart") or p:IsA("UnionOperation")) then
                    -- A big part reaching outside (floors, the baseplate): split it into boxes, or subtract the shape.
                    if splitPart(p, centre, radius, shape, frame, hw, hl, bottomY, topY) then
                    else
                    if not cutter then
                        cutter = Instance.new("Part")
                        cutter.Anchored = true
                        local ch = math.min(2048, h)
                        if shape then
                            cutter.Size = Vector3.new(math.min(2048, hw * 2), ch, math.min(2048, hl * 2))
                            cutter.CFrame = frame - frame.Position + Vector3.new(frame.Position.X, bottomY + ch / 2, frame.Position.Z)
                        else
                            cutter.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
                            cutter.Size = Vector3.new(ch, math.min(2048, radius * 2), math.min(2048, radius * 2))
                            cutter.CFrame = CFrame.new(centre.X, bottomY + ch / 2, centre.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
                        end
                    end
                    local ok, results = pcall(function()
                        return geometry:SubtractAsync(p, {cutter}, {CollisionFidelity = Enum.CollisionFidelity.PreciseConvexDecomposition, SplitApart = false})
                    end)
                    if ok and type(results) == "table" and results[1] then
                        if not SS.enabled then for _, r in ipairs(results) do r:Destroy() end; break end
                        for _, r in ipairs(results) do
                            r.Anchored = true
                            pcall(function() r.UsePartColor = true end)
                            r.Color, r.Material = p.Color, p.Material
                            -- The cut piece keeps the floor's look (studs, decals).
                            for _, d in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
                                if d:IsA("Texture") or d:IsA("Decal") then
                                    local copy = d:Clone()
                                    local saved = state.hidden[p] and state.hidden[p][5][d]
                                    if saved then copy.Transparency = saved end
                                    copy.Parent = r
                                end
                            end
                            r.Parent = p.Parent
                            state.built[r] = true
                        end
                        hidePart(p)
                    elseif inside(p.Position, 0) >= 0 and p.Size.Magnitude < 400 then hidePart(p) end
                    end
                elseif inside(p.Position, 0) >= 0 and p.Position.Y >= bottomY and p.Size.Magnitude < 400 then
                    hidePart(p)
                end
            end
            if i % 400 == 0 then task.wait() end
            if not SS.enabled then break end
        end
        if cutter then cutter:Destroy() end
        if not SS.enabled then return end
        -- Placed blocks and Terrain.
        local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
        local world = ctx and ctx.world
        if world and world.nodes then
            local gone = {}
            for _, n in pairs(world.nodes) do
                if n.center and n.center.Y >= bottomY and inside(n.center, 0) >= 0 then gone[#gone + 1] = n.center end
            end
            for i, c in ipairs(gone) do pcall(world.setBlockAt, c, nil, nil, false, SS.id); if i % 200 == 0 then task.wait() end end
        end
        pcall(function()
            local half=shape and Vector3.new(hw,h/2,hl) or Vector3.new(radius,h/2,radius)
            local cf=shape and frame or CFrame.new(centre.X,midY,centre.Z)
            local lo,hi=Vector3.new(math.huge,math.huge,math.huge),Vector3.new(-math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge)
            for _,x in ipairs({-1,1}) do for _,y in ipairs({-1,1}) do for _,z in ipairs({-1,1}) do
                local p=cf:PointToWorldSpace(half*Vector3.new(x,y,z))
                lo=lo:Min(p);hi=hi:Max(p)
            end end end
            local min=Vector3int16.new(math.clamp(math.floor(lo.X/4),-32768,32767),math.clamp(math.floor(lo.Y/4),-32768,32767),math.clamp(math.floor(lo.Z/4),-32768,32767))
            local max=Vector3int16.new(math.clamp(math.ceil(hi.X/4),-32768,32767),math.clamp(math.ceil(hi.Y/4),-32768,32767),math.clamp(math.ceil(hi.Z/4),-32768,32767))
            local copy=workspace.Terrain:CopyRegion(Region3int16.new(min,max))
            state.terrain=state.terrain or {}
            state.terrain[#state.terrain+1]={copy=copy,corner=min}
            if shape then workspace.Terrain:FillBlock(frame, Vector3.new(hw * 2, h, hl * 2), Enum.Material.Air)
            else workspace.Terrain:FillCylinder(CFrame.new(centre.X, midY, centre.Z), h, radius, Enum.Material.Air) end
        end)
    end
    local function carve(...)
        while state.carving and SS.enabled do task.wait() end
        if not SS.enabled then return end
        state.carving = true
        local ok, err = pcall(carveNow, ...)
        state.carving = false
        if not ok then warn("[Shooting Star] carve: " .. tostring(err)) end
    end

    -- Damage (star.j / spell.d): survival players and mobs in the area are erased; creative / spectator are spared.
    local function killLocal(cause)
        local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
        if not ctx or not CONFIG.Survival or PlayerStats.spectator then return end
        local hum = ctx.humanoid
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
        if ctx.world then ctx.world.lastDamage, ctx.world.lastDamageTime = cause or "shooting_star_demo.shooting_star", os.clock() end
        PlayerStats.killUntil = os.clock() + 1
        hum.Health = 0
    end
    local function hurtLocal(amount)
        local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
        if not ctx or not CONFIG.Survival or PlayerStats.spectator then return end
        local hum = ctx.humanoid
        if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
            if ctx.world then ctx.world.lastDamage, ctx.world.lastDamageTime = "shooting_star_demo.shooting_star", os.clock() end
            hum:TakeDamage(amount * hum.MaxHealth / 20)
        end
    end
    local function eraseArea(test, cause)
        local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
        if not ctx then return end
        local root = ctx.root
        if root and root.Parent and test(root.Position) then killLocal(cause) end
        local mm = ctx.world and ctx.world.gameplay and ctx.world.gameplay.mobsModule
        for _, m in ipairs(mm and mm.list or {}) do
            if not m.puppet and not m.removed and m.humanoid.Health > 0 and test(m.position) then
                m.modLocalDeath = SS.id
                m.invulnerableTime = 0
                pcall(mm.hurt, m, 1e6, {modKill = true})
                if m.humanoid.Health > 0 then m.humanoid.Health = 0 end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Screen: the mod's grade (client.render.f -> fx/composite.fsh), rebuilt every frame from the running casts --------------
    local LASER, LASER_HOT = Color3.new(1, 0.045, 0.07), Color3.new(1, 0.55, 0.6)
    local function sm(x) x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1); return x * x * (3 - 2 * x) end
    local function win(x, a, b, c, d) return math.clamp((x - a) / math.max(b - a, 0.001), 0, 1) * (1 - math.clamp((x - c) / math.max(d - c, 0.001), 0, 1)) end
    local function lerp(a, b, t) return a + (b - a) * t end
    local function rgb(n) return Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(n / 65536) % 256, math.floor(n / 256) % 256, n % 256) end
    local G
    local function resetGrade() G = {a = 0, b = 0, d = 0, m = 0, n = 0, x = 0, h = 0, fc = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), l = 0, vc = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), o = 0, p = 0} end
    resetGrade()
    local Grade = {}
    function Grade.flash(col, amt) if amt > G.h then G.h, G.fc = amt, col end end
    function Grade.vignette(col, amt) if amt > G.l then G.l, G.vc = amt, col end end
    function Grade.impact(amt, mode) if amt > G.o then G.o, G.p = amt, mode end end
    -- fx.e: trauma j (decays 0.035 a tick), k = the grade's shake of the last frame.
    local trauma, gradeShake = 0, 0
    local transient = {}
    local function flash(amount, colour) transient[#transient + 1] = {amount, colour or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)} end
    local function addShake(amount) trauma = math.min(1, trauma + amount) end
    local function shakeAt(pos, amount, range)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local d = cam and (cam.CFrame.Position - pos).Magnitude / B or 0
        addShake(amount * math.clamp(1 - d / range, 0, 1))
    end
    local screen = {}
    local function screenGui()
        if screen.gui and screen.gui.Parent then return screen end
        local pg = Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        g.Name, g.ResetOnSpawn, g.IgnoreGuiInset, g.DisplayOrder = "SteveModScreen", false, true, -1
        local function full(class, z)
            local f = Instance.new(class)
            f.Size, f.BorderSizePixel, f.BackgroundTransparency, f.ZIndex = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 0, 1, z
            f.Parent = g
            return f
        end
        screen.tone = full("Frame", 1)
        screen.vign = full("ImageLabel", 2)
        screen.vign.Image, screen.vign.ImageTransparency, screen.vign.ScaleType = asset("images/vignette.png") or "", 1, Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
        screen.flash = full("Frame", 3)
        g.Parent = pg
        screen.gui = g
        local function effect(class, name)
            local e = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new(class)
            e.Name, e.Enabled = name, false
            e.Parent = Lighting
            return e
        end
        screen.cc = effect("ColorCorrectionEffect", "SteveModImpact")
        screen.bloom = effect("BloomEffect", "SteveModBloom")
        screen.blur = effect("BlurEffect", "SteveModBlur")
        return screen
    end
    local function applyGrade(dt)
        local s = screenGui()
        for i = #transient, 1, -1 do
            local tr = transient[i]
            Grade.flash(tr[2], tr[1])
            tr[1] = tr[1] - dt * 1.6
            if tr[1] <= 0 then table.remove(transient, i) end
        end
        local h = G.h
        s.flash.BackgroundColor3 = G.fc:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), math.clamp(h - 1, 0, 1))
        s.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(h * 0.55 + math.max(0, h - 1) * 0.45, 0, 1)
        s.vign.ImageColor3, s.vign.ImageTransparency = G.vc, 1 - math.clamp(G.l, 0, 1)
        s.bloom.Enabled = G.m > 0.001
        if s.bloom.Enabled then s.bloom.Intensity, s.bloom.Size, s.bloom.Threshold = 0.12 + G.m * 0.3, 24 + 8 * math.max(1, G.n), 0.95 - 0.12 * math.min(G.m, 1) end
        s.blur.Enabled = G.d > 0.001
        s.blur.Size = G.d * 16
        -- Impact frames (composite.fsh Impact modes): two-tone manga frames. Roblox cannot trace the edges of the world,
        -- so each mode is a high-contrast black-and-white picture tinted to its colours.
        if G.o > 0.001 then
            local m = G.p
            local tint, over, overA, bright = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0, -0.05
            if m == 7 then over, overA = Color3.new(0.93, 0.03, 0.07), 0.5
            elseif m == 8 then tint, over, overA, bright = Color3.new(1, 0.42, 0.45), Color3.new(0.93, 0.03, 0.07), 0.2, 0.18
            elseif m == 9 or m == 10 then over, overA = Color3.new(0.98, 0.58, 0.08), 0.4
            elseif m == 11 or m == 12 then over, overA = Color3.new(1, 0.84, 0.1), 0.35
            elseif m == 13 or m == 14 then tint, over, overA = Color3.new(1, 0.8, 0.12), Color3.new(0.035, 0.045, 0.16), 0.35
            elseif m >= 15 and m <= 20 then tint, bright = Color3.new(1, 0.42, 0.12), -0.1
            elseif m >= 21 and m <= 26 then tint, bright = Color3.new(0.64, 0.46, 1), -0.1
            elseif m >= 27 and m <= 32 then tint, bright = Color3.new(1, 0.7, 1), -0.05
            elseif m >= 33 then tint, bright = Color3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.9), -0.15
            elseif m == 2 then tint = Color3.new(1, 0.1, 0.12)
            elseif m == 3 then tint = Color3.new(0.35, 0.9, 1)
            elseif m == 4 then tint = Color3.new(0.22, 0.42, 1)
            elseif m == 5 then tint = Color3.new(1, 0.22, 0.9)
            elseif m == 6 or m == 0 then bright = 0.2 end
            s.cc.Enabled = true
            s.cc.Saturation, s.cc.Contrast, s.cc.Brightness, s.cc.TintColor = -1, 2.8 * G.o, bright, tint
            s.tone.BackgroundColor3 = over
            s.tone.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - overA * G.o
        else
            s.cc.Enabled = false
            s.tone.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        end
        gradeShake = G.a
    end
    -- Camera shake (fx.e.a(PoseStack)): degrees of yaw / pitch / roll from trauma and the grade's shake.
    local function shakeFrame()
        local v = trauma * trauma + gradeShake * 0.25
        local jitter = math.min(1, gradeShake * 0.4 + trauma * trauma * 0.35)
        if v <= 1e-4 and jitter <= 1e-4 then return CFrame.identity end
        local t = os.clock()
        local yaw = (math.sin(t * 37) * 0.6 + math.sin(t * 61) * 0.4) * 2.6 * v
        local pitch = (math.sin(t * 43 + 1.3) * 0.6 + math.sin(t * 71) * 0.4) * 2.2 * v
        local roll = math.sin(t * 29 + 0.7) * 3 * v
        -- composite: the picture itself jitters by 3% of the screen.
        local jx = (math.noise(t * 31, 1.7) * 0.5) * jitter * 0.03 * 70
        local jy = (math.noise(5.3, t * 29) * 0.5) * jitter * 0.03 * 70
        return CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(yaw + jx), 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(pitch + jy), 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(roll))
    end

    -- Cutscene director (client.cinematic.c / d): shots with cubic easing and smoothstep blends, an instant start and a
    -- 14-tick fade back to the player's own view after the last shot. Poses are {pos, look, fov, roll} in studs.
    local function easeCubic(x) x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1); if x < 0.5 then return 4 * x * x * x end return 1 - (-2 * x + 2) ^ 3 / 2 end
    local function lerpPose(a, b, k) return {pos = a.pos:Lerp(b.pos, k), look = a.look:Lerp(b.look, k), fov = lerp(a.fov, b.fov, k), roll = lerp(a.roll, b.roll, k)} end
    local Director = {}
    local function shotPose(c, s, t) return s[4](c, easeCubic((t - s[1]) / math.max(1, s[2] - s[1]))) end
    function Director.pose(c, film, t)
        local idx = 1
        for i, s in ipairs(film) do if t >= s[1] then idx = i end end
        local s = film[idx]
        local p = shotPose(c, s, t)
        if idx > 1 and s[3] > 0 and t - s[1] < s[3] then
            local prev = film[idx - 1]
            p = lerpPose(shotPose(c, prev, prev[2]), p, sm((t - s[1]) / s[3]))
        end
        return p
    end
    function Director.lastShot(film) return film[#film][2] end
    function Director.weight(c, film, t)
        if t < 0 then return 0 end
        local last = film[#film][2]
        local w = 1 - sm((t - last) / 14)
        if c.skipped then w = math.min(w, 1 - sm((t - c.skipped) / 8)) end
        return math.clamp(w, 0, 1)
    end
    -- Helpers the shots use (client.cinematic.i / j), in blocks.
    local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z) end
    local function perp(v) return Vector3.new(-v.Z, 0, v.X) end
    local function casterPos(c)
        local char = c.owner and c.owner.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then return hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, hrp.Size.Y * 0.5 + (char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").HipHeight or 2), 0) end
        return c.casterPos
    end
    -- base + right * side + up + facing * forward (i.a(Vec3, ...)).
    local function offA(c, base, side, up, fwd) return base + perp(c.face) * side * B + Vector3.new(0, up * B, 0) + c.face * fwd * B end
    -- The flat direction from the target to the caster (or behind the facing).
    local function away(c, from)
        local d = flat(casterPos(c) - (from or c.T))
        return d.Magnitude < B and -c.face or d.Unit
    end
    local function rotY(p, centre, deg)
        local a = math.rad(deg)
        local dx, dz = p.X - centre.X, p.Z - centre.Z
        return Vector3.new(centre.X + dx * math.cos(a) - dz * math.sin(a), p.Y, centre.Z + dx * math.sin(a) + dz * math.cos(a))
    end
    local function up(n) return Vector3.new(0, n * B, 0) end
    -- j.a(v, h): never below the ground plus h blocks.
    local function aboveGround(v, h)
        local g = groundAt(v.X, v.Z, nil)
        if g and v.Y < g + h * B then return Vector3.new(v.X, g + h * B, v.Z) end
        return v
    end
    -- j.a(from, to, d): raise the camera (6 blocks at a time, up to d) until it sees the point.
    local function clearUp(from, to, d)
        for dy = 0, d, 6 do
            local p = from + up(dy)
            local hit = mapRay(p, to - p)
            if not hit or (hit.Position - to).Magnitude < 6 * B then return p end
        end
        return from
    end
    local function pose(pos, look, fov, roll) return {pos = pos, look = look, fov = fov, roll = roll or 0} end
    -- The opening shots every skill shares: the hand on the remote, then over the shoulder.
    local function handShot(c, e)
        local p = casterPos(c)
        return pose(offA(c, p, lerp(1.35, 1.2, e), lerp(1.7, 1.6, e), lerp(2.1, 1.85, e)), offA(c, p, 0.36, 1.38, 0.62), 40, 0)
    end

    -- Space films: the mod's space shaders (star_space / star_gun / star_rays ...) rendered offline frame by frame and played
    -- here as an image sequence over the world. index.json: {dt, t0, frames = {{t, file|nil}...}, hud = {{t, labels, range}...}}.
    local Films = {}
    local filmCache = {}
    function Films.data(name)
        local f = filmCache[name]
        if f ~= nil then return f or nil end
        local ok, idx = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(FOLDER .. "/film/" .. name .. "/index.json")) end)
        if not ok or type(idx) ~= "table" or type(idx.frames) ~= "table" then filmCache[name] = false; return nil end
        f = {name = name, dt = idx.dt, t0 = idx.t0, frames = idx.frames, hud = idx.hud or {}, ids = {}, preloaded = 0}
        filmCache[name] = f
        return f
    end
    local function frameId(f, i)
        local id = f.ids[i]
        if id == nil then
            local fr = f.frames[i]
            id = false
            if fr and fr[2] then
                local ok, a = pcall(getcustomasset, FOLDER .. "/film/" .. f.name .. "/" .. fr[2])
                if ok then id = a end
            end
            f.ids[i] = id
        end
        return id or nil
    end
    function Films.preload(f, upTo)
        upTo = math.min(#f.frames, upTo)
        if f.preloaded >= upTo then return end
        local batch = {}
        for i = f.preloaded + 1, upTo do local id = frameId(f, i); if id then batch[#batch + 1] = id end end
        f.preloaded = upTo
        if #batch > 0 then task.spawn(function() pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(batch) end) end) end
    end
    local filmView = {}
    local function filmGui()
        if filmView.gui and filmView.gui.Parent then return filmView end
        local pg = Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        g.Name, g.ResetOnSpawn, g.IgnoreGuiInset, g.DisplayOrder, g.Enabled = "SteveModFilm", false, true, -2, false
        for i, z in ipairs({2, 1}) do
            local l = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            l.Size, l.BackgroundTransparency, l.ScaleType, l.ZIndex, l.BorderSizePixel = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 1, Enum.ScaleType.Crop, z, 0
            l.Parent = g
            filmView[i == 1 and "front" or "back"] = l
        end
        g.Parent = pg
        filmView.gui = g
        return filmView
    end
    -- Show the frame for film time t; returns true when a frame covers the screen.
    function Films.show(name, t)
        local f = Films.data(name)
        if not f then Films.hide(); return false end
        local i = math.floor((t - f.t0) / f.dt + 1e-4) + 1
        local fr = f.frames[i]
        if not fr or not fr[2] then Films.hide(); return false end
        local v = filmGui()
        v.gui.Enabled = true
        local id = frameId(f, i) or ""
        -- Double buffer: the new frame loads on the hidden layer and is swapped in once it has loaded, so a slow
        -- load holds the last frame instead of showing the world.
        local shown, hidden = v.front, v.back
        if shown.Image ~= id then
            if hidden.Image ~= id then hidden.Image = id end
            if hidden.IsLoaded or shown.Image == "" then
                v.front, v.back = hidden, shown
                shown, hidden = v.front, v.back
            end
        end
        shown.ZIndex, hidden.ZIndex = 2, 1
        local png = fr[2]:sub(-4) == ".png"
        shown.ImageTransparency = 0
        -- The next frame starts loading underneath (hidden behind see-through frames).
        local nxt = f.frames[i + 1]
        if shown.Image == id then
            local nid = nxt and nxt[2] and frameId(f, i + 1)
            if nid and hidden.Image ~= nid then hidden.Image = nid end
        end
        hidden.ImageTransparency = png and 0.995 or 0
        Films.preload(f, i + 60)
        return true
    end
    function Films.hide() if filmView.gui then filmView.gui.Enabled = false end end
    function Films.hudAt(name, t)
        local f = Films.data(name)
        if not f then return nil end
        local i = math.floor((t - f.t0) / f.dt + 1e-4) + 1
        return f.hud[math.clamp(i, 1, #f.hud)]
    end

    -- The films are downloaded once (one pack per film, next to the script on GitHub) into the workspace.
    -- Pack: "SSPK1", u32 index length, JSON [[name, offset, length]...], the files. index.json is written last.
    do
    local FILM_NAMES = {"sounds", "images", "addition", "ss01", "gungnir", "stars"}
    local FILM_VERSIONS = {sounds = 1, images = 1, addition = 2, ss01 = 2, gungnir = 2, stars = 2}
    local FILM_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/9s2dyhcgwm-svg/Scripts/main/Steve%20Mods/shooting_star_demo/"
    SS.filmProgress = 1
    local function unpackFilm(name, body)
        if type(body) ~= "string" or body:sub(1, 5) ~= "SSPK1" then return false end
        local n = string.unpack(">I4", body, 6)
        local ok, index = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(body:sub(10, 9 + n)) end)
        if not ok then return false end
        local base = 10 + n
        local dir = FOLDER .. "/film/" .. name
        for _, f in ipairs({FOLDER .. "/film", dir}) do pcall(function() if not isfolder(f) then makefolder(f) end end) end
        for i, e in ipairs(index) do
            writefile(dir .. "/" .. e[1], body:sub(base + e[2], base + e[2] + e[3] - 1))
            if i % 40 == 0 then task.wait() end
        end
        filmCache[name] = nil
        return true
    end
    function SS.ensureFilms()
        if not (request or http_request) or not writefile then return end
        local req = request or http_request
        for k, name in ipairs(FILM_NAMES) do
            SS.filmProgress = (k - 1) / #FILM_NAMES
            local versionFile = FOLDER .. "/film/" .. name .. "/version.txt"
            local have = isfile and isfile(versionFile) and readfile(versionFile) or ""
            if not (isfile and isfile(FOLDER .. "/film/" .. name .. "/index.json")) or have ~= tostring(FILM_VERSIONS[name] or 1) then
                local base = (getgenv and rawget(getgenv(), "SteveFilmURL")) or FILM_URL
                local ok, res = pcall(req, {Url = base .. name .. ".pack", Method = "GET"})
                if ok and type(res) == "table" and res.StatusCode == 200 then
                    if not unpackFilm(name, res.Body) then warn("[Shooting Star] the " .. name .. " film could not be unpacked")
                    else pcall(writefile, versionFile, tostring(FILM_VERSIONS[name] or 1)) end
                else
                    warn("[Shooting Star] the " .. name .. " film could not be downloaded; its space scenes are skipped")
                end
            end
        end
        SS.filmProgress = 1
    end
    end

    -- Film HUD: Minecraft-font text and fills at GUI scale (GuiGraphics), pooled and redrawn every frame.
    local Hud = {}
    local hudView = {pool = {}, fills = {}}
    local function hudGuiFilm()
        if hudView.gui and hudView.gui.Parent then return hudView end
        local pg = Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        g.Name, g.ResetOnSpawn, g.IgnoreGuiInset, g.DisplayOrder = "SteveModFilmHud", false, true, 1
        local canvas = Instance.new("Frame")
        canvas.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        canvas.Parent = g
        local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
        scale.Parent = canvas
        g.Parent = pg
        hudView.gui, hudView.canvas, hudView.scale = g, canvas, scale
        return hudView
    end
    function Hud.begin()
        local v = hudGuiFilm()
        local view = v.gui.AbsoluteSize
        local s = JavaGui.scale(view)
        v.scale.Scale = s
        v.W, v.H = math.floor(view.X / s), math.floor(view.Y / s)
        v.canvas.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(v.W, v.H)
        v.frame = (v.frame or 0) + 1
        v.fillIndex = 0
        return v.W, v.H
    end
    -- text(str, x, y, colour, alpha, scale, align: 0 left / 0.5 centre / 1 right, shadow)
    function Hud.text(str, x, y, colour, alpha, scale, align, shadow)
        if alpha <= 0.01 then return end
        local v = hudView
        scale = scale or 1
        local key = str .. "|" .. scale .. "|" .. colour:ToHex() .. "|" .. tostring(shadow)
        local e = v.pool[key]
        if not e or e.used == v.frame then
            -- Several copies of one string in a frame: a numbered key.
            local n = 1
            while e and e.used == v.frame do n = n + 1; e = v.pool[key .. "#" .. n] end
            if not e then
                local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
                holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(JavaGui.width(str), 9)
                local us = Instance.new("UIScale"); us.Scale = scale; us.Parent = holder
                local txt = JavaGui.text(holder, str, 0, 0, colour, shadow == true, 5)
                holder.Parent = v.canvas
                e = {holder = holder, width = JavaGui.width(str), images = {}, alpha = -1}
                for _, d in ipairs(txt:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("ImageLabel") then e.images[#e.images + 1] = d end end
                v.pool[n == 1 and key or (key .. "#" .. n)] = e
            end
        end
        e.used = v.frame
        e.holder.Visible = true
        local w = e.width * scale
        e.holder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(x - w * (align or 0)), math.floor(y))
        if math.abs(e.alpha - alpha) > 0.01 then
            e.alpha = alpha
            for _, im in ipairs(e.images) do im.ImageTransparency = 1 - alpha end
        end
    end
    function Hud.fill(x0, y0, x1, y1, colour, alpha)
        if alpha <= 0.01 then return end
        local v = hudView
        v.fillIndex = v.fillIndex + 1
        local f = v.fills[v.fillIndex]
        if not f then
            f = Instance.new("Frame")
            f.BorderSizePixel, f.ZIndex = 0, 4
            f.Parent = v.canvas
            v.fills[v.fillIndex] = f
        end
        f.Visible = true
        f.Position, f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(x0, x1), math.min(y0, y1)), UDim2.fromOffset(math.abs(x1 - x0), math.abs(y1 - y0))
        f.BackgroundColor3, f.BackgroundTransparency = colour, 1 - alpha
    end
    -- q.a(gui, x, y, len, dx, dy, colour): an L-shaped corner.
    function Hud.corner(x, y, len, dx, dy, colour, alpha)
        Hud.fill(math.min(x, x + dx * len), y, math.max(x, x + dx * len), y + dy, colour, alpha)
        Hud.fill(x, math.min(y, y + dy * len), x + dx, math.max(y, y + dy * len), colour, alpha)
    end
    -- q.a(gui, x, y, r, colour): a bracket box round a point.
    function Hud.box(x, y, r, colour, alpha)
        local l = math.max(3, math.floor(r / 3))
        Hud.corner(x - r, y - r, l, 1, 1, colour, alpha)
        Hud.corner(x + r, y - r, l, -1, 1, colour, alpha)
        Hud.corner(x - r, y + r, l, 1, -1, colour, alpha)
        Hud.corner(x + r, y + r, l, -1, -1, colour, alpha)
    end
    function Hud.finish()
        local v = hudView
        if not v.gui then return end
        for k, e in pairs(v.pool) do
            if e.used ~= v.frame then
                e.holder.Visible = false
                if v.frame - (e.used or 0) > 120 then e.holder:Destroy(); v.pool[k] = nil end
            end
        end
        for i = v.fillIndex + 1, #v.fills do v.fills[i].Visible = false end
    end
    function Hud.clear()
        if hudView.gui then hudView.gui:Destroy() end
        hudView = {pool = {}, fills = {}}
    end
    -- Screen position (GUI pixels) of a world point, or nil behind the camera (fx.e.a(Vec3, GuiGraphics)).
    function Hud.project(pos)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local v = hudView
        local p, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
        if p.Z <= 0.05 then return nil end
        local s = v.scale.Scale
        return p.X / s, p.Y / s
    end
    local function fmt2(x) return string.format("%05.2f", x) end
    local function commas(n)
        local s = string.format("%.0f", n)
        local out = s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse()
        return out:gsub("^,", "")
    end

    -- Casts --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local Cast = {}
    Cast.__index = Cast
    local function rng(seed)
        local s = seed % 2147483647
        if s <= 0 then s = s + 2147483646 end
        return function() s = s * 16807 % 2147483647; return (s - 1) / 2147483646 end
    end
    local function hashNoise(seed, a, b)
        local v = math.sin(a * 12.9898 + b * 78.233 + seed * 0.001) * 43758.5453
        return v - math.floor(v)
    end
    local function stamp(text) return text end

    -- Big Dipper layout (star.c.a): gnomonic projection of the seven stars, rotated so Dubhe -> Alkaid runs along x,
    -- normalised by the width and centred on Megrez.
    local DIPPER = (function()
        local ra = {11.0621, 11.0307, 11.8972, 12.2571, 12.9005, 13.3988, 13.7923}
        local dec = {61.7508, 56.3825, 53.6947, 57.0325, 55.9598, 54.9254, 49.3133}
        local mra, mdec = 0, 0
        for i = 1, 7 do mra = mra + ra[i] / 7; mdec = mdec + dec[i] / 7 end
        local a0, d0 = math.rad(mra * 15), math.rad(mdec)
        local pts = {}
        for i = 1, 7 do
            local a, d = math.rad(ra[i] * 15), math.rad(dec[i])
            local c = math.sin(d0) * math.sin(d) + math.cos(d0) * math.cos(d) * math.cos(a - a0)
            local x = math.cos(d) * math.sin(a - a0) / c
            local y = (math.cos(d0) * math.sin(d) - math.sin(d0) * math.cos(d) * math.cos(a - a0)) / c
            pts[i] = {-x, -y}
        end
        local ang = -math.atan2(pts[7][2] - pts[1][2], pts[7][1] - pts[1][1])
        local co, si = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang)
        local lo, hi = 1e9, -1e9
        for _, p in ipairs(pts) do
            local x, y = p[1] * co - p[2] * si, p[1] * si + p[2] * co
            p[1], p[2] = x, y
            lo, hi = math.min(lo, x), math.max(hi, x)
        end
        local w, cx, cy = hi - lo, pts[4][1], pts[4][2]
        for _, p in ipairs(pts) do p[1], p[2] = (p[1] - cx) / w, (p[2] - cy) / w end
        return pts
    end)()
    local MAGS = {1.79, 2.37, 2.44, 3.31, 1.77, 2.23, 1.86}
    local LINKS = {{1, 2}, {2, 3}, {3, 4}, {4, 1}, {4, 5}, {5, 6}, {6, 7}}
    local STAR_NAMES = {"DUBHE", "MERAK", "PHECDA", "MEGREZ", "ALIOTH", "MIZAR", "ALKAID"}

    function Cast.new(skillIndex, target, power, seed, mine, owner)
        local c = setmetatable({}, Cast)
        c.skill, c.def, c.target, c.power, c.seed, c.mine, c.owner = skillIndex, SKILLS[skillIndex], target, power, seed, mine, owner
        c.rand = rng(seed)
        c.tick, c.started = -1, os.clock()
        c.speed = (mine and state.speed and state.speed[skillIndex]) or 1
        c.damage = (mine and state.damage and state.damage[skillIndex]) or math.huge
        c.folder = Instance.new("Folder")
        c.folder.Name = "Cast_" .. c.def.id
        c.folder.Parent = folder()
        c.filmOn = state.cutscenes == true -- matching enabled peers share the cinematic
        c.film = c.filmOn
        c.ground = groundAt(target.X, target.Z, target.Y)
        c.T = Vector3.new(target.X, c.ground, target.Z)
        c.j, c.I, c.O = power, power, power / 4
        c.k = math.clamp(power / 200, 0.3, 1)
        c.Q = 400 * c.O
        c.objects = {}
        local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
        local caster = owner or Players.LocalPlayer
        local char = caster.Character
        c.casterPos = (char and char:GetPivot().Position) or (ctx and ctx.root and ctx.root.Position) or target
        -- Facing from the caster to the target (the constellation turns to face its caster, star.c.a).
        local d = Vector3.new(target.X - c.casterPos.X, 0, target.Z - c.casterPos.Z)
        c.facing = d.Magnitude < B and 0 or (math.atan2(-d.Z, -d.X) + math.pi / 2)
        -- The caster's facing (client.fx.o.e(): from its yaw).
        local look
        if mine then local wl = ctx and ctx.world and ctx.world.look; look = wl and wl() or workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
        else local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); look = hrp and hrp.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
        local fl = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
        c.face = fl.Magnitude > 1e-3 and fl.Unit or (d.Magnitude > 1 and d.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1))
        return c
    end
    function Cast:at(blocksX, blocksZ) return Vector3.new(self.target.X + blocksX * B, self.ground, self.target.Z + blocksZ * B) end
    function Cast:destroy()
        if self.film then self:endFilm() end
        if self.folder then self.folder:Destroy() end
        for _, s in ipairs(self.sounds or {}) do pcall(function() s:Stop(); s:Destroy() end) end
    end
    function Cast:sound(name, pos, volume)
        local s = play(name, pos, volume)
        if s then self.sounds = self.sounds or {}; self.sounds[#self.sounds + 1] = s end
        return s
    end
    function Cast:stopSounds()
        for _, s in ipairs(self.sounds or {}) do pcall(function() s:Stop(); s:Destroy() end) end
        self.sounds = {}
    end
    function Cast:beginFilm()
        state.filmCast = self
    end
    function Cast:endFilm()
        if state.filmCast == self then
            state.filmCast = nil
            Films.hide()
            SteveMods.cinematic = false
        end
        self.filmOn = false
    end

    -- Ground canvas: SurfaceGuis on flat invisible parts at ground level (one, or four quadrants for wide circles), for the
    -- star_beam shader's ground markings. Items are images placed by world offset from the centre (studs).
    local Canvas = {}
    Canvas.__index = Canvas
    function Canvas.new(parent, centre, radius)
        local self = setmetatable({items = {}, parts = {}}, Canvas)
        self.centre = centre
        local quads = radius * 2 > 2000 and {{-1, -1}, {1, -1}, {-1, 1}, {1, 1}} or {{0, 0}}
        local size = #quads == 1 and radius * 2 or radius
        local spp = math.max(0.25, size / 1600)
        for _, q in ipairs(quads) do
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow, p.Transparency = true, false, false, false, false, 1
            p.Size = Vector3.new(size, 0.2, size)
            local off = Vector3.new(q[1] * size / 2, 0, q[2] * size / 2)
            p.CFrame = CFrame.new(centre + off + Vector3.new(0, 0.25, 0))
            local sg = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
            sg.Face, sg.SizingMode, sg.CanvasSize = Enum.NormalId.Top, Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize, Vector2.new(size / spp, size / spp)
            sg.LightInfluence, sg.Brightness, sg.ClipsDescendants, sg.ZOffset = 0, 2, true, 1
            sg.Adornee = p
            sg.Parent = p
            p.Parent = parent
            self.parts[#self.parts + 1] = {part = p, gui = sg, min = Vector2.new(off.X - size / 2, off.Z - size / 2), spp = spp}
        end
        return self
    end
    -- image(key, texture, x, z, sizeStuds, rotationDeg, colour, transparency)
    function Canvas:image(key, tex, x, z, size, rot, colour, transparency)
        local list = self.items[key]
        if not list then
            list = {}
            for i, q in ipairs(self.parts) do
                local im = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                im.BackgroundTransparency, im.AnchorPoint = 1, Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                im.Image = asset(tex) or ""
                im.Parent = q.gui
                list[i] = im
            end
            self.items[key] = list
        end
        for i, q in ipairs(self.parts) do
            local im = list[i]
            local visible = transparency < 0.995 and size > 0.05
            im.Visible = visible
            if visible then
                im.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((x - q.min.X) / q.spp, (z - q.min.Y) / q.spp)
                im.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size / q.spp, size / q.spp)
                im.Rotation, im.ImageColor3, im.ImageTransparency = rot, colour, transparency
            end
        end
    end
    function Canvas:frame(key, x, z, w, h, colour, transparency)
        local list = self.items[key]
        if not list then
            list = {}
            for i, q in ipairs(self.parts) do
                local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                f.BorderSizePixel, f.AnchorPoint = 0, Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                f.Parent = q.gui
                list[i] = f
            end
            self.items[key] = list
        end
        for i, q in ipairs(self.parts) do
            local f = list[i]
            f.Visible = transparency < 0.995
            f.Position, f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset((x - q.min.X) / q.spp, (z - q.min.Y) / q.spp), UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1, w / q.spp), math.max(1, h / q.spp))
            f.BackgroundColor3, f.BackgroundTransparency = colour, transparency
        end
    end
    local function blackbody(x)
        local c = Color3.new(0.3, 0.01, 0):Lerp(Color3.new(1, 0.25, 0.02), sm(x / 0.45))
        c = c:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 0.68, 0.22), sm((x - 0.4) / 0.45))
        return c:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 0.95, 0.85), sm((x - 0.85) / 0.4))
    end

    -- SS-01 The Shooting Star (star.i, client.fx.p, client.cinematic.h) --------------------------------------------------------------
    local RED, RED_HOT, EMBER = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 72), Color3.fromRGB(255, 224, 228), Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 74)
    local HUD_RED, HUD_DIM, HUD_CYAN = rgb(16724808), rgb(16766684), rgb(8381183)
    local function beamRadius(t, w)
        if t < 352 then return 0 elseif t < 462 then return w end
        local x = math.clamp((t - 462) / 24, 0, 1)
        return w * (1 - x) ^ 1.6
    end
    -- fx.p.a(double): the countdown's clock (accelerating pulses).
    local function countdownA(t)
        if t < 29 then return 0 end
        local v2 = 16.15
        local v4 = math.min(t - 29, 323) / 20
        local v6 = v4 / v2
        return 0.6 * v4 + 3.4 * v2 * v6 * v6 * v6 / 3
    end
    -- client.cinematic.h: the film's shots.
    local SS01_SHOTS = {
        {0, 8, 0, handShot},
        {8, 30, 0, function(c, e) return pose(offA(c, casterPos(c), 1.1, 2.1, -3.2), c.T + up(lerp(30, 4, e)), lerp(58, 30, e)) end},
        {30, 46, 0, function(c, e)
            local d = away(c)
            return pose(c.T + d * lerp(7.5, 6, e) * B + perp(d) * 2.8 * B + up(lerp(1, 1.4, e)), c.T + up(lerp(0.3, 24, e * e)), lerp(64, 70, e), lerp(0, 4, e))
        end},
        {46, 72, 3, function(c, e)

        end},
        {72, 342, 0, function(c, e) local base = c.T + up(480); return pose(base, base + away(c) * 10 * B + up(40), 70) end},
        {342, 352, 0, function(c, e)

        end},
        {374, 422, 6, function(c, e)
            local d, k = away(c), c.k
            local p = c.T + d * (c.j + 175 * k) * B + up(lerp(95, 175, e) * k)
            return pose(rotY(p, c.T, lerp(-18, 16, e)), c.T + up(lerp(130, 230, e) * k), lerp(76, 80, e))

            return pose(p + perp(d) * lerp(-24, 24, e) * k * B + up(4),
                c.T + d * (c.j - 30 * k) * B + perp(d) * lerp(30, -30, e) * k * B + up(lerp(30, 90, e) * k), 74, lerp(6, -6, e))
        end},
        {462, 494, 0, function(c, e)
            local d, k = away(c), c.k
