        end},
        {494, 530, 8, function(c, e)
            local d, k = away(c), c.k
            return pose(c.T + d * (c.j + lerp(60, 30, e) * k) * B + perp(d) * lerp(20, -10, e) * k * B + up(lerp(150, 60, e) * k),
                c.T + d * lerp(40, 0, e) * k * B + up(lerp(-40, -110, e) * k), lerp(78, 72, e))
        end},
        {530, 564, 10, function(c, e)
            local p, d = casterPos(c), away(c)
            return pose(p + d * lerp(3.2, 5, e) * B + perp(d) * lerp(1.4, 2.2, e) * B + up(lerp(1.9, 2.8, e)), c.T + up(-70), lerp(64, 72, e))
        end},
    }
    -- The nearest point of the strike zone to a position (sounds come from there): p.a(Vec3).
    local function zonePoint(c, pos)
        local d = Vector3.new(pos.X - c.T.X, 0, pos.Z - c.T.Z)
        local l = d.Magnitude
        if l < 0.001 then return c.T end
        return c.T + d * (math.min(l, c.j * B) / l) + Vector3.new(0, math.min(math.max(pos.Y - c.T.Y, 0), 80 * B), 0)
    end
    local function camPos() local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera; return cam and cam.CFrame.Position or Vector3.zero end
    -- Sounds: 2D while the film plays, otherwise from the zone (linear roll-off over 256 blocks).
    local function ssSound(c, name, pos, filmOnly)
        if c.filmOn then return c:sound(name, nil, 1) end
        if filmOnly then return nil end
        return c:sound(name, pos, 1)
    end
    local function ss01Build(c)
        local w = {}
        c.world = w
        local T = c.T
        local function anchor(pos)
            local a = Instance.new("Part")
            a.Anchored, a.CanCollide, a.CanQuery, a.CanTouch, a.Transparency, a.Size = true, false, false, false, 1, Vector3.one
            a.Position = pos
            a.Parent = c.folder
            local at = Instance.new("Attachment"); at.Parent = a
            return a, at
        end
        local _, a0 = anchor(T)
        local _, a1 = anchor(T + up(6000))
        local function beam(width, colour, tex, lightEmission)
            local b = Instance.new("Beam")
            b.Attachment0, b.Attachment1 = a0, a1
            b.Width0, b.Width1, b.FaceCamera, b.LightEmission, b.LightInfluence = width, width, true, lightEmission or 1, 0
            b.Color, b.Segments = ColorSequence.new(colour), 1
            if tex then b.Texture, b.TextureMode, b.TextureLength = asset(tex) or "", Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, 1 end
            b.Parent = c.folder
            return b
        end
        w.laserAir = beam(1, LASER, "images/glow.png")
        w.laser = beam(0.3, LASER)
        w.laserCore = beam(0.15, LASER_HOT)
        -- Ground markings round the target (reticle, spot) and the strike zone.
        w.near = Canvas.new(c.folder, T, 16 * B)
        w.zone = Canvas.new(c.folder, T, math.max(c.j + 490, c.j * 1.02) * B)
        -- The falling star.
        local starA = anchor(T)
        w.starAnchor = starA
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Size, bb.LightInfluence, bb.AlwaysOnTop, bb.MaxDistance, bb.Adornee = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), 0, false, 1e6, starA
        local im = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        im.Size, im.BackgroundTransparency, im.Image = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 1, asset("images/ss_star.png") or ""
        im.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0.55, 0.58)
        im.Parent = bb
        bb.Parent = starA
        w.star, w.starImage = bb, im
        -- The column (built at impact).
        w.particles = {}
        local pz = anchor(T + up(0.5))
        pz.Size = Vector3.new(math.min(2048, c.j * 2 * B), 0.2, math.min(2048, c.j * 2 * B))
        w.zoneDust = glowEmitter(pz, RED, 0, 0.9 * B, 1.2 * B, 1.6, {acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 1.2 * B, 0), spread = Vector2.new(15, 15)})
        w.zoneDust.Shape, w.zoneDust.ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Disc, Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume
        local ps = anchor(T + up(0.3))
        w.sparks = glowEmitter(ps, RED, 0, 0.5 * B, 2 * B, 1.0, {acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 2 * B, 0), spread = Vector2.new(35, 35)})
        w.sparkAnchor = ps
    end
    local function ss01Column(c)
        local w = c.world
        local R = c.j * B
        local function shell(r, colour, transparency)
            local parts = {}
            for i = 0, 3 do
                local p = Instance.new("Part")
                p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
                p.Shape, p.Material, p.Color, p.Transparency = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Enum.Material.Neon, colour, transparency
                p.Size = Vector3.new(2000, math.min(2048, r * 2), math.min(2048, r * 2))
                p.Parent = c.folder
                parts[#parts + 1] = p
            end
            return {parts = parts, r = r}
        end
        w.columns = {
            shell(R * 1.6, Color3.new(1, 0.02, 0.05), 0.965),
            shell(R * 1.005, Color3.new(1, 0.12, 0.14), 0.75),
            shell(R, Color3.new(0.78, 0.01, 0.04), 0.05),
            shell(R * 0.7, Color3.new(0.96, 0.02, 0.05), 0.15),
            shell(R * 0.3, Color3.new(0.98, 0.3, 0.3), 0.25),
            shell(math.max(R * 0.07, 0.4), Color3.new(1, 0.92, 0.92), 0),
        }
        -- Flowing streaks down the column.
        w.streaks = {}
        local n = 14
        for i = 1, n do
            local a = (i - 1) / n * math.pi * 2
            local top = Instance.new("Attachment")
            local bot = Instance.new("Attachment")
            local holder = Instance.new("Part")
            holder.Anchored, holder.CanCollide, holder.CanQuery, holder.CanTouch, holder.Transparency, holder.Size = true, false, false, false, 1, Vector3.one
            holder.Position = c.T
            holder.Parent = c.folder
            top.Parent, bot.Parent = holder, holder
            local b = Instance.new("Beam")
            b.Attachment0, b.Attachment1 = top, bot
            b.Width0, b.Width1 = 2 * math.pi * R / n * 1.2, 2 * math.pi * R / n * 1.2
            b.FaceCamera, b.LightEmission, b.LightInfluence = true, 1, 0
            b.Texture, b.TextureMode, b.TextureLength, b.TextureSpeed = asset("images/ss_streak.png") or "", Enum.TextureMode.Wrap, 160, 260 * B / 160
            b.Color, b.Transparency = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 0.35, 0.35)), NumberSequence.new(0.55)
            b.Parent = c.folder
            w.streaks[i] = {top = top, bot = bot, angle = a, beam = b}
        end
        -- Glowing walls of the shaft (heat) and the abyss below.
        w.walls = {}
        local nw = 48
        for i = 1, nw do
            local a = (i - 0.5) / nw * math.pi * 2
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow, p.Material = true, false, false, false, false, Enum.Material.Neon
            p.Size = Vector3.new(2 * math.pi * R / nw * 1.05, 8 * B, 0.3)
            p.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(c.T + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * (R - 0.3), -4 * B, math.sin(a) * (R - 0.3)), c.T + Vector3.new(0, -4 * B, 0))
            p.Transparency = 1
            p.Parent = c.folder
            w.walls[i] = p
        end
        local abyss = Instance.new("Part")
        abyss.Anchored, abyss.CanCollide, abyss.CanQuery, abyss.CanTouch, abyss.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
        abyss.Shape, abyss.Color, abyss.Material = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Color3.new(0.05, 0.005, 0.008), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        abyss.Size = Vector3.new(1200, math.min(2048, R * 2 - 0.6), math.min(2048, R * 2 - 0.6))
        abyss.CFrame = CFrame.new(c.T - Vector3.new(0, 1.2 * B + 600, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
        abyss.Transparency = 1
        abyss.Parent = c.folder
        w.abyss = abyss
        -- Rim spray and embers.
        w.rim = {}
        for i = 1, 16 do
            local a = i / 16 * math.pi * 2
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.Transparency, p.Size = true, false, false, false, 1, Vector3.new(2 * math.pi * R / 16, 0.5, 1)
            p.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(c.T + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * R, 0.5, math.sin(a) * R), c.T + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
            p.Parent = c.folder
            w.rim[i] = glowEmitter(p, i % 3 == 0 and RED_HOT or RED, 0, 1.4 * B, 14 * B, 2, {acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 4 * B, 0)})
        end
    end
    -- The world part of star_beam.fsh, every frame (t = film time with the partial tick).
    local function ss01Render(c, t)
        local w = c.world
        if not w then return end
        local laser = win(t, 9, 10.5, 352, 353)
        local inc = t < 352 and sm((t - 308) / 44) or 0
        local zone = win(t, 15, 39, 351, 353)
        local on = win(t, 352, 352.5, 485, 487)
        local since = t >= 352 and (t - 352) / 20 or -1
        local collapse = math.clamp((t - 462) / 24, 0, 1)
        local heat = t < 474 and 0 or sm((t - 486 + 12) / 12) * math.exp(-math.max(0, t - 486) / 420)
        local reticle = win(t, 9, 21, 332, 352)
        local pulse = countdownA(t) % 1
        local abyss = win(t, 470, 486, 1346, 1386)
        local R = beamRadius(t, c.j) * B
        local fullR = c.j * B
        local time = t / 20
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local camP = cam.CFrame.Position
        local pix = 2 * math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) / 2) / math.max(1, cam.ViewportSize.Y)
        -- Laser from orbit: width never under ~0.7 px.
        local axisDist = Vector3.new(camP.X - c.T.X, 0, camP.Z - c.T.Z).Magnitude
        local thick = (0.07 + 0.9 * inc * inc) * B
        local wpx = math.max(thick, axisDist * pix * 0.7)
        local flicker = 0.85 + 0.15 * math.sin(time * 43) * math.sin(time * 29 + 1.3)
        local lt = 1 - math.clamp(laser * flicker, 0, 1)
        w.laser.Width0, w.laser.Width1, w.laser.Transparency = wpx * 2, wpx * 2, NumberSequence.new(lt)
        w.laserCore.Width0, w.laserCore.Width1, w.laserCore.Transparency = wpx * 0.9, wpx * 0.9, NumberSequence.new(lt)
        w.laserAir.Width0, w.laserAir.Width1 = wpx * 14 + 0.8 * B, wpx * 14 + 0.8 * B
        w.laserAir.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1 - math.clamp(laser * (0.35 + 0.6 * inc) * flicker, 0, 1))
        -- Ground spot, halo and reticle.
        local near = w.near
        local spot = (0.35 + 1.5 * inc) * B
        near:image("spot", "images/glow.png", 0, 0, spot * 4, 0, Color3.new(1, 0.85, 0.85), 1 - math.clamp(laser * 1.2, 0, 1))
        near:image("halo", "images/glow.png", 0, 0, (1.8 + 6 * inc) * B * 6, 0, LASER, 1 - math.clamp(laser * 0.8, 0, 1))
        local br = lerp(11, 4.5, reticle) * B
        local rv = 1 - math.clamp(reticle * 2.5, 0, 1)
        near:image("brackets", "images/ss_brackets.png", 0, 0, br * 2 / 0.94, -math.deg(time * 0.8), LASER, rv)
        near:image("dashes", "images/ss_dashes.png", 0, 0, 2.6 * B * 2 / 0.94, -time * 15, LASER, 1 - math.clamp(reticle * 1.5, 0, 1))
        local lw = math.max(0.12 * B, axisDist * pix * 1.2)
        for i, d in ipairs({{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}}) do
            local mid = 2.5 * B
            near:frame("cross" .. i, d[1] * mid, d[2] * mid, d[1] ~= 0 and 2.6 * B or lw, d[2] ~= 0 and 2.6 * B or lw, LASER, 1 - math.clamp(reticle * 1.2, 0, 1))
        end
        -- Strike zone: edge ring, ticks, sweeping wedge and the closing pulse.
        local z = w.zone
        local zt = 1 - math.clamp(zone * 1.6, 0, 1)
        z:image("edge", "images/ss_ring.png", 0, 0, fullR * 2 / 0.985, 0, LASER, zt)
        z:image("ticks", "images/ss_ticks.png", 0, 0, fullR * 2 / 0.985, 0, LASER, 1 - math.clamp(zone * 1.2, 0, 1))
        z:image("wedge", "images/ss_wedge.png", 0, 0, fullR * 2, time * 0.35 * 360, LASER, 1 - math.clamp(zone * 0.35, 0, 1))
        z:image("closing", "images/ss_ring.png", 0, 0, math.max(0.1, fullR * (1 - pulse)) * 2 / 0.985, 0, LASER, 1 - math.clamp((1 - pulse) * 1.6 * zone, 0, 1))
        -- The falling star and the darkening sky.
        local drop = 20 + 8980 * math.max(1 - inc, 0) ^ 1.5
        local g = sm((inc - 0.2) / 0.8)
        w.starAnchor.Position = c.T + up(drop)
        w.star.Enabled = inc > 0.001
        if inc > 0.001 then
            local twinkle = 0.7 + 0.3 * math.sin(time * 53) * math.sin(time * 31 + 2)
            local px = cam.ViewportSize.Y * (0.03 + 0.3 * g * g) * twinkle / 0.165
            w.star.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(8, px), math.max(8, px))
            w.starImage.ImageTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(g * 1.6 + inc * 0.25, 0, 1)
        end
        c.dusk = inc * inc * inc * inc * 0.9
        -- The column: falls from the sky in 0.14 s, then fills the shaft.
        if on > 0.001 and R > 0.05 * B then
            if not w.columns then ss01Column(c) end
            local land = math.clamp(since / 0.14, 0, 1)
            local foot = lerp(c.T.Y + 3000 * B, c.T.Y - 300, land * land)
            local top = c.T.Y + 6000 * B
            local flick = 0.94 + 0.06 * math.sin(time * 60) * math.sin(time * 37)
            for li, layer in ipairs(w.columns) do
                local r = layer.r * (R / (c.j * B))
                for i, p in ipairs(layer.parts) do
                    local y0 = foot + (i - 1) * 2000
                    local y1 = math.min(top, y0 + 2000)
                    if y1 > y0 then
                        p.Size = Vector3.new(y1 - y0, math.min(2048, r * 2), math.min(2048, r * 2))
                        p.CFrame = CFrame.new(c.T.X, (y0 + y1) / 2, c.T.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2)
                        p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 - on * flick
                    else p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end
                end
            end
            for _, s in ipairs(w.streaks) do
                s.top.WorldPosition = Vector3.new(c.T.X + math.cos(s.angle) * R * 0.92, top, c.T.Z + math.sin(s.angle) * R * 0.92)
                s.bot.WorldPosition = Vector3.new(c.T.X + math.cos(s.angle) * R * 0.92, foot, c.T.Z + math.sin(s.angle) * R * 0.92)
                s.beam.Width0, s.beam.Width1 = 2 * math.pi * R / #w.streaks * 1.2, 2 * math.pi * R / #w.streaks * 1.2
                s.beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1 - 0.45 * on)
            end
            c.shade = on * land * (1 - collapse)
        elseif w.columns then
            for _, layer in ipairs(w.columns) do for _, p in ipairs(layer.parts) do p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end end
            for _, s in ipairs(w.streaks) do s.beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1) end
            c.shade = 0
        end
        -- Shock ring after impact.
        if since > 0 and since < 3 then
            local front = (c.j + since * 160) * B
            z:image("shock", "images/ss_ring.png", 0, 0, front * 2 / 0.985, 0, LASER_HOT:Lerp(LASER, since / 3), 1 - math.clamp((1 - since / 3) * 2.5, 0, 1))
        else
            z:image("shock", "images/ss_ring.png", 0, 0, 1, 0, LASER, 1)
        end
        -- Heat on the shaft walls and lip; the abyss below.
        if w.walls then
            local col = blackbody(0.1 + 0.45 * heat)
            for _, p in ipairs(w.walls) do p.Color, p.Transparency = col, 1 - math.clamp(heat * 0.6, 0, 1) end
            z:image("lip", "images/ss_ring.png", 0, 0, fullR * 2 / 0.985, 0, blackbody(0.35 + 0.4 * heat), 1 - math.clamp(heat * 0.9, 0, 1))
            w.abyss.Transparency = 1 - math.clamp(abyss, 0, 1)
        end
    end
    -- client.fx.p.a(Minecraft, ClientLevel, int): sounds, particles, the carve and damage, once a tick.
    local function ss01Tick(c, tick)
        local w = c.world
        if tick == 0 then ss01Build(c) end
        local camZone = zonePoint(c, camPos())
        if tick == 0 then ssSound(c, "star_rg_arm", casterPos(c)) end
        if tick == 7 then ssSound(c, "star_rg_press", casterPos(c)) end
        if tick == 9 then
            ssSound(c, "star_lock", c.filmOn and c.T or camZone)
            w.sparks:Emit(40)
        end
        if tick == 29 and not c.filmOn then c:sound("star_countdown", camZone, 1) end
        if c.filmOn then
            if tick == 44 then c:sound("star_ascent", nil, 1) end
            if tick == 238 then c:sound("star_gun", nil, 1) end
            if tick == 314 then c:sound("star_fire", nil, 1) end
        end
        if tick >= 9 and tick < 352 then
            w.sparks:Emit(3)
            if tick > 312 then
                local f = (tick - 352 + 40) / 40
                w.zoneDust:Emit(math.floor(30 * f * f))
                if tick % 4 == 0 then shakeAt(camZone, 0.05 + 0.15 * f * f, 400) end
            end
        end
        if tick == 352 then
            c:stopSounds()
            ssSound(c, "star_impact", camZone)
            ssSound(c, "star_beam", camZone)
            shakeAt(camZone, 1, 700)
            task.spawn(function() carve(c.T, c.j * B + 2, nil, nil) end)
        end
        if tick >= 352 and tick < 486 then
            local R = beamRadius(tick, c.j)
            if w.rim then for _, e in ipairs(w.rim) do e:Emit(tick == 352 and 30 or 3) end end
            if tick % 5 == 0 then shakeAt(camZone, 0.18, 500) end
            if (tick - 352) % 2 == 0 then
                eraseArea(function(p) return Vector3.new(p.X - c.T.X, 0, p.Z - c.T.Z).Magnitude <= R * B end, "shooting_star_demo.shooting_star")
            end
        end
        if tick == 462 then c:sound("star_rg_collapse", c.filmOn and nil or camZone, 1) end
        if tick == 490 then c:sound("star_rg_after", c.filmOn and nil or camZone, 1) end
        if tick >= 486 and tick < 1286 and w.rim then
            local f = 1 - (tick - 486) / 800
            for i, e in ipairs(w.rim) do
                e.Color = ColorSequence.new(i % 5 < 2 and EMBER or Color3.fromRGB(154, 146, 148))
                e.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5 * B, 2 * B)
                e.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -3 * B, 0)
                if math.random() < f * 1.5 then e:Emit(1) end
            end
        end
    end
    -- client.fx.p.a(d, render.f): the grade over the world (when no space film covers it).
    local function ss01Grade(c, t, filmCovered)
        if filmCovered then return end
        local cam = camPos()
        local dist = (cam - zonePoint(c, cam)).Magnitude / B
        local near = math.clamp(1 - dist / 900, 0.15, 1)
        if t > 308 and t < 352 then
            local k = sm((t - 352 + 44) / 44)
            Grade.vignette(rgb(3801094), k * 0.4 * near)
            G.a = math.max(G.a, k * k * 0.35 * near)
            G.b = math.max(G.b, k * k * 0.3 * near)
        end
        local s = (t - 352) / 20
        if s >= 0 and t < 506 then
            -- Impact frames: red / white manga frames every 0.05 s (modes 7 7 8 7 8 8).
            local idx = math.floor(s / 0.05)
            local modes = {7, 7, 8, 7, 8, 8}
            if modes[idx + 1] then Grade.impact(near, modes[idx + 1]) end
            G.a = math.max(G.a, win(s, 0, 0.05, 3.5, 6) * 0.9 * near)
            G.b = math.max(G.b, win(s, 0, 0.05, 0.6, 3) * near)
            G.d = math.max(G.d, win(s, 0, 0.03, 0.35, 1.4) * 0.55 * near)
            local k = win(t, 352, 358, 482, 490)
            G.m = math.max(G.m, 1.4 * k)
            G.n = math.max(G.n, 1 + 1.2 * k)
            Grade.vignette(rgb(4849672), k * 0.35 * near)
            G.a = math.max(G.a, k * 0.22 * near)
            G.b = math.max(G.b, k * 0.12 * near)
            local k2 = win(t, 483, 486, 488, 502)
            Grade.flash(rgb(16736368), k2 * 1.2 * near)
            G.a = math.max(G.a, k2 * 0.5 * near)
        end
    end
    -- fx.p.b(render.f, t, weight): the grade while the space film plays.
    local function ss01FilmGrade(t, weight)
        local function cS(x) return math.clamp((x - 58) / 14, 0, 1) end
        local d = (t < 58 or t >= 342 or (t >= 238 and t < 318)) and 0 or (t >= 318 and 1 or cS(t))
        local gun = t >= 238 and t < 318
        local ink = (t >= 331 and t < 342) and sm((t - 331) / 2) or 0
        local cover = d * weight
        if cover > 0.001 or gun then G.m = math.max(G.m, 0.5 * (1 - ink * 0.85)) end
        for _, t0 in ipairs({126, 170, 204, 214}) do
            local k = win(t, t0 - 1, t0, t0 + 1, t0 + 5)
            G.b = math.max(G.b, k * 0.9)
            Grade.flash(rgb(10479871), k * 0.18)
        end
        if gun and t < 314 then
            local k = math.clamp((t - 291) / 19, 0, 1)
            local l = sm((t - 310) / 2.5)
            G.b = math.max(G.b, k * k * 0.35 + l * 0.5)
            G.a = math.max(G.a, k * k * 0.12 * (1 - l))
            Grade.vignette(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), l * 0.6)
        end
        if t >= 314 and t < 320 then
            local s = t - 314
            Grade.flash(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), s < 1 and 3.2 or 3.2 * math.exp(-(s - 1) * 1.6))
            G.a = math.max(G.a, math.exp(-s * 0.5))
            G.b = math.max(G.b, math.exp(-s * 0.4) * 1.2)
            G.d = math.max(G.d, math.exp(-s * 0.6) * 0.7)
        end
        if t >= 318 and t < 342 then
            G.d = math.max(G.d, 0.5 * (1 - ink)); G.a = math.max(G.a, 0.06); G.b = math.max(G.b, 0.3 * (1 - ink))
        end
        for _, t0 in ipairs({331, 342}) do
            local k = win(t, t0 - 0.5, t0, t0 + 1, t0 + 3)
            G.a = math.max(G.a, k * 0.7); G.b = math.max(G.b, k * 1.1)
        end
        if t >= 341.5 and t < 352 then Grade.vignette(rgb(2752516), 0.2 + 0.35 * sm((t - 342) / 10)) end
        return d > 0.001 or gun
    end
    -- client.fx.q.a: the film's HUD.
    local function ss01FilmHud(c, t, weight, W, H)
        local a = math.clamp(weight * 1.6 - 0.3, 0, 1)
        if a <= 0.01 then return end
        local blink = math.floor(t * 3) % 11 == 0
        Hud.corner(12, 12, 22, 1, 1, HUD_RED, a)
        Hud.corner(W - 12, 12, 22, -1, 1, HUD_RED, a)
        Hud.corner(12, H - 12, 22, 1, -1, HUD_RED, a)
        Hud.corner(W - 12, H - 12, 22, -1, -1, HUD_RED, a)
        Hud.text("UPLINK // SS-01 > THE SHOOTING STAR", 18, 18, blink and HUD_DIM or HUD_RED, blink and a * 0.55 or a)
        Hud.text("T+" .. fmt2(t / 20), 18, 29, HUD_DIM, a * 0.55)
        Hud.text(t < 352 and ("IMPACT T-" .. fmt2(math.max(0, (352 - t) / 20))) or "IMPACT CONFIRMED", W - 18, 18, HUD_RED, a, 1, 1)
        local lock = c.T / B
        Hud.text(string.format("LOCK %d / %d / %d", math.floor(lock.X), math.floor(lock.Y), math.floor(lock.Z)), W - 18, H - 26, HUD_DIM, a * 0.55, 1, 1)
        if t < 62 then
            if t >= 9 then
                local x, y = Hud.project(c.T + up(0.5))
                if x then
                    local r = lerp(60, 9, math.clamp((t - 9) / 8, 0, 1))
                    Hud.box(x, y, r, HUD_RED, a)
                    Hud.text("TARGET ACQUIRED", x + r + 4, y - 9, HUD_RED, a)
                    Hud.text("STRIKE RADIUS " .. math.floor(c.j + 0.5) .. " \u{b7} FULL DEPTH", x + r + 4, y + 1, HUD_DIM, a * 0.55)
                end
            end
            return
        end
        local ink = (t >= 331 and t < 342) and sm((t - 331) / 2) or 0
        if (t < 238 or (t >= 318 and t < 342)) and ink <= 0.3 then
            local hud = Films.hudAt("ss01", t)
            if hud then
                for _, l in ipairs(hud[2]) do
                    local x, y = W / 2 + l[3] * H / 2, H / 2 - l[4] * H / 2
                    local r = math.clamp(l[5] * H / 2 + 6, 7, 160)
                    local hot = l[1] == "TARGET" or (l[1] == "SOL" and t > 170)
                    Hud.box(x, y, r, hot and HUD_RED or HUD_CYAN, a)
                    Hud.text(l[1], x + r + 4, y - 9, hot and HUD_RED or HUD_CYAN, a)
                    Hud.text(l[2], x + r + 4, y + 1, HUD_DIM, a * 0.55)
                end
                local range = hud[3]
                local lg = math.log10(math.max(range, 1))
                local ex = math.floor(lg)
                Hud.text("SCALE 10^" .. ex .. " KM", 18, H - 40, HUD_RED, a, 1.5)
                Hud.text(range > 9.4607e12 and ("RANGE " .. commas(range / 9.4607e12) .. " LY") or ("RANGE " .. commas(range) .. " KM"), 18, H - 24, HUD_DIM, a * 0.55)
                Hud.fill(18, H - 46, 138, H - 45, HUD_DIM, a * 0.55)
                Hud.fill(18, H - 48, 18 + math.floor(120 * (lg - ex)), H - 45, HUD_RED, a)
            end
            if t >= 314 then Hud.text("[ RIDING THE BEAM ]", W / 2, 30, HUD_RED, a, 1.5, 0.5) end
        end
        if t >= 238 and t < 318 then
            local k = win(t, 250, 253, 276, 284)
            if k > 0.01 then
                local jx = t < 256 and math.floor(math.sin(t * 91) * 6) or 0
                Hud.text("THE SHOOTING STAR", W / 2 + jx, H / 2 - 70, HUD_RED, a * k, 4, 0.5)
                Hud.text("SS-01 GALACTIC RAILGUN \u{b7} BEYOND THE RIM \u{b7} 58,000 LY FROM HOME", W / 2, H / 2 - 28, HUD_DIM, a * k, 1.25, 0.5)
            end
            if t >= 290 and t < 314 then
                local charge = math.clamp((t - 291) / 19, 0, 1)
                local bw = math.min(240, math.floor(W / 3))
                local x0, y0 = math.floor(W / 2 - bw / 2), H - 50
                Hud.fill(x0, y0, x0 + bw, y0 + 1, HUD_DIM, a * 0.55)
                Hud.fill(x0, y0 + 1, x0 + math.floor(bw * charge), y0 + 3, HUD_RED, a)
                Hud.text("CHARGE", x0, y0 - 11, HUD_DIM, a * 0.55)
                Hud.text(string.format("%3d%%", math.floor(charge * 100 + 0.5)), x0 + bw, y0 - 11, HUD_RED, a, 1, 1)
                local on = math.floor(t / 3) % 2 == 0
                Hud.text("TARGET SOL-3 \u{b7} LOCKED", W / 2, H - 72, on and HUD_RED or HUD_DIM, on and a or a * 0.55, 1, 0.5)
            end
        end
        if t >= 342 and t < 352 then
            local x, y = Hud.project(c.T + up(0.5))
            if x then Hud.box(x, y, 9, HUD_RED, a) end
            local on = math.floor(t / 2) % 2 == 0
            Hud.text("[ INBOUND ]", W / 2, 30, on and HUD_RED or HUD_DIM, on and a or a * 0.55, 1.5, 0.5)
        end
        if t >= 356 and t < 412 then Hud.text("[ IMPACT CONFIRMED ]", W / 2, H / 2 + 50, HUD_RED, a * math.clamp((412 - t) / 12, 0, 1), 2, 0.5) end
        if t >= 494 then Hud.text("SHAFT \u{d8}400 \u{b7} WORLD TOP TO VOID", W / 2, H - 42, HUD_DIM, a * math.clamp((t - 494) / 10, 0, 1), 1.25, 0.5) end
    end
    -- client.fx.p.a(GuiGraphics): the plain HUD near a strike (no film).
    local function ss01PlainHud(c, t, W, H)
        if t < 9 or t >= 352 then return end
        local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
        local root = ctx and ctx.root
        if not root then return end
        local d = Vector3.new(root.Position.X - c.T.X, 0, root.Position.Z - c.T.Z).Magnitude / B
        if d > c.j + 120 then return end
        local a = 0.55 + 0.45 * (1 - countdownA(t) % 1)
        Hud.text(d < c.j and "[ INSIDE THE STRIKE ZONE ]" or "[ ORBITAL STRIKE INBOUND ]", W / 2, 26, HUD_RED, a, 1.5, 0.5)
        Hud.text("T-" .. fmt2(math.max(0, (352 - t) / 20)), W / 2, 44, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 1, 1.25, 0.5)
    end

    -- client.cinematic.f: SS-04 Seven Stars' shots (I = power; stars land at 290 + 16 i).
    local function sevenStarsFilm(starPos, starRadius, centroid)
        local function within(c, v)
            -- f.b(): no further than the render distance from the caster, never under the ground.
            local p = casterPos(c)
            local d = Vector3.new(v.X - p.X, 0, v.Z - p.Z)
            local maxd = math.max(96, ((JavaGui.options and JavaGui.options.renderDistance) or 12) * 16 - 26) * B
            if d.Magnitude > maxd then v = Vector3.new(p.X + d.X / d.Magnitude * maxd, v.Y, p.Z + d.Z / d.Magnitude * maxd) end
            return aboveGround(v, 2.5)
        end
        local function framed(pos, look, fov, roll) return pose(clearUp(pos, look, 160 * B), look, fov, roll) end
        local film = {
            {0, 8, 0, handShot},
            {8, 24, 0, function(c, e) return pose(offA(c, casterPos(c), 4, lerp(28, 44, e), -lerp(20, 28, e)), c.T + up(-12), lerp(74, 80, e)) end},
            {24, 52, 4, function(c, e)
                return pose(offA(c, casterPos(c), 1.2, 1.9, -1.6), centroid(c) + up(900 * c.I * lerp(0.6, 1, e)), lerp(84, 76, e), lerp(-4, 6, e))
            end},
            {52, 70, 3, function(c, e) local p = within(c, centroid(c) + up(20 + 420 * e * e)); return pose(p, p + Vector3.new(0, 100 * B, 12 * B), 76) end},
            {70, 272, 0, function(c, e) local p = within(c, centroid(c) + up(460)); return pose(p, p + Vector3.new(0, 40 * B, 10 * B), 70) end},
        }
        for i = 1, 7 do
            local land = 290 + (i - 1) * 16
            local from = i == 1 and 272 or (290 + (i - 2) * 16 + 6)
            film[#film + 1] = {from, land, 0, function(c, e)
                local X = starPos(c, i)
                local d = away(c, X)
                local r = starRadius(c, i)
                local p = within(c, X + d * (r + 48) * B + perp(d) * 40 * B + up(3))
                local h = 900 * c.I * math.max(1 - e, 0) ^ 0.75
                return framed(p, X + up(math.max(h * 0.85, 14 * c.I)), lerp(72, 66, e), lerp(2, -2, e))
            end}
            film[#film + 1] = {land, i < 7 and land + 6 or land + 10, 0, function(c, e)
                local X = starPos(c, i)
                local d = away(c, X)
                local r = starRadius(c, i)
                local p = within(c, X + d * (r * 1.25 + 30) * B + perp(d) * -60 * B + up(30 + r * 0.35))
                return framed(p, X + up(6 * c.I), lerp(76, 80, e), lerp(-3, 0, e))
            end}
        end
        film[#film + 1] = {396, 440, 4, function(c, e)
            local C = centroid(c)
            local d = away(c, C)
            local v = C + d * lerp(260, 220, e) * B + up(lerp(150, 180, e))
            return framed(within(c, rotY(v, C, lerp(-14, 14, e))), C + up(-10 * c.I), 78)
        end}
        film[#film + 1] = {440, 476, 0, function(c, e)
            local C = centroid(c)
            local d = away(c, C)
            return framed(within(c, C + d * lerp(300, 260, e) * B + perp(d) * 80 * B + up(lerp(110, 140, e))), C + up(lerp(150, 260, e) * c.I), 88, lerp(-3, 3, e))
        end}
        film[#film + 1] = {476, 526, 8, function(c, e)
            local X = starPos(c, 5)
            local d = away(c, X)
            local r = starRadius(c, 5)
            return framed(within(c, X + d * r * lerp(0.8, 0.6, e) * B + perp(d) * lerp(30, 50, e) * B + up(lerp(24, 48, e))), X + up(lerp(10, 220, e * e) * c.I), lerp(70, 80, e))
        end}
        film[#film + 1] = {526, 556, 10, function(c, e)
            local p = casterPos(c)
            local v = -away(c, centroid(c))
            return pose(p + v * -lerp(3.2, 5, e) * B + perp(v) * lerp(1.4, 2.2, e) * B + up(lerp(1.9, 2.8, e)), centroid(c) + up(60 * c.I), lerp(64, 72, e))
        end}
        return film
    end

    -- SS-03 Gungnir --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function gungnirShape(c)
        if c.shape then return c.shape end
        local O = c.power / 4
        local P = math.min(1, math.sqrt(O))
        local s = {O = O, P = P, Q = 400 * O, R = 88 * O, T = 20 * O, V = 36 * O, U = 7 * math.max(O, 0.5), W = 6.5 * P, X = 20 * P}
        s.S = math.min(200, 160 * O) -- the pit (to the world's bottom in the mod; bounded here)
        local r = rng(c.seed)
        s.L = {r() * 6.283, r() * 6.283, r() * 6.283}
        c.shape = s
        return s
    end
    -- CraterHeight (star.e.a): ground level minus the bowl, the pit and the raised rim; ejecta rays scar the floor.
    local function gungnirDepth(s, d, angle)
        local edge = s.Q + s.O * (6 * math.sin(3 * angle + s.L[1]) + 4 * math.sin(7 * angle + s.L[2]) + 2.4 * math.sin(13 * angle + s.L[3]))
        if d > edge then return nil end
        local h = 0
        local inner = math.max(edge - s.V, s.R + 1)
        local f = math.min(d / inner, 1)
        h = h - s.T * (1 - f ^ 1.6)
        if d < s.R then local x = d / s.R; h = h - s.S * (1 - x * x) * (1 - x * x * 0.35) end
        local over = d - (edge - s.V)
        if over > 0 then h = h + over * over / s.V * 1.1 end
        return h
    end
    local function gungnirMaterial(s, d, noise)
        local n = (d + (noise - 0.5) * 24 * s.O) * (200 / s.Q)
        if n < 10 then return noise < 0.5 and "magma_block" or (noise < 0.8 and "obsidian" or "blackstone")
        elseif n < s.R * 200 / s.Q then return noise < 0.34 and "blackstone" or noise < 0.58 and "basalt" or noise < 0.7 and "magma_block" or noise < 0.8 and "obsidian" or "cobbled_deepslate"
        elseif n < 100 then return noise < 0.3 and "coarse_dirt" or noise < 0.45 and "blackstone" or noise < 0.65 and "gravel" or noise < 0.73 and "basalt" or noise < 0.86 and "tuff" or "cobbled_deepslate"
        elseif n < 170 then return noise < 0.35 and "coarse_dirt" or noise < 0.5 and "gravel" or "dirt" end
        return "coarse_dirt"
    end
    local function buildGungnirCrater(c)
        local s = gungnirShape(c)
        local tgt = Vector3.new(c.target.X, c.ground, c.target.Z)
        local crater = Instance.new("Model"); crater.Name = "GungnirCrater"; crater.Parent = c.folder
        c.crater = crater
        task.spawn(function()
            local reach = math.ceil(s.Q + 13 * s.O + 1)
            local groundId = VX.ground(mapRay(Vector3.new(tgt.X + (reach + 6) * B, c.ground + 200, tgt.Z), Vector3.new(0, -600, 0)), "grass_block")
            carve(tgt, (s.Q + 12) * B, c.ground - (s.S + s.T + 10) * B, nil)
            if not SS.enabled then return end
            -- CraterHeight on the block grid: every column's top block from the material bands.
            local ci, _, ck = VX.index(tgt)
            local gj = VX.layer(c.ground)
            VX.terrain(crater, {i0 = ci - reach, i1 = ci + reach, k0 = ck - reach, k1 = ck + reach, budget = 7000,
                lod = function(x, z)
                    local d = math.sqrt((x - ci) ^ 2 + (z - ck) ^ 2)
                    return d < s.R + 24 and 1 or (d < s.Q * 0.6 and 2 or 4)
                end,
                column = function(x, z)
                    local dx, dz = x - ci, z - ck
                    local d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
                    if d > reach then return nil end
                    local h = gungnirDepth(s, d, math.atan2(dz, dx))
                    if not h then return gj, groundId end
                    return gj + math.floor(h + 0.5), gungnirMaterial(s, d, hashNoise(c.seed, math.floor(x / 2), math.floor(z / 2)))
                end})
            if not SS.enabled then return end
            -- The pit's floor glows.
            local pitFloor = c.ground - (s.S + s.T) * B
            local lava = neon(crater, Vector3.new(1, s.R * 0.6 * B, s.R * 0.6 * B), CFrame.new(tgt.X, pitFloor, tgt.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi / 2), Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 30), 0.1, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
            local l = Instance.new("PointLight"); l.Color, l.Range, l.Brightness = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 40), 60, 6; l.Parent = lava
        end)
    end
    -- The spire (star.e.m): an octagonal hull of gungnir_hull from the pit to the sky, gungnir_seam bands every 24 blocks.
    local function buildGungnirSpire(c)
        local s = gungnirShape(c)
        local tgt = Vector3.new(c.target.X, c.ground, c.target.Z)
        local bottom = c.ground - (s.S + s.T) * B
        local top = c.ground + 300 * B
        local h = top - bottom
        local spire = Instance.new("Model"); spire.Name = "GungnirSpire"; spire.Parent = c.folder
        c.spire = spire
        local _ = h
        -- An octagon of gungnir_hull (Block of Tungsten) from the pit to the sky, a band of gungnir_seam (Thermal Conduit)
        -- every 24 blocks from the ground up, the flared tip: one box per row of the octagon per band.
        local ci, _, ck = VX.index(tgt)
        local j0, j1, gj = VX.layer(bottom), VX.layer(top), VX.layer(c.ground)
        local function octagon(half, jFrom, jTo, id)
            local r = math.floor(half)
            for dz = -r, r do
                local w = math.floor(math.min(half, half * 1.4142 - math.abs(dz)))
                if w >= 0 then VX.box(spire, id, ci - w, jFrom, ck + dz, ci + w, jTo, ck + dz) end
            end
        end
        local light = Instance.new("PointLight"); light.Color, light.Range, light.Brightness = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 40), 60, 3
        light.Parent = anchorAt(spire, tgt + Vector3.new(0, 4 * B, 0))
        task.spawn(function()
            local half = s.W * 0.83
            local seam = gj
            while seam - 24 >= j0 do seam = seam - 24 end
            local j = j0
            while j <= j1 - 31 do
                if not SS.enabled or not spire.Parent then return end
                local upTo = math.min(j1 - 31, seam - 1)
                if upTo >= j then octagon(half, j, upTo, "gungnir_hull") end
                if seam <= j1 - 31 then octagon(half, seam, seam, "gungnir_seam") end
                j, seam = seam + 1, seam + 24
                task.wait()
            end
            for i = 6, 1, -1 do
                local f = i / 6
                local jt = j1 - math.floor(f * 30)
                octagon((s.W + (s.X - s.W) * (1 - f) ^ 0.7) * 0.5, jt - 4, jt, "gungnir_hull")
            end
        end)
    end
    local GUNG = (function()
    -- SS-03 Gungnir: client.fx.f (ticks, grade), fx.g (film HUD), fx/gungnir_world.fsh (the world) ---------------------------------
    local ORANGE, ORANGE_HOT = Color3.fromRGB(255, 88, 31), Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 96)
    local G_EMBER, G_EMBER_HOT, G_WHITE = Color3.new(1, 0.3, 0.06), Color3.new(1, 0.62, 0.3), Color3.new(1, 0.95, 0.88)
    local G_RED, G_DIM, G_CYAN = rgb(16734751), rgb(16769740), rgb(8381183)
    -- fx.f.c(double): the countdown clock.
    local function gCountdown(t)
        if t < 29 then return 0 end
        local v2 = 13.05
        local v4 = math.min(t - 29, 261) / 20
        local v6 = v4 / v2
        return 0.6 * v4 + 3.4 * v2 * v6 * v6 * v6 / 3
    end
    -- star.e.b: the shockwave's radius (blocks).
    local function gFront(c, t) return t <= 322 and 0 or c.Q * ((t - 322) / 36) ^ 0.6 end
    -- star.e.c: when the shockwave reaches a distance (blocks); past 1.3 Q it slows (fx.f.b(double)).
    local function gArrive(c, d)
        local function at(x) return 322 + 36 * (math.max(x, 0) / c.Q) ^ (5 / 3) end
        local lim = c.Q * 1.3
        return d <= lim and at(d) or at(lim) + (d - lim) / 17
    end
    local function gZonePoint(c, pos)
        local d = Vector3.new(pos.X - c.T.X, 0, pos.Z - c.T.Z)
        local l = d.Magnitude
        if l < 0.001 then return c.T end
        return c.T + d * (math.min(l, c.Q * B) / l) + Vector3.new(0, math.min(math.max(pos.Y - c.T.Y, 0), 80 * B), 0)
    end
    local function gungnirBuild(c)
        local w = {}
        c.world = w
        local T = c.T
        local function anchor(pos)
            local a = Instance.new("Part")
            a.Anchored, a.CanCollide, a.CanQuery, a.CanTouch, a.Transparency, a.Size = true, false, false, false, 1, Vector3.one
            a.Position = pos
            a.Parent = c.folder
            local at = Instance.new("Attachment"); at.Parent = a
            return a, at
        end
        w.near = Canvas.new(c.folder, T, 18 * B)
        w.zone = Canvas.new(c.folder, T, (c.Q * 2.6 + 10) * B)
        -- The dashed ember laser up the axis (beam with a dash texture that climbs).
        local _, a0 = anchor(T)
        local _, a1 = anchor(T + up(5000))
        local b = Instance.new("Beam")
        b.Attachment0, b.Attachment1, b.FaceCamera, b.LightEmission, b.LightInfluence = a0, a1, true, 1, 0
        b.Texture, b.TextureMode, b.TextureLength, b.TextureSpeed = asset("images/ss_dashes.png") or "", Enum.TextureMode.Static, 14 * B, 1.2
        b.Color = ColorSequence.new(G_EMBER)
        b.Parent = c.folder
        w.laser = b
        -- The falling needle: a white-hot streak above its head, shock rings, a flare.
        local headA, headAt = anchor(T)
        local _, tailAt = anchor(T)
        w.head, w.headAt, w.tailAt = headA, headAt, tailAt
        local streak = Instance.new("Beam")
        streak.Attachment0, streak.Attachment1, streak.FaceCamera, streak.LightEmission, streak.LightInfluence = headAt, tailAt, true, 1, 0
        streak.Color = ColorSequence.new(G_WHITE, Color3.new(1, 0.45, 0.5))
        streak.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
        streak.Parent = c.folder
        w.streak = streak
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Size, bb.LightInfluence, bb.AlwaysOnTop, bb.MaxDistance, bb.Adornee = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), 0, false, 1e6, headA
        local im = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        im.Size, im.BackgroundTransparency, im.Image, im.ImageColor3 = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 1, asset("images/ss_star.png") or "", G_EMBER_HOT
        im.Parent = bb
        bb.Parent = headA
        w.flare, w.flareImage = bb, im
        w.rings = {}
        for i = 0, 3 do w.rings[i] = Canvas.new(c.folder, T, 400 * B) end
        -- Impact: the white dome of light.
        local dome = Instance.new("Part")
        dome.Anchored, dome.CanCollide, dome.CanQuery, dome.CanTouch, dome.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
        dome.Shape, dome.Material, dome.Color, dome.Transparency = Enum.PartType.Ball, Enum.Material.Neon, G_WHITE, 1
        dome.Position = T + up(4)
        dome.Parent = c.folder
        w.dome = dome
        -- Rising holographic rings (shells) and the scan ring.
        w.shells = {}
        for i = 0, 6 do w.shells[i] = Canvas.new(c.folder, T, (c.Q * 0.8 + 60) * B) end
        -- Plasma column from the spire's crown.
        local _, c0 = anchor(T + up(300))
        local _, c1 = anchor(T + up(300 + 4200))
        local col = Instance.new("Beam")
        col.Attachment0, col.Attachment1, col.FaceCamera, col.LightEmission, col.LightInfluence = c0, c1, true, 1, 0
        col.Texture, col.TextureMode = asset("images/glow.png") or "", Enum.TextureMode.Stretch
        col.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 0.55, 0.6), Color3.new(0.6, 0.35, 0.9))
        col.Parent = c.folder
        w.column = col
        -- Dust wall riding the shockwave.
        w.dust = {}
        for i = 1, 24 do
            local a = (i - 0.5) / 24 * math.pi * 2
            local p = anchor(T)
            local e = glowEmitter(p, Color3.fromRGB(140, 128, 116), 0, 8 * B, 2 * B, 3.5, {acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 1.5 * B, 0), spread = Vector2.new(50, 50), shrink = 1.6})
            e.LightEmission, e.LightInfluence = 0.15, 1
            e.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
            w.dust[i] = {part = p, emitter = e, angle = a}
        end
        local ps = anchor(T + up(0.3))
        w.sparks = glowEmitter(ps, ORANGE, 0, 0.5 * B, 2 * B, 1.0, {acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 2 * B, 0), spread = Vector2.new(35, 35)})
        local pz = anchor(T + up(0.5))
        pz.Size = Vector3.new(math.min(2048, c.Q * 2 * B), 0.2, math.min(2048, c.Q * 2 * B))
        w.zoneDust = glowEmitter(pz, Color3.fromRGB(184, 167, 160), 0, 1.1 * B, 1.2 * B, 1.6, {acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 1 * B, 0), spread = Vector2.new(15, 15)})
        w.zoneDust.Shape, w.zoneDust.ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Disc, Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume
        local pb = anchor(T + up(3))
        w.burst = glowEmitter(pb, G_WHITE, 0, 2.5 * B, 30 * B, 2.5, {acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -2 * B, 0)})
    end
    function Canvas:moveY(y)
        for _, q in ipairs(self.parts) do local p = q.part.Position; q.part.Position = Vector3.new(p.X, y, p.Z) end
    end
    local function gungnirRender(c, t)
        local w = c.world
        if not w then return end
        local s = gungnirShape(c)
        local time = t / 20
        local mark = win(t, 9, 10.5, 300, 318)
        local fall = (t >= 300 and t < 322) and (t - 300) / 22 or 0
        local since = t >= 322 and (t - 322) / 20 or -1
        local front = gFront(c, t)
        local reticle = win(t, 9, 21, 292, 300)
        local pulse = gCountdown(t) % 1
        local shellsK = t < 322 and 0 or win(t, 322, 322.5, 392, 432)
        local auraK = t < 325 and 0 or win(t, 325, 352, 1142, 1222)
        local plume = t < 322 and 0 or sm((t - 322) / 4) * math.exp(-(t - 322) / 160)
        local dustK = win(t, 323, 328, 522, 642)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local camP = cam.CFrame.Position
        local pix = 2 * math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) / 2) / math.max(1, cam.ViewportSize.Y)
        local axisDist = Vector3.new(camP.X - c.T.X, 0, camP.Z - c.T.Z).Magnitude
        -- Mark: the hex reticle, ring, cross, dot; the zone with its sweep, ticks and closing pulse; the dashed laser.
        local n = w.near
        local hr = lerp(14, 6, reticle) * B
        n:image("hex", "images/gg_hex.png", 0, 0, hr * 2 / 0.95, math.deg(time * 0.6), G_EMBER, 1 - math.clamp(reticle * 2.6, 0, 1))
        n:image("hex2", "images/gg_hex.png", 0, 0, hr * 0.9 / 0.95, -math.deg(time * 1.02), G_EMBER, 1 - math.clamp(reticle * 1.4, 0, 1))
        n:image("ring", "images/ss_dashes.png", 0, 0, 2.2 * B * 2 / 0.94, time * 30, G_EMBER, 1 - math.clamp(reticle * 1.6, 0, 1))
        n:image("dot", "images/glow.png", 0, 0, 2.4 * B, 0, G_EMBER_HOT, 1 - math.clamp(mark * 2, 0, 1))
        local lw = math.max(0.12 * B, axisDist * pix * 1.2)
        for i, d in ipairs({{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}}) do
            n:frame("cross" .. i, d[1] * 4 * B, d[2] * 4 * B, d[1] ~= 0 and 2 * B or lw, d[2] ~= 0 and 2 * B or lw, G_EMBER, 1 - math.clamp(reticle * 1.4, 0, 1))
        end
        local z = w.zone
        local Q = c.Q * B
        z:image("edge", "images/ss_ring.png", 0, 0, Q * 2 / 0.985, 0, G_EMBER, 1 - math.clamp(mark * 1.6, 0, 1))
        z:image("ticks", "images/ss_ticks.png", 0, 0, Q * 2 / 0.985, 0, G_EMBER, 1 - math.clamp(mark * 1.1, 0, 1))
        z:image("wedge", "images/ss_wedge.png", 0, 0, Q * 2, -time * 0.3 * 360, G_EMBER, 1 - math.clamp(mark * 0.4, 0, 1))
        z:image("closing", "images/ss_ring.png", 0, 0, math.max(0.1, Q * (1 - pulse)) * 2 / 0.985, 0, G_EMBER, 1 - math.clamp((1 - pulse) * 1.5 * mark, 0, 1))
        local wl = math.max(0.06 * B, axisDist * pix * 0.8)
        w.laser.Width0, w.laser.Width1 = wl * 2, wl * 2
        w.laser.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1 - math.clamp(mark * (1 - fall), 0, 1))
        -- The needle falls from 9,000 blocks.
        local h = 20 + 9000 * math.max(1 - fall, 0) ^ 0.75
        local head = c.T + up(h)
        w.head.Position = head
        w.tailAt.Parent.Position = head + up(math.min(h * 1.5, 5000))
        local on = fall > 0.001
        local hw = math.max((0.4 + h * 0.002) * B, (head - camP).Magnitude * pix * 0.8)
        w.streak.Width0, w.streak.Width1 = hw * 2, hw * 0.6
        w.streak.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, on and math.clamp(1 - fall * 1.2, 0, 1) or 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
        w.flare.Enabled = on
        if on then
            local g = sm((fall - 0.1) / 0.9)
            local twinkle = 0.75 + 0.25 * math.sin(time * 61) * math.sin(time * 37 + 2)
            local px = cam.ViewportSize.Y * (0.03 + 0.34 * g * g) * twinkle / 0.165
            w.flare.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(8, px), math.max(8, px))
            w.flareImage.ImageTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(0.3 + 1.4 * g, 0, 1)
        end
        for i = 0, 3 do
            local dy = h * (0.015 + i * 0.03) + i * 3
            local ring = w.rings[i]
            ring:moveY(head.Y + dy * B)
            ring:image("r", "images/ss_ring.png", 0, 0, math.max(1, dy * 0.3 * B) * 2 / 0.985, 0, Color3.new(0.95, 0.97, 1), 1 - math.clamp((0.9 - i * 0.18) * sm((fall - 0.2) / 0.5), 0, 1))
        end
        c.dusk = fall > 0 and (sm(fall / 0.6) ^ 2) * 0.92 or 0
        -- Impact.
        if since >= 0 then
            local dome = math.exp(-since * 9)
            w.dome.Size = Vector3.one * (6 + since * 60) * 2 * B
            w.dome.Transparency = 1 - math.clamp(dome, 0, 1)
            if since < 4 then
                local wf = (2.5 + since * 4) * B
                z:image("front", "images/ss_ring.png", 0, 0, math.max(1, front * B) * 2 / 0.985, 0, G_WHITE:Lerp(G_EMBER, math.clamp(since * 0.9, 0, 1)), 1 - math.clamp(3 * math.exp(-since * 0.8) * 0.5, 0, 1))
                z:image("chevrons", "images/ss_dashes.png", 0, 0, math.max(1, (front - 5) * B) * 2 / 0.94, since * 120, G_WHITE:Lerp(G_EMBER, math.clamp(since * 0.8, 0, 1)), 1 - math.clamp(math.exp(-since * 0.6) * 0.8, 0, 1))
                local _ = wf
            else
                z:image("front", "images/ss_ring.png", 0, 0, 1, 0, G_EMBER, 1)
                z:image("chevrons", "images/ss_dashes.png", 0, 0, 1, 0, G_EMBER, 1)
            end
            -- Shells: seven barcode rings rising over the crater, then the scan ring.
            local spireR = 6.5 * s.P
            for i = 0, 6 do
                local sh = w.shells[i]
                local scan = i == 6
                local k = scan and since or since - i * 0.045
                if k > 0 and shellsK > 0.001 then
                    local y = scan and (380 * (1 - math.exp(-since * 1.4))) or (18 + i * 50 + k * 34)
                    local rr = scan and spireR + 12 or spireR + 5 + i * 6 + c.Q * 0.75 * (1 - math.exp(-k * (1.9 - i * 0.2)))
                    local fade = scan and math.exp(-since * 0.6) or math.exp(-k * (0.9 + i * 0.2))
                    sh:moveY(c.T.Y + y * B)
                    local col = G_WHITE:Lerp(G_EMBER, math.clamp(k * 1.1, 0, 1))
                    sh:image("band", "images/ss_dashes.png", 0, 0, rr * B * 2 / 0.94, k * (i - 2.5) * 0.12 * 360, col, 1 - math.clamp(fade * 2.6 * shellsK, 0, 1))
                    sh:image("inner", "images/ss_ring.png", 0, 0, rr * 0.95 * B * 2 / 0.985, 0, col, 1 - math.clamp(fade * 1.2 * shellsK, 0, 1))
                    sh:image("brackets", "images/ss_brackets.png", 0, 0, rr * 1.08 * B * 2 / 0.94, -k * (i - 2.5) * 0.24 * 360, col, 1 - math.clamp(fade * 2.4 * shellsK, 0, 1))
                else
                    for _, key in ipairs({"band", "inner", "brackets"}) do sh:image(key, "images/ss_ring.png", 0, 0, 1, 0, G_EMBER, 1) end
                end
            end
            -- Telemetry etched into the crater floor, cooling over time.
            local reveal = (c.Q + 5) * 1.04 * (1 - math.exp(-since * 3))
            local cool = math.exp(-since / 12)
            local tcol = Color3.new(0.55, 0.06, 0.02):Lerp(G_EMBER_HOT, cool)
            local tel = t < 322 and 0 or win(t, 322, 322.5, 1142, 1222)
            z:image("telemetry", "images/gg_telemetry.png", 0, 0, reveal * 2 * B, 0, tcol, 1 - math.clamp(tel * (0.35 + 1.8 * cool) * 0.6, 0, 0.85))
            -- Dust riding the front.
            for _, d in ipairs(w.dust) do
                local r = math.min(front, c.Q * 2.5) * B
                d.part.Position = c.T + Vector3.new(math.cos(d.angle) * r, 2 * B, math.sin(d.angle) * r)
                d.emitter.Rate = dustK * 14
            end
        end
        -- Aura round the spire and the plume from its crown.
        w.column.Width0, w.column.Width1 = (1.2 + (1 - plume) * 8) * B * 2, (1.2 + (1 - plume) * 8 + 8) * B * 2
        w.column.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1 - math.clamp(plume * plume * 0.6 * 1.5, 0, 1))
        c.aura = auraK
    end
    -- client.fx.f.a(Minecraft, ClientLevel, int).
    local G_IMPACT = {17, 20, 15, 18, 19, 20, 16, 0, 18, 17, 20, 6, 15, 19}
    local G_BOOM = {20, 16, 18, 20, 15, 19, 17, 20, 1, 18, 15}
    local function gungnirTick(c, tick)
        local s = gungnirShape(c)
        local tgt = c.T
        if tick == 0 then gungnirBuild(c) end
        local w = c.world
        local camP = camPos()
        local camZone = gZonePoint(c, camP)
        local dist = Vector3.new(camP.X - tgt.X, 0, camP.Z - tgt.Z).Magnitude / B
        local near = dist < 2000
        if tick == 0 then ssSound(c, "star_arm", casterPos(c)) end
        if tick == 7 then ssSound(c, "star_press", casterPos(c)) end
        if tick == 9 then
            ssSound(c, "gungnir_mark", c.filmOn and tgt or camZone)
            w.sparks:Emit(50)
        end
        if tick == 29 and not c.filmOn then c:sound("gungnir_countdown", camZone, 1) end
        if c.filmOn then
            for tk, name in pairs({[44] = "gungnir_ascent", [124] = "gungnir_ring", [146] = "gungnir_load", [168] = "gungnir_spin", [247] = "gungnir_release", [256] = "gungnir_flight"}) do
                if tick == tk then c:sound(name, nil, 1) end
            end
        end
        if tick >= 9 and tick < 322 then w.sparks:Emit(3) end
        if tick == 290 then
            c:stopSounds()
            if c.filmOn or near then c:sound("gungnir_hush", nil, c.filmOn and 1 or math.clamp(1.2 - dist / 2000, 0.3, 1)) end
        end
        if tick > 282 and tick < 322 then
            local f = (tick - 322 + 40) / 40
            w.zoneDust:Emit(math.floor(26 * f * f))
            if tick % 3 == 0 then addShake(0.05 + 0.2 * f) end
        end
        if tick == 322 then
            if c.filmOn or near then c:sound("gungnir_crack", nil, c.filmOn and 1 or 0.8) end
            buildGungnirSpire(c)
            buildGungnirCrater(c)
            w.burst:Emit(300)
        end
        -- Damage: everything the shockwave passes inside the crater is erased; outside it throws you.
        if tick >= 322 and tick < 400 then
            local r = gFront(c, tick)
            if tick <= 370 and (tick - 322) % 2 == 0 then
                local inner = math.min(r, s.Q + 4 * s.O)
                eraseArea(function(p) return Vector3.new(p.X - tgt.X, 0, p.Z - tgt.Z).Magnitude <= inner * B and p.Y > c.ground - (s.S + 8) * B end, "shooting_star_demo.shooting_star")
            end
            local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
            if ctx and ctx.root and r > s.Q and not c.thrown then
                local prev = gFront(c, math.max(tick - 1, 322))
                local d = Vector3.new(ctx.root.Position.X - tgt.X, 0, ctx.root.Position.Z - tgt.Z)
                local dd = d.Magnitude / B
                if dd > math.max(prev, s.Q) and dd <= math.min(r, s.Q * 2.5) then
                    c.thrown = true
                    local f = 1 - (dd - s.Q) / (s.Q * 1.5)
                    if ctx.world and ctx.world.knockback then ctx.world.knockback((d.Magnitude > 0 and d.Unit or Vector3.xAxis) * (1.2 + 2.8 * f) + Vector3.new(0, 0.6 + 1.2 * f, 0)) end
                    hurtLocal(4 + 26 * f * f)
                end
            end
        end
        -- The boom when the wave reaches you (fixed at 341 in the film), the wind just after, the hum.
        local arrive = c.filmOn and 341 or gArrive(c, dist)
        if not c.boom and tick >= 322 and tick >= arrive and dist < 4000 then
            c.boom = tick
            local v = math.clamp(1.3 - dist / 1600, 0.35, 1)
            c:sound("gungnir_boom", nil, c.filmOn and 1 or v)
            addShake(2.4 * v)
        end
        if c.boom and tick == c.boom + 2 then c:sound("gungnir_wind", nil, c.filmOn and 1 or math.clamp(1.2 - dist / 900, 0.2, 1)) end
        if tick == 372 then
            ssSound(c, "gungnir_hum", c.filmOn and tgt or Vector3.new(tgt.X, math.min(math.max(camP.Y, tgt.Y), tgt.Y + 300 * B), tgt.Z))
        end
    end
    -- fx.f.a(d, render.f): the grade over the world.
    local function gungnirGrade(c, t, filmOn, covered)
        if covered then return end
        local camP = camPos()
        local dz = (camP - gZonePoint(c, camP)).Magnitude / B
        local near = filmOn and 1 or math.clamp(1 - dz / 1200, 0.2, 1)
        if t > 300 and t < 322 then
            local k = sm((t - 300) / 22)
            Grade.vignette(rgb(655872), k * 0.55 * near)
            G.b = math.max(G.b, k * k * 0.35 * near)
            G.d = math.max(G.d, k * k * k * 0.25 * near)
        end
        local s14 = (t - 322) / 20
        if s14 >= 0 and s14 < 6 then
            local s11 = s14 - 0.05
            if s11 >= 0 and s11 < #G_IMPACT / 12 then
                local idx = math.floor(s11 * 12)
                local fr = s11 * 12 - idx
                Grade.impact(near, G_IMPACT[idx + 1])
                if idx % 2 == 0 then G.d = math.max(G.d, (1 - fr) * 0.9 * near) else G.b = math.max(G.b, (1 - fr) * 1.4 * near) end
            end
            G.d = math.max(G.d, win(s14, 0, 0.02, 0.4, 1.4) * 0.7 * near)
            G.b = math.max(G.b, win(s14, 0, 0.02, 0.5, 2) * near)
            G.m = math.max(G.m, 1.2 * win(s14, 0, 0.1, 2, 5))
            G.n = math.max(G.n, 1 + 1.2 * win(s14, 0, 0.1, 1, 3))
        end
        if c.boom then
            local s15 = (t - c.boom) / 20
            if s15 >= 0 and s15 < 8 then
                local k = filmOn and 1 or near
                if s15 < #G_BOOM / 12 then
                    local idx = math.floor(s15 * 12)
                    Grade.impact(k, G_BOOM[idx + 1])
                    G.d = math.max(G.d, idx % 2 == 0 and k or 0.3 * k)
                end
                G.a = math.max(G.a, win(s15, 0, 0.02, 0.8, 3.5) * 2.4 * k)
                G.b = math.max(G.b, win(s15, 0, 0.02, 0.3, 1.6) * 1.3 * k)
                G.d = math.max(G.d, win(s15, 0, 0.02, 0.2, 0.9) * 0.6 * k)
                Grade.vignette(rgb(2759184), win(s15, 0.2, 1, 4, 8) * 0.45 * k)
            end
        end
        if s14 >= 0 then G.m = math.max(G.m, 0.8 * win(s14, 0.5, 3, 20, 40)) end
    end
    -- fx.f.b(render.f, t, weight).
    local function gungnirFilmGrade(t, weight)
        local cover = (t >= 50 and t < 300) and math.clamp((t - 50) / 12, 0, 1) or 0
        local m4 = cover * weight
        if m4 > 0.001 then G.m = math.max(G.m, 0.55) end
        for _, t0 in ipairs({84, 110}) do local k = win(t, t0 - 1, t0, t0 + 1, t0 + 5); G.b = math.max(G.b, k * 0.9); Grade.flash(rgb(16763296), k * 0.22) end
        G.b = math.max(G.b, win(t, 124, 128, 140, 146) * 0.2)
        G.d = math.max(G.d, win(t, 141, 145, 146, 147) * 0.5)
        local s15 = t - 160
        if s15 >= 0 and s15 < 12 then G.a = math.max(G.a, math.exp(-s15 * 0.5) * 0.9); G.b = math.max(G.b, math.exp(-s15 * 0.4) * 0.7); Grade.flash(rgb(16770760), math.exp(-s15 * 1.2) * 0.6) end
        if t >= 168 and t < 252 then
            local k = (t - 168) / 84
            G.a = math.max(G.a, 0.05 + 0.35 * k * k); G.b = math.max(G.b, 0.1 + 0.6 * k * k)
            if t < 202 or t >= 226 then G.d = math.max(G.d, 0.55 * k * k) end
            for i = 1, 6 do
                local ti = 168 + 84 * (i / 7) ^ 0.45454545454545453
                local k2 = win(t, ti - 0.5, ti, ti + 0.5, ti + 3)
                G.a = math.max(G.a, k2 * (0.3 + 0.1 * i)); G.b = math.max(G.b, k2 * 0.8); Grade.flash(rgb(16767152), k2 * 0.15 * i / 6)
            end
        end
        local s17 = t - 252
        if s17 >= 0 and s17 < 10 then
            Grade.flash(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), s17 < 1 and 3.6 or 3.6 * math.exp(-(s17 - 1) * 1.4))
            G.a = math.max(G.a, math.exp(-s17 * 0.45) * 1.3); G.b = math.max(G.b, math.exp(-s17 * 0.35) * 1.4); G.d = math.max(G.d, math.exp(-s17 * 0.5) * 0.8)
        end
        if t >= 256 and t < 290 then
            G.d = math.max(G.d, 0.3)
            local k19 = win(t, 262, 263, 264, 265); G.b = math.max(G.b, k19 * 0.9); G.d = math.max(G.d, k19 * 0.5)
            G.a = math.max(G.a, win(t, 266, 268, 275, 277) * 0.4)
            local k23 = win(t, 284, 285, 285.5, 287); G.a = math.max(G.a, k23 * 0.5); G.b = math.max(G.b, k23 * 0.6)
        end
        if t >= 288 and t < 300 then
            local k = sm((t - 290 + 2) / 6)
            G.a = math.max(G.a, k * 0.8); G.b = math.max(G.b, k * 0.8); Grade.vignette(rgb(4854784), k * 0.4); G.m = math.max(G.m, 0.9 * k)
        end
        Grade.flash(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), win(t, 300, 300.2, 300.6, 303) * 1.4)
        return cover > 0.001
    end

    -- SS-04 Seven Stars ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local VIOLET, VIOLET_HOT = Color3.fromRGB(184, 167, 255), Color3.fromRGB(228, 220, 255)
    local function starNodes(c)
        if c.nodes then return c.nodes end
        local I = c.power
        local scale = 360 * I
        local co, si = math.cos(c.facing), math.sin(c.facing)
        c.nodes = {}
        for i = 1, 7 do
            local x, z = DIPPER[i][1] * scale, DIPPER[i][2] * scale
            local wx, wz = x * co - z * si, x * si + z * co
            local pos = Vector3.new(c.target.X + wx * B, 0, c.target.Z + wz * B)
            local gy, solid = groundAt(pos.X, pos.Z, c.ground)
            c.nodes[i] = {pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, gy, pos.Z), solid = solid, radius = (16 + (3.4 - MAGS[i]) * 12) * I}
        end
        return c.nodes
    end
    local function landTick(i) return 290 + (i - 1) * 16 end
    local function linkTick(k) return 398 + (k - 1) * 5 end
    local function starMaterial(c, d, noise, noise2)
        local n = d + (noise - 0.5) * 0.18
        if n < 0.25 then return noise2 < 0.5 and "crying_obsidian" or (noise2 < 0.8 and "obsidian" or "amethyst_block")
        elseif n < 0.7 then return noise2 < 0.35 and "amethyst_block" or noise2 < 0.55 and "calcite" or noise2 < 0.8 and "blackstone" or "smooth_basalt" end
        return noise2 < 0.3 and "calcite" or noise2 < 0.55 and "tuff" or "cobbled_deepslate"
    end
    local function buildStarCrater(c, i)
        local node = starNodes(c)[i]
        local I = c.power
        local m = Instance.new("Model"); m.Name = "Star_" .. STAR_NAMES[i]; m.Parent = c.folder
        local rr = node.radius
        local depth = rr * 0.45
        task.spawn(function()
            if node.solid then
                local reach = math.ceil(rr * 1.1 + 2 * I + 1)
                local groundId = VX.ground(mapRay(node.pos + Vector3.new((reach + 6) * B, 200, 0), Vector3.new(0, -600, 0)), "grass_block")
                carve(node.pos, (rr * 1.1 + 2 * I) * B, node.pos.Y - (depth + 8) * B, nil)
                if not SS.enabled then return end
                local ci, _, ck = VX.index(node.pos)
                local gj = VX.layer(node.pos.Y)
                VX.terrain(m, {i0 = ci - reach, i1 = ci + reach, k0 = ck - reach, k1 = ck + reach, budget = 1800,
                    column = function(x, z)
                        local d = math.sqrt((x - ci) ^ 2 + (z - ck) ^ 2)
                        if d > reach then return nil end
                        if d > rr then return gj, groundId end
                        local xx = d / rr
                        local h = -depth * (1 - xx * xx) * (1 - 0.3 * xx * xx)
                        return gj + math.floor(h + 0.5), starMaterial(c, xx, hashNoise(c.seed, math.floor(x / 2) * 7 + i, math.floor(z / 2)), hashNoise(c.seed + 9, math.floor(z / 2) * 3 + i, math.floor(x / 2)))
                    end})
            end
            -- Star-core crystals (star.h.e): 5..7 spikes leaning out of the crater's heart, a tall one upright.
            local bottom = node.pos.Y - depth * B
            local count = 5 + math.floor(hashNoise(c.seed, i, 17) * 3)
            local sizeF = rr / (36 * I)
            local spikes, cell = {}, 1
            for k = 0, count do
                local upright = k == 0
                local yaw = upright and 0 or (k - 1 + hashNoise(c.seed, i * 13 + k, 5) * 0.6) / count * math.pi * 2
                local tilt = upright and 0 or (0.35 + hashNoise(c.seed, k, i * 7) * 0.5)
                local length = (upright and 16 or (7 + hashNoise(c.seed, i + k * 3, 9) * 7)) * (0.6 + 0.6 * sizeF) * I
                local radius = (upright and 2.2 or 1.2) * I
                local dir = Vector3.new(math.cos(yaw) * math.sin(tilt), math.cos(tilt), math.sin(yaw) * math.sin(tilt))
                spikes[#spikes + 1] = {dir, length, radius}
                cell = math.max(cell, VX.cellFor(length, radius, 700))
            end
            -- star_core blocks, voxel by voxel (coarser voxels when the stars are very bright)
            local set = {}
            for _, sp in ipairs(spikes) do VX.spike(set, Vector3.new(node.pos.X, bottom, node.pos.Z), sp[1], sp[2], sp[3], sp[3] * 0.15, "star_core", cell) end
            VX.solid(m, set, cell)
            local core = anchorAt(m, Vector3.new(node.pos.X, bottom + 4 * B, node.pos.Z))
            local l = Instance.new("PointLight"); l.Color, l.Range, l.Brightness = VIOLET, 60, 4; l.Parent = core
            glowEmitter(core, VIOLET, 8, 1.2 * B, 3 * B, 3, {acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 1 * B, 0)})
        end)
        return m
    end
    local function buildTrench(c, k)
        local nodes = starNodes(c)
        local a, b = nodes[LINKS[k][1]], nodes[LINKS[k][2]]
        local I = c.power
        local J, K = 5.5 * I, 12 * I
        local from, to = a.pos, b.pos
        local mid = (from + to) / 2
        local flat = Vector3.new(to.X - from.X, 0, to.Z - from.Z)
        local len = flat.Magnitude
        if len < 1 then return end
        local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(mid.X, mid.Y, mid.Z), Vector3.new(to.X, mid.Y, to.Z))
        local m = Instance.new("Model"); m.Name = "Trace_" .. k; m.Parent = c.folder
        task.spawn(function()
            -- Carve the trench in steps along the line.
            if a.solid or b.solid then carve(mid, nil, math.min(from.Y, to.Y) - (K + 4) * B, nil, {cf = cf, w = J * 2 * B, l = len}) end
            if not SS.enabled then return end
            c.traces = c.traces or {}
            c.traces[k] = m
            -- The trench on the block grid: amethyst floor, a line of star_trace down the middle, basalt / calcite walls.
            local dir = flat.Unit
            local side = Vector3.new(-dir.Z, 0, dir.X)
            local floorJ, gj = VX.layer(mid.Y - K * B), VX.layer(mid.Y)
            local ai, _, ak = VX.index(from)
            local bi, _, bk = VX.index(to)
            local pad = math.ceil(J + 2)
            local lineHalf = math.max(I, 0.6)
            VX.terrain(m, {i0 = math.min(ai, bi) - pad, i1 = math.max(ai, bi) + pad, k0 = math.min(ak, bk) - pad, k1 = math.max(ak, bk) + pad, budget = 1500, edge = K,
                column = function(x, z)
                    local p = VX.centre(x, 0, z)
                    local rx, rz = (p.X - from.X) / B, (p.Z - from.Z) / B
                    local along, across = rx * dir.X + rz * dir.Z, rx * side.X + rz * side.Z
                    if along < 0 or along > len / B or math.abs(across) > J then return nil end
                    if math.abs(across) > J - 2 then return gj, across < 0 and "smooth_basalt" or "calcite" end
                    if math.abs(across) <= lineHalf then return floorJ, "star_trace" end
                    return floorJ, "amethyst_block"
                end})
        end)
    end
    local STARS = (function()
    -- SS-04 Seven Stars: client.fx.l (ticks, grade), fx.m (film HUD), fx/stars_world.fsh (the world) ------------------------------------
    local S_VIOLET, S_VIOLET_HOT, S_WHITE = Color3.new(0.62, 0.48, 1), Color3.new(0.86, 0.8, 1), Color3.new(0.97, 0.95, 1)
    local S_HUD, S_DIM, S_CYAN = rgb(12101887), rgb(15262463), rgb(8381183)
    local STAR_LY = {123, 79, 83, 81, 83, 83, 104}
    local STAR_GREEK = {"\u{3b1}", "\u{3b2}", "\u{3b3}", "\u{3b4}", "\u{3b5}", "\u{3b6}", "\u{3b7}"}
    local S_IMPACT = {23, 21, 26, 24, 22, 25}
    local S_FINALE = {23, 21, 26, 24, 25, 22, 23, 1, 21, 26, 24, 6, 25, 22, 21, 26}
    local function sCountdown(t)
        if t < 29 then return 0 end
        local v2 = 13.05
        local v4 = math.min(t - 29, 261) / 20
        local v6 = v4 / v2
        return 0.6 * v4 + 3.4 * v2 * v6 * v6 * v6 / 3
    end
    local function sLand(i) return 290 + (i - 1) * 16 end
    local function sFall(t, i) local l = sLand(i); return t >= l and 0 or math.clamp((t - (l - 16)) / 16, 0, 1) end
    local function sLock(t, i) return sm((t - (24 + (i - 1) * 4)) / 4) end
    local function nearestNode(c, pos)
        local nodes, best = starNodes(c), nil
        for i = 1, 7 do if not best or (nodes[i].pos - pos).Magnitude < (best - pos).Magnitude then best = nodes[i].pos end end
        return best
    end
    local function starsBuild(c)
        local w = {}
        c.world = w
        local nodes = starNodes(c)
        local skyH = 900 * c.I * B
        local function anchor(pos)
            local a = Instance.new("Part")
            a.Anchored, a.CanCollide, a.CanQuery, a.CanTouch, a.Transparency, a.Size = true, false, false, false, 1, Vector3.one
            a.Position = pos
            a.Parent = c.folder
            local at = Instance.new("Attachment"); at.Parent = a
            return a, at
        end
        local function glint(pos, colour)
            local a = anchor(pos)
            local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            bb.Size, bb.LightInfluence, bb.AlwaysOnTop, bb.MaxDistance, bb.Adornee, bb.Enabled = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), 0, false, 1e6, a, false
            local im = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            im.Size, im.BackgroundTransparency, im.Image, im.ImageColor3 = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 1, asset("images/ss_star.png") or "", colour
            im.Parent = bb
            bb.Parent = a
            return {part = a, gui = bb, image = im}
        end
        local function beam(a0, a1, colour, tex)
            local b = Instance.new("Beam")
            b.Attachment0, b.Attachment1, b.FaceCamera, b.LightEmission, b.LightInfluence = a0, a1, true, 1, 0
            b.Color, b.Transparency = ColorSequence.new(colour), NumberSequence.new(1)
            if tex then b.Texture, b.TextureMode, b.TextureLength = asset(tex) or "", Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, 1 end
            b.Parent = c.folder
            return b
        end
        w.stars = {}
        for i = 1, 7 do
            local n = nodes[i]
            local st = {}
            st.canvas = Canvas.new(c.folder, n.pos, (n.radius * 2 + 160 * c.I + 20) * B)
            st.sky = glint(n.pos + Vector3.new(0, skyH, 0), S_VIOLET)
            st.head = glint(n.pos, S_VIOLET_HOT)
            local _, ha = anchor(n.pos)
            local _, sa = anchor(n.pos + Vector3.new(0, skyH, 0))
            st.headAt, st.skyAt = ha, sa
            st.streak = beam(ha, sa, S_WHITE)
            local _, ga = anchor(n.pos)
            st.groundAt = ga
            st.column = beam(ga, sa, S_WHITE)
            st.rings = {}
            for r = 0, 2 do st.rings[r] = Canvas.new(c.folder, n.pos, 120 * c.I * B + 10) end
            local dome = Instance.new("Part")
            dome.Anchored, dome.CanCollide, dome.CanQuery, dome.CanTouch, dome.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
            dome.Shape, dome.Material, dome.Color, dome.Transparency = Enum.PartType.Ball, Enum.Material.Neon, S_WHITE, 1
            dome.Position = n.pos + up(3 * c.I)
            dome.Parent = c.folder
            st.dome = dome
            local burst = anchor(n.pos + up(2))
            st.burst = glowEmitter(burst, S_VIOLET, 0, 2.4 * B, 18 * B, 2.2, {acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -3 * B, 0)})
            local motes = anchor(n.pos + up(0.5))
            st.motes = glowEmitter(motes, S_VIOLET, 0, 0.7 * B, 1 * B, 3, {acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 0.8 * B, 0), spread = Vector2.new(30, 30)})
            w.stars[i] = st
        end
        -- The links: dashed marks on the ground, the burning traces, the finale's lines in the sky.
        w.links = {}
        for k, l in ipairs(LINKS) do
            local a, b = nodes[l[1]].pos, nodes[l[2]].pos
            local _, ga0 = anchor(a + up(0.3))
            local _, ga1 = anchor(b + up(0.3))
            local _, gh = anchor(a + up(0.3))
            local _, sa0 = anchor(a + Vector3.new(0, skyH, 0))
            local _, sa1 = anchor(b + Vector3.new(0, skyH, 0))
            local mark = beam(ga0, ga1, S_VIOLET, "images/dash.png")
            mark.TextureMode, mark.TextureLength, mark.TextureSpeed = Enum.TextureMode.Static, 10 * c.I * B, -1.5
            w.links[k] = {a = a, b = b, mark = mark, trace = beam(ga0, gh, S_VIOLET_HOT), headAt = gh, sky = beam(sa0, sa1, S_VIOLET_HOT), ground = beam(ga0, ga1, S_WHITE)}
        end
    end
    local function starsRender(c, t)
        local w = c.world
        if not w then return end
        local nodes = starNodes(c)
        local K = c.I
        local time = t / 20
        local skyH = 900 * K * B
        local mark = win(t, 9, 10.5, 260, 290)
        local night = win(t, 18, 38, 740, 940)
        local linkS = t >= 398 and (t - 398) / 20 or -1
        local finale = t >= 440 and (t - 440) / 20 or -1
        local reticle = sm((t - 9) / 14)
        local after = t < 440 and 0 or win(t, 460, 500, 740, 940)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local camP = cam.CFrame.Position
        local pix = 2 * math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) / 2) / math.max(1, cam.ViewportSize.Y)
        local function glintSize(st, size, alpha)
            st.gui.Enabled = alpha > 0.01
            if st.gui.Enabled then
                local twinkle = 0.8 + 0.2 * math.sin(time * 47 + size * 13)
                local px = cam.ViewportSize.Y * (0.02 + 0.22 * size) * twinkle / 0.165
                st.gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(6, px), math.max(6, px))
                st.image.ImageTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1)
            end
        end
        c.night = night
        local fin = finale >= 0 and math.exp(-finale * 1.2) or 0
        for i = 1, 7 do
            local n, st = nodes[i], w.stars[i]
            local since = t >= sLand(i) and (t - sLand(i)) / 20 or -1
            local fall = sFall(t, i)
            local lock = sLock(t, i) * (t > 1040 and 0 or 1)
            local R = n.radius * B
            local skyPos = n.pos + Vector3.new(0, skyH, 0)
            -- Locked: a glint where the star waits in the sky; later the finale's and the afterglow's.
            local skyAlpha = 0
            if fall < 0.001 and since < 0 and lock > 0.001 then skyAlpha = lock * 0.8 end
            skyAlpha = math.max(skyAlpha, fin, after * 0.6)
            glintSize(st.sky, fin > 0.01 and 1 or 0.08 + 0.12 * lock, skyAlpha)
            -- Falling.
            local h = 12 * K + (900 * K - 12 * K) * math.max(1 - fall, 0) ^ 0.75
            local head = n.pos + up(h)
            st.head.part.Position = head
            st.headAt.WorldPosition = head
            local falling = fall > 0.001 and since < 0
            local sw = math.max((0.4 * K + h * 0.003) * B, (head - camP).Magnitude * pix * 0.8)
            st.streak.Width0, st.streak.Width1 = sw * 2, sw
            st.streak.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(falling and 0.1 or 1, 1)
            glintSize(st.head, 0.3 + 0.7 * fall, falling and (0.5 + fall) or 0)
            for r = 0, 2 do
                local dy = h * (0.02 + r * 0.035) + r * 2 * K
                st.rings[r]:moveY(head.Y + dy * B)
                st.rings[r]:image("r", "images/ss_ring.png", 0, 0, math.max(1, dy * 0.32 * B) * 2 / 0.985, 0, Color3.new(0.9, 0.9, 1), falling and 1 - math.clamp((0.8 - r * 0.2) * sm((fall - 0.3) / 0.5), 0, 1) or 1)
            end
            -- Landed: dome, column, ring, heat, the hex / ring telemetry.
            local cv = st.canvas
            if since >= 0 then
                local dome = math.exp(-since * 8)
                st.dome.Size = Vector3.one * (4 + since * 50) * K * 2 * B
                st.dome.Transparency = 1 - math.clamp(dome, 0, 1)
                local colA = math.exp(-since * 3.5)
                local cw = math.max(R * 0.25, (n.pos - camP).Magnitude * pix)
                st.column.Width0, st.column.Width1 = math.max(cw, (2.5 + math.max(finale, 0) * 1.5) * K * B) * 2, math.max(cw, (2.5 + math.max(finale, 0) * 1.5) * K * B) * 2
                st.column.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1 - math.clamp(math.max(colA * 0.9, fin * 0.9), 0, 1))
                local front = R * 0.9 + since * 150 * K * B
                cv:image("front", "images/ss_ring.png", 0, 0, front * 2 / 0.985, 0, S_WHITE:Lerp(S_VIOLET, math.clamp(since, 0, 1)), 1 - math.clamp(math.exp(-since * 1.2) * 1.3, 0, 1))
                local heat = math.exp(-since / 20)
                cv:image("heat", "images/glow.png", 0, 0, R * 2.2, 0, S_VIOLET:Lerp(S_WHITE, math.clamp(heat, 0, 1)), 1 - math.clamp(heat * 0.7, 0, 1))
                local draw = sm(since / 0.25)
                local cool = math.exp(-since / 14)
                local tc = S_VIOLET:Lerp(S_VIOLET_HOT, cool)
                local ta = 1 - math.clamp(draw * (0.3 + 1.4 * cool) * 0.8, 0, 1)
                cv:image("hex", "images/gg_hex.png", 0, 0, R * 1.25 * 2 / 0.92, math.deg(since * 0.25 + i), tc, ta)
                cv:image("ring1", "images/ss_dashes.png", 0, 0, R * 1.45 * 2 / 0.94, 0, tc, ta)
                cv:image("ring2", "images/ss_ring.png", 0, 0, R * 1.55 * 2 / 0.985, 0, tc, ta)
            else
                st.column.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1 - math.clamp(fin * 0.9, 0, 1))
                -- Marked: a turning hexagon, a ring and a dot round each node.
                local hr = lerp(R * 1.8, R * 0.9, reticle)
                cv:image("mark", "images/gg_hex.png", 0, 0, hr * 2 / 0.92, math.deg(time * 0.5 + i), S_VIOLET, 1 - math.clamp(mark * 2, 0, 1))
                cv:image("inner", "images/ss_ring.png", 0, 0, 3 * K * B * 2 / 0.985, 0, S_VIOLET, 1 - math.clamp(mark * 1.6, 0, 1))
                cv:image("dot", "images/glow.png", 0, 0, 2.5 * K * B, 0, S_VIOLET, 1 - math.clamp(mark * 1.6, 0, 1))
                -- The ground brightens under a falling star.
                cv:image("light", "images/glow.png", 0, 0, R * 5, 0, S_VIOLET_HOT, 1 - math.clamp(fall * fall * 0.8, 0, 1))
            end
            if since >= 0 and since < 2 then cv:image("mark", "images/gg_hex.png", 0, 0, 1, 0, S_VIOLET, 1) end
        end
        -- Links: dashed marks, the burn along each line (one after another), the finale's lines.
        for k, l in ipairs(w.links) do
            l.mark.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1 - math.clamp(mark * 1.2, 0, 1))
            l.mark.Width0, l.mark.Width1 = 0.7 * K * B, 0.7 * K * B
            local s = linkS - (k - 1) * 0.25
            if linkS >= 0 and s >= 0 then
                local len = Vector3.new(l.b.X - l.a.X, 0, l.b.Z - l.a.Z).Magnitude
                local head = math.clamp(s / 0.4, 0, 1)
                l.headAt.WorldPosition = l.a:Lerp(l.b, head) + up(0.3)
                local cool = math.exp(-math.max(s - 0.4, 0) / 10)
                l.trace.Color = ColorSequence.new(S_VIOLET:Lerp(S_VIOLET_HOT, cool))
                l.trace.Width0, l.trace.Width1 = 2.2 * K * B, 2.2 * K * B
                l.trace.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1 - math.clamp((0.4 + 1.6 * cool) * 0.6, 0, 1))
                local _ = len
            else
                l.trace.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1)
            end
            l.sky.Width0, l.sky.Width1 = math.max(1.5 * K * B, (l.a - camP).Magnitude * pix) * 2, math.max(1.5 * K * B, (l.b - camP).Magnitude * pix) * 2
            l.sky.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1 - math.clamp(fin * 1.2, 0, 1))
            l.ground.Width0, l.ground.Width1 = 2.5 * K * B * 2, 2.5 * K * B * 2
            l.ground.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1 - math.clamp(fin * 1.5, 0, 1))
        end
    end
    -- client.fx.l.a(Minecraft, ClientLevel, int).
    local function starsTick(c, tick)
        local I = c.I
        local nodes = starNodes(c)
        if tick == 0 then starsBuild(c) end
        local w = c.world
        local camP = camPos()
        local nearZ = nearestNode(c, camP)
        local close = (camP - nearZ).Magnitude / B < 1400 * c.I
        if tick == 0 then ssSound(c, "star_arm", casterPos(c)) end
        if tick == 7 then ssSound(c, "star_press", casterPos(c)) end
        if tick == 9 then
            ssSound(c, "stars_mark", c.filmOn and c.T or nearZ)
            for i = 1, 7 do w.stars[i].motes:Emit(20) end
        end
        if tick == 24 then ssSound(c, "stars_lock", c.filmOn and c.T or nearZ) end
        if tick == 29 and not c.filmOn then c:sound("stars_countdown", nearZ, 1) end
        if c.filmOn then
            for tk, name in pairs({[56] = "stars_ascent", [130] = "stars_array", [208] = "stars_fire", [236] = "stars_return"}) do
