                if tick == tk then c:sound(name, nil, 1) end
            end
        end
        for i = 1, 7 do
            local land = sLand(i)
            local pitch = 1.15 - (i - 1) * 0.05
            local n = nodes[i]
            if tick == land - 18 then
                local s = c:sound("stars_fall", c.filmOn and nil or n.pos, c.filmOn and 0.6 or 0.6 * math.max(I, 1))
                if s then s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch end
            end
            if tick == land then
                local s = c:sound("stars_land", c.filmOn and nil or n.pos, c.filmOn and 1 or math.max(I, 1))
                if s then s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch end
                shakeAt(n.pos, 1.1, 900 * c.I)
                w.stars[i].burst:Emit(240)
                buildStarCrater(c, i)
                eraseArea(function(p) return Vector3.new(p.X - n.pos.X, 0, p.Z - n.pos.Z).Magnitude <= (n.radius + 8 * I) * B end, "shooting_star_demo.shooting_star")
            end
            if tick > land and tick < land + 40 then w.stars[i].motes:Emit(math.floor(6 * (1 - (tick - land) / 40))) end
        end
        if tick == 398 then ssSound(c, "stars_link", c.filmOn and c.T or nearZ) end
        for k, link in ipairs(LINKS) do
            local lt = 398 + (k - 1) * 5
            if tick == lt then buildTrench(c, k) end
            if tick >= lt and tick <= lt + 10 and (tick - lt) % 2 == 0 then
                local p1, p2 = nodes[link[1]].pos, nodes[link[2]].pos
                local J = 5.5 * I
                eraseArea(function(p)
                    local ab = Vector3.new(p2.X - p1.X, 0, p2.Z - p1.Z)
                    local ap = Vector3.new(p.X - p1.X, 0, p.Z - p1.Z)
                    local u = math.clamp(ap:Dot(ab) / math.max(ab:Dot(ab), 1e-6), 0, 1)
                    return (ap - ab * u).Magnitude <= (J + 1.5 * I) * B
                end, "shooting_star_demo.shooting_star")
            end
        end
        if tick == 434 and (c.filmOn or close) then c:sound("stars_finale", c.filmOn and nil or nearZ, 1) end
        if tick == 440 then
            shakeAt(c.T, 1.8, 1600 * c.I)
            for i = 1, 7 do w.stars[i].burst:Emit(120) end
        end
        if tick == 470 then ssSound(c, "stars_hum", c.filmOn and c.T or nearZ) end
        if tick > 440 and tick < 1240 and tick % 3 == 0 then for i = 1, 7 do w.stars[i].motes:Emit(1) end end
    end
    -- fx.l.a(d, render.f): the grade over the world.
    local function starsGrade(c, t, covered)
        if covered then return end
        local nodes = starNodes(c)
        local camP = camPos()
        Grade.vignette(rgb(656928), win(t, 24, 44, 640, 840) * 0.3)
        for i = 1, 7 do
            local near = c.filmOn and 1 or math.clamp(1 - (camP - nodes[i].pos).Magnitude / B / (1200 * c.I), 0.2, 1)
            local f = sFall(t, i)
            if f > 0 then G.b = math.max(G.b, f * f * 0.5 * near); G.d = math.max(G.d, f * f * f * 0.35 * near) end
            local s = (t - sLand(i)) / 20
            if s >= 0 and s < 2.5 then
                if s < 0.05 then Grade.flash(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 4.5 * near)
                elseif s - 0.05 < #S_IMPACT / 12 then
                    local idx = math.floor((s - 0.05) * 12)
                    Grade.impact(near, S_IMPACT[(idx + i - 1) % #S_IMPACT + 1])
                    G.d = math.max(G.d, (idx % 2 == 0 and 0.9 or 0.25) * near)
                end
                Grade.flash(rgb(14207231), math.exp(-s * 5) * near)
                G.a = math.max(G.a, win(s, 0, 0.02, 0.5, 2) * 1.1 * near)
                G.b = math.max(G.b, win(s, 0, 0.02, 0.4, 1.5) * 1.1 * near)
                G.m = math.max(G.m, 1.1 * win(s, 0, 0.1, 1, 2.5))
            end
        end
        local k15 = win(t, 398, 402, 436, 440)
        G.a = math.max(G.a, k15 * 0.25); G.m = math.max(G.m, k15 * 0.55)
        local s17 = (t - 440) / 20
        if s17 >= 0 and s17 < 8 then
            if s17 < 0.06 then Grade.flash(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 6)
            elseif s17 - 0.06 < #S_FINALE / 12 then
                local idx = math.floor((s17 - 0.06) * 12)
                Grade.impact(1, S_FINALE[idx + 1])
                G.d = math.max(G.d, idx % 2 == 0 and 1 or 0.3)
                G.b = math.max(G.b, idx % 2 == 0 and 0.4 or 1.6)
            end
            Grade.flash(rgb(13154559), math.exp(-s17 * 2.5) * 1.4)
            G.a = math.max(G.a, win(s17, 0, 0.02, 1, 4) * 1.8)
            G.m = math.max(G.m, 1.5 * win(s17, 0, 0.1, 3, 8))
            G.n = math.max(G.n, 1 + 1.2 * win(s17, 0, 0.1, 2, 6))
        end
    end
    -- fx.l.b(render.f, t, weight).
    local function starsFilmGrade(t, weight)
        local cover = (t >= 58 and t < 272) and math.clamp((t - 58) / 12, 0, 1) or 0
        if cover * weight > 0.001 then G.m = math.max(G.m, 0.6) end
        for _, t0 in ipairs({96, 130}) do local k = win(t, t0 - 1, t0, t0 + 1, t0 + 5); G.b = math.max(G.b, k * 0.9); Grade.flash(rgb(14208255), k * 0.25) end
        for i = 0, 6 do
            local a = 150 + i * 6
            local k = win(t, a, a + 0.5, a + 1, a + 4)
            G.a = math.max(G.a, k * 0.35); G.b = math.max(G.b, k * 0.6)
            local s = 208 + i * 4
            local k2 = win(t, s, s + 0.3, s + 0.6, s + 3)
            Grade.flash(rgb(15788799), k2 * (0.6 + 0.2 * i)); G.a = math.max(G.a, k2 * (0.4 + 0.1 * i)); G.d = math.max(G.d, k2 * 0.5)
        end
        G.d = math.max(G.d, win(t, 236, 238, 270, 272) * 0.4)
        Grade.flash(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), win(t, 272, 272.2, 272.6, 275) * 1.2)
        return cover > 0.001
    end
    -- client.fx.m.a: the film's HUD.
    local function starsFilmHud(c, t, weight, W, H)
        local a = math.clamp(weight * 1.6 - 0.3, 0, 1)
        if a <= 0.01 then return end
        local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        local blink = math.floor(t * 3) % 13 == 0
        Hud.corner(12, 12, 22, 1, 1, S_HUD, a)
        Hud.corner(W - 12, 12, 22, -1, 1, S_HUD, a)
        Hud.corner(12, H - 12, 22, 1, -1, S_HUD, a)
        Hud.corner(W - 12, H - 12, 22, -1, -1, S_HUD, a)
        Hud.text("UPLINK // SS-04 > SEVEN STARS", 18, 18, blink and S_DIM or S_HUD, blink and a * 0.55 or a)
        Hud.text("T+" .. fmt2(t / 20), 18, 29, S_DIM, a * 0.55)
        local landed = 0
        for i = 1, 7 do if t >= sLand(i) then landed = landed + 1 end end
        local right = t < 290 and ("FIRST IMPACT T-" .. fmt2((290 - t) / 20)) or (landed < 7 and string.format("IMPACTS %d / 7", landed) or (t < 440 and "LINKING" or "URSA MAJOR BURNED"))
        Hud.text(right, W - 18, 18, S_HUD, a, 1, 1)
        local fig = c.T / B
        Hud.text(string.format("FIGURE %d / %d / %d", math.floor(fig.X), math.floor(fig.Y), math.floor(fig.Z)), W - 18, H - 26, S_DIM, a * 0.55, 1, 1)
        local nodes = starNodes(c)
        if t >= 62 and t < 272 then
            local k11 = win(t, 132, 135, 148, 152)
            local k12 = 1 - k11
            local hud = Films.hudAt("stars", t)
            if hud and k12 > 0.02 then
                for _, l in ipairs(hud[2]) do
                    local x, y = W / 2 + l[3] * H / 2, H / 2 - l[4] * H / 2
                    local col = l[1] == "SOL" and S_CYAN or S_HUD
                    Hud.box(x, y, 7, col, a * k12)
                    Hud.text(l[1], x + 11, y - 9, col, a * k12)
                    Hud.text(l[2], x + 11, y + 1, S_DIM, a * 0.55 * k12)
                end
            end
            if hud then
                local range = hud[3]
                Hud.text(range > 9.4607e12 and string.format("RANGE %s LY", string.format("%.1f", range / 9.4607e12)) or ("RANGE " .. commas(range) .. " KM"), 18, H - 24, S_DIM, a * 0.55)
            end
            if t >= 96 and t < 130 then
                local on = math.floor(t / 2) % 2 == 0
                Hud.text("[ PARALLAX \u{b7} THE FIGURE ONLY HOLDS FROM SOL ]", W / 2, 30, on and S_HUD or S_DIM, on and a or a * 0.55, 1.5, 0.5)
            end
            if k11 > 0.01 then
                local jx = t < 138 and math.floor(math.sin(t * 91) * 6) or 0
                Hud.text("THE SHOOTING STAR", W / 2 + jx, H / 2 - 96, S_HUD, a * k11, 4, 0.5)
                Hud.text("SS-04 SEVEN STARS \u{b7} STELLAR ARRAY \u{b7} URSA MAJOR \u{b7} 79-123 LY", W / 2, H / 2 - 54, S_DIM, a * k11, 1.25, 0.5)
            end
            if (t >= 150 and t < 192) or (t >= 208 and t < 236) then
                local x0, y0 = W - 170, math.floor(H / 2 - 50)
                Hud.text("ARRAYS", x0, y0 - 14, S_DIM, a * 0.55)
                for i = 1, 7 do
                    local online = sm((t - (150 + (i - 1) * 6)) / 5) > 0.5
                    local fired = t >= 208 + (i - 1) * 4
                    local col = fired and WHITE or (online and S_CYAN or S_DIM)
                    local al = (fired or online) and a or a * 0.55
                    Hud.text(STAR_NAMES[i], x0, y0 + (i - 1) * 11, col, al)
                    Hud.text(fired and "FIRED" or (online and "ONLINE" or "\u{b7} \u{b7} \u{b7}"), x0 + 150, y0 + (i - 1) * 11, col, al, 1, 1)
                end
            end
            if t >= 208 and t < 236 then Hud.text(string.format("[ FIRE %d / 7 ]", math.clamp(math.floor((t - 208) / 4) + 1, 1, 7)), W / 2, 30, WHITE, a, 2, 0.5) end
            if t >= 192 and t < 208 then Hud.text("[ URSA MAJOR \u{b7} 7 ARMED \u{b7} SOL-3 ]", W / 2, 30, S_HUD, a, 1.5, 0.5) end
            return
        end
        if t >= 9 and t < 290 then
            local skyH = 900 * c.I * B
            for i = 1, 7 do
                local lk = sLock(t, i)
                local x, y = Hud.project(lk > 0.01 and nodes[i].pos + Vector3.new(0, skyH, 0) or nodes[i].pos + up(1))
                if x then
                    local r = lerp(24, 8, lk)
                    local col = lk > 0.99 and S_HUD or S_DIM
                    Hud.box(x, y, r, col, lk > 0.99 and a or a * 0.55)
                    if lk > 0.01 then
                        local s0 = 24 + (i - 1) * 4
                        local dur = i < 7 and 4 or 14
                        local al = a * win(t, s0, s0 + 1, s0 + dur, s0 + dur + 2)
                        if al > 4 / 255 then Hud.text(string.format("%s %s \u{b7} %d LY", STAR_NAMES[i], STAR_GREEK[i], STAR_LY[i]), x + r + 4, y - 4, S_HUD, al) end
                    else
                        Hud.text("NODE " .. i, x + r + 4, y - 4, col, lk > 0.99 and a or a * 0.55)
                    end
                end
            end
            if t >= 24 then
                local locked = 0
                for i = 1, 7 do if sLock(t, i) > 0.99 then locked = locked + 1 end end
                Hud.text(locked < 7 and string.format("[ STELLAR LOCK %d / 7 ]", locked) or "[ URSA MAJOR \u{b7} ARRAY LINKED ]", W / 2, 30, S_HUD, a, 1.5, 0.5)
            end
            return
        end
        for i = 1, 7 do
            local s = t - sLand(i)
            if s >= 0 and s < 14 then
                local al = a * math.clamp(1 - (s - 10) / 4, 0, 1)
                local jx = s < 5 and math.floor(math.sin(t * 91) * 5) or 0
                Hud.text("IMPACT " .. i .. " \u{b7} " .. STAR_NAMES[i], W / 2 + jx, H / 2 - 80, S_HUD, al, 3, 0.5)
                Hud.text(string.format("%s URSAE MAJORIS \u{b7} %d LY \u{b7} CRATER \u{d8}%d", STAR_GREEK[i], STAR_LY[i], math.floor(nodes[i].radius * 2)), W / 2, H / 2 - 46, S_DIM, al, 1.25, 0.5)
            end
        end
        if t >= 290 and t < 398 then
            for i = 1, 7 do Hud.fill(W / 2 - 70 + (i - 1) * 20, H - 40, W / 2 - 58 + (i - 1) * 20, H - 36, t >= sLand(i) and S_HUD or S_DIM, t >= sLand(i) and a or a * 0.55) end
        end
        if t >= 398 and t < 440 then Hud.text(string.format("[ LINK %d / 7 ]", math.clamp(math.floor((t - 398) / 5) + 1, 0, 7)), W / 2, 30, WHITE, a, 2, 0.5) end
        if t >= 470 then
            local al = a * math.clamp((t - 470) / 10, 0, 1)
            Hud.text("[ CONSTELLATION BURNED ]", W / 2, H - 64, S_HUD, al, 2, 0.5)
            Hud.text(string.format("URSA MAJOR \u{b7} 7 STARS \u{b7} 7 LINES \u{b7} %d BLOCKS", math.floor(360 * c.I)), W / 2, H - 40, S_DIM, al, 1.25, 0.5)
        end
    end
    -- client.fx.l.a(GuiGraphics): the plain HUD near the figure.
    local function starsPlainHud(c, t, W, H)
        if t < 9 or t >= 480 then return end
        local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
        local root = ctx and ctx.root
        if not root or (root.Position - nearestNode(c, root.Position)).Magnitude / B > 300 * c.I then return end
        if t < 290 then
            local a = 0.55 + 0.45 * (1 - sCountdown(t) % 1)
            Hud.text("[ STELLAR STRIKE INBOUND \u{b7} 7 NODES ]", W / 2, 26, S_HUD, a, 1.5, 0.5)
            Hud.text("T-" .. fmt2((290 - t) / 20), W / 2, 44, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 1, 1.25, 0.5)
        else
            local landed = 0
            for i = 1, 7 do if t >= sLand(i) then landed = landed + 1 end end
            local text = landed < 7 and string.format("STAR %d / 7 \u{b7} %s", landed, STAR_NAMES[math.max(landed, 1)]) or (t < 440 and "LINKING" or "CONSTELLATION BURNED")
            Hud.text("[ " .. text .. " ]", W / 2, 26, rgb(12101887), 1, 1.5, 0.5)
        end
    end

    return {tick = starsTick, render = starsRender, grade = starsGrade, filmGrade = starsFilmGrade, filmHud = starsFilmHud, plainHud = starsPlainHud}
    end)()
    -- The Shooting Star Addition 1.5.1 (adamko_10): shared pieces of SA-01 Halley and SA-02 Luna ------------------------------
    -- GlowBatch (client.render.GlowBatch + halley_glow.fsh): additive light as Beams (billboards, ribbons, columns, rects) and
    -- lit ground decals (flat, wall); HalleySky (halley_sky.fsh): a dome of the shader's own sky round the camera.
    local ADD = (function()
        local DOME_R = 1900
        local Terrain = workspace.Terrain
        local assets = {}
        local function img(file)
            local a = assets[file]
            if a == nil then
                a = false
                pcall(function()
                    local path = FOLDER .. "/film/addition/" .. file
                    if isfile and isfile(path) then a = getcustomasset(path) end
                end)
                assets[file] = a
            end
            return a or nil
        end
        local colours = {}
        local function C(n)
            local c = colours[n]
            if not c then c = Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(n / 65536) % 256, math.floor(n / 256) % 256, n % 256); colours[n] = c end
            return c
        end
        local holder
        local function root()
            if not holder or not holder.Parent then
                holder = Instance.new("Folder")
                holder.Name = "SteveAdditionLight"
                holder.Parent = workspace
            end
            return holder
        end

        -- GlowBatch ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local beams, beamN = {}, 0
        local flats, flatN = {}, 0
        local cam, camPos, camRight, camUp, camLook = nil, Vector3.zero, Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.yAxis, -Vector3.zAxis
        local function frameStart()
            cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local cf = cam.CFrame
            camPos, camRight, camUp, camLook = cf.Position, cf.RightVector, cf.UpVector, cf.LookVector
        end
        local function newBeam()
            local a0, a1 = Instance.new("Attachment"), Instance.new("Attachment")
            a0.Parent, a1.Parent = Terrain, Terrain
            local b = Instance.new("Beam")
            b.Attachment0, b.Attachment1 = a0, a1
            b.LightEmission, b.LightInfluence = 1, 0
            b.TextureMode, b.TextureLength, b.TextureSpeed = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, 1, 0
            b.FaceCamera = true
            b.Segments = 1
            b.Parent = root()
            return {beam = b, a0 = a0, a1 = a1, cache = {}}
        end
        local function setp(o, k, v) if o.cache[k] ~= v then o.cache[k] = v; o.beam[k] = v end end
        -- Positions are studs. Light further than the dome is pulled in (GlowBatch.vertex: maxDistance).
        local function clampFar(p, size)
            local d = p - camPos
            local m = d.Magnitude
            local far = DOME_R * 0.9
            if m > far then local k = far / m; return camPos + d * k, size * k end
            return p, size
        end
        local function beam(p0, p1, w0, w1, shape, variant, rgb, strength, segs, c0, c1)
            if strength <= 0.003 then return end
            local tex = img("glow_" .. shape .. "_" .. variant .. ".png") or img("glow_" .. shape .. "_0.png")
            if not tex then return end
            beamN = beamN + 1
            local o = beams[beamN]
            if not o then o = newBeam(); beams[beamN] = o end
            local dir = p1 - p0
            local axis = dir.Magnitude > 1e-6 and dir.Unit or camRight
            local upv = math.abs(axis:Dot(camLook)) < 0.99 and camLook or camUp
            o.a0.WorldCFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(p0, c0 and c0.Unit or axis, upv)
            o.a1.WorldCFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(p1, c1 and c1.Unit or axis, upv)
            setp(o, "Enabled", true)
            setp(o, "Texture", tex)
            setp(o, "Width0", w0)
            setp(o, "Width1", w1)
            setp(o, "Segments", segs or 1)
            setp(o, "CurveSize0", c0 and c0.Magnitude or 0)
            setp(o, "CurveSize1", c1 and c1.Magnitude or 0)
            setp(o, "Color", ColorSequence.new(C(rgb)))
            local s = math.min(1, strength)
            setp(o, "Transparency", NumberSequence.new(1 - s))
            setp(o, "Brightness", math.max(1, strength) * 1.4)
        end
        local G = {}
        -- the "light" batch is drawn over the world (GLARE): its quads are pulled to just in front of the eye.
        local function near(p, size, glare)
            if glare then
                local d = p - camPos
                local m = d.Magnitude
                if m > 3 then local k = 3 / m; return camPos + d * k, size * k end
                return p, size
            end
            return clampFar(p, size)
        end
        function G.billboard(p, size, shape, variant, rgb, strength, rotation, glare)
            if strength <= 0.003 then return end
            p, size = near(p, size, glare)
            local c, s = math.cos(rotation or 0), math.sin(rotation or 0)
            local a = camRight * c + camUp * s
            beam(p - a * size, p + a * size, size * 2, size * 2, shape, variant, rgb, strength)
        end
        function G.pulled(p, pull, size, shape, variant, rgb, strength, rotation)
            local view = p - camPos
            local d = view.Magnitude
            if d < 0.001 then return end
            local nearD = math.max(d - pull, math.min(d, 6 * B))
            local k = nearD / d
            G.billboard(camPos + view * k, size * k, shape, variant, rgb, strength, rotation)
        end
        function G.rect(p, hw, hh, shape, variant, rgb, strength, glare)
            if strength <= 0.003 then return end
            local k = 1
            local q = p
            q, k = near(p, 1, glare)
            beam(q - camRight * hw * k, q + camRight * hw * k, hh * 2 * k, hh * 2 * k, shape, variant, rgb, strength)
        end
        -- ribbon(head, tail, bend): head + axis k + bend k^2 as a Bezier beam, widths head..tail (each side).
        function G.ribbon(head, tail, bend, w0, w1, shape, variant, rgb, strength)
            if strength <= 0.003 then return end
            local h, k0 = clampFar(head, 1)
            local t, k1 = clampFar(tail + bend, 1)
            local axis = (tail - head)
            -- the quadratic's cubic control points
            local c1 = head + axis / 3
            local c2 = head + axis * 2 / 3 + bend / 3
            local s = (h - head).Magnitude > 1 and k0 or 1
            beam(h, t, w0 * 2 * k0, w1 * 2 * k1, shape, variant, rgb, strength, 10, (c1 - head) * s, (tail + bend - c2) * k1)
        end
        function G.column(base, height, hw, shape, variant, rgb, strength)
            if strength <= 0.003 then return end
            local top = base + Vector3.new(0, height, 0)
            local b, k = clampFar(base, 1)
            local t = clampFar(top, 1)
            -- columns are drawn bottom (u = 0) to top, like the quad's a axis
            beam(b, t, hw * 2 * k, hw * 2 * k, shape, variant, rgb, strength)
        end
        -- ground decals: a thin part with the shape on its top face (the light of the quad, lit, not added).
        local function newFlat()
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow, p.Transparency = true, false, false, false, false, 1
            p.Size = Vector3.new(1, 0.05, 1)
            p.Parent = root()
            local guis = {}
            for _, face in ipairs({Enum.NormalId.Top, Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.NormalId.Back}) do
                local g = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
                g.Face, g.LightInfluence, g.Brightness, g.AlwaysOnTop = face, 0, 2, false
                g.SizingMode, g.CanvasSize = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize, Vector2.new(256, 256)
                g.Adornee = p
                g.Parent = p
                local i = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                i.BackgroundTransparency, i.Size = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                i.Parent = g
                guis[face.Name] = {gui = g, image = i}
            end
            return {part = p, guis = guis, cache = {}}
        end
        local function flatTake()
            flatN = flatN + 1
            local o = flats[flatN]
            if not o then o = newFlat(); flats[flatN] = o end
            return o
        end
        local function dress(o, faceName, shape, variant, rgb, strength)
            for name, g in pairs(o.guis) do
                local on = name == faceName or (faceName == "Wall" and name ~= "Top")
                if g.on ~= on then g.on = on; g.gui.Enabled = on end
                if on then
                    local tex = img("glow_" .. shape .. "_" .. variant .. ".png") or img("glow_" .. shape .. "_0.png") or ""
                    if g.tex ~= tex then g.tex = tex; g.image.Image = tex end
                    local c = C(rgb)
                    if g.col ~= c then g.col = c; g.image.ImageColor3 = c end
                    local tr = 1 - math.min(1, strength)
                    if g.tr ~= tr then g.tr = tr; g.image.ImageTransparency = tr end
                    local br = math.max(1, strength) * 2
                    if g.br ~= br then g.br = br; g.gui.Brightness = br end
                end
            end
        end
        local flatParts, flatCFs = {}, {}
        function G.flat(centre, axis, halfAlong, halfAcross, shape, variant, rgb, strength)
            if strength <= 0.003 then return end
            local a = Vector3.new(axis.X, 0, axis.Z)
            if a.Magnitude < 1e-6 then return end
            a = a.Unit
            local o = flatTake()
            local size = Vector3.new(math.min(2048, halfAlong * 2), 0.05, math.min(2048, halfAcross * 2))
            if o.cache.size ~= size then o.cache.size = size; o.part.Size = size end
            flatParts[#flatParts + 1], flatCFs[#flatCFs + 1] = o.part, CFrame.fromMatrix(centre, -a, Vector3.yAxis)
            dress(o, "Top", shape, variant, rgb, strength)
        end
        function G.wall(a, b, height, shape, variant, rgb, strength)
            if strength <= 0.003 then return end
            local d = b - a
            if d.Magnitude < 1e-3 then return end
            local o = flatTake()
            local size = Vector3.new(math.min(2048, d.Magnitude), math.min(2048, height), 0.05)
            if o.cache.size ~= size then o.cache.size = size; o.part.Size = size end
            local mid = (a + b) / 2 + Vector3.new(0, height / 2, 0)
            flatParts[#flatParts + 1], flatCFs[#flatCFs + 1] = o.part, CFrame.fromMatrix(mid, d.Unit, Vector3.yAxis)
            dress(o, "Wall", shape, variant, rgb, strength)
        end
        function G.screenAngle(at, direction)
            local view = at - camPos
            local f = view.Magnitude < 1e-6 and camLook or view.Unit
            local flat = direction - f * direction:Dot(f)
            return math.atan2(flat:Dot(camUp), flat:Dot(camRight)) - math.pi / 2
        end
        function G.camera() return camPos end

        -- HalleySky: the dome -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local FACES = {
            px = {Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)}, nx = {Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)},
            pz = {Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)}, nz = {Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)},
            py = {Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)}, ny = {Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)},
        }
        local LAYERS = {{"night", 128}, {"veil", 128}, {"stars", 1024}, {"aurora", 384}}
        local dome
        local function buildDome()
            dome = {parts = {}, layers = {}, palette = -1}
            local f = Instance.new("Folder"); f.Name = "SteveAdditionSky"; f.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
            dome.folder = f
            for name, fv in pairs(FACES) do
                for qi = 0, 3 do
                    local qu, qv = qi % 2 == 0 and -1 or 1, qi < 2 and -1 or 1
                    local p = Instance.new("Part")
                    p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow, p.Transparency = true, false, false, false, false, 1
                    p.Size = Vector3.new(DOME_R, DOME_R, 1)
                    p.Parent = f
                    local g = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
                    g.Face, g.LightInfluence, g.Brightness, g.AlwaysOnTop = Enum.NormalId.Back, 0, 1, false
                    g.SizingMode, g.CanvasSize, g.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize, Vector2.new(512, 512), Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
                    g.Adornee = p
                    g.Parent = f
                    for li, l in ipairs(LAYERS) do
                        local i = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                        i.BackgroundTransparency, i.Size, i.ZIndex, i.ImageTransparency = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), li, 1
                        local half = l[2] / 2
                        i.ImageRectOffset, i.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new((qu + 1) / 2 * half, (qv + 1) / 2 * half), Vector2.new(half, half)
                        i.Parent = g
                        dome.layers[#dome.layers + 1] = {image = i, layer = l[1], face = name}
                    end
                    local fl = Instance.new("Frame")
                    fl.Size, fl.BorderSizePixel, fl.BackgroundColor3, fl.BackgroundTransparency, fl.ZIndex = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 0, Color3.new(0.85, 0.95, 1), 1, 10
                    fl.Parent = g
                    dome.layers[#dome.layers + 1] = {frame = fl, layer = "flash"}
                    dome.parts[#dome.parts + 1] = {part = p, c = fv[1], u = fv[2], v = fv[3], qu = qu, qv = qv}
                end
            end
            local function board(name, file)
                local a = Instance.new("Part")
                a.Anchored, a.CanCollide, a.CanQuery, a.CanTouch, a.Transparency, a.Size = true, false, false, false, 1, Vector3.one
                a.Parent = f
                local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                bb.LightInfluence, bb.AlwaysOnTop, bb.Adornee = 0, false, a
                bb.Parent = f
                local i = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                i.BackgroundTransparency, i.Size, i.Image, i.ImageTransparency = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), img(file) or "", 1
                i.Parent = bb
                dome[name] = {anchor = a, gui = bb, image = i}
            end
            board("halo", "halo.png")
            board("comet", "comet_light.png")
        end
        local best, bestStrength, frameId = nil, 0, -1
        local Sky = {}
        -- look = SkyLook (halley_sky): night, stars, aurora, veil, halo, flash, cometDir, cometGlow, cometHeat, darkLand, palette
        function Sky.submit(look)
            local id = math.floor(os.clock() * 240)
            local strength = (1 - (1 - look.night) * (1 - look.veil * 0.75)) + look.flash + look.aurora * 0.2 + look.cometGlow * 0.1
            if id ~= frameId then frameId, best, bestStrength = id, nil, 0 end
            if strength >= bestStrength then best, bestStrength = look, strength end
            Sky.pending = true
        end
        local function setT(o, k, v) if o[k] ~= v then o[k] = v end end
        function Sky.apply()
            local look = Sky.pending and best or nil
            Sky.pending = false
            if not look then
                if dome then dome.folder.Parent = nil end
                return 0
            end
            if not dome then buildDome() end
            dome.folder.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local c = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
            local parts, cfs = {}, {}
            for _, q in ipairs(dome.parts) do
                local centre = c + q.c * DOME_R + q.u * (q.qu * DOME_R / 2) + q.v * (q.qv * DOME_R / 2)
                parts[#parts + 1], cfs[#cfs + 1] = q.part, CFrame.fromMatrix(centre, q.u, -q.v)
            end
            workspace:BulkMoveTo(parts, cfs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
            if dome.palette ~= look.palette then
                dome.palette = look.palette
                for _, l in ipairs(dome.layers) do
                    if l.image then
                        local file = (l.layer == "night" or l.layer == "veil") and ("sky_" .. l.layer .. look.palette .. "_" .. l.face .. ".png") or ("sky_" .. l.layer .. "_" .. l.face .. ".png")
                        l.image.Image = img(file) or ""
                    end
                end
            end
            local vals = {night = 1 - look.night, veil = 1 - look.veil * 0.75, stars = 1 - math.min(1, look.stars), aurora = 1 - math.min(1, look.aurora)}
            local flashT = 1 - math.min(1, look.flash * 0.9)
            for _, l in ipairs(dome.layers) do
                if l.image then setT(l.image, "ImageTransparency", vals[l.layer]) else setT(l.frame, "BackgroundTransparency", flashT) end
            end
            local function board(b, dir, span, alpha, colour)
                local d = DOME_R * 0.85
                b.anchor.Position = c + dir * d
                local s = 2 * math.tan(span) * d
                b.gui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(s, s)
                b.image.ImageTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1)
                if colour then b.image.ImageColor3 = colour end
            end
            local light = Lighting:GetSunDirection()
            local lightUp = math.clamp((light.Y + 0.05) / 0.15, 0, 1)
            lightUp = lightUp * lightUp * (3 - 2 * lightUp)
            board(dome.halo, light, 0.75, look.halo * lightUp, nil)
            local heat = math.clamp(look.cometHeat, 0, 1)
            board(dome.comet, look.cometDir, 0.9, look.cometGlow, Color3.new(0.32, 0.72, 1):Lerp(Color3.new(1, 0.7, 0.4), heat))
            return look.darkLand
        end

        local A = {}
        A.img, A.C, A.Glow, A.Sky = img, C, G, Sky
        local stepping = false
        -- Every frame after the casts have drawn: hide the light not drawn, place the sky.
        function A.beginFrame() frameStart(); beamN, flatN = 0, 0; flatParts, flatCFs = {}, {} end
        function A.endFrame()
            for i = beamN + 1, #beams do local o = beams[i]; if o.cache.Enabled ~= false then o.cache.Enabled = false; o.beam.Enabled = false end end
            for i = flatN + 1, #flats do
                local o = flats[i]
                for _, g in pairs(o.guis) do if g.on then g.on = false; g.gui.Enabled = false end end
            end
            if #flatParts > 0 then workspace:BulkMoveTo(flatParts, flatCFs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged) end
            return Sky.apply()
        end
        function A.clear()
            for _, o in ipairs(beams) do o.beam:Destroy(); o.a0:Destroy(); o.a1:Destroy() end
            for _, o in ipairs(flats) do o.part:Destroy() end
            beams, flats, beamN, flatN = {}, {}, 0, 0
            if holder then holder:Destroy(); holder = nil end
            if dome then dome.folder:Destroy(); dome = nil end
        end
        return A
    end)()
    -- SA-01 Halley (The Shooting Star Addition: HalleyPlan, world.HalleyStrike, client.HalleyFx / HalleyHud,
    -- render.CometVisuals / CometExtras / GroundMarks, film.HalleyStoryboard). A comet comes in low over the horizon in
    -- front of the caster, touches down beyond the mark, ploughs a trench toward it and detonates on it.
    local HALLEY = (function()
        local ICE, PALE, WHITE, ION, DUST, HEAT, FROST, VAPOUR = 7334143, 14875647, 16777215, 5222143, 13231871, 16767408, 11858175, 8825289
        local Glow = ADD.Glow
        local function V(x, y, z) return Vector3.new(x, y, z) end
        local function S(v) return v * B end          -- blocks -> studs
        local function smooth(x) x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1); return x * x * (3 - 2 * x) end
        local function frac(x) return x - math.floor(x) end
        local function surface(x, z, fallback)         -- blocks
            local y = groundAt(x * B, z * B, nil)
            return y and y / B or fallback
        end
        local function hashN(seed, a, b)
            local h = (seed * 0.000131 + a * 12.9898 + b * 78.233)
            return frac(math.sin(h) * 43758.5453)
        end

        -- HalleyPlan -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local function newPlan(c)
            local P = {}
            local s = math.clamp(c.power or 1, 0.1, 10)
            local function sc(v, m) return math.max(m, math.floor(v * s + 0.5)) end
            P.scale = s
            P.trenchLength, P.trenchWidth, P.depthT = sc(240, 3), sc(30, 2), sc(22, 1)
            P.craterRadius, P.craterDepth, P.blastReach = sc(56, 3), sc(24, 2), 2.6
            P.carve, P.heart, P.rays = true, true, true
            P.seed = c.seed
            local origin = casterPos(c) / B
            local target = c.T / B
            P.origin, P.target = origin, target
            local flat = V(target.X - origin.X, 0, target.Z - origin.Z)
            if flat.Magnitude < 1 then flat = V(c.face.X, 0, c.face.Z) end
            P.dir = flat.Unit
            P.side = V(-P.dir.Z, 0, P.dir.X)
            local tdx, tdz = target.X + P.dir.X * P.trenchLength, target.Z + P.dir.Z * P.trenchLength
            P.touchdownGround = surface(tdx, tdz, target.Y)
            P.touchdown = V(tdx, P.touchdownGround, tdz)
            P.sideSign = (math.floor(P.seed / 128) % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1
            local sideRad = math.rad(26) * P.sideSign
            local across = P.dir * math.cos(sideRad) + P.side * math.sin(sideRad)
            local descent = math.rad(13.5)
            P.incoming = V(across.X * math.cos(descent), math.sin(descent), across.Z * math.cos(descent)).Unit
            P.impact = 300 + math.max(1, math.ceil(P.trenchLength / (8 * s)))
            P.duration = P.impact + 196
            P.phase = {}
            for i = 0, 5 do P.phase[i] = (math.floor(P.seed / 2 ^ (i * 9)) % 6283) / 1000 end
            function P.approach(t) return math.clamp((t - 30) / 270, 0, 1) end
            function P.distanceToGo(t) return 4600 * (1 - P.approach(t) ^ 2.35) end
            function P.ploughSpeed() return 8 * s end
            function P.ploughed(t) return math.clamp((t - 300) * P.ploughSpeed(), 0, P.trenchLength) end
            function P.frontAlong(t) return P.trenchLength - P.ploughed(t) end
            function P.groundLine(along) local k = math.clamp(along / P.trenchLength, 0, 1); return target.Y + (P.touchdownGround - target.Y) * k end
            function P.groundPoint(along) return V(target.X + P.dir.X * along, P.groundLine(along), target.Z + P.dir.Z * along) end
            local function progress(along) return 1 - math.clamp(along / P.trenchLength, 0, 1) end
            function P.trenchHalfWidth(along) return P.trenchWidth * 0.5 * (0.38 + 0.62 * math.sqrt(progress(along))) end
            function P.trenchDepth(along)
                local k = math.clamp(progress(along) / 0.55, 0, 1)
                return P.depthT * (0.22 + 0.78 * k * k * (3 - 2 * k))
            end
            function P.comet(t)
                if t <= 300 then return P.touchdown + P.incoming * P.distanceToGo(t) end
                local along = P.frontAlong(t)
                local sunk = P.carve and P.trenchDepth(along) * 0.35 or 0
                return P.groundPoint(along) + V(0, 3 - sunk, 0)
            end
            function P.heading(t) return t <= 300 and -P.incoming or -P.dir end
            function P.speed(t)
                if t > 300 then return t <= P.impact and P.ploughSpeed() or 0 end
                return 10810 * P.approach(t) ^ 1.35 / 270
            end
            function P.along(x, z) return (x - target.X) * P.dir.X + (z - target.Z) * P.dir.Z end
            function P.across(x, z) return (x - target.X) * P.side.X + (z - target.Z) * P.side.Z end
            function P.trenchCross(x, z)
                local along, lat = P.along(x, z), P.across(x, z)
                if along < 0 then return math.huge end
                if along > P.trenchLength then return math.sqrt((along - P.trenchLength) ^ 2 + lat * lat) / P.trenchHalfWidth(P.trenchLength) end
                local hw = P.trenchHalfWidth(along) * (1 + 0.07 * math.sin(along * 0.11 + P.phase[0]) + 0.04 * math.sin(along * 0.29 + P.phase[1]))
                return math.abs(lat) / hw
            end
            function P.trenchFloor(x, z)
                local cross = P.trenchCross(x, z)
                if cross > 1 then return nil end
                local along = math.clamp(P.along(x, z), 0, P.trenchLength)
                local lat = P.across(x, z)
                local bowl = math.max(0, 1 - cross * cross) ^ 0.65
                local grooves = 1.1 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(lat * 0.9 + P.phase[2])) * bowl
                return math.floor(P.groundLine(along) - 1 - P.trenchDepth(along) * bowl - grooves)
            end
            function P.craterK(x, z)
                local a, l = P.along(x, z) / 1.18, P.across(x, z)
                local ang = math.atan2(l, a)
                local edge = P.craterRadius * (1 + 0.05 * math.sin(5 * ang + P.phase[3]) + 0.025 * math.sin(11 * ang + P.phase[4]))
                return math.sqrt(a * a + l * l) / edge
            end
            function P.craterRim(theta)
                local edge = P.craterRadius * (1 + 0.05 * math.sin(5 * theta + P.phase[3]) + 0.025 * math.sin(11 * theta + P.phase[4]))
                local along, across = 1.18 * edge * math.cos(theta), edge * math.sin(theta)
                return V(target.X + P.dir.X * along + P.side.X * across, target.Y, target.Z + P.dir.Z * along + P.side.Z * across)
            end
            function P.trenchFloorY(along) local base = P.groundLine(along) - 1; return P.carve and base - P.trenchDepth(along) + 1 or base + 1 end
            function P.craterFloor(x, z)
                local k = P.craterK(x, z)
                if k > 1 then return nil end
                return math.floor(target.Y - 1 - P.craterDepth * (1 - k * k) * (1 - 0.3 * k * k))
            end
            function P.inScar(x, z, margin)
                if P.craterK(x, z) * P.craterRadius <= P.craterRadius + margin then return true end
                local along = P.along(x, z)
                if along < -margin or along > P.trenchLength + P.trenchHalfWidth(P.trenchLength) + margin then return false end
                local hw = P.trenchHalfWidth(math.clamp(along, 0, P.trenchLength))
                return P.trenchCross(x, z) * hw <= hw + margin
            end
            function P.hash(x, z) return hashN(P.seed, x, z) end
            return P
        end

        -- CometVisuals' fixed directions and the heart -------------------------------------------------------------------
        local function newVisuals(P)
            local Vs = {}
            Vs.size = P.scale
            Vs.tailSize = math.sqrt(P.scale)
            local upv = V(0, 1, 0)
            local out = P.side * P.sideSign
            Vs.ionDir = (P.incoming * 0.35 + upv * 0.75 + out * 0.55).Unit
            Vs.ionDir2 = (Vs.ionDir + out * 0.08 + upv * -0.05).Unit
            Vs.dustDir = (Vs.ionDir * 0.75 + P.incoming * 0.65).Unit
            Vs.dustBend = (P.incoming - Vs.ionDir).Unit * 260
            Vs.spin = (P.seed % 1024) / 1023 * math.pi
            Vs.entryDistance = P.distanceToGo(250)
            local floor = P.craterFloor(math.floor(P.target.X), math.floor(P.target.Z)) or (P.target.Y - P.craterDepth)
            Vs.heartSize = math.max(0.5, P.craterRadius / 56)
            Vs.heartBase = V(math.floor(P.target.X) + 0.5, floor + 0.5, math.floor(P.target.Z) + 0.5)
            local length = 26 * Vs.heartSize
            Vs.heartTip = Vs.heartBase + V(math.sin(0.08) * length, math.cos(0.08) * length, 0)
            Vs.heart = Vs.heartBase + V(0, 12 * Vs.heartSize, 0)
            return Vs
        end

        -- GroundMarks ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local function newMarks(P)
            local M = {}
            local function on(x, z, fb) return V(x, surface(x, z, fb) + 0.07, z) end
            M.mark = on(P.target.X, P.target.Z, P.target.Y)
            M.rim, M.rimAngle = {}, {}
            for i = 0, 95 do
                local th = i * math.pi * 2 / 96
                local p = P.craterRim(th)
                M.rim[i + 1], M.rimAngle[i + 1] = on(p.X, p.Z, P.target.Y), th
            end
            M.chev, M.chevAlong = {}, {}
            local n = math.max(1, math.floor((P.trenchLength - 8) / 14) + 1)
            for i = 0, n - 1 do
                local along = 8 + i * 14
                local p = P.groundPoint(along)
                M.chev[i + 1], M.chevAlong[i + 1] = on(p.X, p.Z, p.Y), along
            end
            M.left, M.right, M.edgeAlong = {}, {}, {}
            for i = 0, math.floor(P.trenchLength / 6) do
                local along = i * 6
                local p = P.groundPoint(along)
                local hw = P.trenchHalfWidth(along)
                M.left[i + 1] = on(p.X + P.side.X * hw, p.Z + P.side.Z * hw, p.Y)
                M.right[i + 1] = on(p.X - P.side.X * hw, p.Z - P.side.Z * hw, p.Y)
                M.edgeAlong[i + 1] = along
            end
            M.touchdown = on(P.touchdown.X, P.touchdown.Z, P.touchdown.Y)
            return M
        end

        -- CometExtras ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local function newExtras(P)
            local r = Random.new(P.seed + 104376)
            local E = {fragments = {}, shards = {}, cracks = {}, sparkLife = {}, sparkDrift = {}}
            local function gauss() return math.sqrt(-2 * math.log(math.max(1e-9, r:NextNumber()))) * math.cos(2 * math.pi * r:NextNumber()) end
            for i = 1, 9 do
                local split = 200 + r:NextNumber() * 75
                local lead = -4 + r:NextNumber() * 6
                local burst = math.min(split + 10 + r:NextNumber() * 20, 296 - math.max(lead, 0))
                local sideways = (r:NextNumber() < 0.5 and 1 or -1) * (6 + r:NextNumber() * 9)
                burst = math.max(burst, split + 6)
                local room = P.comet(math.min(burst + lead, 300)).Y - (P.touchdownGround + 35)
                local down = math.max(-4 + r:NextNumber() * 5, -math.max(0, room) / (burst - split))
                E.fragments[i] = {split = split, burst = burst, lead = lead, drift = P.side * sideways + V(0, down, 0), size = 3 + r:NextNumber() * 4}
            end
            for i = 1, 44 do
                E.sparkLife[i] = 10 + r:NextNumber() * 10
                E.sparkDrift[i] = V(gauss(), gauss() * 0.7, gauss()) * (1.2 + r:NextNumber() * 2.5)
            end
            local radius = P.craterRadius
            for i = 1, 30 do
                local angle = r:NextNumber() * math.pi * 2
                local from = math.sqrt(r:NextNumber()) * radius * 0.35
                local launch = P.target + V(math.cos(angle) * from, 2 + r:NextNumber() * 4, math.sin(angle) * from)
                local heading = angle + gauss() * 0.3
                local out = 0.9 + r:NextNumber() * 1.8
                local upv = 1.6 + r:NextNumber() * 2
                local drop = launch.Y - (P.target.Y - 1)
                E.shards[i] = {launchAt = P.impact + r:NextNumber() * 5, launch = launch, vel = V(math.cos(heading) * out, upv, math.sin(heading) * out),
                    flight = (upv + math.sqrt(upv * upv + 0.16 * drop)) / 0.08, size = 0.8 + r:NextNumber() * 1.6, spin = r:NextNumber() * math.pi}
            end
            local made, tries = 0, 0
            while made < 13 and tries < 52 do
                tries = tries + 1
                local angle = r:NextNumber() * math.pi * 2
                local deg = (math.deg(angle) + 180) % 360 - 180
                if math.abs(deg) >= 32 then
                    local bends = {}
                    for k = 1, 9 do bends[k] = gauss() * 0.32 end
                    made = made + 1
                    E.cracks[made] = {angle = angle, length = radius * (0.7 + r:NextNumber() * 1.1), bends = bends, width = 0.35 + r:NextNumber() * 0.35}
                end
            end
            return E
        end
        local function fragAt(P, f, t)
            local k = math.clamp(t, f.split, f.burst)
            return P.comet(math.min(k + f.lead, 300)) + f.drift * (k - f.split)
        end
        local function shardAt(s, a) return s.launch + V(s.vel.X * a, s.vel.Y * a - 0.04 * a * a, s.vel.Z * a) end

        -- The cast -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local function setup(c)
            if c.H then return c.H end
            local P = newPlan(c)
            local H = {P = P, Vs = newVisuals(P), E = newExtras(P), later = {}, cells = {}, rand = Random.new(c.seed)}
            local day = Lighting.ClockTime
            H.toNight = (day >= 19.5 or day < 5.5) and 0 or 1
            c.H = H
            return H
        end
        local function camB() return workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position / B end
        local function nearPt(camera, centre, radius)
            local flat = V(camera.X - centre.X, 0, camera.Z - centre.Z)
            local d = flat.Magnitude
            local p = d < 0.001 and centre or centre + flat * (math.min(d, radius) / d)
            return V(p.X, centre.Y + math.clamp(camera.Y - centre.Y, 0, 60), p.Z)
        end
        local function skyPt(camera, source)
            local d = source - camera
            local l = d.Magnitude
            return l < 96 and source or camera + d * (96 / l)
        end
        local function window(t, a, b, c2, d) return math.clamp((t - a) / math.max(b - a, 0.001), 0, 1) * (1 - math.clamp((t - c2) / math.max(d - c2, 0.001), 0, 1)) end
        local function proximity(camera, at, range) return math.clamp(1 - (camera - at).Magnitude / range, 0.15, 1) end

        -- sounds: in the film they play flat at full volume, outside it they sound from where they happen
        local function snd(c, name, at, volume, pitch)
            local film = c.filmOn
            local s
            if film then s = play(name, nil, math.min(1, volume), pitch or 1)
            else s = play(name, S(at), volume, pitch or 1) end
            if s then c.sounds = c.sounds or {}; c.sounds[#c.sounds + 1] = s end
            return s
        end
        local function boom(c, H, name, source, ear, volume, shake, range)
            local camera = camB()
            local delay = c.filmOn and 0 or math.floor(math.min(30, (camera - source).Magnitude / 17))
            local function go()
                snd(c, name, ear, volume)
                if range == math.huge then addShake(shake) else shakeAt(S(source), shake, range) end
            end
            if delay <= 0 then go() else H.later[#H.later + 1] = {at = c.tick - 1 + delay, run = go} end
        end
        local function emit(kind, at, vel, opts)
            local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
            local fx = ctx and ctx.world and ctx.world.effects
            if fx and fx.emit then pcall(fx.emit, kind, S(at), vel * B, opts) end
        end
        -- HalleyFx.burst: explosion emitters, thrown ground, clouds, snow and sparks (a share of the Java counts).
        local function burst(H, at, radius, size)
            local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
            local fx = ctx and ctx.world and ctx.world.effects
            local r = H.rand
            local function g(s) return (r:NextNumber() - 0.5) * 2 * s end
            for _ = 1, 3 do if fx and fx.explosion then pcall(fx.explosion, S(at + V(g(radius * 0.3), 2, g(radius * 0.3)))) end end
            for _ = 1, math.floor(30 * size) do
                local a = r:NextNumber() * math.pi * 2
                local d = math.sqrt(r:NextNumber()) * radius
                local x, z = at.X + math.cos(a) * d, at.Z + math.sin(a) * d
                local out = 0.6 + r:NextNumber() * 1.4 * math.sqrt(size)
                emit("cloud", V(x, surface(x, z, at.Y) + 1, z), V(math.cos(a) * out * 0.5, 0.2 + r:NextNumber() * 0.3, math.sin(a) * out * 0.5), {life = 60, size = 0.8})
            end
            for _ = 1, math.floor(20 * size) do emit("snowflake", at + V(g(radius * 0.5), 2 + r:NextNumber() * radius * 0.4, g(radius * 0.5)), V(g(0.6), 0.3 + r:NextNumber() * 0.9, g(0.6)), {life = 60}) end
            for _ = 1, math.floor(8 * size) do emit("end_rod", at + V(g(radius * 0.3), 1, g(radius * 0.3)), V(g(0.5), 0.4 + r:NextNumber() * 0.8, g(0.5)), {life = 40, fullbright = true}) end
        end

        -- HalleyStrike: the land -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local TRENCH_CORE = {{"blue_ice", 38}, {"packed_ice", 34}, {"calcite", 16}, {"snow_block", 12}}
        local TRENCH_SLOPE = {{"packed_ice", 25}, {"snow_block", 25}, {"tuff", 20}, {"calcite", 15}, {"cobbled_deepslate", 15}}
        local TRENCH_LIP = {{"snow_block", 30}, {"tuff", 20}, {"gravel", 12}, {false, 38}}
        local CRATER_CORE = {{"blue_ice", 45}, {"packed_ice", 35}, {"calcite", 20}}
        local CRATER_BOWL = {{"packed_ice", 30}, {"snow_block", 22}, {"calcite", 18}, {"tuff", 16}, {"smooth_basalt", 14}}
        local CRATER_RIM = {{"snow_block", 32}, {"tuff", 23}, {"cobbled_deepslate", 20}, {false, 25}}
        local function pick(pal, roll)
            local total = 0
            for _, e in ipairs(pal) do total = total + e[2] end
            local acc = 0
            for _, e in ipairs(pal) do acc = acc + e[2] / total; if roll < acc then return e[1] end end
            return pal[#pal][1]
        end
        -- The scar is real blocks on the world grid (VX): one column per block, its top block from the palette.
        local function groundBlock(x, z)
            return VX.ground(mapRay(Vector3.new(S(x), 2400, S(z)), Vector3.new(0, -4000, 0)), "snow_block")
        end
        local function gridOf(x, z)
            local i, k = VX.fromBlocks(x, z)
            return math.floor(i + 0.5), math.floor(k + 0.5)
        end
        local function inCraterDisc(P, x, z)
            local R = P.craterRadius * 1.22 + 11
            return (x - P.target.X) ^ 2 + (z - P.target.Z) ^ 2 <= R * R
        end
        local function cutTrench(c, H, upTo)
            local P = H.P
            local endw = P.trenchHalfWidth(P.trenchLength)
            local total = P.trenchLength + endw
            local pieces = math.ceil(total / 32)
            H.segments = H.segments or 0
            while H.segments < pieces and H.segments * 32 - endw <= upTo do
                local far = P.trenchLength + endw - H.segments * 32
                local nearA = math.max(0, far - 32)
                local mid = (far + nearA) * 0.5
                local hw = P.trenchHalfWidth(nearA) * 1.12 + 3
                local gp = P.groundPoint(mid)
                local deepest = gp.Y - P.trenchDepth(nearA) - 4
                H.segments = H.segments + 1
                task.spawn(function()
                    local groundId = groundBlock(gp.X + P.side.X * (hw + 2), gp.Z + P.side.Z * (hw + 2))
                    carve(nil, nil, S(deepest - 2), S(gp.Y + 400), {cf = CFrame.lookAt(S(gp), S(gp + P.dir)), w = S(hw * 2), l = S(far - nearA + 2)})
                    if not SS.enabled then return end
                    local i0, i1, k0, k1 = math.huge, -math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge
                    for _, a in ipairs({nearA, far}) do
                        for _, l in ipairs({-hw, hw}) do
                            local i, k = gridOf(P.target.X + P.dir.X * a + P.side.X * l, P.target.Z + P.dir.Z * a + P.side.Z * l)
                            i0, i1, k0, k1 = math.min(i0, i), math.max(i1, i), math.min(k0, k), math.max(k1, k)
                        end
                    end
                    VX.terrain(c.folder, {i0 = i0 - 1, i1 = i1 + 1, k0 = k0 - 1, k1 = k1 + 1, budget = 900,
                        column = function(x, z)
                            local wx, wz = VX.toBlocks(x, z)
                            local rx, rz = wx - P.target.X, wz - P.target.Z
                            local a = rx * P.dir.X + rz * P.dir.Z
                            local l = rx * P.side.X + rz * P.side.Z
                            if a < nearA or a >= far or math.abs(l) > hw or inCraterDisc(P, wx, wz) then return nil end
                            local floor = P.trenchFloor(wx, wz)
                            if floor then
                                if P.heart and math.abs(P.across(wx, wz)) < 1.6 then return VX.layer(S(floor + 1)), "comet_trail" end
                                local cross = P.trenchCross(wx, wz)
                                return VX.layer(S(floor + 1)), pick(cross < 0.45 and TRENCH_CORE or (cross < 0.8 and TRENCH_SLOPE or TRENCH_LIP),
                                    P.hash(math.floor(wx / 2) * 3 + 1, math.floor(wz / 2) * 5 - 2)) or groundId
                            elseif a <= P.trenchLength then
                                -- the box cut beside the bowl: the old ground level comes back
                                return VX.layer(S(P.groundLine(a))), groundId
                            end
                        end})
                end)
            end
        end
        -- The comet's heart: spikes of comet_heart out of the crater's middle.
        local function placeHeart(c, H)
            local P, Vs = H.P, H.Vs
            local base = Vs.heartBase
            local size = Vs.heartSize
            local spikes = 6 + math.floor(P.hash(5, 9) * 3)
            local model = Instance.new("Model"); model.Name = "CometHeart"; model.Parent = c.folder
            local list, cell = {}, 1
            for s = -1, spikes - 1 do
                local yaw = s < 0 and 0 or (s + P.hash(s * 13, 7) * 0.5) / spikes * math.pi * 2
                local lean = s < 0 and 0.08 or 0.42 + P.hash(s, 31) * 0.55
                local length = (s < 0 and 26 or 9 + P.hash(s * 3, 17) * 11) * size
                local thick = (s < 0 and 3.4 or 1.7 + P.hash(s, 5) * 0.9) * size
                local axis = V(math.cos(yaw) * math.sin(lean), math.cos(lean), math.sin(yaw) * math.sin(lean))
                list[#list + 1] = {axis, length, thick + 0.45}
                cell = math.max(cell, VX.cellFor(length, thick + 0.45, 900))
            end
            local set = {}
            for _, sp in ipairs(list) do VX.spike(set, S(base), sp[1], sp[2], sp[3], 0.45, "comet_heart", cell) end
            VX.solid(model, set, cell)
            local l = Instance.new("PointLight"); l.Color, l.Range, l.Brightness = Color3.fromRGB(111, 232, 255), 60, 3
            l.Parent = anchorAt(model, S(base + V(0, 4 * size, 0)))
        end
        local function digCrater(c, H)
            local P = H.P
            local R = P.craterRadius * 1.22 + 10
            task.spawn(function()
                local groundId = groundBlock(P.target.X + R + 4, P.target.Z)
                carve(S(P.target), S(R), S(P.target.Y - P.craterDepth - 6), nil)
                if not SS.enabled then return end
                local ci, ck = gridOf(P.target.X, P.target.Z)
                local r = math.ceil(R + 2)
                local groundJ = VX.layer(S(P.target.Y))
                VX.terrain(c.folder, {i0 = ci - r, i1 = ci + r, k0 = ck - r, k1 = ck + r, budget = 4500,
                    column = function(x, z)
                        local wx, wz = VX.toBlocks(x, z)
                        local floor = P.craterFloor(wx, wz)
                        if floor then
                            local k = P.craterK(wx, wz) + (P.hash(math.floor(wx), math.floor(wz)) - 0.5) * 0.16
                            return VX.layer(S(floor + 1)), pick(k < 0.24 and CRATER_CORE or (k < 0.66 and CRATER_BOWL or CRATER_RIM),
                                P.hash(math.floor(wz / 2) * 7 + 3, math.floor(wx / 2) * 11 - 5)) or groundId
                        elseif (wx - P.target.X) ^ 2 + (wz - P.target.Z) ^ 2 <= (R + 1) ^ 2 then
                            -- the cut beyond the bowl: the old ground level comes back
                            return groundJ, groundId
                        end
                    end})
                if not SS.enabled then return end
                if P.heart then placeHeart(c, H) end
                H.craterDone = c.tick
                -- paintRays(): snow and packed ice out from the rim, like ejecta round a fresh crater
                if P.rays then
                    local rays = 12 + math.floor(P.hash(77, 3) * 6)
                    local r = P.craterRadius
                    local seen = {}
                    for i = 0, rays - 1 do
                        local angle = (i + P.hash(i, 101) * 0.7) / rays * math.pi * 2
                        local length = r * (0.55 + P.hash(i * 7, 13) * 0.75)
                        local co, si = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
                        for d = r * 1.04, r * 1.04 + length, 1 do
                            local fade = 1 - (d - r * 1.04) / length
                            local half = 0.6 + 2.4 * fade
                            if P.hash(math.floor(d), i * 17) <= 0.25 + 0.6 * fade then
                                for off = -math.floor(half), math.floor(half) do
                                    local x, z = P.target.X + co * d - si * off, P.target.Z + si * d + co * off
                                    local gi, gk = gridOf(x, z)
                                    local key = gi .. ":" .. gk
                                    if not seen[key] then
                                        seen[key] = true
                                        local y = surface(x, z, P.target.Y)
                                        VX.coat(c.folder, P.hash(gi, gk * 3) < 0.18 and "packed_ice" or "snow_block", gi, gk, S(y))
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        task.wait()
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        local function hitArea(c, test, damage)
            if damage == nil or damage >= math.huge then eraseArea(test, "shooting_star_addition.halley_wake"); return end
            local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
            if not ctx then return end
            if ctx.root and ctx.root.Parent and test(ctx.root.Position) then hurtLocal(damage) end
            local mm = ctx.world and ctx.world.gameplay and ctx.world.gameplay.mobsModule
            for _, m in ipairs(mm and mm.list or {}) do
                if not m.puppet and not m.removed and m.humanoid.Health > 0 and test(m.position) then pcall(mm.hurt, m, damage, {}) end
            end
        end
        local function throwLocal(c, at, away, push, lift, damage)
            local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
            if not (ctx and ctx.root and ctx.root.Parent) then return end
            if not CONFIG.Survival or PlayerStats.spectator then return end
            if ctx.world and ctx.world.knockback then ctx.world.knockback(away * push + V(0, lift, 0)) end
            local cap = c.damage or math.huge
            hurtLocal(math.min(damage, cap))
        end

        local function tick(c, t)
            local H = setup(c)
            local P = H.P
            local camera = camB()
            for i = #H.later, 1, -1 do local j = H.later[i]; if t >= j.at then table.remove(H.later, i); j.run() end end
            if not H.marks and t >= 9 then H.marks = newMarks(P) end
            -- HalleyFx.sounds
            if t == 0 then snd(c, "staff_select", P.origin, 0.8) end
            if t == 7 then snd(c, "staff_select", P.origin, 0.9) end
            if t == 9 then snd(c, "halley_mark", c.filmOn and P.target or nearPt(camera, P.target, P.craterRadius), 1) end
            if t == 12 then snd(c, "halley_dusk", c.filmOn and P.target or camera + V(0, 24, 0), 1.2) end
            if t == 29 then snd(c, "halley_countdown", nearPt(camera, P.target, P.craterRadius), 1) end
            if t == 30 then snd(c, "halley_sight", skyPt(camera, P.comet(t)), 1) end
            if t == 130 then H.approachSound = snd(c, "halley_approach", skyPt(camera, P.comet(t)), 1.4) end
            if t == 250 then local at = P.comet(t); boom(c, H, "halley_boom", at, skyPt(camera, at), 2, 0.3, math.huge) end
            if t == 300 then boom(c, H, "halley_touchdown", P.touchdown, nearPt(camera, P.touchdown, P.trenchHalfWidth(P.trenchLength) * 3), 2.4, 0.7, 800) end
            if t == 301 then H.ploughSound = snd(c, "halley_plough", nearPt(camera, P.comet(t), P.trenchHalfWidth(P.frontAlong(t)) * 1.5), 2) end
            if t > 300 and t < P.impact and t % 3 == 0 then shakeAt(S(P.comet(t)), 0.12, 420) end
            if t == P.impact then
                if c.filmOn then c:stopSounds() end
                boom(c, H, "halley_impact", P.target, nearPt(camera, P.target, P.craterRadius * P.blastReach), 3, 1, 1100)
            end
            if t == P.impact + 12 then snd(c, "halley_frost", nearPt(camera, P.target, P.craterRadius * 1.2), 1.4) end
            if t >= P.impact + 40 and t < P.duration - 60 and (t - P.impact - 40) % 100 == 0 then snd(c, "halley_hum", H.Vs.heart, 0.8) end
            -- the extras' bursts and the shards' landings
            for _, f in ipairs(H.E.fragments) do
                if t == math.ceil(f.burst) then
                    local at = fragAt(P, f, f.burst)
                    boom(c, H, "halley_burst", at, skyPt(camera, at), 1.4, 0.12, 900)
                    if (camera - at).Magnitude < 260 then for _ = 1, 24 do emit("firework", at, V(H.rand:NextNumber() - 0.5, H.rand:NextNumber() - 0.5, H.rand:NextNumber() - 0.5) * 1.2, {life = 30}) end end
                end
            end
            for _, s in ipairs(H.E.shards) do
                if t == math.ceil(s.launchAt + s.flight) then
                    local land = shardAt(s, s.flight)
                    local g = V(land.X, surface(land.X, land.Z, land.Y), land.Z)
                    if (camera - g).Magnitude < 160 then
                        for _ = 1, 6 do emit("snowflake", g + V(0, 0.6, 0), V(H.rand:NextNumber() - 0.5, 0.2, H.rand:NextNumber() - 0.5) * 0.4, {life = 30}) end
                        emit("cloud", g + V(0, 0.6, 0), V(0, 0.05, 0), {life = 40, size = 0.5})
                    end
                end
            end
            -- particles (HalleyFx.particles), sparse
            if (camera - P.target).Magnitude < 700 + P.trenchLength then
                if t == 9 then for i = 1, 14 do emit("end_rod", P.target + V((H.rand:NextNumber() - 0.5) * 1.2, 0.3, (H.rand:NextNumber() - 0.5) * 1.2), V(0, 0.08, 0), {life = 40, fullbright = true}) end end
                if t >= 268 and t < 300 and t % 2 == 0 then
                    local a = H.rand:NextNumber() * math.pi * 2
                    local d = math.sqrt(H.rand:NextNumber()) * 34
                    local at = V(P.touchdown.X + math.cos(a) * d, 0, P.touchdown.Z + math.sin(a) * d)
                    at = V(at.X, surface(at.X, at.Z, P.touchdown.Y) + 0.4, at.Z)
                    emit("snowflake", at, V(math.cos(a) * 0.15, 0.3, math.sin(a) * 0.15), {life = 30})
                end
                if t == 300 then
                    burst(H, P.touchdown, P.trenchHalfWidth(P.trenchLength) * 1.6, 1)
                end
                if t > 300 and t <= P.impact then
                    local head = P.comet(t)
                    for _ = 1, 4 do emit("snowflake", head + V((H.rand:NextNumber() - 0.5) * 8, 1, (H.rand:NextNumber() - 0.5) * 8), V(0, 0.4, 0), {life = 30}) end
                    emit("cloud", head + V(0, 1, 0), -P.dir * 0.3, {life = 40, size = 0.6})
                end
                if t == P.impact then burst(H, P.target, P.craterRadius, 3.2) end
                if t > P.impact and t < P.duration - 20 and t % 3 == 0 then
                    local a = H.rand:NextNumber() * math.pi * 2
                    local d = math.sqrt(H.rand:NextNumber()) * P.craterRadius * 1.6
                    emit("snowflake", P.target + V(math.cos(a) * d, 30 + H.rand:NextNumber() * 50, math.sin(a) * d), V(0, -0.15, 0), {life = 120})
                end
            end
            -- HalleyStrike.tick: the land and what stands on it
            if t == 31 and c.mine and not CONFIG.Survival then
                local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
                local me = ctx and ctx.root and ctx.root.Position / B
                if me and math.sqrt((me.X - P.target.X) ^ 2 + (me.Z - P.target.Z) ^ 2) < P.craterRadius + 20 then
                    -- StarBridge.liftClear: lift the creative caster clear of the zone, with a subtitle.
                    local away = V(me.X - P.target.X, 0, me.Z - P.target.Z)
                    away = away.Magnitude > 0.1 and away.Unit or -P.dir
                    local dest = P.target + away * (P.craterRadius + 56)
                    dest = V(dest.X, surface(dest.X, dest.Z, P.target.Y) + 1, dest.Z)
                    snd(c, "halley_evac", me, 1.2)
                    if ctx.world and ctx.world.chat and ctx.world.chat.teleport then pcall(ctx.world.chat.teleport, S(dest)) else ctx.root.CFrame = CFrame.new(S(dest) + V(0, 3, 0)) end
                    local chat = ctx.world and ctx.world.chat
                    if chat and chat.showTitle then chat.showTitle("subtitle", {{text = "EVAC // CLEAR OF THE IMPACT ZONE", color = rgb(ICE)}}); chat.showTitle("title", {{text = ""}}) end
                end
            end
            if t == 300 then
                cutTrench(c, H, 12)
                local r = P.trenchHalfWidth(P.trenchLength) + 6
                local td = P.touchdown
                hitArea(c, function(pos) local p = pos / B; return math.sqrt((p.X - td.X) ^ 2 + (p.Z - td.Z) ^ 2) <= r end, c.damage)
            end
            if t > 300 and t <= P.impact then
                local ploughed = P.ploughed(t)
                cutTrench(c, H, ploughed + 12)
                local fromA = P.trenchLength - ploughed - 4
                local toA = P.trenchLength - (H.ploughedBefore or 0) + 6
                H.ploughedBefore = ploughed
                hitArea(c, function(pos)
                    local p = pos / B
                    local along = P.along(p.X, p.Z)
                    return along >= fromA and along <= toA and P.trenchCross(p.X, p.Z) <= 1.15
                end, c.damage)
                -- the wake throws what stands beside the trench
                local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
                local me = ctx and ctx.root and ctx.root.Parent and ctx.root.Position / B
                if me and not H.wakeThrown then
                    local along, cross = P.along(me.X, me.Z), P.trenchCross(me.X, me.Z)
                    if cross > 1.15 and cross < 2.6 and math.abs(along - P.frontAlong(t)) < 18 then
                        H.wakeThrown = true
                        local lat = P.across(me.X, me.Z)
                        local k = math.clamp(1 - (cross - 1.15) / 1.45, 0, 1)
                        throwLocal(c, me, (P.side * (lat >= 0 and 1 or -1) + P.dir * -0.4).Unit, 0.9 + 1.6 * k, 0.5 + 0.7 * k, 3 + 10 * k * k)
                    end
                end
            end
            if t == P.impact then
                cutTrench(c, H, math.huge)
                digCrater(c, H)
                local r = P.craterRadius * 1.22 + 4
                hitArea(c, function(pos) local p = pos / B; return P.craterK(p.X, p.Z) <= 1.06 end, c.damage)
                H.blastBefore = P.craterRadius
            end
            if t > P.impact and t <= P.impact + 28 then
                local radius, reach = P.craterRadius, P.craterRadius * P.blastReach
                local front = radius + (reach - radius) * ((t - P.impact) / 28) ^ 0.6
                local from = H.blastBefore
                H.blastBefore = front
                local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
                local me = ctx and ctx.root and ctx.root.Parent and ctx.root.Position / B
                if me and not H.blastThrown then
                    local d = math.sqrt((me.X - P.target.X) ^ 2 + (me.Z - P.target.Z) ^ 2)
                    if d > from and d <= front then
                        H.blastThrown = true
                        local strength = 1 - (d - radius) / math.max(1, reach - radius)
                        local out = V(me.X - P.target.X, 0, me.Z - P.target.Z)
                        throwLocal(c, me, out.Magnitude > 0.01 and out.Unit or P.dir, 1 + 2.6 * strength, 0.5 + 1.1 * strength, 4 + 24 * strength * strength)
                    end
                end
                local mm = ctx and ctx.world and ctx.world.gameplay and ctx.world.gameplay.mobsModule
                for _, m in ipairs(mm and mm.list or {}) do
                    if not m.puppet and not m.removed and m.humanoid.Health > 0 then
                        local p = m.position / B
                        local d = math.sqrt((p.X - P.target.X) ^ 2 + (p.Z - P.target.Z) ^ 2)
                        if d > from and d <= front then
                            local strength = 1 - (d - radius) / math.max(1, reach - radius)
                            local out = V(p.X - P.target.X, 0, p.Z - P.target.Z)
                            m.knock = (out.Magnitude > 0.01 and out.Unit or P.dir) * (1 + 2.6 * strength) * B
                            pcall(mm.hurt, m, math.min(4 + 24 * strength * strength, c.damage or math.huge), {})
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        -- CometVisuals.draw + CometExtras.draw ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local function fadeFor(camera, at, range) return 1 - smooth(((camera - at).Magnitude - range) / 48) end
        local function dash(centre, direction, halfLength, halfThickness, rgbv, strength)
            local flat = V(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
            if flat.Magnitude < 1e-6 then return end
            local d = flat.Unit
            Glow.flat(S(centre), V(-d.Z, 0, d.X), S(halfThickness), S(halfLength), 8, 0, rgbv, strength)
        end
        local function segment(a, b, fill, ht, rgbv, strength)
            local along = b - a
            dash((a + b) / 2, along, V(along.X, 0, along.Z).Magnitude * fill * 0.5, ht, rgbv, strength)
        end
        local function render(c, t)
            local H = setup(c)
            local P, Vs = H.P, H.Vs
            if t < 0 or t > P.duration then return end
            local camera = camB()
            local film = c.filmOn and 1 or 0
            local range = 160
            local towardMark = -P.dir
            local function flat(centre, axis, ha, hc, shape, variant, rgbv, strength) Glow.flat(S(centre), axis, S(ha), S(hc), shape, variant, rgbv, strength) end
            local function bb(at, size, shape, variant, rgbv, strength, rot, glare) Glow.billboard(S(at), S(size), shape, variant, rgbv, strength, rot, glare) end
            local function rib(head, tail, bend, w0, w1, shape, variant, rgbv, strength) Glow.ribbon(S(head), S(tail), S(bend), S(w0), S(w1), shape, variant, rgbv, strength) end
            local function col(base, h, hw, shape, variant, rgbv, strength) Glow.column(S(base), S(h), S(hw), shape, variant, rgbv, strength) end
            local function rect(at, hw, hh, shape, variant, rgbv, strength, glare) Glow.rect(S(at), S(hw), S(hh), shape, variant, rgbv, strength, glare) end
            -- marks
            local M = H.marks
            if M and t >= 9 and t < P.impact + 4 then
                local since = t - 9
                local gone = 1 - smooth((t - (P.impact - 3)) / 3)
                local length = P.trenchLength
                if since < 18 then
                    local ping = smooth(since / 2) * (1 - smooth((since - 3) / 15))
                    col(M.mark, 30 + 260 * smooth(since / 5), 0.9, 3, 0, PALE, 0.9 * ping)
                    flat(M.mark, P.dir, 4 + since * 3, 4 + since * 3, 9, 0, ICE, 0.7 * (1 - smooth(since / 14)))
                end
                local reticleIn = smooth(since / 3) * gone * fadeFor(camera, M.mark, range)
                local size = 7 * (1 + 2.2 * (1 - smooth(since / 8)))
                flat(M.mark, towardMark, size, size, 6, 0, ICE, 0.95 * reticleIn)
                flat(M.mark, towardMark, 2.2, 2.2, 0, 0, PALE, 0.5 * reticleIn)
                local beat = 0.75 + 0.25 * math.sin(t * (0.25 + 0.5 * smooth((t - 150) / 150)))
                local far = reticleIn * smooth(((camera - M.mark).Magnitude - 20) / 60)
                bb(M.mark + V(0, 1.2, 0), 3.2, 0, 0, ICE, 0.8 * far * beat, 0)
                col(M.mark, 48, 0.45, 3, 0, ICE, 0.55 * far * smooth((since - 6) / 6))
                local n = #M.rim
                for i = 1, n do
                    local theta = M.rimAngle[i]
                    local fromFront = math.abs((math.deg(theta) + 180) % 360 - 180) / 180
                    local inA = smooth((since - 2 - fromFront * 10) / 3)
                    if inA > 0 then
                        local a, b = M.rim[i], M.rim[i % n + 1]
                        local run = 0.75 + 0.25 * math.sin(theta * 3 - t * 0.12)
                        segment(a, b, 0.72, 1.1, ICE, 0.95 * inA * run * gone * fadeFor(camera, a, range))
                    end
                end
                local flow = 0.025 + 0.11 * smooth((t - 150) / 150)
                local phase = (t - 9) * flow
                local ploughWhen = function(along) return 1 - smooth((t - (300 + (P.trenchLength - along) / P.ploughSpeed())) / 3) end
                for ix, at in ipairs(M.chev) do
                    local along = M.chevAlong[ix]
                    local inA = smooth((since - 4 - 30 * along / length) / 4)
                    local passed = ploughWhen(along)
                    if inA > 0 and passed > 0 then
                        local wave = frac(along / length * 2 + phase)
                        local pulse = math.exp(-((wave - 0.5) / 0.1) ^ 2)
                        local hw = P.trenchHalfWidth(along) * 0.75
                        local k = inA * passed * gone * fadeFor(camera, at, range)
                        flat(at, towardMark, hw * 0.6, hw, 5, 0, ICE, (0.45 + 0.55 * pulse) * k)
                        bb(at + V(0, 1, 0), 1.1 + 1.4 * pulse, 0, 0, pulse > 0.5 and PALE or ICE, (0.35 + 0.65 * pulse) * k, 0)
                    end
                end
                for side = 1, 2 do
                    local edge = side == 1 and M.left or M.right
                    for ix = 1, #edge - 1 do
                        local along = M.edgeAlong[ix]
                        local inA = smooth((since - 4 - 30 * along / length) / 4)
                        local passed = ploughWhen(along)
                        if inA > 0 and passed > 0 then
                            local k = inA * passed * gone * fadeFor(camera, edge[ix], range)
                            segment(edge[ix], edge[ix + 1], 0.6, 0.6, ICE, 0.7 * k)
                            if (ix - 1) % 4 == 0 then bb(edge[ix] + V(0, 0.9, 0), 1, 0, 0, ICE, 0.6 * k, 0) end
                        end
                    end
                end
                local tdIn = smooth((since - 34) / 6) * (1 - smooth((t - 300) / 2))
                if tdIn > 0 then
                    local r = P.trenchHalfWidth(length) * 1.25 / 0.86
                    local f = tdIn * fadeFor(camera, M.touchdown, range)
                    flat(M.touchdown, towardMark, r, r, 1, 1, ICE, 0.6 * f)
                    flat(M.touchdown, towardMark, 5, 5, 6, 0, PALE, 0.6 * f)
                    flat(M.touchdown, towardMark, 46, 46, 7, 0, ICE, 0.32 * smooth((t - 262) / 38) * f)
                end
            end
            -- the approach
            if t >= 30 and t <= 300 then
                local boost = 1 + 0.9 * (1 - film)
                local head = P.comet(t)
                local d = (head - camera).Magnitude
                local on = smooth((t - 30) / 30)
                local nearK = math.clamp(1 - d / 5000, 0, 1)
                local coma = math.max(30 * Vs.size, d * 0.02 * boost * Vs.tailSize)
                local nucleus = math.max(8 * Vs.size, d * 0.006 * boost * Vs.tailSize)
                local glint = math.max(36 * Vs.size, d * 0.05 * boost * Vs.tailSize)
                local tails = on * (1 - smooth((t - 240) / 35))
                if tails > 0.003 then
                    local ion = math.max(2400 * Vs.tailSize, d * 0.6)
                    local dust = math.max(1600 * Vs.tailSize, d * 0.4)
                    local bend = Vs.dustBend * (dust / 1600)
                    rib(head, head + Vs.ionDir * ion, Vector3.zero, coma * 0.6, coma * 0.6 + ion * 0.1, 3, 0, ION, 0.9 * tails)
                    rib(head, head + Vs.ionDir * ion * 0.9, Vector3.zero, coma * 0.25, coma * 0.25 + ion * 0.03, 3, 0, PALE, 0.8 * tails)
                    rib(head, head + Vs.ionDir2 * ion * 0.75, Vector3.zero, coma * 0.3, coma * 0.3 + ion * 0.05, 3, 0, ICE, 0.45 * tails)
                    rib(head, head + Vs.dustDir * dust, bend, coma * 0.9, coma * 0.9 + dust * 0.2, 3, 1, DUST, 0.6 * tails)
                end
                bb(head, coma * 2.3, 0, 0, ICE, (0.6 + 0.2 * nearK) * on, 0)
                bb(head, coma, 0, 0, PALE, 0.9 * on, 0)
                bb(head, nucleus, 0, 0, WHITE, on, 0)
                bb(head, glint, 2, 0, PALE, (0.6 + 0.35 * nearK) * on, Vs.spin + t * 0.004)
                rect(head, coma * 7, coma * 0.24, 10, 0, ION, 0.22 * on * (0.5 + 0.5 * nearK))
                local since = t - 250
                local sheath = smooth((since + 8) / 14)
                if sheath > 0 then
                    local heading = P.heading(t)
                    local angle = Glow.screenAngle(S(head), heading)
                    bb(head + heading * coma * 0.3, coma * 1.5, 4, 0, HEAT, 0.55 * sheath, angle, true)
                    bb(head, coma * 1.2, 4, 0, PALE, 0.35 * sheath, angle, true)
                    bb(head, coma * 1.8, 0, 0, HEAT, 0.4 * sheath, 0, true)
                    rect(head, coma * 12, coma * 0.35, 10, 0, HEAT, 0.35 * sheath)
                    local flown = math.max(1, Vs.entryDistance - P.distanceToGo(t))
                    local back = head + P.incoming * flown
                    rib(head, back, Vector3.zero, coma * 0.9, coma * 0.9 + flown * 0.12, 3, 1, HEAT, 0.6 * sheath)
                    rib(head, back, Vector3.zero, coma * 0.7, coma * 0.7 + flown * 0.06, 3, 2, PALE, 0.9 * sheath)
