                        if fx and fx.explosion then pcall(fx.explosion, S(P.target + V(math.cos(a) * P.restFootprint * 0.9, 2 + r:NextNumber() * P.moonRadius * 0.3, math.sin(a) * P.restFootprint * 0.9))) end
                    end
                    for _ = 1, 40 do
                        local a = r:NextNumber() * math.pi * 2
                        emit("large_smoke", P.target + V(math.cos(a) * P.restFootprint, 1, math.sin(a) * P.restFootprint), V(0, 0.3, 0), {life = 60, size = 1})
                        emit("flame", P.target + V(math.cos(a) * P.restFootprint, 1, math.sin(a) * P.restFootprint), V(math.cos(a), 0.1, math.sin(a)) * 1.2, {life = 30, fullbright = true})
                    end
                end
                if t > 330 and t <= 360 then
                    local inner = math.max(P.rimInner, P.moonRadius)
                    local front = inner + (P.blastRadius() - inner) * (1 - math.exp(-(t - 330) / 15))
                    for i = 1, 12 do
                        local a = r:NextNumber() * math.pi * 2
                        emit(i % 3 == 0 and "cloud" or "ash", P.target + V(math.cos(a) * front, 0.6 + r:NextNumber() * 3, math.sin(a) * front), V(math.cos(a) * 0.7, 0.2, math.sin(a) * 0.7), {life = 40, size = 0.8})
                    end
                end
                if t > 340 and t < 650 and t % 3 == 0 then
                    local a = r:NextNumber() * math.pi * 2
                    local d = P.footprint(t) + seamWidth(P.moonRadius) * 0.5
                    local sx, sz = P.target.X + math.cos(a) * d, P.target.Z + math.sin(a) * d
                    emit(r:NextNumber() < 0.3 and "lava" or "large_smoke", V(sx, math.min(P.target.Y, surface(sx, sz, P.target.Y)) + 0.4, sz), V(0, 0.08, 0), {life = 50, size = 0.6})
                end
            end
        end

        -- MoonVisuals.draw -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local function render(c, rt)
            local L = setup(c)
            local P = L.P
            local t = ltime(c)
            if t < 0 or t > 670 then return end
            local camera = camB()
            local function flat(centre, axis, ha, hc, shape, variant, rgbv, strength) Glow.flat(S(centre), axis, S(ha), S(hc), shape, variant, rgbv, strength) end
            local function bb(at, size, shape, variant, rgbv, strength, rot, glare) Glow.billboard(S(at), S(size), shape, variant, rgbv, strength, rot, glare) end
            local function rib(head, tail, bend, w0, w1, shape, variant, rgbv, strength) Glow.ribbon(S(head), S(tail), S(bend), S(w0), S(w1), shape, variant, rgbv, strength) end
            local function col(base, h, hw, shape, variant, rgbv, strength) Glow.column(S(base), S(h), S(hw), shape, variant, rgbv, strength) end
            local function rect(at, hw, hh, shape, variant, rgbv, strength, glare) Glow.rect(S(at), S(hw), S(hh), shape, variant, rgbv, strength, glare) end
            local r = P.moonRadius
            placeSphere(c, L, t)
            -- mark
            if t >= 10 and t <= 332 then
                local inA = smooth((t - 10) / 10) * (1 - smooth((t - 326) / 6))
                if inA > 0 then
                    local at = P.target + V(0, 0.08, 0)
                    local size = 8 * (1 + 1.6 * (1 - smooth((t - 10) / 20)))
                    flat(at, V(1, 0, 0), size, size, 6, 0, GOLD, 0.9 * inA)
                    flat(at, V(1, 0, 0), 2.4, 2.4, 0, 0, GOLD, 0.5 * inA)
                    bb(at + V(0, 1, 0), 2.6, 0, 0, GOLD, 0.6 * inA * (0.7 + 0.3 * math.sin(t * 0.3)), 0)
                    local eraseR, blastR = P.eraseRadius(), P.blastRadius()
                    local pulse = 0.65 + 0.35 * math.sin(t * 0.22)
                    local sweep = frac(t * 0.012)
                    flat(at, P.travel, eraseR, eraseR, 1, 1, GOLD, (0.75 + 0.25 * pulse) * inA)
                    flat(at, P.travel, blastR, blastR, 1, 2, FIRE, (0.55 + 0.3 * (1 - pulse)) * inA)
                    for ri, ring in ipairs({{eraseR, GOLD, 0.9, sweep}, {blastR, FIRE, 0.8, -sweep * 0.6}}) do
                        local tickL = math.max(1.5, ring[1] * 0.045)
                        for i = 0, 47 do
                            local k = i / 48
                            if frac(k * 3 + ring[4]) <= 0.5 then
                                local angle = k * math.pi * 2
                                local axis = V(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle))
                                flat(at + axis * ring[1], axis, tickL, tickL * 0.3, 8, 0, ring[2], ring[3] * inA)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local c0 = P.centre(t)
            local heading = P.heading(t)
            if t >= 30 and t < 340 then
                local steady = 1 - smooth((t - 185) / 30)
                if steady > 0.01 then
                    local nearK = fall(t)
                    bb(c0, r * 1.9, 0, 1, PALE, (0.16 + 0.12 * nearK) * steady, 0)
                    bb(c0, r * 3.2, 0, 1, CHEESE, (0.07 + 0.06 * nearK) * steady, 0)
                end
                local build = math.clamp((t - 50) / 150, 0, 1) ^ 2.2 * (1 - smooth((t - 200) / 20))
                if build > 0.01 then bb(c0 + heading * r * 0.4, r * 1.35, 4, 0, FIRE, 0.35 * build, Glow.screenAngle(S(c0), heading)) end
            end
            local dk = dustTrail(t)
            if dk > 0.01 then
                local back = -heading
                rib(c0, c0 + back * r * 10, Vector3.zero, r * 0.85, r * 2.4, 3, 1, CHEESE, 0.3 * dk)
                rib(c0, c0 + back * r * 6, Vector3.zero, r * 0.4, r * 0.9, 3, 0, PALE, 0.22 * dk)
            end
            if t >= 185 and t <= 340 then
                local b = burn(t)
                if b > 0.003 then
                    local angle = Glow.screenAngle(S(c0), heading)
                    local back = -heading
                    bb(c0 + heading * r * 0.45, r * 1.38, 4, 0, FIRE, 0.6 * b, angle, true)
                    bb(c0, r * 1.75, 0, 1, FIRE, 0.8 * b, 0)
                    bb(c0, r * 3, 0, 1, DEEP, 0.45 * b, 0)
                    local reach = r * (11 + 7 * b)
                    rib(c0, c0 + back * reach, Vector3.zero, r * 1.5, r * 3.6, 3, 1, DEEP, 0.5 * b)
                    rib(c0, c0 + back * reach * 0.8, Vector3.zero, r * 1.05, r * 2.2, 3, 2, FIRE, 0.85 * b)
                    rib(c0, c0 + back * reach * 0.55, Vector3.zero, r * 0.5, r * 0.9, 3, 0, HOT, 0.75 * b)
                    -- flames off the leading edge
                    local view = c0 - camera
                    local side = heading:Cross(view)
                    side = side.Magnitude < 1e-6 and heading:Cross(V(0, 1, 0)) or side.Unit
                    local fwd = view:Cross(side)
                    if fwd:Dot(heading) < 0 then fwd = -fwd end
                    fwd = fwd.Magnitude < 1e-9 and heading or fwd.Unit
                    for i = 0, 11 do
                        local h = P.hash(i, 26220, 1)
                        local a = ((i + 0.5) / 12 - 0.5) * math.pi * 1.7 + (h - 0.5) * 0.25
                        local out = fwd * math.cos(a) + side * math.sin(a)
                        local root = c0 + out * r * 0.97
                        local flicker = 0.65 + 0.35 * math.sin(t * (0.9 + P.hash(i, 8, 2)) + i * 1.9)
                        local length = r * (1.4 + 2.2 * P.hash(i, 16, 3)) * (0.6 + 0.6 * b) * (0.85 + 0.3 * flicker)
                        rib(root, root + back * length + out * r * 0.35, out * r * 0.25, r * 0.2, r * 0.05, 3, 2, i % 3 == 0 and HOT or FIRE, 0.65 * b * flicker)
                    end
                end
            end
            if t >= 285 and t < 336 then
                local k = smooth((t - 285) / 45)
                local out = 1 - smooth((t - 330) / 6)
                flat(P.target + V(0, 0.3, 0), P.travel, r * (0.5 + 0.9 * k), r * (0.5 + 0.9 * k), 0, 1, FIRE, 0.9 * k * k * out)
                flat(P.target + V(0, 0.35, 0), P.travel, r * (0.25 + 0.4 * k), r * (0.25 + 0.4 * k), 0, 0, HOT, 0.7 * k * k * k * out)
                local gap = math.max(0, c0.Y - r - P.target.Y)
                if gap > 0.5 then col(P.target, gap + 2, r * 0.32 * k, 3, 2, FIRE, 0.55 * k * out) end
                local blow = smooth((t - 304) / 26)
                if blow > 0 then
                    local ring = r * (0.6 + 2.4 * blow)
                    flat(P.target + V(0, 0.6, 0), P.travel, ring / 0.9, ring / 0.9, 9, 1, DUSTC, 0.55 * blow * out)
                    flat(P.target + V(0, 2.5, 0), P.travel, ring * 0.8 / 0.9, ring * 0.8 / 0.9, 9, 3, ASHC, 0.3 * blow * out)
                end
            end
            if t >= 330 then
                local a = t - 330
                local zone = P.rimCrest
                local ctr = P.target
                if a < 50 then
                    bb(ctr + V(0, zone * 0.35, 0), zone * 4.6, 0, 0, WHITE, 2.2 * math.exp(-a / 5), 0, true)
                    rect(ctr + V(0, zone * 0.35, 0), zone * 38, zone * 0.45, 10, 0, HOT, 1.7 * math.exp(-a / 7), true)
                    rect(ctr + V(0, zone * 0.2, 0), zone * 22, zone * 0.2, 10, 0, FIRE, 1.2 * math.exp(-a / 10), true)
                end
                if a < 90 then
                    local ball = math.exp(-a / 22) * smooth(a / 2)
                    local top = P.centre(t) + V(0, r * 0.35, 0)
                    bb(top, r * (1.5 + 1.6 * smooth(a / 14)), 0, 1, FIRE, 0.75 * ball, 0)
                    bb(top, r * (1 + 0.9 * smooth(a / 10)), 0, 0, HOT, 0.6 * ball, 0)
                end
                if a < 260 then
                    local height = zone * (1.4 + 5.4 * (1 - math.exp(-a / 11)))
                    col(ctr + V(0, -2, 0), height, zone * (0.3 + 0.28 * (1 - math.exp(-a / 24))), 3, 1, ASHC, 0.9 * math.exp(-a / 85))
                    col(ctr, height * 0.75, zone * 0.13, 3, 0, FIRE, 0.75 * math.exp(-a / 24))
                    if a > 6 then
                        local capR = zone * (0.5 + 1.6 * (1 - math.exp(-(a - 6) / 45)))
                        local cap = smooth((a - 6) / 20) * math.exp(-a / 120)
                        local at = ctr + V(0, height * 0.92, 0)
                        bb(at, capR, 0, 1, ASHC, 0.55 * cap, 0)
                        bb(at + V(0, -capR * 0.25, 0), capR * 0.8, 0, 1, DUSTC, 0.4 * cap, 0)
                    end
                end
                if a < 50 then
                    local reach = P.blastRadius()
                    local k = math.clamp(a / 32, 0, 1) ^ 0.6
                    local front = zone + (reach - zone) * k + math.max(0, a - 32) * 0.7
                    local s = (1 - smooth((a - 6) / 40)) * smooth(a / 1.5)
                    for i = 0, 3 do flat(ctr + V(0, 0.7 + i * 3.2, 0), P.travel, front / 0.9, front / 0.9, 9, i, HOT, s * (i == 0 and 1.1 or (i == 1 and 0.5 or (i == 2 and 0.28 or 0.14)))) end
                end
                -- jets
                if a <= 34 then
                    local from = math.max(P.footprint(t), r * 0.3)
                    local fade = math.exp(-a / 9) * smooth(a / 1.2)
                    for i = 0, 13 do
                        local angle = (i + 0.5) / 14 * math.pi * 2 + (P.hash(i, 51, 0) - 0.5) * 0.35
                        local length = r * (0.5 + 1.9 * smooth(a / 7)) * (0.65 + 0.7 * P.hash(i, 53, 1))
                        local dir = V(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle))
                        local floor = -P.craterDepth * settle(t)
                        local tail = P.target + dir * from + V(0, floor + 2, 0)
                        local head = P.target + dir * (from + length) + V(0, floor * 0.5 + 1 + r * 0.06, 0)
                        rib(tail, head, V(0, r * 0.08, 0), r * 0.16, r * 0.42, 3, 2, FIRE, 0.95 * fade)
                        rib(tail, tail + (head - tail) * 0.6, Vector3.zero, r * 0.07, r * 0.16, 3, 0, HOT, 0.8 * fade)
                    end
                end
                -- the contact line (the molten seam round the moon)
                local rf = P.footprint(t)
                local hk = heat(t) * (1 - smooth((t - 630) / 40))
                if rf >= 1 and hk >= 0.01 then
                    local core = hk > 0.65 and HOT or (hk > 0.3 and FIRE or DEEP)
                    local haze = hk > 0.45 and FIRE or (hk > 0.18 and DEEP or EMBER)
                    local seam = seamWidth(r)
                    local radius = rf + seam * 0.5
                    local count = math.max(32, math.floor(radius * math.pi * 2 / 3))
                    local floorY = P.target.Y - P.craterDepth * settle(t)
                    for i = 0, count - 1 do
                        local angle = (i + 0.5) / count * math.pi * 2
                        local radial = V(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle))
                        local at = V(P.target.X + radial.X * radius, floorY + 0.25, P.target.Z + radial.Z * radius)
                        local flicker = 0.8 + 0.2 * math.sin(t * 0.6 + i * 1.7 + P.phase[i % 6])
                        flat(at, V(-radial.Z, 0, radial.X), radius * math.pi / count * 2.2, seam * (0.7 + 0.6 * hk), 8, 0, core, 0.85 * hk * flicker)
                        if i % 2 == 0 then bb(at + V(0, 1.5 + 2.5 * hk, 0), seam * (1.8 + 2.4 * hk), 0, 1, haze, 0.5 * hk * flicker, 0) end
                    end
                end
                -- the shock wall
                if a <= 70 then
                    local inner = math.max(P.rimInner, r)
                    local front = inner + (P.blastRadius() - inner) * (1 - math.exp(-a / 15))
                    local height = r * (0.18 + 0.75 * math.exp(-a / 22))
                    local s = math.exp(-a / 24) * smooth(a / 2)
                    local count = math.max(32, math.min(96, math.floor(front * math.pi * 2 / 12)))
                    local prev
                    for i = 0, count do
                        local angle = i / count * math.pi * 2
                        local x, z = P.target.X + math.cos(angle) * front, P.target.Z + math.sin(angle) * front
                        local p = V(x, surface(x, z, P.target.Y), z)
                        if prev then
                            Glow.wall(S(prev), S(p), S(height), 11, i % 4, DUSTC, 0.75 * s)
                            Glow.wall(S(prev + V(0, -0.5, 0)), S(p + V(0, -0.5, 0)), S(height * 0.45), 11, (i + 2) % 4, FIRE, 0.35 * s * math.exp(-a / 10))
                        end
                        prev = p
                    end
                end
                -- ejecta
                if a <= 80 then
                    for i = 0, P.debrisCount - 1, 2 do
                        local flight = P.debrisFlight(i)
                        if a <= flight + 6 then
                            local land = P.debrisLanding(i)
                            local endp = V(land.X, surface(land.X, land.Z, P.target.Y), land.Z)
                            local out = V(endp.X - P.target.X, 0, endp.Z - P.target.Z).Unit
                            local start = P.target + out * P.restFootprint * 0.85 + V(0, r * 0.25, 0)
                            local apex = (start - endp).Magnitude * (0.35 + 0.3 * P.hash(i, 61, 2)) + r * 0.3
                            local hot = P.hash(i, 5, 3) < 0.6 and GOLD or FIRE
                            local function arc(s) return start:Lerp(endp, s) + V(0, 4 * apex * s * (1 - s), 0) end
                            if a <= flight then
                                local s = a / flight
                                local size = 1.3 + 1.6 * P.hash(i, 67, 4)
                                local glowK = 1 - 0.5 * s
                                bb(arc(s), size * 2.2, 0, 0, hot, 0.9 * glowK, 0)
                                rib(arc(s), arc(math.max(0, s - 0.07)), Vector3.zero, size * 0.9, size * 0.2, 3, 1, FIRE, 0.55 * glowK)
                            else
                                local l2 = math.exp(-(a - flight) / 1.8)
                                bb(endp + V(0, 1, 0), 5, 0, 0, hot, 0.9 * l2, 0, true)
                                flat(endp + V(0, 0.2, 0), P.travel, 4, 4, 9, i % 4, DUSTC, 0.6 * l2)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                -- cracks glowing as they run out
                local glowC = smooth(a / 4) * hk
                if glowC > 0.01 then
                    local core = hk > 0.7 and GOLD or (hk > 0.35 and FIRE or DEEP)
                    local haze = hk > 0.5 and FIRE or (hk > 0.2 and DEEP or EMBER)
                    for i in ipairs(P.cracks) do
                        local front = P.crackFront(i, t)
                        if front > 0 then
                            local pieces = P.cracks[i].parent >= 0 and 6 or 12
                            local prev = P.crackPoint(i, 0)
                            prev = V(prev.X, surface(prev.X, prev.Z, P.target.Y) + 0.09, prev.Z)
                            for k = 1, pieces do
                                local along = front * k / pieces
                                local nx = P.crackPoint(i, along)
                                nx = V(nx.X, surface(nx.X, nx.Z, P.target.Y) + 0.09, nx.Z)
                                local taper = 1 - 0.5 * along
                                local hw = math.max(0.35, P.crackHalfWidth(i, along))
                                local tip = front < 1 and 1 + 0.8 * math.exp(-(front - along) * 6) or 1
                                local d = nx - prev
                                local l = V(d.X, 0, d.Z).Magnitude
                                if l > 0.001 then
                                    local axis = V(-d.Z / l, 0, d.X / l)
                                    flat((prev + nx) / 2, axis, hw, l * 0.5 + hw * 0.5, 8, 0, core, glowC * taper * tip)
                                    flat((prev + nx) / 2, axis, hw * 3.5, l * 0.5 + hw * 1.75, 8, 0, haze, glowC * taper * 0.4)
                                end
                                prev = nx
                            end
                            if front < 1 then bb(prev + V(0, 1.2, 0), 2.5 + P.crackHalfWidth(i, front) * 3, 0, 0, HOT, 0.8 * glowC, 0) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if t >= 400 then
                local vis = L.handover and 1 - smooth((t - L.handover) / 50) or 1
                local on = smooth((t - 406) / 20) * (1 - smooth((t - 630) / 40))
                if on > 0 then
                    local pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * math.sin(t * 0.17)
                    local core = V(math.floor(P.restCentre.X) + 0.5, math.floor(P.restCentre.Y) + 0.5, math.floor(P.restCentre.Z) + 0.5)
                    bb(core, r * 1.1, 0, 1, FIRE, 0.18 * on * pulse * vis, 0)
                    bb(core, r * 0.4, 0, 0, HOT, 0.3 * on * vis, 0)
                end
                if L.handover then
                    local since = t - L.handover
                    if since >= 0 and since <= 100 then
                        local k = math.exp(-since / 32)
                        bb(P.restCentre, r * 1.5, 0, 1, FIRE, 0.55 * k, 0)
                        bb(P.restCentre, r * 0.65, 0, 0, HOT, 0.7 * k, 0)
                    end
                end
            end
            -- MoonFx.sky (palette 1: the sick red-orange night)
            local reachD = math.sqrt((camera.X - P.target.X) ^ 2 + (camera.Z - P.target.Z) ^ 2)
            local w = 1 - smooth((reachD - 1400) / 1600)
            local rtime = c.t or c.tick
            local cover = smooth((rtime - 10) / 30) * (1 - smooth((rtime - 580) / 90))
            local hh = smooth((rtime - 180) / 50) * (1 - smooth((rtime - 380) / 90))
            local function pulse(at, decay) return rtime < at and 0 or math.exp(-(rtime - at) / decay) end
            local flashK = 0.4 * pulse(200, 5) + 1.5 * pulse(330, 6)
            local veil = smooth((rtime - 340) / 40) * (1 - smooth((rtime - 610) / 60))
            local at = rtime <= 330 and P.centre(rtime) or P.target + V(0, P.craterRadius * 0.4, 0)
            local toward = at - camera
            toward = toward.Magnitude < 1e-6 and V(0, 1, 0) or toward.Unit
            local glowK = rtime <= 330 and 0.5 + 1.7 * hh or 1.8 * math.exp(-(rtime - 330) / 30)
            ADD.Sky.submit({night = cover * w, stars = cover * (1 - 0.8 * hh) * w, aurora = 0, veil = veil * w * 0.6, halo = 0, flash = flashK * w,
                cometDir = toward, cometGlow = glowK * w, cometHeat = 1, darkLand = cover * (1 - 0.5 * hh) * 0.85 * w, palette = 1})
        end

        -- MoonFx.screen -> the grade ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local function grade(c, rt, covered)
            local L = setup(c)
            local P = L.P
            local t = rt
            local camera = camB()
            local film = c.filmOn
            local function sh(k) if k > G.a then G.a = k end end
            local function ab(k) if k > G.b then G.b = k end end
            local function zb(k) if k > G.d then G.d = k end end
            local function bl(k, r) if k > 0.001 then G.m = math.max(G.m, k); G.n = math.max(G.n, r) end end
            local function de(k) if k > G.x then G.x = k end end
            local alarmWin = window(t, 10, 12, 70, 80)
            if alarmWin > 0 then Grade.vignette(rgb(11737626), alarmWin * 0.55 * (0.55 + 0.45 * math.sin(t * 1.1))) end
            if t > 50 and t < 330 then
                local fk = fall(t)
                local nearK = film and 1 or proximity(camera, P.target, 2400)
                sh(fk * fk * 0.5 * nearK); ab(fk * fk * 0.3 * nearK); bl(0.25 * fk * nearK, 1.2)
                local entryWin = window(t, 190, 210, 320, 330)
                Grade.flash(rgb(16742958), 0.18 * entryWin * nearK)
                Grade.vignette(rgb(4198912), entryWin * 0.3 * nearK)
                local pre = window(t, 305, 314, 328, 330)
                if pre > 0 then zb(pre * 0.55 * nearK); sh(pre * pre * 1.3 * nearK); ab(pre * 0.5 * nearK); Grade.vignette(rgb(11744778), pre * 0.55 * nearK) end
            end
            local since = (t - 330) / 20
            if since >= 0 and since < 12 then
                local nearK = film and 1 or proximity(camera, P.target, 3200)
                local modes = {9, 15, 10, 17, 2, 16, 9, 19, 15, 10}
                local step = math.floor(since / 0.05)
                if step < #modes then Grade.impact(nearK, modes[step + 1]) end
                local decay = since < 0.06 and 1 or math.exp(-(since - 0.06) * 4.2)
                Grade.flash(rgb(16777215), 2.1 * nearK * decay)
                Grade.flash(rgb(16742958), 0.8 * nearK * math.exp(-since * 1.1))
                zb(window(since, 0, 0.04, 0.5, 2) * 0.9 * nearK)
                sh(window(since, 0, 0.06, 3.2, 7.5) * 1.2 * nearK)
                ab(window(since, 0, 0.06, 0.9, 4.5) * nearK)
                local hold = window(t, 330, 338, 470, 540)
                bl(1.4 * hold, 1.6 + 1.5 * hold)
                Grade.vignette(rgb(2756101), hold * 0.5 * nearK)
                de(0.22 * window(t, 340, 370, 510, 580) * nearK)
            end
            if t > 330 and t < 460 then
                local nearK = film and 1 or proximity(camera, P.target, 1800)
                local k = 1 - smooth((t - 330) / 140)
                local heave = math.clamp((rise(t + 1) - rise(t - 1)) * 10, 0, 1)
                sh((0.15 * k + 0.35 * heave) * nearK)
            end
            for _, at in ipairs({425, 530}) do
                if t > at and t < at + 40 then sh((at == 425 and 0.4 or 0.22) * math.exp(-(t - at) / 9) * (film and 1 or proximity(camera, P.target, 1400))) end
            end
        end

        -- MoonHud ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local REDc, CYANc, GOLDc, WHITEc, DIMc = rgb(16724016), rgb(3203327), rgb(GOLD), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), rgb(16769736)
        local PHASES = {{7, "PHASE 1 · UPLINK", "EARTH SYSTEM SHUTDOWN AUTHORISED"}, {30, "PHASE 2 · FRACTURE", "LUNAR CRUST FAILING ALONG MOLTEN SEAMS"},
            {50, "PHASE 3 · DESCENT", "ORBIT LOST · ON COURSE FOR THE MARK"}, {200, "PHASE 4 · ENTRY", "ATMOSPHERIC INTERFACE · HULL AT 9000 K"},
            {330, "PHASE 5 · IMPACT", "THE MOON IS DOWN"}, {400, "AFTERMATH", "IMPACT ZONE ERASED · THE MOON AT REST"}}
        local function bracketed(s, cx, y, colour, alpha, scale) Hud.text("[ " .. s .. " ]", cx, y, colour, alpha, scale, 0.5) end
        local function pseudo(seed) local h = math.sin(seed * 12.9898) * 43758.5453; return h - math.floor(h) end
        local function alert(c, t, W, Hh)
            local since = t - 10
            if since < 0 or since > 70 then return end
            local fade = window(since, 0, 5, 54, 70)
            if fade <= 0.01 then return end
            local seed = c.seed + math.floor(since * 971)
            local burst = pseudo(seed) < 0.22
            local jx = burst and math.floor((pseudo(seed + 11) - 0.5) * 14) or 0
            local jy = burst and math.floor((pseudo(seed + 29) - 0.5) * 5) or 0
            local cx, cy = W / 2 + jx, Hh / 2 - 20 + jy
            for y = 0, Hh, 4 do Hud.fill(0, y, W, y + 1, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 10 / 255 * fade) end
            local split = burst and 3 or 1
            Hud.text("EARTH SYSTEM SHUT DOWN", cx - split, cy, REDc, fade * 2 / 3, 4, 0.5)
            Hud.text("EARTH SYSTEM SHUT DOWN", cx + split, cy, CYANc, fade * 2 / 3, 4, 0.5)
            Hud.text("EARTH SYSTEM SHUT DOWN", cx, cy, WHITEc, fade, 4, 0.5)
            Hud.text("// SA-02 LUNA · ALL SYSTEMS DOWN //", W / 2, cy + 20 + 14, REDc, fade * 0.75, 1.5, 0.5)
        end
        local function plainHud(c, rt, W, Hh)
            local L = setup(c)
            local P = L.P
            local t = ltime(c)
            if c.mine then alert(c, t, W, Hh) end
            local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
            local me = ctx and ctx.root and ctx.root.Parent and ctx.root.Position / B
            if me and t >= 30 and t < 330 then
                local blast = P.blastRadius()
                local fromMark = P.fromMark(me.X, me.Z)
                if fromMark <= blast + P.moonRadius + 160 then
                    local erase = fromMark < P.eraseRadius()
                    local inBlast = fromMark < blast
                    local rate = 1 + 3 * math.clamp((t - 200) / 130, 0, 1)
                    local blink = (t / 20 * rate) % 1
                    bracketed(erase and "INSIDE THE ERASE RADIUS" or (inBlast and "INSIDE THE BLAST RADIUS" or "MOON INBOUND"), W / 2, 26, (erase or inBlast) and REDc or CYANc, 0.55 + 0.45 * (1 - blink), 1.5)
                    Hud.text(string.format("T-%05.2f", math.max(0, (330 - t) / 20)), W / 2, 44, WHITEc, 1, 1.25, 0.5)
                end
            end
            if me and t >= 30 and t < 330 and P.fromMark(me.X, me.Z) <= 4000 then
                local moon = P.centre(t)
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                local lp = cam.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(S(moon))
                local behind = lp.Z > 0
                local sp = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(S(moon))
                local vp = cam.ViewportSize
                local nx, ny = sp.X / vp.X * 2 - 1, -(sp.Y / vp.Y * 2 - 1)
                if behind then nx, ny = -nx, -ny end
                if behind or math.abs(nx) >= 0.94 or math.abs(ny) >= 0.9 then
                    local angle = math.atan2(ny * Hh, nx * W)
                    local co, si = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
                    local reachS = math.min((W * 0.5 - 30) / math.max(math.abs(co), 1e-4), (Hh * 0.5 - 30) / math.max(math.abs(si), 1e-4))
                    local x, y = W * 0.5 + co * reachS, Hh * 0.5 - si * reachS
                    local a = 0.6 + 0.4 * math.abs(math.sin(t * 0.22))
                    for i = 0, 13, 2 do
                        for j = -(14 - i), 14 - i, 2 do
                            local px, py = i - 14, j
                            Hud.fill(x + px * co - py * -si, y + px * -si + py * co, x + px * co - py * -si + 2, y + px * -si + py * co + 2, GOLDc, a)
                        end
                    end
                    local lx, ly = math.clamp(x - co * 48, 60, W - 60), math.clamp(y + si * 40, 20, Hh - 30)
                    Hud.text("SA-02 · LUNA", lx, ly - 12, GOLDc, a, 1.25, 0.5)
                    Hud.text(string.format("%.1f KM", (moon - camB()).Magnitude / 1000), lx, ly + 1, rgb(14875647), a * 0.7, 1, 0.5)
                end
            end
        end
        local function filmHud(c, rt, weight, W, Hh)
            local L = setup(c)
            local P = L.P
            local ct = ltime(c)
            local fade = math.clamp(weight * 1.6 - 0.3, 0, 1)
            if fade <= 0.01 then return end
            local flicker = math.floor(ct * 3) % 11 == 0
            local bar = math.floor(Hh * 0.055 * math.clamp(ct / 12, 0, 1) * fade)
            if bar > 0 then
                Hud.fill(0, 0, W, bar, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.92 * fade)
                Hud.fill(0, Hh - bar, W, Hh, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.92 * fade)
            end
            if ct >= 10 and ct <= 80 then alert(c, ct, W, Hh) end
            local m, arm = 12 + bar, 22
            Hud.corner(12, m, arm, 1, 1, GOLDc, fade); Hud.corner(W - 12, m, arm, -1, 1, GOLDc, fade)
            Hud.corner(12, Hh - m, arm, 1, -1, GOLDc, fade); Hud.corner(W - 12, Hh - m, arm, -1, -1, GOLDc, fade)
            Hud.text("UPLINK // SA-02 > LUNA", 18, m + 6, flicker and DIMc or GOLDc, flicker and fade * 0.55 or fade)
            Hud.text(string.format("T+%05.2f", ct / 20), 18, m + 17, DIMc, fade * 0.55)
            Hud.text(ct < 330 and string.format("IMPACT T-%05.2f", math.max(0, (330 - ct) / 20)) or "IMPACT CONFIRMED", W - 18, m + 6, GOLDc, fade, 1, 1)
            Hud.text(string.format("LOCK %d / %d / %d", math.floor(P.target.X), math.floor(P.target.Y), math.floor(P.target.Z)), W - 18, m + 17, DIMc, fade * 0.55, 1, 1)
            -- phase
            for i = #PHASES, 1, -1 do
                local ph = PHASES[i]
                local since = ct - ph[1]
                if since >= 0 then
                    local k = window(since, 0, 3, 56, 70)
                    if k * fade >= 4 / 255 then
                        local typed = math.min(#ph[2], math.floor(since * 1.6))
                        local typedSub = math.min(#ph[3], math.max(0, math.floor((since - 6) * 2.4)))
                        local cursor = typed < #ph[2] and math.floor(ct * 2) % 2 == 0
                        local x, y = 18, Hh - m - 78
                        Hud.fill(x, y - 3, x + 2, y + 21, GOLDc, fade * k)
                        Hud.text(ph[2]:sub(1, typed) .. (cursor and "_" or ""), x + 7, y, WHITEc, fade * k, 1.25)
                        if typedSub > 0 then Hud.text(ph[3]:sub(1, typedSub), x + 7, y + 13, DIMc, fade * k * 0.7) end
                    end
                    break
                end
            end
            if ct >= 10 and ct < 80 then
                local x, y = Hud.project(S(P.target + V(0, 0.5, 0)))
                if x then
                    local k = math.clamp((ct - 10) / 10, 0, 1)
                    local size = math.floor(70 + (10 - 70) * k)
                    Hud.box(x, y, size, GOLDc, fade)
                    Hud.text("TARGET ACQUIRED", x + size + 4, y - 9, GOLDc, fade)
                    Hud.text(string.format("ERASE %d M · BLAST %d M", math.ceil(P.eraseRadius()), math.ceil(P.blastRadius())), x + size + 4, y + 1, DIMc, fade * 0.55)
                end
            end
            if ct >= 30 and ct < 330 then
                local moon = P.centre(ct)
                local x, y = Hud.project(S(moon))
                local d = (moon - camB()).Magnitude
                if x then
                    local size = math.floor(math.clamp(20 - d / 300, 8, 20))
                    Hud.box(x, y, size, GOLDc, fade)
                    Hud.text("SA-02 · LUNA", x + size + 4, y - 9, GOLDc, fade)
                    Hud.text(string.format("RANGE %.2f KM · ALT %s M", d / 1000, commas(math.floor(moon.Y - P.target.Y + 0.5))), x + size + 4, y + 1, DIMc, fade * 0.55)
                end
                Hud.text(string.format("V %s M/S", commas(math.floor(P.speed(ct) * 20 + 0.5))), W - 18, Hh - m - 44, GOLDc, fade, 1.5, 1)
                Hud.text(string.format("ETA %.1f S · CLOSING", math.max(0, 330 - ct) / 20), W - 18, Hh - m - 28, DIMc, fade * 0.55, 1, 1)
                if ct >= 170 then
                    local blink = math.floor(ct / 2) % 2 == 0
                    bracketed("ENTRY · PLASMA SHEATH", W / 2, m + 22, blink and GOLDc or DIMc, blink and fade or fade * 0.55, 1.5)
                end
            end
            -- descent bar
            if ct >= 10 and ct <= 370 then
                local out = math.clamp((370 - ct) / 20, 0, 1)
                local b = fade * out * math.clamp((ct - 10) / 10, 0, 1)
                if b >= 4 / 255 then
                    local x0, x1 = W / 2 - math.min(160, W / 4), W / 2 + math.min(160, W / 4)
                    local y = Hh - m - 8
                    Hud.fill(x0, y, x1, y + 1, DIMc, b * 0.5)
                    local k = math.clamp((ct - 10) / 320, 0, 1)
                    local filled = x0 + math.floor((x1 - x0) * k + 0.5)
                    Hud.fill(x0, y - 1, filled, y + 2, GOLDc, b)
                    for _, at in ipairs({30, 50, 200, 330}) do
                        local tx = x0 + math.floor((x1 - x0) * (at - 10) / 320 + 0.5)
                        local passed = ct >= at
                        Hud.fill(tx, y - 4, tx + 1, y + 5, passed and GOLDc or DIMc, passed and b or b * 0.5)
                    end
                    local pulseK = 0.6 + 0.4 * math.abs(math.sin(ct * (0.15 + 0.5 * k)))
                    Hud.fill(filled - 2, y - 3, filled + 3, y + 4, WHITEc, b * pulseK)
                    Hud.text("DESCENT", (x0 + x1) / 2, y - 14, DIMc, b * 0.6, 1, 0.5)
                end
            end
            local rate = filmRate(c, c.t or c.tick)
            if rate < 0.97 and ct >= 330 then
                local k = math.clamp((1 - rate) / 0.6, 0, 1)
                if math.floor(ct / 6) % 2 == 0 then Hud.fill(18, m + 32, 24, m + 38, rgb(14692394), fade * k) end
                Hud.text(string.format("HIGH-SPEED CAPTURE · %.2f×", rate), 28, m + 31, WHITEc, fade * k)
                Hud.text(string.format("%d FPS", math.floor(24 / math.max(0.05, rate) + 0.5)), 28, m + 41, DIMc, fade * k * 0.6)
            end
            if ct >= 334 and ct < 390 then bracketed("IMPACT CONFIRMED", W / 2, Hh / 2 + 50, GOLDc, fade * math.clamp((390 - ct) / 12, 0, 1), 2) end
            if ct >= 430 then
                Hud.text(string.format("IMPACT ZONE Ø%d · MOON Ø%d · %d%% BURIED", P.craterRadius * 2, P.moonRadius * 2, 70), W / 2, Hh - m - 30, DIMc,
                    fade * math.clamp((ct - 430) / 10, 0, 1), 1.25, 0.5)
            end
        end

        -- MoonStoryboard ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local function shots(c)
            local L = setup(c)
            local P = L.P
            local side = V(-P.travel.Z, 0, P.travel.X)
            local travel, mark = P.travel, P.target
            local radius, moonR = P.craterRadius, P.moonRadius
            local function l(k, a, b) return a + (b - a) * k end
            local function feet() return casterPos(c) / B end
            local function frame(anchor, r, u, f)
                local fw = c.face
                local rt = V(-fw.Z, 0, fw.X)
                return anchor + V(rt.X * r + fw.X * f, u, rt.Z * r + fw.Z * f)
            end
            local function keep(pos) return pos end
            local function safe(fn)
                return function(c2, k)
                    local pos, look, fov, roll = fn(c2, k)
                    local t = ltime(c2)
                    local moon = t <= 400 and P.centre(t) or P.restCentre
                    local d = pos - moon
                    local minD = moonR * 2.4
                    if d.Magnitude < minD then pos = moon + (d.Magnitude < 1e-4 and V(0, 0.15, 1).Unit or d.Unit) * minD end
                    return pose(S(pos), S(look), fov, roll or 0)
                end
            end
            local quarter = (side * -0.8 + travel * -0.6).Unit
            local high = (side * 0.7 + travel * -0.7).Unit
            return {
                {0, 28, 0, safe(function(c2, k) local f = feet(); return frame(f, l(k, 1.3, 1.08), l(k, 1.72, 1.56), l(k, 2, 1.75)), frame(f, 0.36, 1.38, 0.62), l(k, 42, 48), 0 end)},
                {28, 62, 0, safe(function(c2, k) local f = feet(); return frame(f, l(k, 0.55, 0.42), l(k, 1.78, 1.86), l(k, -0.7, -0.55)), P.centre(ltime(c2)), l(k, 34, 20), l(k, 0, -1.5) end)},
                {62, 120, 0, safe(function(c2, k)
                    return keep(mark + side * radius * l(k, 0.5, 0.42) + travel * (-radius * 0.18) + V(0, 2.4, 0)), P.centre(ltime(c2)), l(k, 74, 70), 0
                end)},
                {120, 210, 0, safe(function(c2, k)
                    local angle = math.rad(l(k, -20, 28))
                    local around = side * -math.cos(angle) + travel * math.sin(angle)
                    local pos = mark + around * (radius * 0.95 + moonR * 0.5) + V(0, 6 + moonR * 0.18, 0)
                    local look = (mark + V(0, moonR * 0.3, 0)):Lerp(P.centre(ltime(c2)), 0.72)
                    return keep(pos), look, l(k, 64, 72), 0
                end)},
                {210, 304, 0, safe(function(c2, k)
                    local pos = mark + side * (radius * 1.05 + moonR * 0.9) + travel * radius * l(k, 0.35, 0.1) + V(0, 4 + moonR * 0.25, 0)
                    return keep(pos), P.centre(ltime(c2)):Lerp(mark, 0.34), l(k, 74, 80), l(k, 0, 3)
                end)},
                {304, 330, 0, safe(function(c2, k)
                    local pos = mark + travel * (radius * 1.15 + moonR * 0.6) + side * radius * 0.18 + V(0, 2.2, 0)
                    return keep(pos), P.centre(ltime(c2)):Lerp(mark, 0.2), l(k, 80, 88), l(k, -1, 2.5)
                end)},
                {330, 388, 0, safe(function(c2, k)
                    local e = k * k * (3 - 2 * k)
                    local pos = mark + quarter * l(e, radius * 0.78 + moonR, radius * 1.5 + moonR * 1.3) + V(0, l(e, radius * 0.16 + moonR * 0.25, radius * 0.55 + moonR * 0.6), 0)
                    return keep(pos), mark + V(0, l(e, moonR * 0.55, moonR * 0.3), 0), l(e, 60, 76), l(k, -2, 0)
                end)},
                {388, 430, 8, safe(function(c2, k)
                    local angle = math.rad(l(k, 0, 38))
                    local around = high * math.cos(angle) + V(-high.Z, 0, high.X) * math.sin(angle)
                    return keep(mark + around * radius * 1.25 + V(0, radius * 0.75 + moonR * 0.4, 0)), mark + V(0, moonR * 0.2, 0), l(k, 70, 64), 0
                end)},
                {430, 495, 10, safe(function(c2, k)
                    local pos = mark + side * radius * 0.62 + travel * (-radius * l(k, 0.42, 0.7)) + V(0, P.rimHeight + moonR * l(k, 0.55, 1.35), 0)
                    return keep(pos), P.restCentre + V(0, moonR * 0.25, 0), l(k, 56, 66), 0
                end)},
            }
        end

        return {tick = tick, render = render, grade = grade, filmHud = filmHud, plainHud = plainHud, shots = shots}
    end)()
    local RUN = {ss01Tick, GUNG.tick, STARS.tick, HALLEY.tick, LUNA.tick}
    local function starCentroid(c)
        local nodes = starNodes(c)
        local s = Vector3.zero
        for i = 1, 7 do s = s + nodes[i].pos end
        return s / 7
    end
    -- Per skill: the space film's name and the world / grade / HUD parts.
    local SKILLFX = {
        {film = "ss01", render = ss01Render, grade = function(c, t, covered) ss01Grade(c, t, covered) end,
            filmGrade = ss01FilmGrade, filmHud = ss01FilmHud, plainHud = ss01PlainHud},
        {film = "gungnir", render = GUNG.render, grade = function(c, t, covered) GUNG.grade(c, t, c.filmOn, covered) end,
            filmGrade = GUNG.filmGrade, filmHud = GUNG.filmHud, plainHud = GUNG.plainHud},
        {film = "stars", render = STARS.render, grade = function(c, t, covered) STARS.grade(c, t, covered) end,
            filmGrade = STARS.filmGrade, filmHud = STARS.filmHud, plainHud = STARS.plainHud},
        {render = HALLEY.render, grade = HALLEY.grade, filmHud = HALLEY.filmHud, plainHud = HALLEY.plainHud},
        {render = LUNA.render, grade = LUNA.grade, filmHud = LUNA.filmHud, plainHud = LUNA.plainHud},
    }
    local FILMS = {
        function() return SS01_SHOTS end,
        gungnirFilm,
        function() return sevenStarsFilm(function(c, i) return starNodes(c)[i].pos end, function(c, i) return starNodes(c)[i].radius end, starCentroid) end,
        function(c) return HALLEY.shots(c) end,
        function(c) return LUNA.shots(c) end,
    }

    -- Running casts --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function startCast(skillIndex, target, power, seed, mine, owner)
        if not SS.enabled then return end
        local c = Cast.new(skillIndex, target, power, seed, mine, owner)
        state.casts[#state.casts + 1] = c
        c.shots = FILMS[skillIndex](c)
        if c.filmOn then
            if state.filmCast then state.filmCast:endFilm() end
            c:beginFilm()
            local fx = SKILLFX[skillIndex]
            local f = fx.film and Films.data(fx.film)
            if f then f.preloaded = 0; Films.preload(f, 60) end
        end
        return c
    end
    local heartbeat, render
    local function stepCasts()
        local now = os.clock()
        pcall(VX.step)
        for idx = #state.casts, 1, -1 do
            local c = state.casts[idx]
            local target = math.floor((now - c.started) * 20 * (c.speed or 1))
            local catchupBudget=80
            while c.tick < target and catchupBudget>0 do
                catchupBudget-=1
                c.tick = c.tick + 1
                local ok, err = pcall(RUN[c.skill], c, c.tick)
                if not ok and not c.warned then c.warned = true; warn("[Shooting Star] " .. tostring(err)) end
                if c.tick > c.def.film then break end
            end
            if c.tick > c.def.film then
                -- The effect is over; the land it changed stays (folder kept until the mod is turned off).
                c:endFilm()
                c.done = true
                table.remove(state.casts, idx)
                state.finished = state.finished or {}
                state.finished[#state.finished + 1] = c
            end
        end
        -- Animated block textures (star_core, star_trace, gungnir_seam).
        local tick = math.floor(now * 20)
        if tick ~= state.texTick then
            state.texTick = tick
            for t, sprite in pairs(animatedTextures) do
                if not t.Parent then animatedTextures[t] = nil
                else
                    local frame = math.floor(tick / (sprite.frametime or 1)) % #sprite.frames + 1
                    if t:GetAttribute("Frame") ~= frame then
                        t:SetAttribute("Frame", frame)
                        local content = JavaContent.spriteImage(sprite.frames[frame])
                        if content then pcall(function() t.TextureContent = content end) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- client.fx.p / f / l .c(): the caster's right arm holding the remote up (xRot curve, yRot -0.12), blended in over 3 ticks
    -- and out over the last 8.
    local POSE_CURVES = {
        {{0, -0.35}, {4, -1.4}, {9, -1.4}, {16, -2.55}, {60, -2.55}, {80, -1.25}, {496, -1.25}, {516, -0.35}, ends = {512, 520}},
        {{0, -0.35}, {4, -1.4}, {9, -1.4}, {16, -2.6}, {60, -2.6}, {80, -1.3}, {402, -1.3}, {432, -0.35}, ends = {428, 436}},
        {{0, -0.35}, {4, -1.4}, {9, -1.4}, {16, -2.7}, {60, -2.7}, {80, -1.3}, {500, -1.3}, {530, -0.35}, ends = {526, 534}},
        {{0, -0.35}, {4, -1.4}, {9, -1.4}, {16, -2.35}, {58, -2.35}, {78, -1.25}, {496, -1.25}, {516, -0.35}, ends = {512, 520}},
        {{0, -0.35}, {10, -1.3}, {22, -2.3}, {50, -2.25}, {330, -2.1}, {350, -1.2}, {640, -1.2}, {660, -0.35}, ends = {656, 664}},
    }
    function SteveMods.castPose()
        local best
        for _, c in ipairs(state.casts) do if c.mine and c.t and (not best or c.started > best.started) then best = c end end
        if not best then return nil end
        local curve, t = POSE_CURVES[best.skill], best.t
        local x = curve[#curve][2]
        for i = 1, #curve - 1 do
            if t >= curve[i][1] and t < curve[i + 1][1] then x = lerp(curve[i][2], curve[i + 1][2], sm((t - curve[i][1]) / (curve[i + 1][1] - curve[i][1]))) break end
        end
        return x, -0.12, 0, win(t, 0, 3, curve.ends[1], curve.ends[2])
    end
    -- Every frame (called by the controller right after it places its own camera): the films' world parts, the camera of
    -- the cutscene playing for this player, the space film over it, the grade, the HUD and the shake.
    local skipHint = "[J] skip"
    function SteveMods.cameraOverride(dt)
        dt = dt or 1 / 60
        resetGrade()
        pcall(ADD.beginFrame)
        trauma = math.max(0, trauma - dt * 0.7)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local now = os.clock()
        local dusk, shade, night = 0, 0, 0
        for _, c in ipairs(state.casts) do
            c.t = c.tick + math.clamp((now - c.started) * 20 * (c.speed or 1) - c.tick, 0, 1)
            local fx = SKILLFX[c.skill]
            if fx.render then
                local ok, err = pcall(fx.render, c, c.t)
                if not ok and not c.warnedR then c.warnedR = true; warn("[Shooting Star] " .. tostring(err)) end
            end
            dusk, shade, night = math.max(dusk, c.dusk or 0), math.max(shade, c.shade or 0), math.max(night, c.night or 0)
        end
        do
            local okSky, dark = pcall(ADD.endFrame)
            if okSky and dark then night = math.max(night, dark) end
        end
        local W, H = Hud.begin()
        local outCF, outFov
        local weight, spaceShown = 0, false
        local fc = state.filmCast
        if fc and fc.filmOn and fc.t then
            local t = fc.filmClock and fc.filmClock(fc) or fc.t
            weight = Director.weight(fc, fc.shots, t)
            if weight > 0.001 then
                local ok, p = pcall(Director.pose, fc, fc.shots, t)
                if ok and p then
                    -- cinematic.d.a(a): keep the camera out of the ground between the look point and the camera.
                    local from = p.look + up(0.6)
                    local dir = p.pos - from
                    if dir.Magnitude > 0.05 then
                        local hit = mapRay(from, dir)
                        if hit then p.pos = hit.Position - dir.Unit * 0.45 * B end
                    end
                    -- Blend from the player's own view (position, look point, FOV, roll).
                    local base = cam.CFrame
                    local pos = base.Position:Lerp(p.pos, weight)
                    local look = (base.Position + base.LookVector * B):Lerp(p.look, weight)
                    if (look - pos).Magnitude < 1e-3 then look = pos + base.LookVector end
                    outCF = CFrame.lookAt(pos, look) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-p.roll * weight))
                    outFov = lerp(cam.FieldOfView, p.fov, weight)
                elseif not ok and not fc.warnedC then fc.warnedC = true; warn("[Shooting Star] camera: " .. tostring(p)) end
                local fx = SKILLFX[fc.skill]
                if fx.filmGrade then
                    local covering = fx.filmGrade(t, weight)
                    if covering and fx.film then spaceShown = Films.show(fx.film, t) end
                end
            elseif t > Director.lastShot(fc.shots) then
                fc:endFilm()
            end
        end
        if not spaceShown then Films.hide() end
        for _, c in ipairs(state.casts) do
            local fx = SKILLFX[c.skill]
            if fx.grade and c.t then pcall(fx.grade, c, c.t, spaceShown and c == fc) end
        end
        SteveMods.cinematic = weight > 0.001
        if weight > 0.35 then
            local fx = SKILLFX[fc.skill]
            if fx.filmHud then
                local ok, err = pcall(fx.filmHud, fc, fc.t, weight, W, H)
                if not ok and not fc.warnedH then fc.warnedH = true; warn("[Shooting Star] hud: " .. tostring(err)) end
            end
            -- cinematic.d.b: the skip hint.
            local a = math.clamp((fc.t - 4) / 8, 0, 1) * math.clamp(weight * 2 - 1, 0, 1) * 110 / 255
            if a > 4 / 255 then Hud.text(skipHint, W - 18 - JavaGui.width(skipHint), H - 38, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), a) end
        else
            for _, c in ipairs(state.casts) do
                local fx = SKILLFX[c.skill]
                if fx.plainHud and c.t then pcall(fx.plainHud, c, c.t, W, H) end
            end
        end
        Hud.finish()
        -- The world under the beam goes dark red (star_beam's shade); the sky darkens as the star falls.
        local s = screenGui()
        if not s.shade then
            s.shade = Lighting:FindFirstChild("SteveModShade") or Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
            s.shade.Name = "SteveModShade"
            s.shade.Parent = Lighting
        end
        local tint = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(Color3.new(0.55, 0.12, 0.14), math.clamp(shade * 0.8, 0, 1))
        tint = tint:Lerp(Color3.new(0.35, 0.05, 0.08), math.clamp(dusk * (spaceShown and 0 or 0.6), 0, 1))
        s.shade.Enabled = shade > 0.001 or dusk > 0.001
        s.shade.TintColor = tint
        if night > 0.001 then
            if not state.savedClock then state.savedClock = Lighting.ClockTime end
            local c0 = state.savedClock
            Lighting.ClockTime = c0 >= 12 and c0 + (24 - c0) * night or c0 * (1 - night)
        elseif state.savedClock then
            Lighting.ClockTime = state.savedClock
            state.savedClock = nil
        end
        applyGrade(dt)
        return (outCF or cam.CFrame) * shakeFrame(), outFov
    end

    -- Casting with the Stellar Remote --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function pickTarget()
        local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
        local world = ctx and ctx.world
        local eye = world and world.eye and world.eye() or workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
        local look = world and world.look and world.look() or workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
        local hit = mapRay(eye, look * 420 * B)
        if hit then return hit.Position end
        local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
        if flat.Magnitude < 1e-3 then flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
        local p = eye + flat.Unit * 260 * B
        local y = groundAt(p.X, p.Z, eye.Y - 3)
        return Vector3.new(p.X, y, p.Z)
    end
    local function actionBar(text, colour)
        local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
        local chat = ctx and ctx.world and ctx.world.chat
        if chat and chat.showTitle then chat.showTitle("actionbar", {{text = text, color = colour or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)}}) end
    end
    function SS.cast(skillIndex)
        local def = SKILLS[skillIndex]
        local free = state.noCooldown == true and not CONFIG.Survival
        if not free then
            for _, c in ipairs(state.casts) do
                if c.skill == skillIndex and c.mine then actionBar(def.label .. " is already on its way", def.colour); return false end
            end
        end
        local left = (state.recharge[skillIndex] or 0) - os.clock()
        if left > 0 and not free then actionBar(string.format("%s is recharging — %ss", def.label, math.ceil(left)), Color3.fromRGB(170, 0, 170)); return false end
        state.recharge[skillIndex] = os.clock() + (free and 0 or (def.recharge or RECHARGE) / 20)
        local target = pickTarget()
        local seed = math.random(1, 2147483646)
        local power = state.powers[skillIndex]
        startCast(skillIndex, target, power, seed, true, Players.LocalPlayer)
        if SteveMods.netSend then pcall(SteveMods.netSend, skillIndex, target, power, seed) end
        return true
    end
    function SS.useItem(stack, name, sneaking)
        if name ~= "stellar_remote" then return false end
        if sneaking then
            state.selected = state.selected % #SKILLS + 1
            play("staff_select", nil, 1)
            actionBar("Selected: " .. SKILLS[state.selected].label, SKILLS[state.selected].colour)
            return true
        end
        SS.cast(state.selected)
        return true
    end
    -- Other players' casts (T_SKILL).
    function SS.onNet(peer, skillIndex, target, power, seed, elapsed)
        if not SKILLS[skillIndex] then return end
        local c=startCast(skillIndex, target, power, seed, peer and peer.player==Players.LocalPlayer, peer and peer.player)
        if c and elapsed and elapsed>0 then
            c.started-=math.min(elapsed,3600)
            if elapsed*20*(c.speed or 1)>Director.lastShot(c.shots) then c:endFilm() end
        end
    end

    -- White Space: the Stellar Remote's skill menu (client.magic.h / k / l / c / d). H opens it: the world whites out,
    -- the panels hang round you in space, you aim at them with the crosshair and click. Every panel is laid out and
    -- projected exactly as k.java / l.java do it (a Matrix3x2f per panel); each matrix is then drawn as a SurfaceGui on a
    -- 3D card in front of the camera, tilted so its on-screen shape is that same matrix.
    local WS = (function()
        local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
        local Workspace = workspace
        local sin, cos, abs, sqrt, floor, ceil, max, min, atan2 = math.sin, math.cos, math.abs, math.sqrt, math.floor, math.ceil, math.max, math.min, math.atan2
        local RAD = math.pi / 180
        -- c.java colours.
        local WHITE, PLATE, PLATE2, LINE, INK, GREY, PALE, HOT, HOT2, SHADOW, GREEN, WARN, ICE =
            16777215, 16514044, 15659251, 13225686, 3883080, 9080985, 11909826, 16037439, 16774364, 1712688, 3055195, 14239816, 15923455
        local REMOTE_COLOUR = 16724808
        local DEMO_NOTICE = "Demo made by tiktok.com/@rimuru.dev - All rights reserved - discord.gg/rimurudev"
        local DEMO_HANDLE = "tiktok.com/@rimuru.dev"
        local E_UNIT = 1.88 * math.tan(0.17 * RAD) -- l.e: world units per panel pixel at the panel sphere
        local HV = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0.12)        -- l.h
        local MG = 18                              -- canvas margin round each panel (shadows and glows spill past it)
        local DEPTH = 10                           -- studs in front of the camera the cards hang at

        local function round(x) return floor(x + 0.5) end
        local function c01(x) return x < 0 and 0 or (x > 1 and 1 or x) end
        local function dOut(x) local v = 1 - x; return 1 - v * v * v end
        local function eIn(x) return x * x * x end
        local function fInOut(x) return x < 0.5 and 4 * x * x * x or 1 - (-2 * x + 2) ^ 3 / 2 end
        local function gBack(x) local c1 = 1.70158; local v = x - 1; return 1 + (c1 + 1) * v * v * v + c1 * v * v end
        local function lerp(t, a, b) return a + (b - a) * t end
        local function wrapDeg(a) a = (a + 180) % 360; if a < 0 then a = a + 360 end; return a - 180 end
        local function chan(rgb) return floor(rgb / 65536) % 256, floor(rgb / 256) % 256, rgb % 256 end
        local function mix(a, b, t)
            t = c01(t)
            local ar, ag, ab = chan(a)
            local br, bg, bb = chan(b)
            return round(lerp(t, ar, br)) * 65536 + round(lerp(t, ag, bg)) * 256 + round(lerp(t, ab, bb))
        end
        local colourCache = {}
        local function C3(rgb)
            local c = colourCache[rgb]
            if not c then local r, g, b = chan(rgb); c = Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b); colourCache[rgb] = c end
            return c
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Fonts (c.java: white_space_text / caption / title, Selawik at 9 / 7 / 16 px; size index H from the window).
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local FONT = {}
        for kind, f in pairs(WS_FONTS.fonts) do
            local per = {}
            for si, list in ipairs(f.adv) do
                local map, i = {}, 0
                for _, cp in utf8.codes(WS_FONTS.chars) do i = i + 1; map[cp] = list[i] end
                per[si] = map
            end
            FONT[kind] = {adv = per, size = f.size, file = f.font, shift = kind == "title" and 1.0 or (kind == "text" and -0.35 or -1.05)}
        end
        local fontIndex = 3
        local faces = {}
        local function fontFace(kind)
            local f = FONT[kind]
            local face = faces[f.file]
            if face == nil then
                face = false
                pcall(function()
                    local ttf = asset("fonts/" .. f.file .. ".ttf")
                    if not ttf then return end
                    local path = FOLDER .. "/fonts/" .. f.file .. ".json"
                    pcall(function() if not isfolder(FOLDER .. "/fonts") then makefolder(FOLDER .. "/fonts") end end)
                    writefile(path, '{"name":"' .. f.file .. '","faces":[{"name":"Regular","weight":400,"style":"normal","assetId":"' .. ttf .. '"}]}')
                    face = Font.new(getcustomasset(path))
                end)
                faces[f.file] = face
            end
            return face or Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.BuilderSans)
        end
        local function charWidth(kind, cp, idx)
            local a = FONT[kind].adv[idx or fontIndex][cp]
            if a and a >= 0 then return a end
            return JavaGui.width(utf8.char(cp)) -- minecraft:default fallback
        end
        local function width(kind, s, idx)
            local w = 0
            for _, cp in utf8.codes(s) do w = w + charWidth(kind, cp, idx) end
            return ceil(w - 1e-4)
        end
        -- StringSplitter.splitLines: greedy, breaking after the last space that fits (the space is dropped).
        local function split(kind, s, maxW)
            local lines = {}
            for para in (s .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
                local cps = {}
                for _, cp in utf8.codes(para) do cps[#cps + 1] = cp end
                local i, n = 1, #cps
                if n == 0 then lines[#lines + 1] = "" end
                while i <= n do
                    local w, j, lastSpace = 0, i, nil
                    while j <= n do
                        local cw = charWidth(kind, cps[j])
                        if cps[j] == 32 then lastSpace = j end
                        if w + cw > maxW and j > i then break end
                        w = w + cw
                        j = j + 1
                    end
                    local stop, nextStart
                    if j > n then stop, nextStart = n, n + 1
                    elseif lastSpace and lastSpace >= i then stop, nextStart = lastSpace - 1, lastSpace + 1
                    else stop, nextStart = j - 1, j end
                    local t = {}
                    for q = i, stop do t[#t + 1] = utf8.char(cps[q]) end
                    lines[#lines + 1] = table.concat(t)
                    i = nextStart
                end
            end
            return lines
        end
        -- c.d(): upper case, letters spaced, word gaps doubled.
        local function spaced(s)
            s = s:upper()
            local out, cps = {}, {}
            for _, cp in utf8.codes(s) do cps[#cps + 1] = cp end
            for i, cp in ipairs(cps) do
                out[#out + 1] = cp == 32 and "  " or utf8.char(cp)
                if i < #cps then out[#out + 1] = " " end
            end
            return table.concat(out)
        end
        -- k.a(Font, String, int): an item's name in spaced capitals, words joined by three spaces, wrapped at 104.
        local function nameLines(s, maxW)
            local lines, cur = {}, ""
            for word in s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""):gmatch("%S+") do
                local w = spaced(word)
                local nextLine = cur == "" and w or cur .. "   " .. w
                if cur ~= "" and width("text", nextLine) > maxW then lines[#lines + 1] = cur; cur = w else cur = nextLine end
            end
            if cur ~= "" then lines[#lines + 1] = cur end
            return lines
        end
        -- k.a(Font, String, int, boolean): cut with an ellipsis to fit.
        local function ellipsize(kind, s, maxW)
            if width(kind, s) <= maxW then return s end
            local cps = {}
            for _, cp in utf8.codes(s) do cps[#cps + 1] = cp end
            local out = s
            while #cps > 1 do
                cps[#cps] = nil
                local t = {}
                for i, cp in ipairs(cps) do t[i] = utf8.char(cp) end
                out = (table.concat(t):gsub("%s+$", ""):gsub("^%s+", "")) .. "…"
                if width(kind, out) <= maxW then return out end
            end
            return out
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Skills (magic.d), the locked ones (client.magic.b), tuning (client.magic.g) and keys (client.magic.f).
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local LOCKED = {
            {id = "meridian", label = "SS-02 · Meridian", title = "The Shooting Star", colour = 16757575, followers = "40,000", after = "the_shooting_star", locked = true},
            {id = "secret", label = "SS-06 · Secret", title = "The Shooting Star", colour = 12106952, followers = "50,000", after = "tesseract", locked = true},
        }
        local DAMAGE = {2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 60, 80, 100, 150, 200, 300, 500, 1000, math.huge}
        local SPEED = {a = 0.3, b = 3, c = 1, d = true, e = 0}
        local function colourOf(def) local c = def.colour; return round(c.R * 255) * 65536 + round(c.G * 255) * 256 + round(c.B * 255) end
        local function rangeOf(def) local p = def.power; return p and {a = p[1], b = p[2], c = p[3], d = p[4], e = def.unitBlocks or 1} or nil end
        -- magic.c
        local function rClamp(r, v) if v ~= v then return r.c end; return max(r.a, min(r.b, v)) end
        local function rToU(r, v) v = rClamp(r, v); return r.d and math.log(v / r.a) / math.log(r.b / r.a) or (v - r.a) / (r.b - r.a) end
        local function rSnap(r, v)
            local s
            if not r.d then s = round(v / 10) * 10
            elseif v < 1 then s = round(v * 20) / 20
            elseif v < 10 then s = round(v * 10) / 10
            else s = round(v * 2) / 2 end
            return rClamp(r, s)
        end
        local function rFromU(r, u) u = c01(u); return rSnap(r, r.d and r.a * (r.b / r.a) ^ u or r.a + (r.b - r.a) * u) end
        local function rStep(r, v, dir)
            local cur = rClamp(r, v)
            local u = rToU(r, cur)
            for k = 1, 40 do local n = rFromU(r, u + dir * k / 60); if n ~= cur then return n end end
            return cur
        end
        local function damageIndex(v)
            if v >= math.huge then return #DAMAGE - 1 end
            local best = 0
            for i = 1, #DAMAGE - 1 do
                if abs(math.log(DAMAGE[i + 1] / v)) < abs(math.log(DAMAGE[best + 1] / v)) then best = i end
            end
            return best
        end
        local function indexOf(def) for i, d in ipairs(SKILLS) do if d == def then return i end end end
        local function power(def) local i = indexOf(def); return state.powers[i] end
        local function damage(def) local i = indexOf(def); return state.damage and state.damage[i] or math.huge end
        local function speed(def) local i = indexOf(def); return state.speed and state.speed[i] or 1 end
        local function overWarn(def) return def.power ~= nil and def.warn ~= nil and power(def) > def.warn + 1e-4 end
        -- k.a(magic.c, float)
        local function fmtRange(r, v)
            if not r.d then return tostring(round(v)) end
            local s
            if v < 1 then s = string.format("%.2f", v); if s:sub(-1) == "0" then s = s:sub(1, -2) end
            elseif v < 10 then s = string.format("%.1f", v)
            else s = v == round(v) and tostring(round(v)) or string.format("%.1f", v) end
            return s .. "×"
        end
        local function fmtDamage(v) return v >= math.huge and "∞" or tostring(round(v)) end
        local function commas(n)
            local s = tostring(n)
            local out = s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse()
            return (out:gsub("^,", ""))
        end
        local function sliderPos(def, kind)
            if kind == 0 then return rToU(rangeOf(def), power(def))
            elseif kind == 2 then return rToU(SPEED, speed(def)) end
            return damageIndex(damage(def)) / (#DAMAGE - 1)
        end
        local saveDirty = false
        local function setPower(def, v) local i = indexOf(def); v = rSnap(rangeOf(def), v); if v == state.powers[i] then return false end; state.powers[i] = v; saveDirty = true; return true end
        local function setSpeed(def, v) local i = indexOf(def); v = rSnap(SPEED, v); if v == speed(def) then return false end; state.speed[i] = v; saveDirty = true; return true end
        local function setDamage(def, idx) local i = indexOf(def); local v = DAMAGE[max(0, min(#DAMAGE - 1, idx)) + 1]; if v == damage(def) then return false end; state.damage[i] = v; saveDirty = true; return true end
        local function save()
            if not saveDirty then return end
            saveDirty = false
            pcall(function()
                local out = {cutscenes = state.cutscenes, everyone = state.everyone, skills = {}}
                for i, d in ipairs(SKILLS) do
                    out.skills[d.id] = {power = state.powers[i], damage = state.damage[i] >= math.huge and "infinite" or state.damage[i], speed = state.speed[i], key = state.keys[d.id]}
                end
                writefile(FOLDER .. "/skills.json", HttpService:JSONEncode(out))
            end)
        end
        local function load()
            state.damage, state.speed, state.keys = state.damage or {}, state.speed or {}, state.keys or {}
            for i, d in ipairs(SKILLS) do
                state.damage[i] = state.damage[i] or math.huge
                state.speed[i] = state.speed[i] or 1
                if state.keys[d.id] == nil then state.keys[d.id] = d.key or false end
            end
            pcall(function()
                if not (isfile and isfile(FOLDER .. "/skills.json")) then return end
                local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(FOLDER .. "/skills.json"))
                if type(data.cutscenes) == "boolean" then state.cutscenes = data.cutscenes end
                if type(data.everyone) == "boolean" then state.everyone = data.everyone end
                for i, d in ipairs(SKILLS) do
                    local s = data.skills and data.skills[d.id]
                    if s then
                        if tonumber(s.power) and d.power then state.powers[i] = rSnap(rangeOf(d), tonumber(s.power)) end
                        if s.damage == "infinite" then state.damage[i] = math.huge elseif tonumber(s.damage) then state.damage[i] = DAMAGE[damageIndex(tonumber(s.damage)) + 1] end
                        if tonumber(s.speed) then state.speed[i] = rSnap(SPEED, tonumber(s.speed)) end
                        if s.key ~= nil then state.keys[d.id] = s.key end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        -- client.magic.f.a(KeyMapping): the key's short name.
        local function keyName(def)
            local k = state.keys and state.keys[def.id]
            if not k then return "" end
            local name = tostring(k)
            if #name <= 3 then return name:upper() end
            local words = {}
            for w in name:gsub("(%l)(%u)", "%1 %2"):gsub("(%a)(%d)", "%1 %2"):gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w end
            if #words == 1 then return name:sub(1, 3) end
            local out = ""
            for _, w in ipairs(words) do out = out .. (w:match("^%d") and w or w:sub(1, 1)) end
            return out:sub(1, 4)
        end
        local function keyClash(def)
            local k = state.keys and state.keys[def.id]
            if not k then return nil end
            for _, d in ipairs(SKILLS) do if d ~= def and state.keys[d.id] == k then return d end end
            return nil
        end
        -- client.magic.a: remaining recharge (ticks) and how much of it is left.
        local function rechargeLeft(def)
            local i = indexOf(def)
            if not i then return 0 end
            return max(0, ceil(((state.recharge[i] or 0) - os.clock()) * 20 - 1e-6))
        end
        local function rechargeFrac(def) return min(1, rechargeLeft(def) / max(1, def.recharge or RECHARGE)) end

        -- The items that carry skills (magic.b): the Stellar Remote and its skill list (client.magic.b.a: locked ones slotted in).
        local SKILLS_HAS_ADDON = false
        for _, d in ipairs(SKILLS) do if d.addon then SKILLS_HAS_ADDON = true end end
        local ITEMS = {{id = "stellar_remote", name = "Stellar Remote", colour = REMOTE_COLOUR,
            lore = "A random TV remote you found lying around. It probably does nothing... right?"}}
        local function skillList()
            local list = {}
            for _, d in ipairs(SKILLS) do list[#list + 1] = d end
            -- the remote's own order (star.k), the addon's skills after them
            table.sort(list, function(a, b) return (a.order or 50) < (b.order or 50) end)
            for _, lk in ipairs(LOCKED) do
                local at = nil
                for i, d in ipairs(list) do if d.id == lk.after then at = i end end
                -- (its skill not on this remote: it goes after the mod's own skills)
                if not at then at = 0; for i, d in ipairs(list) do if not d.addon and not d.locked then at = i end end end
                table.insert(list, at + 1, lk)
            end
            return list
        end
        local function itemSkills(idx) return skillList() end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- State (client.magic.h).
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local H = {j = "a", k = 0, l = 0, m = 0, n = 0, o = 0, p = 0, q = -1, r = 0, s = 0, t = -1, u = 0, v = nil, w = nil, x = nil, y = nil,
            O = nil, P = -10, z = {}, A = nil, B = -100, C = nil, D = -100, Q = -1, E = nil, F = -100, G = nil, R = {0, 0}, S = {0, 0}, T = {0, 0},
            U = 0, V = nil, Hs = -100, W = -10, I = 0, J = 0, K = 0, L = 0, M = false, X = 0, Y = -100, ab = 0, N = 0, carried = {false}}
        local list = {}
        local aj, ak = 164.88235, -150
        local function active() return H.j == "b" or H.j == "c" end
        local function isOpen() return H.j ~= "a" end
        local function hover(name, partial)
            local v = H.z[name]
            return v and lerp(partial, v[1], v[2]) or 0
        end
        local function isSlider(name) return name ~= nil and (name:sub(1, 6) == "power:" or name:sub(1, 7) == "damage:" or name:sub(1, 6) == "speed:") end
        local function skillOfName(name)
            local id = name:sub((name:find(":", 1, true) or 0) + 1)
            for _, d in ipairs(itemSkills(H.q)) do if d.id == id then return d end end
            return nil
        end
        local function sliderKind(name) return name:find("power:", 1, true) and 0 or (name:find("speed:", 1, true) and 2 or 1) end
        local function uiSound(name, pitch, volume) play(name, nil, volume, pitch) end
        local function ctx() return SteveMods.ctx end
        local function mcView()
            local c = ctx()
            if not (c and c.getView) then return 0, 0 end
            local yaw, pitch = c.getView()
            return -math.deg(yaw), -math.deg(pitch)
        end
        local function setMcView(yaw, pitch)
            local c = ctx()
            if c and c.setView then c.setView(-math.rad(yaw), -math.rad(pitch)) end
        end
        local function scanCarried()
