        local function shardCards(t, W, Hh)
            -- the fallback shards (c.a(g, 0xF2F7FF, a, cracking)): white triangles flying apart, drawn as cards too
            if not shards then shards = makeShards(W, Hh) end
            local v5 = 1 - c01((t - 8) / 6)
            local v6 = max(0, t - 1)
            local v7 = Hh * 0.0025
            local v8 = 1 - 0.3 * c01(v6 / 13)
            local out = {}
            for i, s in ipairs(shards) do
                local x16 = s.c + s.e * v6
                local y17 = s.d + s.f * v6 + 0.5 * v7 * v6 * v6
                local r = math.rad(s.g * v6)
                local cr, sr = cos(r), sin(r)
                local px, py = {}, {}
                for k = 1, 3 do
                    local dx, dy = (s.a[k] - s.c) * v8, (s.b[k] - s.d) * v8
                    px[k], py[k] = x16 + dx * cr - dy * sr, y17 + dx * sr + dy * cr
                end
                out[i] = {(px[2] - px[1]) / 64, (py[2] - py[1]) / 64, (px[3] - px[1]) / 64, (py[3] - py[1]) / 64, px[1], py[1]}
            end
            return out, v5, t < 2
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- h.java: open, close, ticks, keys, mouse.
        ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local hiddenGuis = {}
        local function hideHud(on)
            local pg = Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            if on then
                for _, g in ipairs(pg and pg:GetChildren() or {}) do
                    if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and g.Enabled and g.Name ~= "SteveWhiteSpaceOverlay" and (g.Name:find("Steve") or g.Name:find("Java") or g.Name:find("Minecraft")) then
                        hiddenGuis[g] = true; g.Enabled = false
                    end
                end
            else
                for g in pairs(hiddenGuis) do if g.Parent then g.Enabled = true end end
                hiddenGuis = {}
            end
        end
        local renderConn, inputConns = nil, {}
        local finish, close, shatter
        local function restoreView() setMcView(H.m, H.n) end
        local function storeView() local y, p = mcView(); H.o, H.p = wrapDeg(y - H.m), p end
        local function chooseItem(i)
            local tt = H.k
            H.t, H.u, H.q, H.r = H.q, tt, i, tt
            H.s = H.t >= 0 and tt + 3 or tt
            H.K, H.J, H.I = 0, 0, 0
        end
        local function selectSkill(def, name)
            if H.carried[1] then
                local i = indexOf(def)
                state.selected = i
                local c = ctx()
                play("staff_select", c and c.root and c.root.Position, 0.8, 0.9 + (i - 1) * 0.05)
                actionBar("✦ " .. def.label, def.colour)
                H.C, H.D, H.Q = name, H.k, H.k + 4
            else
                H.E, H.F = name, H.k
                uiSound("ws_deny", 1, 0.5)
            end
        end
        local function openInfo(def, idx, name)
            local src
            for _, el in ipairs(list) do if el.a == name then src = el end end
            local p4 = src and src.b or pos(0, 0, 1.88)
            local w5, h6 = src and src.e or 40, src and src.f or 20
            local y, p = mcView()
            local v8 = wrapDeg(y - H.m)
            local v10 = math.clamp(v8 * 0.7, -24, 24) / 0.17
            local v11 = math.clamp(-p * 0.7, -10, 10) / 0.17
            if H.v then H.v.j = H.k; H.w = H.v end
            H.v = {a = def, b = idx, c = name, d = p4, e = w5, f = h6, g = v10, h = v11, i = H.k, j = -1}
            uiSound("ws_info_open", 1, 0.45)
        end
        local function closeInfo()
            if H.v then
                H.v.j = H.k; H.w = H.v; H.v = nil; H.x = nil
                uiSound("ws_info_close", 1, 0.4)
            end
        end
        local function sliderSound(v)
            H.Hs = H.k
            if H.k - H.W >= 1 then uiSound("ws_hover", 0.8 + 0.8 * c01(v), 0.22); H.W = H.k end
        end
        local function stepSlider(name, dir)
            local def = skillOfName(name)
            if not (def and def.power) then return end
            local changed
            if name:sub(1, 6) == "power:" then changed = setPower(def, rStep(rangeOf(def), power(def), dir))
            elseif name:sub(1, 6) == "speed:" then changed = setSpeed(def, rStep(SPEED, speed(def), dir))
            else changed = setDamage(def, damageIndex(damage(def)) + dir) end
            if changed then sliderSound(sliderPos(def, sliderKind(name))); save() end
        end
        local function dragSlider(u)
            if not H.G or u ~= u then return end
            local def = skillOfName(H.G)
            if not (def and def.power) then return end
            local changed
            if H.G:sub(1, 6) == "power:" then changed = setPower(def, rFromU(rangeOf(def), u))
            elseif H.G:sub(1, 6) == "speed:" then changed = setSpeed(def, rFromU(SPEED, u))
            else changed = setDamage(def, round(c01(u) * (#DAMAGE - 1))) end
            if changed then sliderSound(u) end
        end
        local function scrollList(dir)
            H.Y = H.k
            local v = stepScroll(H.K, dir)
            if v ~= H.K then
                H.K = v
                if H.k - H.W >= 1 then uiSound("ws_hover", 1, 0.18); H.W = H.k end
            end
        end
        local function onSelect(name)
            if name == nil then if H.v then closeInfo() end; return end
            if name == "switch:cutscenes" then
                state.cutscenes = not state.cutscenes; saveDirty = true; save()
                uiSound(state.cutscenes and "ws_bound" or "ws_bind", state.cutscenes and 1.2 or 0.9, 0.4)
            elseif name == "switch:everyone" then
                state.everyone = not state.everyone; saveDirty = true; save()
                uiSound(state.everyone and "ws_bound" or "ws_bind", state.everyone and 1.2 or 0.9, 0.4)
            elseif isSlider(name) then
                H.G = name
                uiSound("ws_bind", 1.3, 0.3)
            elseif name:sub(1, 5) == "item:" then
                local idx = -1
                for i, it in ipairs(ITEMS) do if it.id == name:sub(6) then idx = i - 1 end end
                if idx < 0 or (idx == H.q and H.t ~= idx) then return end
                chooseItem(idx)
            elseif name:sub(1, 6) == "skill:" then
                local id = name:sub(7)
                for _, lk in ipairs(LOCKED) do
                    if lk.id == id then H.E, H.F = name, H.k; uiSound("ws_deny", 1, 0.35); openInfo(lk, H.q, name); return end
                end
                local def = skillOfName(name)
                if def then selectSkill(def, name) end
            elseif name == "info:setkey" and H.v and H.v.a and not H.v.a.locked then
                H.x = H.v.a
                uiSound("ws_bind", 1, 0.45)
            elseif name == "info:select" and H.v and H.v.a and not H.v.a.locked then
                selectSkill(H.v.a, name)
            elseif name == "info:close" then
                closeInfo()
            end
        end
        local function onDetails(name)
            if name == nil then if H.v then closeInfo() end; return end
            if name:sub(1, 5) == "item:" then
                for i, it in ipairs(ITEMS) do if it.id == name:sub(6) then openInfo(nil, i - 1, name) end end
            elseif name:sub(1, 6) == "skill:" then
                local id = name:sub(7)
                for _, lk in ipairs(LOCKED) do if lk.id == id then openInfo(lk, H.q, name); return end end
                local def = skillOfName(name)
                if def then openInfo(def, H.q, name) end
            end
        end
        local accum = 0
        local lastW, lastH = 0, 0
        local function tick()
            if H.j == "a" then return end
            local c = ctx()
            local hum = c and c.humanoid
            H.k = H.k + 1
            for name, v in pairs(H.z) do
                v[1] = v[2]
                local target = (name == H.y and active()) and 1 or 0
                v[2] = v[2] + (target - v[2]) * 0.5
            end
            if H.y and active() and not H.z[H.y] then H.z[H.y] = {0, 0} end
            if not active() then for name, v in pairs(H.z) do if v[1] < 0.002 and v[2] < 0.002 then H.z[name] = nil end end end
            H.R[1] = H.R[2]; H.R[2] = H.R[2] + ((state.cutscenes and 1 or 0) - H.R[2]) * 0.6
            H.S[1] = H.S[2]; H.S[2] = H.S[2] + ((state.everyone and 1 or 0) - H.S[2]) * 0.6
            H.T[1] = H.T[2]; H.T[2] = H.T[2] + ((state.cutscenes and 1 or 0) - H.T[2]) * 0.45
            H.J = H.I
            H.I = H.I + (H.K - H.I) * 0.45
            if abs(H.K - H.I) < 0.05 then H.I = H.K end
            scanCarried()
            if active() then
                local health = hum and hum.Health or 20
                if (hum and (health < H.ab - 0.01 or health <= 0)) then shatter()
                elseif GuiService.MenuIsOpen then close()
                elseif H.Q >= 0 and H.k >= H.Q then close() end
            end
            H.ab = hum and hum.Health or 20
            if H.y and H.y ~= H.O and active() and H.k - H.P >= 2 and H.y ~= "info" then uiSound("ws_hover", 1, 0.25); H.P = H.k end
            H.O = H.y
            if H.q >= 0 and active() and H.k == ceil(H.r) then uiSound("ws_open", 1, 0.45) end
            if H.w and H.k - H.w.j >= 5 then H.w = nil end
            if H.j == "b" and H.k - H.l >= 10 then H.j = "c"; H.l = H.k
            elseif (H.j == "d" and H.k - H.l >= 8) or (H.j == "e" and H.k - H.l >= 14) then finish() end
        end
        local function render(dt)
            if H.j == "a" then return end
            accum = accum + dt
            while accum >= 0.05 do accum = accum - 0.05; tick(); if H.j == "a" then return end end
            local partial = accum / 0.05
            local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            local vp = cam.ViewportSize
            local gs = JavaGui.scale(vp)
            local W, Hh = vp.X / gs, vp.Y / gs
            fontIndex = (function()
                local v = vp.Y * 0.5 * (math.tan(0.17 * RAD) / math.tan(35 * RAD))
                local best = 1
                for i, d in ipairs(WS_FONTS.sizes) do if abs(d / 10 - v) < abs(WS_FONTS.sizes[best] / 10 - v) then best = i end end
                return best
            end)()
            -- the view, held inside the ellipse h.a(double, double) keeps it in (55 x 45 degrees)
            if active() then
                local y, p = mcView()
                local rel = wrapDeg(y - H.m)
                local e = sqrt(rel * rel / 3025 + p * p / 2025)
                if e > 1 then setMcView(H.m + rel / e, p / e) end
            end
            local yaw, pitch
            if active() then local y, p = mcView(); yaw, pitch = wrapDeg(y - H.m), p else yaw, pitch = H.o, H.p end
            local t = H.k + partial
            local P = Proj(yaw, pitch, W, Hh)
            list = build(P, t, partial)
            if active() then
                if H.G then
                    for _, el in ipairs(list) do
                        if el.a == H.G then local u = inverse(el, W * 0.5, Hh * 0.5); dragSlider(u and (u - 44) / 68 or 0 / 0) end
                    end
                end
                H.y = H.G or pick(list, W, Hh)
            end
            local cf = cam.CFrame
            frameCam = {pos = cf.Position, right = cf.RightVector, up = cf.UpVector, look = cf.LookVector, vx = vp.X, vy = vp.Y, gs = gs,
                fy = vp.Y * 0.5 / math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) * 0.5)}
            -- the sheet
            local kz = DEPTH * 1.5 / frameCam.fy
            root.sheet.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(cf.Position + cf.LookVector * DEPTH * 1.5, cf.RightVector, cf.UpVector)
            root.sheet.Size = Vector3.new(vp.X * kz, vp.Y * kz, 0.01)
            set(root.sheetGui, "CanvasSize", vp)
            drawBackground(t, W, Hh, gs)
            -- the panels, far to near
            local sorted = table.clone(list)
            table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) return a.v > b.v end)
            local S = max(2, math.ceil(gs))
            local parts, cfs = {}, {}
            for _, c in pairs(cards) do c.used = false end
            local z = 1
            local function drawCard(name, T, w, h, fn)
                local card = cards[name] or G.newCard(name)
                card.S = S
                G.begin(card)
                card.n, card.z, card.tx, card.ty, card.ts = {}, 0, 0, 0, 1
                local ok = placeCard(card, T, w, h, S, z)
                if ok then
                    card.used = true
                    local okDraw, err = pcall(fn)
                    if not okDraw and not root.warned then root.warned = true; warn("[White Space] " .. tostring(err)) end
                    for kind, pool in pairs(card.pools) do
                        for i = (card.n[kind] or 0) + 1, #pool do set(pool[i], "Visible", false) end
                    end
                    parts[#parts + 1], cfs[#cfs + 1] = card.part, card.cf
                    z = z + 1
                end
            end
            if H.j == "e" then
                local mats, a, cracking = shardCards(t - H.l, W, Hh)
                for i, T in ipairs(mats) do
                    drawCard("shard:" .. i, T, 64, 64, function()
                         G.sprite(asset(cracking and "images/ws_shard_crack.png" or "images/ws_shard.png"), 0, 0, 64, 64, WHITE, a, true)
                    end)
                end
                local v3 = t - H.l
                root.bg.White.BackgroundTransparency = v3 < 2 and 1 - 0.75 * (1 - v3 / 2) or 1
            end
            for _, el in ipairs(sorted) do
                if el.t and el.i > 0.004 then
                    local fn = PAINT[el.g]
                    if fn then drawCard(el.a, el.t, el.e, el.f, function() fn(el, t, partial) end) end
                end
            end
            for name, c in pairs(cards) do
                if not c.used then set(c.gui, "Enabled", false) else set(c.gui, "Enabled", true) end
            end
            Workspace:BulkMoveTo(parts, cfs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
            drawOverlay(t, partial, W, Hh, gs)
            -- the game turns its HUD back on every frame (F1): keep what the menu hid hidden
            for g in pairs(hiddenGuis) do if g.Enabled then g.Enabled = false end end
        end
        local function teardown()
            if renderConn then renderConn:Disconnect(); renderConn = nil end
            for _, c in ipairs(inputConns) do c:Disconnect() end
            inputConns = {}
            for k, c in pairs(cards) do c.part:Destroy(); c.gui:Destroy(); cards[k] = nil end
            if root.sheet then root.sheet:Destroy() end
            if root.folder then root.folder:Destroy() end
            if overlay.gui then overlay.gui:Destroy() end
            root, overlay, shards = {}, {}, nil
            addition.frame, addition.key = nil, nil
            SteveMods.inputBlocked = false
            hideHud(false)
        end
        finish = function()
            -- h.c(Minecraft): the close is done.
            H.j = "a"
            H.G = nil
            H.v, H.w = nil, nil
            save()
            teardown()
        end
        close = function()
            if not active() then return end
            storeView()
            H.j, H.l, H.x, H.G = "d", H.k, nil, nil
            save()
            restoreView()
            SteveMods.inputBlocked = false
            uiSound("ws_warp_out", 1, 0.6)
        end
        shatter = function()
            storeView()
            H.j, H.l, H.x, H.G = "e", H.k, nil, nil
            save()
            shards = nil
            H.N = (math.random() - 0.5)
            restoreView()
            SteveMods.inputBlocked = false
            uiSound("ws_shatter", 1, 0.85)
        end
        local function onKey(input)
            if not active() then return end
            local kc = input.KeyCode
            if H.x then
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or kc == Enum.KeyCode.Delete then
                    state.keys[H.x.id] = false; uiSound("ws_bound", 0.8, 0.45)
                elseif kc ~= Enum.KeyCode.Escape and kc ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                    state.keys[H.x.id] = kc.Name; uiSound("ws_bound", 1, 0.45)
                end
                saveDirty = true; save()
                H.x = nil
                return
            end
            if H.C then return end
            if kc == Enum.KeyCode.H then close(); return end
            if SKILLS_HAS_ADDON and additionKey(kc) then return end
            if isSlider(H.y) and not H.v and (kc == Enum.KeyCode.Right or kc == Enum.KeyCode.Left) then
                stepSlider(H.y, kc == Enum.KeyCode.Right and 1 or -1); return
            end
            if H.L > 0 and not H.v and (kc == Enum.KeyCode.Up or kc == Enum.KeyCode.Down) then
                scrollList(kc == Enum.KeyCode.Down and 1 or -1); return
            end
            if H.L > 0 and not H.v and (kc == Enum.KeyCode.PageUp or kc == Enum.KeyCode.PageDown) then
                local n = pageSize(H.K)
                H.Y = H.k
                for _ = 1, n do scrollList(kc == Enum.KeyCode.PageDown and 1 or -1) end
                return
            end
            if H.q >= 0 then
                for _, def in ipairs(SKILLS) do
                    if state.keys[def.id] and state.keys[def.id] == kc.Name then selectSkill(def, "skill:" .. def.id); return end
                end
            end
        end
        local function onWheel(dz)
            if not active() or H.G or H.v then return end
            if H.L > 0 and not (isSlider(H.y) and H.k - H.Y >= 10) then
                H.X = H.X + dz
                local n = H.X >= 0 and floor(H.X) or ceil(H.X)
                H.X = H.X - n
                if n ~= 0 then scrollList(-n) end
                return
            end
            if isSlider(H.y) then
                if H.y ~= H.V then H.U = 0; H.V = H.y end
                H.U = H.U + dz
                local n = H.U >= 0 and floor(H.U) or ceil(H.U)
                H.U = H.U - n
                for _ = 1, min(abs(n), 5) do stepSlider(H.y, n > 0 and 1 or -1) end
            end
        end
        local function open()
            if H.j ~= "a" then return end
            local c = ctx()
            if not c or (c.humanoid and c.humanoid.Health <= 0) then return end
            load()
            scanCarried()
            makeRoots()
            local y, p = mcView()
            H.j, H.k, H.l, H.m, H.n = "b", 0, 0, y, p
            H.ab = c.humanoid and c.humanoid.Health or 20
            H.q = 0
            H.r, H.s, H.t = 13, 13, -1
            H.v, H.w, H.x, H.y, H.O, H.z, H.A, H.C, H.E, H.G = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, {}, nil, nil, nil, nil
            local cut, every = state.cutscenes and 1 or 0, state.everyone and 1 or 0
            H.R, H.S, H.T = {cut, cut}, {every, every}, {cut, cut}
            H.Q, H.K, H.J, H.I, H.Y, H.X, H.M = -1, 0, 0, 0, -100, 0, true
            accum = 0
            SteveMods.inputBlocked = true
            if c.resetInput then pcall(c.resetInput) end
            hideHud(true)
            uiSound("ws_warp_in", 1, 0.65)
            RunService:BindToRenderStep("SteveWhiteSpace", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 5, function(dt)
                local ok, err = pcall(render, math.min(dt, 0.1))
                if not ok then warn("[White Space] " .. tostring(err)); pcall(finish); H.j = "a" end
            end)
            renderConn = {Disconnect = function() pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("SteveWhiteSpace") end) end}
            inputConns[#inputConns + 1] = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
                local t = input.UserInputType
                if t == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then onKey(input)
                elseif (t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) and active() then
                    if H.x then H.x = nil; return end
                    if H.C then return end
                    local name = H.y
                    H.A, H.B = name, H.k
                    if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then onSelect(name) else onDetails(name) end
                end
            end)
            inputConns[#inputConns + 1] = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and H.G then
                    H.G = nil
                    save()
                    uiSound("ws_bound", 1.2, 0.3)
                end
            end)
            inputConns[#inputConns + 1] = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then onWheel(input.Position.Z) end
            end)
            inputConns[#inputConns + 1] = UIS.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
                if H.G then H.G = nil; save(); uiSound("ws_bound", 1.2, 0.3) end
            end)
        end
        local api = {}
        function api.open() open() end
        function api.close() close() end
        function api.toggle() if active() then close() elseif H.j == "a" then open() end end
        function api.isOpen() return isOpen() end
        function api.kill() if H.j ~= "a" then H.j = "a"; teardown() end end
        function api.load() load() end
        function api.selectByKey(kc)
            for i, def in ipairs(SKILLS) do
                if state.keys and state.keys[def.id] == kc.Name then return i end
            end
        end
        api.state = H
        return api
    end)()

    local menu = {}
    local function closeMenu() WS.kill() end
    function SS.openMenu() WS.toggle() end
    SS.menu = WS
    -- R opens the skill menu while holding the remote (Java's skill_menu key).
    local inputConn, moveConn, endConn
    local function bindKeys()
        if inputConn then return end
        inputConn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
            if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() or not SS.enabled then return end
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.H then
                local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
                local stack = ctx and ctx.world and ctx.world.mainStack
                local entry = stack and JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
                SS.openMenu()
            elseif not WS.isOpen() and WS.selectByKey(input.KeyCode) then
                -- A skill's own key (client ShootingStarDemoClient.tick): selects it while you hold the remote.
                local ctx = SteveMods.ctx
                local stack = ctx and ctx.world and ctx.world.mainStack
                local entry = stack and JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
                if entry and entry.id == "stellar_remote" then
                    local i = WS.selectByKey(input.KeyCode)
                    state.selected = i
                    play("staff_select", ctx.root and ctx.root.Position, 0.8, 0.9 + (i - 1) * 0.05)
                    actionBar("✦ " .. SKILLS[i].label, SKILLS[i].colour)
                end
            elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.J then
                -- cinematic.d.f(): skip the cutscene playing, otherwise toggle cutscenes.
                local fc = state.filmCast
                if fc and fc.filmOn and fc.t and not fc.skipped then
                    fc.skipped = fc.t
                else
                    state.cutscenes = not state.cutscenes
                    actionBar(state.cutscenes and "Spell cutscenes: ON" or "Spell cutscenes: OFF")
                end
            end
        end)
        moveConn = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if menu.drag and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then menu.drag(input) end
        end)
        endConn = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if menu.release and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then menu.release() end
        end)
    end

    -- Items and blocks the mod adds ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local modBlocksData
    local function modBlocks()
        if modBlocksData ~= nil then return modBlocksData or nil end
        modBlocksData = false
        pcall(function()
            local path = FOLDER .. "/film/addition/modblocks.json"
            if isfile and isfile(path) then modBlocksData = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(path)) end
        end)
        return modBlocksData or nil
    end
    -- The blocks of both mods (gen_modblocks.py): local texture / model indices shifted onto the end of the catalog's.
    local function registerBlocks()
        local MB = modBlocks()
        if not MB then return end
        local data = JavaContent.data
        local texBase, modelBase = #data.textures, #data.models
        for _, tx in ipairs(MB.textures) do data.textures[#data.textures + 1] = tx end
        for _, m in ipairs(MB.models) do

-- BEGIN MOD: VILLAGER NEWS
;(function()
local Molang = (function()
-- Molang (Bedrock Edition's expression language), compiled to Lua closures. Plain Lua 5.1 subset: runs in Luau and in
-- the offline tests.
--   Molang.compile(source) -> fn(env) -> value
--   env = {v = variables (per entity), t = temps (fresh per run), c = context, q = function(name, args, env) -> value,
--          arrays = {name = list}, rand = function() -> 0..1}
-- Values are numbers, strings, tables (structs) or resource references ("texture:x", "geometry:x", "material:x").
-- Booleans are 1 / 0. Angles in Math.sin / cos / asin / acos / atan / atan2 are degrees, as in Bedrock.
local Molang = {}

local floor, abs = math.floor, math.abs
local RAD = math.pi / 180

-- Tokens --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function tokenize(src)
    local toks, i, n = {}, 1, #src
    while i <= n do
        local c = src:sub(i, i)
        if c:match("%s") then
            i = i + 1
        elseif c:match("%d") or (c == "." and src:sub(i + 1, i + 1):match("%d")) then
            local j = i
            while j <= n and src:sub(j, j):match("[%d%.]") do j = j + 1 end
            if src:sub(j, j):match("[eE]") and src:sub(j + 1, j + 1):match("[%d%-%+]") then
                j = j + 2
                while j <= n and src:sub(j, j):match("%d") do j = j + 1 end
            end
            local text = src:sub(i, j - 1)
            if src:sub(j, j):match("[fF]") then j = j + 1 end
            toks[#toks + 1] = {k = "num", v = tonumber(text) or 0}
            i = j
        elseif c:match("[%a_]") then
            local j = i
            while j <= n and src:sub(j, j):match("[%w_%.]") do j = j + 1 end
            local word = src:sub(i, j - 1)
            -- a trailing dot belongs to nothing
            while word:sub(-1) == "." do word = word:sub(1, -2); j = j - 1 end
            toks[#toks + 1] = {k = "id", v = word, lower = word:lower()}
            i = j
        elseif c == "'" or c == '"' then
            local j = src:find(c, i + 1, true) or (n + 1)
            toks[#toks + 1] = {k = "str", v = src:sub(i + 1, j - 1)}
            i = j + 1
        else
            local two = src:sub(i, i + 1)
            if two == "&&" or two == "||" or two == "==" or two == "!=" or two == "<=" or two == ">=" or two == "??" or two == "->" then
                toks[#toks + 1] = {k = "op", v = two}
                i = i + 2
            else
                toks[#toks + 1] = {k = "op", v = c}
                i = i + 1
            end
        end
    end
    toks[#toks + 1] = {k = "eof", v = ""}
    return toks
end

-- Value helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function num(x)
    local t = type(x)
    if t == "number" then return x end
    if t == "boolean" then return x and 1 or 0 end
    return 0
end
local function truthy(x)
    if x == nil or x == false then return false end
    if type(x) == "number" then return x ~= 0 end
    return true
end
local function b(x) return x and 1 or 0 end

-- Paths: "v.a.b" -> scope "v", keys {"a", "b"}
local SCOPES = {v = "v", variable = "v", t = "t", temp = "t", c = "c", context = "c"}
local function getPath(env, scope, keys)
    local tbl = env[scope]
    if tbl == nil then return nil end
    for i = 1, #keys do
        if type(tbl) ~= "table" then return nil end
        tbl = tbl[keys[i]]
        if tbl == nil then return nil end
    end
    return tbl
end
local function setPath(env, scope, keys, value)
    local tbl = env[scope]
    if tbl == nil then tbl = {}; env[scope] = tbl end
    for i = 1, #keys - 1 do
        local nxt = tbl[keys[i]]
        if type(nxt) ~= "table" then nxt = {}; tbl[keys[i]] = nxt end
        tbl = nxt
    end
    tbl[keys[#keys]] = value
end

-- Math ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function rnd(env) return env.rand and env.rand() or math.random() end
local function lerprotate(a, b2, t)
    local d = ((b2 - a) % 360 + 540) % 360 - 180
    return a + d * t
end
local MATH = {
    abs = function(_, a) return abs(num(a)) end,
    sin = function(_, a) return math.sin(num(a) * RAD) end,
    cos = function(_, a) return math.cos(num(a) * RAD) end,
    asin = function(_, a) return math.asin(math.max(-1, math.min(1, num(a)))) / RAD end,
    acos = function(_, a) return math.acos(math.max(-1, math.min(1, num(a)))) / RAD end,
    atan = function(_, a) return math.atan(num(a)) / RAD end,
    atan2 = function(_, y, x) local yy, xx = num(y), num(x); local r
        if xx > 0 then r = math.atan(yy / xx) elseif xx < 0 then r = math.atan(yy / xx) + (yy >= 0 and math.pi or -math.pi)
        else r = yy > 0 and math.pi / 2 or (yy < 0 and -math.pi / 2 or 0) end
        return r / RAD end,
    ceil = function(_, a) return math.ceil(num(a)) end,
    floor = function(_, a) return floor(num(a)) end,
    round = function(_, a) return floor(num(a) + 0.5) end,
    trunc = function(_, a) local x = num(a); return x < 0 and math.ceil(x) or floor(x) end,
    clamp = function(_, a, lo, hi) return math.max(num(lo), math.min(num(hi), num(a))) end,
    lerp = function(_, a, b2, t) a, b2, t = num(a), num(b2), num(t); return a + (b2 - a) * t end,
    lerprotate = function(_, a, b2, t) return lerprotate(num(a), num(b2), num(t)) end,
    ln = function(_, a) local x = num(a); return x > 0 and math.log(x) or 0 end,
    exp = function(_, a) return math.exp(num(a)) end,
    max = function(_, a, b2) return math.max(num(a), num(b2)) end,
    min = function(_, a, b2) return math.min(num(a), num(b2)) end,
    min_angle = function(_, a) return ((num(a) % 360) + 540) % 360 - 180 end,
    mod = function(_, a, b2) local y = num(b2); if y == 0 then return 0 end; local x = num(a); return x - y * (x / y < 0 and math.ceil(x / y) or floor(x / y)) end,
    pow = function(_, a, b2) return num(a) ^ num(b2) end,
    sqrt = function(_, a) local x = num(a); return x > 0 and math.sqrt(x) or 0 end,
    sign = function(_, a) local x = num(a); return x > 0 and 1 or (x < 0 and -1 or 0) end,
    copy_sign = function(_, a, s) local x = abs(num(a)); return num(s) < 0 and -x or x end,
    pi = function() return math.pi end,
    random = function(env, lo, hi) lo, hi = num(lo), num(hi); return lo + (hi - lo) * rnd(env) end,
    random_integer = function(env, lo, hi) lo, hi = floor(num(lo)), floor(num(hi)); return lo + floor(rnd(env) * (hi - lo + 1)) end,
    die_roll = function(env, n, lo, hi) local s = 0; for _ = 1, floor(num(n)) do s = s + num(lo) + (num(hi) - num(lo)) * rnd(env) end; return s end,
    die_roll_integer = function(env, n, lo, hi) local s = 0; for _ = 1, floor(num(n)) do s = s + floor(num(lo)) + floor(rnd(env) * (floor(num(hi)) - floor(num(lo)) + 1)) end; return s end,
    hermite_blend = function(_, a) local t = num(a); return 3 * t * t - 2 * t * t * t end,
    ease_in_quad = function(_, a, b2, t) t = num(t); return num(a) + (num(b2) - num(a)) * t * t end,
    ease_out_quad = function(_, a, b2, t) t = num(t); return num(a) + (num(b2) - num(a)) * (1 - (1 - t) * (1 - t)) end,
    ease_in_out_quad = function(_, a, b2, t) t = num(t); local k = t < 0.5 and 2 * t * t or 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ^ 2 / 2; return num(a) + (num(b2) - num(a)) * k end,
    ease_in_cubic = function(_, a, b2, t) t = num(t); return num(a) + (num(b2) - num(a)) * t * t * t end,
    ease_out_cubic = function(_, a, b2, t) t = num(t); return num(a) + (num(b2) - num(a)) * (1 - (1 - t) ^ 3) end,
    ease_in_out_cubic = function(_, a, b2, t) t = num(t); local k = t < 0.5 and 4 * t * t * t or 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ^ 3 / 2; return num(a) + (num(b2) - num(a)) * k end,
    ease_in_sine = function(_, a, b2, t) t = num(t); return num(a) + (num(b2) - num(a)) * (1 - math.cos(t * math.pi / 2)) end,
    ease_out_sine = function(_, a, b2, t) t = num(t); return num(a) + (num(b2) - num(a)) * math.sin(t * math.pi / 2) end,
    ease_in_out_sine = function(_, a, b2, t) t = num(t); return num(a) + (num(b2) - num(a)) * (-(math.cos(math.pi * t) - 1) / 2) end,
    inverse_lerp = function(_, a, b2, v) a, b2 = num(a), num(b2); if a == b2 then return 0 end; return (num(v) - a) / (b2 - a) end,
}

-- Parser: recursive descent straight to closures ------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Control flow (return / break / continue) travels in env._flow.
local Parser = {}
Parser.__index = Parser
local function newParser(toks) return setmetatable({toks = toks, i = 1}, Parser) end
function Parser:peek() return self.toks[self.i] end
function Parser:next() local t = self.toks[self.i]; self.i = self.i + 1; return t end
function Parser:isOp(v) local t = self.toks[self.i]; return t.k == "op" and t.v == v end
function Parser:expectOp(v) if self:isOp(v) then self.i = self.i + 1 else error("molang: expected '" .. v .. "' near token " .. self.i) end end

-- statements: expr { ; expr } ; returns a closure running them all, the value of a `return` (or 0)
function Parser:statements(stop)
    local list = {}
    while true do
        while self:isOp(";") do self:next() end
        local t = self:peek()
        if t.k == "eof" or (stop and self:isOp(stop)) then break end
        list[#list + 1] = self:statement()
        if not self:isOp(";") then
            local t2 = self:peek()
            if t2.k == "eof" or (stop and self:isOp(stop)) then break end
        end
    end
    local count = #list
    return function(env)
        for k = 1, count do
            list[k](env)
            if env._flow then return end
        end
    end
end
function Parser:statement()
    local t = self:peek()
    if t.k == "id" then
        local w = t.lower
        if w == "return" then
            self:next()
            local e = self:expr()
            return function(env) env._ret = e(env); env._flow = "return" end
        elseif w == "break" then self:next(); return function(env) env._flow = "break" end
        elseif w == "continue" then self:next(); return function(env) env._flow = "continue" end
        end
    end
    local e = self:expr()
    return function(env) e(env) end
end

function Parser:expr() return self:assignment() end
function Parser:assignment()
    local start = self.i
    local t = self:peek()
    if t.k == "id" then
        local parts = {}
        for p in t.lower:gmatch("[^%.]+") do parts[#parts + 1] = p end
        local scope = SCOPES[parts[1]]
        if scope and #parts >= 2 then
            self:next()
            if self:isOp("=") then
                self:next()
                local keys = {}
                for k = 2, #parts do keys[#keys + 1] = parts[k] end
                local rhs = self:assignment()
                return function(env) local v = rhs(env); setPath(env, scope, keys, v); return v end
            end
            self.i = start
        end
    end
    return self:conditional()
end
function Parser:conditional()
    local cond = self:coalesce()
    if self:isOp("?") then
        self:next()
        local a = self:conditional()
        if self:isOp(":") then
            self:next()
            local c = self:conditional()
            return function(env) if truthy(cond(env)) then return a(env) end return c(env) end
        end
        return function(env) if truthy(cond(env)) then return a(env) end return 0 end
    end
    return cond
end
function Parser:coalesce()
    local left = self:orExpr()
    while self:isOp("??") do
        self:next()
        local l, r = left, self:orExpr()
        left = function(env) local v = l(env); if v == nil then return r(env) end return v end
    end
    return left
end
function Parser:orExpr()
    local left = self:andExpr()
    while self:isOp("||") do
        self:next()
        local l, r = left, self:andExpr()
        left = function(env) return b(truthy(l(env)) or truthy(r(env))) end
    end
    return left
end
function Parser:andExpr()
    local left = self:compare()
    while self:isOp("&&") do
        self:next()
        local l, r = left, self:compare()
        left = function(env) return b(truthy(l(env)) and truthy(r(env))) end
    end
    return left
end
local function eq(a, c)
    if type(a) == "string" or type(c) == "string" then return tostring(a or "") == tostring(c or "") end
    return num(a) == num(c)
end
function Parser:compare()
    local left = self:additive()
    while true do
        local t = self:peek()
        if t.k ~= "op" then break end
        local op = t.v
        if op == "==" or op == "!=" or op == "<" or op == ">" or op == "<=" or op == ">=" then
            self:next()
            local l, r = left, self:additive()
            if op == "==" then left = function(env) return b(eq(l(env), r(env))) end
            elseif op == "!=" then left = function(env) return b(not eq(l(env), r(env))) end
            elseif op == "<" then left = function(env) return b(num(l(env)) < num(r(env))) end
            elseif op == ">" then left = function(env) return b(num(l(env)) > num(r(env))) end
            elseif op == "<=" then left = function(env) return b(num(l(env)) <= num(r(env))) end
            else left = function(env) return b(num(l(env)) >= num(r(env))) end end
        else break end
    end
    return left
end
function Parser:additive()
    local left = self:multiplicative()
    while self:isOp("+") or self:isOp("-") do
        local op = self:next().v
        local l, r = left, self:multiplicative()
        if op == "+" then left = function(env) return num(l(env)) + num(r(env)) end
        else left = function(env) return num(l(env)) - num(r(env)) end end
    end
    return left
end
function Parser:multiplicative()
    local left = self:unary()
    while self:isOp("*") or self:isOp("/") do
        local op = self:next().v
        local l, r = left, self:unary()
        if op == "*" then left = function(env) return num(l(env)) * num(r(env)) end
        else left = function(env) local d = num(r(env)); if d == 0 then return 0 end return num(l(env)) / d end end
    end
    return left
end
function Parser:unary()
    if self:isOp("!") then self:next(); local e = self:unary(); return function(env) return b(not truthy(e(env))) end end
    if self:isOp("-") then self:next(); local e = self:unary(); return function(env) return -num(e(env)) end end
    if self:isOp("+") then self:next(); return self:unary() end
    return self:postfix()
end
function Parser:args()
    local list = {}
    if self:isOp("(") then
        self:next()
        if not self:isOp(")") then
            repeat
                if self:isOp(",") then self:next() end
                list[#list + 1] = self:expr()
            until not self:isOp(",")
        end
        self:expectOp(")")
    end
    return list
end
function Parser:postfix()
    local e = self:primary()
    -- a->b: b read on another entity (its env, e.g. c.owning_entity for attachables)
    while self:isOp("->") do
        self:next()
        local other, rhs = e, self:primary()
        e = function(env)
            local o = other(env)
            if type(o) ~= "table" or o.v == nil then return 0 end
            return rhs(o)
        end
    end
    while self:isOp("[") do
        self:next()
        local idx = self:expr()
        self:expectOp("]")
        local base = e
        e = function(env)
            local arr = base(env)
            if type(arr) ~= "table" or #arr == 0 then return nil end
            local k = floor(num(idx(env)))
            k = k % #arr
            return arr[k + 1]
        end
    end
    return e
end
local function evalArgs(list, env)
    local out = {}
    for k = 1, #list do out[k] = list[k](env) end
    return out
end
function Parser:primary()
    local t = self:next()
    if t.k == "num" then local v = t.v; return function() return v end end
    if t.k == "str" then local v = t.v; return function() return v end end
    if t.k == "op" then
        if t.v == "(" then
            -- (a; b) is allowed too: a statement list whose value is its last return
            local e = self:expr()
            if self:isOp(";") then
                local first = e
                local rest = self:statements(")")
                self:expectOp(")")
                return function(env) first(env); rest(env); return env._ret or 0 end
            end
            self:expectOp(")")
            return e
        elseif t.v == "{" then
            local body = self:statements("}")
            self:expectOp("}")
            return function(env) body(env); return 0 end
        end
        error("molang: unexpected '" .. t.v .. "'")
    end
    if t.k == "eof" then return function() return 0 end end
    local word = t.lower
    local parts = {}
    for p in word:gmatch("[^%.]+") do parts[#parts + 1] = p end
    local head = parts[1]
    if head == "true" then return function() return 1 end end
    if head == "false" then return function() return 0 end end
    if head == "this" then return function(env) return env.this or 0 end end
    if head == "math" then
        local fn = MATH[parts[2] or ""] or function() return 0 end
        local args = self:args()
        return function(env)
            local a = evalArgs(args, env)
            return fn(env, a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4])
        end
    end
    if head == "q" or head == "query" then
        local name = parts[2] or ""
        local args = self:args()
        return function(env)
            local q = env.q
            if not q then return 0 end
            return q(name, evalArgs(args, env), env)
        end
    end
    if head == "texture" or head == "geometry" or head == "material" then
        local ref = head .. ":" .. t.v:sub(#head + 2)
        return function() return ref end
    end
    if head == "array" then
        local name = t.v:sub(7)
        return function(env) return env.arrays and env.arrays[name:lower()] or nil end
    end
    if head == "loop" then
        local args = self:args()
        return function(env)
            local count = floor(num(args[1](env)))
            for _ = 1, math.min(count, 1024) do
                args[2](env)
                local f = env._flow
                if f == "break" then env._flow = nil; break end
                if f == "continue" then env._flow = nil end
                if f == "return" then break end
            end
            return 0
        end
    end
    if head == "for_each" then
        -- for_each(t.x, array, {body})
        self:expectOp("(")
        local vt = self:next()
        local vparts = {}
        for p in vt.lower:gmatch("[^%.]+") do vparts[#vparts + 1] = p end
        local scope, keys = SCOPES[vparts[1]] or "t", {}
        for k = 2, #vparts do keys[#keys + 1] = vparts[k] end
        self:expectOp(",")
        local arr = self:expr()
        self:expectOp(",")
        local body = self:expr()
        self:expectOp(")")
        return function(env)
            local list = arr(env)
            if type(list) ~= "table" then return 0 end
            for _, item in ipairs(list) do
                setPath(env, scope, keys, item)
                body(env)
                local f = env._flow
                if f == "break" then env._flow = nil; break end
                if f == "continue" then env._flow = nil end
                if f == "return" then break end
            end
            return 0
        end
    end
    local scope = SCOPES[head]
    if scope then
        local keys = {}
        for k = 2, #parts do keys[#keys + 1] = parts[k] end
        if #keys == 0 then return function() return 0 end end
        return function(env) return getPath(env, scope, keys) end
    end
    -- unknown identifiers read as 0 (Bedrock logs and carries on)
    return function() return 0 end
end

-- Compile ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local cache = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local cacheStr = {}
function Molang.compile(src)
    if type(src) == "number" then return function() return src end end
    if type(src) == "boolean" then local v = src and 1 or 0; return function() return v end end
    if type(src) ~= "string" then return function() return 0 end end
    local hit = cacheStr[src]
    if hit then return hit end
    local fn
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        local p = newParser(tokenize(src))
        if src:find(";", 1, true) then
            local body = p:statements()
            fn = function(env)
                env._ret, env._flow = nil, nil
                body(env)
                local r = env._ret
                env._ret, env._flow = nil, nil
                if r == nil then return 0 end
                return r
            end
        else
            local e = p:expr()
            fn = function(env)
                env._flow = nil
                local r = e(env)
                if env._flow == "return" then r = env._ret; env._ret, env._flow = nil, nil end
                return r
            end
        end
    end)
    if not ok then
        Molang.lastError = tostring(err) .. " in: " .. src
        fn = function() return 0 end
    end
    cacheStr[src] = fn
    return fn
end
function Molang.eval(src, env) return Molang.compile(src)(env) end
Molang.num, Molang.truthy = num, truthy
return Molang

end)()
local createBedrock = (function()
-- Bedrock Edition client entities in Roblox: geometry (bones, cubes, box / per-face UV, inflate, mirror), render
-- controllers (geometry / texture / part visibility / uv_anim through Molang), animations (keyframes, Molang channels,
-- loop modes, timelines, blend weights), animation controllers (states, transitions, on_entry / on_exit) and the
-- entity scripts (initialize, pre_animation, animate, scale).
--   local BR = createBedrock({Molang = Molang, data = vnData, image = function(file) -> Content/asset id, folder = Folder})
--   local vis = BR.visual("oreville_vn:villager", entityAPI)  -- entityAPI: query(name, args, env) and properties
--   vis.update(dt, frame, studsPerBlock)  -- frame: the entity's feet, facing -Z (Bedrock models face north)
--   vis.destroy()
-- Coordinates: Bedrock model space is Blockbench's with x negated, so x -> -x, rotation (x, y, z) -> (-x, -y, z),
-- Euler order Z * Y * X, which then matches Roblox (y up, front -Z, right +X).
local function createBedrock(deps)
    local Molang, data = deps.Molang, deps.data
    local BR = {}
    local rad = math.pi / 180
    local V3 = Vector3.new

    local function lower(s) return type(s) == "string" and s:lower() or s end
    local function refName(ref, kind)
        -- "texture:abc" / "Texture.abc" -> "abc"
        if type(ref) ~= "string" then return nil end
        local l = ref:lower()
        local p = kind .. ":"
        if l:sub(1, #p) == p then return ref:sub(#p + 1) end
        p = kind .. "."
        if l:sub(1, #p) == p then return ref:sub(#p + 1) end
        return ref
    end
    local function eulerZYX(x, y, z)
        return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, z * rad) * CFrame.Angles(0, y * rad, 0) * CFrame.Angles(x * rad, 0, 0)
    end
    local function vec3(t, default)
        if type(t) ~= "table" then return default or Vector3.zero end
        return V3(tonumber(t[1]) or 0, tonumber(t[2]) or 0, tonumber(t[3]) or 0)
    end

    -- Geometry --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- A face: centre (model px, Roblox axes), U / D unit directions (texture right / down), width / height (px),
    -- uv rect {u, v, w, h} in texture-width units.
    local FACES = {
        north = function(f, t) return V3((f.X + t.X) / 2, (f.Y + t.Y) / 2, f.Z), V3(-1, 0, 0), V3(0, -1, 0), t.X - f.X, t.Y - f.Y end,
        south = function(f, t) return V3((f.X + t.X) / 2, (f.Y + t.Y) / 2, t.Z), V3(1, 0, 0), V3(0, -1, 0), t.X - f.X, t.Y - f.Y end,
        east = function(f, t) return V3(t.X, (f.Y + t.Y) / 2, (f.Z + t.Z) / 2), V3(0, 0, -1), V3(0, -1, 0), t.Z - f.Z, t.Y - f.Y end,
        west = function(f, t) return V3(f.X, (f.Y + t.Y) / 2, (f.Z + t.Z) / 2), V3(0, 0, 1), V3(0, -1, 0), t.Z - f.Z, t.Y - f.Y end,
        up = function(f, t) return V3((f.X + t.X) / 2, t.Y, (f.Z + t.Z) / 2), V3(1, 0, 0), V3(0, 0, 1), t.X - f.X, t.Z - f.Z end,
        down = function(f, t) return V3((f.X + t.X) / 2, f.Y, (f.Z + t.Z) / 2), V3(1, 0, 0), V3(0, 0, -1), t.X - f.X, t.Z - f.Z end,
    }
    local function boxUV(u, v, sx, sy, sz, mirror)
        local r = {
            east = {u, v + sz, sz, sy}, north = {u + sz, v + sz, sx, sy}, west = {u + sz + sx, v + sz, sz, sy},
            south = {u + sz + sx + sz, v + sz, sx, sy}, up = {u + sz, v, sx, sz}, down = {u + sz + sx, v + sz, sx, -sz},
        }
        if mirror then
            r.east, r.west = r.west, r.east
            for _, q in pairs(r) do q[1], q[3] = q[1] + q[3], -q[3] end
        end
        return r
    end
    local geoCache = {}
    -- Pre-baked geometry: bones in order (parents first) with their faces in model px.
    local function bakeGeometry(id)
        if geoCache[id] ~= nil then return geoCache[id] or nil end
        local g = data.geometry[id]
        if not g then geoCache[id] = false; return nil end
        local desc = g.description or {}
        local out = {id = id, tw = desc.texture_width or 64, th = desc.texture_height or 64, bones = {}, byName = {}}
        local pending = {}
        for _, b in ipairs(g.bones or {}) do pending[#pending + 1] = b end
        -- parents before children
        local placed = {}
        local guard = 0
        while #pending > 0 and guard < 64 do
            guard = guard + 1
            local rest = {}
            for _, b in ipairs(pending) do
                local parent = b.parent and lower(b.parent)
                if not parent or placed[parent] or not (function() for _, o in ipairs(g.bones) do if lower(o.name) == parent then return true end end return false end)() then
                    local pv = vec3(b.pivot)
                    local rot = vec3(b.rotation)
                    local bone = {name = lower(b.name), parent = parent, pivot = V3(-pv.X, pv.Y, pv.Z), rest = V3(-rot.X, -rot.Y, rot.Z), faces = {}}
                    for _, c in ipairs(b.cubes or {}) do
                        local o, s = vec3(c.origin), vec3(c.size)
                        local flat = math.abs(s.X) < 0.2 or math.abs(s.Y) < 0.2 or math.abs(s.Z) < 0.2
                        local inf = tonumber(c.inflate) or tonumber(b.inflate) or 0
                        local from = V3(-(o.X + s.X) - inf, o.Y - inf, o.Z - inf)
                        local to = V3(-o.X + inf, o.Y + s.Y + inf, o.Z + s.Z + inf)
                        local mirror = c.mirror
                        if mirror == nil then mirror = b.mirror end
                        local uvs
                        if type(c.uv) == "table" and c.uv[1] == nil then
                            uvs = {}
                            for name, fu in pairs(c.uv) do
                                if type(fu) == "table" and fu.uv then
                                    local sz = fu.uv_size or {0, 0}
                                    uvs[lower(name)] = {fu.uv[1], fu.uv[2], sz[1], sz[2]}
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            local uv = c.uv or {0, 0}
                            uvs = boxUV(uv[1], uv[2], s.X, s.Y, s.Z, mirror == true)
                        end
                        local cubeRot
                        if c.rotation then
                            local r = vec3(c.rotation)
                            local cp = vec3(c.pivot, V3((o.X * 2 + s.X) / 2 * -1, o.Y + s.Y / 2, o.Z + s.Z / 2))
                            if c.pivot then cp = V3(-cp.X, cp.Y, cp.Z) end
                            cubeRot = {pivot = cp, cf = eulerZYX(-r.X, -r.Y, r.Z)}
                        end
                        for name, rect in pairs(uvs) do
                            local maker = FACES[name]
                            if maker and rect[3] ~= 0 and rect[4] ~= 0 then
                                -- Flip the UV with the underside basis so its artwork keeps
                                -- its orientation while its visible normal faces downward.
                                if name == "down" then rect = {rect[1], rect[2]+rect[4], rect[3], -rect[4]} end
                                local centre, U, D, w, h = maker(from, to)
                                if w > 1e-4 and h > 1e-4 then
                                    if cubeRot then
                                        centre = cubeRot.pivot + cubeRot.cf * (centre - cubeRot.pivot)
                                        U, D = cubeRot.cf * U, cubeRot.cf * D
                                    end
                                    bone.faces[#bone.faces + 1] = {centre = centre, U = U, D = D, w = w, h = h, uv = rect, flat = flat}
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    out.bones[#out.bones + 1] = bone
                    out.byName[bone.name] = bone
                    placed[bone.name] = true
                else
                    rest[#rest + 1] = b
                end
            end
            pending = rest
        end
        -- Stacked face pieces (eye whites, pupils, lids, brows, mouth, lips): parallel faces that overlap and lie within
        -- 0.35 px of each other. Each gets a rank = how many pieces sit behind it in the stack (Bedrock's depth / draw
        -- order). At runtime a piece is pushed towards the viewer by rank * a step that grows with camera distance, so
        -- Roblox's depth buffer still keeps the order far away, while up close the push stays invisible.
        local all = {}
        for _, bone in ipairs(out.bones) do for _, f in ipairs(bone.faces) do all[#all + 1] = f end end
        for i, f in ipairs(all) do f.index, f.normal = i, f.D:Cross(f.U); f.depth = f.centre:Dot(f.normal) end
        local sorted = table.clone(all)
        table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) if math.abs(a.depth - b.depth) > 1e-4 then return a.depth < b.depth end return a.index < b.index end)
        local function overlap(f, o, margin)
            local dc = o.centre - f.centre
            local ox = (f.w + math.abs(o.U:Dot(f.U)) * o.w + math.abs(o.D:Dot(f.U)) * o.h) / 2 - math.abs(dc:Dot(f.U))
            local oy = (f.h + math.abs(o.U:Dot(f.D)) * o.w + math.abs(o.D:Dot(f.D)) * o.h) / 2 - math.abs(dc:Dot(f.D))
            return ox > margin and oy > margin
        end
        local link = {}
        for i, f in ipairs(sorted) do
            f.rank = 0
            link[f] = link[f] or {f}
            for j = 1, i - 1 do
                local o = sorted[j]
                local dz = (f.centre - o.centre):Dot(f.normal)
                if f.normal:Dot(o.normal) > 0.999 and dz < 0.35 then
                    -- a different depth: ordered whenever the pieces are within 1 px (pupils / lids slide under each
                    -- other when animated); the same depth: only when they really overlap (flat face plates stay flat)
                    if (dz > 1e-3 and overlap(f, o, -1)) or (dz <= 1e-3 and overlap(f, o, 0.1)) then
                        f.rank = math.max(f.rank, o.rank + 1)
                        -- join the two stacks
                        local a, b = link[f], link[o]
                        if a ~= b then for _, x in ipairs(b) do a[#a + 1] = x; link[x] = a end end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        -- each stack's surface: the depth with the most area (the head's face plates); it keeps rank 0
        local done = {}
        for _, f in ipairs(sorted) do
            local group = link[f]
            if not done[group] then
                done[group] = true
                local area, best, baseRank = {}, -1, 0
                for _, x in ipairs(group) do
                    local key = math.floor(x.depth * 100 + 0.5)
                    area[key] = (area[key] or 0) + x.w * x.h
                end
                local surface
                for key, a in pairs(area) do if a > best then best, surface = a, key end end
                baseRank = math.huge
                for _, x in ipairs(group) do if math.floor(x.depth * 100 + 0.5) == surface then baseRank = math.min(baseRank, x.rank) end end
                for _, x in ipairs(group) do
                    x.rank = x.rank - baseRank
                    -- solid boxes in front of the surface (the brow bar) stay put: their sides would split from them
                    if x.rank > 0 and not x.flat then x.rank = 0 end
                end
            end
        end
        geoCache[id] = out
        return out
    end
    BR.bakeGeometry = bakeGeometry

    -- Textures ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local imageCache = {}
    local function texturePath(def, ref)
        local name = refName(ref, "texture")
        if not name then return nil end
        local path = def.textures and (def.textures[name] or def.textures[lower(name)])
        if not path then
            for k, p in pairs(def.textures or {}) do if lower(k) == lower(name) then path = p; break end end
        end
        return path
    end
    local function textureInfo(path)
        if not path then return nil end
        local hit = imageCache[path]
        if hit ~= nil then return hit or nil end
        local t = data.textures[path]
        if not t then imageCache[path] = false; return nil end
        -- Empty profession placeholder: its sole opaque texel is a red marker at
        -- (63,63), not clothing. The large brim UV otherwise exposes it in space.
        if t.file == "t2_oreville__vn__din.png" then imageCache[path] = false; return nil end
        local ok, img = pcall(deps.image, t.file)
        local info = ok and img and {image = img, file = t.file, w = t.w, h = t.h, opaque = t.o == 1, mask = t.m, grid = t.c} or false
        imageCache[path] = info
        return info or nil
    end
    -- is every texel of the rect (texture px, may be fractional / flipped) fully opaque?
    local function rectOpaque(info, x, y, w, h)
        if info.opaque then return true end
        local mask = info.mask
        if not mask then return false end
        local x0, x1 = math.min(x, x + w), math.max(x, x + w)
        local y0, y1 = math.min(y, y + h), math.max(y, y + h)
        x0, x1 = math.max(0, math.floor(x0 + 1e-3)), math.min(info.w, math.ceil(x1 - 1e-3)) - 1
        y0, y1 = math.max(0, math.floor(y0 + 1e-3)), math.min(info.h, math.ceil(y1 - 1e-3)) - 1
        if x1 < x0 or y1 < y0 then return false end
        for py = y0, y1 do
            for px = x0, x1 do
                local i = py * info.w + px
                local bi = math.floor(i / 8)
                local byte = tonumber(mask:sub(bi * 2 + 1, bi * 2 + 2), 16) or 0
                if bit32.band(byte, bit32.rshift(0x80, i % 8)) == 0 then return false end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function rectColour(info, x, y, w, h)
        local g = info.grid
        if not g then return Color3.new(0.6, 0.45, 0.35) end
        local gx = math.clamp(math.floor((x + w / 2) / info.w * 8), 0, 7)
        local gy = math.clamp(math.floor((y + h / 2) / info.h * 8), 0, 7)
        local i = (gy * 8 + gx) * 6
        return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(g:sub(i + 1, i + 2), 16) or 150, tonumber(g:sub(i + 3, i + 4), 16) or 110, tonumber(g:sub(i + 5, i + 6), 16) or 90)
    end
    BR.textureInfo = textureInfo

    -- Cache alpha coverage, not coloured pixels: each opaque run writes depth and empty
    -- atlas regions produce no surfaces. Shared by every villager using this outfit.
    local coverageCache = {}
    local function covered(info, x, y)
        if info.opaque or not info.mask then return true end
        x, y = math.floor(x), math.floor(y)
        if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= info.w or y >= info.h then return false end
        local i = y * info.w + x
        local byte = tonumber(info.mask:sub(math.floor(i / 8) * 2 + 1, math.floor(i / 8) * 2 + 2), 16) or 0
        return bit32.band(byte, bit32.rshift(0x80, i % 8)) ~= 0
    end
    local function coverage(entries, key)
        if coverageCache[key] then return coverageCache[key] end
        local nx, ny = 1, 1
        for _, e in ipairs(entries) do nx = math.max(nx, math.ceil(math.abs(e.w))); ny = math.max(ny, math.ceil(math.abs(e.h))) end
        local rects, prev = {}, {}
        for y = 0, ny - 1 do
            local row, x = {}, 0
            while x < nx do
                local function solid(px)
                    for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
                        if covered(e.info, e.x + (px + 0.5) / nx * e.w, e.y + (y + 0.5) / ny * e.h) then return true end
                    end
                    return false
                end
                if solid(x) then
                    local start = x
                    repeat x = x + 1 until x >= nx or not solid(x)
                    local id = start .. ":" .. x
                    local r = prev[id]
                    if r then r[4] = r[4] + 1 else r = {start, y, x - start, 1}; rects[#rects + 1] = r end
                    row[id] = r
                else x = x + 1 end
            end
            prev = row
        end
        for _, r in ipairs(rects) do r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4] = r[1]/nx, r[2]/ny, r[3]/nx, r[4]/ny end
        coverageCache[key] = rects
        return rects
    end

    -- Animation data ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local animCache = {}
    local function sortedKeys(map)
        local list = {}
        for k, v in pairs(map) do
            local t = tonumber(k)
            if t then list[#list + 1] = {t = t, v = v} end
        end
        table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.t < b.t end)
        return list
    end
    local function compileValue(v)
        -- number | molang string | {x, y, z} -> function(env) -> Vector3 (or number)
        if type(v) == "number" then return function() return V3(v, v, v) end, true end
        if type(v) == "string" then local f = Molang.compile(v); return function(env) local n = Molang.num(f(env)); return V3(n, n, n) end end
        if type(v) == "table" then
            local fx, fy, fz = Molang.compile(v[1] or 0), Molang.compile(v[2] or 0), Molang.compile(v[3] or 0)
            return function(env) return V3(Molang.num(fx(env)), Molang.num(fy(env)), Molang.num(fz(env))) end
        end
        return function() return Vector3.zero end
    end
    local function compileChannel(ch)
        if ch == nil then return nil end
        if type(ch) == "table" and ch[1] == nil and next(ch) ~= nil then
            -- keyframes
            local keys = {}
            for _, k in ipairs(sortedKeys(ch)) do
                local v = k.v
                local pre, post, mode
                if type(v) == "table" and v[1] == nil and (v.pre or v.post) then
                    pre, post, mode = compileValue(v.pre or v.post), compileValue(v.post or v.pre), v.lerp_mode
                elseif type(v) == "table" and v[1] == nil and v.vector then
                    pre = compileValue(v.vector); post = pre; mode = v.lerp_mode
                else
                    pre = compileValue(v); post = pre
                end
                keys[#keys + 1] = {t = k.t, pre = pre, post = post, mode = mode}
            end
            if #keys == 0 then return nil end
            return function(env, time)
                if time <= keys[1].t or #keys == 1 then return keys[1].pre(env) end
                local last = keys[#keys]
                if time >= last.t then return last.post(env) end
                for i = 1, #keys - 1 do
                    local a, b = keys[i], keys[i + 1]
                    if time >= a.t and time < b.t then
                        local f = (time - a.t) / math.max(1e-6, b.t - a.t)
                        local pa, pb = a.post(env), b.pre(env)
                        if a.mode == "catmullrom" or b.mode == "catmullrom" then
                            local p0 = i > 1 and keys[i - 1].post(env) or pa
                            local p3 = i + 2 <= #keys and keys[i + 2].pre(env) or pb
                            local f2, f3 = f * f, f * f * f
                            return 0.5 * (2 * pa + (pb - p0) * f + (2 * p0 - 5 * pa + 4 * pb - p3) * f2 + (3 * pa - p0 - 3 * pb + p3) * f3)
                        elseif a.mode == "step" then
                            return pa
                        end
                        return pa:Lerp(pb, f)
                    end
                end
                return last.post(env)
            end, keys[#keys].t
        end
        local fn = compileValue(ch)
        return function(env) return fn(env) end, 0
    end
    local function compileAnimation(name)
        local hit = animCache[name]
        if hit ~= nil then return hit or nil end
        local a = data.animations[name]
        if not a then animCache[name] = false; return nil end
        local out = {name = name, bones = {}, timeline = {}, loop = a.loop, length = tonumber(a.animation_length),
            override = a.override_previous_animation == true}
        local maxT = 0
        for boneName, ch in pairs(a.bones or {}) do
            local b = {name = lower(boneName)}
            local t1, t2, t3
            b.rotation, t1 = compileChannel(ch.rotation)
            b.position, t2 = compileChannel(ch.position)
            b.scale, t3 = compileChannel(ch.scale)
            maxT = math.max(maxT, t1 or 0, t2 or 0, t3 or 0)
            out.bones[#out.bones + 1] = b
        end
        for _, k in ipairs(sortedKeys(a.timeline or {})) do
            local list = type(k.v) == "table" and k.v or {k.v}
            local fns = {}
            for _, s in ipairs(list) do
                if type(s) == "string" and s:sub(1, 1) ~= "/" and s:sub(1, 1) ~= "@" then fns[#fns + 1] = Molang.compile(s) end
            end
            out.timeline[#out.timeline + 1] = {t = k.t, run = fns}
            maxT = math.max(maxT, k.t)
        end
        if not out.length then out.length = maxT end
        out.startDelay = a.start_delay and Molang.compile(a.start_delay)
        out.blend = a.blend_weight and Molang.compile(a.blend_weight)
        out.timeUpdate = a.anim_time_update and Molang.compile(a.anim_time_update)
        out.loopIsExpr = type(a.loop) == "string" and a.loop ~= "hold_on_last_frame"
        if out.loopIsExpr then out.loopFn = Molang.compile(a.loop) end
        animCache[name] = out
        return out
    end

    -- Visual ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    function BR.visual(entityId, api)
        local def = data.client_entities[entityId] or data.attachables[entityId]
        if not def then return nil end
        local scripts = def.scripts or {}
        local model = Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name = entityId
        model:SetAttribute("VNRenderer", "alpha-depth-v1")
        model.Parent = deps.folder
        local vis = {model = model, bones = {}, parts = {}, def = def}
        local env = {v = {}, t = {}, c = {owning_entity = api and api.owner}, arrays = {}}
        vis.env = env
        env.q = function(name, args, e) return api.query(name, args, e or env, vis) end

        -- animation instances (name in def.animations -> anim or controller)
        local instances = {}
        local function instanceOf(shortName)
            local key = lower(shortName)
            local inst = instances[key]
            if inst then return inst end
            local full
            for k, v in pairs(def.animations or {}) do if lower(k) == key then full = v; break end end
            if not full then instances[key] = false; return false end
            if lower(full):find("^controller%.") then
                local c = data.animation_controllers[full]
                inst = c and {kind = "controller", def = c, name = full, state = nil, stateTime = 0, children = {}} or false
            else
                local a = compileAnimation(full)
                inst = a and {kind = "animation", def = a, name = full, time = 0, last = -1, done = false} or false
            end
            instances[key] = inst
            return inst
        end

        -- layers: one per render controller
        local layers = {}
        local function rcList()
            local list = {}
            for _, entry in ipairs(def.render_controllers or {}) do
                if type(entry) == "string" then list[#list + 1] = {name = entry}
                elseif type(entry) == "table" then
                    for k, cond in pairs(entry) do list[#list + 1] = {name = k, cond = Molang.compile(cond)} end
                end
            end
            return list
        end
        local rcs = rcList()
        for i, rc in ipairs(rcs) do
            local rdef = data.render_controllers[rc.name]
            if rdef then
                local arrays = {}
                for _, group in pairs(rdef.arrays or {}) do
                    for arrName, list in pairs(group) do
                        local clean = {}
                        for k, ref in ipairs(list) do
                            local l = lower(ref)
                            if l:sub(1, 8) == "texture." then clean[k] = "texture:" .. ref:sub(9)
                            elseif l:sub(1, 9) == "geometry." then clean[k] = "geometry:" .. ref:sub(10)
                            elseif l:sub(1, 9) == "material." then clean[k] = "material:" .. ref:sub(10)
                            else clean[k] = ref end
                        end
                        arrays[lower(arrName):gsub("^array%.", "")] = clean
                    end
                end
                local vis2 = {}
                for _, pv in ipairs(rdef.part_visibility or {}) do
                    for pattern, cond in pairs(pv) do
                        local pat = "^" .. lower(pattern):gsub("[%-%.%+%[%]%(%)%$%^%%%?]", "%%%0"):gsub("%*", ".*") .. "$"
                        vis2[#vis2 + 1] = {pat = pat, cond = Molang.compile(cond)}
                    end
                end
                local uvAnim
                if rdef.uv_anim then
                    local o, s = rdef.uv_anim.offset or {0, 0}, rdef.uv_anim.scale or {1, 1}
                    uvAnim = {Molang.compile(o[1]), Molang.compile(o[2]), Molang.compile(s[1]), Molang.compile(s[2])}
                end
                -- one layer per texture slot: slot 2+ (profession outfits, masks) is drawn over slot 1 on the same geometry
                for slot, texExpr in ipairs(rdef.textures or {"Texture.default"}) do
                    layers[#layers + 1] = {rc = rc, def = rdef, arrays = arrays, geometry = Molang.compile(rdef.geometry or "Geometry.default"),
                        texture = Molang.compile(texExpr), visibility = vis2, uvAnim = uvAnim,
                        build = nil, geoId = nil, order = #layers + 1, slot = slot}
                end
            end
        end

        -- Geometry builds are shared: every render controller (and texture slot) drawing the same geometry puts its image
        -- into the same face surface, stacked by draw order (ZIndex), the way Bedrock blends them over each other. So
        -- clothing, badges and masks never fight the skin for depth. Faces whose image is fully opaque are drawn as solid
        -- parts (they write depth, so eyes / brows / nose / mouth sort exactly like in Bedrock); see-through ones stay
        -- transparent.
        local builds = {} -- geoId -> {geo, faces, bones, users = {[layer] = true}}
        local function getBuild(geoId)
            local bd = builds[geoId]
            if bd then return bd end
            local g = bakeGeometry(geoId)
            if not g then return nil end
            bd = {geo = g, faces = {}, bones = {}, users = {}}
            for _, bone in ipairs(g.bones) do
                local b = {def = bone, faces = {}}
                bd.bones[bone.name] = b
                for _, f in ipairs(bone.faces) do
                    local p = Instance.new("Part")
                    p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
                    p.Transparency, p.Size, p.Name = 1, V3(0.05, 0.05, 0.001), bone.name
                    p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                    p.TopSurface, p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth, Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
                    local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
                    gui.Face, gui.LightInfluence, gui.SizingMode = Enum.NormalId.Front, 0.5, Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize
                    gui.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(128, 128)
                    gui.PixelsPerStud, gui.ClipsDescendants = 50, true
                    gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
                    gui.Parent = p
                    local face = {part = p, gui = gui, def = f, bone = b, labels = {}, opaqueBy = {}, hidden = true,
                        transparency = 1, rank = f.rank or 0, tiles = {}, samples = {}}
                    b.faces[#b.faces + 1] = face
                    bd.faces[#bd.faces + 1] = face
                end
            end
            builds[geoId] = bd
            return bd
        end
        local function detachLayer(layer)
            local bd = layer.build
            if bd then
                for _, face in ipairs(bd.faces) do
                    local l = face.labels[layer]
                    if l then l:Destroy(); face.labels[layer] = nil end
                    face.opaqueBy[layer] = nil
                    face.samples[layer] = nil
                    face.tileMask = nil
                end
                bd.users[layer] = nil
                if next(bd.users) == nil then
                    for _, face in ipairs(bd.faces) do
                        for _, tile in ipairs(face.tiles) do tile.part:Destroy() end
                        face.part:Destroy()
                    end
                    builds[layer.geoId] = nil
                end
            end
            layer.build, layer.geoId, layer.texKey, layer.hasImage = nil, nil, nil, false
        end
        local function attachLayer(layer, geoId)
            detachLayer(layer)
            local bd = getBuild(geoId)
            if not bd then return end
            layer.geoId, layer.build, layer.boneVis = geoId, bd, {}
            bd.users[layer] = true
            for _, face in ipairs(bd.faces) do
                local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                img.BackgroundTransparency, img.Size, img.BorderSizePixel = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 0
                img.ResampleMode = Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated
                img.ZIndex, img.Visible = layer.order, false
                img.Parent = face.gui
                face.labels[layer] = img
            end
        end
        local function applyTexture(layer, path, uvo)
            local info = textureInfo(path)
            local bd = layer.build
            if not bd then return end
            local g = bd.geo
            for _, face in ipairs(bd.faces) do
                local img = face.labels[layer]
                face.tileMask = nil
                if info then
                    local kx, ky = info.w / g.tw, info.h / g.th
                    local r = face.def.uv
                    local ox, oy = 0, 0
                    if uvo then ox, oy = uvo[1] * g.tw, uvo[2] * g.th end
                    local x, y, w, h = (r[1] + ox) * kx, (r[2] + oy) * ky, r[3] * kx, r[4] * ky
                    -- a hair inside the rect so the edge texels never pick up the neighbouring (often empty) atlas pixels
                    local ex, ey = (w >= 0 and 1 or -1) * math.min(0.02, math.abs(w) * 0.1), (h >= 0 and 1 or -1) * math.min(0.02, math.abs(h) * 0.1)
                    img.Image = info.image
                    img.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(x + ex, y + ey)
                    img.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(w - 2 * ex, h - 2 * ey)
                    face.samples[layer] = {info = info, x = x, y = y, w = w, h = h}
                    face.opaqueBy[layer] = rectOpaque(info, x, y, w, h) and rectColour(info, x, y, w, h) or false
                else
                    img.Image = ""
                    face.opaqueBy[layer] = false
                    face.samples[layer] = nil
                end
            end
            layer.hasImage = info ~= nil
        end

        local function syncTiles(face, lv)
            local mask = 0
            for layer in pairs(face.labels) do
                if lv[layer] and face.samples[layer] then mask = mask + 2 ^ (layer.order - 1) end
            end
            if face.tileMask == mask then return end
            face.tileMask = mask
            local keys, entries, active = {}, {}, {}
            for _, layer in ipairs(layers) do
                local e = face.samples[layer]
                if lv[layer] and e and face.labels[layer] then
                    keys[#keys+1] = layer.order .. ":" .. tostring(layer.texKey) .. ":" .. e.x .. ":" .. e.y .. ":" .. e.w .. ":" .. e.h
                    entries[#entries+1] = e
                    active[#active+1] = layer
                end
            end
            local key = table.concat(keys, "|")
            if face.tileKey == key then return end
            face.tileKey = key
            for _, tile in ipairs(face.tiles) do tile.part:Destroy() end
            face.tiles = {}
            if #entries == 0 then return end
            for _, rect in ipairs(coverage(entries, key)) do
                local p = face.part:Clone()
                p:ClearAllChildren()
                p.Transparency = 0
                local gui = face.gui:Clone()
                gui:ClearAllChildren()
                gui.Parent = p
                local visibleLayers = {}
                for i = #active, 1, -1 do
                    local layer = active[i]
                    local e = face.samples[layer]
                    local x, y, width, height = e.x+rect[1]*e.w, e.y+rect[2]*e.h, rect[3]*e.w, rect[4]*e.h
                    local anyPixel = false
                    for py = math.floor(math.min(y,y+height)), math.ceil(math.max(y,y+height))-1 do
                        for px = math.floor(math.min(x,x+width)), math.ceil(math.max(x,x+width))-1 do
                            if covered(e.info,px,py) then anyPixel = true; break end
                        end
                        if anyPixel then break end
                    end
