                    if anyPixel then visibleLayers[#visibleLayers+1] = layer end
                    if rectOpaque(e.info,x,y,width,height) then break end
                end
                for _, layer in ipairs(visibleLayers) do
                    local e = face.samples[layer]
                    local img = face.labels[layer]:Clone()
                    img.Visible = true
                    img.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(e.x + rect[1]*e.w, e.y + rect[2]*e.h)
                    img.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(rect[3]*e.w, rect[4]*e.h)
                    img.Parent = gui
                end
                local e = entries[1]
                p.Color = rectColour(e.info, e.x, e.y, e.w, e.h)
                -- The adult skin's two irises are single, fully opaque green texels
                -- (verified at atlas [10,14] and [13,14]). Render their exact colour
                -- as geometry, avoiding tiny SurfaceGui rasterization / atlas filtering.
                -- Keep the animated bone transform and normal depth testing: lids still blink.
                local top = visibleLayers[1] and face.samples[visibleLayers[1]]
                if (face.bone.def.name == "d67l_6q6" or face.bone.def.name == "ja89l_6q6")
                    and top and top.info.file == "t2_oreville__vn__dil.png"
                    and top.y == 14 and (top.x == 10 or top.x == 13) and top.w == 1 and top.h == 1 then
                    p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 17)
                    gui:Destroy()
                end
                face.tiles[#face.tiles+1] = {part=p, rect=rect}
            end
        end

        -- pose state
        local pose = {} -- bone name -> {rot = Vector3 deg, pos = Vector3 px, scale = Vector3}
        local function resetPose() for k in pairs(pose) do pose[k] = nil end end
        local function poseOf(name)
            local p = pose[name]
            if not p then p = {rot = Vector3.zero, pos = Vector3.zero, scale = V3(1, 1, 1)}; pose[name] = p end
            return p
        end
        local function runAnimation(inst, weight, dt)
            local a = inst.def
            local length = a.length or 0
            -- time
            if a.timeUpdate then
                env.this = inst.time
                inst.time = Molang.num(a.timeUpdate(env))
            else
                inst.time = inst.time + dt
            end
            local t = inst.time
            if a.startDelay and not inst.delay then inst.delay = Molang.num(a.startDelay(env)) end
            t = t - (inst.delay or 0)
            if t < 0 then return end
            local loop = a.loop
            if a.loopIsExpr then loop = Molang.truthy(a.loopFn(env)) end
            if loop == true and length > 0 then
                if t >= length then
                    -- timeline events of the wrapped part
                    inst.last = -1
                    t = t % length
                    inst.time = t + (inst.delay or 0)
                end
            elseif t >= length then
                if loop == "hold_on_last_frame" then t = length
                else
                    inst.done = true
                    if length > 0 then t = length end
                end
            end
            env.q_anim_time = t
            if inst.done and loop ~= "hold_on_last_frame" and loop ~= true and length > 0 and t >= length and inst.appliedDone then return end
            -- timeline
            for _, ev in ipairs(a.timeline) do
                if ev.t > inst.last and ev.t <= t then for _, fn in ipairs(ev.run) do fn(env) end end
            end
            inst.last = t
            if inst.done then inst.appliedDone = true end
            local w = weight
            if a.blend then w = w * Molang.num(a.blend(env)) end
            if w == 0 then return end
            for _, b in ipairs(a.bones) do
                local p = poseOf(b.name)
                if a.override then p.rot, p.pos = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero end
                if b.rotation then p.rot = p.rot + b.rotation(env, t) * w end
                if b.position then p.pos = p.pos + b.position(env, t) * w end
                if b.scale then local s = b.scale(env, t); p.scale = p.scale * (V3(1, 1, 1):Lerp(s, w)) end
            end
        end
        local runEntry
        local function runController(inst, weight, dt)
            local c = inst.def
            if not inst.state then
                inst.state = c.initial_state or "default"
                inst.stateTime = 0
                local st = c.states and c.states[inst.state]
                if st then for _, s in ipairs(st.on_entry or {}) do if type(s) == "string" and s:sub(1, 1) ~= "/" and s:sub(1, 1) ~= "@" then Molang.compile(s)(env) end end end
            end
            local st = c.states and c.states[inst.state]
            if not st then return end
            inst.stateTime = inst.stateTime + dt
            env.q_state_time = inst.stateTime
            -- transitions (first true wins)
            for _, tr in ipairs(st.transitions or {}) do
                local target, cond
                for k, v in pairs(tr) do target, cond = k, v end
                if target and Molang.truthy(Molang.compile(cond)(env)) then
                    for _, s in ipairs(st.on_exit or {}) do if type(s) == "string" and s:sub(1, 1) ~= "/" and s:sub(1, 1) ~= "@" then Molang.compile(s)(env) end end
                    inst.state = target
                    inst.stateTime = 0
                    inst.children = {}
                    st = c.states[target]
                    if st then for _, s in ipairs(st.on_entry or {}) do if type(s) == "string" and s:sub(1, 1) ~= "/" and s:sub(1, 1) ~= "@" then Molang.compile(s)(env) end end end
                    break
                end
            end
            if not st then return end
            env.q_state_time = inst.stateTime
            local finishedAll, finishedAny = true, false
            for _, entry in ipairs(st.animations or {}) do
                local name, wexpr = entry, nil
                if type(entry) == "table" then for k, v in pairs(entry) do name, wexpr = k, v end end
                local w = weight
                if wexpr ~= nil then w = w * Molang.num(Molang.compile(wexpr)(env)) end
                local child = inst.children[lower(name)]
                if not child then
                    local proto = instanceOf(name)
                    if proto then
                        child = {kind = proto.kind, def = proto.def, name = proto.name, time = 0, last = -1, done = false, state = nil, stateTime = 0, children = {}}
                        inst.children[lower(name)] = child
                    end
                end
                if child then
                    if w > 0 or child.kind == "controller" then runEntry(child, w, dt) end
                    if child.kind == "animation" then
                        if child.done then finishedAny = true else finishedAll = false end
                    end
                end
            end
            inst.allFinished, inst.anyFinished = finishedAll, finishedAny
            env.q_all_finished, env.q_any_finished = finishedAll, finishedAny
        end
        runEntry = function(inst, weight, dt)
            if inst.kind == "controller" then runController(inst, weight, dt) else runAnimation(inst, weight, dt) end
        end

        -- one-shot animations (Entity.playAnimation / playanimation): run on top of the animate list until finished
        local oneShots = {}
        function vis.play(name, opts)
            local full = name
            for k, v in pairs(def.animations or {}) do if lower(k) == lower(name) then full = v; break end end
            local a = compileAnimation(full)
            if not a then return false end
            for i = #oneShots, 1, -1 do if oneShots[i].name == full then table.remove(oneShots, i) end end
            oneShots[#oneShots + 1] = {kind = "animation", def = a, name = full, time = 0, last = -1, done = false,
                blendOut = opts and opts.blendOut or 0, maxTime = opts and opts.maxTime}
            return true
        end
        function vis.stopAll() oneShots = {} end
        function vis.playing(name)
            for _, o in ipairs(oneShots) do if o.name == name and not o.done then return true end end
            return false
        end
        local animate = {}
        for _, entry in ipairs(scripts.animate or {}) do
            if type(entry) == "string" then animate[#animate + 1] = {name = entry}
            else for k, v in pairs(entry) do animate[#animate + 1] = {name = k, cond = Molang.compile(v)} end end
        end
        local preAnim = {}
        for _, s in ipairs(scripts.pre_animation or {}) do preAnim[#preAnim + 1] = Molang.compile(s) end
        local scaleFn = scripts.scale and Molang.compile(scripts.scale)
        for _, s in ipairs(scripts.initialize or {}) do Molang.compile(s)(env) end
        vis.life = 0

        local disposed = false
        -- bone world transforms: {cf, s (number), o (pivot)}
        local function update(dt, frame, studsPerBlock)
            -- depth step for stacked face pieces: 0.002 studs up close, more with distance (see bakeGeometry)
            local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local camDist = camera and (camera.CFrame.Position - frame.Position).Magnitude or 0
            local depthStep = math.clamp(math.floor(camDist / 5 + 0.5) * 5 * 0.0015, 0.002, 0.08)
            if disposed then return end
            vis.life = vis.life + dt
            env.dt = dt
            env.t = {}
            for _, fn in ipairs(preAnim) do env.t = {}; fn(env) end
            -- render controllers decide geometry / texture
            for _, layer in ipairs(layers) do
                env.arrays = layer.arrays
                env.t = {}
                local on = true
                if layer.rc.cond then on = Molang.truthy(layer.rc.cond(env)) end
                layer.on = on
                if on then
                    local gname = refName(layer.geometry(env), "geometry")
                    local gid = gname and def.geometry and (def.geometry[gname] or def.geometry[lower(gname)])
                    if not gid and gname then for k, v in pairs(def.geometry or {}) do if lower(k) == lower(gname) then gid = v; break end end end
                    if gid and gid ~= layer.geoId then attachLayer(layer, gid) end
                    local path = texturePath(def, layer.texture(env))
                    local uvo
                    if layer.uvAnim then uvo = {Molang.num(layer.uvAnim[1](env)), Molang.num(layer.uvAnim[2](env))} end
                    local key = tostring(path) .. (uvo and (uvo[1] .. "," .. uvo[2]) or "")
                    if layer.build and key ~= layer.texKey then layer.texKey = key; applyTexture(layer, path, uvo) end
                    -- part visibility (per layer: hiding a bone in one render controller leaves the others drawn)
                    if layer.build then
                        local bv = layer.boneVis
                        for name in pairs(layer.build.bones) do bv[name] = true end
                        for _, pv in ipairs(layer.visibility) do
                            local show = Molang.truthy(pv.cond(env))
                            for name in pairs(layer.build.bones) do if name:match(pv.pat) then bv[name] = show end end
                        end
                    end
                elseif layer.build then
                    detachLayer(layer)
                end
            end
            env.arrays = {}
            -- animations
            resetPose()
            for _, entry in ipairs(animate) do
                local w = 1
                if entry.cond then w = Molang.num(entry.cond(env)) end
                local inst = instanceOf(entry.name)
                if inst then
                    if w > 0 or inst.kind == "controller" then runEntry(inst, w, dt)
                    elseif inst.kind == "animation" then inst.time, inst.last, inst.done, inst.appliedDone, inst.delay = 0, -1, false, false, nil end
                end
            end
            for i = #oneShots, 1, -1 do
                local o = oneShots[i]
                runAnimation(o, 1, dt)
                local len = o.def.length or 0
                if (o.done and o.def.loop ~= "hold_on_last_frame") or o.time > math.max(len, o.maxTime or 0) + 0.25 then table.remove(oneShots, i) end
            end
            -- pose the faces
            local scale = scaleFn and Molang.num(scaleFn(env)) or 1
            if scale <= 0 then scale = 1 end
            local k = studsPerBlock / 16 * scale
            local allWorlds = {}
            local moving, frames = {}, {}
            for _, bd in pairs(builds) do
                -- affine bone transforms (full per-axis scale): x, y, z columns and translation t
                local worlds = {}
                local rootX, rootY, rootZ = frame.XVector * k, frame.YVector * k, frame.ZVector * k
                local rootT = frame.Position
                for _, bone in ipairs(bd.geo.bones) do
                    local b = bd.bones[bone.name]
                    local parent = bone.parent and worlds[bone.parent]
                    local px, py, pz, pt = rootX, rootY, rootZ, rootT
                    if parent then px, py, pz, pt = parent.x, parent.y, parent.z, parent.t end
                    local p = pose[bone.name]
                    local rot = bone.rest
                    local pos, sc = Vector3.zero, V3(1, 1, 1)
                    if p then
                        rot = rot + V3(-p.rot.X, -p.rot.Y, p.rot.Z)
                        pos = V3(-p.pos.X, p.pos.Y, p.pos.Z)
                        sc = p.scale
                    end
                    -- local = T(pivot + pos) * R * S * T(-pivot)
                    local r = eulerZYX(rot.X, rot.Y, rot.Z)
                    local lx, ly, lz = r.XVector * sc.X, r.YVector * sc.Y, r.ZVector * sc.Z
                    local a = bone.pivot + pos
                    local lt = a - (lx * bone.pivot.X + ly * bone.pivot.Y + lz * bone.pivot.Z)
                    -- world = parent * local
                    local function apply(v) return px * v.X + py * v.Y + pz * v.Z end
                    local w = {x = apply(lx), y = apply(ly), z = apply(lz), t = pt + apply(lt)}
                    -- which layers show this bone (a hidden bone hides its children too)
                    local lv, any = {}, false
                    for layer in pairs(bd.users) do
                        local on = layer.on and layer.hasImage and layer.boneVis[bone.name] ~= false and (not parent or parent.lv[layer] == true)
                        lv[layer] = on and true or false
                        if on then any = true end
                    end
                    w.lv = lv
                    worlds[bone.name] = w
                    if allWorlds[bone.name] == nil then allWorlds[bone.name] = w end
                    w.cf = CFrame.fromMatrix(w.t, w.x.Magnitude > 1e-9 and w.x.Unit or Vector3.xAxis, w.y.Magnitude > 1e-9 and w.y.Unit or Vector3.yAxis)
                    local lw = b.lastW
                    local still = lw ~= nil and b.lastStep == depthStep and (w.x - lw.x).Magnitude + (w.y - lw.y).Magnitude + (w.z - lw.z).Magnitude + (w.t - lw.t).Magnitude < 1e-4
                    b.lastW, b.lastStep = w, depthStep
                    -- rigid bone: rotation + uniform scale, right-handed
                    local mag = w.x.Magnitude
                    local rigid = false
                    local boneCF
                    if mag > 1e-6 then
                        local my, mz = w.y.Magnitude, w.z.Magnitude
                        local tol = mag * 1e-3
                        if math.abs(my - mag) < tol and math.abs(mz - mag) < tol
                            and math.abs(w.x:Dot(w.y)) < tol * mag and math.abs(w.y:Dot(w.z)) < tol * mag and math.abs(w.x:Dot(w.z)) < tol * mag
                            and w.x:Cross(w.y):Dot(w.z) > 0 then
                            rigid = true
                            boneCF = CFrame.fromMatrix(w.t, w.x / mag, w.y / mag, w.z / mag)
                        end
                    end
                    if rigid then
                        if not b.anchor or not b.anchor.Parent then
                            local a = Instance.new("Part")
                            a.Name, a.Anchored, a.Transparency, a.Size = "BoneAnchor", true, 1, V3(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
                            a.CanCollide, a.CanQuery, a.CanTouch, a.CastShadow = false, false, false, false
                            a.CFrame = boneCF
                            a.Parent = model
                            b.anchor = a
                            b.anchorCF = nil
                        end
                        if b.anchorCF ~= boneCF and not (still and b.anchorCF) then
                            b.anchorCF = boneCF
                            moving[#moving+1] = b.anchor
                            frames[#frames+1] = boneCF
                        end
                    end
                    for _, face in ipairs(b.faces) do
                        local f = face.def
                        local before = face.tiles
                        syncTiles(face, lv)
                        local tilesSame = face.tiles == before and face.placed
                        local skip
                        if rigid then
                            skip = tilesSame and face.weldMag ~= nil and math.abs(face.weldMag - mag) < mag * 1e-4 and face.weldStep == depthStep
                        else
                            skip = still and tilesSame and not face.welded
                        end
                        if #face.tiles > 0 and skip then
                            -- unchanged since the last placement
                        elseif #face.tiles > 0 then
                            face.placed = true
                            local U = w.x * f.U.X + w.y * f.U.Y + w.z * f.U.Z
                            local D = w.x * f.D.X + w.y * f.D.Y + w.z * f.D.Z
                            if U.Magnitude * f.w > 1e-4 and D.Magnitude * f.h > 1e-4 then
                                local u = U.Unit
                                local d = D - u * D:Dot(u)
                                if d.Magnitude > 1e-6 then
                                    d = d.Unit
                                    local n = d:Cross(u)
                                    local centre = w.t + w.x*f.centre.X + w.y*f.centre.Y + w.z*f.centre.Z + n*(face.rank*depthStep)
                                    for _, tile in ipairs(face.tiles) do
                                        local r, p = tile.rect, tile.part
                                        -- only a face's outer edges reach 0.03 px past (closes corners); inner tile edges meet exactly
                                        local gl, gr = r[1] < 1e-6 and 0.03 or 0, r[1] + r[3] > 1 - 1e-6 and 0.03 or 0
                                        local gt, gb = r[2] < 1e-6 and 0.03 or 0, r[2] + r[4] > 1 - 1e-6 and 0.03 or 0
                                        local size = V3(U.Magnitude*(f.w*r[3]+gl+gr+0.02), D.Magnitude*(f.h*r[4]+gt+gb+0.02), 0.001)
                                        if tile.size ~= size then tile.size = size; p.Size = size end
                                        local cf = CFrame.fromMatrix(centre + U*(f.w*(r[1]+r[3]/2-0.5) + (gr-gl)/2) + D*(f.h*(r[2]+r[4]/2-0.5) + (gb-gt)/2), -u, -d)
                                        if rigid then
                                            if not tile.weld or not tile.weld.Parent then
                                                local wd = Instance.new("Weld")
                                                wd.Part0, wd.Part1 = b.anchor, p
                                                wd.C0 = boneCF:ToObjectSpace(cf)
                                                p.Anchored, p.Massless = false, true
                                                wd.Parent = p
                                                tile.weld = wd
                                            else
                                                if tile.weld.Part0 ~= b.anchor then tile.weld.Part0 = b.anchor end
                                                tile.weld.C0 = boneCF:ToObjectSpace(cf)
                                            end
                                        else
                                            if tile.weld then tile.weld:Destroy(); tile.weld = nil; p.Anchored = true end
                                            moving[#moving+1] = p
                                            frames[#frames+1] = cf
                                        end
                                        if not tile.parented then tile.parented = true; p.Parent = model end
                                    end
                                    face.welded = rigid
                                    face.weldMag = rigid and mag or nil
                                    face.weldStep = depthStep
                                else
                                    face.placed = false
                                    for _, tile in ipairs(face.tiles) do if tile.parented then tile.parented=false; tile.part.Parent = nil end end
                                end
                            else
                                face.placed = false
                                for _, tile in ipairs(face.tiles) do if tile.parented then tile.parented=false; tile.part.Parent = nil end end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if #moving > 0 then workspace:BulkMoveTo(moving, frames, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged) end
            vis.worlds = allWorlds
        end
        vis.update = update
        local function release()
            if disposed then return end
            disposed = true
            for _, layer in ipairs(layers) do detachLayer(layer) end
        end
        model.Destroying:Connect(release)
        function vis.destroy()
            release()
            model:Destroy()
        end
        function vis.instances() return instances end
        return vis
    end
    return BR
end
return createBedrock

end)()
local createDialogEngine = (function()
-- Villager News dialogue engine (port of the add-on's Dialog module): weighted variants that avoid repeats, global /
-- per-entity / per-tag cooldowns (seconds, sped up near players), voice + lip-sync animation at the speaker,
-- subtitles at their timestamps for players within hearing range, interruption, and the request / play / subtitle /
-- stop hooks the add-on's logic listens to.
--   local DE = createDialogEngine(io)
--   io.tick() -> current game tick (20 per second)
--   io.play(entity, variant)          -- voice + animation (variant.soundId, variant.animationName)
--   io.stopSound(entity, variant)
--   io.subtitle(text key, entity)     -- show a subtitle line
--   io.clearSubtitle(entity)
--   io.hearers(entity) -> list of listeners within range (the local player or {})
--   io.alive(entity) -> bool
local function createDialogEngine(io)
    local DE = {}
    local dialogs = {}
    -- tuning (Dialog.ifdzpj.set at the end of the add-on): global {all, per dialog}, entity {all, per dialog}, tag
    local cfg = {global = {all = 6, each = 20}, entity = {all = 10, each = 30}, tag = {entity = 15, global = 30}}
    local maxDistance = 16
    local speedDivisor = 1         -- chattiness scales cooldowns (pghxhz.bvptra)
    local weightStrategy = "weight" -- rare lines setting
    function DE.configure(o)
        if o.global then for k, v in pairs(o.global) do cfg.global[k] = v end end
        if o.entity then for k, v in pairs(o.entity) do cfg.entity[k] = v end end
        if o.divisor then speedDivisor = o.divisor end
        if o.weights then weightStrategy = o.weights end
        if o.maxDistance then maxDistance = o.maxDistance end
    end
    function DE.maxDistance() return maxDistance end

    function DE.register(d)
        local variants = {}
        for i, v in ipairs(d.slhkqn or d.variants or {}) do
            local lines = {}
            for t, l in pairs(v.aswuwr or {}) do lines[#lines + 1] = {t = tonumber(t) or 0, key = l.ysyeto} end
            table.sort(lines, function(a, b) return a.t < b.t end)
            variants[i] = {animationName = v.animationName, soundId = v.soundId, duration = v.duration or 1, weight = v.weight or 1, lines = lines}
        end
        local tags = {}
        for tag, t in pairs(d.tags or {}) do tags[tag] = {global = t.plgoli, entity = t.andugb} end
        local def = {id = d.id, variants = variants, global = d.jqgklx and d.jqgklx.didrid, globalAll = d.jqgklx and d.jqgklx.iqirsz,
            entity = d.csiavd and d.csiavd.didrid, entityAll = d.csiavd and d.csiavd.iqirsz, tags = tags}
        dialogs[def.id] = def
        return def
    end
    function DE.get(id) return dialogs[id] end

    -- Cooldown timers: {left = ticks, at = tick, speed}
    local function timer() return {left = 0, at = io.tick(), speed = 1} end
    local function remaining(st)
        if not st then return 0 end
        local r = st.left - (io.tick() - st.at) * st.speed
        return r > 0 and r or 0
    end
    local function settle(st) st.left = remaining(st); st.at = io.tick() end
    local function ticksFor(seconds, duration) return math.floor(20 * seconds / speedDivisor) + math.floor(20 * duration) end
    local function block() return {all = timer(), each = {}, tags = {}} end
    local globalCd = block()
    local entityCd = {}      -- entity -> block
    local lastSpoke = {}     -- dialog id -> tick (any speaker)
    local lastVariant = {}   -- dialog id -> variant index
    local entitySpoke = {}   -- entity -> {dialog id -> tick}
    local function cdOf(entity, create)
        local b = entityCd[entity]
        if not b and create then b = block(); entityCd[entity] = b end
        return b
    end
    local function active(st) return remaining(st) > 0 end

    -- why a request is refused (hdodgt): global / per-dialog / entity / per-dialog-entity / tag cooldowns
    local function blocked(req)
        local f = req.flags or {}
        local r = {}
        if not f.ignoreGlobal then
            r.global = active(globalCd.all)
            r.globalDialog = active(globalCd.each[req.dialog.id])
        end
        if not f.ignoreEntity then
            local b = cdOf(req.entity)
            if b then r.entity = active(b.all); r.entityDialog = active(b.each[req.dialog.id]) end
        end
        if not f.ignoreTags then
            local b = cdOf(req.entity)
            for tag in pairs(req.dialog.tags) do
                if active(globalCd.tags[tag]) then r.tagGlobal = true end
                if b and active(b.tags[tag]) then r.tagEntity = true end
            end
        end
        return r.global or r.globalDialog or r.entity or r.entityDialog or r.tagGlobal or r.tagEntity, r
    end
    DE.blocked = blocked
    local function startCooldowns(def, vi, entity)
        local v = def.variants[vi]
        if not v then return end
        lastSpoke[def.id] = io.tick()
        local function set(st, seconds) if seconds and seconds > 0 then st.left, st.at, st.speed = ticksFor(seconds, v.duration), io.tick(), st.speed or 1 end end
        set(globalCd.all, def.globalAll or cfg.global.all)
        globalCd.each[def.id] = globalCd.each[def.id] or timer(); set(globalCd.each[def.id], def.global or cfg.global.each)
        for tag, t in pairs(def.tags) do
            globalCd.tags[tag] = globalCd.tags[tag] or timer(); set(globalCd.tags[tag], t.global or cfg.tag.global)
        end
        if entity then
            local b = cdOf(entity, true)
            set(b.all, def.entityAll or cfg.entity.all)
            b.each[def.id] = b.each[def.id] or timer(); set(b.each[def.id], def.entity or cfg.entity.each)
            for tag, t in pairs(def.tags) do
                b.tags[tag] = b.tags[tag] or timer(); set(b.tags[tag], t.entity or cfg.tag.entity)
            end
            entitySpoke[entity] = entitySpoke[entity] or {}
            entitySpoke[entity][def.id] = io.tick()
        end
    end
    function DE.lastSpokeBy(entity, id) local t = entitySpoke[entity]; return t and t[id] or 0 end
    function DE.lastSpoke(id) return lastSpoke[id] or 0 end
    -- speed up / reset cooldowns (Dialog.xjuzaj): speed 1.25-3 near players
    function DE.setEntitySpeed(entity, speed)
        local b = cdOf(entity, true)
        settle(b.all); b.all.speed = speed
        for _, st in pairs(b.tags) do settle(st); st.speed = speed end
    end
    function DE.cooldownInfo(entity, def)
        local b = cdOf(entity)
        local info = {global = remaining(globalCd.all), globalDialog = def and remaining(globalCd.each[def.id]) or 0}
        if b then info.entity = remaining(b.all); info.entityDialog = def and remaining(b.each[def.id]) or 0 end
        return info
    end

    -- hooks (Dialog.bhnotn): request / play / subtitle / stop
    local hooks = {request = {}, play = {}, subtitle = {}, stop = {}}
    function DE.on(kind, fn) hooks[kind][#hooks[kind] + 1] = fn end
    local function fire(kind, ev)
        local cancelled = false
        ev.cancel = function() cancelled = true end
        for _, fn in ipairs(hooks[kind]) do fn(ev) end
        return cancelled
    end

    -- speaking
    local speaking = {} -- entity -> {def, vi, untilTick, timers = {}}
    local function stillSpeaking(entity)
        local s = speaking[entity]
        if s and io.tick() <= s.untilTick then return s end
        speaking[entity] = nil
    end
    function DE.speaking(entity) local s = stillSpeaking(entity); return s and s.def end
    function DE.speakingVariant(entity) local s = stillSpeaking(entity); return s and s.vi end
    function DE.isSpeaking(entity) return stillSpeaking(entity) ~= nil end
    local function stop(entity, opts)
        local s = speaking[entity]
        if not s then return end
        speaking[entity] = nil
        s.cancelled = true
        local v = s.def.variants[s.vi]
        if v then pcall(io.stopSound, entity, v) end
        pcall(io.clearSubtitle, entity)
        fire("stop", {dialog = s.def, variant = s.vi, entity = entity, reason = "interrupted", by = opts and opts.by})
    end
    DE.stop = stop

    -- variant choice (fsdzjm): weights, never the one just played when there is a choice
    local function weightOf(v, info)
        if weightStrategy == "rare" then return info.max + info.min - v.weight end
        if weightStrategy == "never" then return v.weight >= 0.8 * info.max and v.weight or 0 end
        return v.weight
    end
    local function pickVariant(def)
        local vs = def.variants
        local last = #vs > 1 and lastVariant[def.id] or -1
        local info = {min = math.huge, max = -math.huge}
        for _, v in ipairs(vs) do info.min = math.min(info.min, v.weight); info.max = math.max(info.max, v.weight) end
        local total = 0
        for i, v in ipairs(vs) do if i ~= last then total = total + math.max(0, weightOf(v, info)) end end
        if total <= 0 then return (last == 1 and #vs > 1) and 2 or 1 end
        local roll = math.random() * total
        for i, v in ipairs(vs) do
            if i ~= last then
                roll = roll - math.max(0, weightOf(v, info))
                if roll <= 0 then return i end
            end
        end
        return (last == 1 and #vs > 1) and 2 or 1
    end

    local function play(def, vi, entity)
        local v = def.variants[vi]
        local dur = math.floor(20 * v.duration)
        if fire("play", {dialog = def, variant = vi, entity = entity, startTick = io.tick(), endTick = io.tick() + dur}) then return false end
        pcall(io.play, entity, v)
        local s = {def = def, vi = vi, untilTick = io.tick() + dur, start = os.clock()}
        speaking[entity] = s
        lastVariant[def.id] = vi
        -- subtitles at their timestamps
        for _, line in ipairs(v.lines) do
            task.delay(line.t, function()
                if s.cancelled or not io.alive(entity) then return end
                for _, listener in ipairs(io.hearers(entity)) do
                    if not fire("subtitle", {dialog = def, variant = vi, entity = entity, key = line.key, listener = listener}) then
                        pcall(io.subtitle, line.key, entity, listener)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        task.delay((dur + 10) / 20, function()
            if s.cancelled then return end
            if speaking[entity] == s then speaking[entity] = nil end
            pcall(io.clearSubtitle, entity)
            fire("stop", {dialog = def, variant = vi, entity = entity, reason = "finished"})
        end)
        startCooldowns(def, vi, entity)
        return true
    end

    -- request (izbnnu): refused while speaking (unless forced), out of everyone's hearing, or cooling down
    -- flags = {force = interrupt a line, ignoreGlobal, ignoreEntity, ignoreTags}
    function DE.request(req)
        local entity, def = req.entity, req.dialog
        if not entity or not io.alive(entity) or not def or #def.variants == 0 then return {status = "refused"} end
        local f = req.flags or {}
        local current = stillSpeaking(entity)
        if current and not f.force then
            if fire("request", {request = req, result = {status = "refused", speaking = true}}) then return {status = "refused"} end
            return {status = "refused", speaking = true}
        end
        if #io.hearers(entity) == 0 then return {status = "refused", nobody = true} end
        local isBlocked = blocked(req)
        if isBlocked then
            fire("request", {request = req, result = {status = "refused", cooldown = true}})
            return {status = "refused", cooldown = true}
        end
        if fire("request", {request = req, result = {status = "ok"}}) then return {status = "refused", hooked = true} end
        if current then stop(entity, {by = def}) end
        local vi = pickVariant(def)
        if play(def, vi, entity) then return {status = "played", variant = vi} end
        return {status = "refused", hooked = true}
    end
    -- can this be said now (rfcrcn's cooldown part)
    function DE.canSay(entity, def, flags)
        local isBlocked = blocked({entity = entity, dialog = def, flags = flags})
        return not isBlocked
    end
    function DE.forget(entity) speaking[entity] = nil; entityCd[entity] = nil; entitySpoke[entity] = nil end
    function DE.globalLastTick() return globalCd.all.at end
    return DE
end
return createDialogEngine

end)()
-- Villager News (Oreville Studios & Element Animation) for the Steve script ------------------------------------------------
-- Every villager and wandering trader is drawn by the add-on's own Bedrock models, textures and animations (through the
-- Bedrock runtime), speaks the add-on's voice lines with lip-sync and subtitles, and reacts to the world through a port
-- of the add-on's own logic (vn_triggers). The special villagers (Mayor, Testificate Man, Villager #5, Villager #9,
-- Can't Catch Me!) and Wooly the Sheep spawn from eggs in the normal Spawn Eggs tab; the add-on's items sit in the normal
-- tabs. All assets come from villager_news.pack (downloaded the first time the mod is turned on).
local function createVillagerNews(lib)
    local Molang, createBedrock, createDialogEngine = lib.Molang, lib.createBedrock, lib.createDialogEngine
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local SteveMods = JavaContent.mods
    local B = CONFIG.Block
    local FOLDER = "Steve Mods/villager_news"
    local PACK_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/9s2dyhcgwm-svg/Scripts/main/Steve%20Mods/villager_news/"
    local PACK_VERSION = "4"

    local VN = {id = "villager_news", name = "Villager News", author = "Oreville Studios & Element Animation", version = "1.0",
        description = "Villagers with voices, faces and opinions: 2,000+ voiced lines, special villagers, hats and noses.",
        icon = lib.icon, enabled = false}
    SteveMods.list[#SteveMods.list + 1] = VN
    SteveMods.byId[VN.id] = VN

    -- Types (the add-on's entity ids) ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local T = {villager = "oreville_vn:villager", trader = "oreville_vn:txczvv", mayor = "oreville_vn:ilvfra", testificate = "oreville_vn:poztxf",
        five = "oreville_vn:vwpagn", nine = "oreville_vn:xcrjxf", untouchable = "oreville_vn:ghibss", wooly = "oreville_vn:mlkxjo"}
    VN.T = T
    -- ekyudk: entity type -> the key the trigger filters use
    local TYPE_KEY = {[T.villager] = "villager", [T.trader] = "wandering_trader", [T.mayor] = "mywqes", [T.testificate] = "poztxf",
        [T.five] = "vbcyvo", [T.nine] = "hbgekt", [T.untouchable] = "ghibss", [T.wooly] = "mlkxjo"}
    local DEFAULT_KEYS = {villager = true, mywqes = true, wandering_trader = true, poztxf = true, vbcyvo = true, hbgekt = true, ghibss = true}
    local SPECIAL = {[T.mayor] = true, [T.testificate] = true, [T.five] = true, [T.nine] = true, [T.trader] = true, [T.untouchable] = true, [T.wooly] = true}
    local NAMES = {[T.mayor] = "Mayor", [T.testificate] = "Testificate Man", [T.five] = "Villager #5", [T.nine] = "Villager #9",
        [T.untouchable] = "Can't Catch Me!", [T.wooly] = "Wooly"}
    -- Bedrock villager_v2 variant (profession) and mark_variant (biome) numbers
    local PROFESSIONS = {"unskilled", "farmer", "fisherman", "shepherd", "fletcher", "librarian", "cartographer", "cleric", "armorer",
        "weaponsmith", "toolsmith", "butcher", "leatherworker", "stone_mason", "nitwit"}
    local PROF_INDEX = {}
    for i, p in ipairs(PROFESSIONS) do PROF_INDEX[p] = i - 1 end
    local BIOMES = {plains = 0, desert = 1, jungle = 2, savanna = 3, snow = 4, swamp = 5, taiga = 6}

    -- Pack -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local data, BR, DE
    local function packReady() return isfile and isfile(FOLDER .. "/version.txt") and readfile(FOLDER .. "/version.txt") == PACK_VERSION end
    local function ensurePack(progress)
        if packReady() then return true end
        local req = request or http_request
        if not (req and writefile and makefolder) then return false end
        local base = (getgenv and rawget(getgenv(), "SteveFilmURL")) or PACK_URL
        local ok, res = pcall(req, {Url = base .. "villager_news.pack", Method = "GET"})
        if not (ok and type(res) == "table" and res.StatusCode == 200 and type(res.Body) == "string" and res.Body:sub(1, 5) == "SSPK1") then
            warn("[Villager News] the villager_news pack could not be downloaded")
            return false
        end
        local body = res.Body
        local n = string.unpack(">I4", body, 6)
        local index = HttpService:JSONDecode(body:sub(10, 9 + n))
        local start = 10 + n
        for _, f in ipairs({"Steve Mods", FOLDER}) do pcall(function() if not isfolder(f) then makefolder(f) end end) end
        for i, e in ipairs(index) do
            writefile(FOLDER .. "/" .. e[1], body:sub(start + e[2], start + e[2] + e[3] - 1))
            if i % 60 == 0 then if progress then progress(i / #index) end; task.wait() end
        end
        writefile(FOLDER .. "/version.txt", PACK_VERSION)
        return true
    end
    local assets = {}
    local function asset(file)
        local a = assets[file]
        if a == nil then
            a = false
            pcall(function() if isfile(FOLDER .. "/" .. file) then a = getcustomasset(FOLDER .. "/" .. file) end end)
            assets[file] = a
        end
        return a or nil
    end
    local function loadData()
        if data then return true end
        local ok, d = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(FOLDER .. "/vn.json")) end)
        if not ok then warn("[Villager News] " .. tostring(d)); return false end
        data = d
        VN.data = d
        return true
    end

    -- World access ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function ctx() return SteveMods.ctx end
    local function world() local c = ctx(); return c and c.world end
    local function mobsModule() local w = world(); return w and w.gameplay and w.gameplay.mobsModule end
    local function mobList() local m = mobsModule(); return m and m.list or {} end
    local tickCount = 0
    local function now() return tickCount end
    VN.now = now
    local function dayTime()
        local w = world()
        local b = w and w.blocks
        local ok, t = pcall(function() return b.dayTime() end)
        return ok and type(t) == "number" and t % 24000 or 6000
    end
    local function weather() local w = world(); local c = w and w.chat; return c and c.weather or "clear" end
    local function cellCenter(p) local w = world(); return w and w.cell and w.cell(p) or p end
    local function blockAt(p)
        local w = world()
        if not (w and w.sample) then return nil end
        local ok, s = pcall(w.sample, cellCenter(p))
        if ok and s then return s.id end
        return nil
    end
    local function isMob(e) return type(e) == "table" and e.humanoid ~= nil end
    local function alive(e)
        if not isMob(e) then return e ~= nil end
        return not e.removed and e.humanoid.Health > 0
    end
    local function posOf(e)
        if isMob(e) then return e.position end
        if type(e) == "table" and e.player then local c = ctx(); return c and c.root and (c.root.Position - Vector3.new(0, c.root.Size.Y / 2, 0)) or Vector3.zero end
        if typeof(e) == "Vector3" then return e end
        return Vector3.zero
    end
    local function headOf(e)
        if isMob(e) then return e.position + Vector3.new(0, (e.eye or 1.5) * e.scale, 0) end
        if type(e) == "table" and e.player then local w = world(); return w and w.eye and w.eye() or posOf(e) end
        return posOf(e)
    end
    local function dist(a, b) return (posOf(a) - posOf(b)).Magnitude / B end
    VN.posOf, VN.headOf, VN.dist, VN.alive, VN.blockAt, VN.dayTime, VN.weather = posOf, headOf, dist, alive, blockAt, dayTime, weather

    -- The local player as an entity
    local PLAYER = {player = true, id = "player"}
    VN.PLAYER = PLAYER
    function VN.lookDir() local w = world(); return w and w.look and w.look() or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
    function VN.creative() return not CONFIG.Survival end
    function VN.spectator() return PlayerStats and PlayerStats.spectator == true end
    function VN.heldItem()
        local w = world()
        local s = w and w.mainStack
        local e = s and JavaContent.byIndex[s.id]
        return e and e.id or nil, s
    end

    -- Villager state ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function vnType(m)
        if not isMob(m) then return nil end
        if m.vnType then return m.vnType end
        if m.id == "villager" then return T.villager end
        if m.id == "wandering_trader" then return T.trader end
        return nil
    end
    VN.vnType = vnType
    local function isVillagerLike(m) return vnType(m) ~= nil end
    local function profession(m)
        if not isMob(m) then return nil end
        local t = vnType(m)
        if t ~= T.villager and t ~= T.mayor then return nil end
        local p = m.profession or (m.variantName or ""):match("^[a-z]+_(.+)$") or "none"
        if p == "none" then return "unskilled" end
        if p == "mason" then return "stone_mason" end
        return p
    end
    VN.profession = profession
    local function isBaby(m) return isMob(m) and m.baby == true end
    VN.isBaby = isBaby
    local function stateOf(m)
        local s = m.vn
        if s then return s end
        local t = vnType(m)
        s = {type = t, props = {}, dyn = {}, born = now(), skin = math.random(0, 5), nextChat = now() + math.random(19, 37) * 20}
        -- the companion's properties at their defaults (bp entity description.properties)
        local bp = data and data.bp_entities[t == T.villager and T.villager or t]
        for name, p in pairs(bp and bp.description and bp.description.properties or {}) do
            local d = p.default
            if type(d) == "boolean" then d = d and 1 or 0 end
            s.props[name:lower()] = d
        end
        local biome = "plains"
        pcall(function()
            local info = rawget(_G, "SteveInfo")
            if info and info.blockPos then
                local _, _, _, b = info.blockPos(m.position)
                if type(b) == "string" then
                    for k in pairs(BIOMES) do if b:find(k, 1, true) then biome = k end end
                    if b:find("snow", 1, true) or b:find("frozen", 1, true) or b:find("ice", 1, true) then biome = "snow" end
                    if b:find("badlands", 1, true) or b:find("mesa", 1, true) then biome = "desert" end
                    if b:find("forest", 1, true) and b:find("taiga", 1, true) then biome = "taiga" end
                end
            end
        end)
        local own = (m.variantName or ""):match("^(%a+)")
        if own and BIOMES[own] then biome = own end
        s.mark = BIOMES[biome] or 0
        m.vn = s
        return s
    end
    VN.stateOf = stateOf
    local function prop(m, name) local s = stateOf(m); return s.props[name:lower()] end
    local function setProp(m, name, v) local s = stateOf(m); if type(v) == "boolean" then v = v and 1 or 0 end; s.props[name:lower()] = v end
    VN.prop, VN.setProp = prop, setProp
    function VN.dyn(m, k) return stateOf(m).dyn[k] end
    function VN.setDyn(m, k, v) stateOf(m).dyn[k] = v end

    -- Nearby queries
    function VN.villagersNear(p, radius, filter)
        local out = {}
        for _, m in ipairs(mobList()) do
            if alive(m) and isVillagerLike(m) and (not filter or filter(m)) then
                local d = (m.position - posOf(p)).Magnitude / B
                if d <= radius then out[#out + 1] = {m = m, d = d} end
            end
        end
        table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.d < b.d end)
        local list = {}
        for i, e in ipairs(out) do list[i] = e.m end
        return list
    end
    function VN.mobsNear(p, radius, filter)
        local out = {}
        for _, m in ipairs(mobList()) do
            if alive(m) and (not filter or filter(m)) then
                local d = (m.position - posOf(p)).Magnitude / B
                if d <= radius then out[#out + 1] = {m = m, d = d} end
            end
        end
        table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.d < b.d end)
        local list = {}
        for i, e in ipairs(out) do list[i] = e.m end
        return list
    end
    function VN.playerNear(p, radius) return VN.enabled and dist(PLAYER, p) <= radius end
    function VN.speedOf(m) -- blocks per tick, horizontal
        if not isMob(m) or not m.previous then return 0 end
        local d = m.position - m.previous
        return Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z).Magnitude / B
    end

    -- Settings (the Handbook): subtitles, chattiness, rare lines, style ---------------------------------------------------------
    local SETTINGS_FILE = FOLDER .. "/settings.json"
    local settings = {subtitles = true, chattiness = "default", rare = "default", style = 0, specials = true}
    local function loadSettings()
        pcall(function()
            if isfile(SETTINGS_FILE) then
                local s = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SETTINGS_FILE))
                for k, v in pairs(s) do settings[k] = v end
            end
        end)
    end
    local function saveSettings() pcall(function() writefile(SETTINGS_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(settings)) end) end
    VN.settings = settings
    -- chattiness (uwruge): silent / less / default / more
    local CHAT_DIVISOR = {silent = 0, less = 0.5, default = 1, more = 5}
    local function applySettings()
        if not DE then return end
        local c = settings.chattiness
        DE.configure({divisor = CHAT_DIVISOR[c] ~= 0 and CHAT_DIVISOR[c] or 1,
            global = {all = c == "less" and 3 or 6}, weights = settings.rare == "never" and "never" or (settings.rare == "more" and "rare" or "weight")})
    end
    function VN.set(k, v) settings[k] = v; saveSettings(); applySettings() end

    -- Voice and subtitles -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local voices = {}
    local subtitleState = {}
    local function playVoice(m, v)
        local snd = data.sounds[v.soundId]
        local f = snd and snd.files[1]
        local id = f and asset(f.file)
        if not id then return end
        local parent = isMob(m) and m.hitbox
        if not parent then return end
        if voices[m] then pcall(function() voices[m]:Destroy() end) end
        local s = Instance.new("Sound")
        s.SoundId = id
        s.Volume = 1 * (f.volume or 1)
        s.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
        s.RollOffMinDistance, s.RollOffMaxDistance = 2 * B, (DE.maxDistance() + 4) * B
        s.Parent = parent
        s.Ended:Connect(function() if voices[m] == s then voices[m] = nil end; s:Destroy() end)
        voices[m] = s
        s:Play()
    end
    local function showSubtitle(key, m)
        if not settings.subtitles then return end
        local text = data.lang[key]
        if not text or text == "" then return end
        local w = world()
        local c = w and w.chat
        if c and c.showTitle then pcall(c.showTitle, "actionbar", {{text = text, color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)}}) end
        subtitleState.last = {m = m, at = os.clock()}
    end
    local function visualOf(m) return m.vn and m.vn.vis end

    -- Dialogue engine --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function hearers(m)
        if VN.spectator() and false then return {} end
        if dist(PLAYER, m) <= DE.maxDistance() then return {PLAYER} end
        return {}
    end
    local function buildEngine()
        DE = createDialogEngine({
            tick = now,
            alive = alive,
            hearers = hearers,
            play = function(m, v)
                playVoice(m, v)
                local vis = visualOf(m)
                if vis and v.animationName then pcall(vis.play, v.animationName) end
            end,
            stopSound = function(m) if voices[m] then pcall(function() voices[m]:Stop(); voices[m]:Destroy() end); voices[m] = nil end end,
            subtitle = function(key, m) showSubtitle(key, m) end,
            clearSubtitle = function() end,
        })
        for _, d in ipairs(data.dialogs) do DE.register(d) end
        VN.DE = DE
        applySettings()
    end
    local function D(id) return DE.get(id) end
    VN.D = D

    -- The request helpers the add-on's logic is written with -------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- flags (tcfxgj): force = interrupt (nombrd), entity = ignore entity cooldowns (biwvyy), global = ignore global (nnanoj),
    -- tags = ignore tag cooldowns (fuyoyw). states: "adult" / "baby" / "sleeping" (mbzvnx) / "urgent" (rzllva).
    local FORCE = {force = true, ignoreEntity = true, ignoreGlobal = true, ignoreTags = true}
    VN.FORCE = FORCE
    local function flagsOf(f)
        if not f then return nil end
        if f.ignoreGlobal ~= nil or f.force ~= nil then return f end
        return {force = f.nombrd, ignoreEntity = f.biwvyy, ignoreGlobal = f.nnanoj, ignoreTags = f.fuyoyw}
    end
    local function stateSet(list)
        local s = {}
        for _, v in ipairs(list or {"adult"}) do s[v] = true end
        return s
    end
    -- ihylcx: may this entity say a line now
    local function mayTalk(m, opts)
        local keys = opts and opts.keys or DEFAULT_KEYS
        local states = stateSet(opts and opts.states)
        local t = vnType(m)
        if not t or not keys[TYPE_KEY[t]] then return false end
        if m.sleeping and not states.sleeping then return false end
        if t == T.mayor and not states.baby then return false end -- the Mayor speaks his "baby" lines (jiixbx)
        if t == T.villager then if isBaby(m) then if not states.baby then return false end elseif not states.adult then return false end end
        if t == T.untouchable and prop(m, "p:zsuvyv") == 1 and not states.untouchableFlee then return false end
        if not states.urgent then
            local hurt = stateOf(m).hurtTick
            if hurt and now() <= hurt + 40 then return false end
            for _, o in ipairs(VN.mobsNear(m, 8, function(o) return mobsModule().hostile and mobsModule().hostile[o.id] end)) do if o then return false end end
        end
        return true
    end
    VN.mayTalk = mayTalk
    local function silenced(m) return stateOf(m).silenced == true end
    -- ioflio: say it now (returns the request result)
    local function say(m, dialogId, opts)
        if m.puppet and not (opts and opts.network) then return nil end
        if not alive(m) or silenced(m) or not VN.enabled then return nil end
        if not mayTalk(m, opts) then return nil end
        local d = D(dialogId)
        if not d then return nil end
        local r = DE.request({entity = m, dialog = d, flags = flagsOf(opts and opts.flags), target = opts and opts.target})
        if r.status == "played" then
            stateOf(m).lookAt = opts and opts.target
            if not m.puppet and m.netId and SteveMods.netEvent then
                SteveMods.netEvent(VN.id,{kind="speech",mob=m.netId,dialog=dialogId})
            end
        end
        return r
    end
    VN.say = say
    function VN.onEvent(peer,event)
        if not VN.enabled or event.kind~="speech" or type(event.dialog)~="string" then return end
        local owner=peer.player.UserId%16777216
        for _,m in ipairs(mobList()) do
            if m.puppet and m.puppet.owner==owner and m.puppet.mid==event.mob then say(m,event.dialog,{bypass=true,network=true});return end
        end
    end
    -- rfcrcn: would it be allowed (cooldowns) right now
    local function canSay(m, dialogId, opts)
        if not alive(m) or silenced(m) then return false end
        if not mayTalk(m, opts) then return false end
        local d = D(dialogId)
        return d ~= nil and DE.canSay(m, d, flagsOf(opts and opts.flags))
    end
    VN.canSay = canSay
    -- ufjrcy / rzpfzr: queue it; it is said once the speaker can (on the ground, head out of water), within `timeout` ticks
    local queue = {}
    local NOOP = {queued = false, waiting = false, cancel = function() end}
    local CHAT_RATE = {less = 40, default = 10}
    local CHAT_MAX = {less = 1, default = 3}
    local talking = {} -- speakers right now
    local lastTalkTick = 0
    local function chattinessAllows()
        local c = settings.chattiness
        local gap = CHAT_RATE[c]
        if gap and now() - lastTalkTick < gap then return false end
        local maxN = CHAT_MAX[c]
        local n = 0
        for m in pairs(talking) do if alive(m) and DE.isSpeaking(m) then n = n + 1 else talking[m] = nil end end
        return not (maxN and n >= maxN)
    end
    local function standing(m)
        if not isMob(m) then return false end
        if not m.onGround and m.vn and m.vn.everGrounded then return false end
        if m.onGround then stateOf(m).everGrounded = true end
        local id = blockAt(headOf(m))
        return id ~= "water"
    end
    local function queueSay(m, dialogId, opts)
        if not alive(m) or not canSay(m, dialogId, opts) then return NOOP end
        local q = {m = m, id = dialogId, opts = opts, deadline = now() + (opts and opts.timeout or 40), when = opts and opts.when,
            bypass = opts and opts.bypass, state = "waiting", onSaid = {}}
        queue[#queue + 1] = q
        return {queued = true, entry = q, cancel = function() if q.state == "waiting" then q.state = "cancelled" end end,
            onSaid = function(fn) q.onSaid[#q.onSaid + 1] = fn end}
    end
    VN.queueSay = queueSay
    local function stepQueue()
        local keep = {}
        for _, q in ipairs(queue) do
            if q.state == "waiting" then
                if not alive(q.m) or now() >= q.deadline then q.state = "expired"
                elseif (not q.when or q.when()) and (q.bypass or chattinessAllows()) and standing(q.m) then
                    local r = say(q.m, q.id, q.opts)
                    if r and r.status == "played" then
                        q.state = "said"
                        for _, fn in ipairs(q.onSaid) do pcall(fn, r, q.m) end
                    end
                end
            end
            if q.state == "waiting" then keep[#keep + 1] = q end
        end
        queue = keep
    end
    -- hrdsiq: the adult line or the baby line
    function VN.sayAge(m, adultId, babyId, opts)
        if not alive(m) then return NOOP end
        opts = opts or {}
        local baby = isBaby(m) or vnType(m) == T.mayor
        local o = {}
        for k, v in pairs(opts) do o[k] = v end
        local states = {baby and "baby" or "adult"}
        if opts.sleeping then states[#states + 1] = "sleeping" end
        if opts.urgent then states[#states + 1] = "urgent" end
        o.states = states
        return queueSay(m, baby and babyId or adultId, o)
    end
    -- ivrfrc / mebjmh: the Mayor's and Wooly's own lines
    function VN.sayMayor(m, id, opts) local o = {}; for k, v in pairs(opts or {}) do o[k] = v end; o.keys = {mywqes = true}; o.states = {"baby"}; return queueSay(m, id, o) end
    function VN.sayWooly(m, id, opts) local o = {}; for k, v in pairs(opts or {}) do o[k] = v end; o.keys = {mlkxjo = true}; o.states = {"adult"}; return queueSay(m, id, o) end
    -- tgelfd / nodrae: someone near `p` says it (the one who said it least recently first)
    local function nearSpeakers(p, radius, exclude)
        local list = VN.villagersNear(p, radius or 16, function(m) return vnType(m) ~= T.trader and vnType(m) ~= T.wooly and m ~= exclude end)
        return list
    end
    function VN.sayNear(p, id, opts)
        local list = nearSpeakers(p, opts and opts.radius, opts and opts.exclude)
        table.sort(list, function(a, b) return DE.lastSpokeBy(a, id) < DE.lastSpokeBy(b, id) end)
        for _, m in ipairs(list) do
            local h = queueSay(m, id, opts)
            if h.queued then return h, m end
        end
    end
    function VN.sayNearAge(p, adultId, babyId, opts)
        local list = nearSpeakers(p, opts and opts.radius, opts and opts.exclude)
        for _, m in ipairs(list) do
            local h = VN.sayAge(m, adultId, babyId, opts)
            if h.queued then return h, m end
        end
    end

    -- Rendering hook: villagers get the add-on's model ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function queryFor(m)
        local rad = math.pi / 180
        return function(name, args, env, vis)
            local s = m.vn
            if name == "anim_time" then return env.q_anim_time or 0 end
            if name == "life_time" then return vis.life end
            if name == "delta_time" then return env.dt or 0 end
            if name == "state_time" then return env.q_state_time or 0 end
            if name == "all_animations_finished" then return env.q_all_finished and 1 or 0 end
            if name == "any_animation_finished" then return env.q_any_finished and 1 or 0 end
            if name == "property" then local v = s and s.props[tostring(args[1]):lower()]; if v == nil then return 0 end return v end
            if name == "has_property" then return (s and s.props[tostring(args[1]):lower()] ~= nil) and 1 or 0 end
            if name == "variant" then return PROF_INDEX[profession(m) or "unskilled"] or 0 end
            if name == "mark_variant" then return s and s.mark or 0 end
            if name == "skin_id" then return s and s.skin or 0 end
            if name == "is_alive" then return alive(m) and 1 or 0 end
            if name == "is_baby" then return m.baby and 1 or 0 end
            if name == "health" then return m.humanoid.Health end
            if name == "death_ticks" then return m.deathTime or 0 end
            if name == "modified_move_speed" then return math.clamp((m.walkSpeed or 0) * 1.6, 0, 1) end
            if name == "ground_speed" then return VN.speedOf(m) * 20 end
            if name == "vertical_speed" then return m.previous and (m.position.Y - m.previous.Y) / B * 20 or 0 end
            if name == "modified_distance_moved" then return (m.walkPos or 0) end
            if name == "is_on_ground" then return m.onGround and 1 or 0 end
            if name == "is_in_water" then return blockAt(m.position + Vector3.new(0, 0.3 * B, 0)) == "water" and 1 or 0 end
            if name == "is_avoiding_mobs" or name == "is_panicking" then return (s and s.avoiding) and 1 or 0 end
            if name == "has_target" then return m.target and 1 or 0 end
            if name == "is_sleeping" then return m.sleeping and 1 or 0 end
            if name == "body_y_rotation" then return 180 - (m.bodyYaw or m.yaw or 0) / rad end
            if name == "target_y_rotation" then
                local wrap = function(a) return (a + math.pi) % (math.pi * 2) - math.pi end
                return math.clamp(-wrap((m.headYaw or 0) - (m.bodyYaw or m.yaw or 0)) / rad, -75, 75)
            end
            if name == "target_x_rotation" then return (m.headPitch or 0) / rad end
            if name == "trade_tier" then return math.max(0, (m.tradeLevel or 1) - 1) end
            if name == "is_name_any" then
                for _, a in ipairs(args) do if m.customName == a then return 1 end end
                return 0
            end
            if name == "is_sheared" then return m.sheared and 1 or 0 end
            if name == "in_range" then local v, a, b2 = Molang.num(args[1]), Molang.num(args[2]), Molang.num(args[3]); return (v >= a and v <= b2) and 1 or 0 end
            if name == "any" then for i = 2, #args do if args[i] == args[1] then return 1 end end return 0 end
            if name == "graphics_mode_is_any" then return 1 end
            if name == "distance_from_camera" then local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera; return cam and (cam.CFrame.Position - m.position).Magnitude / B or 8 end
            if name == "rotation_to_camera" then
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if not cam then return 0 end
                local d = cam.CFrame.Position - headOf(m)
                if Molang.num(args[1]) == 0 then return -math.deg(math.atan2(d.Y, Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z).Magnitude)) end
                return math.deg(math.atan2(-d.X, d.Z))
            end
            if name == "position" then local p = m.position / B; local a = Molang.num(args[1]); return a == 0 and p.X or (a == 1 and p.Y or p.Z) end
            if name == "position_delta" then local p = m.previous and (m.position - m.previous) / B or Vector3.zero; local a = Molang.num(args[1]); return a == 0 and p.X or (a == 1 and p.Y or p.Z) end
            if name == "frame_alpha" then return 0 end
            if name == "yaw_speed" then return 0 end
            return 0
        end
    end
    local function makeVisual(m)
        if not (VN.enabled and data and BR) then return nil end
        local t = vnType(m)
        if not t then return nil end
        stateOf(m)
        local vis = BR.visual(t, {query = function(name, args, env, v) return queryFor(m)(name, args, env, v) end})
        if not vis then return nil end
        m.vn.vis = vis
        local last = os.clock() - math.random() * 0.1 -- random phase: villagers spread over frames
        local holder = {model = vis.model, bones = {}, parts = {}, bedrock = vis, destroy = vis.destroy}
        function holder.pivot(frame)
            local t2 = os.clock()
            -- Animate nearby villagers at 30 Hz and distant ones at 15 Hz.
            -- Simulation and dialogue keep their own tick rates.
            local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local distance = camera and (camera.CFrame.Position - frame.Position).Magnitude or 0
            local interval = distance < 30 and 1/30 or distance < 60 and 1/15 or distance < 120 and 1/8 or 1/4
            if camera and distance > 8 then
                -- off screen (with a margin for a model half inside the view): a slow update keeps its state going
                local vp, inFront = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(frame.Position + Vector3.new(0, B, 0))
                local size = camera.ViewportSize
                if vp.Z <= 0 or vp.X < -size.X * 0.25 or vp.X > size.X * 1.25 or vp.Y < -size.Y * 0.25 or vp.Y > size.Y * 1.25 then interval = 1/2 end
            end
            if vis.life > 0 and t2 - last < interval then return end
            local dt = math.min(0.25, t2 - last)
            last = t2
            -- the Java visual is turned round (Angles(0, pi, 0)); Bedrock models face north already
            -- the add-on keeps the villager's companion 1.9 blocks above it (0.98 for babies) and its "offset" animation
            -- draws the model that far lower; asleep, the companion sits on the villager itself
            local lift = 0
            if vnType(m) == T.villager and not m.sleeping then lift = (isBaby(m) and 0.98 or 1.9) * B end
            local ok, err = pcall(vis.update, dt, frame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0) + Vector3.new(0, lift, 0), B)
            if not ok and not VN.renderWarned then VN.renderWarned = true; warn("[Villager News] " .. tostring(err)) end
        end
        return holder
    end
    VN.makeVisual = makeVisual
    local function refreshVisuals()
        local mm = mobsModule()
        if not (mm and mm.buildVisual) then return end
        for _, m in ipairs(mobList()) do
            if isVillagerLike(m) then
                local had = m.vn and m.vn.vis
                if (VN.enabled and not had) or (not VN.enabled and had) then
                    if had then m.vn.vis = nil end -- buildVisual detaches the hitbox before destroying the old renderer
                    pcall(mm.buildVisual, m)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Ticking -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local triggers -- vn_triggers: set by VN.install
    local heartbeat
    local acc = 0
    local function step(dt)
        acc = acc + dt
        while acc >= 0.05 do
            acc = acc - 0.05
            tickCount = tickCount + 1
            if tickCount % 3 == 0 then pcall(stepQueue) end
            if triggers and triggers.tick then
                local ok, err = pcall(triggers.tick, tickCount)
                if not ok and not VN.tickWarned then VN.tickWarned = true; warn("[Villager News] " .. tostring(err)) end
            end
        end
    end
    function VN.install(t) triggers = t end

    -- Turning it on and off -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    function VN.enable(onDone)
        if VN.enabled or VN.enabling then return end
        VN.enabling = true
        VN.generation=(VN.generation or 0)+1
        local generation=VN.generation
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok = ensurePack()
            ok = ok and loadData()
            if generation~=VN.generation then return end
            if ok then
                loadSettings()
                BR = createBedrock({Molang = Molang, data = data, folder = workspace, image = asset})
                VN.BR = BR
                if not DE then buildEngine() end
                if triggers and triggers.registerContent then pcall(triggers.registerContent) end
                VN.enabled = true
                local mm = mobsModule()
                if mm then mm.customVisual = makeVisual end
                refreshVisuals()
                if triggers and triggers.start then pcall(triggers.start) end
                if not heartbeat then heartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step) end
                SteveMods.changed(VN.id)
            end
            VN.enabling = false
            if onDone then onDone(ok) end
        end)
    end
    function VN.disable()
        VN.generation=(VN.generation or 0)+1
        VN.enabled = false
        VN.enabling = false
        SteveMods.changed(VN.id)
        if heartbeat then heartbeat:Disconnect(); heartbeat = nil end
        if triggers and triggers.stop then pcall(triggers.stop) end
        local mm = mobsModule()
        if mm and mm.customVisual == makeVisual then mm.customVisual = nil end
        if mm then
            for i=#mobList(),1,-1 do local m=mobList()[i];if m.modOwner==VN.id then mm.remove(m) end end
        end
        refreshVisuals()
        for m, s in pairs(voices) do pcall(function() s:Destroy() end); voices[m] = nil end
        queue = {}
    end
    VN.ensurePack, VN.asset, VN.mobList, VN.mobsModule, VN.world, VN.ctx = ensurePack, asset, mobList, mobsModule, world, ctx
    VN.isVillagerLike, VN.mobs = isVillagerLike, mobList
    return VN
end
