-- Villager News: the add-on's logic (port of scripts/oreville/ebi.js). Each block names the add-on's feature; dialogue
-- names are the add-on's own variables (VNID: vn_ids.lua), block lists come from vn_sets.lua.
-- Two things the shipped add-on's obfuscation broke are restored as intended: the weekday / holiday lines (their keys
-- were renamed, so they never matched) and the conversations that continue line by line between two villagers (their
-- "NN_MM" ids were renamed, so they always stopped after the first line).
local function createVillagerNewsTriggers(VN)
    local Tr = {}
    local T, I, S = VN.T, VNID, VNSETS
    local B = CONFIG.Block
    local say, queueSay, sayAge, sayNear, sayNearAge = VN.say, VN.queueSay, VN.sayAge, VN.sayNear, VN.sayNearAge
    local PLAYER = VN.PLAYER
    local FORCE = VN.FORCE
    local function rand(list) return list[math.random(#list)] end
    local function now() return VN.now() end
    local function isType(m, t) return VN.vnType(m) == t end
    local function adultVillager(m) return isType(m, T.villager) and not VN.isBaby(m) end
    local function villagers(p, r, f) return VN.villagersNear(p, r, f) end
    local function plainVillagers(p, r) return villagers(p, r, function(m) return isType(m, T.villager) end) end
    local function speaking(m) return VN.DE.isSpeaking(m) end
    local function moving(m, v) return VN.speedOf(m) > v end
    local function timeIn(t, a, b) if a <= b then return t >= a and t < b end return t >= a or t < b end
    local function playerLooksAt(m, maxDist, minDot)
        local w = VN.world()
        if not (w and w.eye) then return false end
        local eye, look = w.eye(), VN.lookDir()
        local to = (VN.posOf(m) + Vector3.new(0, 1 * B, 0)) - eye
        local d = to.Magnitude / B
        if d > (maxDist or 8) or d == 0 then return false end
        return look:Dot(to.Unit) >= (minDot or 0.97)
    end
    local function holdingTag(tag)
        local id = VN.heldItem()
        if not id then return false end
        if tag == "sword" then return id:match("_sword$") ~= nil end
        if tag == "axe" then return id:match("_axe$") ~= nil end
        if tag == "shovel" then return id:match("_shovel$") ~= nil end
        if tag == "hoe" then return id:match("_hoe$") ~= nil end
        return false
    end
    local function onLine(m, id) local d = VN.DE.speaking(m); return d and d.id == I[id] end

    -- Reputation (mktuau / gossip): per villager, per player; decays daily, shared with neighbours ------------------------
    local GOSSIP = {cured_major = {add = 20, decay = 0, share = 100, max = 20, weight = 5}, cured_minor = {add = 25, decay = 1, share = 5, max = 200, weight = 1},
        hurt_minor = {add = 20, decay = 20, share = 15, max = 200, weight = -1}, hurt_major = {add = 25, decay = 10, share = 10, max = 100, weight = -5},
        trading = {add = 15, decay = 2, share = 20, max = 25, weight = 1}}
    local REP_LEVELS = {loved = 100, liked = 50, neutral = 0, disliked = -150, hated = -300}
    local function rep(m) local s = VN.stateOf(m); s.rep = s.rep or {}; return s.rep end
    local function addRep(m, kind, amount)
        local r = rep(m)
        local g = GOSSIP[kind]
        r[kind] = math.min(g.max, (r[kind] or 0) + (amount or g.add))
    end
    local function repScore(m)
        local r, sum = rep(m), 0
        for k, g in pairs(GOSSIP) do sum = sum + (r[k] or 0) * g.weight end
        return sum
    end
    local function repLevel(m)
        local score, best, bestD = repScore(m), "neutral", 9999
        for name, v in pairs(REP_LEVELS) do local d = math.abs(score - v); if d < bestD then best, bestD = name, d end end
        return best
    end
    Tr.repLevel = repLevel

    -- Paired conversations (restored): when one line ends the partner says the next -----------------------------------------
    local CHAINS = {
        {I.ttrupp, I.ljgzjn, I.qszcdr, I.czskdz, I.mgoerv},             -- gossip (wrjbdd)
        {I.xfrvpl, I.lnypom, I.hnesls, I.sielzt, I.bhrjnb, I.wurdly, story = true}, -- campfire ghost story (wrswgi)
        {I.jmggiv, I.mmjdlb, I.rzcfxh}, {I.aauayl, I.crddtp, I.recauj}, {I.cqnvlx, I.odbtke, I.fnttnf, I.vtwzja}, {I.ikfzpg, I.hunbbc},
        {I.aoxcud, I.noamte}, {I.callrv}, {I.vzncrb, I.ruyoez, I.jxgpxu}, {I.ycjzxd, I.tfeswu}, {I.magguz, I.ceeogv, I.ppxuhn}, {I.umcxkl},
    }
    local chainOf = {}
    for _, c in ipairs(CHAINS) do for k, id in ipairs(c) do chainOf[id] = {chain = c, k = k} end end
    local function endPair(a, b)
        for _, m in ipairs({a, b}) do if m then local s = VN.stateOf(m); s.partner, s.inPair = nil, nil end end
    end
    local function startPair(a, b, firstId)
        local r = say(a, firstId, {target = b})
        if r and r.status == "played" then
            local sa, sb = VN.stateOf(a), VN.stateOf(b)
            sa.partner, sb.partner, sa.inPair, sb.inPair = b, a, true, true
            VN.setDyn(a, "pairTick", now()); VN.setDyn(b, "pairTick", now())
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    -- Dialogue hooks (Dialog.bhnotn) -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function installHooks()
        local DE = VN.DE
        -- request: the panicking villager only speaks when hurt by a player; silent chattiness; only the villager nearest the
        -- player inside 10 blocks speaks when another one within 5 of the player is talking (unless "more")
        DE.on("request", function(ev)
            local m = ev.request.entity
            if not VN.alive(m) then return end
            if VN.prop(m, "p:sbkmbc") == 1 and not VN.dyn(m, "hurtByPlayer") then ev.cancel(); return end
            if VN.settings.chattiness == "silent" then ev.cancel(); return end
            if ev.result.status ~= "ok" then return end
            local f = ev.request.flags
            if f and f.force then return end
            if VN.dist(PLAYER, m) >= 10 then return end
            if VN.settings.chattiness ~= "more" then
                for other in pairs(Tr.talking) do
                    if other ~= m and VN.alive(other) and speaking(other) and VN.dist(other, PLAYER) < 5 then ev.cancel(); return end
                end
            end
        end)
        -- play: never two "would anybody like to trade" at night; dead never speak
        DE.on("play", function(ev)
            local m = ev.entity
            if VN.settings.chattiness == "silent" then ev.cancel(); return end
            if ev.dialog.id == I.ygriye and (ev.variant == 1 and not (VN.dayTime() > 23000 or VN.dayTime() < 12500)) then ev.cancel(); return end
            if not VN.alive(m) then ev.cancel(); return end
            Tr.talking[m] = true
        end)
        -- subtitles only from the nearest speaker
        DE.on("subtitle", function(ev)
            local d = VN.dist(ev.entity, PLAYER)
            for other in pairs(Tr.talking) do
                if other ~= ev.entity and VN.alive(other) and speaking(other) and VN.dist(other, PLAYER) < d then ev.cancel(); return end
            end
        end)
        -- stop: conversations continue, the speaker stops looking at its target
        DE.on("stop", function(ev)
            local m = ev.entity
            Tr.talking[m] = nil
            if ev.reason ~= "finished" then return end
            if VN.alive(m) then VN.stateOf(m).lookAt = nil end
            local c = chainOf[ev.dialog.id]
            if c then
                local s = VN.stateOf(m)
                local partner = s.partner
                local nextId = c.chain[c.k + 1]
                if not nextId or not partner or not VN.alive(partner) or VN.dist(m, partner) > 2.5 then endPair(m, partner); return end
                local speaker, listener = partner, m
                -- the story: lines 2 and 4 are said by whoever just spoke
                if c.chain.story and (c.k + 1 == 2 or c.k + 1 == 4) then speaker, listener = m, partner end
                local r = say(speaker, nextId, {target = listener, flags = {ignoreEntity = true, ignoreGlobal = true}})
                if not r or r.status ~= "played" then endPair(m, partner) end
                return
            end
            if ev.dialog.id:sub(1, 6) == "slbqfw" then
                local s = VN.stateOf(m)
                local other = s.partner
                if other and VN.alive(other) and not speaking(other) then Tr.hurtLine(other, I.rvgzhy, {target = m}) end
                s.partner = nil
            end
            -- Wooly answers "That Sheep knows things." (its third variant)
            if ev.dialog.id == I.bmceek and ev.variant == 3 then
                local w = VN.mobsNear(m, 4, function(o) return isType(o, T.wooly) end)[1]
                if w then VN.sayWooly(w, I.mqlpnh, {target = m, flags = {ignoreGlobal = true, ignoreEntity = true, ignoreTags = true}, bypass = true}) end
            end
        end)
    end
    Tr.talking = {}

    -- Dates (the weekday / holiday lines, keys restored) ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    local WEEKDAY = {"Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"}
    local MONTH = {"Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "June", "July", "Aug", "Sept", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"}
    local WEEKDAY_LINES = {Sunday = I.tkuvtt, Monday = I.pqgbtu, Tuesday = I.msyjvd, Wednesday = I.xoojwu, Thursday = I.vqysch, Friday = I.vupzyf, Saturday = I.qhbxgu}
    local WEEKDAY_WANDER = {Sunday = I.cusiat, Monday = I.dcepse, Tuesday = I.wdqktg, Wednesday = I.xfbehu, Thursday = I.knhows, Friday = I.bxiigq, Saturday = I.slcpeg}
    local HOLIDAY = {["Jan 1"] = I.ncbelq, ["Feb 14"] = I.mgqfgb, ["May 17"] = I.qfnxjr, ["Oct 31"] = I.qsidhn, ["Dec 24"] = I.ffulgr, ["Dec 25"] = I.uteinj}
    local HOLIDAY_WANDER = {["Apr 1"] = I.zhjeam, ["Dec 31"] = I.uroybs}
    local function today()
        local d = os.date("!*t")
        return {weekday = WEEKDAY[d.wday], month = MONTH[d.month], day = d.day, minutes = d.min}
    end
    local function weekend(w) return w == "Sunday" or w == "Saturday" end
    local function dateLines() -- hknmjq
        local out, d = {}, today()
        out[#out + 1] = WEEKDAY_LINES[d.weekday]
        if weekend(d.weekday) then out[#out + 1] = I.wynuki end
        if d.minutes == 0 then out[#out + 1] = I.pupqvq end
        if d.weekday == "Friday" and d.day == 13 then out[#out + 1] = I.hxlcls end
        local h = HOLIDAY[d.month .. " " .. d.day]
        if h then out[#out + 1] = h end
        return out
    end
    local function wanderLines() -- siigqd
        local out, d = {}, today()
        out[#out + 1] = WEEKDAY_WANDER[d.weekday]
        if weekend(d.weekday) then out[#out + 1] = I.bxeirn end
        if d.month == "Oct" then out[#out + 1] = I.mysaje end
        if d.month == "Dec" then out[#out + 1] = I.bneskj end
        local h = HOLIDAY_WANDER[d.month .. " " .. d.day]
        if h then out[#out + 1] = h end
        return out
    end

    -- Things a villager notices about the player and the world --------------------------------------------------------------
    local function hurtLine(m, id, o) -- wlslxd
        if not VN.alive(m) then return end
        o = o or {}
        local opts = {target = o.target, states = {"adult", "urgent"}, flags = {force = true, ignoreTags = true, ignoreEntity = o.cooldowns == false, ignoreGlobal = o.cooldowns == false},
            bypass = true, when = o.when}
        if o.cooldowns ~= false then opts.flags.ignoreEntity, opts.flags.ignoreGlobal = true, true end
        if isType(m, T.wooly) then VN.sayWooly(m, id, opts)
        elseif isType(m, T.mayor) then VN.sayMayor(m, id, opts)
        else
            if VN.isBaby(m) then opts.states = {"baby", "urgent"} end
            queueSay(m, id, opts)
        end
    end
    Tr.hurtLine = hurtLine

    -- The periodic "say something" tick of every villager (BP controllers: vszwnq every 19-37 s, rfqiru 23-41 s) --------
    local function kidChatter(m) -- kdzisl: babies racing round by day
        local racing = false
        for _, o in ipairs(plainVillagers(m, 8)) do if VN.isBaby(o) and moving(o, 0.18 / 2) and VN.dayTime() < 11000 then racing = true end end
        local weekendLine = weekend(today().weekday) and I.uftkac or I.tdujsb
        queueSay(m, racing and I.xoyovb or weekendLine, {states = {"baby"}})
    end
    local function gossip(m) -- eyijiy: two adults standing together gossip; otherwise talk about the bell
        if VN.stateOf(m).inPair then return end
        local partner
        for _, o in ipairs(plainVillagers(m, 2.5)) do
            if o ~= m and not VN.isBaby(o) and not speaking(o) and not VN.stateOf(o).inPair then partner = o; break end
        end
        if partner then startPair(m, partner, rand({I.ttrupp, I.yetmul})); return end
        queueSay(m, rand({I.xufila}))
    end
    local function canGossip(m)
        local p = VN.profession(m)
        if not p or p == "nitwit" or VN.isBaby(m) then return false end
        return timeIn(VN.dayTime(), 8000, 10000) and not moving(m, 0.02)
    end
    local function nightLines(m) -- spmpvk
        local list = {}
        if VN.dyn(m, "slept") and now() - VN.dyn(m, "slept") >= 12000 then queueSay(m, I.ipvalv); return end
        list[#list + 1] = I.mqzcex
        queueSay(m, rand({I.ipvalv, I.mqzcex}))
    end
    local function nightMoving(m)
        local a, b = 12000, 24000
        if VN.profession(m) == "nitwit" then a, b = 14000, 2000 end
        return timeIn(VN.dayTime(), a, b) and moving(m, 0.15) and not m.sleeping
    end
    local function ambientLine(m) -- txggyx / qeodli
        local list = {}
        local hasNose = VN.prop(m, "p:gcfsvg") ~= 0
        local y = VN.posOf(m).Y / B
        if y > 190 then list[#list + 1] = I.rmyrtz elseif y < 60 and VN.prop(m, "p:bvkgap") == 1 then list[#list + 1] = I.eeuwhe end
        if not hasNose then list[#list + 1] = I.oifauy end
        local p = VN.profession(m)
        list[#list + 1] = p == "nitwit" and I.pstlby or (p == "unskilled" and I.qtukrr or I.ygriye)
        queueSay(m, rand(list), {flags = {ignoreGlobal = true}})
    end
    local NOSE_TALK = {both = {I.jmggiv, I.aauayl, I.cqnvlx, I.ikfzpg}, neither = {I.aoxcud, I.callrv, I.vzncrb}, one = {I.ycjzxd, I.magguz, I.umcxkl}}
    local function pairTalk(m) -- ocbshv: two adults chat (what they say depends on their noses), otherwise a line of their own
        local s = VN.stateOf(m)
        if s.inPair then return end
        local partner
        for _, o in ipairs(plainVillagers(m, 2.5)) do
            if o ~= m and not VN.isBaby(o) and not speaking(o) and not VN.stateOf(o).inPair then partner = o; break end
        end
        local last = VN.dyn(m, "pairTick") or -1e9
        if partner and now() - last >= 1400 then
            local a, b = VN.prop(m, "p:gcfsvg") ~= 0, VN.prop(partner, "p:gcfsvg") ~= 0
            local pool = {}
            if not a and not b then for _, x in ipairs(NOSE_TALK.neither) do pool[#pool + 1] = x end end
            if a ~= b then for _, x in ipairs(NOSE_TALK.one) do pool[#pool + 1] = x end end
            if a and b then for _, x in ipairs(NOSE_TALK.both) do pool[#pool + 1] = x end end
            if #pool > 0 and startPair(m, partner, rand(pool)) then return end
        end
        ambientLine(m)
    end
    local function chatPairTime(m)
        local p = VN.profession(m)
        if not p or VN.isBaby(m) then return false end
        local t = VN.dayTime()
        if p == "unskilled" then return timeIn(t, 0, 8000) or timeIn(t, 10000, 11000) end
        if p == "nitwit" then return timeIn(t, 2000, 12000) end
        return timeIn(t, 0, 8000) or timeIn(t, 10000, 12000)
    end
    local WORKSTATION = {armorer = "blast_furnace", butcher = "smoker", cartographer = "cartography_table", cleric = "brewing_stand", farmer = "composter",
        fisherman = "barrel", fletcher = "fletching_table", librarian = "lectern", leatherworker = "cauldron", stone_mason = "stonecutter", shepherd = "loom",
        toolsmith = "smithing_table", weaponsmith = "grindstone"}
    local function nearBlock(m, id, r)
        local p = VN.posOf(m)
        for dx = -r, r do for dz = -r, r do for dy = -1, 1 do
            if VN.blockAt(p + Vector3.new(dx, dy + 0.5, dz) * B) == id then return true end
        end end end
        return false
    end
    local function workLine(m) -- zmcfbf / ricihi
        local p = VN.profession(m)
        if not p then return end
        if p == "librarian" and not moving(m, 0.02) then
            local ahead = VN.posOf(m) + Vector3.new(-math.sin(m.yaw or 0), 1, -math.cos(m.yaw or 0)) * B
            if VN.blockAt(ahead) == "bookshelf" then queueSay(m, I.wjetfq); return end
        elseif p == "farmer" then
            local below = VN.blockAt(VN.posOf(m) - Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * B, 0))
            if below == "farmland" then queueSay(m, I.mqdxjn); return end
        end
        local station = WORKSTATION[p]
        if station and not moving(m, 0.02) and nearBlock(m, station, 1) then
            queueSay(m, math.random() < 0.3 and I.jvqbuz or (S.ugrwyf[p] or I.jvqbuz))
            VN.setDyn(m, "worked", now())
        elseif now() - (VN.dyn(m, "worked") or -1e9) > 12000 and now() - (VN.dyn(m, "jobless") or -1e9) > 2400 then
            VN.setDyn(m, "jobless", now())
            queueSay(m, I.frzlte)
        end
    end
    local function workTime(m)
        local p = VN.profession(m)
        if not p or p == "nitwit" or p == "unskilled" or VN.isBaby(m) then return false end
        local t = VN.dayTime()
        return timeIn(t, 0, 8000) or timeIn(t, 10000, 11000)
    end
    local CELEBRITY = {[T.mayor] = I.wawcjs, [T.testificate] = I.dbjybq, [T.five] = I.nidkix, [T.nine] = I.nidkix}
    local function chatTick(m)
        local t = VN.vnType(m)
        if t == T.trader then return Tr.traderTick(m) end
        if t == T.villager then
            if VN.isBaby(m) and moving(m, 0.09) and VN.dayTime() < 11000 then kidChatter(m) end
            if canGossip(m) then gossip(m) end
            if nightMoving(m) then nightLines(m) end
            local orbs = 0
            pcall(function() for _ in pairs(VN.world().xpOrbsNear and VN.world().xpOrbsNear(VN.posOf(m), 12 * B) or {}) do orbs = orbs + 1 end end)
            if orbs >= 4 then queueSay(m, I.zdmddh, {target = VN.posOf(m)}) end
            if chatPairTime(m) then if math.random() > 0.8 then local l = wanderLines(); if #l > 0 then queueSay(m, rand(l), {flags = {ignoreGlobal = true}}) end else pairTalk(m) end end
            if workTime(m) then workLine(m) end
        else
            local line = CELEBRITY[t]
            if t == T.nine and math.random() > 0.5 then line = I.pdncci end
            if line then
                local opts = {flags = {ignoreGlobal = true}}
                if t == T.mayor then VN.sayMayor(m, line, opts) else queueSay(m, line, opts) end
            end
        end
    end
    function Tr.traderTick(m) -- odzhpm
        local facing
        if VN.dist(PLAYER, m) <= 16 then
            local look = Vector3.new(-math.sin(m.yaw or 0), 0, -math.cos(m.yaw or 0))
            local to = VN.posOf(PLAYER) - VN.posOf(m)
            if to.Magnitude > 0 and look:Dot(Vector3.new(to.X, 0, to.Z).Unit) >= math.cos(math.rad(60)) then facing = PLAYER end
        end
        local list = {}
        if facing then list[#list + 1] = I.eqpyyx end
        local id = #list > 0 and rand(list) or I.oipgau
        local r = say(m, id, {keys = {wandering_trader = true}})
        if r and r.status == "played" and facing then VN.stateOf(m).lookAt = facing end
    end

    -- What a villager says about whoever it sees (lwnzmp, every 60 ticks) ---------------------------------------------------
    local MOB_LINES = {
        allay = {I.tapdxs}, armor_stand = {I.dvmcxu}, bat = {I.qntcft}, bogged = {I.drulun}, camel = {I.rqokdt}, cat = {I.zkkwju, I.wjeaup},
        cave_spider = {I.piczhy}, cod = {I.eyarrt}, chicken = {I.qahcew, I.vfdjqj}, copper_golem = {I.pmplch}, cow = {I.lvnlty, I.wdkqko},
        creaking = {I.zhzwtl}, creeper = {I.eteftj}, dolphin = {I.nriyde}, drowned = {I.yrhbyu, I.fdxfey}, ender_dragon = {I.neazrx},
        enderman = {I.razyoq}, frog = {I.eiqzgm}, happy_ghast = {I.ryonox}, horse = {I.ndfwwy, I.rnuiqp}, husk = {I.ydhzmo, I.mqjyaf},
        iron_golem = {I.ssyrav, nil, baby = I.mmbfvm}, llama = {I.sovdzq}, panda = {I.jlwncb, I.aczrkv}, parrot = {I.teygrz}, phantom = {I.rqioif},
        pig = {I.nkfszs, I.ezafzs}, polar_bear = {I.nhilhb}, pufferfish = {I.eyarrt}, rabbit = {I.aylckp}, salmon = {I.eyarrt}, skeleton = {I.gexcma},
        slime = {I.fniger}, sniffer = {I.dgxfad}, snow_golem = {I.sfrplb}, spider = {I.piczhy}, stray = {I.veejpb}, sulfur_cube = {I.wafqfw},
        trader_llama = {I.sovdzq}, tropical_fish = {I.eyarrt}, turtle = {I.gpvjte}, warden = {I.tpwbik}, witch = {I.gprihi}, wither = {I.ncypsc},
        zombified_piglin = {I.zdaqll, I.gudnst}, zombie_villager = {I.bypbex, I.cnztij},
    }
    local SPECIAL_SEEN = {[T.testificate] = {I.nywkyd}, [T.mayor] = {nil, I.xrizld}, [T.five] = {I.behbyn}, [T.nine] = {I.vakimk}}
    local REP_LINES = {loved = {I.hfdifp, I.rxveoc}, liked = {I.wtvnoa, I.rxveoc}, neutral = {I.mgdkhs, I.rxveoc},
        disliked = {I.gwpvoi, I.rqpebk}, hated = {I.inzdvy, I.rqpebk}}
    local function greeting() -- wbnztg
        local t = VN.dayTime()
        if t < 6000 then return {I.doqlbg} elseif t < 12000 then return {I.uossjo} elseif t < 13000 then return {I.kpwnom} end
        return {I.fwmmpo}
    end
    local function linesForPlayer(m) -- evfstu
        if VN.spectator() then return nil end
        if not playerLooksAt(m, 8, 0.97) then return nil end
        local t = VN.vnType(m)
        if t == T.mayor then
            local hat = Tr.playerHat and Tr.playerHat()
            return {nil, hat == "cryhjc" and I.tvlnxx or I.xbvywt}
        elseif t == T.wooly then return {I.ptyvtn}
        elseif t == T.testificate then return {(Tr.playerHat and Tr.playerHat() == "ufernq") and I.tbdwse or I.peeajj}
        elseif t == T.five then return {(Tr.playerHat and Tr.playerHat() == "odplew") and I.ngfhdb or I.ubydqu}
        elseif t == T.nine then return {I.oswlxc}
        end
        local pool = {}
        local level = repLevel(m)
        if level ~= "hated" then pool[#pool + 1] = REP_LINES[level]
        elseif holdingTag("sword") then pool[#pool + 1] = {I.ntbcoy, I.rqpebk}
        else pool[#pool + 1] = REP_LINES.hated end
        for _, id in ipairs(dateLines()) do pool[#pool + 1] = {id, I.rxveoc} end
        pool[#pool + 1] = greeting()
        return pool[math.random(#pool)]
    end
    local function linesForMob(m, o) -- zacvmf
        local id = o.id
        local baby = o.baby == true
        if VN.vnType(o) then
            local seen = SPECIAL_SEEN[VN.vnType(o)]
            if seen then return seen end
            if isType(o, T.villager) and isType(m, T.testificate) then return nil end
            local hat = VN.prop(o, "p:mlxeez")
            if isType(o, T.villager) and hat and hat ~= "none" and hat ~= 0 then
                if isType(m, T.testificate) and hat == "ufernq" then return {I.oqkfej} end
                return {I.nkkrdb}
            end
            return nil
        end
        if id == "bee" then return {o.angry and I.ltmpey or (baby and I.gmtvdm or I.mlkzxm)} end
        if id == "wolf" then return {o.tamed and (baby and I.ekkbfp or I.ajeiwo) or (baby and I.eotpwg or I.tkpsmd)} end
        if id == "sheep" or isType(o, T.wooly) then return {o.sheared and I.wlacvx or (baby and I.vcjhxo or I.bmceek)} end
        if id == "zombie" then return {baby and I.bsvrsa or I.fnevhp} end
        local list = MOB_LINES[id]
        if list then
            if baby and list[2] then return {list[2]} end
            if list.baby then return {list[1], list.baby} end
            return {list[1]}
        end
        if baby then return {I.qegrca} end
        return nil
    end
    local seenAt = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local function reactTo(m, o, pair)
        if not pair then return false end
        local adultId, babyId = pair[1], pair[2]
        if VN.vnType(m) == T.mayor then
            if babyId then VN.sayMayor(m, babyId, {target = o}); return true end
            return false
        end
        if VN.vnType(m) == T.wooly then if adultId then VN.sayWooly(m, adultId, {target = o}); return true end return false end
        if pair.baby and VN.isBaby(m) then return queueSay(m, pair.baby, {target = o, states = {"baby"}}).queued end
        if adultId and babyId then return sayAge(m, adultId, babyId, {target = o, timeout = 80}).queued end
        local baby = VN.isBaby(m)
        local id = baby and babyId or adultId
        if not id then return false end
        return queueSay(m, id, {target = o, states = {baby and "baby" or "adult"}, timeout = 80}).queued
    end
    local function lookAround(m)
        if VN.vnType(m) == T.trader then return end
        if speaking(m) then return end
        local crowd = #villagers(m, 5)
        if crowd >= 32 then say(m, I.zsixrk); return end
        local seen = seenAt[m]
        if not seen then seen = {}; seenAt[m] = seen end
        local t = now()
        -- the player
        if VN.dist(PLAYER, m) <= 5 and (not seen.player or t - seen.player >= 6000) then
            local pair = linesForPlayer(m)
            if pair and reactTo(m, PLAYER, pair) then seen.player = t; return end
        end
        -- mobs (monsters further away)
        local hostile = VN.mobsModule() and VN.mobsModule().hostile or {}
        for _, o in ipairs(VN.mobsNear(m, 12, function(o) return o ~= m end)) do
            local d = VN.dist(m, o)
            if d <= (hostile[o.id] and 12 or 5) then
                local key = o
                local gap = o.id == "ender_dragon" and 600 or 6000
                if not seen[key] or t - seen[key] >= gap then
                    if not (isType(m, T.wooly) and o.id ~= "player") then
                        local pair = linesForMob(m, o)
                        if pair and reactTo(m, o, pair) then seen[key] = t; return end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Hurt (cmrjqq / tysiya / uxofrn) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local SPECIAL_HURT = {[T.mayor] = {I.gtdspf, I.wyiyjn}, [T.trader] = {nil, I.jgylar}, [T.testificate] = {I.gwqhla, I.gwqhla},
        [T.five] = {I.kwckbt, I.kwckbt}, [T.nine] = {I.nmnuwt, I.pqxbqj}, [T.wooly] = {I.lfmsol, I.bozlyt}}
    local MOB_ATTACK = {zoglin = I.itfzqc, vindicator = I.fyfhvf, evoker = I.aarhqv, ravager = I.phrblc, vex = I.slrknj, zombie = I.hbbpjd,
        husk = I.hbbpjd, drowned = I.hbbpjd, pillager = I.jptvwa}
    local function weaponLine()
        if holdingTag("sword") then return I.zwvozr end
        if holdingTag("axe") then return I.egoztp end
        if holdingTag("shovel") then return I.difmpn end
        if holdingTag("hoe") then return I.wbdolc end
        return I.jgylar
    end
    local function underRoof(m)
        local p = VN.posOf(m)
        for dy = 2, 8 do
            local id = VN.blockAt(p + Vector3.new(0, dy - 0.5, 0) * B)
            if id and S.tiqpey[id] then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function onVillagerHurt(m, byPlayer, attacker)
        local s = VN.stateOf(m)
        s.hurtTick = now()
        VN.setDyn(m, "hurtByPlayer", byPlayer)
        -- the voice cries out (vhbfyc) unless the line it is saying is meant to carry on
        local cur = VN.DE.speaking(m)
        if cur then VN.DE.stop(m) end
        -- "is it safe now?" 200 ticks after the last hit (villagers)
        s.safeAt = now() + 200
        local t = VN.vnType(m)
        if t ~= T.villager then
            local lines = SPECIAL_HURT[t]
            if lines then
                if byPlayer and lines[2] then hurtLine(m, lines[2], {target = PLAYER}) elseif lines[1] then hurtLine(m, lines[1]) end
            end
            return
        end
        if byPlayer then
            if VN.isBaby(m) then
                queueSay(m, I.kfycqp, {target = PLAYER, states = {"baby", "urgent"}, flags = FORCE, bypass = true})
            end
            addRep(m, "hurt_minor")
            -- in its own home, with a family member near: the family protests
            if underRoof(m) then
                local other
                for _, o in ipairs(plainVillagers(m, 4)) do if o ~= m and underRoof(o) then other = o end end
                if other then hurtLine(m, I.uyueim, {target = PLAYER}); VN.stateOf(m).partner = other
                else hurtLine(m, I.lotwee, {target = PLAYER}) end
            else
                hurtLine(m, weaponLine(), {target = PLAYER})
            end
        elseif attacker and MOB_ATTACK[attacker.id] then
            hurtLine(m, MOB_ATTACK[attacker.id], {when = function() return not VN.alive(attacker) or VN.dist(m, attacker) > 10 end})
        elseif attacker and attacker.id == "witch" then
            hurtLine(m, I.dzqmhb, {target = attacker})
        else
            -- the world hurt it: fire, lava, a fall, the cold...
            local c = s.lastCause
            local CAUSE = {fall = {I.nddhqm, true}, fire = {I.jusosh}, lava = {I.crnydh}, freezing = {I.jkskqg}, contact = {I.yndeyi}, anvil = {I.iemscl, true},
                stalactite = {I.qchtxy, true}, suffocation = {I.gcuhbd}, explosion = {I.lkjzxy}}
            local e = c and CAUSE[c]
            if e then hurtLine(m, e[1], {cooldowns = not e[2] and nil or false}) end
        end
    end
    Tr.onVillagerHurt = onVillagerHurt

    -- Interacting with a villager (pre-trade) --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local HATS = {mayor_hat = "cryhjc", testificate_man_helmet = "ufernq", microphone = "dsojot", moustache = "odplew"}
    local HAT_ITEM = {cryhjc = "mayor_hat", ufernq = "testificate_man_helmet", dsojot = "microphone", odplew = "moustache"}
    Tr.HATS, Tr.HAT_ITEM = HATS, HAT_ITEM
    local HAT_COMMENT = {ufernq = I.yxnhca, dsojot = I.tlihhr, odplew = I.fzyigl}
    local HAT_BABY = {cryhjc = I.egqivb, ufernq = I.fsepbc, dsojot = I.wylybx, odplew = I.okjbgd}
    local NAMED = {Dinnerbone = {I.gfwfal, I.kyfyme}, Grumm = {I.gfwfal, I.kyfyme}, lorsgs = {I.plbcqt, I.kyfyme}, dragon = {I.mzmwtx, I.qwrhov}, Dragon = {I.mzmwtx, I.qwrhov}}
    local function dropItem(id, m)
        local e = JavaContent.itemById[id]
        local w = VN.world()
        if e and w and w.drop then pcall(w.drop, {id = e.index, count = 1}, VN.headOf(m), Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * B, 0), true) end
    end
    local function useHeld(count)
        if not CONFIG.Survival then return end
        local _, s = VN.heldItem()
        if s then s.count = s.count - (count or 1); if s.count <= 0 then local w = VN.world(); if w and w.mainStack == s then pcall(function() w.clearMainStack() end) end end end
    end
    local function forceLine(m, id, states)
        return queueSay(m, id, {target = PLAYER, states = states or {"adult"}, flags = FORCE, bypass = true})
    end
    function Tr.preInteract(m, stack, name)
        if not VN.enabled or not VN.vnType(m) then return nil end
        if m.sleeping then return nil end
        local t = VN.vnType(m)
        local baby = VN.isBaby(m)
        name = name or ""
        -- noses (bahthp / scefwy): shears take the nose, the nose item gives it back
        if name == "shears" and (t == T.villager or t == T.testificate or t == T.five or t == T.nine or t == T.trader or t == T.untouchable) then
            local hat = VN.prop(m, "p:mlxeez")
            if t == T.villager and hat and hat ~= "none" and hat ~= 0 then
                dropItem(HAT_ITEM[hat], m); VN.setProp(m, "p:mlxeez", "none")
                forceLine(m, I.bbkhrp)
            elseif VN.prop(m, "p:gcfsvg") ~= 0 and not baby then
                dropItem("villager_nose", m); VN.setProp(m, "p:gcfsvg", false)
                if MinecraftSounds then pcall(MinecraftSounds.play, "entity.sheep.shear", VN.headOf(m), 1, 1) end
                forceLine(m, I.pkrkml)
            end
            return true
        end
        if name == "villager_nose" then
            if baby then return true end
            if VN.prop(m, "p:gcfsvg") == 0 then useHeld(); VN.setProp(m, "p:gcfsvg", true); forceLine(m, I.ueviuf)
            elseif not onLine(m, "kmkrwf") then forceLine(m, I.kmkrwf) end
            return true
        end
        if HATS[name] and t == T.villager then
            local hat = HATS[name]
            local cur = VN.prop(m, "p:mlxeez")
            if cur and cur ~= "none" and cur ~= 0 then return true end
            useHeld(); VN.setProp(m, "p:mlxeez", hat)
            local adultPool = {}
            if hat ~= "dsojot" then adultPool[#adultPool + 1] = I.ellido end
            if HAT_COMMENT[hat] then adultPool[#adultPool + 1] = HAT_COMMENT[hat]; adultPool[#adultPool + 1] = HAT_COMMENT[hat] end
            if baby then forceLine(m, HAT_BABY[hat], {"baby"}) else forceLine(m, rand(adultPool)) end
            return true
        end
        if name == "name_tag" and stack and stack.customName and t == T.villager then
            local pair = NAMED[stack.customName] or {I.mzmwtx, I.kyfyme}
            task.defer(function() sayAge(m, pair[1], pair[2], {target = PLAYER}) end)
            return nil
        end
        if name == "lead" then queueSay(m, I.viermm, {target = PLAYER}); return nil end
        -- trading (nitwits and the jobless refuse; babies call their dad)
        if baby and t == T.villager and name ~= "villager_spawn_egg" then queueSay(m, I.ttcowf, {target = PLAYER, states = {"baby"}}); return nil end
        local p = VN.profession(m)
        if t == T.villager and (p == "nitwit" or p == "unskilled") then
            local pool = {I.xqziim}
            if p == "nitwit" then pool[#pool + 1] = I.wgtrhx end
            if p == "unskilled" then pool[#pool + 1] = I.quixba end
            queueSay(m, rand(pool), {target = PLAYER})
        end
        return nil
    end

    -- Trading (jchdev): hello, a trade, goodbye ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local TRADE_LINES = {
        [T.villager] = {bye = I.wbfihy, done = I.qcpcff, none = I.hkyjxu, pick = I.awubwu},
        [T.mayor] = {hello = I.hnvutr, done = I.lawvmj, none = I.ispono},
        [T.testificate] = {hello = I.uxsugf, bye = I.gbcxhl, done = I.unhvfb, none = I.vpstmi, pick = I.awubwu},
        [T.five] = {hello = I.krrsws, bye = I.wxpxfl, done = I.hbmvaz, none = I.hkyjxu, pick = I.awubwu},
        [T.nine] = {hello = I.hnembx, bye = I.azczlr, done = I.qcpcff, none = I.hkyjxu, pick = I.awubwu},
        [T.trader] = {hello = I.risoiq, bye = I.wbfihy, done = I.ybdmjv, none = I.kpdqcj, pick = I.awubwu},
    }
    local REP_HELLO = {loved = I.cykjbk, liked = I.vjhigs, neutral = I.itujcr, disliked = I.idhzvj, hated = I.jnzwcu}
    local function tradeLine(m, id)
        if not id then return false end
        local cur = VN.DE.speaking(m)
        if cur and Tr.tradeLineIds[cur.id] then return false end
        local opts = {target = PLAYER, flags = FORCE, bypass = true}
        if isType(m, T.mayor) then return VN.sayMayor(m, id, opts).queued end
        return queueSay(m, id, opts).queued
    end
    Tr.tradeLineIds = {}
    for _, set in pairs(TRADE_LINES) do for _, id in pairs(set) do Tr.tradeLineIds[id] = true end end
    for _, id in pairs(REP_HELLO) do Tr.tradeLineIds[id] = true end
    Tr.tradeLineIds[I.ansymf], Tr.tradeLineIds[I.gfycdw] = true, true
    local trading = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local function offersUsed(m)
        local n = 0
        for _, o in ipairs(m.offers or {}) do n = n + (o.uses or 0) end
        return n
    end
    local function tradeWatch(m)
        local tr = trading[m]
        if m.trading and not tr then
            trading[m] = {uses = offersUsed(m), traded = false, level = m.tradeLevel}
            local set = TRADE_LINES[VN.vnType(m)]
            if VN.vnType(m) == T.mayor then tradeLine(m, set.hello)
            else
                local hello = REP_HELLO[repLevel(m)]
                tradeLine(m, set and set.hello and math.random() < 0.5 and set.hello or hello)
            end
        elseif m.trading and tr then
            local used = offersUsed(m)
            if used > tr.uses then
                tr.uses, tr.traded = used, true
                addRep(m, "trading")
                local set = TRADE_LINES[VN.vnType(m)]
                if set and set.pick then local cur = VN.DE.speaking(m); if not (cur and (cur.id == I.ansymf or cur.id == I.gfycdw)) then tradeLine(m, set.pick) end end
            end
            if m.tradeLevel and tr.level and m.tradeLevel > tr.level then
                -- guftpz: more trades unlocked (master level: the know-it-all line)
                local lines = {I.ansymf}
                if m.tradeLevel >= 5 then table.insert(lines, 1, I.gfycdw) end
                for _, id in ipairs(lines) do if say(m, id, {target = PLAYER, flags = FORCE}) then break end end
                tr.level = m.tradeLevel
            end
        elseif not m.trading and tr then
            trading[m] = nil
            local set = TRADE_LINES[VN.vnType(m)] or {}
            if tr.traded then if not tradeLine(m, set.done) then tradeLine(m, set.bye) end
            elseif not tradeLine(m, set.none) then tradeLine(m, set.bye) end
        end
    end

    -- The world around the player (every second, near the player): water, magma, ice, snow, fire, campfires, TNT, beds ----
    local function envChecks(m, phase)
        if not VN.alive(m) or not isType(m, T.villager) then return end
        local p = VN.posOf(m)
        local at = VN.blockAt(p + Vector3.new(0, 0.3 * B, 0))
        local below = VN.blockAt(p - Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * B, 0))
        if at == "water" and VN.blockAt(p + Vector3.new(0, 1.3 * B, 0)) == nil and below ~= nil and below ~= "water" then queueSay(m, I.ppnlxa); return end
        if m.onGround then
            if below == "magma_block" then queueSay(m, I.pigifn, {states = {"adult", "urgent"}, timeout = 100, when = function() return VN.blockAt(VN.posOf(m) - Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * B, 0)) == "magma_block" end}); return end
            if below and S.ICE[below] then queueSay(m, I.wtifxy); return end
            if at == "snow" or below == "snow_block" or below == "snow" then queueSay(m, I.pmbnnb); return end
        end
        local r = ({[1] = {3, 4}, [2] = {5, 3}, [3] = {7, 2}})[phase]
        if not r then return end
        local found = {}
        local w = VN.world and VN.world()
        local nowc = os.clock()
        if not VN.hotBlocks or nowc - (VN.hotBlocksAt or 0) > 0.5 then
            -- the placed fire / campfire / TNT blocks (listed once, shared by every villager this round)
            local list = {}
            for _, n in pairs(w and w.nodes or {}) do
                local id = n.id
                if id == "fire" or id == "soul_fire" or id == "campfire" or id == "soul_campfire" or id == "tnt" then list[#list + 1] = n end
            end
            VN.hotBlocks, VN.hotBlocksAt = list, nowc
        end
        if #VN.hotBlocks > 0 then
            local feet = w and w.cell and w.cell(p + Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * B, 0)) or (p + Vector3.new(0, 0.5 * B, 0))
            for _, n in ipairs(VN.hotBlocks) do
                local d = (n.center - feet) / B
                local kx, ky, kz = math.floor(d.X + 0.5), math.floor(d.Y + 0.5), math.floor(d.Z + 0.5)
                if math.abs(kx) <= r[1] and math.abs(kz) <= r[1] and math.abs(ky) <= r[2] then
                    local id = n.id
                    if id == "fire" or id == "soul_fire" then found.fire = true end
                    if (id == "campfire" or id == "soul_campfire") and not found.campfire then found.campfire = n.center end
                    if id == "tnt" and not found.tnt then found.tnt = n.center end
                end
            end
        end
        if found.fire then queueSay(m, I.imsmdz) end
        if found.campfire then
            local others = VN.villagersNear(found.campfire, 6, function(o) return o ~= m and isType(o, T.villager) end)
            local last = VN.dyn(m, "pairTick") or -1e9
            if #others > 0 and now() - last >= 14000 and not VN.stateOf(others[1]).inPair then startPair(m, others[1], I.xfrvpl)
            else queueSay(m, I.wietmj, {target = found.campfire}) end
        end
        if found.tnt then queueSay(m, I.mnlnkp, {target = found.tnt}) end
    end

    -- Events from the Steve script (SteveEventListeners) --------------------------------------------------------------------
    local PLACE_RULES = { -- vmceeh: first that matches
        function(id) return S.uznqvb[id] and I.hmhkin end, function(id) return id:match("_button$") and I.lltpxj end,
        function(id) return S.mmbxmm[id] and I.gukynu end, function(id) return S.WOOL[id] and I.dvvgwo end,
        function(id) return S.pmdglp[id] and I.myhxfp end, function(id) return S.ICE[id] and I.ubcuql end,
        function(id) return S.PURPUR[id] and I.pynjjx end, function(id) return S.dhpknp[id] and I.vdvezc end,
        function(id) return S.mrehgv[id] and I.vqexcy end, function(id) return S.GLASS[id] and I.npzhed end,
        function(id) return S.CONCRETE[id] and I.byyfte end, function(id) return S.CONCRETE_POWDER[id] and I.ynbkzg end,
        function(id) return (id == "dirt" or id == "grass_block" or id == "coarse_dirt" or id == "rooted_dirt" or id == "podzol" or id == "mud") and I.ovhmpi end,
        function(id) return S.yjgbhn[id] and I.nemjuc end, function(id) return id == "iron_block" and I.vkdnip end,
        function(id) return S.bfdxmk[id] and I.filawm end, function(id) return S.lxqucu[id] and I.scrprj end,
        function(id) return S.exyicm[id] and I.xpotlw end, function(id) return (id:match("_planks$") or id:match("_log$") or id:match("_wood$")) and I.uxigeb end,
        function(id) return S.jjzkdv[id] and I.ysqrrg end, function(id) return S.kvuwyi[id] and I.sdxyuz end,
        function(id) return S.ovfbhp[id] and I.mwvecp end, function(id) return S.ktcssk[id] and I.uglnpq end,
        function(id) return S.pbldxj[id] and I.wgyrqk end, function() return I.ahnfys end,
    }
    local function golemShape(p) -- ezhbzs: an iron golem's T of iron blocks around the placed block
        local function iron(q) return VN.blockAt(q) == "iron_block" end
        local function row(c, axis)
            local d = axis == "x" and Vector3.new(B, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 0, B)
            return iron(c) and iron(c - d) and iron(c + d) and iron(c - Vector3.new(0, B, 0))
        end
        for _, axis in ipairs({"x", "z"}) do
            local d = axis == "x" and Vector3.new(B, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 0, B)
            for k = -1, 1 do if row(p + d * k, axis) then return true end end
            if row(p + Vector3.new(0, B, 0), axis) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local breakStreak = {tick = -100, n = 0}
    local function onPlace(data)
        local id = data.id or ""
        local list = {}
        if S.ptlgsd[id] then list[#list + 1] = S.ptlgsd[id] end
        if id == "iron_block" and data.position and golemShape(data.position) then list[#list + 1] = I.byrgzp end
        for _, rule in ipairs(PLACE_RULES) do local d = rule(id); if d then list[#list + 1] = d end end
        for _, d in ipairs(list) do
            local h = sayNear(PLAYER, d, {target = PLAYER})
            if h and h.queued then return end
        end
    end
    local function onBreak(data)
        local id = data.id or ""
        local t = now()
        if t - breakStreak.tick < 40 then breakStreak.n = breakStreak.n + 1 else breakStreak.n = 0 end
        breakStreak.tick = t
        local crops = {wheat = true, carrots = true, potatoes = true, beetroots = true, torchflower_crop = true, pitcher_crop = true, melon_stem = true, pumpkin_stem = true}
        if crops[id] then
            for _, m in ipairs(plainVillagers(PLAYER, 12)) do if VN.profession(m) == "farmer" then queueSay(m, I.tdqero, {target = PLAYER}) end end
        end
        -- tdyfnk
        local wood = id:match("_log$") or id:match("_planks$") or id:match("_wood$") or id:match("_stem$") or id:match("_hyphae$")
        local stone = id == "stone" or id == "cobblestone" or id:match("stone") or id:match("deepslate") or id == "andesite" or id == "diorite" or id == "granite" or id == "tuff"
        local line
        if breakStreak.n > 3 then line = I.iznsty
        elseif id == "bell" then line = I.tkmaou
        elseif id:match("_bed$") then line = I.mbshnf
        elseif S.tygfjk[id] then line = I.hbhqfe
        elseif S.qysnhe[id] then line = I.vqolrf
        elseif wood then line = I.smjzof
        elseif crops[id] then line = I.dvzbnd
        elseif stone then line = I.zcqyrl
        elseif S.zjguht[id] or id:match("_banner$") then line = I.ylvteh
        else line = I.qtmvgc end
        if line then sayNear(PLAYER, line, {target = PLAYER}) end
    end
    local listeners = {}
    local function listen(name, fn)
        local all = rawget(_G, "SteveEventListeners")
        if type(all) ~= "table" then all = {}; rawset(_G, "SteveEventListeners", all) end
        local prev = all[name]
        local mine = function(kind, data)
            if prev then pcall(prev, kind, data) end
            if VN.enabled then local ok, err = pcall(fn, data); if not ok then warn("[Villager News] " .. tostring(err)) end end
        end
        all[name] = mine
        listeners[#listeners + 1] = {name = name, prev = prev, mine = mine}
    end

    -- Using blocks (ptsnla): cauldrons, composters, campfires, candles, doors, jukeboxes, chests, workstations... -------------
    local function onUseBlock(id, held)
        local line
        if id == "bell" then
            Tr.bellRung = now()
            for _, m in ipairs(villagers(PLAYER, 50, function(o) return not o.sleeping end)) do
                local cur = VN.DE.speaking(m)
                if not cur or (cur.id ~= "kljgyu" and cur.id ~= "nxalcz") then
                    local at = now() + math.random(0, 4)
                    sayAge(m, I.hemzsp, I.cddtmk, {target = PLAYER, flags = FORCE, bypass = true, when = function() return now() >= at end, timeout = 14})
                end
            end
            return
        end
        if id == "cauldron" or id == "water_cauldron" or id == "lava_cauldron" then line = I.cbpsmo
        elseif id == "composter" then if held and S.thtsof[held] then line = I.mynnqj end
        elseif S.kbdkpy[id] then
            if held and S.gkzwei[held] then line = I.qhvdes elseif held == "flint_and_steel" or held == "fire_charge" then line = I.lmxxlo
            elseif held and (held:match("_shovel$") or held == "water_bucket") then line = I.ciauun end
        elseif S.qoqeys[id] or (id:match("_candle$")) then
            if held == "flint_and_steel" or held == "fire_charge" then line = I.svielq end
        elseif S.hvbgow[id] then line = I.xoelbu
        elseif id == "carved_pumpkin" and held == "shears" then line = I.amhagx
        elseif id == "jukebox" and held and held:match("^music_disc") then line = I.dialog_jukebox
        elseif S.yvdokj[id] or id:match("_fence_gate$") then line = I.wpafie
        elseif S.iiofgc[id] or (id:match("_door$") and id ~= "iron_door") then line = I.jiyalb
        elseif S.wskqaq[id] then line = S.wskqaq[id]
        elseif id:match("shulker_box$") then line = I.hnovmi
        elseif id == "chest" then
            local m = plainVillagers(PLAYER, 16)[1]
            if m then
                if underRoof(m) and queueSay(m, I.nczgqn, {target = PLAYER}).queued then return end
                queueSay(m, I.dialog_chest, {target = PLAYER})
            end
            return
        elseif id == "lever" then line = I.zhniaw
        elseif id:match("_button$") then line = I.eredzt
        end
        if S.koflio[id] then sayNear(VN.posOf(PLAYER), I.qwrsdw, {radius = 2}) end
        if line then sayNear(PLAYER, line, {target = PLAYER}) end
    end

    -- Player watching (picture, statue, flying, durability, effects, game mode, death, nose disguise) -------------------------
    local watch = {picture = nil, still = {pos = nil, since = 0}, mode = nil, health = nil, deathAt = nil, nose = false}
    local function playerTick(t)
        if VN.spectator() then return end
        local w = VN.world()
        -- taking a picture: looking straight at a villager for 4 s without a sword
        if t % 10 == 0 then
            local p = watch.picture
            if p then
                if not VN.alive(p.m) or not playerLooksAt(p.m, 8, 0.97) then watch.picture = nil
                else
                    if p.noSword and holdingTag("sword") then p.noSword = false end
                    if t >= p.since + 80 then
                        if p.noSword then queueSay(p.m, I.dzzxej, {target = PLAYER}) end
                        watch.picture = nil
                    end
                end
            elseif t % 40 == 0 then
                for _, m in ipairs(villagers(PLAYER, 8)) do
                    if playerLooksAt(m, 8, 0.97) then watch.picture = {m = m, since = t, noSword = not holdingTag("sword")}; break end
                end
            end
        end
        -- statue: not moved for 2400 ticks
        if t % 400 == 0 then
            local pos = VN.posOf(PLAYER)
            if not watch.still.pos or (watch.still.pos - pos).Magnitude > 0.01 then watch.still.pos, watch.still.since = pos, t
            elseif watch.still.since + 2400 <= t then sayNear(PLAYER, I.dfsbyt) end
        end
        -- flying / gliding
        if t % 40 == 0 and w then
            local gliding = w.gliding and w.gliding()
            local flying = w.flying and w.flying()
            if gliding then sayNear(PLAYER, I.wdpwuw, {target = PLAYER}) elseif flying then sayNear(PLAYER, I.rxdskh, {target = PLAYER}) end
        end
        -- a nearly broken tool
        if t % 200 == 0 then
            local _, s = VN.heldItem()
            if s and s.damage and toolStats and toolStats[s.id] and toolStats[s.id].durability then
                if s.damage / toolStats[s.id].durability > 0.8 then sayNear(PLAYER, I.jhhktz, {target = PLAYER}) end
            end
        end
        -- effects: hero of the village, too many potions
        if t % 60 == 0 and w and w.effects and w.effects.list then
            local ok, list = pcall(w.effects.list)
            if ok and type(list) == "table" then
                local n, hero = 0, false
                for k in pairs(list) do n = n + 1; if k == "hero_of_the_village" then hero = true end end
                if hero then sayNearAge(PLAYER, I.hdchrk, I.okndes, {target = PLAYER}) end
                if n > 1 then sayNear(PLAYER, I.sczayc, {target = PLAYER}) end
            end
        end
        -- game mode changes
        local mode = CONFIG.Survival and "survival" or "creative"
        if PlayerStats and PlayerStats.spectator then mode = "spectator" end
        if watch.mode and watch.mode ~= mode then sayNear(PLAYER, mode == "creative" and I.gepjdh or I.dzahzk, {target = PLAYER}) end
        watch.mode = mode
        -- the player died
        local c = VN.ctx()
        local hum = c and c.humanoid
        if hum then
            local hp = hum.Health
            if watch.health and watch.health > 0 and hp <= 0 then
                local line = (watch.deathAt and watch.deathAt + 6000 > t) and I.uaoyhe or I.qhcxdg
                sayNear(VN.posOf(PLAYER), line, {target = VN.posOf(PLAYER)})
                watch.deathAt = t
            elseif watch.health and hp < watch.health and hp > 0 then
                -- "Oof! That's gotta hurt." from whoever saw it
                sayNear(PLAYER, I.qdwzwm, {target = PLAYER})
            end
            watch.health = hp
        end
        -- wearing a villager nose: "did you see where the player went?"
        local nose = Tr.playerHat and Tr.playerWearing and Tr.playerWearing("villager_nose")
        if nose and not watch.nose then sayNear(PLAYER, I.iyhtlh, {target = PLAYER}) end
        watch.nose = nose
    end

    -- Every tick ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local lastDay
    local healthOf = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    function Tr.tick(t)
        local list = VN.mobs()
        -- time skips (sleeping through the night, /time): wgqued
        local day = VN.dayTime()
        if lastDay and t % 25 == 0 then
            local d = math.abs(day - lastDay)
            d = math.min(d, 24000 - d)
            if d > 4000 then
                local pick = math.random() > 0.7 and {I.exoxjo, I.dmnsqh} or (day < 11000 and {I.iuaybi, I.ryhvxd} or ((day > 13500 and day < 22500) and {I.bjjlsc, I.augsct} or {I.exoxjo, I.dmnsqh}))
                sayNearAge(PLAYER, pick[1], pick[2], {target = PLAYER})
            end
        end
        if t % 25 == 0 then lastDay = day end
        playerTick(t)
        for _, m in ipairs(list) do
            if VN.vnType(m) and VN.alive(m) then
                local s = VN.stateOf(m)
                -- the companion's properties (ntshmr): asleep / on ground / in water / riding
                local sleeping, ground, water = m.sleeping and 1 or 0, m.onGround and 1 or 0, VN.blockAt(VN.posOf(m) + Vector3.new(0, 0.3 * B, 0)) == "water" and 1 or 0
                VN.setProp(m, "p:fsjsbp", 1000 * sleeping + 100 * ground + 10 * water)
                VN.setProp(m, "p:mreyue", math.clamp((m.tradeLevel or 1) - 1, 0, 5))
                VN.setProp(m, "p:pmpece", VN.settings.style or 0)
                VN.setProp(m, "p:bvkgap", (VN.posOf(m).Y / B < 60) and 1 or 0)
                -- avoiding mobs (BP: is_avoiding_mobs -> panic flag, "find a bed")
                local hostile = VN.mobsModule() and VN.mobsModule().hostile or {}
                local avoiding = false
                if t % 10 == 0 then
                    for _, o in ipairs(VN.mobsNear(m, 8, function(o) return o.id == "zombie" or o.id == "husk" or o.id == "drowned" or o.id == "zombie_villager" or o.id == "pillager" or o.id == "vindicator" or o.id == "evoker" or o.id == "ravager" or o.id == "vex" or o.id == "zoglin" end)) do avoiding = true; break end
                    if avoiding ~= (s.avoiding == true) then
                        s.avoiding = avoiding
                        VN.setProp(m, "p:sbkmbc", avoiding)
                        if avoiding and isType(m, T.villager) then
                            local last = VN.dyn(m, "bedRun")
                            if not (last and now() - last < 200) then
                                task.delay(25 / 20, function() if VN.alive(m) then queueSay(m, I.mqzcex); VN.setDyn(m, "bedRun", now()) end end)
                            end
                        end
                        if avoiding and isType(m, T.untouchable) then say(m, I.kckrgd, {flags = FORCE, states = {"adult", "untouchableFlee"}}) end
                    end
                end
                -- "is it safe now?"
                if s.safeAt and t >= s.safeAt then
                    s.safeAt = nil
                    if isType(m, T.villager) then sayAge(m, I.hdffcc, I.jqkaeq) end
                end
                -- hurt by anything (health went down)
                local hp = m.humanoid.Health
                local before = healthOf[m]
                healthOf[m] = hp
                if before and hp < before then
                    local byPlayer = false
                    local attacker
                    if not byPlayer then
                        for _, o in ipairs(VN.mobsNear(m, 3, function(o) return o.target == m or hostile[o.id] end)) do attacker = o; break end
                    end
                    if s.playerHitTick and now() - s.playerHitTick <= 2 then byPlayer = true end
                    onVillagerHurt(m, byPlayer, attacker)
                    -- whoever saw it
                    if not byPlayer then sayNear(m, I.qdwzwm, {exclude = m, target = m}) end
                end
                -- the periodic line
                if t >= s.nextChat then
                    s.nextChat = t + math.random(isType(m, T.trader) and 23 or 19, isType(m, T.trader) and 41 or 37) * 20
                    if VN.dist(PLAYER, m) <= 32 then pcall(chatTick, m) end
                end
                -- trading watch
                pcall(tradeWatch, m)
                -- look at whoever it is talking to
                if s.lookAt and speaking(m) then
                    local target = s.lookAt
                    local p = target == PLAYER and VN.headOf(PLAYER) or (type(target) == "table" and VN.headOf(target)) or (typeof(target) == "Vector3" and target)
                    local mm = VN.mobsModule()
                    if p and mm and mm.lookAt then pcall(mm.lookAt, m, p, 10) end
                end
                -- rain on the nose (tojjnl / ycuook), every 7-12 s while it rains, under the open sky
                if t % 200 == 0 and VN.weather() ~= "clear" and isType(m, T.villager) then
                    local open = true
                    for dy = 2, 40 do if VN.blockAt(VN.posOf(m) + Vector3.new(0, dy - 0.5, 0) * B) then open = false; break end end
                    if open then queueSay(m, I.kxivri) end
                end
            end
        end
        -- what they see, every 60 ticks
        if t % 60 == 0 then
            for _, m in ipairs(list) do
                if VN.vnType(m) and VN.alive(m) and VN.dist(PLAYER, m) <= 32 then pcall(lookAround, m) end
            end
            -- cooldowns run faster near the player (sdybzn)
            for _, m in ipairs(villagers(PLAYER, 10)) do
                local speed = 1.25
                local close = VN.dist(PLAYER, m) < 6
                if close then speed = speed + 0.5 end
                if playerLooksAt(m, 8, 0.97) then speed = speed + (close and 1.5 or 0.75) end
                VN.DE.setEntitySpeed(m, speed)
            end
        end
        -- the world near the player, every second (phase 0..3 widens the search for fire / campfires / TNT)
        if t % 20 == 0 then
            local phase = (t / 20) % 4
            for _, m in ipairs(villagers(PLAYER, 16)) do pcall(envChecks, m, phase) end
            -- standing on an occupied bed
            local under = VN.blockAt(VN.posOf(PLAYER) - Vector3.new(0, 0.3 * B, 0))
            if under and under:match("_bed$") then sayNear(VN.posOf(PLAYER), I.pqbhyp, {radius = 2.5, target = PLAYER}) end
        end
    end

    -- Death / removal --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function onMobDied(data)
        local m = data and data.mob
        local p = data and data.position
        if m and VN.vnType(m) then
            sayNear(VN.posOf(m), I.txumkc, {exclude = m, target = VN.posOf(m)})
            -- killed by the player: everyone nearby remembers
            if m.lastHurtBy then for _, o in ipairs(villagers(m, 16)) do if o ~= m then addRep(o, "hurt_major") end end end
        elseif p then
            -- any other death the villagers saw
        end
    end

    -- Spawn eggs of the special villagers and Wooly; the add-on's items ---------------------------------------------------
    local EGGS = {
        {id = "vn_mayor_spawn_egg", name = "Mayor Villager Spawn Egg", type = T.mayor, base = "villager", colours = {0x6f4a2f, 0xd9b05b}},
        {id = "vn_testificate_man_spawn_egg", name = "Testificate Man Spawn Egg", type = T.testificate, base = "villager", colours = {0x3a5fb5, 0xd23b3b}},

    function Tr.renderWorn()
        local key = VN.enabled and Tr.playerHat() or nil
        if worn.key ~= key then
            if worn.vis then pcall(worn.vis.destroy) end
            worn.vis, worn.key = nil, key
            if key and VN.BR then
                worn.vis = VN.BR.visual("oreville_vn:" .. key, {query = function(name, args, env, vis)
                    if name == "anim_time" then return env.q_anim_time or 0 end
                    if name == "life_time" then return vis.life end
                    if name == "delta_time" then return env.dt or 0 end
                    return 0
                end, owner = nil})
            end
        end
        local vis = worn.vis
        if not vis then return end
        local w = VN.world()
        local body = w and w.gameplay and w.gameplay.body
        local head = body and body.head
        if not head or (w.renderFirstPerson) then vis.model.Parent = nil; return end
        vis.model.Parent = workspace
        local now2 = os.clock()
        local dt = math.min(0.1, now2 - worn.last)
        worn.last = now2
        local k = B / 16
        local neck = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -4 * k, 0)
        pcall(vis.update, dt, neck * CFrame.new(0, -24 * k, 0), B)
    end

    function Tr.openHandbook()
        if handbook then Tr.closeHandbook(); return end
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local pg = Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if not pg then return end

        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.IgnoreGuiInset, gui.DisplayOrder = "VillagerNewsHandbook", false, true, 50
        local shade = Instance.new("Frame")
        shade.Size, shade.BackgroundColor3, shade.BackgroundTransparency, shade.BorderSizePixel = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.45, 0
        shade.Parent = gui

        canvas.Parent = gui

        req.villager_news = true
        local function layout()
            local view = gui.AbsoluteSize
            local s = JavaGui.scale(view)
            scale.Scale = s
            return math.floor(view.X / s), math.floor(view.Y / s)
        end
        local W, H = layout()
        canvas.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)
        local top = math.floor(H / 2 - 70)
        local function centred(text, y, color)
            JavaGui.text(canvas, text, math.floor((W - JavaGui.width(text)) / 2), y, color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1), true, 3)
        end
        centred("Villager News", top)
        centred("By Oreville Studios & Element Animation", top + 12, Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170))
        local function button(x, y, w, text, onClick)
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
            b.BackgroundTransparency, b.Text, b.AutoButtonColor = 1, "", false
            b.Position, b.Size, b.ZIndex = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), UDim2.fromOffset(w, 20), 6
            b.Parent = canvas

            local lit = G["widget/button_highlighted"] and JavaGui.slice(canvas, G["widget/button_highlighted"], 3, x, y, w, 20, 3)
            if lit then lit.Visible = false end
            local label = JavaGui.text(canvas, text, x + math.floor((w - JavaGui.width(text)) / 2), y + 6, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), true, 4)
            b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if lit then lit.Visible = true end end)

                if MinecraftSounds then pcall(MinecraftSounds.play, "ui.button.click", nil, 0.25, 1) end
                onClick()
            end)
            return label
        end

            local function caption()
                local v = VN.settings[opt.key]

            end

            local function redraw()
                if holder.label then holder.label:Destroy() end
                holder.label = JavaGui.text(canvas, caption(), math.floor((W - JavaGui.width(caption())) / 2), holder.y + 6, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), true, 4)
            end

            end)

            y = y + 24
        end
        button(math.floor(W / 2 - 100), y + 6, 200, "Done", function() Tr.closeHandbook() end)

    -- Item use: the eggs, the Handbook --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local baseUse
    function Tr.useItem(stack, name, sneaking)
        if not VN.enabled then return false end
        local e = stack and JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
        if not e then return false end
        if e.vnEgg then
            local w = VN.world()
            if not (w and w.eye and w.look) then return false end
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(w.eye(), w.look() * CONFIG.Reach * B)
            if not hit then return false end
            spawnSpecial(e.vnEgg, hit.Position + hit.Normal * 0.05)
            useHeld()
            return true
        end
        if e.id == "villager_news_handbook" then
            if Tr.openHandbook then Tr.openHandbook() end
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    function Tr.start()
        installHooks()
        local mm = VN.mobsModule()
        if mm then
            Tr.prevPreInteract = mm.preInteract
            mm.preInteract = function(m, s, name)
                if Tr.prevPreInteract then local r = Tr.prevPreInteract(m, s, name); if r ~= nil then return r end end
                return Tr.preInteract(m, s, name)
            end
            Tr.prevPlayerHit = mm.onPlayerHit
            mm.onPlayerHit = function(m)
                if Tr.prevPlayerHit then pcall(Tr.prevPlayerHit, m) end
                if VN.vnType(m) then VN.stateOf(m).playerHitTick = now() end
            end
        end
        listen("place", onPlace)
        listen("break", onBreak)
        listen("mob_died", onMobDied)
        listen("tnt_primed", function(d)
            if d and d.position and VN.dist(PLAYER, d.position) <= 6 then sayNear(d.position, I.psznlm, {target = PLAYER}) end
        end)
        if not Tr.wornConn then Tr.wornConn = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function() pcall(Tr.renderWorn) end) end
        local w = VN.world()
        if w and w.blocks and w.blocks.use and not Tr.wrappedUse then
            local base = w.blocks.use
            Tr.wrappedUse = base
            w.blocks.use = function(hit, sneaking, ...)
                local r = base(hit, sneaking, ...)
                if VN.enabled and r ~= nil then
                    pcall(function()
                        local n = w.resolve and w.resolve(hit.Instance)
                        if n then onUseBlock(n.id, (VN.heldItem())) end
                    end)
                end
                return r
            end
        end
        VN.useItem = Tr.useItem
    end
    function Tr.stop()
        local mm = VN.mobsModule()
        if mm then mm.preInteract = Tr.prevPreInteract; mm.onPlayerHit = Tr.prevPlayerHit end
        local all = rawget(_G, "SteveEventListeners")
        if type(all) == "table" then for i = #listeners, 1, -1 do local l = listeners[i]; if all[l.name] == l.mine then all[l.name] = l.prev end end end
        listeners = {}
        Tr.closeHandbook()
        if Tr.wornConn then Tr.wornConn:Disconnect(); Tr.wornConn = nil end
        if worn.vis then pcall(worn.vis.destroy); worn.vis, worn.key = nil, nil end
        local w = VN.world()
        if w and w.blocks and Tr.wrappedUse then w.blocks.use = Tr.wrappedUse; Tr.wrappedUse = nil end
        Tr.talking = {}
    end
    return Tr
end

-- BEGIN MOD: REALISTIC WATER (a modified port of Skaffy's Realistic Water: github.com/sskaffy/Realistic-Water)
;(function()
local createFluidSim = (function()
-- Realistic Water (Skaffy) - the fluid simulation, rebuilt for Luau on the CPU.
-- The original runs FLIP on the GPU (particles + a MAC grid + a multigrid pressure solve). This is the same method at a
-- resolution Luau can carry: particles carry the fluid, a staggered grid around them takes their velocity (P2G), gets
-- gravity, viscosity / adhesion, solid walls and an incompressibility solve (Gauss-Seidel with volume correction), and
-- hands the change back to the particles (G2P, FLIP / PIC blend). Units are blocks and seconds (1 block = 1 m).
--   local sim = createFluidSim(params, hooks)
--   hooks.solid(bx, by, bz) -> true for a solid block; hooks.heat(bx, by, bz) -> heat code (1 magma, 2 lava, 3 fire,
--   4 furnace, 5 cooling) or nil
--   sim.addBlock(bx, by, bz, fill) / sim.addSpring(bx, by, bz) / sim.step(dt) / sim.fills -> {[key] = fill 0..1+}
local function createFluidSim(P, hooks)
    local floor, sqrt, exp, min, max, abs, random = math.floor, math.sqrt, math.exp, math.min, math.max, math.abs, math.random
    local R = P.res or 2                       -- cells per block
    local PPC = P.ppc or 4                     -- particles per cell
    local H = 1 / R                            -- cell size (blocks)
    local PER_BLOCK = PPC * R * R * R
    local S = {params = P, n = 0, awake = true, calm = 0, fills = {}, springs = {}, blockCount = {}, boxes = {}, heated = {},
        steps = 0, events = {}}
    local px, py, pz, vx, vy, vz, temp, strand = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
    S.px, S.py, S.pz, S.vx, S.vy, S.vz, S.temp = px, py, pz, vx, vy, vz, temp

    -- numeric block keys, exact in a double (< 2^53): blocks within +-65536 of the origin
    local function bkey(bx, by, bz) return (bx + 65536) + (by + 65536) * 131072 + (bz + 65536) * 17179869184 end
    S.bkey = bkey
    S.pending = {}
    -- while a time-sliced step is paused, changes from outside wait until it ends (the arrays stay consistent)
    local function deferred(fn)
        return function(...)
            if S.stepping then
                local args = table.pack(...)
                S.pending[#S.pending + 1] = function() fn(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n)) end
                return 0
            end
            return fn(...)
        end
    end
    S.deferred = deferred

    -- solid blocks (cached per step box; hooks.solid is called once per block per refresh)
    local solidCache, solidAge = {}, 0
    local function solidBlock(bx, by, bz)
        local k = bkey(bx, by, bz)
        local s = solidCache[k]
        if s == nil then s = hooks.solid(bx, by, bz) and true or false; solidCache[k] = s end
        return s
    end
    -- solidity at quarter-block cells when the host gives it (hooks.solidFine(qx, qy, qz)); whole blocks otherwise
    local fineCache = {}
    local function solidAt(x, y, z)
        local sf = hooks.solidFine
        if not sf then local bx0, by0, bz0 = floor(x), floor(y), floor(z); return solidBlock(bx0, by0, bz0) end
        local qx, qy, qz = floor(x * 4), floor(y * 4), floor(z * 4)
        local k = (qx + 131072) + (qz + 131072) * 262144 + (qy + 16384) * 68719476736
        local s = fineCache[k]
        if s == nil then s = sf(qx, qy, qz) and true or false; fineCache[k] = s end
        return s
    end
    S.solidAt = solidAt
    function S.invalidate() solidCache = {}; fineCache = {}; S.wake() end
    function S.wake() S.awake = true; S.calm = 0 end

    -- particles ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function add(x, y, z, ux, uy, uz, t)
        if S.n >= (P.maxParticles or 6000) then return false end
        local i = S.n + 1
        S.n = i
        px[i], py[i], pz[i] = x, y, z
        vx[i], vy[i], vz[i] = ux or 0, uy or 0, uz or 0
        temp[i] = t or (P.ambient or 20)
        strand[i] = 0
        return true
    end
    S.add = add
    local function remove(i)
        local n = S.n
        px[i], py[i], pz[i], vx[i], vy[i], vz[i], temp[i], strand[i] = px[n], py[n], pz[n], vx[n], vy[n], vz[n], temp[n], strand[n]
        px[n], py[n], pz[n], vx[n], vy[n], vz[n], temp[n], strand[n] = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
        S.n = n - 1
    end
    S.remove = remove
    -- a block of fluid: PPC particles in each of its R^3 cells, jittered (from y0 to y1 of the block)
    function S.addBlock(bx, by, bz, fill, y0, y1, ux, uy, uz)
        fill = fill or 1
        y0, y1 = y0 or 0, y1 or fill
        local count = 0
        for cz = 0, R - 1 do for cy = 0, R - 1 do for cx = 0, R - 1 do
            local cyy = (cy + 0.5) * H
            if cyy >= y0 and cyy <= y1 + 1e-6 then
                for _ = 1, PPC do
                    if add(bx + (cx + random()) * H, by + (cy + random()) * H, bz + (cz + random()) * H, ux, uy, uz) then count = count + 1 end
                end
            end
        end end end
        S.wake()
        return count
    end
    function S.removeBlock(bx, by, bz)
        local removed = 0
        for i = S.n, 1, -1 do
            if floor(px[i]) == bx and floor(py[i]) == by and floor(pz[i]) == bz then remove(i); removed = removed + 1 end
        end
        if removed > 0 then S.wake() end
        return removed
    end
    function S.addSpring(bx, by, bz) S.springs[bkey(bx, by, bz)] = {bx, by, bz}; S.wake() end
    function S.removeSpring(bx, by, bz) S.springs[bkey(bx, by, bz)] = nil end
    function S.clear()
        for i = S.n, 1, -1 do px[i], py[i], pz[i], vx[i], vy[i], vz[i], temp[i], strand[i] = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil end
        S.n = 0; S.springs = {}; S.fills = {}; S.blockCount = {}
    end

    -- grid ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local nx, ny, nz, ox, oy, oz = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0     -- box in cells; origin in cells
    local cellType, cellCount, pres = {}, {}, {}
    local u, v, w, uw, vw, ww, u0, v0, w0 = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
    local fluidCells = {}
    local function cidx(i, j, k) return i + nx * (j + ny * k) + 1 end
    local function uidx(i, j, k) return i + (nx + 1) * (j + ny * k) + 1 end
    local function vidx(i, j, k) return i + nx * (j + (ny + 1) * k) + 1 end
    local function widx(i, j, k) return i + nx * (j + ny * k) + 1 end

    local bodyVel = {}
    local function buildBox(p0, p1)
        local minx, miny, minz, maxx, maxy, maxz = math.huge, math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
        for i = p0, p1 do
            local x, y, z = px[i], py[i], pz[i]
            if x < minx then minx = x end; if x > maxx then maxx = x end
            if y < miny then miny = y end; if y > maxy then maxy = y end
            if z < minz then minz = z end; if z > maxz then maxz = z end
        end
        local pad = 2
        ox, oy, oz = floor(minx * R) - pad, floor(miny * R) - pad, floor(minz * R) - pad
        nx = floor(maxx * R) + pad + 1 - ox
        ny = floor(maxy * R) + pad + 1 - oy
        nz = floor(maxz * R) + pad + 1 - oz
        local nc = nx * ny * nz
        for c = 1, nc do cellType[c] = 0; cellCount[c] = 0; pres[c] = 0 end
        for c = 1, (nx + 1) * ny * nz do u[c] = 0; uw[c] = 0 end
        for c = 1, nx * (ny + 1) * nz do v[c] = 0; vw[c] = 0 end
        for c = 1, nx * ny * (nz + 1) do w[c] = 0; ww[c] = 0 end
        -- solid cells (a cell is solid when the block holding its centre is)
        for k = 0, nz - 1 do for j = 0, ny - 1 do for i = 0, nx - 1 do
            if solidAt((ox + i + 0.5) * H, (oy + j + 0.5) * H, (oz + k + 0.5) * H) then cellType[cidx(i, j, k)] = 2 end
        end end end
        -- realistic block cells are moving solids (WaterWorld.writeBodyCells): their faces carry the body's velocity
        bodyVel = {}
        for _, c in ipairs(S.bodyCells or {}) do
            local M = c.R
            local ex = abs(M[1]) * c.hx + abs(M[2]) * c.hy + abs(M[3]) * c.hz
            local ey = abs(M[4]) * c.hx + abs(M[5]) * c.hy + abs(M[6]) * c.hz
            local ez = abs(M[7]) * c.hx + abs(M[8]) * c.hy + abs(M[9]) * c.hz
            for k = max(0, floor((c.z - ez) * R) - oz), min(nz - 1, floor((c.z + ez) * R) - oz) do
                for j = max(0, floor((c.y - ey) * R) - oy), min(ny - 1, floor((c.y + ey) * R) - oy) do
                    for i = max(0, floor((c.x - ex) * R) - ox), min(nx - 1, floor((c.x + ex) * R) - ox) do
                        local dx, dy, dz = (ox + i + 0.5) * H - c.x, (oy + j + 0.5) * H - c.y, (oz + k + 0.5) * H - c.z
                        if abs(M[1] * dx + M[4] * dy + M[7] * dz) < c.hx and abs(M[2] * dx + M[5] * dy + M[8] * dz) < c.hy
                            and abs(M[3] * dx + M[6] * dy + M[9] * dz) < c.hz then
                            local q = cidx(i, j, k)
                            cellType[q] = 2
                            bodyVel[q] = c
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- trilinear splat / sample for one staggered component
    local function splat(arr, wts, gx, gy, gz, val, sx, sy, sz)
        local i0, j0, k0 = floor(gx), floor(gy), floor(gz)
        local fx, fy, fz = gx - i0, gy - j0, gz - k0
        if i0 < 0 then i0, fx = 0, 0 elseif i0 > sx - 2 then i0, fx = sx - 2, 1 end
        if j0 < 0 then j0, fy = 0, 0 elseif j0 > sy - 2 then j0, fy = sy - 2, 1 end
        if k0 < 0 then k0, fz = 0, 0 elseif k0 > sz - 2 then k0, fz = sz - 2, 1 end
        local sxy = sx * sy
        local base = i0 + sx * j0 + sxy * k0 + 1
        local gx0, gy0, gz0 = 1 - fx, 1 - fy, 1 - fz
        local c, wgt
        c = base;                 wgt = gx0 * gy0 * gz0; arr[c] = arr[c] + val * wgt; wts[c] = wts[c] + wgt
        c = base + 1;             wgt = fx * gy0 * gz0;  arr[c] = arr[c] + val * wgt; wts[c] = wts[c] + wgt
        c = base + sx;            wgt = gx0 * fy * gz0;  arr[c] = arr[c] + val * wgt; wts[c] = wts[c] + wgt
        c = base + sx + 1;        wgt = fx * fy * gz0;   arr[c] = arr[c] + val * wgt; wts[c] = wts[c] + wgt
        c = base + sxy;           wgt = gx0 * gy0 * fz;  arr[c] = arr[c] + val * wgt; wts[c] = wts[c] + wgt
        c = base + sxy + 1;       wgt = fx * gy0 * fz;   arr[c] = arr[c] + val * wgt; wts[c] = wts[c] + wgt
        c = base + sxy + sx;      wgt = gx0 * fy * fz;   arr[c] = arr[c] + val * wgt; wts[c] = wts[c] + wgt
        c = base + sxy + sx + 1;  wgt = fx * fy * fz;    arr[c] = arr[c] + val * wgt; wts[c] = wts[c] + wgt
    end
    local function sample(arr, gx, gy, gz, sx, sy, sz)
        local i0, j0, k0 = floor(gx), floor(gy), floor(gz)
        local fx, fy, fz = gx - i0, gy - j0, gz - k0
        if i0 < 0 then i0, fx = 0, 0 elseif i0 > sx - 2 then i0, fx = sx - 2, 1 end
        if j0 < 0 then j0, fy = 0, 0 elseif j0 > sy - 2 then j0, fy = sy - 2, 1 end
        if k0 < 0 then k0, fz = 0, 0 elseif k0 > sz - 2 then k0, fz = sz - 2, 1 end
        local sxy = sx * sy
        local base = i0 + sx * j0 + sxy * k0 + 1
        local a000, a100 = arr[base], arr[base + 1]
        local a010, a110 = arr[base + sx], arr[base + sx + 1]
        local a001, a101 = arr[base + sxy], arr[base + sxy + 1]
        local a011, a111 = arr[base + sxy + sx], arr[base + sxy + sx + 1]
        local x00 = a000 + (a100 - a000) * fx
        local x10 = a010 + (a110 - a010) * fx
        local x01 = a001 + (a101 - a001) * fx
        local x11 = a011 + (a111 - a011) * fx
        local y0 = x00 + (x10 - x00) * fy
        local y1 = x01 + (x11 - x01) * fy
        return y0 + (y1 - y0) * fz
    end

    local function substep(dt, p0, p1)
        local yc = S.yieldCheck
        local flip = P.flip or 0.95
        local gravity = P.gravity or 9.81
        local maxSpeed = P.maxSpeed or 40
        local clock = os.clock
        local prof = S.prof
        local t0 = clock()
        buildBox(p0, p1)
        if yc then yc() end
        local t1 = clock(); if prof then prof.box = (prof.box or 0) + t1 - t0 end
        -- P2G
        local nfl = 0
        for p = p0, p1 do
            local gx, gy, gz = px[p] * R - ox, py[p] * R - oy, pz[p] * R - oz
            local ci, cj, ck = floor(gx), floor(gy), floor(gz)
            local c = cidx(ci, cj, ck)
            if cellType[c] == 0 then cellType[c] = 1; nfl = nfl + 1; fluidCells[nfl] = c end
            cellCount[c] = cellCount[c] + 1
            splat(u, uw, gx, gy - 0.5, gz - 0.5, vx[p], nx + 1, ny, nz)
            splat(v, vw, gx - 0.5, gy, gz - 0.5, vy[p], nx, ny + 1, nz)
            splat(w, ww, gx - 0.5, gy - 0.5, gz, vz[p], nx, ny, nz + 1)
            if yc and p % 256 == 0 then yc() end
        end
        local t2 = clock(); if prof then prof.p2g = (prof.p2g or 0) + t2 - t1 end
