        for c = 1, #uw do local q = uw[c]; if q > 0 then u[c] = u[c] / q end; u0[c] = u[c] end
        for c = 1, #vw do local q = vw[c]; if q > 0 then v[c] = v[c] / q end; v0[c] = v[c] end
        for c = 1, #ww do local q = ww[c]; if q > 0 then w[c] = w[c] / q end; w0[c] = w[c] end
        -- forces: gravity on every vertical face that touches fluid
        local nf = nfl
        for q = nf + 1, #fluidCells do fluidCells[q] = nil end
        local gdt = gravity * dt
        for q = 1, nf do
            local c = fluidCells[q]
            local idx = c - 1
            local i = idx % nx
            local j = floor(idx / nx) % ny
            local k = floor(idx / (nx * ny))
            local vb = vidx(i, j, k)
            v[vb] = v[vb] - gdt
            if cellType[c + nx] ~= 1 then v[vb + nx] = v[vb + nx] - gdt end
        end
        -- viscosity (slime): smooth the face velocities between fluid cells
        local visc = P.viscosity or 0
        if visc > 0 then
            local a = min(0.9, visc * dt * 6)
            for _ = 1, P.viscosityIterations or 2 do
                for k = 1, nz - 2 do for j = 1, ny - 2 do for i = 1, nx - 1 do
                    local c = uidx(i, j, k)
                    if cellType[cidx(i, j, k)] == 1 or cellType[cidx(i - 1, j, k)] == 1 then
                        local avg = (u[uidx(i, j - 1, k)] + u[uidx(i, j + 1, k)] + u[uidx(i, j, k - 1)] + u[uidx(i, j, k + 1)]) * 0.25
                        u[c] = u[c] + (avg - u[c]) * a
                    end
                end end end
                for k = 1, nz - 2 do for j = 1, ny - 1 do for i = 1, nx - 2 do
                    local c = vidx(i, j, k)
                    if cellType[cidx(i, j, k)] == 1 or cellType[cidx(i, j - 1, k)] == 1 then
                        local avg = (v[vidx(i - 1, j, k)] + v[vidx(i + 1, j, k)] + v[vidx(i, j, k - 1)] + v[vidx(i, j, k + 1)]) * 0.25
                        v[c] = v[c] + (avg - v[c]) * a
                    end
                end end end
                for k = 1, nz - 1 do for j = 1, ny - 2 do for i = 1, nx - 2 do
                    local c = widx(i, j, k)
                    if cellType[cidx(i, j, k)] == 1 or cellType[cidx(i, j, k - 1)] == 1 then
                        local avg = (w[widx(i - 1, j, k)] + w[widx(i + 1, j, k)] + w[widx(i, j - 1, k)] + w[widx(i, j + 1, k)]) * 0.25
                        w[c] = w[c] + (avg - w[c]) * a
                    end
                end end end
            end
        end
        -- solid walls: no flow through a face that touches a solid cell (adhesion also slows flow along walls)
        local adhesion = P.adhesion or 0
        local stick = adhesion > 0 and exp(-adhesion * dt) or 1
        local stride = nx * ny
        for q = 1, nf do
            local c = fluidCells[q]
            local idx = c - 1
            local i = idx % nx
            local j = floor(idx / nx) % ny
            local k = floor(idx / (nx * ny))
            local bv
            if cellType[c - 1] == 2 then bv = bodyVel[c - 1]; u[uidx(i, j, k)] = bv and bv.vx or 0 end
            if cellType[c + 1] == 2 then bv = bodyVel[c + 1]; u[uidx(i + 1, j, k)] = bv and bv.vx or 0 end
            if cellType[c - nx] == 2 then bv = bodyVel[c - nx]; v[vidx(i, j, k)] = bv and bv.vy or 0 end
            if cellType[c + nx] == 2 then bv = bodyVel[c + nx]; v[vidx(i, j + 1, k)] = bv and bv.vy or 0 end
            if cellType[c - stride] == 2 then bv = bodyVel[c - stride]; w[widx(i, j, k)] = bv and bv.vz or 0 end
            if cellType[c + stride] == 2 then bv = bodyVel[c + stride]; w[widx(i, j, k + 1)] = bv and bv.vz or 0 end
            if stick < 1 then
                local nearSolid = (i > 0 and cellType[c - 1] == 2) or (i < nx - 1 and cellType[c + 1] == 2)
                    or (j > 0 and cellType[cidx(i, j - 1, k)] == 2) or (j < ny - 1 and cellType[cidx(i, j + 1, k)] == 2)
                    or (k > 0 and cellType[cidx(i, j, k - 1)] == 2) or (k < nz - 1 and cellType[cidx(i, j, k + 1)] == 2)
                if nearSolid then
                    u[uidx(i, j, k)] = u[uidx(i, j, k)] * stick; u[uidx(i + 1, j, k)] = u[uidx(i + 1, j, k)] * stick
                    v[vidx(i, j, k)] = v[vidx(i, j, k)] * stick; v[vidx(i, j + 1, k)] = v[vidx(i, j + 1, k)] * stick
                    w[widx(i, j, k)] = w[widx(i, j, k)] * stick; w[widx(i, j, k + 1)] = w[widx(i, j, k + 1)] * stick
                end
            end
        end
        -- pressure (q = p dt / h): sum over open neighbours (q_nb - q) = divergence, air q = 0, solid faces closed
        local vc = P.volumeCorrection or 2
        local div, open = S.div or {}, S.open or {}
        S.div, S.open = div, open
        for q = 1, nf do
            local c = fluidCells[q]
            local idx = c - 1
            local i = idx % nx
            local j = floor(idx / nx) % ny
            local k = floor(idx / (nx * ny))
            local d = u[uidx(i + 1, j, k)] - u[uidx(i, j, k)] + v[vidx(i, j + 1, k)] - v[vidx(i, j, k)] + w[widx(i, j, k + 1)] - w[widx(i, j, k)]
            local dens = cellCount[c] / PPC
            if dens > 1 then d = d - vc * min(dens - 1, 2) * H end
            div[q] = d
            local o = 0
            if cellType[c - 1] ~= 2 then o = o + 1 end
            if cellType[c + 1] ~= 2 then o = o + 1 end
            if cellType[c - nx] ~= 2 then o = o + 1 end
            if cellType[c + nx] ~= 2 then o = o + 1 end
            if cellType[c - nx * ny] ~= 2 then o = o + 1 end
            if cellType[c + nx * ny] ~= 2 then o = o + 1 end
            open[q] = o
        end
        local t3 = clock(); if prof then prof.forces = (prof.forces or 0) + t3 - t2 end
        local omega = 1.6
        if yc then yc() end
        for it = 1, P.iterations or 24 do
            if yc and it % 4 == 0 then yc() end
            for q = 1, nf do
                local o = open[q]
                if o > 0 then
                    local c = fluidCells[q]
                    local s = 0
                    local t
                    t = cellType[c - 1]; if t == 1 then s = s + pres[c - 1] end
                    t = cellType[c + 1]; if t == 1 then s = s + pres[c + 1] end
                    t = cellType[c - nx]; if t == 1 then s = s + pres[c - nx] end
                    t = cellType[c + nx]; if t == 1 then s = s + pres[c + nx] end
                    t = cellType[c - stride]; if t == 1 then s = s + pres[c - stride] end
                    t = cellType[c + stride]; if t == 1 then s = s + pres[c + stride] end
                    local new = (s - div[q]) / o
                    pres[c] = pres[c] + (new - pres[c]) * omega
                end
            end
        end
        local t4 = clock(); if prof then prof.solve = (prof.solve or 0) + t4 - t3 end
        -- subtract the pressure gradient on faces between non-solid cells where one side is fluid
        -- each fluid cell updates its -x/-y/-z faces, and its + faces when the neighbour there is air
        for q = 1, nf do
            local c = fluidCells[q]
            local idx = c - 1
            local i = idx % nx
            local j = floor(idx / nx) % ny
            local k = floor(idx / (nx * ny))
            local pc = pres[c]
            local t
            t = cellType[c - 1]
            if t ~= 2 then local f = uidx(i, j, k); u[f] = u[f] - (pc - (t == 1 and pres[c - 1] or 0)) end
            t = cellType[c + 1]
            if t == 0 then local f = uidx(i + 1, j, k); u[f] = u[f] - (0 - pc) end
            t = cellType[c - nx]
            if t ~= 2 then local f = vidx(i, j, k); v[f] = v[f] - (pc - (t == 1 and pres[c - nx] or 0)) end
            t = cellType[c + nx]
            if t == 0 then local f = vidx(i, j + 1, k); v[f] = v[f] - (0 - pc) end
            t = cellType[c - stride]
            if t ~= 2 then local f = widx(i, j, k); w[f] = w[f] - (pc - (t == 1 and pres[c - stride] or 0)) end
            t = cellType[c + stride]
            if t == 0 then local f = widx(i, j, k + 1); w[f] = w[f] - (0 - pc) end
        end
        local t5 = clock(); if prof then prof.grad = (prof.grad or 0) + t5 - t4 end
        -- G2P + advection + collisions
        local film = P.filmFriction or 0
        local maxSq = maxSpeed * maxSpeed
        local fastest = 0
        local sumSpeed = 0
        local maxStep = 0.45 / dt   -- never more than 0.45 block per substep: no tunnelling through 1-block walls
        local maxStepSq = maxStep * maxStep
        if yc then yc() end
        for p = p0, p1 do
            if yc and p % 256 == 0 then yc() end
            if px[p] == nil then break end
            local gx, gy, gz = px[p] * R - ox, py[p] * R - oy, pz[p] * R - oz
            local pu = sample(u, gx, gy - 0.5, gz - 0.5, nx + 1, ny, nz)
            local pv = sample(v, gx - 0.5, gy, gz - 0.5, nx, ny + 1, nz)
            local pw = sample(w, gx - 0.5, gy - 0.5, gz, nx, ny, nz + 1)
            local du = pu - sample(u0, gx, gy - 0.5, gz - 0.5, nx + 1, ny, nz)
            local dv = pv - sample(v0, gx - 0.5, gy, gz - 0.5, nx, ny + 1, nz)
            local dw = pw - sample(w0, gx - 0.5, gy - 0.5, gz, nx, ny, nz + 1)
            local nvx = flip * (vx[p] + du) + (1 - flip) * pu
            local nvy = flip * (vy[p] + dv) + (1 - flip) * pv
            local nvz = flip * (vz[p] + dw) + (1 - flip) * pw
            -- thin film on the ground: friction stops a spreading sheet (puddles settle)
            if film > 0 then
                local ci, cj, ck = floor(gx), floor(gy), floor(gz)
                local c = cidx(ci, cj, ck)
                if cj > 0 and cellType[c - nx] == 2 and cellCount[c] < PPC * 0.6 and (cj + 1 >= ny or cellType[c + nx] ~= 1) then
                    local f = exp(-film * dt)
                    nvx, nvz = nvx * f, nvz * f
                end
            end
            local sq = nvx * nvx + nvy * nvy + nvz * nvz
            if sq > maxSq then local s = maxSpeed / sqrt(sq); nvx, nvy, nvz = nvx * s, nvy * s, nvz * s; sq = maxSq end
            if sq > maxStepSq then local s = maxStep / sqrt(sq); nvx, nvy, nvz = nvx * s, nvy * s, nvz * s; sq = maxStepSq end
            if sq > fastest then fastest = sq end
            sumSpeed = sumSpeed + sqrt(sq)
            -- move, then push out of solids one axis at a time
            local x, y, z = px[p], py[p], pz[p]
            local nx2, ny2, nz2 = x + nvx * dt, y + nvy * dt, z + nvz * dt
            if solidAt(nx2, y, z) then nx2 = x; nvx = -nvx * 0.1 end
            if solidAt(nx2, ny2, z) then ny2 = y; nvy = 0 end
            if solidAt(nx2, ny2, nz2) then nz2 = z; nvz = -nvz * 0.1 end
            -- keep particles a hair off block faces so the grid does not count them in the wall
            px[p], py[p], pz[p] = nx2, ny2, nz2
            vx[p], vy[p], vz[p] = nvx, nvy, nvz
        end
        if sqrt(fastest) > (S.stepFastest or 0) then S.stepFastest = sqrt(fastest) end
        S.stepSum = (S.stepSum or 0) + sumSpeed
        S.stepCount = (S.stepCount or 0) + (p1 - p0 + 1)
        if prof then prof.g2p = (prof.g2p or 0) + clock() - t5 end
    end

    -- entities shove fluid out of their boxes (box = {x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, vx, vy, vz})
    local function pushEntities()
        for _, b in ipairs(S.boxes) do
            local moving = abs(b[7]) + abs(b[8]) + abs(b[9]) > 0.05
            for p = 1, S.n do
                local x, y, z = px[p], py[p], pz[p]
                if x > b[1] and x < b[4] and y > b[2] and y < b[5] and z > b[3] and z < b[6] then
                    -- out through the nearest side wall (or the top)
                    local cx, cz = (b[1] + b[4]) * 0.5, (b[3] + b[6]) * 0.5
                    local dx, dz = x - cx, z - cz
                    local nx2, nz2 = x, z
                    if abs(dx) > abs(dz) then nx2 = dx > 0 and b[4] + 0.01 or b[1] - 0.01 else nz2 = dz > 0 and b[6] + 0.01 or b[3] - 0.01 end
                    -- never through a wall: if the side is blocked the water goes over the body instead
                    if solidAt(nx2, y, nz2) then
                        if not solidAt(x, b[5] + 0.01, z) then py[p] = b[5] + 0.01 end
                    else
                        px[p], pz[p] = nx2, nz2
                    end
                    if moving then vx[p], vy[p], vz[p] = vx[p] * 0.5 + b[7], vy[p] * 0.5 + max(b[8], 0) + 0.5, vz[p] * 0.5 + b[9] end
                    S.wake()
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- realistic block cells (g2p.comp collideEntities): a particle inside an oriented cell goes out through the nearest
    -- face and takes the body's speed along that face's normal. S.bodyCells = {{x, y, z, R, hx, hy, hz, vx, vy, vz}}
    local function pushBodies()
        local cells = S.bodyCells
        if not cells or #cells == 0 then return end
        local grid = {}
        for _, c in ipairs(cells) do
            local M = c.R
            local ex = abs(M[1]) * c.hx + abs(M[2]) * c.hy + abs(M[3]) * c.hz
            local ey = abs(M[4]) * c.hx + abs(M[5]) * c.hy + abs(M[6]) * c.hz
            local ez = abs(M[7]) * c.hx + abs(M[8]) * c.hy + abs(M[9]) * c.hz
            for bx = floor(c.x - ex), floor(c.x + ex) do for by = floor(c.y - ey), floor(c.y + ey) do for bz = floor(c.z - ez), floor(c.z + ez) do
                local k = bkey(bx, by, bz)
                local l = grid[k]
                if not l then l = {}; grid[k] = l end
                l[#l + 1] = c
            end end end
        end
        local moved = false
        for p = 1, S.n do
            local l = grid[bkey(floor(px[p]), floor(py[p]), floor(pz[p]))]
            if l then
                for _, c in ipairs(l) do
                    local M = c.R
                    local dx, dy, dz = px[p] - c.x, py[p] - c.y, pz[p] - c.z
                    local lx, ly, lz = M[1] * dx + M[4] * dy + M[7] * dz, M[2] * dx + M[5] * dy + M[8] * dz, M[3] * dx + M[6] * dy + M[9] * dz
                    local ax, ay, az = c.hx - abs(lx), c.hy - abs(ly), c.hz - abs(lz)
                    if ax > 0 and ay > 0 and az > 0 then
                        local nx, ny, nz
                        if ay <= ax and ay <= az then
                            local s = ly >= 0 and 1 or -1
                            ly = s * (c.hy + 0.01); nx, ny, nz = M[2] * s, M[5] * s, M[8] * s
                        elseif ax <= az then
                            local s = lx >= 0 and 1 or -1
                            lx = s * (c.hx + 0.01); nx, ny, nz = M[1] * s, M[4] * s, M[7] * s
                        else
                            local s = lz >= 0 and 1 or -1
                            lz = s * (c.hz + 0.01); nx, ny, nz = M[3] * s, M[6] * s, M[9] * s
                        end
                        local qx = c.x + M[1] * lx + M[2] * ly + M[3] * lz
                        local qy = c.y + M[4] * lx + M[5] * ly + M[6] * lz
                        local qz = c.z + M[7] * lx + M[8] * ly + M[9] * lz
                        if not solidAt(qx, qy, qz) then px[p], py[p], pz[p] = qx, qy, qz end
                        local vn = vx[p] * nx + vy[p] * ny + vz[p] * nz
                        local en = c.vx * nx + c.vy * ny + c.vz * nz
                        if vn < en then vx[p], vy[p], vz[p] = vx[p] + nx * (en - vn), vy[p] + ny * (en - vn), vz[p] + nz * (en - vn) end
                        -- no-slip-ish skin: water touching the hull moves with it (the body's speed along the face)
                        vn = vx[p] * nx + vy[p] * ny + vz[p] * nz
                        local tx, ty, tz = vx[p] - nx * vn, vy[p] - ny * vn, vz[p] - nz * vn
                        local bx, by, bz = c.vx - nx * en, c.vy - ny * en, c.vz - nz * en
                        vx[p], vy[p], vz[p] = nx * vn + bx + (tx - bx) * 0.6, ny * vn + by + (ty - by) * 0.6, nz * vn + bz + (tz - bz) * 0.6
                        moved = true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        S.bodyPushed = moved
    end
    -- water pumps (g2p.comp pumpWater): water behind a powered pump is pulled toward it and jumps out of its front.
    -- S.pumps = {{lo = {x, y, z}, hi = {x, y, z}, shift = {x, y, z}, rate, speed}} (blocks, per second)
    local function pumpWater(dt)
        local pumps = S.pumps
        if not pumps or #pumps == 0 then return end
        for _, pm in ipairs(pumps) do
            local lo, hi, sh = pm.lo, pm.hi, pm.shift
            local l = sqrt(sh[1] * sh[1] + sh[2] * sh[2] + sh[3] * sh[3])
            local dx, dy, dz = sh[1] / l, sh[2] / l, sh[3] / l
            local w = hi[1] - lo[1]
            local bx, by, bz = -dx * w, -dy * w, -dz * w
            local plx, ply, plz = min(lo[1], lo[1] + bx), min(lo[2], lo[2] + by), min(lo[3], lo[3] + bz)
            local phx, phy, phz = max(hi[1], hi[1] + bx), max(hi[2], hi[2] + by), max(hi[3], hi[3] + bz)
            local fill = max(S.fills[bkey(floor((lo[1] + hi[1]) / 2), floor((lo[2] + hi[2]) / 2), floor((lo[3] + hi[3]) / 2))] or 0, 0.08)
            local chance = pm.rate * dt / fill
            local speed = pm.speed
            for p = 1, S.n do
                local x, y, z = px[p], py[p], pz[p]
                if x >= plx and x <= phx and y >= ply and y <= phy and z >= plz and z <= phz then
                    local along = vx[p] * dx + vy[p] * dy + vz[p] * dz
                    if along < 0.5 * speed then
                        local k = min(0.5 * speed - along, 3 * speed * dt)
                        vx[p], vy[p], vz[p] = vx[p] + dx * k, vy[p] + dy * k, vz[p] + dz * k
                    end
                    if x >= lo[1] and x <= hi[1] and y >= lo[2] and y <= hi[2] and z >= lo[3] and z <= hi[3] and random() < chance
                        and not solidAt(x + sh[1], y + sh[2], z + sh[3]) then
                        px[p], py[p], pz[p] = x + sh[1], y + sh[2], z + sh[3]
                        local a = vx[p] * dx + vy[p] * dy + vz[p] * dz
                        vx[p], vy[p], vz[p] = dx * speed + (vx[p] - dx * a) * 0.3, dy * speed + (vy[p] - dy * a) * 0.3, dz * speed + (vz[p] - dz * a) * 0.3
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    S.pushBodies = pushBodies

    -- heat (water): neighbourhood mixing, heat sources half a block away, boiling (BoilingWater / g2p.comp stepHeat)
    local function stepHeat(dt)
        local heatOf = hooks.heat
        if not heatOf or not P.heat then return end
        local rate, ambient = P.heatRate or 0.1, P.ambient or 20
        local targets = P.heatTargets or {300, 700, 450, 250}
        local reach = 0.5
        local probes = {{0, 0, 0}, {reach, 0, 0}, {-reach, 0, 0}, {0, reach, 0}, {0, -reach, 0}, {0, 0, reach}, {0, 0, -reach}}
        local sources = S.heatCache or {}
        S.heatCache = sources
        local boiled = 0
        for p = S.n, 1, -1 do
            local t = temp[p]
            local heated = false
            for q = 1, 7 do
                local o = probes[q]
                local bx, by, bz = floor(px[p] + o[1]), floor(py[p] + o[2]), floor(pz[p] + o[3])
                local k = bkey(bx, by, bz)
                local code = sources[k]
                if code == nil then code = heatOf(bx, by, bz) or false; sources[k] = code end
                if code and code >= 1 and code <= 4 then
                    t = t + (targets[code] - t) * (1 - exp(-rate * dt)); heated = true
                elseif code and code >= 5 then
                    t = t + (0 - t) * (1 - exp(-(P.iceCooling or 0.05) * dt))
                end
            end
            t = t + (ambient - t) * (1 - exp(-(1 / 3600) * dt))
            if t > 100 then
                local excess = t - 100
                t = 100
                vx[p] = vx[p] + (random() - 0.5) * (P.boilChurn or 6) * dt
                vy[p] = vy[p] + random() * (P.boilChurn or 6) * dt
                vz[p] = vz[p] + (random() - 0.5) * (P.boilChurn or 6) * dt
                if random() < excess / 540 then
                    local ev = S.events
                    ev[#ev + 1] = {"boil", px[p], py[p], pz[p]}
                    boiled = boiled + 1
                    remove(p)
                    t = nil
                end
            end
            if t then
                temp[p] = t
                if heated and t >= 85 then S.heated[bkey(floor(px[p]), floor(py[p]), floor(pz[p]))] = t end
                if t > (P.wispTemperature or 60) and random() < 0.05 * (t - 60) / 40 * dt then
                    local ev = S.events
                    ev[#ev + 1] = {"wisp", px[p], py[p], pz[p]}
                end
            end
        end
        if boiled > 0 then S.wake() end
    end

    -- springs keep their block about sourceFill full
    local function feedSprings()
        S.fed = false
        local want = (P.sourceFill or 0.9) * PER_BLOCK
        for _, s in pairs(S.springs) do
            local have = S.blockCount[bkey(s[1], s[2], s[3])] or 0
            local missing = floor(want - have)
            if missing > 0 then
                missing = min(missing, PPC * R * R)
                for _ = 1, missing do
                    add(s[1] + random(), s[2] + 0.5 + random() * 0.5, s[3] + random(), 0, -0.5, 0)
                end
                S.fed = true
                S.wake()
            end
        end
    end

    -- per-block counts -> fills; lone drops dry up
    local function countBlocks(dt)
        local counts = {}
        for p = 1, S.n do
            local k = bkey(floor(px[p]), floor(py[p]), floor(pz[p]))
            counts[k] = (counts[k] or 0) + 1
        end
        S.blockCount = counts
        local fills = {}
        for k, c in pairs(counts) do fills[k] = c / PER_BLOCK end
        S.fills = fills
        -- stranded: fewer than strandedNeighbors particles in the block and its 6 neighbours
        local need = P.strandedNeighbors or 3
        local life = P.strandedTime or 1.5
        for p = S.n, 1, -1 do
            local bx, by, bz = floor(px[p]), floor(py[p]), floor(pz[p])
            local around = (counts[bkey(bx, by, bz)] or 0)
            if around < need then
                around = around + (counts[bkey(bx + 1, by, bz)] or 0) + (counts[bkey(bx - 1, by, bz)] or 0) + (counts[bkey(bx, by - 1, bz)] or 0)
                    + (counts[bkey(bx, by + 1, bz)] or 0) + (counts[bkey(bx, by, bz + 1)] or 0) + (counts[bkey(bx, by, bz - 1)] or 0)
            end
            if around < need then
                strand[p] = strand[p] + dt
                if strand[p] > life then remove(p) end
            else
                strand[p] = 0
            end
        end
    end

    -- connected bodies: union of occupied blocks (26-neighbourhood); particles reordered so each body is one range
    function S.cluster()
        local n = S.n
        if n == 0 then return {} end
        local parent = {}
        local blockOf = {}
        local function find(k)
            local r = k
            while parent[r] ~= r do r = parent[r] end
            while parent[k] ~= r do local nk = parent[k]; parent[k] = r; k = nk end
            return r
        end
        for p = 1, n do
            local k = bkey(floor(px[p]), floor(py[p]), floor(pz[p]))
            blockOf[p] = k
            if parent[k] == nil then parent[k] = k end
        end
        for k in pairs(parent) do
            for dz = -1, 1 do for dy = -1, 1 do for dx = -1, 1 do
                if dx ~= 0 or dy ~= 0 or dz ~= 0 then
                    local k2 = k + dx + dy * 131072 + dz * 17179869184
                    if parent[k2] ~= nil then
                        local a, b = find(k), find(k2)
                        if a ~= b then parent[a] = b end
                    end
                end
            end end end
        end
        local groups, order = {}, {}
        for p = 1, n do
            local r = find(blockOf[p])
            local g = groups[r]
            if not g then g = {}; groups[r] = g; order[#order + 1] = r end
            g[#g + 1] = p
        end
        if #order == 1 then return {{1, n}} end
        local ax, ay, az, avx, avy, avz, at, as = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
        local ranges, q = {}, 0
        for _, r in ipairs(order) do
            local first = q + 1
            for _, p in ipairs(groups[r]) do
                q = q + 1
                ax[q], ay[q], az[q], avx[q], avy[q], avz[q], at[q], as[q] = px[p], py[p], pz[p], vx[p], vy[p], vz[p], temp[p], strand[p]
            end
            ranges[#ranges + 1] = {first, q}
        end
        for i = 1, n do px[i], py[i], pz[i], vx[i], vy[i], vz[i], temp[i], strand[i] = ax[i], ay[i], az[i], avx[i], avy[i], avz[i], at[i], as[i] end
        return ranges
    end

    -- one frame: substeps by speed (CFL), sleep when calm
    function S.step(dt)
        S.stepping = true
        local okStep, errStep = pcall(S.stepInner, dt)
        S.stepping = false
        local pending = S.pending
        S.pending = {}
        for _, fn in ipairs(pending) do pcall(fn) end
        if not okStep then error(errStep, 0) end
    end
    function S.stepInner(dt)
        S.events = {}
        S.heated = {}
        solidAge = solidAge + dt
        if solidAge > 2 then solidAge = 0; solidCache = {}; fineCache = {}; S.heatCache = {} end
        feedSprings()
        if S.n == 0 then S.fills, S.blockCount = {}, {}; return end
        -- a pump with water at its intake, or a body moving through the fluid, keeps it awake
        for _, pm in ipairs(S.pumps or {}) do
            local c = S.fills[bkey(floor((pm.lo[1] + pm.hi[1]) / 2), floor((pm.lo[2] + pm.hi[2]) / 2), floor((pm.lo[3] + pm.hi[3]) / 2))]
            if c and c > 0.02 then S.awake = true; S.calm = 0 end
        end
        for _, c in ipairs(S.bodyCells or {}) do
            if abs(c.vx) + abs(c.vy) + abs(c.vz) > 1.0 then S.awake = true; S.calm = 0; break end
        end
        if not S.awake then return end
        local cfl = P.cfl or 1
        local maxDt = P.maxDt or 0.025
        local speed = max(S.fastest or 1, 1)
        local steps = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt / min(maxDt, cfl * H / speed)))
        steps = min(steps, P.maxSteps or 3)
        local sdt = dt / steps
        S.stepFastest, S.stepSum, S.stepCount = 0, 0, 0
        for _ = 1, steps do
            -- separate bodies (blocks not touching) are solved in their own small grids
            local ranges = S.cluster()
            if S.yieldCheck then S.yieldCheck() end
            for _, rg in ipairs(ranges) do substep(sdt, rg[1], rg[2]) end
            pushEntities()
            pushBodies()
            pumpWater(sdt)
            if S.yieldCheck then S.yieldCheck() end
        end
        S.fastest = S.stepFastest
        S.mean = S.stepSum / math.max(S.stepCount, 1)
        stepHeat(dt)
        countBlocks(dt)
        S.steps = S.steps + 1
        -- sleeping (fluidRestSpeed / fluidRestTime)
        if (S.mean or 0) < (P.restSpeed or 0.15) and not S.fed then
            S.calm = S.calm + dt
            if S.calm > (P.restTime or 1.5) then S.awake = false end
        else
            S.calm = 0
        end
    end
    -- the box the grid covered last step (cells), for debugging
    function S.box() return ox, oy, oz, nx, ny, nz end
    S.add, S.remove, S.addBlock, S.removeBlock = deferred(S.add), deferred(S.remove), deferred(S.addBlock), deferred(S.removeBlock)
    return S
end
return createFluidSim

end)()
local buildFluidMesh = (function()
-- Realistic Water - the fluid surface (the original's SurfaceMesher + nets_vertices / nets_quads: surface nets).
-- Each particle adds a smooth bump (kernel (1 - d^2/r^2)^3) to a voxel grid finer than the simulation; the surface is
-- where that field crosses `iso`. Surface nets put one vertex in every voxel the surface passes through (the average
-- of its edge crossings) and one quad across every grid edge the surface cuts, so the mesh is smooth, closed and light.
-- Normals come from the field's gradient. Quads whose edge lies inside a solid block are skipped (the underside of a
-- puddle, the sides against a wall), and points inside walls next to the fluid are filled so the water meets the wall.
--   local mesh = buildFluidMesh(px, py, pz, n, {res = 3, radius = 1.6, iso = 0.5, norm = k, solid = fn(bx, by, bz)})
--   -> {verts = {x, y, z, ...}, normals = {x, y, z, ...}, tris = {a, b, c, ...}, nv, nt}
local function slicer(opt)
    local yf = opt.yield
    if not yf then return function() end end
    local clock = os.clock
    local start = clock()
    return function()
        if clock() - start > 0.005 then yf(); start = clock() end
    end
end
local function buildFluidMesh(px, py, pz, n, opt)
    local floor, ceil, sqrt, max = math.floor, math.ceil, math.sqrt, math.max
    local slice = slicer(opt)
    local M = opt.res or 3
    local r = opt.radius or 1.6
    local iso = opt.iso or 0.5
    local norm = opt.norm or 1
    local r2 = r * r
    if n == 0 then return nil end
    local minx, miny, minz, maxx, maxy, maxz = math.huge, math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
    for i = 1, n do
        local x, y, z = px[i] * M, py[i] * M, pz[i] * M
        if x < minx then minx = x end; if x > maxx then maxx = x end
        if y < miny then miny = y end; if y > maxy then maxy = y end
        if z < minz then minz = z end; if z > maxz then maxz = z end
    end
    local pad = ceil(r) + 2
    local ox, oy, oz = floor(minx) - pad, floor(miny) - pad, floor(minz) - pad
    local sx, sy, sz = floor(maxx) + pad + 2 - ox, floor(maxy) + pad + 2 - oy, floor(maxz) + pad + 2 - oz
    local sxy = sx * sy
    local field = {}
    for c = 1, sx * sy * sz do field[c] = 0 end
    for i = 1, n do
        if i % 32 == 0 then slice() end
        local x, y, z = px[i] * M - ox, py[i] * M - oy, pz[i] * M - oz
        local i0, i1 = ceil(x - r), floor(x + r)
        local j0, j1 = ceil(y - r), floor(y + r)
        local k0, k1 = ceil(z - r), floor(z + r)
        for k = k0, k1 do
            local dz = k - z
            local dz2 = dz * dz
            for j = j0, j1 do
                local dy = j - y
                local dyz = dy * dy + dz2
                if dyz < r2 then
                    local row = j * sx + k * sxy + 1
                    for ii = i0, i1 do
                        local dx = ii - x
                        local d2 = dx * dx + dyz
                        if d2 < r2 then
                            local s = 1 - d2 / r2
                            local c = row + ii
                            field[c] = field[c] + s * s * s * norm
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- surfaceSmoothing: a [1 2 1] / 4 blur along each axis, so the surface reads as smooth liquid, not particle bumps
    local passes = opt.smooth or 1
    if passes > 0 then
        local tmp = {}
        local nAll = sx * sy * sz
        for _ = 1, passes do
            for _, d in ipairs({1, sx, sxy}) do
                slice()
                for c = 1, nAll do
                    if c % 4096 == 0 then slice() end
                    local a, b = field[c - d], field[c + d]
                    tmp[c] = (field[c] * 2 + (a or field[c]) + (b or field[c])) * 0.25
                end
                field, tmp = tmp, field
            end
        end
    end
    -- solid lookups per block (cached for this build)
    local solid = opt.solid
    local solidHit = {}
    local function solidAt(gx, gy, gz)
        if not solid then return false end
        local bx, by, bz = floor((gx + ox) / M), floor((gy + oy) / M), floor((gz + oz) / M)
        local key = (bx + 65536) + (by + 65536) * 131072 + (bz + 65536) * 17179869184
        local s = solidHit[key]
        if s == nil then s = solid(bx, by, bz) and true or false; solidHit[key] = s end
        return s
    end
    -- walls: a point inside a solid block next to fluid takes its neighbours' value (the surface reaches the wall)
    if solid then
        local fills = {}
        for k = 1, sz - 2 do slice(); for j = 1, sy - 2 do for i = 1, sx - 2 do
            local c = i + j * sx + k * sxy + 1
            if field[c] < iso then
                local best = max(field[c - 1], field[c + 1], field[c - sx], field[c + sx], field[c - sxy], field[c + sxy])
                if best >= iso and solidAt(i, j, k) then fills[#fills + 1] = c; fills[#fills + 1] = best end
            end
        end end end
        for q = 1, #fills, 2 do field[fills[q]] = fills[q + 1] end
    end
    -- vertices: one per voxel (cube between points) the surface passes through
    local verts, normals, tris = {}, {}, {}
    local vid = {}
    local nv, nt = 0, 0
    local CX = {0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1}
    local CY = {0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 1}
    local CZ = {0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1}
    local EDGES = {{1, 2}, {3, 4}, {5, 6}, {7, 8}, {1, 3}, {2, 4}, {5, 7}, {6, 8}, {1, 5}, {2, 6}, {3, 7}, {4, 8}}
    local CO = {}
    for q = 1, 8 do CO[q] = CX[q] + CY[q] * sx + CZ[q] * sxy end
    local fv = {}
    for k = 1, sz - 3 do slice(); for j = 1, sy - 3 do for i = 1, sx - 3 do
        local base = i + j * sx + k * sxy + 1
        local mask = 0
        for q = 1, 8 do
            local f = field[base + CO[q]]
            fv[q] = f
            if f > iso then mask = mask + 1 end
        end
        if mask > 0 and mask < 8 then
            local ax, ay, az, cnt = 0, 0, 0, 0
            for e = 1, 12 do
                local a, b = EDGES[e][1], EDGES[e][2]
                local fa, fb = fv[a], fv[b]
                if (fa > iso) ~= (fb > iso) then
                    local t = (iso - fa) / (fb - fa)
                    ax = ax + CX[a] + (CX[b] - CX[a]) * t
                    ay = ay + CY[a] + (CY[b] - CY[a]) * t
                    az = az + CZ[a] + (CZ[b] - CZ[a]) * t
                    cnt = cnt + 1
                end
            end
            ax, ay, az = ax / cnt, ay / cnt, az / cnt
            -- gradient (trilinear over the cube's corner differences), pointing out of the fluid
            local gx = (fv[1] - fv[2]) * (1 - ay) * (1 - az) + (fv[3] - fv[4]) * ay * (1 - az) + (fv[5] - fv[6]) * (1 - ay) * az + (fv[7] - fv[8]) * ay * az
            local gy = (fv[1] - fv[3]) * (1 - ax) * (1 - az) + (fv[2] - fv[4]) * ax * (1 - az) + (fv[5] - fv[7]) * (1 - ax) * az + (fv[6] - fv[8]) * ax * az
            local gz = (fv[1] - fv[5]) * (1 - ax) * (1 - ay) + (fv[2] - fv[6]) * ax * (1 - ay) + (fv[3] - fv[7]) * (1 - ax) * ay + (fv[4] - fv[8]) * ax * ay
            local l = sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy + gz * gz)
            if l > 1e-9 then gx, gy, gz = gx / l, gy / l, gz / l else gx, gy, gz = 0, 1, 0 end
            nv = nv + 1
            local o = nv * 3
            verts[o - 2], verts[o - 1], verts[o] = (i + ax + ox) / M, (j + ay + oy) / M, (k + az + oz) / M
            normals[o - 2], normals[o - 1], normals[o] = gx, gy, gz
            vid[base] = nv
        end
    end end end
    -- quads: across every grid edge with a sign change (the 4 voxels around the edge); skipped inside solids
    local function quad(a, b, c, d, flip)
        if not (a and b and c and d) then return end
        if not flip then a, b, c, d = a, d, c, b end
        nt = nt + 6
        tris[nt - 5], tris[nt - 4], tris[nt - 3] = a, b, c
        tris[nt - 2], tris[nt - 1], tris[nt] = a, c, d
    end
    for k = 2, sz - 3 do slice(); for j = 2, sy - 3 do for i = 2, sx - 3 do
        local c = i + j * sx + k * sxy + 1
        local f0 = field[c]
        local in0 = f0 > iso
        -- x edge (c -> c+1): voxels around it are (j-1..j, k-1..k)
        local f1 = field[c + 1]
        if in0 ~= (f1 > iso) and not solidAt(i + 0.5, j, k) then
            quad(vid[c], vid[c - sx], vid[c - sx - sxy], vid[c - sxy], in0)
        end
        f1 = field[c + sx]
        if in0 ~= (f1 > iso) and not solidAt(i, j + 0.5, k) then
            quad(vid[c], vid[c - sxy], vid[c - 1 - sxy], vid[c - 1], in0)
        end
        f1 = field[c + sxy]
        if in0 ~= (f1 > iso) and not solidAt(i, j, k + 0.5) then
            quad(vid[c], vid[c - 1], vid[c - 1 - sx], vid[c - sx], in0)
        end
    end end end
    -- optional relaxation (falling water, drops): Laplacian smoothing pulls the voxel-sized facets into round blobs and
    -- smooth streams; normals are then taken from the smoothed faces (turned to agree with the field gradient)
    local iters = opt.relax or 0
    if iters > 0 and nv > 0 then
        local adj = {}
        for q = 1, nt, 3 do
            local a, b, c = tris[q], tris[q + 1], tris[q + 2]
            for _, e in ipairs({{a, b}, {b, c}, {c, a}}) do
                local l = adj[e[1]]; if not l then l = {}; adj[e[1]] = l end; l[e[2]] = true
                l = adj[e[2]]; if not l then l = {}; adj[e[2]] = l end; l[e[1]] = true
            end
        end
        -- Taubin: a smoothing step (+0.5) then an inflating one (-0.53), so thin streams keep their thickness
        for it = 1, iters * 2 do
            local lam = it % 2 == 1 and 0.5 or -0.53
            local nvp = {}
            for v = 1, nv do
                local l = adj[v]
                local o = v * 3
                if l then
                    local sx2, sy2, sz2, c = 0, 0, 0, 0
                    for u in pairs(l) do local p2 = u * 3; sx2, sy2, sz2, c = sx2 + verts[p2 - 2], sy2 + verts[p2 - 1], sz2 + verts[p2], c + 1 end
                    nvp[o - 2] = verts[o - 2] + (sx2 / c - verts[o - 2]) * lam
                    nvp[o - 1] = verts[o - 1] + (sy2 / c - verts[o - 1]) * lam
                    nvp[o] = verts[o] + (sz2 / c - verts[o]) * lam
                else
                    nvp[o - 2], nvp[o - 1], nvp[o] = verts[o - 2], verts[o - 1], verts[o]
                end
            end
            verts = nvp
        end
        local acc = {}
        for q = 1, nt, 3 do
            local a, b, c = tris[q] * 3, tris[q + 1] * 3, tris[q + 2] * 3
            local ux, uy, uz = verts[b - 2] - verts[a - 2], verts[b - 1] - verts[a - 1], verts[b] - verts[a]
            local vx, vy, vz = verts[c - 2] - verts[a - 2], verts[c - 1] - verts[a - 1], verts[c] - verts[a]
            local fx, fy, fz = uy * vz - uz * vy, uz * vx - ux * vz, ux * vy - uy * vx
            for _, o in ipairs({a, b, c}) do acc[o - 2] = (acc[o - 2] or 0) + fx; acc[o - 1] = (acc[o - 1] or 0) + fy; acc[o] = (acc[o] or 0) + fz end
        end
        for v = 1, nv do
            local o = v * 3
            local fx, fy, fz = acc[o - 2] or 0, acc[o - 1] or 0, acc[o] or 0
            local l = sqrt(fx * fx + fy * fy + fz * fz)
            if l > 1e-12 then
                fx, fy, fz = fx / l, fy / l, fz / l
                if fx * normals[o - 2] + fy * normals[o - 1] + fz * normals[o] < 0 then fx, fy, fz = -fx, -fy, -fz end
                normals[o - 2], normals[o - 1], normals[o] = fx, fy, fz
            end
        end
    end
    return {verts = verts, normals = normals, tris = tris, nv = nv, nt = nt / 3}
end
-- Thin water (puddles, sheets spreading over a floor): too thin for the surface above, drawn like the original's film
-- (filmDepth / filmShading): a smooth height sheet over the floor. Each particle's volume is spread over nearby
-- columns (0.25-block cells, a 3x3 tent); a cell with water on top of a solid block gets a sheet at floor + depth.
--   buildFluidFilm(px, py, pz, n, {volume = blocks per particle, solid = fn, maxDepth = 0.35}) -> same mesh format
local function buildFluidFilm(px, py, pz, n, opt)
    local floor, sqrt = math.floor, math.sqrt
    local slice = slicer(opt)
    local C = 4                                 -- cells per block
    local vol = opt.volume or (1 / 32)
    local maxDepth = opt.maxDepth or 0.35
    local solid = opt.solid
    local cellArea = 1 / (C * C)
    local depth, floorY = {}, {}
    local solidHit = {}
    local function solidAt(bx, by, bz)
        local key = (bx + 65536) + (by + 65536) * 131072 + (bz + 65536) * 17179869184
        local s = solidHit[key]
        if s == nil then s = solid and solid(bx, by, bz) and true or false; solidHit[key] = s end
        return s
    end
    -- each particle's volume spread over a disc of radius SPREAD blocks, weights (1 - d^2/r^2)^2, normalised
    local SPREAD = opt.spread or 0.65
    local RC = math.ceil(SPREAD * C)
    local offs, wsum = {}, 0
    for dz = -RC, RC do for dx = -RC, RC do
        local d2 = ((dx) / C) ^ 2 + ((dz) / C) ^ 2
        if d2 < SPREAD * SPREAD then
            local w = (1 - d2 / (SPREAD * SPREAD)) ^ 2
            offs[#offs + 1] = {dx, dz, w}
            wsum = wsum + w
        end
    end end
    for _, o in ipairs(offs) do o[3] = o[3] / wsum end
    for i = 1, n do
        if i % 32 == 0 then slice() end
        local y = py[i]
        local by = floor(y)
        local bxs, bzs = floor(px[i]), floor(pz[i])
        -- on top of a floor: the block under this particle's block is solid, or it is in the bottom of its block
        local fy = nil
        if solidAt(bxs, by - 1, bzs) then fy = by elseif y - by < 0.05 and solidAt(bxs, by - 1, bzs) then fy = by end
        if fy and y - fy < maxDepth + 0.2 then
            local cx, cz = floor(px[i] * C), floor(pz[i] * C)
            for _, o in ipairs(offs) do
                local key = (cx + o[1]) .. "," .. fy .. "," .. (cz + o[2])
                depth[key] = (depth[key] or 0) + vol * o[3] / cellArea
            end
        end
    end
    -- contour (marching squares) over the corner depths: smooth puddle edges, one-cell gaps closed
    local THR = opt.threshold or 0.02
    local verts, normals, tris = {}, {}, {}
    local nv, nt = 0, 0
    local cornerCache = {}
    local function cornerDepth(gx, fy, gz)
        local key = gx .. "," .. fy .. "," .. gz
        local d = cornerCache[key]
        if d then return d end
        local s = 0
        for dz = -1, 0 do for dx = -1, 0 do s = s + (depth[(gx + dx) .. "," .. fy .. "," .. (gz + dz)] or 0) end end
        d = s / 4
        cornerCache[key] = d
        return d
    end
    local vid = {}
    local function cornerVertex(gx, fy, gz)
        local key = gx .. "," .. fy .. "," .. gz
        local id = vid[key]
        if id then return id end
        local d = cornerDepth(gx, fy, gz)
        local h = fy + 0.004 + math.min(d, maxDepth)
        local nx, ny, nz = (cornerDepth(gx - 1, fy, gz) - cornerDepth(gx + 1, fy, gz)) * C * 0.5, 1, (cornerDepth(gx, fy, gz - 1) - cornerDepth(gx, fy, gz + 1)) * C * 0.5
        local l = sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz)
        nv = nv + 1
        local o = nv * 3
        verts[o - 2], verts[o - 1], verts[o] = gx / C, h, gz / C
        normals[o - 2], normals[o - 1], normals[o] = nx / l, ny / l, nz / l
        vid[key] = nv
        return nv
    end
    local edgeVid = {}
    local function edgeVertex(ax, az, bx, bz, fy, da, db)
        local k1, k2 = ax .. "," .. az, bx .. "," .. bz
        local key = (k1 < k2 and k1 .. "|" .. k2 or k2 .. "|" .. k1) .. "|" .. fy
        local id = edgeVid[key]
        if id then return id end
        local f = (THR - da) / (db - da)
        nv = nv + 1
        local o = nv * 3
        verts[o - 2], verts[o - 1], verts[o] = (ax + (bx - ax) * f) / C, fy + 0.004 + THR, (az + (bz - az) * f) / C
        normals[o - 2], normals[o - 1], normals[o] = 0, 1, 0
        edgeVid[key] = nv
        return nv
    end
    local done = {}
    local count = 0
    for key in pairs(depth) do
        count = count + 1
        if count % 64 == 0 then slice() end
        local cx, fy, cz = key:match("^(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+)$")
        cx, fy, cz = tonumber(cx), tonumber(fy), tonumber(cz)
        if not done[key] then
            done[key] = true
            local bx, bz = floor(cx / C), floor(cz / C)
            if not solidAt(bx, fy, bz) and solidAt(bx, fy - 1, bz) then
                -- the square's corners in order: (cx,cz) (cx,cz+1) (cx+1,cz+1) (cx+1,cz) (counter-clockwise seen from +y)
                local P = {{cx, cz}, {cx, cz + 1}, {cx + 1, cz + 1}, {cx + 1, cz}}
                local D, inside, nin = {}, {}, 0
                for q = 1, 4 do
                    D[q] = cornerDepth(P[q][1], fy, P[q][2])
                    inside[q] = D[q] > THR and D[q] < maxDepth * 1.5
                    if inside[q] then nin = nin + 1 end
                end
                if nin > 0 then
                    local poly = {}
                    for q = 1, 4 do
                        local q2 = q % 4 + 1
                        if inside[q] then poly[#poly + 1] = cornerVertex(P[q][1], fy, P[q][2]) end
                        if inside[q] ~= inside[q2] then
                            poly[#poly + 1] = edgeVertex(P[q][1], P[q][2], P[q2][1], P[q2][2], fy, D[q], D[q2])
                        end
                    end
                    for q = 2, #poly - 1 do
                        nt = nt + 3
                        tris[nt - 2], tris[nt - 1], tris[nt] = poly[1], poly[q], poly[q + 1]
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return {verts = verts, normals = normals, tris = tris, nv = nv, nt = nt / 3}
end
return {surface = buildFluidMesh, film = buildFluidFilm}

end)()
local createFluidSheet = (function()
-- Realistic Water - the pooled surface (what the original renders every frame on the GPU).
-- Water that rests on a floor is drawn as a height sheet over 0.25-block cells: each particle's volume is spread over
-- the cells around it, so a column's depth is the water volume standing on it (a steady, flat surface, never particle
-- bumps). The sheet's shape (which cells are wet, its contour) is rebuilt a few times a second; its HEIGHTS follow the
-- simulation every step and are interpolated every rendered frame, so waves move at the game's frame rate.
-- Particles flying above the sheet (falls, splashes) are reported back as "airborne" for the 3D surface.
--   local sheet = createFluidSheet({solid = fn, volume = blocks per particle, B = studs per block, studs = fn})
--   sheet.update(px, py, pz, n) -> airborne list   (each simulation step)
--   sheet.frame()                                   (every rendered frame)
--   sheet.rebuild(look, parent, yield)              (topology, a few times a second; yields)
local function createFluidSheet(opt)
    local floor, sqrt, min, max = math.floor, math.sqrt, math.min, math.max
    local C = 4
    local cellArea = 1 / (C * C)
    local solid, vol, B = opt.solid, opt.volume, opt.B
    local THR = 0.045   -- thinner than this is not drawn (a near-dry floor otherwise breaks into specks)
    local S = {cur = {}, prev = {}, stepAt = os.clock(), stepLen = 0.05}
    -- numeric keys: cell (cx, cz) at floor level fy
    local function ck(cx, cz, fy) return (cx + 262144) + (cz + 262144) * 524288 + (fy + 512) * 274877906944 end
    S.ck = ck
    -- spread disc (radius 0.55 block)
    local SPREAD = 0.55
    local RC = math.ceil(SPREAD * C)
    local offs, wsum = {}, 0
    for dz = -RC, RC do for dx = -RC, RC do
        local d2 = (dx / C) ^ 2 + (dz / C) ^ 2
        if d2 < SPREAD * SPREAD then local w = (1 - d2 / (SPREAD * SPREAD)) ^ 2; offs[#offs + 1] = {dx, dz, w}; wsum = wsum + w end
    end end
    for _, o in ipairs(offs) do o[3] = o[3] / wsum * vol / cellArea end
    -- the floor under a block: the first solid block below (up to 8 down); nil over a drop
    local floorCache, floorAge = {}, 0
    local function floorOf(bx, by, bz)
        local k = (bx + 65536) + (by + 65536) * 131072 + (bz + 65536) * 17179869184
        local f = floorCache[k]
        if f == nil then
            f = false
            if not solid(bx, by, bz) then
                for y = by, by - 8, -1 do if solid(bx, y - 1, bz) then f = y; break end end
            end
            floorCache[k] = f
        end
        return f or nil
    end
    -- the floor under a quarter-block cell, at quarter-block precision (opt.solidQ): steps and slabs that are not whole
    -- blocks are where the water really lies. Scans down from quarter cell qy; nil over a drop (16 quarters).
    local fineCache = {}
    local function floorAt(cx, cz, qy)
        local sq = opt.solidQ
        if not sq then return nil end
        local k = (cx + 131072) + (cz + 131072) * 262144 + (qy + 16384) * 68719476736
        local f = fineCache[k]
        if f == nil then
            f = false
            for q = qy, qy - 16, -1 do if sq(cx, q, cz) then f = (q + 1) / 4; break end end
            fineCache[k] = f
        end
        return f or nil
    end
    S.floorAt = floorAt
    -- a cell's floor height (blocks) for layer fy: what the particles found, else the scan, else the layer itself
    local cellFloor = {}
    S.cellFloor = cellFloor
    local function floorOfCell(cx, cz, fy)
        local f = cellFloor[ck(cx, cz, fy)]
        if f then return f end
        if opt.solidQ then
            f = floorAt(cx, cz, (fy + 1) * 4 - 1)
            if f and f >= fy - 0.01 and f <= fy + 1 then return f end
        end
        return fy
    end
    S.floorOfCell = floorOfCell
    -- a wall for water whose floor is at height h: the quarter cell just above h is solid
    local function wallFine(cx, cz, h)
        if not opt.solidQ then return nil end
        return opt.solidQ(cx, floor((h + 0.15) * 4), cz)
    end
    function S.invalidate() floorCache = {}; fineCache = {} end
    -- the water surface's height (blocks) over (x, z) for something at height y, or nil where there is no pool
    function S.surfaceAt(x, y, z)
        local depth = S.depth
        if not (depth and opt.solidQ) then return nil end
        local cx, cz = floor(x * C), floor(z * C)
        local fh = floorAt(cx, cz, floor(y * 4))
        if not fh then return nil end
        local k = ck(cx, cz, floor(fh + 1e-4))
        local d = depth[k]
        if not d or d <= THR then return nil end
        return (cellFloor[k] or fh) + d
    end

    -- one simulation step: depths per cell, airborne particles
    function S.update(px, py, pz, n)
        floorAge = floorAge + 1
        if floorAge > 40 then floorAge = 0; floorCache = {}; fineCache = {} end
        local depth = {}
        local top = {}
        local pf, pk, ph = {}, {}, {}
        cellFloor = {}
        S.cellFloor = cellFloor
        for i = 1, n do
            local cx, cz = floor(px[i] * C), floor(pz[i] * C)
            local fy, fh
            if opt.solidQ then
                fh = floorAt(cx, cz, floor(py[i] * 4))
                if fh then fy = floor(fh + 1e-4) end
            else
                fy = floorOf(floor(px[i]), floor(py[i]), floor(pz[i]))
                fh = fy
            end
            if fy then
                pf[i], ph[i] = fy, fh
                pk[i] = ck(cx, cz, fy)
                local own = pk[i]
                if not cellFloor[own] or fh > cellFloor[own] then cellFloor[own] = fh end
                for q = 1, #offs do
                    local o = offs[q]
                    local nx2, nz2 = cx + o[1], cz + o[2]
                    local k = ck(nx2, nz2, fy)
                    local f = cellFloor[k]
                    if f == nil and opt.solidQ then
                        -- the neighbour's floor: a riser above this water is a wall (no water spread onto it); a drop keeps
                        -- this floor (the water's edge hangs over it)
                        if wallFine(nx2, nz2, fh) then f = false
                        else
                            local g = floorAt(nx2, nz2, floor((fh + 0.1) * 4))
                            f = (g and g > fh - 0.6) and g or fh
                        end
                        cellFloor[k] = f
                    end
                    if f ~= false then
                        depth[k] = (depth[k] or 0) + o[3]
                        local h = py[i] - (f or fh)
                        if h > (top[k] or -1) then top[k] = h end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for k, f in pairs(cellFloor) do if f == false then cellFloor[k] = nil end end
        -- particles well above their column's water are falling / splashing: not part of the pool
        local airborne = {}
        for i = 1, n do
            local fy = pf[i]
            if not fy or (py[i] - ph[i] > math.max((S.depth and S.depth[pk[i]]) or 0, 0.2) + 0.45 and not (opt.near and opt.near(floor(px[i]), floor(py[i]), floor(pz[i])))) then
                airborne[#airborne + 1] = i
                if fy then
                    local cx, cz = floor(px[i] * C), floor(pz[i] * C)
                    for q = 1, #offs do
                        local o = offs[q]
                        local k = ck(cx + o[1], cz + o[2], fy)
                        depth[k] = (depth[k] or 0) - o[3]
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        -- packed water (a pump's outlet, a crowded corner) is not deeper than its highest particle
        for k, d in pairs(depth) do
            local t0 = top[k]
            if t0 and d > t0 + 0.3 then depth[k] = t0 + 0.3 end
        end
        -- water reaches the walls: an empty cell between wet water and a wall (within half a block) takes the water's depth
        do
            local fills = {}
            local wallC = {}
            local function wallAt(cx, cz, fy)
                if opt.solidQ then
                    local k = ck(cx, cz, fy)
                    local w = wallC[k]
                    if w == nil then w = wallFine(cx, cz, floorOfCell(cx, cz, fy)) and true or false; wallC[k] = w end
                    return w
                end
                local bx, bz = floor(cx / C), floor(cz / C)
                local k = ck(bx, bz, fy)
                local w = wallC[k]
                if w == nil then w = solid(bx, fy, bz) and true or false; wallC[k] = w end
                return w
            end
            for key, d in pairs(depth) do
                if d > THR then
                    local fy = floor(key / 274877906944) - 512
                    local rest = key - (fy + 512) * 274877906944
                    local cz = floor(rest / 524288) - 262144
                    local cx = rest % 524288 - 262144
                    for _, o in ipairs({{1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1}}) do
                        for step = 1, 2 do
                            local nx2, nz2 = cx + o[1] * step, cz + o[2] * step
                            if wallAt(nx2, nz2, fy) then
                                -- fill the cells between this one and the wall
                                for s2 = 1, step - 1 do
                                    local k2 = ck(cx + o[1] * s2, cz + o[2] * s2, fy)
                                    if (depth[k2] or 0) < d then fills[k2] = math.max(fills[k2] or 0, d) end
                                end
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            for k, d in pairs(fills) do depth[k] = d end
        end
        -- smoothing (sand): one [1 2 1] pass along x and along z, so pile edges are round instead of cell steps
        if opt.blur then
            for _, axis in ipairs({1, 524288}) do
                local out = {}
                for k, d in pairs(depth) do
                    if d > 0 then
                        out[k] = (out[k] or 0) + d * 0.5
                        out[k - axis] = (out[k - axis] or 0) + d * 0.25
                        out[k + axis] = (out[k + axis] or 0) + d * 0.25
                    end
                end
                depth = out
            end
        end
        -- smoothing (water, lava): normalised [1 2 1] passes over the wet cells only, so the uneven packing of the particles
        -- does not show as spikes and nothing bleeds into the walls
        for _ = 1, opt.smooth or 0 do
            for _, axis in ipairs({1, 524288}) do
                local out = {}
                for k, d in pairs(depth) do
                    if d > 0 then
                        local s, w = d * 2, 2
                        local l, r = depth[k - axis], depth[k + axis]
                        if l and l > 0 then s, w = s + l, w + 1 end
                        if r and r > 0 then s, w = s + r, w + 1 end
                        out[k] = s / w
                    end
                end
                depth = out
            end
        end
        local now = os.clock()
        S.stepLen = S.stepLen * 0.7 + math.clamp(now - S.stepAt, 0.02, 0.2) * 0.3
        S.stepAt = now
        S.depth = depth
        -- the current sheet's corners: previous target -> new target
        local T = S.topo
        if T then
            for _, c in ipairs(T.corners) do
                c.prev = c.cur
                local s, cells = 0, c.cells
                for q = 1, #cells do s = s + max(depth[cells[q]] or 0, 0) end
                c.cur = #cells > 0 and s / #cells or 0
            end
            T.normalsDirty = true
        end
        return airborne
    end

    -- every frame: heights interpolated between the last two steps
    function S.frame()
        local T = S.topo
        if not (T and T.em) then return end
        local now = os.clock()
        local a = min((now - S.stepAt) / S.stepLen, 1)
        local em = T.em
        local cx0, cy0, cz0 = T.cx, T.cy, T.cz
        for _, c in ipairs(T.corners) do
            local d = c.prev + (c.cur - c.prev) * a
            c.now = d
            em:SetPosition(c.vid, Vector3.new(c.x * B - cx0, ((c.fl or c.fy) + 0.004 + d - 0.5) * B - cy0, c.z * B - cz0))
        end
        if T.normalsDirty or (opt.ripples and now - (T.normalAt or 0) >= 1 / 30) then
            T.normalAt = now
            T.normalsDirty = false
            for _, c in ipairs(T.corners) do
                local function nd(n) if n then return (n.fl or n.fy) + (n.now or n.cur) end return (c.fl or c.fy) + c.now end
                local dx = nd(c.w) - nd(c.e)
                local dz = nd(c.n) - nd(c.s)
                local nx, nz = dx * C * 0.5, dz * C * 0.5
                -- Small travelling normal waves, adapted from composite.frag. Keep the
                -- volume/collision surface unchanged; fade detail out at the thin shoreline.
                if opt.ripples then
                    local fade = math.clamp((c.now - 0.045) / 0.18, 0, 1)
                    local p1 = (c.x * 0.94 + c.z * 0.34) * 3.0 + now * 0.8
                    local p2 = (c.x * -0.42 + c.z * 0.91) * 5.79 + now * 1.1
                    local p3 = (c.x * 0.71 - c.z * 0.70) * 10.71 + now * 1.4
                    nx = nx - fade * (0.050 * math.cos(p1) - 0.025 * math.cos(p2) + 0.022 * math.cos(p3))
                    nz = nz - fade * (0.018 * math.cos(p1) + 0.054 * math.cos(p2) - 0.022 * math.cos(p3))
                end
                local l = sqrt(nx * nx + 1 + nz * nz)
                em:SetNormal(c.nid, Vector3.new(nx / l, 1 / l, nz / l))
            end
        end
    end

    -- the sheet's shape (marching squares over the corner depths); a new MeshPart replaces the old one when ready
    local SIDE_NB = {{-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {1, 0}, {0, -1}}
    function S.rebuild(look, parent, origin, yieldf)
        local generation = S.generation or 0
        local depth = S.depth
        if not depth then return end
        local corners, cornerAt = {}, {}
        local verts = {}       -- {x, y, z, isCorner, corner}
        local tris = {}
        local edgeAt = {}
        local edgeNb = {}
        -- a corner's height: the mean of the cells around it that can hold water (a cell inside a wall is not a dry
        -- cell: counting it as 0 would curl the surface down before it reaches the wall and leave a notched gap)
        local wallCache = {}
        local function wet(cx, cz, fy)
            if opt.solidQ then
                local k = ck(cx, cz, fy)
                local w = wallCache[k]
                if w == nil then w = (not S.cellFloor[k] and wallFine(cx, cz, floorOfCell(cx, cz, fy))) and true or false; wallCache[k] = w end
                return not w
            end
            local bx, bz = floor(cx / C), floor(cz / C)
            local k = ck(bx, bz, fy)
            local w = wallCache[k]
            if w == nil then w = solid(bx, fy, bz) and true or false; wallCache[k] = w end
            return not w
        end
        local function openCells(gx, gz, fy)
            local list = {}
            for dz = -1, 0 do for dx = -1, 0 do
                if wet(gx + dx, gz + dz, fy) then list[#list + 1] = ck(gx + dx, gz + dz, fy) end
            end end
            return list
        end
        local function cornerDepth(gx, gz, fy)
            local s, n = 0, 0
            for dz = -1, 0 do for dx = -1, 0 do
                if wet(gx + dx, gz + dz, fy) then s = s + max(depth[ck(gx + dx, gz + dz, fy)] or 0, 0); n = n + 1 end
            end end
            return n > 0 and s / n or 0
        end
        -- a corner's floor: the mean floor of the cells around it that hold water
        local function cornerFloor(gx, gz, fy)
            local s, n = 0, 0
            for dz = -1, 0 do for dx = -1, 0 do
                if wet(gx + dx, gz + dz, fy) then s = s + floorOfCell(gx + dx, gz + dz, fy); n = n + 1 end
            end end
            return n > 0 and s / n or fy
        end
        local function cornerVertex(gx, gz, fy)
            local key = ck(gx, gz, fy)
            local c = cornerAt[key]
            if c then return c.vi end
            c = {x = gx / C, z = gz / C, fy = fy, cells = openCells(gx, gz, fy), gx = gx, gz = gz}
            c.fl = cornerFloor(gx, gz, fy)
            c.cur = cornerDepth(gx, gz, fy); c.prev = c.cur; c.now = c.cur
            corners[#corners + 1] = c
            cornerAt[key] = c
            verts[#verts + 1] = {c.x, c.fl + 0.004 + c.cur, c.z, c}
            c.vi = #verts
            return c.vi
        end
        local function edgeVertex(ax, az, bx, bz, fy, da, db)
            local k1, k2 = ck(ax, az, fy), ck(bx, bz, fy)
            local key = k1 < k2 and string.format("%.0f|%.0f", k1, k2) or string.format("%.0f|%.0f", k2, k1)
            local id = edgeAt[key]
            if id then return id end
            local f = (THR - da) / (db - da)
            local fa, fb = cornerFloor(ax, az, fy), cornerFloor(bx, bz, fy)
            verts[#verts + 1] = {(ax + (bx - ax) * f) / C, fa + (fb - fa) * f + 0.004 + THR, (az + (bz - az) * f) / C}
            edgeAt[key] = #verts
            return #verts
        end
        local count = 0
        for key, d in pairs(depth) do
            count = count + 1
            if count % 200 == 0 and yieldf then yieldf() end
            if d > 0.001 then
                local fy = floor(key / 274877906944) - 512
                local rest = key - (fy + 512) * 274877906944
                local cz = floor(rest / 524288) - 262144
                local cx = rest % 524288 - 262144
                local bx, bz = floor(cx / C), floor(cz / C)
                if (opt.solidQ and wet(cx, cz, fy)) or (not opt.solidQ and not solid(bx, fy, bz)) then
                    local P = {{cx, cz}, {cx, cz + 1}, {cx + 1, cz + 1}, {cx + 1, cz}}
                    local D, inside, nin = {}, {}, 0
                    for q = 1, 4 do
                        D[q] = cornerDepth(P[q][1], P[q][2], fy)
                        inside[q] = D[q] > THR
                        if inside[q] then nin = nin + 1 end
                    end
                    if nin > 0 then
                        local poly = {}
                        for q = 1, 4 do
                            local q2 = q % 4 + 1
                            if inside[q] then poly[#poly + 1] = cornerVertex(P[q][1], P[q][2], fy) end
                            if inside[q] ~= inside[q2] then poly[#poly + 1] = edgeVertex(P[q][1], P[q][2], P[q2][1], P[q2][2], fy, D[q], D[q2]) end
                        end
                        for q = 2, #poly - 1 do tris[#tris + 1] = {poly[1], poly[q], poly[q + 1]} end
                        -- the outline: consecutive edge vertices of a cell are one piece of the water's edge
                        for q = 1, #poly do
                            local a, b = poly[q], poly[q % #poly + 1]
                            if not verts[a][4] and not verts[b][4] then
                                local la = edgeNb[a]; if not la then la = {}; edgeNb[a] = la end; la[b] = true
                                local lb = edgeNb[b]; if not lb then lb = {}; edgeNb[b] = lb end; lb[a] = true
                            end
                        end
                        -- the sides against walls: water seen through glass is a body of water down to its floor, not a
                        -- skin floating in the air (the top edge is the surface's own corners, so it moves with it)
                        if opt.sides then
                            for q = 1, 4 do
                                local q2 = q % 4 + 1
                                if inside[q] and inside[q2] then
                                    local nb = SIDE_NB[q]
                                    if not wet(cx + nb[1], cz + nb[2], fy) then
                                        local a = cornerVertex(P[q][1], P[q][2], fy)
                                        local b = cornerVertex(P[q2][1], P[q2][2], fy)
                                        local ca, cb = verts[a][4], verts[b][4]
                                        verts[#verts + 1] = {verts[a][1], ca.fl + 0.004, verts[a][3]}
                                        local ab = #verts
                                        verts[#verts + 1] = {verts[b][1], cb.fl + 0.004, verts[b][3]}
                                        local bb = #verts
                                        -- lit like a level surface: one even blue (a wall-facing or sloped normal turns Glass grey or white)
                                        local out = Vector3.yAxis
                                        tris[#tris + 1] = {a, b, bb, out}; tris[#tris + 1] = {a, bb, ab, out}
                                        tris[#tris + 1] = {a, bb, b, Vector3.new(-out.X, out.Y, -out.Z)}; tris[#tris + 1] = {a, ab, bb, Vector3.new(-out.X, out.Y, -out.Z)}
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        -- smooth the edge: the marching-squares outline steps every quarter block; relaxing the edge vertices along it
        -- turns the steps into a curve (positions only move along the floor)
        for _ = 1, 3 do
            local moved = {}
            for v, nb in pairs(edgeNb) do
                local sx2, sz2, c = 0, 0, 0
                for u in pairs(nb) do sx2, sz2, c = sx2 + verts[u][1], sz2 + verts[u][3], c + 1 end
                if c >= 2 then moved[v] = {verts[v][1] + (sx2 / c - verts[v][1]) * 0.5, verts[v][3] + (sz2 / c - verts[v][3]) * 0.5} end
            end
            for v, m in pairs(moved) do verts[v][1], verts[v][3] = m[1], m[2] end
        end
        if #tris == 0 then
            if S.topo and S.topo.part then S.topo.part:Destroy() end
            S.topo = nil
            return
        end
        -- neighbours for the normals
        for _, c in ipairs(corners) do
            c.w = cornerAt[ck(c.gx - 1, c.gz, c.fy)]; c.e = cornerAt[ck(c.gx + 1, c.gz, c.fy)]
            c.n = cornerAt[ck(c.gx, c.gz - 1, c.fy)]; c.s = cornerAt[ck(c.gx, c.gz + 1, c.fy)]
        end
        local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
        local em = AssetService:CreateEditableMesh({FixedSize = false})
        local minx, miny, minz, maxx, maxy, maxz = math.huge, math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
        for _, v in ipairs(verts) do
            local x, y, z = v[1] * B, (v[2] - 0.5) * B, v[3] * B
            minx, maxx, miny, maxy, minz, maxz = min(minx, x), max(maxx, x), min(miny, y), max(maxy, y), min(minz, z), max(maxz, z)
        end
        local cx0, cy0, cz0 = (minx + maxx) / 2, (miny + maxy) / 2, (minz + maxz) / 2
        local ids, nids, uids = {}, {}, {}
        for i, v in ipairs(verts) do
            if i % 400 == 0 and yieldf then yieldf() end
            ids[i] = em:AddVertex(Vector3.new(v[1] * B - cx0, (v[2] - 0.5) * B - cy0, v[3] * B - cz0))
            nids[i] = em:AddNormal(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
            uids[i] = em:AddUV(Vector2.new(v[1] / 2, v[3] / 2))
            if v[4] then v[4].vid, v[4].nid = ids[i], nids[i] end
        end
        for i, t in ipairs(tris) do
            if i % 400 == 0 and yieldf then yieldf() end
            local f = em:AddTriangle(ids[t[1]], ids[t[2]], ids[t[3]])
            if t[4] then
                -- a side face: lit as a wall of water, not as the surface
                local nn = em:AddNormal(t[4])
                em:SetFaceNormals(f, {nn, nn, nn})
            else
                em:SetFaceNormals(f, {nids[t[1]], nids[t[2]], nids[t[3]]})
            end
            em:SetFaceUVs(f, {uids[t[1]], uids[t[2]], uids[t[3]]})
        end
        if generation ~= (S.generation or 0) then em:Destroy(); return end
        local part = AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromObject(em))
        if generation ~= (S.generation or 0) then part:Destroy(); em:Destroy(); return end
        part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
        part.CastShadow = look.castShadow or false
        part.Material, part.Color, part.Transparency, part.Reflectance = look.material, look.color, look.transparency, look.reflectance
        part.Name = look.name or "RealisticSheet"
        -- B/2 shift: block (b) spans [b - 0.5, b + 0.5) * B around its centre O + b * B
        part.CFrame = CFrame.new(origin + Vector3.new(cx0 - 0.5 * B, cy0, cz0 - 0.5 * B))
        part.Parent = parent
        local old = S.topo
        -- carry the interpolation over (the new corners start at the current depths)
        S.topo = {em = em, part = part, corners = corners, cx = cx0, cy = cy0, cz = cz0, normalsDirty = true}
        if old then
            if old.part then old.part:Destroy() end
            if old.em then old.em:Destroy() end
        end
        S.frame()
        return part
    end
    function S.destroy()
        S.generation = (S.generation or 0) + 1
        if S.topo then
            if S.topo.part then S.topo.part:Destroy() end
            if S.topo.em then S.topo.em:Destroy() end
        end
        S.topo = nil
    end
    return S
end
return createFluidSheet

end)()
local createSandSim = (function()
-- Realistic Sand (Skaffy's Realistic Water) on the CPU: grains that pour, pile up at an angle of repose and settle.
-- The original solves sand as an elastoplastic continuum (MPM, Drucker-Prager friction). Here every grain is a ball of
-- diameter D (3 grains per block) solved with position-based dynamics: gravity, contacts with other grains (pushed
-- apart, with Coulomb friction so slopes hold at the friction angle), solid blocks, slowing in water, and sleep when
-- still (sandRestSpeed / sandRestTime). It exposes the same fields the fluid code reads (n, px.., fills, bkey, step).
local function createSandSim(P, hooks)
    local floor, sqrt, min, max, abs, random = math.floor, math.sqrt, math.min, math.max, math.abs, math.random
    local R = P.res or 3
    local D = 1 / R
    local PER_BLOCK = R * R * R
    local MU = P.friction or 0.6         -- tan(31 deg)
    local G = P.gravity or 9.81
    local S = {params = {ppc = PER_BLOCK, res = 1}, n = 0, awake = true, fills = {}, springs = {}, boxes = {}, events = {}, heated = {},
        mean = 0, fastest = 0}
    local px, py, pz, vx, vy, vz, rest, slp = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
    S.px, S.py, S.pz, S.vx, S.vy, S.vz = px, py, pz, vx, vy, vz
    local function bkey(bx, by, bz) return (bx + 65536) + (by + 65536) * 131072 + (bz + 65536) * 17179869184 end
    S.bkey = bkey
    local solidCache = {}
    local function solidBlock(bx, by, bz)
        local k = bkey(bx, by, bz)
        local s = solidCache[k]
        if s == nil then s = hooks.solid(bx, by, bz) and true or false; solidCache[k] = s end
        return s
    end
    function S.wake() S.awake = true; for i = 1, S.n do slp[i] = false; rest[i] = 0 end end
    function S.invalidate() solidCache = {}; S.wake() end
    local function add(x, y, z)
        if S.n >= (P.maxParticles or 5000) then return end
        local i = S.n + 1
        S.n = i
        px[i], py[i], pz[i], vx[i], vy[i], vz[i], rest[i], slp[i] = x, y, z, 0, 0, 0, 0, false
    end
    S.add = add
    local function remove(i)
        local n = S.n
        for _, t in ipairs({px, py, pz, vx, vy, vz, rest, slp}) do t[i] = t[n]; t[n] = nil end
        S.n = n - 1
    end
    S.remove = remove
    function S.addBlock(bx, by, bz)
        for k = 0, R - 1 do for j = 0, R - 1 do for i = 0, R - 1 do
            add(bx + (i + 0.5 + (random() - 0.5) * 0.2) * D, by + (j + 0.5) * D, bz + (k + 0.5 + (random() - 0.5) * 0.2) * D)
        end end end
        S.wake()
    end
    function S.removeBlock(bx, by, bz)
        local removed = 0
        for i = S.n, 1, -1 do if floor(px[i]) == bx and floor(py[i]) == by and floor(pz[i]) == bz then remove(i); removed = removed + 1 end end
        if removed > 0 then S.wake() end
        return removed
    end
    function S.addSpring() end
    function S.removeSpring() end
    function S.clear() for i = S.n, 1, -1 do remove(i) end; S.fills = {} end

    -- spatial hash of grains (cell = one grain diameter)
    local function hk(cx, cy, cz) return (cx + 262144) + (cy + 4096) * 524288 + (cz + 262144) * 4294967296 end

    local function substep(dt)
        local n = S.n
        local ox, oy, oz = {}, {}, {}
        -- predict
        for i = 1, n do
            ox[i], oy[i], oz[i] = px[i], py[i], pz[i]
            if not slp[i] then
                local bx, by, bz = floor(px[i]), floor(py[i]), floor(pz[i])
                local water = hooks.water and hooks.water(bx, by, bz) or 0
                local g = G
                if water > 0.3 then g = G * 0.45; vx[i], vy[i], vz[i] = vx[i] * 0.9, vy[i] * 0.9, vz[i] * 0.9 end
                vy[i] = vy[i] - g * dt
                px[i], py[i], pz[i] = px[i] + vx[i] * dt, py[i] + vy[i] * dt, pz[i] + vz[i] * dt
            end
        end
        -- hash
        local grid = {}
        for i = 1, n do
            local k = hk(floor(px[i] * R), floor(py[i] * R), floor(pz[i] * R))
            local c = grid[k]
            if not c then c = {}; grid[k] = c end
            c[#c + 1] = i
        end
        local r = D * 0.5
        for _ = 1, 3 do
            for i = 1, n do
                if not slp[i] then
                    local cx, cy, cz = floor(px[i] * R), floor(py[i] * R), floor(pz[i] * R)
                    for dz = -1, 1 do for dy = -1, 1 do for dx = -1, 1 do
                        local c = grid[hk(cx + dx, cy + dy, cz + dz)]
                        if c then
                            for _, j in ipairs(c) do
                                if j ~= i then
                                    local ex, ey, ez = px[i] - px[j], py[i] - py[j], pz[i] - pz[j]
                                    local d2 = ex * ex + ey * ey + ez * ez
                                    if d2 < D * D and d2 > 1e-12 then
                                        local d = sqrt(d2)
                                        local pen = D - d
                                        local nx, ny, nz = ex / d, ey / d, ez / d
                                        local wi = slp[j] and 1 or 0.5
                                        px[i], py[i], pz[i] = px[i] + nx * pen * wi, py[i] + ny * pen * wi, pz[i] + nz * pen * wi
                                        if not slp[j] then px[j], py[j], pz[j] = px[j] - nx * pen * 0.5, py[j] - ny * pen * 0.5, pz[j] - nz * pen * 0.5 end
                                        -- Coulomb friction on the relative tangential motion this step
                                        local rx = (px[i] - ox[i]) - (px[j] - ox[j])
                                        local ry = (py[i] - oy[i]) - (py[j] - oy[j])
                                        local rz = (pz[i] - oz[i]) - (pz[j] - oz[j])
                                        local rn = rx * nx + ry * ny + rz * nz
                                        local tx, ty, tz = rx - rn * nx, ry - rn * ny, rz - rn * nz
                                        local tl = sqrt(tx * tx + ty * ty + tz * tz)
                                        if tl > 1e-9 then
                                            local f = tl < MU * pen and 1 or (MU * pen / tl)
                                            px[i], py[i], pz[i] = px[i] - tx * f * wi, py[i] - ty * f * wi, pz[i] - tz * f * wi
                                            if not slp[j] then px[j], py[j], pz[j] = px[j] + tx * f * 0.5, py[j] + ty * f * 0.5, pz[j] + tz * f * 0.5 end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end end end
                end
            end
            -- quarter-block solids (hooks.solidFine): the same pushes against the map's real shapes
            local sQ = hooks.solidFine
            if sQ then
                local fc = {}
                local function sq(x, y, z)
                    local qx, qy, qz = floor(x * 4), floor(y * 4), floor(z * 4)
                    local k = (qx + 131072) + (qz + 131072) * 262144 + (qy + 16384) * 68719476736
                    local v = fc[k]
                    if v == nil then v = sQ(qx, qy, qz) and true or false; fc[k] = v end
                    return v
                end
                for i = 1, n do
                    if not slp[i] then
                        -- floor: out of the solid cell under the grain's bottom (up to three quarter cells, a small step)
                        for _ = 1, 3 do
                            local bottom = py[i] - r
                            if sq(px[i], bottom, pz[i]) then
                                local topY = floor(bottom * 4) / 4 + 0.25
                                if topY - bottom > 0.6 then break end
                                py[i] = topY + r
                                local sx, sz = px[i] - ox[i], pz[i] - oz[i]
                                px[i], pz[i] = ox[i] + sx * 0.4, oz[i] + sz * 0.4
                            else break end
                        end
                        local y = py[i]
                        local qx, qz = floor(px[i] * 4), floor(pz[i] * 4)
                        if floor((px[i] + r) * 4) ~= qx and sq(px[i] + r, y, pz[i]) then px[i] = floor((px[i] + r) * 4) / 4 - r end
                        if floor((px[i] - r) * 4) ~= qx and sq(px[i] - r, y, pz[i]) then px[i] = floor((px[i] - r) * 4) / 4 + 0.25 + r end
                        if floor((pz[i] + r) * 4) ~= qz and sq(px[i], y, pz[i] + r) then pz[i] = floor((pz[i] + r) * 4) / 4 - r end
                        if floor((pz[i] - r) * 4) ~= qz and sq(px[i], y, pz[i] - r) then pz[i] = floor((pz[i] - r) * 4) / 4 + 0.25 + r end
                        if floor((py[i] + r) * 4) ~= floor(py[i] * 4) and sq(px[i], py[i] + r, pz[i]) then
                            py[i] = floor((py[i] + r) * 4) / 4 - r
                            if vy[i] > 0 then vy[i] = 0 end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            -- solid blocks: the grain's bottom on a floor block's top (with floor friction), then the four sides and the ceiling
            for i = 1, (sQ and 0 or n) do
                if not slp[i] then
                    local by = floor(py[i] - r)
                    if solidBlock(floor(px[i]), by, floor(pz[i])) and (by + 1) - (py[i] - r) < 0.6 then
                        py[i] = by + 1 + r
                        local sx, sz = px[i] - ox[i], pz[i] - oz[i]
                        px[i], pz[i] = ox[i] + sx * 0.4, oz[i] + sz * 0.4
                    end
                    local bx, bz = floor(px[i]), floor(pz[i])
