            local minv, maxv = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge), -Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
            for i = 1, #v, 3 do
                local q = Vector3.new(v[i], v[i + 1], v[i + 2]) * B
                minv, maxv = minv:Min(q), maxv:Max(q)
            end
            local mid = (minv + maxv) / 2
            local em = AssetService:CreateEditableMesh({FixedSize = false})
            for t = 0, #v / 9 - 1 do
                local ids, uids, pts = {}, {}, {}
                for k = 0, 2 do
                    local o = t * 9 + k * 3
                    pts[k + 1] = Vector3.new(v[o + 1], v[o + 2], v[o + 3]) * B - mid
                    ids[k + 1] = em:AddVertex(pts[k + 1])
                    local u = (t * 3 + k) * 2
                    uids[k + 1] = em:AddUV(Vector2.new(uv[u + 1], uv[u + 2]))
                end
                local nrm = (pts[2] - pts[1]):Cross(pts[3] - pts[1])
                if nrm.Magnitude > 1e-9 then
                    local f = em:AddTriangle(ids[1], ids[2], ids[3])
                    em:SetFaceUVs(f, uids)
                    local nid = em:AddNormal(nrm.Unit)
                    em:SetFaceNormals(f, {nid, nid, nid})
                end
                if t % 400 == 399 then task.wait() end
            end
            local part = AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromObject(em))
            part.Name = "CreateMeshPart" .. (#parts + 1)
            part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, true
            part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            part.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            local tex = meshTexture(p.tex, p.folder)
            if tex then
                pcall(function() part.TextureContent = Content.fromUri(tex) end)
                pcall(function() part.TextureID = tex end)
                if p.alpha then
                    -- cut-out texture (grills, flames): its transparent pixels must not show the part's colour
                    pcall(function()
                        local sa = Instance.new("SurfaceAppearance")
                        sa.AlphaMode = Enum.AlphaMode.Transparency
                        sa.ColorMapContent = Content.fromUri(tex)
                        sa.Parent = part
                    end)
                    part.Transparency = 0.02
                end
            end
            part.Parent = template
            parts[#parts + 1] = {part, CFrame.new(mid)}
        end
        return {template = template, parts = parts}
    end
    local function meshReady(name)
        local c = meshCache[name]
        if c == nil then
            meshCache[name] = "building"
            task.spawn(function()
                local data = CR and CR.catalog and CR.catalog.meshes and CR.catalog.meshes[name]
                local ok, res = false, "no mesh data"
                if data then ok, res = pcall(buildMesh, name, data) end
                if ok then meshCache[name] = res
                else meshCache[name] = false; warn("[Create] mesh " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(res)) end
            end)
            return nil
        end
        return type(c) == "table" and c or nil
    end
    local function meshVisual(name, center)
        local c = meshReady(name)
        if not c then return nil end
        local model = c.template:Clone()
        local list = {}
        for i, pair in ipairs(c.parts) do
            local part = model:FindFirstChild(pair[1].Name)
            list[i] = {part, pair[2]}
            part.CFrame = CFrame.new(center) * pair[2]
        end
        model.Parent = holder
        return {model = model, parts = list}
    end
    K.meshVisual = function(name, center) return meshVisual(name, center) end
    K.meshReady = function(name) return meshReady(name) ~= nil end
    -- items drawn as an OBJ mesh in a hand: the built mesh (nil while it builds) and the block size it was built at
    JavaContent.meshTemplate = function(name) return meshReady(name), B end
    task.spawn(function()
        -- build the held meshes early (Create's items now, Aeronautics' once it is enabled)
        for _ = 1, 24 do
            for _, e in pairs(JavaContent.byIndex) do
                if type(e) == "table" and e.heldMesh then pcall(meshReady, e.heldMesh) end
            end
            task.wait(5)
        end
    end)
    K.partialVisual = function(name, center)
        local e = partialEntry(name)
        if not e then return nil end
        local ok, v = pcall(JavaContent.model, e.index, {}, B, holder, center, true)
        if not (ok and v) then return nil end
        for _, d in ipairs(v.model:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.CanCollide, d.CanQuery, d.CanTouch = false, false, false end end
        return v
    end
    local function ensureVisuals(n)
        local def = DEF[n.id]
        if not def.partials then return end
        local key = n.id
        for k, v in pairs(n.state) do key = key .. k .. tostring(v) end
        if def.speedKey then local s = n.overstressed and 0 or (n.speed or 0); key = key .. (s > 0 and "+" or s < 0 and "-" or "0") end
        if n.cr and n.cr.handPose then key = key .. n.cr.handPose end
        if def.visualKey then key = key .. "|" .. tostring(def.visualKey(n)) end
        if n.partialKey == key and n.partialVisuals then return end
        local wanted = def.partials(n)
        -- meshes are built in the background: wait for them before swapping the visuals
        for _, p in ipairs(wanted) do if p.mesh and not meshReady(p[1]) then return end end
        clearVisuals(n)
        n.partialKey = key
        local list = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(wanted) do
            local e = not p.mesh and partialEntry(p[1])
            if e or p.mesh then
                local ok, v
                if p.mesh then ok, v = pcall(meshVisual, p[1], n.center)
                else ok, v = pcall(JavaContent.model, e.index, {}, B, holder, n.center, true) end
                if ok and v then
                    for _, d in ipairs(v.model:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.CanCollide, d.CanQuery, d.CanTouch = false, false, false end
                    end
                    local to = p[3] or (POSITIVE[AXIS_OF[n.state.facing or "up"]] and "up") or nil
                    local base
                    if p[2] == "up" and not p[3] then
                        -- along the block's rotation axis (an axis block's shaft / cog)
                        local ax = axisOf(n)
                        base = orient("up", ax == "x" and "east" or ax == "z" and "south" or "up")
                    else
                        base = orient(p[2], p[3])
                    end
                    local yaw
                    if p.facingYaw then
                        -- horizontal blocks: the part turns with the block's facing (AngleHelper.horizontalAngle)
                        local Y = {south = 0, west = 90, north = 180, east = 270}
                        yaw = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Y[n.state.facing or "north"] or 0), 0)
                    end
                    if p.spinY then base = base * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(p.spinY), 0) end
                    list[#list + 1] = {visual = v, base = base, side = p.side, crank = p.crank, move = p.move, yaw = yaw, still = p.still}
                end
            end
        end
        n.partialVisuals = list
    end
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local function offsetOf(n, ax)
        -- KineticBlockEntityVisual.rotationOffset
        local x = ax == "x" and 0 or n.kx
        local y = ax == "y" and 0 or n.ky
        local z = ax == "z" and 0 or n.kz
        if math.fmod(x + y + z, 2) == 0 then return 22.5 end
        return isLarge(n) and 11.25 or 0
    end
    local startClock = os.clock()
    local function render()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local camPos = cam and cam.CFrame.Position or Vector3.zero
        local ticks = (os.clock() - startClock) * 20
        local parts, frames = {}, {}
        local xfFor = K.transformFor or function(n) local w=world(); return w and w.physicsTransform and w.physicsTransform(n.center) end
        for _, n in pairs(byPos) do
            local def = DEF[n.id]
            -- a block on an Aeronautics ship lives in its plot: drawn where the ship is
            local xf = xfFor and xfFor(n)
            local seen = xf and (xf * n.center) or n.center
            if n.center and (seen - camPos).Magnitude < 96 * B then
                local ax = axisOf(n)
                local speed = n.overstressed and 0 or (n.speed or 0)
                local turn = n.turnAngle or 0
                if speed ~= 0 then turn = (ticks * speed * 0.3 + offsetOf(n, ax)) % 360 elseif not n.turnAngle then turn = offsetOf(n, ax) end
                n.turnAngle = turn
                local rot = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(AXV[ax], math.rad(turn))
                local first = #frames + 1
                if def.whole and n.visual and n.visual.parts then
                    n.visual.physicsSpin=n.physicsOwner and rot or nil
                    local at = CFrame.new(n.center) * rot
                    for _, pair in ipairs(n.visual.parts) do
                        local p = pair[1]
                        if p.Parent and p.Name ~= "BlockOutline" and p.Name ~= "BlockCollider" and p.Name ~= "SteveMarker" and p.Name ~= "BlockLight" then
                            parts[#parts + 1] = p; frames[#frames + 1] = at * pair[2]
                        end
                    end
                end
                if def.partials then
                    ensureVisuals(n)
                    for _, pv in ipairs(n.partialVisuals or {}) do
                        local r = rot
                        if pv.side then
                            -- a gearbox / split shaft half turns with the speed it hands on that side
                            local m = axisModifier(n, pv.side)
                            local sideSpeed = (n.overstressed and 0 or (n.speed or 0)) * m
                            local sax = AXIS_OF[pv.side]
                            local a = (ticks * sideSpeed * 0.3 + offsetOf(n, sax)) % 360
                            r = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(AXV[sax], math.rad(a))
                        elseif pv.still then
                            r = CFrame.identity
                        elseif pv.crank then
                            local fa = AXIS_OF[n.state.facing or "up"]
                            n.crankAngle = (n.crankAngle or 0) + ((n.crankUse or 0) > 0 and (n.crankBack and -1 or 1) * 18 or 0) * (1 / 60)
                            r = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(AXV[fa], math.rad((n.crankAngle or 0) * 20))
                        end
                        local at
                        if pv.move then
                            -- a moving part: offset (studs) and its own turn about the block's axis (nil = no turn)
                            local off, ang, axisName = pv.move(n, ticks)
                            local rr = ang and CFrame.fromAxisAngle(typeof(axisName) == "Vector3" and axisName or AXV[axisName or ax], math.rad(ang)) or CFrame.identity
                            at = CFrame.new(n.center + (off or Vector3.zero)) * rr * (pv.yaw or CFrame.identity) * pv.base
                        else
                            at = CFrame.new(n.center) * r * pv.base
                        end
                        for _, pair in ipairs(pv.visual.parts) do
                            local p = pair[1]
                            if p.Parent then parts[#parts + 1] = p; frames[#frames + 1] = at * pair[2] end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if xf then for i = first, #frames do frames[i] = xf * frames[i] end end
            end
        end
        if #parts > 0 then workspace:BulkMoveTo(parts, frames, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged) end
    end

    -- sources ticking: the crank's use timer, water wheels' flow (every 3 s), redstone on split shafts ----------------------
    local tickAcc, flowAcc, scanAcc = 0, 0, 0
    local function flowAt(bx, by, bz)
        local w = world()
        local rw = JavaContent.mods.byId.realistic_water
        local c = O + Vector3.new(bx, by, bz) * B
        local s = w and w.sample and w.sample(c)
        local id = s and s.id
        local node = s and s.node
        if id == "water" or id == "flowing_water" then
            -- FlowingFluid.getFlow: towards the lower neighbours
            local lvl = tonumber(node and node.state and node.state.level) or 0
            local fx, fz = 0, 0
            for _, d in ipairs({"north", "south", "east", "west"}) do
                local v = DIR[d]
                local o = w.sample(c + Vector3.new(v[1], 0, v[3]) * B)
                if o and (o.id == "water" or o.id == "flowing_water") then
                    local l2 = tonumber(o.node and o.node.state and o.node.state.level) or 0
                    local diff = (l2 % 8) - (lvl % 8)
                    fx, fz = fx + v[1] * diff, fz + v[3] * diff
                elseif not o then fx, fz = fx + v[1] * 1, fz + v[3] * 1 end
            end
            local below = w.sample(c - Vector3.new(0, B, 0))
            local fy = (lvl >= 8 or (below == nil)) and -1 or 0
            return Vector3.new(fx, fy, fz)
        end
        if rw and rw.enabled and rw.sims and rw.sims.water then
            local sim = rw.sims.water
            if (sim.fills[sim.bkey(bx, by, bz)] or 0) > 0.1 then
                local sx, sy, sz, cnt = 0, 0, 0, 0
                for i = 1, sim.n do
                    if floor(sim.px[i]) == bx and floor(sim.py[i]) == by and floor(sim.pz[i]) == bz then
                        sx, sy, sz, cnt = sx + sim.vx[i], sy + sim.vy[i], sz + sim.vz[i], cnt + 1
                    end
                end
                if cnt > 0 then return Vector3.new(sx / cnt, sy / cnt, sz / cnt) end
            end
        end
        return Vector3.zero
    end
    local function waterWheelScore(n)
        -- WaterWheelBlockEntity.determineAndApplyFlowScore: size 1 checks the 4 neighbours around the axle; size 2 the
        -- 3-block faces of the 5x5 ring (LARGE_OFFSETS)
        local ax = axisOf(n)
        local plane = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) - AXV[ax]
        local offsets = {}
        local size = DEF[n.id].size or 1
        for _, d in ipairs(NAMES) do
            if AXIS_OF[d] ~= ax then
                local v = DIR[d]
                local c = Vector3.new(v[1], v[2], v[3]) * size
                offsets[#offsets + 1] = c
                if size == 2 then
                    for _, d2 in ipairs(NAMES) do
                        if AXIS_OF[d2] ~= ax and AXIS_OF[d2] ~= AXIS_OF[d] then
                            local w2 = DIR[d2]
                            offsets[#offsets + 1] = c + Vector3.new(w2[1], w2[2], w2[3])
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local score = 0
        for _, off in ipairs(offsets) do
            local flow = flowAt(n.kx + off.X, n.ky + off.Y, n.kz + off.Z) * plane
            if flow.Magnitude > 1e-4 then
                flow = flow.Unit
                local positive = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(AXV[ax], math.rad(90)) * off.Unit
                local dot = flow:Dot(positive)
                if abs(dot) > 0.5 then score = score + (dot > 0 and 1 or -1) end
            end
        end
        return score
    end
    local lookAt
    local function update(dt)
        local w = world()
        if not w then return end
        tickAcc = tickAcc + dt
        scanAcc = scanAcc + dt
        flowAcc = flowAcc + dt
        if scanAcc > 2 then scanAcc = 0; dirty = true end
        while tickAcc >= 0.05 do
            tickAcc = tickAcc - 0.05
            if K.processing then
                local okP, errP = pcall(K.processing.tick)
                if not okP and not K.procWarned then K.procWarned = true; warn("[Create] processing: " .. tostring(errP)) end
            end
            for _, n in pairs(byPos) do
                if n.crankUse and n.crankUse > 0 then
                    n.crankUse = n.crankUse - 1
                    if n.crankUse == 0 then dirty = true end
                end
                local def = DEF[n.id]
                if def.redstone then
                    local p = (n.input or 0) > 0
                    if p ~= (n.powered or false) then dirty = true end
                end
                if def.watch then
                    local okW, sig = pcall(def.watch, n)
                    if okW and sig ~= n.watched then n.watched = sig; dirty = true end
                end
            end
        end
        if flowAcc > 3 then
            flowAcc = 0
            for _, n in pairs(byPos) do
                if n.id == "water_wheel" or n.id == "large_water_wheel" then
                    local s = waterWheelScore(n)
                    if s ~= (n.flowScore or 0) then n.flowScore = s; dirty = true end
                end
            end
        end
        -- holding the use button on a hand crank keeps it turning
        local crank = K.cranking
        if crank and crank.n then
            local held = game:GetService("UserInputService"):IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2)
            local target = lookAt and lookAt()
            if held and target == crank.n then
                if (crank.n.crankUse or 0) < 4 then crank.n.crankUse = 10 end
            else K.cranking = nil end
        end
        if dirty then local ok, err = pcall(solve); if not ok then warn("[Create] kinetics: " .. tostring(err)) end end
    end

    -- looking at a block -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    lookAt = function()
        local w = world()
        local c = ctx()
        if not (w and w.eye and w.look and c) then return nil end
        local p = RaycastParams.new()
        p.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        p.FilterDescendantsInstances = {c.character, holder}
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(w.eye(), w.look() * (CONFIG.Reach or 4.5) * B, p)
        if not hit then return nil end
        local n = w.resolve and w.resolve(hit.Instance)
        if not (n and DEF[n.id]) then
            -- an outline / collider part: the block at the hit point
            local v = (hit.Position - hit.Normal * 0.05 - O) / B
            n = byPos[pkey(floor(v.X + 0.5), floor(v.Y + 0.5), floor(v.Z + 0.5))] or n
        end
        if n and DEF[n.id] then return n, hit end
        return nil, hit
    end
    K.lookAt = lookAt

    -- use: the hand crank (HandCrankBlock.use: 10 ticks of turning, sneaking turns it backwards)
    function K.useBlock(hit, sneaking)
        local n = lookAt()
        if not n then return nil end
        if n.id == "hand_crank" then
            n.crankUse, n.crankBack = 10, sneaking and true or false
            K.cranking = {n = n}
            dirty = true
            return true
        end
        return nil
    end
    -- scroll on a creative motor: its speed (ScrollValueBehaviour, -256..256, never 0)
    function K.scroll(delta)
        local n = lookAt()
        if not (n and n.id == "creative_motor") then return false end
        local s = n.motorSpeed or 16
        local step = (delta > 0) and 1 or -1
        local fine = game:GetService("UserInputService"):IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
        s = s + step * (fine and 1 or 1)
        if s == 0 then s = step end
        s = max(-256, min(256, s))
        n.motorSpeed = s
        dirty = true
        local w = world()
        local L = JavaContent.data.lang or {}
        local text = (L["create.generic.speed"] or "Speed") .. ": " .. s .. " " .. (L["create.generic.unit.rpm"] or "RPM")
        if w and w.chat and w.chat.showTitle then pcall(w.chat.showTitle, "actionbar", {{text = text, color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)}}) end
        return true
    end

    -- Engineer's Goggles overlay (GoggleOverlayRenderer: generator / kinetic stats) --------------------------------------
    local overlay
    local function goggles()
        local c = ctx()
        local inv = c and c.inventory
        local helm = inv and inv.equipment and inv.equipment.helmet
        local e = helm and JavaContent.byIndex[helm.id]
        return e and e.id == "goggles"
    end
    local function fmt(v) return string.format("%.1f", v) end
    local function drawOverlay()
        local lines
        if goggles() then
            local n = lookAt()
            if n then
                local L = JavaContent.data.lang or {}
                local def = DEF[n.id]
                local speed = abs(n.overstressed and 0 or (n.speed or 0))
                local GOLD, AQUA, GRAY, RED = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0), Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170), Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 85)
                lines = {}
                if def.source and capacityOf(n) > 0 then
                    lines[#lines + 1] = {L["create.gui.goggles.generator_stats"] or "Generator Stats:", Color3.new(1, 1, 1)}
                    lines[#lines + 1] = {" " .. (L["create.tooltip.capacityProvided"] or "Kinetic Stress Capacity:"), GRAY}
                    lines[#lines + 1] = {"  " .. fmt(capacityOf(n) * abs(def.source(n))) .. (L["create.generic.unit.stress"] or "su") .. " " .. (L["create.gui.goggles.at_current_speed"] or "at current speed"), AQUA}
                end
                if impactOf(n) > 0 then
                    lines[#lines + 1] = {L["create.gui.goggles.kinetic_stats"] or "Kinetic Stats:", Color3.new(1, 1, 1)}
                    lines[#lines + 1] = {" " .. (L["create.tooltip.stressImpact"] or "Kinetic Stress Impact:"), GRAY}
                    lines[#lines + 1] = {"  " .. fmt(impactOf(n) * speed) .. (L["create.generic.unit.stress"] or "su") .. " " .. (L["create.gui.goggles.at_current_speed"] or "at current speed"), GOLD}
                end
                lines[#lines + 1] = {(L["create.generic.speed"] or "Speed") .. ": " .. fmt(speed) .. " " .. (L["create.generic.unit.rpm"] or "RPM"), GRAY}
                if n.overstressed then lines[#lines + 1] = {L["create.gui.stressometer.overstressed"] or "Overstressed", RED} end
            end
        end
        local sig = lines and HttpService:JSONEncode((function() local t = {} for i, l in ipairs(lines) do t[i] = l[1] end return t end)()) or ""
        if overlay and overlay.sig == sig then return end
        if overlay then overlay.gui:Destroy(); overlay = nil end
        if not lines then return end
        local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name, gui.IgnoreGuiInset, gui.DisplayOrder, gui.ResetOnSpawn = "CreateGoggles", true, 20, false
        local holderFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
        holderFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        local scale = Instance.new("UIScale"); scale.Parent = holderFrame
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
        local s = JavaGui.scale(vp)
        scale.Scale = s
        local wpx, hpx = math.floor(vp.X / s), math.floor(vp.Y / s)
        holderFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(wpx, hpx)
        holderFrame.Parent = gui
        local width = 0
        for _, l in ipairs(lines) do width = max(width, JavaGui.width(l[1])) end
        local x, y = math.floor(wpx / 2) + 20, math.floor(hpx / 2) - math.floor(#lines * 10 / 2)
        local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
        bg.BackgroundColor3, bg.BackgroundTransparency, bg.BorderSizePixel = Color3.fromRGB(16, 0, 16), 0.06, 0
        bg.Position, bg.Size, bg.ZIndex = UDim2.fromOffset(x - 3, y - 3), UDim2.fromOffset(width + 6, #lines * 10 + 4), 1
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke"); stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 0, 255); stroke.Transparency = 0.5; stroke.Parent = bg
        bg.Parent = holderFrame
        for i, l in ipairs(lines) do JavaGui.text(holderFrame, l[1], x, y + (i - 1) * 10, l[2], true, 3) end
        gui.Parent = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        overlay = {gui = gui, sig = sig}
    end

    -- start / stop ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local conns = {}
    function K.start(cr)
        CR = cr
        holder = Instance.new("Folder")
        holder.Name = "CreateKinetics"
        holder.Parent = workspace
        dirty = true
        conns[#conns + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) local ok, err = pcall(update, dt); if not ok and not K.warned then K.warned = true; warn("[Create] " .. tostring(err)) end end)
        conns[#conns + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local okR, errR = pcall(render)
            if not okR and not K.renderWarned then K.renderWarned = true; warn("[Create] render: " .. tostring(errR)) end
            if K.processing then
                local okP, errP = pcall(K.processing.render)
                if not okP and not K.procRenderWarned then K.procRenderWarned = true; warn("[Create] processing render: " .. tostring(errP)) end
            end
            local okO, errO = pcall(drawOverlay)
            if not okO and not K.overlayWarned then K.overlayWarned = true; warn("[Create] goggles: " .. tostring(errO)) end
        end)
        local listeners = rawget(_G, "SteveEventListeners")
        if type(listeners) ~= "table" then listeners = {}; _G.SteveEventListeners = listeners end
        listeners.create_kinetics = function(kind) if kind == "place" or kind == "break" or kind == "explosion" then dirty = true end end
    end
    function K.stop()
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do c:Disconnect() end
        conns = {}
        local listeners = rawget(_G, "SteveEventListeners")
        if type(listeners) == "table" then listeners.create_kinetics = nil end
        for _, n in pairs(byPos) do clearVisuals(n); n.speed = 0 end
        byPos = {}
        if holder then holder:Destroy(); holder = nil end
        if overlay then overlay.gui:Destroy(); overlay = nil end
    end
    return K
end
return createKinetics

end)()
local createProcessing = (function()
-- Create processing (Phase 2): millstone, crushing wheels, mechanical press, mechanical mixer, basin, blaze burner, depot,
-- encased fan (bulk washing / smoking / blasting / haunting), plus inventories that vanilla hoppers can use. Rules follow
-- Create 6.0.10's block entities (MillstoneBlockEntity, CrushingWheelControllerBlockEntity, PressingBehaviour,
-- MechanicalMixerBlockEntity, BasinRecipe, BlazeBurnerBlockEntity, DepotBehaviour, AirCurrent / FanProcessing).
local function createProcessing(K)
    local P = {}
    local B = CONFIG.Block
    local floor, abs, max, min = math.floor, math.abs, math.max, math.min
    local CR
    local function ctx() return JavaContent.mods.ctx end
    local function world() local c = ctx(); return c and c.world end
    local DIR = {north = {0, 0, -1}, south = {0, 0, 1}, east = {1, 0, 0}, west = {-1, 0, 0}, up = {0, 1, 0}, down = {0, -1, 0}}
    local NAMES = {"north", "south", "east", "west", "up", "down"}
    local OPP = {north = "south", south = "north", east = "west", west = "east", up = "down", down = "up"}
    local AXIS_OF = {north = "z", south = "z", east = "x", west = "x", up = "y", down = "y"}
    local POSITIVE = {south = true, east = true, up = true}
    local function dv(d) local v = DIR[d]; return Vector3.new(v[1], v[2], v[3]) end
    local function O() return K.O or Vector3.zero end
    local function cellOf(p) local v = (p - O()) / B; return floor(v.X + 0.5), floor(v.Y + 0.5), floor(v.Z + 0.5) end
    local function centerOf(x, y, z) return O() + Vector3.new(x, y, z) * B end
    local function pkey(x, y, z) return (x + 65536) + (y + 65536) * 131072 + (z + 65536) * 17179869184 end
    local function sampleAt(c) local w = world(); return w and w.sample and w.sample(c) end
    local function nodeAtC(c) local s = sampleAt(c); return s and s.node, s and s.id end
    local function rel(n, d, k) return n.center + dv(d) * B * (k or 1) end
    local function sound(name, pos, vol, pitch) if MinecraftSounds and MinecraftSounds.play then pcall(MinecraftSounds.play, name, pos, vol or 1, pitch or 1) end end
    local function emit(kind, pos, vel, opt) local w = world(); if w and w.effects then pcall(w.effects.emit, kind, pos, vel or Vector3.zero, opt) end end

    -- items --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function nameOf(stack) return stack and Recipes.name(stack) end
    local function stackOf(name, count) return Recipes.stack(name, count or 1) end
    local function limitOf(stack) return (itemStackLimits[stack.id]) or (toolStats[stack.id] and 1 or 64) end
    local function same(a, b) return a and b and CreativeRules.sameItem(a, b) end
    local function copyN(s, n) return CreativeRules.withCount(s, n) end
    -- ItemHandlerHelper.insertItemStacked into a list of slots: returns what did not fit
    local function insertStacked(slots, size, stack)
        local left = stack.count
        for i = 1, size do
            local s = slots[i]
            if left > 0 and s and same(s, stack) and s.count < limitOf(s) then
                local m = min(left, limitOf(s) - s.count); s.count = s.count + m; left = left - m
            end
        end
        for i = 1, size do
            if left > 0 and not slots[i] then local m = min(left, limitOf(stack)); slots[i] = copyN(stack, m); left = left - m end
        end
        return left
    end
    local function dropAt(stack, pos, vel)
        local w = world()
        if w and stack and stack.count > 0 then w.drop(stack, pos, vel or Vector3.zero, true) end
    end
    local function giveToPlayer(stack)
        local c = ctx()
        if not (c and c.inventory and stack) then return end
        local added = c.inventory.add(stack.id, stack.count, nil, stack.damage, stack)
        if added < stack.count then dropAt(copyN(stack, stack.count - added), c.root.Position) end
        if c.ui and c.ui.refresh then c.ui.refresh() end
    end
    local function held()
        local c = ctx()
        return c and c.inventory and c.ui and c.inventory.slots[c.ui.selected]
    end
    local function consumeHeld(stack, amount)
        local w = world()
        if w and w.consume then return w.consume(stack.id, amount or 1) end
        return true
    end

    -- recipes ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function PR(typ) return CR and CR.catalog and CR.catalog.recipes and CR.catalog.recipes.processing and CR.catalog.recipes.processing[typ] or {} end
    local function singleRecipe(typ, name)
        if not name then return nil end
        for _, r in ipairs(PR(typ)) do
            if #r.i == 1 and not r.f and Recipes.matches(r.i[1], name) then return r end
        end
    end
    -- ProcessingOutput.rollOutput: each of the count rolls against the chance
    local function rollResults(r)
        local out = {}
        for _, res in ipairs(r.r or {}) do
            if res.id then
                local c = 0
                for _ = 1, res.c or 1 do if math.random() < (res.p or 1) then c = c + 1 end end
                local s = c > 0 and stackOf(res.id, c)
                if s then out[#out + 1] = s end
            end
        end
        return out
    end
    local function remainderOf(name) local rem = Recipes.remainder(name); return rem and stackOf(rem, 1) end
    -- RecipeApplier.applyRecipeOn(stack): every item of the stack rolls the recipe; outputs merged
    local function applyOnStack(r, stack)
        local out = {}
        local function add(s)
            for _, o in ipairs(out) do if same(o, s) and o.count + s.count <= limitOf(o) then o.count = o.count + s.count; return end end
            out[#out + 1] = s
        end
        for _ = 1, stack.count do for _, s in ipairs(rollResults(r)) do add(s) end end
        return out
    end
    local function cooking(kind, name)
        for _, r in ipairs((JavaContent.data.recipes.cooking or {})[kind] or {}) do
            if Recipes.matches(r.i, name) then return r end
        end
    end

    -- inventories other blocks can use (vanilla hoppers / droppers): adapter = {insert(stack, face) -> bool (one item),
    -- peek(face) -> stack, take(face)} --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local INV = {}
    function P.inventory(n) local f = n and INV[n.id]; return f and f(n) or nil end

    local function destroyVis(vis) for _, v in pairs(vis or {}) do pcall(function() v.model:Destroy() end) end end
    -- per-block data lives on the node; a replaced node (state change) keeps it ---------------------------------------
    local function data(n) n.cr = n.cr or {}; return n.cr end
    local function setState(n, changes)
        local w = world()
        local st = CreativeRules.copy(n.state)
        local diff = false
        for k, v in pairs(changes) do if st[k] ~= v then st[k] = v; diff = true end end
        if not diff then return n end
        local cr = n.cr
        local ok, nn = pcall(w.setBlockAt, n.center, n.index, st)
        if ok and nn then nn.cr = cr; return nn end
        return n
    end

    -- item visuals (depot / basin contents) --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local holder
    local function itemVisual(stack, scale, pos)
        local ok, v = pcall(JavaContent.model, stack.id, {}, scale, holder, pos, true)
        if not ok or not v then return nil end
        for _, d in ipairs(v.model:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.CanCollide, d.CanQuery, d.CanTouch = false, false, false end end
        return v
    end
    local function placeVisual(v, frame)
        if not v then return end
        if v.pivot then pcall(v.pivot, frame) return end
        for _, pair in ipairs(v.parts or {}) do pair[1].CFrame = frame * pair[2] end
    end
    local function clearShown(d)
        for _, v in ipairs(d.shown or {}) do pcall(function() v.model:Destroy() end) end
        d.shown, d.shownKey = nil, nil
    end

    -- drops ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local function drops() local w = world(); return w and w.drops or {} end
    local function dropCell(d) return cellOf(d.position) end
    local function dropStack(d) return d.template and copyN(d.template, d.count) or {id = d.id, count = d.count, damage = d.damage} end
    local function onGround(d) return abs(d.velocity.Y) < B * 0.6 end
    local function netCount(d) local w = world(); if w and w.netDropCount then pcall(w.netDropCount, d) end end

    -- ===== Millstone ==========================================================================================================
    local function millstone(n, speed)
        local d = data(n)
        d.input, d.out = d.input, d.out or {}
        if speed == 0 then return end
        for i = 1, 9 do local s = d.out[i]; if s and s.count >= limitOf(s) then return end end
        local ps = math.clamp(floor(abs(speed / 16)), 1, 512)
        if (d.timer or 0) > 0 then
            d.timer = d.timer - ps
            if math.random() < 0.3 and d.input then emit("smoke", n.center + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.3, 0), Vector3.new(0, B * 0.5, 0), {life = 10, size = 0.1, tint = {0.8, 0.8, 0.8}}) end
            if d.timer <= 0 then
                local r = d.input and singleRecipe("milling", nameOf(d.input))
                if r then
                    local name = nameOf(d.input)
                    d.input.count = d.input.count - 1
                    if d.input.count <= 0 then d.input = nil end
                    for _, s in ipairs(rollResults(r)) do insertStacked(d.out, 9, s) end
                    local rem = remainderOf(name); if rem then insertStacked(d.out, 9, rem) end
                end
            end
        elseif d.input then
            local r = singleRecipe("milling", nameOf(d.input))
            d.timer = r and (r.t or 100) or 100
        end
    end
    local function millstoneAccept(n, stack)
        local d = data(n)
        if not singleRecipe("milling", nameOf(stack)) then return 0 end
        if d.input and not same(d.input, stack) then return 0 end
        local have = d.input and d.input.count or 0
        local m = min(stack.count, limitOf(stack) - have)
        if m <= 0 then return 0 end
        if d.input then d.input.count = have + m else d.input = copyN(stack, m) end
        return m
    end
    INV.millstone = function(n)
        local d = data(n); d.out = d.out or {}
        return {
            insert = function(stack, face) if face == "down" then return false end return millstoneAccept(n, copyN(stack, 1)) == 1 end,
            peek = function() for i = 1, 9 do if d.out[i] then return d.out[i] end end end,
            take = function() for i = 1, 9 do local s = d.out[i]; if s then s.count = s.count - 1; if s.count <= 0 then d.out[i] = nil end return end end end,
        }
    end

    -- ===== Basin ==============================================================================================================
    -- 9 input slots, 9 output slots, 2 input tanks and 2 output tanks of 1000 mB (SmartFluidTankBehaviour)
    local FLUID_OF_BUCKET = {water_bucket = "water", lava_bucket = "lava", milk_bucket = "milk", chocolate_bucket = "chocolate", honey_bucket = "honey"}
    local BUCKET_OF_FLUID = {water = "water_bucket", lava = "lava_bucket", milk = "milk_bucket", chocolate = "chocolate_bucket", honey = "honey_bucket"}
    local FLUID_COLOR = {water = Color3.fromRGB(63, 118, 228), lava = Color3.fromRGB(230, 110, 20), milk = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 240),
        chocolate = Color3.fromRGB(98, 54, 32), honey = Color3.fromRGB(240, 170, 40), tea = Color3.fromRGB(160, 110, 60), potion = Color3.fromRGB(180, 60, 200)}
    local function basinData(n)
        local d = data(n)
        d.inp = d.inp or {}; d.out = d.out or {}
        d.tin = d.tin or {{}, {}}; d.tout = d.tout or {{}, {}}
        return d
    end
    local function fluidMatches(want, fluid)
        if not fluid then return false end
        if want:sub(1, 1) == "#" then
            local tag = want:sub(2)
            if tag == "c:milk" or tag == "milk" then return fluid == "milk" end
            if tag == "water" then return fluid == "water" end
            if tag == "lava" then return fluid == "lava" end
            return tag:match("([%w_]+)$") == fluid
        end
        return want == fluid
    end
    local function tankFill(tanks, fluid, amount, simulate)
        for _, t in ipairs(tanks) do
            if t.fluid == fluid and (t.amount or 0) + amount <= 1000 then if not simulate then t.amount = t.amount + amount end return true end
        end
        for _, t in ipairs(tanks) do
            if not t.fluid or (t.amount or 0) <= 0 then if not simulate then t.fluid, t.amount = fluid, amount end return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function heatOf(n)
        local below = nodeAtC(rel(n, "down"))
        if not below then return "none" end
        if below.id == "blaze_burner" then return below.state.blaze or "smouldering" end
        if below.id == "lit_blaze_burner" then return "smouldering" end
        -- passive_boiler_heaters (fire, campfires, magma...) count as smouldering
        local passive = {fire = true, soul_fire = true, magma_block = true, lava = true}
        if passive[below.id] or ((below.id == "campfire" or below.id == "soul_campfire") and below.state.lit ~= "false") then return "smouldering" end
        return "none"
    end
    local HEAT_RANK = {none = 0, smouldering = 1, fading = 2, kindled = 3, seething = 4}
    local function heatOk(req, heat)
        if not req or req == "none" then return true end
        if req == "heated" then return (HEAT_RANK[heat] or 0) >= 2 end
        if req == "superheated" then return heat == "seething" end
        return true
    end
    -- BasinRecipe.apply: take every ingredient one item at a time from the input slots, fluids from the tanks, then the
    -- outputs must fit (acceptOutputs)
    local function basinApply(n, rec, test)
        local d = basinData(n)
        if rec.h and not heatOk(rec.h, heatOf(n)) then return false end
        local used = {}
        local plan = {}
        for _, ing in ipairs(rec.ings) do
            local found = false
            if ing ~= "" then
                for slot = 1, 9 do
                    local s = d.inp[slot]
                    if s and s.count > (used[slot] or 0) and Recipes.matches(ing, nameOf(s)) then
                        used[slot] = (used[slot] or 0) + 1; plan[#plan + 1] = slot; found = true; break
                    end
                end
                if not found then return false end
            end
        end
        local fluidUse = {}
        for _, f in ipairs(rec.f or {}) do
            local need = f[2]
            local ok = false
            for ti, t in ipairs(d.tin) do
                local avail = (t.amount or 0) - (fluidUse[ti] or 0)
                if fluidMatches(f[1], t.fluid) and avail >= need then fluidUse[ti] = (fluidUse[ti] or 0) + need; ok = true; break end
            end
            if not ok then return false end
        end
        -- outputs
        local outs, fouts = {}, {}
        if rec.craft then
            local s = stackOf(rec.craft.r, rec.craft.c or 1); if s then outs[1] = s end
            for slot, k in pairs(used) do
                local rem = remainderOf(nameOf(d.inp[slot])); if rem then rem.count = k; outs[#outs + 1] = rem end
            end
        else
            for _, res in ipairs(rec.r or {}) do if res.fluid then fouts[#fouts + 1] = {res.fluid, res.amount} end end
            outs = test and {} or rollResults(rec)
            for slot, k in pairs(used) do
                local rem = remainderOf(nameOf(d.inp[slot])); if rem then rem.count = k; outs[#outs + 1] = rem end
            end
        end
        -- acceptOutputs (simulated on copies)
        local outCopy = {}
        for i = 1, 9 do outCopy[i] = d.out[i] and copyN(d.out[i], d.out[i].count) end
        for _, s in ipairs(test and (rec.craft and outs or {}) or outs) do if insertStacked(outCopy, 9, s) > 0 then return false end end
        local tCopy = {{fluid = d.tout[1].fluid, amount = d.tout[1].amount}, {fluid = d.tout[2].fluid, amount = d.tout[2].amount}}
        for _, f in ipairs(fouts) do if not tankFill(tCopy, f[1], f[2], false) then return false end end
        if test then return true end
        for slot, k in pairs(used) do
            local s = d.inp[slot]; s.count = s.count - k; if s.count <= 0 then d.inp[slot] = nil end
        end
        for ti, a in pairs(fluidUse) do
            local t = d.tin[ti]; t.amount = t.amount - a; if t.amount <= 0 then t.fluid, t.amount = nil, 0 end
        end
        for _, s in ipairs(outs) do insertStacked(d.out, 9, s) end
        for _, f in ipairs(fouts) do tankFill(d.tout, f[1], f[2], false) end
        d.dirtyVisual = true
        return true
    end
    -- the recipes a mixer / press can run in a basin (MechanicalMixerBlockEntity / MechanicalPressBlockEntity filters)
    local basinRecipeCache = {}
    local function basinRecipes(kind)
        if basinRecipeCache[kind] then return basinRecipeCache[kind] end
        local list = {}
        for _, r in ipairs(PR(kind == "mixer" and "mixing" or "compacting")) do
            list[#list + 1] = {ings = r.i, f = r.f, r = r.r, h = r.h, t = r.t, n = r.n}
        end
        for _, r in ipairs(JavaContent.data.recipes.crafting or {}) do
            if kind == "mixer" and r.t == "l" and #r.i > 1 then
                -- allowShapelessInMixer: shapeless crafting with more than one ingredient
                list[#list + 1] = {ings = r.i, craft = r, n = r.n}
            elseif kind == "press" and r.t == "s" and (r.w * r.h == 4 or r.w * r.h == 9) then
                -- allowShapedSquareInPress: 2x2 / 3x3 with every ingredient the same
                local function key(k) return type(k) == "table" and table.concat(k, "|") or tostring(k) end
                local first, allSame = key(r.k[1]), true
                for _, k in ipairs(r.k) do
                    if k == "" or key(k) ~= first then allSame = false; break end
                end
                if allSame then list[#list + 1] = {ings = r.k, craft = r, n = r.n} end
            end
        end
        basinRecipeCache[kind] = list
        return list
    end
    local function basinFind(n, kind)
        local d = basinData(n)
        local empty = true
        for i = 1, 9 do if d.inp[i] then empty = false end end
        for _, t in ipairs(d.tin) do if (t.amount or 0) > 0 then empty = false end end
        if empty then return nil end
        if d.lastRecipe and basinApply(n, d.lastRecipe, true) then return d.lastRecipe end
        for _, rec in ipairs(basinRecipes(kind)) do
            if basinApply(n, rec, true) then d.lastRecipe = rec; return rec end
        end
    end
    INV.basin = function(n)
        local d = basinData(n)
        return {
            insert = function(stack, face) if face == "down" then return false end return insertStacked(d.inp, 9, copyN(stack, 1)) == 0 end,
            peek = function() for i = 1, 9 do if d.out[i] then return d.out[i] end end end,
            take = function() for i = 1, 9 do local s = d.out[i]; if s then s.count = s.count - 1; if s.count <= 0 then d.out[i] = nil end; d.dirtyVisual = true; return end end end,
        }
    end

    -- ===== Depot ==============================================================================================================
    -- DepotBehaviour: one held stack + an output buffer the press fills
    INV.depot = function(n)
        local d = data(n); d.buf = d.buf or {}
        return {
            insert = function(stack)
                if d.held and not same(d.held, stack) then return false end
                if d.held then if d.held.count >= limitOf(d.held) then return false end d.held.count = d.held.count + 1
                else d.held = copyN(stack, 1) end
                d.dirtyVisual = true
                return true
            end,
            peek = function() for i = 1, 8 do if d.buf[i] then return d.buf[i] end end return d.held end,
            take = function()
                for i = 1, 8 do local s = d.buf[i]; if s then s.count = s.count - 1; if s.count <= 0 then d.buf[i] = nil end; d.dirtyVisual = true; return end end
                if d.held then d.held.count = d.held.count - 1; if d.held.count <= 0 then d.held = nil end; d.dirtyVisual = true end
            end,
        }
    end

    -- ===== Blaze burner =====================================================================================================
    local FUEL = {coal = 1600, charcoal = 1600, coal_block = 16000, blaze_rod = 2400, lava_bucket = 20000, stick = 100, dried_kelp_block = 4001,
        bamboo = 50, scaffolding = 50, bowl = 100}
    local function burnTime(name)
        if not name then return 0 end
        if FUEL[name] then return FUEL[name] end
        if name:match("_planks$") or name:match("_log$") or name:match("_wood$") or name:match("_stem$") or name:match("_hyphae$") then return 300 end
        if name:match("_slab$") and (name:match("oak") or name:match("spruce") or name:match("birch") or name:match("jungle") or name:match("acacia")) then return 150 end
        return 0
    end
    -- BlazeBurnerBlockEntity.tryUpdateFuel
    local function burnerFuel(n, stack, forceOverflow)
        local d = data(n)
        local name = nameOf(stack)
        local newFuel, t = 0, 0
        if name == "blaze_cake" or name == "creative_blaze_cake" then newFuel, t = 2, 3200
        else t = burnTime(name); if t > 0 then newFuel = 1 end end
        if newFuel == 0 then return false end
        d.fuel, d.burn = d.fuel or 0, d.burn or 0
        if newFuel < d.fuel then return false end
        if newFuel == d.fuel then
            if d.burn <= 500 then t = t + d.burn
            else
                if not forceOverflow or newFuel ~= 1 then return false end
                t = d.burn < 10000 and min(d.burn + t, 10000) or d.burn
            end
        end
        d.fuel, d.burn = newFuel, t
        sound("entity.blaze.shoot", n.center, 0.25, 1)
        for _ = 1, 8 do emit(newFuel == 2 and "soul_fire_flame" or "flame", n.center + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0.2, math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.6, Vector3.new(0, B * 0.6, 0), {life = 12, size = 0.12}) end
        return true
    end
    local function burnerHeat(n)
        local d = data(n)
        if (d.fuel or 0) == 2 then return "seething" end
        if (d.fuel or 0) == 1 then return (d.burn or 0) / 10000 < 0.0125 and "fading" or "kindled" end
        return "smouldering"
    end
    local function burnerTick(n)
        local d = data(n)
        if (d.burn or 0) > 0 then d.burn = d.burn - 1 end
        if (d.fuel or 0) > 0 and (d.burn or 0) <= 0 then
            if d.fuel == 2 then d.fuel, d.burn = 1, 5000 else d.fuel = 0 end
        end
        local above = nodeAtC(rel(n, "up"))
        d.blockAbove = above ~= nil and above.id == "basin"
        local want = burnerHeat(n)
        if n.state.blaze ~= want then n = setState(n, {blaze = want}) end
        local heat = want
        if heat ~= "smouldering" and math.random() < 0.15 then
            emit(heat == "seething" and "soul_fire_flame" or "flame", n.center + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5, 0.15, (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5) * B, Vector3.new(0, B * 0.3, 0), {life = 14, size = 0.1})
        end
        return n
    end
    INV.blaze_burner = function(n)
        return {insert = function(stack) return burnerFuel(n, stack, false) end, peek = function() end, take = function() end}
    end

    -- ===== Crushing wheels ==================================================================================================
    local controllers = {}
    local function wheelPairs()
        -- CrushingWheelBlock.updateControllers: two wheels with the same axis, two apart across a side, put a controller between
        local want = {}
        for _, n in pairs(K.byPos or {}) do
            if n.id == "crushing_wheel" then
                local ax = n.state.axis or "y"
                for _, s in ipairs(NAMES) do
                    if AXIS_OF[s] ~= ax then
                        local other = nodeAtC(rel(n, s, 2))
                        if other and other.id == "crushing_wheel" and (other.state.axis or "y") == ax then
                            local c = rel(n, s, 1)
                            local valid = (n.speed or 0) ~= 0 and (other.speed or 0) ~= 0 and ((n.speed > 0) ~= (other.speed > 0)) and not n.overstressed
                            local facing = "down"
                            if valid then
                                local ado = (n.speed > 0 and 1 or -1) * (POSITIVE[s] and 1 or -1)
                                local a = ax == "x" and Vector3.xAxis or ax == "y" and Vector3.yAxis or Vector3.zAxis
                                local b = dv(s); b = Vector3.new(abs(b.X), abs(b.Y), abs(b.Z))
                                local v = a:Cross(b) * ado
                                local bx, by, bz = abs(v.X), abs(v.Y), abs(v.Z)
                                if by >= bx and by >= bz then facing = v.Y > 0 and "up" or "down"
                                elseif bx >= bz then facing = v.X > 0 and "east" or "west"
                                else facing = v.Z > 0 and "south" or "north" end
                            end
                            local x, y, z = cellOf(c)
                            want[pkey(x, y, z)] = {center = c, valid = valid, facing = facing, speed = abs(n.speed or 0) / 50}
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return want
    end
    local function maintainControllers()
        local w = world()
        local entry = JavaContent.byId.crushing_wheel_controller
        if not (w and entry) then return end
        local want = wheelPairs()
        for k, c in pairs(want) do
            local node, id = nodeAtC(c.center)
            local st = {valid = tostring(c.valid), facing = c.facing}
            if node and node.id == "crushing_wheel_controller" then
                if node.state.valid ~= st.valid or node.state.facing ~= st.facing then node = setState(node, st) end
                data(node).speed = c.valid and c.speed or 0
                controllers[k] = node
            elseif not node and (id == nil or id == "air" or id == "water") then
                local ok, nn = pcall(w.setBlockAt, c.center, entry.index, st, false, CR and CR.id)
                if ok and nn then data(nn).speed = c.valid and c.speed or 0; controllers[k] = nn end
            end
        end
        for k, node in pairs(controllers) do
            if not want[k] then
                controllers[k] = nil
                local cur = nodeAtC(node.center)
                if cur and cur.id == "crushing_wheel_controller" then
                    local d = data(cur)
                    for _, s in ipairs(d.inv or {}) do dropAt(s, cur.center) end
                    pcall(w.setBlockAt, cur.center, nil, nil, false)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function controllerTick(n)
        local d = data(n)
        d.inv = d.inv or {}
        local facing = n.state.facing or "down"
        local speed = (d.speed or 0) * 4
        -- items falling into the controller's space are taken in (entityInside); the outputs carry a bypass mark
        if not d.inv[1] and d.speed and d.speed > 0 then
            for _, dr in ipairs(drops()) do
                if dr.count > 0 and dr.crBypass ~= n then
                    local x, y, z = dropCell(dr)
                    local cx, cy, cz = cellOf(n.center)
                    if x == cx and y == cy and z == cz then
                        d.inv[1] = dropStack(dr); dr.count = 0; netCount(dr)
                        local r = singleRecipe("crushing", nameOf(d.inv[1])) or singleRecipe("milling", nameOf(d.inv[1]))
                        d.remaining = r and (r.t or 100) or 100
                        d.applied = false
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if not d.inv[1] or speed == 0 then return end
        local count = d.inv[1].count
        local ps = math.clamp(speed / ((not d.applied) and (math.log(count) / math.log(2)) or 1), 0.25, 20)
        if count == 1 and not d.applied then ps = 20 end
        d.remaining = (d.remaining or 100) - ps
        if math.random() < 0.5 then
            local okE, e = pcall(function() return JavaContent.byIndex[d.inv[1].id] end)
            if okE and e then
                local w = world()
                if w and w.effects and w.effects.block and math.random() < 0.2 then pcall(w.effects.block, d.inv[1].id, n.center, false) end
            end
        end
        if d.remaining < 20 and not d.applied then
            local r = singleRecipe("crushing", nameOf(d.inv[1])) or singleRecipe("milling", nameOf(d.inv[1]))
            if r then
                local outs = applyOnStack(r, d.inv[1])
                local rem = remainderOf(nameOf(d.inv[1])); if rem then rem.count = d.inv[1].count; outs[#outs + 1] = rem end
                d.inv = outs
            end
            d.applied = true
        elseif d.remaining <= 0 then
            local off = POSITIVE[facing] and 1 or -1
            local f = dv(facing)
            local outSpeed = Vector3.new(AXIS_OF[facing] == "x" and 0.25 * off or 0, (off == 1 and AXIS_OF[facing] == "y") and 0.5 or 0, AXIS_OF[facing] == "z" and 0.25 * off or 0)
            local outPos = n.center + f * B * 0.55
            local w = world()
            for _, s in ipairs(d.inv) do
                if s.count > 0 and w then
                    w.drop(s, outPos, outSpeed * B * 20, true)
                    local last = w.drops[#w.drops]; if last then last.crBypass = n end
                end
            end
            d.inv = {}
            d.applied = false
        end
    end

    -- ===== Mechanical press =====================================================================================================
    local function pressTick(n, speed)
        local d = data(n)
        d.ticks = d.ticks or 0
        local step = speed == 0 and 0 or floor(math.clamp(abs(speed) / 512, 0, 1) * 59 + 1)
        if d.running then
            d.prev = d.ticks
            if d.ticks == 120 and speed ~= 0 and not d.appliedAt then
                d.appliedAt = true
                if d.mode == "world" then
                    -- applyInWorld: the first item entity on the ground in the block below
                    local bx, by, bz = cellOf(rel(n, "down"))
                    for _, dr in ipairs(drops()) do
                        local x, y, z = dropCell(dr)
                        if dr.count > 0 and x == bx and y == by and z == bz then
                            local r = singleRecipe("pressing", nameOf({id = dr.id}))
                            if r then
                                local one = copyN(dropStack(dr), 1)
                                for _, s in ipairs(applyOnStack(r, one)) do dropAt(s, dr.position, Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 2, 0, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2)) end
                                dr.count = dr.count - 1; netCount(dr)
                            end
                            break
                        end
                    end
                elseif d.mode == "belt" then
                    local dep = nodeAtC(rel(n, "down", 2))
                    local bit = P.beltItemAt and P.beltItemAt(rel(n, "down", 2))
                    if bit and bit.stack then
                        -- BeltPressingCallbacks: the item on the belt becomes the result
                        local r = singleRecipe("pressing", nameOf(bit.stack))
                        local one = copyN(bit.stack, 1)
                        local outs = r and applyOnStack(r, one) or (P.seqStep and {P.seqStep(one, "pressing")}) or {}
                        bit.stack.count = bit.stack.count - 1
                        local rest = bit.stack.count > 0 and bit.stack or nil
                        bit.stack = rest or table.remove(outs, 1)
                        for _, s in ipairs(outs) do dropAt(s, rel(n, "down", 2) + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.5, 0)) end
                        bit.processedAt, bit.waiting = bit.waiting, nil
                    elseif dep and dep.id == "depot" then
                        local dd = data(dep); dd.buf = dd.buf or {}
                        local r = dd.held and singleRecipe("pressing", nameOf(dd.held))
                        local seqOut = (not r) and dd.held and P.seqStep and P.seqStep(copyN(dd.held, 1), "pressing")
                        if r or seqOut then
                            local outs = seqOut and {seqOut} or applyOnStack(r, copyN(dd.held, 1))
                            dd.held.count = dd.held.count - 1
                            if dd.held.count <= 0 then dd.held = table.remove(outs, 1) end
                            for _, s in ipairs(outs) do
                                if dd.held and same(dd.held, s) and dd.held.count + s.count <= limitOf(s) then dd.held.count = dd.held.count + s.count
                                else insertStacked(dd.buf, 8, s) end
                            end
                            dd.dirtyVisual = true
                        end
                    end
                elseif d.mode == "basin" then
                    local basin = nodeAtC(rel(n, "down", 2))
                    if basin and basin.id == "basin" then
                        local rec = basinFind(basin, "press")
                        if rec then basinApply(basin, rec, false) end
                    end
                end
                sound("block.piston.extend", n.center, 0.5, 0.75 + abs(speed) / 1024)
                for _ = 1, 6 do emit("smoke", rel(n, "down", d.mode == "world" and 1 or 2) + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0.3, math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.6, Vector3.new(0, B * 0.2, 0), {life = 10, size = 0.1, tint = {0.8, 0.8, 0.8}}) end
            end
            if d.ticks > 240 then
                d.running, d.ticks, d.appliedAt = false, 0, nil
            else
                local before = d.ticks
                d.ticks = d.ticks + step
                if before < 120 and d.ticks >= 120 then d.ticks = 120; d.appliedAt = nil end
            end
            return
        end
        if speed == 0 then return end
        d.scan = (d.scan or 0) - 1
        if d.scan > 0 then return end
        d.scan = 10
        local below2 = nodeAtC(rel(n, "down", 2))
        local bit = P.beltItemAt and P.beltItemAt(rel(n, "down", 2))
        if bit and bit.stack and (singleRecipe("pressing", nameOf(bit.stack)) or (P.seqKind and P.seqKind(bit.stack) == "pressing")) then
            d.running, d.mode, d.ticks = true, "belt", 0
            return
        end
        if below2 and below2.id == "belt" then return end
        if below2 and below2.id == "depot" then
            local dd = data(below2)
            if dd.held and (singleRecipe("pressing", nameOf(dd.held)) or (P.seqKind and P.seqKind(dd.held) == "pressing")) then d.running, d.mode, d.ticks = true, "belt", 0 end
            return
        end
        if below2 and below2.id == "basin" then
            if basinFind(below2, "press") then d.running, d.mode, d.ticks = true, "basin", 0 end
            return
        end
        local bx, by, bz = cellOf(rel(n, "down"))
        for _, dr in ipairs(drops()) do
            local x, y, z = dropCell(dr)
            if dr.count > 0 and x == bx and y == by and z == bz and onGround(dr) and singleRecipe("pressing", nameOf({id = dr.id})) then
                d.running, d.mode, d.ticks = true, "world", 0
                return
            end
        end
    end

    -- ===== Mechanical mixer =====================================================================================================
    local function mixerTick(n, speed)
        local d = data(n)
        d.rt = d.rt or 0
        if d.rt >= 40 then d.running, d.rt = false, 0 end
        if d.running then
            if speed == 0 then
                if d.rt < 20 then d.rt = 40 - d.rt elseif d.rt == 20 then d.rt = d.rt + 1 end
            end
            if d.rt == 20 then
                local basin = nodeAtC(rel(n, "down", 2))
                if not (basin and basin.id == "basin") then d.running, d.rt = false, 0; return end
                if (d.pt or -1) < 0 then
                    local t = d.recipe and d.recipe.t or 0
                    local rs = t ~= 0 and t / 100 or 1
                    local lg = math.log(512 / max(abs(speed), 1)) / math.log(2)
                    d.pt = max(floor(lg) * math.ceil(rs * 15) + 1, 1)
                    sound("block.bubble_column.whirlpool_ambient", basin.center, 0.5, abs(speed) < 65 and 0.75 or 1.5)
                else
                    d.pt = d.pt - 1
                    if math.random() < 0.4 then emit("splash", basin.center + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6, 0.1, (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6) * B, Vector3.new(0, B * 0.5, 0), {life = 10, size = 0.1}) end
                    if d.pt == 0 then
                        d.rt = d.rt + 1; d.pt = -1
                        local rec = basinFind(basin, "mixer")
                        if rec then basinApply(basin, rec, false) end
                    end
                end
            end
            if d.rt ~= 20 then d.rt = d.rt + 1 end
            return
        end
        if speed == 0 then return end
        d.scan = (d.scan or 0) - 1
        if d.scan > 0 then return end
        d.scan = 10
        local basin = nodeAtC(rel(n, "down", 2))
        if basin and basin.id == "basin" then
            local rec = basinFind(basin, "mixer")
            if rec then d.running, d.rt, d.pt, d.recipe = true, 0, -1, rec end
        end
    end

    -- ===== Encased fan ==========================================================================================================
    local function catalystAt(c)
        local node, id = nodeAtC(c)
        id = id or (node and node.id)
        if not id then return nil end
        if id == "water" or id == "flowing_water" then return "splashing" end
        if id == "lava" or id == "flowing_lava" then return "blasting" end
        if id == "soul_fire" then return "haunting" end
        if id == "fire" then return "smoking" end
        if id == "campfire" and node and node.state.lit ~= "false" then return "smoking" end
        if id == "soul_campfire" and node and node.state.lit ~= "false" then return "haunting" end
        if id == "lit_blaze_burner" then return (node and node.state.flame_type == "soul") and "haunting" or "smoking" end
        if id == "blaze_burner" and node then
            local h = node.state.blaze or "smouldering"
            if h == "smouldering" then return "smoking" end
            if HEAT_RANK[h] and HEAT_RANK[h] >= 2 then return "blasting" end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function blocksAir(c)
        local node, id = nodeAtC(c)
        if not node then return false end
        if id == "water" or id == "lava" or catalystAt(c) then return false end
        local okS, shape = pcall(JavaContent.shape, node.id, node.state)
        if okS and shape then return shape.full == true end
        return node.solid == true
    end
    -- the processing types: what an item becomes (nil = nothing to do)
    local function fanProcess(kind, stack)
        local name = nameOf(stack)
        if kind == "splashing" or kind == "haunting" then
            local r = singleRecipe(kind, name)
            return r and applyOnStack(r, stack) or nil
        end
        if kind == "smoking" then
            local r = cooking("smoking", name)
            if not r then return nil end
            local s = stackOf(r.r, (r.c or 1) * stack.count); return s and {s} or {}
        end
        if kind == "blasting" then
            local sm = cooking("smelting", name) or cooking("blasting", name)
            local smk = cooking("smoking", name)
            if sm then
                if smk and smk.r == sm.r then return {} end
                local s = stackOf(sm.r, (sm.c or 1) * stack.count); return s and {s} or {}
            end
            -- no recipe: the item burns away (unless fire resistant)
            if name and (name:match("^netherite") or name == "ancient_debris") then return nil end
            return {}
        end
    end
    local function fanTick(n, speed)
        local d = data(n)
        if speed == 0 then d.current = nil; return end
        local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
        local conv = POSITIVE[facing] and speed or -speed
        local flowDir = conv > 0 and facing or OPP[facing]
        local pushing = flowDir == facing
        d.rebuild = (d.rebuild or 0) - 1
        if d.rebuild <= 0 or not d.current then
            d.rebuild = 30
            local factor = min(abs(speed) / 256, 1)
            local maxD = 3 + (20 - 3) * factor
            local limit = 0
            for i = 1, math.ceil(maxD) do
                if blocksAir(rel(n, facing, i)) then break end
                limit = i
            end
            maxD = min(maxD, limit)
            local segs = {}
            local typ
            for i = 1, math.ceil(maxD) do
                local t = catalystAt(rel(n, facing, i))
                if pushing then if t then typ = t end segs[i] = typ end
            end
            if not pushing then
                for i = math.ceil(maxD), 1, -1 do local t = catalystAt(rel(n, facing, i)); if t then typ = t end segs[i] = typ end
            end
            d.current = {maxD = maxD, segs = segs}
        end
        local cur = d.current
        if cur.maxD < 0.25 then return end
        local f = dv(facing)
        local flow = dv(flowDir)
        for _, dr in ipairs(drops()) do
            if dr.count > 0 then
                local rp = (dr.position - n.center) / B
                local along = rp:Dot(f)
                local side = rp - f * along
                -- the current's bounds (one block wide) against the item's box (0.25 wide, resting on the floor)
                if along > 0.5 and along <= cur.maxD + 0.5 and abs(side.X) < 0.65 and side.Y > -0.95 and side.Y < 0.65 and abs(side.Z) < 0.65 then
                    -- AirCurrent.tickAffectedEntities: accelerate along the flow (MC blocks/tick -> studs/s)
                    local distOld = max(along, 0.1)
                    local acc = abs(speed) / 512 / (distOld / cur.maxD)
                    local prev = dr.velocity / (B * 20)
                    local maxAcc = 5
                    local dvx = math.clamp(flow.X * acc - prev.X, -maxAcc, maxAcc)
                    local dvy = math.clamp(flow.Y * acc - prev.Y, -maxAcc, maxAcc)
                    local dvz = math.clamp(flow.Z * acc - prev.Z, -maxAcc, maxAcc)
                    dr.velocity = (prev + Vector3.new(dvx, dvy, dvz) * 0.125) * B * 20
                    local typ = cur.segs[math.clamp(math.floor(along - 0.5) + 1, 1, #cur.segs > 0 and #cur.segs or 1)]
                    if typ then
                        -- FanProcessing: 150 ticks x (stack size / 16 rounded up), then the whole stack converts
                        if dr.crFanType ~= typ then
                            local probe = fanProcess(typ, copyN(dropStack(dr), 1))
                            dr.crFanType = typ
                            dr.crFanTime = probe and (150 * (floor((dr.count - 1) / 16) + 1) + 1) or nil
                        end
                        if math.random() < 0.15 then
                            local pk = typ == "splashing" and "splash" or typ == "haunting" and "soul_fire_flame" or typ == "blasting" and "flame" or "smoke"
                            emit(pk, dr.position, Vector3.new(0, B * 0.3, 0), {life = 12, size = 0.1})
                        end
                        if dr.crFanTime then
                            dr.crFanTime = dr.crFanTime - 1
                            if dr.crFanTime <= 0 then
                                local outs = fanProcess(typ, dropStack(dr))
                                if outs then
                                    local pos, vel = dr.position, dr.velocity
                                    dr.count = 0; netCount(dr)
                                    for _, s in ipairs(outs) do dropAt(s, pos, vel) end
                                    if typ == "splashing" then sound("entity.generic.splash", pos, 0.25, 1.5)
                                    elseif typ ~= "haunting" then sound("block.fire.extinguish", pos, 0.25, 1.4) end
                                end
                                dr.crFanType, dr.crFanTime = nil, nil
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        -- airflow particles
        if math.random() < 0.3 then
            local off = pushing and 0.5 or cur.maxD + 0.5
            emit("cloud", n.center + f * B * off + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * B * 0.6, flow * B * 2, {life = 10, size = 0.08, tint = {0.9, 0.9, 0.9}})
        end
    end

    -- ===== Fluids: pipes, mechanical pumps, fluid tanks, spouts, item drains (FluidPropagator / FluidNetwork) ==================
    local FLUID_TANK_CAP = 8000
    local PIPE = {fluid_pipe = true, encased_fluid_pipe = true, glass_fluid_pipe = true, fluid_valve = true, smart_fluid_pipe = true}
    local HANDLER = {fluid_tank = true, creative_fluid_tank = true, basin = true, spout = true, item_drain = true}
    local function fluidHandler(n)
        if not n then return nil end
        if n.id == "fluid_tank" or n.id == "creative_fluid_tank" then
            local d = data(n); d.tank = d.tank or {}
            local creative = n.id == "creative_fluid_tank"
            return {
                fluid = function() return d.tank.fluid, d.tank.amount or 0 end,
                fill = function(fl, a, sim)
                    if d.tank.fluid and d.tank.fluid ~= fl and (d.tank.amount or 0) > 0 then return 0 end
                    local m = math.min(a, FLUID_TANK_CAP - (d.tank.amount or 0))
                    if creative then m = a end
                    if not sim and m > 0 then d.tank.fluid, d.tank.amount = fl, math.min(FLUID_TANK_CAP, (d.tank.amount or 0) + m); d.dirtyVisual = true end
                    return m
                end,
                drain = function(a, sim)
                    local m = math.min(a, d.tank.amount or 0)
                    local fl = d.tank.fluid
                    if creative then return a, fl end
                    if not sim and m > 0 then d.tank.amount = d.tank.amount - m; if d.tank.amount <= 0 then d.tank.fluid = nil end; d.dirtyVisual = true end
                    return m, fl
                end,
            }
        end
        if n.id == "basin" then
            local d = basinData(n)
            return {
                fluid = function() for _, t in ipairs(d.tout) do if (t.amount or 0) > 0 then return t.fluid, t.amount end end return nil, 0 end,
                fill = function(fl, a, sim)
                    for _, t in ipairs(d.tin) do
                        if t.fluid == fl or not t.fluid or (t.amount or 0) <= 0 then
                            local m = math.min(a, 1000 - (t.amount or 0))
                            if not sim and m > 0 then t.fluid, t.amount = fl, (t.amount or 0) + m; d.dirtyVisual = true end
                            return m
                        end
                    end
                    return 0
                end,
                drain = function(a, sim)
                    for _, t in ipairs(d.tout) do
                        if (t.amount or 0) > 0 then
                            local m, fl = math.min(a, t.amount), t.fluid
                            if not sim then t.amount = t.amount - m; if t.amount <= 0 then t.fluid = nil end; d.dirtyVisual = true end
                            return m, fl
                        end
                    end
                    return 0
                end,
            }
        end
        if n.id == "spout" or n.id == "item_drain" then
            local d = data(n); d.tank = d.tank or {}
            local cap = n.id == "spout" and 1000 or 1500
            return {
                fluid = function() return d.tank.fluid, d.tank.amount or 0 end,
                fill = function(fl, a, sim)
                    if n.id == "item_drain" then return 0 end
                    if d.tank.fluid and d.tank.fluid ~= fl and (d.tank.amount or 0) > 0 then return 0 end
                    local m = math.min(a, cap - (d.tank.amount or 0))
                    if not sim and m > 0 then d.tank.fluid, d.tank.amount = fl, (d.tank.amount or 0) + m end
                    return m
                end,
                drain = function(a, sim)
                    if n.id == "spout" then return 0 end
                    local m, fl = math.min(a, d.tank.amount or 0), d.tank.fluid
                    if not sim and m > 0 then d.tank.amount = d.tank.amount - m; if d.tank.amount <= 0 then d.tank.fluid = nil end end
                    return m, fl
                end,
            }
        end
    end
    -- FluidPipeBlock.updateBlockState: a pipe connects to pipes, pumps on their axis and fluid handlers; with fewer than two
    -- connections it stays straight
    local function pipeConnects(n, d)
        local o = nodeAtC(rel(n, d))
        if not o then return false end
        if o.id == "fluid_pipe" or o.id == "encased_fluid_pipe" or o.id == "smart_fluid_pipe" or o.id == "fluid_valve" then return true end
        if o.id == "glass_fluid_pipe" then return (o.state.axis or "y") == AXIS_OF[d] end
        if o.id == "mechanical_pump" then return AXIS_OF[o.state.facing or "north"] == AXIS_OF[d] end
        if HANDLER[o.id] then
            if o.id == "basin" then return d ~= "up" end
            if o.id == "spout" then return d == "down" or AXIS_OF[d] ~= "y" end
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    local function updatePipe(n)
        if n.id ~= "fluid_pipe" then return n end
        local want = {}
        local count = 0
        for _, d in ipairs(NAMES) do want[d] = pipeConnects(n, d); if want[d] then count = count + 1 end end
        if count == 1 then for d, v in pairs(want) do if v then want[OPP[d]] = true end end end
        if count == 0 then want.north, want.south = true, true end
        local changes = {}
        for d, v in pairs(want) do changes[d] = tostring(v) end
        return setState(n, changes)
    end
    -- the sides a fluid block is open to
    local function opens(n, d)
        if n.id == "fluid_pipe" or n.id == "encased_fluid_pipe" then return n.state[d] == "true" or n.id == "encased_fluid_pipe" and pipeConnects(n, d) end
        if n.id == "glass_fluid_pipe" then return (n.state.axis or "y") == AXIS_OF[d] end
        if n.id == "smart_fluid_pipe" or n.id == "fluid_valve" then
            local ax = n.state.axis or AXIS_OF[n.state.facing or "north"]
            if n.id == "fluid_valve" and n.state.enabled == "false" then return false end
            return ax == AXIS_OF[d]
        end
        if n.id == "mechanical_pump" then return AXIS_OF[n.state.facing or "north"] == AXIS_OF[d] end
        return false
    end
    -- walk the pipes from a pump side: handlers and open ends within mechanicalPumpRange (16)
    local function walk(pump, side)
        local out = {}
        local seen = {}
        local start = rel(pump, side)
        local queue = {{start, OPP[side], 1}}
        local px, py, pz = cellOf(pump.center)
        seen[pkey(px, py, pz)] = true
        local head = 1
        while queue[head] do
            local c, from, dist = queue[head][1], queue[head][2], queue[head][3]; head = head + 1
            local x, y, z = cellOf(c)
            local k = pkey(x, y, z)
            if not seen[k] and dist <= 16 then
                seen[k] = true
                local n, id = nodeAtC(c)
                if n and HANDLER[n.id] then
                    out[#out + 1] = {handler = fluidHandler(n), node = n}
                elseif n and PIPE[n.id] then
                    if opens(n, from) then
                        for _, d in ipairs(NAMES) do
                            if d ~= from and opens(n, d) then queue[#queue + 1] = {rel(n, d), OPP[d], dist + 1} end
                        end
                    end
                elseif n and n.id == "mechanical_pump" then
                    -- through another pump in series
                elseif n and (n.id == "water" or n.id == "lava") then
                    -- an open end in a world fluid (OpenEndedPipe pulls / pushes into it)
                    local src = n.state.level == nil or n.state.level == "0"
                    out[#out + 1] = {open = c, id = src and n.id or ("flowing_" .. n.id)}
                elseif not n then
                    -- an open-ended pipe (OpenEndedPipe): world fluids in and out
                    out[#out + 1] = {open = c, id = id}
                end
            end
        end
        return out
    end
    local WORLD_FLUID = {water = "water", flowing_water = "water", lava = "lava", flowing_lava = "lava"}
    local function pumpTick(n, speed)
        local d = data(n)
        if speed == 0 then return end
        d.cool = (d.cool or 0) - 1
        if d.cool > 0 then return end
        d.cool = 5
        local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
