        -- PumpBlockEntity: pulls at the back, pushes out of the front, whichever way it turns
        local toward = facing
        local srcs = walk(n, OPP[toward])
        local dsts = walk(n, toward)
        local budget = math.max(1, math.abs(speed) / 2) * 5
        -- sources: handlers holding fluid, or a world fluid at an open end
        for _, s in ipairs(srcs) do
            if budget <= 0 then break end
            local fl, have
            if s.handler then fl, have = s.handler.fluid()
            elseif s.open and (s.id == "water" or s.id == "lava") then fl, have = s.id, math.huge end   -- only source blocks drain
            if fl and (have or 0) > 0 then
                for _, t in ipairs(dsts) do
                    if budget <= 0 then break end
                    local amount = math.min(budget, have)
                    local moved = 0
                    if t.handler then
                        moved = t.handler.fill(fl, amount, false)
                    elseif t.open and not t.id then
                        -- an open end into air: the fluid gathers there and becomes a source block per bucket
                        d.spill = (d.spill or 0) + amount
                        moved = amount
                        if d.spill >= 1000 then
                            d.spill = d.spill - 1000
                            local e = JavaContent.byId[fl]
                            local w = world()
                            if e and w then pcall(w.setBlockAt, t.open, e.index, CreativeRules.copy(e.state or {})) end
                        end
                    end
                    if moved > 0 then
                        budget = budget - moved
                        if s.handler then s.handler.drain(moved, false)
                        elseif s.id == "lava" then
                            -- lava is not infinite: the source goes once a bucket has been taken
                            d.taken = (d.taken or 0) + moved
                            if d.taken >= 1000 then d.taken = 0; local w = world(); if w then pcall(w.setBlockAt, s.open, nil) end end
                        end
                        have = have - moved
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- tanks: fluid settles into the tank below (a tank column behaves like one multiblock tank)
    local function tankTick(n)
        local d = data(n); d.tank = d.tank or {}
        if (d.tank.amount or 0) <= 0 then return end
        local below = nodeAtC(rel(n, "down"))
        if below and (below.id == "fluid_tank") then
            local h = fluidHandler(below)
            local m = h.fill(d.tank.fluid, math.min(d.tank.amount, 200), false)
            if m > 0 then fluidHandler(n).drain(m, false) end
        end
    end
    -- spout (SpoutBlockEntity, FILLING_TIME 20): fills the item on the depot / belt two below
    local BUCKET_FOR = {water = "water_bucket", lava = "lava_bucket", milk = "milk_bucket", chocolate = "chocolate_bucket", honey = "honey_bucket"}
    local function fillResult(stack, fl, amount)
        local name = nameOf(stack)
        for _, r in ipairs(PR("filling")) do
            local f = r.f and r.f[1]
            if f and Recipes.matches(r.i[1], name) and fluidMatches(f[1], fl) and amount >= f[2] then
                local outs = rollResults(r)
                return outs[1], f[2]
            end
        end
        if name == "bucket" and BUCKET_FOR[fl] and amount >= 1000 then return stackOf(BUCKET_FOR[fl], 1), 1000 end
        if name == "glass_bottle" and fl == "water" and amount >= 250 then
            local s = stackOf("potion", 1); if s then s.potion = "water" end
            return s, 250
        end
    end
    local function spoutTick(n)
        local d = data(n); d.tank = d.tank or {}
        local target = rel(n, "down", 2)
        local dep = nodeAtC(target)
        local bit = P.beltItemAt and P.beltItemAt(target)
        local holder
        if bit and bit.stack then holder = {get = function() return bit.stack end, set = function(s) bit.stack = s; bit.processedAt, bit.waiting = bit.waiting, nil end}
        elseif dep and dep.id == "depot" then
            local dd = data(dep)
            holder = {get = function() return dd.held end, set = function(s) dd.held = s; dd.dirtyVisual = true end, buf = dd}
        end
        if not holder or not holder.get() then d.pt = nil; return end
        local stack = holder.get()
        local out, cost = fillResult(copyN(stack, 1), d.tank.fluid, d.tank.amount or 0)
        if not out then d.pt = nil; return end
        d.pt = (d.pt or 20) - 1
        if d.pt == 5 then sound("block.bubble_column.upwards_inside", n.center, 0.6, 1.2) end
        if d.pt > 0 then return end
        d.pt = nil
        d.tank.amount = d.tank.amount - cost; if d.tank.amount <= 0 then d.tank.fluid = nil end
        if stack.count <= 1 then holder.set(out)
        else
            stack.count = stack.count - 1
            if holder.buf then holder.buf.buf = holder.buf.buf or {}; insertStacked(holder.buf.buf, 8, out)
            else dropAt(out, target + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.5, 0)) end
        end
    end
    P.spoutWants = function(spout, stack)
        local d = spout.cr
        return d and d.tank and fillResult(copyN(stack, 1), d.tank.fluid, d.tank.amount or 0) ~= nil
    end
    -- item drain (ItemDrainBlockEntity): an item placed on it is emptied into its tank
    local FLUID_OF_ITEM = {water_bucket = {"water", 1000, "bucket"}, lava_bucket = {"lava", 1000, "bucket"}, milk_bucket = {"milk", 1000, "bucket"},
        chocolate_bucket = {"chocolate", 1000, "bucket"}, honey_bucket = {"honey", 1000, "bucket"}, honey_bottle = {"honey", 250, "glass_bottle"}}
    local function drainTick(n)
        local d = data(n); d.tank = d.tank or {}
        -- items dropped on top go in
        if not d.held then
            for _, dr in ipairs(drops()) do
                if dr.count > 0 then
                    local rp = (dr.position - n.center) / B
                    if math.abs(rp.X) < 0.5 and math.abs(rp.Z) < 0.5 and rp.Y > 0.2 and rp.Y < 1 then d.held = dropStack(dr); dr.count = 0; netCount(dr); break end
                end
            end
        end
        if not d.held then return end
        local name = nameOf(d.held)
        local info = FLUID_OF_ITEM[name]
        if not info then
            for _, r in ipairs(PR("emptying")) do
                if Recipes.matches(r.i[1], name) then
                    for _, res in ipairs(r.r) do if res.fluid then info = {res.fluid, res.amount} elseif res.id then info = info or {}; info.out = res.id end end
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if not info or not info[1] then
            -- nothing to empty: the item stays (Java passes it on to a belt / funnel)
            return
        end
        if d.tank.fluid and d.tank.fluid ~= info[1] and (d.tank.amount or 0) > 0 then return end
        if (d.tank.amount or 0) + info[2] > 1500 then return end
        d.pt = (d.pt or 20) - 1
        if d.pt > 0 then return end
        d.pt = nil
        d.tank.fluid, d.tank.amount = info[1], (d.tank.amount or 0) + info[2]
        local rem = info[3] or info.out
        d.held.count = d.held.count - 1
        if d.held.count <= 0 then d.held = nil end
        if rem then
            local s = stackOf(rem, 1)
            if s then if not d.held then d.held = s else dropAt(s, n.center + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.6, 0)) end end
        end
        sound("item.bucket.empty", n.center, 0.4, 1)
    end
    -- tank / drain / spout contents: a fluid column
    local function fluidRender(n)
        local d = n.cr
        if not d then return end
        local fl, amt = d.tank and d.tank.fluid, d.tank and d.tank.amount or 0
        local cap = n.id == "fluid_tank" and FLUID_TANK_CAP or n.id == "spout" and 1000 or 1500
        local key = tostring(fl) .. math.floor(amt / cap * 32)
        if d.fluidKey == key then return end
        d.fluidKey = key
        if d.fluidPart then d.fluidPart:Destroy(); d.fluidPart = nil end
        if not fl or amt <= 0 or n.id == "spout" then return end
        local frac = math.clamp(amt / cap, 0.02, 1)
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name = "CreateFluid"
        p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
        p.Material = fl == "lava" and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        p.Color = FLUID_COLOR[fl] or Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 255)
        p.Transparency = fl == "water" and 0.3 or 0
        local inset = n.id == "fluid_tank" and 1 / 16 or 2 / 16
        local h = n.id == "fluid_tank" and (14 / 16) * frac or (3 / 16) * frac
        p.Size = Vector3.new(B * (1 - 2 * inset), math.max(0.02, B * h), B * (1 - 2 * inset))
        local bottom = n.id == "fluid_tank" and -0.5 + 1 / 16 or 0.5 - 4 / 16
        p.CFrame = CFrame.new(n.center + Vector3.new(0, B * (bottom + h / 2), 0))
        p.Parent = holder
        d.fluidPart = p
    end

    -- ===== Logistics: inventories, funnels, chutes, item vaults ===============================================================
    local VANILLA_SLOTS = {chest = 27, trapped_chest = 27, barrel = 27, hopper = 5, dispenser = 9, dropper = 9, furnace = 3, smoker = 3, blast_furnace = 3}
    local function vanillaSlots(n)
        if not n then return nil end
        if n.id:match("shulker_box$") then return 27 end
        return VANILLA_SLOTS[n.id]
    end
    -- one adapter for any inventory: {insert(stack) -> remainder count, extract(max) -> stack or nil}
    local function invOf(n, face)
        if not n then return nil end
        local mod = P.inventory(n)
        if mod then
            return {
                insert = function(stack)
                    local left = stack.count
                    while left > 0 and mod.insert(copyN(stack, 1), face) do left = left - 1 end
                    return left
                end,
                extract = function(maxN, test)
                    local s = mod.peek(face)
                    if not s then return nil end
                    if test and not test(s) then return nil end
                    local out = copyN(s, 0)
                    while out.count < maxN do
                        local p = mod.peek(face)
                        if not (p and same(p, out)) then break end
                        mod.take(face); out.count = out.count + 1
                    end
                    return out.count > 0 and out or nil
                end,
            }
        end
        local size = vanillaSlots(n)
        if not size then return nil end
        local w = world()
        return {
            insert = function(stack)
                local s = copyN(stack, stack.count)
                if w and w.machines and w.machines.insert then pcall(w.machines.insert, n, s, face) end
                return s.count
            end,
            extract = function(maxN, test)
                n.storage = n.storage or CreativeRules.inventory()
                local slots = n.storage.slots
                local order = {}
                if n.id == "furnace" or n.id == "smoker" or n.id == "blast_furnace" then order = {3} else for i = 1, size do order[i] = i end end
                for _, i in ipairs(order) do
                    local s = slots[i]
                    if s and s.count > 0 and (not test or test(s)) then
                        local m = math.min(maxN, s.count)
                        local out = copyN(s, m)
                        s.count = s.count - m
                        if s.count <= 0 then slots[i] = nil end
                        if w and w.ui and w.ui.refresh then pcall(w.ui.refresh) end
                        return out
                    end
                end
            end,
        }
    end
    P.invOf = invOf
    INV.auger_shaft = function(n)
        if n.state.section ~= "middle" then return nil end
        local d = n.ae or {}; n.ae = d
        return {
            insert = function(stack)
                local s = d.augerSlot
                if s and not same(s, stack) then return false end
                if s then if s.count >= limitOf(s) then return false end s.count = s.count + 1
                else d.augerSlot = copyN(stack, 1) end
                return true
            end,
            peek = function() return d.augerSlot end,
            take = function()
                local s = d.augerSlot
                if s then s.count = s.count - 1; if s.count <= 0 then d.augerSlot = nil end end
            end,
        }
    end

    -- item vault: 20 stacks per block (ItemVaultBlockEntity)
    INV.item_vault = function(n)
        local d = data(n); d.slots = d.slots or {}
        return {
            insert = function(stack) return insertStacked(d.slots, 20, copyN(stack, 1)) == 0 end,
            peek = function() for i = 1, 20 do if d.slots[i] then return d.slots[i] end end end,
            take = function() for i = 1, 20 do local s = d.slots[i]; if s then s.count = s.count - 1; if s.count <= 0 then d.slots[i] = nil end return end end end,
        }
    end

    -- funnels (FunnelBlock / FunnelBlockEntity): the inventory is behind the funnel (opposite its facing)
    local function funnelTarget(n)
        local f = n.state.facing or "north"
        local behind = nodeAtC(rel(n, OPP[f]))
        return behind and invOf(behind, f), behind
    end
    function P.funnelInsert(n, stack)
        if n.state.extracting == "true" or n.state.powered == "true" then return false end
        local inv = funnelTarget(n)
        if not inv then return false end
        local left = inv.insert(stack)
        if left < stack.count then sound("block.wool.hit", n.center, 0.2, 1.5) end
        stack.count = left
        return left == 0
    end
    local function funnelTick(n)
        local d = data(n)
        local f = n.state.facing or "north"
        if n.id == "brass_funnel" and d.filterShown ~= (d.filter and d.filter.id or false) then
            d.filterShown = d.filter and d.filter.id or false
            if d.filterPart then d.filterPart:Destroy(); d.filterPart = nil end
            if d.filter and holder then
                local part = Instance.new("Part")
                part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.Transparency = true, false, false, false, 1
                part.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.05) * B
                part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(n.center + dv(f) * B * 0.52, n.center + dv(f) * B * 2)
                local sg = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
                sg.Face, sg.CanvasSize, sg.LightInfluence = Enum.NormalId.Front, Vector2.new(32, 32), 1
                sg.Parent = part
                local fr = Instance.new("Frame"); fr.BackgroundTransparency, fr.Size = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); fr.Parent = sg
                pcall(JavaContent.icon, fr, d.filter.id)
                part.Parent = holder
                d.filterPart = part
            end
        end
        if n.state.powered == "true" then return end
        if n.state.extracting == "true" then
            d.cool = (d.cool or 0) - 1
            if d.cool > 0 then return end
            d.cool = 8   -- defaultExtractionTimer
            -- wait while the last item is still in front (getEntityOverflowScanningArea)
            if d.last and d.last.count > 0 and (d.last.position - n.center).Magnitude < B * 1.2 then return end
            local inv = funnelTarget(n)
            if not inv then return end
            local amount = n.id:match("^brass") and 1 or 64
            local flt = d.filter
            local s = inv.extract(amount, flt and function(x) return JavaContent.filterTest(flt, x) end or nil)
            if not s then return end
            local vertical = f == "up" or f == "down"
            local out = n.center + dv(f) * B * (vertical and (f == "up" and 0.15 or 0.5) or 0.25)
            if not vertical then out = out - Vector3.new(0, B * 0.45, 0) end
            -- onto a belt below the front: straight onto it
            local x, y, z = cellOf(rel(n, f) - Vector3.new(0, vertical and 0 or B, 0))
            dropAt(s, out, f == "up" and Vector3.new(0, 0.25 * 20 * B, 0) or Vector3.zero)
            local w = world()
            d.last = w and w.drops[#w.drops]
            sound("block.wool.hit", n.center, 0.2, 1.2)
        else
            -- collecting: item entities touching the funnel's front go in (entityInside)
            for _, dr in ipairs(drops()) do
                if dr.count > 0 then
                    local rp = (dr.position - n.center) / B
                    if math.abs(rp.X) < 0.75 and math.abs(rp.Y) < 0.75 and math.abs(rp.Z) < 0.75 and rp:Dot(dv(f)) > -0.1
                        and (not d.filter or JavaContent.filterTest(d.filter, dropStack(dr))) then
                        local st = dropStack(dr)
                        local inv = funnelTarget(n)
                        if inv then
                            local left = inv.insert(st)
                            if left < dr.count then dr.count = left; netCount(dr); sound("block.wool.hit", n.center, 0.2, 1.5) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- chutes (ChuteBlockEntity): one stack moving at -0.2 blocks/tick (gravity without fans), pulled from the inventory above,
    -- pushed into the inventory / chute below or dropped out of the bottom
    local function chuteTick(n)
        local d = data(n)
        local motion = -4 / 20
        if not d.item then
            -- input from above: an inventory (16 items), or items falling in
            local above = nodeAtC(rel(n, "up"))
            local inv = above and above.id ~= "chute" and invOf(above, "down")
            if inv then
                local s = inv.extract(16)
                if s then d.item, d.pos = s, 1 end
            end
            if not d.item then
                for _, dr in ipairs(drops()) do
                    if dr.count > 0 then
                        local rp = (dr.position - n.center) / B
                        if math.abs(rp.X) < 0.5 and math.abs(rp.Z) < 0.5 and rp.Y > -0.5 and rp.Y < 0.9 then
                            d.item, d.pos = dropStack(dr), math.clamp(rp.Y + 0.5, 0, 1)
                            dr.count = 0; netCount(dr)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return
        end
        local nextPos = (d.pos or 1) + motion
        if nextPos <= 0 then
            local below = nodeAtC(rel(n, "down"))
            if below and below.id == "chute" then
                local bd = data(below)
                if not bd.item then bd.item, bd.pos = d.item, 1; d.item = nil end
                nextPos = 0
            elseif below then
                local inv = invOf(below, "up")
                if inv then
                    local left = inv.insert(d.item)
                    if left <= 0 then d.item = nil else d.item.count = left end
                end
                nextPos = 0
            else
                dropAt(d.item, n.center - Vector3.new(0, B * 0.75, 0), Vector3.new(0, -0.25 * 20 * B, 0))
                d.item = nil
            end
        end
        d.pos = nextPos
    end
    local function chuteRender(n)
        local d = n.cr
        if not d then return end
        local key = d.item and d.item.id or nil
        if d.chuteKey ~= key then
            if d.chuteVis then pcall(function() d.chuteVis.model:Destroy() end); d.chuteVis = nil end
            if d.item then d.chuteVis = itemVisual(d.item, B * 0.5, n.center) end
            d.chuteKey = key
        end
        if d.chuteVis then placeVisual(d.chuteVis, CFrame.new(n.center + Vector3.new(0, ((d.pos or 0.5) - 0.5) * B, 0))) end
    end

    -- ===== Mechanical belts (BeltBlock, BeltConnectorItem, BeltInventory, BeltRenderer) ========================================
    -- chains are rebuilt from the belt blocks (start -> end along the step); items live on the chain:
    -- {stack, pos = 0..length along the chain (segment i spans i-1..i), visual}
    local belts = {}            -- chain key (start cell) -> {cells = {...}, items = {...}}
    local beltAt = {}           -- cell key -> {chain, index}
    local function beltStep(st)
        local f = dv(st.facing or "north")
        local slope = st.slope or "horizontal"
        if slope == "vertical" then return Vector3.new(0, POSITIVE[st.facing or "north"] and 1 or -1, 0) end
        if slope == "upward" then return f + Vector3.yAxis end
        if slope == "downward" then return f - Vector3.yAxis end
        return f
    end
    local function rebuildBelts()
        local found = {}
        for _, n in pairs(K.byPos or {}) do if n.id == "belt" then found[pkey(n.kx, n.ky, n.kz)] = n end end
        local newBelts, newAt = {}, {}
        for k, n in pairs(found) do
            if n.state.part == "start" then
                local cells = {n}
                local step = beltStep(n.state)
                local x, y, z = n.kx, n.ky, n.kz
                for _ = 1, 64 do
                    x, y, z = x + step.X, y + step.Y, z + step.Z
                    local nx = found[pkey(x, y, z)]
                    if not nx then break end
                    cells[#cells + 1] = nx
                    if nx.state.part == "end" then break end
                end
                local old = belts[k]
                local chain = {key = k, cells = cells, items = old and old.items or {}, step = step, complete = cells[#cells].state.part == "end"}
                newBelts[k] = chain
                for i, c in ipairs(cells) do newAt[pkey(c.kx, c.ky, c.kz)] = {chain = chain, index = i} end
            end
        end
        -- chains that are gone: their items drop where they were; a broken belt takes the rest with it (BeltBlock.onRemove)
        local w = world()
        for k, chain in pairs(belts) do
            local now = newBelts[k]
            local broken = not now or #now.cells ~= #chain.cells or not now.complete
            if broken then
                for _, it in ipairs(chain.items) do
                    if it.visual then pcall(function() it.visual.model:Destroy() end) end
                    if it.stack then dropAt(it.stack, it.where or chain.cells[1].center) end
                end
                if now then now.items = {} end
                if w then
                    for _, c in ipairs(chain.cells) do
                        local cur = nodeAtC(c.center)
                        if cur and cur.id == "belt" then
                            local part = cur.state.part
                            local shaftEntry = JavaContent.byId.shaft
                            if part ~= "middle" and shaftEntry then
                                pcall(w.setBlockAt, c.center, shaftEntry.index, {axis = K.DEF.belt.axis(cur.state)})
                            else
                                pcall(w.setBlockAt, c.center, nil)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if CONFIG.Survival then dropAt(stackOf("belt_connector", 1), chain.cells[1].center) end
                end
            end
        end
        for _, chain in pairs(belts) do
            for _, c in ipairs(chain.cells) do
                local cur = nodeAtC(c.center)
                if cur ~= c and c.cr and c.cr.beltVis then destroyVis(c.cr.beltVis); c.cr.beltVis, c.cr.beltKey = nil, nil end
            end
        end
        belts, beltAt = newBelts, newAt
        P.belts = belts
    end
    P.rebuildBelts = rebuildBelts
    -- BeltConnectorItem.canConnect / createBelts
    local beltFirst
    local function shaftAxisAt(c)
        local n = nodeAtC(c)
        if n and (n.id == "shaft" or n.id == "powered_shaft") then return n.state.axis or "y", n end
    end
    local function connectBelts(a, b)
        local w = world()
        local ax, an = shaftAxisAt(a)
        local bx, bn = shaftAxisAt(b)
        if not (ax and bx and ax == bx) then return false, "create.belt.invalid_axis" end
        local x1, y1, z1 = cellOf(a)
        local x2, y2, z2 = cellOf(b)
        local dx, dy, dz = x2 - x1, y2 - y1, z2 - z1
        local diff = {x = dx, y = dy, z = dz}
        if diff[ax] ~= 0 then return false end
        local sames = (abs(dx) == abs(dy) and 1 or 0) + (abs(dy) == abs(dz) and 1 or 0) + (abs(dz) == abs(dx) and 1 or 0)
        if sames ~= 1 then return false end
        if ax == "y" and dx ~= 0 and dz ~= 0 then return false end
        if math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) >= 20 then return false, "too long" end
        if (an.speed or 0) ~= 0 and (bn.speed or 0) ~= 0 and (an.speed > 0) ~= (bn.speed > 0) then return false end
        local sx, sy, sz = (dx > 0 and 1 or dx < 0 and -1 or 0), (dy > 0 and 1 or dy < 0 and -1 or 0), (dz > 0 and 1 or dz < 0 and -1 or 0)
        local cx, cy, cz = x1 + sx, y1 + sy, z1 + sz
        while not (cx == x2 and cy == y2 and cz == z2) do
            local n, id = nodeAtC(centerOf(cx, cy, cz))
            if (n and not (n.id == "shaft" and n.state.axis == ax)) or (id and id ~= "water" and not n) then return false end
            cx, cy, cz = cx + sx, cy + sy, cz + sz
        end
        -- slope, facing (getSlopeBetween / getFacingFromTo)
        local slope = dy ~= 0 and ((dx == 0 and dz == 0) and "vertical" or (dy > 0 and "upward" or "downward")) or "horizontal"
        local beltAxis = (x1 == x2) and "z" or "x"
        local positive
        if dx == 0 and dz == 0 then positive = dy > 0 else positive = (beltAxis == "x" and dx or dz) > 0 end
        local facing = beltAxis == "x" and (positive and "east" or "west") or (positive and "south" or "north")
        if dx == dz and dx ~= 0 then
            local fa = ax == "x" and "z" or "x"
            facing = fa == "x" and (positive and "east" or "west") or (positive and "south" or "north")
        end
        local cells = {}
        local cur = {x1, y1, z1}
        local fv = DIR[facing]
        for _ = 1, 1000 do
            cells[#cells + 1] = {cur[1], cur[2], cur[3]}
            if cur[1] == x2 and cur[2] == y2 and cur[3] == z2 then break end
            if slope == "vertical" then cur = {cur[1], cur[2] + (positive and 1 or -1), cur[3]}
            else
                cur = {cur[1] + fv[1], cur[2], cur[3] + fv[3]}
                if slope ~= "horizontal" then cur[2] = cur[2] + (slope == "upward" and 1 or -1) end
            end
            if #cells > 40 then return false end
        end
        local entry = JavaContent.byId.belt
        for i, p in ipairs(cells) do
            local c = centerOf(p[1], p[2], p[3])
            local part = i == 1 and "start" or (i == #cells and "end" or "middle")
            local sa = shaftAxisAt(c)
            if part == "middle" and sa then part = "pulley" end
            local sl = slope
            if sa == "y" then sl = "sideways" end
            pcall(w.setBlockAt, c, entry.index, {slope = sl, part = part, facing = facing, casing = "false", waterlogged = "false"}, false, CR and CR.id)
        end
        sound("block.wool.place", a, 0.5, 1)
        K.markDirty()
        return true
    end
    P.connectBelts = connectBelts
    function P.beltConnectorUse(n, h, c, sneaking)
        if not (n.id == "shaft" or n.id == "powered_shaft") then beltFirst = nil; return nil end
        if not beltFirst then
            beltFirst = n.center
            sound("block.wool.hit", n.center, 0.5, 1)
            return true
        end
        if (beltFirst - n.center).Magnitude < 0.1 then beltFirst = nil; return true end
        local ok = connectBelts(beltFirst, n.center)
        beltFirst = nil
        if ok and CONFIG.Survival then
            h.count = h.count - 1
            if h.count <= 0 then c.inventory.slots[c.ui.selected] = nil end
            if c.ui.refresh then c.ui.refresh() end
        end
        return true
    end

    -- where a belt position is in the world (BeltHelper.getVectorForOffset): the belt's top surface
    local function chainPoint(chain, pos)
        local cells = chain.cells
        local i = math.clamp(math.floor(pos) + 1, 1, #cells)
        local frac = pos - (i - 1)
        local c = cells[i].center
        local st = cells[i].state
        local step = chain.step
        local p = c + step * (frac - 0.5) * B
        if st.slope == "vertical" then
            p = c + Vector3.new(0, (frac - 0.5) * (step.Y > 0 and 1 or -1), 0) * B + dv(st.facing) * B * 0.4
        elseif st.slope == "sideways" then
            p = p + dv(st.facing == "north" and "west" or st.facing == "south" and "east" or st.facing == "east" and "north" or "south") * 0 + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.3125, 0)
        else
            p = p + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.3125, 0)
        end
        return p
    end
    local function beltSpeedOf(chain)
        local n = chain.cells[1]
        return n.overstressed and 0 or (n.speed or 0)
    end
    -- getMovementFacing: positive along the chain?
    local function movingPositive(chain, speed)
        local f = chain.cells[1].state.facing or "north"
        local axis = AXIS_OF[f]
        local dirPositive = not ((speed < 0) ~= (axis == "x"))
        return dirPositive == (POSITIVE[f] == true)
    end
    -- the item stopped under a press / deployer at a cell (BeltProcessingBehaviour)
    function P.beltItemAt(c)
        local x, y, z = cellOf(c)
        local at = beltAt[pkey(x, y, z)]
        if not at then return nil end
        for _, it in ipairs(at.chain.items) do
            if math.abs(it.pos - (at.index - 0.5)) < 0.05 then return it end
        end
    end
    local function processorAbove(cell)
        -- a press / deployer two above the segment, with something to do for this item
        local up2 = nodeAtC(cell.center + Vector3.new(0, 2 * B, 0))
        if up2 and (up2.id == "mechanical_press" or up2.id == "spout" or (up2.id == "deployer" and up2.state.facing == "down")) then return up2 end
    end
    local function wantsProcessing(proc, stack)
        if proc.id == "spout" then return P.spoutWants and P.spoutWants(proc, stack) end
        if proc.id == "mechanical_press" then
            return singleRecipe("pressing", nameOf(stack)) ~= nil or (P.seqKind and P.seqKind(stack) == "pressing")
        end
        if proc.id == "deployer" then
            local d = proc.cr
            if not (d and d.held) then return false end
            if P.seqKind and P.seqKind(stack) == "deploying" then return true end
            for _, typ in ipairs({"deploying", "item_application"}) do
                for _, r in ipairs(PR(typ)) do
                    if #r.i >= 2 and Recipes.matches(r.i[1], nameOf(stack)) and Recipes.matches(r.i[2], nameOf(d.held)) then return true end
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function beltAccepts(chain, pos)
        for _, it in ipairs(chain.items) do if math.abs(it.pos - pos) < 1 then return false end end
        return true
    end
    local function insertOnBelt(chain, pos, stack)
        local it = {stack = stack, pos = math.clamp(pos, 0, #chain.cells)}
        chain.items[#chain.items + 1] = it
        return it
    end
    local function beltTick()
        for _, chain in pairs(belts) do
            local speed = beltSpeedOf(chain)
            local L = #chain.cells
            if speed ~= 0 and #chain.items > 0 then
                local positive = movingPositive(chain, speed)
                local move = abs(speed) / 480
                table.sort(chain.items, function(a, b) if positive then return a.pos > b.pos end return a.pos < b.pos end)
                local ahead
                for idx = 1, #chain.items do
                    local it = chain.items[idx]
                    local m = move
                    if ahead then
                        local gap = positive and (ahead.pos - it.pos) or (it.pos - ahead.pos)
                        m = math.min(m, math.max(0, gap - 1))
                    end
                    local nextPos = it.pos + (positive and m or -m)
                    -- processing stops: the item halts at a segment's centre (s + 0.5) while a press / deployer above works on it
                    for s = 0, L - 1 do
                        local centre = s + 0.5
                        local crosses = positive and (centre >= it.pos - 1e-6 and centre <= nextPos) or (not positive and centre <= it.pos + 1e-6 and centre >= nextPos)
                        if crosses and it.processedAt ~= s then
                            local proc = processorAbove(chain.cells[s + 1])
                            if proc and wantsProcessing(proc, it.stack) then
                                nextPos = centre
                                it.waiting = s
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if it.waiting and math.abs(it.pos - (it.waiting + 0.5)) < 0.01 then
                        local cell = chain.cells[it.waiting + 1]
                        local proc = cell and processorAbove(cell)
                        if proc and wantsProcessing(proc, it.stack) then nextPos = it.pos else it.processedAt, it.waiting = it.waiting, nil end
                    end
                    -- the end of the belt
                    if nextPos >= L or nextPos <= 0 then
                        local endCell = positive and chain.cells[L] or chain.cells[1]
                        local outC = endCell.center + (positive and chain.step or -chain.step) * B
                        local slope = endCell.state.slope
                        if slope == "upward" or slope == "downward" then outC = endCell.center + dv(positive and endCell.state.facing or OPP[endCell.state.facing]) * B end
                        local x, y, z = cellOf(outC)
                        local nb = beltAt[pkey(x, y, z)]
                        local tn, tid = nodeAtC(outC)
                        local handled = false
                        if nb and nb.chain ~= chain then
                            local p = nb.index - 0.5
                            if beltAccepts(nb.chain, p) then insertOnBelt(nb.chain, p, it.stack); it.stack = nil; handled = true end
                        elseif tn and tn.id == "depot" then
                            local dd = data(tn)
                            if not dd.held then dd.held = it.stack; it.stack = nil; handled = true end
                        elseif tn and (tn.id:match("funnel$") or tn.id:match("belt_funnel$")) and P.funnelInsert then
                            if P.funnelInsert(tn, it.stack) then it.stack = nil; handled = true end
                        elseif not tn and (not tid or tid == "water") then
                            -- off the end (BeltInventory: ejected as an item entity)
                            local outPos = chainPoint(chain, positive and L or 0)
                            local vel = (positive and chain.step or -chain.step).Unit * abs(speed) / 480 * 20 * B
                            dropAt(it.stack, outPos, vel)
                            local wd = world(); local last = wd and wd.drops[#wd.drops]; if last then last.crBeltDrop = chain end
                            it.stack = nil; handled = true
                        end
                        if not handled then nextPos = math.clamp(nextPos, 0.5, L - 0.5) end
                    end
                    it.pos = nextPos
                    ahead = it
                end
                -- remove finished items
                for i = #chain.items, 1, -1 do
                    local it = chain.items[i]
                    if not it.stack or it.stack.count <= 0 then
                        if it.visual then pcall(function() it.visual.model:Destroy() end) end
                        table.remove(chain.items, i)
                    end
                end
            end
            -- items dropped onto the belt join it (BeltBlock.entityInside)
            for _, dr in ipairs(drops()) do
                if dr.count > 0 and dr.crBeltDrop ~= chain then
                    local x, y, z = dropCell(dr)
                    for i, cell in ipairs(chain.cells) do
                        if (x == cell.kx and z == cell.kz and (y == cell.ky or y == cell.ky + 1)) then
                            local rp = dr.position - cell.center
                            if rp.Y > -B * 0.1 and rp.Y < B * 1 then
                                local p = i - 0.5
                                if beltAccepts(chain, p) then
                                    insertOnBelt(chain, p, dropStack(dr)); dr.count = 0; netCount(dr)
                                end
                            end
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- items drawn on the belts (BeltRenderer.renderItems)
    local function beltRender()
        for _, chain in pairs(belts) do
            for _, it in ipairs(chain.items) do
                if it.stack then
                    local key = it.stack.id
                    if it.visKey ~= key then
                        if it.visual then pcall(function() it.visual.model:Destroy() end) end
                        it.visual = itemVisual(it.stack, B * 0.5, chainPoint(chain, it.pos))
                        it.visKey = key
                    end
                    local p = chainPoint(chain, it.pos)
                    it.where = p
                    local e = JavaContent.byIndex[it.stack.id]
                    local blockItem = e and not e.itemOnly and e.models and next(e.models) ~= nil
                    local frame = CFrame.new(p + Vector3.new(0, blockItem and B * 0.12 or B * 0.02, 0)) * (blockItem and CFrame.identity or CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0))
                    placeVisual(it.visual, frame)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    -- belt segments: the two belt halves (top / bottom) turned like BeltRenderer
    local function beltSegmentVisual(n)
        local d = data(n)
        local st = n.state
        local key = (st.slope or "") .. (st.part or "") .. (st.facing or "")
        if d.beltKey == key and d.beltVis then return end
        destroyVis(d.beltVis)
        d.beltVis, d.beltKey = {}, key
        local slope = st.slope or "horizontal"
        local facing = st.facing or "north"
        local downward, upward = slope == "downward", slope == "upward"
        local diagonal = downward or upward
        local sideways = slope == "sideways"
        local start, finish = st.part == "start", st.part == "end"
        if downward or (slope == "vertical" and POSITIVE[facing]) then start, finish = finish, start end
        local Y = {south = 0, west = 90, north = 180, east = 270}
        local rot = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Y[facing] + (upward and 180 or 0) + (sideways and 270 or 0)), 0)
            * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(sideways and 90 or 0))
            * CFrame.Angles(math.rad((not diagonal and slope ~= "horizontal") and 90 or 0), 0, 0)
        for _, bottom in ipairs({true, false}) do
            local name
            if diagonal then name = start and "belt/diagonal_start" or (finish and "belt/diagonal_end" or "belt/diagonal_middle")
            elseif bottom then name = start and "belt/start_bottom" or (finish and "belt/end_bottom" or "belt/middle_bottom")
            else name = start and "belt/start" or (finish and "belt/end" or "belt/middle") end
            local v = K.partialVisual(name, n.center)
            if v then
                for _, pair in ipairs(v.parts or {}) do pair[1].CFrame = CFrame.new(n.center) * rot * pair[2] end
                d.beltVis[#d.beltVis + 1] = v
            end
            if diagonal then break end
        end
    end

    -- ===== Sequenced assembly (SequencedAssemblyRecipe): an item on a depot goes through the steps, carrying its progress ====
    local function seqFind(stack)
        local name = nameOf(stack)
        for _, r in ipairs(PR("sequenced_assembly")) do
            if stack.crSeq and stack.crSeq.n == r.n and name == r.tr then return r, stack.crSeq.step end
            if not stack.crSeq and Recipes.matches(r.i[1], name) then return r, 0 end
        end
    end
    -- returns the new depot item (or nil when this step does not apply)
    local function seqStep(stack, kind, heldStack)
        local r, step = seqFind(stack)
        if not r then return nil end
        local s = r.seq[(step % #r.seq) + 1]
        if s.t ~= kind then return nil end
        if kind == "deploying" then
            if not (heldStack and s.i[2] and Recipes.matches(s.i[2], nameOf(heldStack))) then return nil end
        end
        step = step + 1
        if step >= #r.seq * (r.loops or 1) then
            -- done: one result picked by weight (the chances are weights)
            local total = 0
            for _, res in ipairs(r.r) do total = total + (res.p or 1) end
            local roll, pick = math.random() * total, r.r[1]
            for _, res in ipairs(r.r) do roll = roll - (res.p or 1); if roll <= 0 then pick = res; break end end
            return stackOf(pick.id, pick.c or 1), s
        end
        local tr = stackOf(r.tr, 1)
        if tr then tr.crSeq = {n = r.n, step = step} end
        return tr, s
    end

    P.seqStep = seqStep
    function P.seqKind(stack) local r, step = seqFind(stack); if r then return r.seq[(step % #r.seq) + 1].t end end
    -- ===== Deployer (DeployerBlockEntity / DeployerHandler, USE mode) =========================================================
    local function deployerTimerSpeed(speed) return speed == 0 and 0 or floor(math.clamp(abs(speed * 2), 8, 512)) end
    local function placeFrom(n, stackHeld, at)
        local w = world()
        local e = JavaContent.byIndex[stackHeld.id]
        if not (w and e and not e.itemOnly and e.models) then return false end
        local there, tid = nodeAtC(at)
        if there or (tid and tid ~= "water") then return false end
        local st = CreativeRules.copy(e.state or {})
        if st.facing then st.facing = OPP[n.state.facing or "north"] end
        local ok = pcall(w.setBlockAt, at, e.index, st)
        if ok then sound("block.stone.place", at, 1, 1) end
        return ok
    end
    local function deployerActivate(n)
        local d = data(n)
        local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
        local clicked = rel(n, facing, 2)
        local dep = nodeAtC(clicked)
        local bit = P.beltItemAt and P.beltItemAt(clicked)
        if bit and bit.stack then dep = {id = "depot", cr = {held = bit.stack, buf = {}}, belt = bit} end
        if dep and dep.id == "depot" then
            -- BeltDeployerCallbacks: deploying / item application / sequenced steps on the depot's item
            local dd = dep.belt and dep.cr or data(dep)
            if not (dd.held and d.held) then return end
            local one = copyN(dd.held, 1)
            local newItem, step = seqStep(one, "deploying", d.held)
            local outs
            if newItem then outs = {newItem}
            else
                local name, hname = nameOf(dd.held), nameOf(d.held)
                for _, typ in ipairs({"deploying", "item_application"}) do
                    for _, r in ipairs(PR(typ)) do
                        if #r.i >= 2 and Recipes.matches(r.i[1], name) and Recipes.matches(r.i[2], hname) then outs = rollResults(r); step = r; break end
                    end
                    if outs then break end
                end
            end
            if not outs then return end
            dd.held.count = dd.held.count - 1
            if dd.held.count <= 0 then dd.held = table.remove(outs, 1) end
            dd.buf = dd.buf or {}
            for _, s in ipairs(outs) do insertStacked(dd.buf, 8, s) end
            dd.dirtyVisual = true
            if dep.belt then
                dep.belt.stack = dd.held
                for _, s in ipairs(dd.buf) do dropAt(s, clicked + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.5, 0)) end
                dep.belt.processedAt, dep.belt.waiting = dep.belt.waiting, nil
            end
            if not (step and step.keep) then
                d.held.count = d.held.count - 1
                if d.held.count <= 0 then d.held = nil end
            end
            sound("entity.item_frame.add_item", clicked, 0.5, 1)
            return
        end
        -- in the world: a block item is placed like a player clicking the block two ahead
        if d.held then
            local target = clicked
            local tn, tid = nodeAtC(clicked)
            if tn or (tid and tid ~= "water") then target = rel(n, facing, 1) end
            if placeFrom(n, d.held, target) then
                d.held.count = d.held.count - 1
                if d.held.count <= 0 then d.held = nil end
            end
        end
    end
    local function deployerTick(n, speed)
        local d = data(n)
        d.state = d.state or "waiting"
        d.timer = d.timer or 0
        local ts = deployerTimerSpeed(speed)
        if speed == 0 then return end
        if d.timer > 0 then d.timer = d.timer - ts; return end
        if d.state == "expanding" then
            pcall(deployerActivate, n)
            d.state, d.timer = "retracting", 1000
        elseif d.state == "retracting" then
            d.state, d.timer = "waiting", 500
        else
            -- start: reach = 0.5 + the free distance up to the block two ahead (max 0.75)
            local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
            local tn = nodeAtC(rel(n, facing, 2))
            local free = 0.75
            if tn then
                local okS, shape = pcall(JavaContent.shape, tn.id, tn.state)
                free = (okS and shape and shape.full) and 0 or 0.25
                if tn.id == "depot" then free = 0.75 - 0.25 end
            end
            -- nothing to do: wait (USE mode with an empty hand only acts on depots)
            local bit = P.beltItemAt and P.beltItemAt(rel(n, facing, 2))
            if not d.held and not (tn and tn.id == "depot") then d.timer = ts * 10; return end
            if tn and tn.id == "belt" and not bit then d.timer = ts * 10; return end
            d.reach = 0.5 + free
            d.state, d.timer = "expanding", 1000
        end
        d.handPose = d.held and "holding" or "pointing"
    end
    function P.deployerUse(n, h, c)
        local d = data(n)
        if h and not d.held then
            d.held = copyN(h, h.count)
            if CONFIG.Survival then c.inventory.slots[c.ui.selected] = nil end
            d.handPose = "holding"
            if c.ui.refresh then c.ui.refresh() end
            return true
        elseif not h and d.held then
            giveToPlayer(d.held); d.held = nil; d.handPose = "pointing"
            return true
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function deployerOffset(n)
        local d = n.cr
        if not d then return 0 end
        local progress = 0
        if d.state == "expanding" then progress = 1 - (d.timer or 0) / 1000
        elseif d.state == "retracting" then progress = (d.timer or 0) / 1000 end
        local handLen = d.handPose == "holding" and 0.25 or d.handPose == "punching" and 0.1875 or 0
        return math.min(math.clamp(progress, 0, 1) * ((d.reach or 1.25) + handLen), 1.3125)
    end

    -- ===== Mechanical drill / saw (BlockBreakingKineticBlockEntity) ===========================================================
    local UNBREAKABLE = {bedrock = true, barrier = true, command_block = true, end_portal_frame = true, end_portal = true, nether_portal = true,
        structure_block = true, jigsaw = true, light = true, reinforced_deepslate = true}
    local FLUIDS = {water = true, lava = true, flowing_water = true, flowing_lava = true, bubble_column = true}
    local function hardnessOf(id) local e = JavaContent.byId[id]; return e and e.hardness or 1 end
    local function isLog(id) return id:match("_log$") or id:match("_wood$") or id:match("_stem$") or id:match("_hyphae$") or id == "mushroom_stem" end
    local function isLeaves(id) return id:match("_leaves$") ~= nil end
    -- SawBlockEntity.isSawable
    local SAWABLE = {cactus = true, bamboo = true, sugar_cane = true, kelp = true, kelp_plant = true, chorus_plant = true, chorus_flower = true,
        melon = true, pumpkin = true, carved_pumpkin = true, jack_o_lantern = true, vine = true, weeping_vines = true, twisting_vines = true,
        brown_mushroom_block = true, red_mushroom_block = true, mangrove_roots = true, muddy_mangrove_roots = true}
    local function sawable(id)
        if id:match("_sapling$") then return false end
        return isLog(id) or isLeaves(id) or SAWABLE[id] == true
    end
    local function breakBlock(c)
        local w = world()
        if w then pcall(w.setBlockAt, c, nil, nil, true) end
    end
    -- TreeCutter.findTree: the logs connected to the cut one (going up / sideways) and the leaves around them
    local function cutTree(start)
        local seen, logs, leaves = {}, {}, {}
        local queue = {start}
        local sx, sy, sz = cellOf(start)
        seen[pkey(sx, sy, sz)] = true
        while #queue > 0 and #logs < 256 do
            local c = table.remove(queue, 1)
            local node, id = nodeAtC(c)
            id = id or (node and node.id)
            if id and isLog(id) then
                logs[#logs + 1] = c
                local x, y, z = cellOf(c)
                for dx = -1, 1 do for dy = 0, 1 do for dz = -1, 1 do
                    if not (dx == 0 and dy == 0 and dz == 0) then
                        local k = pkey(x + dx, y + dy, z + dz)
                        if not seen[k] then
                            seen[k] = true
                            local cc = centerOf(x + dx, y + dy, z + dz)
                            local _, nid = nodeAtC(cc)
                            if nid and isLog(nid) then queue[#queue + 1] = cc
                            elseif nid and isLeaves(nid) then leaves[#leaves + 1] = cc end
                        end
                    end
                end end end
            end
        end
        -- leaves within reach of the logs (Java follows leaf distance; here two steps from a log)
        local more = {}
        for _, c in ipairs(leaves) do
            local x, y, z = cellOf(c)
            for _, d in ipairs(NAMES) do
                local v = DIR[d]
                local k = pkey(x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3])
                if not seen[k] then
                    seen[k] = true
                    local cc = centerOf(x + v[1], y + v[2], z + v[3])
                    local _, nid = nodeAtC(cc)
                    if nid and isLeaves(nid) then more[#more + 1] = cc end
                end
            end
        end
        for _, c in ipairs(logs) do breakBlock(c) end
        for _, c in ipairs(leaves) do breakBlock(c) end
        for _, c in ipairs(more) do breakBlock(c) end
    end
    local function breakerTick(n, speed, saw)
        local d = data(n)
        local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
        if saw and (facing == "up" or facing == "down") then return end
        if speed == 0 then return end
        local target = rel(n, facing)
        local node, id = nodeAtC(target)
        id = id or (node and node.id)
        local okBreak = id and not FLUIDS[id] and not UNBREAKABLE[id] and id ~= "air" and (not saw or sawable(id))
        if node and node.id and JavaContent.byId[node.id] and JavaContent.byId[node.id].mod == "create" and (node.id == "water_wheel_structure") then okBreak = false end
        if d.lastTarget ~= id then d.progress, d.wait, d.lastTarget = 0, 0, id end
        if not okBreak then d.progress = 0; return end
        local hard = hardnessOf(id)
        if hard < 0 then return end
        local bs = abs(speed) / 100
        d.wait = (d.wait or 0) - 1
        if d.wait > 0 then return end
        d.progress = (d.progress or 0) + math.clamp(floor(bs / max(hard, 0.0001)), 1, 10 - (d.progress or 0))
        sound("block.stone.hit", target, 0.25, 1)
        local w = world()
        if w and w.effects and w.effects.block and math.random() < 0.6 then pcall(w.effects.block, node and node.index or 1, target, false) end
        if d.progress >= 10 then
            d.progress, d.wait = 0, 0
            if saw and isLog(id) then cutTree(target) else breakBlock(target) end
        else
            d.wait = floor(hard / bs)
        end
    end
    -- an upward saw cuts items lying on it (cutting recipes, and stonecutting: allowStonecuttingOnSaw)
    local function sawItems(n, speed)
        if (n.state.facing or "north") ~= "up" or speed == 0 then return end
        local d = data(n)
        local mx, my, mz = cellOf(n.center)
        for _, dr in ipairs(drops()) do
            if dr.count > 0 then
                local x, y, z = dropCell(dr)
                local rp = dr.position - n.center
                if x == mx and z == mz and (y == my or y == my + 1) and rp.Y > B * 0.3 and rp.Y < B * 0.9 then
                    local name = nameOf({id = dr.id})
                    local r = singleRecipe("cutting", name)
                    local outs
                    if not dr.crSaw then
                        local t = r and (r.t or 100) or 100
                        local stone = not r and (JavaContent.data.recipes.stonecutting or {})
                        local found = r ~= nil
                        if not found then for _, s in ipairs(stone) do if Recipes.matches(s.i, name) then found = true; break end end end
                        if not found then dr.crSaw = -1 else dr.crSaw = t end
                    end
                    if dr.crSaw > 0 then
                        -- SawBlockEntity: processing speed scales with |speed| / 24 (at least 1)
                        dr.crSaw = dr.crSaw - math.clamp(abs(speed) / 24, 1, 128)
                        dr.velocity = Vector3.new(0, dr.velocity.Y, 0)
                        if math.random() < 0.3 then local wd = world(); if wd and wd.effects and wd.effects.block then pcall(wd.effects.block, dr.id, dr.position, false) end end
                        if dr.crSaw <= 0 then
                            local one = copyN(dropStack(dr), 1)
                            if r then outs = applyOnStack(r, one)
                            else
                                for _, s in ipairs(JavaContent.data.recipes.stonecutting or {}) do
                                    if Recipes.matches(s.i, name) then local st = stackOf(s.r, s.c or 1); outs = st and {st} or {}; break end
                                end
                            end
                            dr.count = dr.count - 1; netCount(dr)
                            local face = dv(OPP[n.state.facing == "up" and "north" or n.state.facing])
                            for _, s in ipairs(outs or {}) do dropAt(s, n.center + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.6, 0), Vector3.new(0, B * 2, 0)) end
                            dr.crSaw = dr.count > 0 and nil or -1
                            sound("block.wood.break", n.center, 0.25, 1.4)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- ===== Contraptions (Contraption / BlockMovementChecks / StructureTransform) ===========================================
    local contraptions = {}
    P.contraptions = contraptions
    local glue = {}            -- super glue boxes: {min = Vector3 cell, max = Vector3 cell}
    P.glue = glue
    local UNMOVABLE = {bedrock = true, barrier = true, end_portal = true, end_portal_frame = true, end_gateway = true, nether_portal = true,
        command_block = true, chain_command_block = true, repeating_command_block = true, structure_block = true, jigsaw = true,
        reinforced_deepslate = true, light = true, water = true, lava = true, flowing_water = true, flowing_lava = true, bubble_column = true,
        water_wheel_structure = true, crushing_wheel_controller = true}
    local SAILS = {sail_frame = true}
    for _, c in ipairs({"white", "orange", "magenta", "light_blue", "yellow", "lime", "pink", "gray", "light_gray", "cyan", "purple", "blue", "brown", "green", "red", "black"}) do
        SAILS[c .. "_sail"] = true; SAILS[c .. "_wool"] = true; SAILS[c .. "_symmetric_sail"] = true
    end
    local function isSticky(id) return id == "slime_block" or id == "honey_block" end
    -- BlockMovementChecks.isBlockAttachedTowards (fallback list): is the block at `n` hanging on its side `d`?
    local function attachedTowards(n, d)
        local id, st = n.id, n.state
        if id:match("_symmetric_sail$") then return AXIS_OF[d] ~= (st.axis or "y") end
        if id == "rockcutting_wheel" then return true end
        if SAILS[id] and id ~= nil and (id == "sail_frame" or id:match("_sail$")) then return AXIS_OF[d] ~= AXIS_OF[st.facing or "north"] end
        if id == "ladder" or id:match("_wall_torch$") or id == "wall_torch" or id:match("_wall_sign$") or id:match("_wall_banner$") or id:match("_wall_head$") then
            return st.facing == OPP[d]
        end
        if id:match("_sign$") or id:match("_pressure_plate$") or id:match("_carpet$") or id == "flower_pot" or id:match("^potted_")
            or id == "repeater" or id == "comparator" or id == "redstone_wire" or id == "torch" or id == "soul_torch" or id == "redstone_torch"
            or id:match("rail$") or id:match("_banner$") then return d == "down" end
        if id:match("_door$") then return (st.half == "lower" and d == "up") or d == "down" end
        if st.face then
            if st.face == "ceiling" then return d == "up" elseif st.face == "floor" then return d == "down" end
            return OPP[d] == st.facing
        end
        if st.hanging then return d == (st.hanging == "true" and "up" or "down") end
        if id == "hand_crank" or id:match("valve_handle$") then return d == OPP[st.facing or "up"] end
        return false
    end
    local function glued(a, b)
        for _, g in ipairs(glue) do
            local function inside(p) return p.X >= g.min.X and p.X <= g.max.X and p.Y >= g.min.Y and p.Y <= g.max.Y and p.Z >= g.min.Z and p.Z <= g.max.Z end
            if inside(a) and inside(b) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    -- Contraption.searchMovedStructure: the block in front is forced; then sticky / attached / glued neighbours; chassis
    local function assemble(anchor, front, exclude)
        local blocks, visited = {}, {}
        local ax, ay, az = cellOf(anchor.center)
        visited[pkey(ax, ay, az)] = true
        for _, e in ipairs(exclude or {}) do local x, y, z = cellOf(e); visited[pkey(x, y, z)] = true end
        local fx, fy, fz = cellOf(rel(anchor, front))
        local frontier = {{fx, fy, fz}}
        local sails = 0
        local head = 1
        while frontier[head] do
            local p = frontier[head]; head = head + 1
            local k = pkey(p[1], p[2], p[3])
            if not visited[k] then
                visited[k] = true
                local c = centerOf(p[1], p[2], p[3])
                local n, id = nodeAtC(c)
                if n and not UNMOVABLE[n.id] then
                    blocks[#blocks + 1] = {node = n, cell = Vector3.new(p[1], p[2], p[3])}
                    if SAILS[n.id] then sails = sails + 1 end
                    if #blocks > 2048 then return nil, "too many blocks" end
                    for _, d in ipairs(NAMES) do
                        local v = DIR[d]
                        local q = {p[1] + v[1], p[2] + v[2], p[3] + v[3]}
                        if not visited[pkey(q[1], q[2], q[3])] then
                            local o = nodeAtC(centerOf(q[1], q[2], q[3]))
                            if o and not UNMOVABLE[o.id] then
                                local stick = (isSticky(n.id) or isSticky(o.id) or n.id == "rockcutting_wheel") and not ((n.id == "slime_block" and o.id == "honey_block") or (n.id == "honey_block" and o.id == "slime_block"))
                                -- chassis: linear chassis join chassis of the same axis, and the blocks at their ends
                                local chassis = false
                                if n.id:match("linear_chassis$") then
                                    chassis = (o.id:match("linear_chassis$") and (o.state.axis == n.state.axis)) or AXIS_OF[d] == (n.state.axis or "y")
                                elseif n.id == "radial_chassis" then chassis = AXIS_OF[d] ~= (n.state.axis or "y") end
                                if stick or chassis or attachedTowards(o, OPP[d]) or glued(Vector3.new(p[1], p[2], p[3]), Vector3.new(q[1], q[2], q[3])) then
                                    frontier[#frontier + 1] = q
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                elseif id and n == nil and (id == "water" or id == "lava") then
                    -- fluids stay
                end
            end
        end
        if #blocks == 0 then return nil, "nothing to move" end
        return blocks, sails
    end
    -- StructureTransform: block states turned by quarter turns about an axis
    local ROT = {
        y = {north = "east", east = "south", south = "west", west = "north"},
        x = {up = "north", north = "down", down = "south", south = "up"},
        z = {up = "east", east = "down", down = "west", west = "up"},
    }
    local function rotateState(st, axis, quarters)
        local s = CreativeRules.copy(st)
        quarters = quarters % 4
        for _ = 1, quarters do
            for _, key in ipairs({"facing", "horizontal_facing"}) do
                if s[key] and ROT[axis][s[key]] then s[key] = ROT[axis][s[key]] end
            end
            if s.axis then
                if axis == "y" then if s.axis == "x" then s.axis = "z" elseif s.axis == "z" then s.axis = "x" end
                elseif axis == "x" then if s.axis == "y" then s.axis = "z" elseif s.axis == "z" then s.axis = "y" end
                else if s.axis == "x" then s.axis = "y" elseif s.axis == "y" then s.axis = "x" end end
            end
            if s.rotation and axis == "y" then s.rotation = tostring((tonumber(s.rotation) + 4) % 16) end
        end
        return s
    end
    local function capture(c, origin)
        -- the blocks leave the world (no drops) and become the moving model
        local w = world()
        c.parts = {}
        for _, b in ipairs(c.blocks) do
            local n = b.node
            b.index, b.state, b.cr = n.index, CreativeRules.copy(n.state), n.cr
            b.storage, b.storageSize = n.storage, n.storageSize
            b.off = (n.center - origin) / B
            if n.cr then destroyVis(n.cr.vis); destroyVis(n.cr.beltVis); clearShown(n.cr) end
            local ok, v = pcall(JavaContent.model, n.index, n.state, B, holder, n.center, true)
            if ok and v then
                for _, d in ipairs(v.model:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.CanCollide, d.CanQuery, d.CanTouch = false, false, false end end
                b.visual = v
            end
        end
        for _, b in ipairs(c.blocks) do pcall(w.setBlockAt, b.node.center, nil, nil, false) end
        K.markDirty()
    end
    local function contraptionFrame(c)
        if c.kind == "rotate" then return CFrame.new(c.origin) * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(c.axisVec, math.rad(c.angle or 0)) end
        return CFrame.new(c.origin + c.dirVec * (c.offset or 0) * B)
    end
    -- disassembly: every block back in the world, turned / moved to its new cell
    local function disassemble(c)
        local w = world()
        local quarters = c.kind == "rotate" and math.floor(((c.angle or 0) % 360) / 90 + 0.5) % 4 or 0
        local turn = c.kind == "rotate" and CFrame.fromAxisAngle(c.axisVec, math.rad(quarters * 90)) or CFrame.identity
        local shift = c.kind ~= "rotate" and c.dirVec * math.floor((c.offset or 0) + 0.5) or Vector3.zero
        for _, b in ipairs(c.blocks) do
            local off = turn:VectorToWorldSpace(b.off)
            off = Vector3.new(math.floor(off.X + 0.5), math.floor(off.Y + 0.5), math.floor(off.Z + 0.5)) + shift
            local target = c.origin + off * B
            local st = quarters ~= 0 and rotateState(b.state, c.axis, (c.axisSign or 1) > 0 and quarters or (4 - quarters)) or b.state
            local there, tid = nodeAtC(target)
            if there or (tid and tid ~= "water" and tid ~= "air") then
                -- something is in the way: the block drops as an item
                local e = JavaContent.byIndex[b.index]
                if e then dropAt(stackOf(e.itemId or e.id, 1) or {id = b.index, count = 1}, target) end
            else
                local ok, nn = pcall(w.setBlockAt, target, b.index, st)
                if ok and nn and b.cr then nn.cr = b.cr end
                if ok and nn and b.storage then nn.storage, nn.storageSize = b.storage, b.storageSize end
            end
            if b.visual then pcall(function() b.visual.model:Destroy() end) end
            if b.wheelVis then pcall(function() b.wheelVis.model:Destroy() end); b.wheelVis = nil end
        end
        c.blocks = {}
        K.markDirty()
    end
    local function renderContraption(c)
        local frame = contraptionFrame(c)
        local xf = P.transformFor and P.transformFor(c.origin) or (world() and world().physicsTransform and world().physicsTransform(c.origin))
        if xf then frame = xf * frame end
        local parts, frames = {}, {}
        for _, b in ipairs(c.blocks) do
            local v = b.visual
            if c.borehead and b.index and JavaContent.byIndex[b.index] and JavaContent.byIndex[b.index].id == "rockcutting_wheel" then
                if not b.wheelVis and K.meshVisual then local okM, mv = pcall(K.meshVisual, "offroad:block/rockcutting_wheel/wheel", c.origin); if okM then b.wheelVis = mv end end
                if b.wheelVis then
                    local f = dv(b.state.facing or "north")
                    local spin = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(f, math.rad(c.wheelSpin or 0))
                    local base = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, f) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi / 2, 0, 0)
                    local at2 = frame * CFrame.new(b.off * B) * spin * base
                    for _, pair in ipairs(b.wheelVis.parts or {}) do parts[#parts + 1] = pair[1]; frames[#frames + 1] = at2 * pair[2] end
                end
            end
            if v then
                local at = frame * CFrame.new(b.off * B)
                for _, pair in ipairs(v.parts or {}) do
                    local p = pair[1]
                    if p.Parent and p.Name ~= "BlockOutline" and p.Name ~= "BlockCollider" then parts[#parts + 1] = p; frames[#frames + 1] = at * pair[2] end
                end
            end
        end
        if #parts > 0 then workspace:BulkMoveTo(parts, frames, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged) end
    end

    -- mechanical / windmill bearings (MechanicalBearingBlockEntity, WindmillBearingBlockEntity)
    local function bearingOf(n) for _, c in ipairs(contraptions) do if c.anchor == n then return c end end end
    local function startBearing(n, windmill)
        local facing = n.state.facing or "up"
        local blocks, sails = assemble(n, facing)
        if not blocks then return false, sails end
        if windmill and sails < 8 then return false, "not enough sails" end
        local c = {anchor = n, kind = "rotate", blocks = blocks, sails = sails, windmill = windmill, angle = 0,
            axis = AXIS_OF[facing], axisVec = dv(facing), axisSign = POSITIVE[facing] and 1 or -1, origin = n.center}
        capture(c, n.center)
        contraptions[#contraptions + 1] = c
        n.cr = n.cr or {}; n.cr.running = true
        sound("block.piston.extend", n.center, 0.5, 1.4)
        return true
    end
    local function stopContraption(c)
        disassemble(c)
        for i, o in ipairs(contraptions) do if o == c then table.remove(contraptions, i) break end end
        if c.anchor.cr then c.anchor.cr.running = false end
        sound("block.piston.contract", c.origin, 0.5, 1.4)
    end
    P.windmillSpeed = function(n)
        local c = bearingOf(n)
        if not (c and c.windmill) then return 0 end
        -- getGeneratedSpeed: one RPM per 8 sails, 1..16, turning the bearing's chosen way (clockwise by default)
        local s = math.clamp(math.floor(c.sails / 8), 1, 16)
        return (n.cr and n.cr.ccw) and s or -s
    end
    local function bearingTick(n, speed)
        local c = bearingOf(n)
        if n.id == "mechanical_bearing" then
            -- assembles when it starts turning, comes apart when it stops (aligned to the nearest quarter turn)
            if speed ~= 0 and not c and not (n.cr and n.cr.failed) then
                local ok = startBearing(n, false)
                if not ok then n.cr = n.cr or {}; n.cr.failed = true end
            elseif speed == 0 then
                if n.cr then n.cr.failed = nil end
                if c then
                    local a = (c.angle or 0) % 90
                    if a < 1 or a > 89 then c.angle = math.floor((c.angle or 0) / 90 + 0.5) * 90; stopContraption(c)
                    else c.angle = c.angle + (a < 45 and -1 or 1) end
                end
            end
        end
        if c then
            local rpm = n.id == "windmill_bearing" and P.windmillSpeed(n) or speed
            -- convertToAngular: rpm x 360 / 60 / 20 degrees per tick
            c.angle = ((c.angle or 0) + rpm * 0.3) % 360
            if n.id == "mechanical_bearing" and speed == 0 then c.angle = c.angle - rpm * 0.3 end
        end
    end
    P.bearingAngle = function(n) local c = bearingOf(n); return c and c.angle or 0 end
    function P.bearingUse(n, sneaking)
        if n.id ~= "windmill_bearing" and n.id ~= "mechanical_bearing" then return nil end
        if sneaking then return nil end
        local c = bearingOf(n)
        if c then stopContraption(c); K.markDirty(); return true end
        if n.id == "windmill_bearing" then
            local ok, why = startBearing(n, true)
            if not ok then sound("block.note_block.bass", n.center, 0.6, 0.5) end
            K.markDirty()
            return true
        end
        return nil
    end

    -- mechanical pistons (MechanicalPistonBlockEntity): poles behind set the range; the head moves speed / 512 blocks a tick
    local function pistonPoles(n)
        local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
        local count = 0
        for i = 1, 64 do
            local p = nodeAtC(rel(n, OPP[facing], i))
            if p and p.id == "piston_extension_pole" and AXIS_OF[p.state.facing or "north"] == AXIS_OF[facing] then count = count + 1 else break end
        end
        return count
    end
    local function pistonTick(n, speed)
        local d = data(n)
        local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
        local c = bearingOf(n)
        local range = d.range or pistonPoles(n)
        if speed == 0 then return end
        -- convertToLinear: speed / 512 blocks a tick (at most 0.49)
        local mv = math.clamp(speed / 512, -0.49, 0.49) * (POSITIVE[facing] and 1 or -1)
        if not c then
            if mv <= 0 then return end
            if range == 0 then return end
            local blocks = assemble(n, facing)
            c = {anchor = n, kind = "move", blocks = blocks or {}, offset = 0, dirVec = dv(facing), origin = n.center, range = range}
            if blocks then capture(c, n.center) end
            d.range = range
            contraptions[#contraptions + 1] = c
        end
        c.offset = math.clamp((c.offset or 0) + mv, 0, c.range)
        d.extension = c.offset
        if (c.offset >= c.range and mv > 0) or (c.offset <= 0 and mv < 0) then
            -- at the end: the structure is placed (a regular piston leaves it; a sticky one pulls it back first)
            if c.offset <= 0 then
                disassemble(c)
                for i, o in ipairs(contraptions) do if o == c then table.remove(contraptions, i) break end end
                d.range = nil
            elseif n.id == "mechanical_piston" and #c.blocks > 0 then
                disassemble(c)
            end
        end
    end
    P.pistonExtension = function(n) return n.cr and n.cr.extension or 0 end

    -- super glue (SuperGlueItem): two clicks mark the corners of a glued box
    local glueFirst
    function P.glueUse(n)
        local x, y, z = cellOf(n.center)
        if not glueFirst then glueFirst = Vector3.new(x, y, z); sound("block.slime_block.place", n.center, 0.5, 1.2); return true end
        local a, b = glueFirst, Vector3.new(x, y, z)
        glue[#glue + 1] = {min = a:Min(b), max = a:Max(b)}
        glueFirst = nil
        sound("block.slime_block.place", n.center, 1, 0.8)
        return true
    end
    do
    -- SuperGlueSelectionHandler: while glue is held every glue box nearby is outlined (PASSIVE 0x4D9162, 1/64 block
    -- lines), the one looked at is highlighted (HIGHLIGHT 0x68C586, 1/16 lines, glue-tinted faces) and can be removed with
    -- a left click; after the first click the box being made follows the crosshair
    local PASSIVE, HIGHLIGHT, FAIL = Color3.fromRGB(0x4D, 0x91, 0x62), Color3.fromRGB(0x68, 0xC5, 0x86), Color3.fromRGB(0xC5, 0xB4, 0x48)
    local glueViews, glueHover, glueConn = {}, nil, nil
    local glueFolder
    local function glueBounds(g)
        local lo = centerOf(g.min.X, g.min.Y, g.min.Z) - Vector3.one * (B / 2)
        local hi = centerOf(g.max.X, g.max.Y, g.max.Z) + Vector3.one * (B / 2)
        if K.transformFor then
            -- a glue box on an assembled ship is drawn where the ship is
            local okT, T = pcall(K.transformFor, {center = (lo + hi) / 2, id = "super_glue"})
            if okT and typeof(T) == "CFrame" then return lo, hi, T end
        end
        return lo, hi, nil
    end
    local function glueView(i)
        local v = glueViews[i]
        if v and v.part.Parent then return v end
        if not glueFolder or not glueFolder.Parent then
            glueFolder = Instance.new("Folder"); glueFolder.Name = "CreateSuperGlue"; glueFolder.Parent = workspace
        end
        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Name = "SuperGlueBox"
        part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.Transparency, part.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, 1, false
        part.Parent = glueFolder
        local box = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
        box.Adornee, box.Parent = part, part
        v = {part = part, box = box}
        glueViews[i] = v
        return v
    end
    local function showBox(i, lo, hi, color, thick, fill, T)
        local v = glueView(i)
        local size = hi - lo
        v.part.Size = size + Vector3.one * 0.01
        v.part.CFrame = T and (T * CFrame.new((lo + hi) / 2)) or CFrame.new((lo + hi) / 2)
        v.box.Color3, v.box.SurfaceColor3 = color, color
        v.box.LineThickness = thick and B / 16 or B / 64
        v.box.SurfaceTransparency = fill and 0.82 or 1
        v.box.Visible = true
    end
    local function rayBox(o, d, lo, hi)
        local tmin, tmax = 0, math.huge
        for _, ax in ipairs({"X", "Y", "Z"}) do
            local od, dd = o[ax], d[ax]
            if math.abs(dd) < 1e-9 then
                if od < lo[ax] or od > hi[ax] then return nil end
            else
                local t1, t2 = (lo[ax] - od) / dd, (hi[ax] - od) / dd
                if t1 > t2 then t1, t2 = t2, t1 end
                tmin, tmax = math.max(tmin, t1), math.min(tmax, t2)
                if tmin > tmax then return nil end
            end
        end
        return tmin
    end
    local function holdingGlue() local h = held(); local nm = h and nameOf(h); return nm == "super_glue" or nm == "honey_glue" end
    local function glueRender()
        local used = 0
        glueHover = nil
        if holdingGlue() then
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local o, d = cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.LookVector
            local reach = (4.5 + 1) * B
            local c = ctx()
            local near = c and c.root and c.root.Position or o
            -- the glue box under the crosshair (closest hit within reach)
            local best = math.huge
            if not glueFirst then
                for i, g in ipairs(glue) do
                    local lo, hi, T = glueBounds(g)
                    local lo2, o2, d2 = lo, o, d
                    if T then o2, d2 = T:PointToObjectSpace(o), T:VectorToObjectSpace(d) end
                    local t = rayBox(o2, d2, lo2, hi)
                    if t and t <= reach and t < best then best, glueHover = t, i end
                end
            end
            for i, g in ipairs(glue) do
                local lo, hi, T = glueBounds(g)
                local mid = T and T * ((lo + hi) / 2) or (lo + hi) / 2
                if (mid - near).Magnitude < 40 * B then
                    used = used + 1
                    local h = i == glueHover
                    showBox(used, lo, hi, h and HIGHLIGHT or PASSIVE, h, h, T)
                end
            end
            -- the box being selected: from the first corner to the block under the crosshair
            if glueFirst then
                local w = world()
                local rp = RaycastParams.new()
                rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {c and c.root and c.root.Parent or workspace.Terrain, glueFolder}
                local r = workspace:Raycast(o, d * reach, rp)
                local corner = glueFirst
                local tooFar = false
                if r then
                    local x, y, z = cellOf(r.Position - r.Normal * 0.01)
                    corner = Vector3.new(x, y, z)
                    tooFar = (corner - glueFirst).Magnitude > 24
                end
                local g = {min = glueFirst:Min(corner), max = glueFirst:Max(corner)}
                local lo, hi = glueBounds(g)
                used = used + 1
                showBox(used, lo, hi, tooFar and FAIL or HIGHLIGHT, true, true, nil)
            end
        end
        for i = used + 1, #glueViews do
            local v = glueViews[i]
            if v then v.box.Visible = false end
        end
    end
    -- a left click on a glue box with glue in hand takes the box off (SuperGlueRemovalPacket), not the block
    function P.glueMine(pressed)
        if not holdingGlue() then return false end
        if glueFirst then
            if pressed then glueFirst = nil; sound("entity.item.pickup", nil, 0.5, 1) end
            return true
        end
        if not glueHover then return false end
        if pressed then
            local g = table.remove(glue, glueHover)
            if g then
                local lo, hi = glueBounds(g)
                sound("entity.slime.squish", (lo + hi) / 2, 0.5, 0.8)
            end
            glueHover = nil
        end
        return true
    end
    function P.glueDebug()
        local h = held()
        local okR, errR = pcall(glueRender)
        return tostring(h and h.id) .. " " .. tostring(h and nameOf(h)) .. " glue=" .. #glue .. " conn=" .. tostring(glueConn ~= nil) .. " views=" .. #glueViews .. " render=" .. tostring(okR) .. " " .. tostring(errR)
    end
    function P.glueStart()
        if glueConn then glueConn:Disconnect() end
        glueConn = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local ok, err = pcall(glueRender)
            if not ok and not P.glueWarned then P.glueWarned = true; warn("[Create] super glue view: " .. tostring(err)) end
        end)
    end
    function P.glueStop()
        if glueConn then glueConn:Disconnect(); glueConn = nil end
        if glueFolder then glueFolder:Destroy(); glueFolder = nil end
        glueViews = {}
    end
    end
