        local center
        while inst and not center do center = inst:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter"); inst = inst.Parent end
        local s = center and physics.shipOfCenter(center)
        return s, hit.Position, hit
    end
    local function beamTo(a, b)
        if not beam then
            beam = Instance.new("Part")
            beam.Name = "PhysicsStaffBeam"
            beam.Anchored, beam.CanCollide, beam.CanQuery, beam.CanTouch, beam.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
            beam.Material, beam.Color = Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 255)
            beam.Transparency = 0.25
            beam.Parent = workspace
        end
        local len = (b - a).Magnitude
        beam.Size = Vector3.new(0.08 * B, 0.08 * B, len)
        beam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b)
    end
    local function staffTick()
        if not drag then if beam then beam:Destroy(); beam = nil end return end
        local c = ctx()
        local w = world()
        local s = drag.ship
        local stillThere = false
        for _, o in ipairs(physics.ships) do if o == s then stillThere = true end end
        if not stillThere or not UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then
            drag = nil
            sound("block.beacon.deactivate", c and c.root.Position or Vector3.zero, 0.4, 1.6)
            return
        end
        local R = physics.Rigid
        local b = s.b
        -- the goal: along the look, at the grabbed distance; the anchor point is pulled there (a stiff spring with damping)
        local eye = w.eye()
        local goal = eye + w.look() * drag.distance
        local o = (JavaContent.mods.byId.create.kinetics.O or Vector3.zero)
        local g = (goal - o) / B + Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
        local ax, ay, az = R.toWorld(b, drag.anchor.X, drag.anchor.Y, drag.anchor.Z)
        local dx, dy, dz = g.X - ax, g.Y - ay, g.Z - az
        b.sleeping, b.kinematic = false, false
        b.vx, b.vy, b.vz = dx * 8, dy * 8 + 0.16, dz * 8
        b.wx, b.wy, b.wz = b.wx * 0.8, b.wy * 0.8, b.wz * 0.8
        local hand = c.root.Position + c.root.CFrame.RightVector * B * 0.35 + Vector3.new(0, B * 0.15, 0)
        beamTo(hand, o + (Vector3.new(ax, ay, az) - Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)) * B)
    end
    function I.staffUse()
        -- holding right-click repeats the use: an ongoing drag is not a new use (no swing)
        if drag then return false end
        local s, pos = shipUnderCrosshair()
        if not s then return nil end
        local w = world()
        local o = (JavaContent.mods.byId.create.kinetics.O or Vector3.zero)
        local sim = (pos - o) / B + Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
        local ax, ay, az = physics.Rigid.toGrid(s.b, sim.X, sim.Y, sim.Z)
        drag = {ship = s, anchor = Vector3.new(ax, ay, az), distance = math.clamp((pos - w.eye()).Magnitude, 2 * B, 128 * B)}
        if s.locked then s.locked = false end
        sound("block.beacon.activate", pos, 0.4, 1.6)
        return true
    end
    local function staffLock()
        local s, pos = shipUnderCrosshair()
        if not s then return false end
        s.locked = not s.locked
        local b = s.b
        b.vx, b.vy, b.vz, b.wx, b.wy, b.wz = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
        b.kinematic = s.locked
        sound(s.locked and "block.beacon.power_select" or "block.beacon.deactivate", pos, 0.5, 1.4)
        return true
    end

    -- ===== hooks ================================================================================================================
    function I.useBlock(hit, sneaking)
        local _, name = held()
        if name == "creative_physics_staff" then return I.staffUse() end
        local w = world()
        local n = w and hit and hit.Instance and w.resolve(hit.Instance)
        if n and n.id == "physics_assembler" and not sneaking then
            -- holding right-click repeats the use: the hold already going keeps its lever
            if hold and hold.node == n then return false end
            startHold(n)
            return true
        end
        return nil
    end
    -- the physics staff's left click locks a ship; it never breaks blocks
    function I.mine(pressed)
        local _, name = held()
        return name == "creative_physics_staff"
    end
    function I.start(ae)
        AE = ae
        conns[#conns + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local ok, err = pcall(function() renderLevers(); holdTick(); staffTick() end)
            if not ok and not I.warned then I.warned = true; warn("[Create Aeronautics] interact: " .. tostring(err)) end
        end)
        conns[#conns + 1] = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                local _, name = held()
                if name == "creative_physics_staff" then pcall(staffLock) end
            end
        end)
    end
    function I.stop()
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do c:Disconnect() end
        conns = {}
        for n, l in pairs(levers) do pcall(function() l.visual.model:Destroy() end) end
        levers = {}
        if hud then hud:Destroy(); hud = nil end
        if beam then beam:Destroy(); beam = nil end
        hold, drag = nil, nil
    end
    return I
end
return createAeroInteract

end)()
local createAeroBlocks = (function()
-- Create Aeronautics (Simulated): the blocks' own behaviour - their right-click, their screens, their redstone and their moving
-- parts, as the Java block entities do it.
--  * Throttle Lever (ThrottleLeverBlockEntity / ThrottleLeverHandler): hold right-click and move the mouse up / down to set
--    0..15; the brass value bar beside the crosshair; the handle tilts -40..40 degrees, the diode glows; the wrench inverts it.
--  * Altitude Sensor (AltitudeSensorBlockEntity / AltitudeSensorScreen): right-click opens its screen (the low / high grabbers
--    on the two bars, Ctrl moves both); the signal is the height between them; the dial follows; the wrench swaps the dial.
--  * Velocity Sensor (VelocitySensorBlockEntity): the ship's speed along its axis over the max speed (10 m/s) as 0..15 on the
--    side it moves towards; the fan spins with it.
--  * Gimbal Sensor (GimbalSensorBlockEntity): the ship's tilt, 0..15 per side over 45 degrees.
--  * Redstone Accumulator (RedstoneAccumulatorBlockEntity): back input counts up, side input counts down, one step per 10
--    ticks; right-click inverts.
--  * Redstone Inductor (RedstoneInductorBlockEntity): the output walks one step per 10 ticks towards the back input;
--    right-click inverts.
local function createAeroBlocks(physics)
    local Bk = {}
    local B = CONFIG.Block
    local RunService, UIS = game:GetService("RunService"), game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local floor, abs, max, min, clamp = math.floor, math.abs, math.max, math.min, math.clamp
    local AE, conns = nil, {}
    local function ctx() return JavaContent.mods.ctx end
    local function world() local c = ctx(); return c and c.world end
    local function K() local cr = JavaContent.mods.byId.create; return cr and cr.kinetics end
    local function O() local k = K(); return (k and k.O) or Vector3.zero end
    local function sound(name, pos, vol, pitch) if MinecraftSounds and MinecraftSounds.play then pcall(MinecraftSounds.play, name, pos, vol or 1, pitch or 1) end end
    local function L(key, default) local l = JavaContent.data.lang or {}; return l[key] or default or key end
    local OPP = {north = "south", south = "north", east = "west", west = "east", up = "down", down = "up"}
    local CW = {north = "east", east = "south", south = "west", west = "north"}
    local CCW = {north = "west", west = "south", south = "east", east = "north"}
    local DIRV = {north = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), south = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), east = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), west = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0),
        up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), down = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)}
    local YROT = {south = 0, west = 90, north = 180, east = 270}
    local function held()
        local c = ctx()
        local s = c and c.inventory and c.ui and c.inventory.slots[c.ui.selected]
        local e = s and JavaContent.byIndex[s.id]
        return s, e and (e.itemId or e.id)
    end
    -- right mouse held (tests can hold it with _G.__aeroFakeRMB)
    local function rmb() return UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) or rawget(_G, "__aeroFakeRMB") == true end
    local function holdingWrench() local _, name = held(); return name == "wrench" end
    local function rgb(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end
    local REDSTONE_OFF, REDSTONE_ON = rgb(86, 1, 1), rgb(205, 0, 0)
    local function redstoneColor(frac) return REDSTONE_OFF:Lerp(REDSTONE_ON, clamp(frac, 0, 1)) end

    -- GUI textures of the packs ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local assets = {}
    local function gui(key)
        local mod, folder
        if key:sub(1, 7) == "create:" then mod, folder = JavaContent.mods.byId.create, "Steve Mods/create"
        else mod, folder = JavaContent.mods.byId.create_aeronautics, "Steve Mods/create_aeronautics" end
        local g = mod and mod.catalog and mod.catalog.gui and mod.catalog.gui[key]
        if not g then return nil end
        if assets[key] == nil then
            assets[key] = false
            pcall(function() assets[key] = getcustomasset(folder .. "/" .. g.file) end)
        end
        return assets[key] and {image = assets[key], k = g.k or 8, w = g.w, h = g.h} or nil
    end
    -- one piece of a GUI texture (u, v, w, h in texture pixels) drawn at (x, y) in GUI pixels, stretched to (dw, dh)
    local function piece(parent, key, u, v, w, h, x, y, dw, dh, z)
        local t = gui(key)
        local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        img.BackgroundTransparency, img.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
        img.ResampleMode = Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated
        if t then img.Image = t.image; img.ImageRectOffset, img.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(u * t.k, v * t.k), Vector2.new(w * t.k, h * t.k) end
        img.Position, img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), UDim2.fromOffset(dw or w, dh or h)
        img.ZIndex = z or 5
        img.Parent = parent
        return img
    end

    -- nodes, data, redstone ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local DEF = {}
    local nodes = {}          -- node -> true for the blocks with a definition
    local scanAt = 0
    local function data(n)
        n.ae = n.ae or {}
        return n.ae
    end
    -- the world position of a block (a ship block is drawn where the ship is)
    local function worldFrame(n)
        local xf = physics.transformFor(n.center)
        return xf and (xf * CFrame.new(n.center)) or CFrame.new(n.center), xf ~= nil
    end
    local function setState(n, key, value)
        if n.state[key] == value then return end
        local st = table.clone(n.state)
        st[key] = value
        local w = world()
        if w and w.setBlockAt then
            -- keep the block entity data across the rebuild
            local keep = n.ae
            pcall(w.setBlockAt, n.center, n.index, st)
            local s = w.sample and w.sample(n.center)
            if s and s.node then s.node.ae = keep end
        else
            n.state[key] = value
        end
    end
    -- outputs read by CreativeRules.redstone: n.signal (weak, every side), n.signalDir[side] (weak, one side) and
    -- n.strongDir[side] (strong into the block on that side); sides name where the power goes
    local function emit(n, weak, dirs, strong)
        n.signal = weak
        n.signalDir = dirs
        n.strongDir = strong
    end
    local function received(n, side) return (n.received and n.received[side]) or 0 end

    -- partial models placed every frame ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local visuals = {}        -- node -> {name -> visual}
    local function partial(n, name)
        visuals[n] = visuals[n] or {}
        local v = visuals[n][name]
        if v == nil then
            local k = K()
            v = k and k.partialVisual and k.partialVisual(name, n.center) or false
            visuals[n][name] = v
        end
        return v or nil
    end
    local moveParts, moveFrames = {}, {}
    local function place(v, frame)
        if not v then return end
        for _, pair in ipairs(v.parts or {}) do
            if pair[1].Parent then moveParts[#moveParts + 1] = pair[1]; moveFrames[#moveFrames + 1] = frame * pair[2] end
        end
    end
    local function tint(v, color)
        if not v then return end
        for _, d in ipairs(v.model:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Texture") or d:IsA("Decal") then d.Color3 = color end
        end
    end
    local function clearVisuals(n)
        for _, v in pairs(visuals[n] or {}) do if v then pcall(function() v.model:Destroy() end) end end
        visuals[n] = nil
    end
    -- FaceAttachedHorizontalDirectionalBlock: floor / wall / ceiling, then the facing
    local function faceFrame(n)
        local st = n.state
        local rx = st.face == "floor" and 0 or (st.face == "wall" and 90 or 180)
        local ry = YROT[st.facing or "north"] or 0
        local frame = worldFrame(n)
        return frame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(ry), 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rx), 0, 0)
    end
    -- getConnectedDirection().getOpposite(): the block it hangs on
    local function supportSide(n)
        local st = n.state
        if st.face == "floor" then return "down" elseif st.face == "ceiling" then return "up" end
        return OPP[st.facing or "north"]
    end

    -- ===== Throttle lever =====================================================================================================
    local hold        -- the throttle lever being held (ThrottleLeverHandler)
    local hud
    local function throttleHud(show, value, shown)
        if not show then if hud then hud.Enabled = false end return end
        if not hud then
            local pg = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            hud = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            hud.Name, hud.ResetOnSpawn, hud.IgnoreGuiInset, hud.DisplayOrder = "AeroThrottleHUD", false, true, 50
            hud.Parent = pg
            local root = Instance.new("Frame")
            root.Name, root.BackgroundTransparency, root.Size = "Root", 1, UDim2.fromOffset(100, 14)
            root.Parent = hud
            local scale = Instance.new("UIScale"); scale.Parent = root
            -- the frame is drawn across and turned upright (renderOverlay: rotate 90 about its centre)
            local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
            bar.Name, bar.BackgroundTransparency, bar.Size, bar.Rotation = "Bar", 1, UDim2.fromOffset(100, 14), 90
            bar.Parent = root
            local V = "create:value_settings"
            piece(bar, V, 65, 9, 4, 4, 0, 0)
            piece(bar, V, 70, 9, 4, 4, 96, 0)
            piece(bar, V, 65, 19, 4, 4, 0, 10)
            piece(bar, V, 70, 19, 4, 4, 96, 10)
            piece(bar, V, 65, 14, 3, 4, 0, 4, 3, 6)
            piece(bar, V, 71, 14, 3, 4, 97, 4, 3, 6)
            piece(bar, V, 0, 24, 92, 3, 4, 0)
            piece(bar, V, 0, 27, 92, 3, 4, 11)
            piece(bar, V, 7, 0, 94, 8, 3, 3)
            local cursor = Instance.new("Frame")
            cursor.Name, cursor.BackgroundTransparency, cursor.Size = "Cursor", 1, UDim2.fromOffset(20, 14)
            cursor.Parent = root
            piece(cursor, V, 0, 9, 3, 14, 0, 0, nil, nil, 7)
            piece(cursor, V, 4, 9, 14, 14, 3, 0, nil, nil, 7)
            piece(cursor, V, 61, 9, 3, 14, 17, 0, nil, nil, 7)
        end
        hud.Enabled = true
        local root = hud.Root
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local size = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
        local sc = (JavaGui and JavaGui.scale and JavaGui.scale(size)) or 3
        root.UIScale.Scale = sc
        -- x = width / 2 - 50 + 16, y = height / 2 - 7 (GUI pixels)
        local gw, gh = size.X / sc, size.Y / sc
        local x, y = math.floor(gw / 2) - 50 + 16, math.floor(gh / 2) - 7
        root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x * sc, y * sc)
        -- the cursor: cx = x + 43, cy = y - 2 + (1 - 2 value) * 42 + 2 (relative to the root)
        local cy = -2 + (1 - 2 * value) * 3 * 14 + 2
        local cursor = root.Cursor
        cursor.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(43 - 3, cy)
        if cursor:GetAttribute("Shown") ~= shown then
            cursor:SetAttribute("Shown", shown)
            if cursor:FindFirstChild("Value") then cursor.Value:Destroy() end
            local t = JavaGui.text(cursor, tostring(shown), 3 + 1, 3, rgb(68, 32, 0), false, 8)
            t.Name = "Value"
        end
    end
    DEF.throttle_lever = {
        use = function(n, sneaking)
            if holdingWrench() then
                -- onWrenched: cycle INVERTED, the signal flips with it
                local d = data(n)
                local inverted = n.state.inverted ~= "true"
                d.state = 15 - (d.state or 0)
                setState(n, "inverted", tostring(inverted))
                sound("block.lever.click", n.center, 0.2, 0.25 + ((d.state + 5) / 15) * 0.5)
                return true
            end
            if hold then return false end
            local c = ctx()
            local d = data(n)
            local inverted = n.state.inverted == "true"
            local yaw, pitch = c.getView()
            local signal = inverted and 15 - (d.state or 0) or (d.state or 0)
            hold = {node = n, yaw = yaw, pitch = pitch, inverted = inverted, signal = signal, last = d.state or 0,
                value = signal / 15, anim = signal / 15}
            d.pressed = true
            return true
        end,
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            d.state = d.state or 0
            -- lastChange: the neighbours hear the new value 15 ticks after the last change
            if d.lastChange and d.lastChange > 0 then
                d.lastChange = d.lastChange - 1
                if d.lastChange == 0 then d.out = d.state end
            end
            d.out = d.out or d.state
            emit(n, d.out, nil, {[supportSide(n)] = d.out})
        end,
        render = function(n, dt)
            local d = data(n)
            local inverted = n.state.inverted == "true"
            -- clientAngle chases the state (0.5 per tick)
            local target = inverted and 15 - (d.state or 0) or (d.state or 0)
            d.angle = d.angle and (d.angle + (target - d.angle) * min(1, dt * 20 * 0.5)) or target
            d.press = (d.press or 0) + ((d.pressed and 1 or 0) - (d.press or 0)) * min(1, dt * 20 * 0.45)
            local face = n.state.face
            local angle = math.rad(d.angle / 15 * 80 - 40)
            if face == "wall" then angle = -angle end
            local base = faceFrame(n)
            local pivot = CFrame.new(0, (0.1875 - 0.5) * B, 0)
            local handle = base * pivot * CFrame.Angles(angle, 0, 0) * pivot:Inverse()
            if face == "wall" then handle = handle * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0) end
            place(partial(n, "simulated:throttle_lever/handle"), handle)
            local bp = CFrame.new(0, (0.875 - 0.5) * B, 0)
            place(partial(n, "simulated:throttle_lever/button"), handle * bp * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(d.press * -7), 0, 0) * bp:Inverse())
            local diode = partial(n, "simulated:throttle_lever/diode")
            place(diode, base)
            if diode and d.diodeAt ~= d.state then d.diodeAt = d.state; tint(diode, redstoneColor((d.state or 0) / 15)) end
        end,
    }
    local function throttleHoldTick()
        if not hold then throttleHud(false); return end
        local c = ctx()
        local n = hold.node
        local d = data(n)
        local root = c and c.root
        local down = rmb()
        if not down or not root or (root.Position - worldFrame(n).Position).Magnitude > B * 7 then
            d.pressed = false
            hold = nil
            throttleHud(false)
            return
        end
        local yaw, pitch = c.getView()
        local dp = math.deg(pitch - hold.pitch)
        c.setView(hold.yaw, hold.pitch)
        -- activeOnMouseMove: value -= pitch / 180 (looking up raises it)
        hold.value = clamp(hold.value + dp / 180, 0, 1)
        local signal = clamp(floor(hold.value * 15 + 0.5), 0, 15)
        if signal ~= hold.signal then
            hold.signal = signal
            -- the block entity: changeState steps towards it (setSignal sound)
            local out = hold.inverted and 15 - signal or signal
            if out ~= d.state then
                d.state = out
                d.lastChange = 15
                sound("block.lever.click", n.center, 0.2, 0.25 + ((signal + 5) / 15) * 0.5)
            end
        end
        hold.anim = hold.anim * 0.15 + signal / 15 * 0.85
        throttleHud(true, hold.anim, hold.inverted and 15 - signal or signal)
    end

    -- ===== Altitude sensor ====================================================================================================
    local MIN_Y, MAX_Y = -64, 320
    local function blockHeight(n)
        local p = worldFrame(n).Position
        return (p.Y - O().Y) / B
    end
    local function toNormal(y) return (y - MIN_Y) / (MAX_Y - MIN_Y) end
    local function toWorld(v) return MIN_Y + v * (MAX_Y - MIN_Y) end
    local function altitudeScreen(n)
        local c = ctx()
        local kit = c and c.ui and c.ui.kit
        local screens = c and c.world and c.world.screens
        if not (kit and screens) then return end
        local d = data(n)
        local high, low = d.high or 1, d.low or 0
        local vHigh, vLow = high, low
        local dragL, dragR = false, false
        local soundStep
        local KEY = "simulated:altitude_sensor"
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("altitude_sensor", 42, 206)
            local win = screen.window
            piece(win, KEY, 0, 0, 42, 206, 0, 0, nil, nil, 3)
            -- the lit bar above the high mark and the fade down to the low mark
            local litTop = piece(win, KEY, 48, 0, 10, 200, 16, 3, nil, nil, 4)
            local fade = piece(win, KEY, 48, 0, 10, 200, 16, 3, nil, nil, 4)
            local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            grad.Rotation = 90
            grad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
            grad.Parent = fade
            local grabL = piece(win, KEY, 64, 0, 26, 16, -6, 0, nil, nil, 6)
            local grabR = piece(win, KEY, 64, 0, 26, 16, 28 - 6, 0, nil, nil, 6)
            local title = L("simulated.gui.altitude_sensor.title", "Altitude Sensor")
            local tw = JavaGui.width(title)
            JavaGui.text(win, title, -floor(tw / 2) - 10 - floor(tw / 2), 103 - 9, rgb(221, 221, 221), true, 6)
            local labels = {}
            local function label(key, text, cx, y, color)
                if labels[key] and labels[key].text == text and labels[key].color == color and labels[key].y == y then return end
                if labels[key] then labels[key].node:Destroy() end
                local node = JavaGui.text(win, text, cx - floor(JavaGui.width(text) / 2), y, color, true, 8)
                labels[key] = {node = node, text = text, color = color, y = y}
            end
            local function overGrabby(x, y, left)
                local inv = floor((1 - (left and vLow or vHigh)) * 200)
                local gx = (left and 3 or 28) - 6
                local gy = 3 - 8 + inv
                return x > gx and x < gx + 26 and y > gy and y < gy + 16
            end
            local wasDown = false
            screens.install(screen)
            screen.onClick = function(button, x, y)
                if button ~= 1 then return false end
                dragL, dragR = overGrabby(x, y, true), overGrabby(x, y, false)
                return dragL or dragR
            end
            screen.onUpdate = function(x, y)
                local down = UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
                if not down then dragL, dragR = false, false end
                if (dragL or dragR) and down then
                    -- updateValues: the mouse height on the bar; Ctrl moves both grabbers together
                    local progress = clamp(1 - (y - 3) / 200, 0, 1)
                    local change = 0
                    if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl) then
                        change = dragL and progress - low or progress - high
                    end
                    if low + change >= 0 and low + change <= 1 and high + change >= 0 and high + change <= 1 then
                        if dragL then low = progress; high = high + change
                        else high = progress; low = low + change end
                        local step = floor(progress * 15)
                        if step ~= soundStep then soundStep = step; sound("block.lever.click", nil, 0.2, 0.25 + progress * 0.5) end
                    end
                end
                wasDown = down
                -- LerpedFloat chase 0.85 (per tick)
                vHigh = vHigh + (high - vHigh) * 0.85
                vLow = vLow + (low - vLow) * 0.85
                local highMax, lowMax = floor(vHigh * 200), floor(vLow * 200)
                if low > high then
                    litTop.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 3 + 200 - highMax)
                    litTop.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, highMax)
                    litTop.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(48, 200 - highMax) * (gui(KEY) and gui(KEY).k or 8)
                    litTop.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(10, highMax) * (gui(KEY) and gui(KEY).k or 8)
                else
                    litTop.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 3)
                    litTop.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 200 - highMax)
                    litTop.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(48, 0) * (gui(KEY) and gui(KEY).k or 8)
                    litTop.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(10, 200 - highMax) * (gui(KEY) and gui(KEY).k or 8)
                end
                local top, bottom = 3 + 200 - highMax, 3 + 200 - lowMax
                if bottom < top then top, bottom = bottom, top; grad.Rotation = 270 else grad.Rotation = 90 end
                fade.Position, fade.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, top), UDim2.fromOffset(10, max(0, bottom - top))
                local k = gui(KEY) and gui(KEY).k or 8
                fade.ImageRectOffset, fade.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(48, top - 3) * k, Vector2.new(10, max(0, bottom - top)) * k
                fade.Visible = bottom > top
                local invHigh, invLow = floor((1 - vHigh) * 200), floor((1 - vLow) * 200)
                grabL.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-6, 3 - 8 + invLow)
                grabR.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(28 - 6, 3 - 8 + invHigh)
                local brown, white = rgb(142, 111, 73), rgb(221, 221, 221)
                label("low", tostring(floor(toWorld(low))), 3 + 4, 3 - 4 + invLow, (dragL or overGrabby(x, y, true)) and white or brown)
                label("high", tostring(floor(toWorld(high))), 28 + 7 + 1, 3 - 4 + invHigh, (dragR or overGrabby(x, y, false)) and white or brown)
            end
        end, function()
            -- onClose: ConfigureAltitudeSensorPacket
            d.high, d.low = high, low
        end)
    end
    DEF.altitude_sensor = {
        use = function(n)
            if holdingWrench() then
                setState(n, "dial", n.state.dial == "radial" and "linear" or "radial")
                sound("block.lever.click", n.center, 0.3, 0.8)
                return true
            end
            altitudeScreen(n)
            return true
        end,
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            local high, low = d.high or 1, d.low or 0
            local y = toNormal(blockHeight(n))
            local value = high == low and 0 or clamp((y - low) / (high - low), 0, 1)
            d.signal = floor(value * 15 + 0.5)
            emit(n, d.signal, nil, {down = d.signal})
            d.ticks = (d.ticks or 0) + 1
            local wy = blockHeight(n)
            d.visualHeight = d.visualHeight and (d.visualHeight * 0.85 + wy * 0.15) or wy
        end,
        render = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            local st = n.state
            local radial = st.dial == "radial"
            local facing = st.facing or "north"
            -- yRot: facing (Z axis) or its opposite (X axis), then + 180
            local yr = (facing == "north" or facing == "south") and YROT[facing] or YROT[OPP[facing]]
            local base = worldFrame(n) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(yr + 180), 0)
            local time = (d.ticks or 0)
            local wobble = -math.sin(time * 0.8) * math.exp(-time / 3.5) * 0.7
            local caseFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(wobble, 0, 0)
            place(partial(n, radial and "simulated:altitude_sensor/radial_case" or "simulated:altitude_sensor/linear_case"), caseFrame)
            local hand
            local vh = toNormal(d.visualHeight or blockHeight(n))
            if radial then
                hand = caseFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -(d.visualHeight or 0) * math.pi / 2)
            else
                local dial = clamp((vh - (d.low or 0)) / max(1e-6, (d.high or 1) - (d.low or 0)), 0, 1)
                hand = caseFrame * CFrame.new(0, (dial * 8 - 4) / 16 * B, 0)
            end
            place(partial(n, radial and "simulated:altitude_sensor/radial_hand" or "simulated:altitude_sensor/linear_hand"), hand)
            local faceAngle = st.face == "wall" and 90 or (st.face == "ceiling" and 180 or 0)
            local ind = partial(n, "simulated:altitude_sensor/indicator")
            place(ind, base * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(faceAngle), 0, 0))
            if ind and d.tintAt ~= d.signal then d.tintAt = d.signal; tint(ind, redstoneColor((d.signal or 0) / 15)) end
        end,
    }

    -- ===== Velocity sensor ====================================================================================================
    -- AbstractDirectionalAxisBlock.getAxis: the facing and axis_along_first pick the measured axis
    local function sensorAxis(st)
        local facing = st.facing or "north"
        local first = st.axis_along_first == "true"
        if facing == "up" or facing == "down" then return first and "x" or "z" end
        local up = first ~= (facing == "north" or facing == "south")
        if up then return "y" end
        return (CW[facing] == "east" or CW[facing] == "west") and "x" or "z"
    end
    local POS = {x = "east", y = "up", z = "south"}
    DEF.velocity_sensor = {
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            local frame, onShip = worldFrame(n)
            local axis = sensorAxis(n.state)
            local positive = POS[axis]
            local strength = 0
            if onShip and d.lastPos then
                local vel = (frame.Position - d.lastPos) / B * 20         -- blocks per second
                local normal = frame:VectorToWorldSpace(DIRV[positive])
                local dot = vel:Dot(normal)
                d.velocity = abs(dot) > 0.05 and dot or 0
                local maxSigned = (d.maxSpeed or 10) * (d.towards and 1 or -1)
                strength = clamp(math.modf(d.velocity / maxSigned * 15), -15, 15)
            else
                d.velocity = 0
            end
            d.lastPos = frame.Position
            local powered = strength == 0 and "0" or (strength < 0 and "1" or "2")
            if n.state.powered ~= powered then setState(n, "powered", powered) end
            -- getSignal: the strength on the positive side (powered 1) or the negative side (powered 2)
            local side = powered == "2" and OPP[positive] or positive
            d.signal = abs(strength)
            emit(n, nil, strength ~= 0 and {[OPP[side]] = d.signal} or nil, nil)
            d.fanTarget = clamp((d.velocity or 0) / ((d.maxSpeed or 10) * (d.towards and 1 or -1)), -1, 1)
        end,
        render = function(n, dt)
            local d = data(n)
            d.fanSpeed = (d.fanSpeed or 0) + ((d.fanTarget or 0) - (d.fanSpeed or 0)) * min(1, dt * 20 * 0.5)
            d.fan = (d.fan or 0) + (d.fanSpeed or 0) * dt * 20
            local axis = sensorAxis(n.state)
            local rot = axis == "x" and CFrame.Angles(d.fan, 0, 0) or axis == "y" and CFrame.Angles(0, d.fan, 0) or CFrame.Angles(0, 0, d.fan)
            place(partial(n, "simulated:velocity_sensor/fan"), worldFrame(n) * rot)
            local diode = partial(n, "simulated:velocity_sensor/diode")
            place(diode, worldFrame(n))
            if diode and d.tintAt ~= d.signal then d.tintAt = d.signal; tint(diode, redstoneColor((d.signal or 0) / 15)) end
        end,
    }

    -- ===== Gimbal sensor ======================================================================================================
    DEF.gimbal_sensor = {
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            local frame, onShip = worldFrame(n)
            local map = {}
            if onShip then
                -- the world's down in the ship's frame: the tilt about X and Z
                local ld = frame:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.new(0, -1, 0))
                local xa = (ld.Y < 0 or ld.Z * ld.Z > 0.001) and math.atan2(ld.Z, -ld.Y) or 0
                local za = (ld.Y < 0 or ld.X * ld.X > 0.001) and math.atan2(ld.X, -ld.Y) or 0
                local primaryAxis = n.state.axis or "x"
                local function power(angle, dir)
                    local along = (dir == "east" or dir == "west") and "x" or "z"
                    local limit = along == primaryAxis and (d.primary or 45) or (d.secondary or 45)
                    if limit == 0 then return 0 end
                    return max(min(floor(14.5 * angle / math.rad(limit) + 0.5), 15), 0)
                end
                map.east, map.west = power(za, "east"), power(-za, "west")
                map.south, map.north = power(xa, "south"), power(-xa, "north")
            end
            d.map = map
            emit(n, nil, map, nil)
        end,
    }

    -- ===== Redstone accumulator ===============================================================================================
    DEF.redstone_accumulator = {
        use = function(n)
            if holdingWrench() then return nil end
            local d = data(n)
            d.inverted = not d.inverted
            sound("block.lever.click", n.center, 0.3, d.inverted and 0.5 or 0.6)
            return true
        end,
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
            local back = received(n, facing) > 0
            local side = received(n, CW[facing]) > 0 or received(n, CCW[facing]) > 0
            d.out = d.out or 0
            d.delay = d.delay or 0
            local limit = d.inputDelay or 10
            if not (back and side) then
                if not back and not side then d.delay = 0 end
                if d.delay == limit then
                    if back then d.out = min(15, d.out + 1); d.delay = 0
                    elseif side then d.out = max(0, d.out - 1); d.delay = 0 end
                else
                    d.delay = min(d.delay + 1, limit)
                end
            end
            local out = d.inverted and 15 - d.out or d.out
            local powered, sidePowered, powering = tostring(back), tostring(side), tostring(out > 0)
            if n.state.powered ~= powered or n.state.side_powered ~= sidePowered or n.state.powering ~= powering then
                local st = table.clone(n.state)
                st.powered, st.side_powered, st.powering = powered, sidePowered, powering
                local w = world()
                local keep = n.ae
                if w and w.setBlockAt then pcall(w.setBlockAt, n.center, n.index, st); local s = w.sample(n.center); if s and s.node then s.node.ae = keep end end
            end
            emit(n, nil, {[OPP[facing]] = out}, {[OPP[facing]] = out})
        end,
    }

    -- ===== Redstone inductor ==================================================================================================
    DEF.redstone_inductor = {
        use = function(n)
            if holdingWrench() then return nil end
            setState(n, "inverted", n.state.inverted == "true" and "false" or "true")
            sound("block.lever.click", n.center, 0.3, n.state.inverted ~= "true" and 0.6 or 0.5)
            return true
        end,
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
            local backSignal = received(n, facing)
            d.out = d.out or 0
            d.delay = d.delay or 0
            local limit = d.inputDelay or 10
            local temp = d.out
            if temp == 0 and n.state.powered ~= "true" then d.delay = 0 end
            if limit ~= 0 and d.delay >= limit then
                d.delay = 0
                if temp > backSignal then temp = temp - 1 end
                if temp < backSignal then temp = temp + 1 end
            elseif limit == 0 and d.delay > 2 then
                d.delay = 0
                temp = backSignal
            end
            d.delay = d.delay + 1
            d.out = temp
            local powered = tostring(backSignal > 0)
            if n.state.powered ~= powered then setState(n, "powered", powered) end
            local inverted = n.state.inverted == "true"
            local out = inverted and 15 - d.out or d.out
            emit(n, nil, {[OPP[facing]] = out}, {[OPP[facing]] = out})
        end,
    }

    -- ===== Create's value settings (ValueBox / ValueSettingsClient / ValueSettingsScreen) =====================================
    -- A block's settings live on a small box on one of its faces. Looking at it shows the box and its value; holding
    -- right-click on it for 5 ticks opens the brass board (rows x values with milestones), the cursor starts on the current
    -- value and follows the mouse, Shift snaps to milestones, the wheel steps, releasing right-click confirms. A short click
    -- runs the block's own action (an accumulator / inductor inverts).
    local VS = "create:value_settings"
    local BROWN = rgb(68, 32, 0)          -- 4464640
    local function brassFrame(parent, x, y, w, h, z)
        piece(parent, VS, 65, 9, 4, 4, x, y, nil, nil, z)
        piece(parent, VS, 70, 9, 4, 4, x + w - 4, y, nil, nil, z)
        piece(parent, VS, 65, 19, 4, 4, x, y + h - 4, nil, nil, z)
        piece(parent, VS, 70, 19, 4, 4, x + w - 4, y + h - 4, nil, nil, z)
        if h > 8 then
            piece(parent, VS, 65, 14, 3, 4, x, y + 4, 3, h - 8, z)
            piece(parent, VS, 71, 14, 3, 4, x + w - 3, y + 4, 3, h - 8, z)
        end
        if w > 8 then
            piece(parent, VS, 0, 24, min(256, w - 8), 3, x + 4, y, nil, nil, z)
            piece(parent, VS, 0, 27, min(256, w - 8), 3, x + 4, y + h - 3, nil, nil, z)
        end
    end
    local valueHold      -- {node, spec, ticks}
    local function openValueBoard(spec, row0, value0, onDone)
        local c = ctx()
        local kit = c and c.ui and c.ui.kit
        local screens = c and c.world and c.world.screens
        if not (kit and screens) then return end
        local rows, maxV, mile = spec.rows, spec.max, spec.milestone
        local scale = maxV > 128 and 1 or 2
        local mSize = 4
        local labelW = 0
        for _, r in ipairs(rows) do labelW = max(labelW, JavaGui.width(r)) end
        local mCount = floor(maxV / mile) + 1
        local barW = (maxV + 1) * scale + 1 + mCount * mSize
        local width, height = labelW + 14 + barW + 10, #rows * 11
        local function coord(row, col)
            local x = floor((max(1, col) - 1) / mile) * mSize + col * scale + 1.5 + labelW + 14 + 4
            if col % mile == 0 then x = x + mSize / 2 end
            if col > 0 then x = x + mSize end
            return x, (row + 0.5) * 11 - 0.5
        end
        local function closest(mx, my)
            local shift = UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
            local row, best = 0, math.huge
            for r = 0, #rows - 1 do
                local _, y = coord(r, 0)
                local diff = abs(y - my)
                if diff < best then best, row = diff, r end
            end
            local col, bestx = 0, math.huge
            for cc = 0, maxV do
                local v = shift and min(cc * mile, maxV) or cc
                local x = coord(row, v)
                local diff = abs(x - mx)
                if diff < bestx then bestx, col = diff, v end
                if shift and cc * mile > maxV then break end
            end
            return row, col
        end
        local wheel
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("value_settings", width, height)
            local win = screen.window
            local title = spec.title
            local tip = (L("create.gui.value_settings.release_to_confirm", "Release %1$s to Confirm"):gsub("%%1%$s", L("key.mouse.right", "Right Button")))
            local fattest = max(JavaGui.width(tip), JavaGui.width(title))
            local fatOff = floor(max(0, fattest + 10 - (width + 13)) / 2)
            local bgW = max(width + 13, fattest + 10)
            local x0 = -11 - fatOff
            piece(win, VS, 80, 9, 1, 1, x0, -17, bgW, height + 33, 2)
            piece(win, VS, 80, 9, 1, 1, x0 + 1, -18, bgW - 2, 1, 2)
            piece(win, VS, 80, 9, 1, 1, x0 + 1, -17 + height + 33, bgW - 2, 1, 2)
            local textX = x0 + floor(bgW / 2)
            JavaGui.text(win, title, textX - floor(JavaGui.width(title) / 2), -14, rgb(221, 221, 221), false, 6)
            JavaGui.text(win, tip, textX - floor(JavaGui.width(tip) / 2), height + 33 - 27, rgb(221, 221, 221), false, 6)
            brassFrame(win, labelW + 14, -3, barW + 8, #rows * 11 + 5, 4)
            piece(win, VS, 75, 9, 1, 1, labelW + 17, 0, barW + 2, #rows * 11 - 1, 3)
            for i, r in ipairs(rows) do
                local y = (i - 1) * 11
                local bx = labelW + 14 + 4
                piece(win, VS, 0, 31, min(161, labelW + 8), 11, -4, y, nil, nil, 3)
                local w = 0
                while w < barW do
                    local seg = min(248, barW - w)
                    piece(win, VS, 7, 0, seg, 8, bx + w, y + 1, nil, nil, 4)
                    w = w + 248
                end
                JavaGui.text(win, r, 0, y + 1, BROWN, false, 6)
                local mx = bx
                for _ = 1, mCount do
                    piece(win, VS, 0, 0, 7, 8, mx, y + 1, nil, nil, 5)
                    mx = mx + mSize + mile * scale
                end
            end
            brassFrame(win, -7, -3, labelW + 14, #rows * 11 + 5, 4)
            local cursor = Instance.new("Frame")
            cursor.BackgroundTransparency, cursor.Size, cursor.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 14), 8
            cursor.Parent = win
            local origin, offset
            local lastRow, lastCol, cursorKey
            local sx, sy = coord(row0, value0)
            wheel = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel or not offset then return end
                local shift = UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
                local col = clamp(lastCol + (input.Position.Z > 0 and 1 or -1) * (shift and mile or 1), 0, maxV)
                local tx, ty = coord(lastRow, col)
                local px, py = origin.X + offset.X, origin.Y + offset.Y
                offset = offset + Vector2.new(tx - px, ty - py)
            end)
            screens.install(screen)
            local done = false
            screen.onUpdate = function(mx, my)
                if not origin then origin = Vector2.new(sx, sy); offset = Vector2.zero; screen.mouse0 = Vector2.new(mx, my) end
                local p = origin + offset + (Vector2.new(mx, my) - screen.mouse0)
                local row, col = closest(p.X, p.Y)
                if row ~= lastRow or col ~= lastCol then
                    if lastRow then sound("block.note_block.hat", nil, 0.25, 1.15 + (col / maxV) * 0.35) end
                    lastRow, lastCol = row, col
                    if spec.hover then pcall(spec.hover, row, col) end
                end
                local text = spec.format(row, col)
                local key = text .. "|" .. row .. "|" .. col
                if key ~= cursorKey then
                    cursorKey = key
                    cursor:ClearAllChildren()
                    local cw = floor(JavaGui.width(text) / 2) * 2 + 3
                    local cx, cy = coord(row, col)
                    local x, y = floor(cx) - floor(cw / 2), floor(cy) - 7
                    piece(cursor, VS, 0, 9, 3, 14, x - 3, y, nil, nil, 8)
                    piece(cursor, VS, 4, 9, min(56, cw), 14, x, y, cw, 14, 8)
                    piece(cursor, VS, 61, 9, 3, 14, x + cw, y, nil, nil, 8)
                    JavaGui.text(cursor, text, x + 2, y + 3, BROWN, false, 9)
                end
                -- mouseReleased(use): save and close
                if not done and not rmb() then
                    done = true
                    wheel:Disconnect()
                    pcall(onDone, row, col)
                    task.defer(function() if c.ui.open then c.ui.toggle() end end)
                end
            end
        end, function() if wheel then wheel:Disconnect() end end)
    end
    Bk.openValueBoard = openValueBoard
    -- the brass diode board (BrassDiodeScrollValueBehaviour): ticks / seconds / minutes up to 60
    local function diodeSpec(n, title, minimum, zeroText)
        local d = data(n)
        local function get()
            local v = d.inputDelay or 10
            if v > 1200 then return 2, floor(v / 1200) elseif v > 60 then return 1, floor(v / 20) end
            return 0, v
        end
        return {title = title, rows = {L("create.generic.unit.ticks", "Ticks"), L("create.generic.unit.seconds", "Seconds"), L("create.generic.unit.minutes", "Minutes")},
            max = 60, milestone = 10,
            format = function(row, v)
                if minimum == 0 and row == 0 and v == 0 then return zeroText() end
                v = max(1, v)
                if row == 0 then return max(minimum, v) .. "t" elseif row == 1 then return "0:" .. (v < 10 and "0" or "") .. v end
                return v .. ":00"
            end,
            get = get,
            set = function(row, v)
                if minimum == 0 and row == 0 and v == 0 then d.inputDelay = 0; return end
                local mult = row == 0 and 1 or (row == 1 and 20 or 1200)
                d.inputDelay = max(minimum, max(1, v) * mult)
            end,
            value = function() local r, v = get(); return (minimum == 0 and d.inputDelay == 0) and zeroText() or ((r == 0 and max(minimum, v) .. "t") or (r == 1 and "0:" .. (v < 10 and "0" or "") .. v) or (v .. ":00")) end}
    end
    DEF.redstone_accumulator.values = function(n)
        local s = diodeSpec(n, L("block.simulated.redstone_accumulator.input_delay", "Input Delay"), 2)
        s.offset, s.normal, s.scale = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.4125, 0.5), Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), 0.5
        s.short = function() DEF.redstone_accumulator.use(n) end
        return s
    end
    DEF.redstone_inductor.values = function(n)
        local s = diodeSpec(n, L("block.simulated.redstone_accumulator.input_delay", "Input Delay"), 0, function()
            return L(n.state.inverted == "true" and "block.simulated.redstone_inductor.invert" or "block.simulated.redstone_inductor.copy")
        end)
        s.offset, s.normal, s.scale = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.34375, 0.5), Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), 0.5
        s.short = function() DEF.redstone_inductor.use(n) end
        return s
    end
    DEF.velocity_sensor.values = function(n, side)
        local axis = sensorAxis(n.state)
        if not side or ((side == "east" or side == "west") and "x" or (side == "up" or side == "down") and "y" or "z") ~= axis then return nil end
        local d = data(n)
        return {offset = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) + DIRV[side] * (12.8 - 8) / 16, normal = DIRV[side], scale = 0.35,
            title = L("simulated.velocity_sensor.description", "Max Speed"),
            rows = {L("simulated.velocity_sensor.selection.away", "Away"), L("simulated.velocity_sensor.selection.towards", "Towards")},
            max = 50, milestone = 10,
            format = function(_, v) return v .. " m/s" end,
            get = function() return d.towards and 1 or 0, d.maxSpeed or 10 end,
            set = function(row, v) d.maxSpeed = max(1, v); d.towards = row == 1 end,
            value = function() return (d.maxSpeed or 10) .. " m/s" end}
    end
    DEF.gimbal_sensor.values = function(n, side)
        if not side or side == "up" or side == "down" then return nil end
        local d = data(n)
        local sideAxis = (side == "east" or side == "west") and "x" or "z"
        local primary = sideAxis ~= (n.state.axis or "x")
        local key = primary and "primary" or "secondary"
        local function value() local v = d[key]; if v == nil then v = 45 end; return v end
        return {offset = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) + DIRV[side] * 0.5, normal = DIRV[side], scale = 0.5,
            title = L("create.kinetics.valve_handle.rotated_angle", "Rotation when used"), rows = {"⟳", "⟲"},
            max = 90, milestone = 15,
            format = function(_, v) return abs(v) .. L("create.generic.unit.degrees", "°") end,
            get = function() local v = value(); return v < 0 and 0 or 1, abs(v) end,
            set = function(row, v) v = max(0, v); d[key] = row == 0 and -v or v end,
            value = function() return abs(value()) .. L("create.generic.unit.degrees", "°") end}
    end
    -- which value box the crosshair is on: (node, spec) when the look ray hits the box on its face
    local function lookBox()
        local w = world()
        local c = ctx()
        if not (w and w.eye and w.look and c) then return nil end
        local p = RaycastParams.new()
        p.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        p.FilterDescendantsInstances = {c.character}
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(w.eye(), w.look() * (CONFIG.Reach or 4.5) * B, p)
        if not hit then return nil end
        local center = hit.Instance:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter")
        local s = center and w.sample(center)
        local n = s and s.node
        if not (n and DEF[n.id] and DEF[n.id].values) then return nil end
        local frame = worldFrame(n)
        local lp = frame:PointToObjectSpace(hit.Position) / B + Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
        local ln = frame:VectorToObjectSpace(hit.Normal)
        local side
        local ax, ay, az = abs(ln.X), abs(ln.Y), abs(ln.Z)
        if ax >= ay and ax >= az then side = ln.X > 0 and "east" or "west"
        elseif ay >= az then side = ln.Y > 0 and "up" or "down" else side = ln.Z > 0 and "south" or "north" end
        local ok, spec = pcall(DEF[n.id].values, n, side)
        if not (ok and spec) then return nil end
        -- ValueBoxTransform.testHit: within half the box's size of its centre
        if (lp - spec.offset).Magnitude >= spec.scale / 2 + 0.03 then return nil end
        return n, spec
    end
    -- the box outline and the hover tip (title, value, "Click and hold to edit")
    local boxPart, tipGui
    local function drawHover(n, spec)
        if not n then
            if boxPart then boxPart.Parent = nil end
            if tipGui then tipGui.Enabled = false end
            return
        end
        if not boxPart then
            boxPart = Instance.new("Part")
            boxPart.Name, boxPart.Anchored, boxPart.CanCollide, boxPart.CanQuery, boxPart.CanTouch, boxPart.Transparency = "AeroValueBox", true, false, false, false, 1
            local sel = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
            sel.Adornee, sel.LineThickness, sel.Color3, sel.SurfaceTransparency = boxPart, 0.012, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 1
            sel.Parent = boxPart
        end
        local frame = worldFrame(n)
        local pos = frame * ((spec.offset - Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)) * B)
        local nrm = frame:VectorToWorldSpace(spec.normal)
        local up = abs(nrm.Y) > 0.9 and frame.LookVector or Vector3.yAxis
        boxPart.Size = Vector3.new(spec.scale * B, spec.scale * B, 0.01)
        boxPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos + nrm * 0.01, pos + nrm * 2, up)
        boxPart.Parent = workspace
        if not tipGui then
            local pg = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            tipGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            tipGui.Name, tipGui.ResetOnSpawn, tipGui.IgnoreGuiInset, tipGui.DisplayOrder = "AeroValueTip", false, true, 40
            tipGui.Parent = pg
            local root = Instance.new("Frame"); root.Name, root.BackgroundTransparency = "Root", 1; root.Parent = tipGui
            local sc = Instance.new("UIScale"); sc.Parent = root
        end
        tipGui.Enabled = true
        local root = tipGui.Root
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local size = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
        local sc = (JavaGui and JavaGui.scale and JavaGui.scale(size)) or 3
        root.UIScale.Scale = sc
        root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(size.X / 2 + 12 * sc, size.Y / 2 - 6 * sc)
        local lines = {{spec.title, rgb(255, 255, 255)}, {spec.value and spec.value() or "", rgb(255, 255, 85)},
            {L("create.gui.value_settings.hold_to_edit", "Click and hold to edit"), rgb(170, 170, 170)}}
        local key = lines[1][1] .. lines[2][1]
        if root:GetAttribute("Key") ~= key then
            root:SetAttribute("Key", key)
            root:ClearAllChildren()
            local s2 = Instance.new("UIScale"); s2.Name = "UIScale"; s2.Scale = sc; s2.Parent = root
            local wmax = 0
            for _, l in ipairs(lines) do wmax = max(wmax, JavaGui.width(l[1])) end
            local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
            bg.BackgroundColor3, bg.BackgroundTransparency, bg.BorderSizePixel = rgb(16, 0, 16), 0.06, 0
            bg.Position, bg.Size, bg.ZIndex = UDim2.fromOffset(-3, -3), UDim2.fromOffset(wmax + 6, #lines * 10 + 4), 1
            bg.Parent = root
            local border = Instance.new("UIStroke"); border.Color = rgb(40, 0, 127); border.Thickness = 1; border.Parent = bg
            for i, l in ipairs(lines) do JavaGui.text(root, l[1], 0, (i - 1) * 10, l[2], true, 3) end
        end
    end
    local function valueTick()
        local c = ctx()
        local uiOpen = c and c.ui and c.ui.open
        if valueHold then
            local n, spec = lookBox()
            if not rmb() then
                -- released early: the short interaction
                if valueHold.spec.short then pcall(valueHold.spec.short) end
                valueHold = nil
            elseif n ~= valueHold.node then
                valueHold = nil
            else
                valueHold.ticks = valueHold.ticks + 1
                if valueHold.ticks >= 5 then
                    local h = valueHold
                    valueHold = nil
                    local row, v = h.spec.get()
                    openValueBoard(h.spec, row, v, function(r, val)
                        local before = {h.spec.get()}
                        h.spec.set(r, val)
                        local after = {h.spec.get()}
                        if before[1] ~= after[1] or before[2] ~= after[2] then sound("block.note_block.hat", n and n.center, 0.25, 1.5) end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        if uiOpen then drawHover(nil); return end
        local n, spec = lookBox()
        drawHover(n, spec)
    end
    local valueAcc = 0

    -- ===== Redstone links (RedstoneLinkNetworkHandler / LinkBehaviour) =========================================================
    -- Every transmitter and receiver has a frequency of two items. A receiver hears the strongest transmitter with the same
    -- pair within 256 blocks. Transmitters: Create's Redstone Link (transmit mode) and a held Linked Typewriter key.
    local LINK_RANGE = 256
    local links = {}
    JavaContent.redstoneLinks = links
    local function freqKey(f1, f2)
        local function k(s) if not s then return "" end local e = JavaContent.byIndex[s.id]; return e and (e.itemId or e.id) or tostring(s.id) end
        return k(f1) .. "|" .. k(f2)
    end
    local function linkPos(n) return worldFrame(n).Position end
    local transmitters = {}
    local function refreshTransmitters()
        transmitters = {}
        for _, l in ipairs(links) do
            local p = l.power and l.power() or 0
            if p > 0 then
                local key = l.key()
                transmitters[key] = transmitters[key] or {}
                table.insert(transmitters[key], {pos = l.pos(), power = p})
            end
        end
    end
    local function strongestFor(key, at, shape)
        local best, raw = 0, 0
        for _, t in ipairs(transmitters[key] or {}) do
            local rel = (t.pos - at) / B
            if rel.Magnitude <= LINK_RANGE then
                local s, r
                if shape then s, r = shape(rel, t.power) else s, r = t.power, rel.Magnitude end
                if s > best then best, raw = s, r end
            end
        end
        return best, raw
    end
    Bk.links = {freqKey = freqKey, strongestFor = strongestFor}

    -- frequency slots on a block (RedstoneLinkFrequencySlot / LinkedReceiverFrequencySlot)
    local HANGLE = {south = 0, north = 180, east = 90, west = 270}
    local function rotY(v, deg)
        local c = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
        return c + CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(deg), 0):VectorToWorldSpace(v - c)
    end
    local function slotOffsets(n, horizontal, vertical, step)
        local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
        local out = {}
        for i, first in ipairs({true, false}) do
            local v
            if facing ~= "up" and facing ~= "down" then
                v = horizontal + (first and Vector3.new(0, step, 0) or Vector3.zero)
                v = rotY(v, HANGLE[facing])
            else
                v = vertical + (first and Vector3.new(0, 0, step) or Vector3.zero)
                if facing == "down" then v = Vector3.new(v.X, 1 - v.Y, 1 - v.Z) end
            end
            out[i] = v
        end
        return out
    end
    -- the frequency items, drawn flat on the slots (a small panel with the item's icon)
    local function frequencyItems(n, offsets, scale)
        local d = data(n)
        d.freq = d.freq or {}
        local out = DIRV[n.state.facing or "north"]
        local frame = worldFrame(n)
        visuals[n] = visuals[n] or {}
        for i = 1, 2 do
            local stack = d.freq[i]
            local key = "freq" .. i
            local v = visuals[n][key]
            local want = stack and stack.id or nil
            if v and v.id ~= want then pcall(function() v.model:Destroy() end); v = nil; visuals[n][key] = nil end
            if want and not v then
                local part = Instance.new("Part")
                part.Name, part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.Transparency = "LinkFrequency", true, false, false, false, 1
                part.Size = Vector3.new(scale * B, scale * B, 0.02)
                local sg = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
                sg.Face, sg.SizingMode, sg.PixelsPerStud, sg.LightInfluence = Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud, 64, 1
                sg.Parent = part
                local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
                holder.BackgroundTransparency, holder.Size, holder.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 1
                holder.Parent = sg
                pcall(JavaContent.icon, holder, want)
                part.Parent = workspace
                v = {model = part, id = want, parts = {{part, CFrame.identity}}}
                visuals[n][key] = v
            end
            if v then
                local p = frame * ((offsets[i] - Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)) * B)
                local look = frame:VectorToWorldSpace(out)
                local up = abs(look.Y) > 0.9 and frame.LookVector or Vector3.yAxis
                place(v, CFrame.lookAt(p + look * 0.02, p + look, up))
            end
        end
    end
    -- right-click on a frequency slot sets it to the held item (LinkHandler)
    local function frequencyUse(n, offsets, scale)
        local w = world()
        local c = ctx()
        local p = RaycastParams.new()
        p.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        p.FilterDescendantsInstances = {c.character}
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(w.eye(), w.look() * (CONFIG.Reach or 4.5) * B, p)
        if not hit then return false end
        local lp = worldFrame(n):PointToObjectSpace(hit.Position) / B + Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
        for i = 1, 2 do
            if (lp - offsets[i]).Magnitude < scale / 2 + 0.03 then
                local s = held()
                local d = data(n)
                d.freq = d.freq or {}
                d.freq[i] = s and {id = s.id, count = 1} or nil
                sound("entity.item_frame.add_item", n.center, 0.25, 0.1)
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function registerLink(n, entry)
        local d = data(n)
        -- a state change rebuilds the node (its data is carried over): the entry follows the new node
        if d.link and d.link.node ~= n then
            for i = #links, 1, -1 do if links[i] == d.link then table.remove(links, i) end end
            d.link = nil
        end
        if d.link then return end
        entry.node = n
        entry.key = entry.key or function() local f = data(n).freq or {}; return freqKey(f[1], f[2]) end
        entry.pos = entry.pos or function() return linkPos(n) end
        d.link = entry
        links[#links + 1] = entry
    end
    local function dropLinks()
        for i = #links, 1, -1 do
            local l = links[i]
            if l.node and not nodes[l.node] then table.remove(links, i) end
        end
    end
    Bk.refreshTransmitters, Bk.dropLinks = refreshTransmitters, dropLinks

    -- Create's Redstone Link: transmit what powers it, or (receiver mode: sneak-click / wrench) output what it hears
    local CREATE_LINK_H, CREATE_LINK_V = Vector3.new(8, 5.5, 3.01) / 16, Vector3.new(8, 3.01, 5.5) / 16
    DEF.redstone_link = {
        useSneaking = true,
        use = function(n, sneaking)
            if sneaking or holdingWrench() then
                local receiver = n.state.receiver ~= "true"
                local st = table.clone(n.state); st.receiver = tostring(receiver)
                local keep = n.ae
                local w = world(); pcall(w.setBlockAt, n.center, n.index, st)
                local s = w.sample(n.center); if s and s.node then s.node.ae = keep end
                return true
            end
            return frequencyUse(n, slotOffsets(n, CREATE_LINK_H, CREATE_LINK_V, 0.3125), 0.4975) or nil
        end,
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            registerLink(n, {power = function()
                if n.state.receiver == "true" then return 0 end
                local p = 0
                for side in pairs(DIRV) do p = max(p, received(n, side)) end
                return p
            end})
            if n.state.receiver == "true" then
                local s = strongestFor(d.link.key(), linkPos(n))
                d.out = s
                emit(n, s, nil, {[OPP[n.state.facing or "north"]] = s})
                local powered = tostring(s > 0)
                if n.state.powered ~= powered then setState(n, "powered", powered) end
            else
                emit(n, nil, nil, nil)
                local powered = tostring(d.link.power() > 0)
                if n.state.powered ~= powered then setState(n, "powered", powered) end
            end
        end,
        render = function(n) frequencyItems(n, slotOffsets(n, CREATE_LINK_H, CREATE_LINK_V, 0.3125), 0.3) end,
    }

    -- Simulated's receivers: the signal shaped by where the transmitter is (AbstractLinkedReceiverBlockEntity)
    local RECV_H, RECV_V = Vector3.new(5, 3, 2.5) / 16, Vector3.new(11, 2.5, 3) / 16
    local function receiverTick(n, shape)
        local d = data(n)
        registerLink(n, {})
        local frame = worldFrame(n)
        local s, raw = strongestFor(d.link.key(), frame.Position, function(rel, power) return shape(frame:VectorToObjectSpace(rel), power) end)
        d.out, d.raw = s, raw
        emit(n, s, nil, {[OPP[n.state.facing or "north"]] = s})
        local powered = tostring(s > 0)
        if n.state.powered ~= powered then setState(n, "powered", powered) end
    end
    DEF.directional_linked_receiver = {
        use = function(n) return frequencyUse(n, slotOffsets(n, RECV_H, RECV_V, 0.625), 0.5) or nil end,
        tick = function(n)
            local normal = DIRV[n.state.facing or "north"]
            receiverTick(n, function(rel, power)
                local len = rel.Magnitude
                if len < 1e-6 then return power, 90 end
                local dot = rel:Dot(normal) / len
                if dot < 0 then return 0, 0 end
                local angle = math.asin(math.min(1, dot))
                return math.ceil(clamp(angle / math.pi * 2, 0, 1) * power), math.deg(angle)
            end)
        end,
        render = function(n) frequencyItems(n, slotOffsets(n, RECV_H, RECV_V, 0.625), 0.3) end,
    }
    local function modulatingScreen(n)
        local c = ctx()
        local kit = c and c.ui and c.ui.kit
        local screens = c and c.world and c.world.screens
        if not (kit and screens) then return end
        local d = data(n)
        d.minRange, d.maxRange = d.minRange or 8, d.maxRange or 64
        local KEY = "simulated:modulating_linked_receiver"
        local function offset(value) return floor(119 * (value - 1) * (20 + 256 - 1) / ((256 - 1) * (20 + value - 1)) + 0.5) end
        local wheel
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("modulating_linked_receiver", 182, 99)
            local win = screen.window
            piece(win, KEY, 0, 0, 182, 99, 0, 0, nil, nil, 3)
            local title = L("simulated.gui.modulating_linked_receiver.title", "Modulating Linked Receiver")
            JavaGui.text(win, title, floor((182 - 8) / 2) - floor(JavaGui.width(title) / 2), 4, rgb(89, 36, 36), false, 5)
            local dyn = Instance.new("Frame"); dyn.BackgroundTransparency = 1; dyn.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); dyn.ZIndex = 4; dyn.Parent = win
            local function label(x, text) JavaGui.text(dyn, text, x, 26 + 25, rgb(255, 255, 238), true, 6) end
            local drawnKey
            local function redraw()
                local key = d.minRange .. "," .. d.maxRange .. "," .. tostring(d.raw and floor(d.raw) or -1)
                if key == drawnKey then return end
                drawnKey = key
                dyn:ClearAllChildren()
                label(22, L("simulated.gui.modulating_linked_receiver.min", "Min"))
                local t = tostring(d.minRange)
                label(22 + 34 + (12 - floor(JavaGui.width(t) / 2)), t)
                label(99, L("simulated.gui.modulating_linked_receiver.max", "Max"))
                t = tostring(d.maxRange)
                label(99 + 34 + (12 - floor(JavaGui.width(t) / 2)), t)
                local minPos, maxPos = 37 + offset(d.minRange), 37 + offset(d.maxRange)
                if minPos > 37 then piece(dyn, KEY, 0, 100, minPos - 37, 16, 38, 25, nil, nil, 5) end
                if maxPos > minPos then
                    local fade = piece(dyn, KEY, minPos - 37, 100, maxPos - minPos, 16, minPos, 25, nil, nil, 5)
                    local g = Instance.new("UIGradient"); g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1); g.Parent = fade
                end
                piece(dyn, KEY, 193, 4, 3, 20, minPos, 23, nil, nil, 6)
                piece(dyn, KEY, 193, 4, 3, 20, maxPos, 23, nil, nil, 6)
                if d.raw and d.raw > 0 and d.raw < 256 then piece(dyn, KEY, 188, 4, 4, 4, 37 + offset(d.raw), 16, nil, nil, 6) end
            end
            local inputs = {{x = 55, y = 47, get = function() return d.minRange end,
                set = function(v) d.minRange = v; d.maxRange = max(d.maxRange, v) end, title = L("simulated.gui.modulating_linked_receiver.minimum_range", "Minimum Range")},
                {x = 132, y = 47, get = function() return d.maxRange end,
                set = function(v) d.maxRange = v; d.minRange = min(d.minRange, v) end, title = L("simulated.gui.modulating_linked_receiver.maximum_range", "Maximum Range")}}
            local mouse = Vector2.zero
            wheel = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then return end
                for _, inp in ipairs(inputs) do
                    if mouse.X >= inp.x and mouse.X < inp.x + 26 and mouse.Y >= inp.y and mouse.Y < inp.y + 16 then
                        local step = ((UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)) and 10 or 1) * (input.Position.Z > 0 and 1 or -1)
                        inp.set(clamp(inp.get() + step, 1, 257))
                        sound("block.note_block.hat", nil, 0.25, 1.3)
                    end
                end
            end)
            screens.install(screen)
            screens.button(screen, 182 - 33, 99 - 24, 18, 18, "", function() c.ui.toggle() end)
            piece(win, "create:icons", 0, 16, 16, 16, 182 - 33 + 1, 99 - 24 + 1, nil, nil, 7)
            screen.onTooltip = function(x, y)
                for _, inp in ipairs(inputs) do
                    if x >= inp.x and x < inp.x + 26 and y >= inp.y and y < inp.y + 16 then return {inp.title, tostring(inp.get())} end
                end
            end
            screen.onUpdate = function(x, y) mouse = Vector2.new(x, y); redraw() end
        end, function() if wheel then wheel:Disconnect() end end)
    end
    DEF.modulating_linked_receiver = {
        use = function(n)
            local _, name = held()
            if name == "linked_typewriter" then return nil end
            if frequencyUse(n, slotOffsets(n, RECV_H, RECV_V, 0.625), 0.5) then return true end
            modulatingScreen(n)
            return true
        end,
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            local minR, maxR = d.minRange or 8, d.maxRange or 64
            receiverTick(n, function(rel, power)
                local dist = rel.Magnitude
                if dist > maxR then return 0, dist end
                if minR == maxR then return power, dist end
                return math.ceil(clamp((dist - maxR) / (minR - maxR), 0, 1) * power), dist
            end)
        end,
        render = function(n) frequencyItems(n, slotOffsets(n, RECV_H, RECV_V, 0.625), 0.3) end,
    }

    -- ===== Linked Typewriter (LinkedTypewriterBlock / LinkedTypewriterInteractionHandler / LinkedTypewriterScreen) ==========
    -- Right-click with an empty hand: the keyboard types into it - every bound key transmits its frequency while held (Esc or
    -- walking away stops). Sneak + right-click: the binding screen (the keyboard; click a key to set its two frequency items
    -- from the inventory; the trash removes it, the bottom-left trash clears every key after a second click).
    local GLFW = {[32] = "Space", [39] = "Quote", [44] = "Comma", [45] = "Minus", [46] = "Period", [47] = "Slash",
        [48] = "Zero", [49] = "One", [50] = "Two", [51] = "Three", [52] = "Four", [53] = "Five", [54] = "Six", [55] = "Seven",
        [56] = "Eight", [57] = "Nine", [59] = "Semicolon", [61] = "Equals", [91] = "LeftBracket", [92] = "BackSlash",
        [93] = "RightBracket", [96] = "Backquote", [257] = "Return", [258] = "Tab", [259] = "Backspace", [261] = "Delete",
        [262] = "Right", [263] = "Left", [264] = "Down", [265] = "Up", [266] = "PageUp", [267] = "PageDown", [269] = "End",
        [280] = "CapsLock", [340] = "LeftShift", [341] = "LeftControl", [342] = "LeftAlt", [343] = "LeftSuper", [344] = "RightShift",
        [345] = "RightControl", [346] = "RightAlt", [348] = "Menu"}
    for code = 65, 90 do GLFW[code] = string.char(code) end
    local KEYNAME = {[32] = "Space", [39] = "'", [44] = ",", [45] = "-", [46] = ".", [47] = "/", [59] = ";", [61] = "=", [91] = "[",
        [92] = "\\", [93] = "]", [96] = "`", [257] = "Enter", [258] = "Tab", [259] = "Backspace", [261] = "Delete", [262] = "Right Arrow",
        [263] = "Left Arrow", [264] = "Down Arrow", [265] = "Up Arrow", [266] = "Page Up", [267] = "Page Down", [269] = "End",
        [280] = "Caps Lock", [340] = "Left Shift", [341] = "Left Control", [342] = "Left Alt", [343] = "Left Win", [344] = "Right Shift",
        [345] = "Right Control", [346] = "Right Alt", [348] = "Menu"}
    local function keyName(code) return KEYNAME[code] or (code >= 48 and code <= 57 and tostring(code - 48)) or (code >= 65 and code <= 90 and string.char(code)) or ("Key " .. code) end
    local KEYCODE_TO_GLFW = {}
    for code, name in pairs(GLFW) do local ok, kc = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[name] end); if ok and kc then KEYCODE_TO_GLFW[kc] = code end end
    local PRESET = {[81] = 0, [87] = 1, [69] = 2, [65] = 6, [83] = 7, [68] = 8, [32] = 13}
    local typing
    local function keyIndex(code) return PRESET[code] or (code * 7919) % 13 end
    local function typewriterScreen(n)
        local c = ctx()
        local kit = c and c.ui and c.ui.kit
        local screens = c and c.world and c.world.screens
        if not (kit and screens) then return end
        local d = data(n)
        d.keys = d.keys or {}
        local entries = {}
        for k, v in pairs(d.keys) do entries[k] = {v[1], v[2]} end
        local MAIN = "simulated:linked_typewriter/linked_typewriter"
        local ROWS = {
            {{14, 96}, {14, 49}, {14, 50}, {14, 51}, {14, 52}, {14, 53}, {14, 54}, {14, 55}, {14, 56}, {14, 57}, {14, 48}, {14, 45}, {14, 61}, {26, 259}, {14, 261}},
            {{20, 258}, {14, 81}, {14, 87}, {14, 69}, {14, 82}, {14, 84}, {14, 89}, {14, 85}, {14, 73}, {14, 79}, {14, 80}, {14, 91}, {14, 93}, {20, 92}, {14, 266}},
            {{26, 280}, {14, 65}, {14, 83}, {14, 68}, {14, 70}, {14, 71}, {14, 72}, {14, 74}, {14, 75}, {14, 76}, {14, 59}, {14, 39}, {28, 257}, {14, 267}},
            {{32, 340}, {14, 90}, {14, 88}, {14, 67}, {14, 86}, {14, 66}, {14, 78}, {14, 77}, {14, 44}, {14, 46}, {14, 47}, {22, 344}, {14, 265, {0, 32}}, {14, 269}},
            {{18, 341}, {14, 343}, {14, 342}, {88, 32}, {14, 346}, {14, 348}, {18, 345}, {14, 263, {16, 32}}, {14, 264, {32, 32}}, {14, 262, {48, 32}}}}
        local modifying
        local confirmReset = false
        local keyConn
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("linked_typewriter", 246, 127)
            local win = screen.window
            piece(win, MAIN, 0, 0, 246, 127, 0, 0, nil, nil, 3)
            local layer = Instance.new("Frame"); layer.BackgroundTransparency = 1; layer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); layer.ZIndex = 4; layer.Parent = win
            local function draw()
                layer:ClearAllChildren()
                if modifying then
                    local dim = Instance.new("Frame")
                    dim.BackgroundColor3, dim.BackgroundTransparency, dim.BorderSizePixel = rgb(16, 16, 16), 0.3, 0
                    dim.Position, dim.Size, dim.ZIndex = UDim2.fromOffset(-1000, -1000), UDim2.fromOffset(3000, 3000), 9
                    dim.Parent = layer
                    local cx, cy = 11, -31
                    piece(layer, MAIN, 0, 145, 214, 80, cx, cy, nil, nil, 10)
                    piece(layer, "create:player_inventory", 0, 0, 176, 108, cx + 19, cy + 72, nil, nil, 10)
                    JavaGui.text(layer, L("container.inventory", "Inventory"), cx + 19 + 8, cy + 72 + 6, rgb(64, 64, 64), false, 11)
                    local prompt = modifying.code == -1 and L("simulated.linked_typewriter.bind_new_key", "Bind new key")
                        or (modifying.binding and L("simulated.linked_typewriter.bind_screen_prompt", "Press key...") or keyName(modifying.code))
                    JavaGui.text(layer, prompt, cx + 19 + 3, cy + 32 + 4, rgb(255, 255, 255), true, 11)
                    for i = 1, 2 do
                        local v = JavaGui.itemView(layer, 105 + (i - 1) * 18, 1, 12)
                        v.set(modifying.f[i])
                    end
                    piece(layer, "create:widgets", 0, 0, 18, 18, cx + 214 - 56, cy + 31, nil, nil, 11)
                    piece(layer, "create:icons", 0, 16, 16, 16, cx + 214 - 56 + 1, cy + 32, nil, nil, 12)
                    piece(layer, "create:widgets", 0, 0, 18, 18, cx + 214 - 33, cy + 31, nil, nil, 11)
                    piece(layer, "create:icons", 16, 0, 16, 16, cx + 214 - 33 + 1, cy + 32, nil, nil, 12)
                    return
                end
                local title = L("block.simulated.linked_typewriter", "Linked Typewriter")
                JavaGui.text(layer, title, floor(246 / 2) - floor(JavaGui.width(title) / 2), 4, rgb(89, 36, 36), false, 5)
                for r, row in ipairs(ROWS) do
                    local x, y = 8, 21 + (r - 1) * 14
                    for _, key in ipairs(row) do
                        local w, code, icon = key[1], key[2], key[3]
                        local bound = entries[code] ~= nil
                        local hover = screen.mouse and screen.mouse.X >= x and screen.mouse.X < x + w and screen.mouse.Y >= y and screen.mouse.Y < y + 14
                        local yy = y + (hover and 2 or 0)
                        local u = bound and 60 or 73
                        piece(layer, MAIN, u, 127, 6, 14, x, yy, nil, nil, 5)
                        if w > 12 then piece(layer, MAIN, u + 6, 127, 2, 14, x + 6, yy, w - 12, 14, 5) end
                        piece(layer, MAIN, u + 8, 127, 6, 14, x + w - 6, yy, nil, nil, 5)
                        if icon then
                            local img = piece(layer, "simulated:icons", icon[1], icon[2], 16, 16, x + 3, yy + 4, 8, 8, 6)
                            img.ImageColor3 = bound and Color3.new(0.447, 0.278, 0.192) or Color3.new(0.318, 0.125, 0.094)
                        end
                        x = x + w
                    end
                end
                piece(layer, "create:widgets", 0, 0, 18, 18, 8, 127 - 24, nil, nil, 5)
                piece(layer, "create:icons", 16, 0, 16, 16, 9, 127 - 23, nil, nil, 6)
                piece(layer, "create:widgets", 0, 0, 18, 18, 246 - 33, 127 - 24, nil, nil, 5)
                piece(layer, "create:icons", 0, 16, 16, 16, 246 - 32, 127 - 23, nil, nil, 6)
                piece(layer, "create:widgets", 0, 0, 18, 18, 246 - 62, 127 - 24, nil, nil, 5)
                piece(layer, "simulated:icons", 16, 16, 16, 16, 246 - 61, 127 - 23, nil, nil, 6)
                if confirmReset then
                    JavaGui.text(layer, L("simulated.linked_typewriter.confirm_delete_all", "Click again to confirm."), 30, 127 - 19, rgb(255, 85, 85), true, 6)
                end
            end
            local function keyAt(mx, my)
                for r, row in ipairs(ROWS) do
                    local x, y = 8, 21 + (r - 1) * 14
                    for _, key in ipairs(row) do
                        if mx >= x and mx < x + key[1] and my >= y and my < y + 14 then return key[2] end
                        x = x + key[1]
                    end
                end
            end
