            screens.install(screen)
            local lastKey
            screen.onClick = function(button, mx, my)
                if button ~= 1 then return false end
                if modifying then
                    local cx, cy = 11, -31
                    for i = 1, 2 do
                        local sx = 105 + (i - 1) * 18
                        if mx >= sx and mx < sx + 16 and my >= 1 and my < 17 then
                            local cur = c.inventory.cursor
                            modifying.f[i] = cur and {id = cur.id, count = 1} or nil
                            draw(); return true
                        end
                    end
                    if mx >= cx + 19 and mx < cx + 87 and my >= cy + 32 and my < cy + 48 then modifying.binding = not modifying.binding; draw(); return true end
                    if mx >= cx + 158 and mx < cx + 176 and my >= cy + 31 and my < cy + 49 then
                        if modifying.code ~= -1 then entries[modifying.code] = {modifying.f[1], modifying.f[2]} end
                        modifying = nil; draw(); return true
                    end
                    if mx >= cx + 181 and mx < cx + 199 and my >= cy + 31 and my < cy + 49 then modifying = nil; draw(); return true end
                    return false
                end
                local code = keyAt(mx, my)
                if code then
                    local e = entries[code]
                    entries[code] = nil
                    modifying = {code = code, f = {e and e[1], e and e[2]}}
                    sound("ui.button.click", nil, 0.25, 1)
                    draw(); return true
                end
                if mx >= 8 and mx < 26 and my >= 103 and my < 121 then
                    if confirmReset then entries = {}; confirmReset = false else confirmReset = true end
                    draw(); return true
                end
                if mx >= 213 and mx < 231 and my >= 103 and my < 121 then c.ui.toggle(); return true end
                if confirmReset then confirmReset = false; draw() end
                return false
            end
            keyConn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if modifying and modifying.binding and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                    local code = KEYCODE_TO_GLFW[input.KeyCode]
                    if code then modifying.code = code; modifying.binding = false; draw() end
                end
            end)
            screen.onUpdate = function(mx, my)
                screen.mouse = Vector2.new(mx, my)
                local k = modifying and "m" or tostring(keyAt(mx, my))
                if k ~= lastKey then lastKey = k; draw() end
            end
            screen.onTooltip = function(mx, my)
                if modifying then return nil end
                local code = keyAt(mx, my)
                if not code then return nil end
                local e = entries[code]
                local function nm(s) return s and Recipes.name(s) or "-" end
                return {keyName(code), nm(e and e[1]) .. " + " .. nm(e and e[2])}
            end
            draw()
        end, function()
            if keyConn then keyConn:Disconnect() end
            if modifying and modifying.code ~= -1 then entries[modifying.code] = {modifying.f[1], modifying.f[2]} end
            d.keys = entries
            d.keyLinks = nil
        end)
    end
    local function stopTyping()
        if not typing then return end
        pcall(function() game:GetService("ContextActionService"):UnbindAction("AeroTypewriter") end)
        local n = typing.node
        typing = nil
        local d = data(n)
        d.pressed = {}
        d.user = false
        local w = world()
        if w and w.chat and w.chat.showTitle then pcall(w.chat.showTitle, "actionbar", {{text = (L("simulated.linked_typewriter.stop_controlling", "Stopped controlling %s"):gsub("%%s", L("block.simulated.linked_typewriter", "Linked Typewriter"))), color = rgb(255, 255, 255)}}) end
    end
    local function startTyping(n)
        local d = data(n)
        d.keys = d.keys or {}
        d.pressed = {}
        d.user = true
        typing = {node = n}
        local codes = {}
        for kc, code in pairs(KEYCODE_TO_GLFW) do if d.keys[code] then codes[#codes + 1] = kc end end
        codes[#codes + 1] = Enum.KeyCode.Escape
        game:GetService("ContextActionService"):BindActionAtPriority("AeroTypewriter", function(_, state, input)
            if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then stopTyping() end return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
            local code = KEYCODE_TO_GLFW[input.KeyCode]
            if not code or not typing then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
            local td = data(typing.node)
            if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
                td.pressed[code] = true
                sound("block.wooden_button.click_on", typing.node.center, 0.4, 1.6)
            elseif state == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                td.pressed[code] = nil
                sound("block.wooden_button.click_off", typing.node.center, 0.4, 1.4)
            end
            return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
        end, false, Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value + 200, table.unpack(codes))
        local w = world()
        if w and w.chat and w.chat.showTitle then pcall(w.chat.showTitle, "actionbar", {{text = (L("simulated.linked_typewriter.start_controlling", "Now controlling %s"):gsub("%%s", L("block.simulated.linked_typewriter", "Linked Typewriter"))), color = rgb(255, 255, 255)}}) end
    end
    Bk.stopTyping = stopTyping
    DEF.linked_typewriter = {
        useSneaking = true,
        use = function(n, sneaking)
            if held() then return nil end
            if sneaking then stopTyping(); typewriterScreen(n); return true end
            if typing and typing.node == n then stopTyping() else stopTyping(); startTyping(n) end
            return true
        end,
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            d.keys = d.keys or {}
            d.pressed = d.pressed or {}
            -- one link entry per bound key: its frequency transmits 15 while the key is held
            if d.keyLinksNode ~= n then d.keyLinks = nil; d.keyLinksNode = n end
            if not d.keyLinks then
                for i = #links, 1, -1 do if links[i].typewriter and links[i].data == d then table.remove(links, i) end end
                d.keyLinks = {}
                for code in pairs(d.keys) do
                    local entry = {node = n, typewriter = true, data = d,
                        key = function() local e = d.keys[code]; return e and freqKey(e[1], e[2]) or "" end,
                        pos = function() return linkPos(n) end,
                        power = function() return (d.keys[code] and d.pressed[code]) and 15 or 0 end}
                    d.keyLinks[code] = entry
                    links[#links + 1] = entry
                end
            end
            n.comparatorStrength = d.user and 15 or 0
            if typing and typing.node == n then
                local c = ctx()
                if not c.root or (c.root.Position - worldFrame(n).Position).Magnitude > B * 8 or (c.ui and c.ui.open) then stopTyping() end
            end
        end,
        render = function(n, dt)
            local d = data(n)
            d.keyAnim = d.keyAnim or {}
            local down = {}
            for code in pairs(d.pressed or {}) do down[keyIndex(code)] = true end
            -- LinkedTypewriterRenderer: six keys, seven keys and the space bar
            local corner = worldFrame(n) * CFrame.new(-0.5 * B, -0.5 * B, -0.5 * B)
            local base = corner * CFrame.new(0.5 * B, 0.25 * B, 0.5 * B) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(HANGLE[n.state.facing or "north"]), 0)
                * CFrame.new(-0.4375 * B, 0.0625 * B, 0.125 * B)
            local function key(i, frame, spacebar)
                d.keyAnim[i] = (d.keyAnim[i] or 0) + ((down[i] and 1 or 0) - (d.keyAnim[i] or 0)) * min(1, dt * 20 * 0.4)
                local f = frame * CFrame.new(0, -0.046875 * B * d.keyAnim[i], 0) * CFrame.new(0.5 * B, 0.5 * B, 0.5 * B)
                visuals[n] = visuals[n] or {}
                local vk = "key" .. i
                local v = visuals[n][vk]
                if v == nil then
                    local k = K()
                    v = k and k.partialVisual and k.partialVisual(spacebar and "simulated:linked_typewriter/key_spacebar" or "simulated:linked_typewriter/key", n.center) or false
                    visuals[n][vk] = v
                end
                place(v or nil, f)
            end
            local f = base
            for i = 0, 5 do f = f * CFrame.new(0.125 * B, 0, 0); key(i, f) end
            local row2 = base * CFrame.new(-0.0625 * B, -0.0625 * B, 0.125 * B)
            f = row2
            for i = 6, 12 do f = f * CFrame.new(0.125 * B, 0, 0); key(i, f) end
            key(13, row2 * CFrame.new(0.5 * B, -0.0625 * B, 0.125 * B), true)
        end,
    }


    -- ===== Nameplates (NameplateBlock / NameplateBlockEntity / NameplateScreen / NameplateRenderer) ==========================
    -- A row of same-coloured plates facing the same way shares one name, kept by its left plate (the controller) and drawn
    -- across the row. Right-click opens "Edit Name" (the plate and the text, 122 px at most). Dye sets the text colour, glow
    -- ink makes it glow, an ink sac takes the glow off, honeycomb waxes it (no more editing).
    local DYE_RGB = {white = 0xF9FFFE, orange = 0xF9801D, magenta = 0xC74EBD, light_blue = 0x3AB3DA, yellow = 0xFED83D, lime = 0x80C71F,
        pink = 0xF38BAA, gray = 0x474F52, light_gray = 0x9D9D97, cyan = 0x169C9C, purple = 0x8932B8, blue = 0x3C44AA, brown = 0x835432,
        green = 0x5E7C16, red = 0xB02E26, black = 0x1D1D21}
    local TEXT_RGB = {white = 0xFFFFFF, orange = 0xFF681F, magenta = 0xFF00FF, light_blue = 0x9AC0CD, yellow = 0xFFFF00, lime = 0xBFFF00,
        pink = 0xFF69B4, gray = 0x808080, light_gray = 0xD3D3D3, cyan = 0x00FFFF, purple = 0xA020F0, blue = 0x0000FF, brown = 0x8B4513,
        green = 0x00FF00, red = 0xFF0000, black = 0x000000}
    local function hex(n) return rgb(floor(n / 65536) % 256, floor(n / 256) % 256, n % 256) end
    local function plateColor(n) return n.id:match("^(.-)_nameplate$") end
    -- the row: same plates with the same facing along the axis across the facing
    local function plateRow(n)
        local w = world()
        local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
        local across = DIRV[CW[facing]]
        local row = {n}
        for _, sgn in ipairs({1, -1}) do
            local c = n.center
            for _ = 1, 32 do
                c = c + across * B * sgn
                local s = w.sample(c)
                local m = s and s.node
                if not (m and m.id == n.id and m.state.facing == facing) then break end
                if sgn > 0 then table.insert(row, m) else table.insert(row, 1, m) end
            end
        end
        return row
    end
    local function plateController(n)
        local row = plateRow(n)
        local ctrl = row[1]
        for _, m in ipairs(row) do if m.state.position == "left" or m.state.position == "single" then ctrl = m; break end end
        return ctrl, row
    end
    local function nameplateScreen(n)
        local c = ctx()
        local kit = c and c.ui and c.ui.kit
        local screens = c and c.world and c.world.screens
        if not (kit and screens) then return end
        local ctrl = plateController(n)
        local d = data(ctrl)
        local color = plateColor(n)
        local entry = JavaContent.byId[n.id]
        local tex = entry and JavaContent.data.textures[entry.particle]
        local textColor = d.color or "black"
        local function darkColor()
            local v = TEXT_RGB[textColor] or 0
            if textColor == "black" and d.glowing then return hex(0xF0EBCC) end
            return rgb(floor((floor(v / 65536) % 256) * 0.4), floor((floor(v / 256) % 256) * 0.4), floor((v % 256) * 0.4))
        end
        local message = d.name or ""
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("nameplate", 200, 200)
            local win = screen.window
            local title = L("simulated.nameplate.edit", "Edit Name")
            JavaGui.text(win, title, 100 - floor(JavaGui.width(title) / 2), 0, rgb(255, 255, 255), true, 4)
            -- the plate: eight 16 x 10 strips of the plate texture at 2.5x (renderSignBackground)
            local content = tex and JavaGui.content(tex)
            local k = tex and tex.w / 32 or 1
            local sx, sy = 2.5, 2.5
            for i = 0, 7 do
                local u = i == 0 and 0 or (i == 7 and 16 or 8)
                local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                img.BackgroundTransparency, img.ResampleMode, img.ZIndex = 1, Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated, 3
                if content then img.ImageContent = content; img.ImageRectOffset, img.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(u * k, 12 * k), Vector2.new(16 * k, 10 * k) end
                img.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(100 + floor((-56 + i * 16 - 8) * sx), 74 + floor((5.7 - 8) * sy))
                img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(floor(16 * sx), floor(10 * sy))
                img.Parent = win
            end
            local drawn
            local field = screens.textField(screen, 100 - 61 * 2, 74 - 8, 244, 20, {text = message, maxLength = 64,
                onChange = function(t)
                    while JavaGui.width(t) > 122 do t = t:sub(1, -2) end
                    message = t
                end})
            field.draw = function()
                local caret = field.box:IsFocused() and os.clock() % 0.6 < 0.3
                local key = message .. tostring(caret)
                if drawn and drawn:GetAttribute("Key") == key then return end
                if drawn then drawn:Destroy() end
                -- the text at 2x, centred on the plate
                drawn = Instance.new("Frame")
                drawn.BackgroundTransparency, drawn.ZIndex = 1, 8
                local sc = Instance.new("UIScale"); sc.Scale = 2; sc.Parent = drawn
                local w = JavaGui.width(message)
                drawn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(100 - w, 74 - 8)
                drawn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w + 8, 9)
                JavaGui.text(drawn, message .. (caret and "_" or ""), 0, 0, darkColor(), false, 8)
                drawn:SetAttribute("Key", key)
                drawn.Parent = win
            end
            screens.button(screen, 0, 200 - 30, 200, 20, L("gui.done", "Done"), function() c.ui.toggle() end)
            screens.install(screen)
            task.defer(function() field.focus() end)
        end, function()
            d.name = message
        end)
    end
    local NAMEPLATE = {
        use = function(n)
            local ctrl = plateController(n)
            local d = data(ctrl)
            local _, name = held()
            if name then
                local dye = name:match("^(.-)_dye$")
                if (dye or name == "glow_ink_sac" or name == "ink_sac" or name == "honeycomb") and d.waxed then
                    sound("block.sign.waxed_interact_fail", n.center, 1, 1); return true
                end
                if dye and TEXT_RGB[dye] then d.color = dye; sound("item.dye.use", n.center, 1, 1); return true end
                if name == "glow_ink_sac" then d.glowing = true; sound("item.glow_ink_sac.use", n.center, 1, 1); return true end
                if name == "ink_sac" then d.glowing = false; sound("item.ink_sac.use", n.center, 1, 1); return true end
                if name == "honeycomb" then d.waxed = true; sound("item.honeycomb.wax_on", n.center, 1, 1); return true end
            end
            if d.waxed then sound("block.sign.waxed_interact_fail", n.center, 1, 1); return true end
            nameplateScreen(n)
            return true
        end,
        render = function(n)
            if not (n.state.position == "left" or n.state.position == "single") then return end
            local d = data(n)
            local row = plateRow(n)
            local name = d.name or ""
            visuals[n] = visuals[n] or {}
            local key = name .. "|" .. #row .. "|" .. tostring(d.color) .. tostring(d.glowing)
            local v = visuals[n].text
            if v and v.key ~= key then pcall(function() v.model:Destroy() end); v = nil; visuals[n].text = nil end
            if name ~= "" and not v then
                -- 6 px tall text across the row (7 font units = 6 / 16 block)
                local avail = (#row * 16 - 6) * 7 / 6 + 1
                local part = Instance.new("Part")
                part.Name, part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.Transparency = "NameplateText", true, false, false, false, 1
                local unit = B * (6 / 16) / 7
                part.Size = Vector3.new(avail * unit, 9 * unit, 0.02)
                local sg = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
                sg.Face, sg.SizingMode, sg.CanvasSize, sg.LightInfluence = Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize, Vector2.new(avail, 9), d.glowing and 0 or 1
                sg.Parent = part
                local textColor = d.color or "black"
                local base = TEXT_RGB[textColor] or 0
                local col
                if d.glowing then col = hex(base) else col = rgb(floor((floor(base / 65536) % 256) * 0.4), floor((floor(base / 256) % 256) * 0.4), floor((base % 256) * 0.4)) end
                local trimmed = name
                while JavaGui.width(trimmed) > avail and #trimmed > 0 do trimmed = trimmed:sub(1, -2) end
                local w = JavaGui.width(trimmed)
                pcall(JavaGui.text, sg, trimmed, floor((avail - 1) / 2 - w / 2), 1, col, false, 2)
                part.Parent = workspace
                v = {model = part, key = key, parts = {{part, CFrame.identity}}}
                visuals[n].text = v
            end
            if v then
                -- centred on the row, on the plates' front (z 12 / 16, facing out)
                local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
                local mid = Vector3.zero
                for _, m in ipairs(row) do mid = mid + m.center end
                mid = mid / #row
                local frame = worldFrame(n)
                local out = frame:VectorToWorldSpace(DIRV[facing])
                local pos = frame.Position + (mid - n.center) - out * (0.25 * B - 0.01)
                place(v, CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos - out, Vector3.yAxis) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0))
            end
        end,
    }
    for c in pairs(TEXT_RGB) do DEF[c .. "_nameplate"] = NAMEPLATE end

    -- ===== Lasers (LaserPointerBlockEntity / LaserSensorBlockEntity / OpticalSensorBlockEntity) ==============================
    local SENSOR_FACE = function(m)
        if m.state.target == "ceiling" then return "up" elseif m.state.target == "floor" then return "down" end
        return m.state.facing or "north"
    end
    -- a ray from the block's face along dir, at most range blocks: the hit (position, node, normal) or nil
    local function laserCast(n, dir, range)
        local frame = worldFrame(n)
        local d = frame:VectorToWorldSpace(DIRV[dir])
        local start = frame.Position + d * 0.5 * B
        local p = RaycastParams.new()
        p.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local c = ctx()
        local ex = {c and c.character}
        if visuals[n] then for _, v in pairs(visuals[n]) do if v and v.model then ex[#ex + 1] = v.model end end end
        p.FilterDescendantsInstances = ex
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(start + d * 0.01, d * range * B, p)
        if not hit then return start, start + d * range * B, nil end
        local center = hit.Instance:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter")
        local w = world()
        local s = center and w and w.sample(center)
        return start, hit.Position, s and s.node, hit.Normal, hit
    end
    local function beam(n, key, a, b, color, width, transparency)
        visuals[n] = visuals[n] or {}
        local v = visuals[n][key]
        if not v then
            local part = Instance.new("Part")
            part.Name, part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.CastShadow = "Laser", true, false, false, false, false
            part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            part.Parent = workspace
            v = {model = part, parts = {{part, CFrame.identity}}}
            visuals[n][key] = v
        end
        local part = v.model
        local len = (b - a).Magnitude
        if len < 0.01 then part.Transparency = 1; return end
        part.Color, part.Transparency = color, transparency
        part.Size = Vector3.new(width, width, len)
        place(v, CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b))
    end
    local function hideBeam(n, key) local v = visuals[n] and visuals[n][key]; if v then v.model.Transparency = 1 end end
    DEF.laser_pointer = {
        use = function(n)
            local s, name = held()
            if not name then return nil end
            local d = data(n)
            local dye = name:match("^(.-)_dye$")
            local changed = false
            if dye and TEXT_RGB[dye] then
                local col = TEXT_RGB[dye]
                if d.color ~= col or d.rainbow then d.color = col; changed = true end
            elseif name == "amethyst_shard" then
                if d.color ~= nil or d.rainbow then d.color = nil; d.rainbow = false; changed = true end
            elseif name == "prismarine_crystals" then
                if not d.rainbow then d.rainbow = true; changed = true end
            end
            if changed then sound("item.dye.use", n.center, 0.3, 1); return true end
            return nil
        end,
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            local best = 0
            for side in pairs(DIRV) do best = max(best, received(n, side)) end
            local powered = tostring(best > 0)
            if n.state.powered ~= powered then setState(n, "powered", powered) end
            d.power = n.state.inverted == "true" and 15 - best or best
            local range = d.range or 100
            d.hitNode = nil
            if d.power > 0 then
                local a, b, hitNode, normal = laserCast(n, n.state.facing or "north", range)
                d.a, d.b = a, b
                -- a laser sensor hit on its face hears the pointer's power
                if hitNode and hitNode.id == "laser_sensor" then
                    local face = worldFrame(hitNode):VectorToWorldSpace(DIRV[SENSOR_FACE(hitNode)])
                    if normal and face:Dot(normal) > 0.9 then
                        local sd = data(hitNode)
                        sd.tracked = max(sd.tracked or 0, d.power)
                    end
                end
            end
        end,
        render = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            local col = d.color and hex(d.color) or rgb(188, 118, 255)
            if d.rainbow then col = Color3.fromHSV((os.clock() / 5) % 1, 0.6, 1) end
            local on = (d.power or 0) > 0
            local frame = worldFrame(n)
            local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
            -- rotateToFace: the lens turned to the facing
            local rot = facing == "up" and CFrame.Angles(math.pi / 2, 0, 0) or facing == "down" and CFrame.Angles(-math.pi / 2, 0, 0)
                or CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad((YROT[facing] or 0) + 180), 0)
            local lens = partial(n, on and "simulated:laser_pointer/lens_on" or "simulated:laser_pointer/lens_off")
            local other = partial(n, on and "simulated:laser_pointer/lens_off" or "simulated:laser_pointer/lens_on")
            if other then for _, pr in ipairs(other.parts or {}) do pr[1].Transparency = 1 end end
            if lens then for _, pr in ipairs(lens.parts or {}) do pr[1].Transparency = 0 end; place(lens, frame * rot); if d.tintCol ~= col then d.tintCol = col; tint(lens, col) end end
            if on and d.a then beam(n, "beam", d.a, d.b, col, 0.48 / 16 * B * 0.6, 1 - math.clamp((d.power or 0) / 60 + 0.45, 0, 0.8))
            else hideBeam(n, "beam") end
        end,
    }
    DEF.laser_sensor = {
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            d.current = d.current or 0
            local nextPower = d.next or 0
            d.cool = max(0, (d.cool or 0) - 1)
            if d.current ~= nextPower then
                if (d.current == 0) == (nextPower == 0) or d.cool <= 0 then
                    d.current = nextPower
                    d.cool = 3
                    local powered = tostring(d.current > 0)
                    if n.state.powered ~= powered then setState(n, "powered", powered) end
                end
            end
            d.next = d.tracked or 0
            d.tracked = 0
            emit(n, d.current, nil, nil)
        end,
    }
    DEF.optical_sensor = {
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            local range = d.range or 15
            local a, b, hitNode = laserCast(n, SENSOR_FACE(n), range)
            local dist = hitNode and (b - a).Magnitude / B or range
            d.a, d.b = a, b
            local passed = hitNode ~= nil
            if passed and d.filter then
                local e = JavaContent.byIndex[d.filter.id]
                passed = e and (e.id == hitNode.id or e.itemId == hitNode.id)
            end
            local power = passed and floor((range - dist) * (15 / range) + 0.5) or 0
            d.power = power
            local powered = tostring(power > 0)
            if n.state.powered ~= powered then setState(n, "powered", powered) end
            local face = SENSOR_FACE(n)
            local dirs = {}
            for side in pairs(DIRV) do if side ~= face then dirs[side] = power end end
            emit(n, nil, dirs, nil)
        end,
        render = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            if d.a then beam(n, "beam", d.a, d.b, rgb(255, 80, 80), 0.02 * B, 0.85) end
        end,
    }

    -- ===== Aeronautics: envelopes, burners, steam vents ======================================================================
    --  * Envelope (EnvelopeBlock.applyDye): dye recolours the envelope; on one already that colour it recolours the touching
    --    envelopes, and when none change, the whole connected envelope (125 steps).
    --  * Hot Air Burner: a coal block makes it burn fire, soul sand / soil soul fire; its value box sets the hot air
    --    (5..500 m³, the board in 5 m³ steps); the output is that x signal / 15.
    --  * Steam Vent: a golden / iron sheet changes its trim; the steam amount 50..5000 m³.
    local COLOURS16 = {"white", "orange", "magenta", "light_blue", "yellow", "lime", "pink", "gray", "light_gray", "cyan", "purple",
        "blue", "brown", "green", "red", "black"}
    local function envelopeColor(id)
        local c = id:match("^(.-)_envelope$")
        if c then return c, false end
        c = id:match("^(.-)_envelope_encased_shaft$")
        if c then return c, true end
        if id == "envelope" then return "white", false end
    end
    local function recolor(n, color)
        local c, encased = envelopeColor(n.id)
        if not c or c == color then return false end
        local e = JavaContent.byId[color .. (encased and "_envelope_encased_shaft" or "_envelope")]
        if not e then return false end
        local w = world()
        pcall(w.setBlockAt, n.center, e.index, encased and {axis = n.state.axis or "y"} or table.clone(e.state or {}))
        return true
    end
    local function envelopeDye(n, color)
        if recolor(n, color) then return end
        local w = world()
        local changed = false
        for _, d in pairs(DIRV) do
            local s = w.sample(n.center + d * B)
            if s and s.node and recolor(s.node, color) then changed = true end
        end
        if changed then return end
        -- the whole envelope it belongs to
        local frontier, visited, budget = {n.center}, {}, 125
        while #frontier > 0 and budget > 0 do
            budget = budget - 1
            local c = table.remove(frontier, 1)
            for _, d in pairs(DIRV) do
                local p = c + d * B
                local key = string.format("%d,%d,%d", floor(p.X + 0.5), floor(p.Y + 0.5), floor(p.Z + 0.5))
                if not visited[key] then
                    visited[key] = true
                    local s = w.sample(p)
                    local m = s and s.node
                    if m and envelopeColor(m.id) then
                        recolor(m, color)
                        frontier[#frontier + 1] = p
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local ENVELOPE = {use = function(n)
        local _, name = held()
        local dye = name and name:match("^(.-)_dye$")
        if not dye then return nil end
        envelopeDye(n, dye)
        sound("item.dye.use", n.center, 1, 1.1 - math.random() * 0.2)
        return true
    end}
    for _, c in ipairs(COLOURS16) do DEF[c .. "_envelope"] = ENVELOPE; DEF[c .. "_envelope_encased_shaft"] = ENVELOPE end
    DEF.envelope = ENVELOPE

    local function gasValues(n, side, kind)
        if side == "up" then return nil end
        local d = data(n)
        local maxV = kind == "steam" and 5000 or 500
        local minV = kind == "steam" and 50 or 5
        local interval = math.max(1, floor((maxV - minV + 250) / 500) * 5)
        local offset
        if side == "down" then offset = Vector3.new(0.5, 0, 0.5)
        else offset = rotY(Vector3.new(8, 5, 15.75) / 16, HANGLE[side]) end
        return {offset = offset, normal = DIRV[side], scale = 0.45,
            title = L(kind == "steam" and "aeronautics.scroll_option.steam_amount" or "aeronautics.scroll_option.hot_air_amount", kind == "steam" and "Steam Amount" or "Hot Air Amount"),
            rows = {L("aeronautics.generic.hot_air", "Hot Air")}, max = floor(maxV / interval), milestone = 10,
            format = function(_, v) return (L("aeronautics.unit.meter_cubed", "%s m³"):gsub("%%s", tostring(clamp(v * interval, minV, maxV)))) end,
            get = function() return 0, floor((d.hotAir or maxV) / interval) end,
            set = function(_, v) d.hotAir = clamp(v * interval, minV, maxV) end,
            value = function() return (L("aeronautics.unit.meter_cubed", "%s m³"):gsub("%%s", tostring(d.hotAir or maxV))) end}
    end
    DEF.adjustable_burner = {
        use = function(n)
            local _, name = held()
            if not name then return nil end
            local variant = (name == "coal_block") and "fire" or ((name == "soul_sand" or name == "soul_soil") and "soulful") or nil
            if variant and n.state.variant ~= variant then
                setState(n, "variant", variant)
                sound(variant == "fire" and "block.netherrack.place" or "block.soul_sand.place", n.center, 1, 1)
                return true
            end
            return nil
        end,
        values = function(n, side) return gasValues(n, side, "burner") end,
    }
    DEF.steam_vent = {
        use = function(n)
            local _, name = held()
            if not name then return nil end
            local variant = (name == "golden_sheet") and "gold" or (name == "iron_sheet" and "iron") or nil
            if variant and n.state.variant ~= variant then
                setState(n, "variant", variant)
                sound("block.copper.place", n.center, 1, 1)
                return true
            end
            return nil
        end,
        values = function(n, side) return gasValues(n, side, "steam") end,
    }

    -- ===== Potato cannons (Create's PotatoCannonItem / PotatoProjectileEntity, Aeronautics' MountedPotatoCannonBlockEntity) ===
    local projectiles = {}
    local function potatoType(stackId)
        local cr = JavaContent.mods.byId.create
        local types = cr and cr.catalog and cr.catalog.potatoTypes
        local e = JavaContent.byIndex[stackId]
        local id = e and (e.itemId or e.id)
        if not (types and id) then return nil end
        for _, t in ipairs(types) do
            for _, it in ipairs(t.items or {}) do if it == id then return t end end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function launch(stack, pos, motion, t, mult, fromPlayer)
        local e = JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Name, part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.Transparency = "PotatoProjectile", true, false, false, false, 1
        part.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.02) * B
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Size, bb.AlwaysOnTop, bb.LightInfluence = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), false, 1
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0.5 * B, 0, 0.5 * B, 0)
        bb.Parent = part
        local f = Instance.new("Frame"); f.BackgroundTransparency = 1; f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); f.Parent = bb
        pcall(JavaContent.icon, f, stack.id)
        part.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
        part.Parent = workspace
        projectiles[#projectiles + 1] = {part = part, pos = pos, motion = motion, t = t or {damage = 0, knockback = 1, drag = 0.99, gravity = 1},
            stack = {id = stack.id, count = 1}, mult = mult or 1, life = 0, fromPlayer = fromPlayer}
    end
    local function projectileTick()
        local w = world()
        local gameplay = w and w.gameplay
        local mobsApi = gameplay and gameplay.mobsModule
        local c = ctx()
        for i = #projectiles, 1, -1 do
            local p = projectiles[i]
            p.life = p.life + 1
            local nextPos = p.pos + p.motion * B
            local params = RaycastParams.new()
            params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {p.part, p.fromPlayer and c and c.character or nil}
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(p.pos, nextPos - p.pos, params)
            local done = false
            -- mobs along the way
            if mobsApi and gameplay.mobs then
                for _, m in ipairs(gameplay.mobs) do
                    if m.position and (m.position - nextPos).Magnitude < 0.9 * B then
                        pcall(mobsApi.hurt, m, (p.t.damage or 0) * p.mult, {kind = "potato"})
                        if m.velocity then m.velocity = m.velocity + p.motion.Unit * (p.t.knockback or 1) * 0.3 * B + Vector3.new(0, 0.1 * B, 0) end
                        done = true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if not done and hit then
                -- on_block_hit: plant a crop on farmland
                if p.t.onBlock == "create:plant_crop" and p.t.block ~= "" then
                    local s = w.sample(hit.Instance:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter") or hit.Position)
                    local below = s and s.node
                    if below and below.id == "farmland" and hit.Normal.Y > 0.5 then
                        local crop = JavaContent.byId[p.t.block:gsub("^minecraft:", "")]
                        if crop then pcall(w.setBlockAt, below.center + Vector3.new(0, B, 0), crop.index, table.clone(crop.state or {})) end
                    end
                end
                done = true
            end
            if done or p.life > 200 then
                p.part:Destroy()
                table.remove(projectiles, i)
            else
                p.pos = nextPos
                p.motion = p.motion * (p.t.drag or 0.99) - Vector3.new(0, 0.05 * (p.t.gravity or 1), 0)
                p.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(p.pos)
            end
        end
    end
    Bk.projectileTick = projectileTick
    -- the handheld cannon: right-click fires the first ammo found in the inventory (reload: the ammo's ticks)
    local cannonReady = 0
    function Bk.useItem(stack, name, sneaking)
        if name == "clipboard" and Bk.clipScreen then Bk.clipScreen(stack); return true end
        if name == "handheld_worldshaper" and Bk.shaperUse then return Bk.shaperUse(stack, sneaking) end
        if name == "wand_of_symmetry" and Bk.symmetryUse then return Bk.symmetryUse(stack, sneaking) end
        if name == "linked_controller" and Bk.controllerUse then return Bk.controllerUse(stack, sneaking) end
        if (name == "filter" or name == "attribute_filter") and Bk.filterScreen then return Bk.filterScreen(stack) end
        if name == "plunger_launcher" and Bk.plungerUse then return Bk.plungerUse(stack, sneaking) end
        if name ~= "potato_cannon" then return false end
        local c = ctx()
        if os.clock() < cannonReady then return true end
        local inv = c.inventory
        local ammoSlot, t
        for i = 1, 36 do
            local s = inv.slots[i]
            if s and s ~= stack then
                local tt = potatoType(s.id)
                if tt then ammoSlot, t = i, tt; break end
            end
        end
        if not ammoSlot then return false end
        local s = inv.slots[ammoSlot]
        local w = world()
        local eye, look = w.eye(), w.look()
        local motion = look * 2 * (t.velocity or 1)
        for i = 1, (t.split or 1) do
            local m = motion
            if (t.split or 1) > 1 then m = m + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3 end
            launch(s, eye + look * 0.5 * B, m, t, 1, true)
        end
        if CONFIG.Survival then s.count = s.count - 1; if s.count <= 0 then inv.slots[ammoSlot] = nil end end
        cannonReady = os.clock() + (t.reload or 10) / 20
        sound("entity.firework_rocket.blast", eye, 1, (t.pitch or 1) + math.random() * 0.2)
        pcall(function() c.ui.refresh() end)
        return true
    end
    -- the mounted cannon: ammo in its slot (up to 16), rotation charges it, a redstone signal fires
    DEF.mounted_potato_cannon = {
        use = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            local c = ctx()
            local s = held()
            if s then
                if d.slot and d.slot.id ~= s.id then return false end
                local room = 16 - (d.slot and d.slot.count or 0)
                local move = math.min(room, s.count)
                if move <= 0 then return false end
                d.slot = {id = s.id, count = (d.slot and d.slot.count or 0) + move}
                if CONFIG.Survival then s.count = s.count - move; if s.count <= 0 then c.inventory.slots[c.ui.selected] = nil end end
                pcall(function() c.ui.refresh() end)
                return true
            elseif d.slot then
                local back = d.slot; d.slot = nil
                c.inventory.add(back.id, back.count)
                pcall(function() c.ui.refresh() end)
                return true
            end
            return nil
        end,
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            local powered = false
            for side in pairs(DIRV) do if received(n, side) > 0 then powered = true end end
            if n.state.powered ~= tostring(powered) and n.state.powered ~= nil then setState(n, "powered", tostring(powered)) end
            local t = d.slot and potatoType(d.slot.id)
            d.state = d.state or "charging"
            if d.state == "charging" then
                local speed = math.abs(n.speed or 0)
                if t and speed > 0 then d.charge = (d.charge or 0) + speed / (64 * (t.reload or 10)) end
                if (d.charge or 0) >= 1 then d.state = "charged" end
            elseif d.state == "charged" and powered and t then
                local frame = worldFrame(n)
                local aim = frame:VectorToWorldSpace(DIRV[n.state.facing or "north"])
                local motion = aim * (t.velocity or 1) * 2
                for i = 1, (t.split or 1) do
                    local m = motion
                    if (t.split or 1) > 1 then m = m + Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4 end
                    launch(d.slot, frame.Position + aim * 1.1 * B, m, t, 2, false)
                end
                d.slot.count = d.slot.count - 1
                if d.slot.count <= 0 then d.slot = nil end
                sound("entity.firework_rocket.blast", frame.Position, 1, (t.pitch or 1) + math.random() * 0.2)
                d.state, d.charge = "charging", 0
            end
        end,
    }

    -- ===== Handles (HandleBlock / ClientHandleHandler) =======================================================================
    -- Hold right-click on a handle: you are pulled to it and hang on (W / S bring it nearer / further); it moves with its ship.
    -- Sneak while grabbing it: you pull the ship instead, towards where you look.
    local handleHold
    local HANDLE = {
        useSneaking = true,
        use = function(n, sneaking)
            if holdingWrench() then return nil end
            if handleHold then return false end
            local w = world()
            local center = worldFrame(n).Position
            local range = math.min((center - w.eye()).Magnitude / B, 5)
            handleHold = {node = n, range = range, moving = sneaking and physics.shipOfCenter(n.center) ~= nil}
            if handleHold.moving then
                local s = physics.shipOfCenter(n.center)
                local o = O()
                local sim = (center - o) / B + Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
                local ax, ay, az = physics.Rigid.toGrid(s.b, sim.X, sim.Y, sim.Z)
                handleHold.ship, handleHold.anchor = s, Vector3.new(ax, ay, az)
            end
            return true
        end,
    }
    for _, c in ipairs({"iron", "copper", "white", "orange", "magenta", "light_blue", "yellow", "lime", "pink", "gray", "light_gray", "cyan",
        "purple", "blue", "brown", "green", "red", "black"}) do DEF[c .. "_handle"] = HANDLE end
    local function handleTick()
        if not handleHold then return end
        local h = handleHold
        local c = ctx()
        local w = world()
        if not rmb() or not nodes[h.node] or not c.root then handleHold = nil; return end
        local center = worldFrame(h.node).Position
        local eye = w.eye()
        if (center - eye).Magnitude > (4 + h.range + 2) * B then handleHold = nil; return end
        if h.moving then
            -- the ship's grabbed point is pulled to where the player looks (as the staff does, gentler)
            local s = h.ship
            local R = physics.Rigid
            local b = s.b
            local goal = eye + w.look() * h.range * B
            local o = O()
            local g = (goal - o) / B + Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
            local ax, ay, az = R.toWorld(b, h.anchor.X, h.anchor.Y, h.anchor.Z)
            b.sleeping, b.kinematic = false, false
            b.vx, b.vy, b.vz = (g.X - ax) * 3, (g.Y - ay) * 3 + 0.16, (g.Z - az) * 3
            b.wx, b.wy, b.wz = b.wx * 0.9, b.wy * 0.9, b.wz * 0.9
            return
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then h.range = math.max(0.5, h.range - 0.5 * 0.05) end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then h.range = math.min(5, h.range + 0.5 * 0.05) end
        -- the eye goes to a point behind the handle along the look (activeTick), at most 2 blocks a tick
        local look = w.look()
        local goalEye = center + look * (-(h.range * 0.4) - math.max(-look.Y, 0)) * B
        local diff = (goalEye - eye) / B
        if diff.Magnitude > 2 then diff = diff.Unit * 2 end
        local motion = w.items and w.items.motion and w.items.motion()
        if motion and w.knockback then
            local want = motion * 0.25 + diff * 0.3
            w.knockback(want - motion)
            if w.items then w.items.fallDistance = 0 end
        end
    end
    Bk.handleTick = handleTick

    -- ===== Navigation Table (NavTableBlockEntity / NavigationTarget) ==========================================================
    -- Its item (compass, lodestone compass, recovery compass, map, redstone magnet) gives a target; the pointer turns to it
    -- and each side outputs asin(dot) / pi * 30 (up to 15) for how much the target lies that way (2-block dead zone).
    local function navTarget(n, d)
        local s = d.item
        if not s then return nil end
        local e = JavaContent.byIndex[s.id]
        local id = e and (e.itemId or e.id)
        if id == "compass" then
            if s.lodestone then return s.lodestone end
            -- the world spawn
            return O() + Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        elseif id == "recovery_compass" then
            return d.deathPos
        elseif id == "filled_map" then
            if s.mapCenter then return s.mapCenter end
            return O()
        elseif id == "redstone_magnet" then
            local best, bestD
            local here = worldFrame(n).Position
            for m in pairs(nodes) do
                if m.id == "redstone_magnet" and m ~= n then
                    local p = worldFrame(m).Position
                    local dd = (p - here).Magnitude
                    if not bestD or dd < bestD then best, bestD = p, dd end
                end
            end
            return best
        end
    end
    DEF.navigation_table = {
        use = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            local c = ctx()
            local s, name = held()
            if s and (name == "compass" or name == "recovery_compass" or name == "filled_map" or name == "redstone_magnet") and not d.item then
                d.item = {id = s.id, count = 1, lodestone = s.lodestone, mapCenter = s.mapCenter}
                s.count = s.count - 1
                if s.count <= 0 then c.inventory.slots[c.ui.selected] = nil end
                sound("entity.item_frame.add_item", n.center, 1, 1)
                pcall(function() c.ui.refresh() end)
                return true
            elseif not s and d.item then
                c.inventory.add(d.item.id, 1)
                d.item = nil
                sound("entity.item_frame.remove_item", n.center, 1, 1)
                pcall(function() c.ui.refresh() end)
                return true
            end
            return nil
        end,
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            local target = navTarget(n, d)
            local facing = n.state.facing or "up"
            local frame = worldFrame(n)
            local dirs = {}
            if target then
                local diff = frame:VectorToObjectSpace((target - frame.Position) / B)
                local normal = DIRV[facing]
                local proj = diff - normal * diff:Dot(normal)
                local dist = proj.Magnitude
                if dist >= 2 then
                    for side, v in pairs(DIRV) do
                        local dot = -proj:Dot(v) / dist
                        -- the output side: the signal goes out of that face
                        local p = floor(math.asin(clamp(dot, -1, 1)) / math.pi * 30 + 0.5)
                        if p > 0 then dirs[OPP[side]] = p end
                    end
                end
                -- the pointer's angle in the table's plane
                d.angle = math.atan2(proj.Z, proj.X)
            end
            emit(n, nil, dirs, nil)
        end,
        render = function(n, dt)
            local d = data(n)
            d.visual = d.visual or 0
            local target = d.angle or d.visual
            local diff = (target - d.visual + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
            d.visual = d.visual + diff * math.min(1, dt * 20 * 0.8)
            local facing = n.state.facing or "up"
            local base = worldFrame(n)
            local orient = facing == "up" and CFrame.identity or facing == "down" and CFrame.Angles(math.pi, 0, 0)
                or CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad((YROT[facing] or 0) + 180), 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi / 2, 0, 0)
            place(partial(n, "simulated:navigation_table/nav_table_pointer"), base * orient * CFrame.Angles(0, -d.visual, 0))
        end,
    }

    -- ===== Ropes (RopeItem / RopeStrandHolderBehavior / RopeWinchBlockEntity / ServerRopeStrand) ==========================
    -- The Rope Coupling joins two rope holders (Rope Connectors, Rope Winches) up to 40 blocks apart: click one, then the
    -- other (sneak-click forgets the first). The rope is a chain of 1-block segments that hangs and swings; a taut rope pulls
    -- the ships it is tied to. A winch reels it in / out with its shaft (speed / 512 blocks a tick, at most 0.49); breaking
    -- a holder drops the rope.
    local ROPE_RANGE = 40
    local strands = {}
    local ropeFirst            -- the holder clicked first with the coupling
    local function holderPoint(n)
        local frame = worldFrame(n)
        if n.id == "rope_connector" then
            local f = DIRV[n.state.facing or "up"]
            return frame * (f * -0.1875 * B)
        end
        return frame.Position
    end
    local function strandOf(n)
        for _, s in ipairs(strands) do if s.a == n or s.b == n then return s end end
    end
    local function dropRope(s, at)
        for i, o in ipairs(strands) do if o == s then table.remove(strands, i) break end end
        for _, seg in ipairs(s.parts or {}) do pcall(function() seg:Destroy() end) end
        if at and CONFIG.Survival then
            local w = world()
            local e = JavaContent.itemById.rope_coupling
            if e then pcall(w.drop, {id = e.index, count = 1}, at, Vector3.zero, true) end
        end
    end
    local function makeRope(a, b)
        local pa, pb = holderPoint(a), holderPoint(b)
        local dist = (pb - pa).Magnitude / B
        if dist > ROPE_RANGE then return false end
        local sa, sb = strandOf(a), strandOf(b)
        if sa then dropRope(sa, holderPoint(a)) end
        if sb then dropRope(sb, holderPoint(b)) end
        -- the winch owns the rope (its end is the first point)
        if b.id == "rope_winch" and a.id ~= "rope_winch" then a, b, pa, pb = b, a, pb, pa end
        local whole = math.floor(dist)
        local short = dist - whole
        local dir = (pb - pa).Unit
        local pts, prev = {pa}, {pa}
        for i = 0, math.max(1, whole + 1) - 1 do
            local p = pa + dir * (i + short) * B
            pts[#pts + 1] = p; prev[#prev + 1] = p
        end
        pts[#pts] = pb; prev[#prev] = pb
        strands[#strands + 1] = {a = a, b = b, points = pts, prev = prev, extension = math.max(short, 0.0001), parts = {}}
        sound("block.wool.place", pa, 0.5, 1); sound("block.wool.place", pb, 0.5, 1)
        return true
    end
    local ROPE_HOLDER = {
        useSneaking = true,
        use = function(n, sneaking)
            local s, name = held()
            if name ~= "rope_coupling" then return nil end
            if sneaking then ropeFirst = nil; return true end
            if ropeFirst and ropeFirst ~= n and nodes[ropeFirst] then
                if not (ropeFirst.id == "rope_winch" and n.id == "rope_winch") and makeRope(ropeFirst, n) then
                    if CONFIG.Survival then
                        local c = ctx()
                        s.count = s.count - 1
                        if s.count <= 0 then c.inventory.slots[c.ui.selected] = nil end
                        pcall(function() c.ui.refresh() end)
                    end
                end
                ropeFirst = nil
            else
                ropeFirst = n
            end
            return true
        end,
    }
    DEF.rope_connector = ROPE_HOLDER
    DEF.rope_winch = ROPE_HOLDER
    local function winchSpeed(n) return clamp((n.speed or 0) / 512, -0.49, 0.49) end
    local function ropeTick()
        for i = #strands, 1, -1 do
            local s = strands[i]
            if not (nodes[s.a] and nodes[s.b]) then
                dropRope(s, nodes[s.a] and holderPoint(s.a) or (nodes[s.b] and holderPoint(s.b)) or s.points[1])
            else
                local pts, prev = s.points, s.prev
                -- the winch: the first segment grows / shrinks, whole segments are added at the winch / taken away
                if s.a.id == "rope_winch" then
                    local move = winchSpeed(s.a)
                    local current = 0
                    for k = 1, #pts - 1 do current = current + (pts[k + 1] - pts[k]).Magnitude / B end
                    local desired = s.extension + (#pts - 2)
                    if current > desired * 1.1 then move = math.max(0, move) end
                    if current > ROPE_RANGE then move = math.min(0, move) end
                    local ext = s.extension + move
                    if ext < 1 and #pts == 2 then ext = 1 else
                        while ext < 0 and #pts > 2 do table.remove(pts, 2); table.remove(prev, 2); ext = ext + 1 end
                        while ext > 1 do table.insert(pts, 2, pts[1]); table.insert(prev, 2, pts[1]); ext = ext - 1 end
                        if ext < 1 and #pts <= 2 then ext = 1 end
                    end
                    s.extension = math.max(ext, 0.0001)
                end
                -- verlet: gravity, a little damping, then the segment lengths
                local pa, pb = holderPoint(s.a), holderPoint(s.b)
                for k = 2, #pts - 1 do
                    local p = pts[k]
                    local v = (p - prev[k]) * 0.98
                    prev[k] = p
                    pts[k] = p + v + Vector3.new(0, -0.04 * B, 0)
                end
                pts[1], pts[#pts] = pa, pb
                for _ = 1, 12 do
                    for k = 1, #pts - 1 do
                        local rest = (k == 1 and s.extension or 1) * B
                        local d = pts[k + 1] - pts[k]
                        local len = d.Magnitude
                        if len > 1e-4 and len > rest then
                            local corr = d * ((len - rest) / len)
                            local fixA, fixB = k == 1, k + 1 == #pts
                            if fixA and not fixB then pts[k + 1] = pts[k + 1] - corr
                            elseif fixB and not fixA then pts[k] = pts[k] + corr
                            elseif not fixA and not fixB then pts[k] = pts[k] + corr * 0.5; pts[k + 1] = pts[k + 1] - corr * 0.5 end
                        end
                    end
                end
                -- a taut rope pulls the ships at its ends towards each other
                local total, rest = 0, (s.extension + (#pts - 2)) * B
                for k = 1, #pts - 1 do total = total + (pts[k + 1] - pts[k]).Magnitude end
                local stretch = (pb - pa).Magnitude - rest
                if stretch > 0 then
                    for _, endNode in ipairs({s.a, s.b}) do
                        local ship = physics.shipOfCenter(endNode.center)
                        if ship and ship.b then
                            local other = endNode == s.a and pb or pa
                            local here = endNode == s.a and pa or pb
                            local dir = (other - here).Unit
                            local b = ship.b
                            b.sleeping, b.kinematic = false, false
                            local pull = math.min(stretch / B, 2) * 0.5
                            b.vx, b.vy, b.vz = b.vx + dir.X * pull, b.vy + dir.Y * pull, b.vz + dir.Z * pull
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local ROPE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(134, 98, 61)
    local function ropeRender()
        for _, s in ipairs(strands) do
            local pts = s.points
            for k = 1, #pts - 1 do
                local seg = s.parts[k]
                if not seg then
                    seg = Instance.new("Part")
                    seg.Name, seg.Anchored, seg.CanCollide, seg.CanQuery, seg.CanTouch = "RopeSegment", true, false, false, false
                    seg.Material, seg.Color = Enum.Material.Fabric, ROPE_COLOR
                    seg.Parent = workspace
                    s.parts[k] = seg
                end
                local a, b = pts[k], pts[k + 1]
                local len = (b - a).Magnitude
                seg.Size = Vector3.new(0.125 * B, 0.125 * B, math.max(0.01, len + 0.02 * B))
                if len > 1e-4 then moveParts[#moveParts + 1] = seg; moveFrames[#moveFrames + 1] = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b) end
            end
            for k = #pts, #s.parts do if s.parts[k] then s.parts[k]:Destroy(); s.parts[k] = nil end end
        end
    end
    Bk.ropeTick, Bk.ropeRender = ropeTick, ropeRender

    -- ===== Simulated's kinetic blocks in Create's rotation network ===========================================================
    --  * Directional Gearshift (DirectionalGearshiftBlockEntity): a split shaft; a signal on its left side passes the rotation
    --    on, on its right side reverses it, both or neither stop it.
    --  * Analog Transmission (AnalogTransmissionBlockEntity): a shaft and a cogwheel; the cog turns at 1 - (signal + 1) / 16
    --    of the shaft's speed (no signal: the same; 15: disconnected).
    --  * Portable Engine (PortableEngineBlockEntity): fuel in its slot (right-click) burns; while lit it drives 32 RPM out of
    --    its front (blaze cake: superheated, 64 RPM; creative blaze cake: forever); dye recolours it; comparators read the fuel.
    --  * Steering Wheel (SteeringWheelBlockEntity / SteeringWheelHandler): hold right-click and move the mouse sideways to turn
    --    it (at most its angle setting, 180 degrees); it drives 16 RPM down its shaft until the wheel reaches that angle.
    local AXO = {north = "z", south = "z", east = "x", west = "x", up = "y", down = "y"}
    local POSD = {east = true, up = true, south = true}
    local FUEL = {coal = 1600, charcoal = 1600, coal_block = 16000, blaze_rod = 2400, lava_bucket = 20000, stick = 100,
        dried_kelp_block = 4001, bamboo = 50, scaffolding = 50, bowl = 100, ladder = 300, crafting_table = 300, chest = 300,
        bookshelf = 300, jukebox = 300, note_block = 300, barrel = 300, lectern = 300, composter = 300, wooden_pickaxe = 200,
        wooden_axe = 200, wooden_shovel = 200, wooden_hoe = 200, wooden_sword = 200, bow = 300, fishing_rod = 300, blaze_cake = 6400,
        creative_blaze_cake = math.huge}
    local function burnTime(id)
        if FUEL[id] then return FUEL[id] end
        if id:match("_planks$") or id:match("_log$") or id:match("_wood$") or id:match("_stem$") or id:match("_hyphae$")
            or id:match("_fence$") or id:match("_fence_gate$") or id:match("_trapdoor$") or id:match("_pressure_plate$") then return 300 end
        if id:match("_slab$") and id:match("oak") then return 150 end
        if id:match("_sapling$") or id:match("_door$") then return id:match("_door$") and 200 or 100 end
        if id:match("_wool$") then return 100 end
        if id:match("_carpet$") then return 67 end
        if id:match("_button$") then return 100 end
        return 0
    end
    local function engineSpeed(n)
        local d = data(n)
        if not ((d.burn or 0) > 0) then return 0 end
        local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
        local s = 32 * (d.reverse and -1 or 1)
        s = POSD[facing] and s or -s
        return s * (d.superheated and 2 or 1)
    end
    local function registerKinetics()
        local k = K()
        if not (k and k.DEF) or k.simulatedRegistered then return end
        k.simulatedRegistered = true
        local D = k.DEF
        local dirAxis = k.dirAxis
        D.directional_gearshift = {axis = dirAxis, shaft = function(st, d) return AXO[d] == dirAxis(st) end, kind = "dirshift",
            watch = function(n)
                local f = n.state.facing or "north"
                return tostring(received(n, f) > 0) .. tostring(received(n, OPP[f]) > 0)
            end,
            partials = function(n)
                local list = {}
                for _, d in ipairs({"north", "south", "east", "west", "up", "down"}) do
                    if AXO[d] == dirAxis(n.state) then list[#list + 1] = {"shaft_half", "south", d, side = d} end
                end
                return list
            end}
        D.analog_transmission = {axis = function(st) return st.axis or "y" end, shaft = function(st, d) return AXO[d] == (st.axis or "y") end,
            cog = "small", watch = function(n) return n.input or 0 end,
            partials = function() return {{"shaft", "up", nil}, {"simulated:analog_transmission/gear", "up", nil}} end}
        local engine = {axis = function(st) return AXO[st.facing or "north"] end, shaft = function(st, d) return d == (st.facing or "north") end,
            source = engineSpeed, watch = function(n) return engineSpeed(n) end,
            partials = function(n) return {{"shaft_half", "south", n.state.facing or "north"}} end}
        for c in pairs({white = 1, orange = 1, magenta = 1, light_blue = 1, yellow = 1, lime = 1, pink = 1, gray = 1, light_gray = 1,
            cyan = 1, purple = 1, blue = 1, brown = 1, green = 1, red = 1, black = 1}) do D[c .. "_portable_engine"] = engine end
        D.steering_wheel = {axis = function() return "y" end, shaft = function(st, d) return d == (st.on_floor == "true" and "down" or "up") end,
            source = function(n) local d = data(n); return d.generated or 0 end, watch = function(n) return data(n).generated or 0 end}
        D.wheel_mount = {axis = function(st) return AXO[st.facing or "north"] end,
            shaft = function(st, d) return d == OPP[st.facing or "north"] end}
        D.rope_winch = {axis = dirAxis, shaft = function(st, d) return AXO[d] == dirAxis(st) end,
            partials = function() return {{"simulated:rope_winch/shaft", "up", nil}} end}
        D.mounted_potato_cannon = {axis = function(st) return AXO[st.facing or "north"] end,
            shaft = function(st, d) return d == OPP[st.facing or "north"] end}
        D.torsion_spring = {axis = function(st) return AXO[st.facing or "north"] end,
            shaft = function(st, d) return d == OPP[st.facing or "north"] end,
            watch = function(n) return n.ae and n.ae.outSpeed or 0 end,
            extra = function(n)
                n.torsionOut = n.torsionOut or {id = "torsion_spring_output", parent = n, capacityId = "torsion_spring"}
                return n.torsionOut
            end,
            partials = function(n)
                local f = n.state.facing or "north"
                local function springTurn(m) return Vector3.zero, (m.ae and m.ae.springAngle or 0) end
                return {{"shaft_half", "south", OPP[f], side = OPP[f]},
                    {"shaft_half", "south", f, move = springTurn},
                    {"simulated:torsion_spring/spring", "up", f, move = springTurn}}
            end}
        D.torsion_spring_output = {axis = function(st) return AXO[st.facing or "north"] end,
            shaft = function(st, d) return d == (st.facing or "north") end,
            source = function(o) local d = o.parent and o.parent.ae; return d and d.outSpeed or 0 end}
        local function augerAxis(st) return st.axis or "y" end
        D.auger_shaft = {axis = augerAxis, shaft = function(st, d) return AXO[d] == augerAxis(st) end,
            partials = function() return {{"shaft", "up", nil}} end}
        D.auger_cog = {axis = augerAxis, shaft = function(st, d) return AXO[d] == augerAxis(st) end, cog = "small",
            speedKey = true,
            partials = function(n)
                local lit = n.ae and n.ae.augerFlow
                return {{"shaft", "up", nil}, {"simulated:auger_shaft/cog", "up", nil},
                    {lit and "simulated:auger_shaft/redstone_top_on" or "simulated:auger_shaft/redstone_top_off", "up", nil, still = true}}
            end,
            visualKey = function(n) return n.ae and n.ae.augerFlow and 1 or 0 end}
        D.borehead_bearing = {axis = function(st) return AXO[st.facing or "up"] end, shaft = function(st, d) return d == OPP[st.facing or "up"] end,
            partials = function(n) return {{"shaft_half", "south", OPP[n.state.facing or "up"]}} end}
        D.rockcutting_wheel = {axis = function(st) return AXO[st.facing or "north"] end, shaft = function() return false end,
            partials = function(n) local f = n.state.facing or "north"
                return {{"offroad:block/rockcutting_wheel/wheel", "up", f, mesh = true, still = true}} end}
        local function seqAxis(st) return st.vertical == "true" and "y" or (st.axis or "x") end
        D.sequenced_gearshift = {axis = seqAxis, shaft = function(st, d) return AXO[d] == seqAxis(st) end, kind = "seqshift",
            watch = function(n) return (n.ae and n.ae.seqMod) or 0 end,
            partials = function(n)
                local list = {}
                for _, d in ipairs({"north", "south", "east", "west", "up", "down"}) do
                    if AXO[d] == seqAxis(n.state) then list[#list + 1] = {"shaft_half", "south", d, side = d} end
                end
                return list
            end}
        if k.markDirty then k.markDirty() end
    end
    Bk.registerKinetics = registerKinetics

    -- the Portable Engine's slot, fuel and colour
    local ENGINE = {
        use = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            local c = ctx()
            local s, name = held()
            local color = name and name:match("^(.-)_dye$")
            if color and DIRV and JavaContent.byId[color .. "_portable_engine"] then
                local e = JavaContent.byId[color .. "_portable_engine"]
                local keep = n.ae
                local w = world()
                pcall(w.setBlockAt, n.center, e.index, table.clone(n.state))
                local ns = w.sample(n.center); if ns and ns.node then ns.node.ae = keep end
                sound("item.dye.use", n.center, 1, 1)
                return true
            end
            if not s and not d.slot then return nil end
            if s and burnTime(name) <= 0 then return false end
            if not d.slot then
                -- the held stack goes in
                d.slot = {id = s.id, count = s.count}
                c.inventory.slots[c.ui.selected] = nil
            elseif s and s.id == d.slot.id then
                local maxStack = (JavaContent.byIndex[s.id] or {}).maxStack or 64
                local move = math.min(maxStack - d.slot.count, s.count)
                if move > 0 then d.slot.count = d.slot.count + move; s.count = s.count - move; if s.count <= 0 then c.inventory.slots[c.ui.selected] = nil end end
            else
                -- empty hand (or another item): take the fuel back
                local back = d.slot
                d.slot = nil
                local added = c.inventory.add(back.id, back.count)
                if added < back.count then local w = world(); pcall(w.drop, {id = back.id, count = back.count - added}, n.center, Vector3.zero, true) end
                sound("entity.item.pickup", n.center, 0.2, 1.2)
            end
            pcall(function() c.ui.refresh() end)
            return true
        end,
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            d.burn = d.burn or 0
            if d.burn > 0 and d.burn ~= math.huge then d.burn = d.burn - 1 end
            if d.burn <= 0 and d.slot then
                local e = JavaContent.byIndex[d.slot.id]
                local id = e and (e.itemId or e.id) or ""
                local t = burnTime(id)
                if t > 0 then
                    d.burn = t
                    d.superheated = id == "blaze_cake" or id == "creative_blaze_cake"
                    if id ~= "creative_blaze_cake" then
                        d.slot.count = d.slot.count - 1
                        if d.slot.count <= 0 then d.slot = id == "lava_bucket" and {id = JavaContent.itemById.bucket.index, count = 1} or nil end
                    end
                end
            end
            if d.burn <= 0 then d.superheated = false end
            local lit = tostring(d.burn > 0)
            if n.state.lit ~= lit then setState(n, "lit", lit) end
            -- getAnalogOutputSignal: the fuel left (burn time / 200, at most 15)
            local total = d.burn + (d.slot and burnTime((JavaContent.byIndex[d.slot.id] or {}).id or "") * d.slot.count or 0)
            n.comparatorStrength = total == math.huge and 15 or (total > 0 and math.min(math.floor(total / 200), 14) + 1 or 0)
        end,
    }
    for c in pairs({white = 1, orange = 1, magenta = 1, light_blue = 1, yellow = 1, lime = 1, pink = 1, gray = 1, light_gray = 1,
        cyan = 1, purple = 1, blue = 1, brown = 1, green = 1, red = 1, black = 1}) do DEF[c .. "_portable_engine"] = ENGINE end

    -- the Steering Wheel: hold and turn
    local steer
    DEF.steering_wheel = {
        use = function(n)
            if steer then return false end
            local c = ctx()
            local yaw, pitch = c.getView()
            steer = {node = n, yaw = yaw, pitch = pitch}
            data(n).held = true
            return true
        end,
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            d.angle = d.angle or 0
            d.target = d.target or 0
            local diff = d.target - d.angle
            -- 16 RPM = 4.8 degrees a tick towards the target
            if math.abs(diff) > 0.001 then
                local step = math.sign(diff) * math.min(4.8, math.abs(diff))
                d.angle = d.angle + step
                local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
                local floorOn = n.state.on_floor == "true"
                local logical = 16 * math.sign(diff)
                d.generated = ((facing == "north" or facing == "west") == floorOn) and -logical or logical
            else
                d.generated = 0
            end
        end,
        render = function(n, dt)
            local d = data(n)
            d.visual = (d.visual or 0) + ((d.angle or 0) - (d.visual or 0)) * math.min(1, dt * 20 * 0.5)
            local k = K()
            visuals[n] = visuals[n] or {}
            local v = visuals[n].wheel
            if v == nil and k and k.meshVisual then
                local okM, vis = pcall(k.meshVisual, "simulated:block/steering_wheel/wheel", n.center)
                if okM and vis then v = vis; visuals[n].wheel = v end
            end
            if v then
                local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
                local frame = worldFrame(n) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad((YROT[facing] or 0) + 180), 0)
                place(v, frame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(d.visual)))
            end
        end,
    }
    local function steerTick()
        if not steer then return end
        local c = ctx()
        local n = steer.node
        local d = data(n)
        if not rmb() or not nodes[n] then d.held = false; steer = nil; return end
        local yaw, pitch = c.getView()
        local dy = math.deg(yaw - steer.yaw)
        c.setView(steer.yaw, steer.pitch)
        local limit = d.limit or 180
        d.target = clamp((d.target or 0) - dy * 3, -limit, limit)
    end
    Bk.steerTick = steerTick

    -- ===== Offroad: Wheel Mount ===============================================================================================
    local TIRES = {small_tire = 0.75, tire = 0.96875, large_tire = 1.25, monstrous_tire = 2.0, crushing_wheel = 1.0, water_wheel = 1.0,
        flywheel = 1.375, large_water_wheel = 2.4375, rockcutting_wheel = 0.8}
    local TIRE_MESH = {small_tire = "offroad:item/small_tire/small_tire", tire = "offroad:item/tire/tire",
        large_tire = "offroad:item/large_tire/large_tire", monstrous_tire = "offroad:item/monstrous_tire/monstrous_tire",
        rockcutting_wheel = "offroad:block/rockcutting_wheel/wheel", crushing_wheel = "crushing_wheel/block", water_wheel = "water_wheel/wheel",
        flywheel = "flywheel/block", large_water_wheel = "large_water_wheel/block"}
    local function tireOf(stack)
        local e = stack and JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
        local id = e and (e.itemId or e.id)
        return id and TIRES[id] and id or nil
    end
    local function wheelDrop(n, radius)
        -- the ground under the tire (the block in front of the mount), at most 0.65 + radius + 0.25 below it
        local frame = worldFrame(n)
        local attach = frame * (DIRV[n.state.facing or "north"] * B)
        local rp = RaycastParams.new()
        rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local ex = {}
        local c = ctx(); if c and c.character then ex[#ex + 1] = c.character end
        if visuals[n] then for _, v in pairs(visuals[n]) do if v and v.model then ex[#ex + 1] = v.model end end end
        rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = ex
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(attach, Vector3.new(0, -(0.65 + radius + 0.25) * B, 0), rp)
        if not hit then return 0.65, attach, false end
        return clamp((attach - hit.Position).Magnitude / B - radius, 0, 0.65), attach, true
    end
    DEF.wheel_mount = {
        use = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            local c = ctx()
            local s = held()
            local tid = tireOf(s)
            if s and not tid then return nil end
            if not s and not d.tire then return nil end
            local old = d.tire
            if tid then
                d.tire = {id = s.id, name = tid, radius = TIRES[tid]}
                if CONFIG.Survival then s.count = s.count - 1; if s.count <= 0 then c.inventory.slots[c.ui.selected] = nil end end
            else
                d.tire = nil
            end
            if old then c.inventory.add(old.id, 1) end
            visuals[n] = visuals[n] or {}
            if visuals[n].tire then pcall(function() visuals[n].tire.model:Destroy() end); visuals[n].tire = nil end
            sound("entity.item_frame.add_item", n.center, 0.6, 0.8)
            pcall(function() c.ui.refresh() end)
            return true
        end,
        values = function(n, side)
            local f = n.state.facing or "north"
            if not side or side == "up" or side == "down" or AXO[side] == AXO[f] then return nil end
            local d = data(n)
            return {offset = Vector3.new(0.5, 11 / 16, 0.5) + DIRV[side] * (7.5 / 16), normal = DIRV[side], scale = 0.5,
                title = L("offroad.scroll_option.suspension_strength", "Suspension Strength"),
                rows = {L("offroad.scroll_option.suspension_strength_label", "Strength")}, max = 180, milestone = 20,
                format = function(_, v) return tostring(math.max(5, v)) end,
                get = function() return 0, d.strength or 10 end,
                set = function(_, v) d.strength = math.max(5, v) end,
                value = function() return tostring(d.strength or 10) end}
        end,
        tick = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            -- getSteeringSignal: the clockwise side minus the counter-clockwise side
            local f = n.state.facing or "north"
            local CW = {north = "east", east = "south", south = "west", west = "north"}
            local CCW = {north = "west", west = "south", south = "east", east = "north"}
            local steer = (CW[f] and received(n, CW[f]) or 0) - (CCW[f] and received(n, CCW[f]) or 0)
            -- computeYaw
            d.yaw = steer == 0 and 0 or (-steer / 15 * math.pi / 4 * (2 / 3))
            d.visualYaw = (d.visualYaw or 0) + (d.yaw - (d.visualYaw or 0)) * 0.2
            if not d.tire then return end
            if not physics.shipOfCenter(n.center) then
                local drop = wheelDrop(n, d.tire.radius)
                d.drop = drop
            end
        end,
        render = function(n, dt)
            local d = data(n)
            if not d.tire then return end
            local k = K()
            visuals[n] = visuals[n] or {}
            local v = visuals[n].tire
            if v == nil and k and k.meshVisual then
                local okM, vis = pcall(k.meshVisual, TIRE_MESH[d.tire.name] or "offroad:item/tire/tire", n.center)
                if okM and vis then v = vis; visuals[n].tire = v end
            end
            if not v then return end
            local facing = n.state.facing or "north"
            local axisX = facing == "east" or facing == "west"
            -- turning with the shaft (the brake signal above slows it)
            local speed = n.overstressed and 0 or (n.speed or 0)
            local brake = received(n, "up") / 15
            d.spin = (d.spin or 0) + (axisX and -speed or speed) * math.pi * 2 / 60 * dt * (1 - brake)
            d.vdrop = (d.vdrop or 0.5) + ((d.drop or 0.5) - (d.vdrop or 0.5)) * math.min(1, dt * 20 * 0.7)
            local frame = worldFrame(n)
            local center = frame * (DIRV[facing] * B - Vector3.new(0, d.vdrop * B, 0))
            local rot = frame.Rotation * CFrame.Angles(0, (d.visualYaw or 0) + (axisX and math.pi / 2 or 0), 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi / 2, 0, 0)
            place(v, CFrame.new(center) * rot * CFrame.Angles(0, d.spin, 0))
        end,
    }
    -- ===== Simulated: Redstone Magnet ==========================================================================================
    local MAGNET_SPRITES = {
        {w = 8, h = 8, p = {10461087, 13619151}, alpha = {1, 1}, d = "00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000010000000000000102010000000000000100000000000000000000000000000000000000"},
        {w = 8, h = 8, p = {10461087, 13619151, 16777215}, alpha = {1, 1, 1}, d = "00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001020100000000000203020000000000010201000000000000000000000000000000000000"},
        {w = 8, h = 8, p = {10461087, 16777215, 13619151}, alpha = {1, 1, 1}, d = "00000000000000000000000000000000000000000100000000000001020100000000010202030100000000010301000000000000010000000000000000000000"},
        {w = 8, h = 8, p = {10461087, 13619151, 16777215}, alpha = {1, 1, 1}, d = "00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001020100000000000203020000000000010201000000000000000000000000000000000000"},
        {w = 8, h = 8, p = {10461087, 13619151}, alpha = {1, 1}, d = "00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000010000000000000102010000000000000100000000000000000000000000000000000000"}}
    local magnetEmitters, magnetParticles = {}, {}
    local magnetFolder
    local function magnetPose(n)
        -- world position (blocks) and moment (facing x signal/15 x sqrt(1000)) of a powered magnet
        local frame = worldFrame(n)
        local p = (frame.Position - O()) / B
        local m = frame.Rotation * DIRV[n.state.facing or "north"] * ((n.ae and n.ae.magnetSignal or 0) / 15 * math.sqrt(1000))
        return p, m
    end
    local function magnetField(list, p)
        local f = Vector3.zero
        for _, e in ipairs(list) do
            local r = p - e.p
            local d2 = r:Dot(r)
            if d2 > 1e-4 then
                local d = math.sqrt(d2)
                f = f + (r * (3 * e.m:Dot(r) / d2) - e.m) / (d2 * d)
            end
        end
        local l = f.Magnitude
        return l > 1e-9 and f / l or Vector3.zero
    end
    local function solidAt(p)
        local w = world()
        local o = O()
        local v = (p * B)
        local c = o + Vector3.new(floor(v.X / B + 0.5), floor(v.Y / B + 0.5), floor(v.Z / B + 0.5)) * B
        local s = w and w.sample and w.sample(c)
        return s and s.node ~= nil
    end
    local function magnetParticle(p, negative)
        if not magnetFolder or not magnetFolder.Parent then
            magnetFolder = Instance.new("Folder"); magnetFolder.Name = "SteveMagnetParticles"; magnetFolder.Parent = workspace
        end
        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.Transparency = true, false, false, false, 1
        part.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
