        -- quadSize: 0.1 x (0.5..1) x 2 x 0.75 (half size) and the 0.01 spread of sendParticles
        local q = 0.1 * (math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5) * 2 * 0.75
        local jitter = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02
        part.CFrame = CFrame.new(O() + (p + jitter) * B)
        local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        gui.Size = UDim2.new(q * 2 * B, 0, q * 2 * B, 0)
        gui.LightInfluence, gui.Adornee, gui.Parent = 0, part, part
        local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        img.BackgroundTransparency, img.Size, img.ResampleMode = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated
        img.ImageTransparency = 0.6
        img.ImageColor3 = negative and Color3.new(0.7, 0.7, 1) or Color3.new(1, 0.7, 0.7)
        local content = JavaGui.content(MAGNET_SPRITES[1]); if content then img.ImageContent = content end
        img.Parent = gui
        part.Parent = magnetFolder
        magnetParticles[#magnetParticles + 1] = {part = part, img = img, age = 0}
    end
    local function magnetParticleTick()
        for i = #magnetParticles, 1, -1 do
            local pt = magnetParticles[i]
            pt.age = pt.age + 1
            if pt.age >= 5 then pt.part:Destroy(); table.remove(magnetParticles, i)
            else
                -- SpriteSet.get(age, lifetime): index age x (5 - 1) / 5
                local content = JavaGui.content(MAGNET_SPRITES[floor(pt.age * 4 / 5) + 1])
                if content then pt.img.ImageContent = content end
            end
        end
        for i = #magnetEmitters, 1, -1 do
            local e = magnetEmitters[i]
            e.time = e.time - 1
            if e.time < 0 or solidAt(e.pos) then table.remove(magnetEmitters, i)
            else
                magnetParticle(e.pos, e.negative)
                -- rk4 along the field line (backwards from the south pole)
                local sgn = e.negative and -1 or 1
                local k1 = magnetField(e.list, e.pos) * sgn
                local k2 = magnetField(e.list, e.pos + k1 * 0.1) * sgn
                local k3 = magnetField(e.list, e.pos + k2 * 0.1) * sgn
                local k4 = magnetField(e.list, e.pos + k3 * 0.2) * sgn
                e.pos = e.pos + (k1 + k2 * 2 + k3 * 2 + k4) * (0.2 / 6)
            end
        end
    end
    Bk.magnetParticleTick = magnetParticleTick
    DEF.redstone_magnet = {
        tick = function(n)
            -- a node replaced by a state change waits for the next scan: leave it alone
            local w = world()
            local here = w and w.sample and w.sample(n.center)
            if not here or here.node ~= n then return end
            local d = data(n)
            -- getBestNeighborSignal
            local sig = n.input or 0
            if sig ~= d.magnetSignal then d.magnetSignal = sig end
            setState(n, "powered", sig > 0 and "true" or "false")
            physics.magnets = physics.magnets or {}
            physics.magnets[n] = os.clock()
            if sig <= 0 then return end
            -- spawnParticles
            if math.random() >= 0.1 * sig / 15 then return end
            local negative = math.random() < 0.5
            local f = DIRV[n.state.facing or "north"] * (negative and -1 or 1)
            local frame = worldFrame(n)
            local center = (frame.Position - O()) / B
            -- the block on that pole (a ship's blocks keep their grid places)
            local side = w.sample(n.center + f * B)
            if side and side.node then return end
            local off = Vector3.new(math.random() * 0.7 - 0.35, math.random() * 0.7 - 0.35, math.random() * 0.7 - 0.35)
            off = off - f * off:Dot(f)
            local start = center + frame.Rotation * ((f + off) * 0.55)
            local list = {}
            for m in pairs(nodes) do
                if m.id == "redstone_magnet" and m.ae and (m.ae.magnetSignal or 0) > 0 then
                    local p, mm = magnetPose(m)
                    if (p - center).Magnitude <= 8 then list[#list + 1] = {p = p, m = mm} end
                end
            end
            magnetEmitters[#magnetEmitters + 1] = {pos = start, list = list, negative = negative,
                time = 4 + floor(20 * sig / 15 * math.random())}
        end,
    }
    -- ===== Simulated: Torsion Spring ==========================================================================================
    local function springLimit(d) return d.springLimit or 90 end
    DEF.torsion_spring = {
        tick = function(n)
            local w = world()
            local here = w and w.sample and w.sample(n.center)
            if not here or here.node ~= n then return end
            local d = data(n)
            setState(n, "powered", (n.input or 0) > 0 and "true" or "false")
            local input = n.overstressed and 0 or (n.speed or 0)
            local powered = (n.input or 0) > 0
            local limit = springLimit(d)
            local angle = d.springAngle or 0
            if input ~= 0 then d.springLast = abs(input) end
            -- where the output is going: the angle limit the input turns toward, home once it stops (held when powered)
            local target
            if input ~= 0 then target = limit * (input > 0 and 1 or -1)
            elseif not powered then target = 0
            else target = angle end
            local out = 0
            if abs(target - angle) > 1e-6 then
                local dir = target > angle and 1 or -1
                out = (input ~= 0 and abs(input) or (d.springLast or 0)) * dir
                -- convertToAngular: rpm x 360 / 60 / 20 degrees a tick
                local step = out * 0.3
                angle = angle + step
                if (dir > 0 and angle >= target) or (dir < 0 and angle <= target) then angle = target end
            end
            d.springOld = d.springAngle or angle
            d.springAngle = angle
            d.outSpeed = out
            -- ComparatorBlockMixin: the share of the angle limit
            n.comparatorStrength = floor(abs(angle) / limit * 15 + 1e-6)
        end,
        values = function(n, side)
            local f = n.state.facing or "north"
            if not side or AXO[side] == AXO[f] then return nil end
            -- only while the spring is still (onlyActiveWhen isSpringStatic)
            local d = data(n)
            if (d.outSpeed or 0) ~= 0 then return nil end
            return {offset = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) + DIRV[side] * (7.5 / 16) - DIRV[f] * 0.3125, normal = DIRV[side], scale = 0.5,
                title = L("simulated.torsion_spring.angle_limit", "Max Angle"), rows = {"⟳"},
                max = 360, milestone = 45,
                format = function(_, v) return max(1, v) .. L("create.generic.unit.degrees", "°") end,
                get = function() return 0, springLimit(d) end,
                set = function(_, v) d.springLimit = max(1, v) end,
                value = function() return springLimit(d) .. L("create.generic.unit.degrees", "°") end}
        end,
    }
    -- ===== Simulated: Auger Shaft / Auger Cogwheel ============================================================================
    local AXV3 = {x = Vector3.xAxis, y = Vector3.yAxis, z = Vector3.zAxis}
    local POSDIR = {x = "east", y = "up", z = "south"}
    local NEGDIR = {x = "west", y = "down", z = "north"}
    local function isAuger(m) return m and (m.id == "auger_shaft" or m.id == "auger_cog") end
    local function nodeAt(p)
        local w = world()
        local s = w and w.sample and w.sample(p)
        return s and s.node
    end
    local function stackMax(s) local e = s and JavaContent.byIndex[s.id]; return (e and e.maxStack) or 64 end
    local function setStates(n, changes)
        local diff = false
        for k, v in pairs(changes) do if n.state[k] ~= v then diff = true; break end end
        if not diff then return end
        local st = table.clone(n.state)
        for k, v in pairs(changes) do st[k] = v end
        local w = world()
        local keep = n.ae
        pcall(w.setBlockAt, n.center, n.index, st)
        local s = w.sample(n.center); if s and s.node then s.node.ae = keep end
    end
    local function augerShape(n)
        -- AugerShaftBlock.updateShape: the section from the same block on either side along the axis, side brackets
        local axis = n.state.axis or "y"
        local function connects(dir)
            local m = nodeAt(n.center + DIRV[dir] * B)
            return m ~= nil and m.id == n.id and (m.state.axis or "y") == axis
        end
        local a, b = connects(POSDIR[axis]), connects(NEGDIR[axis])
        local section = (a and b) and "middle" or (a and "end") or (b and "front") or "single"
        local changes = {section = section}
        for dir in pairs(DIRV) do
            local m = nodeAt(n.center + DIRV[dir] * B)
            local on = false
            if m then
                if m.id:match("funnel$") and (m.state.facing == dir) then on = true
                elseif (dir == "up" or dir == "down") and (m.id == "chute" or m.id == "smart_chute") then on = true end
            end
            changes[dir] = on and "true" or "false"
        end
        setStates(n, changes)
    end
    local function augerTick(n)
        local w = world()
        local here = w and w.sample and w.sample(n.center)
        if not here or here.node ~= n then return end
        augerShape(n)
        local d = data(n)
        local speed = n.overstressed and 0 or (n.speed or 0)
        if speed == 0 then d.augerProgress = 0; d.augerFlow = false; return end
        local axis = n.state.axis or "y"
        local flow = speed > 0 and POSDIR[axis] or NEGDIR[axis]
        if not d.augerSlot then
            -- extract: the start of the flow pulls from the inventory behind it
            local back = nodeAt(n.center - DIRV[flow] * B)
            local k = K()
            local P = k and k.processing
            if back and not isAuger(back) and P and P.invOf then
                local inv = P.invOf(back, flow)
                local s = inv and inv.extract(16)
                if s then d.augerSlot = s end
            end
        end
        if not d.augerSlot then d.augerProgress = 0; d.augerFlow = false; return end
        -- getItemSpeed: one block every max(8, 8 / (|rpm| / 256)) ticks
        local ticks = math.max(8, 8 / (abs(speed) / 256))
        d.augerProgress = (d.augerProgress or 0) + 1 / ticks
        d.augerFlow = true
        if d.augerProgress < 1 then return end
        d.augerProgress = 0
        -- handleItemPassed: into the next auger along the flow
        local nxt = nodeAt(n.center + DIRV[flow] * B)
        if not isAuger(nxt) then return end
        local nd = data(nxt)
        local s = d.augerSlot
        local t = nd.augerSlot
        if t and not CreativeRules.sameItem(t, s) then return end
        local room = stackMax(s) - (t and t.count or 0)
        local m = math.min(room, s.count)
        if m <= 0 then return end
        if t then t.count = t.count + m else nd.augerSlot = CreativeRules.withCount(s, m) end
        s.count = s.count - m
        if s.count <= 0 then d.augerSlot = nil end
    end
    local function augerUse(n)
        local c = ctx()
        local s, name = held()
        local w = world()
        if name == "industrial_iron_block" and n.state.encased ~= "true" then
            setStates(n, {encased = "true"})
            sound("block.netherite_block.place", n.center, 1, 1)
            return true
        end
        if holdingWrench() then
            if n.state.encased == "true" then
                setStates(n, {encased = "false"})
                sound("block.netherite_block.break", n.center, 1, 1)
                return true
            end
            -- transformAuger: shaft <-> cog, keeping the axis
            local other = JavaContent.byId[n.id == "auger_shaft" and "auger_cog" or "auger_shaft"]
            if other then
                local keep = n.ae
                local st = {axis = n.state.axis or "y", encased = "false", section = n.state.section or "single"}
                if other.id == "auger_shaft" then for dir in pairs(DIRV) do st[dir] = n.state[dir] or "false" end end
                pcall(w.setBlockAt, n.center, other.index, st)
                local ns = w.sample(n.center); if ns and ns.node then ns.node.ae = keep end
                sound("block.copper.place", n.center, 0.8, 1.2)
                return true
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    DEF.auger_shaft = {tick = augerTick, use = augerUse}
    DEF.auger_cog = {tick = augerTick, use = augerUse}
    -- ===== Simulated: Symmetric Sails =========================================================================================
    local function symColor(id) return id and id:match("^(.-)_symmetric_sail$") end
    local function symAxisDirs(axis)
        local out = {}
        for dir in pairs(DIRV) do if AXO[dir] ~= axis then out[#out + 1] = dir end end
        return out
    end
    local function symDye(n, color, hitPos)
        local w = world()
        local e = JavaContent.byId[color .. "_symmetric_sail"]
        if not e then return false end
        local axis = n.state.axis or "y"
        local function paint(m) pcall(w.setBlockAt, m.center, e.index, {axis = m.state.axis or "y"}) end
        if symColor(n.id) ~= color then paint(n); return true end
        -- the nearest neighbour (orderedByDistanceExceptAxis from where it was hit)
        local dirs = symAxisDirs(axis)
        table.sort(dirs, function(a, b)
            return ((n.center + DIRV[a] * B * 0.5) - hitPos).Magnitude < ((n.center + DIRV[b] * B * 0.5) - hitPos).Magnitude
        end)
        for _, dir in ipairs(dirs) do
            local s = w.sample(n.center + DIRV[dir] * B)
            local m = s and s.node
            if m and symColor(m.id) and (m.state.axis or "y") == axis and symColor(m.id) ~= color then paint(m); return true end
        end
        -- all of them (100 steps)
        local frontier, visited, timeout = {n.center}, {}, 100
        local function key(p) return string.format("%d,%d,%d", floor(p.X / B + 0.5), floor(p.Y / B + 0.5), floor(p.Z / B + 0.5)) end
        while #frontier > 0 and timeout > 0 do
            timeout = timeout - 1
            local cur = table.remove(frontier, 1)
            visited[key(cur)] = true
            for _, dir in ipairs(dirs) do
                local p2 = cur + DIRV[dir] * B
                if not visited[key(p2)] then
                    local s = w.sample(p2)
                    local m = s and s.node
                    if m and symColor(m.id) and (m.state.axis or "y") == axis then
                        if symColor(m.id) ~= color then paint(m) end
                        frontier[#frontier + 1] = p2
                        visited[key(p2)] = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    local SYM = {
        use = function(n, _, hit)
            local _, name = held()
            local color = name and name:match("^(.-)_dye$")
            if not color then return nil end
            local at = (typeof(hit) == "RaycastResult" and hit.Position) or (type(hit) == "table" and hit.position) or n.center
            symDye(n, color, at)
            sound("item.dye.use", n.center, 1, 1.1 + math.random() * 0.2)
            return true
        end,
    }
    for _, c in ipairs({"white", "orange", "magenta", "light_blue", "yellow", "lime", "pink", "gray", "light_gray", "cyan", "purple",
        "blue", "brown", "green", "red", "black"}) do DEF[c .. "_symmetric_sail"] = SYM end
    -- ===== Simulated: Spring ==================================================================================================
    local springPending
    local springSeq = 0
    local SPRING_SIZES = {"small", "medium", "large"}
    local function status(text)
        local c = ctx()
        pcall(function()
            if c.ui and c.ui.actionBar then c.ui.actionBar(text) elseif c.ui and c.ui.status then c.ui.status(text) end
        end)
    end
    local function faceOf(n, normal)
        local frame = worldFrame(n)
        local loc = frame.Rotation:Inverse() * normal
        local best, bd = "up", -2
        for dir, v in pairs(DIRV) do local dd = v:Dot(loc); if dd > bd then best, bd = dir, dd end end
        return best
    end
    local function springWorldPos(center) local w = worldFrame({center = center}); return w.Position end
    local function springClick(n, hit)
        local w = world()
        local normal = ((typeof(hit) == "RaycastResult" or type(hit) == "table") and hit.Normal) or Vector3.yAxis
        local face = faceOf(n, normal)
        local target = n.center + DIRV[face] * B
        local there = w.sample(target)
        if there and there.node then status(L("simulated.spring.block_exists", "A block exists here!")); return true end
        if not springPending then
            springPending = {target = target, face = face}
            sound("block.note_block.hat", n.center, 0.5, 1.5)
            return true
        end
        local a = springPending
        springPending = nil
        if (a.target - target).Magnitude < 0.01 then status(L("simulated.spring.connection_terminated", "Selection discarded")); return true end
        local pa, pb = springWorldPos(a.target), springWorldPos(target)
        if ((pa - pb) / B).Magnitude ^ 2 > 81 then status(L("simulated.merging_glue.out_of_range", "Out of range!")); return true end
        local e = JavaContent.byId.spring
        if not e then return true end
        local st = table.clone(e.state or {})
        st.facing = a.face
        pcall(w.setBlockAt, a.target, e.index, st)
        local st2 = table.clone(e.state or {})
        st2.facing = face
        pcall(w.setBlockAt, target, e.index, st2)
        local na, nb = w.sample(a.target), w.sample(target)
        na, nb = na and na.node, nb and nb.node
        if not (na and nb) then return true end
        local len = clamp(floor(((pa - pb) / B).Magnitude / 0.25 + 0.5) * 0.25, 0.25, 9)
        springSeq = springSeq + 1
        local id = tostring(os.clock()) .. ":" .. springSeq
        na.ae = {springPartner = target, springController = true, springLength = len, springId = id, springMate = nb}
        nb.ae = {springPartner = a.target, springController = false, springLength = len, springId = id, springMate = na}
        local c = ctx()
        local s = held()
        if CONFIG.Survival and s then s.count = s.count - 1; if s.count <= 0 then c.inventory.slots[c.ui.selected] = nil end; pcall(c.ui.refresh) end
        sound("block.chain.place", target, 1, 1)
        return true
    end
    local function springPartnerNode(n)
        local d = n.ae
        if not d then return nil end
        local w = world()
        local function live(m) local s = m and w and w.sample(m.center); return s and s.node == m and m.id == "spring" end
        local m = d.springMate
        if not live(m) then
            m = nil
            if d.springId == nil then d.springMate = nil; return nil end
            -- the pair shares an id (blocks move to the ship grid when a ship assembles)
            for o in pairs(nodes) do
                if o ~= n and o.id == "spring" and o.ae and o.ae.springId == d.springId and live(o) then m = o; break end
            end
            d.springMate = m
        end
        if m then d.springPartner = m.center end
        return m
    end
    local function springBreak(n)
        local w = world()
        local m = springPartnerNode(n)
        pcall(w.setBlockAt, n.center, nil, nil, true)
        if m then pcall(w.setBlockAt, m.center, nil, nil, true) end
    end
    DEF.spring = {
        useSneaking = true,
        use = function(n, sneaking)
            local _, name = held()
            local d = data(n)
            local m = springPartnerNode(n)
            if name == "spring" then
                -- tryAdjustSpring: 0.25 longer, sneaking 0.25 shorter
                local cur = d.springLength or 1
                local want = clamp(floor((cur + (sneaking and -0.25 or 0.25)) / 0.25 + 0.5) * 0.25, 0.25, 9)
                if want == cur then
                    status((want >= 9 and L("simulated.spring.max_length", "Length at maximum (%sm)") or L("simulated.spring.min_length", "Length at minimum (%sm)")):gsub("%%s", string.format("%.2f", cur)))
                    return true
                end
                d.springLength = want
                if m then data(m).springLength = want end
                status((L("simulated.spring.new_length", "Length set to %sm"):gsub("%%s", string.format("%.2f", want))))
                sound("block.chain.step", n.center, 0.6, 1.2)
                return true
            end
            if holdingWrench() then
                local cur = n.state.size or "large"
                local nxt = "large"
                for i, v in ipairs(SPRING_SIZES) do if v == cur then nxt = SPRING_SIZES[i % 3 + 1] end end
                if m then setState(m, "size", nxt) end
                setState(n, "size", nxt)
                sound("block.chain.place", n.center, 0.5, 1)
                return true
            end
            return nil
        end,
        tick = function(n)
            local w = world()
            local here = w and w.sample and w.sample(n.center)
            if not here or here.node ~= n then return end
            local d = data(n)
            if springPartnerNode(n) then d.springAlone = 0 else d.springAlone = (d.springAlone or 0) + 1 end
            if d.springAlone >= 20 or (d.springSnap or 0) > 0.75 then springBreak(n) end
        end,
        render = function(n)
            local d = data(n)
            if not d.springController then return end
            local m = springPartnerNode(n)
            local k = K()
            visuals[n] = visuals[n] or {}
            local vs = visuals[n]
            local function drop(from)
                local i = from
                while vs["coil" .. i] do pcall(function() vs["coil" .. i].model:Destroy() end); vs["coil" .. i] = nil; i = i + 1 end
            end
            if not m or not (k and k.partialVisual) then drop(1); return end
            local f1 = DIRV[n.state.facing or "north"]
            local f2 = DIRV[m.state.facing or "north"]
            local fr1, fr2 = worldFrame(n), worldFrame(m)
            -- from the end plate of one block (0.25 out of its support) to the other's
            local a = fr1 * (-f1 * B * 0.25)
            local b = fr2 * (-f2 * B * 0.25)
            local dir = b - a
            local len = dir.Magnitude
            if len < 1e-3 then return end
            local u = dir / len
            local count = math.max(1, math.ceil(len / (B * 0.5)))
            local side = (math.abs(u.Y) < 0.9 and u:Cross(Vector3.yAxis) or u:Cross(Vector3.xAxis)).Unit
            local rot = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, side, u)
            for i = 1, count do
                local v = vs["coil" .. i]
                if not v then
                    local okV, vis = pcall(k.partialVisual, "simulated:spring/middle", n.center)
                    if okV and vis then v = vis; vs["coil" .. i] = v end
                end
                if v then place(v, CFrame.new(a + u * (len * (i - 0.5) / count)) * rot) end
            end
            drop(count + 1)
        end,
    }
    -- ===== Simulated: Contraption Diagram =====================================================================================
    local DG = "simulated:diagram"
    local DG_INK, DG_INK2, DG_TEXT = rgb(84, 74, 118), rgb(150, 140, 185), rgb(85, 64, 42)
    local function shipOfNode(n)
        for _, s in ipairs(physics.ships or {}) do
            for _, m in ipairs(s.nodes or {}) do if m == n then return s end end
        end
    end
    local function diagramScreen(s)
        local c = ctx()
        local kit = c and c.ui and c.ui.kit
        local screens = c and c.world and c.world.screens
        if not (kit and screens) then return end
        local Rigid = physics.Rigid
        local yaw, pitch = 45, 30
        local paperOpen, showMass, showCom, merged = true, true, true, true
        local hidden = {}
        local function nameOf(id)
            if id == "gravity" then return L("simulated.contraption_diagram.gravity", "Gravity") end
            local e = JavaContent.byId[id]
            return (e and e.name) or id
        end
        kit.open(function()
            local screen = kit.newScreen("contraption_diagram", 336, 192)
            local win = screen.window
            piece(win, DG, 0, 64, 256, 192, 0, 0, nil, nil, 3)
            local layer = Instance.new("Frame")
            layer.BackgroundTransparency, layer.Size, layer.ZIndex, layer.ClipsDescendants = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(256, 192), 4, true
            layer.Parent = win
            local paper = Instance.new("Frame")
            paper.BackgroundTransparency, paper.Size, paper.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(96, 128), 2
            paper.Parent = win
            piece(paper, DG, 256, 0, 96, 128, 0, 0, nil, nil, 2)
            local paperText = Instance.new("Frame")
            paperText.BackgroundTransparency, paperText.Size, paperText.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(96, 128), 3
            paperText.Parent = paper
            local tip = Instance.new("Frame")
            tip.BackgroundTransparency, tip.ZIndex = 1, 20
            tip.Parent = win
            -- buttons: forces paper, mass, centre of mass; the turn gizmo
            local buttons = {
                {x = 9, y = 9, w = 16, h = 16, u = 0, v = 48, act = function() paperOpen = not paperOpen end},
                {x = 9, y = 29, w = 16, h = 16, u = 16, v = 48, act = function() showMass = not showMass end},
                {x = 9, y = 49, w = 16, h = 16, u = 32, v = 48, act = function() showCom = not showCom end},
                {x = 236, y = 8, w = 7, h = 7, u = 224, v = 48, act = function() pitch = clamp(pitch + 45, -90, 90) end},
                {x = 236, y = 22, w = 7, h = 7, u = 208, v = 48, act = function() pitch = clamp(pitch - 45, -90, 90) end},
                {x = 228, y = 12, w = 8, h = 13, u = 192, v = 48, act = function() yaw = yaw - 45 end},
                {x = 243, y = 12, w = 8, h = 13, u = 240, v = 48, act = function() yaw = yaw + 45 end},
            }
            for _, bt in ipairs(buttons) do bt.img = piece(win, DG, bt.u, bt.v, bt.w, bt.h, bt.x, bt.y, nil, nil, 6) end
            local mergeBtn = {x = 0, y = 0, w = 16, h = 16}
            local paperX = 246
            local arrows = {}
            local function toLocalDir(b, x, y, z)
                local R = b.R
                return R[1] * x + R[4] * y + R[7] * z, R[2] * x + R[5] * y + R[8] * z, R[3] * x + R[6] * y + R[9] * z
            end
            local function project(v, scale, cx, cy)
                local cy0, sy0 = math.cos(math.rad(yaw)), math.sin(math.rad(yaw))
                local x = v.X * cy0 - v.Z * sy0
                local z = v.X * sy0 + v.Z * cy0
                local cp, sp = math.cos(math.rad(pitch)), math.sin(math.rad(pitch))
                local y = v.Y * cp - z * sp
                local depth = v.Y * sp + z * cp
                return cx + x * scale, cy - y * scale, depth
            end
            local lastKey
            local function redraw(mx, my)
                local b = s.b
                local com = Vector3.new(b.comX, b.comY, b.comZ)
                local cells, lo, hi = {}, Vector3.one * math.huge, -Vector3.one * math.huge
                for _, m in ipairs(s.nodes) do
                    local x, y, z = physics.cellOf(m.center)
                    local g = Vector3.new(x, y, z) - s.shift + Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) - com
                    cells[#cells + 1] = g
                    lo, hi = lo:Min(g), hi:Max(g)
                end
                local ext = math.max(1, (hi - lo).Magnitude)
                local scale = math.min(14, 150 / ext)
                layer:ClearAllChildren()
                -- the blueprint: the cells back to front
                local list = {}
                for _, g in ipairs(cells) do
                    local sx, sy, dz = project(g, scale, 128, 100)
                    list[#list + 1] = {sx, sy, dz}
                end
                table.sort(list, function(a, c2) return a[3] > c2[3] end)
                local size = math.max(3, floor(scale * 1.05))
                for _, q in ipairs(list) do
                    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                    f.BorderSizePixel, f.ZIndex = 0, 4
                    f.BackgroundColor3, f.BackgroundTransparency = rgb(246, 238, 216), 0
                    f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
                    f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(floor(q[1] - size / 2), floor(q[2] - size / 2))
                    local st = Instance.new("UIStroke"); st.Color, st.Thickness = DG_INK, 1; st.Parent = f
                    f.Parent = layer
                end
                -- the centre of mass
                if showCom then
                    local cx, cy = project(Vector3.zero, scale, 128, 100)
                    piece(layer, DG, 48, 48, 16, 16, floor(cx - 8), floor(cy - 8), nil, nil, 7)
                end
                -- force arrows
                arrows = {}
                local groups = {}
                local log = s.forceLog or {}
                local all = {}
                for _, q in ipairs(log) do all[#all + 1] = q end
                all[#all + 1] = {source = "gravity", gx = b.comX, gy = b.comY, gz = b.comZ, dx = 0, dy = -1, dz = 0, force = b.mass * physics.W.gravity}
                for _, q in ipairs(all) do
                    local lx, ly, lz = q.source == "gravity" and 0 or q.dx, q.source == "gravity" and -1 or q.dy, q.source == "gravity" and 0 or q.dz
                    if q.source ~= "gravity" then lx, ly, lz = toLocalDir(b, q.dx, q.dy, q.dz) else lx, ly, lz = toLocalDir(b, 0, -1, 0) end
                    local key = merged and q.source or tostring(q)
                    local gr = groups[key]
                    if not gr then gr = {source = q.source, count = 0, pos = Vector3.zero, vec = Vector3.zero, mag = 0}; groups[key] = gr end
                    gr.count = gr.count + 1
                    gr.pos = gr.pos + Vector3.new(q.gx, q.gy, q.gz)
                    gr.vec = gr.vec + Vector3.new(lx, ly, lz) * q.force
                    gr.mag = gr.mag + q.force
                end
                local maxMag = 0
                for _, gr in pairs(groups) do maxMag = math.max(maxMag, gr.vec.Magnitude) end
                for _, gr in pairs(groups) do
                    if not hidden[gr.source] and gr.vec.Magnitude > 1e-6 then
                        local at = gr.pos / gr.count - com
                        local x0, y0 = project(at, scale, 128, 100)
                        local len = 10 + 30 * math.sqrt(gr.vec.Magnitude / math.max(maxMag, 1e-6))
                        local dirV = gr.vec.Unit
                        local x1, y1 = project(at + dirV * (len / scale), scale, 128, 100)
                        local dx, dy = x1 - x0, y1 - y0
                        local l = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
                        local color = gr.source == "gravity" and rgb(200, 70, 60) or DG_INK
                        local function line(ax, ay, bx, by, w)
                            local lx, ly = bx - ax, by - ay
                            local ll = math.sqrt(lx * lx + ly * ly)
                            if ll < 0.5 then return end
                            local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                            f.BorderSizePixel, f.BackgroundColor3, f.ZIndex = 0, color, 8
                            f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                            f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ll, w)
                            f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((ax + bx) / 2, (ay + by) / 2)
                            f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(ly, lx))
                            f.Parent = layer
                        end
                        if l > 2 then
                            line(x0, y0, x1, y1, 2)
                            local ux, uy = dx / l, dy / l
                            line(x1, y1, x1 - ux * 5 - uy * 4, y1 - uy * 5 + ux * 4, 2)
                            line(x1, y1, x1 - ux * 5 + uy * 4, y1 - uy * 5 - ux * 4, 2)
                        else
                            -- along the view: in / out of the page
                            local out = (select(3, project(at + dirV, scale, 128, 100)) or 0) < (select(3, project(at, scale, 128, 100)) or 0)
                            piece(layer, DG, out and 16 or 0, 32, 16, 16, floor(x0 - 8), floor(y0 - 8), nil, nil, 8)
                        end
                        arrows[#arrows + 1] = {x0 = x0, y0 = y0, x1 = x1, y1 = y1, gr = gr}
                    end
                end
                -- the paper
                paper.Visible = paperOpen
                paper.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(paperX, 20)
                paperText:ClearAllChildren()
                local y = 8
                local function ptext(t, color) JavaGui.text(paperText, t, 16, y, color or DG_TEXT, false, 4); y = y + 10 end
                if showMass then
                    ptext(L("simulated.contraption_diagram.total_mass", "Total mass: "))
                    ptext((L("simulated.contraption_diagram.mass", "%s kpg"):gsub("%%s", string.format("%.2f", b.mass))))
                end
                ptext(L("simulated.contraption_diagram.center_of_mass", "Center of Mass: "))
                ptext(string.format("%.1f %.1f %.1f", b.px, b.py, b.pz))
                ptext(L("simulated.contraption_diagram.merge_forces", "Force Arrows: "))
                mergeBtn.x, mergeBtn.y = paperX + 14, 20 + y
                piece(paperText, DG, merged and 48 or 32, 32, 16, 16, 14, y, nil, nil, 4)
                JavaGui.text(paperText, merged and L("simulated.contraption_diagram.merged", "Merged") or L("simulated.contraption_diagram.unmerged", "Separate"), 32, y + 4, DG_TEXT, false, 4)
                y = y + 18
                local names = {}
                for _, gr in pairs(groups) do names[gr.source] = true end
                local sorted = {}
                for k in pairs(names) do sorted[#sorted + 1] = k end
                table.sort(sorted)
                screen.toggles = {}
                for _, k in ipairs(sorted) do
                    if y > 116 then break end
                    local shown = not hidden[k]
                    local label = nameOf(k)
                    if JavaGui.width(label) > 60 then label = label:sub(1, 10) .. "." end
                    JavaGui.text(paperText, label, 16, y, shown and DG_TEXT or rgb(170, 150, 120), false, 4)
                    screen.toggles[#screen.toggles + 1] = {source = k, y = 20 + y}
                    y = y + 11
                end
                -- tooltips
                tip:ClearAllChildren()
                local best
                for _, a in ipairs(arrows) do
                    local d1 = math.min((Vector2.new(mx, my) - Vector2.new(a.x0, a.y0)).Magnitude, (Vector2.new(mx, my) - Vector2.new(a.x1, a.y1)).Magnitude)
                    if d1 < 6 then best = a end
                end
                if best then
                    local gr = best.gr
                    local mag = (L("simulated.contraption_diagram.force_arrow_magnitude", "%s pN"):gsub("%%s", string.format("%.1f", gr.vec.Magnitude)))
                    local t
                    if gr.count > 1 then
                        t = L("simulated.contraption_diagram.merged_force_arrow", "%s %s forces totalling %s")
                        t = t:gsub("%%s", tostring(gr.count), 1):gsub("%%s", nameOf(gr.source), 1):gsub("%%s", mag, 1)
                    else
                        t = L("simulated.contraption_diagram.force_arrow", "%s force of %s")
                        t = t:gsub("%%s", nameOf(gr.source), 1):gsub("%%s", mag, 1)
                    end
                    local w2 = JavaGui.width(t) + 8
                    local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
                    bg.BorderSizePixel, bg.BackgroundColor3, bg.BackgroundTransparency, bg.ZIndex = 0, rgb(16, 0, 16), 0.06, 20
                    bg.Size, bg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(w2, 14), UDim2.fromOffset(mx + 10, my - 14)
                    bg.Parent = tip
                    JavaGui.text(tip, t, mx + 14, my - 11, rgb(255, 255, 255), true, 21)
                end
            end
            screens.install(screen)
            screen.onClick = function(button, x, y)
                if button ~= 1 then return false end
                for _, bt in ipairs(buttons) do
                    if x >= bt.x and x < bt.x + bt.w and y >= bt.y and y < bt.y + bt.h then
                        bt.act(); sound("ui.button.click", nil, 0.25, 1); lastKey = nil; return true
                    end
                end
                if paperOpen then
                    if x >= mergeBtn.x and x < mergeBtn.x + 16 and y >= mergeBtn.y and y < mergeBtn.y + 16 then
                        merged = not merged; sound("ui.button.click", nil, 0.25, 1); return true
                    end
                    for _, t in ipairs(screen.toggles or {}) do
                        if x >= paperX and x < paperX + 96 and y >= t.y - 1 and y < t.y + 10 then
                            hidden[t.source] = not hidden[t.source]; sound("ui.button.click", nil, 0.25, 1); return true
                        end
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            local acc = 1
            screen.onUpdate = function(x, y)
                acc = acc + 1
                -- RequestDiagramDataPacket every few ticks
                if acc >= 6 then acc = 0; pcall(redraw, x, y) end
            end
            pcall(redraw, -100, -100)
        end, function() end)
    end
    Bk.diagramScreen = diagramScreen
    local function initializeControlsAndUpdates()
        -- ===== Create: Sequenced Gearshift =========================================================================================
        local SEQ = {
            {key = "turn_angle", param = "angle", value = true, speed = true, max = 360, step = 45, default = 90, tex = {0, 16}},
            {key = "turn_distance", param = "distance", value = true, speed = true, max = 128, step = 5, default = 5, tex = {0, 16}},
            {key = "delay", param = "duration", value = true, speed = false, max = 600, step = 20, default = 10, tex = {0, 60}},
            {key = "await", value = false, speed = false, tex = {0, 162}},
            {key = "end", value = false, speed = false, tex = {0, 82}},
        }
        local SEQ_MODS = {{2, ">>", "forward_fast"}, {1, "->", "forward"}, {-1, "<-", "back"}, {-2, "<<", "back_fast"}}
        local function seqData(n)
            local d = data(n)
            if not d.seq then d.seq = {{i = 1, v = 90, m = 2}, {i = 5, v = 0, m = 2}} end
            return d
        end
        local function seqDuration(ins, rpm)
            local def = SEQ[ins.i]
            local s = abs(rpm * SEQ_MODS[ins.m][1])
            if def.key == "turn_angle" then return s == 0 and math.huge or math.ceil(ins.v / (s * 0.3)) + 2 end
            if def.key == "turn_distance" then return s == 0 and math.huge or math.ceil(ins.v / (s / 512)) + 2 end
            if def.key == "delay" then return ins.v end
            if def.key == "await" then return -1 end
            return 0
        end
        local function seqRun(n, i)
            local d = seqData(n)
            local ins = d.seq[i]
            if not ins or SEQ[ins.i].key == "end" then
                d.seqAt, d.seqDur, d.seqTimer = nil, -1, 0
                d.seqMod = 0
                setState(n, "state", "0")
                return
            end
            d.seqAt, d.seqTimer = i, 0
            d.seqDur = seqDuration(ins, n.speed or 0)
            d.seqMod = SEQ[ins.i].speed and SEQ_MODS[ins.m][1] or 0
            setState(n, "state", tostring(math.min(i, 5)))
        end
        local function seqScreen(n)
            local c = ctx()
            local kit = c and c.ui and c.ui.kit
            local screens = c and c.world and c.world.screens
            if not (kit and screens) then return end
            local d = seqData(n)
            local list = {}
            for _, ins in ipairs(d.seq) do list[#list + 1] = {i = ins.i, v = ins.v, m = ins.m} end
            local G = "create:sequencer"
            local wheelConn
            local LIGHT, TITLE = rgb(255, 255, 238), rgb(0x59, 0x24, 0x24)
            kit.open(function()
                local screen = kit.newScreen("sequenced_gearshift", 173, 161)
                local win = screen.window
                local layer = Instance.new("Frame")
                layer.BackgroundTransparency, layer.Size, layer.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(173, 161), 4
                layer.Parent = win
                local tip = Instance.new("Frame"); tip.BackgroundTransparency, tip.ZIndex = 1, 20; tip.Parent = win
                local function redraw(mx, my)
                    layer:ClearAllChildren()
                    piece(layer, G, 0, 0, 173, 161, 0, 0, nil, nil, 3)
                    local title = L("create.gui.sequenced_gearshift.title", "Sequenced Gearshift")
                    JavaGui.text(layer, title, floor((173 - JavaGui.width(title)) / 2), 4, TITLE, false, 6)
                    for row = 1, 5 do
                        local y = 16 + (row - 1) * 22
                        local ins = list[row]
                        if not ins then piece(layer, G, 0, 104, 162, 22, 0, y, nil, nil, 4)
                        else
                            local def = SEQ[ins.i]
                            piece(layer, G, def.tex[1], def.tex[2], 162, 22, 0, y, nil, nil, 4)
                            JavaGui.text(layer, tostring(row), 10, y + 7, LIGHT, true, 6)
                            JavaGui.text(layer, L("create.gui.sequenced_gearshift.instruction." .. def.key, def.key), 34, y + 7, LIGHT, true, 6)
                            if def.value then
                                local txt = tostring(ins.v)
                                if def.key == "turn_angle" then txt = ins.v .. "°"
                                elseif def.key == "turn_distance" then txt = ins.v .. "m"
                                elseif def.key == "delay" then txt = ins.v < 20 and (ins.v .. "t") or (string.format("%g", ins.v / 20) .. "s") end
                                JavaGui.text(layer, txt, 92, y + 7, LIGHT, true, 6)
                            end
                            if def.speed then JavaGui.text(layer, SEQ_MODS[ins.m][2], 124, y + 7, LIGHT, true, 6) end
                        end
                    end
                    -- the item, big, beside the sheet (renderAdditional)
                    -- tooltip for the hovered box
                    tip:ClearAllChildren()
                    local row = math.floor((my - 16) / 22) + 1
                    local ins = list[row]
                    if ins and my >= 16 then
                        local def = SEQ[ins.i]
                        local t
                        if mx >= 30 and mx < 80 then t = L("create.gui.sequenced_gearshift.instruction." .. def.key .. ".descriptive", def.key)
                        elseif mx >= 88 and mx < 116 and def.value then t = L("create.gui.sequenced_gearshift.instruction." .. def.key .. "." .. def.param, def.param)
                        elseif mx >= 118 and mx < 146 and def.speed then t = L("create.gui.sequenced_gearshift.speed." .. SEQ_MODS[ins.m][3], "") end
                        if t and t ~= "" then
                            local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
                            bg.BorderSizePixel, bg.BackgroundColor3, bg.BackgroundTransparency, bg.ZIndex = 0, rgb(16, 0, 16), 0.06, 20
                            bg.Size, bg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(JavaGui.width(t) + 8, 14), UDim2.fromOffset(mx + 10, my - 14)
                            bg.Parent = tip
                            JavaGui.text(tip, t, mx + 14, my - 11, rgb(255, 255, 255), true, 21)
                        end
                    end
                end
                local function change(row, field, delta, shift)
                    local ins = list[row]
                    if not ins then return end
                    local def = SEQ[ins.i]
                    if field == "i" then
                        local ni = ((ins.i - 1 + delta) % #SEQ) + 1
                        ins.i = ni
                        local nd = SEQ[ni]
                        if nd.value then ins.v = nd.default end
                        -- the last row: a new End follows anything but End; End drops the rows after it
                        if nd.key == "end" then for k = #list, row + 1, -1 do table.remove(list, k) end
                        elseif row == #list and #list < 5 then list[#list + 1] = {i = 5, v = 0, m = 2} end
                    elseif field == "v" and def.value then
                        local step = shift and def.step or 1
                        ins.v = math.clamp(ins.v + delta * step, 1, def.max)
                    elseif field == "m" and def.speed then
                        ins.m = ((ins.m - 1 + delta) % 4) + 1
                    end
                    sound("ui.button.click", nil, 0.15, 1.6)
                end
                local function at(x, y)
                    if y < 16 then return end
                    local row = math.floor((y - 16) / 22) + 1
                    if row < 1 or row > 5 then return end
                    local field = (x >= 30 and x < 80 and "i") or (x >= 88 and x < 116 and "v") or (x >= 118 and x < 146 and "m") or nil
                    return row, field
                end
                screens.install(screen)
                local mouse = Vector2.new(-100, -100)
                screen.onClick = function(button, x, y)
                    -- the confirm button (bottom right)
                    if button == 1 and x >= 173 - 33 and x < 173 - 15 and y >= 161 - 24 and y < 161 - 6 then
                        task.defer(function() if c.ui.open then c.ui.toggle() end end)
                        return true
                    end
                    local row, field = at(x, y)
                    if not field then return false end
                    local shift = UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
                    change(row, field, button == 1 and 1 or -1, shift)
                    redraw(x, y)
                    return true
                end
                local wheel = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then return end
                    local row, field = at(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
                    if not field then return end
                    local shift = UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
                    change(row, field, input.Position.Z > 0 and 1 or -1, shift)
                    redraw(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
                end)
                wheelConn = wheel
                local acc = 0
                screen.onUpdate = function(x, y)
                    mouse = Vector2.new(x, y)
                    acc = acc + 1
                    if acc % 4 == 0 then redraw(x, y) end
                end
                redraw(-100, -100)
            end, function()
                -- ConfigureSequencedGearshiftPacket: the sequence is stored and stops
                if wheelConn then wheelConn:Disconnect(); wheelConn = nil end
                d.seq = list
                seqRun(n, 0)
            end)
        end
        DEF.sequenced_gearshift = {
            use = function(n)
                if holdingWrench() then return nil end
                seqScreen(n)
                return true
            end,
            tick = function(n)
                local w = world()
                local here = w and w.sample and w.sample(n.center)
                if not here or here.node ~= n then return end
                local d = seqData(n)
                local powered = (n.input or 0) > 0
                -- onRedstoneUpdate / risingFlank
                if powered and not d.seqPowered then
                    if d.seqAt == nil then
                        if (n.speed or 0) ~= 0 then seqRun(n, 1) end
                    elseif d.seq[d.seqAt] and SEQ[d.seq[d.seqAt].i].key == "await" then
                        seqRun(n, d.seqAt + 1)
                    end
                end
                d.seqPowered = powered
                if d.seqAt == nil then d.seqMod = 0; return end
                if (d.seqDur or 0) < 0 then return end
                if d.seqTimer < d.seqDur then d.seqTimer = d.seqTimer + 1; return end
                seqRun(n, d.seqAt + 1)
            end,
        }
        -- ===== Create: Threshold Switch ===========================================================================================
        local VSLOTS = {chest = 27, trapped_chest = 27, barrel = 27, hopper = 5, dispenser = 9, dropper = 9, furnace = 3, smoker = 3, blast_furnace = 3}
        local function thTarget(n)
            local t = n.state.target or "ceiling"
            local side = t == "floor" and "down" or (t == "ceiling" and "up" or OPP[n.state.facing or "north"])
            local w = world()
            local s = w and w.sample(n.center + DIRV[side] * B)
            return s and s.node
        end
        local function thLevel(n, d)
            local m = thTarget(n)
            if not m then return nil end
            local size = VSLOTS[m.id] or (m.id:match("shulker_box$") and 27) or nil
            local slots
            if size then slots = m.storage and m.storage.slots or {}
            elseif m.cr and m.cr.slots and m.id == "item_vault" then size, slots = 20, m.cr.slots end
            if not size then return nil end
            local count, cap = 0, size * 64
            for i = 1, size do
                local s = slots[i]
                if s and (not d.thFilter or CreativeRules.sameItem(s, d.thFilter)) then count = count + s.count end
            end
            return count, cap
        end
        local function thScreen(n)
            local c = ctx()
            local kit = c and c.ui and c.ui.kit
            local screens = c and c.world and c.world.screens
            if not (kit and screens) then return end
            local d = data(n)
            local G = "create:threshold_switch"
            local LIGHT, TITLE, DARK = rgb(255, 255, 238), rgb(0x59, 0x24, 0x24), rgb(0x3d, 0x3c, 0x48)
            local wheelConn
            local mouse = Vector2.new(-100, -100)
            kit.open(function()
                local screen = kit.newScreen("threshold_switch", 182, 103)
                local win = screen.window
                local layer = Instance.new("Frame")
                layer.BackgroundTransparency, layer.Size, layer.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(182, 103), 4
                layer.Parent = win
                local function unit() return d.thStacks and 64 or 1 end
                local function fmt(v) return tostring(math.floor(v / unit())) end
                local function redraw(mx, my)
                    layer:ClearAllChildren()
                    piece(layer, G, 0, 0, 182, 103, 0, 0, nil, nil, 3)
                    local title = L("create.gui.threshold_switch.title", "Threshold Switch")
                    JavaGui.text(layer, title, floor((182 - JavaGui.width(title)) / 2), 4, TITLE, false, 6)
                    local count, cap = thLevel(n, d)
                    for row = 0, 1 do
                        local y = 21 + row * 24
                        piece(layer, G, 0, 105, 115, 22, 44, y, nil, nil, 4)
                        local v = row == 0 and (d.thAbove or 128) or (d.thBelow or 0)
                        JavaGui.text(layer, (row == 0 and "≥ " or "≤ ") .. fmt(v), 54, y + 7, LIGHT, true, 6)
                        local u = d.thStacks and L("create.schedule.condition.threshold.stacks", "Stacks") or L("create.schedule.condition.threshold.items", "Items")
                        JavaGui.text(layer, u, 101, y + 7, LIGHT, true, 6)
                        -- the state lamp: the row that applies now
                        local on = (d.thPowered and row == 1) or (not d.thPowered and row == 0)
                        if on then piece(layer, G, 0, 153, 24, 24, 20, y - 1, nil, nil, 5) end
                        local lamp = Instance.new("Frame")
                        lamp.BackgroundTransparency, lamp.Size, lamp.Position, lamp.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), UDim2.fromOffset(24, y + 2), 6
                        lamp.Parent = layer
                        local torch = JavaContent.byId[row == 0 and "redstone_torch" or "redstone_torch"]
                        if torch then pcall(JavaContent.icon, lamp, torch.index) end
                        if row == 1 then pcall(function() lamp.ItemIcon.ImageColor3 = rgb(120, 120, 120) end) end
                    end
                    -- the filter slot
                    local slot = Instance.new("Frame")
                    slot.BackgroundTransparency, slot.Size, slot.Position, slot.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), UDim2.fromOffset(13, 80), 6
                    slot.Parent = layer
                    if d.thFilter then pcall(JavaContent.icon, slot, d.thFilter.id) end
                    local cur
                    if count then cur = (L("create.gui.threshold_switch.currently", "Currently %1$s"):gsub("%%1%$s", fmt(count)))
                    else cur = L("create.gui.threshold_switch.not_attached", "Not attached to a block") end
                    JavaGui.text(layer, cur, 34, 84, DARK, false, 6)
                    -- tooltips
                    local t
                    if my >= 21 and my < 43 and mx >= 20 and mx < 159 then t = L("create.gui.threshold_switch.power_on_when", "Power on when...") .. " " .. L("create.gui.threshold_switch.upper_threshold", "...at or above:")
                    elseif my >= 45 and my < 67 and mx >= 20 and mx < 159 then t = L("create.gui.threshold_switch.power_off_when", "Power off when...") .. " " .. L("create.gui.threshold_switch.lower_threshold", "...at or below:")
                    elseif mx >= 120 and mx < 138 and my >= 79 and my < 97 then t = L("create.gui.threshold_switch.invert_signal", "Invert Signal") .. (d.thInverted and " (on)" or "")
                    elseif mx >= 13 and mx < 29 and my >= 80 and my < 96 then t = L("create.schedule.condition.threshold.place_item", "Reference Item") end
                    if t then
                        local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
                        bg.BorderSizePixel, bg.BackgroundColor3, bg.BackgroundTransparency, bg.ZIndex = 0, rgb(16, 0, 16), 0.06, 20
                        bg.Size, bg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(JavaGui.width(t) + 8, 14), UDim2.fromOffset(mx + 10, my - 14)
                        bg.Parent = layer
                        JavaGui.text(layer, t, mx + 14, my - 11, rgb(255, 255, 255), true, 21)
                    end
                end
                local function bump(row, field, delta, shift)
                    if field == "unit" then d.thStacks = not d.thStacks
                    else
                        local key = row == 0 and "thAbove" or "thBelow"
                        local step = unit() * (shift and (d.thStacks and 10 or 64) or 1)
                        local _, cap = thLevel(n, d)
                        d[key] = math.clamp((d[key] or (row == 0 and 128 or 0)) + delta * step, 0, cap or 1000 * 64)
                        if (d.thBelow or 0) > (d.thAbove or 128) then if row == 0 then d.thBelow = d.thAbove else d.thAbove = d.thBelow end end
                    end
                    sound("ui.button.click", nil, 0.15, 1.6)
                end
                local function at(x, y)
                    local row = (y >= 21 and y < 43) and 0 or ((y >= 45 and y < 67) and 1 or nil)
                    if not row then return end
                    if x >= 44 and x < 96 then return row, "value" elseif x >= 96 and x < 159 then return row, "unit" end
                end
                screens.install(screen)
                screen.onClick = function(button, x, y)
                    local shift = UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
                    if x >= 149 and x < 167 and y >= 79 and y < 97 then task.defer(function() if c.ui.open then c.ui.toggle() end end); return true end
                    if x >= 120 and x < 138 and y >= 79 and y < 97 then d.thInverted = not d.thInverted; sound("ui.button.click", nil, 0.25, 1); redraw(x, y); return true end
                    if x >= 13 and x < 29 and y >= 80 and y < 96 then
                        local s = held()
                        d.thFilter = s and CreativeRules.withCount(s, 1) or nil
                        sound("ui.button.click", nil, 0.25, 1); redraw(x, y); return true
                    end
                    local row, field = at(x, y)
                    if not row then return false end
                    bump(row, field, button == 1 and 1 or -1, shift)
                    redraw(x, y)
                    return true
                end
                wheelConn = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then return end
                    local row, field = at(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
                    if not row then return end
                    bump(row, field, input.Position.Z > 0 and 1 or -1, UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift))
                    redraw(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
                end)
                local acc = 0
                screen.onUpdate = function(x, y)
                    mouse = Vector2.new(x, y)
                    acc = acc + 1
                    if acc % 4 == 0 then redraw(x, y) end
                end
                redraw(-100, -100)
            end, function() if wheelConn then wheelConn:Disconnect(); wheelConn = nil end end)
        end
        DEF.stockpile_switch = {
            use = function(n)
                if holdingWrench() then return nil end
                thScreen(n)
                return true
            end,
            tick = function(n)
                local w = world()
                local here = w and w.sample and w.sample(n.center)
                if not here or here.node ~= n then return end
                local d = data(n)
                local count, cap = thLevel(n, d)
                if count then
                    -- the hysteresis between the two thresholds
                    if count >= (d.thAbove or 128) then d.thPowered = true
                    elseif count <= (d.thBelow or 0) then d.thPowered = false end
                    setState(n, "level", tostring(math.clamp(math.floor(count / math.max(cap, 1) * 5 + 0.5), 0, 5)))
                else
                    d.thPowered = false
                end
                local out = (d.thPowered ~= (d.thInverted == true)) and 15 or 0
                emit(n, out, nil, nil)
            end,
        }
        -- ===== Create: Clipboard =================================================================================================
        local CLIP_INK, CLIP_DONE, CLIP_BOX, CLIP_TICK = rgb(0x31, 0x1A, 0x00), rgb(0x8D, 0x7F, 0x6B), rgb(0x8D, 0x7F, 0x6B), rgb(0x31, 0xB2, 0x5D)
        local function clipScreen(owner, onSave)
            local c = ctx()
            local kit = c and c.ui and c.ui.kit
            local screens = c and c.world and c.world.screens
            if not (kit and screens) then return end
            owner.clipboard = owner.clipboard or {pages = {{}}}
            local pages = owner.clipboard.pages
            local page = 1
            local editing
            local field
            local G = "create:clipboard"
            kit.open(function()
                local screen = kit.newScreen("clipboard", 256, 256)
                local win = screen.window
                local layer = Instance.new("Frame")
                layer.BackgroundTransparency, layer.Size, layer.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(256, 256), 4
                layer.Parent = win
                local function entries() pages[page] = pages[page] or {}; return pages[page] end
                local function stopEditing()
                    if field then
                        local list = entries()
                        if editing and list[editing] then list[editing].t = field.text end
                        pcall(function() field.box:Destroy() end)
                        for i, wdg in ipairs(screen.widgets or {}) do if wdg == field then table.remove(screen.widgets, i) break end end
                        field = nil
                    end
                    editing = nil
                end
                local redraw
                local function edit(i)
                    stopEditing()
                    local list = entries()
                    if not list[i] then return end
                    editing = i
                    field = screens.textField(screen, 56, 50 + (i - 1) * 9 - 1, 154, 10, {text = list[i].t, maxLength = 40, color = CLIP_INK,
                        shadow = false, inset = 2,
                        onChange = function(t) if list[i] then list[i].t = t end end,
                        onEnter = function()
                            if #list < 15 then table.insert(list, i + 1, {t = "", c = false}); task.defer(function() edit(i + 1); redraw() end) end
                        end})
                    field.focus()
                end
                redraw = function()
                    layer:ClearAllChildren()
                    piece(layer, G, 0, 0, 256, 256, 0, 0, nil, nil, 3)
                    local total = math.max(#pages, page)
                    local ind = (L("book.pageIndicator", "Page %1$s of %2$s"):gsub("%%1%$s", tostring(page)):gsub("%%2%$s", tostring(total)))
                    JavaGui.text(layer, ind, 200 - JavaGui.width(ind), 39, CLIP_DONE, false, 5)
                    for i, e in ipairs(entries()) do
                        local y = 50 + (i - 1) * 9
                        local box = Instance.new("Frame")
                        box.BackgroundTransparency, box.Size, box.Position, box.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7), UDim2.fromOffset(45, y), 5
                        local st = Instance.new("UIStroke"); st.Color, st.Thickness = CLIP_BOX, 1; st.Parent = box
                        box.Parent = layer
                        if e.c then JavaGui.text(layer, "x", 46, y - 1, CLIP_TICK, false, 6) end
                        if editing ~= i then JavaGui.text(layer, e.t, 58, y, e.c and CLIP_DONE or CLIP_INK, false, 5) end
                    end
                    -- the buttons: erase checked, close (create:icons), page arrows
                    local function icon(ix, iy, x, y) piece(layer, "create:icons", ix * 16, iy * 16, 16, 16, x, y, nil, nil, 6) end
                    icon(4, 7, 234, 153)
                    icon(4, 0, 234, 175)
                    if page > 1 then JavaGui.text(layer, "<", 56, 229, CLIP_INK, false, 6) end
                    if page < 50 then JavaGui.text(layer, ">", 180, 229, CLIP_INK, false, 6) end
                end
                screens.install(screen)
                screen.onClick = function(button, x, y)
                    if button ~= 1 then return false end
                    if x >= 234 and x < 250 and y >= 153 and y < 169 then
                        -- ClipboardScreen: erase the checked entries on every page
                        stopEditing()
                        for pi, list in ipairs(pages) do
                            for i = #list, 1, -1 do if list[i].c then table.remove(list, i) end end
                        end
                        sound("ui.button.click", nil, 0.25, 1); redraw(); return true
                    end
                    if x >= 234 and x < 250 and y >= 175 and y < 191 then task.defer(function() if c.ui.open then c.ui.toggle() end end); return true end
                    if y >= 226 and y < 240 and x >= 50 and x < 66 and page > 1 then stopEditing(); page = page - 1; sound("item.book.page_turn", nil, 1, 1); redraw(); return true end
                    if y >= 226 and y < 240 and x >= 174 and x < 190 and page < 50 then
                        stopEditing()
                        if #entries() == 0 and page >= #pages then return true end
                        page = page + 1; pages[page] = pages[page] or {}
                        sound("item.book.page_turn", nil, 1, 1); redraw(); return true
                    end
                    local list = entries()
                    if x >= 40 and x < 210 and y >= 50 and y < 50 + 15 * 9 then
                        local i = math.floor((y - 50) / 9) + 1
                        if list[i] then
                            if x < 56 then list[i].c = not list[i].c; sound("ui.button.click", nil, 0.2, list[i].c and 1.5 or 0.8); stopEditing()
                            else edit(i) end
                        elseif #list < 15 then
                            list[#list + 1] = {t = "", c = false}
                            edit(#list)
                        end
                        redraw(); return true
                    end
                    stopEditing(); redraw()
                    return false
                end
                redraw()
            end, function()
                stopEditing()
                -- drop empty trailing pages, then save
                for i = #pages, 2, -1 do if #pages[i] == 0 then table.remove(pages, i) else break end end
                local any = false
                for _, list in ipairs(pages) do if #list > 0 then any = true end end
                owner.clipboard.written = any
                if onSave then pcall(onSave, any) end
            end)
        end
        Bk.clipScreen = clipScreen
        DEF.clipboard = {
            use = function(n, sneaking)

            end,

        -- ===== Create: Toolbox ===================================================================================================
        -- the eight 24 x 24 boxes of the sheet, clockwise from the top (item at box + 4)
        local TB_RING = {{82, 31}, {115, 37}, {121, 70}, {115, 103}, {82, 109}, {49, 103}, {43, 70}, {49, 37}}
        local function tbData(n)
            local d = data(n)
            d.tb = d.tb or {}
            for i = 1, 8 do d.tb[i] = d.tb[i] or {filter = nil, count = 0} end
            return d.tb
        end
        local function tbMax(stack) local e = stack and JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]; return ((e and e.maxStack) or 64) * 4 end
        local function tbInsert(tb, stack)
            -- a matching compartment first, then an empty one
            local left = stack.count
            for pass = 1, 2 do
                for i = 1, 8 do
                    local cpt = tb[i]
                    if left > 0 and ((pass == 1 and cpt.filter and CreativeRules.sameItem(cpt.filter, stack)) or (pass == 2 and not cpt.filter)) then
                        if not cpt.filter then cpt.filter = CreativeRules.withCount(stack, 1) end
                        local m = math.min(tbMax(stack) - cpt.count, left)
                        cpt.count = cpt.count + m; left = left - m
                    end
                end
            end
            return left
        end
        local function tbScreen(n)
            local c = ctx()
            local kit = c and c.ui and c.ui.kit
            local screens = c and c.world and c.world.screens
            if not (kit and screens) then return end
            local tb = tbData(n)
            local inv = c.inventory
            kit.open(function()
                local screen = kit.newScreen("toolbox", 188, 171)
                local win = screen.window
                local layer = Instance.new("Frame")
                layer.BackgroundTransparency, layer.Size, layer.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(188, 171), 4
                layer.Parent = win
                local function redraw(mx, my)
                    layer:ClearAllChildren()
                    piece(layer, "create:toolbox", 0, 0, 188, 171, 0, 0, nil, nil, 3)
                    local e = JavaContent.byId[n.id]
                    local title = (e and e.name) or "Toolbox"
                    JavaGui.text(layer, title, floor((188 - JavaGui.width(title)) / 2), 4, rgb(0x59, 0x24, 0x24), false, 6)
                    for i, off in ipairs(TB_RING) do
                        local cpt = tb[i]
                        local x, y = off[1], off[2]
                        if cpt.filter then
                            local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                            f.BackgroundTransparency, f.Size, f.Position, f.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), 6
                            f.Parent = layer
                            pcall(JavaContent.icon, f, cpt.filter.id)
                            if cpt.count == 0 then pcall(function() f.ItemIcon.ImageTransparency = 0.6 end) end
                            local t = tostring(cpt.count)
                            JavaGui.text(layer, t, x + 17 - JavaGui.width(t), y + 9, rgb(255, 255, 255), true, 8)
                        end
                        if mx >= x - 1 and mx < x + 17 and my >= y - 1 and my < y + 17 then
                            local hl = Instance.new("Frame")
                            hl.BorderSizePixel, hl.BackgroundColor3, hl.BackgroundTransparency, hl.ZIndex = 0, rgb(255, 255, 255), 0.5, 7
                            hl.Size, hl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
                            hl.Parent = layer
                        end
                    end
                end
                screens.install(screen)
                screen.onClick = function(button, x, y)
                    for i, off in ipairs(TB_RING) do
                        local sx, sy = off[1], off[2]
                        if x >= sx - 1 and x < sx + 17 and y >= sy - 1 and y < sy + 17 then
                            local cpt = tb[i]
                            local s = inv.slots[c.ui.selected]
                            local sneaking = UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)
                            if s and (not cpt.filter or CreativeRules.sameItem(cpt.filter, s)) then
                                if not cpt.filter then cpt.filter = CreativeRules.withCount(s, 1) end
                                local m = math.min(tbMax(s) - cpt.count, s.count)
                                cpt.count = cpt.count + m; s.count = s.count - m
                                if s.count <= 0 then inv.slots[c.ui.selected] = nil end
                            elseif not s and cpt.filter and cpt.count > 0 then
                                local want = sneaking and cpt.count or math.min(cpt.count, tbMax(cpt.filter) / 4)
                                local added = tonumber(inv.add(cpt.filter.id, want, nil, cpt.filter.damage, cpt.filter)) or 0
                                cpt.count = cpt.count - added
                            elseif not s and cpt.filter and cpt.count == 0 and button ~= 1 then
                                cpt.filter = nil
                            end
                            sound("ui.button.click", nil, 0.2, 1.4)
                            pcall(c.ui.refresh)
                            redraw(x, y)
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                    return false
                end
                local acc = 0
                screen.onUpdate = function(x, y) acc = acc + 1; if acc % 3 == 0 then redraw(x, y) end end
                redraw(-100, -100)
            end, function() end)
        end
        local function isToolbox(id) return id and id:match("_toolbox$") ~= nil end
        -- the radial menu (RadialToolboxMenu): hold Left Alt
        local radial
        local function nearestToolbox()
            local c = ctx()
            local root = c and c.character and c.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then return nil end
            local best, bd
            for m in pairs(nodes) do
                if isToolbox(m.id) then
                    local dd = (worldFrame(m).Position - root.Position).Magnitude / B
                    if dd <= 10 and (not bd or dd < bd) then best, bd = m, dd end
                end
            end
            return best
        end
        local function radialTick()
            local down = UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt)
            local c = ctx()
            if down and not radial and not (c and c.ui and c.ui.open) then
                local n = nearestToolbox()
                if not n then return end
                local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
                gui.Name, gui.IgnoreGuiInset, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.DisplayOrder = "SteveToolboxRadial", true, false, 40
                gui.Parent = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
                radial = {gui = gui, node = n, sel = nil, items = {}}
                local tb = tbData(n)
                local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
                for i = 1, 8 do
                    local ang = (i - 1) / 8 * math.pi * 2 - math.pi / 2
                    local f = Instance.new("Frame")
                    f.AnchorPoint, f.Size = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44)
                    f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(vp.X / 2 + math.cos(ang) * 90, vp.Y / 2 + math.sin(ang) * 90)
                    f.BackgroundColor3, f.BackgroundTransparency, f.BorderSizePixel = rgb(30, 30, 30), 0.4, 0
                    f.Parent = gui
                    local icon = Instance.new("Frame"); icon.BackgroundTransparency, icon.Size, icon.Position = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32), UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6); icon.Parent = f
                    if tb[i].filter then pcall(JavaContent.icon, icon, tb[i].filter.id) end
                    radial.items[i] = f
                end
            elseif radial and down then
                -- the compartment the mouse points at
                local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
                local m = UIS:GetMouseLocation() - vp / 2
                local sel
                if m.Magnitude > 30 then
                    local ang = math.atan2(m.Y, m.X) + math.pi / 2
                    sel = (math.floor(ang / (math.pi * 2) * 8 + 0.5) % 8) + 1
                end
                radial.sel = sel
                for i, f in ipairs(radial.items) do f.BackgroundTransparency = (i == sel) and 0.05 or 0.4 end
            elseif radial and not down then
                local r = radial
                radial = nil
                r.gui:Destroy()
                if not r.sel then return end
                local tb = tbData(r.node)
                local cpt = tb[r.sel]
                local inv = c.inventory
                local held0 = inv.slots[c.ui.selected]
                -- the held item goes back first, then a stack comes out
                if held0 then
                    local left = tbInsert(tb, held0)
                    if left > 0 then held0.count = left; return end
                    inv.slots[c.ui.selected] = nil
                end
                if cpt.filter and cpt.count > 0 then
                    local m = math.min(cpt.count, tbMax(cpt.filter) / 4)
                    inv.slots[c.ui.selected] = CreativeRules.withCount(cpt.filter, m)
                    cpt.count = cpt.count - m
                end
                sound("item.armor.equip_generic", nil, 0.6, 1.2)
                pcall(c.ui.refresh)
            end
        end
