        ;(function() -- own function: the module is at Luau's 200-register limit
        -- ===== Create: filters ===================================================================================================
        local FUELS = {coal = 1, charcoal = 1, coal_block = 1, blaze_rod = 1, lava_bucket = 1, stick = 1, dried_kelp_block = 1, bamboo = 1}
        local function itemName(s) local e = s and JavaContent.byIndex[s.id]; return e and (e.itemId or e.id) end
        local function inTag(name, tag)
            local list = JavaContent.data.itemTags and JavaContent.data.itemTags[tag]
            if not list then return false end
            for _, v in ipairs(list) do if v == name or v == "minecraft:" .. name then return true end end
            return false
        end
        local function tagsOf(name)
            local out = {}
            for tag, list in pairs(JavaContent.data.itemTags or {}) do
                for _, v in ipairs(list) do if v == name then out[#out + 1] = tag; break end end
            end
            table.sort(out)
            return out
        end
        local function cookable(name, kind)
            local list = JavaContent.data.recipes and JavaContent.data.recipes.cooking and JavaContent.data.recipes.cooking[kind]
            for _, r in ipairs(list or {}) do if Recipes.matches(r.i, name) then return true end end
            return false
        end
        -- ItemAttribute types (the ones these items can have)
        local ATTR = {
            placeable = function(s) local e = JavaContent.byIndex[s.id]; return e ~= nil and not e.itemOnly end,
            consumable = function(s) local n = itemName(s); return inTag(n, "c:foods") or inTag(n, "minecraft:foods") end,
            not_stackable = function(s) local e = JavaContent.byIndex[s.id]; return e ~= nil and (e.maxStack or 64) == 1 end,
            damaged = function(s) return (s.damage or 0) > 0 end,
            enchanted = function(s) return s.enchantments ~= nil and next(s.enchantments) ~= nil end,
            furnace_fuel = function(s) local n = itemName(s) or ""; return FUELS[n] ~= nil or n:match("_planks$") ~= nil or n:match("_log$") ~= nil end,
            smeltable = function(s) return cookable(itemName(s), "smelting") end,
            blastable = function(s) return cookable(itemName(s), "blasting") end,
            smokable = function(s) return cookable(itemName(s), "smoking") end,
            added_by = function(s, arg) local e = JavaContent.byIndex[s.id]; return ((e and e.mod) or "minecraft") == arg end,
            in_tag = function(s, arg) return inTag(itemName(s), arg) end,
        }
        local ATTR_ORDER = {"placeable", "consumable", "not_stackable", "damaged", "enchanted", "furnace_fuel", "smeltable", "blastable", "smokable"}
        local function attrText(a)
            local key = "create.item_attributes." .. a.key .. (a.inv and ".inverted" or "")
            return (L(key, a.key):gsub("%%1%$s", tostring(a.arg or "")))
        end
        local function attrsFor(s)
            local out = {}
            for _, k in ipairs(ATTR_ORDER) do if ATTR[k](s) then out[#out + 1] = {key = k} end end
            local e = JavaContent.byIndex[s.id]
            out[#out + 1] = {key = "added_by", arg = (e and e.mod) or "minecraft"}
            for _, t in ipairs(tagsOf(itemName(s))) do out[#out + 1] = {key = "in_tag", arg = t} end
            return out
        end
        local filterTest
        filterTest = function(f, s)
            if not f then return true end
            if not s then return false end
            local fid = itemName(f)
            if fid == "filter" then
                local fd = f.filterData or {items = {}}
                local any = false
                for i = 1, 18 do
                    local it = fd.items[i]
                    if it then
                        local m
                        local iid = itemName(it)
                        if iid == "filter" or iid == "attribute_filter" then m = filterTest(it, s)
                        elseif fd.respect then m = CreativeRules.sameItem(it, s)
                        else m = it.id == s.id end
                        if m then any = true; break end
                    end
                end
                if fd.deny then return not any end
                return any
            elseif fid == "attribute_filter" then
                local ad = f.attrData or {mode = "any", list = {}}
                local list = ad.list or {}
                if #list == 0 then return ad.mode == "deny" end
                local function has(a) local fn = ATTR[a.key]; local r = fn and fn(s, a.arg) or false; if a.inv then r = not r end; return r end
                if ad.mode == "all" then for _, a in ipairs(list) do if not has(a) then return false end end; return true end
                local any = false
                for _, a in ipairs(list) do if has(a) then any = true; break end end
                if ad.mode == "deny" then return not any end
                return any
            end
            return CreativeRules.sameItem(f, s) or f.id == s.id
        end
        JavaContent.filterTest = filterTest

        local function filterButtons(layer, list, state)
            for _, b in ipairs(list) do
                piece(layer, "create:icons", b.icon[1] * 16, b.icon[2] * 16, 16, 16, b.x + 1, b.y + 1, nil, nil, 6)
                if b.on and b.on() then
                    local hl = Instance.new("Frame")
                    hl.BackgroundTransparency, hl.Size, hl.Position, hl.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), UDim2.fromOffset(b.x, b.y), 7
                    local st = Instance.new("UIStroke"); st.Color, st.Thickness = rgb(255, 230, 120), 1; st.Parent = hl
                    hl.Parent = layer
                end
            end
        end

            for _, b in ipairs(list) do
                if b.tip and mx >= b.x and mx < b.x + 18 and my >= b.y and my < b.y + 18 then
                    local t = b.tip()
                    local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
                    bg.BorderSizePixel, bg.BackgroundColor3, bg.BackgroundTransparency, bg.ZIndex = 0, rgb(16, 0, 16), 0.06, 20
                    bg.Size, bg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(JavaGui.width(t) + 8, 14), UDim2.fromOffset(mx + 10, my - 14)
                    bg.Parent = layer
                    JavaGui.text(layer, t, mx + 14, my - 11, rgb(255, 255, 255), true, 21)
                end
            end
        end

        ;(function() -- Create: Linked Controller (own function: register limit)
        local KEYS = {Enum.KeyCode.W, Enum.KeyCode.S, Enum.KeyCode.A, Enum.KeyCode.D, Enum.KeyCode.Space, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift}

            local col, row = (i - 1) % 6, math.floor((i - 1) / 6)

        end
        local function heldController()
            local s, name = held()
            if name == "linked_controller" then s.ctrl = s.ctrl or {freq = {}}; return s end
        end
        local pressed = {}
        -- six transmitters that follow the player and the held controller
        local function addTransmitters()
            for i = 1, 6 do
                links[#links + 1] = {
                    controller = true,
                    key = function()
                        local s = heldController()
                        if not s then return "" end
                        return Bk.links.freqKey(s.ctrl.freq[i], s.ctrl.freq[i + 6])
                    end,
                    power = function()
                        local s = heldController()
                        if not (s and s.ctrl.active and pressed[i]) then return 0 end
                        if not (s.ctrl.freq[i] or s.ctrl.freq[i + 6]) then return 0 end
                        return 15
                    end,
                    pos = function()
                        local c = ctx()
                        local root = c and c.character and c.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        return root and root.Position or Vector3.zero
                    end,
                }
            end
        end
        local added = false
        function Bk.controllerTick()
            if not added then added = true; addTransmitters() end
            local s = heldController()
            local c = ctx()
            local typing = UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil or (c and c.ui and c.ui.open)
            for i, k in ipairs(KEYS) do
                local fake = rawget(_G, "__ctrlFake")

                if down ~= (pressed[i] or false) and down then sound("ui.button.click", nil, 0.2, 1.2) end
                pressed[i] = down
            end
        end

        ;(function() -- Create: Wand of Symmetry (own function: register limit)
        local TYPES = {
            {key = "plane", lang = "create.symmetry.mirror.plane", aligns = {{"create.orientation.alongZ", "Along Z"}, {"create.orientation.alongX", "Along X"}}},
            {key = "cross_plane", lang = "create.symmetry.mirror.doublePlane", aligns = {{"create.orientation.orthogonal", "Orthogonal"}, {"create.orientation.diagonal", "Diagonal"}}},
            {key = "triple_plane", lang = "create.symmetry.mirror.triplePlane", aligns = {{"create.orientation.horizontal", "Horizontal"}}},
        }
        -- the maps (dx, dz) -> (dx', dz') of each mirror
        local function maps(sym)
            local t, a = sym.t or 1, sym.a or 1
            local mx = function(x, z) return -x, z end
            local mz = function(x, z) return x, -z end
            local both = function(x, z) return -x, -z end
            local d1 = function(x, z) return z, x end
            local d2 = function(x, z) return -z, -x end
            local r1 = function(x, z) return -z, x end
            local r2 = function(x, z) return z, -x end
            if t == 1 then return {a == 1 and mz or mx} end
            if t == 2 then if a == 1 then return {mx, mz, both} else return {d1, d2, both} end end
            return {mx, mz, both, d1, d2, r1, r2}
        end
        local DIRS = {north = {0, -1}, south = {0, 1}, east = {1, 0}, west = {-1, 0}}
        local function mapState(st, f)
            local s = table.clone(st)
            for _, k in ipairs({"facing", "horizontal_facing"}) do
                local d = DIRS[s[k] or ""]
                if d then
                    local x, z = f(d[1], d[2])
                    for name, v in pairs(DIRS) do if v[1] == x and v[2] == z then s[k] = name end end
                end
            end
            if s.axis == "x" or s.axis == "z" then
                local x, z = f(s.axis == "x" and 1 or 0, s.axis == "z" and 1 or 0)
                s.axis = (math.abs(x) == 1) and "x" or "z"
            end
            return s
        end
        local function activeWand()
            local c = ctx()
            local inv = c and c.inventory
            if not inv then return nil end
            for i = 1, 9 do
                local s = inv.slots[i]
                local e = s and JavaContent.byIndex[s.id]
                if e and (e.itemId or e.id) == "wand_of_symmetry" and s.sym and s.sym.pos then return s end
            end
        end
        local mirroring = false
        local hooked
        local function nearPlayer(pos)
            local c = ctx()
            local root = c and c.character and c.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            return root and (pos - root.Position).Magnitude < 8 * B
        end
        local function eachMirror(wand, pos, fn)
            local m = wand.sym.pos
            local d = (pos - m) / B
            local dx, dy, dz = math.floor(d.X + 0.5), math.floor(d.Y + 0.5), math.floor(d.Z + 0.5)
            for _, f in ipairs(maps(wand.sym)) do
                local x, z = f(dx, dz)
                if x ~= dx or z ~= dz then
                    local target = m + Vector3.new(x, dy, z) * B
                    if (target - m).Magnitude < 50 * B then fn(target, f) end
                end
            end
        end
        local function hook()
            local w = world()
            if not w or hooked == w then return end
            hooked = w
            -- SymmetryHandler.onBlockPlaced: the player's placement, copied to the mirrored places
            local origPlace = w.place
            w.place = function(index, position, ...)
                local r = table.pack(origPlace(index, position, ...))
                local wand = not mirroring and r[1] and activeWand()
                if wand and nearPlayer(position) then
                    mirroring = true
                    pcall(function()
                        local c = ctx()
                        local s0 = w.sample(position)
                        local placed = s0 and s0.node
                        eachMirror(wand, position, function(target, f)
                            local here = w.sample(target)
                            if here and here.node then return end
                            if CONFIG.Survival then
                                local e = JavaContent.byIndex[index]
                                local item = e and JavaContent.itemById[e.itemId or e.id]
                                local found = false
                                for i = 1, 36 do
                                    local s = c.inventory.slots[i]
                                    if s and item and s.id == item.index then s.count = s.count - 1; if s.count <= 0 then c.inventory.slots[i] = nil end; found = true; break end
                                end
                                if not found then return end
                            end
                            w.setBlockAt(target, index, placed and mapState(placed.state, f) or nil)
                        end)
                        pcall(function() c.ui.refresh() end)
                    end)
                    mirroring = false
                end
                return table.unpack(r, 1, r.n)
            end
            -- SymmetryHandler.onBlockDestroyed: the same block at the mirrored places goes too
            local origBreak = w.breakBlock
            w.breakBlock = function(hit, harvest, lootContext, ...)
                local n = not mirroring and not lootContext and hit and hit.Instance and w.resolve(hit.Instance)
                local id, center = n and n.id, n and n.center
                local r = table.pack(origBreak(hit, harvest, lootContext, ...))
                local wand = id and r[1] and activeWand()
                if wand and nearPlayer(center) then
                    mirroring = true
                    pcall(function()
                        eachMirror(wand, center, function(target)
                            local here = w.sample(target)
                            if here and here.node and here.node.id == id then w.setBlockAt(target, nil, nil, true) end
                        end)
                    end)
                    mirroring = false
                end
                return table.unpack(r, 1, r.n)
            end
        end
        local effect, effectKey
        function Bk.symmetryTick()
            hook()
            -- the mirror's model while the wand is held
            local s, name = held()
            local sym = name == "wand_of_symmetry" and s.sym
            local key = sym and sym.pos and (tostring(sym.pos) .. sym.t .. sym.a) or nil
            if key ~= effectKey then
                effectKey = key
                if effect then pcall(function() effect.model:Destroy() end); effect = nil end
                local k = K()
                if key and k and k.partialVisual then
                    local okV, v = pcall(k.partialVisual, "symmetry_effect/" .. ({"plane", "crossplane", "tripleplane"})[sym.t], sym.pos)
                    if okV and v then
                        effect = v
                        for _, d in ipairs(v.model:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.Transparency = math.max(d.Transparency, 0.3) end end
                    end
                end
            end
            if effect and sym then
                local yaw = (sym.t == 1 and sym.a == 2) and math.pi / 2 or ((sym.t == 2 and sym.a == 2) and math.pi / 4 or 0)
                local bob = math.sin(os.clock() * 2) * 0.05 * B
                place(effect, CFrame.new(sym.pos + Vector3.new(0, bob, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0))
            end
        end
        local function wandScreen(stack)
            local c = ctx()
            local kit = c and c.ui and c.ui.kit
            local screens = c and c.world and c.world.screens
            if not (kit and screens) then return end
            local sym = stack.sym
            local wheel
            kit.open(function()
                local screen = kit.newScreen("wand_of_symmetry", 188, 101)
                local win = screen.window
                local layer = Instance.new("Frame")
                layer.BackgroundTransparency, layer.Size, layer.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(188, 101), 4
                layer.Parent = win
                local function redraw()
                    layer:ClearAllChildren()
                    piece(layer, "create:curiosities", 0, 131, 188, 101, 0, 0, nil, nil, 3)
                    local e = JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
                    local title = (e and e.name) or "Wand of Symmetry"
                    JavaGui.text(layer, title, floor((188 - JavaGui.width(title)) / 2), 4, rgb(0x59, 0x24, 0x24), false, 6)
                    local tp = TYPES[sym.t]
                    JavaGui.text(layer, L(tp.lang, tp.key), 51, 26, rgb(255, 255, 255), true, 6)
                    local al = tp.aligns[math.min(sym.a, #tp.aligns)]
                    JavaGui.text(layer, L(al[1], al[2]), 51, 48, rgb(255, 255, 255), true, 6)
                end
                local function bump(which, delta)
                    if which == 1 then sym.t = ((sym.t - 1 + delta) % #TYPES) + 1; sym.a = 1
                    else sym.a = ((sym.a - 1 + delta) % #TYPES[sym.t].aligns) + 1 end
                    sound("ui.button.click", nil, 0.15, 1.6)
                    redraw()
                end
                local function at(x, y)
                    if x >= 45 and x < 154 and y >= 21 and y < 39 then return 1 end
                    if x >= 45 and x < 154 and y >= 43 and y < 61 then return 2 end
                end
                screens.install(screen)
                local mouse = Vector2.new(-100, -100)
                screen.onClick = function(button, x, y)
                    if x >= 155 and x < 173 and y >= 77 and y < 95 then task.defer(function() if c.ui.open then c.ui.toggle() end end); return true end
                    local which = at(x, y)
                    if not which then return false end
                    bump(which, button == 1 and 1 or -1)
                    return true
                end
                screen.onUpdate = function(x, y) mouse = Vector2.new(x, y) end
                wheel = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then return end
                    local which = at(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
                    if which then bump(which, input.Position.Z > 0 and 1 or -1) end
                end)
                redraw()
            end, function() if wheel then wheel:Disconnect() end end)
        end
        function Bk.symmetryUse(stack, sneaking, hit, n)
            stack.sym = stack.sym or {t = 1, a = 1}
            if sneaking then wandScreen(stack); return true end
            if n and hit then
                local normal = (typeof(hit) == "RaycastResult" or type(hit) == "table") and hit.Normal or Vector3.yAxis
                local best, bd = Vector3.yAxis, -2
                for _, v in pairs(DIRV) do local dd = v:Dot(normal); if dd > bd then best, bd = v, dd end end
                stack.sym.pos = n.center + best * B
                sound("block.beacon.activate", n.center, 0.3, 2)
            else
                stack.sym.pos = nil
                sound("block.beacon.deactivate", nil, 0.3, 2)
            end
            return true
        end

        ;(function() -- Create: Worldshaper (own function: register limit)
        local BRUSHES = {
            {key = "cuboid", params = {{"Width", 1, 32, 3}, {"Height", 1, 32, 3}, {"Length", 1, 32, 3}}},
            {key = "sphere", params = {{"Radius", 0, 10, 2}}},
            {key = "cylinder", params = {{"Radius", 0, 8, 2}, {"Height", 1, 8, 2}}},
            {key = "surface", params = {{"Range", 1, 10, 3}}, dynamic = true, surface = true},
            {key = "cluster", params = {{"Range", 1, 10, 3}}, dynamic = true},
        }
        local TOOLS = {{"fill", {7, 2}}, {"place", {8, 2}}, {"replace", {9, 2}}, {"clear", {10, 2}}, {"overlay", {11, 2}}, {"flatten", {12, 2}}}
        local PLACEMENTS = {{"merged", {4, 2}}, {"attached", {5, 2}}, {"inserted", {6, 2}}}
        local function cfg(stack)
            stack.shaper = stack.shaper or {brush = 1, params = {3, 3, 3}, tool = 1, placement = 1, diag = false, fuzzy = false}
            return stack.shaper
        end
        local function shapeOffsets(c)
            local b = BRUSHES[c.brush]
            local out = {}
            if b.key == "cuboid" then
                local sx, sy, sz = c.params[1], c.params[2], c.params[3]
                for x = 0, sx - 1 do for y = 0, sy - 1 do for z = 0, sz - 1 do
                    out[#out + 1] = Vector3.new(x - math.floor(sx / 2), y - math.floor(sy / 2), z - math.floor(sz / 2))
                end end end
            elseif b.key == "sphere" then
                local r = c.params[1]
                for x = -r, r do for y = -r, r do for z = -r, r do
                    if Vector3.new(x, y, z).Magnitude < r + 0.5 then out[#out + 1] = Vector3.new(x, y, z) end
                end end end
            elseif b.key == "cylinder" then
                local r, h = c.params[1], c.params[2]
                for x = -r, r do for z = -r, r do if x * x + z * z < (r + 0.5) ^ 2 then
                    for y = 0, h - 1 do out[#out + 1] = Vector3.new(x, y - math.floor(h / 2), z) end
                end end end
            end
            return out
        end
        local function extentAlong(c, face)
            local b = BRUSHES[c.brush]
            local f = Vector3.new(math.abs(face.X), math.abs(face.Y), math.abs(face.Z))
            if b.key == "cuboid" then return math.floor((f.X * c.params[1] + f.Y * c.params[2] + f.Z * c.params[3]) / 2) end
            if b.key == "cylinder" then return f.Y > 0.5 and math.floor(c.params[2] / 2) or c.params[1] end
            return c.params[1]
        end
        local function apply(stack, n, face)
            local c = cfg(stack)
            local w = world()
            if not w then return end
            local mat = c.material and JavaContent.byIndex[c.material]
            local b = BRUSHES[c.brush]
            local center = n.center
            local positions = {}
            if b.dynamic then
                -- DynamicBrush: the connected blocks of the clicked material (surface: only those next to air)
                local range = c.params[1]
                local seen, queue = {}, {n.center}
                local function key(p) return string.format("%d,%d,%d", math.floor(p.X / B + 0.5), math.floor(p.Y / B + 0.5), math.floor(p.Z / B + 0.5)) end
                seen[key(n.center)] = true
                local dirs = {}
                for dx = -1, 1 do for dy = -1, 1 do for dz = -1, 1 do
                    local k = math.abs(dx) + math.abs(dy) + math.abs(dz)
                    if k == 1 or (c.diag and k > 1) then dirs[#dirs + 1] = Vector3.new(dx, dy, dz) end
                end end end
                while #queue > 0 and #positions < 4096 do
                    local p = table.remove(queue, 1)
                    local s = w.sample(p)
                    local m = s and s.node
                    if m and (c.fuzzy or m.id == n.id) and (p - n.center).Magnitude <= range * B + 0.01 then
                        local exposed = false
                        for _, d in ipairs({Vector3.xAxis, -Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.yAxis, -Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.zAxis, -Vector3.zAxis}) do
                            local o = w.sample(p + d * B); if not (o and o.node) then exposed = true; break end
                        end
                        if not b.surface or exposed then positions[#positions + 1] = p end
                        for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
                            local q = p + d * B
                            local k = key(q)
                            if not seen[k] then seen[k] = true; queue[#queue + 1] = q end
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                -- PlacementOptions
                if c.placement == 2 then center = center + face * B * (extentAlong(c, face) + 1)
                elseif c.placement == 3 then center = center - face * B * extentAlong(c, face) end
                for _, o in ipairs(shapeOffsets(c)) do positions[#positions + 1] = center + o * B end
            end
            local tool = TOOLS[c.tool][1]
            if b.dynamic and (tool == "fill" or tool == "place" or tool == "flatten") then tool = "replace" end
            local count = 0
            for _, p in ipairs(positions) do
                if count > 4096 then break end
                local s = w.sample(p)
                local solid = s and s.node
                if tool == "clear" then if solid then pcall(w.setBlockAt, p, nil); count = count + 1 end
                elseif tool == "fill" then if not solid and mat then pcall(w.setBlockAt, p, mat.index, table.clone(mat.state or {})); count = count + 1 end
                elseif tool == "place" then if mat then pcall(w.setBlockAt, p, mat.index, table.clone(mat.state or {})); count = count + 1 end
                elseif tool == "replace" then if solid and mat then pcall(w.setBlockAt, p, mat.index, table.clone(mat.state or {})); count = count + 1 end
                elseif tool == "overlay" then
                    local above = w.sample(p + Vector3.yAxis * B)
                    if solid and not (above and above.node) and mat then pcall(w.setBlockAt, p + Vector3.yAxis * B, mat.index, table.clone(mat.state or {})); count = count + 1 end
                elseif tool == "flatten" then
                    if p.Y > center.Y + 0.01 then if solid then pcall(w.setBlockAt, p, nil) end
                    elseif not solid and mat then pcall(w.setBlockAt, p, mat.index, table.clone(mat.state or {})) end
                    count = count + 1
                end
            end
            sound("block.beacon.deactivate", n.center, 0.4, 2)
        end
        local function shaperScreen(stack)
            local c0 = ctx()
            local kit = c0 and c0.ui and c0.ui.kit
            local screens = c0 and c0.world and c0.world.screens
            if not (kit and screens) then return end

                    f.Parent = layer
                    if c.material then
                        local item = JavaContent.byIndex[c.material]

                        local pdef = b.params[i]
                        local x = 57 + (i - 1) * 20
                        if pdef then
                            local t = tostring(c.params[i] or pdef[4])
                            JavaGui.text(layer, t, x + 9 - floor(JavaGui.width(t) / 2), 45, rgb(255, 255, 255), true, 6)
                        else
                            piece(layer, "create:curiosities", 238, 0, 18, 18, x - 1, 39, nil, nil, 5)
                        end
                    end
                    for i, t in ipairs(TOOLS) do
                        local x, y = 158 + ((i - 1) % 3) * 18, 21 + math.floor((i - 1) / 3) * 18
                        local supported = not b.dynamic or t[1] == "replace" or t[1] == "clear" or t[1] == "overlay"
                        icon(t[2][1], t[2][2], x, y, c.tool == i, not supported)
                    end
                    if b.dynamic then
                        icon(2, 7, 7, 79, c.diag)
                        icon(3, 7, 25, 79, c.fuzzy)
                    else
                        for i, pl in ipairs(PLACEMENTS) do icon(pl[2][1], pl[2][2], 136 + (i - 1) * 18 - 72, 79, c.placement == i) end
                    end
                end
                local function bumpParam(i, delta, shift)
                    local b = BRUSHES[c.brush]
                    local pdef = b.params[i]
                    if not pdef then return end
                    c.params[i] = math.clamp((c.params[i] or pdef[4]) + delta * (shift and 5 or 1), pdef[2], pdef[3])
                end
                local function at(x, y)
                    if x >= 56 and x < 133 and y >= 20 and y < 38 then return "brush" end
                    for i = 1, 3 do local px = 57 + (i - 1) * 20; if x >= px - 1 and x < px + 18 and y >= 39 and y < 58 then return "param", i end end
                end
                screens.install(screen)
                screen.onClick = function(button, x, y)
                    local shift = UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)
                    if x >= 201 and x < 219 and y >= 79 and y < 97 then task.defer(function() if c0.ui.open then c0.ui.toggle() end end); return true end
                    local what, i = at(x, y)
                    if what == "brush" then
                        c.brush = ((c.brush - 1 + (button == 1 and 1 or -1)) % #BRUSHES) + 1
                        c.params = {}
                        for k, pdef in ipairs(BRUSHES[c.brush].params) do c.params[k] = pdef[4] end
                        redraw(); return true
                    elseif what == "param" then bumpParam(i, button == 1 and 1 or -1, shift); redraw(); return true end
                    for k = 1, #TOOLS do
                        local tx, ty = 158 + ((k - 1) % 3) * 18, 21 + math.floor((k - 1) / 3) * 18
                        if x >= tx and x < tx + 18 and y >= ty and y < ty + 18 then c.tool = k; sound("ui.button.click", nil, 0.25, 1); redraw(); return true end
                    end
                    local b = BRUSHES[c.brush]
                    if b.dynamic then
                        if x >= 7 and x < 25 and y >= 79 and y < 97 then c.diag = not c.diag; redraw(); return true end
                        if x >= 25 and x < 43 and y >= 79 and y < 97 then c.fuzzy = not c.fuzzy; redraw(); return true end
                    else
                        for k = 1, 3 do
                            local px = 136 + (k - 1) * 18 - 72
                            if x >= px and x < px + 18 and y >= 79 and y < 97 then c.placement = k; redraw(); return true end
                        end
                    end
                    return false
                end
                screen.onUpdate = function(x, y) mouse = Vector2.new(x, y) end
                wheel = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then return end

                    if what == "param" then bumpParam(i, input.Position.Z > 0 and 1 or -1, UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)); redraw() end

        local function lookNode(range)
            local w = world()
            if not (w and w.eye and w.look) then return nil end
            local c = ctx()
            local rp = RaycastParams.new()
            rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {c and c.character}
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(w.eye(), w.look() * range * B, rp)
            local center = hit and hit.Instance:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter")
            local s = center and w.sample(center)
            return s and s.node, hit
        end
        function Bk.shaperUse(stack, sneaking)
            if sneaking then shaperScreen(stack); return true end
            local n, hit = lookNode(128)
            if not n then return false end
            local best, bd = Vector3.yAxis, -2
            for _, v in pairs(DIRV) do local dd = v:Dot(hit.Normal); if dd > bd then best, bd = v, dd end end
            apply(stack, n, best)
            return true
        end

            local s, name = held()
            if name == "handheld_worldshaper" then
                if pressed then
                    local n = lookNode(128)
                    if n then
                        cfg(s).material = n.index
                        local e = JavaContent.byIndex[n.index]
                        pcall(function() local cc = ctx(); if cc.ui.actionBar then cc.ui.actionBar((L("create.terrainzapper.usingBlock", "Using: %1$s"):gsub("%%1%$s", (e and e.name) or n.id))) end end)
                        sound("block.note_block.hat", n.center, 0.5, 1.5)
                    end
                end
                return true
            end
            if prevMine then return prevMine(pressed) end
            return false
        end
        -- other mods (Realistic Water) set the hook too: keep ours first, chained to theirs

        ;(function() -- Create: Display Link + nixie tubes (own function: register limit)
        local pending

        local function sourceOf(n)

        local function bar(frac, len)
            local full = math.floor(frac * len + 0.5)
            return string.rep("|", full) .. string.rep(".", len - full)
        end
        local SOURCES = {
            {key = "count_items", ok = function(m) return VSL[m.id] ~= nil or (m.id:match("shulker_box$") ~= nil) or m.id == "item_vault" end,
                read = function(m)

                end},
            {key = "fill_level", ok = function(m) return VSL[m.id] ~= nil or m.id == "item_vault" end,

            {key = "kinetic_stress", ok = function(m) return m.network ~= nil or m.id == "stressometer" end,

                read = function(m, opt)
                    local net = m.network
                    local st, cap = net and net.stress or 0, net and net.capacity or 0
                    if opt == 1 then return bar(cap > 0 and math.min(1, st / cap) or 0, 10)
                    elseif opt == 2 then return (cap > 0 and math.floor(st / cap * 100 + 0.5) or 0) .. "%"
                    elseif opt == 3 then return math.floor(st) .. "su"
                    elseif opt == 4 then return math.floor(math.max(0, cap - st)) .. "su" end
                    return math.floor(cap) .. "su"
                end},
            {key = "time_of_day", ok = function(m) return m.id == "cuckoo_clock" or m.id == "mysterious_cuckoo_clock" end,

                    if opt == 2 then return string.format("%02d:%02d", hours, mins) end

                    return string.format("%d:%02d %s", h12, mins, hours < 12 and "AM" or "PM")
                end},

        local function available(m)
            local out = {}
            if not m then return out end
            for i, s in ipairs(SOURCES) do if s.ok(m) then out[#out + 1] = i end end

        -- nixie rows: tubes side by side (perpendicular to their facing), 2 characters each
        local function nixieRow(m)
            local w = world()
            local f = m.state.facing or "north"
            -- the two tubes stand along the facing, and so does the row
            local right = DIRV[f]
            local row = {m}
            local p = m.center
            for _ = 1, 16 do
                p = p + right * B
                local s = w.sample(p)
                if s and s.node and isNixie(s.node.id) then row[#row + 1] = s.node else break end
            end
            return row
        end
        local function nixieDraw(m)
            local d = data(m)
            local text = d.nixie or ""
            local back = d.nixieBack or text
            visuals[m] = visuals[m] or {}
            local vs = visuals[m]
            if d.nixieShown == text .. "|" .. back and vs.nixieText then return end
            d.nixieShown = text .. "|" .. back
            if vs.nixieText then pcall(function() vs.nixieText.model:Destroy() end); vs.nixieText = nil end
            if text == "" then return end
            local f = m.state.facing or "north"
            local frame = worldFrame(m)
            local along = DIRV[f]
            local side = along:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
            local color = rgb(255, 154, 60)
            local c = m.id:match("^(.-)_nixie_tube$")
            local tints = {white = rgb(255, 255, 255), red = rgb(255, 80, 80), blue = rgb(90, 140, 255), green = rgb(110, 230, 110), yellow = rgb(255, 230, 90),
                cyan = rgb(80, 230, 230), lime = rgb(170, 255, 90), pink = rgb(255, 150, 200), purple = rgb(190, 110, 255), magenta = rgb(255, 100, 255),
                light_blue = rgb(130, 200, 255), orange = rgb(255, 154, 60), gray = rgb(170, 170, 170), light_gray = rgb(210, 210, 210), black = rgb(90, 90, 90), brown = rgb(200, 140, 90)}
            if c and tints[c] then color = tints[c] end
            local model = Instance.new("Model")
            model.Name = "NixieText"
            for _, sgn in ipairs({1, -1}) do
                -- a text plane just outside the glass on each side, the characters in reading order for that side
                local part = Instance.new("Part")
                part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.Transparency = true, false, false, false, 1
                part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 0.6, 0.02) * B
                local normal = side * sgn
                part.CFrame = frame * CFrame.lookAt(normal * 0.2 * B - Vector3.new(0, 0.05 * B, 0), normal * 2 * B - Vector3.new(0, 0.05 * B, 0))
                local sg = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
                sg.Face, sg.CanvasSize, sg.LightInfluence = Enum.NormalId.Front, Vector2.new(32, 19), 0
                sg.Parent = part
                local holder = Instance.new("Frame"); holder.BackgroundTransparency, holder.Size = 1, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1); holder.Parent = sg
                -- the viewer's right on this side
                local viewRight = Vector3.yAxis:Cross(normal)
                local str = viewRight:Dot(along) > 0 and text or back
                for i = 1, 2 do
                    local ch = str:sub(i, i)
                    local slot = i - 1
                    if ch ~= "" and ch ~= " " then JavaGui.text(holder, ch, slot * 16 + 8 - math.floor(JavaGui.width(ch) / 2), 6, color, false, 2) end
                end
                part.Parent = model
            end
            local part = model
            part.Parent = workspace
            vs.nixieText = {model = part, parts = {}}
        end
        local function writeTarget(t, d, text)
            local w = world()
            if isNixie(t.id) then
                local row = nixieRow(t)
                local L = #row
                for i, m in ipairs(row) do
                    local dm = data(m)
                    dm.nixie = text:sub((i - 1) * 2 + 1, (i - 1) * 2 + 2)
                    -- seen from the other side the row runs the other way
                    dm.nixieBack = text:sub((L - i) * 2 + 1, (L - i) * 2 + 2)
                end
            elseif isSign(t.id) then
                t.sign = t.sign or {front = {lines = {"", "", "", ""}, color = "black"}, back = {lines = {"", "", "", ""}, color = "black"}}
                local line = math.clamp(d.dlLine or 1, 1, 4)
                if t.sign.front.lines[line] ~= text then
                    t.sign.front.lines[line] = text:sub(1, 15)
                    if w.blocks and w.blocks.drawSign then pcall(w.blocks.drawSign, t) end
                end
            end
        end
        local function linkScreen(n)
            local c = ctx()
            local kit = c and c.ui and c.ui.kit
            local screens = c and c.world and c.world.screens
            if not (kit and screens) then return end
            local d = data(n)
            kit.open(function()
                local screen = kit.newScreen("display_link", 235, 162)
                local win = screen.window
                local layer = Instance.new("Frame")
                layer.BackgroundTransparency, layer.Size, layer.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(235, 162), 4
                layer.Parent = win
                local function redraw()
                    layer:ClearAllChildren()
                    piece(layer, "create:display_link", 0, 0, 235, 162, 0, 0, nil, nil, 3)
                    JavaGui.text(layer, L("create.display_link.title", "Display Link"), floor((235 - JavaGui.width(L("create.display_link.title", "Display Link"))) / 2), 4, rgb(0x59, 0x24, 0x24), false, 6)
                    local src, tgt = sourceOf(n), targetOf(d)
                    local function iconOf(m, x, y)
                        if not m then return end
                        local e = JavaContent.byIndex[m.index]
                        local ie = e and JavaContent.itemById[e.itemId or e.id]
                        local f = Instance.new("Frame"); f.BackgroundTransparency, f.Size, f.Position, f.ZIndex = 1, UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), 6; f.Parent = layer
                        if ie then pcall(JavaContent.icon, f, ie.index) end
                    end
                    iconOf(src, 37, 26); iconOf(tgt, 37, 105)
                    local list = available(src)
                    local si = list[d.dlSource or 1] and SOURCES[list[d.dlSource or 1]]
                    local light, grey = rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(0xD3, 0xD3, 0xD3)
                    JavaGui.text(layer, si and L("create.display_source." .. si.key, si.key) or L("create.display_link.no_source", "Not a Display Source"), 65, 30, si and light or grey, true, 6)
                    if si and si.opts then
                        local o = si.opts[d.dlOpt or 1] or si.opts[1]
                        JavaGui.text(layer, "> " .. L(o, o), 65, 50, light, true, 6)
                    end
                    local tt
                    if tgt and isSign(tgt.id) then tt = L("create.display_link.display_on", "Write data to:") .. " " .. (d.dlLine or 1)
                    elseif tgt and isNixie(tgt.id) then tt = JavaContent.byIndex[tgt.index] and JavaContent.byIndex[tgt.index].name or tgt.id
                    else tt = L("create.display_link.no_target", "Not a Display Target") end
                    JavaGui.text(layer, tt, 65, 109, tgt and light or grey, true, 6)
                end
                screens.install(screen)
                screen.onClick = function(button, x, y)
                    local dir = button == 1 and 1 or -1
                    if x >= 202 and x < 220 and y >= 138 and y < 156 then task.defer(function() if c.ui.open then c.ui.toggle() end end); return true end
                    if x >= 61 and x < 196 and y >= 26 and y < 42 then
                        local list = available(sourceOf(n))
                        if #list > 0 then d.dlSource = (((d.dlSource or 1) - 1 + dir) % #list) + 1; d.dlOpt = 1 end
                        redraw(); return true
                    end
                    if x >= 61 and x < 196 and y >= 46 and y < 62 then
                        local list = available(sourceOf(n))
                        local si = list[d.dlSource or 1] and SOURCES[list[d.dlSource or 1]]
                        if si and si.opts then d.dlOpt = (((d.dlOpt or 1) - 1 + dir) % #si.opts) + 1 end
                        redraw(); return true
                    end
                    if x >= 61 and x < 196 and y >= 105 and y < 121 then d.dlLine = (((d.dlLine or 1) - 1 + dir) % 4) + 1; redraw(); return true end
                    return false
                end
                redraw()
            end, function() d.dlRefresh = 0 end)
        end
        DEF.display_link = {
            use = function(n) linkScreen(n); return true end,
            tick = function(n)
                local d = data(n)
                if not d.dlTarget and pending and (pending - n.center).Magnitude <= 64 * B then d.dlTarget = pending; pending = nil end
                d.dlRefresh = (d.dlRefresh or 0) - 1
                if d.dlRefresh > 0 then return end
                d.dlRefresh = 20
                if (n.input or 0) > 0 then return end
                local src, tgt = sourceOf(n), targetOf(d)
                if not (src and tgt) then return end
                local list = available(src)
                local si = list[d.dlSource or 1] and SOURCES[list[d.dlSource or 1]]
                if not si then return end
                local okR, text = pcall(si.read, src, d.dlOpt or 1)
                if okR and text then writeTarget(tgt, d, tostring(text)) end
            end,
        }
        local NIXIE = {render = function(m) nixieDraw(m) end}
        DEF.nixie_tube = NIXIE
        for _, col in ipairs({"white", "orange", "magenta", "light_blue", "yellow", "lime", "pink", "gray", "light_gray", "cyan", "purple",
            "blue", "brown", "green", "red", "black"}) do DEF[col .. "_nixie_tube"] = NIXIE end
        function Bk.displayLinkSelect(n)
            if isSign(n.id) or isNixie(n.id) then
                pending = n.center
                pcall(function() local cc = ctx(); if cc.ui.actionBar then cc.ui.actionBar(L("create.display_link.set", "Targeted position selected")) end end)
                sound("block.note_block.hat", n.center, 0.5, 1.5)
                return true
            end
            return false
        end
        end)()
        ;(function() -- Simulated: Plunger Launcher (own function: register limit)
        physics.plungers = physics.plungers or {}
        local plungers = {}
        local waiting
        local folder
        local function makeVisual()
            if not folder or not folder.Parent then folder = Instance.new("Folder"); folder.Name = "StevePlungers"; folder.Parent = workspace end
            local m = Instance.new("Model")
            local cup = Instance.new("Part")
            cup.Shape, cup.Size = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.12, 0.42, 0.42) * B
            cup.Color, cup.Material = Color3.fromRGB(168, 38, 42), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            local stick = Instance.new("Part")
            stick.Shape, stick.Size = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.45, 0.1, 0.1) * B
            stick.Color, stick.Material = Color3.fromRGB(150, 108, 64), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            for _, q in ipairs({cup, stick}) do q.Anchored, q.CanCollide, q.CanQuery, q.CanTouch = true, false, false, false; q.Parent = m end
            m.Parent = folder
            return {model = m, cup = cup, stick = stick}
        end
        local function ropeVisual()
            local r = Instance.new("Part")
            r.Anchored, r.CanCollide, r.CanQuery, r.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
            r.Color, r.Material, r.Size = Color3.fromRGB(110, 88, 60), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 1) * B
            r.Parent = folder
            return r
        end
        local function worldEnd(e)
            if e.stuck then
                local pe = physics.plungerEnd
                if pe and e.node then local q = pe(e); return O() + (q - Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)) * B end
            end
            return e.pos
        end
        local function clearAll()
            for _, e in ipairs(plungers) do pcall(function() e.vis.model:Destroy() end) end
            for _, pr in ipairs(physics.plungers) do if pr.rope then pcall(function() pr.rope:Destroy() end) end end
            plungers, waiting = {}, nil
            table.clear(physics.plungers)
        end
        function Bk.plungerUse(stack, sneaking)
            if sneaking then
                clearAll()
                pcall(function() local cc = ctx(); if cc.ui.actionBar then cc.ui.actionBar(L("simulated.plunger_launcher.clear_plungers", "Cleared launched plungers!")) end end)
                sound("entity.item.pickup", nil, 0.6, 0.8)
                return true
            end
            local w = world()
            if not (w and w.eye and w.look) then return false end
            local c = ctx()
            local eye, look = w.eye(), w.look()
            local rp = RaycastParams.new()
            rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {c and c.character, folder}
            local hit = workspace:Raycast(eye, look * 48 * B, rp)
            local e = {pos = eye + look * B * 0.8, dir = look, vis = makeVisual(), flight = 0}
            if hit then
                local center = hit.Instance:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter")
                local s = center and w.sample(center)
                e.target = hit.Position
                e.dist = (hit.Position - eye).Magnitude
                if s and s.node then
                    local best, bd = Vector3.yAxis, -2
                    local xf = physics.transformFor and physics.transformFor(s.node.center)
                    local ln = xf and xf.Rotation:Inverse() * hit.Normal or hit.Normal
                    for _, v in pairs(DIRV) do local dd = v:Dot(ln); if dd > bd then best, bd = v, dd end end
                    e.node, e.normal = s.node, best
                end
            else
                e.target, e.dist = eye + look * 48 * B, 48 * B
            end
            plungers[#plungers + 1] = e
            if waiting then
                local pr = {waiting, e}
                pr.rope = ropeVisual()
                table.insert(physics.plungers, pr)
                waiting = nil
            else
                waiting = e
            end
            sound("entity.firework_rocket.launch", eye, 0.8, 0.6)
            return true
        end
        function Bk.plungerTick(dt)
            for i = #plungers, 1, -1 do
                local e = plungers[i]
                if not e.stuck then
                    -- flying at 50 blocks a second toward where it will stick
                    e.flight = e.flight + dt * 50 * B
                    if e.flight >= e.dist then
                        if e.node then e.stuck = true; sound("block.slime_block.place", e.target, 0.8, 1.4)
                        else pcall(function() e.vis.model:Destroy() end); table.remove(plungers, i) end
                    else
                        e.pos = e.pos + (e.target - e.pos).Unit * math.min(dt * 50 * B, (e.target - e.pos).Magnitude)
                    end
                elseif e.node then
                    local w = world()
                    local s = w.sample(e.node.center)
                    if not (s and s.node == e.node) and not (physics.shipOfCenter and physics.shipOfCenter(e.node.center)) then e.stuck = false; e.node = nil end
                end
                local at = worldEnd(e)
                local dir
                if e.stuck and e.normal then
                    local xf = physics.transformFor and e.node and physics.transformFor(e.node.center)
                    dir = xf and xf.Rotation * e.normal or e.normal
                else dir = -(e.dir or Vector3.zAxis) end
                local cf = CFrame.lookAt(at, at + dir)
                e.vis.cup.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.03 * B) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0)
                e.vis.stick.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.27 * B) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0)
            end
            for i = #physics.plungers, 1, -1 do
                local pr = physics.plungers[i]
                local a, b2 = worldEnd(pr[1]), worldEnd(pr[2])
                local len = (b2 - a).Magnitude
                if len > 50 * B and pr[1].stuck and pr[2].stuck then
                    -- the rope snaps past 50 blocks
                    pcall(function() pr.rope:Destroy() end); table.remove(physics.plungers, i)
                elseif pr.rope then
                    pr.rope.Size = Vector3.new(0.05 * B, 0.05 * B, math.max(0.01, len))
                    pr.rope.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((a + b2) / 2, b2)
                end
            end
        end
        end)()
        -- ===== the loop ===========================================================================================================
        local function scan()
            local w = world()
            if not w or not w.nodes then return end
            local seen = {}
            for _, n in pairs(w.nodes) do
                if DEF[n.id] then seen[n] = true; nodes[n] = true end
            end
            for n in pairs(nodes) do
                if not seen[n] then
                    nodes[n] = nil
                    clearVisuals(n)
                end
            end
        end
        local tickAcc = 0
        local function step(dt)
            if os.clock() > scanAt then scanAt = os.clock() + 0.5; scan(); dropLinks(); if Bk.registerKinetics then pcall(Bk.registerKinetics) end end
            tickAcc = tickAcc + dt
            local ticks = 0
            while tickAcc >= 0.05 and ticks < 4 do
                tickAcc = tickAcc - 0.05
                ticks = ticks + 1
                refreshTransmitters()
                if Bk.projectileTick then pcall(Bk.projectileTick) end
                if Bk.handleTick then pcall(Bk.handleTick) end
                if Bk.ropeTick then pcall(Bk.ropeTick) end
                if Bk.magnetParticleTick then pcall(Bk.magnetParticleTick) end
                for n in pairs(nodes) do
                    local def = DEF[n.id]
                    if def and def.tick then
                        local ok, err = pcall(def.tick, n)
                        if not ok and not Bk.warned then Bk.warned = true; warn("[Create Aeronautics] " .. n.id .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end
                    end
                end
            end
            if tickAcc > 0.2 then tickAcc = 0 end
            valueAcc = valueAcc + dt
            if valueAcc >= 0.05 then valueAcc = 0; pcall(valueTick) end
            throttleHoldTick()
            if Bk.toolboxRadialTick then pcall(Bk.toolboxRadialTick) end
            if Bk.controllerTick then pcall(Bk.controllerTick) end
            if Bk.plungerTick then pcall(Bk.plungerTick, dt) end
            if Bk.symmetryTick then pcall(Bk.symmetryTick) end
            if Bk.shaperHookTick then pcall(Bk.shaperHookTick) end
            if Bk.steerTick then Bk.steerTick() end
            moveParts, moveFrames = {}, {}
            for n in pairs(nodes) do
                local def = DEF[n.id]
                if def and def.render then pcall(def.render, n, dt) end
            end
            if Bk.ropeRender then pcall(Bk.ropeRender) end
            if #moveParts > 0 then workspace:BulkMoveTo(moveParts, moveFrames, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged) end
        end

        -- the block under the crosshair (the hit part's block)
        local function nodeOf(hit)
            local center = hit and hit.Instance and hit.Instance:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter")
            local w = world()
            local s = center and w and w.sample(center)
            return s and s.node
        end
        function Bk.useBlock(hit, sneaking)
            local n = nodeOf(hit)
            if not n then return nil end
            do
                local _, heldName = held()
                if (heldName == "filter" or heldName == "attribute_filter") and not sneaking and n.id ~= "brass_funnel" then
                    local s = held()
                    if s then Bk.filterScreen(s) end
                    return true
                end
                if heldName == "linked_controller" and n.id ~= "redstone_link" and n.id ~= "lectern" then
                    local s = held()
                    if s then Bk.controllerUse(s, sneaking) end
                    return true
                end
                if heldName == "wand_of_symmetry" then
                    local s = held()
                    if s then Bk.symmetryUse(s, sneaking, hit, n) end
                    return true
                end
                if heldName == "display_link" and not sneaking and Bk.displayLinkSelect and Bk.displayLinkSelect(n) then return true end
                if heldName == "clipboard" and not sneaking and n.id ~= "clipboard" then
                    local s = held()
                    if s then clipScreen(s) end
                    return true
                end
                if heldName == "contraption_diagram" then
                    local s = shipOfNode(n)
                    if s then pcall(diagramScreen, s)
                    else status(L("simulated.contraption_diagram.cannot_use", "This Diagram must be on a Simulated Contraption to be inspected...")) end
                    return true
                end
                if heldName == "spring" and n.id ~= "spring" then
                    local okS, r = pcall(springClick, n, hit)
                    if not okS then warn("[Create Aeronautics] spring: " .. tostring(r)) end
                    return true
                end
            end
            local def = DEF[n.id]
            if def and def.values and not sneaking then
                local bn, spec = lookBox()
                if bn == n and spec then
                    if not valueHold then valueHold = {node = n, spec = spec, ticks = 0} end
                    return true
                end
            end
            if not (def and def.use) then return nil end
            -- sneaking with a block in hand places against it (the Steve rule); an empty sneak still uses a few
            if sneaking and not def.useSneaking then return nil end
            local ok, r = pcall(def.use, n, sneaking, hit)
            if not ok then warn("[Create Aeronautics] use " .. n.id .. ": " .. tostring(r)); return nil end
            return r
        end
        Bk.DEF = DEF
        function Bk.debug()
            local cnt, ids = 0, {}
            for n in pairs(nodes) do cnt = cnt + 1; ids[#ids + 1] = n.id .. (n.ae and n.ae.link and (n.ae.link.node == n and "+" or "~") or "") end
            return #links, cnt, table.concat(ids, ",")
        end
        function Bk.start(ae)
            if Bk.running then return end
            Bk.running = true
            AE = ae
            -- item use (the handheld potato cannon) goes through this first
            if not Bk.useItemWrapped then
                Bk.useItemWrapped = true
                local orig = JavaContent.mods.useItem
                JavaContent.mods.useItem = function(stack, name, sneaking)
                    if Bk.useItem then local okI, used = pcall(Bk.useItem, stack, name, sneaking); if okI and used then return true end end
                    return orig(stack, name, sneaking)
                end
            end
            -- the script's Stop (exit / reload) stops this copy too
            pcall(function() conns[#conns + 1] = stopEvent.Event:Connect(function() pcall(Bk.stop) end) end)
            conns[#conns + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
                local ok, err = pcall(step, dt)
                if not ok and not Bk.lwarned then Bk.lwarned = true; warn("[Create Aeronautics] blocks: " .. tostring(err)) end
            end)
        end
        function Bk.stop()
            Bk.running = false
            pcall(stopTyping)
            if boxPart then boxPart:Destroy(); boxPart = nil end
            if tipGui then tipGui:Destroy(); tipGui = nil end
            valueHold = nil
            for _, c in ipairs(conns) do c:Disconnect() end
            conns = {}
            for n in pairs(nodes) do clearVisuals(n); n.signal, n.signalDir, n.strongDir = nil, nil, nil end
            nodes = {}
            hold = nil
            if hud then hud:Destroy(); hud = nil end
            local mf = workspace:FindFirstChild("SteveMagnetParticles"); if mf then mf:Destroy() end
            local pf = workspace:FindFirstChild("StevePlungers"); if pf then pf:Destroy() end
        end
    end
    initializeControlsAndUpdates()
    return Bk
end
return createAeroBlocks

end)()
do
    local PHY = createAeroPhysics(createRigidPhysics)
    local INT = createAeroInteract(PHY)
    local BLK = createAeroBlocks(PHY)
    local start, stop, use = INT.start, INT.stop, INT.useBlock
    INT.blocks = BLK
    JavaContent.modBlocks = BLK
    INT.start = function(ae) start(ae); local ok, err = pcall(BLK.start, ae); if not ok then warn("[Create Aeronautics] blocks: " .. tostring(err)) end end
    INT.stop = function() stop() end
    -- the block behaviour also serves Create on its own (redstone links, value panels): it runs once the world is up
    task.spawn(function()
        while not (JavaContent.mods and JavaContent.mods.ctx and JavaContent.mods.ctx.world) do task.wait(1) end
        local ok, err = pcall(BLK.start)
        if not ok then warn("[Create Aeronautics] blocks: " .. tostring(err)) end
    end)
    INT.useBlock = function(hit, sneaking)
        local ok, r = pcall(BLK.useBlock, hit, sneaking)
        if ok and r ~= nil then return r end
        return use(hit, sneaking)
    end
    createAeronauticsMod({data = AERO_DATA, physics = PHY, interact = INT})
end
end)()
-- END MOD: CREATE AERONAUTICS
local function setup(character)
    -- The block grid follows the map: its vertical offset puts a cell boundary on the floor the player starts on, so
    -- the floor's cells are whole blocks (Java blocks are whole cells of the world). Only when the game set no grid.
    if workspace:GetAttribute("SteveGridAuto") then
        -- set by this script on an earlier load: measured again (the player may stand somewhere else now)
        workspace:SetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin", nil)
        workspace:SetAttribute("SteveGroundTop", nil)
    end
    if workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin") == nil or workspace:GetAttribute("SteveGroundTop") == nil then
        local okG, errG = pcall(function()
            local B = CONFIG.Block
            local from = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
            if not from then
                local spawn = workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
                from = spawn and spawn.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
            end
            if not from then return end
            local rp = RaycastParams.new()
            rp.FilterType, rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, {character}
            -- the floor, not a spawn pad or a small part standing on it: look further down past those
            local skip = {character}
            local r
            for _ = 1, 12 do
                rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = skip
                r = workspace:Raycast(from + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -300, 0), rp)
                local hitPart = r and r.Instance
                if not hitPart or hitPart == workspace.Terrain then break end
                local sz = hitPart.Size
                local small = hitPart:IsA("SpawnLocation") or math.max(sz.X, sz.Z) < 24 or not hitPart.CanCollide or hitPart.Transparency > 0.9
                if not small then break end
                skip[#skip + 1] = hitPart
                r = nil
            end
            local inst = r and r.Instance
            _G.SteveGridProbe = tostring(inst and inst:GetFullName()) .. " " .. tostring(r and r.Normal)
            if not inst or inst == workspace.Terrain or r.Normal.Y < 0.99 then return end
            if inst:GetAttribute("SteveVoxel") or inst:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter") or inst:GetAttribute("SteveGenTerrain") or inst:GetAttribute("SteveHoleFace") then return end
            local top = r.Position.Y
            local y = top - B / 2
            if workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin") == nil then
                workspace:SetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin", Vector3.new(0, y - math.floor(y / B) * B, 0))
                workspace:SetAttribute("SteveGridAuto", true)
            end
            -- the endless ground (SteveGround) starts under this floor, on the grid
            local o = workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin")
            local edge = o.Y - B / 2
            workspace:SetAttribute("SteveGroundTop", edge + math.floor((top - edge) / B + 0.5) * B)
        end)
        if not okG then _G.SteveGridProbe = tostring(errG) end
    end
    if stopped or not steveEnabled then return end
    generation = generation + 1
    local myGeneration = generation
    if cleanupCharacter then cleanupCharacter(); cleanupCharacter = nil end
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
    local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
    if not humanoid or not root or myGeneration ~= generation or stopped then return end
    local r15Body, torso, head, leftArm, rightArm, leftLeg, rightLeg, rig

    local savedObjects, savedParts, savedAccessories = {}, {}, {}
    local function stash(object)

    end
    local function hideAccessoryPart(part)
        if not savedAccessories[part] then
            savedAccessories[part] = {part.Transparency, part.LocalTransparencyModifier}
            connections[#connections + 1] = part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalTransparencyModifier"):Connect(function()
                if not disposed and part.Parent and part.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end
            end)
        end
        part.Transparency, part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1, 1
    end
    local function hideExtra(object)
        if object:IsA("Accessory") then
            for _, part in ipairs(object:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then hideAccessoryPart(part) end
            end
        elseif object:IsA("CharacterMesh") or object:IsA("Shirt") or object:IsA("Pants") or object:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
            stash(object)
        end
    end

        if object:IsA("Accessory") then

    local function setVisible(part, visible)
        local value = visible and 0 or 1
        part.Transparency = value

            elseif decal.Name=="StevePixelSurface" then decal.Enabled=visible

        end
    end
    -- Each opaque Java texture pixel becomes a small extrusion. The transparent
    -- outline, palette, one-pixel thickness, and handheld display transforms are
    -- taken from the user's 1.21.1 assets; no uploaded mesh/texture is required.
    local function buildTool(index, scale)
        local model, pixels = Instance.new("Model"), {}
        model.Name, model.Parent = blockNames[index], viewModel
        local sprite = toolSprites[index]
        for y, row in ipairs(sprite.rows) do
            local x = 1
            while x <= 16 do
                local letter = row:sub(x,x)
                local finish = x
                while finish < 16 and row:sub(finish+1,finish+1) == letter do finish = finish+1 end
                if letter ~= "." then
                    local color = sprite.palette[letter:byte()-64]
                    local p = viewPart("Pixel", Vector3.new(finish-x+1,1,1) * (scale/16))
                    p.Parent, p.Color, p.Transparency = model, Color3.fromRGB(color[1],color[2],color[3]), 1
                    pixels[#pixels+1] = {p, CFrame.new(((x+finish)/2-8.5)*scale/16,(8.5-y)*scale/16,0)}
                end
                x = finish+1
            end
        end
        return pixels
    end
    local toolModels = {}
    for i = 8, 10 do
        toolModels[i] = {first = buildTool(i, viewScale * toolDisplay.first.scale),
            third = buildTool(i, CONFIG.Block * toolDisplay.third.scale)}
    end

    end

    local function floorAt(offset, distance)
        local center = root.Position + offset - Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2 - 0.08, 0)
        return workspace:Blockcast(CFrame.new(center), Vector3.new(root.Size.X - 0.08, 0.08, root.Size.Z - 0.08),
            Vector3.new(0, -distance, 0), cast)
    end
    local function changeHeight(blocks)
        local height = blocks * CONFIG.Block
        local delta = height - root.Size.Y
        if math.abs(delta) < 0.001 then return true end
        if delta > 0 then
            -- Sweep the current hull upward to check the newly occupied volume,
            -- including Terrain, before growing it. Never stand through a ceiling.
            local hit = workspace:Blockcast(root.CFrame, root.Size - Vector3.new(0.04, 0.04, 0.04),
                Vector3.new(0, delta + 0.04, 0), cast)
            if hit then return false end
        end
        local previousSize, previousFrame = root.Size, root.CFrame
        root.Size = Vector3.new(root.Size.X, height, root.Size.Z)
        root.CFrame = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, delta / 2, 0)
        if bodyCollision.blocked(root.Position) then
            root.Size,root.CFrame = previousSize,previousFrame
            return false
        end
        return true
    end
    local function tagged(object, tag)
        while object and object ~= workspace do
            if CollectionService:HasTag(object, tag) then return true end
            object = object.Parent
        end
        return false
    end
    local function waterAt(position)
        -- Terrain water is voxel-based. This samples the voxel containing the point.
        local region = Region3.new(position - Vector3.new(0.01, 0.01, 0.01), position + Vector3.new(0.01, 0.01, 0.01)):ExpandToGrid(4)
        local materials, occupancy = workspace.Terrain:ReadVoxels(region, 4)
        return materials[1][1][1] == Enum.Material.Water and occupancy[1][1][1] > 0
    end
    local function environment()
        inWater, climbing, inLava = false, false, false
        for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(root.CFrame, root.Size + Vector3.new(0.3, 0, 0.3), overlaps)) do
            if tagged(part, "MinecraftWater") then inWater = true end
            if tagged(part, "MinecraftLava") then inLava = true end
            if part:IsA("TrussPart") or tagged(part, "MinecraftLadder") then climbing = true end
        end
        if not climbing then
            local nearby = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(root.CFrame, root.Size + Vector3.new(4, 2, 4), overlaps)
            local function matchingRung(a, b)
                local delta = b.Position - a.Position
                if math.abs(delta.Y) < 1.5 or math.abs(delta.Y) > 2.5
                    or math.abs(delta.X) > 0.15 or math.abs(delta.Z) > 0.15 then return false end
                if (a.Size - b.Size).Magnitude > 0.1 then return false end
                return a.CFrame.RightVector:Dot(b.CFrame.RightVector) > 0.98
                    and a.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(b.CFrame.UpVector) > 0.98
                    and a.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(b.CFrame.LookVector) > 0.98
            end
            for i, first in ipairs(nearby) do
                if first:IsA("BasePart") and not first:IsA("TrussPart") then
                    for j = i + 1, #nearby do
                        local second = nearby[j]
                        if second:IsA("BasePart") and not second:IsA("TrussPart") and matchingRung(first, second) then
                            climbing = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                if climbing then break end
            end
        end
        if not inWater then inWater = waterAt(root.Position) end
        if JavaContent.fluidQuery then
            -- Java: in water while the feet are (the bounding box touches the fluid)
            local okF, f = pcall(JavaContent.fluidQuery, root.Position - Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2 - 0.1, 0))
            if okF and (f == "water" or f == "slime") then inWater = true elseif okF and f == "lava" then inLava = true end
        end
        if inWater then climbing = false end
    end

    local function selectSlot(index)
        local old=selected
        selectedSlot=(index-1)%9+1
        selected=inventoryState.slots[selectedSlot] and inventoryState.slots[selectedSlot].id or 11
        local native=nativeTools[selected]
        if old~=selected then
            if creativeWorld and creativeWorld.gameplay then local use=creativeWorld.gameplay;use.scoping=false;use.blocking=false;use.charge=0;use.useTicks=0;use.useHeld=false end
            -- Roblox tools too: Steve keeps his Java pose (Roblox still welds the tool to the right hand).
            if originalAnimate then originalAnimate.Disabled=true end
            for _,joint in pairs(rig)do joint.Transform=CFrame.identity end
        end
        if native and native.Parent==player:FindFirstChildOfClass('Backpack') then humanoid:EquipTool(native)
        elseif not native and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Tool') then humanoid:UnequipTools() end
        if old~=selected then attackTicker=0; if clearMining then clearMining() end end
    end
    local function resetInput()
        keys,sprintLatched,sprinting,lastForward={},false,false,-math.huge
        primaryQueued,secondaryQueued=false,false
        if creativeWorld and creativeWorld.gameplay then creativeWorld.gameplay.charge=0;creativeWorld.gameplay.scoping=false;creativeWorld.gameplay.blocking=false;creativeWorld.gameplay.useHeld=false end
        if clearMining then clearMining() end
    end
    local function blockedInput()
        local requests = rawget(_G, "SteveCursorRequests")
        return disposed or not alive or jesusFrozen or menuOpen or inventoryOpen or Input:GetFocusedTextBox()~=nil or JavaGui.deathOpen()
            or (type(requests) == "table" and next(requests) ~= nil) or JavaContent.mods.inputBlocked == true
    end
    local function blockedCameraInput()

        return disposed or not alive or menuOpen or inventoryOpen or Input:GetFocusedTextBox()~=nil or JavaGui.deathOpen()
            or (type(requests) == "table" and next(requests) ~= nil)
    end

    -- Read-only view of the Minecraft world for other scripts (The Verity Script).
    local function entryName(e,fallback) return e and e.name or (fallback and tostring(fallback):gsub('_',' ')) end
    local function solidCell(c)
        local n=creativeWorld.nodeAt(c)
        if n then return not JavaContent.nonSolid(n.id),true end
        local session=WG.current and WG.current()
        if session then
            local info=session:sampleCell(c)
            if info and not info.air and not info.liquid and not JavaContent.nonSolid(info.id) then return true,false end
        end
        return false,false
    end
    _G.SteveInfo={
        blockSize=CONFIG.Block,
        held=function()
            local stack=inventoryState.slots[selectedSlot]
            if not stack then return nil end
            local e=JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
            return {id=e and e.id or tostring(stack.id),name=stack.name or entryName(e,blockNames[stack.id] or stack.id),count=stack.count or 1}
        end,
        status=function()
            local g=creativeWorld.gameplay
            local hum=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            return {survival=CONFIG.Survival==true,health=hum and math.floor(hum.Health/math.max(hum.MaxHealth,1)*20+0.5) or 20,
                hunger=g and g.hunger or 20,level=PlayerStats.xpLevel or 0}
        end,
        -- Minecraft block coordinates (and biome in a generated world) of a Roblox position.
        blockPos=function(pos)
            local session=WG.current and WG.current()
            if session and pos.Y>session.origin.Y+(WG.MIN_Y-64)*session.size then
                local x,y,z=session:toBlock(pos)
                local okB,biome=pcall(function() return session.gen:biome(x,y,z) end)
                return x,y,z,okB and biome or nil
            end
            local origin=workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin")
            if typeof(origin)~="Vector3" then origin=Vector3.new(0,CONFIG.Block/2,0) end
            local v=(pos-origin)/CONFIG.Block
            return math.floor(v.X+.5),math.floor(v.Y+.5),math.floor(v.Z+.5),nil
        end,
        -- What a ray hits, as Minecraft sees it: {kind="block"|"mob", id, name, ...} or nil.
        identify=function(origin,direction)
            local params=RaycastParams.new()
            params.FilterType,params.FilterDescendantsInstances=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude,{character}
            local hit=workspace:Raycast(origin,direction,params)
            for _=1,6 do
                if not (hit and hit.Instance:GetAttribute("SteveCollider")) then break end
                local list=params.FilterDescendantsInstances;list[#list+1]=hit.Instance;params.FilterDescendantsInstances=list
                hit=workspace:Raycast(origin,direction,params)
            end
            if not hit then return nil end
            local inst=hit.Instance
            local g=creativeWorld.gameplay
            for _,m in ipairs(g and g.mobs or {}) do
                if (m.hitbox and inst==m.hitbox) or (m.visual and m.visual.model and inst:IsDescendantOf(m.visual.model)) then
                    local hum=m.humanoid
                    return {kind="mob",id=m.id,name=(tostring(m.id):gsub("_"," ")),customName=m.customName,health=hum and hum.Health,maxHealth=hum and hum.MaxHealth,baby=m.baby,position=m.position,instance=inst}
                end
            end
            local n=creativeWorld.resolve(inst)
            if n then return {kind="block",id=n.id,name=entryName(JavaContent.byIndex[n.index],n.id),state=n.state,position=n.center,instance=inst} end
            if inst:GetAttribute("SteveGenTerrain") then
                local session=WG.current and WG.current()
                local c=creativeWorld.cell(hit.Position-hit.Normal*0.05)
                local info=session and session:sampleCell(c)
                if info and info.entry then return {kind="block",id=info.id,name=info.entry.name,position=c,instance=inst,natural=true} end
            end
            local id=inst:GetAttribute("MinecraftBlockId")
            if id then return {kind="block",id=id,name=entryName(JavaContent.byId[id],id),position=hit.Position,instance=inst} end
            return {kind="other",instance=inst,position=hit.Position}
        end,
        -- Is the player inside a closed space (roof + four walls), and how many placed blocks are near?
        shelter=function()
            local size=CONFIG.Block
            local feet=creativeWorld.cell(root.Position-Vector3.new(0,root.Size.Y/2-0.2,0))
            local up=Vector3.new(0,size,0)
            local roof=false
            for dy=2,8 do if solidCell(feet+up*dy) then roof=true;break end end
            local walls=0
            for _,d in ipairs({Vector3.new(1,0,0),Vector3.new(-1,0,0),Vector3.new(0,0,1),Vector3.new(0,0,-1)}) do
                for k=1,10 do
                    local a=solidCell(feet+d*size*k);local b=solidCell(feet+up+d*size*k)
                    if a or b then walls=walls+1;break end
                end
            end
            local placed=0
            for _,n in pairs(creativeWorld.nodes) do if (n.center-feet).Magnitude<=12*size then placed=placed+1 end end
            local x,y,z=_G.SteveInfo.blockPos(feet)
            return {enclosed=roof and walls==4,roof=roof,walls=walls,placedNear=placed,cell=feet,x=x,y=y,z=z}
        end,
    }
