    local function syncNativeTools()
        if disposed then return end
        local owned={}
        local changed=false
        for _,container in ipairs({backpack,character}) do for _,tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do if tool:IsA('Tool') then
            local id=nativeIds[tool]
            if not id then nextNativeId=nextNativeId-1;id=nextNativeId;nativeIds[tool]=id;nativeTools[id]=tool;toolStats[id]={kind='native',attackSpeed=4,damage=1} end
            blockNames[id]=tool.Name;owned[id]=true
        end end end
        local present={}
        for slot,stack in pairs(inventoryState.slots) do if stack.id<0 then
            if owned[stack.id] then present[stack.id]=true else inventoryState.slots[slot]=nil;changed=true end
        end end
        if inventoryState.cursor and inventoryState.cursor.id<0 then
            if owned[inventoryState.cursor.id] then present[inventoryState.cursor.id]=true else inventoryState.cursor=nil;changed=true end
        end
        for id in pairs(owned) do if not present[id] then if inventoryState.add(id,1)>0 then changed=true end end end
        if changed then creativeUI.refresh() end
    end
    local syncQueued=false
    local function queueNativeSync()
        if syncQueued then return end;syncQueued=true
        task.defer(function()syncQueued=false;syncNativeTools()end)
    end

            end
        end
        return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
    end,false,Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value+100,Enum.KeyCode.Q)
    local boundKeys = {Enum.KeyCode.W, Enum.KeyCode.A, Enum.KeyCode.S, Enum.KeyCode.D,

    end, false, Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value + 100, table.unpack(boundKeys))

    local function viewRotation()
        return CFrame.Angles(0, viewYaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(viewPitch, 0, 0)
    end
    local function lookVector()
        return viewRotation().LookVector
    end
    local function eyePosition()
        local p = root.Position
        return Vector3.new(p.X, p.Y - root.Size.Y / 2 + math.min(eyeHeight, root.Size.Y - 0.05), p.Z)
    end
    creativeWorld.eye,creativeWorld.look=eyePosition,lookVector
    local function aimHit()
        -- Java picks blocks from the player's eye along the view direction in
        -- every POV, which is the centre of the screen in first person.
        local origin, reach = eyePosition(), lookVector() * (CONFIG.Reach * CONFIG.Block)
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, reach, aimCast)
        local heldEntry = JavaContent.byIndex[selected]
        local heldId = heldEntry and heldEntry.id or ""
        local fluidTool = heldId == "bucket" or heldId == "glass_bottle" or heldId == "lily_pad" or heldId == "frogspawn" or heldId:match("boat$") or heldId:match("raft$")
        local function skipped(h) return h and (h.Instance:GetAttribute("SteveCollider") or (not fluidTool and h.Instance:GetAttribute("SteveFluid"))) end
        if skipped(hit) then
            local skip = {character}
            for _ = 1, 12 do
                if not skipped(hit) then break end
                skip[#skip + 1] = hit.Instance
                local params = RaycastParams.new()
                params.FilterType, params.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, skip
                hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, reach, params)
            end
        end
        return hit
    end
    -- LevelRenderer.renderHitOutline(): the edges of the targeted block's outline shape.
    local extraOutlines = {}
    local function targetBoxes(target)
        local movingBoxes = creativeWorld.physicsOutline(target.Instance)
        if movingBoxes then return movingBoxes end
        local center = worldMining.cell(target)
        local inst = target.Instance
        local list = {}
        if JavaContent.mods.outline and inst:GetAttribute("RealisticBody") then
            local okO, own = pcall(JavaContent.mods.outline, inst)
            if okO and own then return own end
        end
        if inst.Name == "BlockOutline" and inst.Parent then
            for _, p in ipairs(inst.Parent:GetChildren()) do
                if p.Name == "BlockOutline" and p:IsA("BasePart") then list[#list + 1] = {p.CFrame, p.Size} end
            end
            if #list > 0 then return list end
        end
        if inst:GetAttribute("SteveGenTerrain") and WG.current and WG.current() then
            local info, bx, _, bz = WG.current():sampleCell(center)
            local shape = info and info.entry and JavaContent.shape(info.id, info.state)
            if shape and not shape.full and #shape.outline > 0 then
                local unit = CONFIG.Block / 16
                local shift = Vector3.zero
                if info.entry.offset then
                    local dx, dy, dz = CreativeRules.blockOffset(info.entry, bx, bz)
                    if dx then shift = Vector3.new(dx, dy, dz) * CONFIG.Block end
                end
                for _, n in ipairs(shape.outline) do
                    local a, b = Vector3.new(n[1], n[2], n[3]), Vector3.new(n[4], n[5], n[6])
                    list[#list + 1] = {CFrame.new(center + shift + ((a + b) / 2 - Vector3.new(8, 8, 8)) * unit), Vector3.new(math.max(b.X - a.X, 0.1), math.max(b.Y - a.Y, 0.1), math.max(b.Z - a.Z, 0.1)) * unit}
                end
                return list
            end
        end
        if inst:IsA("BasePart") and not inst:GetAttribute("SteveVoxel") and not inst:GetAttribute("SteveVoxelCenter") and inst ~= workspace.Terrain then
            -- the part's own box in the world: a map part a block or smaller is outlined as itself (it is the block);
            -- a bigger one is outlined where it fills the targeted cell
            local cf, size = inst.CFrame, inst.Size
            pcall(function() cf, size = inst.ExtentsCFrame, inst.ExtentsSize end)
            local rot, s = cf.Rotation, size / 2
            local ex = math.abs(rot.XVector.X) * s.X + math.abs(rot.YVector.X) * s.Y + math.abs(rot.ZVector.X) * s.Z
            local ey = math.abs(rot.XVector.Y) * s.X + math.abs(rot.YVector.Y) * s.Y + math.abs(rot.ZVector.Y) * s.Z
            local ez = math.abs(rot.XVector.Z) * s.X + math.abs(rot.YVector.Z) * s.Y + math.abs(rot.ZVector.Z) * s.Z
            local B = CONFIG.Block
            local aligned = math.max(math.abs(rot.XVector.X), math.abs(rot.XVector.Y), math.abs(rot.XVector.Z)) > 0.999
                and math.max(math.abs(rot.YVector.X), math.abs(rot.YVector.Y), math.abs(rot.YVector.Z)) > 0.999
            if size.X <= B * 1.05 and size.Y <= B * 1.05 and size.Z <= B * 1.05 then
                if aligned then return {{CFrame.new(cf.Position), Vector3.new(ex, ey, ez) * 2}} end
                return {{cf, size}}
            end
            local p, h = cf.Position, B / 2
            local lo = Vector3.new(math.max(p.X - ex, center.X - h), math.max(p.Y - ey, center.Y - h), math.max(p.Z - ez, center.Z - h))
            local hi = Vector3.new(math.min(p.X + ex, center.X + h), math.min(p.Y + ey, center.Y + h), math.min(p.Z + ez, center.Z + h))
            if aligned and hi.X - lo.X > 0.01 and hi.Y - lo.Y > 0.01 and hi.Z - lo.Z > 0.01 then
                return {{CFrame.new((lo + hi) / 2), hi - lo}}
            end
        end
        return {{CFrame.new(center), Vector3.new(CONFIG.Block, CONFIG.Block, CONFIG.Block)}}
    end
    local function showOutline(boxes)
        boxes = boxes or {}
        for i, box in ipairs(boxes) do
            local holder, adorn = cellOutline, outline
            if i > 1 then
                local extra = extraOutlines[i - 1]
                if not extra then
                    local p = cellOutline:Clone(); p.Parent = character
                    local o = outline:Clone(); o.Parent = outline.Parent
                    extra = {p, o}; extraOutlines[i - 1] = extra
                end
                holder, adorn = extra[1], extra[2]
            end
            holder.CFrame, holder.Size = box[1], box[2]
            adorn.Adornee = holder
        end
        if #boxes == 0 then outline.Adornee = nil end
        for i = math.max(#boxes, 1), #extraOutlines do extraOutlines[i][2].Adornee = nil end
    end
    local function mineable(target)
        -- Adventure and spectator players cannot break blocks.
        if PlayerStats.adventure or PlayerStats.spectator then return false end
        return worldMining.mineable(target)
    end
    local function miningStats(target, hit, center)
        local hardness = tonumber(target:GetAttribute("MinecraftHardness"))
        local harvestable = target:GetAttribute("MinecraftHarvestable")
        if hardness == nil then
            local stats = blockStats[worldMining.kind(hit,center)]
            hardness = stats and stats.hardness or 1.5
            if harvestable == nil and stats then harvestable = stats.harvestable end
        end
        if harvestable == nil then harvestable = false end
        return hardness, harvestable == true
    end
    clearMining = function()
        if miningTarget and miningTarget.Parent then
            miningTarget:SetAttribute("MinecraftBreakProgress", -1)
        end
        miningTarget, miningNormal = nil, nil
        miningCell = nil
        if creativeWorld then creativeWorld.effects.hideCrack() end
        miningProgress, miningSoundTick = 0, 0
    end
    local function victimOf(target)
        local model = target and target:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        return model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), model
    end
    local function startSwing()
        -- LivingEntity.swing(): a running swing restarts only once it is half
        -- done, which is why a held destroy swings every 3 ticks.
        if swing >= 0.5 then swing = 0; creativeWorld.swingOff = creativeWorld.inOffhand == true end
        if creativeWorld.replication then creativeWorld.replication.swing(creativeWorld.swingOff == true) end
    end
    creativeWorld.swing=startSwing
    local function place(hit)
        hit=creativeWorld.physicsHit(hit)
        local target = hit.Instance
        if not target:IsA("BasePart") or victimOf(target) or not blockTextures[selected] or worldMining.busy then return end
        local nx, ny, nz = dominantFace(hit.Normal.X,hit.Normal.Y,hit.Normal.Z)
        local normal = Vector3.new(nx,ny,nz)
        local size = CONFIG.Block
        local grid = workspace:GetAttribute("MinecraftGridOrigin")
        if typeof(grid) ~= "Vector3" then grid = Vector3.new(0, size / 2, 0) end
        local blockSize = Vector3.new(size, size, size)
        local ownBlock=creativeWorld.resolve(target)
        local position,replacing
        local function replaceable(n)
            return n and JavaContent.replaceable[n.id] and not (n.id=='snow' and tonumber(n.state.layers or 1)>1) and n.index~=selected
        end
        local shift
        if ownBlock then
            if replaceable(ownBlock) then position,replacing=ownBlock.center,ownBlock else position=ownBlock.center+normal*size end
            -- Rows built off a flush block stay flush.
            shift=ownBlock.shift
        else
            position=creativeWorld.cell(hit.Position+hit.Normal*0.05)
            if not creativeWorld.nodeAt(position) and worldMining.occupied(position) then position=position+normal*size end
            -- Map surfaces rarely sit on the grid: slide the block along the face axis so it touches the surface.
            if hit.Normal:Dot(normal)>0.999 then
                local gap=((position-normal*size/2)-hit.Position):Dot(normal)
                if math.abs(gap)>0.01 and math.abs(gap)<size-0.01 then shift=-normal*gap end
            end
        end
        local there=creativeWorld.nodeAt(position)
        if there and there~=replacing then
            if replaceable(there) then replacing=there else position=nil end
        elseif not replacing and worldMining.occupied(position) then
            position=nil
        end
        if not position then worldMining.message = "No room for a block on that face"; return end
        if (creativeWorld.renderPosition(position)-eyePosition()).Magnitude > CONFIG.Reach*size + size/2 then return end
        -- Java refuses to place a block that would intersect the player.
        local gap = creativeWorld.renderPosition(position) - root.Position
        local reach = (blockSize + root.Size) / 2 - Vector3.new(0.02, 0.02, 0.02)
        local entry=JavaContent.byIndex[selected]
        if not (entry and JavaContent.nonSolid(entry.id)) and math.abs(gap.X) < reach.X and math.abs(gap.Y) < reach.Y and math.abs(gap.Z) < reach.Z then return end
        if replacing and replacing.visual and replacing.visual.parts[1] then
            creativeWorld.breakBlock({Instance=replacing.visual.parts[1][1]},false)
        end
        if not creativeWorld.place(selected,position,hit,hit.physicsTransform and hit.physicsTransform:VectorToObjectSpace(lookVector()) or lookVector()) then return end
        if shift and creativeWorld.setShift then creativeWorld.setShift(creativeWorld.nodeAt(position),shift) end
        do local placedNode = creativeWorld.nodeAt(position); if placedNode then placedNode.placer = player.Name end end
        if MinecraftSounds then
            local placedNode = creativeWorld.nodeAt(position)
            MinecraftSounds.block(placedNode and placedNode.index or selected, "place", position)
        end
        startSwing()
        -- ItemInHandRenderer.itemUsed(): the placed block dips and re-rises.
        mainHandHeight = 0
        return true
    end
    -- Arm pose codes: 0 EMPTY 1 ITEM 2 BLOCK 3 BOW_AND_ARROW 4 THROW_TRIDENT 5 CROSSBOW_CHARGE
    -- 6 CROSSBOW_HOLD 7 SPYGLASS 8 TOOT_HORN 9 BRUSH. Returns right, left, use ticks, charge duration.
    creativeWorld.netArmPoses = function()
        local gp, using = creativeWorld.gameplay, creativeWorld.items and creativeWorld.items.using
        local offUse = creativeWorld.offhandUsing
        local function pose(stack, isOff)
            if not stack or PlayerStats.spectator then return 0, 0 end
            local e = JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
            local name = e and e.id or ""
            if (isOff and offUse) or (not isOff and not offUse) then
                if gp.blocking and name == "shield" then return 2, 0 end
                if gp.scoping and name == "spyglass" then return 7, 0 end
                if (gp.charge or 0) > 0 and name == "bow" then return 3, 0 end
                if using and using.name == name then
                    if using.kind == "crossbow" then return 5, using.ticks or 0 end
                    if using.kind == "trident" then return 4, 0 end
                    if name == "goat_horn" then return 8, 0 end
                    if name == "brush" then return 9, 0 end
                end
            end
            if name == "crossbow" and stack.charged then return 6, 0 end
            return 1, 0
        end
        local right, ticks = pose(inventoryState.slots[selectedSlot], false)
        local left, ticks2 = pose(inventoryState.slots[41], true)
        return right, left, math.max(ticks, ticks2), using and using.duration or 25
    end
    -- ItemInHandRenderer.renderArmWithItem, BOW / CROSSBOW use: applyItemArmTransform, then the draw transform
    -- (with the pull shake and push), instead of the attack transform. Returns nil when the hand is not drawing;
    -- the second value is the charged-crossbow hold (applied after the attack transform when not swinging).
    creativeWorld.useArmFrame = function(offhand, equip, q, partial)
        local gp = creativeWorld.gameplay
        local stack = offhand and inventoryState.slots[41] or inventoryState.slots[selectedSlot]
        local entry = stack and JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
        local id = entry and (entry.itemId or entry.id)
        if not id then return nil end
        local rad, i = math.rad, offhand and -1 or 1
        if (creativeWorld.offhandUsing and true or false) ~= offhand then
            if id == "crossbow" and stack.charged and not offhand then return nil, CFrame.new(-0.641864 * q, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(10), 0) end
            return nil
        end
        local base = CFrame.new(i * 0.56 * q, (-0.52 - (equip or 0) * 0.6) * q, -0.72 * q)
        -- EAT / DRINK: applyEatTransform, then applyItemArmTransform (no attack transform).
        local eating = creativeWorld.items and creativeWorld.items.using
        if eating and eating.kind == "consume" and (eating.duration or 0) > 0 then
            local f = (eating.duration - eating.ticks) - partial + 1
            local g = f / eating.duration
            local fr = CFrame.identity
            if g < 0.8 then fr = CFrame.new(0, math.abs(math.cos(f / 4 * math.pi) * 0.1) * q, 0) end
            local h = 1 - math.clamp(g, 0, 1) ^ 27
            fr = fr * CFrame.new(h * 0.6 * i * q, h * -0.5 * q, 0)
                * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(i * h * 90), 0) * CFrame.Angles(rad(h * 10), 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad(i * h * 30))
            return fr * base
        end
        if id == "bow" and (gp.charge or 0) > 0 then
            local m = gp.charge - 1 + partial
            local f = m / 20; f = (f * f + f * 2) / 3; if f > 1 then f = 1 end
            local fr = base * CFrame.new(i * -0.2785682 * q, 0.18344387 * q, 0.15731531 * q)
                * CFrame.Angles(rad(-13.935), 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(i * 35.3), 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad(i * -9.785))
            if f > 0.1 then fr = fr * CFrame.new(0, math.sin((m - 0.1) * 1.3) * (f - 0.1) * 0.004 * q, 0) end
            return fr * CFrame.new(0, 0, f * 0.04 * q) * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(-i * 45), 0)
        end
        local u = creativeWorld.items and creativeWorld.items.using
        if id == "crossbow" and u and u.kind == "crossbow" then
            local f = (u.ticks or 0) - 1 + partial
            local g = math.clamp(f / math.max(1, u.duration or 25), 0, 1)
            local fr = base * CFrame.new(i * -0.4785682 * q, -0.094387 * q, 0.05731531 * q)
                * CFrame.Angles(rad(-11.935), 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(i * 65.3), 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad(i * -9.785))
            if g > 0.1 then fr = fr * CFrame.new(0, math.sin((f - 0.1) * 1.3) * (g - 0.1) * 0.004 * q, 0) end
            return fr * CFrame.new(0, 0, g * 0.04 * q) * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(-i * 45), 0)
        end
        return nil
    end
    -- AbstractClientPlayer.getFieldOfViewModifier: drawing a bow narrows the view up to 15%.
    creativeWorld.bowZoom = function()
        local gp = creativeWorld.gameplay
        local c = gp and gp.charge or 0
        if c <= 0 then return 1 end
        local stack = creativeWorld.offhandUsing and inventoryState.slots[41] or inventoryState.slots[selectedSlot]
        local entry = stack and JavaContent.byIndex[stack.id]
        if not entry or (entry.itemId or entry.id) ~= "bow" then return 1 end
        local g = c / 20
        if g > 1 then g = 1 else g = g * g end
        return 1 - g * 0.15
    end
    creativeWorld.withOffhand = function(fn)
        local off = inventoryState.slots[41]
        if not off or off.id < 0 then return false end
        local main, saved, count = inventoryState.slots[selectedSlot], selected, off.count
        inventoryState.slots[selectedSlot], inventoryState.slots[41] = off, main
        selected = off.id
        creativeWorld.inOffhand = true
        local ok, result = pcall(fn)
        creativeWorld.inOffhand = false
        local after = inventoryState.slots[selectedSlot]
        inventoryState.slots[selectedSlot], inventoryState.slots[41] = inventoryState.slots[41], after
        selected = saved
        if after ~= off or (after and after.count ~= count) then creativeUI.refresh() end
        if not ok then warn("Steve offhand: " .. tostring(result)) end
        return ok and result
    end
    creativeWorld.items.motion = function() return motion end
    -- Player.getAttackStrengthScale(0) and the "full" icon (charged, aiming at a living target in reach).
    creativeUI.attackIndicator = function()
        local stats = toolStats[selected]
        local delay = stats and 20 / stats.attackSpeed or CONFIG.AttackDelayTicks
        local strength = clamp(attackTicker / delay, 0, 1)
        local ready = false
        if strength >= 1 and delay > 5 then
            local hit = aimHit()
            local v = hit and victimOf(hit.Instance)
            ready = v ~= nil and v.Health > 0
        end
        return strength, ready
    end
    -- Player.attack's inputs (attack strength uses Java's +0.5 partial tick).
    creativeWorld.attackInfo = function()
        local stats = toolStats[selected]
        local delay = stats and 20 / stats.attackSpeed or CONFIG.AttackDelayTicks
        return {strength = clamp((attackTicker + 0.5) / delay, 0, 1),
            baseDamage = math.max(0, ((stats and stats.damage or 1) + PlayerStats.attackBonus) * PlayerStats.attackMultiplier),
            sprinting = sprinting, grounded = grounded, falling = motion.Y < 0, inWater = inWater, climbing = climbing,
            riding = creativeWorld.gameplay.riding ~= nil, horizontalSpeed = Vector3.new(motion.X, 0, motion.Z).Magnitude,
            position = root.Position, yaw = viewYaw,
            onKnockback = function() motion = Vector3.new(motion.X * 0.6, motion.Y, motion.Z * 0.6); sprinting, sprintLatched = false, false end,
            noFall = function() creativeWorld.items.fallDistance = 0; motion = Vector3.new(motion.X, 0.01, motion.Z) end,
            launch = function(v) motion = Vector3.new(motion.X, v, motion.Z) end}
    end
    createDeveloperTags({gui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"), connections = connections})
    creativeWorld.touch = createTouchControls({virtual = VirtualInput, gui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"), connections = connections,
        disposed = function() return disposed end,
        blocked = function() return disposed or not alive or jesusFrozen or menuOpen or inventoryOpen or Input:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil end,
        cameraBlocked = blockedCameraInput,
        -- (touch.paused is checked by the touch layer itself)
        flying = function() return keybinds ~= nil and keybinds.flying == true end,
        aimingAtEntity = function()
            local hit = aimHit()
            if not hit then return false end
            return victimOf(hit.Instance) ~= nil
        end})
    local lastPlayerHit = 0
    createSteveNet({world = creativeWorld, humanoid = humanoid, character = character, connections = connections,
        disposed = function() return disposed end,
        jesusStart = function()
            if not alive or disposed then return end
            if creativeWorld.chat then creativeWorld.chat.setGameMode("survival") end
            jesusFrozen = true
            resetInput()
        end,
        jesusAscend = function()
            if not alive or disposed then return end
            if creativeWorld.chat then creativeWorld.chat.setGameMode("survival") end
            jesusFrozen = true
            resetInput()
            local oldAutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate
            humanoid.AutoRotate = false
            local origin = root.CFrame
            local began = os.clock()
            -- Into the light: the screen whites out as you rise.
            local whiteGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            whiteGui.Name, whiteGui.IgnoreGuiInset, whiteGui.DisplayOrder, whiteGui.ResetOnSpawn = "SteveHeavenLight", true, 2000, false
            local white = Instance.new("Frame")
            white.Size, white.BorderSizePixel, white.BackgroundColor3, white.BackgroundTransparency = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 252, 235), 1
            white.Parent = whiteGui
            whiteGui.Parent = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            if MinecraftSounds then pcall(MinecraftSounds.play, "block.beacon.power_select", nil, 1, 0.7) end
            while alive and not disposed and os.clock() - began < 4 do
                local amount = math.clamp((os.clock() - began) / 4, 0, 1)
                white.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp((amount - 0.35) / 0.6, 0, 1)
                root.CFrame = origin + Vector3.new(0, CONFIG.Block * 42 * amount, 0)
                motion = Vector3.zero
                lastSolvedPosition = root.Position
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
            humanoid.AutoRotate = oldAutoRotate
            -- Interrupted (died / script stopped): take the white-out down again.
            if not alive or disposed then whiteGui:Destroy() end
            if alive and not disposed then
                player:Kick("Your Minecraft character has ascended above the clouds and into heaven")
            end
        end,
        -- Player.hurt from another player: survival/adventure only, 10 invulnerable ticks, armour,
        -- then LivingEntity.knockback(0.4) away from the attacker.
        hurt = function(damage, direction)
            if not CONFIG.Survival or PlayerStats.spectator or not alive then return end
            if os.clock() - lastPlayerHit < 0.5 then return end
            lastPlayerHit = os.clock()
            local amount = creativeWorld.gameplay and creativeWorld.gameplay.armorDamage and creativeWorld.gameplay.armorDamage(damage) or damage
            humanoid:TakeDamage(amount * humanoid.MaxHealth / 20)
            local d = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
            if d.Magnitude > 0.01 then d = d.Unit end
            if creativeWorld.knockback then creativeWorld.knockback(Vector3.new(d.X * 0.4, 0.36, d.Z * 0.4)) end
        end,
        live = function()
            local stack = inventoryState.slots[selectedSlot]
            return {held = stack, pitch = viewPitch, crouching = crouching, swimming = swimming, flying = keybinds and keybinds.flying,
                offhand = inventoryState.slots[41], equipment = inventoryState.equipment, dead = not alive,
                blocking = creativeWorld.gameplay and creativeWorld.gameplay.blocking,
                arms = {creativeWorld.netArmPoses()}, inWater = inWater, riding = creativeWorld.gameplay.riding ~= nil,
                gliding = creativeWorld.gameplay.gliding,
                using = (creativeWorld.items and creativeWorld.items.using ~= nil) or creativeWorld.gameplay.blocking or creativeWorld.gameplay.scoping
                    or (creativeWorld.gameplay.charge or 0) > 0,
                usingOff = creativeWorld.offhandUsing, swingOff = creativeWorld.swingOff == true}
        end})
    connections[#connections+1]=Input.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 or not alive or menuOpen then return end
        if inventoryOpen then if CONFIG.AllowCatalog then creativeUI.middle() end; return end
        if CONFIG.Survival then
            local picked=aimHit();local n=picked and creativeWorld.resolve(picked.Instance)
            local id=n and JavaContent.itemIndex(n.index)
            if id then for i=1,9 do if inventoryState.slots[i] and inventoryState.slots[i].id==id then creativeUI.select(i);return end end end
            return
        end
        local hit=aimHit(); if not hit then return end
        local n=creativeWorld.resolve(hit.Instance)
        local index=n and n.index
        if not index then
            local kind=JavaContent.classify(hit)
            for i,e in pairs(JavaContent.byIndex) do if e.name==kind then index=i; break end end
        end
        index=index and JavaContent.itemIndex(index)
        if index then inventoryState.slots[selectedSlot]={id=index,count=(itemStackLimits[index] or (toolStats[index] and 1 or 64))}; creativeUI.refresh() end
    end)
    -- One game tick of MultiPlayerGameMode-style input: holding the primary
    -- button keeps destroying whatever block the crosshair is on (switching
    -- blocks restarts progress), and holding the secondary button places
    -- again every 4 ticks (Java's rightClickDelay).
    local verityCharge
    local function holdingVerity()
        local bridge = rawget(_G, "VerityBridge")
        if type(bridge) ~= "table" or type(bridge.holding) ~= "function" then return nil end
        local ok, holding = pcall(bridge.holding)
        return ok and holding == true and bridge or nil
    end
    local function updateInteraction()
        local primaryPressed, secondaryPressed = primaryQueued, secondaryQueued
        primaryQueued, secondaryQueued = false, false
        -- Spectators cannot break, place, attack or use anything.
        if PlayerStats.spectator then clearMining(); return end
        -- Holding Verity: a fresh right click starts charging (the jump bar fills like riding a horse:
        -- 10% a tick, then easing back towards 80%), releasing throws him that hard.
        local carrier = holdingVerity()
        if carrier and not blockedInput() then
            clearMining()
            if secondaryPressed and not verityCharge then verityCharge = os.clock() end
            if verityCharge then
                local ticks = (os.clock() - verityCharge) * 20
                local power = ticks < 10 and ticks * 0.1 or 0.8 + 2 / (ticks - 9) * 0.1
                if Input:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then
                    _G.SteveHudPower = math.max(power, 0.05)
                else
                    verityCharge, _G.SteveHudPower = nil, nil
                    local okThrow, e = pcall(carrier.throw, math.clamp(power, 0.05, 1))
                    if not okThrow then warn("Verity throw: " .. tostring(e)) end
                end
            end
            return
        elseif verityCharge then
            verityCharge, _G.SteveHudPower = nil, nil
        end
        if nativeTools[selected] then clearMining();return end
        if blockedInput() or worldMining.busy then creativeWorld.gameplay.charge=0;clearMining(); return end
        local primaryHeld = primaryPressed or Input:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
        local secondaryHeld = secondaryPressed or Input:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2)
        -- The Verity Script (when running): right click picks him up, left click punches him.
        if (primaryPressed or secondaryPressed) and type(rawget(_G, "VerityBridge")) == "table" then
            local bridge = _G.VerityBridge
            local okModel, verityModel = pcall(bridge.model)
            if okModel and typeof(verityModel) == "Instance" and verityModel:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
                local cast = RaycastParams.new()
                cast.FilterType, cast.FilterDescendantsInstances = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include, {verityModel}
                local reach = lookVector() * (CONFIG.Reach * CONFIG.Block)
                local onVerity = workspace:Raycast(eyePosition(), reach, cast)
                local other = aimHit()
                if onVerity and (not other or other.Instance:IsDescendantOf(verityModel)
                    or (other.Position - eyePosition()).Magnitude + 0.05 >= (onVerity.Position - eyePosition()).Magnitude) then
                    clearMining()
                    if secondaryPressed then
                        placeDelay = CONFIG.PlaceDelayTicks
                        local okUse, e = pcall(bridge.pickup)
                        if not okUse then warn("Verity pickup: " .. tostring(e)) end
                    else
                        startSwing()
                        local okHit, e = pcall(bridge.punch, eyePosition(), lookVector())
                        if not okHit then warn("Verity punch: " .. tostring(e)) end
                    end
                    return
                end
            end
        end
        if creativeWorld.offhandUsing then
            local still = creativeWorld.withOffhand(function()
                return (creativeWorld.items and creativeWorld.items.interact(secondaryHeld,false,crouching,selected,aimHit,place))
                    or creativeWorld.gameplay.updateUse(secondaryHeld,selected,lookVector(),eyePosition())
            end)
            if still and secondaryHeld then clearMining(); return end
            creativeWorld.offhandUsing = false
        end
        -- Items (batch 7d): entity, block, useOn and use in Java's order, plus held uses.
        if creativeWorld.items and creativeWorld.items.interact(secondaryHeld,secondaryPressed,crouching,selected,aimHit,place) then
            -- Minecraft.startUseItem sets rightClickDelay = 4 for every use, not only placing.
            if secondaryPressed then placeDelay = CONFIG.PlaceDelayTicks end
            clearMining();return
        end
        if creativeWorld.gameplay.updateUse(secondaryHeld,selected,lookVector(),eyePosition()) then clearMining();return end
        if placeDelay > 0 then placeDelay = placeDelay - 1 end
        if primaryHeld then
            local hit = aimHit()
            local target = hit and hit.Instance
            -- Boats and minecarts take hits like Java vehicles (creative: removed at once).
            if primaryPressed and target and creativeWorld.items and creativeWorld.items.attackEntity(target) then clearMining(); startSwing(); return end
            if primaryPressed and target and creativeWorld.gameplay.vehicles.attack(target,(toolStats[selected] and toolStats[selected].damage) or 1) then
                clearMining(); startSwing(); return
            end
            local victim, victimModel = victimOf(target)
            -- Spears jab instead of a normal attack (PiercingWeapon): every mob 2-4.5 blocks along the aim.
            local heldStats = toolStats[selected]
            if primaryPressed and heldStats and heldStats.kind == "spear" and creativeWorld.items and creativeWorld.items.spearJab then
                local info = creativeWorld.attackInfo()
                if info.strength >= 1 then
                    startSwing()
                    attackTicker = 0
                    if creativeWorld.items.spearJab(info) then creativeWorld.damageTool(selected, 1) end
                end
                if victim then clearMining(); return end
            end
            if victim then
                clearMining()
                if primaryPressed then
                    startSwing()
                    local info = creativeWorld.attackInfo()
                    attackTicker = 0
                    local stats = toolStats[selected]
                    local wear = stats and (stats.kind == "sword" or stats.kind == "trident" or stats.kind == "mace" or stats.kind == "spear") and 1 or 2
                    local victimPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(victimModel)
                    local net = creativeWorld.net
                    local mob = creativeWorld.items and creativeWorld.items.mobFrom(target)
                    if victimPlayer and net and net.peers[victimPlayer] and not PlayerStats.spectator then
                        -- Another player running this script: Java's damage, applied by their script.
                        local s = inventoryState.slots[selectedSlot]
                        local strength = info.strength
                        local full = strength > 0.9
                        local base = info.baseDamage * (0.2 + strength * strength * 0.8)
                        local crit = full and info.falling and not grounded and not inWater and not climbing and not info.riding and not sprinting
                        if crit then base = base * 1.5; creativeWorld.effects.hit(hit.Position,true) end
                        local damage = base + strength * creativeWorld.items.enchantDamage(s, "player")
                        if MinecraftSounds then MinecraftSounds.play(crit and "entity.player.attack.crit" or full and "entity.player.attack.strong" or "entity.player.attack.weak", root.Position, 1, 1) end
                        local away = victimModel:GetPivot().Position - root.Position
                        net.attack(victimPlayer, damage, away)
                        if full and sprinting then info.onKnockback() end
                        creativeWorld.damageTool(selected, wear)
                    elseif mob then
                        if creativeWorld.items.playerAttack(mob, info) then creativeWorld.damageTool(selected, wear) end
                    elseif not victimPlayer then
                        -- Other Roblox humanoids (no Minecraft mob): the same damage numbers.
                        local strength = info.strength
                        victim:TakeDamage(info.baseDamage * (0.2 + strength * strength * 0.8))
                        creativeWorld.damageTool(selected, wear)
                    end
                end
            elseif creativeWorld.items and hit and creativeWorld.items.blocksMining(hit,primaryPressed) then clearMining()
                if JavaContent.mods.afterMine then pcall(JavaContent.mods.afterMine) end
            elseif mineable(target) and not CONFIG.Survival then
                -- Creative (MultiPlayerGameMode): the block breaks the moment it is hit, then a held
                -- button waits destroyDelay = 5 ticks; swords, tridents and maces break nothing.
                clearMining()
                local stats = toolStats[selected]
                local item = JavaContent.byIndex[selected]
                if (stats and (stats.kind == "sword" or stats.kind == "trident")) or (item and item.id == "mace") then
                elseif primaryPressed or (creativeWorld.destroyDelay or 0) <= 0 then
                    startSwing()
                    creativeWorld.destroyDelay = 5
                    local center = worldMining.cell(hit)
                    local entry = JavaContent.byName[worldMining.kind(hit,center)]
                    if not creativeWorld.breakBlock(hit,false,{toolIndex=selected}) then
                        worldMining.cut(hit,center,false,function(ok)
                            if ok then if entry then creativeWorld.effects.block(entry.index,center,true) end;creativeWorld.vibrate(center,12,{player=true}) end
                        end,selected)
                    end
                else
                    creativeWorld.destroyDelay = creativeWorld.destroyDelay - 1
                end
            elseif mineable(target) then
                local center = worldMining.cell(hit)
                if target ~= miningTarget or center ~= miningCell then
                    clearMining()
                    miningTarget, miningNormal = target, hit.Normal
                    miningCell = center
                    target:SetAttribute("MinecraftBreakProgress", 0)
                end
                -- MultiPlayerGameMode.continueDestroyBlock() swings every tick.
                startSwing()
                local hardness, harvestable = miningStats(target,hit,center)
                local destroySpeed
                destroySpeed, harvestable = toolMining(selected,worldMining.kind(hit,center),harvestable)
                local entry=JavaContent.byName[worldMining.kind(hit,center)]
                if entry then
                    local tool=toolStats[selected]
                    destroySpeed=tool and tool.kind==entry.tool and (tool.speed or 4) or 1
                    -- Player.hasCorrectToolForDrops(): only requiresCorrectToolForDrops blocks need the
                    -- block's #mineable tool at the tier of its #needs_<tier>_tool tag (cobwebs: sword).
                    local required=entry.requiredTier or 0
                    if entry.requiresTool==nil then harvestable=entry.tool~='pickaxe' or (tool and tool.kind=='pickaxe') or false
                    elseif not entry.requiresTool then harvestable=true
                    else
                        local kind=entry.tool or (entry.id=='cobweb' and 'sword')
                        harvestable=(tool and tool.kind==kind and (tool.tier or 0)>=required) or false
                    end
                    if entry.id=='cobweb' and tool and tool.kind=='sword' then destroySpeed=15 end
                    if tool and tool.kind=='shears' and (entry.id:find('leaves',1,true) or entry.id=='cobweb' or entry.id:find('wool',1,true)) then destroySpeed=15;harvestable=true end
                end
                -- Player.getDestroySpeed() applies the vanilla underwater and
                -- airborne penalties when no Aqua Affinity/tool is present.
                miningProgress = miningProgress + javaDestroyProgress(destroySpeed, hardness, harvestable, inWater, grounded)
                local stage = math.min(9, math.floor(miningProgress * 10))
                target:SetAttribute("MinecraftBreakProgress", stage)
                -- LevelRenderer draws destroy_stage_<n> over the block; Minecraft.continueAttack()
                -- adds one crack particle on the struck face every tick.
                local node=creativeWorld.resolve(target)
                local crackParts={}
                if node then
                    for _,pair in ipairs(node.visual.parts) do
                        local p=pair[1]
                        if p.Parent and (p.Name=='BlockCollider' or not node.visual.model:FindFirstChild('BlockCollider')) then crackParts[#crackParts+1]=p end
                    end
                end
                if #crackParts==0 then
                    -- Plain Roblox parts and terrain: crack the whole cell.
                    crackParts={{CFrame=CFrame.new(center),Size=Vector3.new(CONFIG.Block,CONFIG.Block,CONFIG.Block)}}
                end
                creativeWorld.effects.showCrack(target,center,stage,crackParts)
                if entry then creativeWorld.effects.crack(entry.index,center,hit.Normal,node and node.state) end
                miningSoundTick = stage
                creativeWorld.mineTicks = (creativeWorld.mineTicks or 0) + 1
                if MinecraftSounds and creativeWorld.mineTicks % 4 == 0 then
                    if entry then MinecraftSounds.block(entry.index, "hit", center) end
                end
                if miningProgress >= 1 then
                    local used=selected;local usedStack=inventoryState.slots[selectedSlot]
                    local wear=toolStats[used] and toolStats[used].kind=='sword' and 2 or 1
                    if creativeWorld.breakBlock(hit,harvestable,{toolIndex=used}) then creativeWorld.damageTool(used,wear,usedStack)
                    else worldMining.cut(hit,center,harvestable,function(ok)
                        if ok then if entry then creativeWorld.effects.block(entry.index,center,true) end;creativeWorld.vibrate(center,12,{player=true});creativeWorld.damageTool(used,wear,usedStack) end
                    end,used) end
                    clearMining()
                end
            else
                clearMining()
                -- Minecraft.startAttack() on a miss: swing and reset strength.
                if primaryPressed then startSwing(); attackTicker = 0 end
            end
            return
        end
        clearMining()
        if secondaryHeld and (secondaryPressed or placeDelay <= 0) then
            placeDelay = CONFIG.PlaceDelayTicks
            local hit = aimHit()
            local done = false
            if hit then
                if creativeWorld.use(hit,crouching,selected) then startSwing(); done = true else done = place(hit) end
            end
            -- The main hand did nothing: the offhand item (its use, or placing its block).
            if not done and inventoryState.slots[41] then
                local used = creativeWorld.withOffhand(function()
                    if secondaryPressed then creativeWorld.gameplay.useHeld = false end
                    if secondaryPressed and ((creativeWorld.items and creativeWorld.items.interact(true,true,crouching,selected,aimHit,place))
                        or creativeWorld.gameplay.updateUse(true,selected,lookVector(),eyePosition())) then return "use" end
                    return hit and place(hit) and "place"
                end)
                if used == "use" then creativeWorld.offhandUsing = true end
            end
        end
    end
    -- ItemInHandRenderer.tick(): the shown item follows attack strength
    -- cubed and drops to 0 (then swaps) whenever the selected item differs.
    local function updateHandHeight()
        attackTicker = attackTicker + 1
        local stats = toolStats[selected]
        local strength = clamp((attackTicker + 1) / (stats and 20/stats.attackSpeed or CONFIG.AttackDelayTicks), 0, 1)
        local same = blockNames[shownSlot] == blockNames[selected]
        mainHandHeightOld = mainHandHeight
        mainHandHeight = mainHandHeight + clamp((same and strength * strength * strength or 0) - mainHandHeight, -0.4, 0.4)
        if mainHandHeight < 0.1 then showSlot(selected) end
    end
    local oldHealth = humanoid.Health
    connections[#connections + 1] = humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
        if health < oldHealth and alive and (not CONFIG.Survival or PlayerStats.spectator) and os.clock() > (PlayerStats.killUntil or 0) then
            humanoid.Health = oldHealth
            return
        end
        if health < oldHealth then
            hurtTime = 0.45
            if MinecraftSounds then
                MinecraftSounds.play(health <= 0 and "entity.player.death" or "entity.player.hurt", nil, 1, (math.random() - math.random()) * 0.2 + 1)
            else hurt:Play() end
        end
        oldHealth = health
        -- Totem of undying (LivingEntity.checkTotemDeathProtection).
        if health <= 0 and alive and creativeWorld and creativeWorld.items and creativeWorld.items.tryTotem() then oldHealth = humanoid.Health; return end
        if health <= 0 and alive then
            alive = false; resetInput(); deathTime = 0
            pcall(JavaGui.showDeath, JavaContent.deathMessage(creativeWorld, player.Name), PlayerStats.xpTotal or 0)
            walkSpeedOld, walkSpeed, walkPosition = 0, 0, 0
            swimAmountOld, swimAmount = 0, 0
            makeCorpse()
            -- The kinematic solver stops on death; let Roblox physics hold the body.
            motion, root.CanCollide = Vector3.zero, true
            -- Java's death fall on the real avatar first (other players see it), then the Roblox death.
            do
                local r = creativeWorld and creativeWorld.replication
                if r and r.die then r.die() end
                task.delay(r and r.die and 0.65 or 0, function()
                    if r and r.died then r.died() end
                    if disposed or player.Character ~= character then return end
                    pcall(function()
                        humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
                        humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = true
                        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
                    end)
                    task.delay(0.6, function() pcall(function() character:BreakJoints() end) end)
                end)
            end
        end
    end)

    local function cameraDirections()
        -- Movement follows the player's view, not the camera: in the
        -- third-person front view the camera faces the opposite way.
        local look = lookVector()
        local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
        -- Looking straight up/down must not erase WASD direction.
        if flat.Magnitude < 0.001 then flat = CFrame.Angles(0, viewYaw, 0).LookVector end
        flat = flat.Unit
        return look, flat, Vector3.new(-flat.Z, 0, flat.X)
    end
    -- Entity.collide(), Java style: sweep the axis-aligned hull along one axis
    -- at a time and stop CollisionSkin short of the first hit. A cast box
    -- shrunk by the skin never starts inside the surface it is resting on,
    -- so flat seams between parts/blocks can never act like a wall.
    local sweep = bodyCollision.sweep
    local function sweepHorizontal(position, delta)
        -- Direction.axisStepOrder(): the larger horizontal axis moves first.
        local axes = math.abs(delta.X) >= math.abs(delta.Z) and {"X", "Z"} or {"Z", "X"}
        local blocked = {}
        for _, axis in ipairs(axes) do
            local offset = axis == "X" and Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 0, delta.Z)
            local moved, hit = sweep(position, offset)
            position, blocked[axis] = position + moved, hit
        end
        return position, blocked.X, blocked.Z
    end
    -- Entity.move(): Y first, then X/Z, then the 0.6-block step-up retry
    -- when a horizontal collision happens on (or onto) the ground.
    local function moveBodyStep(delta)
        local start = root.Position
        local movedY, hitY = sweep(start, Vector3.new(0, delta.Y, 0))
        local landed = hitY and delta.Y < 0
        local position, hitX, hitZ = sweepHorizontal(start + movedY, delta)
        if (hitX or hitZ) and (grounded or landed) then
            local rise = sweep(start, Vector3.new(0, CONFIG.StepHeight * CONFIG.Block, 0))
            local stepped, stepX, stepZ = sweepHorizontal(start + rise, delta)
            local drop, stepLanded = sweep(stepped, Vector3.new(0, -rise.Y + math.min(delta.Y, 0), 0))
            stepped = stepped + drop
            local function travelled(p) return Vector3.new(p.X - start.X, 0, p.Z - start.Z).Magnitude end
            if stepLanded and not bodyCollision.blocked(stepped) and travelled(stepped) > travelled(position) + 1e-4 then
                position, hitX, hitZ, hitY, landed = stepped, stepX, stepZ, true, true
            end
        end
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
        return hitX, hitY, hitZ, landed
    end
    lastSolvedPosition = root.Position
    -- For items (ender pearls, chorus fruit, riptide, projectiles): motion in blocks per tick, water, sneaking, view.
    creativeWorld.motion=function() return motion end
    creativeWorld.inWater=function() return inWater end
    creativeWorld.sneaking=function() return crouching end
    creativeWorld.firstPerson=function() return cameraView==1 end
    creativeWorld.teleport=function(feet)
        if creativeWorld.gameplay.riding then creativeWorld.gameplay.vehicles.dismount() end
        root.CFrame=CFrame.new(feet+Vector3.new(0,root.Size.Y/2+0.02,0));motion=Vector3.zero;lastSolvedPosition=root.Position
    end
    local function moveBody(delta)
        -- Spectator mode: no collision at all.
        if PlayerStats.noclip then root.CFrame = root.CFrame + delta; lastSolvedPosition = root.Position; return false,false,false,false end
        local recovered, clear = bodyCollision.recover(root.Position)
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(recovered)
        if not clear then return true,true,true,false end
        -- Bound displacement per solve, including fast falls and low frame rates.
        local count = math.max(1,math.ceil(delta.Magnitude/(math.min(root.Size.X,root.Size.Z)*0.45)))
        if count > 128 then delta=delta*(128/count); count=128 end
        local step = delta/count
        local x,y,z,landed = false,false,false,false
        for _=1,count do
            local hx,hy,hz,ground = moveBodyStep(step)
            x,y,z,landed = x or hx,y or hy,z or hz,landed or ground
            step = Vector3.new(hx and 0 or step.X,hy and 0 or step.Y,hz and 0 or step.Z)
        end
        bodyCollision.remember(root.Position)
        lastSolvedPosition = root.Position
        return x,y,z,landed
    end
    keybinds = createJavaKeybinds({gui = gui, root = root, player = player, connections = connections,
        world = function() return creativeWorld end, ui = function() return creativeUI end, inventory = inventoryState,
        aimHit = aimHit, mineable = mineable, worldMining = worldMining,
        view = function() return viewYaw, viewPitch end,
        state = function() return disposed, alive, menuOpen, inventoryOpen end})
    -- Status effects and the Java chat / commands (kept on the world table: setup is at its local limit).
    creativeWorld.statusEffects = createStatusEffects({humanoid = humanoid, gui = gui, character = character, connections = connections,
        gameplay = function() return creativeWorld.gameplay end,
        -- The Darkness effect drives the same pulsing darkness the warden uses (fades over 22 ticks).
        darkness = function()
            local m = creativeWorld.machines
            if not m then return end
            if creativeWorld.tickCount >= m.darknessUntil then m.darknessStart = creativeWorld.tickCount end
            m.darknessUntil = creativeWorld.tickCount + 22
        end})
    creativeWorld.chat = createChat({player = player, root = root, humanoid = humanoid, gui = gui, connections = connections,
        world = creativeWorld, inventory = inventoryState, ui = creativeUI, keybinds = keybinds, effects = creativeWorld.statusEffects,
        getView = function() return viewYaw, viewPitch end,
        setView = function(yaw, pitch) viewYaw, viewPitch = yaw, clamp(pitch, -CONFIG.MaxPitch, CONFIG.MaxPitch) end,
        teleport = function(feet)
            if creativeWorld.gameplay.riding then creativeWorld.gameplay.vehicles.dismount() end
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(feet + Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2, 0)); motion = Vector3.zero; lastSolvedPosition = root.Position
        end,
        onOpen = function(open) inventoryOpen = open; resetInput() end,
        blocked = function() return disposed or not alive or jesusFrozen or menuOpen or inventoryOpen end})
    -- /spawnpoint survives respawns: a new character starts there.
    do
        local spawn = player:GetAttribute("SteveSpawnPoint")
        if typeof(spawn) == "Vector3" then root.CFrame = CFrame.new(spawn + Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2 + 0.05, 0)) end
    end
    local function simulationTick()
        local canControl=not blockedInput()
        creativeWorld.gameplay.controls={forward=canControl and keys[Enum.KeyCode.W],back=canControl and keys[Enum.KeyCode.S],left=canControl and keys[Enum.KeyCode.A],right=canControl and keys[Enum.KeyCode.D],sneak=canControl and (keys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] or keys[Enum.KeyCode.RightShift]),jump=canControl and keys[Enum.KeyCode.Space],look=lookVector()}
        creativeWorld.tick()
        environment()
        -- LivingEntity.pushEntities -> Entity.push: an overlapping player pushes us apart by 0.05 a tick.
        if alive and not PlayerStats.noclip and not creativeWorld.gameplay.riding then
            for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local otherRoot = other ~= player and other.Character and other.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if otherRoot then
                    local d = otherRoot.Position - root.Position
                    local reach = math.max(otherRoot.Size.X, otherRoot.Size.Z) * 0.5 + root.Size.X * 0.5
                    if math.abs(d.X) < reach and math.abs(d.Z) < reach and math.abs(d.Y) < root.Size.Y * 0.5 + 3 then
                        local dx, dz = d.X / CONFIG.Block, d.Z / CONFIG.Block
                        local m = math.max(math.abs(dx), math.abs(dz))
                        if m >= 0.01 then
                            m = math.sqrt(m)
                            dx, dz = dx / m, dz / m
                            local f = math.min(1, 1 / m)
                            motion = motion - Vector3.new(dx * f * 0.05, 0, dz * f * 0.05)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local velocity = motion
        local floor = floorAt(Vector3.zero, 0.18)
        grounded = floor ~= nil and floor.Normal.Y > 0.65 and velocity.Y <= 0.02
        -- Java advances block destroy progress once per game tick while the
        -- primary mouse button remains held on the same block.
        local net = creativeWorld.net
        local acting = net and (primaryQueued or secondaryQueued or Input:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
            or Input:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2))
        if acting then pcall(net.beginAction, aimHit()) end
        updateInteraction()
        if acting then pcall(net.endAction) end
        updateHandHeight()
        if creativeWorld.gameplay.riding then
            local vehicle=creativeWorld.gameplay.riding
            -- The frame step seats the player (interpolated); here only the motion stops.
            motion=Vector3.zero
            walkSpeedOld,walkSpeed=walkSpeed,walkSpeed*0.6
            if vehicle.kind=='boat' then
                -- Boat.clampRotation(): the body faces the boat, the view turns at most 105 degrees from it.
                bodyYawOld,bodyYaw=bodyYaw,vehicle.yaw
                local rel=wrapAngle(viewYaw-vehicle.yaw)
                if math.abs(rel)>math.rad(105) then viewYaw=vehicle.yaw+clamp(rel,-math.rad(105),math.rad(105)) end
            end
            return
        end
        local look, forward, right = cameraDirections()
        local w, s = keys[Enum.KeyCode.W], keys[Enum.KeyCode.S]
        local a, d = keys[Enum.KeyCode.A], keys[Enum.KeyCode.D]
        local shift = keys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] or keys[Enum.KeyCode.RightShift]
        local ctrl = keys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] or keys[Enum.KeyCode.RightControl]
        local jump = keys[Enum.KeyCode.Space]
        if blockedInput() then w, s, a, d, shift, ctrl, jump = false, false, false, false, false, false, false end
        -- LocalPlayer.aiStep(): a second jump press within 7 ticks toggles creative flight;
        -- touching the ground ends it, and sneaking while flying descends instead of crouching.
        local kb = keybinds
        if kb.jumpTriggerTime > 0 then kb.jumpTriggerTime = kb.jumpTriggerTime - 1 end
        local jumpPressed = jump and not kb.jumpWasDown
        kb.jumpWasDown = jump
        if CONFIG.Survival or not alive or creativeWorld.gameplay.gliding then kb.flying = false
        elseif jumpPressed then
            if kb.jumpTriggerTime == 0 then kb.jumpTriggerTime = 7 else kb.flying = not kb.flying; kb.jumpTriggerTime = 0 end
        end
        if kb.flying and grounded and not jump then kb.flying = false end
        if PlayerStats.spectator then kb.flying = true end
        local flying = kb.flying
        sprinting = alive and w and not s and (flying or not shift) and not climbing and (ctrl or sprintLatched) or false
        swimming = inWater and sprinting
        local desiredHeight = swimming and CONFIG.SwimHeight or (shift and not inWater and not flying and CONFIG.CrouchHeight or CONFIG.StandHeight)
        if not changeHeight(desiredHeight) then
            -- Stay in the smaller pose until there is actually room to exit it (crouching first).
            if desiredHeight > CONFIG.CrouchHeight then changeHeight(CONFIG.CrouchHeight) end
            swimming = root.Size.Y < CONFIG.CrouchHeight * CONFIG.Block - 0.01
        end
        -- Crawling (the swimming pose out of water) is "moving slowly": no sprinting.
        if swimming and not inWater then sprinting, sprintLatched = false, false end
        crouching = not swimming and not inWater and root.Size.Y < CONFIG.StandHeight * CONFIG.Block - 0.01
        if crouching then sprinting, sprintLatched = false, false end
        local input = forward * ((w and 1 or 0) - (s and 1 or 0)) + right * ((d and 1 or 0) - (a and 1 or 0))
        if input.Magnitude > 1 then input = input.Unit end
        local vx, vy, vz = velocity.X, velocity.Y, velocity.Z
        if flying then
            -- Player.travel() while flying: flyingSpeed 0.05 (x2 sprinting) with air drag 0.91,
            -- jump/sneak add +/-0.15 (flyingSpeed*3) and vertical speed keeps 60% per tick.
            local speed = sprinting and 0.1 or 0.05
            vx, vz = (vx + input.X * 0.98 * speed) * 0.91, (vz + input.Z * 0.98 * speed) * 0.91
            if shift then vy = vy - 0.15 end
            if jump then vy = vy + 0.15 end
            vy = vy * 0.6
        elseif inLava and not inWater then
            -- travelInLava(): moveRelative 0.02, then x0.5 on every axis and gravity/4; jump adds 0.04.
            if jump then vy = vy + 0.04 end
            vx, vz = (vx + input.X * 0.02) * 0.5, (vz + input.Z * 0.02) * 0.5
            vy = vy * 0.5 - 0.02
            if wallBump then vy = math.max(vy, 0.3) end
        elseif inWater then
            -- LivingEntity.jumpInLiquid(): holding jump in water swims up by 0.04 a tick.
            local fluidH = JavaContent.fluidDepthAt and JavaContent.fluidDepthAt(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2 - 0.02, 0)) or nil
            if jump and grounded and fluidH and fluidH <= 0.4 then
                vy, grounded = PlayerStats.jumpStrength + PlayerStats.jumpBoost, false
            elseif jump and not swimming then vy = vy + 0.04 end
            -- Player.travel() adds a look-pitch swim impulse before
            -- LivingEntity.travelInWater(). The horizontal input passed to
            -- moveRelative remains level; water then scales Y separately.
            local fallingInWater = vy <= 0
            if swimming then
                local lookY = look.Y
                local swimLift = lookY < -0.2 and 0.085 or 0.06
                if lookY <= 0 or jump then vy = vy + (lookY - vy) * swimLift end
            end
            local swimDirection = swimming
                and (forward * ((w and 1 or 0) - (s and 1 or 0))
                    + right * ((d and 1 or 0) - (a and 1 or 0)))
                or input
            if swimDirection.Magnitude > 1 then swimDirection = swimDirection.Unit end
            local drag = swimming and 0.9 or 0.8
            vx, vz = (vx + swimDirection.X * 0.02) * drag, (vz + swimDirection.Z * 0.02) * drag
            vy = vy * 0.8
            if not sprinting and fallingInWater then vy = vy - 0.005 end
            if shift then vy = vy - 0.02 end
            -- travelInWater(): pushing into a ledge with open air 0.6 above lifts you out (0.3).
            if wallBump then
                local above = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2 + 0.6 * CONFIG.Block, 0)
                local cellAbove = creativeWorld.nodeAt(creativeWorld.cell(above))
                if not waterAt(above) and not (cellAbove and (cellAbove.id == "water" or cellAbove.state.waterlogged == "true")) then vy = 0.3 end
            end
        else
            local slipperiness = floor and floor.Material == Enum.Material.Ice and 0.98 or 0.6
            if floor and floor.Instance:IsA("BasePart") then
                slipperiness = clamp(tonumber(floor.Instance:GetAttribute("MinecraftSlipperiness")) or slipperiness, 0.1, 0.99)
            end
            local phys = creativeWorld.blockPhysics
            if phys and grounded then slipperiness = phys.friction() or slipperiness end
            vx, vz = horizontalTick(vx, vz, input.X, input.Z, grounded, sprinting, crouching or swimming, slipperiness)
            if phys then
                local factor = phys.speedFactor()
                vx, vz = vx * factor, vz * factor
                if grounded then vx, vz = phys.stepOn(vx, vy, vz, crouching) end
            end
            vy = grounded and 0 or verticalTick(vy)
            if phys and not grounded then vy = phys.honeySlide(vy) or vy end
            -- Java has no arbitrary jump cooldown: a held jump input fires as
            -- soon as the collision solver reports the next grounded tick.
            if jump and grounded then
                vy, grounded = (PlayerStats.jumpStrength + PlayerStats.jumpBoost) * (phys and phys.jumpFactor() or 1), false
                if sprinting then vx, vz = vx + forward.X * 0.2, vz + forward.Z * 0.2 end
            end
            if climbing then
                vx, vz, vy = clamp(vx, -0.15, 0.15), clamp(vz, -0.15, 0.15), math.max(vy, shift and 0 or -0.15)
                if (w or jump) and not shift then vy = 0.2 end
            end
        end
        if not alive then vx, vz = vx * 0.6, vz * 0.6 end
        -- Entity.makeStuckInBlock (cobweb, sweet berry bush, powder snow): the motion is held back and the fall resets.
        if creativeWorld.blockPhysics and not flying then
            local stuck = creativeWorld.blockPhysics.stuck()
            if stuck then vx, vy, vz = vx * stuck[1], vy * stuck[2], vz * stuck[3]; creativeWorld.blockPhysics.fallDistance = 0 end
        end
        if math.abs(vx) < 0.003 then vx = 0 end
        if math.abs(vz) < 0.003 then vz = 0 end
        -- LivingEntity.tickHeadTurn(): body follows movement by 0.3 per
        -- client tick, then absorbs any view angle beyond the player's 50
        -- degree max head rotation. This prevents a local Neck from ever
        -- accumulating a full 360-degree turn.
        local flight=creativeWorld.gameplay.flightTick(velocity,look,grounded,inWater,jump)
        if flight then vx,vy,vz=flight.X,flight.Y,flight.Z end
        bodyYawOld = bodyYaw
        local viewYawNow = viewYaw
        local bodyTarget = bodyYaw
        if vx * vx + vz * vz > 0.0025 then
            local moveYaw = math.atan2(-vx, -vz)
            if math.abs(wrapAngle(viewYawNow - moveYaw)) > math.rad(95) then
                moveYaw = wrapAngle(moveYaw + math.pi)
            end
            bodyTarget = moveYaw
        end
        if swing < 1 then bodyTarget = viewYawNow end
        bodyYaw = approachAngle(bodyYaw, bodyTarget, 0.3)
        local headDiff = wrapAngle(viewYawNow - bodyYaw)
        if math.abs(headDiff) > CONFIG.HeadYaw then
            bodyYaw = wrapAngle(bodyYaw + headDiff - (headDiff > 0 and CONFIG.HeadYaw or -CONFIG.HeadYaw))
        end
        -- LivingEntity.calculateEntityAnimation() measures the distance
        -- moved during this client tick, then WalkAnimationState.update()
        -- smooths that value by 0.4 and advances its phase by the smoothed
        -- speed. Keep the same tick-domain state for Java's limb equations.
        -- vx/vz are already blocks-per-tick (the same unit returned by
        -- Java's movement code), so do not multiply by the 0.05 second tick.
        local distance = math.sqrt(vx * vx + vz * vz)
        walkSpeedOld = walkSpeed
        walkSpeed = walkSpeed + (math.min(distance * 4, 1) - walkSpeed) * 0.4
        walkPosition = walkPosition + walkSpeed
        -- Entity.move(): STEP each time moveDist (0.6 per block walked) passes the next step,
        -- HIT_GROUND on landing; sneaking (isSteppingCarefully) makes neither vibration.
        local cw = creativeWorld
        local feetPosition = root.Position - Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2, 0)
        if grounded and alive and not cw.gameplay.riding then
            cw.stepDistance = (cw.stepDistance or 0) + distance * 0.6
            if cw.stepDistance >= 1 then
                cw.stepDistance = cw.stepDistance % 1
                if MinecraftSounds then
                    local under = cw.sample(cw.cell(feetPosition - Vector3.new(0, CONFIG.Block * 0.2, 0)))
                    if under and under.id and under.id ~= "unknown" then MinecraftSounds.blockId(under.id, "step", feetPosition)
                    else
                        local ground = workspace:Raycast(feetPosition + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0), Vector3.new(0, -CONFIG.Block * 0.5, 0), cast)
                        if ground then MinecraftSounds.material(ground.Material, "step", feetPosition) end
                    end
                end
                if not crouching then cw.vibrate(feetPosition, 1, {player = true}) end
            end
            if cw.wasAirborne and not crouching then cw.vibrate(feetPosition, 2, {player = true}) end
        end
        cw.wasAirborne = not grounded and not inWater and not keybinds.flying and alive
        walkPositionScale = 1
        swimAmountOld = swimAmount
        swimAmount = swimming and math.min(1, swimAmount + 0.09) or math.max(0, swimAmount - 0.09)
        -- Entity.move() walkDist and Player.aiStep() bob for GameRenderer.bobView().
        walkDistOld, viewBobOld = walkDist, viewBob
        walkDist = walkDist + distance * 0.6
        local bobTarget = grounded and alive and not swimming and math.min(0.1, distance) or 0
        viewBob = viewBob + ((CONFIG.ViewBobbing == false and 0 or bobTarget) - viewBob) * 0.4
        motion = Vector3.new(vx, vy, vz)
    end
    connections[#connections + 1] = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
        if disposed or not root.Parent then return end
        if not alive then gravity.Force = Vector3.zero; return end
        -- Clear stock movement requests without touching/importing PlayerModule.
        humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
        humanoid.Jump = false
        for _,joint in pairs(rig) do joint.Transform=CFrame.identity end
        -- These are local physical properties. Never anchor the character or change world gravity.
        gravity.Force = Vector3.new(0, root.AssemblyMass * workspace.Gravity, 0)
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        -- /generate_world holds the player still while its loading screen is up.
        if creativeWorld.genHold then motion=Vector3.zero;accumulator=0;root.CFrame=CFrame.new(lastSolvedPosition);root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;return end
        -- Reconcile small engine/network displacements through the same swept
        -- hull, so a correction cannot quietly teleport us below a thin floor.
        if PlayerStats.noclip then root.CFrame = CFrame.new(lastSolvedPosition) end
        local correction = root.Position-lastSolvedPosition
        if not creativeWorld.gameplay.riding and correction.Magnitude > 0.0001 and correction.Magnitude < CONFIG.Block*4 then
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(lastSolvedPosition)
        end
        -- Player.updatePlayerPose(): a body that no longer fits takes the crouching pose, else the
        -- swimming pose (crawling), instead of being pushed out of the gap.
        if false then
            local previousSize, previousFrame = root.Size, root.CFrame
            local feet = previousFrame.Position.Y - previousSize.Y / 2
            local fitted = false
            for _, blocks in ipairs({CONFIG.CrouchHeight, CONFIG.SwimHeight}) do
                local height = blocks * CONFIG.Block
                if height < previousSize.Y - 0.001 then
                    root.Size = Vector3.new(previousSize.X, height, previousSize.Z)
                    root.CFrame = previousFrame + Vector3.new(0, feet + height / 2 - previousFrame.Position.Y, 0)
                    if not bodyCollision.blocked(root.Position) then fitted = true; break end
                end
            end
            if fitted then lastSolvedPosition = root.Position else root.Size, root.CFrame = previousSize, previousFrame end
        end
        local recovered, clear = root.Position, true
        if not PlayerStats.noclip and not creativeWorld.gameplay.riding then recovered, clear = bodyCollision.recover(root.Position) end
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(recovered)
        if not clear then motion=Vector3.zero; root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero; return end
        dt = math.min(dt, 0.1)
        accumulator = accumulator + dt
        while accumulator >= CONFIG.Tick do
            accumulator = accumulator - CONFIG.Tick
            simulationTick()
        end
        -- Move this frame's share of the tick motion through the solver, so the
        -- 20 Hz Java motion renders smoothly at any frame rate.
        local delta = motion * (CONFIG.Block * dt / CONFIG.Tick)
        -- Player.maybeBackOffFromEdge(): sneaking never walks off a ledge
        -- (checked per axis and diagonally); jumping still leaves the edge.
        if alive and crouching and grounded and not climbing and delta.Y <= 0 then
            local x, z = delta.X, delta.Z
            local depth = CONFIG.StepHeight * CONFIG.Block + 0.15
            if x ~= 0 and not floorAt(Vector3.new(x, 0, 0), depth) then x = 0 end
            if z ~= 0 and not floorAt(Vector3.new(0, 0, z), depth) then z = 0 end
            if (x ~= 0 or z ~= 0) and not floorAt(Vector3.new(x, 0, z), depth) then x, z = 0, 0 end
            delta = Vector3.new(x, delta.Y, z)
            motion = Vector3.new(x == 0 and 0 or motion.X, motion.Y, z == 0 and 0 or motion.Z)
        end
        local hitX, hitY, hitZ, landed = false, false, false, false
        if JavaContent.mods.carry and not creativeWorld.gameplay.riding then
            local okC, carried = pcall(JavaContent.mods.carry)
            if okC and typeof(carried) == "Vector3" then delta = delta + carried end
        end
        if not creativeWorld.gameplay.riding then hitX, hitY, hitZ, landed = moveBody(delta) end
        wallBump = hitX or hitZ
        local fallVy = motion.Y
        -- Java zeroes only the motion component that actually collided.
        motion = Vector3.new(hitX and 0 or motion.X, hitY and 0 or motion.Y, hitZ and 0 or motion.Z)
        if landed then grounded = true end
        -- Riding: the seat at this frame's interpolated vehicle position, after (and instead of) collision -
        -- the seat is inside the vehicle, so the solver would push the body out of it.
        local riding = creativeWorld.gameplay.riding
        if riding then
            local partial = math.clamp(accumulator / CONFIG.Tick, 0, 1)
            local seat = riding.seatAt and riding.seatAt(partial) or (riding.seat and riding.seat()) or riding.position
            if seat then
                root.CFrame = root.CFrame.Rotation + (seat + Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2, 0))
                lastSolvedPosition = root.Position
                motion, grounded = Vector3.zero, true
            end
        end
        -- Entity.checkFallDamage: the fall grows while moving down and is spent on landing (Block.fallOn).
        local phys = creativeWorld.blockPhysics
        if phys then
            local gp = creativeWorld.gameplay
            local fx = creativeWorld.statusEffects
            if inWater or climbing or (keybinds and keybinds.flying) or not alive or PlayerStats.spectator or gp.riding
                or (fx and (fx.has("slow_falling") or fx.has("levitation"))) then
                phys.fallDistance = 0
            elseif delta.Y < 0 and not landed then
                phys.fallDistance = phys.fallDistance - delta.Y / CONFIG.Block
                -- LivingEntity.travel while fall flying: slower than 0.5 a tick keeps the fall at 1.
                if gp.gliding and fallVy > -0.5 then phys.fallDistance = 1 end
            end
            if landed then
                local fall = phys.fallDistance
                phys.fallDistance = 0
                local landedOn = fall > 0 and phys.land(fall, crouching) or nil
                local up = phys.bounce(landedOn, fallVy, crouching)
                if up then motion = Vector3.new(motion.X, up, motion.Z); grounded = false end
            end
        end
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)

    local function cameraCollide(from, target)
        local offset = target - from
        local hit = offset.Magnitude > 0.01 and workspace:Raycast(from, offset, cast)
        if hit then return from + offset.Unit * math.max(0.3, hit.Distance - 0.3) end
        return target
    end
    local renderName = "SteveAnimation_" .. player.UserId
    RunService:BindToRenderStep(renderName, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(dt)
        if disposed or not root.Parent then return end
        dt = math.min(dt, 0.1)
        age, swing, hurtTime = age + dt, math.min(1, swing + dt / 0.3), math.max(0, hurtTime - dt)
        -- Minecraft mouse look in every POV: the cursor stays locked in the
        -- centre and mouse movement turns the view, like Roblox first person.
        -- This runs after Roblox's camera step, so it wins every frame.
        if blockedCameraInput() then
            Input.MouseBehavior, Input.MouseIconEnabled = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default, true
        else
            Input.MouseBehavior, Input.MouseIconEnabled = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter, false
            local delta = Input:GetMouseDelta()
            viewYaw = wrapAngle(viewYaw - delta.X * CONFIG.MouseSensitivity)
            viewPitch = clamp(viewPitch - delta.Y * CONFIG.MouseSensitivity * (CONFIG.InvertMouse and -1 or 1), -CONFIG.MaxPitch, CONFIG.MaxPitch)
        end
        local yaw, pitch = viewYaw, viewPitch
        local v = motion * (CONFIG.Block * 20)
        local speed = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude / CONFIG.Block
        local partial = clamp(accumulator / CONFIG.Tick, 0, 1)
        creativeWorld.renderPartial = partial
        -- Use one tick fraction for the passenger, camera, and vehicle meshes.
        local ride = creativeWorld.gameplay.riding
        if ride then
            local seat = ride.seatAt and ride.seatAt(partial) or (ride.seat and ride.seat())
            if seat then
                root.CFrame = root.CFrame.Rotation + seat + Vector3.new(0, root.Size.Y / 2, 0)
                lastSolvedPosition = root.Position
            end
        end
        local bodyRenderYaw = deathYaw or approachAngle(bodyYawOld, bodyYaw, partial)
        -- HumanoidModel.setupAnim from the installed Java 26.3 client. The
        -- render state uses WalkAnimationState.position(partialTicks) and
        -- speed(partialTicks), rather than a render-delta gait accumulator.
        -- Every angle and pixel offset below is in Java's model space; the
        -- javaPart() conversion to Roblox happens once, when posing joints.
        local animationSpeed = math.min(lerp(walkSpeedOld, walkSpeed, partial), 1)
        local animationPos = (walkPosition - walkSpeed * (1 - partial)) * walkPositionScale
        local limbPhase = animationPos * 0.6662
        local rightA = math.cos(limbPhase + math.pi) * 2 * animationSpeed * 0.5
        local leftA = math.cos(limbPhase) * 2 * animationSpeed * 0.5
        local rightL = math.cos(limbPhase) * 1.4 * animationSpeed
        local leftL = math.cos(limbPhase + math.pi) * 1.4 * animationSpeed
        local armYawL, armYawR = 0, 0
        local armRollL, armRollR = 0, 0
        local legRollL, legRollR = -0.005, 0.005
        -- Java ModelPart pivots (pixels). Java's right side is -X.
        local rightArmX, rightArmZ, leftArmX, leftArmZ = -5, 0, 5, 0
        local bodyPitch, bodyTurn, bodyY, headY, armY, legY, legZ = 0, 0, 0, 0, creativeWorld.skinSlim and 2.5 or 2, 12, 0
        -- Whole-entity rotations (Java's renderer, not the model), in Roblox terms.
        local swimPitch, swimLift, deathRoll, deathLift = 0, 0, 0, 0
        local renderHeadPitch = pitch
        local state = "Idle"
        if speed > 0.1 then state = sprinting and "Sprint" or "Walk" end
        -- HumanoidModel.poseRightArm(ArmPose.ITEM), followed by its modern
        -- WHACK attack animation. Java applies these before crouch, arm bob,
        -- and swim blending, so preserve that ordering here.
        if JavaContent.byIndex[selected] or blockTextures[selected] or toolStats[selected] then
            rightA = rightA * 0.5 - 0.31415927
            armYawR = 0
        end
        if swing < 1 and alive then
            local swingLeft = creativeWorld.swingOff == true
            bodyTurn = math.sin(math.sqrt(swing) * (math.pi * 2)) * 0.2 * (swingLeft and -1 or 1)
            rightArmZ, rightArmX = math.sin(bodyTurn) * 5, -math.cos(bodyTurn) * 5
            leftArmZ, leftArmX = -math.sin(bodyTurn) * 5, math.cos(bodyTurn) * 5
            armYawR, armYawL = armYawR + bodyTurn, armYawL + bodyTurn
            leftA = leftA + bodyTurn
            -- Java's head.xRot is positive looking down: the negated Roblox pitch.
            local attackAmount = math.sin(easeOutQuart(swing) * math.pi) * 1.2
                + math.sin(swing * math.pi) * -(-renderHeadPitch - 0.7) * 0.75
            if swingLeft then
                leftA = leftA - attackAmount
                armYawL = armYawL + bodyTurn * 2
                armRollL = armRollL - math.sin(swing * math.pi) * 0.4
            else
                rightA = rightA - attackAmount
                armYawR = armYawR + bodyTurn * 2
