                armRollR = armRollR - math.sin(swing * math.pi) * 0.4
            end
        end
        if crouching then
            -- HumanoidModel's crouching branch: body leans forward 0.5 rad,
            -- arms follow by 0.4, and the parts drop by 3.2/4.2/3.2 pixels
            -- while the legs move 4 pixels back under the hips.
            state, bodyPitch = "Crouch", 0.5
            bodyY, headY, armY, legY, legZ = 3.2, 4.2, 5.2, 12.2, 4
            leftA, rightA = leftA + 0.4, rightA + 0.4
        end
        -- AnimationUtils.bobModelPart() is part of Java's normal humanoid
        -- setupAnim. It bobs the arms only; the legs keep their +/-0.005
        -- duck-walk z rotations above.
        local ageTicks = age * 20
        local bobZ = math.cos(ageTicks * 0.09) * 0.05 + 0.05
        local bobX = math.sin(ageTicks * 0.067) * 0.05
        armRollR, armRollL = armRollR + bobZ, armRollL - bobZ
        rightA, leftA = rightA + bobX, leftA - bobX
        if not grounded and not inWater and not climbing then
            -- Java's HumanoidModel has no separate jump/fall limb clip. Its
            -- walk pose remains driven by the last walk-animation values.
            state = v.Y > 0 and "Jump" or "Fall"
        end
        if climbing then
            -- Climbing is a movement state in Java, not a special authored
            -- humanoid pose. Keep the normal gait instead of the old Roblox
            -- arms-over-head animation.
            state = "Climb"
        elseif inWater or swimming or swimAmount > 0.0001 then
            -- Java 26.3 uses the walk-animation position for the 26-tick
            -- swim stroke. Arms blend into each phase by swimAmount (0..1),
            -- and the first phase uses quadraticArmUpdate exactly as Java.
            local stroke = animationPos % 26
            local swimBlend = clamp(lerp(swimAmountOld, swimAmount, partial), 0, 1)
            local leftSwimBlend = swimBlend
            local rightSwimBlend = swing < 1 and 0 or swimBlend
            state = swimming and "Swim" or inWater and "Tread water" or "Swim"
            swimPitch = (-math.pi / 2 + pitch * 0.5) * swimBlend
            if not inWater then swimPitch = -math.pi / 2 * swimBlend; state = "Crawl" end
            if swimBlend > 0 then renderHeadPitch = rotLerpRad(swimBlend, pitch, -0.7853982) end
            -- A prone body belongs at the center of the short swim hull.
            swimLift = (root.Size.Y / 2 - 2.925) * swimBlend
            if swimBlend > 0 then
                if stroke < 14 then
                    local q = (-65 * stroke + stroke * stroke) / (-65 * 14 + 14 * 14)
                    leftA = rotLerpRad(leftSwimBlend, leftA, 0)
                    rightA = lerp(rightA, 0, rightSwimBlend)
                    armYawL = rotLerpRad(leftSwimBlend, armYawL, math.pi)
                    armYawR = lerp(armYawR, math.pi, rightSwimBlend)
                    armRollL = rotLerpRad(leftSwimBlend, armRollL, math.pi + 1.8707964 * q)
                    armRollR = lerp(armRollR, math.pi - 1.8707964 * q, rightSwimBlend)
                elseif stroke < 22 then
                    local t = (stroke - 14) / 8
                    leftA = rotLerpRad(leftSwimBlend, leftA, 1.5707964 * t)
                    rightA = lerp(rightA, 1.5707964 * t, rightSwimBlend)
                    armYawL = rotLerpRad(leftSwimBlend, armYawL, math.pi)
                    armYawR = lerp(armYawR, math.pi, rightSwimBlend)
                    armRollL = rotLerpRad(leftSwimBlend, armRollL, 5.012389 - 1.8707964 * t)
                    armRollR = lerp(armRollR, 1.2707963 + 1.8707964 * t, rightSwimBlend)
                else
                    local t = (stroke - 22) / 4
                    local target = 1.5707964 * (1 - t)
                    leftA = rotLerpRad(leftSwimBlend, leftA, target)
                    rightA = lerp(rightA, target, rightSwimBlend)
                    armYawL = rotLerpRad(leftSwimBlend, armYawL, math.pi)
                    armYawR = lerp(armYawR, math.pi, rightSwimBlend)
                    armRollL = rotLerpRad(leftSwimBlend, armRollL, math.pi)
                    armRollR = lerp(armRollR, math.pi, rightSwimBlend)
                end
                leftL = lerp(leftL, 0.3 * math.cos(animationPos * 0.33333334 + math.pi), swimBlend)
                rightL = lerp(rightL, 0.3 * math.cos(animationPos * 0.33333334), swimBlend)
            end
        end
        if not alive then
            deathTime = deathTime + dt
            local progress = clamp(deathTime / 0.8, 0, 1)
            -- Java tips the whole entity 90 degrees about its feet; lift it by
            -- the half-width of torso + arm so the side rests on the floor.
            state, deathRoll, deathLift = "Dead", math.sqrt(progress) * math.pi / 2, progress * 8 * modelPixel
            leftA, rightA, leftL, rightL = 0, 0, 0, 0
            bodyPitch, bodyTurn, swimPitch, swimLift = 0, 0, 0, 0
            renderHeadPitch = 0
            rightArmX, rightArmZ, leftArmX, leftArmZ = -5, 0, 5, 0
        end
        -- The root turns to the view yaw (that replicates); the model frame is relative to it.
        if alive then creativeWorld.rootYaw = yaw end
        if creativeWorld.rootYaw then
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, creativeWorld.rootYaw, 0)
            upright.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, creativeWorld.rootYaw, 0)
        end
        -- Model frame in root space: origin at Java's model y=0 (the neck),
        -- 24 pixels above the feet, facing the rendered body yaw.
        local px = modelPixel
        local height = deathHeight or root.Size.Y
        local modelFrame = CFrame.new(0, -height / 2 + deathLift, 0)
            * CFrame.Angles(0, bodyRenderYaw + CONFIG.ModelYawOffset - (creativeWorld.rootYaw or 0), 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, deathRoll)
            * CFrame.new(0, 18 * px + swimLift, 0) * CFrame.Angles(swimPitch, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 6 * px, 0)
        if creativeWorld.gameplay.gliding then
            -- PlayerRenderer.setupRotations() while fall flying: lean (-90 - pitch) scaled by
            -- clamp(t^2/100), then roll toward the direction of travel.
            local t=(creativeWorld.gameplay.glideTicks or 0)+partial
            local lean=clamp(t*t/100,0,1)
            modelFrame=modelFrame*CFrame.Angles(lean*(-math.pi/2+viewPitch),0,0)
            local look=lookVector()
            local dh,lh=motion.X*motion.X+motion.Z*motion.Z,look.X*look.X+look.Z*look.Z
            if dh>1e-6 and lh>1e-6 then
                local cosine=clamp((motion.X*look.X+motion.Z*look.Z)/math.sqrt(dh*lh),-1,1)
                local side=motion.X*look.Z-motion.Z*look.X
                modelFrame=modelFrame*CFrame.Angles(0,(side>0 and 1 or side<0 and -1 or 0)*math.acos(cosine),0)
            end
        end
        if creativeWorld.gameplay.riding then
            -- HumanoidModel riding pose.
            rightA,leftA=rightA-0.62831855,leftA-0.62831855
            rightL,leftL=-1.4137167,-1.4137167
            legRollR,legRollL=0.07853982,-0.07853982
        end
        if JavaContent.mods.castPose then
            local okPose, poseX, poseY, poseZ, poseW = pcall(JavaContent.mods.castPose)
            if okPose and poseW and poseW > 0 then
                rightA, armYawR, armRollR = lerp(rightA, poseX, poseW), lerp(armYawR, poseY, poseW), lerp(armRollR, poseZ, poseW)
            end
        end
        local torsoModel = javaPart(px, 0, bodyY, 0, bodyPitch, bodyTurn, 0, 0, 6)
        local toTorso = torsoModel:Inverse()
        do
        rootJoint.C0 = modelFrame * torsoModel
        -- Wrapped local yaw + bounded pitch: no Euler subtraction and no 360-degree neck spin.
        -- The head is independent of the body's lean/turn, exactly like Java.
        local neckRelative = clamp(wrapAngle(yaw - bodyRenderYaw - CONFIG.ModelYawOffset), -CONFIG.HeadYaw, CONFIG.HeadYaw)
        local neckPitch = clamp(renderHeadPitch - swimPitch, -CONFIG.HeadPitch, CONFIG.HeadPitch)
        if not alive then neckRelative, neckPitch = 0, 0 end
        neck.C0 = toTorso * CFrame.new(0, -headY * px, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, neckRelative, 0)
            * CFrame.Angles(neckPitch, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 4 * px, 0)
        rs.C0 = toTorso * javaPart(px, rightArmX, armY, rightArmZ, rightA, armYawR, armRollR, creativeWorld.skinSlim and -0.5 or -1, 4)
        ls.C0 = toTorso * javaPart(px, leftArmX, armY, leftArmZ, leftA, armYawL, armRollL, creativeWorld.skinSlim and 0.5 or 1, 4)
        rh.C0 = toTorso * javaPart(px, -1.9, legY, legZ, rightL, creativeWorld.gameplay.riding and 0.31415927 or 0, legRollR, 0, 6)
        lh.C0 = toTorso * javaPart(px, 1.9, legY, legZ, leftL, creativeWorld.gameplay.riding and -0.31415927 or 0, legRollL, 0, 6)
        end
        if creativeWorld.replication then
            creativeWorld.replication.update({alive = alive, grounded = grounded, inWater = inWater, climbing = climbing, sneaking = crouching,
                sprinting = sprinting, riding = creativeWorld.gameplay.riding ~= nil, native = false,
                holding = inventoryState.slots[selectedSlot] ~= nil, swimming = swimming, gliding = creativeWorld.gameplay.gliding,
                sleeping = creativeWorld.blocks and creativeWorld.blocks.sleeping, lookY = lookVector().Y,
                holdingOff = inventoryState.slots[41] ~= nil, useOff = creativeWorld.offhandUsing == true,
                useKind = (creativeWorld.gameplay.blocking and "block") or (creativeWorld.gameplay.scoping and "spyglass")
                    or ((creativeWorld.gameplay.charge or 0) > 0 and "bow")
                    or (creativeWorld.items and creativeWorld.items.using and creativeWorld.items.using.kind) or nil,
                using = (creativeWorld.items and creativeWorld.items.using ~= nil) or creativeWorld.gameplay.blocking or creativeWorld.gameplay.scoping or (creativeWorld.gameplay.charge or 0) > 0,
                speed = Vector3.new(motion.X, 0, motion.Z).Magnitude * CONFIG.Block * 20, vertical = motion.Y * CONFIG.Block * 20})
        end
        if corpse then
            local torsoFrame = deathFrame * rootJoint.C0 * rootJoint.C1:Inverse()
            corpseParts[torso].CFrame = torsoFrame
            for _, pair in ipairs({{head, neck}, {leftArm, ls}, {rightArm, rs}, {leftLeg, lh}, {rightLeg, rh}}) do
                corpseParts[pair[1]].CFrame = torsoFrame * pair[2].C0 * pair[2].C1:Inverse()
            end
        end
        local tint = hurtTime > 0 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 150) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        for _, part in ipairs({head, torso, leftArm, rightArm, leftLeg, rightLeg, viewArm}) do
            part.Color = tint
            for _, decal in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                if decal:IsA("Decal") then decal.Color3 = tint end
            end
        end
        -- Java eye height eases between standing, sneaking and swimming.
        local eyeTarget = (swimming and CONFIG.SwimEyeHeight or crouching and CONFIG.CrouchEyeHeight
            or CONFIG.EyeHeight) * CONFIG.Block
        eyeHeight = eyeHeight + (eyeTarget - eyeHeight) * (1 - math.exp(-16 * dt))
        local firstPerson = cameraView == 1 and alive
        -- In first person (and after death, when the corpse stands in) the
        -- real body and its third-person held block are fully transparent,
        -- decals included; LocalTransparencyModifier does not hide decals.
        local bodyHidden = firstPerson or corpse ~= nil or PlayerStats.spectator
        for _, part in ipairs(body) do
            setVisible(part, not bodyHidden)
            part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
        end
        setVisible(hand, false)
        hand.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
        local holding = JavaContent.byIndex[shownSlot] ~= nil or blockTextures[shownSlot] ~= nil or toolStats[shownSlot] ~= nil
        setVisible(viewArm, firstPerson and not holding and not PlayerStats.spectator)
        setVisible(viewBlock, false)
        for index,models in pairs(toolModels) do
            displayTool(models.first,CFrame.identity,false)
            -- ItemInHandLayer: align with the posed right hand, then apply
            -- handheld.json's thirdperson_righthand transform.
            local grip = root.CFrame * modelFrame
                * javaPart(px,rightArmX,armY,rightArmZ,rightA,armYawR,armRollR,0,0)
                * CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi)
                * CFrame.Angles(-math.pi/2,0,0) * CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi,0)
                * CFrame.new(CONFIG.Block/16,0.125*CONFIG.Block,-0.625*CONFIG.Block)
                * itemDisplay("third",CONFIG.Block)
            displayTool(models.third,grip,not JavaContent.byIndex[index] and not bodyHidden and selected == index and alive)
        end
        viewDirty = false
        -- Crosshair target outline (LevelRenderer.renderHitOutline).
        local target = alive and not blockedInput() and aimHit()
        showOutline(target and (mineable(target.Instance) or target.Instance:GetAttribute("RealisticBody") ~= nil) and targetBoxes(target) or nil)
        local catalogHandFrame, offhandFirstFrame
        camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera then
            if camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable end
            camera.FieldOfView = creativeWorld.gameplay.scoping and math.max(1,CONFIG.FOV*.1) or camera.FieldOfView + ((sprinting and CONFIG.SprintFOV or CONFIG.FOV) * creativeWorld.bowZoom() - camera.FieldOfView) * (1 - math.exp(-8 * dt))
            local eye = (corpse and corpseParts[head].Position) or eyePosition()
            local rotation = viewRotation()
            -- Camera.setup while sleeping: eye 0.2 above the body at bed height (0.6875), looking from the pillow
            -- toward the foot of the bed (facing - 180), level, moved back 0.3.
            local sleep = alive and creativeWorld.blocks and creativeWorld.blocks.sleeping
            if sleep and sleep.bed then
                local f = ({north = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), south = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1), east = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0), west = Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0)})[sleep.bed.state.facing or "north"] or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
                local toFoot = -f
                rotation = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, toFoot)
                eye = sleep.bed.center + Vector3.new(0, -CONFIG.Block / 2 + (0.6875 + 0.2) * CONFIG.Block, 0) - toFoot * 0.3 * CONFIG.Block
            end
            local look = rotation.LookVector
            local distance = CONFIG.ThirdPersonDistance * CONFIG.Block
            local base
            if firstPerson then
                base = CFrame.new(eye) * rotation
            elseif cameraView == 3 and alive then
                -- Third-person front: the camera sits ahead and looks back at Steve.
                base = CFrame.lookAt(cameraCollide(eye, eye + look * distance), eye)
            else
                -- Third-person back (also used on death): same view direction, pulled back.
                base = CFrame.new(cameraCollide(eye, eye - look * distance)) * rotation
            end
            -- GameRenderer.bobHurt() + bobView(), applied in view space (blocks).
            -- The world and the hand get the same on-screen bob, so the camera
            -- takes its inverse and the hand re-applies it at hand scale.
            local walk = -lerp(walkDistOld, walkDist, partial)
            local bob = alive and lerp(viewBobOld, viewBob, partial) or 0
            local hurtAmount = math.sin(clamp(hurtTime / 0.45, 0, 1) ^ 4 * math.pi)
            local function bobFrame(scale)
                return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-hurtAmount * 14))
                    * CFrame.new(math.sin(walk * math.pi) * bob * 0.5 * scale, -math.abs(math.cos(walk * math.pi) * bob) * scale, 0)
                    * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(math.sin(walk * math.pi) * bob * 3))
                    * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.abs(math.cos(walk * math.pi - 0.2) * bob) * 5), 0, 0)
            end
            camera.CFrame = base * bobFrame(CONFIG.Block):Inverse()
            if JavaContent.mods.cameraOverride then
                local okFilm, filmFrame, filmFov = pcall(JavaContent.mods.cameraOverride, dt)
                if okFilm and filmFrame then camera.CFrame = filmFrame end
                if okFilm and filmFov then camera.FieldOfView = filmFov end
                if not okFilm and not JavaContent.mods.cameraWarned then JavaContent.mods.cameraWarned = true; warn("[Steve] mod camera: " .. tostring(filmFrame)) end
            end
            camera.Focus = CFrame.new(eye)
            -- renderHandsWithItems(): xBob/yBob trail the view by 0.5 per tick
            -- and the hand rotates by a tenth of the lag (in Java degrees,
            -- converted to Roblox axes: Java pitch and yaw are both negated).
            local trail = 1 - 0.5 ^ (dt * 20)
            swayPitch = swayPitch + (viewPitch - swayPitch) * trail
            swayYaw = swayYaw + wrapAngle(viewYaw - swayYaw) * trail
            if firstPerson then
                local q = viewScale
                local handFrame = camera.CFrame * bobFrame(q)
                    * CFrame.Angles(-(viewPitch - swayPitch) * 0.1, 0, 0)
                    * CFrame.Angles(0, -wrapAngle(viewYaw - swayYaw) * 0.1, 0)
                local p = (swing < 1 and not creativeWorld.swingOff) and swing or 0
                local g = math.sqrt(p)
                local equip = 1 - lerp(mainHandHeightOld, mainHandHeight, partial)
                local rad = math.rad
                -- applyItemArmTransform() for the off arm (side -1); the offhand does not swing here.
                -- The offhand swings (side -1) when it was the hand used.
                local po = (swing < 1 and creativeWorld.swingOff) and swing or 0
                local go = math.sqrt(po)
                offhandFirstFrame = handFrame
                    * CFrame.new(0.4 * math.sin(go * math.pi) * q, 0.2 * math.sin(go * math.pi * 2) * q, -0.2 * math.sin(po * math.pi) * q)
                    * CFrame.new(-0.56 * q, -0.52 * q, -0.72 * q)
                    * CFrame.Angles(0, -rad(45 - math.sin(po * po * math.pi) * 20), 0)
                    * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -rad(math.sin(go * math.pi) * -20))
                    * CFrame.Angles(rad(math.sin(go * math.pi) * -80), 0, 0)
                    * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(45), 0)
                do local drawOff = creativeWorld.useArmFrame(true, 0, q, partial); if drawOff then offhandFirstFrame = handFrame * drawOff end end
                if holding then
                    -- Swing translate, applyItemArmTransform(), applyItemArmAttackTransform(),
                    -- then the block model's firstperson_righthand Y45 display rotation.
                    local itemFrame = handFrame
                        * CFrame.new(-0.4 * math.sin(g * math.pi) * q, 0.2 * math.sin(g * math.pi * 2) * q, -0.2 * math.sin(p * math.pi) * q)
                        * CFrame.new(0.56 * q, (-0.52 - equip * 0.6) * q, -0.72 * q)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(45 - math.sin(p * p * math.pi) * 20), 0)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad(math.sin(g * math.pi) * -20))
                        * CFrame.Angles(rad(math.sin(g * math.pi) * -80), 0, 0)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(-45), 0)
                    do
                        local drawMain, chargedHold = creativeWorld.useArmFrame(false, equip, q, partial)
                        if drawMain then itemFrame = handFrame * drawMain elseif chargedHold and p < 0.001 then itemFrame = itemFrame * chargedHold end
                    end
                    if toolModels[shownSlot] and not JavaContent.byIndex[shownSlot] then
                        displayTool(toolModels[shownSlot].first,itemFrame * itemDisplay("first",q),true)
                    else
                        catalogHandFrame = itemFrame
                    end
                else
                    -- ItemInHandRenderer.renderPlayerArm() for the right arm, then
                    -- ModelPart(-5, 2, 0) with its box centre at (-1, 4, 0) pixels.
                    -- The hand pass has no scale(-1, -1, 1), so the Roblox part is
                    -- turned 180 degrees about Z into Java's model axes.
                    viewArm.CFrame = handFrame
                        * CFrame.new((-0.3 * math.sin(g * math.pi) + 0.64000005) * q,
                            (0.4 * math.sin(g * math.pi * 2) - 0.6 - equip * 0.6) * q,
                            (-0.4 * math.sin(p * math.pi) - 0.71999997) * q)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(45), 0)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(math.sin(g * math.pi) * 70), 0)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad(math.sin(p * p * math.pi) * -20))
                        * CFrame.new(-1 * q, 3.6 * q, 3.5 * q)
                        * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad(120)) * CFrame.Angles(rad(200), 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(-135), 0)
                        * CFrame.new(5.6 * q, 0, 0)
                        * CFrame.new(-6 / 16 * q, 6 / 16 * q, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi)
                end
            end
        end
        -- Held items also follow the body while the inventory preview shows it in first person.
        local previewBody=firstPerson and inventoryOpen
        local thirdItemFrame=alive and (not bodyHidden or previewBody) and (root.CFrame*modelFrame
            *javaPart(px,rightArmX,armY,rightArmZ,rightA,armYawR,armRollR,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi)
            *CFrame.Angles(-math.pi/2,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi,0)*CFrame.new(CONFIG.Block/16,.125*CONFIG.Block,-.625*CONFIG.Block)) or nil
        -- ItemInHandLayer for the left arm: x = -1/16 instead of +1/16.
        local offhandThirdFrame=alive and (not bodyHidden or previewBody) and (root.CFrame*modelFrame
            *javaPart(px,leftArmX,armY,leftArmZ,leftA,armYawL,armRollL,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.pi)
            *CFrame.Angles(-math.pi/2,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi,0)*CFrame.new(-CONFIG.Block/16,.125*CONFIG.Block,-.625*CONFIG.Block)) or nil
        creativeWorld.mainStack, creativeWorld.offStack = inventoryState.slots[selectedSlot], inventoryState.slots[41]
        if keybinds.hudHidden or JavaContent.mods.cinematic or (creativeWorld.blocks and creativeWorld.blocks.sleeping) then
            -- F1 (hideGui) also hides the first-person hand and held items.
            catalogHandFrame, offhandFirstFrame = nil, nil
            setVisible(viewArm, false)
            for _, models in pairs(toolModels) do displayTool(models.first, CFrame.identity, false) end
        end
        local offhandStack = inventoryState.slots[41]
        if PlayerStats.spectator then
            creativeWorld.render(firstPerson,-1,-1,catalogHandFrame,thirdItemFrame,nil,offhandFirstFrame,offhandThirdFrame)
        else
            creativeWorld.render(firstPerson,selected,shownSlot,catalogHandFrame,thirdItemFrame,offhandStack and offhandStack.id,offhandFirstFrame,offhandThirdFrame)
        end
        pcall(creativeWorld.nativeHands.update,firstPerson,alive and not PlayerStats.spectator and nativeTools[selected] or nil,
            alive and not PlayerStats.spectator and offhandStack and nativeTools[offhandStack.id] or nil,catalogHandFrame,offhandFirstFrame)
        -- Spectators take no damage.
        local shield = character:FindFirstChild("SteveSpectatorShield")
        if PlayerStats.spectator and not shield then
            shield = Instance.new("ForceField"); shield.Name, shield.Visible = "SteveSpectatorShield", false; shield.Parent = character
        elseif not PlayerStats.spectator and shield then
            shield:Destroy()
        end
        gui.Enabled = not keybinds.hudHidden or inventoryOpen
        keybinds.update(dt)
        crosshair.Visible = alive and not menuOpen and not inventoryOpen and cameraView ~= 3
        local povName = cameraView == 1 and "First person" or cameraView == 2 and "Third person" or "Third-person front"
        label.Text = (blockNames[selected] or "Empty hand") .. "  |  " .. state .. "  |  F5: " .. povName
            .. (worldMining.busy and " | Cutting..." or miningTarget and (" | Mining "..math.floor(miningProgress*100).."%") or (" | "..tostring(worldMining.message or ""))) -- FIXES 8
        character:SetAttribute("SteveMovementState", state) -- local Studio debug aid
        label.Visible = keybinds.debugOpen -- Java has no status line; it stays as an F3 extra
    end)
    cleanupCharacter = function()
        if disposed then return end
        disposed = true
        humanoid:UnequipTools()
        starterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack,oldBackpack)
        resetInput()
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(renderName)
        Actions:UnbindAction("SteveMovement"); Actions:UnbindAction("SteveSlots")
        Actions:UnbindAction("SteveCamera"); Actions:UnbindAction("SteveInventory"); Actions:UnbindAction("SteveDrop")
        keybinds.destroy(); creativeWorld.herobrine.destroy(); creativeWorld.chat.destroy(); creativeWorld.statusEffects.destroy()
        creativeWorld.destroy(); gui:Destroy(); viewModel:Destroy(); cellOutline:Destroy(); bodyCollision.destroy()
        gravity:Destroy(); upright:Destroy(); anchor:Destroy(); heldJoint:Destroy(); hand:Destroy(); hurt:Destroy()
        restoreJointPoses(savedJointPoses)
        if r15Body then r15Body.restore() end
        if corpse then corpse:Destroy() end
        if character.Parent and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            for part, properties in pairs(savedParts) do
                for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                    if (child:IsA("Decal") and child.Name:sub(1, 9) == "SteveSkin") or child.Name=="StevePixelSurface" then child:Destroy() end
                end
                for property, value in pairs(properties) do part[property] = value end
            end
            for _, entry in ipairs(savedObjects) do
                if entry[2] and entry[2].Parent then pcall(function() entry[1].Parent = entry[2] end) end
            end
            for part, properties in pairs(savedAccessories) do
                if part.Parent then part.Transparency, part.LocalTransparencyModifier = properties[1], properties[2] end
            end
            local feet = root.Position.Y - root.Size.Y / 2
            local restoreY = feet + originalRootSize.Y / 2 + originalLegHeight + originalHip
            if creativeWorld and creativeWorld.replication then creativeWorld.replication.destroy(); creativeWorld.replication = nil end
            root.Size, root.CanCollide, root.Transparency = originalRootSize, originalRootCollide, originalRootTransparency
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, restoreY, root.Position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, bodyYaw, 0)
        else
            for _, entry in ipairs(savedObjects) do entry[1]:Destroy() end
        end
        if humanoid.Parent then
            humanoid.AutoRotate, humanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = oldAutoRotate, oldEvaluation
            humanoid.WalkSpeed, humanoid.JumpPower = originalSpeed, originalJump
            humanoid.CameraOffset = originalCameraOffset
            if humanoid.Health > 0 then humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end
        end
        if root.Parent then root.CustomPhysicalProperties = oldPhysics end
        if originalAnimate and originalAnimate.Parent then originalAnimate.Disabled = animateWasDisabled end
        if workspace.CurrentCamera then
            workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = savedFOV
            workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType = originalCameraType or Enum.CameraType.Custom
            pcall(function() workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = originalCameraSubject end)
        end
        Input.MouseBehavior, Input.MouseIconEnabled = originalMouseBehavior, originalMouseIcon
        pcall(function() player.DevEnableMouseLock = originalMouseLock end)
        character:SetAttribute("SteveMovementState", oldDebugState)
    end
end
local holdToken=0
sessionConnections[#sessionConnections+1]=Input.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed)
    if processed or input.KeyCode~=Enum.KeyCode.P or Input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
    holdToken=holdToken+1;local token=holdToken
    task.delay(.65,function()
        if stopped or token~=holdToken or not Input:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.P) or Input:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        steveEnabled=not steveEnabled;generation=generation+1
        if not steveEnabled then if cleanupCharacter then cleanupCharacter();cleanupCharacter=nil end
        elseif player.Character then task.spawn(setup,player.Character) end
    end)
end)
sessionConnections[#sessionConnections+1]=Input.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.P then holdToken=holdToken+1 end end)
sessionConnections[#sessionConnections+1]=Input.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()holdToken=holdToken+1 end)
sessionConnections[#sessionConnections + 1] = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setup)
sessionConnections[#sessionConnections + 1] = player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
    generation = generation + 1
    if cleanupCharacter then cleanupCharacter(); cleanupCharacter = nil end
end)
sessionConnections[#sessionConnections + 1] = stopEvent.Event:Connect(function()
    if stopped then return end
    stopped = true
    pcall(JavaContent.mods.disableAll)
    generation = generation + 1
    for _, connection in ipairs(sessionConnections) do connection:Disconnect() end
    if cleanupCharacter then cleanupCharacter(); cleanupCharacter = nil end
    runtime:Destroy()
end)
if player.Character then task.spawn(setup, player.Character) end
do local launch = rawget((getgenv and getgenv()) or _G, "SteveLaunch"); if type(launch) == "table" then launch.done = true end end
print("Steve client controller loaded. Mouse = look, F5 = POV, Shift = sneak, Ctrl/W double-tap = sprint.")
